concept.title: Finite set
concept.description: A set X is finite if it is bijective with {1,…,n} for some natural number n≥0; its cardinality is n.

concept.title: Integer
concept.description: An integer is an element of the ordered ring ℤ, obtained by adjoining additive inverses to the natural numbers.

concept.title: Real number
concept.description: A real number is an element of a complete ordered field ℝ; completeness means every nonempty subset bounded above has a least upper bound.

concept.title: Real sequence
concept.description: A real sequence is a function a:ℕ₊→ℝ, written (aₙ)ₙ≥1.

concept.title: Limit of a real sequence
concept.description: A sequence (aₙ) converges to L∈ℝ if for every ε>0 there is N such that n≥N implies abs(aₙ−L)<ε.

concept.title: Convergent real series
concept.description: The series ∑ₙ≥1aₙ converges to S if its sequence of partial sums converges to S.

concept.title: Sum of a nonnegative series
concept.description: For aₙ≥0, define ∑ₙ≥1aₙ as the supremum of its finite partial sums; the value may be infinite.

concept.title: Factorial
Factorial domination of fixed exponentials
concept.description: For every fixed real C>0, the sequence Cⁿ/n! tends to zero.

concept.title: Real polynomial
concept.description: A real polynomial is a finite sum ∑ⱼ₌₀ᵐaⱼxʲ with real coefficients and nonnegative integer m.

concept.title: Integer polynomial
concept.description: An integer polynomial is a real polynomial all of whose coefficients lie in ℤ.

concept.title: Derivative of a real function
concept.description: The derivative f′(x) is the finite limit of (f(x+h)−f(x))/h as h→0, when it exists. Higher derivatives are defined by iteration.

concept.title: Riemann integral
concept.description: A bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ has Riemann integral I if all tagged Riemann sums approach I as the maximum length of the partition intervals tends to zero.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for continuous integrands
concept.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], then F(x)=∫ₐˣf(t)dt has derivative f on (a,b); any antiderivative G of f satisfies ∫ₐᵇf=G(b)−G(a).

concept.title: Integration by parts for C¹ real functions
concept.description: For u,v∈C¹([a,b]), ∫ₐᵇuv′=u(b)v(b)−u(a)v(a)−∫ₐᵇu′v.

concept.title: Rational number
concept.description: A real x is rational if x=a/b for integers a,b with b≠0; otherwise it is irrational.

concept.title: Real sine function
concept.description: The sine function is defined by the everywhere convergent power series sin(x)=∑ₖ≥0(−1)ᵏx²ᵏ⁺¹/(2k+1)!.

concept.title: π
concept.description: π is the least positive zero of the real sine function and equals the circumference-to-diameter ratio of a Euclidean circle.

concept.title: Irrationality of π
concept.description: There are no integers a,b with b≠0 such that π=a/b.

concept.title: Cesàro convergence theorem
concept.description: If aₙ→L, then (a₁+···+aₙ)/n→L.

concept.title: Prime number
concept.description: An integer p>1 is prime if its only positive divisors are 1 and p.

concept.title: Congruence modulo an integer
concept.description: The relation a≡b (mod m) means that m divides a−b.

concept.title: Involution of a finite set
concept.description: An involution of a finite set X is a map f:X→X with f(f(x))=x for all x∈X.

concept.title: Fixed point of a self-map
concept.description: A fixed point of f:X→X is an x∈X satisfying f(x)=x. The fixed-point set is Fix(f)={x∈X:f(x)=x}.

concept.title: Fixed-point parity lemma for finite involutions
concept.description: If f is an involution of a finite set X, then X and Fix(f) have the same cardinality modulo two.

concept.title: Zagier's involution
concept.description: For a prime p≡1 (mod 4), let Sₚ={(x,y,z)∈ℤ₊³:x²+4yz=p}. Send (x,y,z) to (x+2z,z,y−x−z) if x<y−z, to (2y−x,y,x−y+z) if y−z<x<2y, and to (x−2y,x−y+z,y) if x>2y. These cases exhaust Sₚ and define an involution with the unique fixed point (1,1,(p−1)/4).

concept.title: Fermat's two-square theorem
concept.description: A prime p is a²+b² for integers a,b if and only if p=2 or p≡1 (mod 4).

concept.title: Euclidean space ℝᵈ
concept.description: For d≥1, ℝᵈ consists of d-tuples of real numbers with distance dist(x,y)=(∑ᵢ(xᵢ−yᵢ)²)¹ᐟ².

concept.title: Convex subset of ℝᵈ
concept.description: C⊆ℝᵈ is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and 0≤t≤1.

concept.title: Convex hull
concept.description: The smallest convex set containing a given set of points.

concept.title: Convex position
concept.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in convex position if no point of P is in the convex hull of the other points.

concept.title: General position for planar point sets
concept.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in general position here if no three distinct points of P lie on one line.

concept.title: Coloring of r-element subsets
concept.description: An r-subset coloring is a map from the r-element subsets of X to C.

concept.title: Homogeneous set for a subset coloring
concept.description: H⊆X is homogeneous for c if c is constant on the r-element subsets of H.

concept.title: Finite Ramsey theorem for uniform subset colorings
concept.description: For integers r≥1 and s,t≥r, there is N such that every red–blue coloring of r-subsets of an N-element set has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set.

concept.title: Two-color uniform Ramsey number Rᵣ(s,t)
concept.description: Rᵣ(s,t) is the least N such that every red–blue r-subset coloring on N elements has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set; set it to ∞ if there is no such N.

concept.title: Finite simple undirected graph
concept.description: A finite simple graph is (V,E), where V is finite and E is a set of two-element subsets of V.

concept.title: Clique
concept.description: A set of vertices of a graph, every two of which are adjacent.

concept.title: Independent set in a graph
concept.description: A set of vertices in a graph containing no edge.

concept.title: Monotone subsequence
concept.description: A strictly increasing subsequence has indices i₁<···<iₖ and values aᵢ₁<···<aᵢₖ; a decreasing subsequence reverses the value comparisons and retains increasing indices.

concept.title: Erdős–Szekeres monotone subsequence theorem
concept.description: For integers r,s≥2, every sequence of (r−1)(s−1)+1 distinct real numbers has an increasing subsequence of length r or a decreasing subsequence of length s, both strict. The threshold is sharp.

concept.title: Cups and caps of planar point sets
concept.description: For planar points p₁,…,pₖ with strictly increasing x-coordinates, a k-cup has strictly increasing successive slopes, and a k-cap has strictly decreasing successive slopes.

concept.title: Binomial coefficient
concept.description: For integers 0≤k≤n, binom(n,k) counts the k-element subsets of an n-element set and equals n!/(k!(n−k)!).

concept.title: Erdős–Szekeres cups–caps theorem
concept.description: For r,s≥3, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 planar points with no three collinear and with distinct x-coordinates contain an r-cup or an s-cap. This threshold is sharp for the cups–caps problem.

concept.title: Erdős–Szekeres convex polygon theorem
concept.description: For each n≥3 there is N such that every planar set of at least N points in general position contains n points in convex position. The 1935 proof gives N≤binom(2n−4,n−2)+1.

concept.title: Esther Klein's five-point theorem
concept.description: Every set of five planar points in general position contains four points in convex position.

concept.title: Monotone-gap selection theorem for points on a line
concept.description: For r,s≥2, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 distinct points on a line contain r points with nondecreasing consecutive gaps or s points with nonincreasing consecutive gaps.

concept.title: Rooted finitely branching tree
concept.description: A rooted tree is a connected acyclic graph with a distinguished root. It is finitely branching if every vertex has finitely many children, meaning adjacent vertices one edge farther from the root.

concept.title: König's infinity lemma
concept.description: Every infinite rooted finitely branching tree has an infinite simple path starting at its root.

concept.title: Geometric n-simplex
concept.description: An n-simplex is conv(v₀,…,vₙ), where v₁−v₀,…,vₙ−v₀ are linearly independent. Its faces are the hulls of subsets of its vertices.

concept.title: Triangulation of a geometric simplex
concept.description: A triangulation of S is a finite collection of simplices covering S, closed under faces, such that any two members intersect in a common face or not at all.

concept.title: Barycentric subdivision
concept.description: Vertices are the barycenters b(F) of nonempty faces F; a simplex corresponds to a chain F₀⊊···⊊Fₖ and has vertices b(F₀),…,b(Fₖ).

concept.title: Sperner labeling of a triangulated simplex
concept.description: For S=conv(v₀,…,vₙ), label each triangulation vertex by an element of {0,…,n}; a vertex on conv(vᵢ:i∈I) must have a label in I.

concept.title: Sperner's lemma
concept.description: Every Sperner-labeled triangulation of an n-simplex has an odd number of elementary n-simplices carrying all n+1 labels. In particular there is at least one.

concept.title: Dual Sperner labeling on a barycentrically subdivided simplex
concept.description: On a barycentric subdivision of the standard n-simplex Δⁿ, n≥1, label vertices by {0,…,n}. A boundary vertex x must receive a label i with xᵢ=0; interior labels are unrestricted.

concept.title: Dual Sperner lemma for barycentric subdivisions
concept.description: For m≥1, the m-fold barycentric subdivision of a simplex satisfying the dual zero-coordinate boundary labeling rule contains an elementary n-simplex with all n+1 labels.

concept.title: Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem in ℝᵈ
concept.description: Every bounded sequence in Euclidean space ℝᵈ has a subsequence converging coordinatewise to a point of ℝᵈ.

concept.title: Closed preference correspondence with finite alternatives
concept.description: For metric X and finite alternatives A, P:X→nonempty subsets of A is a closed preference correspondence if {x:a∈P(x)} is closed in X for every a∈A. Ties are allowed.

concept.title: Envy-free allocation of finitely many shares
concept.description: An allocation is envy-free if each participant weakly prefers their own assigned share to every other share, evaluated at that same allocation.

concept.title: Envy-free interval cake division theorem
concept.description: For n participants and consecutive pieces of [0,1] parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and exclude empty pieces whenever a positive-length piece exists. Then some partition admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred piece.

concept.title: Su's rental harmony theorem
concept.description: For n participants and rooms, let pᵢ≥0 and ∑pᵢ=R>0. Suppose preferred-room sets are nonempty and closed, and contain only free rooms whenever some room is free. Then some price vector admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred room.

concept.title: Envy-free division of an interval of chores
concept.description: For n participants and consecutive chore pieces parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and contain only empty pieces whenever an empty piece is available. Then there is a partition and bijection assigning each participant a preferred piece.

concept.title: Brouwer fixed-point theorem
concept.description: Every continuous f:Δⁿ→Δⁿ has a fixed point. The equivalent closed-ball formulation belongs to this same theorem concept.

concept.title: σ-algebra
concept.description: A σ-algebra on Ω contains Ω and is closed under complements in Ω and countable unions.

concept.title: Measure
concept.description: A measure μ maps a σ-algebra to [0,∞], sends ∅ to 0, and satisfies μ(⋃ₙAₙ)=∑ₙμ(Aₙ) for every pairwise disjoint sequence of measurable sets.

concept.title: Lebesgue integral
concept.description: For measurable f≥0, ∫f dμ is the supremum of integrals of nonnegative simple functions below f. For signed f with ∫abs(f)dμ<∞, define ∫f=∫f⁺−∫f⁻.

concept.title: Probability space
concept.description: A probability space is (Ω,𝔽,P), where 𝔽 is a σ-algebra on Ω and P is a measure on 𝔽 with P(Ω)=1.

concept.title: Real-valued random variable
concept.description: A real-valued random variable is a measurable map from a probability space to ℝ with its Borel σ-algebra.

concept.title: Distribution of a real random variable
concept.description: The distribution μₓ of X is defined by μₓ(B)=P(X∈B) for Borel B⊆ℝ.

concept.title: Expectation of an integrable real random variable
concept.description: If E abs(X)=∫abs(X)dP<∞, the expectation of X is EX=∫X dP.

concept.title: Variance of a real random variable
concept.description: If EX²<∞, then Var(X)=E[(X−EX)²].

concept.title: Pairwise independent random variables
concept.description: A family (Xᵢ) is pairwise independent if P(Xᵢ∈A,Xⱼ∈B)=P(Xᵢ∈A)P(Xⱼ∈B) for all i≠j and Borel A,B⊆ℝ.

concept.title: Independent family of random variables
concept.description: For distinct i₁,…,iₖ and Borel A₁,…,Aₖ, independence requires P(⋂ⱼ{Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ})=∏ⱼP(Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ).

concept.title: Identically distributed random variables
concept.description: A family is identically distributed when all its random variables have the same distribution.

concept.title: Almost-sure convergence of real random variables
concept.description: Xₙ→X almost surely means P({ω:limₙXₙ(ω)=X(ω)})=1.

concept.title: Chebyshev's inequality
concept.description: If EX²<∞ and t>0, then P(abs(X−EX)≥t)≤Var(X)/t².

concept.title: First Borel–Cantelli lemma
concept.description: If ∑ₙP(Aₙ)<∞, then P(⋂ₘ⋃ₙ≥ₘAₙ)=0: almost surely only finitely many Aₙ occur.

concept.title: Monotone convergence theorem for Lebesgue integrals
concept.description: If 0≤fₙ≤fₙ₊₁ and fₙ→f pointwise, then ∫fₙdμ increases to ∫f dμ, allowing infinity.

concept.title: Etemadi's strong law of large numbers
concept.description: If (Xₙ) is pairwise independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concept.title: Kolmogorov's strong law for iid real random variables
concept.description: If (Xₙ) is jointly independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concept.title: Kolmogorov's maximal inequality
concept.description: If X₁,…,Xₙ are independent with EXᵢ=0 and EXᵢ²<∞, then for λ>0, P(max₁≤ₖ≤ₙ abs(∑ᵢ≤ₖXᵢ)≥λ)≤(∑ᵢ≤ₙVar(Xᵢ))/λ².

concept.title: Rectangular average of a real random array
concept.description: For positive integer indices, the rectangular average at (n₁,…,nᵣ) is (∏ⱼnⱼ)⁻¹∑₁≤ᵢⱼ≤ₙⱼXᵢ₁,…,ᵢᵣ. Its joint limit means that every nⱼ tends to infinity.

concept.title: L(log L)ᵏ moment condition
concept.description: X∈L(log L)ᵏ means E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ᵏ]<∞, where log⁺t=max(0,log t) for t>0 and log⁺0=0.

concept.title: Divisor function d(n)
concept.description: d(n) is the number of positive divisors of n, equivalently the number of ordered positive integer pairs (a,b) satisfying ab=n.

concept.title: Divisor summatory bound ∑ₙ≤ₓd(n)=O(x log x)
concept.description: There is an absolute constant C such that ∑₁≤ₙ≤ₓd(n)≤Cx log x for x≥2; the sum counts positive integer pairs (a,b) with ab≤x.

concept.title: Abel's summation formula
concept.description: If Aₖ=∑ⱼ₌₁ᵏaⱼ, then ∑ₖ₌₁ᴺaₖbₖ=A_N b_N+∑ₖ₌₁ᴺ⁻¹Aₖ(bₖ−bₖ₊₁).

concept.title: Etemadi's strong law for random arrays
concept.description: For an r-indexed pairwise independent identically distributed real array with E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ʳ⁻¹]<∞, its rectangular averages converge almost surely to EX as every side length tends to infinity.

concept.title: k-linear category
concept.description: A category whose morphism spaces are vector spaces over a field k and whose composition is k-bilinear. This convention does not require finite sums or a zero object.

concept.title: Monoidal category
concept.description: A category C with a tensor bifunctor C×C→C, a unit object, and natural associativity and unit isomorphisms satisfying the pentagon and triangle identities.

concept.title: Rigid monoidal category
concept.description: A monoidal category in which every object has left and right duals, with evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the zigzag identities.

concept.title: Braided monoidal category
concept.description: A monoidal category with natural isomorphisms c(X,Y):X⊗Y→Y⊗X satisfying the two hexagon identities.

concept.title: Pivotal category
concept.description: A rigid monoidal category with a monoidal natural isomorphism from the identity functor to the double-dual functor.

concept.title: Ribbon category
concept.description: A braided rigid monoidal category with a twist compatible with both the braiding and duality.

concept.title: Trace in a pivotal monoidal category
concept.description: Closing an endomorphism using evaluation, coevaluation and the pivotal structure gives its left and right traces, which lie in End(1). They are scalars when End(1) is the ground field; the two traces need not agree.

concept.title: Karoubi envelope of a category
concept.description: The category obtained by formally splitting idempotent endomorphisms. Its objects are pairs (X,e) with e²=e; a map (X,e)→(Y,f) is a map a:X→Y with a=fae.

concept.title: Negligible morphism in a spherical linear category
concept.description: In a spherical k-linear category with End(1)=k, f:X→Y is negligible if tr(gf)=0 for every g:Y→X. Such morphisms form a tensor ideal.

concept.title: Semisimplification by negligible morphisms
concept.description: Quotient a spherical linear category by its negligible morphisms and take the Karoubi envelope. Under the usual finiteness and nondegeneracy hypotheses this gives a semisimple category; the construction does not guarantee semisimplicity for an arbitrary pivotal category.

concept.title: Simple object in an abelian category
concept.description: A nonzero object whose only subobjects are zero and itself.

concept.title: Semisimple abelian category
concept.description: An abelian category in which every object is a finite direct sum of simple objects.

concept.title: Split simple object in a k-linear abelian category
concept.description: A simple object X in a k-linear abelian category is split if its scalar map k→End(X) is an isomorphism.

concept.title: Split semisimple k-linear category
concept.description: A semisimple k-linear abelian category in which every simple object is split.

concept.title: Primitive idempotent in an algebra
concept.description: A nonzero idempotent that is not a sum of two nonzero orthogonal idempotents. In a finite-dimensional semisimple algebra A, e is primitive exactly when the left ideal Ae is a simple A-module.

concept.title: Schur's lemma
concept.description: A nonzero morphism between simple objects of an abelian category is an isomorphism. Consequently, the endomorphism ring of a simple object is a division ring.

concept.title: Braid group
concept.description: Bₙ is generated by σ₁,…,σₙ₋₁, with σᵢσⱼ=σⱼσᵢ for abs(i−j)>1 and σᵢσᵢ₊₁σᵢ=σᵢ₊₁σᵢσᵢ₊₁.

concept.title: Group algebra
concept.description: For a group G and field k, k[G] consists of finite k-linear combinations of group elements, with multiplication extending the group law bilinearly.

concept.title: Hopf algebra
concept.description: A unital associative algebra H with coassociative coproduct Δ:H→H⊗H and counit ε:H→k that are algebra homomorphisms, and an antipode S satisfying m(S⊗id)Δ=m(id⊗S)Δ=ηε, where m and η are multiplication and unit.

concept.title: Lie algebra 𝔤₂
concept.description: The 14-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra of exceptional type G₂.

concept.title: Quantum group U_q(𝔤₂)
concept.description: The Drinfeld–Jimbo quantized enveloping algebra of 𝔤₂; in the braid-generation theorem q is indeterminate and the coefficient field is ℂ(q).

concept.title: Seven-dimensional fundamental representation of U_q(𝔤₂)
concept.description: The irreducible fundamental U_q(𝔤₂)-module of dimension seven, deforming the smallest nontrivial representation of 𝔤₂.

concept.title: Intertwiner of algebra representations
concept.description: A linear map T between modules over an algebra A such that T(av)=aT(v) for every a∈A and v in the source module.

concept.title: Tensor power of a Hopf-algebra representation
concept.description: The representation on V⊗n obtained by applying the iterated coproduct before acting on its n factors.

concept.title: Centralizer algebra of a representation
concept.description: For an H-module W, End_H(W) is the algebra of linear endomorphisms commuting with H; multiplication is composition.

concept.title: Universal R-matrix
concept.description: An invertible element R in a suitable completion of H⊗H that conjugates the coproduct to its opposite and satisfies the two coproduct compatibility identities; on modules, flip∘R gives a braiding.

concept.title: Braid-group action on a tensor power
concept.description: For an object V in a braided monoidal category, σᵢ acts on V⊗n as the braiding c(V,V) on factors i,i+1 and the identity on all other factors.

concept.title: Strongly multiplicity-free highest-weight representation
concept.description: A finite-dimensional irreducible highest-weight representation of a complex semisimple Lie algebra or its generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, with one-dimensional weight spaces and weights totally ordered by the root order. The root order compares weights whose difference is a nonnegative integral combination of simple roots.

concept.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider
concept.description: Kuperberg’s G₂ spider T(G₂) is the ℂ(q)-linear monoidal category whose objects are natural numbers and whose morphisms n→m are ℂ(q)-linear combinations of G₂ webs in a rectangle with n bottom and m top boundary points, modulo Kuperberg’s local relations: a loop equals q¹⁰+q⁸+q²+1+q⁻²+q⁻⁸+q⁻¹⁰, a monogon vanishes, and bigons, triangles, squares and pentagons reduce to webs with fewer vertices. Composition is vertical stacking, tensor product is juxtaposition, and Kuperberg’s crossing formula, a combination of four webs, makes it braided. Here q is Morrison’s parameter; Kuperberg’s parameter is q².

concept.title: G₂ web
concept.description: A compact one-dimensional subset of a closed disc or rectangle that near each point looks, up to homeomorphism, like an empty disc, an open arc or three arcs meeting at a trivalent vertex, and near the boundary like an empty half-disc or one arc ending on the boundary; closed loop components are allowed and webs are considered up to isotopy fixing the boundary. These planar trivalent graphs present the morphisms of Kuperberg’s G₂ spider.

concept.title: Non-elliptic G₂ web
concept.description: A G₂ web with no closed loop components and with at least six edges on every internal face.

concept.title: Euler measure of a surface with assigned corner angles
concept.description: For a compact surface F with finitely many assigned boundary corner angles θᵢ, its Euler measure is e(F)=χ(F)−∑ᵢ(π−θᵢ)/(2π). Smooth portions of the boundary contribute no corner correction.

concept.title: Tilting module for a quantum group
concept.description: A finite-dimensional module admitting both a filtration by Weyl modules and a filtration by dual Weyl modules.

concept.title: Kuperberg's G₂ web-basis theorem
concept.description: Over ℂ(q), each morphism space in the G₂ spider has a basis consisting of the non-elliptic webs.

concept.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider equivalence theorem
concept.description: Over ℂ(q), the G₂ spider is equivalent, as a braided tensor category, to the category whose objects are tensor powers of the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module and whose morphisms are intertwiners.

concept.title: Braid generation of the G₂ tensor centralizer
concept.description: For the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module V over ℂ(q), the R-matrix representation induces a surjective algebra map ℂ(q)[Bₙ]→End_{U_q(𝔤₂)}(V⊗n) for every n.

concept.title: Lehrer–Zhang braid-generation theorem
concept.description: For a strongly multiplicity-free irreducible representation V of a generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, the braid-group image generates End_U(V⊗n) as an algebra for every n.

concept.title: Fusion category
concept.description: A k-linear semisimple abelian rigid monoidal category with finitely many isomorphism classes of simple objects, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k. Over a non-algebraically closed field, simple objects need not be split.

concept.title: Split fusion category
concept.description: A fusion category in which every simple object has endomorphism algebra k.

concept.title: Scalar extension of a linear category
concept.description: For k⊂K, replace each morphism space Hom(X,Y) by Hom(X,Y)⊗_k K, keeping the same objects and extending composition.

concept.title: Rational form of a tensor category
concept.description: For fields k⊂K and a semisimple K-linear abelian tensor category C_K, a rational form over k is a semisimple k-linear abelian tensor category C_k with a tensor equivalence Kar(C_k⊗_k K)≃C_K. The additional tensor structure must be preserved.

concept.title: Complete rational form of a tensor category
concept.description: A rational form C_k of C_K for which C_k⊗_k K is already idempotent complete, so C_k⊗_k K≃C_K without adding new summands.

concept.title: Cyclotomic field
concept.description: A number field ℚ(ζₙ) generated by a primitive nth root of unity.

concept.title: Cyclotomic integer
concept.description: An algebraic integer lying in a cyclotomic field.

concept.title: Galois conjugate of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category over ℂ with a complete form over a number field k, apply an embedding k→ℂ to its associativity and other structure coefficients and extend scalars to ℂ. This gives a conjugate tensor category, up to tensor equivalence.

concept.title: Frobenius–Perron dimension in a fusion category
concept.description: For a simple object X of a fusion category over ℂ, FPdim(X) is the spectral radius of its fusion matrix, whose entries are multiplicities in X⊗Y. Extend this additively to other objects.

concept.title: Global dimension of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category over ℂ, the global dimension is the sum of the intrinsic squared norms of its simple objects. For a spherical structure it is the sum of their squared categorical dimensions.

concept.title: Brauer's cyclotomic splitting-field theorem
concept.description: If a finite group G has exponent n, then ℚ(ζₙ) is a splitting field for G: every irreducible complex representation of G has a model over ℚ(ζₙ).

concept.title: Cyclotomicity of Frobenius–Perron dimensions
concept.description: The Frobenius–Perron dimension of every object in a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concept.title: Cyclotomicity of global dimensions of fusion categories
concept.description: The global dimension of a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concept.title: II₁ subfactor
concept.description: An inclusion N⊂M of von Neumann factors of type II₁.

concept.title: Jones index
concept.description: For a II₁ subfactor N⊂M, its index [M:N] is the von Neumann dimension of L²(M) as an N-module, possibly infinite.

concept.title: Principal even part of a subfactor
concept.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of N–N bimodules generated by L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concept.title: Dual even part of a subfactor
concept.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of M–M bimodules generated by L²(M)⊗_N L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concept.title: Principal graph pair of a finite-index subfactor
concept.description: The pair of rooted bipartite graphs recording tensoring with the generating N–M Hilbert bimodule and its dual. Even vertices are simple N–N or M–M bimodules, odd vertices are simple mixed bimodules, and edge multiplicities count their summands. The graphs may be infinite.

concept.title: Finite-depth subfactor
concept.description: A finite-index subfactor whose principal graphs are finite, equivalently whose even parts have only finitely many simple objects.

concept.title: Haagerup subfactor
concept.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with index (5+√13)/2 and the Haagerup principal graph pair.

concept.title: Extended Haagerup subfactor
concept.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with the extended Haagerup principal graph pair, of index approximately 4.3772.

concept.title: Principal Haagerup fusion category
concept.description: The principal even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concept.title: Dual Haagerup fusion category
concept.description: The dual even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concept.title: Principal extended Haagerup fusion category
concept.description: The principal even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concept.title: Dual extended Haagerup fusion category
concept.description: The dual even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concept.title: Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category
concept.description: The common braided center of the principal and dual Haagerup fusion categories, with the ribbon structure coming from their subfactor construction.

concept.title: Haagerup planar algebra
concept.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concept.title: Extended Haagerup planar algebra
concept.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the extended Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concept.title: Shaded planar tangle
concept.description: A disc with interior discs and nonintersecting strings, with an even number of endpoints on each boundary, checkerboard-shaded complementary regions and marked boundary intervals; considered up to the prescribed isotopy.

concept.title: Shaded planar algebra
concept.description: Vector spaces P_{n,+},P_{n,−} acted on multilinearly by shaded planar tangles, compatibly with gluing and identity tangles.

concept.title: Uncappable element of a planar algebra
concept.description: A box killed by every operation that caps two adjacent boundary points.

concept.title: Rotational eigenvector in a planar algebra
concept.description: A nonzero n-box S, n>0, satisfying ρ(S)=ωS for the shading-preserving two-click rotation ρ. Since ρⁿ=id, its eigenvalue ω is an nth root of unity.

concept.title: Lopsided planar algebra
concept.description: A connected shaded planar algebra, with one-dimensional 0-box spaces, normalized so the shaded contractible circle evaluates to 1. The unshaded circle then evaluates to the index, the product of the two circle moduli.

concept.title: Quantum integer
concept.description: For n≥1, [n]_q=qⁿ⁻¹+qⁿ⁻³+⋯+q¹⁻ⁿ, and [0]_q=0. Equivalently [n]_q=(qⁿ−q⁻ⁿ)/(q−q⁻¹) when the quotient is defined; the Laurent polynomial also specializes at q=±1.

concept.title: Jones–Wenzl idempotent
concept.description: The idempotent fₙ in TLₙ(δ) with identity-diagram coefficient 1 and eᵢfₙ=fₙeᵢ=0 for every adjacent cap–cup generator. It exists for all n at generic δ; special parameters require care.

concept.title: Normalized third twisted moment
concept.description: For R∈End(Y⊗m), take its threefold twisted closure using pairings and a trivalent vertex, and divide by the theta evaluation times the circle evaluation to the power m−1, as in Morrison–Snyder Definition 4.2.

concept.title: Invariance of the normalized third twisted moment
concept.description: When the pairing and trivalent morphism spaces in Definition 4.2 are one-dimensional with nonzero closure pairings, M₃(R) is independent of the chosen nonzero generators. If Y and R are defined in a split k-linear fusion category, this scalar lies in k.

concept.title: Non-cyclotomicity of the principal Haagerup fusion categories
concept.description: The principal even parts of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup subfactors have no complete rational form over any cyclotomic field.

concept.title: Fields of definition of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concept.description: For ℓ=0,1 write Hℓᵖ,Hℓᵈ for the principal and dual even parts and Dℓ for the index. Put n=4ℓ+4, choose q with q+q⁻¹=√Dℓ, and let λℓ²=−[n+2]_q/([2]_q²[n]_q). Both even parts have rational forms over ℚ(Dℓ); for ℚ⊂k⊂ℂ, Hℓᵈ has a complete rational form over k iff Dℓ∈k, and Hℓᵖ iff λℓ∈k. The center Z(H₀ᵖ) has a complete rational form as a ribbon category over k iff ζ₃₉∈k.

concept.title: Galois conjugates of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concept.description: Up to tensor equivalence, the principal Haagerup even part has two Galois conjugates and the principal extended Haagerup even part has three. All the nonoriginal conjugates are nonunitary. The normal closures of their complete fields of definition have Galois groups D₈ (order eight) and C₂×A₄, respectively.

concept.title: Half-braiding
concept.description: For an object X of a monoidal category C, a natural family of isomorphisms c_Y:X⊗Y→Y⊗X, compatible with tensor products and the unit: c_{Y⊗Z}=(id_Y⊗c_Z)∘(c_Y⊗id_Z), with associators inserted.

concept.title: Drinfeld center of a monoidal category
concept.description: For a monoidal category C, its center Z(C) has objects (X,c), where c is a half-braiding on X, and morphisms f:X→X′ compatible with the half-braidings. Tensoring these pairs makes Z(C) braided; C itself need not be braided.

concept.title: Induction to the Drinfeld center of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, the induction functor I:C→Z(C) is the left adjoint to the functor forgetting the half-braiding. Its underlying object is ⊕_V V⊗X⊗V*, summed over simple representatives V.

concept.title: Module category over a tensor category
concept.description: A category M with an action C×M→M and coherent associativity and unit isomorphisms.

concept.title: Dual fusion category
concept.description: For an indecomposable semisimple module category M over a fusion category C, the category Fun_C(M,M) of module endofunctors, with composition as tensor product.

concept.title: Internal Hom in a module category
concept.description: For objects M,N of a module category over C, an internal Hom is an object [M,N] of C with natural bijections Hom_C(X,[M,N])≅Hom_M(X⊗M,N). It exists in the finite semisimple setting used here.

concept.title: S-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concept.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the S-matrix is indexed by simple objects; its (X,Y) entry is the categorical trace of c(Y,X)c(X,Y) on X⊗Y. This is the unnormalized Hopf-link convention.

concept.title: T-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concept.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the T-matrix is diagonal, with entry at a simple object X equal to the scalar of its ribbon twist θ_X. No additional anomaly scalar is included.

concept.title: Modular tensor category
concept.description: A ribbon fusion category over ℂ whose S-matrix is invertible.

concept.title: Rational forms pass to Drinfeld centers
concept.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, if C_k is a rational form of C_K, the natural functor Z(C_k)⊗_k K→Z(C_K) is fully faithful, dominant, and commutes with induction. Thus Z(C_k) is a braided rational form, with idempotent completion understood.

concept.title: Rational forms pass to dual fusion categories
concept.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, let M_K be an indecomposable finite semisimple module category over D_K and let D_k,M_k be compatible rational forms. Scalar extension induces a fully faithful dominant functor Fun_{D_k}(M_k,M_k)⊗_k K→Fun_{D_K}(M_K,M_K), so the dual category over k is a rational form of the dual over K.

concept.title: Category
concept.description: Objects and morphisms with associative composition and identity morphisms.

concept.title: Functor
concept.description: A map of categories preserving objects, morphisms, identities and composition.

concept.title: Natural transformation
concept.description: A family of maps between the values of two functors, commuting with every morphism in their source category.

concept.title: Equivalence of categories
concept.description: A functor with an inverse up to natural isomorphism.

concept.title: Strong monoidal functor
concept.description: A functor equipped with coherent isomorphisms preserving tensor products and the tensor unit.

concept.title: Tensor equivalence
concept.description: A strong monoidal functor whose underlying functor is an equivalence of categories.

concept.title: Monoidal natural transformation
concept.description: A natural transformation between strong monoidal functors compatible with their tensor-product and unit isomorphisms.

concept.title: Dual object in a monoidal category
concept.description: An object paired with another by evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the two zigzag identities; left and right duals reverse the order of the factors.

concept.title: Double-dual functor
concept.description: The covariant monoidal endofunctor X↦X** obtained by taking a chosen dual twice in a rigid monoidal category.

concept.title: Endomorphism algebra of an object in a linear category
concept.description: The vector space End(X), with multiplication given by composition and unit the identity of X.

concept.title: Idempotent endomorphism
concept.description: An endomorphism e:X→X satisfying e∘e=e.

concept.title: Splitting of an idempotent endomorphism
concept.description: Maps r:X→Y and i:Y→X with ir=e and ri=id_Y exhibit Y as the image of the idempotent e.

concept.title: Additive category
concept.description: A category with abelian-group morphism sets, composition additive in each variable, a zero object and finite biproducts.

concept.title: Abelian category
concept.description: An additive category with kernels and cokernels in which every monomorphism is a kernel and every epimorphism is a cokernel.

concept.title: Subobject in a category
concept.description: An equivalence class of monomorphisms into a fixed object, where two are equivalent if an isomorphism of their domains commutes with the maps.

concept.title: Zero object in a category
concept.description: An object 0 of a category such that for every object X there is exactly one morphism 0→X and exactly one morphism X→0.

concept.title: Finite biproduct in a category
concept.description: An object with injections and projections making it simultaneously the product and coproduct of a finite family of objects, with the usual compatible identity and zero composites.

concept.title: Adjoint functors
concept.description: Functors F:C→D and G:D→C with natural bijections Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY); F is left adjoint to G.

concept.title: Representable functor
concept.description: A functor naturally isomorphic to Hom(A,−), or to Hom(−,A) in the contravariant case.

concept.title: Tensor category over a field
concept.description: A k-linear abelian rigid monoidal category with a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, and finite length for every object. Semisimplicity and finitely many simple isomorphism classes are not required.

concept.title: Twist in a braided monoidal category
concept.description: A natural automorphism θ of the identity with θ₁=id and θ_{X⊗Y}=c_{Y,X}c_{X,Y}(θ_X⊗θ_Y).

concept.title: Tensor ideal of morphisms in a linear monoidal category
concept.description: A family of linear subspaces of morphism spaces closed under composition on either side and tensoring with arbitrary morphisms.

concept.title: Quotient of a linear category by an ideal
concept.description: For a k-linear category C and a linear ideal I closed under composition on either side, C/I has the same objects and morphism spaces Hom_C(X,Y)/I(X,Y), with induced composition.

concept.title: Vector space
concept.description: An abelian group with scalar multiplication by a field satisfying a(v+w)=av+aw, (a+b)v=av+bv, (ab)v=a(bv), and 1v=v.

concept.title: Bilinear map
concept.description: A map of two vector-space variables that is linear in each variable separately.

concept.title: Tensor product of vector spaces
concept.description: The vector space V⊗W with its universal bilinear map from V×W.

concept.title: Field
concept.description: A commutative ring in which 1≠0 and every nonzero element is invertible.

concept.title: Associative algebra over a field
concept.description: A vector space with an associative bilinear multiplication and a multiplicative identity.

concept.title: Module over an associative algebra
concept.description: A vector space on which the algebra acts linearly, compatibly with multiplication and the identity.

concept.title: Idempotent element of an algebra
concept.description: An element e satisfying e²=e.

concept.title: Orthogonal idempotents in an algebra
concept.description: Idempotents e and f satisfying ef=fe=0.

concept.title: Invertible element of an algebra
concept.description: An element with a two-sided multiplicative inverse.

concept.title: Split semisimple algebra
concept.description: A finite-dimensional algebra isomorphic to a finite product of full matrix algebras over its base field.

concept.title: Temperley–Lieb algebra
concept.description: TL_n(δ) is spanned by planar noncrossing pairings of n top and n bottom points. Multiply by stacking and replace every closed loop by δ; equivalently its generators satisfy eᵢ²=δeᵢ, eᵢeᵢ₊₁eᵢ=eᵢ and eᵢeⱼ=eⱼeᵢ for abs(i−j)>1.

concept.title: Colored operad
concept.description: A collection of operations with specified input and output types, with associative substitution into inputs and identity operations.

concept.title: Planar isotopy of tangle diagrams
concept.description: A continuous deformation of embedded diagrams preserving their incidences, boundary components and marked data.

concept.title: Fusion matrix
concept.description: For an object X in a fusion category over ℂ, the matrix (N_X)_{Z,Y} records the multiplicity of the simple object Z in X⊗Y. Rows and columns are indexed by simple isomorphism classes.

concept.title: Grothendieck ring of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category, the free abelian group on simple isomorphism classes, with addition induced by direct sum and multiplication by tensor product.

concept.title: Spectral radius of a finite matrix
concept.description: The maximum absolute value of the complex eigenvalues of the matrix.

concept.title: Perron–Frobenius theorem for nonnegative matrices
concept.description: A nonnegative real matrix has a nonnegative eigenvalue equal to its spectral radius. If it is irreducible, that eigenvalue is simple and has a strictly positive eigenvector, unique up to scalar.

concept.title: Intrinsic squared norm of a simple object in a fusion category
concept.description: For a simple X in a fusion category over ℂ, choose an isomorphism a:X→X**. The product Tr(a)Tr((a⁻¹)*) is independent of this choice and is called |X|². With a pivotal structure it equals dim(X)dim(X*).

concept.title: Type II₁ factor
concept.description: An infinite-dimensional von Neumann algebra with center ℂ1 admitting a faithful normal tracial state.

concept.title: Hilbert bimodule over von Neumann algebras
concept.description: An M–N Hilbert bimodule is a Hilbert space with commuting normal unital *-representations of von Neumann algebras M and Nᵒᵖ, giving left M and right N actions.

concept.title: Tracial L²-space of a finite von Neumann algebra
concept.description: The Hilbert completion of M for the inner product ⟨x,y⟩=τ(y*x), with the natural left and right multiplication actions.

concept.title: Connes fusion of Hilbert bimodules
concept.description: The relative tensor product of an M–N and an N–P Hilbert bimodule, formed using bounded vectors and completion in the canonical relative inner product, producing an M–P Hilbert bimodule.

concept.title: Von Neumann dimension of a Hilbert module
concept.description: A Hilbert module over a finite factor is represented by a projection on a sum of copies of L²(M); its dimension is the extended matrix trace of that projection.

concept.title: Hyperfinite von Neumann algebra
concept.description: A von Neumann algebra that is the weak closure of an increasing union of finite-dimensional *-subalgebras.

concept.title: Field extension
concept.description: An inclusion of one field into another.

concept.title: Number field
concept.description: A finite extension of ℚ.

concept.title: Algebraic integer
concept.description: A complex number satisfying a monic polynomial with integer coefficients.

concept.title: Root of unity
concept.description: In a field, a root of unity is an element ζ with ζⁿ=1 for some positive integer n; its order is the least such n.

concept.title: Field embedding
concept.description: An injective homomorphism of fields preserving the multiplicative identity.

concept.title: Splitting field for a semisimple algebra
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional semisimple k-algebra A, a splitting field is an extension K/k for which K⊗_k A is a finite product of full matrix algebras over K.

concept.title: Galois group of a finite Galois extension
concept.description: The group of field automorphisms of the extension that fix the base field pointwise.

concept.title: Normal closure of a number field
concept.description: The smallest normal extension of ℚ inside a fixed algebraic closure that contains the given number field.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of finite Galois theory
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/k, intermediate fields correspond bijectively, with inclusions reversed, to subgroups of Gal(L/k), by taking fixed fields.

concept.title: Set
concept.description: A collection of distinct elements, regarded as one object.

concept.title: Natural number
concept.description: One of 0, 1, 2, …; natural numbers count finite collections.

concept.title: Function between sets
concept.description: An assignment taking each element of a specified domain set to exactly one element of a specified codomain set.

concept.title: Composition of functions
concept.description: For f:A→B and g:B→C, the composite g∘f:A→C sends x to g(f(x)).

concept.title: Ordered pair
concept.description: A pair (x,y) with distinguished first and second entries; (x,y)=(x′,y′) exactly when x=x′ and y=y′.

concept.title: Cartesian product of sets
concept.description: A×B is the set of ordered pairs (a,b) with a∈A and b∈B.

concept.title: Subset
concept.description: A⊆B means every element of A is an element of B.

concept.title: Union of a family of sets
concept.description: The set of elements belonging to at least one member of the family.

concept.title: Intersection of a family of sets
concept.description: Inside a specified ambient set, the elements belonging to every member of the family.

concept.title: Complement of a subset
concept.description: For A⊆Ω, its complement Ω∖A consists of the elements of Ω that do not belong to A.

concept.title: Disjoint sets
concept.description: Two sets are disjoint when they have no common element; a family is pairwise disjoint when every two distinct members are disjoint.

concept.title: Bijection between sets
concept.description: A function for which each element of the codomain is the image of exactly one element of the domain.

concept.title: Sequence in a set
concept.description: A function from the natural numbers, or the positive natural numbers, to that set.

concept.title: Binary relation on a set
concept.description: A subset R⊆S×S; writing xRy means (x,y)∈R.

concept.title: Partial order
concept.description: A reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive binary relation, usually written ≤.

concept.title: Total order
concept.description: A partial order in which any two elements are comparable.

concept.title: Least upper bound in a partially ordered set
concept.description: For A⊆P, its least upper bound is an upper bound s satisfying s≤b for every upper bound b of A, when such an s exists.

concept.title: Binary operation on a set
concept.description: A function S×S→S.

concept.title: Group
concept.description: A set with an associative binary operation, an identity element, and a two-sided inverse for each element.

concept.title: Abelian group
concept.description: A group whose operation is commutative.

concept.title: Commutative ring with identity
concept.description: An abelian group under addition, together with an associative commutative multiplication with identity, distributing over addition. The zero ring is allowed.

concept.title: Ordered field
concept.description: A field with a total order preserved by addition, in which the product of two positive elements is positive.

concept.title: Isomorphism in a category
concept.description: A morphism f:X→Y having an inverse g:Y→X, so gf=id_X and fg=id_Y.

concept.title: Natural isomorphism
concept.description: A natural transformation whose component at every object is an isomorphism.

concept.title: Product of categories
concept.description: C×D has pairs of objects and pairs of morphisms, with identities and composition defined componentwise.

concept.title: Bifunctor
concept.description: A functor C×D→E from a product of two categories to another category.

concept.title: Extended nonnegative real numbers
concept.description: The nonnegative real numbers together with a greatest element ∞. Sums involving ∞ equal ∞, and 0·∞ is taken to be 0 when integrating simple functions.

concept.title: Open interval in the real line
concept.description: For real a<b, the set (a,b)={x∈ℝ:a<x<b}.

concept.title: σ-algebra generated by a family of subsets
concept.description: The smallest σ-algebra containing that family, equivalently the intersection of all σ-algebras on the ambient set that contain it.

concept.title: Borel σ-algebra on the real line
concept.description: The σ-algebra on ℝ generated by the open intervals.

concept.title: Measurable space
concept.description: A set equipped with a specified σ-algebra of subsets.

concept.title: Preimage of a subset under a function
concept.description: For f:A→B and E⊆B, f⁻¹(E)={x∈A:f(x)∈E}.

concept.title: Measurable map between measurable spaces
concept.description: A function for which the preimage of each measurable subset of the codomain is measurable in the domain.

concept.title: Indicator function of a subset
concept.description: For A⊆Ω, the real function 1_A is 1 on A and 0 on its complement.

concept.title: Measurable simple real function
concept.description: A measurable real function with finite range. It can be written as a finite sum ∑ a_i 1_{A_i} with measurable level sets A_i.

concept.title: Monotonicity of the Lebesgue integral
concept.description: If 0≤f≤g are measurable functions on a measure space, then ∫f dμ≤∫g dμ, allowing infinite integrals.

concept.title: Linearity of the Lebesgue integral
concept.description: If f and g are integrable real functions and a,b are real scalars, then af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)dμ=a∫f dμ+b∫g dμ.

concept.title: Markov’s inequality for nonnegative random variables
concept.description: If Y is a nonnegative integrable real random variable and t>0, then P(Y≥t)≤E[Y]/t.

concept.title: Complex number
concept.description: A complex number is a pair of real numbers, written a+bi. Addition is componentwise and multiplication is (a+bi)(c+di)=(ac−bd)+(ad+bc)i, so i²=−1.

concept.title: Linear map between vector spaces
concept.description: A map between vector spaces over the same field preserving addition and scalar multiplication.

concept.title: Normed vector space
concept.description: A real or complex vector space X with a function ∥·∥:X→[0,∞) that is positive except at zero, absolutely homogeneous, and subadditive.

concept.title: Complex inner-product space
concept.description: A complex vector space with a positive definite Hermitian form ⟨x,y⟩, linear in x and conjugate-linear in y. Its induced norm is ∥x∥=√⟨x,x⟩.

concept.title: Complex Hilbert space
concept.description: A complex inner-product space complete in the metric d(x,y)=∥x−y∥ induced by its inner product.

concept.title: Bounded linear operator
concept.description: A linear map T:X→Y between normed vector spaces is bounded if ∥Tx∥≤C∥x∥ for one finite constant C and every x∈X.

concept.title: Operator norm of a bounded linear operator
concept.description: For a bounded linear map T:X→Y between normed spaces, ∥T∥=sup{∥Tx∥:∥x∥≤1}.

concept.title: Adjoint of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: The adjoint of a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is the unique bounded operator T* satisfying ⟨Tx,y⟩=⟨x,T*y⟩ for every x,y.

concept.title: Bounded self-adjoint operator
concept.description: A bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is self-adjoint if T=T*.

concept.title: Bounded positive operator
concept.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator A is positive, written A≥0, if ⟨Ax,x⟩≥0 for every vector x.

concept.title: Numerical range of a Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a nonzero complex Hilbert space, W(T)={⟨Tx,x⟩:∥x∥=1}.

concept.title: Numerical radius of a Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: For a bounded Hilbert-space operator T, w(T)=sup{|z|:z∈W(T)}.

concept.title: Spectrum of a bounded operator
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Banach space, σ(T) is the set of complex λ for which λI−T has no bounded two-sided inverse.

concept.title: Holomorphic function of one complex variable
concept.description: A function on an open subset of ℂ is holomorphic if its complex derivative exists at every point of that subset.

concept.title: Disk algebra
concept.description: The algebra A(𝔻) of complex functions continuous on the closed unit disk and holomorphic on the open unit disk, with the supremum norm.

concept.title: Finite Blaschke product
concept.description: A function B(z)=c∏ₖ₌₁ⁿ(z−aₖ)/(1−āₖz), with |c|=1 and |aₖ|<1. Constant unimodular functions are allowed when n=0.

concept.title: Biholomorphic automorphism of the unit disk
concept.description: A bijective holomorphic map 𝔻→𝔻 with holomorphic inverse; these maps are z↦c(z−a)/(1−āz), where |c|=1 and |a|<1.

concept.title: Polynomial over a field
concept.description: A formal finite sum a₀+a₁x+⋯+aₙxⁿ with coefficients in a field, with the usual coefficientwise addition and multiplication.

concept.title: Rational function over a field
concept.description: An element of k(x), represented by a quotient p(x)/q(x) of polynomials over k with q≠0; two quotients are equal when their cross-products agree.

concept.title: Partial-fraction decomposition over ℂ
concept.description: A complex rational function is a polynomial plus a finite sum of terms c/(z−a)^j, one collection for each finite pole, with j bounded by its multiplicity.

concept.title: Riesz–Dunford holomorphic functional calculus
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Banach space and f holomorphic near σ(T), define f(T)=(2πi)⁻¹∮Γ f(z)(zI−T)⁻¹ dz, where Γ encloses σ(T) inside that neighborhood.

concept.title: Spectral mapping theorem for holomorphic functional calculus
concept.description: If f is holomorphic near the spectrum of a bounded operator T, then σ(f(T))=f(σ(T)).

concept.title: Carathéodory’s approximation theorem by finite Blaschke products
concept.description: Every holomorphic f:𝔻→ℂ with |f|≤1 is a locally uniform limit of finite Blaschke products. If f(0)=0, the approximating products can also be chosen to vanish at zero.

concept.title: Comparison of numerical radius and operator norm
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space, w(T)≤∥T∥≤2w(T). If T is self-adjoint, w(T)=∥T∥.

concept.title: Toeplitz–Hausdorff theorem
concept.description: The numerical range of every bounded operator on a complex Hilbert space is convex.

concept.title: Berger’s power inequality for numerical radius
concept.description: For every bounded Hilbert-space operator T and integer n≥1, w(Tⁿ)≤w(T)ⁿ.

concept.title: Berger–Stampfli numerical-radius mapping theorem
concept.description: If w(T)≤1 and f∈A(𝔻) has f(0)=0, then f(T)=lim_{r↑1}f(rT) exists in operator norm and w(f(T))≤∥f∥∞.

concept.title: Local norm estimate from numerical radius
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space with w(T)≤1 and a vector x with ∥x∥≤1, ∥Tx∥²≤2+2√(1−|⟨Tx,x⟩|²).

concept.title: Drury’s teardrop theorem
concept.description: If w(T)≤1 and f∈A(𝔻) satisfies ∥f∥∞≤1, then W(f(T)) lies in the convex hull of the closed unit disk and the closed disk centered at f(0) with radius 1−|f(0)|². Consequently w(f(T))≤1+|f(0)|−|f(0)|²≤5/4.

concept.title: Aleksandrov–Clark probability measures for a Schur function vanishing at zero
concept.description: For holomorphic f:𝔻→𝔻 with f(0)=0 and |γ|=1, the Aleksandrov–Clark measure μγ is the probability measure on the unit circle satisfying (1−γ̄f(z))⁻¹=∫(1−ζ̄z)⁻¹ dμγ(ζ) for z∈𝔻.

concept.title: Crouzeix’s numerical-range functional-calculus theorem
concept.description: There is an absolute finite constant C such that ∥f(T)∥≤C sup_{z∈W(T)}|f(z)| for every bounded Hilbert-space operator T and f holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closure of W(T).

concept.title: Vector subspace
concept.description: A subset of a vector space containing zero and closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Linear span of a set of vectors
concept.description: The subspace consisting of all finite linear combinations of a specified set of vectors.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Linearly independent family of vectors
concept.description: A family of vectors is linearly independent if every finite linear combination equalling zero has all coefficients zero.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Basis of a vector space
concept.description: A linearly independent family of vectors whose linear span is the whole vector space.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Dimension of a vector space
concept.description: The cardinality of a basis of the vector space; a finite basis with n vectors gives dimension n.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Finite-dimensional vector space
concept.description: A vector space having a finite basis.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Sum of vector subspaces
concept.description: For subspaces U and W of the same vector space, U+W={u+w:u∈U,w∈W}, the smallest subspace containing both.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Quotient vector space
concept.description: For a subspace U⊆V, the cosets V/U form a vector space with addition and scalar multiplication induced from V.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Direct sum of vector spaces
concept.description: The algebraic direct sum of a family of vector spaces consists of tuples with only finitely many nonzero coordinates, with coordinatewise operations.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Image of a linear map
concept.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its image is the subspace {f(v):v∈V} of W.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Kernel of a linear map
concept.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its kernel is the subspace {v∈V:f(v)=0}.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Cokernel of a linear map
concept.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its cokernel is the quotient W/im(f).
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Exact sequence of vector spaces
concept.description: A sequence of linear maps is exact at a vector space if the image of the incoming map equals the kernel of the outgoing map; it is exact if this holds everywhere.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Snake lemma for vector spaces
concept.description: For a commuting diagram with exact rows 0→A→B→C→0 and 0→A′→B′→C′→0 and vertical maps a,b,c, there is a natural exact sequence 0→ker(a)→ker(b)→ker(c)→coker(a)→coker(b)→coker(c)→0.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Dimension formula for sums of subspaces
concept.description: For finite-dimensional subspaces U,W, dim(U+W)+dim(U∩W)=dim(U)+dim(W).
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Nondegenerate bilinear form
concept.description: A bilinear form b:V×V→F is nondegenerate if b(v,w)=0 for all w forces v=0, and b(v,w)=0 for all v forces w=0.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Orthogonal complement for a bilinear form
concept.description: For a bilinear form b on V and subspace U, its right orthogonal complement is U⊥={v∈V:b(u,v)=0 for every u∈U}. This definition does not assume a positive inner product.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Algebraic element of a field extension
concept.description: An element α of L/F is algebraic over F if a nonzero polynomial in F[x] vanishes at α.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Separable algebraic field extension
concept.description: An algebraic extension L/F is separable if the minimal polynomial over F of every element of L has distinct roots in an algebraic closure.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Subfield generated by a subset
concept.description: For S⊆L in a field extension L/F, F(S) is the smallest subfield of L containing F and S.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Product of finite-dimensional subspaces of a field extension
concept.description: For a field extension L/F and finite-dimensional F-subspaces S,T⊆L, their product ST is the F-linear span of {st:s∈S,t∈T}. It is spanned by products of basis vectors of S and T.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Stabilizer field of a finite-dimensional subspace
concept.description: For a nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace V⊆L in L/F, its stabilizer field is H(V)={x∈L:xV⊆V}. It contains F; every nonzero x in H(V) satisfies xV=V.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Hou–Leung–Xiang linear Kneser theorem
concept.description: Let L/F be a field extension in which every element algebraic over F is separable. For nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspaces S,T⊆L, dim_F(ST)≥dim_F S+dim_F T−dim_F H(ST), where H(ST) is the stabilizer field of ST.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Uniform subfield stabilizer theorem for subspace products
concept.description: Let L/F be any field extension and S⊆L a nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace. Either dim_F(ST)≥dim_F S+dim_F T−1 for every nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace T, or there is a subfield F⊊K⊆L, depending only on S, such that STK=ST for every T violating this bound. No separability assumption is required.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Subgroup
concept.description: A subset of a group containing the identity and closed under multiplication and inverses.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Sumset in an abelian group
concept.description: For subsets A,B of an additive abelian group, A+B={a+b:a∈A,b∈B}.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Translation stabilizer of a subset of an abelian group
concept.description: For a subset A of an abelian group G, H(A)={g∈G:g+A=A}, a subgroup of G.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Kneser’s addition theorem for finite sumsets
concept.description: For finite nonempty subsets A,B of an abelian group, |A+B|≥|A|+|B|−|H(A+B)|, where H(A+B) is the translation stabilizer of the sumset.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Balandraud’s uniform stabilizer theorem for sumsets
concept.description: Fix a finite nonempty subset S of an abelian group. Either |S+T|≥|S|+|T|−1 for every finite nonempty T, or there is a finite nontrivial subgroup H, depending only on S, such that S+T+H=S+T for every T violating that bound.
concept.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concept.title: Nonnegative real square root
concept.description: For t≥0, √t is the unique real number y≥0 satisfying y²=t.

concept.title: Complex conjugation
concept.description: The complex conjugate of z=a+bi is z̄=a−bi.

concept.title: Modulus of a complex number
concept.description: For z=a+bi, its modulus is the nonnegative real number |z|=√(a²+b²).

concept.title: Metric space
concept.description: A set X with a function d:X×X→[0,∞) such that d(x,y)=0 exactly when x=y, d(x,y)=d(y,x), and d(x,z)≤d(x,y)+d(y,z).

concept.title: Convergence of a sequence in a metric space
concept.description: A sequence (xₙ) in a metric space (X,d) converges to x∈X if for every ε>0 there is N such that d(xₙ,x)<ε whenever n≥N.

concept.title: Cauchy sequence in a metric space
concept.description: A sequence (xₙ) in a metric space (X,d) is Cauchy if for every ε>0 there is N such that d(xₙ,xₘ)<ε whenever n,m≥N.

concept.title: Complete metric space
concept.description: A metric space is complete if every Cauchy sequence in it converges to a point of that same space.

concept.title: Metric induced by a norm
concept.description: The metric induced by a norm on a real or complex vector space is d(x,y)=‖x−y‖.

concept.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for complex inner-product spaces
concept.description: In a complex inner-product space, |⟨u,v⟩|²≤⟨u,u⟩⟨v,v⟩ for all u,v.

concept.title: Linear combination of vectors
concept.description: A finite sum a₁v₁+⋯+aₙvₙ of vectors multiplied by scalars from their vector space’s ground field; the empty sum is zero.

concept.title: Divisibility of integers
concept.description: An integer a divides b if b=ac for some integer c.

concept.title: p-integral rational number
concept.description: For a prime p, a rational number is p-integral if it can be written a/b with integers a,b and p not dividing b.

concept.title: Matrix over a ring
concept.description: A rectangular array of elements of a ring; addition is entrywise and matrix multiplication uses row-by-column sums.

concept.title: Symmetric matrix
concept.description: A square matrix A equal to its transpose, so aᵢⱼ=aⱼᵢ.

concept.title: Positive semidefinite real matrix
concept.description: A symmetric real matrix A such that xᵀAx≥0 for every real column vector x.

concept.title: Positive definite real matrix
concept.description: A symmetric real matrix A such that xᵀAx>0 for every nonzero real column vector x.

concept.title: Symplectic group over a commutative ring
concept.description: Sp₂g(R) is the group of invertible 2g×2g matrices M over R satisfying MᵀJM=J for J=[[0,I],[-I,0]].

concept.title: Siegel upper half-space
concept.description: The set ℍ_g of symmetric complex g×g matrices whose imaginary part is positive definite.

concept.title: Scalar-valued Siegel modular form for the full modular group
concept.description: A holomorphic function F on ℍ_g with F((AZ+B)(CZ+D)⁻¹)=det(CZ+D)^k F(Z) for integral symplectic matrices [[A,B],[C,D]], and a Fourier expansion supported on positive semidefinite half-integral symmetric matrices. For g=1 the cusp-holomorphy condition is included.

concept.title: Linear representation of a group
concept.description: A group homomorphism from a group G to the invertible linear maps of a vector space, equivalently a linear action of G.

concept.title: Vector-valued Siegel modular form of finite-quotient type
concept.description: A holomorphic map F:ℍ_g→V transforming by det(CZ+D)^kρ(M), where ρ is a representation of the integral symplectic group with finite-index kernel; its Fourier expansion satisfies the usual holomorphy condition.

concept.title: Fourier expansion of a Siegel modular form
concept.description: The expansion F(Z)=∑_T c(T)exp(2πi tr(TZ)), with T positive semidefinite and half-integral in the full-level scalar case.

concept.title: Jacobi form of Siegel degree g
concept.description: A holomorphic function φ(τ,z) on ℍ_g×ℂ^g with the weight-k, index-m transformation laws under the integral Jacobi group, whose Fourier coefficients c(T,R) vanish unless 4mT−RRᵀ is positive semidefinite.

concept.title: Fourier–Jacobi expansion of a Siegel modular form
concept.description: Expand a degree-(g+1) Siegel form along the last diagonal variable: F([[τ,zᵀ],[z,τ′]])=∑_{m≥0}φ_m(τ,z)exp(2πimτ′), where φ_m are degree-g Jacobi forms.

concept.title: Torsion point of a complex torus
concept.description: A point of a complex torus V/Λ killed by multiplication by a positive integer; an N-torsion point is represented by a vector in (1/N)Λ.

concept.title: Specialization of a Jacobi form at torsion points
concept.description: Evaluate a Jacobi form after its Jacobi-group slash action at z=0 with rational translation parameters; collecting the N-torsion evaluations gives a vector-valued modular form.

concept.title: Field of p-adic numbers
concept.description: For a prime p, ℚ_p is the completion of ℚ for the p-adic absolute value |x|_p=p^{-v_p(x)}.

concept.title: Finite unramified extension of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: A finite extension of a complete discretely valued field whose ramification index is one and whose residue-field extension is separable.

concept.title: Vandermonde determinant formula
concept.description: The determinant of (xᵢ^{j−1})_{1≤i,j≤n} equals ∏_{i<j}(xⱼ−xᵢ).

concept.title: Sturm’s congruence bound for elliptic modular forms
concept.description: For a weight-k holomorphic modular form on SL₂(ℤ) with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients a(n), vanishing a(n) modulo p for 0≤n≤⌊k/12⌋ forces all coefficients to vanish modulo p.

concept.title: Sturm bound k/10 for degree-two Siegel modular forms
concept.description: For p≥5 and an even-weight k Siegel modular form of degree two with p-integral coefficients, if all coefficients indexed by T have zero reduction whenever both diagonal entries are at most ⌊k/10⌋, then the form vanishes modulo p.

concept.title: Richter–Westerholt-Raum Sturm bound for Siegel modular forms
concept.description: For a degree-g≥2, weight-k Siegel modular form with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients, vanishing modulo p of all c(T) with every tᵢᵢ≤(4/3)^g k/16 forces vanishing of every coefficient. For p≥5 the bound improves to (4/3)^g·9k/160.

concept.title: Finite coefficient criterion for integrality of Siegel modular forms
concept.description: For a degree-g≥2, weight-k Siegel modular form with rational coefficients, if every c(T) with all diagonal entries tᵢᵢ≤(4/3)^g k/16 is integral, then every coefficient is integral. The same implication holds for p-integrality.

concept.title: Syndetic subset of the positive integers
concept.description: A set S⊆ℕ₊ is syndetic if some finite bound L makes every interval {a,…,a+L} meet S.

concept.title: Thick subset of the positive integers
concept.description: A subset of ℕ₊ is thick if it contains intervals of arbitrarily large finite length.

concept.title: Finite-sums set of a sequence
concept.description: For a finite or infinite sequence (xᵢ) of positive integers, FS(xᵢ) consists of sums over finite nonempty sets of distinct indices.

concept.title: IP-set of positive integers
concept.description: A subset of ℕ₊ is an IP-set if it contains FS(xᵢ) for some infinite sequence of positive integers.

concept.title: Admissible tuple of integer shifts
concept.description: A finite set H={h₁,…,hₖ} of distinct integers is admissible if its residue classes fail to cover all classes modulo p for every prime p.

concept.title: Pigeonhole principle
concept.description: If more than n objects are assigned to n boxes, at least one box receives two objects; more generally some box receives at least the average number.

concept.title: Bounded prime-cluster theorem for admissible tuples
concept.description: There is an integer k₀ such that every admissible set H of at least k₀ integer shifts has infinitely many translates n+H containing at least two primes.

concept.title: Finite arithmetic progression of integers
concept.description: A sequence a,a+d,…,a+(k−1)d with integers a,d and positive integer k; nonconstant progressions have d≠0.

concept.title: Green–Tao theorem
concept.description: The prime numbers contain nonconstant arithmetic progressions of every finite length.

concept.title: Maillet’s prime-difference conjecture
concept.description: Every positive even integer is a difference of two primes.

concept.title: Kronecker’s prime-difference conjecture
concept.description: Every positive even integer occurs infinitely often as a difference of two primes.

concept.title: de Polignac’s conjecture on consecutive prime gaps
concept.description: Every positive even integer occurs infinitely often as the gap between consecutive primes.

concept.title: Twin-prime conjecture
concept.description: There are infinitely many primes p for which p+2 is prime.

concept.title: Syndeticity of infinitely recurring prime differences
concept.description: The set D of positive integers occurring infinitely often as differences p−q of primes is syndetic. In particular the set of all positive prime differences is syndetic.

concept.title: Pythagorean triple
concept.description: A triple of positive integers (a,b,c) satisfying a²+b²=c².

concept.title: Pythagorean theorem
concept.description: In a Euclidean right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse length is the sum of the squares of the two leg lengths.

concept.title: Perfect cuboid
concept.description: A rectangular box whose three edges, three face diagonals and space diagonal all have positive integer lengths.

concept.title: Euler brick
concept.description: A rectangular box whose edges and all three face diagonals have integer lengths; its space diagonal need not have integer length.

concept.title: Diophantine equation
concept.description: A polynomial equation, usually with integer coefficients, whose solutions are required to be integers or rational numbers.

concept.title: Greatest common divisor of integers
concept.description: For integers a,b not both zero, gcd(a,b) is their greatest positive common divisor.

concept.title: Coprime integers
concept.description: Integers whose greatest common divisor is1.

concept.title: Irreducible polynomial
concept.description: A nonzero nonunit polynomial over a specified coefficient ring that cannot be written as a product of two nonunits. Over a field, both factors would have smaller positive degree.

concept.title: Multiplicity of a polynomial root
concept.description: The multiplicity of a root a of a polynomial P is the largest m≥1 for which (x−a)^m divides P. A root of multiplicity1 is simple.

concept.title: Asymptotic expansion in a scale of functions
concept.description: An expansion f∼∑aₙφₙ along a limit means that after every finite truncation at n, the remainder is o(φₙ), where each successive scale function is of smaller order than the preceding one. Convergence of the series is not required.

concept.title: Newton polygon of a bivariate polynomial
concept.description: The convex hull in ℝ² of exponent pairs (i,j) whose monomial coefficients in P(x,y)=∑cᵢⱼxⁱyʲ are nonzero.

concept.title: Intermediate value theorem for real functions
concept.description: A continuous real function on an interval takes every value between any two of its values.

concept.title: Perfect cuboid existence problem
concept.description: The open existence question asks whether any rectangular box has integer edges, face diagonals and space diagonal.

concept.title: Sharipov’s second cuboid conjecture
concept.description: For distinct coprime positive integers p,q, the polynomial Qₚq(t)=t¹⁰+(2q²+p²)(3q²−2p²)t⁸+(q⁸+10p²q⁶+4p⁴q⁴−14p⁶q²+p⁸)t⁶−p²q²(q⁸−14p²q⁶+4p⁴q⁴+10p⁶q²+p⁸)t⁴−p⁶q⁶(q²+2p²)(3p²−2q²)t²−p¹⁰q¹⁰ is irreducible in ℤ[t]. The family comes from the second special case of the cuboid parametrization.

concept.title: Topological space
concept.description: A set X with a family τ of subsets, called open sets, containing ∅ and X and closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.

concept.title: Continuous map between topological spaces
concept.description: A map is continuous if the preimage of every open subset of its target is open in its domain.

concept.title: Homeomorphism
concept.description: A bijection between topological spaces that is continuous and has a continuous inverse.

concept.title: Smooth map between open Euclidean sets
concept.description: A map on an open subset of ℝⁿ is smooth if all of its component partial derivatives of every order exist and are continuous.

concept.title: Diffeomorphism between open Euclidean sets
concept.description: A bijection between open subsets of Euclidean spaces that is smooth and has a smooth inverse.

concept.title: Lipschitz map between metric spaces
concept.description: A map f:(X,d)→(Y,e) is Lipschitz if e(f(x),f(y))≤L d(x,y) for one finite constant L and all x,y∈X.

concept.title: Bi-Lipschitz map
concept.description: A bijection between metric spaces for which both the map and its inverse are Lipschitz.

concept.title: Lebesgue measure on Euclidean space
concept.description: The completion of the Borel measure on ℝⁿ assigning each rectangular box the product of its side lengths.

concept.title: Lebesgue Lᵖ space
concept.description: For a measure space and 1≤p<∞, Lᵖ consists of measurable scalar functions modulo equality almost everywhere with ∫|f|ᵖ<∞, normed by (∫|f|ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ. For p=∞ use the essential-supremum norm.

concept.title: Weak partial derivative of a locally integrable function
concept.description: A locally integrable v is the ith weak derivative of u on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ if ∫Ω u ∂ᵢφ=−∫Ω vφ for every smooth compactly supported test function φ.

concept.title: First-order Sobolev space W¹,ᵖ
concept.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and 1≤p≤∞, W¹,ᵖ(Ω) consists of Lᵖ functions whose first weak partial derivatives are also in Lᵖ, with norm combining the function and derivative Lᵖ norms; vector-valued versions are componentwise.

concept.title: Uniform convergence of functions into a metric space
concept.description: A sequence fₙ:X→(Y,d) converges uniformly to f if for every ε>0, d(fₙ(x),f(x))<ε for every x∈X once n is sufficiently large independently of x.

concept.title: Affine map between real vector spaces
concept.description: A map of the form x↦Ax+b, where A is linear and b is fixed.

concept.title: Piecewise affine homeomorphism on a planar domain
concept.description: A homeomorphism on an open subset of ℝ² that is affine on every triangle of a locally finite triangulation; the triangulation need not be finite.

concept.title: Lebesgue point of a locally integrable function
concept.description: A point x is a Lebesgue point of f if the average of |f(y)−f(x)| over balls centered at x tends to zero as their radii tend to zero.

concept.title: Lebesgue differentiation theorem
concept.description: Almost every point of a locally integrable function on ℝⁿ is a Lebesgue point.

concept.title: Vitali covering lemma for balls
