concept.description: From a family of Euclidean balls with bounded radii one can choose pairwise disjoint balls whose fivefold concentric dilations cover the union of the original family.

concept.title: Jordan curve theorem
concept.description: A simple closed curve in the plane separates the plane into exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded, and is the boundary of both.

concept.title: Mora-Corral–Pratelli smoothing of planar piecewise affine homeomorphisms
concept.description: A planar piecewise affine homeomorphism in W¹,¹ can be approximated arbitrarily closely, both uniformly and in W¹,¹, by smooth diffeomorphisms, preserving boundary values when the continuous boundary extension is prescribed.

concept.title: Diffeomorphic approximation of planar W¹,¹ homeomorphisms
concept.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝ², every homeomorphism f∈W¹,¹(Ω,ℝ²) admits smooth diffeomorphisms and locally finitely piecewise affine homeomorphisms arbitrarily close both uniformly and in W¹,¹. If f extends continuously to ∂Ω, approximants can have the same boundary values. On a polygonal domain, when f is piecewise affine on the boundary, the affine approximant can use a finite triangulation.

concept.title: Schwartz space
concept.description: The space S(ℝⁿ) of smooth functions φ for which supₓ|xᵅ∂ᵝφ(x)| is finite for every pair of multi-indices α,β, with the topology of these seminorms.

concept.title: Tempered distribution
concept.description: A continuous linear functional on the Schwartz space S(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Fourier transform on Euclidean space
concept.description: For an integrable f on ℝⁿ, its Fourier transform is f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e⁻ⁱˣ·ξ dx; extend it to Schwartz functions and tempered distributions by duality.

concept.title: Convolution on Euclidean space
concept.description: For functions with an appropriate integrability condition, (f*g)(x)=∫f(x−y)g(y)dy; convolution of a tempered distribution with a Schwartz function is defined by duality.

concept.title: Dyadic cube in Euclidean space
concept.description: A half-open cube 2⁻ʲ([0,1)ⁿ+k), with j∈ℤ and k∈ℤⁿ.

concept.title: Variable-exponent Lebesgue space
concept.description: For measurable p:ℝⁿ→(0,∞) with 0<ess inf p≤ess sup p<∞, L^{p(·)} consists of measurable functions of finite Luxemburg quasi-norm inf{λ>0:∫|f(x)/λ|^{p(x)}dx≤1}, modulo equality almost everywhere.

concept.title: Log-Hölder continuous variable exponent
concept.description: An exponent p is locally log-Hölder if |p(x)−p(y)|≤C/log(e+1/|x−y|); global log-Hölder continuity additionally requires |p(x)−p∞|≤C/log(e+|x|) for a constant p∞.

concept.title: Mixed variable Lebesgue–sequence space L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})
concept.description: A sequence of measurable functions (fⱼ) has quasi-norm ∥(∑ⱼ|fⱼ(·)|^{q(·)})^{1/q(·)}∥_{L^{p(·)}}; functions are identified almost everywhere.

concept.title: Peetre maximal function of a band-limited function
concept.description: For scale j and a>0, the Peetre maximal function is f*_{j,a}(x)=sup_y |f(y)|/(1+2ʲ|x−y|)^a, used for functions localized to a frequency band of size 2ʲ.

concept.title: Smooth atom for dyadic function-space decompositions
concept.description: A smooth atom associated to a dyadic cube Q is supported in a fixed dilation of Q, obeys scale-normalized derivative bounds up to a specified order, and has vanishing polynomial moments up to a specified order.

concept.title: Smooth molecule for dyadic function-space decompositions
concept.description: A smooth molecule associated to a dyadic cube has prescribed vanishing moments and scale-normalized derivative bounds with polynomial decay away from that cube, instead of compact support.

concept.title: Frazier–Jawerth φ-transform
concept.description: A discrete analysis map sends a tempered distribution to its scale-normalized convolutions with admissible band-limited Schwartz functions sampled at dyadic cube corners; a dual family reconstructs it by summing the associated atoms.

concept.title: Vector-valued convolution inequality in variable Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: If p,q are globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1<q⁻≤q⁺<∞, then for m>n the kernels ηⱼ,m(x)=2ʲⁿ(1+2ʲ|x|)⁻ᵐ satisfy ∥(ηⱼ,m*fⱼ)ⱼ∥_{L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})}≤C∥(fⱼ)ⱼ∥_{L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})}.

concept.title: Triebel–Lizorkin-type space with variable exponents and cube weight
concept.description: For bounded positive exponents p,q with globally log-Hölder reciprocals, bounded locally log-Hölder smoothness s, and a positive doubling/locally comparable cube weight φ, F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)} consists of tempered distributions with finite sup_P φ(P)⁻¹∥(∑_{j≥max(0,−log₂ℓ(P))}(2^{js(·)}|ϕⱼ*f|)^{q(·)})^{1/q(·)}∥_{L^{p(·)}(P)}. Here P ranges over dyadic cubes and the admissible Schwartz family includes a low-frequency term at j=0.

concept.title: φ-transform characterization of variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin-type spaces
concept.description: For the admissible p,q,s,φ defining F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)}, the Frazier–Jawerth analysis and synthesis maps are bounded between this function space and its matching dyadic coefficient space, and analysis followed by synthesis reconstructs the distribution: TψSϕ=id. In particular the function-space quasi-norm is independent, up to equivalence, of the admissible Schwartz pair.

concept.title: Almost-everywhere property on a measure space
concept.description: A property holds almost everywhere if the set where it fails is contained in a measurable set of measure zero.

concept.title: Lower semicontinuous extended-real function
concept.description: A function u:X→(−∞,∞] on a topological space is lower semicontinuous if {x:u(x)>a} is open for every real a.

concept.title: Hardy space H² on the unit disk
concept.description: The holomorphic functions f(z)=∑ₙ≥0aₙzⁿ on the unit disk with ∑|aₙ|²<∞, normed by (∑|aₙ|²)¹ᐟ²; boundary values identify it with the nonnegative-frequency subspace of L² of the unit circle.

concept.title: Hardy space H∞ on the unit disk
concept.description: The bounded holomorphic functions on the unit disk, with the supremum norm.

concept.title: Superharmonic function on a planar domain
concept.description: A lower semicontinuous function u:Ω→(−∞,∞], not identically∞ on a component, is superharmonic if its value at each center is at least its circle average whenever the closed disk lies in Ω.

concept.title: Weighted holomorphic Dirichlet space
concept.description: For a nonnegative integrable weight ω on the unit disk, Dω consists of holomorphic f with Dω(f)=∫D|f′(z)|²ω(z)dA(z)<∞. When Dω⊆H², its Hilbert norm is ∥f∥²H²+Dω(f), with normalized area measure dA.

concept.title: Reproducing kernel Hilbert space
concept.description: A Hilbert space of scalar functions on a set X in which evaluation at every x∈X is a bounded linear functional; its reproducing kernel satisfies f(x)=⟨f,kₓ⟩.

concept.title: Positive definite complex kernel
concept.description: A kernel K:X×X→ℂ is positive definite if ∑ᵢⱼcᵢc̄ⱼK(xᵢ,xⱼ)≥0 for every finite choice of points xᵢ and scalars cᵢ.

concept.title: Toeplitz operator on H² of the unit disk
concept.description: For ψ∈L∞ of the unit circle, Tψf=P₊(ψf), where P₊ is orthogonal projection from boundary L² onto H².

concept.title: de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b)
concept.description: For b holomorphic on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1, H(b) is the reproducing kernel Hilbert space with kernel Kb(z,w)=(1−b(z)b(w)̄)/(1−zw̄). Equivalently it is the range of (I−TbTb*)¹ᐟ² with the induced range norm.

concept.title: Outer function in Hardy H²
concept.description: A function a∈H² is outer if the linear span of a,z a,z²a,… is dense in H²; this is equivalent to the usual exponential Poisson-integral definition.

concept.title: Inner function on the unit disk
concept.description: A bounded holomorphic function on the unit disk whose radial boundary values have modulus one almost everywhere on the unit circle.

concept.title: Inner–outer factorization in Hardy H²
concept.description: Every nonzero H² function is the product of an inner function and an outer H² function; the factors are unique up to opposite unimodular constants.

concept.title: Smirnov class on the unit disk
concept.description: The holomorphic functions on the unit disk expressible as b/a with a,b∈H∞ and a outer.

concept.title: Poisson kernel of the unit disk
concept.description: For ζ on the unit circle and z in the disk, Pζ(z)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²; integrating it against boundary data gives harmonic extensions.

concept.title: Riesz decomposition for positive superharmonic functions on the disk
concept.description: A positive superharmonic function on the unit disk decomposes uniquely into a Green potential of a positive locally finite measure and a positive harmonic function; the harmonic part has a positive boundary-measure Poisson representation.

concept.title: Bergman projection on the unit disk
concept.description: The orthogonal projection from area L² of the disk onto its holomorphic subspace; with normalized area its kernel is Qψ(z)=∫D ψ(w)/(1−zw̄)² dA(w), whenever the formula is meaningful.

concept.title: Berezin transform on the unit disk
concept.description: For an integrable weight ψ on the disk, Bψ(z)=∫D (1−|z|²)²|1−zw̄|⁻⁴ψ(w)dA(w), the average against the normalized Bergman kernel density.

concept.title: Isometric identification of superharmonic Dirichlet and de Branges–Rovnyak spaces
concept.description: Let μ be a nonzero finite positive measure on the closed unit disk, representing a superharmonic Dirichlet weight, and let b be non-extreme with associated outer a normalized by a(0)>0 and |a|²+|b|²=1 on the circle. Then Dμ=H(b) with equal norms exactly when μ=|α|²δζ and b(z)/a(z)=αz/(1−ζ̄z) for some ζ in the closed disk and α≠0.

concept.title: Dilation inequality for superharmonic Dirichlet integrals
concept.description: For a positive superharmonic Dirichlet weight represented by a finite positive closed-disk measure μ, f∈Dμ and fᵣ(z)=f(rz), Dμ(fᵣ)≤2r/(1+r)Dμ(f) for 0≤r<1.

concept.title: Banach space
concept.description: A real or complex normed vector space complete for the metric induced by its norm.

concept.title: Real inner-product space
concept.description: A real vector space with a symmetric bilinear form ⟨x,y⟩ that is positive on ⟨x,x⟩ for x≠0; its induced norm is √⟨x,x⟩.

concept.title: Real Hilbert space
concept.description: A real inner-product space complete for its induced norm metric.

concept.title: Bounded linear functional
concept.description: A linear map from a real or complex normed vector space to its scalar field satisfying |ℓ(x)|≤C∥x∥ for one finite C and every x.

concept.title: Weak convergence in a Banach space
concept.description: A sequence xₙ converges weakly to x if ℓ(xₙ)→ℓ(x) for every bounded linear functional ℓ on the space.

concept.title: Weak sequential compactness in a Banach space
concept.description: A subset is weakly sequentially compact if every sequence in it has a weakly convergent subsequence whose limit belongs to that same subset.

concept.title: Proper convex extended-real functional
concept.description: A function R:V→(−∞,∞] on a real vector space is proper if it is finite somewhere and is convex if R((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)R(x)+tR(y) for 0≤t≤1.

concept.title: Weakly sequentially lower semicontinuous functional
concept.description: An extended-real functional R satisfies R(x)≤liminfₙR(xₙ) whenever xₙ converges weakly to x.

concept.title: Variational Tikhonov regularization
concept.description: For an operator equation Fx=y, approximate noisy data yδ by minimizing ∥Fx−yδ∥²+αR(x), where α>0 and R is a chosen penalty functional.

concept.title: Penalty-minimizing solution of an inverse problem
concept.description: An R-minimizing solution of Fx=y minimizes the penalty R among all exact solutions of that equation.

concept.title: Embedded smooth surface in ℝ³
concept.description: A subset of ℝ³ that near each point is, after a rigid change of coordinates, the graph of a smooth real function of two variables.

concept.title: Tangent space of an embedded surface
concept.description: At x on a smooth embedded surface M, TₓM is the two-dimensional vector subspace of velocities γ′(0) of smooth surface curves with γ(0)=x.

concept.title: Tangent vector field on an embedded surface
concept.description: A map v:M→ℝ³ with v(x)∈TₓM at each x; smoothness or Sobolev regularity is an additional stated condition.

concept.title: Orthogonal projection onto a closed Hilbert subspace
concept.description: For a closed subspace V of a Hilbert space H, Pᵥx is the unique v∈V for which x−v is orthogonal to V; Pᵥ is a bounded self-adjoint idempotent operator.

concept.title: Surface gradient on an embedded surface
concept.description: For a smooth real f on a surface M⊂ℝ³, ∇Mf is the tangent vector field satisfying ⟨∇Mf,v⟩=df(v) for tangent vectors v; equivalently it is the tangential projection of an ambient smooth extension’s gradient.

concept.title: Levi-Civita covariant derivative on an embedded surface
concept.description: For tangent vector fields X,Y on a surface in ℝ³ with its induced metric, ∇XY is the tangential projection of the ambient directional derivative DXY.

concept.title: First-order Sobolev vector fields on an embedded surface
concept.description: Vector fields with square-integrable components and square-integrable first weak surface derivatives, defined using smooth charts and the surface measure; tangent Sobolev fields additionally lie in each tangent plane almost everywhere.

concept.title: Pullback of a scalar or ambient-valued function between surfaces
concept.description: For a diffeomorphism Φ:M→N, the pullback of f:N→V is Φ*f=f∘Φ. This is composition of functions, not the derivative-based pullback of tangent vector fields.

concept.title: Bochner connection Laplacian on tangent vector fields
concept.description: The rough or connection Laplacian ∇*∇ on tangent vector fields, defined from covariant differentiation and its formal L² adjoint. In the selected surface problem it is the weak operator associated to the squared norm of the tangential covariant derivative, not the Hodge Laplacian on differential forms.

concept.title: Convergence of Tikhonov regularization under surface perturbation
concept.description: For a bounded linear tangent-field inverse operator and its bounded linear ambient approximations on uniformly regular parametrized surfaces with C² surface error γ→0, transported operator error ρ→0 and data error δ→0, minimize squared data discrepancy plus normal-component penalty plus α times the squared first-order surface seminorm. Under weakly lower semicontinuous convex penalties with weakly sequentially compact level sets and existence of a seminorm-minimizing exact tangent solution, α→0 and (ρ²+γ²+δ²)/α→0 imply that weak cluster points of the pulled-back minimizers are seminorm-minimizing solutions.

concept.title: Probability mass function on a finite set
concept.description: A function p from a finite set Ω to [0,1] satisfying ∑_{ω∈Ω}p(ω)=1; the probability of A⊆Ω is ∑_{ω∈A}p(ω).

concept.title: Real exponential function
concept.description: The real function exp(x)=∑_{n≥0}xⁿ/n!, whose series converges for every real x.

concept.title: Natural logarithm
concept.description: The inverse ln:(0,∞)→ℝ of the real exponential function.

concept.title: Product distribution on a finite product space
concept.description: For probability mass functions p_i on finite sets Ω_i, the product distribution on ∏_iΩ_i assigns (ω_i)_i the probability ∏_ip_i(ω_i).

concept.title: Marginal distribution on a finite product space
concept.description: The marginal on a set of coordinates is obtained by summing the joint mass over all other coordinates.

concept.title: Conditional probability given an event
concept.description: If P(B)>0, the conditional probability of A given B is P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B).

concept.title: Total variation distance between finite probability distributions
concept.description: For probability mass functions p,q on the same finite set, d_TV(p,q)=½∑_ω|p(ω)−q(ω)|=sup_A|p(A)−q(A)|.

concept.title: Shannon entropy of a finite distribution
concept.description: For a finite probability mass function p, H(p)=−∑_ωp(ω)ln p(ω), with 0ln0=0.

concept.title: Relative entropy of finite probability distributions
concept.description: D(p∥q)=∑_ωp(ω)ln(p(ω)/q(ω)), with a positive p(ω) and zero q(ω) giving +∞ and zero p terms contributing zero.

concept.title: Gibbs distribution on a finite configuration space
concept.description: For a finite set Ω, energy H:Ω→ℝ and inverse temperature β≥0, the Gibbs distribution is μ(σ)=exp(−βH(σ))/Z, where Z=∑_{τ∈Ω}exp(−βH(τ)).

concept.title: Partition function of a finite Gibbs model
concept.description: The normalizing sum Z=∑_σ exp(−βH(σ)); equivalently Z=∑_σ∏_aψ_a(σ) for positive factor weights. Its logarithm records the model’s free energy up to normalization.

concept.title: Undirected multigraph
concept.description: A vertex set and an edge set, with two unordered endpoints assigned to each edge; distinct edges can have the same endpoints and loops are allowed.

concept.title: Bipartite multigraph
concept.description: An undirected multigraph whose vertices are partitioned into two classes and whose edges join opposite classes.

concept.title: Path in an undirected graph
concept.description: A finite sequence of adjacent edges joining successive vertices; a simple path has no repeated vertex. Its length is the number of edges.

concept.title: Graph distance
concept.description: The distance between two vertices is the minimum length of a path joining them, or infinity if no such path exists.

concept.title: Girth of a graph
concept.description: The length of a shortest cycle, with girth infinity for an acyclic graph. In a multigraph a loop has length one and two parallel edges form a cycle of length two.

concept.title: Finite factor graph
concept.description: A finite bipartite graph with variable nodes, factor nodes, and a nonnegative function at each factor depending on its adjacent variables. Multiplying the factor functions gives the weight of an assignment.

concept.title: Configuration model for a prescribed degree sequence
concept.description: Attach the prescribed number of half-edges to each vertex and match half-edges uniformly at random; collapsing each half-edge bundle gives a random multigraph with those degrees. Bipartite typed versions match compatible half-edge classes.

concept.title: Ising model on a finite graph
concept.description: Spins σ_v∈{−1,+1} receive Gibbs weight exp(β∑_{uv∈E}J_{uv}σ_uσ_v+∑_vh_vσ_v), for specified couplings and external fields.

concept.title: Potts model on a finite graph
concept.description: A finite-state spin at every vertex receives Gibbs weight determined by whether adjacent spins agree; the antiferromagnetic model penalizes agreement.

concept.title: Uniform random k-SAT model
concept.description: A Boolean formula on n variables formed by m independent clauses, each uniformly chosen from the 2ᵏ·binomial(n,k) clauses containing k distinct variables, each independently negated or unnegated.

concept.title: Conditional expectation given a σ-algebra
concept.description: For integrable X and a sub-σ-algebra G, E[X|G] is a G-measurable integrable random variable satisfying ∫_AE[X|G]dP=∫_AXdP for every A∈G, defined up to almost-sure equality.

concept.title: Conditional variance
concept.description: For square-integrable X, Var(X|G)=E[(X−E[X|G])²|G]=E[X²|G]−E[X|G]².

concept.title: Convex function on a real interval
concept.description: A real function φ on an interval I is convex if φ(tx+(1−t)y)≤tφ(x)+(1−t)φ(y) for x,y∈I and 0≤t≤1.

concept.title: Partition of a set
concept.description: A family of nonempty pairwise disjoint subsets whose union is the set.

concept.title: Totally bounded metric space
concept.description: A metric space is totally bounded if for every ε>0 it is covered by finitely many open balls of radius ε.

concept.title: Law of total variance
concept.description: For square-integrable X and sub-σ-algebra G, Var(X)=E[Var(X|G)]+Var(E[X|G]).

concept.title: Discrete-time martingale
concept.description: An integrable process (M_n) adapted to an increasing sequence of σ-algebras (F_n) such that E[M_{n+1}|F_n]=M_n almost surely.

concept.title: Bounded martingale convergence theorem
concept.description: A martingale uniformly bounded by a deterministic constant converges almost surely and in L¹. In particular, conditional expectations of a bounded X along increasing σ-algebras converge to E[X|σ(∪_nF_n)].

concept.title: Azuma–Hoeffding inequality
concept.description: If a real martingale has increments bounded in absolute value by c_i, then P(|M_n−M_0|≥t)≤2exp(−t²/(2∑_{i=1}^nc_i²)) for t>0.

concept.title: Chernoff bound for sums of independent Bernoulli variables
concept.description: If S is a sum of independent Bernoulli variables with mean μ, then for δ>0, P(S≥(1+δ)μ)≤[e^δ/(1+δ)^(1+δ)]^μ; for 0<δ<1, P(S≤(1−δ)μ)≤exp(−μδ²/2).

concept.title: Paley–Zygmund inequality
concept.description: For nonnegative X with 0<E[X²]<∞ and 0<θ<1, P(X>θEX)≥(1−θ)²(EX)²/E[X²].

concept.title: Jensen’s inequality for expectations
concept.description: For an integrable real random variable X and convex φ with E|φ(X)|<∞, φ(EX)≤Eφ(X), when φ is defined on an interval containing the range of X.

concept.title: Stirling’s formula
Rooted locally finite graph
concept.description: A connected graph with a distinguished root and finitely many incident edges at every vertex; finite-radius rooted neighborhoods retain their induced graph structure.

concept.title: Local weak convergence of bounded-degree graphs
concept.description: A bounded-degree graph sequence converges locally to a random rooted graph if, for each finite radius and rooted neighborhood type, the proportion of vertices with that neighborhood converges to the corresponding root-neighborhood probability. For random graphs this convergence may be in probability.

concept.title: Weak convergence of probability measures on a metric space
concept.description: Measures μ_n converge weakly to μ if ∫f dμ_n→∫f dμ for every bounded continuous real function f on the space.

concept.title: Polish space
concept.description: A topological space admitting a complete separable metric that induces its topology.

concept.title: Bethe free energy of factor-graph marginals
concept.description: For consistent variable and factor marginals p_x,p_a, the Bethe log-partition functional is ∑_a[H(p_a)+E_{p_a}lnψ_a]−∑_x(d_x−1)H(p_x). On a limiting rooted factor-tree law one uses the corresponding expected local terms, normalized per variable node.

concept.title: Size-biased change of measure
concept.description: Given a probability measure P and a nonnegative random variable W with 0<E_PW<∞, the W-biased measure is Q(A)=E_P[W·1_A]/E_PW; equivalently dQ/dP=W/E_PW.

concept.title: Non-reconstruction for Gibbs measures on sparse graphs
concept.description: The spin at a typical vertex becomes asymptotically independent of a randomly sampled distant boundary condition, measured by the expected total variation change of its conditional marginal as the boundary radius tends to infinity.

concept.title: Decay of boundary influence for Gibbs measures on trees
concept.description: On rooted factor trees, the root marginal changes by arbitrarily little in total variation under every possible boundary condition at sufficiently large distance. This uniform condition yields uniqueness of the limiting root marginal.

concept.title: Bapst–Coja-Oghlan regularity lemma for probability measures on discrete cubes
concept.description: For finite Ω and ε>0, every measure on Ωⁿ for sufficiently large n admits coordinate and state partitions of bounded total size N(ε,Ω), refining any coordinate partition with at most 1/ε classes. Apart from total mass ε and εn exceptional coordinates, conditioning on a state makes empirical spin distributions regular on each coordinate class: all subsets of relative size at least ε have expected total variation discrepancy below ε from the full class’s empirical distribution. Within each state, empirical distributions on each class have diameter below ε; the unconditioned measure is regular as well.

concept.title: Bethe free-energy limit under local Gibbs decorrelation
concept.description: For a locally convergent sequence of bounded-degree typed factor models with finite spins and positive weights from a fixed finite family, assume every fixed short-cycle-free event has nonvanishing probability in both ordinary and locally conditioned partition-function-biased models. Let p be a consistent limiting-tree marginal assignment. If average two-variable Gibbs marginals converge in total variation to the corresponding products from p, then limsup n⁻¹ElnZ≤B(p). If the same holds in the locally conditioned partition-function-biased model, the limit equals B(p). Non-reconstruction implies the required decorrelation; uniform tree boundary-influence decay yields equality in both models.

concept.title: σ-finite measure
concept.description: A measure whose whole underlying space is a countable union of measurable sets of finite measure.

concept.title: Complete measure
concept.description: A measure is complete if every subset of a measurable null set is measurable and has measure zero.

concept.title: Product measure
concept.description: For σ-finite measure spaces, the product measure on the product σ-algebra assigns a measurable rectangle A×B the value μ(A)ν(B); its completion also includes subsets of product-null sets.

concept.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of measurable functions
concept.description: Measurable functions fₙ converge almost everywhere to f if the pointwise limit fₙ(x)→f(x) holds outside a measurable null set.

concept.title: Probability density relative to a measure
concept.description: A nonnegative measurable function P with ∫P dμ=1; the measure P dμ is the corresponding probability measure.

concept.title: Marginal density on a product measure space
concept.description: A joint density on a product space induces a marginal density by integrating out the coordinates not retained.

concept.title: Fubini’s theorem for integrable functions
concept.description: An integrable function on the product of σ-finite measure spaces has integrable almost-everywhere sections, and its product integral equals either iterated integral.

concept.title: Tonelli’s theorem for nonnegative functions
concept.description: For a nonnegative measurable function on the product of σ-finite measure spaces, the product integral equals either iterated integral, allowing∞.

concept.title: Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem
concept.description: If measurable fₙ converge almost everywhere to f and |fₙ|≤g for an integrable g, then f is integrable and ∫|fₙ−f|→0; consequently their integrals converge.

concept.title: Baire category theorem for complete metric spaces
concept.description: Every countable intersection of dense open subsets of a complete metric space is dense.

concept.title: Generalized N-mean of a kernel of order m
concept.description: For 1≤m≤N, set G_{m,N}(u)(x₁,…,x_N)=binom(N,m)⁻¹∑_{i₁<⋯<i_m}u(x_{i₁},…,x_{i_m}). Kernels need not be symmetric; equalities in measure-theoretic applications are understood almost everywhere.

concept.title: U-statistic with symmetric kernel
concept.description: For independent identically distributed observations X₁,…,X_N and a symmetric kernel u of m variables, the U-statistic is binom(N,m)⁻¹∑_{i₁<⋯<i_m}u(X_{i₁},…,X_{i_m}).

concept.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of generalized means and their kernels
concept.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, fix 1≤m≤N. A sequence G_{m,N}(uₙ) has an almost-everywhere finite limit U exactly when uₙ has an almost-everywhere finite limit u; then U=G_{m,N}(u) almost everywhere. In particular a generalized mean has a unique kernel modulo null sets.

concept.title: Measurability and essential boundedness in generalized-mean kernel recovery
concept.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, G_{m,N}(u) is measurable exactly when its almost-everywhere finite kernel u is measurable. Moreover G_{m,N}(u)∈L∞ exactly when u∈L∞, with ∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞≤∥u∥∞≤C(m,N)∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞.

concept.title: Weighted Lʳ equivalence for generalized means under a marginal lower bound
concept.description: Let P>0 be a symmetric probability density on Λᴺ over a complete nonzero σ-finite measure space. Suppose on a positive-measure set of final coordinates x_N there is γ(x_N)>0 with P(·,x_N)≥γ(x_N)P_{N−1} almost everywhere. For 1≤m≤N and 1≤r<∞, G_{m,N}(u)∈Lʳ(P) exactly when u∈Lʳ(P_m), and the two norms are comparable by constants independent of u.

concept.title: Schauder basis of a Banach space
concept.description: A sequence (eₙ) in a Banach space for which every vector x has a unique expansion x=∑ₙaₙeₙ converging in norm.

concept.title: Unconditional Schauder basis
concept.description: A Schauder basis for which each vector’s expansion converges unconditionally, equivalently converges to the same vector after every permutation of its terms.

concept.title: Block sequence relative to a Schauder basis
concept.description: A sequence of nonzero finitely supported vectors xₙ such that max supp(xₙ)<min supp(xₙ₊₁); its closed linear span is a block subspace.

concept.title: Strictly singular bounded operator
concept.description: A bounded linear operator whose restriction to no infinite-dimensional closed subspace is an isomorphism onto its image, equivalently is bounded below on no such subspace.

concept.title: Diagonal bounded operator relative to a Schauder basis
concept.description: A bounded linear operator D satisfying Deₙ=λₙeₙ for a fixed Schauder basis (eₙ).

concept.title: Tight-by-support Schauder basis
concept.description: A Schauder basis is tight by support if no two infinite-dimensional closed subspaces with disjoint coordinate supports are isomorphic as Banach spaces.

concept.title: Hereditarily indecomposable Banach space
concept.description: An infinite-dimensional Banach space in which no infinite-dimensional closed subspace is a topological direct sum of two infinite-dimensional closed subspaces.

concept.title: Spreading model generated by a basic sequence
concept.description: A basic sequence (xₙ) generates (ẽₙ) as a spreading model when for each finite scalar list (aᵢ), the asymptotic limits of ∥∑ᵢaᵢx_{nᵢ}∥ as the ordered indices move to infinity equal ∥∑ᵢaᵢẽᵢ∥.

concept.title: Schlumprecht’s arbitrarily distortable Banach space
concept.description: The completion of c₀₀ in the least norm satisfying ∥x∥=max{∥x∥∞,sup_{n≥2}(log₂(n+1))⁻¹ sup_{E₁<⋯<Eₙ}∑ᵢ∥Eᵢx∥}, where Eᵢ are successive finite coordinate sets. Its unit vector basis is unconditional and subsymmetric.

concept.title: Gowers’s unconditional space from the hyperplane construction
concept.description: The Banach space X_U from Gowers’s 1994 construction, obtained by completing c₀₀ in a norm combining Schlumprecht-type successive-coordinate averages and specially coded functionals using absolute coordinate data. Its unit vector basis is unconditional and tight by support; admissible coding data are fixed in the construction.

concept.title: ℓ₁ block average in a Banach space with basis
concept.description: An ℓ₁ⁿ average with constant c≥1 is x=n⁻¹(x₁+⋯+xₙ), where the xᵢ are successive block vectors with ∥xᵢ∥≤1 and ∥x∥≥1/c.

concept.title: Failure of diagonal-plus-strictly-singular decomposition on a Gowers-space subspace
concept.description: There is a closed subspace Y of Gowers’s unconditional space X_U and a bounded operator T:Y→X_U which cannot be written D|Y+S with D a bounded diagonal operator on X_U and S strictly singular.

concept.title: Subsequential diagonal decomposition in tight-by-support spaces
concept.description: If X has a tight-by-support unconditional basis, (xₙ) is a seminormalized weakly null sequence in X and T:[xₙ]→X is bounded, then some subsequence (xₙ)_{n∈M} satisfies T|[xₙ:n∈M]=D|[xₙ:n∈M]+S, with D a bounded diagonal operator on X and S strictly singular.

concept.title: Complex exponential function
concept.description: The entire function exp(z)=∑ₙ₌₀∞zⁿ/n!; on imaginary arguments exp(it)=cos(t)+i sin(t).

concept.title: Complex *-algebra, possibly nonunital
concept.description: A complex vector space with associative bilinear multiplication and a conjugate-linear involution a↦a* satisfying (ab)*=b*a*. A multiplicative identity is not required.

concept.title: C*-algebra
concept.description: A complex *-algebra with a complete submultiplicative norm satisfying ∥a*a∥=∥a∥²; an identity is not required.

concept.title: Positive element and order in a C*-algebra
concept.description: An element is positive if it has the form b*b. For self-adjoint a,b, write a≤b when b−a is positive.

concept.title: Positive square root in a C*-algebra
concept.description: Every positive element a of a C*-algebra has a unique positive element b with b²=a. For any a, its absolute value is |a|=(a*a)¹ᐟ².

concept.title: Right module over a complex algebra
concept.description: A complex vector space X with a bilinear action X×A→X satisfying (xa)b=x(ab); for a unital algebra the action is taken to satisfy x1=x.

concept.title: Semi-inner-product C*-module
concept.description: A right module X over a C*-algebra A with an A-valued form ⟨x,y⟩, complex linear and A-linear in y, conjugate symmetric, additive in each argument, and satisfying ⟨x,x⟩≥0. Zero length need not imply x=0; this is not the nonsymmetric semi-inner product used in Banach-space geometry.

concept.title: Inner-product C*-module
concept.description: A semi-inner-product C*-module with ⟨x,x⟩=0 only for x=0. Its norm is ∥x∥=∥⟨x,x⟩∥¹ᐟ²; completeness is not assumed.

concept.title: Hilbert C*-module
concept.description: An inner-product C*-module complete in the norm induced by its C*-algebra-valued inner product.

concept.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for semi-inner-product C*-modules
concept.description: For x,y in a semi-inner-product C*-module, |⟨x,y⟩|²≤∥⟨x,x⟩∥⟨y,y⟩ in the order on the coefficient C*-algebra.

concept.title: Positive linear functional on a C*-algebra
concept.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for every a∈A.

concept.title: Spectral radius in a complex Banach algebra
concept.description: For an element a of a complex Banach algebra, its spectral radius is sup{|λ|:λ belongs to the spectrum of a}, using the unitization when the algebra has no identity.

concept.title: Grüss inequality for bounded real functions
concept.description: If m≤f≤M and n≤g≤N almost everywhere on [a,b], with a<b, then the absolute difference between the average of fg and the product of the averages of f and g is at most (M−m)(N−n)/4. The constant 1/4 is optimal.

concept.title: Vector-valued discrete Fourier transform
concept.description: For x₀,…,xₙ₋₁ in a complex vector space, its discrete Fourier transform has components ∑ₖ₌₀ⁿ⁻¹exp(−2πimk/n)xₖ, m=0,…,n−1. Sign and scalar normalization conventions may vary.

concept.title: Grüss inequality for finite families in semi-inner-product C*-modules
concept.description: Let pᵢ≥0 sum to one, and let xᵢ,yᵢ lie in a semi-inner-product C*-module with ∥xᵢ−a∥≤r and ∥yᵢ−b∥≤s. Then ∥∑pᵢ⟨xᵢ,yᵢ⟩−⟨∑pᵢxᵢ,∑pᵢyᵢ⟩∥≤rs; the constant one is optimal.

concept.title: Compact topological space
concept.description: A topological space in which every open cover has a finite subcover.

concept.title: Absolute continuity of measures
concept.description: A measure ν is absolutely continuous with respect to μ on the same σ-algebra if μ(A)=0 implies ν(A)=0.

concept.title: Radon–Nikodym derivative of a measure
concept.description: A nonnegative measurable function f representing ν relative to μ by ν(A)=∫_A f dμ for every measurable A; it is defined up to μ-almost-everywhere equality when such a density exists.

concept.title: Real polynomial in finitely many variables
concept.description: A finite real linear combination of monomials x₁^{a₁}⋯x_d^{a_d} with nonnegative integer exponents.

concept.title: Convex body in Euclidean space
concept.description: A compact convex subset of ℝᵈ with nonempty interior.

concept.title: Star body about the origin
concept.description: A compact set star shaped about 0 whose radial function ρ(u)=max{t≥0:tu∈K} on the unit sphere is positive and continuous.

concept.title: Support function of a convex body
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, h_K(u)=max{x·u:x∈K}; it may be restricted to the unit sphere or extended positively homogeneously to ℝᵈ.

concept.title: Minkowski sum of subsets of a vector space
concept.description: For subsets A,B of a vector space, A+B={a+b:a∈A,b∈B}.

concept.title: Hausdorff distance between compact sets
concept.description: For nonempty compact sets A,B in a metric space, d_H(A,B) is the maximum of sup_{a∈A}inf_{b∈B}d(a,b) and sup_{b∈B}inf_{a∈A}d(a,b).

concept.title: Banach–Mazur distance between origin-symmetric convex bodies
concept.description: For origin-symmetric convex bodies K,L⊂ℝᵈ, d_BM(K,L)=inf{t≥1:L⊆TK⊆tL for an invertible linear map T}.

concept.title: Surface area measure of a convex body
concept.description: The measure S_K on the unit sphere assigning a Borel set of directions the boundary area of points of K whose outer unit normal lies in that set; points with nonunique normals form a boundary-area null set.

concept.title: Curvature function of a convex body
concept.description: When the surface area measure S_K is absolutely continuous with respect to spherical area measure, its Radon–Nikodym density f_K is called the curvature function.

concept.title: Projection body of a convex body
concept.description: The origin-symmetric convex body ΠK whose support function at a unit vector u is the (d−1)-dimensional volume of the orthogonal projection of K onto u⊥.

concept.title: Cauchy’s projection formula for convex bodies
concept.description: For a convex body K and unit u, the volume of K projected onto u⊥ equals ½∫|u·v| dS_K(v).

concept.title: Intersection body of a star body
concept.description: The star body IK with radial function ρ_IK(u) equal to the (d−1)-dimensional volume of K∩u⊥.

concept.title: Zonoid
concept.description: A compact convex set that is a Hausdorff limit of finite Minkowski sums of line segments.

concept.title: Mixed volume of convex bodies
concept.description: The symmetric coefficient V(K₁,…,K_d) in the homogeneous degree-d volume polynomial |∑tᵢKᵢ| for nonnegative scalars tᵢ, normalized by V(K,…,K)=|K|.

concept.title: Quermassintegral of a convex body
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, W_i(K)=V(K[d−i],B₂ᵈ[i]), where brackets denote repeated arguments and B₂ᵈ is the unit Euclidean ball.

concept.title: Projection body associated with a quermassintegral
concept.description: For 0≤i≤d−2, Π_iK is the convex body with support function h_{Π_iK}(u)=W_i(K|u⊥), where the quermassintegral is taken in the (d−1)-dimensional space u⊥.

concept.title: Aleksandrov–Fenchel inequality for mixed volumes
concept.description: For convex bodies K₁,…,K_d⊂ℝᵈ, V(K₁,K₂,K₃,…,K_d)²≥V(K₁,K₁,K₃,…,K_d)V(K₂,K₂,K₃,…,K_d).

concept.title: Spherical harmonic
concept.description: The restriction to the unit sphere in ℝᵈ of a homogeneous polynomial annihilated by the Euclidean Laplacian. Its degree is the degree of that polynomial.

concept.title: Normalized spherical Radon transform
concept.description: For a function f on S^{d−1}, Rf(u) is its average over the equatorial sphere S^{d−1}∩u⊥; the normalization gives R1=1.

concept.title: Schneider’s projection-functional monotonicity theorem
concept.description: For a full-dimensional convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, set P(K)=|ΠK|/|K|^{d−1}. Then P(K)≥P(ΠK), with equality exactly when K is homothetic to Π²K.

concept.title: Local attraction of the ball under projection-body iteration
concept.description: For each d≥3 there is ε_d>0 such that if a convex body K has absolutely continuous surface area measure and ∥f_{TK}−1∥∞<ε_d for some invertible linear T, then ΠᵐK converges to the Euclidean ball up to linear equivalence, in Banach–Mazur distance.

concept.title: Local strict minimum in Petty’s conjectured projection inequality
concept.description: For each d≥3 there is ε_d>0 such that a nonellipsoidal convex body K with absolutely continuous surface area measure and ∥f_{TK}−1∥∞<ε_d for some invertible linear T satisfies |ΠK|/|K|^{d−1}>|ΠB₂ᵈ|/|B₂ᵈ|^{d−1}.

concept.title: Saroglou–Zvavitch refinement of Lutwak’s quermassintegral inequality
concept.description: For every convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, d≥3, W_{d−2}(Π_{d−2}K)≥[d(d−2)ω_{d−1}²/((d−1)²ω_d)]W_{d−1}(K)²+[ω_{d−1}²/(d−1)²]W_{d−2}(K), where ω_j is the j-dimensional unit ball volume. Equality holds for balls; the inequality is strict for bodies that are not centrally symmetric.

concept.title: Compact set star shaped about the origin
concept.description: A nonempty compact set K⊂ℝⁿ such that [0,x]⊆K for every x∈K. It need not be convex, have interior, or have a continuous positive radial function.

concept.title: Support function of a nonempty compact Euclidean set
concept.description: For nonempty compact K⊂ℝⁿ, h_K(u)=max{x·u:x∈K}; this equals the support function of its convex hull.

concept.title: Mean support function on the unit sphere
concept.description: For nonempty compact K⊂ℝⁿ, M*(K)=∫_{S^{n−1}}h_K(u)dσ(u), with σ normalized to total mass one. This is half the mean width under the convention that width in direction u is h_K(u)+h_K(−u).

concept.title: Reflection in a linear hyperplane in Euclidean space
concept.description: For a unit vector u, reflection in u⊥ is R_u(x)=x−2(x·u)u.

concept.title: Minkowski symmetrization of a Euclidean set
concept.description: For K⊂ℝⁿ and a unit u, M_u(K)=½(K+R_uK), where R_u is reflection in u⊥.

concept.title: ε-net of a subset of a metric space
concept.description: A set N is an ε-net of A if every point of A is within distance ε of some point of N. Unless specified otherwise, N need not be a subset of A.

concept.title: Klartag’s quantitative Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concept.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact convex set K⊂ℝⁿ with M*(K)=M₀, at most cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M₀B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M₀B₂ⁿ, for a universal c.

concept.title: Florentin–Segal quantitative symmetrization theorem for star-shaped sets
concept.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact set K⊂ℝⁿ star shaped about 0, at most Cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for a universal C.

concept.title: Special linear group SL₂(ℤ)
concept.description: The group of2×2 integer matrices [[a,b],[c,d]] satisfying ad−bc=1, with matrix multiplication.

concept.title: Congruence subgroup of SL₂(ℤ)
concept.description: A subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) containing Γ(N)={M:M≡I moduloN} for some positive integer N.

concept.title: Congruence subgroup Γ₁(N)
concept.description: The subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) whose matrices [[a,b],[c,d]] satisfy a≡d≡1 and c≡0 moduloN.

concept.title: Modular form of integer weight on a congruence subgroup
concept.description: A holomorphic function f on the upper half-plane satisfying f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)^k f(τ) for matrices in a specified congruence subgroup, and holomorphic at every cusp.

concept.title: Weight-k slash operator on the upper half-plane
concept.description: For γ=[[a,b],[c,d]]∈SL₂(ℤ), (f|ₖγ)(τ)=(cτ+d)^{-k}f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d)).

concept.title: Almost holomorphic modular form
concept.description: For a specified congruence subgroup and integer weight k, a function obeying the scalar modular weight-k transformation, polynomial in 1/Im(τ) with holomorphic coefficients and of at most polynomial growth in Im(τ) after normalization at every cusp. This is the almost holomorphic convention called nearly holomorphic by Larson, and excludes cusp poles.

concept.title: Quasimodular form
concept.description: A holomorphic function whose weight-k modular transformation differs by a finite polynomial in c/(cτ+d), with holomorphic coefficient functions and the required cusp-growth conditions; equivalently the holomorphic part of an almost holomorphic modular form.

concept.title: Classical Jacobi form
concept.description: For an integer weight k and integer index m≥0, a holomorphic function φ(τ,z) on H×C with φ((aτ+b)/(cτ+d),z/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)^k exp(2πimcz²/(cτ+d))φ(τ,z) for γ in a specified congruence subgroup, φ(τ,z+rτ+s)=exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz))φ(τ,z), and Fourier support 4mn−ℓ²≥0 at every cusp. This is the scalar trivial-multiplier convention.

concept.title: Almost holomorphic Jacobi form
concept.description: For integer weight k and nonnegative integer index m, a function with the scalar Jacobi modular and elliptic transformations, polynomial in 1/(τ−τ̄) and (z−z̄)/(τ−τ̄) with holomorphic coefficients, and satisfying |φ(τ,z)|≤C·Im(τ)^N exp(2πm Im(z)²/Im(τ)) in a Jacobi translation strip after each cusp normalization.

concept.title: Jacobi theta function
concept.description: The holomorphic series θ(τ,z)=∑_{n∈ℤ}exp(πin²τ+2πinz) for Im(τ)>0; this specifies the zero-characteristic theta convention.

concept.title: Complex partial derivative
concept.description: The complex derivative in one coordinate of a function of several complex variables, holding the other coordinates fixed.

concept.title: Dedekind eta function
concept.description: For Im(τ)>0 and q=exp(2πiτ), η(τ)=exp(πiτ/12)∏_(n≥1)(1−qⁿ). The explicit exponential prefactor specifies the meaning of q^(1/24) without choosing a complex root.

concept.title: Infinite q-Pochhammer symbol
Rose’s generalized sum-of-divisor functions
concept.description: For a positive integer n,a set S⊆{1,…,n} stable under negation modulo n,and k≥1, A_{S,n,k}(q)=∑_{0<m₁<⋯<mₖ, mᵢ mod n∈S}q^{m₁+⋯+mₖ}/∏ᵢ(1−q^{mᵢ})² for∣q∣<1.

concept.title: Multinomial theorem
concept.description: For commuting variables,(x₁+⋯+xᵣ)^n=∑_{n₁+⋯+nᵣ=n}n!/(n₁!⋯nᵣ!)x₁^{n₁}⋯xᵣ^{nᵣ}, summing over nonnegative indices.

concept.title: Larson’s Γ₁(n) level theorem for generalized divisor sums
concept.description: For every symmetric residue set S modulo n and k≥1, Rose’s A_{S,n,k} is a quasimodular form of mixed weight at most2k on Γ₁(n).

concept.title: Positional base-b expansion of a nonnegative integer
concept.description: For an integer base b≥2, write x=∑_{i=0}^{n−1}aᵢbⁱ with digits0≤aᵢ<b and a nonzero leading digit when x>0;0 has the zero expansion.

concept.title: Digit-power sum map
concept.description: For base b≥2 and integer e≥1, S_{e,b}(x) is the sum of the e-th powers of the base-b digits of the positive integer x.

concept.title: Iteration of a self-map
concept.description: For f:X→X, define f⁰=id_X and f^{n+1}=f∘fⁿ for natural n.

concept.title: Generalized happy number
concept.description: A positive integer x is happy for base b and exponent e if some iterate of the digit-power map S_{e,b} sends x to1; ordinary happy numbers have b=10 and e=2.

concept.title: Attraction height for a digit-power sum map
concept.description: For fixed b,e and target u, the attraction height of x is the least h≥0 with S_{e,b}^h(x)=u, when such an h exists.

concept.title: Smallest integer of a specified digit-power attraction height
concept.description: For fixed b,e,u and h, σ_h(u) is the least positive integer whose first hit of u under S_{e,b} occurs at exactly h iterations, when this set is nonempty.

concept.title: Asymptotic density of a subset of the positive integers
concept.description: For S⊆ℕ₊, its asymptotic density is lim_{N→∞}|S∩{1,…,N}|/N when this limit exists.

concept.title: Waring number g(k)
concept.description: For k≥1, g(k) is the least s such that every nonnegative integer is a sum of s nonnegative integer k-th powers, allowing zero summands.

concept.title: Hilbert–Waring theorem
concept.description: For every positive integer k, the Waring number g(k) is finite.

concept.title: Mei–Read-McFarland recurrence for large minimal attracted numbers
concept.description: Fix b≥2 and e≥1. There is an explicit threshold M(b,e) such that, whenever the exact-height minima σ_h(u),σ_{h+1}(u) exist and σ_h(u) exceeds M(b,e), S_{e,b}(σ_{h+1}(u))=σ_h(u). The paper gives a threshold on the size of σ_h(u), not a uniform threshold on h.

concept.title: Stochastic transition matrix
concept.description: A square real matrix P with nonnegative entries and row sums one; P(x,y) is the one-step transition probability from x to y.

concept.title: Time-homogeneous Markov chain on a finite state space
concept.description: A sequence of random states in a finite set whose conditional next-state distribution given its whole past depends only on the present state, through one fixed stochastic transition matrix.

concept.title: Stationary distribution of a finite Markov chain
concept.description: A probability row vector π satisfying πP=π for the chain’s transition matrix P.

concept.title: Irreducible finite Markov chain
concept.description: A finite Markov chain is irreducible if for any states x,y some number of steps n has Pⁿ(x,y)>0.

concept.title: Aperiodic finite Markov chain
concept.description: A state has period equal to the gcd of its possible positive return times. An irreducible chain is aperiodic when this common period is one.

concept.title: Detailed balance for a finite Markov chain
concept.description: A positive probability vector π satisfies detailed balance for P if π(x)P(x,y)=π(y)P(y,x) for every pair of states.

concept.title: Reversible finite Markov chain
concept.description: A finite Markov chain with a positive stationary distribution π satisfying detailed balance; under π its finite path laws are invariant under reversal of time.

concept.title: Filtration of σ-algebras
concept.description: An increasing family (F_t) of sub-σ-algebras on a fixed probability space, indexed by ordered time: F_s⊆F_t for s≤t.

concept.title: Stopping time for a filtration
concept.description: A random time T taking values in the time index together with infinity, such that {T≤t}∈F_t for every t; by time t one can determine whether T has occurred.

concept.title: Uniform distribution on the unit interval
concept.description: The real probability law on [0,1] whose probability of an interval [a,b]⊆[0,1] is b−a.

concept.title: Randomized stopping time
concept.description: A stopping time after the process filtration has been enlarged by auxiliary randomization independent of the original process.

concept.title: Hitting time of a set for a Markov chain
concept.description: For A in the state space, T_A=inf{t≥0:X_t∈A}, with infinity if A is never visited. The starting state or initial law is specified separately.

concept.title: Coupling of finite probability distributions
concept.description: A joint probability distribution on a product of finite state spaces whose marginals are the specified distributions.

concept.title: Maximal coupling of finite probability distributions
concept.description: A coupling (X,Y) of p and q with P(X≠Y)=d_TV(p,q), attaining the smallest possible disagreement probability.

concept.title: Strong stationary time of a Markov chain
concept.description: A randomized stopping time T such that X_T has the stationary distribution and is independent of T.

concept.title: Separation distance from a positive finite distribution
concept.description: For a probability mass function p and a strictly positive π, sep(p,π)=max_x(1−p(x)/π(x)). It is generally not symmetric.

concept.title: Total variation mixing time
concept.description: For a finite chain and chosen initial law, t_mix(ε)=inf{t:d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤ε}. Worst-case mixing time takes the maximum over starting states.

concept.title: Total variation cutoff for a family of finite Markov chains
concept.description: For chosen initial laws, a family has cutoff at t_N if d_N(ct_N)→1 for every 0<c<1 and d_N(ct_N)→0 for every c>1, where d_N is distance to stationarity.

concept.title: Cutoff window in total variation
concept.description: A scale w_N=o(t_N) is a cutoff window if lim_{γ→∞}liminf_N d_N(t_N−γw_N)=1 and lim_{γ→∞}limsup_N d_N(t_N+γw_N)=0, with integer times rounded in discrete time.

concept.title: Finite birth-and-death chain
concept.description: A finite Markov chain on {0,…,N} that can move only to neighboring states or remain at its current state; continuous-time versions have jump rates only between neighbors.

concept.title: Stochastically monotone Markov kernel
concept.description: On a partially ordered finite state space, P is monotone if Pf is increasing whenever f is increasing, equivalently P(x,·) is stochastically dominated by P(y,·) whenever x≤y.

concept.title: Halting set for total variation mixing
concept.description: For a Markov chain with specified initial distribution, a set A is halting for total variation if d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤P(T_A>t) for every t≥0.

concept.title: Eigenvalue of a linear endomorphism
concept.description: A scalar λ for which a linear endomorphism T has a nonzero vector v with Tv=λv.

concept.title: Spectral gap of a reversible finite Markov chain
concept.description: For an irreducible reversible transition matrix with eigenvalues 1=λ₀>λ₁≥⋯, its spectral gap is 1−λ₁; the absolute spectral gap instead uses max_{i≥1}|λ_i|.

concept.title: Killed transition matrix of a finite Markov chain
concept.description: For a set A, retain the submatrix P_{Aᶜ,Aᶜ}; missing row mass records killing when the chain enters A. Its powers give survival transition probabilities before hitting A.

concept.title: Time-homogeneous continuous-time Markov chain on a finite set
concept.description: A right-continuous jump process on a finite state space whose future conditional law depends only on its current state and elapsed time. Its transition matrices form a semigroup.

concept.title: Generator of a finite continuous-time Markov chain
concept.description: The real matrix Q with Q(x,y)=lim_{h↓0}(P_h(x,y)−1_{x=y})/h, nonnegative off-diagonal entries and zero row sums; off-diagonal entries are jump rates.

concept.title: Matrix exponential
concept.description: For a finite square real or complex matrix A, exp(A)=∑_{n≥0}Aⁿ/n!, with convergence in any matrix norm.

concept.title: Sequence of orthogonal polynomials
concept.description: A sequence of real polynomials of successive degrees, orthogonal under ∫p(x)q(x)dμ(x) for a specified positive measure with the necessary finite moments.

concept.title: Gilbert–Shannon–Reeds riffle shuffle
concept.description: Split a deck at a binomially chosen position and interleave the two packets uniformly while preserving each packet’s internal order. Repeating gives a Markov chain on permutations.

concept.title: Ehrenfest urn chain
concept.description: A chain tracking the number of particles in one of two urns when particles switch urns, equivalently the number of ones in a collection of two-state coordinates. Discrete and continuous rates must be specified.

concept.title: Bernoulli–Laplace urn chain
concept.description: Two urns hold fixed numbers of red and black balls; choose one ball uniformly in each urn and swap them. The number of red balls in one urn is a birth-and-death chain.

concept.title: Aldous–Diaconis optimal strong stationary time theorem
concept.description: For an irreducible aperiodic finite Markov chain with positive stationary law, there exists a strong stationary time T with P(T>n)=sep(Law(X_n),π) for every n; any strong stationary time has tail at least this separation distance.

concept.title: Griffeath’s maximal coupling theorem for Markov chains
concept.description: Finite Markov chains with the same transition kernel can be coupled so that their coalescence time T satisfies P(T>n)=d_TV(Law(X_n),Law(Y_n)) for every n. Such a coupling need not be co-adapted.

concept.title: Coquio’s total variation halting-set criterion
concept.description: For a finite Markov chain with stationary law π and specified initial law, the set M={x:Law(X_t)(x)≤π(x) for every t≥0} is halting: d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤P(T_M>t). The empty set gives only the trivial bound.

concept.title: Coquio’s cutoff criterion from a concentrated halting time
concept.description: For a family of finite irreducible reversible chains with halting sets A_N and irreducible aperiodic killed kernels, let m_N=ET_{A_N}→∞, s_N²=Var(T_{A_N}), and λ_N the largest killed-kernel eigenvalue. If s_N=o(m_N) and (1−λ_N)m_N→∞, there is total variation cutoff at m_N. If also liminf(1−λ_N)s_N>0, s_N is a cutoff window.

concept.title: Middle halting states of symmetric birth-and-death chains
concept.description: For an irreducible symmetric monotone discrete-time birth-and-death chain on {0,…,2N+1} started at0, N+1 is halting for total variation. For a symmetric continuous-time irreducible birth-and-death chain on {0,…,N} started at0, ceil(N/2) is halting. Symmetry means reflection invariance of transition probabilities or jump rates.

concept.title: Geometric distribution on positive integers
concept.description: For 0<p≤1, P(G=k)=p(1−p)^(k−1) for k=1,2,…; G counts trials up to and including the first success. Its tail is P(G>k)=(1−p)^k.

concept.title: Binomial distribution
concept.description: The law of the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli(p) trials: P(B=k)=binom(n,k)p^k(1−p)^(n−k),0≤k≤n.

concept.title: Absolute spectral gap of a finite Markov chain
concept.description: For an irreducible finite transition matrix P, the absolute spectral gap is 1−max{|λ|:λ≠1 is an eigenvalue of P}. Unlike 1−λ₂ for a reversible chain, this definition allows complex eigenvalues and nonreversibility.

concept.title: Doubly stochastic matrix
concept.description: A square real matrix with nonnegative entries and every row and column summing to one. The uniform probability vector is stationary.

concept.title: With high probability in an asymptotic random model
concept.description: An event A_n holds with high probability if P(A_n)→1 as n→∞. Also called asymptotically almost surely; this does not itself assert almost-sure eventual occurrence on a common probability space.

concept.title: Big O notation
concept.description: The assertion f=O(g) along a specified limit means |f(x)|≤C|g(x)| near that limit for a fixed finite C. Subscripts specify allowed dependence on fixed parameters. For sequences use x=n→∞.

concept.title: Little o notation
concept.description: The assertion f=o(g) along a specified limit means f(x)/g(x)→0, where g is nonzero near that limit. Sequences are the instance x=n→∞.

concept.title: Asymptotic equivalence
concept.description: The assertion f∼g along a specified limit means f(x)/g(x)→1, where g is nonzero near that limit. Sequences are the instance x=n→∞.

concept.title: Cycle graph
concept.description: The finite graph C_n,n≥3,whose vertices can be arranged cyclically so that each is joined to its predecessor and successor.

concept.title: Pure drift chain on uniformly rewired cycle arcs
concept.description: Cut a directed cycle at k uniformly chosen distinct edges into arcs. Along each remaining arc the chain moves deterministically forward; at an arc endpoint it chooses the start of one of the k arcs uniformly. Equivalently one can begin with k independent positive geometric arc lengths and then condition their sum to obtain a fixed-size model.

concept.title: Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling
concept.description: Use a Markov chain with a prescribed stationary distribution to generate dependent approximate samples from that distribution,with ergodic averages used to estimate expectations.

concept.title: Spectral-gap bound for pure drift on randomly rewired cycle arcs
concept.description: Let k arc lengths be independent Geometric(1/L) variables,with k,L→∞ and fixed 0<ρ_l<log L/log k<ρ_u<∞. For the pure drift chain that moves along arcs and chooses the next arc uniformly at endpoints, every γ>4 gives absolute spectral gap greater than 1/(L(log k)^γ) with high probability; the exceptional probability is O(k^(−c)L^(−d)) for any fixed c,d>0. Conditioning the total number of vertices to be n gives the same high-probability bound for the uniformly cut-cycle model with L=n/k.

concept.title: Finite hypergraph
concept.description: A finite vertex set V with a family E of subsets of V called hyperedges.

concept.title: Fractional matching in a finite hypergraph
concept.description: Weights φ(e)≥0 on the hyperedges such that ∑_{e∋v}φ(e)≤1 for every vertex v. The fractional matching number is the maximum of ∑_eφ(e).

concept.title: Independent set in a hypergraph
concept.description: A set of vertices containing no hyperedge.

concept.title: b-fold coloring of a graph
concept.description: An assignment of a set of b colors to every vertex such that adjacent vertices receive disjoint color sets. The b-fold chromatic number χ_b(G) is the smallest total number of colors permitting such an assignment.

concept.title: Greatest lower bound
concept.description: For a subset A of a partially ordered set, its greatest lower bound is a lower bound of A lying above every lower bound of A, when one exists.

concept.title: Fractional chromatic number of a graph
concept.description: For a finite graph G, χ_f(G)=inf_{b≥1}χ_b(G)/b, where χ_b is its b-fold chromatic number.

concept.title: Dependency graph for random variables
concept.description: A finite graph on the indices of random variables such that families indexed by disjoint vertex sets with no edge between them are independent. In particular, a variable is independent of the joint family of all its nonneighbors.

concept.title: Hypergraph-correlated random variables
concept.description: For a finite hypergraph (V,E), an E-indexed family Y_e is hypergraph-correlated if independent underlying variables X_v exist with each Y_e a measurable function only of (X_v)_{v∈e}.

concept.title: Bernoulli distribution
concept.description: The distribution on {0,1} assigning probability p to 1 and 1−p to 0, for 0≤p≤1.

concept.title: Erdős–Rényi G(n,p) random graph
concept.description: The random simple graph on n labeled vertices in which every possible edge is present independently with probability p.

concept.title: Independence system
concept.description: A finite set V and a nonempty family I of subsets of V closed under taking subsets.

concept.title: k-wise independent random variables
concept.description: A family of random variables is k-wise independent if every subfamily of at most k members is jointly independent.

concept.title: Hölder’s inequality
concept.description: For measurable functions f_i and exponents p_i∈[1,∞] with ∑_i1/p_i=1, ∫|∏_if_i|dμ≤∏_i‖f_i‖_{p_i}.

concept.title: Young’s inequality for products
concept.description: For a,b≥0 and p,q>1 with 1/p+1/q=1, ab≤aᵖ/p+bᑫ/q.

concept.title: Concavity of the weighted geometric mean
concept.description: For β_i≥0 with ∑_iβ_i=1, the function (x_i)↦∏_ix_i^{β_i} is concave on the nonnegative orthant, with zero-weight factors omitted.

concept.title: Finner’s inequality
concept.description: If nonnegative Y_e are hypergraph-correlated over a finite hypergraph and φ is a fractional matching with positive weights on the factors considered, then E∏_eY_e≤∏_e(EY_e^{1/φ(e)})^{φ(e)}. Zero-weight factors can instead be controlled by their essential suprema.

concept.title: Hölder inequality controlled by b-fold graph coloring
concept.description: For nonnegative random variables Y_v admitting dependency graph G and every positive integer b, E∏_vY_v≤∏_v(EY_v^{χ_b(G)/b})^{b/χ_b(G)}, with the usual extended-integral interpretation.

concept.title: Janson’s Hoeffding bound for dependency graphs
concept.description: If n random variables Y_v∈[0,1] have dependency graph G and q=n⁻¹∑_vEY_v, then P(∑_vY_v≥n(q+ε))≤exp(−2nε²/χ_f(G)) for ε>0.

concept.title: Pelekis–Ramon–Wang Bennett bound for dependency graphs
concept.description: If finitely many real random variables Y_v have dependency graph G, EY_v=0, Y_v≤1 and S=∑_vVar(Y_v)>0, then for t>0, P(∑_vY_v≥t)≤exp{−S[(1+t/S)ln(1+t/S)−t/S]/χ_f(G)}.

concept.title: Bennett exponential-moment bound for a bounded-above variable
concept.description: If EY=0, Y≤1 and EY²=σ²<∞, then Eexp(aY)≤exp(σ²(eᵃ−1−a)) for a≥0.

concept.title: Fractional-matching bound for random independent sets in a hypergraph
concept.description: Include each vertex v of a finite hypergraph independently with probability p_v. For every fractional matching φ, the probability that the chosen vertices contain no hyperedge is at most ∏_e(1−∏_{v∈e}p_v)^{φ(e)}. For k-uniform hypergraphs and constant p this is at most (1−pᵏ)^{ν*(H)}.

concept.title: Partially ordered abelian group
concept.description: An abelian group with a translation-invariant partial order. In this paper it is directed: every element is a difference of positive elements.

concept.title: Order unit in a partially ordered abelian group
concept.description: A positive element u such that every g satisfies −Nu≤g≤Nu for some positive integer N.

concept.title: Unperforated partially ordered abelian group
concept.description: An ordered abelian group in which ng≥0 for a positive integer n implies g≥0.

concept.title: Riesz decomposition property for an ordered abelian group
concept.description: Whenever0≤a≤b+c with b,c≥0, there are0≤b₁≤b and0≤c₁≤c with a=b₁+c₁.

concept.title: Dimension group
concept.description: A directed unperforated partially ordered abelian group with the Riesz decomposition property.

concept.title: Simple partially ordered abelian group
concept.description: A nontrivial directed ordered abelian group in which every nonzero positive element is an order unit.

concept.title: Group homomorphism
concept.description: A map f:G→H satisfying f(xy)=f(x)f(y) for all x,y.

concept.title: Trace on a partially ordered abelian group
concept.description: A nonzero additive homomorphism τ:G→ℝ sending positive elements to nonnegative reals; it is normalized at an order unit u when τ(u)=1.

concept.title: Quotient of an abelian group by a subgroup
concept.description: For an abelian group G and subgroup H,the cosets G/H form an abelian group under (g+H)+(g′+H)=g+g′+H.

concept.title: Torsion-free abelian group
concept.description: An abelian group in which ng=0 with a nonzero integer n forces g=0.

concept.title: Convex subset of a real vector space
concept.description: A subset C of a real vector space is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and0≤t≤1. The vector space may be infinite-dimensional.

concept.title: Face of a convex set
concept.description: A convex subset F of a convex set K is a face if an interior point of a nontrivial segment in K belongs to F only when both endpoints belong to F.

concept.title: Extreme point of a convex set
concept.description: A point x of a convex set is extreme if x=(1−t)y+tz with0<t<1 and y,z in the set implies y=z=x.

concept.title: Real affine function on a convex set
concept.description: A function f:C→ℝ on a convex set satisfying f((1−t)x+ty)=(1−t)f(x)+tf(y) for0≤t≤1.

concept.title: Space of continuous affine functions on a compact convex set
concept.description: Aff(K) is the real vector space of continuous affine functions on a compact convex set K,equipped with the supremum norm and pointwise order.

concept.title: Normalized trace space of an ordered abelian group
concept.description: For an ordered abelian group with order unit u, S(G,u) is the set of positive homomorphisms τ:G→ℝ with τ(u)=1, with the topology of pointwise convergence on G.

concept.title: Choquet simplex
concept.description: A compact convex set in a locally convex real topological vector space for which each point has a unique maximal representing probability measure in the Choquet order. In the metrizable case this is the unique representing probability measure supported on its extreme boundary.

concept.title: Affine representation of an ordered group with order unit
concept.description: The homomorphism G→Aff(S(G,u)) sending g to the evaluation function τ↦τ(g). Its kernel is the infinitesimal subgroup.

concept.title: Convex subgroup of an ordered abelian group
concept.description: A subgroup H such that h₁≤g≤h₂ with h₁,h₂∈H forces g∈H. The quotient carries the induced order when H is convex.

concept.title: Dense subset of a metric space
concept.description: A subset A of a metric space X is dense if every open ball centered in X with positive radius meets A.

concept.title: Full lattice in Euclidean space
concept.description: A subgroup Λ⊂ℝⁿ generated overℤ by a real vector-space basis ofℝⁿ.

concept.title: Refinable trace on an ordered abelian group
concept.description: A positive trace τ is refinable if every equality τ(g)=∑ᵢτ(aᵢ),with g,aᵢ positive and g nonzero,can be realized by positive aᵢ′ with g=∑ᵢaᵢ′ and τ(aᵢ′)=τ(aᵢ).

concept.title: Good trace on an ordered abelian group
concept.description: A positive trace τ is good if for a∈G and positive nonzero g with0<τ(a)<τ(g),there is0≤a′≤g with τ(a′)=τ(a).

concept.title: Gordan’s theorem of the alternative
concept.description: For a real matrix A,exactly one holds: Ay=0 for some nonzero y≥0; or xA is strictly positive for some real row x.

concept.title: Farkas’ lemma
concept.description: For a real m×n matrix A and real row b,exactly one holds: xA≤b for some real row x; or Ay=0 for some nonzero column y≥0 with by<0.

concept.title: Handelman–Roy criterion for one-sided linear Diophantine approximation
concept.description: Let H⊂ℝⁿ be an additive subgroup containing no strictly positive vector,and F the smallest face of the standard simplex containing the nonnegative normalized linear functionals that vanish on H. Then for every h∈H,m≥1 and ε>0 there exists h′∈H with h−mh′>−ε coordinatewise iff for every f∈F,the subgroup f(H) is zero or dense inℝ.

concept.title: Handelman–Roy unperforation criterion for finite-trace dimension groups
concept.description: Let G be a simple noncyclic dimension group with finitely many pure traces,and H=ker_G Z(H) a subgroup with H∩G⁺={0},where Z(H) consists of normalized traces vanishing on H. If F is the smallest face containing Z(H),then G/H is unperforated iff f(H) is zero or dense inℝ for every f∈F.

concept.title: Affine algebraic group over a field
concept.description: An affine algebraic group over a field F is specified by a finitely generated commutative Hopf F-algebra A: for each commutative F-algebra R its group of R-points is Hom_(F-alg)(A,R), with multiplication induced by the coproduct. Equivalently it is a finite-type affine group scheme over F.

concept.title: Connected reductive algebraic group
concept.description: A smooth connected affine algebraic group whose largest connected normal unipotent subgroup over an algebraic closure is trivial.

concept.title: Restriction of scalars of an algebraic group
concept.description: For a finite field extension M/F and an M-group H, Res_{M/F}H is the F-group with R-points H(R⊗_F M) for each F-algebra R.

concept.title: Algebraic torus
concept.description: An algebraic group that becomes isomorphic over an algebraic closure to a finite product of copies of the multiplicative group.

concept.title: Anisotropic reductive group over a field
concept.description: A reductive group over F containing no nontrivial F-split torus; an anisotropic torus has no positive-dimensional split subtorus.

concept.title: Parabolic subgroup of a reductive algebraic group
concept.description: A closed algebraic subgroup P of a connected reductive F-group G such that, after base change to an algebraic closure, P contains a Borel subgroup of G. Equivalently G/P is projective.

concept.title: Unipotent radical of an algebraic group
concept.description: The largest smooth connected normal unipotent subgroup of an algebraic group.

concept.title: Place of a number field
concept.description: An equivalence class of nontrivial absolute values on a number field; its completion is denoted F_v. Archimedean and nonarchimedean places give its infinite and finite places.

concept.title: Adele ring of a number field
concept.description: The restricted product A_F=∏′_v F_v of all completions of a number field,where almost every finite component lies in the valuation ring O_v.

concept.title: Adelic points of an algebraic group
concept.description: For an algebraic group G over a number field F,the restricted product G(A_F)=∏′_v G(F_v),using integral compact subgroups at almost all finite places.

concept.title: Haar measure on a locally compact group
concept.description: A nonzero Radon measure on a locally compact group, i.e. a Borel measure finite on compact sets, outer regular on Borel sets and inner regular on open sets, invariant under left translation: μ(gA)=μ(A). A right Haar measure is defined analogously with right translations.

concept.title: Unimodular locally compact group
concept.description: A locally compact group whose left Haar measures are also right invariant.

concept.title: Unitary character of a topological group
concept.description: A continuous homomorphism from a topological group to the unit circle inℂ under multiplication.

concept.title: Compactly supported smooth test function on an adelic group
concept.description: A compactly supported complex function on G(A_F) that is smooth in the archimedean variables and locally constant in the nonarchimedean variables. Factorizable test functions are restricted tensors of local test functions.

concept.title: Harish–Chandra subgroup of adelic points
concept.description: The subgroup G(A_F)¹ of points x satisfying∣χ(x)∣_A=1 for every F-rational algebraic character χ:G→G_m; equivalently the kernel of the logarithmic Harish–Chandra map.

concept.title: Tamagawa measure of a reductive group over a number field
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group G of dimension d, choose an invariant F-rational gauge form and its standard local measures m_v. Let ρ_G be the Galois representation on X*(G)⊗C and r_G the leading nonzero Laurent coefficient of its finite-place Artin L-function at s=1. The Tamagawa measure is r_G⁻¹|d_F|^(−d/2)(∏_(v infinite)m_v)(∏_(v finite)L_v(1,ρ_G)m_v). It is independent of rescaling that gauge form by F×.

concept.title: Hyperspecial maximal compact subgroup
concept.description: For a reductive group over a nonarchimedean local field,a subgroup given by the valuation-ring points of a smooth affine integral group scheme whose special fiber is connected reductive.

concept.title: First nonabelian Galois cohomology set
concept.description: For an algebraic F-group H, H¹(F,H) is the pointed set of continuous 1-cocycles of Gal(F^sep/F) with values in the discrete group H(F^sep), modulo c′(σ)=h⁻¹c(σ)σ(h). The distinguished point is the trivial cocycle.

concept.title: Twisted relative orbit for two involutions
concept.description: Given G=Res_{M/F}G₀ with commuting involutions σ and τ,and θ=στ,the relative classes are double cosets G^σ(k)∖G(k)/G^θ(k); geometric relative classes permit the acting elements over an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Relatively τ-semisimple element
concept.description: In the commuting-involution setting θ=στ,an element γ is relatively τ-semisimple when δ=γγ^{-θ} is τ-semisimple,meaning δδ^τ is semisimple.

concept.title: Strongly relatively τ-regular element
concept.description: A relatively τ-semisimple γ for which the τ-centralizer of γγ^{-θ} in G^σ is a connected torus.

concept.title: Relatively τ-elliptic element
concept.description: In the commuting-involution setup G=Res_(M/F)G₀, θ=στ, a relatively τ-semisimple γ is relatively τ-elliptic if C^τ_(G,δ)/Z(G₀), with δ=γγ^(−θ), is anisotropic over the ground field. The centralizer here is in all G; anisotropy of a possibly disconnected reductive quotient means its identity component has no nontrivial split torus.

concept.title: Twisted relative orbital integral
concept.description: Over a local field k, for relatively semisimple γ∈G(k), put H=G^σ(k)×G^θ(k) and L=(G_γ^(σθ))°(k). Given a unitary character χ of H trivial on L and compatible Haar measures, the twisted relative orbital integral is ∫_(L∖H)χ(x,y)f(x⁻¹γy)d[x,y], for compactly supported smooth f. In the convention χ(x,y)=μ₁(x)μ₂(y)⁻¹, relevance requires this actual character to be trivial on L. The adelic version replaces local points by adelic points and is defined when the integral converges.

concept.title: F-supercuspidal local test function
concept.description: At a finite place v,a compactly supported locally constant function on G(F_v) is F-supercuspidal if every left or right translate has zero integral along the unipotent radical of each proper F-defined parabolic subgroup.

concept.title: Automorphic cusp form on a reductive group
concept.description: An automorphic form on a connected reductive number-field group whose constant term ∫_(N(F)∖N(A_F))φ(ng)dn vanishes for every g and every unipotent radical N of a proper F-parabolic subgroup. Its square-integrable Hilbert closure on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ is a separate cuspidal L²-space.

concept.title: Cuspidal automorphic representation
concept.description: An irreducible unitary representation occurring as a closed summand in the cuspidal L²-space of the adelic group, with the chosen central or Harish–Chandra normalization. Its smooth K∞-finite vectors give the usual algebraic automorphic representation.

concept.title: Automorphic period integral on a Harish–Chandra quotient
concept.description: For a reductive F-group G, an F-subgroup H, a smooth cuspidal form φ on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ and a unitary character χ trivial on H(F), the period in this normalization is ∫_(H(F)∖(H(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹))χ(h)φ(h)dh, with quotient Haar measure, when absolutely convergent.

concept.title: Distinguished automorphic representation
concept.description: Let G be a reductive group over a number field F, H an F-subgroup and χ a unitary character of H(A_F) trivial on H(F). A cuspidal automorphic representation π of G is (H,χ)-distinguished if the automorphic period integral of χ·φ over H(F)∖(H(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹) is nonzero for some smooth cusp form φ in the π-isotypic subspace of the cuspidal L²-space. The subgroup and character are part of the specification. The local analogue asks only for a nonzero H(F)-equivariant functional to χ.

concept.title: Twisted relative spectral trace
concept.description: For a cuspidal representation π,the integral of its convolution-kernel K_{π(f)}(x,y) against μ(x,y^{-1}) over the normalized G^σ and G^θ automorphic quotients. For a K-finite test function it is the sum of products of the corresponding period integrals over an orthonormal basis.

concept.title: Lang–Steinberg theorem
concept.description: For a smooth connected affine algebraic group over a finite field with Frobenius F, the map x↦x⁻¹F(x) is surjective over an algebraic closure; equivalently its first Galois cohomology is trivial.

concept.title: Hahn’s simple twisted relative trace formula
concept.description: Let G=Res_{M/F}G₀ for a quadratic or trivial extension of a number field,with commuting involutions σ,τ,θ=στ and connected G^σ. For a factorizable compact test function having local factors supported on relatively τ-elliptic and strongly relatively τ-regular elements and an F-supercuspidal factor,the weighted sum of relevant regular elliptic twisted relative orbital integrals equals the sum of twisted relative spectral traces over the cuspidal automorphic spectrum of G(A_F)¹.

concept.title: Ideal of a commutative ring
concept.description: An additive subgroup I of a commutative ring R such that ri belongs to I for every r in R and i in I.

concept.title: Prime ideal of a commutative ring
concept.description: A proper ideal P of a commutative ring R such that ab in P implies a in P or b in P.

concept.title: Localization of a commutative ring
concept.description: For a multiplicatively closed subset S of a commutative ring R containing 1, S⁻¹R consists of fractions r/s, identifying r/s with r′/s′ when t(rs′−r′s)=0 for some t in S, with the usual fraction operations.
