concept.title: Ring of integers of a number field
concept.description: The subring O_K of a number field K consisting of its elements integral over Z, namely the roots in K of monic integer-coefficient polynomials.

concept.title: Congruence subgroup of the integral symplectic group
concept.description: A subgroup Γ of Sp(2g,Z) containing the kernel of reduction Sp(2g,Z)→Sp(2g,Z/NZ) for some positive integer N; its level is the least such N.

concept.title: Siegel modular form for a congruence subgroup
concept.description: A holomorphic function f on the degree-g Siegel upper half-space transforming as f((AZ+B)(CZ+D)⁻¹)=det(CZ+D)^k f(Z) under a congruence subgroup Γ⊂Sp(2g,Z), with holomorphy at all cusps; for g>1 the usual Koecher principle makes the cusp condition automatic.

concept.title: Formal power series over a commutative ring
concept.description: An expression ∑a_α X^α with coefficients in a commutative ring and multi-indices α in N^n, added coefficientwise and multiplied by the finite Cauchy sums defining each coefficient, without any assertion of analytic convergence.

concept.title: Symmetric square of a module
concept.description: For a module M over a commutative ring R, Sym²_R(M) is (M⊗_R M) modulo the relations x⊗y−y⊗x. In small characteristic this differs from the submodule of M⊗M generated by x⊗x; the paper explicitly uses the latter convention in its integral Witt targets.

concept.title: Alternating tensors in the tensor square of a module
concept.description: For an R-module M, the submodule of M⊗_R M consisting of tensors t with flip(t)=−t. This is a submodule convention, not the quotient definition of the exterior square; in characteristic 2 these conventions need not agree.

concept.title: Witt operators for genus-two Siegel modular forms
concept.description: The restriction of a genus-two modular form to block-diagonal matrices and its first two normalized transverse Taylor coefficients: f([[τ₁,z],[z,τ₂]])=W(f)+2W′(f)(2πiz)+W″(f)(2πiz)²+O(z³). Their targets are tensor products of elliptic modular or quasimodular form spaces, with parity determined by the weight.

concept.title: Holomorphic Eisenstein series for SL₂(Z)
concept.description: For even k≥4, the modular form E_k(τ)=½∑_(c,d)=1(cτ+d)^(−k), normalized to constant Fourier coefficient 1. The weight-two series E₂=1−24∑_{n≥1}σ₁(n)q^n is quasimodular rather than modular.

concept.title: Ramanujan delta modular form
concept.description: The normalized weight-12 cusp form Δ=(E₄³−E₆²)/1728=q∏_{n≥1}(1−q^n)^24 for SL₂(Z), where q=exp(2πiτ).

concept.title: Igusa’s generators for genus-two Siegel modular forms
concept.description: The complex graded ring of full-group genus-two scalar Siegel modular forms is generated by E₄,E₆,χ₁₀,χ₁₂,χ₃₅, with χ₃₅² a polynomial in the first four. Over Z its even-weight subring has Igusa’s fourteen integral generators, and every integral odd-weight form is χ₃₅ times an integral even-weight form.

concept.title: Nagaoka’s genus-two modular-form structure modulo 2 and 3
concept.description: For p=2 or 3, every reduction modulo p of an integral even-weight full-group genus-two Siegel modular form is a unique polynomial over F_p in the reductions of Igusa’s X₁₀,Y₁₂,X₁₆, after forgetting the weight grading.

concept.title: Borcherds automorphic product
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (2,n) and a weakly holomorphic modular form F of weight 1−n/2 and type ρ_M whose principal-part coefficients c_γ(m), m≤0, are integers, the Borcherds product Ψ_M(F) is the meromorphic automorphic form of weight c₀(0)/2 with a unitary character on the orthogonal symmetric domain of M for which log|Ψ_M| is −Φ_M(F)/4 up to an explicit multiple of log|Y_M|. Its divisor is a sum of rational quadratic divisors λ^⊥ with multiplicities ∑_(x>0)c_(xλ)(x²λ²/2), and near each cusp it has a convergent infinite product expansion.

concept.title: Kikuta–Takemori’s sharp genus-two Sturm bound
concept.description: Let f be a scalar full-group degree-two Siegel modular form of weight k≥0 with coefficients in O_{K,𝔭}. Put b_k=⌊k/10⌋ for even k and ⌊(k−5)/10⌋ for odd k. If the coefficients indexed by T=(m,r/2;r/2,n)≥0 with m,n≤b_k vanish modulo 𝔭^ν, then all coefficients do, for every prime ideal 𝔭 and ν≥1. This bound is optimal whenever the weight-k space is nonzero.

concept.title: Goldbach number
concept.description: A positive integer expressible as the sum of two prime numbers.

concept.title: Infinitely recurring prime difference
concept.description: A positive integer d such that p−q=d for infinitely many pairs of prime numbers p,q; the two primes need not be consecutive. Benatar calls these de Polignac numbers, a convention distinguished here from consecutive prime gaps.

concept.title: Normalized consecutive prime gap
concept.description: For consecutive primes p_n,p_{n+1}, the real number (p_{n+1}−p_n)/log p_n. Its finite limit points are subsequential limits of this sequence.

concept.title: Möbius function
concept.description: The arithmetic function μ(n) equal to 0 if a squared prime divides n and to (−1)^r if n is a product of r distinct primes, including μ(1)=1.

concept.title: Euler totient function
concept.description: The number φ(n) of integers 1≤a≤n coprime to n.

concept.title: Selberg sieve weight
concept.description: A nonnegative arithmetic weight obtained by squaring a divisor sum, typically (∑_{d|P(n)}λ_d)² with coefficients λ_d supported on d≤R, designed to suppress values with small prime factors.

concept.title: Maynard–Tao multidimensional sieve
concept.description: A refinement of Selberg’s sieve using weights (∑_{d_i|n+h_i}λ_{d₁,…,d_k})² for an admissible tuple h₁,…,h_k, with coefficients selected by a function on a simplex. Comparing weighted prime counts with total mass produces several primes in a common translate.

concept.title: Smooth integer
concept.description: A positive integer whose prime factors are all at most a specified bound y; equivalently its largest prime factor P⁺(n) is at most y, with a harmless convention for n=1.

concept.title: Dirichlet character
concept.description: A group character of (Z/qZ)× with complex values, extended periodically to Z by zero on integers not coprime to q. A character is primitive when it is not induced from a proper divisor of q.

concept.title: Dirichlet L-function
concept.description: For a Dirichlet character χ, the Dirichlet series L(s,χ)=∑_{n≥1}χ(n)n^(−s) for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation.

concept.title: Level of distribution of the primes
concept.description: An exponent θ for which the average error in the prime number theorem in progressions, summed over moduli q≤x^(θ−ε), is O_A,ε(x/(log x)^A) for every A,ε>0. The precise weighted prime count and allowed modulus family must be stated when using a variant.

concept.title: Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem
concept.description: For every A>0 there is B>0 such that ∑_{q≤x^(1/2)/(log x)^B} max_(a,q)=1 |ψ(x;q,a)−x/φ(q)|≪_A x/(log x)^A, where ψ uses the von Mangoldt weight and the sum runs over all positive moduli.

concept.title: Elliott–Halberstam conjecture
concept.description: The primes have every level of distribution θ<1, in the averaged arithmetic-progression error sense, with arbitrary logarithmic saving.

concept.title: Polymath’s smooth-modulus distribution theorem for primes
concept.description: Put θ=1/2+7/300. Given ε>0 there is δ>0 such that, for every fixed A≥1 and any choice of a nonzero residue a_p modulo each prime p, ∑_{q≤x^(θ−ε), q squarefree and x^δ-smooth}|ψ(x;q,a_q)−x/φ(q)|≪_{A,ε,δ}x/(log x)^A, uniformly in those choices. Here a_q is the coherent Chinese-remainder residue of the a_p for p dividing q, and ψ is the von Mangoldt prime count.

concept.title: Complete bipartite graph
concept.description: The simple graph K_{s,t} with two disjoint vertex sets of sizes s,t, every edge between the two sets and no edges within either set.

concept.title: Subgraph of a simple graph
concept.description: A graph obtained from a simple graph by choosing some vertices and some of the original edges between those vertices; an induced subgraph retains all such edges.

concept.title: Kővári–Sós–Turán theorem
concept.description: For fixed integers s,t≥2, every n-vertex simple graph containing no K_{s,t} subgraph has O_{s,t}(n^(2−1/s)) edges. The paper uses the balanced case s=t.

concept.title: Szemerédi’s theorem
concept.description: Every subset of the positive integers having positive upper asymptotic density contains arbitrarily long finite arithmetic progressions.

concept.title: Smooth bump function on Euclidean space
concept.description: A smooth real-valued function on R^n with compact support, often chosen to be one on a specified compact set and zero outside a prescribed open neighbourhood.

concept.title: Euler–Lagrange equation for first-order variational integrals
concept.description: Let Ω⊂R^n be open, L∈C²(Ω×R×R^n), and u∈C²(Ω). If for every φ∈C_c^∞(Ω) the first variation at t=0 of ∫_{supp φ}[L(x,u+tφ,∇u+t∇φ)−L(x,u,∇u)]dx vanishes, then L_u(x,u,∇u)−∑ᵢ∂ᵢL_{pᵢ}(x,u,∇u)=0 throughout Ω.

concept.title: Benatar’s Goldbach–prime-difference dichotomy
concept.description: Either successive Goldbach numbers have bounded gaps beyond some point, or the set D of infinitely recurring positive prime differences has full relative density among the even integers, with |((2N)∖D)∩[1,N]|≪N^κ for some κ<1. Differences in D need not be consecutive prime gaps.

concept.title: Benatar’s density bounds for normalized prime-gap limit points
concept.description: If L is the set of finite limit points of (p_{n+1}−p_n)/log p_n, then liminf_{T→∞}m(L∩[0,T])/T≥1/4 and m(L∩[0,T])/T≥3/25 for every T>0, where m is Lebesgue measure. Under the specific level-one distribution variant in §5, the first lower bound improves to 1/2.

concept.title: Radon measure
concept.description: A Borel measure on a Hausdorff topological space that is finite on compact sets and inner regular: the measure of every Borel set is the supremum of the measures of its compact subsets.

concept.title: Vague convergence of Radon measures
concept.description: On a locally compact Hausdorff space, μ_n converge vaguely to μ if ∫f dμ_n→∫f dμ for every continuous compactly supported real function f.

concept.title: Locally finite point configuration
concept.description: An integer-valued Radon measure ξ=∑_iδ_{x_i} assigning finite mass to every compact set; repeated points may have multiplicity. Configuration space carries the vague topology.

concept.title: Point process
concept.description: A random locally finite point configuration, or equivalently a probability measure on configuration space with its measurable structure generated by counting points in bounded Borel sets.

concept.title: Correlation functions of a point process
concept.description: Relative to a reference measure dx, the k-point correlation function ρ⁽ᵏ⁾ is the density satisfying E∑_{x₁,…,xₖ distinct in ξ}f(x₁,…,xₖ)=∫fρ⁽ᵏ⁾dx₁⋯dxₖ for nonnegative measurable f, when this density exists. The sum counts distinct particle labels.

concept.title: Poisson point process
concept.description: A point process with intensity measure λ for which counts in disjoint measurable sets are independent and ξ(A) has Poisson law of mean λ(A) whenever λ(A)<∞.

concept.title: Poisson distribution
concept.description: The distribution on nonnegative integers with masses P(N=k)=e⁻ˡλᵏ/k! for λ≥0.

concept.title: Reduced Palm distribution of a point process
concept.description: The disintegration μ_x of the reduced Campbell measure: E∑_{x∈ξ}F(x,ξ−δ_x)=∫E_{μ_x}F(x,η)ρ⁽¹⁾(x)dx. It describes the remaining configuration viewed conditional on a point at x, without conditioning on a usually null event.

concept.title: Determinantal point process
concept.description: A point process whose k-point correlation functions satisfy ρ⁽ᵏ⁾(x₁,…,xₖ)=det(K(x_i,x_j))_{i,j=1}ᵏ for a specified kernel K and reference measure.

concept.title: Quasi-Gibbs measure for a point process
concept.description: For specified one-body and pair potentials Φ,Ψ, a point-process law is quasi-Gibbs if its restriction to configurations with m particles in each bounded region can be approximated increasingly by submeasures whose conditional inside laws, given the outside configuration, are bounded above and below by positive multiples of exp(−H_inside) times Poisson reference measure restricted to m particles. Constants may depend on the region, particle number, approximation level and outside configuration.

concept.title: Closed nonnegative symmetric form on a Hilbert space
concept.description: A nonnegative symmetric bilinear form E on a dense vector subspace D of a real Hilbert space H is closed if D is complete for the norm ‖u‖_{E,1}=(‖u‖_H²+E(u,u))¹ᐟ².

concept.title: Closable nonnegative symmetric form
concept.description: A densely defined nonnegative symmetric form E is closable if u_n→0 in H and E(u_n−u_m,u_n−u_m)→0 imply E(u_n,u_n)→0. Equivalently it has a closed extension obtained by completing its graph norm.

concept.title: Symmetric Dirichlet form
concept.description: A closed densely defined nonnegative symmetric form E on real L²(X,m) satisfying the Markov contraction property: for u∈D(E), v=(0∨u)∧1 belongs to D(E) and E(v,v)≤E(u,u).

concept.title: Nest for a Dirichlet form
concept.description: An increasing sequence of closed sets F_n such that the union of {u∈D(E):u=0 m-a.e. outside F_n} is dense in D(E) for the E₁ norm. A set is E-exceptional if it is contained in the complement of the union of some nest.

concept.title: Quasi-continuity relative to a Dirichlet form
concept.description: A real function has an E-quasi-continuous version if it agrees m-a.e. with a function whose restriction to every member of some E-nest is continuous.

concept.title: Quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet form
concept.description: A symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(X,m) is quasi-regular if it has a nest of compact sets, an E₁-dense subset of its domain with quasi-continuous versions, and countably many domain elements with quasi-continuous versions separating all points outside an exceptional set.

concept.title: Markov transition semigroup
concept.description: A family of transition kernels P_t(x,A), t≥0, with P₀(x,·)=δ_x and P_{s+t}(x,A)=∫P_t(y,A)P_s(x,dy). Sub-Markov semigroups may lose mass at a cemetery state.

concept.title: Symmetric Markov semigroup
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup is symmetric with respect to m if ∫fP_tg dm=∫gP_tf dm for suitable f,g. Its stationary process has time-reversal invariant finite-dimensional distributions when initialized from a probability measure m.

concept.title: Strong Markov process
concept.description: A Markov process whose conditional future after any finite stopping time, given the past through that time, has the transition law started from its state at that stopping time.

concept.title: Càdlàg path
concept.description: A path from a real time interval into a metric space that is right-continuous and has a left limit at every positive time.

concept.title: Special standard Markov process
concept.description: A right-continuous strong Markov process on a Lusin state space, with cemetery state, that is quasi-left-continuous: along stopping times T_n↑T, X_{T_n}→X_T on the event T is before the lifetime.

concept.title: Process existence for quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
concept.description: A quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a Lusin measurable state space is associated with an m-tight special standard process, unique up to the usual exceptional-set equivalence, whose L² semigroup is the semigroup of the form. The resulting process is m-symmetric; conservativeness requires an additional condition.

concept.title: Densely defined self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space
concept.description: A linear operator A with dense domain D(A) in a Hilbert space such that its Hilbert-space adjoint A* has the same domain and agrees with A. The adjoint domain consists of y for which x↦⟨Ax,y⟩ is bounded on D(A) in the ambient Hilbert norm.

concept.title: Closed symmetric form–semigroup correspondence
concept.description: Densely defined closed nonnegative symmetric forms on a Hilbert space correspond to nonnegative self-adjoint operators and strongly continuous self-adjoint contraction semigroups T_t=exp(−tA), with E(u,v)=⟨A¹ᐟ²u,A¹ᐟ²v⟩ on D(A¹ᐟ²).

concept.title: Lévy process
concept.description: A càdlàg stochastic process starting at zero with stationary independent increments and continuity in probability, taking values in Euclidean space.

concept.title: Isotropic symmetric α-stable Lévy process
concept.description: For 0<α≤2, the Euclidean Lévy process whose characteristic function is Eexp(iξ·X_t)=exp(−t|ξ|ᵅ), up to a specified positive time-scaling constant.

concept.title: Upper semicontinuous function
concept.description: An extended-real-valued function f on a topological space is upper semicontinuous if {x:f(x)<a} is open for every real a.

concept.title: Mollifier on Euclidean space
concept.description: A nonnegative smooth compactly supported function j on ℝᵈ with integral one. Its scaled kernels j_ε(x)=ε⁻ᵈj(x/ε) produce smooth approximations by convolution.

concept.title: Mean value theorem for real functions
concept.description: If f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), there exists c∈(a,b) such that f(b)−f(a)=f′(c)(b−a).

concept.title: Rolle’s theorem
concept.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), and f(a)=f(b), then f′(c)=0 for some c∈(a,b).

concept.title: Extreme value theorem on a compact real interval
concept.description: A continuous real function on [a,b] attains both a maximum and a minimum.

concept.title: Determinant of a square matrix
concept.description: For an n×n matrix A over a commutative ring, det A=∑_{σ∈Sₙ}sgn(σ)∏_{i=1}ⁿA_{i,σ(i)}, with the 0×0 determinant equal to one.

concept.title: Symmetric group of a finite set
concept.description: The group of all bijections of a finite set to itself under composition.

concept.title: Sign of a permutation
concept.description: The sign of a permutation of {1,…,n} is (−1) to the number of inversions, where an inversion is a pair i<j with σ(i)>σ(j).

concept.title: Esaki’s quasi-regularity theorem for infinite-particle jump forms
concept.description: For a configuration law μ with locally Lᵖ finite-region particle densities (p>1), consider the closable jump form E(f,g)=½∫μ(dξ)∫ξ(dx)∫dy ν(ξ,x;y)[f(ξ−δ_x+δ_y)−f(ξ)][g(ξ−δ_x+δ_y)−g(ξ)] on local smooth functions. If ν≤Cp(|x−y|), ρ⁽¹⁾(x)=O(|x|ᵏ), p(r)=O(r⁻ᵈ⁻ᵅ) at infinity with α>κ, p(r)=O(r⁻ᵈ⁻ᵝ) near zero with 0<β<2, and Var ξ(B_r)/(Eξ(B_r))²=O(r⁻ᵟ) for some δ>0, its closure is a quasi-regular Dirichlet form.

concept.title: Esaki’s quasi-Gibbs jump-form closability theorem
concept.description: For the infinite-particle jump form on local smooth functions, suppose μ is (Φ,Ψ)-quasi-Gibbs and Φ,Ψ are bounded above and below by positive constant multiples of upper semicontinuous comparison potentials Φ₀,Ψ₀, locally bounded below, with Ψ₀ even and its infinite-value set compact. Under the standing symmetric jump-kernel integrability assumptions ∫(1∧|x−y|²)ν(ξ,x;y)dy<∞, the form is closable on L²(μ).

concept.title: Normal distribution
concept.description: The real probability distribution N(m,σ²) with density (2πσ²)⁻¹ᐟ²exp(−(x−m)²/(2σ²)) for σ>0; variance zero gives a point mass at m.

concept.title: Standard Brownian motion
concept.description: A continuous process B_t starting at zero with independent increments and B_t−B_s distributed N(0,t−s) for 0≤s<t. A d-dimensional standard Brownian motion has d independent standard components.

concept.title: Wiener measure
concept.description: The probability law of standard Brownian motion on continuous paths starting at zero, equipped with the Borel σ-algebra for uniform convergence on compact time intervals.

concept.title: Itô integral with respect to Brownian motion
concept.description: For an adapted process H with E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds<∞, ∫H_s dB_s is the L² limit of left-endpoint adapted step-process sums. Localization extends the definition to locally square-integrable integrands.

concept.title: Itô stochastic differential equation driven by Brownian motion
concept.description: An adapted continuous process X solves dX_t=b(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dB_t if it satisfies X_t=X₀+∫₀ᵗb(X_s)ds+∫₀ᵗσ(X_s)dB_s almost surely.

concept.title: Convergence in probability
concept.description: Random variables X_n converge in probability to X if P(|X_n−X|>ε)→0 for every ε>0; metric-valued variables use their metric in place of absolute difference.

concept.title: Quadratic covariation of continuous semimartingales
concept.description: For continuous semimartingales X,Y, [X,Y]_t is the limit in probability of sums ∑(X_{t_{i+1}}−X_{t_i})(Y_{t_{i+1}}−Y_{t_i}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

concept.title: Stratonovich integral for continuous semimartingales
concept.description: For continuous semimartingales X,Y, ∫Y∘dX=∫YdX+½[Y,X], when the Itô integral exists. Equivalently it is obtained from symmetric stochastic Riemann sums.

concept.title: Itô’s formula for Brownian diffusions
concept.description: If X solves dX=b dt+σ dB and f is C¹ in time and C² in space, then df(t,X_t)=(∂_tf+b·∇f+½tr(σσᵀD²f))dt+∇f·σdB, with the usual localization hypotheses.

concept.title: Smooth vector field on Euclidean space
concept.description: A smooth map V:ℝⁿ→ℝⁿ, acting on smooth scalar functions by Vf=∑_iVⁱ∂_if.

concept.title: Lie bracket of smooth vector fields
concept.description: The vector field [V,W] characterized by [V,W]f=V(Wf)−W(Vf); in coordinates [V,W]ⁱ=∑_j(Vʲ∂_jWⁱ−Wʲ∂_jVⁱ).

concept.title: Uniformly finitely generated condition for diffusion vector fields
concept.description: For bounded smooth diffusion fields V₀,…,V_d, the C_b^∞ module generated by all iterated brackets except the drift field alone is generated by brackets of uniformly bounded weighted length (a drift letter has weight two, a noise letter weight one). Each longer bracket is a linear combination of these finitely many fields with bounded smooth coefficient functions.

concept.title: Cameron–Martin space for Wiener measure
concept.description: The Hilbert space of absolutely continuous paths h:[0,T]→ℝᵈ with h(0)=0 and square-integrable derivative, with inner product ∫₀ᵀh′(s)·k′(s)ds.

concept.title: Malliavin derivative on Wiener space
concept.description: For a smooth cylindrical Wiener functional F=f(B(h₁),…,B(h_n)), DF=∑_i∂_if(B(h₁),…,B(h_n))h_i in the Cameron–Martin space; its closure defines the Malliavin derivative on the corresponding Sobolev domains.

concept.title: Closed linear operator
concept.description: A linear map A:D(A)⊆X→Y between Banach spaces is closed if x_n→x and Ax_n→y with x_n∈D(A) imply x∈D(A) and Ax=y.

concept.title: Skorokhod divergence on Wiener space
concept.description: The adjoint δ of the Malliavin derivative on L² Wiener space: u belongs to D(δ) when E⟨DF,u⟩=E[Fδ(u)] for all smooth cylindrical F, for some square-integrable δ(u). It extends the adapted Itô integral.

concept.title: Malliavin covariance matrix
concept.description: For a random vector F=(F¹,…,Fⁿ) with Malliavin differentiable components, its covariance matrix is γ_F^{ij}=⟨DFⁱ,DFʲ⟩ in the Cameron–Martin space.

concept.title: Monte Carlo estimator of an expectation
concept.description: Estimate EF by the empirical mean L⁻¹∑_{ℓ=1}ᴸF(X_ℓ) of independent identically distributed samples. Variants may use dependent samples with a separately justified sampling law.

concept.title: Stochastic mesh method for conditional expectations
concept.description: Approximate a Markov transition expectation by weighted values at simulated future states. With transition density p(s,x;t,y) and L simulated paths, a common weight at Y_j=X_j(t) is p(s,x;t,Y_j)/(Lq(Y_j)), where q(y)=L⁻¹∑_ℓp(s,X_ℓ(s);t,y); this reuses one random mesh for many starting states.

concept.title: Risk-neutral valuation of contingent claims
concept.description: Under a specified probability measure making discounted traded asset prices martingales, the arbitrage-free price of a replicable claim is the conditional expectation of its discounted payoff, subject to the market model and integrability hypotheses.

concept.title: Default intensity process
concept.description: For a default time τ, a nonnegative predictable process λ_t such that 1_{τ≤t}−∫₀^{t∧τ}λ_sds is a local martingale in the specified information filtration. Cox-model conditional survival is exp(−∫₀ᵗλ_sds).

concept.title: Unilateral credit valuation adjustment
concept.description: In a model where the valuing institution cannot default, CVA is the expected discounted loss on positive counterparty exposure at counterparty default: E[D(0,τ)L_τ(V_τ)⁺1_{τ<T}], under a specified pricing measure. Here V is the default-free portfolio value and L is the fractional loss at default.

concept.title: Morimoto’s stochastic-mesh CVA estimators
concept.description: For a portfolio whose payoffs each depend only on a shared macro factor and one local factor, approximate each future conditional payoff with a low-dimensional stochastic mesh and time-discretize expected positive aggregate exposure. One estimator uses the approximate exposure itself; another uses the mesh only to classify its sign and averages realized discounted payoffs from independent paths on the estimated positive-exposure region.

concept.title: Real orthogonal matrix
concept.description: A real square matrix U with UᵀU=I, equivalently a linear map preserving the Euclidean inner product.

concept.title: Multivariate normal distribution
concept.description: A distribution of a real vector X for which every real linear combination of coordinates is normally distributed; it is specified by its mean vector and positive semidefinite covariance matrix.

concept.title: Change of variables theorem for Euclidean integrals
concept.description: For a C¹ diffeomorphism Φ:U→V between open subsets of ℝⁿ and a nonnegative measurable or integrable f on V, ∫_Vf(y)dy=∫_Uf(Φ(x))|det DΦ(x)|dx.

concept.title: Orthogonal invariance of the standard Gaussian distribution
concept.description: If X has n independent N(0,1) coordinates and U is a real orthogonal n×n matrix, then UX has the same distribution as X.

concept.title: Householder reflection
concept.description: For a nonzero real vector v, the orthogonal reflection H=I−2vvᵀ/(vᵀv) fixes the hyperplane perpendicular to v and negates v. Applying H to a vector uses O(n) arithmetic operations.

concept.title: Principal component analysis of a random vector
concept.description: For a square-integrable real vector, choose orthonormal eigenvectors of its covariance matrix in decreasing eigenvalue order. Projection onto the first k such vectors captures the largest possible sum of coordinate variances among k-dimensional orthogonal projections.

concept.title: Brownian bridge on a finite interval
concept.description: The centered Gaussian process β_t=B_t−(t/T)B_T,0≤t≤T, with endpoints zero and covariance min(s,t)−st/T. A bridge from x to y adds x+(t/T)(y−x).

concept.title: Brownian-bridge sampling of discrete Brownian paths
concept.description: Generate a Brownian path on a finite grid by first sampling its endpoint, then recursively sampling an interior value conditional on already generated bracketing values using its Gaussian bridge law.

concept.title: ANOVA decomposition on a product probability space
concept.description: For square-integrable f(X₁,…,X_n) with independent inputs, define f_∅=Ef and f_u=E[f|X_u]−∑_{v⊊u}f_v. Then f=∑_uf_u; nonconstant components have zero conditional mean after integrating any one of their active coordinates, and distinct components are orthogonal in L².

concept.title: Effective dimension in the truncation sense
concept.description: For a nonconstant square-integrable function of n independent inputs and tolerance ε∈(0,1), the smallest k for which ANOVA components involving only the first k coordinates account for at least 1−ε of its variance.

concept.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo integration
concept.description: Approximate an integral on [0,1]ˢ by the average of the integrand over a deterministic point set chosen for uniform coverage, typically of low discrepancy; other input laws can be sampled by a transformation of these points.

concept.title: Star discrepancy of a finite point set
concept.description: For points x₁,…,x_N in [0,1]ˢ, D* is sup_{a∈[0,1]ˢ}|N⁻¹∑_i1_{x_i∈[0,a)}−∏_ja_j|.

concept.title: Randomly shifted quasi-Monte Carlo rule
concept.description: Add one uniform random vector in [0,1]ˢ to every point of a deterministic quadrature set, reducing coordinates modulo one. Independent shifts give independent randomized estimates; digital shifts use digitwise addition in a fixed base instead.

concept.title: Population least-squares linear regression
concept.description: For a square-integrable response Y and real predictors X, choose coefficients a,b minimizing E(Y−aᵀX−b)². With independent standard normal predictors, b=EY and a_j=E(YX_j).

concept.title: Geometric Brownian motion
concept.description: The process S_t=S₀exp((μ−σ²/2)t+σB_t), equivalently the solution of dS_t=μS_tdt+σS_tdB_t for S₀>0.

concept.title: Black–Scholes market model
concept.description: A market with a bank account growing at constant rate r and a stock following geometric Brownian motion with constant volatility σ. Under its pricing measure the stock drift is r.

concept.title: Discretely monitored arithmetic Asian option
concept.description: A contingent claim whose payoff depends on an arithmetic average of asset prices at a specified finite set of monitoring times, for example (n⁻¹∑_kS_{t_k}−K)⁺.

concept.title: Up-and-in barrier option
concept.description: A contingent claim activated only if the asset price reaches a specified upper barrier during the monitoring period; discrete and continuous monitoring are distinct contracts. A digital version pays a fixed amount upon activation.

concept.title: Reflection principle for Brownian motion
concept.description: For standard Brownian motion, a≥0 and measurable A⊆(−∞,a), P(max_{s≤t}B_s≥a,B_t∈A)=P(B_t∈2a−A). Reflection of the path after first hitting a preserves Wiener measure.

concept.title: Girsanov change of measure for constant Brownian drift
concept.description: On Brownian paths up to T, changing measure by exp(−νB_T−ν²T/2) makes B_t+νt standard Brownian motion for 0≤t≤T.

concept.title: Regression-based Householder transform for Gaussian quadrature
concept.description: For square-integrable f under standard normal input X, compute a=E[Xf(X)] and reflect e₁ onto a/‖a‖, using identity if a=0 or the directions already agree. Then the fitted linear part of f(UX) is ‖a‖X₁, capturing variance ‖a‖². For f=g∘h the direction may instead use E[Xh(X)]; sequential residual-coordinate reflections accommodate several intermediate functions. Applying k reflections costs O(nk), excluding direction computation.

concept.title: Householder completion preserving leading orthogonal columns
concept.description: Given the first k orthonormal columns of an n×n orthogonal transform, successive Householder transformations on trailing coordinates yield an orthogonal matrix with exactly these columns. Applying its k factors costs O(nk), while the ANOVA variance attributed to the first k transformed Gaussian coordinates agrees with that of any orthogonal completion of those columns.

concept.title: Measure-preserving measurable flow
concept.description: A jointly measurable family θ_t of probability-preserving maps, indexed by real t, with θ₀=id and θ_{s+t}=θ_s∘θ_t.

concept.title: Continuous random dynamical system
concept.description: Over a measure-preserving flow θ, a measurable cocycle φ_t(ω,x) on a Polish state space, continuous in x, with φ₀(ω,x)=x and φ_{t+s}(ω,x)=φ_t(θ_sω,φ_s(ω,x)).

concept.title: Closed partial order on a topological space
concept.description: A partial order whose graph {(x,y):x≤y} is closed in the product topology. For metric spaces this is equivalent to preservation of the relation under limits of convergent pairs.

concept.title: Order interval in a partially ordered set
concept.description: For f≤g, the order interval [f,g] consists of all x satisfying f≤x≤g.

concept.title: Order-preserving random dynamical system
concept.description: A random dynamical system on a partially ordered state space such that x≤y implies φ_t(ω,x)≤φ_t(ω,y) for all t≥0 and every noise realization.

concept.title: Convergence of one-point laws for a random dynamical system
concept.description: A random dynamical system has limiting one-point law μ from every initial state if Law(φ_t(·,x)) converges weakly to μ as t→∞ for every x. This is the paper’s “strongly mixing RDS” condition, distinct from mixing of the noise flow.

concept.title: White-noise random dynamical system
concept.description: A filtered random dynamical system whose noise σ-algebras generated by cocycle increments on disjoint time intervals are independent, and transform with the time shifts of the base flow.

concept.title: Random closed set in a Polish space
concept.description: A nonempty closed-set-valued map A(ω) for which ω↦d(x,A(ω)) is measurable for every fixed x. It is a random compact set if its values are compact almost surely.

concept.title: Invariant random probability measure for a random dynamical system
concept.description: A probability kernel ω↦π_ω on the state space satisfying (φ_t(ω,·))_*π_ω=π_{θ_tω} almost surely for each t. Equivalently P(dω)π_ω(dx) is invariant under the skew-product evolution.

concept.title: Weak point attractor for a random dynamical system
concept.description: An invariant random compact set A such that for every fixed x, d(φ_t(θ_{−t}ω,x),A(ω))→0 in probability. Attraction of every deterministic compact set uniformly is a stronger condition.

concept.title: Weak synchronization by noise
concept.description: Existence of a weak point attractor consisting almost surely of one random point. Its invariance is φ_t(ω,a(ω))=a(θ_tω), and every deterministic initial state converges to it in pullback probability.

concept.title: Tight family of probability measures
concept.description: A family of probability measures on a topological space is tight if for every ε>0 some compact K has μ(K)≥1−ε for every member μ of the family.

concept.title: Prokhorov’s theorem on Polish spaces
concept.description: A family of probability measures on a Polish space is relatively compact for weak convergence if and only if it is tight; in particular every tight sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Portmanteau theorem for probability measures
concept.description: For probability measures on a metric space, weak convergence μ_n⇒μ is equivalent to limsup μ_n(F)≤μ(F) for every closed F, and equivalently to liminf μ_n(G)≥μ(G) for every open G.

concept.title: Integral Grönwall inequality
concept.description: If u is nonnegative and continuous on [0,T], a≥0, b≥0 is integrable, and u(t)≤a+∫₀ᵗb(s)u(s)ds for every t, then u(t)≤a exp(∫₀ᵗb(s)ds) for every t∈[0,T].

concept.title: Continuous dual of a normed vector space
concept.description: The vector space X* of bounded linear maps X→its scalar field, with norm ‖ℓ‖=sup_{‖x‖≤1}|ℓ(x)|.

concept.title: Sobolev space H₀¹ of a Euclidean domain
concept.description: The closure of smooth compactly supported functions in the W¹,² norm. Its elements have zero boundary trace in the usual regular-domain setting.

concept.title: Sobolev space H⁻¹ of a Euclidean domain
concept.description: The continuous dual of H₀¹, with the Hilbert-space dual norm. A locally integrable function defines an element by pairing against test functions whenever that pairing extends continuously.

concept.title: Weak Dirichlet Laplacian from H₀¹ to H⁻¹
concept.description: The operator −Δ:H₀¹→H⁻¹ defined by ⟨−Δu,v⟩=∫∇u·∇v. On a bounded domain it is an isomorphism when H₀¹ carries its gradient norm; its inverse solves the weak zero-boundary Poisson equation.

concept.title: Hilbert-valued Q-Wiener process
concept.description: A continuous Hilbert-space-valued process with independent Gaussian increments, mean zero and covariance (t−s)Q, where Q is nonnegative self-adjoint and trace class. An eigenbasis expansion is ∑_k√q_kβ_k(t)e_k with ∑_kq_k<∞.

concept.title: Stochastic porous medium equation with additive noise
concept.description: The evolution dX_t=[Δ(|X_t|^{m−1}X_t)+cX_t]dt+dW_t, m>1, on a specified domain with specified boundary conditions, interpreted variationally in a negative Sobolev state space when driven by Hilbert-valued additive Wiener noise.

concept.title: Fractional Brownian motion
concept.description: A centered continuous Gaussian process Bᴴ_t with covariance ½(|t|²ᴴ+|s|²ᴴ−|t−s|²ᴴ), H∈(0,1), normalized to start at zero. It has stationary increments, generally dependent unless H=½.

concept.title: Subdifferential of a convex function on Euclidean space
concept.description: For a proper lower semicontinuous convex f:ℝᵈ→ℝ∪{∞}, ∂f(x)={v:f(y)≥f(x)+v·(y−x) for every y}; it may contain multiple vectors or be empty.

concept.title: Normally reflected diffusion in a convex domain
concept.description: A continuous process in a closed convex domain solving an SDE plus an inward normal finite-variation correction supported on boundary times, keeping the process inside the domain.

concept.title: Asymptotic coalescence of ordered couplings with the same limiting marginal law
concept.description: On a Polish space with closed partial order, if X_t≤Y_t and both marginal laws converge weakly to the same probability measure μ, then d(X_t,Y_t)→0 in probability.

concept.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow synchronization criterion for ordered random systems
concept.description: Let a continuous order-preserving random dynamical system on a Polish space have closed partial order and one-point laws converging to μ from every initial state. If for every ε>0 there are f≤g with μ([f,g])≥1−ε, then there is a past-measurable invariant random point attracting every deterministic initial point in pullback probability. No normality, admissibility or white-noise assumption is required.

concept.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow weak synchronization for stochastic porous media
concept.description: On a bounded smooth domain in ℝᵈ with d≤4, the zero-Dirichlet stochastic porous medium equation dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+X]dt+dW, m>1, with trace-class additive Wiener noise has a singleton weak point attractor whenever its associated random dynamical system has one-point laws converging to one limiting law from every H⁻¹ initial state. The point also attracts deterministic sets contained in order intervals for the usual positive-distribution order.

concept.title: Equivalence relation
concept.description: A reflexive, symmetric and transitive binary relation.

concept.title: Equivalence class
concept.description: For an equivalence relation ~ on X, [x]={y∈X:y~x}; the quotient set X/~ consists of these classes.

concept.title: Closure of a subset of a topological space
concept.description: The closure of A is the intersection of all closed subsets containing A; a set is closed when its complement is open.

concept.title: Interior of a subset of a topological space
concept.description: The interior of A is the union of all open subsets contained in A.

concept.title: Boundary of a subset of a topological space
concept.description: The boundary of A is its closure with its interior removed.

concept.title: Dense subset of a topological space
concept.description: A subset is dense if its closure is the whole space.

concept.title: Connected topological space
concept.description: A topological space that is not the union of two disjoint nonempty open subsets.

concept.title: Connected component of a topological space
concept.description: A maximal connected subset, with connectedness understood in the subspace topology.

concept.title: Completion of a metric space
concept.description: A complete metric space containing an isometric dense copy of the given metric space. It is unique up to an isometry fixing that copy.

concept.title: Seminorm on a real or complex vector space
concept.description: A nonnegative function p with p(ax)=|a|p(x) and p(x+y)≤p(x)+p(y); p may vanish on nonzero vectors.

concept.title: Topology generated by a family of seminorms
concept.description: For seminorms (p_i) on a vector space, a neighborhood base at zero consists of finite intersections of sets {x:p_i(x)<ε}; neighborhoods at other points are translates.

concept.title: Topological vector space over ℝ or ℂ
concept.description: A real or complex vector space with a topology for which vector addition and scalar multiplication are continuous.

concept.title: Locally convex topological vector space
concept.description: A real or complex topological vector space whose zero has a neighborhood base of convex sets; equivalently its topology can be generated by seminorms.

concept.title: Limit of a real function at a point
concept.description: The relation lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<|x−a|<δ in the domain implies |f(x)−L|<ε.

concept.title: Partial derivative in Euclidean coordinates
concept.description: The ith partial derivative of f at x is the derivative at zero of t↦f(x+t e_i), with all other coordinates fixed; vector-valued maps are differentiated componentwise.

concept.title: Support of a function
concept.description: The closure in its domain of the set on which a function is nonzero.

concept.title: Compactly supported smooth test function on an open Euclidean set
concept.description: A smooth function on an open Ω⊂ℝⁿ whose support is a compact subset of Ω; these form C_c^∞(Ω).

concept.title: Borel σ-algebra of a topological space
concept.description: The σ-algebra generated by the open subsets of the space.

concept.title: Essential supremum of a measurable real function
concept.description: The infimum of real a for which f≤a almost everywhere, allowing infinite values when no finite bound exists.

concept.title: Limit inferior of an extended-real sequence
concept.description: For a sequence (a_n), liminf a_n=sup_N inf_{n≥N}a_n, allowing infinite endpoints.

concept.title: Norming family of linear functionals
concept.description: A family F of linear functionals on a normed space X is norming when ∥x∥=sup{|f(x)|:f∈F} for every x∈X.

concept.title: Finitely supported scalar sequence
concept.description: A scalar sequence with only finitely many nonzero terms; these sequences form the vector space c₀₀.

concept.title: Locally finite triangulation of a Euclidean set
concept.description: A family of Euclidean simplices covering the set, closed under taking faces and meeting in common faces, such that every point has a neighborhood meeting only finitely many simplices.

concept.title: Formal L² adjoint of a differential operator on a surface
concept.description: For a differential operator D between Euclidean vector-valued functions on a smooth surface, its formal adjoint D* is specified by ∫⟨Du,v⟩=∫⟨u,D*v⟩ for smooth compactly supported test fields, using the induced surface measure. This identity does not assert a bounded operator on L².

concept.title: Homomorphism of commutative rings
concept.description: A map between commutative rings preserving addition, multiplication and the multiplicative identity.

concept.title: Quotient of a commutative ring by an ideal
concept.description: For an ideal I of R, the cosets R/I form a ring under (r+I)+(s+I)=r+s+I and (r+I)(s+I)=rs+I.

concept.title: Module over a commutative ring
concept.description: An abelian group M with an action of a commutative ring R satisfying r(m+n)=rm+rn, (r+s)m=rm+sm, (rs)m=r(sm), and 1m=m. Unlike a vector space, its scalar ring need not be a field.

concept.title: Homomorphism of modules over a commutative ring
concept.description: An additive map f:M→N of modules over the same commutative ring satisfying f(rm)=rf(m).

concept.title: Submodule of a module over a commutative ring
concept.description: An additive subgroup of a module stable under multiplication by every scalar of its coefficient ring.

concept.title: Quotient module
concept.description: For a submodule N of an R-module M, the cosets M/N carry addition and scalar multiplication induced from M.

concept.title: Tensor product of modules over a commutative ring
concept.description: For R-modules M,N, the R-module M⊗_R N with a bilinear map (m,n)↦m⊗n through which every R-bilinear map M×N→P factors uniquely by an R-linear map.

concept.title: Commutative algebra over a commutative ring
concept.description: A commutative ring A with a specified unital ring homomorphism R→A; algebra homomorphisms commute with these structure maps.

concept.title: Commutative algebra over a field
concept.description: A unital associative algebra over a field whose multiplication is commutative, equivalently a commutative ring equipped with a unital homomorphism from that field.

concept.title: Homomorphism of algebras over a field
concept.description: A linear map of unital associative algebras over the same field preserving multiplication and the multiplicative identity.

concept.title: Polynomial ring over a commutative ring
concept.description: The ring R[X₁,…,X_n] of formal finite sums of monomials with coefficients in R, with coefficientwise addition and the usual multiplication of monomials.

concept.title: Finitely generated commutative algebra
concept.description: An R-algebra A generated as an algebra by finitely many elements; equivalently a quotient of R[X₁,…,X_n] for some finite n.

concept.title: Nilpotent ideal of a commutative ring
concept.description: An ideal I for which I^n=0 for some positive integer n, meaning every product of n elements of I is zero.

concept.title: Finitely presented commutative algebra
concept.description: An R-algebra isomorphic to R[X₁,…,X_n]/(f₁,…,f_m) for finite n,m.

concept.title: Smooth finitely presented commutative algebra
concept.description: A finitely presented R-algebra A such that, for every R-algebra B with nilpotent ideal I, every R-algebra map A→B/I lifts to A→B. This is the infinitesimal lifting formulation of smoothness for affine finite-presentation algebras.

concept.title: Commutative Hopf algebra over a field
concept.description: A Hopf algebra over a field whose underlying algebra multiplication is commutative; its coproduct need not be cocommutative.

concept.title: Hopf ideal of a commutative Hopf algebra
concept.description: An ideal I of a commutative Hopf algebra H satisfying Δ(I)⊂I⊗H+H⊗I, ε(I)=0 and S(I)⊂I, so the quotient inherits the Hopf operations.

concept.title: Algebraically closed field
concept.description: A field in which every nonconstant polynomial has a root.

concept.title: Algebraic closure of a field
concept.description: An algebraic extension of a field that is itself algebraically closed. This specifies an object, without including the existence or uniqueness-up-to-isomorphism theorem.

concept.title: Minimal polynomial of an algebraic element
concept.description: The unique monic polynomial of least positive degree over F vanishing at an algebraic element α; it generates the ideal of all polynomials over F vanishing at α.

concept.title: Separable polynomial over a field
concept.description: A polynomial having no repeated root in an algebraic closure of its coefficient field.

concept.title: Finite field
concept.description: A field whose underlying set is finite.

concept.title: Frobenius endomorphism in characteristic p
concept.description: The field endomorphism x↦x^p of a field of characteristic p; over F_q the q-power iterate x↦x^q is the corresponding q-Frobenius.

concept.title: p-adic valuation of a rational number
concept.description: For a prime p and nonzero rational x, v_p(x) is the unique integer r such that x=p^r a/b with integers a,b not divisible by p; put v_p(0)=+∞.

concept.title: Absolute value on a field
concept.description: A map |·|:K→R_{≥0} that vanishes exactly at zero, is multiplicative and satisfies |x+y|≤|x|+|y|. It is nonarchimedean if the stronger bound |x+y|≤max(|x|,|y|) holds.

concept.title: Discrete valuation on a field
concept.description: A surjective map v:K×→Z satisfying v(xy)=v(x)+v(y) and v(x+y)≥min(v(x),v(y)), extended by v(0)=+∞.

concept.title: Valuation ring of a discretely valued field
concept.description: For a discrete valuation v on K, the ring O_v={x:v(x)≥0}; its maximal ideal is m_v={x:v(x)>0}.

concept.title: Residue field of a discretely valued field
concept.description: The quotient O_v/m_v of the valuation ring by its maximal ideal.

concept.title: Ramification index of a finite extension of discretely valued fields
concept.description: For L/K with compatible normalized discrete valuations v_L,v_K, the positive integer e satisfying v_L(x)=e v_K(x) for every x in K×; equivalently [v_L(L×):v_L(K×)]=e.

concept.title: Matching in a graph
concept.description: A set of edges no two of which share a vertex. Unmatched vertices are called monomers in a monomer–dimer interpretation.

concept.title: Monomer–dimer model on a finite graph
concept.description: A probability distribution on graph matchings in which unmatched vertices are monomers and matched edges dimers, with specified nonnegative vertex and edge activities multiplying to give each matching’s unnormalized weight. The matching constraint is the hard-core exclusion.

concept.title: Imitative monomer–dimer model on the complete graph
concept.description: On matchings D of K_N, let S(D)=N−2|D| be the monomer count. With external field h∈ℝ and coupling J≥0, assign D probability proportional to N^{−|D|}exp((h−J)S(D)+JS(D)²/N). This is the complete-graph monomer–dimer model with attractive imitative interaction.

concept.title: Moment generating function
concept.description: For a real random variable X, M_X(t)=Eexp(tX) at real t for which the expectation is finite.

concept.title: Characteristic function of a real probability distribution
concept.description: For a real random variable X, φ_X(t)=Eexp(itX), t∈ℝ. It is always defined and determines the law of X.

concept.title: Convolution of probability distributions on Euclidean space
concept.description: The convolution μ*ν is the law of X+Y for independent random vectors with laws μ,ν; equivalently (μ*ν)(A)=∫∫1_A(x+y)μ(dx)ν(dy).

concept.title: Lévy continuity theorem
concept.description: If characteristic functions φ_n converge pointwise to a function φ continuous at zero, then φ is a characteristic function and the corresponding probability distributions converge weakly to its law. Conversely weak convergence implies pointwise characteristic-function convergence.

concept.title: Moment-generating-function convergence theorem
concept.description: If moment generating functions are finite on a common neighborhood of zero and converge there pointwise to the moment generating function of a probability distribution, the corresponding distributions converge weakly to that distribution.

concept.title: Even moments of a centered Gaussian
concept.description: For Z∼N(0,σ²), E[Z^{2k}]=(2k−1)!!σ^{2k} and odd moments vanish, with (−1)!!=1. The double factorial counts pairings of 2k labeled elements.

concept.title: Integration by parts for real integrals
concept.description: For continuously differentiable u,v on [a,b], ∫_a^buv′=[uv]_a^b−∫_a^bu′v; improper variants follow when boundary terms and integrals converge.

concept.title: Taylor’s theorem with Lagrange remainder
concept.description: If f has n continuous derivatives on an interval and an (n+1)st derivative between a and x, then f(x)=∑_{j=0}ⁿf⁽ʲ⁾(a)(x−a)ʲ/j!+f⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾(ξ)(x−a)ⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)! for some ξ between a and x.

concept.title: Laplace’s method at a nondegenerate real maximum
concept.description: If a smooth real f has a unique interior maximum x₀ with f″(x₀)<0 and integrable exponentially negligible tails, then ∫e^{Nf(x)}dx∼e^{Nf(x₀)}√(2π/(−Nf″(x₀))). Continuous prefactors multiply the leading term by their value at x₀.

concept.title: Laplace asymptotics for varying real integrands
concept.description: Let ψ_n be positive on a fixed compact interval K with f_n=logψ_n and f_n,f_n″ converging uniformly there to f,f″. Suppose each f_n attains its maximum at an interior x_n, f has a unique interior maximum x₀ with f″(x₀)<0, the logarithmic supremum of |ψ_n| outside K is uniformly separated below f_n(x_n), and ∫|ψ_n| is uniformly bounded. Then ∫ψ_n(x)ⁿdx∼exp(nf_n(x_n))√(2π/(−nf″(x₀))).

concept.title: Vitali–Porter convergence theorem for holomorphic functions
concept.description: A locally uniformly bounded sequence of holomorphic functions on a connected domain that converges pointwise on a set with an interior accumulation point converges uniformly on compact subsets to a holomorphic function.

concept.title: Complex line integral along a piecewise smooth path
concept.description: For a piecewise C¹ path γ:[a,b]→ℂ and continuous f on its image, ∫_γf(z)dz=∫_a^bf(γ(t))γ′(t)dt, with real and imaginary parts integrated separately.

concept.title: Cauchy integral formula on a disk
concept.description: If f is holomorphic on a neighborhood of a closed disk with positively oriented boundary circle C, then for z inside the disk, f(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Cf(ζ)/(ζ−z)dζ. Derivatives follow by differentiating the kernel.

concept.title: Interlacing of real-rooted polynomials
concept.description: The real zeros of degree-n and degree-(n−1) real-rooted polynomials interlace if, when listed with multiplicity, α₁≤β₁≤α₂≤⋯≤β_{n−1}≤α_n.

concept.title: Weierstrass theorem on locally uniform holomorphic limits
concept.description: A locally uniform limit of holomorphic functions is holomorphic, and every order of derivative converges locally uniformly to the corresponding derivative of the limit.

concept.title: Heilmann–Lieb real-rootedness theorem for matching polynomials
concept.description: For a finite graph with nonnegative edge weights, the matching polynomial μ_G(x)=∑_D(−1)^{|D|}(∏_{e∈D}w_e)x^{|V|−2|D|} has only real zeros. Equivalently the monomer-activity partition polynomial with positive dimer activities has its zeros on the imaginary axis.

concept.title: Monomer-density limit and phase coexistence in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concept.description: In the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model define g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2, p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)), and F(m)=−Jm²+p₀((2m−1)J+h). If F has a unique global maximizer m*, then S_N/N converges in distribution to m*. On the coexistence curve, where its two nondegenerate global maxima are m₁<m₂, the limit is ρ₁δ_{m₁}+ρ₂δ_{m₂}, with ρ_l proportional to [−F″(m_l)(2−m_l)]⁻¹ᐟ².

concept.title: Gaussian and quartic monomer-count fluctuations in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concept.description: For the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model with J>0, let F and its unique maximizer m* be as in the density-limit theorem. Away from coexistence and the critical endpoint, (S_N−Nm*)/√N converges to N(0,−1/F″(m*)−1/(2J)). At the critical endpoint, F″=F‴=0,F⁽⁴⁾<0 and (S_N−Nm*)/N³ᐟ⁴ converges to the density proportional to exp(F⁽⁴⁾(m*)x⁴/24). For J=0 the Gaussian limit has mean-density g(h) and variance g′(h).

concept.title: Exponential distribution
concept.description: The nonnegative distribution with survival function P(T>t)=exp(−rt), t≥0, for rate r>0; its mean is 1/r.

concept.title: Probability generating function
concept.description: For a nonnegative integer-valued random variable A, G(s)=E[sᴬ]=∑_{k≥0}P(A=k)sᵏ for 0≤s≤1, with extension where the series converges.

concept.title: Galton–Watson branching process
concept.description: A population process Z_{n+1}=∑_{i=1}^{Z_n}A_{n,i}, where all offspring counts are independent with a common nonnegative-integer distribution and are independent of the past.

concept.title: Markov process killed on leaving a domain
concept.description: Run a Markov process until its first exit time τ_D from a specified domain and then send it to an absorbing cemetery state. Its sub-Markov semigroup is P_tᴰf(x)=E_x[f(X_t)1_{t<τ_D}].

concept.title: Branching diffusion killed at the boundary of a domain
concept.description: Particles move independently as a specified diffusion in D, are killed upon leaving D, and independently branch at rate β into A offspring at their current positions; offspring repeat the same dynamics independently. Start from a specified finite configuration.

concept.title: Uniformly elliptic symmetric divergence-form operator
concept.description: A second-order operator Lf=∑_{i,j}∂_i(a^{ij}(x)∂_jf) with symmetric coefficients for which c|ξ|²≤∑a^{ij}(x)ξ_iξ_j≤C|ξ|² uniformly in x, for fixed0<c≤C<∞; coefficients and boundary conditions determine its realization.

concept.title: Principal Dirichlet eigenpair of a symmetric elliptic operator
concept.description: For a connected bounded domain and a symmetric uniformly elliptic Dirichlet operator −L, the smallest eigenvalue λ₁ and its positive L²-normalized eigenfunction φ solve −Lφ=λ₁φ with zero boundary trace.

concept.title: Doob ground-state transform of a killed semigroup
concept.description: If a positive function h satisfies P_tᴰh=e^{−λt}h, define Q_tf(x)=e^{λt}P_tᴰ(hf)(x)/h(x). This is a Markov semigroup representing the process conditioned by h; for a killed symmetric diffusion and principal eigenfunction h it describes conditioning to stay in the domain.

concept.title: Intrinsic ultracontractivity of a symmetric killed semigroup
concept.description: A symmetric killed semigroup with positive ground state φ is intrinsically ultracontractive if for every t>0 its transition density satisfies p_t(x,y)≤C_tφ(x)φ(y) almost everywhere for a finite C_t. Equivalently its ground-state-transformed semigroup maps L²(φ²dx) boundedly to L∞.

concept.title: Many-to-one lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concept.description: If particles branch independently at rate β with mean offspring m and move by a killed Markov semigroup P_tᴰ, then E_x∑_{u∈N_t}f(X_u(t))=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf(x) for nonnegative measurable f.

concept.title: Many-to-two second-moment formula for branching Markov processes
concept.description: For rate-β branching with offspring mean m and finite factorial second moment q=E[A(A−1)], set T_tf=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf. Then E_x[(∑_uf(X_u(t)))(∑_ug(X_u(t)))]=T_t(fg)(x)+βq∫₀ᵗT_s[(T_{t−s}f)(T_{t−s}g)](x)ds for bounded nonnegative f,g.

concept.title: Additive-martingale spine change of measure for a branching diffusion
concept.description: Weight the branching law up to t by M_t/M₀, where M_t=e^{(λ−β(m−1))t}∑_uφ(X_u(t)). Under the weighted law a distinguished lineage moves by the φ-ground-state transform, branches at accelerated rate mβ with size-biased offspring law kP(A=k)/m, and chooses one child uniformly to continue the spine; other children start independent original branching families.

concept.title: Fisher–Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov equation
concept.description: A reaction–diffusion equation ∂_tu=DΔu+r u(1−u), with D,r>0, on a specified spatial domain and with specified initial and boundary conditions. It appears in population models and branching Brownian survival probabilities.

concept.title: Dini’s theorem
concept.description: If continuous real functions on a compact space converge pointwise monotonically to a continuous limit, the convergence is uniform.

concept.title: Method of moments for convergence in distribution
concept.description: If probability laws have all moments, each moment converges to the corresponding finite moment of a probability law uniquely determined by its moments, then the laws converge weakly to that law.

concept.title: Moment determinacy from a finite exponential moment
concept.description: A real probability law whose moment generating function is finite in a neighborhood of zero is uniquely determined by its moments. In particular exponential distributions are moment-determinate.

concept.title: Poincaré inequality on H₀¹ of a bounded domain
concept.description: For a bounded domain D⊂ℝᵈ there is C_D<∞ such that ‖u‖_{L²(D)}≤C_D‖∇u‖_{L²(D)} for all u∈H₀¹(D).

concept.title: Parseval’s identity for an orthonormal Hilbert basis
concept.description: For an orthonormal basis (e_k) of a separable Hilbert space, x=∑_k⟨x,e_k⟩e_k in norm and ‖x‖²=∑_k|⟨x,e_k⟩|².

concept.title: Continuous-time martingale
concept.description: An integrable process M_t adapted to a filtration F_t, t≥0, with E[M_t|F_s]=M_s almost surely whenever s≤t. Right-continuity of paths is an additional regularity condition when needed.

concept.title: Nonnegative martingale convergence theorem
concept.description: A nonnegative right-continuous martingale converges almost surely to a finite integrable random variable as t→∞. Its limiting expectation may be strictly smaller than its initial expectation.

concept.title: Sevast’yanov–Watanabe extinction criterion for bounded-domain branching diffusions
concept.description: For a bounded connected sufficiently regular domain D, a symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion with principal Dirichlet eigenvalue λ, and independent rate-β branching of mean m>1, survival forever has positive probability exactly when β(m−1)>λ. At and below criticality extinction is almost sure; the survival probability to t tends to zero uniformly over starting positions. Lipschitz boundary suffices.

concept.title: Critical branching-diffusion survival asymptotic on a C¹ domain
concept.description: On a bounded connected C¹ domain, let −L be symmetric uniformly elliptic with smooth coefficients and positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction φ, eigenvalue λ. For rate β=λ/(m−1) branching with mean m=EA>1 and finite second moment, P_x(N_t>0)∼2(m−1)φ(x)/[λE(A(A−1))∫_Dφ³·t].

concept.title: Yaglom limit for critical bounded-domain branching diffusions
concept.description: Under the C¹-domain, symmetric elliptic motion and finite-second-moment offspring hypotheses of the critical survival theorem, for measurable E⊆D the conditional law of N_t(E)/t given N_t>0 converges to an exponential law of mean λE[A(A−1)](∫_Eφ)(∫_Dφ³)/(2(m−1)); zero mean denotes the degenerate law at zero. The conditional empirical spatial law converges in probability on each such E to ∫_Eφ/∫_Dφ.

concept.title: Powell’s fixed-window limit under long-survival conditioning
concept.description: For the critical killed branching diffusion on a bounded C¹ domain under the survival-asymptotic hypotheses, for every fixed T and event B measurable through time T, lim_{t→∞}P_x(B|N_t>0)=Q_x(B), where Q_x is the additive-martingale spine law.

concept.title: Group action on a set
concept.description: A map G×X→X, written (g,x)↦gx, satisfying ex=x and (gh)x=g(hx).

concept.title: Product topology
concept.description: On a Cartesian product of topological spaces, the topology with basic open sets restricting finitely many coordinates to open subsets and leaving all other coordinates unrestricted.

concept.title: Subspace topology
concept.description: For A⊆X, the topology whose open sets are A∩U for U open in X.

concept.title: Quotient topology
concept.description: For a surjection q:X→Y, a subset U⊆Y is open exactly when q⁻¹(U) is open in X.

concept.title: Hausdorff topological space
concept.description: A topological space in which any two distinct points have disjoint open neighbourhoods.

concept.title: Locally compact Hausdorff space
concept.description: A Hausdorff topological space in which every point has a neighbourhood with compact closure.

concept.title: Topological group
concept.description: A group with a topology for which multiplication G×G→G and inversion G→G are continuous.

concept.title: Locally compact group
concept.description: A topological group whose underlying space is locally compact and Hausdorff.

concept.title: Topological ring
concept.description: A ring with a topology for which addition, multiplication and additive inversion are continuous; the rings here are commutative with identity.

concept.title: Completion of a field with an absolute value
concept.description: The metric completion of K for d(x,y)=|x−y|, with the field operations extended continuously. A completion is regarded as containing K through its canonical isometric embedding.

concept.title: Complete discretely valued field
concept.description: A field with a discrete valuation v which is complete for the metric defined by any absolute value c^(−v(x)) with c>1, extended by |0|=0.

concept.title: Nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: A field complete for a nontrivial discrete valuation and having a finite residue field.

concept.title: Restricted product of topological groups
concept.description: For groups G_i with chosen open subgroups K_i, the group of tuples g_i with g_i∈K_i for all but finitely many i, with the topology whose basic opens are products of open sets equal to K_i outside finitely many coordinates.

concept.title: Complex derivative
concept.description: For a complex-valued function on an open subset of C, f′(z) is the limit of (f(z+h)−f(z))/h as nonzero complex h→0, when it exists.

concept.title: Holomorphic function of several complex variables
concept.description: A complex function on an open subset of C^n that is locally representable by a convergent power series in the n complex coordinates. Vector-valued holomorphy for a finite-dimensional target means holomorphy of its coordinates in any basis.

concept.title: Cusp of a subgroup of SL₂(Z)
concept.description: An orbit of a subgroup Γ⊂SL₂(Z) on Q∪{∞} under fractional linear transformations; for a congruence subgroup its cusp width is the positive translation period after sending a representative to infinity.

concept.title: Holomorphy of a modular form at a cusp
concept.description: After applying the weight-k slash action by a matrix sending a cusp to infinity, the resulting periodic function has a Fourier expansion in q_h=exp(2πiτ/h) with no negative powers, where h is the cusp width.

concept.title: Complex torus
concept.description: A quotient V/Λ of a finite-dimensional complex vector space V by a discrete subgroup Λ generated over Z by a real basis of V, with the quotient topology and the local complex coordinates induced by translations in V.

concept.title: Convex function on a convex subset of a real vector space
concept.description: A function f:C→R on a convex subset of a real vector space satisfying f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y) for x,y∈C and 0≤t≤1. Unlike the separate interval-convex-function identity, the domain may be infinite-dimensional.

concept.title: Representing measure for a point of a compact convex set
concept.description: A Borel probability measure μ on a compact convex subset K of a locally convex space represents x∈K if ∫_K f dμ=f(x) for every continuous affine real function f on K.

concept.title: Choquet order on probability measures
concept.description: For Borel probability measures on a compact convex set K, write μ≼ν if ∫f dμ≤∫f dν for every continuous convex real function f on K. A maximal measure has no strictly larger measure for this order.

concept.title: Directed ordered abelian group
concept.description: A partially ordered abelian group in which any two elements have a common upper bound; equivalently every element is a difference of two nonnegative elements.

concept.title: General linear group over a commutative ring
concept.description: The group GL_n(R) of square matrices over a commutative ring R having a two-sided matrix inverse, with matrix multiplication.

concept.title: Trace of a square matrix
concept.description: The sum of the diagonal entries of a square matrix.

concept.title: Automorphism of a group
concept.description: A bijective group homomorphism from a group to itself; automorphisms form a group under composition.

concept.title: Semidirect product of groups
concept.description: Given a homomorphism α:G→Aut(H), the group H⋊_αG has underlying set H×G and multiplication (h,g)(h′,g′)=(hα(g)(h′),gg′).

concept.title: Integral Heisenberg group for scalar-index Jacobi forms
concept.description: For λ,μ in Z^g and κ in Z, use the triples (λ,μ,κ) with product (λ+λ′,μ+μ′,κ+κ′+λ·μ′−μ·λ′). The dot products are the finite coordinate sums; this specifies the integral normalization used in the scalar-index Jacobi slash action.

concept.title: Integral Jacobi group
concept.description: The semidirect product of Sp(2g,Z) with the integral Heisenberg group, where the symplectic factor acts on the λ,μ coordinates and fixes the center; its action on H_g×C^g is the one used in Jacobi modular and elliptic transformation laws.

concept.title: Right triangle in Euclidean space
concept.description: A nondegenerate triangle with vertices a,a+u,a+v for nonzero Euclidean vectors u,v satisfying u·v=0, where u·v is the sum of coordinate products. The side from a+u to a+v is the hypotenuse.

concept.title: von Mangoldt function
concept.description: The arithmetic function Λ(n)=log p if n=p^k for a prime p and integer k≥1, and Λ(n)=0 otherwise.

concept.title: Real power of a positive real number
concept.description: For x>0 and p∈ℝ, define xᵖ=exp(p log x). For p>0 extend by 0ᵖ=0.

concept.title: Quasi-normed vector space
concept.description: A real or complex vector space with a positive definite absolutely homogeneous function q satisfying q(x+y)≤C(q(x)+q(y)) for a fixed C≥1.

concept.title: Homogeneous real polynomial
concept.description: A real polynomial in finitely many variables whose nonzero monomials all have the same total degree.

concept.title: Uniform convergence on compact subsets
concept.description: A sequence of functions converges locally uniformly on a topological space if it converges uniformly on every compact subset.

concept.title: Complex power series
concept.description: A series ∑ₙ₌₀∞aₙ(z−z₀)ⁿ with complex coefficients, considered at points where its partial sums converge.

concept.title: Fréchet derivative between normed spaces
concept.description: The Fréchet derivative of f at x is a bounded linear map A with ∥f(x+h)−f(x)−Ah∥/∥h∥→0 as h→0.

concept.title: Complex Banach algebra, possibly nonunital
concept.description: A complex Banach space with associative bilinear multiplication satisfying ∥ab∥≤∥a∥∥b∥. An identity is not required.

concept.title: Unitization of a complex Banach algebra
concept.description: For a nonunital complex Banach algebra A, its unitization is A⊕ℂ with multiplication (a,λ)(b,μ)=(ab+λb+μa,λμ), identity (0,1), and norm ∥a∥+|λ|.

concept.title: Spectrum of an element of a complex Banach algebra
concept.description: For a in a complex Banach algebra A, σ(a) consists of complex λ for which λ1−a has no two-sided inverse, using the unitization if A has no identity.

concept.title: Hausdorff measure of a metric space
concept.description: For s≥0, the s-dimensional Hausdorff measure is the limit as δ↓0 of the infimum of normalized sums of diameters^s over countable covers by sets of diameter at most δ.

concept.title: Area measure on the Euclidean unit sphere
concept.description: On S^{d−1}⊂ℝᵈ, spherical area is the restriction of (d−1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Its probability normalization divides by its total mass.

concept.title: Pushforward measure
concept.description: For a measurable map f:X→Y and measure μ on X, the pushforward f_*μ on Y satisfies f_*μ(B)=μ(f⁻¹(B)).

concept.title: Outer unit normal of a convex body
concept.description: A unit vector u is an outer normal at x∈∂K if (y−x)·u≤0 for every y∈K; at boundary points with a unique such u, this gives the Gauss map.

concept.title: Harmonic function on a plane domain
concept.description: A twice continuously differentiable real function u on an open Ω⊂ℝ² satisfying ∂₁²u+∂₂²u=0.

concept.title: Green function of the unit disk
concept.description: For z,ζ in the disk, G(z,ζ)=log|(1−ζ̄z)/(z−ζ)|, with value∞ at z=ζ; it is zero at the boundary in the z variable and gives the disk’s logarithmic potential kernel.

concept.title: Isomorphism of Banach spaces
concept.description: A bounded linear bijection between Banach spaces whose inverse is bounded.

concept.title: Independent σ-algebras
concept.description: A family of sub-σ-algebras is independent if the probability of the intersection of events from any finite subfamily equals the product of their probabilities.

concept.title: Stochastic process
concept.description: A family (X_t) indexed by a specified time set, with each X_t a measurable map from a probability space into a specified measurable state space. Adaptation, joint measurability and path regularity are additional conditions when required.

concept.title: Gaussian process
concept.description: A real or vector-valued stochastic process whose every finite vector of coordinate evaluations has a multivariate normal law.

concept.title: Separable metric space
concept.description: A metric space having a countable dense subset.

concept.title: Lusin topological space
concept.description: A Hausdorff topological space that is a continuous bijective image of a Polish space. Its Borel measurable space is consequently standard Borel; the topology need not itself be Polish.

concept.title: Function of bounded variation on an interval
concept.description: A real function f has bounded variation on [a,b] if sup∑_i|f(t_i)−f(t_{i−1})| over finite ordered partitions is finite. Vector-valued paths use the corresponding norm.

concept.title: Continuous local martingale
concept.description: A continuous adapted process M_t for which stopping times T_n↑∞ almost surely exist such that M_{t∧T_n} is a martingale for every n.

concept.title: Continuous semimartingale
concept.description: A continuous adapted process expressible as M+A where M is a continuous local martingale and A is an adapted continuous process of finite variation on every bounded time interval.

concept.title: Predictable stochastic process
concept.description: A process measurable for the σ-algebra on time×sample space generated by adapted left-continuous processes. This formalizes choosing an integrand from information available just before the integration time.

concept.title: Absolutely continuous function on a real interval
concept.description: A real function f on [a,b] is absolutely continuous if for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that any finite disjoint family of intervals (a_i,b_i) with ∑(b_i−a_i)<δ has ∑|f(b_i)−f(a_i)|<ε.

concept.title: Finite-rank linear operator
concept.description: A linear map whose image is finite-dimensional.

concept.title: Positive trace-class operator on a Hilbert space
concept.description: A nonnegative bounded self-adjoint operator Q is trace class if ∑_k⟨Qe_k,e_k⟩<∞ for an orthonormal basis; the sum is independent of the basis and equals its trace.

concept.title: Local martingale
concept.description: An adapted càdlàg process M for which stopping times T_n↑∞ almost surely exist such that each stopped process M_{t∧T_n} is a martingale.

concept.title: Characteristic of a field
concept.description: The least positive integer n with n·1=0 in the field, if one exists, and zero otherwise.

concept.title: Element integral over a commutative ring
concept.description: For a ring inclusion R⊂A, an element a∈A is integral over R if it satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in R.

concept.title: Normal subgroup
concept.description: A subgroup H of G satisfying gHg⁻¹=H for every g∈G.

concept.title: Commutator subgroup
concept.description: The subgroup [G,G] generated by all commutators xyx⁻¹y⁻¹ with x,y∈G.

concept.title: Solvable group
concept.description: A group whose iterated commutator subgroups reach the trivial subgroup after finitely many steps.

concept.title: Tensor product of commutative algebras
concept.description: For commutative R-algebras A,B, the module A⊗_R B with multiplication (a⊗b)(a′⊗b′)=aa′⊗bb′ and unit 1⊗1; it is the coproduct of A and B among commutative R-algebras.

concept.title: Base change of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For a field extension L/F and an affine F-group with coordinate Hopf algebra A, its base change to L has coordinate Hopf algebra L⊗_F A.

concept.title: Morphism of affine algebraic groups
concept.description: A homomorphism defined by regular coordinate functions; in coordinate algebras it is a homomorphism of commutative Hopf algebras in the opposite direction, preserving coproduct, counit and antipode.

concept.title: Closed subgroup of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: A subgroup represented by the quotient of its ambient group’s coordinate Hopf algebra by a Hopf ideal.

concept.title: Rational points of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For an affine F-group G with coordinate Hopf algebra A and commutative F-algebra R, the group G(R)=Hom_(F-alg)(A,R), with group multiplication induced by the coproduct of A.

concept.title: Algebraic representation of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: A morphism of algebraic groups G→GL(V) for a finite-dimensional vector space V; equivalently an action with regular matrix coefficient functions. A faithful representation identifies G with a closed algebraic subgroup of GL(V).

concept.title: Smooth affine algebraic group
concept.description: An affine algebraic group over F whose coordinate algebra is smooth over F. In the finite-type characteristic-zero case all affine group schemes are smooth, but that assertion is a separate theorem.

concept.title: Geometrically connected affine algebraic group
concept.description: An affine F-group whose coordinate algebra after extension to an algebraic closure has no idempotents other than 0 and 1. This is the coordinate-algebra account of connectedness after base change.

concept.title: Unipotent affine algebraic group
concept.description: An affine algebraic group that, after extension to an algebraic closure, has a faithful algebraic representation with all matrices upper triangular and every diagonal entry 1.

concept.title: Solvable smooth affine algebraic group
concept.description: A smooth affine algebraic group whose group of points over an algebraic closure is solvable. For the characteristic-zero groups used here this agrees with termination of the algebraic derived series.

concept.title: Borel subgroup of a connected affine algebraic group
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, a maximal smooth connected solvable closed subgroup. Over F, a subgroup is an F-Borel subgroup if its base change to an algebraic closure is such a Borel subgroup.

concept.title: Multiplicative algebraic group
concept.description: The affine F-group G_m with R-points R×, represented by F[t,t⁻¹], whose coproduct sends t to t⊗t.

concept.title: Split algebraic torus
concept.description: An algebraic F-group isomorphic over F to a finite product of copies of G_m. An F-torus need only become such a product after extending F to an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Commutative Hopf algebra over a commutative ring
concept.description: A commutative R-algebra A with R-algebra maps Δ:A→A⊗_R A, ε:A→R and S:A→A satisfying the coassociativity, counit and inverse identities: (Δ⊗id)Δ=(id⊗Δ)Δ and m(S⊗id)Δ=m(id⊗S)Δ=ηε.

concept.title: Affine group scheme of finite presentation over a ring
concept.description: A commutative Hopf R-algebra A that is finitely presented as an R-algebra, regarded through its group-valued functor B↦Hom_(R-alg)(A,B). This coordinate account defines the affine group scheme without requiring general scheme theory.

concept.title: Base change of an affine group scheme
concept.description: For R→S and an affine group scheme represented by A, its base change is represented by S⊗_R A with the induced Hopf operations. A residue-field fiber is this construction for S=R/𝔪.

concept.title: Topological field
