concept.description: A field with a topology making addition, multiplication, additive inversion and inversion on the nonzero elements continuous.

concept.title: Local field
concept.description: A nondiscrete locally compact Hausdorff topological field. Both archimedean and nonarchimedean local fields are allowed.

concept.title: Local-field topology on points of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For a local field F and an affine embedding G⊂A^n, give G(F) the subspace topology from F^n. Polynomial coordinate maps show this topology is independent of the chosen affine embedding.

concept.title: Separable closure of a field
concept.description: A separable algebraic extension F^sep/F that has no further nontrivial finite separable algebraic extension, equivalently the separable elements in a chosen algebraic closure.

concept.title: Krull topology on an infinite Galois group
concept.description: On Gal(L/F), the subgroup fixing each finite intermediate extension E/F is an open neighbourhood of the identity; their cosets form a basis. For an absolute Galois group take L=F^sep.

concept.title: Absolute Galois group
concept.description: The group Gal(F^sep/F), with its Krull topology, where F^sep is a separable closure.

concept.title: Continuous nonabelian 1-cocycle
concept.description: For a topological group Γ acting continuously on a group H, a continuous map c:Γ→H satisfying c(στ)=c(σ)σ(c(τ)). Cocycles are equivalent when c′(σ)=h⁻¹c(σ)σ(h) for one h∈H.

concept.title: Existence of a closed algebraic-group orbit
concept.description: A nonempty algebraic variety over an algebraically closed field, acted on morphically by an algebraic group, contains an orbit closed in that variety.

concept.title: Fiber dimension theorem for algebraic varieties
concept.description: For a dominant morphism of irreducible algebraic varieties, the generic fiber has dimension dim X−dim Y; if all fibers have dimension r, then dim X=dim Y+r.

concept.title: Irreducibility of connected smooth algebraic groups
concept.description: A connected smooth algebraic group over an algebraically closed field is irreducible, and every proper closed subvariety has strictly smaller dimension.

concept.title: Frobenius generates the absolute Galois group of a finite field
concept.description: For F_q, its absolute Galois group is procyclic, topologically generated by x↦x^q; equivalently the integer powers of that Frobenius are dense in Gal(F_q^sep/F_q).

concept.title: Dynkin’s π–λ theorem
concept.description: If a family P contains the whole space and is closed under finite intersections, every family containing P and closed under complements and countable disjoint unions contains the σ-algebra generated by P.

concept.title: Uniqueness theorem for characteristic functions
concept.description: Two Borel probability measures on ℝ have the same characteristic function if and only if they are equal.

concept.title: Tower property of conditional expectation
concept.description: For sub-σ-algebras F⊆G and integrable X, E[E[X|G]|F]=E[X|F]; also E[E[X|F]|G]=E[X|F].

concept.title: Hoeffding’s lemma
concept.description: If a≤X≤b almost surely and EX=0, then Eexp(tX)≤exp(t²(b−a)²/8) for every real t.

concept.title: Taylor’s theorem with integral remainder
concept.description: If f is C^{n+1} on the interval joining a and x, then f(x)=∑_{k=0}ⁿf⁽ᵏ⁾(a)(x−a)ᵏ/k!+∫_a^xf⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾(s)(x−s)ⁿ/n! ds.

concept.title: Orthonormal family in a Hilbert space
concept.description: Vectors (e_i) with ⟨e_i,e_j⟩=0 for i≠j and ‖e_i‖=1.

concept.title: Orthonormal basis of a Hilbert space
concept.description: An orthonormal family whose linear span is dense in the Hilbert space.

concept.title: Strongly continuous contraction semigroup
concept.description: Bounded operators T_t on a Banach space satisfy T₀=I,T_{s+t}=T_sT_t,‖T_t‖≤1 and T_tx→x in norm as t↓0 for every x.

concept.title: Uniqueness of finite-dimensional characteristic functions
concept.description: Two Borel probability laws on ℝᵈ agree if their characteristic functions u↦Eexp(iu·X) agree for every u∈ℝᵈ. Equivalently, equality in law of every scalar linear combination of coordinates determines the joint law.

concept.title: Tagged Riemann sum
concept.description: For a partition a=x₀<⋯<x_n=b and tags t_i∈[x_{i−1},x_i], the Riemann sum of f is ∑ᵢf(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}); the partition mesh is maxᵢ(x_i−x_{i−1}).

concept.title: Fatou’s lemma
concept.description: For nonnegative measurable functions f_n on a measure space, ∫liminf_n f_n≤liminf_n∫f_n, allowing∞.

concept.title: Approximation of nonnegative measurable functions by simple functions
concept.description: Every nonnegative measurable function is the pointwise increasing limit of nonnegative measurable simple functions.

concept.title: Norm of a bounded self-adjoint operator from its quadratic form
concept.description: For a bounded self-adjoint operator A on a complex Hilbert space, ∥A∥=sup_{∥x∥=1}|⟨Ax,x⟩|.

concept.title: Continuous functional calculus for a self-adjoint C*-algebra element
concept.description: For self-adjoint a in a C*-algebra, continuous scalar functions on σ(a) can be evaluated at a by the unique isometric *-homomorphism sending the identity function to a and the constant one to the unit of the unitization. Functions vanishing at zero give elements of the original algebra.

concept.title: Spectral characterization of positive C*-algebra elements
concept.description: An element of a C*-algebra has the form b*b exactly when it is self-adjoint with spectrum contained in [0,∞).

concept.title: Norm closedness of the positive cone of a C*-algebra
concept.description: A norm limit of positive elements of a C*-algebra is positive.

concept.title: Norm monotonicity for positive C*-algebra elements
concept.description: If 0≤a≤b in a C*-algebra, then ∥a∥≤∥b∥.

concept.title: Order-unit bound for a positive C*-algebra element
concept.description: For positive a in a C*-algebra, a≤∥a∥1 in its unitization.

concept.title: Path-connected topological space
concept.description: A topological space in which every pair of points is joined by a continuous map from [0,1] with those endpoints.

concept.title: Locally path-connected topological space
concept.description: A space in which every neighborhood of each point contains a path-connected open neighborhood of that point.

concept.title: Tietze extension theorem
concept.description: Every continuous real-valued function on a closed subset of a normal topological space extends continuously to the whole space; if the function takes values in [−1,1], the extension can have the same range.

concept.title: Pasting lemma for a finite closed cover
concept.description: Maps on finitely many closed subsets covering a topological space glue to a continuous map if they are continuous and agree on every overlap.

concept.title: Normality of metric spaces
concept.description: Any two disjoint closed subsets of a metric space have disjoint open neighborhoods; equivalently every metric space is normal.

concept.title: Components of a locally path-connected space
concept.description: Every connected component of a locally path-connected topological space is open and path connected.

concept.title: Real orthogonal group
concept.description: The group O(n) of real n×n matrices U satisfying UᵀU=I; these are the linear isometries of Euclidean space.

concept.title: Spherical harmonic decomposition of L² of a sphere
concept.description: The real Hilbert space L²(S^{n−1}) is the orthogonal sum of the finite-dimensional spaces of spherical harmonics of degrees k≥0; a polynomial of degree m restricts to a sum of harmonics of degrees at most m.

concept.title: Addition theorem for spherical harmonics
concept.description: For n≥3 and an orthonormal basis Y₁,…,Y_N of degree-k real spherical harmonics under probability-normalized area, ∑ⱼYⱼ(u)Yⱼ(v)=N G_{k,n}(u·v), where G_{k,n} is the normalized zonal Gegenbauer polynomial with G_{k,n}(1)=1. In particular the diagonal sum equals N. For n=2 the corresponding zonal polynomial is the Chebyshev polynomial cos(k arccos t).

concept.title: Jackson approximation theorem on the sphere
concept.description: For a λ-Lipschitz real function f on S^{n−1} and positive integer k, a real polynomial P of degree at most k satisfies sup_{S^{n−1}}|f−P|≤Cλn/k for an absolute C.

concept.title: Klartag’s linear-size isomorphic Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concept.description: For n≥2 and a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, at most 5n Minkowski symmetrizations produce a centrally symmetric body K̃ with (1−c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for an absolute c. In particular its outer radius is at most an absolute multiple of M*(K).

concept.title: Haar’s theorem for compact groups
concept.description: Every compact Hausdorff topological group has a unique left-invariant regular Borel probability measure, and that measure is also right invariant.

concept.title: Zorn’s lemma
concept.description: If every chain in a partially ordered set has an upper bound in that set, then the set has a maximal element.

concept.title: Strong Markov property of Brownian motion
concept.description: At every almost surely finite stopping time T, the process B_{T+t}−B_T is a standard Brownian motion independent of the information through time T.

concept.title: Montel’s theorem for locally bounded holomorphic families
concept.description: A locally uniformly bounded family of holomorphic functions on a complex domain is normal: every sequence has a subsequence converging uniformly on compact subsets to a holomorphic function.

concept.title: Identity theorem for holomorphic functions
concept.description: Two holomorphic functions on a connected complex domain that agree on a set with an accumulation point inside the domain agree everywhere.

concept.title: Cauchy’s integral theorem on simply connected domains
concept.description: The integral of a holomorphic function around every closed piecewise C¹ curve in a simply connected complex domain is zero.

concept.title: Irreducible nonnegative matrix
concept.description: A finite square nonnegative real matrix A is irreducible if for every pair i,j some n≥0 satisfies (Aⁿ)_{ij}>0. Equivalently its directed support graph is strongly connected.

concept.title: Right-continuous path
concept.description: A path x:[0,∞)→E in a metric space is right-continuous if d(x(t+h),x(t))→0 as h↓0 for every t≥0.

concept.title: Jordan normal form theorem
concept.description: Every linear endomorphism of a finite-dimensional complex vector space has a basis consisting of Jordan chains for its eigenvalues; its matrix in that basis is block diagonal with Jordan blocks.

concept.title: Generalized eigenvector
concept.description: For an endomorphism T and scalar λ, a nonzero vector v with (T−λI)ᵏv=0 for some k≥1 is a generalized eigenvector; a Jordan chain satisfies (T−λI)v₁=0 and (T−λI)v_{j+1}=v_j.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of Lebesgue integration
concept.description: If g∈L¹([a,b]), F(x)=∫_a^xg is absolutely continuous and F′=g almost everywhere. Conversely every absolutely continuous F has an integrable a.e. derivative and F(x)−F(a)=∫_a^xF′.

concept.title: Doob’s upcrossing inequality
concept.description: If (X_n) is a submartingale and U_n(a,b) counts completed upcrossings from at most a to at least b by time n, then (b−a)EU_n(a,b)≤E(X_n−a)⁺−E(X₀−a)⁺ for a<b.

concept.title: Discrete-time submartingale
concept.description: An integrable adapted process X_n with E[X_{n+1}|F_n]≥X_n almost surely for every n.

concept.title: Conditional Jensen inequality
concept.description: For integrable X and convex φ with φ(X) integrable, φ(E[X|G])≤E[φ(X)|G] almost surely.

concept.title: Pull-out property of conditional expectation
concept.description: If Y is G-measurable and X,YX are integrable, then E[YX|G]=Y E[X|G] almost surely, when the right side is integrable.

concept.title: Moment-determinate probability distribution
concept.description: A probability law with finite moments of every nonnegative integer order is moment-determinate if no other probability law has the same sequence of moments.

concept.title: Limit of a function between metric spaces
concept.description: For f defined near an accumulation point a of a metric space, lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<d(x,a)<δ implies d(f(x),L)<ε.

concept.title: Cardinality of a set
concept.description: The size of a set, with two sets having the same cardinality when there is a bijection between them. A set has finite cardinality n when it is in bijection with {1,…,n}; infinite cardinalities are distinguished by the same bijection criterion.

concept.title: Convergence of bounded monotone real sequences
concept.description: Every bounded monotone sequence of real numbers converges.

concept.title: Riemann integrability of continuous functions
concept.description: Every continuous real function on a compact interval is Riemann integrable.

concept.title: Linearity of the Riemann integral
concept.description: If f,g are Riemann integrable on the same compact interval and a,b are real, af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)=a∫f+b∫g.

concept.title: Interval additivity of the Riemann integral
concept.description: For integrable f on [a,b] and c∈[a,b], ∫_a^b f=∫_a^c f+∫_c^b f, with the usual orientation convention.

concept.title: Order bounds for the Riemann integral
concept.description: If integrable f satisfies m≤f≤M on [a,b], then m(b−a)≤∫_a^b f≤M(b−a).

concept.title: Extension of a linearly independent family to a finite basis
concept.description: Every linearly independent family in a finite-dimensional vector space can be extended to a basis.

concept.title: Closedness of finitely generated cones
concept.description: The set of all nonnegative real linear combinations of finitely many vectors in R^n is closed.

concept.title: Strict separation of a point from a closed convex cone
concept.description: If C is a nonempty closed convex cone in R^n and b∉C, there is y such that y·c≥0 for every c∈C and y·b<0.

concept.title: Special linear group over a commutative ring
concept.description: The group SL_n(R) of square matrices over a commutative ring R whose determinant is 1, with matrix multiplication.

concept.title: Metaplectic double cover of SL₂(R)
concept.description: The group Mp₂(R) of pairs (γ,φ), with γ=[[a,b],[c,d]]∈SL₂(R) and φ a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying φ(τ)²=cτ+d; multiplication is (γ₁,φ₁)(γ₂,φ₂)=(γ₁γ₂,(φ₁∘γ₂)φ₂). The projection to γ is a double cover.

concept.title: Modular form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concept.description: For κ∈(1/2)Z, a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying f(γτ)=χ(γ,φ)φ(τ)^(2κ)f(τ) on the metaplectic preimage of a congruence subgroup, for a fixed compatible finite-image character χ, and holomorphic at every cusp. The multiplier is specified as part of the data.

concept.title: Jacobi form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concept.description: A holomorphic function on H×C of weight κ∈(1/2)Z and index m∈(1/2)Z_{≥0}, with a specified compatible finite-image multiplier, transforming by the metaplectic modular weight factor and exp(2πimcz²/(cτ+d)), and by exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz)) times its multiplier under z↦z+rτ+s. At every cusp its Fourier indices obey 4mn−ℓ²≥0.

concept.title: Almost holomorphic modular form of half-integral weight
concept.description: A function obeying the metaplectic modular transformation of a specified half-integral weight and compatible finite-image multiplier, polynomial in 1/Im(τ) with holomorphic coefficients and of at most polynomial growth in Im(τ) after normalization at every cusp.

concept.title: Almost holomorphic Jacobi form of half-integral weight
concept.description: A function with a specified half-integral weight, half-integral nonnegative index and compatible multiplier, obeying the Jacobi transformations, polynomial in 1/(τ−τ̄) and (z−z̄)/(τ−τ̄) with holomorphic coefficients, and with Jacobi cusp growth: after each cusp normalization, |φ(τ,z)|≤C·Im(τ)^N exp(2πm Im(z)²/Im(τ)) in a Jacobi translation strip for some C,N.

concept.title: Perfect-cuboid criterion in the second-cuboid parametrization
concept.description: For coprime distinct positive integers p,q and an integer root t of the degree-ten Q_{p,q} from the second cuboid conjecture, the corresponding parametrized cuboid is perfect exactly when t>max(p²,pq,q²) and (p²+t)(pq+t)>2t². This is a criterion within that parametrized family, not a claim that every perfect cuboid belongs to it.

concept.title: Masharov–Sharipov’s bound for second-cuboid searches
concept.description: In the second-cuboid parametrization with distinct coprime positive p,q, no root giving a perfect cuboid can occur for q≥59p. Thus every possible candidate in this family has q<59p and t<61p². This does not assert nonexistence of arbitrary perfect cuboids.

concept.title: Schwarz lemma
concept.description: If f maps the unit disk holomorphically to itself and f(0)=0, then |f(z)|≤|z| and |f′(0)|≤1. Equality at a nonzero point or in the derivative bound forces f(z)=cz with |c|=1.

concept.title: Maximum modulus principle
concept.description: A nonconstant holomorphic function on a connected open subset of ℂ cannot have a local maximum of its modulus in the interior.

concept.title: Scalar Schur algorithm on the unit disk
concept.description: For a holomorphic disk map f with |f(0)|<1, replace f by (f(z)−f(0))/(z(1−overline{f(0)}f(z))) and iterate; Schwarz’s lemma makes the removable value at zero and the disk bound valid. The successive values at zero are its Schur parameters.

concept.title: Closure of finite Blaschke products under composition
concept.description: The composition of two nonconstant finite Blaschke products of degrees m and n is a finite Blaschke product of degree mn; composing with a disk automorphism preserves the degree.

concept.title: Algebra homomorphism property of holomorphic functional calculus
concept.description: For a bounded operator T, evaluation f↦f(T) is a unital algebra homomorphism from functions holomorphic on a common neighborhood of σ(T) into bounded operators; it agrees with polynomial evaluation.

concept.title: Riemann’s removable singularity theorem
concept.description: A holomorphic function on a punctured neighborhood of a complex point extends holomorphically across that point if it is bounded near the point.

concept.title: Beurling’s invariant subspace theorem for Hardy H²
concept.description: Every nonzero closed subspace of H² invariant under multiplication by z has the form θH² for an inner function θ, unique up to multiplication by a unimodular constant.

concept.title: Division algorithm for polynomials over a field
concept.description: For polynomials a,b over a field with b≠0, there are unique polynomials q,r with a=bq+r and either r=0 or deg r<deg b.

concept.title: Bézout identity for polynomials over a field
concept.description: The monic greatest common divisor of polynomials a,b, not both zero, is ua+vb for some polynomials u,v. In particular coprime polynomials admit ua+vb=1.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of algebra
concept.description: Every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a complex root; equivalently it factors completely into linear factors over ℂ.

concept.title: Hardy–Littlewood maximal function
concept.description: For locally integrable f on ℝⁿ, Mf(x)=sup_{r>0}|B(x,r)|⁻¹∫_{B(x,r)}|f(y)|dy.

concept.title: Hardy–Littlewood weak (1,1) maximal inequality
concept.description: For integrable f on ℝⁿ and λ>0, the Lebesgue measure of {Mf>λ} is at most C_n∥f∥₁/λ, with a constant depending only on n.

concept.title: Density of continuous compactly supported functions in Euclidean L¹
concept.description: Every function in L¹(ℝⁿ) can be approximated in L¹ norm by continuous compactly supported functions.

concept.title: Weak Lᵖ space
concept.description: For 0<p<∞ on a measure space, weak Lᵖ consists of measurable f with sup_{λ>0}λ μ({|f|>λ})^{1/p}<∞, modulo almost-everywhere equality.

concept.title: Modular of a variable-exponent Lebesgue space
concept.description: For an exponent p(x)∈(0,∞), the modular is ρ_p(f)=∫|f(x)|^{p(x)}dx. The Luxemburg quasi-norm tests whether this modular becomes at most one after scaling f.

concept.title: Vector-valued maximal inequality with variable Lᵖ exponent and fixed sequence exponent
concept.description: If p is globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1<q<∞ is constant, then ∥(∑_j|Mf_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}≤C∥(∑_j|f_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}.

concept.title: Jensen estimate for variable-exponent local averages
concept.description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1≤p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and k≥0, some β∈(0,1) gives (β avg_B|f|)^{p(x)}≤avg_B|f(y)|^{p(y)}+min(|B|^k,1)[(e+|x|)^{-k}+avg_B(e+|y|)^{-k}] for x∈B and ∥f∥_{p(·)}≤1. Here B is any ball; constants depend on the fixed exponent and k.

concept.title: Singular value decomposition of a real matrix
concept.description: Every real m×n matrix is UΣVᵀ with U,V orthogonal and Σ rectangular diagonal with nonnegative entries, its singular values.

concept.title: Polar coordinates in the Euclidean plane
concept.description: A point is written (r cosθ,r sinθ) with r≥0; away from zero, r>0 and the angle is understood modulo2π.

concept.title: Jacobian matrix of a differentiable Euclidean map
concept.description: For f:ℝⁿ→ℝᵐ, its Jacobian matrix at a point has entries ∂f_i/∂x_j. For m=n its determinant is the Jacobian determinant.

concept.title: Frobenius norm of a real or complex matrix
concept.description: The Frobenius norm of A is (∑_{i,j}|a_{ij}|²)^{1/2}.

concept.title: Inverse function theorem in Euclidean space
concept.description: A continuously differentiable map between open subsets of ℝⁿ whose derivative is invertible at a point restricts near that point to a C¹ diffeomorphism. A C^k or smooth map has an inverse of the same regularity.

concept.title: Chain rule for Fréchet derivatives
concept.description: If g is Fréchet differentiable at x and f at g(x), then f∘g is Fréchet differentiable at x with D(f∘g)(x)=Df(g(x))∘Dg(x).

concept.title: Mixed discriminant of square matrices
concept.description: The symmetric multilinear coefficient D(A₁,…,A_n) in det(∑t_iA_i), normalized by D(A,…,A)=det A.

concept.title: Alexandrov’s inequality for mixed discriminants
concept.description: For real symmetric A and positive definite real symmetric B,M₃,…,M_n, D(A,B,M₃,…,M_n)²≥D(A,A,M₃,…,M_n)D(B,B,M₃,…,M_n).

concept.title: Curvature matrix of a smooth support function
concept.description: At u∈S^{n−1}, restrict the Euclidean Hessian of the1-homogeneous extension of h to u⊥; this equals the spherical Hessian ∇²_Sh+hI. Positive definiteness describes the strictly curved support functions used in the smooth argument.

concept.title: Divergence theorem in Euclidean space
concept.description: For a bounded domain with C¹ boundary and a C¹ vector field F on its closure, ∫_Ωdiv F dx=∫_{∂Ω}F·ν dS, where ν is the outer unit normal.

concept.title: Smooth positively curved approximation of a convex body
concept.description: Every full-dimensional Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex bodies with smooth support functions and positive definite curvature matrices.

concept.title: Continuity of mixed volume under Hausdorff convergence
concept.description: If each sequence K_{i,j} of convex bodies converges in Hausdorff distance to K_i, then V(K_{1,j},…,K_{n,j})→V(K₁,…,K_n).

concept.title: Integral representation of mixed volume using curvature matrices
concept.description: For C² convex bodies with positive definite curvature matrices, V(K₁,…,K_n)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_{K₁}D(D²h_{K₂},…,D²h_{K_n})dS, where D² is the curvature matrix of the homogeneous support function.

concept.title: Discrete spectral theorem for self-adjoint elliptic operators on closed manifolds
concept.description: A symmetric uniformly elliptic second-order differential operator with smooth coefficients on a closed smooth manifold, in L² of a smooth positive density, has a self-adjoint extension with domain H² and discrete real spectrum with an orthonormal basis of smooth eigenfunctions.

concept.title: Principal eigenvalue theorem for a scalar elliptic operator on a closed manifold
concept.description: A self-adjoint uniformly elliptic scalar operator with real coefficients on a connected closed smooth manifold, whose principal part is ∑a^{ij}∂ᵢ∂ⱼ with positive definite (a^{ij}), has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction. Any strictly positive eigenfunction corresponds to that eigenvalue.

concept.title: Reverse Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for a form of positive index at most one
concept.description: If a real symmetric bilinear form B has no two-dimensional positive definite subspace, then B(x,y)²≥B(x,x)B(y,y) whenever B(y,y)>0.

concept.title: Surface-area integral formula for first mixed volume
concept.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_L(u)dS_K(u).

concept.title: Minkowski’s first inequality for mixed volumes
concept.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)^n≥|K|^{n−1}|L|, with equality exactly when K and L are homothetic.

concept.title: Approximation of a convex body by polytopes
concept.description: Every Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex hulls of finite point sets.

concept.title: Weak continuity of surface area measure
concept.description: If full-dimensional convex bodies K_j converge in Hausdorff distance to K, their surface area measures satisfy ∫f dS_{K_j}→∫f dS_K for every continuous function f on the unit sphere.

concept.title: Continuity of projection volume under Hausdorff convergence
concept.description: For a fixed linear subspace E, Hausdorff convergence of convex bodies K_j to K implies convergence of the Euclidean volumes of K_j|E to that of K|E.

concept.title: Distribution on an open Euclidean set
concept.description: A continuous linear functional on C_c^∞(Ω), where test functions on each fixed compact support converge with all derivatives uniformly. It need not extend to a tempered distribution.

concept.title: Distributional Laplacian
concept.description: For a distribution T on an open Euclidean set, its Laplacian is defined by (ΔT)(φ)=T(Δφ), with Δ=∑ᵢ∂ᵢ².

concept.title: Positive distributions are Radon measures
concept.description: A distribution T satisfying T(φ)≥0 for every nonnegative smooth compactly supported test function is integration against a unique positive Radon measure.

concept.title: Weyl’s lemma for harmonic distributions
concept.description: A distribution annihilated by the Euclidean Laplacian is represented by a smooth harmonic function.

concept.title: Logarithmic fundamental solution of −Δ in the plane
concept.description: The locally integrable function Γ(x)=(2π)⁻¹log(1/|x|) on ℝ² satisfies −ΔΓ=δ₀ in the distributional sense.

concept.title: Harnack convergence theorem for monotone harmonic functions
concept.description: An increasing sequence of positive harmonic functions on a connected domain either tends to∞ everywhere or converges uniformly on compact subsets to a harmonic function. A decreasing sequence bounded below by a harmonic function has a harmonic limit if finite at one point.

concept.title: Existence of a greatest harmonic minorant on the unit disk
concept.description: A superharmonic function on the unit disk that has a subharmonic minorant not identically−∞ has a greatest harmonic function lying below it.

concept.title: Minimum principle for superharmonic functions
concept.description: A superharmonic function on a bounded domain with nonnegative lower boundary limits is nonnegative throughout the domain. An interior minimum forces it to be constant on that connected component.

concept.title: Poisson representation of positive harmonic functions on the disk
concept.description: Every nonnegative harmonic function h on the unit disk is uniquely h(z)=∫_T(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²dμ(ζ) for a finite positive Borel measure μ on the unit circle.

concept.title: Distributional characterization of superharmonic functions
concept.description: A locally integrable function with nonnegative distribution−Δu has a unique superharmonic representative equal to it almost everywhere. Conversely every superharmonic function is locally integrable and has−Δu≥0.

concept.title: Binary expansion of a nonnegative number
concept.description: For a nonnegative real number, a representation x=∑_kb_k2ᵏ with digits b_k∈{0,1}; integers use finitely many nonnegative powers, while fractional parts may use a convergent series of negative powers. Dyadic fractional values use the terminating convention when uniqueness is needed.

concept.title: Bitwise exclusive-or
concept.description: For finite binary strings of equal length, exclusive-or adds corresponding digits modulo2. Binary integers are padded with zeros, and binary fractions are aligned by place value before applying the same operation.

concept.title: Field with two elements
concept.description: The field F₂={0,1} with1+1=0 and the usual identities0+a=a,1·a=a,0·a=0.

concept.title: Primitive polynomial over a finite field
concept.description: A monic irreducible polynomial p of degree s over F_q is primitive if the residue class of x generates the multiplicative group of the field F_q[x]/(p), which has qˢ elements.

concept.title: Sobol sequence in a finite-dimensional unit cube
concept.description: For each coordinate choose a primitive binary polynomial xˢ+a₁xˢ⁻¹+⋯+a_{s−1}x+1 and odd initial m_k<2ᵏ for1≤k≤s. Continue m_k=(⊕_{i=1}^{s−1}2ⁱa_im_{k−i})⊕2ˢm_{k−s}⊕m_{k−s}, and put v_k=m_k/2ᵏ. The n-th coordinate is ⊕_kn_kv_k, where n_k are binary digits of n. A standard first coordinate uses v_k=2⁻ᵏ. Gray-code indexing reorders each initial power-of-two block; polynomial and direction-number choices specify the sequence.

concept.title: Discrete sine transform of type I
concept.description: The orthonormal real transform on ℝᴺ given by (Sy)_j=√(2/(N+1))∑_{k=1}ᴺy_k sin(πjk/(N+1)),1≤j≤N. Other discrete sine transform types are separate conventions.

concept.title: Discrete orthonormal Haar transform on a dyadic grid
concept.description: For a vector of length2ᵐ, replace each consecutive pair by its normalized sum and difference, (a+b)/√2 and(a−b)/√2, then recursively transform the sums until a single average remains. Order the average and detail coefficients by scale.

concept.title: Spectral theorem for a real symmetric matrix
concept.description: Every real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal basis of real eigenvectors; equivalently A=UΛUᵀ with U orthogonal and Λ real diagonal.

concept.title: Multi-index for Euclidean partial derivatives
concept.description: An n-tuple α=(α₁,…,α_n) of nonnegative integers, with |α|=∑α_i; Dᵅ denotes taking α_i partial derivatives in coordinate i.

concept.title: Sobolev space Wᵏ,ᵖ of a Euclidean domain
concept.description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) consists of Lᵖ functions whose distributional partial derivatives Dᵅ for all |α|≤k also lie in Lᵖ. A norm combines the finitely many derivative Lᵖ norms.

concept.title: Continuously differentiable Euclidean map
concept.description: A map on an open Euclidean set whose first coordinate partial derivatives exist and are continuous.

concept.title: C¹ domain in Euclidean space
concept.description: An open connected subset of ℝᵈ whose boundary near every point can, after a rigid change of coordinates, be written as the graph of a C¹ function, with the domain locally on one side.

concept.title: Lipschitz domain in Euclidean space
concept.description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a Lipschitz function, with the domain locally on one side.

concept.title: C¹,¹ domain in Euclidean space
concept.description: A C¹ domain whose local boundary graph functions have Lipschitz continuous first derivatives.

concept.title: Smooth domain in Euclidean space
concept.description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a C∞ function, with the domain locally on one side.

concept.title: Injective function
concept.description: A function f is injective if f(x)=f(y) implies x=y for all points of its domain.

concept.title: Continuous linear embedding of normed spaces
concept.description: An injective bounded linear map, usually used to identify one normed space with a linear subspace of another.

concept.title: Relatively compact subset of a topological space
concept.description: A subset whose closure is compact.

concept.title: Compact linear operator
concept.description: A bounded linear operator between normed spaces that maps every bounded subset to a relatively compact subset.

concept.title: Reflexive Banach space
concept.description: A Banach space X for which the canonical isometric map X→X**, sending x to the functional ℓ↦ℓ(x), is onto.

concept.title: Gelfand triple of Banach and Hilbert spaces
concept.description: A reflexive real Banach space V embedded continuously and densely in a real Hilbert space H, with H identified with its continuous dual so that V⊂H⊂V*. The duality V*×V extends the H inner product.

concept.title: Banach-valued simple function
concept.description: A measurable function with finitely many values in a Banach space, represented as a finite sum∑_ix_i1_{A_i} with measurable sets A_i.

concept.title: Strongly measurable Banach-valued function
concept.description: A function that is an almost-everywhere pointwise norm limit of Banach-valued simple functions.

concept.title: Bochner integral
concept.description: For a strongly measurable Banach-valued f with ∫‖f‖<∞, its integral is the norm limit of the integrals of simple approximants converging in the integral of their norm difference; simple functions integrate by∑x_iμ(A_i).

concept.title: Bochner Lᵖ space
concept.description: For a Banach space X, Lᵖ(S;X) consists of strongly measurable X-valued functions modulo a.e. equality with finite norm(∫‖f‖ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ for1≤p<∞; use essential supremum for p=∞.

concept.title: Weak time derivative of a Banach-valued function
concept.description: An integrable X-valued v is the weak derivative of u on an interval if∫u(t)φ′(t)dt=−∫v(t)φ(t)dt as Bochner integrals for every compactly supported smooth scalar test function φ.

concept.title: Aubin–Lions compactness lemma
concept.description: Let X₀↪X↪X₁ be Banach spaces, the first embedding compact and the second continuous. For1<p<∞ and1<q≤∞, a set bounded in Lᵖ(0,T;X₀) whose weak time derivatives are bounded in Lᑫ(0,T;X₁) is relatively compact in Lᵖ(0,T;X).

concept.title: Sobolev embedding W²,ᵖ into continuous functions
concept.description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᵈ, if1<p<∞ and2p>d, every W²,ᵖ function has a continuous representative on the closure, with sup norm bounded by C‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}.

concept.title: W²,ᵖ regularity of the Dirichlet Poisson problem
concept.description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain and2≤p<∞, for f∈Lᵖ the weak solution u∈H₀¹ of−Δu=f belongs to W²,ᵖ and satisfies‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C‖f‖_{Lᵖ}.

concept.title: Variational pressure theorem for the imitative monomer–dimer model
concept.description: For complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer parameters h∈ℝ,J≥0, let g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2 and p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)). Then lim_NN⁻¹logZ_N=max_{m∈[0,1]}{−Jm²+p₀(h+(2m−1)J)}.

concept.title: Coexistence curve and critical point of the imitative monomer–dimer model
concept.description: For J>0 and the variational function in the pressure theorem, there is a critical endpoint m_c=2−√2,J_c=(3+2√2)/4,h_c=½log(2√2−2)−¼. A coexistence curve h=γ(J),J>J_c, has exactly two distinct nondegenerate global maximizers. Off that curve the global maximizer is unique; at the endpoint its second and third derivatives vanish and fourth derivative is negative. Away from the curve and endpoint it is nondegenerate.

concept.title: Multiple-spine change of measure for constant-rate branching
concept.description: For rate-β branching with offspring A and moments m_j=EAʲ finite for1≤j≤k, start one ancestor with k marks. A particle carrying j marks moves by the original Markov motion, branches at rateβm_j with offspring law aʲP(A=a)/m_j, and each mark independently chooses a child uniformly. Unmarked particles retain the original branching law. The marked genealogical subtree is its skeleton.

concept.title: Many-to-few lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concept.description: Let Q_k be the multiple-spine law with unchanged motion, m_j=EAʲ, and let D_s(v) count marks on a skeleton particle v alive at s. For nonnegative measurable F of k terminal particle positions (or their ancestral paths), E_P∑_{(u₁,…,u_k)∈N_tᵏ}F(u₁,…,u_k)=E_{Q_k}[F(ξ¹,…,ξᵏ)exp{β∫₀ᵗ∑_{v marked alive at s}(m_{D_s(v)}−1)ds}]. Offspring moments through k are finite; repeated labels are included. Killed marks contribute zero. This is the unchanged-motion specialization of the full Harris–Roberts lemma.

concept.title: Population law of the binary Yule process
concept.description: For one initial particle splitting into two at rateβ per particle without death, P(N_t=n)=e^{−βt}(1−e^{−βt})^{n−1} for n≥1. All integer moments are finite at every finite time.

concept.title: Duhamel formula for an inhomogeneous semigroup equation
concept.description: If T_t is a strongly continuous semigroup with generator A and u is a classical solution of u′=Au+f with suitably integrable continuous forcing, then u(t)=T_tu(0)+∫₀ᵗT_{t−s}f(s)ds. The integral is a Bochner integral.

concept.title: Binomial theorem
concept.description: For commuting elements a,b in a commutative ring and integer n≥0, (a+b)ⁿ=∑_{j=0}ⁿbinomial(n,j)aʲb^{n−j}.

concept.title: Moment recursion for binary branching Markov processes
concept.description: For binary rate-β branching with killed-motion semigroup P_tᴰ, set T_t=e^{βt}P_tᴰ and u_n(t,x)=E_x(∑_{v∈N_t}f(X_v(t)))ⁿ for bounded nonnegative f. Then u_n(t)=T_t(fⁿ)+β∑_{j=1}^{n−1}binomial(n,j)∫₀ᵗT_s[u_j(t−s)u_{n−j}(t−s)]ds. This includes repeated particle labels.

concept.title: Maynard’s variational criterion for prime clusters
concept.description: Let M_k be the supremum of (∑ᵢJ_i(F))/I(F) for nonzero real Riemann-integrable F supported on {t_i≥0,∑t_i≤1}, where I=∫F² and J_i=∫(∫F dt_i)². If primes have level of distribution θ>0, every admissible k-tuple has infinitely many translates containing at least ceil(θM_k/2) primes.

concept.title: Maynard’s lower bound for the prime-cluster variational constant
concept.description: For all sufficiently large k, the prime-cluster variational constant M_k satisfies M_k>log k−2loglog k−2.

concept.title: Hardy–Littlewood asymptotic formula in Waring’s problem
concept.description: For every k≥2 and all sufficiently large fixed s, the number R_{s,k}(n) of ordered representations of n as s positive kth powers is asymptotic to Γ(1+1/k)^s·S_{s,k}(n)·n^(s/k−1)/Γ(s/k). The singular series is ∑_{q≥1}∑_{(a,q)=1}(q⁻¹∑_{r=1}^q exp(2πiar^k/q))^s exp(−2πian/q), and is bounded below by a positive constant uniformly in n when s is sufficiently large.

concept.title: Integral Miller basis for full-group elliptic modular forms
concept.description: For each integral weight k, M_k(SL₂(Z)) has a basis f_j=q^j+O(q^d), 0≤j<d, with integer Fourier coefficients, where d=dim_C M_k. For even k≥0, d≤floor(k/12)+1; spaces of odd weight and weight2 are zero.

concept.title: Kernel of the genus-two Witt operator modulo p≥5
concept.description: For an even integer k≥0 and prime p≥5, the kernel of the reduced Witt restriction on full-group genus-two forms over Z_(p) is X₁₀ times the reduced weight-(k−10) space.

concept.title: Nagaoka’s congruences for Igusa’s integral generators modulo2 and3
concept.description: For p=2 or3, the reductions of all fourteen even-weight Igusa integral generators are explicit polynomials in X₁₀,Y₁₂,X₁₆. In particular X₄≡X₆≡1, X₁₂≡X₁₀, X₁₈≡X₁₆ and X₂₄≡X₁₀X₁₆. The complete finite identity list, with the distinct p=2 and p=3 higher-weight formulas, is fixed by the stated source locator.

concept.title: First-order Malliavin Sobolev space on Wiener space
concept.description: For1<p<∞, D¹,ᵖ is the completion of smooth cylindrical Wiener functionals in the norm(E|F|ᵖ+E‖DF‖_Hᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ, using the closed Malliavin derivative D and Cameron–Martin space H.

concept.title: Parabolic Hörmander bracket condition for a diffusion
concept.description: For smooth Stratonovich fields V₀,V₁,…,V_d, the noise fields V_i,i≥1, together with their iterated Lie brackets with V₀,…,V_d, span the spatial tangent space at every point. The drift field alone is not included as a generating direction.

concept.title: Transport bound for a finite UFG bracket family
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with generating brackets V_α and flow Jacobian J_t, each V_α(x) can be expressed as∑_βb_{βα}(t,x)J_t(x)^{-1}V_β(X_t^x). The finitely many coefficients b_{βα} have moments of every order bounded uniformly over x and bounded time intervals.

concept.title: Preservation of full Hörmander rank for UFG diffusions
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with finite bracket-generation level ℓ, let h(x) be the determinant of the Gram matrix formed from brackets of weighted length≤ℓ, excluding the drift alone. The solution started in E={h>0} remains in E at every fixed time almost surely. For p>1 and0≤t≤T, E[h(X_t^x)^{-p}]≤C_{p,T}h(x)^{-p}.

concept.title: Hörmander smooth-density theorem for diffusions
concept.description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich diffusion fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander bracket condition, the transition law at positive time has a smooth density with respect to Lebesgue measure. A full-rank invariant open region may be used in place of the whole Euclidean space.

concept.title: Gaussian upper bound for full-rank UFG transition densities
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields on ℝᴺ generated through weighted length ℓ, write h for their finite-bracket Gram determinant and E={h>0}. For0<t≤T and x,y∈E, the smooth transition density satisfies p_t(x,y)≤Ct^{−(N+1)ℓ/2}h(x)^{−2(N+1)ℓ}exp(−c|x−y|²/t). The same estimate holds with h(y) replacing h(x); C,c>0 may depend on the fields and T.

concept.title: Malliavin integration by parts along UFG bracket directions
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG Stratonovich fields, a generated bracket V_α of weighted length |α|, and random weight Φ with uniformly bounded D¹,ᵖ norms for every p>1, there are weights H_α(Φ;t,x) with uniformly bounded Lᵖ norms on0<t≤T such that E[Φ(V_αf)(X_t^x)]=t^{−|α|/2}E[H_α(Φ;t,x)f(X_t^x)] for bounded smooth f. Constants depend on the fields, bracket and weight norms.

concept.title: First and second noise-direction estimates for UFG diffusion semigroups
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields, P_tf(x)=Ef(X_t^x) and every noise field V_j,j≥1, there is C_T such that ‖V_jP_tf‖∞≤C_T‖∇f‖∞ and ‖V_j²P_tf‖∞≤C_Tt^{-1/2}‖∇f‖∞ for0<t≤T and smooth f with bounded first derivative.

concept.title: Sobolev–Morrey bound for W¹,ᵖ on Euclidean space
concept.description: If p>N, a function in W¹,ᵖ(ℝᴺ) has a bounded continuous representative with ‖f‖∞≤C‖f‖_{W¹,ᵖ}.

concept.title: Gaussian exponential displacement moments for bounded-coefficient diffusions
concept.description: For a Brownian diffusion with globally bounded drift and diffusion coefficients, for every T>0 there are c,C>0 such that sup_{x,0<t≤T}Eexp(c|X_t^x−x|²/t)≤C.

concept.title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequality in L²
concept.description: For a continuous local martingale M with M₀=0 and a stopping time T, E[M]_T≤E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E[M]_T, with expectations allowed infinite and [M] its quadratic variation. The finite case follows by localization.

concept.title: Doob’s L² maximal inequality
concept.description: For a right-continuous square-integrable martingale M on[0,T], E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E|M_T|².

concept.title: Quadratic-variation isometry for continuous martingales
concept.description: If M is a continuous square-integrable martingale with M₀=0, then E|M_T|²=E[M]_T for bounded stopping times T. Localized versions apply when the expectations are finite.

concept.title: Quadratic covariation of Brownian coordinates
concept.description: For coordinates of standard multidimensional Brownian motion, [B^i,B^j]_t=δ_{ij}t almost surely, simultaneously for all t≥0.

concept.title: Itô isometry for Brownian integrals
concept.description: For a predictable Brownian integrand H with E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds<∞, E|∫₀ᵀH_s dB_s|²=E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds, and the integral has mean zero.

concept.title: Strong well-posedness of globally Lipschitz Brownian SDEs
concept.description: If drift b and diffusion matrix σ are globally Lipschitz on ℝⁿ, then for each deterministic initial state and Brownian motion there is a pathwise unique adapted continuous strong solution of dX=b(X)dt+σ(X)dB, with finite second moments of its supremum on bounded time intervals.

concept.title: Smooth stochastic flow for bounded smooth diffusion fields
concept.description: For C_b∞ Stratonovich fields on ℝⁿ, the solution maps x↦X_t^x form a stochastic flow of C∞ diffeomorphisms, after choosing a suitable version. Their spatial derivatives and inverse Jacobians have all finite moments locally uniformly in time, uniformly in the starting point.

concept.title: Completeness of Bochner Lᵖ spaces
concept.description: If X is a Banach space and1≤p≤∞, the Bochner space Lᵖ(μ;X) is complete for its norm.

concept.title: Completeness of continuous Banach-valued function spaces
concept.description: For a compact metric space K and Banach space X, the continuous maps K→X form a Banach space for the supremum norm.

concept.title: Weak Jacobi form
concept.description: An integer-weight, nonnegative integer-index scalar Jacobi form with the usual modular and elliptic transformation laws, whose Fourier expansion at every cusp has n≥0 but may have negative discriminant 4mn−ℓ². This weakens the Fourier-support condition of a holomorphic Jacobi form.

concept.title: Jacobi theta function with characteristics
concept.description: For fixed real a,b, θ[a,b](τ,z)=∑_{n∈Z}exp(πi(n+a)²τ+2πi(n+a)(z+b)), with Im(τ)>0. The three even half-characteristics (1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2) give the standard θ₂,θ₃,θ₄ conventions.

concept.title: Canonical weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁
concept.description: The weight-zero, index-one weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁(τ,z)=4∑_{(a,b)=(1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2)}(θ[a,b](τ,z)/θ[a,b](τ,0))². It begins ζ⁻¹+10+ζ+O(q); its coefficient c(n,ℓ) depends only on 4n−ℓ².

concept.title: Infinite product of complex numbers or functions
concept.description: The limit of the finite partial products ∏_{j=1}^N a_j as N→∞, when it exists; for functions the mode of convergence is specified, such as locally uniform convergence on the stated domain. Formal products mean stabilization of each coefficient instead of analytic convergence.

concept.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product formulas for Igusa cusp forms
concept.description: Write q=e^(2πiz₁), r=e^(2πiz₂), s=e^(2πiz₃), and let f(D) be the discriminant coefficients of φ₀,₁. The integrally normalized Igusa forms satisfy X₁₀=qrs∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(2f(4nm−l²)) and X₃₅=q²rs²(q−s)∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f₂(4nm−l²)), where f₂(N)=8f(4N)+2((−N/2)−1)f(N)+f(N/4), using the Kronecker symbol and f(N/4)=0 unless 4 divides N. Products range over n,m≥0, arbitrary l when n+m>0, and l<0 when n=m=0; they converge near the standard cusp.

concept.title: Kronecker symbol with denominator2
concept.description: For an integer a, (a/2)=0 if a is even, and (a/2)=(−1)^((a²−1)/8) if a is odd; equivalently it is 1 for a≡±1 modulo8 and −1 for a≡±3 modulo8.

concept.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product for the genus-two weight-five theta product
concept.description: The genus-two modular form Δ₅, the normalized product of the ten even genus-two theta constants, has product (qrs)^(1/2)∏_(n,l,m)>0(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f(4nm−l²)), where f is the discriminant coefficient function of φ₀,₁.

concept.title: Multiplicative Hecke operator on Siegel modular forms
concept.description: For a finite double-coset correspondence ΓMΓ, the multiplicative transform of F is the product of its weight-slash transforms over left-coset representatives, with the corresponding weight and character. It contrasts with the additive sum defining an ordinary Hecke operator.

concept.title: Humbert divisors of the Igusa cusp forms
concept.description: On the genus-two Siegel modular variety, the weight-five even-theta product has simple divisor H₁, and the weight35 Igusa cusp form has divisor H₁+H₄ with multiplicity one on both Humbert surfaces.

concept.title: Humbert surface in the genus-two Siegel modular variety
concept.description: The image in Sp₄(Z)∖H₂ of the quadratic divisor a z₁+b z₂+c z₃+d(z₂²−z₁z₃)+e=0 with primitive integer coefficients and positive discriminant D=b²−4ac−4de; all such divisors of discriminant D give the Humbert surface H_D.

concept.title: Divisor of a meromorphic function on a complex manifold
concept.description: The locally finite formal sum of irreducible complex hypersurfaces weighted by the orders of zeros of a meromorphic function, negative for poles.

concept.title: Koecher’s principle for Siegel modular forms
concept.description: In genus g≥2, a holomorphic function on H_g obeying a Siegel modular transformation law for an arithmetic congruence group has the usual nonnegative cusp Fourier support, without an additional growth hypothesis.

concept.title: Squarefree integer
concept.description: A positive integer divisible by no square of a prime.

concept.title: Gradient of a scalar function on Euclidean space
concept.description: For differentiable f on an open subset of R^n, the vector ∇f=(∂₁f,…,∂ₙf), defined by its coordinate partial derivatives.

concept.title: First variation of a functional
concept.description: For a functional J on a space of functions, its first variation at u in the allowed direction φ is the derivative at t=0 of J(u+tφ), when it exists. A function is stationary if this derivative vanishes for every allowed variation.

concept.title: Fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations
concept.description: If a continuous real function g on an open Ω⊂R^n satisfies ∫gφ=0 for every smooth compactly supported real φ, then g=0 on Ω.

concept.title: Chinese remainder theorem for integers
concept.description: For pairwise coprime positive integers m₁,…,m_r and residues a_i modulo m_i, there is a unique residue modulo ∏m_i reducing to a_i modulo every m_i.

concept.title: Multiple dense divisibility of integers
concept.description: Fix y≥1. Every positive integer is 0-tuply y-densely divisible. Recursively n is i-tuply y-densely divisible if, for all j+k=i−1 and 1≤R≤yn, there is n=ab with R/y≤b≤R, where a is j-tuply and b is k-tuply y-densely divisible.

concept.title: Polymath’s prime distribution to fourfold densely divisible moduli
concept.description: If ϖ,δ>0 satisfy600ϖ+180δ<7, the Motohashi–Pintz–Zhang discrepancy estimate holds for squarefree4-tuply x^δ-densely divisible moduli q≤x^(1/2+2ϖ−ε), for every ε>0: uniformly over bounded prime sets I and a coprime to P_I, the sum over q dividing P_I of |Δ(Λ1_[x,2x];a mod q)| is O_A(x/(log x)^A). Here Δ subtracts the coprime-class mean.

concept.title: Prime number theorem with de la Vallée Poussin’s error term
concept.description: There is c>0 for which ψ(x)=x+O(x exp(−c√log x)) as x→∞, where ψ(x)=∑_{n≤x}Λ(n).

concept.title: Bézout’s identity for integers
concept.description: For integers a,b not both zero, there are integers u,v such that ua+vb=gcd(a,b).

concept.title: Nonexplosion of finite-mean continuous-time Galton–Watson branching
concept.description: For independent rate-β lifetimes and a finite-mean integer offspring law, a continuous-time Galton–Watson process started from finitely many individuals has finitely many individuals and branching events on each bounded time interval almost surely.

concept.title: Poisson random measure
concept.description: An integer-valued random measure N with intensity ν such that N(A) is Poisson with meanν(A) for every finite-intensity measurable set A, and counts on disjoint sets are independent.

concept.title: Compensation formula for Poisson random measures
concept.description: If N has intensity dt·ν(dz), then for every nonnegative predictable H, E∫H(t,z)N(dt,dz)=E∫H(t,z)dtν(dz). The predictable hypothesis refers to a filtration in which future Poisson increments are independent of the past.

concept.title: Positive-power criterion for finite Markov chains
concept.description: An irreducible finite transition matrix is aperiodic if and only if some positive integer power is entrywise strictly positive; then every sufficiently large power is entrywise positive.

concept.title: Convergence to equilibrium for finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chains
concept.description: Every finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chain has a unique strictly positive stationary law π, and Pⁿ(x,y)→π(y) for every pair of states, hence in total variation from every initial law.

concept.title: Direct sum of abelian groups
concept.description: For a family of abelian groups A_i, the subgroup of their Cartesian product consisting of tuples with finite support, with coordinatewise addition.

concept.title: Nonnegative grading on a commutative ring
concept.description: A decomposition R=⊕_{n≥0}R_n of its additive group such that R_mR_n⊆R_{m+n} and 1∈R_0. Multiplication is ordinarily commutative; this does not mean the sign rule sometimes called graded commutativity.

concept.title: Least common multiple of integers
concept.description: For nonzero integers a₁,…,a_r, the least positive integer divisible by every a_i.

concept.title: Rational parametrization of the unit circle
concept.description: The map t↦((1−t²)/(1+t²),2t/(1+t²)) from Q to rational points of x²+y²=1 other than (−1,0). Its inverse is t=y/(1+x); t∈(0,1) describes the positive quadrant after exchanging coordinates if desired.

concept.title: Hille–Yosida theorem for contraction semigroups
concept.description: A densely defined operator A on a Banach space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup exactly when it is closed, every λ>0 belongs to its resolvent, and ‖(λI−A)^{-n}‖≤λ^{-n} for every integer n≥1. Its resolvent is the Laplace transform∫₀∞e^{-λt}T_tdt.

concept.title: Completeness of Sobolev spaces
concept.description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, W^{k,p}(Ω) is a Banach space for the norm combining all weak-derivative Lᵖ norms. In particular W^{k,2} is Hilbert.

concept.title: Perron theorem for compact positivity-improving self-adjoint operators
concept.description: A nonzero compact self-adjoint nonnegative operator on L² that sends every nonzero nonnegative function to a strictly positive function has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction.

concept.title: Regular symmetric Dirichlet form
concept.description: A symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(E,m), where E is locally compact separable metric and m is a full-support Radon measure, is regular if its domain intersected with compactly supported continuous functions is dense both in the domain’s E₁ norm and in C_c(E) for the uniform norm.

concept.title: Quasi-homeomorphism of Dirichlet spaces
concept.description: A map between full nest unions of two Dirichlet spaces that restricts to a homeomorphism on each corresponding pair of closed nest sets, pushes one reference measure to the other, and identifies the two forms by pullback, including their domains.

concept.title: Regular representation theorem for quasi-regular Dirichlet forms
concept.description: Every quasi-regular Dirichlet form is quasi-homeomorphic to a regular Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space; conversely such a quasi-homeomorphic image of a regular form is quasi-regular.

concept.title: Hunt-process existence for regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
concept.description: A regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space with full-support Radon reference measure has an associated symmetric Hunt process, outside a properly exceptional set, whose transition semigroup agrees with the L² semigroup of the form.

concept.title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
concept.description: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has an orthonormal basis consisting of eigenvectors together with a basis of its kernel; every nonzero eigenvalue has finite multiplicity and zero is the only possible accumulation point of nonzero eigenvalues.

concept.title: Spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators
concept.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has a unique projection-valued spectral measure, supported on its real spectrum, representing the operator and its bounded Borel functional calculus.

concept.title: Polar decomposition of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: Every bounded operator J between Hilbert spaces has a factorization J=U(J*J)¹ᐟ² with a partial isometry U whose initial space is the closure of the range of J*. Equivalently J=(JJ*)¹ᐟ²U.

concept.title: Riesz representation theorem for Hilbert-space functionals
concept.description: Every bounded linear functional ℓ on a real or complex Hilbert space H is uniquely of the form x↦⟨x,y⟩ for some y∈H, with ‖ℓ‖=‖y‖; the inner product is linear in its first argument, so in the complex case y depends conjugate-linearly on ℓ.

concept.title: Lax–Milgram theorem over real Hilbert spaces
concept.description: If a bounded bilinear form a on a real Hilbert space H is coercive, a(u,u)≥c‖u‖² for c>0, then for every bounded linear functional ℓ there is a unique u∈H with a(u,v)=ℓ(v) for all v∈H.

concept.title: Rellich compactness of H₀¹ into L² on a bounded domain
concept.description: For a bounded Euclidean domain, the inclusion H₀¹(Ω)→L²(Ω) is compact.

concept.title: Regularity of Dirichlet elliptic eigenfunctions
concept.description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain, Dirichlet eigenfunctions of the real symmetric uniformly elliptic divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth real coefficients and no zeroth-order term are smooth in the interior, bounded, and extend continuously by zero to the boundary.

concept.title: Strong maximum principle for uniformly elliptic equations
concept.description: For L=div(A∇)+b·∇+c with uniformly elliptic A, locally bounded lower-order coefficients and c≤0, a nonnegative weak supersolution Lu≤0 on a connected domain is either positive almost everywhere or identically zero.

concept.title: Eigenvalue of a densely defined operator
concept.description: For A:D(A)⊆H→H, a scalar λ is an eigenvalue if there is a nonzero v∈D(A) with Av=λv. The operator need not be bounded or defined on all of H.

concept.title: Spectral decomposition of a bounded-domain Dirichlet elliptic operator
concept.description: For the real divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic coefficients and no zeroth-order term, on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, the L² realization has eigenvalues0<λ₁<λ₂≤⋯→∞ and a real orthonormal eigenbasis φ_n. The principal eigenvalue is simple with φ₁>0 inside. Eigenfunctions are smooth inside and continuous by zero at the boundary, and P_tᴰf=∑_ne^{−λ_nt}⟨f,φ_n⟩φ_n in L².

concept.title: Spectral characterization of H₀¹ and the Dirichlet Laplacian domain
concept.description: Let λ_n,φ_n be Dirichlet eigenpairs of−½Δ on a bounded C¹ domain. A function f∈L² is in H₀¹ exactly when∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞, and then∫|∇f|²=2∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|². For f∈H₀¹, its weak Laplacian lies in L² exactly when∑λ_n²|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞. No global H² boundary regularity is asserted.

concept.title: First Dirichlet spectral gap
concept.description: For a bounded-domain self-adjoint Dirichlet operator with ordered eigenvalues λ₁<λ₂≤⋯, the first spectral gap is λ₂−λ₁.

concept.title: Intrinsic ultracontractivity on bounded Lipschitz domains
concept.description: The killed symmetric uniformly elliptic diffusion semigroup on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain with smooth coefficients is intrinsically ultracontractive: for each t>0 its kernel satisfies p_t(x,y)≤C_tφ₁(x)φ₁(y).

concept.title: Uniform exponential mixing of the ground-state-transformed Dirichlet diffusion
concept.description: For a bounded connected Lipschitz domain and a smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion, let φ be its positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction and γ=λ₂−λ₁. Its ground-state transition density K_t satisfies sup_{x,y}|K_t(x,y)/φ(y)²−1|≤C_εe^{−γt} for every t≥ε>0.

concept.title: Rank of a linear map
concept.description: The dimension of the image of a linear map.

concept.title: Moore–Penrose inverse of a real matrix
concept.description: For a real matrix A, its Moore–Penrose inverse A† is the matrix satisfying AA†A=A, A†AA†=A†, (AA†)ᵀ=AA† and (A†A)ᵀ=A†A. For full column rank, A†=(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ.

concept.title: Induced Riemannian metric of an embedded surface
concept.description: An embedded smooth surface inherits the Euclidean inner product on each tangent plane; in a chart m its metric matrix is g_{ij}=∂ᵢm·∂ⱼm.

concept.title: Unit normal field on an embedded surface
concept.description: A smooth map n:M→S² perpendicular to T_xM at every x. A global choice fixes an orientation; such a choice is an additional assumption when it does not exist globally.

concept.title: Shape operator of an oriented embedded surface
concept.description: With a chosen unit normal field n, the shape operator is S_x(v)=−dn_x(v) on T_xM. This uses the −dn sign convention.

concept.title: Source condition for a differentiable quadratic Tikhonov penalty
concept.description: Let F:X→Y be bounded linear between real Hilbert spaces and R a differentiable quadratic penalty. The variational source condition at x† is R′(x†)=F′w for some w∈Y*, where F′w=w∘F and R′(x†)∈X*. Under Hilbert-space identifications this is the usual adjoint range condition, with constant factors absorbed in w.

concept.title: C^k map between Euclidean open sets
concept.description: For a finite integer k≥0, a map is C^k if all component partial derivatives of order at most k exist and are continuous. C^0 means continuous.

concept.title: C² embedded surface in ℝ³
concept.description: A subset of ℝ³ that locally, after a rigid coordinate change, is the graph of a twice continuously differentiable real function of two variables.

concept.title: Support of a distribution
concept.description: The complement of the largest open set on which the distribution vanishes on every smooth compactly supported test function.

concept.title: Hyperplane trace operator for a function space
concept.description: The restriction map f(x₁,…,x_n)↦f(x₁,…,x_{n−1},0), initially on smooth functions; a trace on a larger function space is a continuous extension of this map when such an extension exists.

concept.title: Hölder inequality in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: For measurable p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1/p(x)+1/p′(x)=1, ∫|fg|≤2∥f∥_{p(·)}∥g∥_{p′(·)}.

concept.title: Minkowski inequality for Lᵖ norms
concept.description: For 1≤p≤∞ and f,g∈Lᵖ of a measure space, ∥f+g∥_p≤∥f∥_p+∥g∥_p.

concept.title: Fourier inversion theorem on Schwartz space
concept.description: With f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^{−ix·ξ}dx, every Schwartz function satisfies f(x)=(2π)^{−n}∫f̂(ξ)e^{ix·ξ}dξ, and the Fourier transform maps Schwartz space continuously onto itself.

concept.title: Calderón reproducing formula for an inhomogeneous dyadic resolution
concept.description: Let φ₀,ψ₀ be fixed Schwartz kernels and, for j≥1, let φ_j,ψ_j be the standard dyadic dilations of fixed Schwartz kernels with annular Fourier support, with φ̂₀ψ̂₀+∑_{j≥1}φ̂_jψ̂_j=1 and the high-frequency terms supported in dyadic annuli. Then f=ψ₀*φ₀*f+∑_{j≥1}ψ_j*φ_j*f in S′ for every tempered distribution f.

concept.title: Non-extreme scalar Schur function
concept.description: A holomorphic b on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1 that is not an extreme point of the closed unit ball of H∞, regarded as a real convex set.

concept.title: Pythagorean pair for a non-extreme scalar Schur function
concept.description: For a non-extreme b, a pair (b,a) has a∈H∞ outer, a(0)>0, and |a|²+|b|²=1 almost everywhere on the unit circle.

concept.title: Partial isometry between Hilbert spaces
concept.description: A bounded linear operator that preserves norms on the orthogonal complement of its kernel.

concept.title: Hilbert space structure on an operator range
concept.description: For a bounded map A:H→K between Hilbert spaces, give Ran A the norm ∥y∥=inf{∥x∥:Ax=y}, equivalently transport the norm from (ker A)⊥ through A. This norm can differ from the ambient K norm.

concept.title: Douglas range inclusion and factorization theorem
concept.description: For bounded maps A:H₁→H₀ and B:H₂→H₀ between Hilbert spaces, Ran A⊆Ran B, AA*≤λBB* for some λ≥0, and A=BC for some bounded C are equivalent. The least possible ∥C∥ is the square root of the least such λ.

concept.title: Outer function with prescribed boundary modulus
concept.description: If w≥0 belongs to L² of the unit circle and log w∈L¹, there is a unique outer a∈H² with a(0)>0 and |a|=w almost everywhere. If w≤1 then a∈H∞ with norm at most one.

concept.title: Poisson formula for the logarithm of an outer function
concept.description: For a nonzero outer a∈H² of the unit disk, log|a(z)|=∫_T P_z(ζ)log|a*(ζ)|dm(ζ), where P_z(ζ)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|² and m is normalized arc measure. In particular |a(0)|=exp∫log|a*|dm.

concept.title: Logarithmic boundary integrability of nonzero Hardy H² functions
concept.description: A nonzero f∈H² has log|f*|∈L¹ on the unit circle, and log|f(0)|≤∫log|f*|dm when f(0)≠0, with m probability-normalized arc measure.

concept.title: Boundary norm formula for Hardy H∞
concept.description: For bounded holomorphic f on the disk, its radial boundary function f* exists almost everywhere and sup_D|f|=ess sup_T|f*|.

concept.title: Extreme-point criterion for the closed unit ball of H∞
concept.description: A scalar Schur function b is non-extreme exactly when log(1−|b*|²) is integrable on the unit circle.

concept.title: Sarason’s Toeplitz characterization of H(b) for non-extreme b
concept.description: For a Pythagorean pair (b,a), f∈H² lies in H(b) exactly when T_{b̄}f=T_{ā}g for some g∈H². That g is unique and ∥f∥²_{H(b)}=∥f∥²_{H²}+∥g∥²_{H²}.

concept.title: Polynomial density in H(b) for non-extreme b
concept.description: If b is a non-extreme scalar Schur function, analytic polynomials are dense in its de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b).

concept.title: Nowhere dense subset of a topological space
concept.description: A subset whose closure has empty interior.

concept.title: Meagre subset of a topological space
concept.description: A countable union of nowhere dense subsets.

concept.title: Residual subset of a topological space
concept.description: A subset whose complement is meagre.

concept.title: Baire topological space
concept.description: A topological space in which every countable intersection of dense open subsets is dense.

concept.title: Closed range of a bounded linear operator
concept.description: A bounded linear operator has closed range when its image is a closed subset of its codomain.

concept.title: Symmetric measurable function on a finite product space
concept.description: A measurable function f(x₁,…,x_N) unchanged by every permutation of its N arguments.

concept.title: Counting measure
concept.description: The measure on all subsets of a set that assigns a finite set its cardinality and an infinite set the value∞.

concept.title: ℓᵖ space of scalar sequences
concept.description: For1≤p≤∞, ℓᵖ is Lᵖ on the natural numbers with counting measure: p-summable scalar sequences for finite p and bounded sequences for p=∞.

concept.title: Banach space c₀ of null sequences
concept.description: The scalar sequences tending to zero, with the supremum norm.

concept.title: Domination of one basic sequence by another
concept.description: A basic sequence (x_n) dominates (y_n) if some C satisfies ∥∑a_n y_n∥≤C∥∑a_n x_n∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence (a_n).

concept.title: Equivalent basic sequences
concept.description: Two basic sequences are equivalent if each dominates the other; equivalently their coordinate correspondence extends to a Banach-space isomorphism of their closed spans.

concept.title: Subsymmetric Schauder basis
concept.description: An unconditional Schauder basis equivalent to each of its subsequences.

concept.title: C*-seminorm on a complex *-algebra
concept.description: A seminorm γ on a complex *-algebra satisfying γ(ab)≤γ(a)γ(b) and γ(a*a)=γ(a)². It can vanish on nonzero elements and does not imply completeness.

concept.title: Positive linear functional on a complex *-algebra
concept.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for all a∈A; neither a C*-norm on A nor continuity is assumed.

concept.title: Trace-class operator on a Hilbert space
concept.description: A bounded operator T for which |T|=(T*T)¹ᐟ² is a positive trace-class operator, equivalently its singular values are summable.

concept.title: Origin-symmetric generalized zonoid
concept.description: An origin-symmetric convex body K that is a Minkowski difference of origin-symmetric zonoids: there are such zonoids L,M with K+M=L, equivalently h_K=h_L−h_M.

concept.title: Difference body of a convex body
concept.description: The origin-symmetric body K−K=K+(−K), where−K={−x:x∈K}. Some sources use the normalized difference body½(K−K).

concept.title: Riemann integral of a continuous Banach-valued function
concept.description: For continuous f:[a,b]→X with X Banach, its integral is the norm limit of tagged sums ∑f(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

concept.title: Norm bound for a Banach-valued Riemann integral
concept.description: For continuous f from a compact real interval into a Banach space, ∥∫f(t)dt∥≤∫∥f(t)∥dt.

concept.title: Continuity of holomorphic functional calculus under compact uniform convergence
concept.description: If f_n→f uniformly on compact subsets of a common neighborhood of σ(T), for a bounded Banach-space operator T, then f_n(T)→f(T) in operator norm.

concept.title: Test-function topology on C_c^∞ of an open Euclidean set
concept.description: The finest locally convex topology making every inclusion D_K→C_c^∞(Ω) continuous, where D_K consists of smooth functions supported in a fixed compact K⊂Ω and has the seminorms max_{|α|≤m}sup|∂^αφ|.

concept.title: Smooth real manifold
concept.description: A Hausdorff second-countable topological space with charts to open subsets of R^n whose transition maps are smooth. Smooth functions and maps are those whose expressions in these charts are smooth.

concept.title: Real Lie group
concept.description: A group that is a smooth real manifold, with smooth multiplication and inversion.

concept.title: Derivation of an algebra
concept.description: A linear map D:A→A on an associative algebra over a field satisfying D(ab)=D(a)b+aD(b).

concept.title: Smooth vector field on a manifold
concept.description: An R-linear derivation of the algebra C∞(M) of smooth real functions on a smooth manifold M. In local coordinates it acts as ∑_i X^i(x)∂_i with smooth coefficient functions.

concept.title: Lie algebra over a field
concept.description: A vector space with a bilinear bracket [x,y] satisfying [x,x]=0 and [x,[y,z]]+[y,[z,x]]+[z,[x,y]]=0.

concept.title: Lie algebra of a real Lie group
concept.description: The real vector space of left-invariant smooth vector fields on a real Lie group, with bracket [X,Y] acting on smooth functions as X∘Y−Y∘X. It is identified with the tangent space at the identity.

concept.title: Universal enveloping algebra of a Lie algebra
concept.description: The unital associative algebra U(g) with a linear map i:g→U(g) satisfying i([x,y])=i(x)i(y)−i(y)i(x), universal for such maps from g into associative algebras. Its universal property does not include an unproved assertion of injectivity.

concept.title: Center of an associative algebra
concept.description: The subalgebra of elements commuting with every element of the associative algebra.

concept.title: Maximal compact subgroup of a Lie group
concept.description: A compact subgroup of a real Lie group maximal among its compact subgroups under inclusion.

concept.title: K-finite function under right translation
concept.description: For a subgroup K of G, a complex function f on G is K-finite if the functions x↦f(xk), k∈K, span a finite-dimensional complex vector space. In automorphic applications K is compact.

concept.title: Z(g)-finite smooth function on a Lie group
concept.description: A smooth complex function f on a real Lie group is Z(g)-finite when the span of zf, for z in the center of U(g⊗_R C), is finite-dimensional. The action differentiates right translations and extends to the enveloping algebra.

concept.title: Locally constant function
concept.description: A function that is constant on some open neighbourhood of each point of its domain.

concept.title: Restricted tensor product of vector spaces
concept.description: For vector spaces V_i with specified nonzero reference vectors v_i, the vector space spanned by tensors ⊗_i w_i for which w_i=v_i outside a finite set, subject to the usual multilinear relations. This is the algebraic restricted tensor product, without a Hilbert completion.

concept.title: Normalized local multiplicative norm on a number field
concept.description: At a real place use the usual absolute value, at a complex place use the square of the usual complex modulus, and at a finite place v use |x|_v=(#k_v)^(−ord_v(x)), with |0|_v=0. The complex normalization is multiplicative but need not satisfy the ordinary triangle inequality.

concept.title: Matrix height on an adelic linear algebraic group
concept.description: Fix a faithful F-algebraic representation ρ of G. For g=(g_v), take H(g)=∏_v max(1,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v)_(ij)|_v,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v⁻¹)_(ij)|_v), using normalized local multiplicative norms. Almost all factors are1; equivalent faithful choices give comparable polynomial growth conditions.

concept.title: Moderate growth of an adelic function
concept.description: A function f on G(A_F) has moderate growth if |f(g)|≤C H(g)^N for some constants C,N>0 and a fixed faithful adelic matrix height H. Uniform moderate growth requires a common N for all derivatives from U(g_∞⊗C), with constants allowed to depend on the derivative.

concept.title: Automorphic form on a reductive group over a number field
concept.description: A complex function on G(A_F) for a connected reductive F-group, smooth at infinity and right invariant under an open compact subgroup at the finite places, left G(F)-invariant, of moderate growth, K∞-finite for a chosen maximal compact subgroup, and Z(g_∞)-finite.

concept.title: Unitary operator on a complex Hilbert space
concept.description: A surjective complex linear map preserving the inner product.

concept.title: Unitary representation of a topological group
concept.description: A group homomorphism π from a topological group to the unitary operators of a complex Hilbert space, strongly continuous in the sense that g↦π(g)v is norm-continuous for each vector v.

concept.title: Irreducible unitary representation
concept.description: A nonzero unitary representation with no closed invariant complex linear subspace other than0 and the whole Hilbert space.

concept.title: Discrete subgroup of a locally compact group
concept.description: A subgroup whose induced topology is discrete; equivalently the identity is isolated in the subgroup.

concept.title: Quotient Haar measure for unimodular groups
concept.description: For a closed unimodular subgroup H of a unimodular locally compact group G with fixed Haar measures, the right G-invariant measure on H∖G characterized by ∫_G f(g)dg=∫_(H∖G)∫_H f(hg)dh d[g] for compactly supported continuous f.

concept.title: L²-space on an automorphic quotient
concept.description: Complex square-integrable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality on Γ∖G, for a discrete subgroup Γ of a unimodular locally compact group G and the quotient Haar measure; the inner product is ∫_(Γ∖G)f·conj(h).

concept.title: Cuspidal L²-space of a reductive group
concept.description: The closed subspace of L²(G(F)∖G(A_F)¹) generated by the square-integrable smooth cuspidal automorphic forms, with the right regular unitary action. It is the Hilbert realization of the cuspidal spectrum.

concept.title: Kernel of an integral operator
concept.description: For a measure space, a measurable function K(x,y) representing an operator by (Tf)(x)=∫K(x,y)f(y)dμ(y), on the specified class of functions where the expression is defined. A square-integrable kernel is an element of L² of the product measure space.

concept.title: Convolution of functions on a locally compact group
concept.description: With a chosen left Haar measure, (f*g)(x)=∫_G f(y)g(y⁻¹x)dy when the integral exists, in particular for compactly supported continuous functions. The order matters for noncommutative groups.

concept.title: Integrated operator of a unitary representation
concept.description: For f∈L¹(G), the bounded operator π(f) determined weakly by ⟨π(f)v,w⟩=∫_G f(g)⟨π(g)v,w⟩dg. This uses a fixed Haar measure and a unitary representation of a locally compact group.

concept.title: Tightness of a probability measure on a Polish space
concept.description: Every Borel probability measure on a Polish space is tight: for every ε>0 some compact set has probability at least1−ε.

concept.title: Weak compactness of probabilities on a compact metric space
concept.description: The Borel probability measures on a compact metric space form a compact metrizable space for weak convergence; in particular every sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Riesz–Markov representation on a compact space
concept.description: Every positive linear functional on the continuous real functions on a compact Hausdorff space is integration against a unique finite regular Borel measure.

concept.title: Separability of continuous functions on a compact metric space
concept.description: For a compact metric space K, the Banach space C(K) with supremum norm is separable.

concept.title: Total variation distance between probability measures
concept.description: For probability measures μ,ν on the same measurable space, d_TV(μ,ν)=sup_{A measurable}|μ(A)−ν(A)|. This convention takes values in[0,1]; the total variation norm of μ−ν is twice this distance.

concept.title: Interlacing and positive partial fractions
concept.description: If p,q are monic real polynomials of degrees d,d−1 with real roots weakly interlacing, then after cancellation q/p has only simple real poles and a partial-fraction expansion∑_jc_j/(z−r_j), with c_j≥0. A denominator root of multiplicity m cancels at least m−1 times. Conversely such a ratio gives weak interlacing after reinserting common real factors.

concept.title: Basis of a free module
concept.description: A family (e_i) in a module over a commutative ring such that every element is a unique finite linear combination of the e_i with coefficients in that ring. A module with such a family is free.

concept.title: Integral basis of a number field
concept.description: A finite Z-module basis of the ring of integers O_F: every algebraic integer in F is a unique integer linear combination of the basis elements.

concept.title: Trace in a finite field extension
concept.description: For a finite field extension L/K and a∈L, Tr_(L/K)(a) is the trace of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

concept.title: Discriminant of a number field
concept.description: For an integral basis ω₁,…,ω_n of F, the integer d_F=det(Tr_(F/Q)(ω_iω_j))_(i,j). A change of integral basis leaves this determinant unchanged.
