concept.title: Algebraic character of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: A morphism of algebraic groups G→G_m over the specified field. Characters form an abelian group by pointwise multiplication.

concept.title: Geometric character lattice of a reductive group
concept.description: For a connected reductive F-group, X*(G)=Hom_(Fsep-groups)(G_Fsep,G_m) with pointwise multiplication and its natural absolute-Galois action. It is a finitely generated free abelian group; its fixed elements are the F-rational characters.

concept.title: Idele group of a number field
concept.description: The restricted product ∏′_v F_v× with respect to O_v× at finite places. As a group it is the unit group of the adele ring, but its restricted-product topology is specified independently rather than taken as the subspace topology from A_F.

concept.title: Idelic norm
concept.description: For an idele a=(a_v), |a|_A=∏_v|a_v|_v using the normalized local multiplicative norms; almost all factors are1. This is a continuous homomorphism A_F×→R_{>0}.

concept.title: Normal algebraic field extension
concept.description: An algebraic extension L/F such that every irreducible polynomial over F with a root in L factors into linear polynomials over L.

concept.title: Galois field extension
concept.description: An algebraic field extension that is both normal and separable.

concept.title: Artin representation of a number field
concept.description: A finite-dimensional complex representation of the absolute Galois group of a number field that is continuous and has finite image, equivalently one factoring through the Galois group of a finite Galois extension.

concept.title: Decomposition group at a prime of a Galois extension
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/F and a prime w above v, the subgroup D_w⊂Gal(L/F) of automorphisms preserving w.

concept.title: Inertia group at a prime of a Galois extension
concept.description: The subgroup I_w of the decomposition group consisting of automorphisms acting trivially on the residue field at w.

concept.title: Quotient of a group by a normal subgroup
concept.description: For a normal subgroup H of G, the cosets G/H form a group under (gH)(g′H)=gg′H.

concept.title: Frobenius element at a prime of a Galois extension
concept.description: The element of D_w/I_w acting on the residue extension by x↦x^(#k_v). At an unramified prime it gives a conjugacy class in Gal(L/F), independently of the chosen w above v.

concept.title: Fixed vector subspace of a group representation
concept.description: For a representation π on V and a subgroup H, the subspace V^H={v:π(h)v=v for every h∈H}. This means pointwise fixed vectors, not merely an invariant subspace.

concept.title: Meromorphic function of one complex variable
concept.description: A function on a complex domain locally expressible as a quotient of holomorphic functions with denominator not identically zero; zeros of the denominator give poles after common factors cancel.

concept.title: Meromorphic continuation
concept.description: A meromorphic function on a larger connected complex domain that agrees with a given function on its original open domain.

concept.title: Artin L-function
concept.description: For an Artin representation ρ factoring through Gal(L/F), the Euler product over finite places L(s,ρ)=∏_v det(1−ρ(Frob_w)(#k_v)^(−s)|V^(I_w))^(−1), initially for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation. The local factor uses inertia-fixed vectors, so ramified places are included.

concept.title: Exterior power of a module over a commutative ring
concept.description: The module Λ^n_R M equipped with the universal alternating R-multilinear map M^n→Λ^n_R M; equivalently the corresponding quotient of the tensor power by tensors with repeated entries. This is the alternating quotient convention, not the anti-invariant tensor submodule.

concept.title: Kähler differentials of an algebra
concept.description: For a commutative F-algebra A, the A-module Ω_(A/F) generated by symbols da, a∈A, subject to additivity, F-linearity and d(ab)=a·db+b·da.

concept.title: Lie algebra of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For a coordinate Hopf algebra A with counit ε, the F-vector space of linear maps D:A→F satisfying D(ab)=ε(a)D(b)+ε(b)D(a). Extend them to invariant derivations using the coproduct; their commutator induces the Lie bracket.

concept.title: Invariant gauge form on a smooth affine algebraic group
concept.description: A nowhere-zero left-invariant algebraic differential form ω of degree d=dim_F Lie(G): in coordinates it is an element of Λ^d Ω_(O(G)/F) whose value at every geometric point is nonzero. It is defined over F, and its invariant choices differ by F×.

concept.title: Analytic manifold over a local field
concept.description: A Hausdorff topological space with charts to open subsets of K^n, for a local field K, whose transition functions are locally given by convergent K-power series. Over R this means real analytic, over C complex analytic, and over a nonarchimedean field its usual convergent power-series notion.

concept.title: Local measure defined by an algebraic gauge form
concept.description: On the local-field points of a smooth algebraic group, write an invariant gauge form in analytic coordinates as ω=f(x)dx₁∧…∧dx_d and use |f(x)|_v times product additive Haar measure. For the number-field standard convention take vol(O_v)=1 at finite places, dx over R, and2 dxdy over C.

concept.title: Product formula for a number field
concept.description: For every nonzero a in a number field F, ∏_v|a|_v=1 using normalized local multiplicative norms at every finite and infinite place. Only finitely many factors differ from1.

concept.title: Norm in a finite field extension
concept.description: For a finite field extension L/K, N_(L/K)(a) is the determinant of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

concept.title: Compatibility of field norm with normalized place norms
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields and every place v of K, ∏_(w|v)|a|_w=|N_(L/K)(a)|_v for all a∈L×.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
concept.description: Every integer n≥2 factors as a product of primes uniquely up to ordering.

concept.title: Real cosine function
concept.description: For real t, cos(t) is the real part of exp(it).

concept.title: Hermitian angle between nonzero complex vectors
concept.description: For nonzero vectors x,y in a complex inner-product space, their Hermitian angle is the unique θ∈[0,π/2] with cos θ=|⟨x,y⟩|/(∥x∥∥y∥).

concept.title: Uniformly continuous map between metric spaces
concept.description: A map f:X→Y between metric spaces such that for every ε>0 some δ>0 satisfies d_Y(f(x),f(y))<ε whenever d_X(x,y)<δ. The same δ works at every point.

concept.title: Heine–Cantor theorem
concept.description: A continuous map from a compact metric space into a metric space is uniformly continuous.

concept.title: Sequential characterization of compact metric spaces
concept.description: A metric space is compact exactly when every sequence has a convergent subsequence with limit in the space.

concept.title: Density approximation for the weighted generalized-mean integrability criterion
concept.description: Let (Λ,μ) be a nonzero σ-finite measure space and N≥2. Symmetric probability densities P on Λᴺ can be approximated in L¹ by strictly positive symmetric densities Q for which Q(·,x)≥γ(x)Q_(N−1) almost everywhere for almost every x in a positive-measure set, with γ(x)>0 and Q_(N−1) the marginal. If 0<μ(Λ)<∞, such densities contain an open dense subset of the bounded symmetric probability densities in the L∞ topology.

concept.title: Minimum attainment for lower semicontinuous functions on compact sets
concept.description: A lower semicontinuous function from a nonempty compact space into (−∞,∞] attains its infimum.

concept.title: Malliavin smooth Wiener functional
concept.description: A Wiener functional is Malliavin smooth if it belongs to D^{k,p} for every integer k≥0 and every1<p<∞; here D^{k,p} is the completion of smooth cylindrical functionals in the Lᵖ norms of the functional and its first k Malliavin derivatives.

concept.title: Malliavin criterion for a smooth density
concept.description: If an ℝⁿ-valued Wiener functional F is Malliavin smooth and its Malliavin covariance Γ is invertible almost surely with E‖Γ⁻¹‖ᵖ<∞ for every p>1, then its law has a C∞ Lebesgue density.

concept.title: Norris’s lemma for continuous semimartingales
concept.description: Let Z_t=Z₀+∫₀ᵗA_sds+∫₀ᵗB_sdW_s on[0,1], with adapted A,B whose1/3-Hölder norms have every finite moment. There is r>0 such that for every p>0, P(‖Z‖∞≤ε and max(‖A‖∞,‖B‖∞)>εʳ)≤C_pεᵖ for0<ε≤1.

concept.title: Small-ball estimate for the reduced Hörmander covariance
concept.description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander condition, with flow Jacobian J and noise matrix V, C_t=∫₀ᵗJ_s⁻¹V(X_s)V(X_s)ᵀ(J_s⁻¹)ᵀds satisfies sup_{|η|=1}P(ηᵀC_tη<ε)≤C_{p,t,x}εᵖ for every p>0,t>0 and initial point x.

concept.title: Kusuoka’s Malliavin control estimates for UFG brackets
concept.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields and a generating bracket V_α of weighted length |α|, there is a Cameron–Martin-valued random control u_α(t,x) with D_{u_α}f(X_t^x)=(V_αf)(X_t^x), and sup_{x,0<t≤T}t^{|α|/2}‖u_α(t,x)‖_{D^{k,p}(H)}<∞ for every integer k≥0,p>1. This need not invert the full spatial covariance.

concept.title: Sobolev bound for the Skorokhod divergence
concept.description: For1<p<∞, the Skorokhod divergence on Wiener space extends to a bounded map D^{1,p}(H)→Lᵖ: ‖δu‖_p≤C_p‖u‖_{D^{1,p}(H)}.

concept.title: Kolmogorov continuity criterion
concept.description: If a real-valued random field on[0,1]ᵈ satisfies E|X_x−X_y|ᵖ≤C|x−y|^{d+αp} for p>0,α>0, then it has a modification with locally β-Hölder paths for every0<β<α.

concept.title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequalities
concept.description: For each p>0 there are0<c_p≤C_p<∞ such that every real continuous local martingale M starting at zero satisfies c_p E[M]_T^{p/2}≤E sup_{t≤T}|M_t|ᵖ≤C_p E[M]_T^{p/2}, with extended expectations and stopping times T.

concept.title: Real implicit function theorem
concept.description: If a Cᵏ map F:U⊆ℝⁿ×ℝᵐ→ℝᵐ, k≥1, vanishes at(a,b) and its derivative in the second variable is invertible there, then near(a,b) the zero set of F is uniquely the graph of a Cᵏ map y=g(x).

concept.title: Automorphism of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: An isomorphism G→G of algebraic groups over the specified field; equivalently an invertible endomorphism of its coordinate Hopf algebra.

concept.title: Involution of an algebraic group
concept.description: An algebraic-group automorphism σ satisfying σ²=id. In involution setups the identity automorphism is allowed unless order exactly two is required.

concept.title: Fixed subgroup of an algebraic-group involution
concept.description: The closed subgroup G^σ whose R-points are {g∈G(R):σ(g)=g} for each algebra over the ground field.

concept.title: Diagonalizable linear endomorphism
concept.description: A linear endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space admitting a basis of eigenvectors over its ground field. Diagonalizability over an algebraic closure is specified separately.

concept.title: Semisimple element of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: An element whose image in a faithful finite-dimensional algebraic representation is diagonalizable over an algebraic closure. This property is independent of the faithful representation; that independence is a theorem, rather than an additional part of the definition.

concept.title: Twisted centralizer in an algebraic group
concept.description: For an automorphism τ of G, a τ-stable closed subgroup H⊂G and δ∈G(k), C^τ_(H,δ) is the k-subgroup with R-points {x∈H(R):xδτ(x)⁻¹=δ}. The ambient H is part of the specification.

concept.title: Center of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: The closed subgroup Z(G) whose elements commute with every element after every extension of the ground algebra. Over a characteristic-zero field it is equivalently the closed subgroup whose geometric points form the center of G over an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Identity component of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: The connected component containing the identity, with its induced closed subgroup structure. In coordinate terms over an algebraic closure it is the factor of the coordinate algebra selected by the primitive idempotent whose value at the identity is1; this component descends to the ground field.

concept.title: Quotient of an affine algebraic group by a normal subgroup
concept.description: For a smooth affine group G over a characteristic-zero field and a closed normal subgroup N, G/N is the affine algebraic group with surjective quotient homomorphism G→G/N, geometric kernel N, and universal factorization property for algebraic homomorphisms killing N. Its geometric points are the cosets G(k̄)/N(k̄); over the ground field surjectivity on rational points is not asserted.

concept.title: Double coset of two subgroups
concept.description: For subgroups H,K⊂G, the double coset HgK={hgk:h∈H,k∈K}; H∖G/K denotes the partition into these subsets.

concept.title: Relative stabilizer for two algebraic involutions
concept.description: For involutions σ,θ of an affine group G and γ∈G(k), the k-group G_γ^(σθ) has R-points {(x,y)∈G^σ(R)×G^θ(R):x⁻¹γy=γ}. It is the stabilizer of γ under the left-right action.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem for Banach-valued Sobolev functions
concept.description: If u and its weak time derivative u′ belong to L¹(0,T;X) for a Banach space X, then u has an absolutely continuous representative satisfying u(t)−u(s)=∫_s^tu′(r)dr.

concept.title: Ehrling’s lemma
concept.description: If X₀ embeds compactly into a Banach space X and X embeds continuously into X₁, then for every ε>0 there is C_ε with ‖v‖_X≤ε‖v‖_{X₀}+C_ε‖v‖_{X₁} for all v∈X₀.

concept.title: Sobolev inequality on Euclidean space
concept.description: For1≤p<d and p*=dp/(d−p), every u∈W¹,ᵖ(ℝᵈ) satisfies ‖u‖_{p*}≤C_{d,p}‖∇u‖_p.

concept.title: Sobolev extension theorem for Lipschitz domains
concept.description: A bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᵈ admits, for each integer k≥1 and1<p<∞, a bounded linear extension E:W^{k,p}(Ω)→W^{k,p}(ℝᵈ) with Eu=u almost everywhere on Ω.

concept.title: Morrey’s inequality on Euclidean space
concept.description: For p>d, every u∈W¹,ᵖ(ℝᵈ) has a representative with |u(x)−u(y)|≤C|x−y|^{1−d/p}‖∇u‖_p for all x,y∈ℝᵈ.

concept.title: Calderón–Zygmund Dirichlet estimate on a C¹,¹ domain
concept.description: For a bounded C¹,¹ domain Ω and1<p<∞, every u∈W²,ᵖ(Ω)∩W₀¹,ᵖ(Ω) satisfies ‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C(‖Δu‖_p+‖u‖_p). The constant is uniform under domain approximations with uniformly controlled C¹,¹ charts.

concept.title: Calderón–Zygmund estimate for the half-space Dirichlet Laplacian
concept.description: For1<p<∞ and smooth u compactly supported in the closed half-space with u=0 on its boundary, ‖D²u‖_p≤C_p‖Δu‖_p. The same estimate holds for constant symmetric uniformly elliptic operators after a boundary-preserving linear change of coordinates.

concept.title: Interpolation between first and second Sobolev derivatives
concept.description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain, for1<p<∞ and ε>0, ‖∇u‖_p≤ε‖D²u‖_p+C_ε‖u‖_p for u∈W²,ᵖ.

concept.title: Rellich compactness in the same Sobolev exponent
concept.description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain and1<p<∞, W^{k,p}(Ω) embeds compactly into W^{k−1,p}(Ω) for every integer k≥1.

concept.title: Smooth Dirichlet solvability for Poisson’s equation
concept.description: On a bounded smooth Euclidean domain, smooth right-hand side f and zero boundary values have a unique solution of−Δu=f smooth up to the boundary.

concept.title: Adapted stochastic process
concept.description: A process X_t is adapted to a filtration(F_t) if each X_t is F_t-measurable.

concept.title: Riemann–Stieltjes integral
concept.description: For continuous real f and a real bounded-variation function g on[a,b], ∫_a^bf,dg is the common limit of sums∑f(ξ_i)(g(t_i)−g(t_{i−1})) as the partition mesh tends to zero, with ξ_i∈[t_{i−1},t_i]. Vector pairings are defined by summing the component integrals.

concept.title: Hilbert–Schmidt operator
concept.description: A bounded linear map B:U→H between Hilbert spaces is Hilbert–Schmidt if ∑_k‖Be_k‖²<∞ for an orthonormal basis(e_k) of U. The square root of this basis-independent sum is its Hilbert–Schmidt norm.

concept.title: Isonormal Gaussian process over a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A linear map W:H→L²(Ω) whose values are centered jointly Gaussian random variables and satisfy E[W(h)W(k)]=⟨h,k⟩_H. It need not be represented by an H-valued Gaussian random variable.

concept.title: Cylindrical Wiener process on a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A family W_t(h),t≥0,h∈U, linear in h, centered jointly Gaussian and adapted, with E[W_t(h)W_s(k)]=min(t,s)⟨h,k⟩ and independent increments relative to the filtration. For each h it is a real Brownian motion scaled by ‖h‖. In infinite dimension the formal sum∑_kβ_k(t)e_k generally is not U-valued.

concept.title: Itô integral against cylindrical Wiener noise
concept.description: For a predictable Hilbert–Schmidt-valued B_s:U→H with E∫₀ᵀ‖B_s‖²_HS ds<∞, ∫₀ᵗB_sdW_s is the L²(Ω;H) limit of the finite sums∑_k∫₀ᵗB_se_kdβ_k(s), where β_k are the independent Brownian coordinates of cylindrical W. Local versions use stopping.

concept.title: Gaussian space-time white noise
concept.description: On a measured spatial set(S,m), Gaussian space-time white noise is an isonormal Gaussian process indexed by L²(ℝ₊×S,dt⊗m). Thus integrals W(f) have covariance∫fg,dt,dm; equivalently W_t(h)=W(1_[0,t]h) is cylindrical Wiener noise on L²(S,m).

concept.title: Stochastic convolution for a Hilbert-space semigroup
concept.description: Given a strongly continuous contraction semigroup S(t) on H, cylindrical Wiener noise W on U and a coefficient B:U→H, the stochastic convolution is Z_t=∫₀ᵗS(t−s)B,dW_s whenever the composed operators are Hilbert–Schmidt with ∫₀ᵗ‖S(t−s)B‖²_HS ds<∞.

concept.title: Unit circle
concept.description: The subspace S¹={(x,y)∈ℝ²:x²+y²=1}, often identified with a2π-periodic angular coordinate and equipped with arc-length measure.

concept.title: Heat semigroup on the circle
concept.description: On the circle parametrized modulo2π, (S_tf)(x)=∫₀²πK_t(x−y)f(y)dy, where K_t(z)=∑_{k∈ℤ}(4πt)^{−1/2}exp(−(z+2πk)²/(4t)). This is the semigroup generated by the periodic Laplacian ∂ₓ².

concept.title: Stochastic heat equation between two reflecting walls
concept.description: On S¹ let h₁<h₂ be continuous walls, f Lipschitz and W space-time white noise. A reflected solution is a continuous adapted u with h₁≤u≤h₂ satisfying du=(∂ₓ²u+f(u))dt+dW+dη₁−dη₂ in the weak test-function sense, for nonnegative reflection measures with∫(u−h₁)dη₁=∫(h₂−u)dη₂=0 on finite time intervals.

concept.title: Cameron–Martin space of a Hilbert Gaussian measure
concept.description: For a centered Gaussian measure on a real separable Hilbert space with covariance Q, take an eigenbasis Qe_k=q_ke_k. Its Cameron–Martin space consists of u=∑_ku_ke_k with u_k=0 when q_k=0 and∑_{q_k>0}|u_k|²/q_k<∞; that sum is its squared norm. Equivalently it is Range(Q¹ᐟ²) with the minimum preimage norm.

concept.title: Distributional order on H⁻¹
concept.description: For u,v∈H⁻¹(Ω), write u≤v if ⟨v−u,φ⟩≥0 for every nonnegative φ∈H₀¹(Ω). This is the usual positive-distribution order, distinct from the order transported by the inverse Dirichlet Laplacian.

concept.title: Stochastic differential inclusion for a convex subdifferential
concept.description: Let η:ℝᵈ→(−∞,∞] be proper lower semicontinuous convex, b Lipschitz and W Brownian. A solution of dX+∂η(X)dt∋b(X)dt+dW is a continuous adapted X in closure(dom∂η) with X_t=x+∫₀ᵗb(X_s)ds+W_t−K_t, K₀=0 of locally bounded variation, such that∫_sᵗ⟨X_r−a,dK_r−a*dr⟩≥0 for all(a,a*)∈graph∂η and0≤s≤t. K need not have a Lebesgue density.

concept.title: Normal cone of a closed convex set
concept.description: For a closed convex D⊂ℝᵈ and x∈D, the outward normal cone is N_D(x)={v:⟨v,y−x⟩≤0 for every y∈D}; it is empty outside D. It equals the convex subdifferential of the extended-real indicator I_D.

concept.title: Variational solution of an additive-noise SPDE
concept.description: On a Gelfand triple V⊂H⊂V*, with cylindrical Wiener noise W and Hilbert–Schmidt B:U→H, a variational solution of dX=A(X)dt+BdW is an adapted H-continuous process with X∈Lᵖ(0,T;V) and A(X)∈L^{p/(p−1)}(0,T;V*) almost surely, satisfying X_t=x+∫₀ᵗA(X_s)ds+∫₀ᵗBdW_s as an identity in V* for every t.

concept.title: Local Dirichlet integral at a closed-disk point
concept.description: For holomorphic f on the unit disk and |ζ|≤1, put Dζ(f)=∫|f′(z)|²ωζ(z)dA(z), with normalized area. For |ζ|<1 use ωζ(z)=2G(z,ζ)/(1−|ζ|²); for |ζ|=1 use the Poisson kernel ωζ(z)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|². The integral may be infinite.

concept.title: Fourier coefficient of an integrable circle function
concept.description: For an integrable function g on the unit circle, its nth Fourier coefficient is ĝ(n)=(2π)⁻¹∫₀²π g(e^{it})e^{−int}dt, for n∈ℤ.

concept.title: Fatou boundary-value theorem for Hardy H²
concept.description: For f(z)=∑a_nzⁿ∈H², radial boundary values f* exist almost everywhere, f(r·)→f* in L² of normalized arc measure, and ∥f*∥²₂=∑|a_n|². Its Fourier coefficients are a_n for n≥0 and zero for n<0.

concept.title: Plancherel theorem for Fourier series on the circle
concept.description: Fourier coefficients give an isometric isomorphism from L² of the probability-normalized unit circle to ℓ²(ℤ). Equivalently, the functions ζ↦ζⁿ, n∈ℤ, are a complete orthonormal system.

concept.title: Poisson convergence at Lebesgue points on the circle
concept.description: For an integrable function g on the unit circle, its Poisson integral converges radially to g(ζ) at every Lebesgue point ζ of g.

concept.title: Green–Poisson identity for the squared modulus of a holomorphic function
concept.description: For holomorphic f on a neighborhood of the closed unit disk and ζ in the disk, ∫_T Pζ|f|²dm−|f(ζ)|²=2∫_D G(z,ζ)|f′(z)|²dA(z), with normalized arc and area measure.

concept.title: Reproducing kernel for a Poisson-weighted Bergman space
concept.description: For |λ|=1, the holomorphic L² space with weight (1−|z|²)/|z−λ|² and normalized area has reproducing kernel 2(z−λ)(w̄−λ̄)/(1−zw̄)³.

concept.title: Boundary growth estimate for Hardy H² functions
concept.description: If g∈H², then (1−|z|²)¹ᐟ²|g(z)|→0 as |z|→1.

concept.title: Uniqueness of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space from its kernel
concept.description: Two Hilbert spaces of functions on the same set with the same reproducing kernel have the same functions, inner product and norm.

concept.title: Local Douglas formula on the closed unit disk
concept.description: For f∈H² and |ζ|≤1, Dζ(f)=∫_T |(f*(λ)−f(ζ))/(λ−ζ)|²dm(λ). At a boundary point ζ, f(ζ) means its radial limit; if that limit does not exist then Dζ(f)=∞. Both sides may be infinite.

concept.title: Strong domination of normalized basic sequences
concept.description: For normalized basic sequences (x_n),(y_n), put Δ(ε)=sup{∥∑a_n y_n∥: a has finite support, max|a_n|≤ε, ∥∑a_n x_n∥≤1}. The first strongly dominates the second if Δ(ε)→0 as ε↓0 and inf_{|A|=m}∥∑_{n∈A}x_n∥→∞ as m→∞.

concept.title: Suppression 1-unconditional, 1-subsymmetric normalized basis
concept.description: A normalized Schauder basis whose coordinate-suppression projections have norm at most one and whose subsequences are isometrically equivalent to the whole basis.

concept.title: Odell’s Schreier unconditionality theorem
concept.description: For every normalized weakly null sequence (x_n) in a Banach space and η>0, some subsequence (y_n) satisfies ∥∑_{i∈F}a_i y_i∥≤(2+η)∥∑a_i y_i∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence a and every finite F⊂ℕ with |F|≤min F.

concept.title: Brunel–Sucheston spreading-model existence theorem
concept.description: Every normalized basic sequence in a Banach space has a subsequence generating a spreading model; a normalized basic weakly null sequence can be thinned so that the model is normalized, 1-subsymmetric and suppression 1-unconditional.

concept.title: Schlumprecht’s strong-domination and spreading-model criterion
concept.description: Let (e_i) be a suppression1-unconditional,1-subsymmetric normalized basis with ∥∑_{i=1}^m e_i∥→∞, and let (y_i) a normalized basic weakly null sequence. The following are equivalent: some subsequence of (y_i) is strongly dominated by (e_i); some subsequence has a spreading model strongly dominated by (e_i); some subsequence (z_i) satisfies ∥∑a_i z_i∥≤sup_k δ_k max_{i₁<⋯<i_k}∥∑_{j=1}^k a_{i_j}e_j∥ for finitely supported a and positive δ_k↓0. Equivalently, one may use lengths ℓ_k and require k≤i₁<⋯<i_{ℓ_k} in the bound.

concept.title: Hahn–Banach norm-preserving extension theorem
concept.description: A bounded linear functional on a vector subspace of a real or complex normed space extends to the whole space without increasing its norm.

concept.title: ℓ¹ strong domination criterion for weakly null basic sequences
concept.description: A normalized basic weakly null sequence has a subsequence strongly dominated by the ℓ¹ unit vector basis exactly when it has a subsequence whose spreading model is not equivalent to the ℓ¹ unit vector basis.

concept.title: Nilpotent element of a ring
concept.description: An element a such that a^n=0 for some positive integer n.

concept.title: Reduced commutative ring
concept.description: A commutative ring whose only nilpotent element is0.

concept.title: Affine algebraic variety over a field
concept.description: An affine algebraic variety is specified here by a finitely generated reduced commutative algebra A over a field F. Its k-points, for extensions k/F, are the F-algebra homomorphisms A→k. Morphisms are induced by algebra homomorphisms in the opposite direction. Reducible affine varieties are allowed.

concept.title: Zariski topology on an affine variety
concept.description: On the k-points of an affine variety with coordinate algebra A, closed sets are the common zero sets {x:f(x)=0 for all f∈I} of subsets I⊂A. Geometric closedness is tested after extension to an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Algebraic action on an affine variety
concept.description: An action of an affine algebraic group G on an affine variety X by a morphism G×X→X; in coordinate algebras it is a coaction O(X)→O(G)⊗O(X) satisfying the counit and coassociativity identities.

concept.title: Orbit and stabilizer of an algebraic group action
concept.description: For an algebraic action G on X and x∈X(k), the geometric orbit consists of gx for g∈G(k̄), and the stabilizer G_x is the closed k-subgroup fixing x after every algebra extension. An orbit is closed if it is closed in the geometric Zariski topology.

concept.title: Subalgebra over a field
concept.description: A vector subspace of an algebra over a field that contains the identity and is closed under multiplication; the inherited operations make it an algebra over the same field.

concept.title: Invariant coordinate ring
concept.description: For an algebraic action G on an affine variety X, O(X)^G is the subalgebra of regular functions f satisfying f(gx)=f(x) after every extension of the ground algebra. Equivalently the coaction sends f to1⊗f.

concept.title: Reductive affine algebraic group, allowing components
concept.description: A smooth affine algebraic group whose identity component is a connected reductive algebraic group. In this catalogue a disconnected group may therefore be reductive; connectedness is separately specified when required.

concept.title: Hilbert finite generation and closed-orbit separation for reductive actions
concept.description: For a reductive group G acting algebraically on an affine variety X over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, O(X)^G is finitely generated. The map π:X→Spec O(X)^G is surjective; two geometric points have the same image exactly when their orbit closures intersect. Every fiber contains exactly one closed orbit.

concept.title: Reynolds operator for a reductive action
concept.description: For a rational representation of a linearly reductive group, the natural projection onto invariant vectors, killing the sum of the nontrivial simple subrepresentations. On a coordinate algebra it satisfies E(fg)=fE(g) when f is invariant.

concept.title: Complete reducibility for characteristic-zero reductive groups
concept.description: Every finite-dimensional algebraic representation of a reductive group over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field is a direct sum of irreducible representations.

concept.title: Hilbert basis theorem
concept.description: If R is a noetherian commutative ring, then R[x] is noetherian. In particular a polynomial ring in finitely many variables over a field is noetherian.

concept.title: Hilbert Nullstellensatz
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, maximal ideals of a finitely generated algebra have residue field equal to the ground field, and the ideal of the zero set of an ideal is its radical.

concept.title: Matsushima’s affineness criterion
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field and a closed subgroup H, H is reductive exactly when it occurs as the stabilizer of a point in a finite-dimensional algebraic G-representation with closed orbit. Equivalently, the homogeneous quotient G/H is affine exactly when H is reductive. Consequently stabilizers of closed orbits in affine G-varieties are reductive.

concept.title: Equivariant linear embedding of an affine group variety
concept.description: Every affine variety with an algebraic action of an affine algebraic group admits a closed equivariant embedding into a finite-dimensional algebraic representation.

concept.title: Compact real form of a complex reductive group
concept.description: A maximal compact subgroup K of a complex reductive group G whose real Lie algebra k satisfies Lie(G)=k⊕ik. Finite-dimensional G-representations admit K-invariant positive Hermitian inner products.

concept.title: Existence of a compact real form of a complex reductive group
concept.description: Every complex reductive algebraic group has a maximal compact subgroup K with Lie(G)=Lie(K)⊕iLie(K), and every finite-dimensional algebraic representation admits a K-invariant positive Hermitian inner product.

concept.title: Reductivity of the Zariski closure of a compact linear group
concept.description: The Zariski closure in GL_n(C) of a compact subgroup is a reductive algebraic group. In particular an algebraic subgroup H whose Lie algebra is the complexification of Lie(H)∩Lie(K), for a compact subgroup K, has reductive identity component.

concept.title: Algebraically closed base-extension invariance of reductivity and closed orbits
concept.description: For affine algebraic data over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, extending to a larger algebraically closed field preserves and reflects reductivity of a smooth affine group and geometric closedness of an orbit of an algebraic action.

concept.title: Dimension bound for an isotropic symplectic subspace
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional symplectic vector space (V,ω), a subspace W satisfying ω|_(W×W)=0 has dimension at most half the dimension of V.

concept.title: Lefschetz principle for algebraically closed fields
concept.description: Every first-order sentence in the language of rings with rational coefficients has the same truth value in all algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero. Bounded finite-type algebraic data can be transported to C after choosing a finitely generated field of definition.

concept.title: Cousin’s gauge-partition lemma
concept.description: For every positive function δ on a compact interval [a,b], there is a finite tagged partition a=t₀<⋯<t_m=b with tags ξ_i∈[t_{i−1},t_i] and [t_{i−1},t_i]⊂(ξ_i−δ(ξ_i),ξ_i+δ(ξ_i)).

concept.title: Jordan decomposition of a real function of bounded variation
concept.description: A real function on a compact interval has finite total variation exactly when it is the difference of two bounded nondecreasing functions.

concept.title: Lebesgue’s differentiability theorem for monotone functions
concept.description: A bounded nondecreasing real function on [a,b] is differentiable with finite nonnegative derivative almost everywhere, its derivative is integrable, and ∫_a^bF′≤F(b)−F(a).

concept.title: Regularity of Lebesgue measure
concept.description: Every Lebesgue measurable subset of ℝⁿ has measure equal to the infimum of measures of open supersets and the supremum of measures of compact subsets.

concept.title: Distributions with zero derivative on an interval
concept.description: A distribution on a connected open real interval whose distributional derivative is zero is a constant distribution.

concept.title: ACL characterization of first-order Sobolev functions
concept.description: For an open Ω⊂ℝⁿ and1≤p≤∞, f∈W¹,ᵖ(Ω) exactly when f∈Lᵖ has a representative absolutely continuous on compact subintervals of almost every coordinate-parallel line in Ω, with its almost-everywhere classical partial derivatives in Lᵖ. Those derivatives are its weak partial derivatives.

concept.title: Elementary-matrix factorization of an invertible matrix
concept.description: Every invertible square matrix over a field is a finite product of elementary matrices representing row swaps, multiplication of one row by a nonzero scalar, and addition of a multiple of one row to another.

concept.title: Affine change of variables for Lebesgue integration
concept.description: For an invertible real n×n matrix A, b∈ℝⁿ and nonnegative measurable or integrable g, ∫_{ℝⁿ}g(Ax+b)|detA|dx=∫_{ℝⁿ}g(y)dy.

concept.title: Planar piecewise affine extension with boundary-length control
concept.description: For the open unit square S and an injective piecewise affine g:∂S→ℝ², there is a finitely piecewise affine homeomorphism h:S→ℝ² extending continuously as g on∂S with ∫_S|Dh|≤C∫_{∂S}|Dτg|dℋ¹, for an absolute constant C. The image is the bounded polygonal region determined by the boundary curve.

concept.title: Rank-one W¹,¹ extension estimate for a square
concept.description: For the open unit square S and M=diag(1,0), an injective piecewise affine g:∂S→ℝ² with ∫_{∂S}|Dτg−Mτ|dℋ¹<δ admits a finitely piecewise affine homeomorphic extension h with ∫_S|Dh−M|≤Cδ, provided0<δ≤δ₀ for absolute constants C,δ₀.

concept.title: Polygonal domain in the plane
concept.description: A bounded connected open subset of ℝ² whose boundary is a finite union of disjoint simple closed polygonal curves; holes are allowed. Each boundary curve consists of finitely many line segments meeting only at successive endpoints.

concept.title: Invariant probability for a Markov semigroup
concept.description: A probability measure μ is invariant for a Markov transition semigroup P_t if ∫P_tf,dμ=∫f,dμ for every bounded measurable f and every t≥0.

concept.title: Progressively measurable stochastic process
concept.description: A process X_t is progressively measurable for a filtration(F_t) if for every T≥0, (t,ω)↦X_t(ω) on[0,T]×Ω is measurable for B([0,T])⊗F_T.

concept.title: Schauder’s theorem on compact adjoints
concept.description: A bounded linear operator between Banach spaces is compact if and only if its continuous dual operator is compact.

concept.title: Itô isometry for Hilbert-valued Wiener integrals
concept.description: For predictable Hilbert–Schmidt B_s:U→H with E∫₀ᵀ‖B_s‖²_HSds<∞, E‖∫₀ᵀB_sdW_s‖²_H=E∫₀ᵀ‖B_s‖²_HSds. The integral has a continuous H-valued martingale version.

concept.title: Variational Itô formula for the Hilbert norm
concept.description: Let V⊂H⊂V* be a separable Gelfand triple, p>1, X₀∈L²(Ω;H), Y∈L^{p/(p−1)}(dt⊗P;V*) progressive and B predictable with E∫‖B‖²_HS<∞. If X_t=X₀+∫₀ᵗY_sds+∫₀ᵗB_sdW_s has an Lᵖ(dt⊗P;V) version, then it has continuous H paths, E sup_{t≤T}‖X_t‖²_H<∞, and ‖X_t‖²_H=‖X₀‖²_H+∫₀ᵗ(2⟨Y_s,X_s⟩+‖B_s‖²_HS)ds+2∫₀ᵗ⟨X_s,B_sdW_s⟩_H.

concept.title: Well-posedness of monotone evolution equations in a Gelfand triple
concept.description: Let V⊂H⊂V* be a separable reflexive Gelfand triple and p>1. Suppose measurable A(t,v) is hemicontinuous, 2⟨A(t,u)−A(t,v),u−v⟩≤C‖u−v‖²_H, 2⟨A(t,v),v⟩≤C‖v‖²_H−c‖v‖ᵖ_V+f(t), and ‖A(t,v)‖_{V*}^{p/(p−1)}≤C‖v‖ᵖ_V+f(t), with c>0 and f≥0 integrable. For x∈H, u′=A(t,u),u(0)=x has a unique solution u∈C([0,T];H)∩Lᵖ(0,T;V),u′∈L^{p/(p−1)}(0,T;V*).

concept.title: Stationary solution for a strongly monotone additive SPDE
concept.description: Let V⊂H⊂V* be a separable reflexive Gelfand triple and p>2. If a time-independent hemicontinuous drift M satisfies 2⟨M(u)−M(v),u−v⟩≤−c‖u−v‖ᵖ_V, coercivity 2⟨M(v),v⟩≤C−c′‖v‖ᵖ_V, and ‖M(v)‖_{V*}^{p/(p−1)}≤C(1+‖v‖ᵖ_V), then trace-class additive Wiener noise admits a strictly stationary variational solution with continuous H paths and locally Lᵖ(V) paths, obtainable as the pullback limit from fixed initial states.

concept.title: Girsanov theorem for cylindrical Wiener noise
concept.description: If an adapted U-valued h satisfies E exp(½∫₀ᵀ‖h_s‖²ds)<∞, then R=exp(−∫₀ᵀ⟨h_s,dW_s⟩−½∫₀ᵀ‖h_s‖²ds) has mean one, and W_t+∫₀ᵗh_sds is cylindrical Wiener noise under R,dP.

concept.title: Krylov–Bogoliubov invariant-measure theorem
concept.description: For a Feller Markov semigroup on a Polish space, any weak subsequential limit of a tight family of Cesàro occupation laws T⁻¹∫₀ᵀP_t(x,·)dt, with T→∞, is invariant. Feller means P_t maps bounded continuous functions to bounded continuous functions.

concept.title: Doob’s strong-Feller irreducible mixing theorem
concept.description: A stochastically continuous Markov semigroup on a Polish space which is strong Feller and topologically irreducible at each positive time has at most one invariant probability measure; if it exists, P_t(x,·) converges to it in total variation for every x. Strong Feller means bounded Borel functions become continuous, and irreducibility means P_t(x,O)>0 for each nonempty open O.

concept.title: Variational well-posedness and continuous cocycle for additive stochastic porous media
concept.description: On a bounded smooth Ω⊂ℝᵈ, m>1 and c∈ℝ, dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+cX]dt+dW with zero Dirichlet conditions and trace-class H⁻¹-valued Wiener noise has a unique variational solution from each H⁻¹ initial state, with continuous H⁻¹ paths and locally L^{m+1}(time×Ω) paths. On the canonical two-sided noise space the solutions have a version defining a continuous random dynamical system on H⁻¹.

concept.title: Strong mixing of nondegenerate additive stochastic porous media
concept.description: On a bounded smooth domain, consider dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+cX]dt+dW with m>1,c∈ℝ, zero Dirichlet conditions and covariance Q trace class onH⁻¹. Put p=m+1,V=Lᵖ,H=H⁻¹. If Q¹ᐟ² is injective and ‖u‖ᵖ_V≥a‖u‖^σ_{Q¹ᐟ²}‖u‖^{p−σ}_H for all nonzero u∈V, for some a>0,σ≥2,σ>p−2, then its transition laws converge in total variation to a unique invariant probability measure. This includes the weak one-point-law mixing required for synchronization.

concept.title: Restriction in first Galois cohomology
concept.description: For an extension L/F and an F-group H, the map H¹(F,H)→H¹(L,H_L) restricts a cocycle to the corresponding absolute Galois subgroup after compatible separable-closure choices. For a completion F_v it is the localization map; its pointed-set class is independent of the choices.

concept.title: Tate–Shafarevich group of a number-field torus
concept.description: For a torus T over a number field F, Sha¹(F,T) is the kernel of H¹(F,T)→∏_v H¹(F_v,T), over all places. Since T is commutative these H¹ sets and their kernel are abelian groups; its classes are torsors locally trivial at every place.

concept.title: Finiteness of first cohomology of a local-field torus
concept.description: If k is R,C, or a finite extension of Q_p and T is an algebraic torus over k, then H¹(k,T) is a finite abelian group.

concept.title: Finiteness of the Tate–Shafarevich group of a torus
concept.description: For every algebraic torus T over a number field F, Sha¹(F,T) is finite. This asserts finite kernel, not finite H¹(F,T).

concept.title: Galois-cohomological classification of rational orbits
concept.description: For an algebraic action H on an affine F-variety X, a point x∈X(F), and its stabilizer I, the H(F)-orbits of F-points in the geometric orbit H(Fsep)x are naturally bijective to ker[H¹(F,I)→H¹(F,H)]. The kernel means classes mapping to the distinguished point, and the orbit of x corresponds to the trivial class.

concept.title: Finite Galois splitting of an algebraic torus
concept.description: Every algebraic torus over a field becomes isomorphic to G_m^r over some finite Galois extension of that field.

concept.title: Hilbert’s theorem90
concept.description: For a field F with separable closure Fsep, H¹(Gal(Fsep/F),(Fsep)×)=0. Equivalently, for a finite Galois extension L/F every multiplicative1-cocycle c_σ is b⁻¹σ(b) for some b∈L×.

concept.title: Inflation–restriction sequence in first group cohomology
concept.description: For a normal subgroup N of a group Γ acting on an abelian group M, the sequence0→H¹(Γ/N,M^N)→H¹(Γ,M)→H¹(N,M)^(Γ/N) is exact. The last action is quotient conjugation. For continuous cohomology, Γ is profinite, N is closed normal, and M is a discrete continuous Γ-module.

concept.title: Finiteness of positive-degree finite-group cohomology of lattices
concept.description: For a finite group Γ and a finitely generated abelian Γ-module M, H^i(Γ,M) is finite for every i>0. For a finitely generated Z_p-module the same holds: cohomology is finitely generated and annihilated by |Γ|.

concept.title: Logarithm on sufficiently small principal units of a p-adic field
concept.description: For a finite extension L/Q_p, on1+𝔭_L^n for sufficiently large n the convergent p-adic logarithm and exponential are inverse isomorphisms to the additive group 𝔭_L^n. The latter is a finite-rank free Z_p-module; O_L×/(1+𝔭_L^n) is finite and L×/O_L×≅Z by the valuation.

concept.title: Exact sequence of the complex exponential
concept.description: The complex exponential is surjective C→C× with kernel2πiZ, giving0→2πiZ→C→C×→1. Coordinatewise this sequence respects conjugation and integer monomial actions.

concept.title: Dirichlet’s unit theorem
concept.description: For a number field L with r₁ real places and r₂ pairs of complex places, O_L× is the product of its finite roots-of-unity group and a free abelian group of rank r₁+r₂−1.

concept.title: Finiteness of the ideal class group of a number field
concept.description: The group of nonzero fractional ideals of a number field, modulo principal fractional ideals, is finite.

concept.title: Shapiro’s lemma for group cohomology
concept.description: For a subgroup Δ of a finite group Γ and a Δ-module M, H^i(Γ,Ind_Δ^Γ M)≅H^i(Δ,M); induction and coinduction agree for finite groups.

concept.title: Long exact sequence in cohomology of a short exact module sequence
concept.description: A short exact sequence of modules for a group induces the connecting maps and exact cohomology sequence beginning0→A^Γ→B^Γ→C^Γ→H¹(Γ,A)→H¹(Γ,B)→H¹(Γ,C)→H²(Γ,A)→⋯.

concept.title: Weight of a split torus representation
concept.description: For an algebraic representation ρ of a split torus T, a character α:T→G_m is a weight if V_α={v:ρ(t)v=α(t)v after every algebra extension} is nonzero. V_α is its weight space.

concept.title: Adjoint representation of an algebraic group
concept.description: The algebraic representation Ad:G→GL(Lie G) obtained by differentiating the conjugation maps h↦ghg⁻¹ at the identity.

concept.title: Roots of a reductive group relative to a split torus
concept.description: For a maximal split torus T of a connected reductive group G, the nontrivial characters occurring as weights in Ad on Lie G are the relative roots. A choice of minimal parabolic containing T specifies the positive roots; the simple roots are the positive roots not expressible as a sum of two positive roots.

concept.title: Levi subgroup of a parabolic subgroup
concept.description: A reductive subgroup M of a parabolic P such that multiplication identifies P with the semidirect product M⋉R_u(P), where R_u(P) is the unipotent radical. This defines a Levi subgroup without incorporating its existence theorem.

concept.title: Derived subgroup of a smooth affine algebraic group
concept.description: The smallest closed algebraic subgroup containing all geometric commutators xyx⁻¹y⁻¹. For a connected group it is the closed connected subgroup generated by these commutators, with the corresponding ground-field descent.

concept.title: Siegel set for an adelic reductive group
concept.description: Fix a minimal F-parabolic P=MN of a connected reductive number-field group, a compatible maximal compact K, and the maximal split torus T₀ of the derived group in M. Let A_(T₀)=Hom(X*(T₀),R_(>0)), embedded diagonally in T₀(F_∞), be its positive real split part. For compact Ω⊂P(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹ and t>0, a Siegel set is Ω{a∈A_(T₀):|α(a)|_∞≥t for every simple relative root α}K.

concept.title: Rapid decrease on an automorphic quotient
concept.description: A smooth function on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ is rapidly decreasing if on every Siegel set, for every B>0 and every simple relative root α, its absolute value is bounded by C·|α(a)|_∞^(−B), where a is the split-torus coordinate of the point and C may depend on B and the Siegel set.

concept.title: Smooth vector of an adelic unitary representation
concept.description: A vector in a strongly continuous unitary representation of G(A_F) that is fixed by an open compact subgroup at finite places and whose orbit map under the real Lie group G(F_∞) is infinitely Fréchet differentiable in Hilbert norm in local coordinates.

concept.title: Rapid decrease of smooth square-integrable cusp forms
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group, every smooth vector in its cuspidal L²-space is a rapidly decreasing smooth function on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹. More precisely, for fixed compactly supported smooth f, a Siegel set S and B>0, |R(f)φ(x)|≤C_(f,S,B)‖φ‖₂|α(a_x)|_∞^(−B) for every φ in the cuspidal L²-space, x∈S and simple root α.

concept.title: Hilbert direct sum
concept.description: For a family of complex Hilbert spaces H_i, the Hilbert direct sum consists of families (v_i) with ∑_i‖v_i‖²<∞, with coordinatewise linear operations and inner product ∑_i⟨v_i,w_i⟩. The nonnegative sum is the supremum of its finite partial sums.

concept.title: Discreteness and finite multiplicities of the cuspidal spectrum
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group, the right regular representation on L²_cusp(G(F)∖G(A_F)¹) is a Hilbert direct sum of irreducible unitary representations, each with finite multiplicity. This is a statement about the cuspidal subspace, not discreteness of all automorphic L².

concept.title: Smooth kernels and pointwise expansion of cuspidal convolution
concept.description: For a compactly supported smooth f on G(A_F)¹ whose convolution operator has cuspidal image, its L²-kernel has a representative smooth separately in the two variables. Writing K_(π,f) for the kernels obtained by orthogonal projection to cuspidal isotypic components, the sum ∑_π K_(π,f)(x,y) equals that representative pointwise. Each isotypic kernel has the same separate smoothness.

concept.title: Poisson summation on a number field
concept.description: For a Schwartz–Bruhat function f on A_F^n, a nontrivial additive character of A_F/F and its self-dual Haar measure, ∑_(x∈F^n)f(x)=∑_(x∈F^n)f̂(x).

concept.title: Exponential coordinates on a characteristic-zero unipotent group
concept.description: For a connected unipotent algebraic group over a characteristic-zero field, the exponential is a polynomial isomorphism from its nilpotent Lie algebra to the group as varieties; multiplication is given by the finite Baker–Campbell–Hausdorff formula.

concept.title: Adelic Iwasawa decomposition
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a number field F and an F-parabolic subgroup P, there is a maximal compact subgroup K⊂G(A_F) such that G(A_F)=P(A_F)K. The local factors can be chosen hyperspecial outside finitely many places.

concept.title: Dixmier–Malliavin factorization theorem
concept.description: For a continuous representation π of a real Lie group on a Fréchet space, every smooth vector is a finite sum of vectors π(f_i)v_i with f_i∈C_c∞(G) and smooth v_i.

concept.title: Trace-class property of cuspidal convolution
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group and compactly supported smooth f on its central-normalized adelic group, the right convolution operator R_cusp(f) on the cuspidal L²-space is trace class.

concept.title: Trace-class criterion for a discrete unitary representation
concept.description: If every smooth compactly supported convolution operator in a strongly continuous unitary representation of a Lie group times a totally disconnected group is trace class, that representation is a Hilbert direct sum of irreducibles with finite multiplicities.

concept.title: Eisenstein spectral decomposition of automorphic L²
concept.description: The automorphic L²-space of a reductive number-field group decomposes as the orthogonal sum over cuspidal parabolic data of direct integrals of normalized parabolically induced unitary representations; Eisenstein series realize the corresponding unitary maps and residual subspaces.

concept.title: Local fundamental solution for an elliptic operator
concept.description: An elliptic differential operator has a distributional local fundamental solution at a point: applying the operator to the solution gives the Dirac distribution there. Sufficiently high elliptic powers have fundamental solutions with arbitrarily prescribed finite differentiability also at the source, while elliptic regularity gives smoothness away from it.

concept.title: Peter–Weyl approximation with loss of differentiability
concept.description: Let K be a compact subgroup of a real Lie group G. There is an integer ℓ depending only on K such that, for every integer r>ℓ and f∈C_c^r(G), its left-right compact-type projections f_(τ,σ) sum absolutely to f in C_c^(r−ℓ)(G). Supports lie in K·supp(f)·K; for every continuous seminorm p there, ∑_(τ,σ)p(f_(τ,σ)) is bounded by a continuous C_c^r seminorm of f. Each projection is the character-average projector for irreducible K-types τ,σ.

concept.title: Maximal coupling of probability measures
concept.description: For probabilities μ,ν on a standard Borel space, there is a joint law(X,Y) with marginalsμ,ν and P(X≠Y)=d_TV(μ,ν). Every coupling has P(X≠Y)≥d_TV(μ,ν).

concept.title: Mandelbrot–Van Ness representation of fractional Brownian motion
concept.description: For H∈(0,1),H≠½, a two-sided standard fractional Brownian motion can be represented as B_t^H=c_H∫_ℝ[(t−s)_+^{H−½}−(−s)_+^{H−½}]dW_s, with c_H chosen for variance1 at time1. The difference kernel is square integrable; H=½ is ordinary Brownian motion.

concept.title: Riemann–Liouville fractional integral
concept.description: For α>0, (I_{0+}^αf)(t)=Γ(α)⁻¹∫₀ᵗ(t−s)^{α−1}f(s)ds whenever the integral exists. On the appropriate integrability domains these operators compose by I^αI^β=I^{α+β}.

concept.title: Foster–Lyapunov drift condition for a Markov kernel
concept.description: A Markov kernel P satisfies a geometric Foster–Lyapunov condition with V≥1 if PV≤aV+b for constants0≤a<1 and b<∞. Compact sublevel sets of V make the resulting occupation-law bounds useful for tightness.

concept.title: Hairer’s total-variation mixing theorem for additive fractional SDEs
concept.description: Let dX_t=b(X_t)dt+dB_t^H onℝ with H∈(0,1),H≠½ and b∈C¹. Suppose (b(x)−b(y))(x−y)≤min(C−c|x−y|²,C|x−y|²), c>0, and |b(x)|+|b′(x)|≤C(1+|x|)^N. If H>½ also require b′ bounded. Then for each deterministic x the law of X_t^x converges in total variation to a common probability measure μ, the one-point marginal of the unique stationary solution adapted to the two-sided noise past.

concept.title: Outer function in the Smirnov class on the unit disk
concept.description: A holomorphic function of the form c exp(∫_T(ζ+z)/(ζ−z)u(ζ)dm(ζ)), where |c|=1, u is real and integrable on the circle, and m is normalized arc measure. No Hardy H² bound is imposed; the boundary log modulus is u almost everywhere.

concept.title: Inner–outer factorization in the Smirnov class
concept.description: Every nonzero function in the Smirnov class on the disk is a product of an inner function and an outer Smirnov function, uniquely up to opposite unimodular constants.

concept.title: Poisson majorization of the logarithm of a bounded analytic function
concept.description: For nonzero g∈H∞ on the disk, log|g(z)|≤∫_T P_z(ζ)log|g*(ζ)|dm(ζ), where the left side is−∞ at a zero and the boundary logarithm is integrable.

concept.title: Smirnov maximum principle
concept.description: If F belongs to the Smirnov class on the unit disk and its radial boundary values satisfy |F*|≤M almost everywhere for a finite M≥0, then F is bounded analytic and |F(z)|≤M throughout the disk.

concept.title: Diagonal uniqueness for a sesquiholomorphic kernel
concept.description: If K(z,w) is holomorphic in z and antiholomorphic in w on a connected disk product, and K(z,z)=0 throughout the disk, then K is identically zero. Thus such a kernel is determined by its diagonal.

concept.title: Backward shift on Hardy H²
concept.description: The bounded operatorLf(z)=(f(z)−f(0))/z, with the removable value at zero; on Taylor coefficients it drops the constant term.

concept.title: Backward-shift defect identity in an extreme de Branges–Rovnyak space
concept.description: If b is an extreme point of the unit ball of H∞, thenH(b) is invariant underLf=(f−f(0))/z and ∥Lf∥²_{H(b)}=∥f∥²_{H(b)}−|f(0)|² for everyf∈H(b).

concept.title: Sarason’s analytic-function inclusion criterion for H(b)
concept.description: For a scalar Schur function b, the following are equivalent: b is non-extreme; H(b) contains every analytic polynomial; H(b) contains every function holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closed unit disk.

concept.title: Isometric weighted Dirichlet–H(b) criterion for general weights
concept.description: If a nonzero nonnegative integrable disk weightω givesDω=H(b) with the Hardy-plus-Dirichlet norm, thenb is non-extreme with inner factorz up to phase. When∫ωdA=1, suchb exists exactly whenDω⊂H², polynomials are dense inDω, andQω is outer in the Smirnov sense with(1−|z|²)|Qω(z)|²=Bω(z). Then the associated Pythagorean quotient isb/a=czQω for|c|=1.

concept.title: Positive split central subgroup of an adelic reductive group
concept.description: For the largest F-split torus T in the center of a connected reductive number-field group G, A_G=Hom(X*(T),R_(>0)) is its positive real split part, embedded diagonally in T(F_∞) and trivially at finite places. This is the standard central factor complementary to G(A_F)¹, not all of T(F_∞)°.

concept.title: Absolute convergence of reductive periods of cusp forms
concept.description: Let G be connected reductive over a number field, H⊂G a connected reductive subgroup, and φ a smooth vector in L²_cusp(A_G G(F)∖G(A_F)). For a unitary character χ of H(A_F) trivial on H(F) and A_G∩H(A_F), ∫_((A_G∩H(A_F))H(F)∖H(A_F))|χ(h)φ(h)|dh is finite. If H(A_F)=(H(A_F)∩A_G)(H(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹), this is equivalently the normalized H(F)∖(H(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹) period.

concept.title: Siegel-set covering theorem for a reductive adelic quotient
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group, there is a Siegel set S such that G(F)S=G(A_F)¹.

concept.title: Weyl-chamber decomposition of a real split torus
concept.description: The positive real part of a maximal split torus in a connected reductive group is the union of Weyl translates of a chosen closed positive chamber, with distinct chamber interiors disjoint and chamber boundaries of Haar measure zero.

concept.title: Smooth Hensel lifting over a complete discrete valuation ring
concept.description: Let R be a complete discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal 𝔭 and residue field k, and A a smooth finitely presented R-algebra. Every R-algebra homomorphism A→k lifts to A→R. Equivalently each k-point of a smooth affine finite-presentation R-space lifts to an R-point.

concept.title: Reductivity of involution-fixed subgroups in characteristic zero
concept.description: For a connected reductive group over a characteristic-zero field and an algebraic involution σ, the fixed subgroup G^σ is smooth and its identity component is reductive. The fixed subgroup itself need not be connected.

concept.title: Invariant compact form for a finite automorphism group
concept.description: A finite group of algebraic automorphisms of a connected complex reductive group preserves a compact real form of that group.

concept.title: Smoothness of affine algebraic groups in characteristic zero
concept.description: Every affine group scheme of finite type over a characteristic-zero field is smooth.

concept.title: Smooth morphism of affine finite-presentation spaces
concept.description: A morphism represented contravariantly by A→B is smooth when B, as an A-algebra, is finitely presented and satisfies the nilpotent-ideal lifting property.

concept.title: Affine integral model over a ring of S-integers
concept.description: For a finitely generated F-algebra A and the ring O_(F,S) of a number field with finitely many finite primes inverted, an affine integral model is a finitely generated O_(F,S)-subalgebra A₀⊂A with F⊗A₀≅A. In the group case require compatible Hopf-algebra operations. This injective coordinate-algebra convention gives the usual flat model over the Dedekind base.

concept.title: Spreading out smooth affine morphisms over a number field
concept.description: Finite-presentation affine algebraic data over a number field can be defined over O_(F,S) after inverting finitely many primes; if a given generic morphism is smooth, its integral model becomes smooth after enlarging S.

concept.title: Openness of the smooth locus for finite-presentation morphisms
concept.description: For a finite-presentation morphism of schemes, the set of source points where the morphism is smooth is open.

concept.title: Jacobian criterion for smoothness of a finitely presented algebra
concept.description: Locally for A=R[x₁,…,x_n]/(f₁,…,f_m), a suitable invertible Jacobian minor gives a standard smooth presentation; every smooth finitely presented algebra is locally of this form.

concept.title: Increasing event in a Bernoulli product space
concept.description: An event A⊆{0,1}ᴱ is increasing if ω∈A and ω′≥ω coordinatewise imply ω′∈A. The coordinates carry independent Bernoulli laws, which may have different parameters.

concept.title: Harris’s inequality for Bernoulli product measures
concept.description: For increasing events A,B under a finite product of Bernoulli laws, P(A∩B)≥P(A)P(B). If one event is increasing and the other decreasing, the inequality reverses.

concept.title: Janson’s zero-count inequality for increasing product events
concept.description: Let A_i be finitely many increasing events, each determined by coordinates S_i in a finite Bernoulli product space. Put p_i=P(A_i),μ=∑p_i,Δ=∑_{i<j:S_i∩S_j≠∅}P(A_i∩A_j) and ε=max_i p_i<1. Then P(∩A_iᶜ)≤min{exp(−μ+Δ),exp(Δ/(1−ε))∏(1−p_i)}. An arbitrary dependency graph without the product-event hypotheses does not suffice.

concept.title: Hoeffding bound with a fractional matching for hypergraph-correlated variables
concept.description: Let Y_e∈[0,1] be hypergraph-correlated and φ a fractional matching with Φ=∑_eφ(e)>0. For t≥0, P(∑_eφ(e)(Y_e−EY_e)≥t)≤exp(−2t²/Φ). Equivalently the weighted average has upper-tail bound exp(−2Φε²) above its own φ-weighted mean, not the unweighted mean.

concept.title: Distribution of the maximum of Brownian motion with drift
concept.description: For standard Brownian motion B, μ∈ℝ,t>0 and a≥0, P(max_{0≤s≤t}(B_s+μs)≤a)=Φ((a−μt)/√t)−exp(2μa)Φ((−a−μt)/√t), where Φ is the standard normal distribution function. The probability is zero for a<0.

concept.title: Optional sampling for bounded continuous martingales
concept.description: If M is a bounded continuous martingale and σ≤τ are stopping times, then E[M_τ|F_σ]=M_σ. Unbounded-time versions use the almost-sure terminal limit of the uniformly integrable martingale.

concept.title: Kronecker product of matrices
concept.description: For A=(a_ij)∈M_{m,n}(R) and B=(b_kl)∈M_{p,q}(R) over a commutative ring, A⊗B is the mp×nq block matrix whose(i,j) block is a_ijB; its((i,k),(j,l)) entry is a_ijb_kl.

concept.title: Polynomial height bound for an arithmetic lattice kernel
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group G and an adelic height, there are N and a continuous seminorm q on compactly supported continuous test functions such that ∑_(γ∈G(F))|f(x⁻¹γy)|≤q(f)‖x‖^N‖y‖^N for x,y∈G(A_F)¹. On a fixed compact support the seminorm may be bounded by a support-dependent multiple of the supremum norm.

concept.title: Finite crystallographic root system
concept.description: A finite spanning set Φ of nonzero vectors in a real inner-product space, preserved by the orthogonal reflection s_α in each root α, and satisfying2(β,α)/(α,α)∈Z for all α,β∈Φ. Nonreduced systems are allowed; reduced means the only multiples of α in Φ are ±α. A simple system is a basis whose root expansions are all nonnegative or all nonpositive integer combinations.

concept.title: Coroot of a root
concept.description: In a finite root system with specified invariant inner product, the coroot associated to α is α∨=2α/(α,α), identified with the corresponding vector in the dual space via the inner product.

concept.title: Fundamental weight of a root system
concept.description: For a simple system α₁,…,α_r, the fundamental weights ω_i are the dual basis to the simple coroots: (ω_i,α_j∨)=δ_ij. They belong to the real root span; integrality for a specified algebraic group is a separate lattice condition.

concept.title: Dual Weyl chamber for a simple root system
concept.description: The open cone of H in the real root span for which (ω_i,H)>0 for every fundamental weight ω_i of the chosen simple system. Its indicator is the dual-chamber cutoff used in Arthur truncation; partial parabolic chambers use the corresponding quotient root space.

concept.title: Constant term along a parabolic subgroup
concept.description: For P=MN with unipotent radical N and a suitable automorphic function φ, its constant term is φ_P(g)=∫_(N(F)∖N(A_F))φ(ng)dn. Cuspidality means these terms vanish for every proper F-parabolic.

concept.title: Parabolic Harish–Chandra map
concept.description: Fix compatible Iwasawa data G(A_F)=M(A_F)N(A_F)K for P=MN. The map H_P:G(A_F)→a_P=Hom(X*_F(M),R) is specified by ⟨χ,H_P(mnk)⟩=log|χ(m)|_A. It extends the Levi’s logarithmic character map using its Iwasawa component.

concept.title: Arthur truncation operator
concept.description: For fixed minimal-parabolic data and sufficiently regular T, Arthur’s operator on an automorphic function is Λ^Tφ(x)=∑_P(−1)^dim(a_P/a_G)∑_(δ∈P(F)∖G(F))φ_P(δx)·τ̂_P(H_P(δx)−T_P), over standard F-parabolics. Here τ̂_P is the dual-chamber indicator and T_P is the projection of T to a_P. Proper constant terms vanish for cusp forms, so Λ^Tφ=φ there.

concept.title: Absolute rapid decay of the cuspidal spectral kernel sum
concept.description: For compactly supported smooth f on G(A_F)¹, the sum ∑_π|K_(π,f)(x,y)| over cuspidal isotypic kernels converges and decays faster than every inverse power of every simple-root coordinate on each pair of Siegel sets. It is consequently integrable over pairs of normalized connected-reductive period quotients.

concept.title: Reductive integral models at almost every finite place
concept.description: Let G be connected reductive over a number field F and let 𝒢 be an affine integral group model over O_(F,S). After enlarging S by finitely many primes, 𝒢 is smooth and all its geometric fibers are connected reductive. Hence 𝒢(O_v) is hyperspecial in G(F_v) for every v outside S.

concept.title: Openness of reductivity of identity components in smooth affine families
concept.description: For a smooth affine group scheme G→S, the locus where the geometric identity component of the fiber is reductive is open.

concept.title: Closedness of connected fibers in a smooth reductive-identity family
concept.description: For a smooth affine group scheme whose geometric fiber identity components are reductive, the locus of connected fibers is closed. In particular if the base is irreducible and the generic fiber connected, every fiber is connected.

concept.title: Dedekind property of the ring of integers
concept.description: The ring of integers of a number field, and every localization at finitely many primes, is a Dedekind domain: it is noetherian, integrally closed and has dimension1. In particular its finitely generated algebras are finitely presented.

concept.title: Regular C² parametrized surface patch
concept.description: An injective C² map m from a closed planar rectangle into ℝ³, extending C² to a neighborhood, with Dm of rank two everywhere. It parametrizes its image, including the boundary; its tangent planes are the images of Dm and its metric matrix is (Dm)ᵀDm.

concept.title: Cross product in oriented Euclidean three-space
concept.description: The vector u×v characterized by ⟨u×v,w⟩=det(u,v,w) for every w∈ℝ³, with the standard orientation.

concept.title: Extended real line
concept.description: The ordered set ℝ∪{−∞,+∞}, with−∞<r<+∞ for every real r.

concept.title: Coercive functional on a normed space
concept.description: An extended-real functional R is coercive if R(x)→+∞ whenever ∥x∥→∞.

concept.title: Horn–Schunck optical-flow model on a surface
concept.description: For a Riemannian surface M, image derivative data I,J and α>0, minimize ∫_M(|⟨∇_M I,v⟩+J|²+α|∇^M v|²)dS over tangent first-order Sobolev vector fields v. The two terms impose linearized brightness constancy and covariant smoothness.

concept.title: Weak convergence theorem for convex Tikhonov regularization
concept.description: Let X,Y be Hilbert spaces, F:D(F)⊂X→Y bounded linear with weakly closed domain, and R:X→[0,∞] proper convex and weakly sequentially lower semicontinuous. Suppose the effective domain meetsD(F) and every positive-parameter Tikhonov level set is weakly sequentially compact. Minimizers exist and are weakly subsequentially stable for fixedα. If an exact finite-penalty solution exists, α→0 andδ²/α→0 imply that noisy-data minimizers have subsequences converging weakly toR-minimizing exact solutions.

concept.title: Quadratic Tikhonov error rate under operator perturbations
concept.description: Let A:X→Y andL:X→Z be bounded linear maps between real Hilbert spaces with ∥h∥≤C(∥Ah∥+∥Lh∥). LetAx†=y and⟨Lx†,Lh⟩=⟨w,Ah⟩ for allh. If∥A_ρ−A∥≤ρ,∥yδ−y∥≤δ andα is comparable toη=δ+ρ>0 tending to zero, minimizers of∥A_ρx−yδ∥²+α∥Lx∥² satisfy∥x−x†∥²=O(η) for sufficiently smallρ.

concept.title: Algebraic positive cone of a complex *-algebra
concept.description: The cone of finite sums∑a_i* a_i in a complex *-algebra. Writea≤b whenb−a is such a sum. No norm, completeness or spectral characterization is assumed.

concept.title: Semi-inner-product module over a complex *-algebra
concept.description: A complex rightA-moduleX with anA-valued sesquilinear form linear in the second variable, satisfying⟨x,ya⟩=⟨x,y⟩a,⟨x,y⟩*=⟨y,x⟩ and⟨x,x⟩ in the algebraic positive cone. Zero length need not implyx=0; noC*-norm onA is assumed.

concept.title: Unital Banach *-algebra with continuous involution
concept.description: A complex Banach algebra with an identity1 and a continuous conjugate-linear mapa↦a* satisfying(ab)*=b*a* and(a*)*=a. A C*-identity is not required.

concept.title: C*-completion associated to a C*-seminorm
concept.description: For a C*-seminormγ on a complex *-algebraA, identifya,b whenγ(a−b)=0 and complete the resulting quotient algebra in the norm induced byγ. Its multiplication and involution extend continuously, making a possibly nonunitalC*-algebra.

concept.title: Schwarz inequality for a C*-seminorm of an algebraic module form
concept.description: For a semi-inner-product moduleX over a complex *-algebraA and aC*-seminormγ onA, γ(⟨x,y⟩)²≤γ(⟨x,x⟩)γ(⟨y,y⟩) for allx,y∈X.

concept.title: Spectral bound for a positive functional under conjugation
concept.description: For a positive linear functionalφ on a unital Banach *-algebra with continuous involution, a positive elementb (a finite sum of squares) andc∈A, φ(cbc*)≤r(b)φ(cc*), where r is the Banach-algebra spectral radius.

concept.title: Spectral-radius Schwarz bound for positive functionals on Banach *-modules
concept.description: For a semi-inner-product moduleX over a unital Banach *-algebra with continuous involution and a positive linear functionalφ, φ(⟨x,y⟩⟨y,x⟩)≤φ(⟨x,x⟩)r(⟨y,y⟩) for allx,y∈X.

concept.title: Scheme-theoretic image of an affine morphism
concept.description: For an affine morphism represented contravariantly by a ring map A→B, its scheme-theoretic image has coordinate algebra A/ker(A→B), equivalently the image subalgebra of B. This is a closed affine subspace of the target; it need not have all its rational points in the set-theoretic image of the rational-point map.

concept.title: Cartan map of an algebraic involution
concept.description: For an involution σ of an affine algebraic group, the Cartan map is B_σ(g)=gσ(g)⁻¹. It is constant on right cosets of the fixed subgroup and equivariant for the corresponding twisted conjugation action; its affine scheme-theoretic image is often used as a model of the symmetric space. No rational-point surjectivity is included in this definition.

concept.title: Richardson’s semisimple closed-orbit criterion for an involution
concept.description: Let G be connected reductive over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, σ an involution, and Q the affine image of the Cartan map g↦gσ(g)⁻¹. For a semisimple q∈Q, its conjugation orbit under G^σ is Zariski closed in Q. This is the implication of Richardson’s criterion used in Hahn’s proof.

concept.title: Local topology of an algebraic orbit in characteristic zero
concept.description: For a smooth algebraic group acting on an affine variety over R,C or a finite extension of Q_p, the map G(k)/G_x(k)→G(k)x is a homeomorphism onto its orbit with the local-field topology. The rational orbit is open and closed inside the k-points of its geometric orbit; if that geometric orbit is Zariski closed, the rational orbit is closed in the ambient k-points.

concept.title: Smoothness of orbit morphisms in characteristic zero
concept.description: For an algebraic action over a characteristic-zero field, the orbit map from the smooth acting group to a geometric orbit is smooth; its fibers are translates of the smooth algebraic stabilizer.

concept.title: Analytic inverse function theorem over a local field
concept.description: For an analytic map between finite-dimensional manifolds over R,C or a finite extension of Q_p, an invertible derivative at a point gives an analytic local inverse. A surjective derivative gives local analytic sections after choosing complementary coordinates.

concept.title: Integration along a closed subgroup of a local algebraic group
concept.description: Let k be R,C or a finite extension of Q_p, G a smooth affine k-group and H a closed smooth subgroup. With Haar measure dh, q_*f(gH)=∫_(H(k))f(gh)dh maps C_c∞(G(k)) onto C_c∞(G(k)/H(k)). Here smooth means C∞ at archimedean places and locally constant at nonarchimedean places; the target is the analytic homogeneous quotient, not all rational points of an affine quotient variety.

concept.title: Partition of unity on a local-field manifold
concept.description: For a compact subset of a finite-dimensional manifold over R,C or a finite extension of Q_p and a finite open cover, there are compactly supported smooth functions subordinate to the cover summing to1 near that compact subset. In the nonarchimedean case they may be locally constant.

concept.title: Borel–Harish-Chandra finite-volume theorem
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a number field, G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ has finite volume for Haar measure on G(A_F)¹. Equivalently A_G G(F)∖G(A_F) has finite invariant volume.

concept.title: Godement compactness criterion for a reductive adelic quotient
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group G, the normalized quotient G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ is compact exactly when every F-split torus in G is central, equivalently G has F-rank zero after removing its split central directions. In particular an anisotropic reductive group has compact normalized adelic quotient.

concept.title: Haar modulus formula in Iwasawa coordinates
concept.description: For P=MN and compatible Iwasawa coordinates G(A)=N(A)M(A)K, Haar measure has its torus-density factor δ_P(a)⁻¹, where δ_P is the determinant of conjugation by a on Lie N. On the positive split chamber this is the product of inverse positive-root powers with their multiplicities.

concept.title: Adelic Mahler compactness criterion
concept.description: A fixed-covolume family of F-lattices in an adelic finite-dimensional vector space is relatively compact modulo F-linear changes of basis exactly when the family has a common positive lower bound on lengths of nonzero rational lattice vectors.

concept.title: Isomorphism of undirected multigraphs
concept.description: A pair of bijections between the vertex sets and edge sets of two undirected multigraphs that preserves the unordered endpoints of every edge. For rooted or marked graphs it must also preserve the root and all specified marks.

concept.title: Compactness of bounded-degree rooted graphs with finite marks
concept.description: Fix a degree bound Δ and a finite set of vertex/edge marks. Isomorphism classes of connected rooted graphs of degree at mostΔ, with those marks, form a compact metrizable space for local convergence: two rooted graphs are close when their marked balls around the root agree to a large radius. Finite and countably infinite graphs are allowed.

concept.title: Karlin–McGregor spectral representation for a finite birth–death chain
concept.description: For an irreducible birth–death transition matrix P on{0,…,N}, stationary lawπ, and recurrence polynomials φ₀=1 with Pφ(λ)=λφ(λ), there is a probability measureν on its real eigenvalues in[−1,1] such that ∫φ_xφ_y,dν=1_{x=y}π(0)/π(x) and Pⁿ(x,y)=π(y)/π(0)∫λⁿφ_x(λ)φ_y(λ)dν(λ), n≥0.

concept.title: Interlacing of consecutive orthogonal-polynomial zeros
concept.description: For n≥1 let p₀,…,p_n be monic orthogonal polynomials with positive norms for a positive measure having at least n+1 support points and the required finite moments. The next polynomial p_{n+1}=(x−a_n)p_n−b_np_{n−1}, where a_n=∫xp_n²/‖p_n‖² and b_n=‖p_n‖²/‖p_{n−1}‖², has simple real zeros strictly interlacing those of p_n. If the measure has exactly n+1 distinct support points with positive masses, p_{n+1} is their monic vanishing polynomial, even though its measure norm is zero.

concept.title: Character of a finite-dimensional representation
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional representation ρ of a group G, its character is the function χ_ρ(g)=trρ(g). For a unitary representation of a compact group it is a continuous class function; the character of a general representation need not be one-dimensional.

concept.title: C^r topology on functions with compact support
concept.description: For an integer r≥0 on a smooth real manifold, the space C_K^r of r-times continuously differentiable functions supported in a fixed compact K has the seminorms given by uniform bounds on coordinate derivatives of order≤r, using finitely many charts near K. C_c^r has the locally convex inductive-limit topology over compact supports. On a Lie group, invariant derivatives give the same topology.

concept.title: Peter–Weyl theorem
concept.description: For a compact Hausdorff group K, every irreducible continuous unitary representation is finite-dimensional. Its matrix coefficients, multiplied by the square root of their representation dimension, form an orthonormal basis of L²(K) as the irreducible representation varies, and their finite linear span is uniformly dense in C(K).

concept.title: Weyl eigenvalue bound for a compact-manifold Laplacian
concept.description: For a nonnegative elliptic Laplacian on a compact d-dimensional smooth Riemannian manifold, the eigenvalue counting function satisfies N(λ)=O((1+λ)^(d/2)). Consequently (1+Δ)^(−s) is trace class for s>d/2.

concept.title: Casimir Laplacian of a compact Lie group
concept.description: Choose an Ad-invariant inner product on the Lie algebra of a compact Lie group and an orthonormal basis X_j. The operator Δ=−∑X_j² is a nonnegative bi-invariant elliptic Laplacian and acts by a nonnegative scalar on each irreducible matrix-coefficient subspace.

concept.title: Local Iwasawa decomposition
concept.description: For a connected reductive group over R,C or a finite extension of Q_p and a parabolic P, some maximal compact K satisfies G(k)=P(k)K. If a compatible reductive integral model and parabolic model over O_k exist, K can be taken to be the hyperspecial subgroup 𝒢(O_k).

concept.title: Spreading out a parabolic subgroup over S-integers
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group G and an F-parabolic P⊂G, after inverting finitely many primes there are a reductive affine group model 𝒢 and a smooth parabolic model 𝒫⊂𝒢 with generic fibers G and P.

concept.title: Tychonoff’s theorem
concept.description: An arbitrary product of compact topological spaces, with the product topology, is compact.

concept.title: Hardy inequality for boundary distance on a Lipschitz domain
concept.description: For a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω there is C_Ω such that ∫_Ω|u(x)|²/dist(x,∂Ω)²dx≤C_Ω∫_Ω|∇u(x)|²dx for every u∈H₀¹(Ω).

concept.title: Polynomial boundary-distance lower bound for an elliptic ground state
concept.description: For L=∑ᵢⱼ∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth real symmetric uniformly elliptic coefficients and zero Dirichlet condition on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, its positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction φ satisfies φ(x)≥c,dist(x,∂Ω)^κ for some c,κ>0. The exponent may depend on the domain and ellipticity; linear decay is not asserted at corners.

concept.title: Euclidean logarithmic Sobolev inequality with a parameter
concept.description: For d≥1 there is C_d such that every real u∈H¹(ℝᵈ) with ‖u‖₂=1 satisfies ∫u²log(u²)dx≤ε∫|∇u|²dx+C_d−(d/2)logε for ε>0, with the usual0log0 convention.

concept.title: Davies–Simon logarithmic Sobolev criterion for ultracontractivity
concept.description: Let a symmetric Markov semigroup have a strongly local Dirichlet form E on L²(μ). If for every normalized f in its form domain and0<ε≤1, ∫f²log(f²)dμ≤εE(f,f)+C₀+C₁|logε|, then its operators map L²(μ) boundedly into L∞(μ) at every positive time. The criterion applies to the ground-state-transformed elliptic forms here.

concept.title: Interior smoothness of a Dirichlet heat kernel
concept.description: For a smooth uniformly elliptic real divergence-form operator on a domain, the killed diffusion semigroup has a transition density p_t(x,y) smooth in t>0 and in both interior spatial variables. Boundary regularity is not asserted by this statement.

concept.title: Bounded–Lipschitz metrization of weak convergence
