concept.description: On a Polish space with a bounded compatible metric d, β(μ,ν)=sup{|∫f,dμ−∫f,dν|:‖f‖∞≤1,Lip_d(f)≤1} is a metric on Borel probability measures inducing their weak-convergence topology.

concept.title: Isotypic subspace for a compact-group representation
concept.description: For a continuous unitary representation of a compact group K and an irreducible finite-dimensional K-representation τ, its τ-isotypic subspace is the closed span of all subrepresentations isomorphic to τ. Equivalently it is the image of d_τ∫_K conjugate(χ_τ(k))π(k)dk.

concept.title: Admissible unitary representation of an adelic reductive group
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group, a continuous unitary representation is admissible if, for every compact open K_f⊂G(A_f) and every irreducible type τ of a maximal compact K_∞⊂G(F_∞), the subspace of K_f-fixed vectors in its τ-isotypic subspace is finite-dimensional.

concept.title: Admissibility of irreducible unitary adelic representations
concept.description: Every irreducible continuous unitary representation of the adelic group of a connected reductive number-field group is admissible. In particular each cuspidal automorphic isotypic block has finite-dimensional spaces of a fixed archimedean compact type and fixed finite-level invariants, after accounting for its finite automorphic multiplicity.

concept.title: Archimedean–finite factorization of irreducible unitary adelic representations
concept.description: Every irreducible continuous unitary representation of G(A_F)=G(F_∞)×G(A_f), for connected reductive G over a number field, is the Hilbert tensor product of irreducible unitary representations of the two factors, unique up to unitary equivalence.

concept.title: Harish-Chandra’s admissibility theorem
concept.description: For a real reductive algebraic group G and maximal compact subgroup K⊂G(R), every irreducible continuous unitary representation has finite multiplicity for every irreducible K-type. Complex reductive groups are included by restriction to R.

concept.title: Admissibility of irreducible finite-adelic unitary representations
concept.description: For a connected reductive number-field group, every irreducible continuous unitary representation V of G(A_f) has dim V^K<∞ for every compact open subgroup K. This is the finite-adelic form of nonarchimedean admissibility, not a claim about arbitrary totally disconnected groups.

concept.title: Hilbert tensor product
concept.description: The completion of the algebraic tensor product of complex Hilbert spaces for the inner product specified on elementary tensors by ⟨x⊗y,x′⊗y′⟩=⟨x,x′⟩⟨y,y′⟩.

concept.title: Smooth function on a Euclidean sphere
concept.description: A scalar function onS^{d−1} is smooth if it is the restriction of aC∞ function on a neighborhood of the sphere inℝᵈ.

concept.title: Spherical polynomial
concept.description: The restriction toS^{d−1} of a real polynomial in d variables; its degree is the least possible total degree of an extending polynomial.

concept.title: Best L² approximation by spherical polynomials
concept.description: Forf∈L²(S^{d−1}),E_N(f) is the infimum of∥f−P∥₂ over spherical polynomialsP of degree at mostN. Rates of decay ofE_N quantify polynomial approximation.

concept.title: Finite signed measure
concept.description: A differenceµ=µ₁−µ₂ of two finite positive measures on the sameσ-algebra. It is real-valued and countably additive.

concept.title: Spherical cosine transform
concept.description: For an integrable functionf onS^{d−1}, Cf(u)=∫_{S^{d−1}}|⟨u,v⟩|f(v)dσ(v), using probability-normalized spherical area. The same formula definesCµ for finite signed measuresµ.

concept.title: Generating measure of an origin-symmetric zonoid
concept.description: A finite even positive measureµ onS^{d−1} generating an origin-symmetric zonoidZ satisfiesh_Z(u)=∫|⟨u,v⟩|dµ(v). Even means invariance underv↦−v.

concept.title: Uniqueness of a zonal spherical harmonic
concept.description: For d≥3, the degree-k spherical harmonics invariant under all orthogonal transformations fixing a given unit vectoru form a one-dimensional space. Its value as a function ofv is proportional to the Gegenbauer polynomial C_k^{(d−2)/2}(u·v).

concept.title: Gegenbauer polynomial values at zero and one
Spherical Radon transform on spherical harmonics
concept.description: For d≥3, the normalized spherical Radon transform acts on degree-k harmonics by zero for oddk and by(−1)^{k/2}[1·3⋯(k−1)]/[(d−1)(d+1)⋯(d+k−3)] for evenk; the degree-zero multiplier is1.

concept.title: Fischer decomposition of homogeneous polynomials
concept.description: Every real homogeneous polynomial of degreeN inℝᵈ has a unique decomposition∑_{j=0}^{⌊N/2⌋}|x|^{2j}H_{N−2j}(x), where eachH_k is homogeneous and harmonic. ConsequentlydimH_k=binom(k+d−1,d−1)−binom(k+d−3,d−1), with a negative-degree term interpreted as zero.

concept.title: Nikolskii inequality for spherical polynomials
concept.description: For a spherical polynomialP of degree at mostN≥1 onS^{d−1}, ∥P∥∞≤C_dN^{(d−1)/2}∥P∥₂, with spherical area normalized to probability.

concept.title: Spectral multipliers of the spherical cosine transform
concept.description: For d≥3, the spherical cosine transform acts by scalar multipliers on each harmonic degree. Odd multipliers vanish; even multipliers are nonzero, and their absolute values are bounded above and below by positive dimension-dependent constants times(1+k)^{−(d+2)/2} on degree2k.

concept.title: Smoothness characterized by spherical harmonic coefficient decay
concept.description: AnL² function onS^{d−1} is smooth exactly when its degree-k harmonic projection hasL² normO((1+k)^{−N}) for everyN>0. In that case the harmonic expansion and all its derivatives converge to the function.

concept.title: Invertibility of the cosine transform on smooth even functions
concept.description: For d≥3, the spherical cosine transform is a bijection ofC∞ even functions onS^{d−1} onto itself, where even meansf(−u)=f(u).

concept.title: Weak compactness of bounded positive measures on a compact metric space
concept.description: A sequence of finite positive measures on a compact metric space with uniformly bounded total masses has a subsequence converging weakly against continuous functions to a finite positive measure.

concept.title: Real Stone–Weierstrass theorem
concept.description: A unital real subalgebra of the continuous real functions on a compact Hausdorff space is uniformly dense if it separates points.

concept.title: Generating-measure representation theorem for symmetric zonoids
concept.description: An origin-symmetric convex body is a zonoid exactly when it has a finite even positive generating measure on the unit sphere. That generating measure is unique.

concept.title: Smooth symmetric support functions are generalized zonoids
concept.description: An origin-symmetric convex body withC∞ support function is a generalized zonoid: h_K=Cν for a finite even signed measureν, equivalentlyK+M=L for symmetric zonoidsL,M.

concept.title: Determinant formula for the volume of a zonotope
concept.description: The volume of∑_{i=1}^m[−v_i,v_i] inℝᵈ is2ᵈ∑_{1≤i₁<⋯<i_d≤m}|det(v_{i₁},…,v_{i_d})|.

concept.title: Weak convergence of products of finite compact-space measures
concept.description: If finite positive measuresµ_n converge weakly toµ on a compact metric space, their fixed finite product powersµ_n^⊗d converge weakly toµ^⊗d.

concept.title: Hausdorff continuity of convex-body volume
concept.description: If convex compact sets inℝᵈ converge in Hausdorff distance to a convex compact set, theird-dimensional volumes converge.

concept.title: Determinant-integral formula for zonoid volume
concept.description: For a full-dimensional symmetric zonoidZ with generating measureµ defined byh_Z(u)=∫|u·v|dµ(v), |Z|=(2ᵈ/d!)∫⋯∫|det(v₁,…,v_d)|dµ(v₁)⋯dµ(v_d).

concept.title: Surface-area density from a support-function Hessian
concept.description: For aC² support functionh of a strictly convex body, with∇²_Sh+hI positive definite on each tangent space, its surface-area density isdet(∇²_Sh+hI) relative to spherical area.

concept.title: Andréief–Cauchy–Binet determinant identity for rank-one integrals
concept.description: For an integrable rank-one covariance matrixM=∫vvᵀdν(v) inℝ^m, detM=(1/m!)∫⋯∫det(v₁,…,v_m)²dν(v₁)⋯dν(v_m), whenν is finite with bounded support.

concept.title: Weak continuity of convex surface-area measures
concept.description: Hausdorff convergence of full-dimensional convex bodies to a full-dimensional convex body implies weak convergence of their surface-area measures on the sphere.

concept.title: Minkowski existence and stability theorem for surface-area measures
concept.description: A finite positive measure onS^{d−1} with centroid zero and not concentrated on a great subsphere is the surface-area measure of a convex body, uniquely up to translation. Weak convergence of such measures to a measure satisfying the same nondegeneracy condition gives Hausdorff convergence of suitably translated bodies.

concept.title: Preservation of spherical integrals by equatorial averaging
concept.description: For an integrable functiong onS^{d−1}, the normalized spherical Radon transform satisfies∫Rg dσ=∫g dσ, with probability-normalized spherical area.

concept.title: Weil’s formula for bounded curvature densities of projection bodies
concept.description: For d≥3 and a convex bodyK with bounded surface-area densityf_K relative to unnormalized spherical area, ΠK has density f_ΠK(u)=(1/(d−1)!)∫_{(S^{d−1}∩u⊥)^{d−1}}det_{u⊥}(v₁,…,v_{d−1})²∏_jf_K(v_j)dℋ^{d−2}(v_j), for almost everyu.

concept.title: Jacobian of an invertible linear map followed by radial normalization
concept.description: ForB∈GL(d), the sphere mapu↦Bu/|Bu| has spherical Jacobian|detB|/|Bu|ᵈ.

concept.title: Surface-area measure under an invertible linear map
concept.description: IfA∈GL(d), surface-area measure transforms by the normal mapu↦A^(−T)u/|A^(−T)u| with weight|detA||A^(−T)u|. Equivalently integrate a test functiong againstS_AK by integratingg of that normal map times the weight againstS_K.

concept.title: Curvature density under an invertible linear map
concept.description: ForA∈GL(d) and a convex bodyK with surface-area densityf_K, f_AK(v)=|detA|²|Aᵀv|^(−d−1) f_K(Aᵀv/|Aᵀv|) almost everywhere onS^{d−1}.

concept.title: Finite-volume Gibbs probability density
concept.description: For a reference measure m and measurable energy H with0<Z=∫exp(−H)dm<∞, the Gibbs probability measure has density Z⁻¹exp(−H) relative to m. Finite-volume particle configurations commonly use Lebesgue measure or a finite-volume Poisson law as reference.

concept.title: Pair potential for a continuum particle system
concept.description: A symmetric measurable function Ψ(x,y) with values in ℝ∪{+∞}, assigning interaction energy to a pair of particle positions. The energy of a finite configuration sums Ψ over its unordered distinct-particle pairs.

concept.title: Canonical Gibbs specification for a continuum point process
concept.description: A point process satisfies the canonical Gibbs specification for self-potentialΦ and pair potentialΨ if, conditional on the outside configurationη and exactly n particles in a bounded regionΛ, its inside positions have a Lebesgue Gibbs density proportional to exp(−∑_iΦ(x_i)−∑_{i<j}Ψ(x_i,x_j)−∑_i∑_{y∈η}Ψ(x_i,y)). The cross sums and positive finite normalizer must exist for almost every conditioning configuration; particle labels are quotiented out.

concept.title: Lennard–Jones6–12 pair potential
concept.description: The radial pair potential Ψ(x,y)=A|x−y|⁻¹²−B|x−y|⁻⁶ for A,B>0 and x≠y, with Ψ(x,x)=+∞. The inverse-twelfth-power term is repulsive and the inverse-sixth-power term attractive.

concept.title: Repulsive Riesz pair potential
concept.description: For s>0, the Euclidean pair potential Ψ(x,y)=|x−y|^{−s}, with value+∞ on the diagonal. The particle example in Esaki assumes s>d, which controls its long-distance tail.

concept.title: Infinite Ginibre point process
concept.description: The determinantal point process on ℂ with respect to planar Lebesgue measure and kernel K(z,w)=π⁻¹exp(z w̄−(|z|²+|w|²)/2). Its intensity is1/π; this fixes the spatial normalization.

concept.title: Regular symmetric stable-like form with measurable variable order
concept.description: Let α:ℝᵈ→(0,2) be measurable, with α⁻¹,(2−α)⁻¹ locally integrable and∫_{|x|>R}|x|^{−d−α(x)}dx<∞ for some R>1. Set J(x,y)=(|x−y|^{−d−α(x)}+|x−y|^{−d−α(y)})/2. The form E(u,v)=½∬(u(x)−u(y))(v(x)−v(y))J(x,y)dxdy on compactly supported Lipschitz functions is closable inL²; its closure is a regular symmetric Dirichlet form.

concept.title: Handelman–Roy closed-complementary-face unperforation criterion
concept.description: Let (G,u) be a dimension group, U a family of normalized traces, H=ker_G U and F=Z(H)⊂S(G,u), the traces vanishing on H. If F is a face whose complementary face is closed, then the quotient-ordered group G/H is unperforated; if G is simple, the quotient is a simple dimension group. Here complementary means the disjoint face giving the unique convex decomposition of each point between the two faces; the degenerate zero quotient is understood separately.

concept.title: Good subset of a trace simplex
concept.description: A subset U of the normalized trace simplex K is good if, whenever nonnegative continuous affine functions a,b satisfy a<b at every point of U, there is a nonnegative continuous affine a′ on K with a′|U=a|U and a′<b everywhere on K.

concept.title: Handelman–Roy refinability criterion for finite-trace dimension groups
concept.description: Let (G,u) be a simple dimension group whose normalized trace simplex K is finite-dimensional, and let τ be a trace. Put H=kerτ and Z={σ∈K:σ(H)=0}. Then τ is refinable exactly when G/H is unperforated, Z is a good subset of K, and the closure of the affine-evaluation image of H is the space of continuous affine functions on K vanishing on Z. In this situation τ is good exactly when it is refinable and Z={τ}.

concept.title: Free abelian group
concept.description: An abelian group with a family of elements such that every group element is a unique finite integer linear combination of them; the number of basis elements is its rank.

concept.title: Critical dimension group
concept.description: A dense free abelian subgroup of rank n+1 in R^n, equipped with the strict ordering whose positive cone is0 together with the vectors having every coordinate positive. It is regarded as an ordered group with that specified embedding and ordering.

concept.title: Refinable traces on critical dimension groups
concept.description: For a critical dimension group of rank n+1 with n≥2, a trace τ is refinable exactly when kerτ={0}.

concept.title: Benatar’s pair-correlation bound for Maynard–Tao sieve weights
concept.description: There are absolute δ>1/4 and σ>0 such that, for ψ(k)→0 with ψ(k)logk→∞ and all large k, a fixed admissible k-tuple admits smooth Maynard–Tao weights of level N^δ supported on the σ-simplex. Under the probability law proportional to their squared divisor sum on an admissible residue class n≤N, P(n+h_i prime)=(1+o_k(1))δψ(k)logk/k and, for i≠j, P(n+h_i,n+h_j prime)≤(1+o_k(1))δψ(k)²(logk)²/k², with N→∞ first. This is an off-diagonal bound; the diagonal terms are retained when computing a full second moment.

concept.title: Coefficientwise congruence of formal series
concept.description: Two formal series with coefficients in a commutative ring R are congruent modulo an ideal I when every pair of corresponding coefficients differs by an element of I. Reduction applies R→R/I to each coefficient.

concept.title: Kernel of the genus-two Witt operator modulo2 and3
concept.description: Let p=2 or3 and k≥0 be even; use Igusa’s integral generators and reduced forms over Z_(p). If12∤k, kerW̄_k=X̄₁₀M̄_(k−10). If k=12n, put e=4,E=X₄₈ for p=2 and e=3,E=X₃₆ for p=3. For each0≤i≤n not divisible by e, write i=es+t with1≤t<e and set m_i=X₁₂^t E^s Y₁₂^(n−i). Then kerW̄_k=(⊕_i F_p m̄_i)⊕X̄₁₀M̄_(k−10). Moreover for12|k, W(f)≡W″(f)≡0 modp implies f≡X₁₀²g modp for some g of weight k−20. Negative-weight spaces are zero.

concept.title: Multiplicative saturation of a subspace
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional subspace S⊂L of a field extension L/F with1∈S and an F-subspace X, its S-saturation is {x∈L:xS⊂XS}, where XS is the F-span of products. X is S-saturated when it equals this subspace.

concept.title: Boundary-minimizing multiplicative linear kernel
concept.description: For fixed S and an attained finite value λ, a linear kernel is a finite-dimensional S-saturated subspace of minimum dimension among such subspaces satisfying dim(XS)−dimX=λ. In the source an i-kernel refers to the i-th increasing attained boundary value. This is unrelated to the kernel of a linear map.

concept.title: Subfield chain of multiplicative linear kernels
concept.description: Let1∈S⊂L generate L over F, with S finite-dimensional, S≠L and {x:xS⊂S}=F. Suppose some nonzero finite-dimensional T has ST≠L and dimST<dimS+dimT−1. List the positive attained saturated-subspace boundary values below dimS as λ₁<⋯<λ_n. The minimum-dimensional kernels containing1 are unique subfields F₁⊋⋯⊋F_n=F, and every finite-dimensional S-saturated X of boundary λ_i satisfies XF_i=X.

concept.title: Probability kernel between measurable spaces
concept.description: A probability kernel from(S,Σ) to(E,ℰ) assigns a probability measure K(s,·) onE to each s∈S, with s↦K(s,A) Σ-measurable for every A∈ℰ. A random probability measure is such a kernel with a probability space as its domain.

concept.title: Stable convergence of random probability kernels
concept.description: For probability kernels K_n,K on a fixed probability space(Ω,F,P) with Polish targetE, K_n converges stably toK if E[a(ω)∫f(x)K_n(ω,dx)]→E[a(ω)∫f(x)K(ω,dx)] for every bounded F-measurable a and every bounded continuous f onE. The base probabilityP stays fixed.

concept.title: Borel isomorphism theorem for standard Borel spaces
concept.description: Every measurable space arising as the Borel sets of a Polish space is measurably isomorphic to a Borel subset of[0,1]. Its measurable bijection and inverse both preserve Borel measurability.

concept.title: Radon–Nikodym theorem for finite measures
concept.description: If finite positive measuresν,μ on one measurable space satisfyν≪μ, there is a nonnegative integrable f withν(A)=∫_Af,dμ for every measurableA, unique up toμ-null sets.

concept.title: Probability measure determined by a distribution function
concept.description: Every nondecreasing right-continuous F:ℝ→[0,1] with limits0 at−∞ and1 at+∞ is the distribution function of a unique Borel probability measure, characterized byμ((−∞,x])=F(x).

concept.title: Banach–Alaoglu theorem
concept.description: The unit ball of the continuous dual of a normed space is compact for pointwise convergence on that space, the weak-* topology. If the normed space is separable, this compact topology on the dual ball is metrizable and every bounded sequence has a weak-* convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Duality of L¹ and L∞ for a finite measure
concept.description: For a finite measureμ, every bounded linear functional on realL¹(μ) is uniquely integration against an element ofL∞(μ), and its operator norm is that element’s essential supremum norm.

concept.title: Regular conditional distribution for a Polish-valued random variable
concept.description: If X takes values in a Polish spaceE and G⊆F is a sub-σ-algebra, there is a G-measurable probability kernel K(ω,·) with∫f,dK(ω)=E[f(X)|G](ω) almost surely for every bounded Borel f. It is unique up to a common null set. Equivalently a probability measure on a product with Polish second factor disintegrates into its first marginal and such conditional probabilities.

concept.title: Stable compactness of random probability kernels with tight mean laws
concept.description: Let K_n be probability kernels on one probability space with Polish targetE. If their mean probability measuresν_n(A)=E[K_n(ω,A)] form a tight family, then some subsequence converges stably to a probability kernelK on the same base space.

concept.title: Multivalued Skorohod problem for a convex subdifferential
concept.description: For proper lower semicontinuous convex η:ℝᵈ→(−∞,∞], continuous w with w₀=0 and x∈closure(dom∂η), find continuous X and K, K₀=0, K locally of bounded variation, with X=x+w−K in closure(dom∂η) and∫_sᵗ⟨X_r−a,dK_r−a*dr⟩≥0 for every(a,a*)∈graph∂η and s≤t. For an indicator of a closed convex set, this is normal reflection.

concept.title: Moreau–Yosida envelope and proximal map of a convex function
concept.description: For proper lower semicontinuous convex η onℝᵈ andλ>0, η_λ(x)=inf_y{η(y)+|x−y|²/(2λ)}. The unique minimizer is prox_{λη}(x), and∇η_λ(x)=(x−prox_{λη}(x))/λ is globally Lipschitz; it approximates the maximal monotone subdifferential.

concept.title: Helly selection theorem for bounded-variation functions
concept.description: A sequence of real functions on a compact interval with uniformly bounded sup norms and total variations has a pointwise convergent subsequence with bounded-variation limit. The finite-dimensional vector version follows componentwise; uniform convergence needs additional continuity/oscillation control.

concept.title: Arzelà–Ascoli theorem for Euclidean-valued paths
concept.description: A uniformly bounded equicontinuous family inC([0,T];ℝᵈ) is relatively compact in the uniform norm.

concept.title: Picard–Lindelöf theorem for a time-dependent Euclidean ODE
concept.description: A vector field continuous in time and locally Lipschitz in the state has a unique local solution through each initial point, with continuous dependence on initial data and the field on compact sets. If the state stays in a compact set on each finite interval, the solution extends globally; globally Lipschitz fields of linear growth satisfy this condition.

concept.title: One-dimensional regularity of convex functions
concept.description: A finite convex function on an open real interval is locally Lipschitz. Its left and right derivatives exist and are monotone, disagree at at most countably many points, and equal its ordinary derivative almost everywhere.

concept.title: Occupation-time formula for continuous semimartingales
concept.description: A real continuous semimartingale X has local timesL_t^a with∫₀ᵗg(X_s)d[X]_s=∫_ℝg(a)L_t^a da for nonnegative Borel g. In particular if[X]_t=t, it spends zero Lebesgue time in any Lebesgue-null spatial set.

concept.title: Finite speed measure and mixing of a one-dimensional diffusion
concept.description: For a conservative irreducible regular diffusion on an interval with interior generator½f″+qf′ and instantaneous reflection at any regular included endpoint, the speed density is2exp(2∫q). If its total mass is finite, its normalization is the unique invariant probability measure and transition laws converge to it in total variation. Entrance or inaccessible endpoints contribute no boundary holding atom.

concept.title: Uniform convergence after undoing a monotone clock
concept.description: Let τ_n:[0,∞)→[0,∞) be increasing homeomorphisms fixing0, converging locally uniformly to a continuous nondecreasing unboundedτ, and let continuous y_n converge locally uniformly to y. If y is constant on each level interval ofτ, then x(t)=y(s) forτ(s)=t is well-defined and continuous, and y_n∘τ_n⁻¹ converges to x uniformly on compact intervals.

concept.title: Cépa’s well-posedness theorem for multivalued Skorohod equations
concept.description: Let η be proper lower semicontinuous convex onℝᵈ with int(dom∂η) nonempty and b globally Lipschitz. For every x∈closure(dom∂η) and continuous w with w₀=0, X=x+w+∫₀^.b(X_s)ds−K has a unique solution in the multivalued Skorohod sense. The map(x,w)↦X is continuous for uniform convergence on compact time intervals. Brownian inputs therefore define a continuous random dynamical system on closure(dom∂η).

concept.title: Mixing of bounded one-dimensional convex stochastic inclusions
concept.description: Let η:ℝ→(−∞,∞] be proper lower semicontinuous convex with bounded domain and int(dom∂η) nonempty, and let b∈C² have bounded derivatives. The solution of dX+∂η(X)dt∋b(X)dt+dW has a unique invariant probability, with density proportional to exp(2∫_{x₀}^x b(s)ds−2η(x)) on int(domη), and its laws converge in total variation from every state in closure(dom∂η).

concept.title: Mixing of a dissipative one-dimensional additive Brownian SDE
concept.description: If b is locally Lipschitz onℝ and xb(x)≤C−cx² for c>0, the solution of dX=b(X)dt+dW is nonexplosive, has unique invariant density proportional to exp(2∫₀^x b(s)ds), and its transition laws converge to that density in total variation from every starting point.

concept.title: Finite-mixture approximate independence of finite-spin cube measures
concept.description: For every finite spin set Ω, ε>0 and integer k≥2, there is η>0 such that every probability law µ on Ωⁿ with sufficiently large n has disjoint events S₁,…,S_N, each of mass at least η and together of mass at least1−ε, for which the conditional joint law at k uniformly sampled coordinates has expected total variation distance less than ε from the product of its conditional one-coordinate marginals. The number N is at most1/η.

concept.title: Random continuous tests for stable convergence of probability kernels
concept.description: If probability kernels µ_n on a Polish space converge stably to µ, then E∫F(ω,x)µ_n(ω,dx)→E∫F(ω,x)µ(ω,dx) for every jointly measurable F continuous in x with E sup_x|F(ω,x)|<∞. Stable convergence means convergence first for tests a(ω)f(x), with a bounded measurable and f bounded continuous.

concept.title: Invariant random measure for a weakly mixing continuous random dynamical system
concept.description: Let φ be a continuous random dynamical system on a Polish state space over a measure-preserving two-sided noise shift. If its one-point laws converge weakly to µ for µ-almost every initial point, then there is a random probability measure π measurable for the past generated by all solution maps ending no later than time0, with Eπ=µ and φ_t(ω)_*π_ω=π_{θ_tω} almost surely for each t≥0. Independent noise increments are not required.

concept.title: Periodic Sobolev space H² on the circle
concept.description: H²(S¹) consists of2π-periodic L² functions whose first and second distributional derivatives, tested against smooth periodic functions, are also in L². Functions are identified almost everywhere; the sum of the three squared L² norms defines its norm.

concept.title: Continuity of the stochastic heat convolution on the circle
concept.description: For space-time white noise on S¹, Z_t=∫₀ᵗe^{(t−s)∂ₓ²}dW_s has a version jointly continuous in(t,x) on every compact time interval times S¹, starting from0. Thus t↦Z_t is continuous with values in C(S¹) in the supremum norm.

concept.title: Comparison principle for scalar periodic parabolic equations
concept.description: Let F₁≤F₂ be continuous real functions on [0,T]×S¹×ℝ, one of them locally Lipschitz in u uniformly in (t,x). Let u,v be essentially bounded functions in L²(0,T;H¹(S¹))∩C([0,T];L²(S¹)) with weak time derivatives in L²(0,T;H¹(S¹)*) for the Gelfand triple H¹(S¹)⊂L²(S¹)⊂H¹(S¹)*, solving u_t=u_xx+F₁(t,x,u) and v_t=v_xx+F₂(t,x,v) weakly against H¹(S¹) test functions for almost every t. If u(0)≤v(0) almost everywhere, then u(t)≤v(t) almost everywhere for every t∈[0,T]. Bounded classical solutions are a special case.

concept.title: Existence for a smooth-forced parabolic double-obstacle problem
concept.description: For fixed H²(S¹) walls h₁<h₂, Lipschitz f, smooth forcing and smooth initial data between the walls, the periodic equation u_t=u_xx+f(u)+forcing with lower and upper normal reflection has a unique continuous variational solution. The normal corrections satisfy the two complementarity conditions; the solution is obtained by lower/upper penalty limits.

concept.title: Supremum stability of the parabolic double-obstacle solution map
concept.description: For fixed strictly separated continuous walls on the circle and Lipschitz drift f, subtract a continuous free driving field v from a reflected heat solution and write the remainder z. On each finite interval, changing v and the initial data changes z by at most C_T times their supremum-norm changes. The same estimate holds uniformly for the lower and upper penalized equations, independently of the penalty parameters.

concept.title: Nualart–Pardoux well-posedness for a one-wall stochastic heat equation
concept.description: On a one-dimensional compact interval with compatible Dirichlet boundary data, a regular lower obstacle and globally Lipschitz drift, the additive space-time-white-noise heat equation with normal reflection above that obstacle has a unique continuous adapted solution. It is the increasing limit of lower-penalty equations, with a positive complementarity measure locally finite away from the spatial boundary.

concept.title: Skorohod representation theorem on a Polish space
concept.description: If probability measures µ_n converge weakly to µ on a Polish space, they can be realized as laws of random variables X_n,X on one probability space with X_n→X almost surely.

concept.title: Dambis–Dubins–Schwarz time-change theorem
concept.description: A real continuous local martingale M starting at0 can be represented as B_{⟨M⟩_t} for a Brownian motion on its quadratic-variation clock, after extension by independent Brownian noise if the terminal bracket is finite.

concept.title: Lévy characterization of Brownian motion
concept.description: A continuous real local martingale starting at0 with quadratic variation t is Brownian motion relative to its filtration. The vector version requires bracket matrix tI.

concept.title: Coupling inequality for total variation
concept.description: For any coupling(X,Y) of probability measures µ and ν on the same measurable space, d_TV(µ,ν)≤P(X≠Y). On a standard Borel space the equality event is measurable.

concept.title: Dobrushin contraction theorem for a Markov kernel
concept.description: For a Markov kernel K on a standard Borel space, let δ(K)=sup_{x,y}d_TV(K(x,·),K(y,·)). If δ(K)<1, then µ↦µK is a δ(K)-contraction in total variation on probability measures, has a unique fixed probability π, and d_TV(Kⁿ(x,·),π)≤δ(K)ⁿ.

concept.title: Well-posedness and continuous cocycle for the periodic heat equation with two walls
concept.description: For h₁,h₂∈H²(S¹) with h₁<h₂, globally Lipschitz f and continuous initial g between the walls, the additive-white-noise stochastic heat equation with the two normal reflection measures has a unique continuous adapted solution. On canonical two-sided white noise these solutions define a continuous random dynamical system on {g∈C(S¹):h₁≤g≤h₂}.

concept.title: Comparison for the periodic heat equation with two reflecting walls
concept.description: For fixed H²(S¹) walls h₁<h₂ and Lipschitz f, two reflected stochastic heat solutions driven by the same additive space-time white noise preserve pointwise order of their initial states. The order holds simultaneously for all nonnegative times on the pathwise continuous version.

concept.title: Total-variation mixing for the periodic stochastic heat equation with two walls
concept.description: With strictly separated H²(S¹) walls, globally Lipschitz drift and unit additive space-time white noise, the reflected heat equation has a unique invariant probability on its continuous state space, and transition laws converge to it in total variation from every initial state between the walls.

concept.title: Coordinate support relative to a Schauder basis
concept.description: For x=∑a_i e_i in a Banach space with a specified Schauder basis, supp_e(x)={i:a_i≠0}. The support of a subspace is the union of its vectors’ coordinate supports. These supports need not be finite.

concept.title: Seminormalized sequence in a normed space
concept.description: A sequence(x_n) for which0<inf_n∥x_n∥≤sup_n∥x_n∥<∞.

concept.title: Equidistributed finitely supported basis vectors
concept.description: Two finitely supported vectors relative to specified ordered bases are equidistributed when the increasing bijection between their nonzero coordinate supports preserves every coefficient. This means the same ordered coefficient pattern, not equality of probability laws.

concept.title: Diagonal-free operator on a fixed block subspace
concept.description: A bounded operatorT:[x_n]→X, with(x_n) a fixed block sequence of a specified ambient Schauder basis(e_i), is diagonal-free when supp_e(Tx_n)∩supp_e(x_n)=∅ for every n. This depends on the chosen ambient basis and block sequence.

concept.title: Gowers–Maurey rapidly increasing sequence of ℓ₁ averages
concept.description: Fix ε>0, ε′=min(ε,1), f(t)=log₂(t+1), and M(t)=2^(36t²)−1. A finite successive sequencex₁,…,x_N is rapidly increasing with constant1+ε when∥x_k∥=1 and x_k is a sum of n_k successive vectors of norms≤(1+ε)/n_k, with n₁≥4(1+ε)log(2)M(N/ε′)/ε′ and(ε′/2)√f(n_k)≥|supp(x_(k−1))| for k≥2. This is the original quantitative convention for these spaces.

concept.title: Existence of arbitrarily long ℓ₁ averages in Gowers’s unconditional space
concept.description: For every block subspace ofX_U, every integer n≥1 and every c>1, there is an ℓ₁ⁿ block average with constantc in that subspace.

concept.title: Gowers’s disjoint-support separation estimates
concept.description: InX_U, let(u_n),(v_n) be seminormalized block sequences with all supports of theu_n disjoint from all supports of thev_n, and letv_n be ℓ₁ⁿ averages with a common constant. There are successive finite setsJ_k and common coefficientsa_n with∥∑_{J_k}a_nu_n∥=1 and∥∑_{J_k}a_nv_n∥→0. Also, for any basis subsequence(e_(i_n)) with infinite complement there are normalized successive combinationsw_k=∑_{J_k}a_ne_(i_n) whose equidistributed copies∑_{J_k}a_ne_(j_n) have norms tending to0 uniformly over increasing sequences(j_n) disjoint from{i_n}.

concept.title: Schlumprecht spreading model of Gowers’s unconditional basis
concept.description: The unit vector basis ofX_U generates the unit vector basis ofSchlumprecht’s spaceS as a spreading model: for every finite scalar pattern(a_i), its iterated asymptotic norm along increasing basis indices is∥∑a_ie_i∥_S.

concept.title: Coherent disjoint ℓ∞ configurations in Schlumprecht’s space
concept.description: For every0<ε<1/8 there are increasing integersp_j such that, for everyn, one can choose disjointly supported vectorsv₁,…,v_n inS, eachv_j equidistributed with(f(p_j)/p_j)∑_{i=1}^{p_j}e_i, and every tail sum∑_{j=k}^n v_j has norm≤1+ε. The same sequence(p_j) works for alln.

concept.title: Kutzarova–Lin ℓ₁ spreading model in Schlumprecht’s space
concept.description: Schlumprecht’s spaceS contains a seminormalized block sequence generating a spreading model equivalent to the unit vector basis ofℓ₁.

concept.title: Uniform boundedness of Schauder partial-sum projections
concept.description: For a Schauder basis(e_i) of a Banach space, the partial-sum operatorsP_n(∑a_ie_i)=∑_{i≤n}a_ie_i are uniformly bounded. Each coordinate functional is continuous; normalized block sequences consequently have uniformly bounded coordinate functionals on their closed spans.

concept.title: Small perturbation principle for basic sequences
concept.description: Let(x_n) be a basic sequence with continuous coordinate functionalsx_n*. If∑∥x_n*∥∥x_n−y_n∥<1, thenx_n↦y_n extends to an isomorphism between their closed spans.

concept.title: Bessaga–Pełczyński selection principle
concept.description: In a Banach space with a Schauder basis, every seminormalized weakly null sequence has a subsequence equivalent to a seminormalized block sequence; the block vectors can be chosen to approximate that subsequence with any prescribed summable positive error bounds.

concept.title: Norm closure of compact operators
concept.description: An operator-norm limit of compact linear maps between Banach spaces is compact.

concept.title: Compact restriction of a strictly singular operator to a further block subspace
concept.description: IfS:[x_n]→Y is strictly singular on a block subspace of a Banach space with basis, then[x_n] contains a further normalized block sequence(u_k) such thatS|[u_k] is compact.

concept.title: Arbitrarily small restrictions of a strictly singular operator
concept.description: For a strictly singular mapS:X→Y between Banach spaces, every infinite-dimensional closed subspaceM⊂X andε>0 contain an infinite-dimensional closedN⊂M with∥S|N∥<ε.

concept.title: Closed operator ideal of strictly singular maps
concept.description: Strictly singular bounded maps between Banach spaces are closed under operator-norm limits, sums with the same domain and codomain, and composition on either side by bounded linear maps.

concept.title: Diagonal/strictly-singular/diagonal-free decomposition in tight-by-support spaces
concept.description: LetX have a tight-by-support unconditional basis andT:[x_n]→X be bounded on a block subspace. ThenT=D|[x_n]+S+R withD bounded diagonal,S strictly singular andR diagonal-free relative to(x_n). Ifsupp(Tx_n)∩supp(x_m)=∅ for n≠m, one may takeR=0.

concept.title: Scalar-plus-strictly-singular block restriction in tight-by-support spaces
concept.description: IfX has a tight-by-support unconditional basis andT:[x_n]→X is bounded on a block subspace, there are an infinite-dimensional further block subspaceW, a scalarλ and a strictly singularS:[x_n]→X withT|W=λId|W+S|W. Consequently any two isomorphic infinite-dimensional subspaces ofX have unit spheres at distance0.

concept.title: Compact operators are strictly singular
concept.description: A compact linear operator between Banach spaces is strictly singular.

concept.title: Diagonal-plus-strictly-singular decomposition on Gowers block subspaces
concept.description: For every block subspaceY ofX_U, any boundedT:Y→X_U hasT=D|Y+S, withD a bounded diagonal operator onX_U andS strictly singular. In particular every bounded operator diagonal-free relative to a fixed block basis ofY is strictly singular.

concept.title: Block approximation of an infinite-dimensional subspace
concept.description: LetX have a Schauder basis andM⊂X be an infinite-dimensional closed subspace. For any positive summable error boundsε_n, one can choose unit vectorsv_n∈M and successive finite block vectorsu_n with∥v_n−u_n∥<ε_n; the errors can be made small enough that(v_n) and(u_n) are equivalent basic sequences.

concept.title: C*-algebra-valued variance bound for finite module covariance
concept.description: Letp_i≥0 sum to1 andx_i,y_i lie in a semi-inner-productC*-module. Putx̄=∑p_ix_i,ȳ=∑p_iy_i,G=∑p_i⟨x_i,y_i⟩−⟨x̄,ȳ⟩, V_x=∑p_i⟨x_i−x̄,x_i−x̄⟩ andV_y similarly. Then|G|²≤∥V_x∥V_y in theC*-algebra order. In particular, for anya,b, |G|²≤(∑p_i∥x_i−a∥²)(∑p_i|y_i−b|²).

concept.title: C*-algebra-valued Grüss bound after a module projection
concept.description: In an inner-productC*-module, let⟨e,e⟩ be idempotent. Forx,y∈X and anya,b∈A, |⟨x,y⟩−⟨x,e⟩⟨e,y⟩|²≤∥x−ea∥² |y−eb|² in the order ofA. Equivalently, taking positive square roots gives the corresponding unsquared bound.

concept.title: Order monotonicity of positive square roots
concept.description: For positive elementsa≤b of aC*-algebra, a^(1/2)≤b^(1/2).

concept.title: Balanced error rate for surface-perturbed Tikhonov regularization
concept.description: For the transported surface Tikhonov problem with uniformly regular parametrizations, letη=ρ+γ+δ>0 tend to0, whereρ is operator error,γ isC² surface error andδ is data error. Assume uniformly equivalent transported norms, O(γ) errors in the quadratic penalty forms and normal projections, joint coercivity∥h∥²_H¹≤C(∥Fh∥²+∥P_nh∥²+|h|²_H¹), and a variational quadratic source condition at the exact tangent solutionx†. Ifα is comparable toη, the pulled-back minimizers satisfy∥x̂_(σ,α,δ)−x†∥²_H¹=O(η).

concept.title: Doubling cube gauge
concept.description: A positive measurable function φ(x,r) on ℝⁿ×(0,∞), viewed as a weight of the cube centered at x with side r, is doubling if φ(x,2r) is comparable to φ(x,r), uniformly in x,r. Write c̃₁⁻¹≤φ(x,r)/φ(x,2r)≤c₁; neither chosen constant must be at least one.

concept.title: Locally comparable cube gauge
concept.description: A positive measurable cube gauge φ(x,r) is locally comparable if some C≥1 satisfies C⁻¹≤φ(x,r)/φ(y,r)≤C whenever |x−y|≤r. It compares cubes of the same size at nearby centers.

concept.title: Admissible Schwartz pair for an inhomogeneous dyadic resolution
concept.description: An admissible pair (ϕ,Φ) consists of Schwartz functions with supp ϕ̂⊂{1/2≤|ξ|≤2}, |ϕ̂| bounded below on {3/5≤|ξ|≤5/3}, supp Φ̂⊂{|ξ|≤2}, and |Φ̂| bounded below on {|ξ|≤5/3}. Its inhomogeneous family is Φ at scale0 and ϕⱼ(x)=2ʲⁿϕ(2ʲx) for j≥1.

concept.title: Vanishing polynomial moments of a Euclidean function
concept.description: An integrable function with the required weighted integrability has vanishing moments of order below L if ∫xᵅf(x)dx=0 for every multi-index α with |α|<L. Here L is a nonnegative integer; L=0 imposes no moment conditions.

concept.title: Almost orthogonality of dyadically dilated Schwartz kernels
concept.description: If φ,ψ∈S(ℝⁿ) both have vanishing moments below the integer L≥0 and φⱼ(x)=2ʲⁿφ(2ʲx), ψₖ(x)=2ᵏⁿψ(2ᵏx), then for every M>0, |φⱼ*ψₖ(x)|≤C2^{−L|j−k|}2^{n min(j,k)}(1+2^min(j,k)|x|)⁻ᴹ. For j≥k only φ needs the moment condition; for k≥j only ψ does. Constants may depend on the fixed kernels, L,M,n, but not j,k,x.

concept.title: Peetre maximal estimate by dyadic local means
concept.description: Fix an admissible inhomogeneous Schwartz resolution (Φⱼ), a>0, r>0 and an integer N≥a. For f∈S′ and ℓ≥0, [sup_z |Φℓ*f(x+z)|/(1+2^ℓ|z|)^a]^r≤C∑_{v≥0}2⁻ᵛᴺʳ2⁽ᵛ⁺ℓ⁾ⁿ∫|Φᵥ₊ℓ*f(y)|^r/(1+2^ℓ|x−y|)^{ar}dy. The constant depends on the fixed resolution and parameters, not f,ℓ,x; an infinite right side is allowed.

concept.title: Peetre submean inequality for band-limited functions
concept.description: For r>0 and m>n there is C such that every tempered distribution g with Fourier support in {|ξ|≤2^{ν+1}}, ν≥0, satisfies |g(x)|≤C[ηᵥ,ₘ*|g|^r(x)]^{1/r}, where ηᵥ,ₘ(x)=2^{νn}(1+2^ν|x|)⁻ᵐ. The band-limited distribution is represented by a smooth function; C is independent of g,ν,x.

concept.title: Characteristic-function norm estimates in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: Let 0<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and p be globally log-Hölder. For a cube Q, ∥χ_Q∥_{p(·)}≈|Q|^{1/p(x)} for |Q|≤1 and x∈Q, and ≈|Q|^{1/p∞} for |Q|≥1. If Q₁⊂Q₂, their norm ratio lies between constant multiples of (|Q₁|/|Q₂|)^{1/p⁻} and (|Q₁|/|Q₂|)^{1/p⁺}. If p⁻>1, ∥χ_Q∥_{p(·)}∥χ_Q∥_{p′(·)}≈|Q|.

concept.title: Embedding of variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces with a common limit at infinity
concept.description: If globally log-Hölder exponents p₁,p₂ have positive finite lower and upper bounds, p₁≤p₂, and the same limit p∞ at infinity, then L^{p₂(·)}(ℝⁿ) continuously embeds into L^{p₁(·)}(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Log-Hölder extension from a coordinate hyperplane
concept.description: Every bounded globally log-Hölder real function g on ℝⁿ⁻¹ extends to a globally log-Hölder function on ℝⁿ with the same limit at infinity and values between inf g and sup g. For any prescribed A>0, the extension may be chosen equal to g(x′) throughout the strip |t|≤A.

concept.title: Dual norm formula in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: For measurable p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and p′=p/(p−1), the associate norm sup{∫|fg|:∥g∥_{p′(·)}≤1} lies between ∥f∥_{p(·)} and 2∥f∥_{p(·)}. This formula is valid also for a measurable f whose norm is initially allowed to be infinite.

concept.title: Power triangle inequality in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: For a bounded positive measurable exponent p and 0<r≤min(1,p⁻), the Luxemburg quasi-norm satisfies ∥∑ᵢfᵢ∥_{p(·)}^r≤∑ᵢ∥fᵢ∥_{p(·)}^r for every finite family; the analogous countable inequality holds whenever the sum of the pointwise absolute values defines a measurable function.

concept.title: Muckenhoupt A₁ weight
concept.description: A locally integrable function w>0 almost everywhere is an A₁ weight if the Hardy–Littlewood maximal function satisfies Mw≤Cw almost everywhere. Its A₁ constant is the least such C.

concept.title: A₁ extrapolation into variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: Let p be globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞. If a family of nonnegative measurable pairs (f,g) satisfies ∥f∥_{L^{r₀}(w)}≤C([w]_{A₁})∥g∥_{L^{r₀}(w)} for every A₁ weight and a fixed 0<r₀<p⁻, then ∥f∥_{p(·)}≤C_p∥g∥_{p(·)} for pairs with finite left norm; the constant is uniform over the family.

concept.title: Weighted inhomogeneous Littlewood–Paley inequality for A₁ weights
concept.description: For a fixed admissible inhomogeneous Schwartz resolution, 1<r<∞ and an A₁ weight w on ℝⁿ, ∥(∑_{j≥0}|ϕⱼ*f|²)^{1/2}∥_{L^r(w)}≈∥f∥_{L^r(w)}. Constants depend on the resolution, r,n and the A₁ constant, not f.

concept.title: Density of compactly supported smooth functions in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞, C_c∞(ℝⁿ) is dense in L^{p(·)}(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Density of compactly supported smooth functions in variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: Let 1/p and 1/q be globally log-Hölder (so p,q are bounded and bounded away from 0) and let the smoothness α≥0 be bounded, locally log-Hölder and have a limit at infinity. Then C_c^∞(ℝⁿ) is dense in the unweighted inhomogeneous space F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Convolution and Fourier multiplication for a tempered distribution
concept.description: If f is a tempered distribution and ψ is Schwartz, then ψ*f is a smooth function of polynomial growth and its distributional Fourier transform is ψ̂·f̂. Fourier multiplication by a smooth cutoff equal to1 near supp f̂ therefore gives a reproducing convolution kernel.

concept.title: Littlewood–Paley characterization of variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and a fixed admissible inhomogeneous Schwartz resolution, L^{p(·)}(ℝⁿ) consists exactly of the tempered distributions with finite ∥(∑_{j≥0}|ϕⱼ*f|²)^{1/2}∥_{p(·)}, and this square-function norm is equivalent to the Luxemburg norm.

concept.title: Sobolev embedding for cube-weighted variable Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For admissible pᵢ,q,sᵢ,φ, if p₀≤p₁, s₀≥s₁ and s₀−n/p₀=s₁−n/p₁ pointwise, then F^{s₀(·),φ}_{p₀(·),q(·)} continuously embeds into F^{s₁(·),φ}_{p₁(·),q(·)}. If inf(s₀−s₁)>0, the source and target may have different arbitrary admissible sequence exponents q₀,q₁.

concept.title: Atomic and molecular characterization of cube-weighted variable Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For admissible p,q,s,φ, put c̃₁⁻¹≤φ(x,r)/φ(x,2r). If nonnegative integers K>s⁺+max(0,log₂c̃₁) and L>n/min(1,p⁻,q⁻)−n−s⁻, then sufficiently rapidly decaying uniformly normalized (K,L)-molecules synthesize matching dyadic coefficient sequences boundedly into F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)}, with convergence in S′. Conversely every element has a smooth atomic expansion with coefficient quasi-norm bounded by its function-space quasi-norm, with arbitrarily prescribed nonnegative orders K,L; scale0 atoms require no cancellation.

concept.title: Peetre maximal characterization of cube-weighted variable Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For admissible p,q,s,φ, if a>n/min(p⁻,q⁻)+log₂c̃₁+C_log(s), the quasi-norm of F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)} is equivalent to the same cube-wise mixed quasi-norm with each |ϕⱼ*f(x)| replaced by sup_y |ϕⱼ*f(x+y)|/(1+2ʲ|y|)^a. Here c̃₁ is the lower scale-comparison constant in φ(x,r)/φ(x,2r)≥c̃₁⁻¹ and C_log(s) is a local log-Hölder constant.

concept.title: Full-frequency cube norm for variable Triebel–Lizorkin-type spaces
concept.description: For admissible p,q,s,φ with lower scale-comparison constant c̃₁<2^{n/p⁺}, an equivalent quasi-norm of F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)} is obtained by summing all inhomogeneous scales j≥0 inside every dyadic cube, instead of starting at max(0,−log₂ℓ(P)).

concept.title: Variable-exponent Morrey space with a cube gauge
concept.description: For a positive measurable cube gauge φ and a bounded positive exponent p, M_φ^{p(·)}(ℝⁿ) consists of measurable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality for which sup_P φ(P)⁻¹∥fχ_P∥_{L^{p(·)}} is finite; the supremum is over dyadic cubes P. This fixes the cube-gauge convention, which differs from some other generalized Morrey normalizations.

concept.title: Morrey identification of zero-smoothness variable Triebel–Lizorkin-type spaces
concept.description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and a doubling locally comparable cube gauge with c̃₁<2^{n/p⁺}, M_φ^{p(·)}(ℝⁿ)=F^{0,φ}_{p(·),2}(ℝⁿ) with equivalent norms.

concept.title: Hyperplane trace theorem for cube-weighted variable Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For admissible p,q,s,φ on ℝⁿ, n≥2, assume s⁻−1/p⁻−(n−1)(1/min(1,p⁻)−1)>0. Write p̄(x′)=p(x′,0), s̄(x′)=s(x′,0), and φ̄(Q′)=φ(Q′×[0,ℓ(Q′))). Restriction extends continuously and surjectively from F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)}(ℝⁿ) onto F^{s̄(·)−1/p̄(·),φ̄}_{p̄(·),p̄(·)}(ℝⁿ⁻¹); in particular the trace range is independent of q.

concept.title: Normal order cone in a normed space
concept.description: An order on a real normed vector space, compatible with addition and multiplication by nonnegative scalars, has a normal positive cone if some C<∞ satisfies ‖x‖≤C‖y‖ whenever0≤x≤y. Normality bounds the norm diameters of order intervals in terms of their endpoints.

concept.title: Lipschitz composition in W¹,ᵖ
concept.description: For1≤p<∞, u∈W¹,ᵖ(Ω) and Lipschitz F:ℝ→ℝ with F(0)=0, F(u)∈W¹,ᵖ, with its weak gradient given by the almost-everywhere chain rule and bounded in magnitude by Lip(F)|∇u|. If u∈W₀¹,ᵖ then F(u)∈W₀¹,ᵖ. In particular |u| and its positive and negative parts are allowed.

concept.title: Normality of the positive-distribution order on H⁻¹
concept.description: On a bounded smooth domain, H⁻¹=(H₀¹)* with its gradient-dual norm has a normal positive-distribution cone. More precisely, if h≥0 and−h≤w≤h then ‖w‖_{H⁻¹}≤‖h‖_{H⁻¹}; hence the norm diameter of[f,g] is at most‖g−f‖_{H⁻¹}.

concept.title: Maximum principle for a scalar linear parabolic equation
concept.description: A classical supersolution of w_t−∑a_ij(t,x)∂_ijw−∑b_i(t,x)∂_iw−c(t,x)w≥0 on a bounded smooth spatial domain stays nonnegative if its parabolic-boundary values are nonnegative, the symmetric matrix a is positive semidefinite, and the continuous coefficients are bounded on the time interval. An exponential time factor removes any positive upper bound on c.

concept.title: Duality theorem for Lᵖ at a finite reflexive exponent
concept.description: For1<p<∞ and a sigma-finite measure space, every bounded linear functional on Lᵖ is uniquely f↦∫fg for g∈L^{p′},1/p+1/p′=1, and its norm is‖g‖_{p′}.

concept.title: Separability of Lᵖ on a Euclidean domain
concept.description: For1≤p<∞ and a Lebesgue measurable subset Ω of Euclidean space, Lᵖ(Ω) is separable. Rational-valued simple functions built from a countable family of rational boxes, with finite truncations and restriction to Ω, give a countable dense family.

concept.title: Weak subsequences of bounded Lᵖ sequences
concept.description: For1<p<∞ on a bounded Euclidean domain with Lebesgue measure, every norm-bounded sequence in Lᵖ has a weakly convergent subsequence with limit f∈Lᵖ and ‖f‖_p≤liminf‖f_n‖_p along that subsequence.

concept.title: Inverse-potential comparison for a forced porous-medium equation
concept.description: Let u₁,u₂ be bounded variational solutions of ∂_tu=Δ(|u|^{m−1}u)+cu+F on a bounded smooth domain, with m>1, zero Dirichlet conditions and the same smooth forcing F. For R=(−Δ_D)⁻¹, Ru₁(0)≤Ru₂(0) almost everywhere implies Ru₁(t)≤Ru₂(t) for every t≥0.

concept.title: Inverse-Dirichlet order preservation for additive stochastic porous media
concept.description: For the zero-Dirichlet equation dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+cX]dt+dW on a bounded smooth domain, m>1 and trace-class H⁻¹-valued additive Wiener noise, set R=(−Δ_D)⁻¹. Two solutions driven by the same noise satisfy RX_t^x≤RX_t^y almost everywhere for every t≥0 whenever Rx≤Ry. This holds on the continuous cocycle version simultaneously in time and initial states.

concept.title: Positive-distribution order preservation for additive stochastic porous media
concept.description: For the zero-Dirichlet additive stochastic porous-medium equation with m>1 and trace-class H⁻¹ noise, solutions driven by the same noise preserve the ordinary positive-distribution order: x≤y implies X_t^x≤X_t^y for every t≥0 on the continuous cocycle version.

concept.title: Marked temporal point process
concept.description: A sequence of positive random event times T₁<T₂<⋯, with no finite accumulation, together with random marks Jₙ in a specified measurable space; the associated counting measure is ∑ₙδ_(Tₙ,Jₙ). Adapted versions require each event time to be a stopping time and its mark to be known at that event.

concept.title: Compensator of a counting process
concept.description: For an adapted càdlàg counting process N with N₀=0, a predictable increasing process A with A₀=0 is a compensator when N−A is a local martingale; the ambient filtration is part of the data.

concept.title: Intensity of a counting process
concept.description: A nonnegative predictable process λ is an intensity for a counting process N when its compensator is A_t=∫₀ᵗλ_s ds, relative to the specified filtration.

concept.title: Time-inhomogeneous continuous-time Markov chain on a finite set
concept.description: A càdlàg finite-state jump process Z for which the conditional distribution of its future given the past through time s depends only on Z_s and the absolute time s; its transition matrices P_(s,t) satisfy P_(s,u)P_(u,t)=P_(s,t).

concept.title: Hazard rate of an absolutely continuous lifetime
concept.description: For a nonnegative lifetime with absolutely continuous distribution function F and survival S=1−F, its hazard rate is h(t)=F′(t)/S(t) wherever S(t)>0; when S(0)=1 this gives S(t)=exp(−∫₀ᵗh(s)ds) on intervals of positive survival.

concept.title: Lebesgue–Stieltjes integral for a càdlàg path of locally bounded variation
concept.description: A real càdlàg path B of locally bounded variation determines a locally finite signed Stieltjes measure dB by dB((s,t])=B_t−B_s; ∫f dB denotes integration against that signed measure whenever f is integrable with respect to its total variation.

concept.title: Cumulative payment process of an insurance policy
concept.description: A stochastic process B of locally bounded variation whose increment B_t−B_s is the net amount paid by a policy during (s,t]; positive payments and premiums may be represented with opposite signs under a declared convention.

concept.title: Expected cashflow rate of an insurance policy
concept.description: If the expected cumulative policy payments A(t)=E[B_t] are locally absolutely continuous, their cashflow rate is a Radon–Nikodym derivative a(t)=dA/dt, defined almost everywhere with respect to time.

concept.title: Expected discounted liability of an insurance policy
concept.description: For cumulative payments B and a specified positive discount factor v(t), the time-zero liability is E[∫₀^∞v(t)dB_t] when this expectation exists; a constant deterministic short rate r gives v(t)=e^(−rt).

concept.title: Absolute convergence of a real series
concept.description: A real series ∑aₙ converges absolutely if ∑|aₙ| is finite; it converges conditionally if ∑aₙ converges and ∑|aₙ| diverges.

concept.title: Irrationality exponent of an irrational real number
concept.description: For an irrational real θ, μ(θ) is the supremum of real μ for which 0<|θ−p/q|<q^(−μ) has infinitely many solutions in integers p and positive integers q; the value may be infinite.

concept.title: Comparison test for nonnegative real series
concept.description: If 0≤aₙ≤bₙ, convergence of ∑bₙ implies convergence of ∑aₙ; divergence of ∑aₙ implies divergence of ∑bₙ.

concept.title: Sum and convergence of a real geometric series
concept.description: For a real r with |r|<1, the geometric series ∑ₙ≥0rⁿ converges absolutely and has sum 1/(1−r).

concept.title: Convergence criterion for a real p-series
concept.description: For p∈ℝ, the nonnegative series ∑ₙ≥1n^(−p) converges exactly when p>1.

concept.title: Improper Riemann integral
concept.description: An improper Riemann integral over an open endpoint or an unbounded interval is a limit of integrals over compact subintervals; with two improper endpoints both limits must exist separately.

concept.title: Gamma function on the positive real axis
concept.description: For s>0, Γ(s)=∫₀∞e^(−t)t^(s−1)dt, with the integral understood as an improper real integral.

concept.title: Real polylogarithm inside the unit interval
concept.description: For s∈ℝ and 0<z<1, Li_s(z)=∑ₙ≥1zⁿ/nˢ; this defines the real restriction of the polylogarithm by its convergent power series.

concept.title: Leading singularity of a real polylogarithm at one
concept.description: For each real s<1, Li_s(z)∼Γ(1−s)(log(1/z))^(s−1) as z→1 from below.

concept.title: Roth’s theorem on irrationality exponents
concept.description: Every irrational real number algebraic over ℚ has irrationality exponent two.

concept.title: Irrationality exponent of e
concept.description: The base e=exp(1) of the natural logarithm has irrationality exponent two.

concept.title: Salikhov’s upper bound for the irrationality exponent of π
concept.description: Put ψ(x)=Γ′(x)/Γ(x) for x>0 and χ=5−ψ(2/5)+ψ(1/3)+log5−(5/2)log2. Let t₃ be the positive real root and t₁ the upper-half-plane root of5t³−381t²−1525t−1875=0, and put h(t)=|t²+6t+25|³|t|^(3/2)/|25−t|⁵. Then the irrationality exponent ofπ satisfies μ(π)≤1−(χ+logh(t₃))/(χ+logh(t₁)), whose right-hand side is approximately7.606308520711.

concept.title: Almost-everywhere value of the irrationality exponent
concept.description: Lebesgue-almost every real θ is irrational and has irrationality exponent two.

concept.title: Rational-parameter classification of trigonometric power series
concept.description: Let θ=p/q be in lowest terms with q>0 and 0<α≤1. The cosine-power series ∑cosⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ converges conditionally if p,q are odd and otherwise diverges to +∞. The sine-power series converges absolutely if q is odd, conditionally if q≡2 mod 4, and diverges to +∞ if 4 divides q.

concept.title: Irrationality-exponent criterion for trigonometric power series
concept.description: If θ is irrational with finite irrationality exponent μ and α>1−1/(2μ−2), then both ∑sinⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ and ∑cosⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ converge absolutely.

concept.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of trigonometric power series
concept.description: For α>1/2, both ∑sinⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ and ∑cosⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ converge absolutely for Lebesgue-almost every real θ.

concept.title: Dense irrational parameters of trigonometric power-series divergence
concept.description: There is a dense set E of irrational real numbers such that for every θ∈E and every α≤1 both ∑sinⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ and ∑cosⁿ(πnθ)/nᵅ diverge.

concept.title: Post-critically finite self-similar structure
concept.description: A compact connected metrizable space K with finitely many continuous injections ψ_i:K→K and a continuous coding surjection π:S^N→K satisfying π(iω)=ψ_i(π(ω)), for which the postcritical set P=⋃_(m≥1)σ^m(π⁻¹(⋃_(i≠j)(ψ_iK∩ψ_jK))) is finite. Its boundary is V₀=π(P).

concept.title: Regular harmonic structure on a post-critically finite self-similar set
concept.description: For a p.c.f. self-similar structure, a symmetric nonpositive matrix D on boundary functions, with kernel the constants and nonnegative off-diagonal entries, together with weights 0<r_i<1, is a regular harmonic structure if its boundary energy E₀(u)=−uᵀDu equals the minimum of the first-level energy ∑_i r_i⁻¹E₀(v∘ψ_i) over extensions v of u to the first-level vertices.

concept.title: Resistance energy from a regular harmonic structure
concept.description: Given a regular harmonic structure on a p.c.f. self-similar set, define E_m(u)=∑_(|w|=m)r_w⁻¹E₀(u∘ψ_w|V₀), with r_w the product of the cell weights. The resistance-energy domain is the continuous functions with sup_m E_m(u)<∞, and their energy is lim_m E_m(u), with bilinear polarization.

concept.title: Harmonic function for a regular harmonic structure
concept.description: For the resistance energy induced by a regular harmonic structure on a p.c.f. self-similar set, a harmonic function is an energy-domain function minimizing energy among functions with its prescribed values on the finite boundary V₀.

concept.title: Strong locality of a symmetric Dirichlet form
concept.description: A symmetric Dirichlet form E is strongly local if E(u,v)=0 whenever u is constant on a neighborhood of the support of v and v has compact support, for domain functions for which this support condition applies.

concept.title: Energy measure of a strongly local regular Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a strongly local regular Dirichlet form E, the energy measure ν_f of a bounded domain function f is the positive measure characterized on bounded compactly supported domain test functions g by ∫g dν_f=2E(f,fg)−E(f²,g). This uses Hino’s normalization; polarization gives mutual energy measures.

concept.title: Strongly irreducible family of invertible real matrices
concept.description: A family of invertible endomorphisms of a finite-dimensional real vector space is strongly irreducible if no finite union of proper nonzero linear subspaces is invariant under every member of the family.

concept.title: Hermitian complex matrix
concept.description: A square complex matrix A is Hermitian if its conjugate transpose A* equals A.

concept.title: Positive semidefinite complex matrix
concept.description: A Hermitian n×n complex matrix A is positive semidefinite if z*Az≥0 for every z∈ℂⁿ.

concept.title: Positive definite complex matrix
concept.description: A Hermitian n×n complex matrix A is positive definite if z*Az>0 for every nonzero z∈ℂⁿ.

concept.title: Löwner order on Hermitian matrices
concept.description: For Hermitian matrices A,B of the same size, A≤B means that B−A is positive semidefinite.

concept.title: Invertible square matrix
concept.description: A square matrix A over a field is invertible if there is a square matrix B with AB=BA=I; this B is denoted A⁻¹.

concept.title: Weighted power mean of two positive numbers
concept.description: For a,b>0 and v∈[0,1], M_t(v;a,b)=(vaᵗ+(1−v)bᵗ)¹⁄ᵗ for t≠0, with M_0(v;a,b)=aᵛb¹⁻ᵛ. The cases t=1 and −1 are the weighted arithmetic and harmonic means.

concept.title: Weighted arithmetic mean of positive definite matrices
concept.description: For positive definite matrices A,B of the same size and v∈[0,1], A∇ᵥB=vA+(1−v)B.

concept.title: Weighted harmonic mean of positive definite matrices
concept.description: For positive definite matrices A,B of the same size and v∈[0,1], A!ᵥB=(vA⁻¹+(1−v)B⁻¹)⁻¹.

concept.title: Spectral theorem for a Hermitian complex matrix
concept.description: Every Hermitian complex matrix A has a decomposition A=U diag(λ₁,…,λₙ)U* with U unitary and all λⱼ real.

concept.title: Real power of a positive definite complex matrix
concept.description: For A=U diag(λ₁,…,λₙ)U* positive definite and t∈ℝ, define Aᵗ=U diag(λ₁ᵗ,…,λₙᵗ)U*, independently of the unitary diagonalization.

concept.title: Sharp comparison of weighted scalar arithmetic–harmonic gaps
concept.description: For distinct a,b>0, λ≥1 and 0<v<τ<1, with Aᵥ=va+(1−v)b and Hᵥ=(v/a+(1−v)/b)⁻¹, (v/τ)^λ<(Aᵥ^λ−Hᵥ^λ)/(Aτ^λ−Hτ^λ)<((1−v)/(1−τ))^λ; both constants are sharp.

concept.title: Comparison of weighted matrix arithmetic–harmonic gaps
concept.description: If A,B are positive definite matrices and 0<v≤τ<1, then (v/τ)(A∇τB−A!τB)≤A∇ᵥB−A!ᵥB≤((1−v)/(1−τ))(A∇τB−A!τB) in Löwner order.

concept.title: Space of continuous real functions on a compact Hausdorff space
concept.description: For a compact Hausdorff space K, C(K) is the real Banach space of continuous functions K→ℝ with norm ||f||∞=max_K|f|.

concept.title: Bounded linear extension operator for continuous functions
concept.description: For a closed subspace L of a compact Hausdorff space K, a bounded linear operator T:C(L)→C(K) is an extension operator if (Tf)|L=f for every f∈C(L).

concept.title: Compact space of subsets with bounded finite cardinality
concept.description: For a set X and n∈ℕ, σ_n(2^X) is the subspace of {0,1}^X consisting of characteristic functions of subsets of X of cardinality at most n, with the product topology.

concept.title: Infimal norm of extension operators
concept.description: For L closed in compact Hausdorff K, η(L,K) is the infimum of ||T|| over bounded linear extension operators C(L)→C(K), with value ∞ if none exists.

concept.title: Initial topology for a family of maps
concept.description: For maps f_i:X→Y_i into topological spaces, the initial topology on X is generated by the sets f_i⁻¹(U), where U is open in Y_i; it is the coarsest topology making every f_i continuous.

concept.title: Weak topology on a normed vector space
concept.description: The weak topology on a normed space X is the coarsest topology making every bounded linear functional X→ℝ or ℂ continuous.

concept.title: Weak-star topology on a continuous dual
concept.description: The weak-star topology σ(X*,X) on the continuous dual of a normed space X is the topology of pointwise convergence on X.

concept.title: Scattered topological space
concept.description: A topological space is scattered if every nonempty subspace has an isolated point.

concept.title: Well-ordered set
concept.description: A totally ordered set is well ordered if every nonempty subset has a least element.

concept.title: Ordinal number
concept.description: An ordinal is a transitive set whose membership relation is a well ordering; ordinals represent order types of well-ordered sets.

concept.title: Aleph sequence of infinite cardinals
concept.description: The alephs enumerate infinite well-ordered cardinalities: ℵ₀ is countable infinity, ℵ_{α+1} is the least larger infinite cardinal, and at a limit ordinal λ, ℵ_λ=sup_{α<λ}ℵ_α.

concept.title: Fréchet–Urysohn space
concept.description: A topological space is Fréchet–Urysohn if, whenever x lies in the closure of A, there is a sequence in A converging to x.

concept.title: Free-set theorem for finite-valued set mappings
concept.description: For n∈ℕ, |X|≥ℵ_n and S:[X]^n→[X]^{<ω}, there is A∈[X]^{n+1} such that a∉S(A minus {a}) for every a∈A.

concept.title: Extension norms between finite-subset compacta at ℵ₁
concept.description: For 1≤m<n and |X|=ℵ₁, η(σ_m(2^X),σ_n(2^X))=2n−2m+1.

concept.title: Nonexistence of extension operators between distinct weak Hilbert balls
concept.description: If H is a nonseparable real Hilbert space and 0<λ<μ, there is no bounded linear extension operator C(λB_H)→C(μB_H), where both balls carry the weak topology.

concept.title: Locally finite weighted undirected graph
concept.description: A vertex set V has symmetric weights μ_xy≥0, only finitely many nonzero at each x, and vertex weights m(x)>0; x and y are adjacent when μ_xy>0. Loops are allowed.

concept.title: Formal Laplacian on a locally finite weighted graph
concept.description: For a locally finite weighted graph, Δf(x)=m(x)⁻¹∑_y μ_xy(f(y)−f(x)); local finiteness makes this defined for every real-valued function f on the vertices.

concept.title: Carré du champ of a weighted graph Laplacian
concept.description: For a weighted graph Laplacian Δ, Γ(f,g)=½(Δ(fg)−fΔg−gΔf)= (2m(x))⁻¹∑_y μ_xy(f(y)−f(x))(g(y)−g(x)) at x; write Γ(f)=Γ(f,f).

concept.title: Iterated carré du champ of a weighted graph
concept.description: For a weighted graph, Γ₂(f,g)=½(ΔΓ(f,g)−Γ(f,Δg)−Γ(g,Δf)); write Γ₂(f)=Γ₂(f,f).

concept.title: Bakry–Émery CD(K,∞) condition on a weighted graph
concept.description: A weighted graph satisfies CD(K,∞) if Γ₂(f)(x)≥KΓ(f)(x) for every real function f and every vertex x.

concept.title: Pointwise convergence of functions
concept.description: A sequence f_n:X→Y into a metric space converges pointwise to f if f_n(x)→f(x) for every x∈X.

concept.title: Pseudometric space
concept.description: A pseudometric on a set X is a symmetric function d:X×X→[0,∞) with d(x,x)=0 and the triangle inequality; different points may have distance zero.

concept.title: Completeness by Γ-small cutoffs on a weighted graph
concept.description: A weighted graph is complete in the cutoff sense if it admits finitely supported functions 0≤η_k≤1 increasing pointwise to 1 with Γ(η_k)≤1/k everywhere.

concept.title: Intrinsic pseudometric on a weighted graph
concept.description: A pseudometric ρ on a weighted graph is intrinsic if ∑_y μ_xyρ(x,y)²≤m(x) for every vertex x.

concept.title: Dirichlet energy of a weighted graph
concept.description: On ℓ²(V,m), the graph energy is Q(f,g)=½∑_{x,y}μ_xy(f(y)−f(x))(g(y)−g(x)); the Dirichlet domain is the closure of finitely supported functions in the norm (||f||₂²+Q(f,f))¹⁄².

concept.title: Minimal heat semigroup on a weighted graph
concept.description: For the Dirichlet realization L of the weighted graph Laplacian on ℓ²(V,m), P_t=e^{tL} is the associated self-adjoint sub-Markov semigroup, extended to bounded nonnegative functions by monotone approximation.

concept.title: Stochastic completeness of a weighted graph
concept.description: A weighted graph is stochastically complete if its minimal heat semigroup preserves the constant function 1: P_t1=1 for every t>0.

concept.title: Gradient characterization of CD(K,∞) on complete weighted graphs
concept.description: For a locally finite weighted graph complete by Γ-small cutoffs and with inf_x m(x)>0, CD(K,∞) is equivalent to Γ(P_tf)≤e^(−2Kt)P_tΓ(f) for every finitely supported f and t≥0; equivalently this holds for every f in the energy domain.

concept.title: Stochastic completeness from graph cutoff completeness and CD(K,∞)
concept.description: A locally finite weighted graph complete by Γ-small cutoffs, with inf_x m(x)>0 and satisfying CD(K,∞) for some real K, is stochastically complete.

concept.title: Ring of p-adic integers
concept.description: For a prime p, ℤ_p is the subring {x∈ℚ_p:v_p(x)≥0}, with its p-adic topology.

concept.title: Inverse limit of groups
concept.description: For groups G_n and homomorphisms f_n:G_(n+1)→G_n, the inverse limit is the subgroup of ∏G_n consisting of tuples (x_n) satisfying f_n(x_(n+1))=x_n for every n; for topological groups it carries the subspace topology of the product.

concept.title: Pro-l group
concept.description: For a prime ℓ, a pro-ℓ group is a topological group isomorphic to an inverse limit of finite groups of ℓ-power order, the finite groups having the discrete topology.

concept.title: Galois group of an algebraic Galois extension
concept.description: For an algebraic Galois extension L/K, Gal(L/K) is the group of K-automorphisms of L with the Krull topology, whose basic identity neighborhoods fix finite intermediate extensions pointwise.

concept.title: Pro-l Galois extension
concept.description: An algebraic Galois extension L/K is pro-ℓ if its topological Galois group is a pro-ℓ group. It is abelian when that Galois group is abelian.

concept.title: Z_l-extension of a number field
concept.description: For a prime ℓ, a ℤ_ℓ-extension of a number field K is an algebraic Galois extension L/K whose topological Galois group is isomorphic to the additive group ℤ_ℓ.

concept.title: Cyclotomic Z_l-extension of a number field
concept.description: The cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K∞/K is the unique ℤ_ℓ-extension of K contained in the extension obtained by adjoining all roots of unity of ℓ-power order. If K contains μ_(2ℓ) and |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓ^m, its degree-ℓ^n layer is K_n=K(μ_(ℓ^(m+n))).

concept.title: Compositum of field extensions
concept.description: For subfields L_i of one overfield containing K, their compositum is the smallest subfield containing every L_i.

concept.title: Divisible abelian group
concept.description: An abelian group D is divisible if for every positive integer n the map x↦nx is surjective. For a prime ℓ, ℓ-divisibility means this only for n=ℓ.

concept.title: Prime-power torsion subgroup of an abelian group
concept.description: For an abelian group A and a prime ℓ, A[ℓ^m]={a:ℓ^m a=0}, and A[ℓ∞]=⋃_(m≥0)A[ℓ^m].

concept.title: Multiplicative group of a field
concept.description: For a field F, F× is the abelian group of its nonzero elements under multiplication.

concept.title: Universal l-primary Kummer radical of a field
concept.description: For a field K and a prime ℓ, its universal ℓ-primary radical is ℛ_K=(ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)⊗_ℤK×. Torsion in K× disappears in this tensor product, so a representative ℓ^(−k)⊗x is zero exactly when x is a root of unity times an ℓ^k-th power in K.

concept.title: Kummer radical of an abelian pro-l extension
concept.description: If F contains all ℓ-power roots of unity and L/F is abelian pro-ℓ, its Kummer radical consists of the classes ℓ^(−k)⊗x in (ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)⊗F× for which F(x^(1/ℓ^k)) lies in L.

concept.title: L-adified multiplicative group of a field
concept.description: For a field F, the ℓ-adified multiplicative group used here is ℝ_F=ℤ_ℓ⊗_ℤF×. This tensor product, called the group of principal idèles in ℓ-adic class field theory, is distinct from an unrestricted inverse-limit completion unless an equivalence has been checked.

concept.title: Invariant submodule of a group action
concept.description: If a group G acts by R-linear automorphisms on an R-module M, its invariant submodule is M^G={m∈M:g·m=m for every g∈G}.

concept.title: One-variable Iwasawa algebra over Z_l
concept.description: For a prime ℓ and a procyclic group Γ with a chosen topological generator γ, its one-variable Iwasawa algebra is Λ=ℤ_ℓ[[T]], with γ represented by 1+T. This fixes the coordinate convention used for the completed group algebra.

concept.title: L-adic cyclotomic character
concept.description: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character χ_ℓ of an absolute Galois group is the continuous character to ℤ_ℓ× characterized by σ(ζ)=ζ^(χ_ℓ(σ)) for every root of unity ζ of ℓ-power order.

concept.title: Initial Kummer radical of Z_l-extensions
concept.description: Suppose K contains μ_(2ℓ), |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓ^m, and Z is the compositum of all ℤ_ℓ-extensions of K. Its initial radical is {ℓ^(−m)⊗x∈ℛ_K:K∞(x^(1/ℓ^m))⊆Z}, regarded inside the universal radical of K∞.

concept.title: Second Milnor K-group of a field
concept.description: For a field F, K₂^M(F) is (F×⊗_ℤF×) modulo the subgroup generated by a⊗(1−a) for a≠0,1. The class {a,b} is its universal Steinberg symbol, bilinear in both multiplicative arguments.

concept.title: L-adic Tate module of roots of unity
concept.description: The Tate module T_ℓ(μ) is lim←μ_(ℓ^n), with transition maps ζ↦ζ^ℓ and the natural Galois action.

concept.title: Universal Tate kernel in a cyclotomic Kummer radical
concept.description: For K containing μ_(2ℓ), write Γ=Gal(K∞/K) with χ_ℓ(γ)=1+ℓ^m. Let barΓ* be generated by γ^(−1)/(1+ℓ^m), acting on ℛ_(K∞). The universal Tate kernel is the maximal divisible subgroup of ℛ_(K∞)^(barΓ*); its ℓ^m-torsion is the initial exponent-ℓ^m kernel studied here.

concept.title: Kummer descent in a cyclotomic Z_l-tower
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ), with |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓ^m, and put γ*=γ/(1+ℓ^m). The Kummer radical of K_n^ab K∞/K∞ is ℛ_(K∞)^(Γ_n*), where Γ_n* is generated by (γ*)^(ℓ^n). The radical for the compositum of all ℤ_ℓ-extensions of K_n is its maximal ℓ-divisible subgroup.

concept.title: Jaulent’s norm-limit description of the initial Z_l radical
concept.description: In the preceding cyclotomic setup, the initial Kummer radical is the projection to n=0 of lim←ℛ_(K_n)^(Γ*), with norm transition maps. Equivalently it is π₀ lim←(ℝ_(K_n)/(ℝ_(K_n)^(γ*−1)μ_(K_n))), where ℝ_F=ℤ_ℓ⊗F× and γ*=γ/(1+ℓ^m).

concept.title: Jaulent’s norm-limit description of the Tate kernel
concept.description: In the same cyclotomic setup, the ℓ^m-torsion of the universal Tate kernel is π₀ lim←ℛ_(K_n)^(barΓ*), equivalently π₀ lim←(ℝ_(K_n)/(ℝ_(K_n)^(barγ*−1)μ_(K_n))), with norm transitions and barγ*=γ^(−1)/(1+ℓ^m).

concept.title: Rank-one harmonic energy densities on a p.c.f. self-similar set
concept.description: Let a connected p.c.f. self-similar set carry a regular harmonic structure, with every boundary point p fixed by a cell map and K∖{p} connected. For finitely many harmonic functions h₁,…,h_m and ν=∑_i a_iν_(h_i) with a_i>0, the matrix (dν_(h_i,h_j)/dν)_(i,j) has rank at most one ν-almost everywhere; it has rank one wherever ν is nonzero.

concept.title: Boundary-vertex harmonic extension asymptotics
concept.description: For a regular harmonic structure on a connected p.c.f. self-similar set whose boundary pointsp_i are cell fixed points and whose complementsK∖{p_i} are connected, letA_i act on boundary values by harmonic extension into thei-th cell and letP remove constants. Letu_i be thep_i-column ofD and letv_i be the right r_i-eigenvector ofA_i normalized by(u_i,v_i)=1. Thenr_i^(−n)P A_i^n x→(u_i,x)Pv_i for every boundary vectorx.

concept.title: Heine–Borel theorem in finite-dimensional normed spaces
concept.description: A subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector space is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded.

concept.title: Semigroup
concept.description: A semigroup is a set equipped with an associative binary operation.

concept.title: Semigroup with a translation-invariant metric
concept.description: A metric semigroup is a semigroup G with a metric d such that d(ac,bc)=d(a,b)=d(ca,cb) for all a,b,c∈G. No identity, inverses or commutativity are required.

concept.title: Random element of a measurable space
concept.description: A random element of a measurable space E is a measurable map from a probability space into E; a metric space is equipped with its Borel σ-algebra unless otherwise specified.

concept.title: Independent family of random elements
concept.description: Random elements X_i are independent if, for every finite set of distinct indices and measurable sets A_i in their respective targets, P(∩{X_i∈A_i})=∏P(X_i∈A_i).

concept.title: Decreasing rearrangement of a nonnegative random variable
concept.description: For a nonnegative random variable Y, its decreasing rearrangement is Y*(t)=sup{y≥0:P(Y>y)>t} for 0≤t≤1, with the empty supremum taken as 0; it is equidistributed with Y on the Lebesgue probability interval, up to endpoint conventions.

concept.title: Maximum distance of partial products in a metric semigroup
concept.description: For G-valued random elements X₁,…,Xₙ and z₀,z₁∈G, let S_k=X₁⋯X_k and Uₙ=max_{1≤k≤n}d(z₁,z₀S_k); let Mₙ=max_{1≤k≤n}d(z₀,z₀X_k).

concept.title: Hoffmann–Jørgensen tail bound in metric semigroups
concept.description: For independent random elements in a separable invariant-metric semigroup, with Uₙ,Mₙ the partial-product and increment maxima, P(Uₙ>(3K−1)t)≤P(Mₙ>t)+(P(Uₙ>t)/P(Uₙ≤t))^K/K! for positive integers K≤n+1 and t>0 with P(Uₙ≤t)>0.

concept.title: Lévy convergence equivalence in complete metric semigroups
concept.description: For independent random elements X_n in a complete separable invariant-metric semigroup, their ordered partial products S_n converge almost surely to a given random element X if and only if d(S_n,X)→0 in probability. The event that S_n converges has probability zero or one.

concept.title: Moment integrability equivalence for bounded random partial products
concept.description: Let independent random elements X_n in a separable invariant-metric semigroup be indexed by a finite initial segment or ℕ. If U=sup_n d(z₁,z₀X₁⋯X_n)<∞ almost surely, then for every p>0, E U^p<∞ if and only if E(sup_n d(z₀,z₀X_n))^p<∞.
