concept.title: Universal moment comparison for abelian metric semigroups
concept.description: For every p₀>0 there is C(p₀) such that, in any separable abelian invariant-metric semigroup and for any finite independent sequence, ||Uₙ||_q≤C(p₀) q/max(p,log(e+q)) (||Uₙ||_p+||Mₙ||_q) for q≥p≥p₀, where Uₙ and Mₙ are the partial-product and increment maxima.

concept.title: Pure contraction on a Hilbert space
concept.description: A bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is a pure contraction if ||T||≤1 and T*ⁿh→0 in norm for every vector h. This is class C_{·0}.

concept.title: m-hypercontraction
concept.description: For an integer m≥1, a bounded Hilbert-space operator T is an m-hypercontraction if ∑_{k=0}^p(−1)^k binom(p,k)T^kT*^k≥0 for every integer 1≤p≤m.

concept.title: Vector-valued weighted Bergman space on the disk
concept.description: For α≥1 and a complex Hilbert space E, A²_α(E) is the E-valued reproducing-kernel Hilbert space on the unit disk with kernel (1−z w̄)^(−α)I_E; α=1 gives the vector-valued Hardy space.

concept.title: Multiplier between vector-valued weighted Bergman spaces
concept.description: A holomorphic map Θ:𝔻→B(E₁,E₂) is a multiplier A²_{m₁}(E₁)→A²_{m₂}(E₂) if pointwise multiplication f↦Θf is a bounded linear operator between these spaces.

concept.title: Doubly commuting tuple of Hilbert-space operators
concept.description: A finite tuple (T₁,…,Tₙ) of bounded operators on one Hilbert space is doubly commuting if T_iT_j=T_jT_i and T_iT_j*=T_j*T_i for distinct i,j.

concept.title: Hereditary polynomial functional calculus for an operator tuple
concept.description: For a commuting tuple T and p(z,w̄)=∑a_{αβ}z^αw̄^β, the hereditary evaluation is p(T,T*)=∑a_{αβ}T^αT*^β, with all unstarred factors to the left.

concept.title: Agler dilation of a pure m-hypercontraction
concept.description: For a pure m-hypercontraction T and D=(∑_{k=0}^m(−1)^k binom(m,k)T^kT*^k)¹⁄², the map (Vh)(z)=D(I−zT*)^(−m)h is an isometry into A²_m(cl ran D), intertwines T* with M_z*, and realizes T as a compression of M_z.

concept.title: Partially isometric multiplier representation of Bergman invariant subspaces
concept.description: A closed M_z-invariant subspace S of A²_m(E*) can be written S=ΘH²(E) for an auxiliary Hilbert space E and a multiplier Θ:H²(E)→A²_m(E*) whose multiplication operator is a partial isometry.

concept.title: Partially isometric multiplier model of a pure hypercontraction
concept.description: Every pure m-hypercontraction T is unitarily equivalent to P_QM_z|Q on Q=A²_m(D_T)⊖ΘH²(E), for some auxiliary E and partially isometric multiplier Θ, where D_T is the closure of the m-defect operator range.

concept.title: Banach contraction mapping theorem
concept.description: Every map T:X→X on a nonempty complete metric space satisfying d(Tx,Ty)≤q d(x,y) for a fixed 0≤q<1 has a unique fixed point, and Tⁿx converges to it for every x.

concept.title: Strongly continuous nonlinear contraction semigroup
concept.description: On a closed subset X₀ of a Banach space X, maps S(t):X₀→X₀ form a strongly continuous contraction semigroup if S(0)=I, S(t+s)=S(t)S(s), ||S(t)x−S(t)y||≤||x−y||, and every orbit t↦S(t)x is continuous.

concept.title: Dissipative relation on a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A relation A⊆H×H is dissipative if ⟨u−v,x−y⟩≤0 whenever u∈Ax and v∈Ay. Its domain consists of x with Ax nonempty.

concept.title: m-dissipative relation on a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A dissipative relation A on a real Hilbert space H is m-dissipative if ran(I−A)=H. Equivalently, I−A has an everywhere-defined single-valued nonexpansive inverse.

concept.title: Maximal monotone relation on a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A relation M⊆H×H on a real Hilbert space is monotone if ⟨u−v,x−y⟩≥0 for u∈Mx,v∈My, and maximal monotone if it has no proper monotone extension.

concept.title: Komura–Kato generation theorem in Hilbert space
concept.description: An m-dissipative relation A on a real Hilbert space generates a unique strongly continuous nonlinear contraction semigroup on the closure of D(A); for initial values in D(A), the orbit solves x′(t)∈Ax(t) and its right derivative is the minimal-norm section of A.

concept.title: Linear port-Hamiltonian differential operator on an interval
concept.description: On L²((0,1);ℝᵈ), a port-Hamiltonian operator has Ax=∑_{k=0}^N P_k(Hx)^(k), with H bounded, symmetric and uniformly positive, P_N invertible, P_kᵀ=(−1)^{k+1}P_k for k≥1 and P₀+P₀ᵀ≤0; its maximal domain requires Hx∈H^N.

concept.title: Impedance passive boundary control and observation system
concept.description: A boundary system (A,B,C) with state Hilbert space X and matching input/output space U is impedance passive if Re⟨Ax,x⟩_X≤Re⟨Bx,Cx⟩_U for every x∈D(A), where B and C are its boundary input and output maps.

concept.title: Globally exponentially stable zero equilibrium of a nonlinear semigroup
concept.description: For a nonlinear semigroup S(t) with S(t)0=0, zero is globally exponentially stable if ||S(t)x||≤M e^(−ωt)||x|| for all t≥0 and all states x, for some M≥1 and ω>0.

concept.title: Generation under maximal monotone static port-Hamiltonian feedback
concept.description: For an impedance passive real port-Hamiltonian system (A,B,C) and maximal monotone relation φ on its finite-dimensional boundary space, the restriction A_φ with Bx∈−φ(Cx) generates a strongly continuous nonlinear contraction semigroup on the energy Hilbert space.

concept.title: Exponential stability under dissipative first-order port-Hamiltonian feedback
concept.description: For a first-order impedance passive port-Hamiltonian system with Lipschitz H and maximal monotone feedback φ containing (0,0), if its closed-loop generator satisfies Re⟨Ax,x⟩_H≤−κ x(1)*H(1)x(1) for κ>0, the generated nonlinear contraction semigroup has a globally exponentially stable zero equilibrium.

concept.title: P-adic local field
concept.description: A p-adic local field is a finite extension K of ℚ_p, equipped with the uniquely extended p-adic topology and valuation.

concept.title: Uniformizer of a discretely valued field
concept.description: For a normalized discrete valuation v on K, a uniformizer is an element π∈K with v(π)=1; it generates the maximal ideal of the valuation ring.

concept.title: Residue degree of a finite extension of discretely valued fields
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of discretely valued fields, with the discrete valuation of L extending that of K, the residue degree f(L/K) is the degree [k_L:k_K] of the residue-field extension. Finite extensions of nonarchimedean local fields are the basic case.

concept.title: Totally ramified finite extension of local fields
concept.description: A finite extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields is totally ramified if its ramification index equals [L:K], equivalently if its residue-field extension is trivial.

concept.title: Discriminant ideal of a finite local-field extension
concept.description: For a finite separable extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields, its discriminant ideal in O_K is generated by det(Tr_(L/K)(b_i b_j)) for an O_K-basis (b_i) of O_L. A different integral basis changes this generator by a unit square.

concept.title: Eisenstein polynomial over a discretely valued field
concept.description: A monic polynomial f=xⁿ+a_(n−1)x^(n−1)+⋯+a₀ over a discretely valued field is Eisenstein if every a_i lies in the valuation ring, v(a_i)≥1 for i<n, and v(a₀)=1.

concept.title: Newton polygon of a polynomial over a discretely valued field
concept.description: For f=∑a_i x^i over a discretely valued field, its Newton polygon is the lower convex boundary of the points (i,v(a_i)) with a_i≠0, restricted between the least and greatest such abscissas.

concept.title: Ramification polynomial of an Eisenstein polynomial
concept.description: If f is a degree-n Eisenstein polynomial over K with root α, its ramification polynomial is ρ_f(x)=f(αx+α)/αⁿ over K(α).

concept.title: Ramification polygon of a totally ramified local-field extension
concept.description: For a totally ramified finite local-field extension L/K generated by a uniformizer α with minimal polynomial f, its ramification polygon is the Newton polygon of f(αx+α)/αⁿ using the normalized valuation v_L(α)=1. The geometric polygon is independent of the uniformizer.

concept.title: Ramification polygon with coefficient-point markings
concept.description: A marked ramification polygon records the lower Newton polygon of an Eisenstein ramification polynomial together with the specified coefficient points (i,v_L(ρ_i)) lying on it, including intermediate p-power abscissas. These markings distinguish the finer data used in coefficient bounds and residual-polynomial supports.

concept.title: Residual polynomial of a Newton-polygon segment
concept.description: Let ρ=∑ρ_i x^i over a discretely valued field with uniformizer α. For a lower segment from (k,v(ρ_k)) to (k+d,v(ρ_(k+d))) with reduced slope −h/e, its residual polynomial is ∑_(j=0)^(d/e) overline(ρ_(k+je) α^(jh−v(ρ_k))) x^j in the residue field.

concept.title: Residual-polynomial orbit invariant of a local extension
concept.description: For the segments of a ramification polygon with slopes −h_i/e_i and residual polynomials A_i, form the tuples (γ_(δ,i) A_i(δ^(h_i)x)) as δ ranges over nonzero residue-field elements, with γ_(δ,r)=δ^(−h_r deg A_r) and γ_(δ,i)=γ_(δ,i+1)δ^(−h_i deg A_i). Their orbit is the invariant denoted A.

concept.title: Ore’s discriminant-existence criterion for totally ramified local extensions
concept.description: Let K be p-adic with normalized valuation v and maximal ideal 𝔭, and let J=an+b with 0≤b<n. A totally ramified degree-n extension with discriminant 𝔭^(n+J−1) exists exactly when min{n v(b),n v(n)}≤J≤n v(n), using v(0)=∞.

concept.title: Unique extension of a complete discretely valued absolute value
concept.description: If K is complete for a nonarchimedean discrete absolute value, that absolute value extends uniquely to every algebraic extension of K.

concept.title: Krasner’s lemma
concept.description: Let K be complete for a nonarchimedean discrete absolute value, and let α,β be algebraic over K with α separable over K(β). If |β−α|<|α′−α| for every distinct K-conjugate α′ of α, then K(α)⊆K(β).

concept.title: Krasner distance between monic irreducible polynomials
concept.description: For monic irreducible degree-n polynomials f,g over a complete nonarchimedean field, define d(f,g)=|f(β)|=|g(α)|, where α is a root of f and β a root of g. This is the root-evaluation ultrametric used here, without taking an nth root.

concept.title: Sinclair’s mass formula with a marked ramification polygon
concept.description: Let K be p-adic with residue cardinality q and let R be an admissible marked ramification polygon of totally ramified degree-n extensions with discriminant exponent n+J−1. Let L_R(i) be the forced lower coefficient-valuation bounds of Definition 2.8 and B_R the set of nonzero residues modulo n of the marked ordinates. The number of such extensions inside a fixed algebraic closure is n(q−1)^|B_R| q^(n+J−1−∑_(i=1)^(n−1)L_R(i)−|B_R|).

concept.title: Sinclair’s mass formula with residual-polynomial orbit data
concept.description: Under the same hypotheses and notation as the marked-ramification-polygon formula, fix an admissible residual-polynomial orbit A. The number of extensions inside a fixed algebraic closure with these data is n|A| q^(n+J−1−∑_(i=1)^(n−1)L_R(i)−|B_R|).

concept.title: Hermitian matrix
concept.description: A complex square matrix H satisfying H_(ij)=overline(H_(ji)) for every i,j; equivalently it equals its conjugate transpose.

concept.title: Characteristic polynomial of a matrix
concept.description: For a square matrix A over a field, its characteristic polynomial is det(xI−A), a monic polynomial whose roots over an algebraic closure are its eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicity.

concept.title: Gaussian unitary ensemble
concept.description: The Gaussian unitary ensemble of order N is the probability distribution on complex Hermitian N×N matrices with density proportional to exp(−c Tr(H²)) with respect to Lebesgue measure on their independent real coordinates, where c>0 fixes the variance convention. Here c=2N, so the limiting spectral support is [−1,1].

concept.title: Meromorphic gamma function
concept.description: The meromorphic gamma function is the continuation of Γ(z)=∫₀^∞t^(z−1)e^(−t)dt from Re z>0 to the complex plane using Γ(z+1)=zΓ(z); it has simple poles at 0,−1,−2,… .

concept.title: Barnes G-function
concept.description: The Barnes G-function is the canonical entire function given by G(z+1)=(2π)^(z/2)exp(−(z+z²(1+γ))/2)∏_(n≥1)[(1+z/n)^n exp(z²/(2n)−z)], where γ=lim_(n→∞)(∑_(k=1)^n1/k−log n). It satisfies G(1)=1 and G(z+1)=Γ(z)G(z); the recurrence alone does not specify its canonical normalization.

concept.title: Mellin transform of a positive random variable
concept.description: For a positive random variable X, its Mellin transform is M_X(s)=E[X^(s−1)] on the complex strip where the expectation is absolutely integrable, with X^(s−1)=exp((s−1)log X).

concept.title: Bilateral Laplace transform of a real probability distribution
concept.description: For a real random variable Y, its bilateral Laplace transform is L_Y(s)=E[e^(sY)] on the complex strip where this expectation converges absolutely.

concept.title: Standard Gumbel distribution
concept.description: The standard Gumbel distribution has cumulative distribution function P(G≤x)=exp(−exp(−x)) for real x.

concept.title: Gibbs partition function on a measure space
concept.description: For a measured configuration space (X,μ), an energy V and inverse temperature β>0, the Gibbs partition function is Z(β)=∫_X e^(−βV(x))dμ(x), when finite and positive; the associated free energy is F(β)=−β⁻¹log Z(β).

concept.title: Selberg integral evaluation
concept.description: For n≥2, real a,b>0 and γ>−min(1/n,a/(n−1),b/(n−1)), the integral over [0,1]^n of ∏_i x_i^(a−1)(1−x_i)^(b−1)∏_(i<j)|x_i−x_j|^(2γ) equals ∏_(j=0)^(n−1) Γ(a+jγ)Γ(b+jγ)Γ(1+(j+1)γ)/[Γ(a+b+(n+j−1)γ)Γ(1+γ)].

concept.title: Legendre duplication formula for the gamma function
concept.description: For Re z>0, Γ(2z)=2^(2z−1)π^(−1/2)Γ(z)Γ(z+1/2), and the identity extends meromorphically wherever both sides are defined.

concept.title: Krasovsky’s separated-bulk GUE characteristic-polynomial moment asymptotic
concept.description: Let H_N have GUE density proportional to e^(−2NTr(H_N²)), and p_N(x)=det(xI−H_N). For fixed distinct x₁,…,x_k∈(−1,1) and fixed α_j with Re α_j>−1/2, E∏_j|p_N(x_j)|^(2α_j) equals (1+O(log N/N))∏_j[C(α_j)(1−x_j²)^(α_j²/2)(N/2)^(α_j²)e^((2x_j²−1−2log2)α_jN)]∏_(i<j)(2|x_i−x_j|)^(−2α_iα_j), where C(α)=2^(2α²)G(α+1)²/G(2α+1).

concept.title: Fyodorov–Simm conjecture for the GUE characteristic-polynomial maximum
concept.description: For GUE density proportional to e^(−2NTr(H²)), set M_N=max_(x∈[−1,1]){2log|det(xI−H)|−2Elog|det(xI−H)|}. The conjecture predicts 2log N−(3/2)loglog N−M_N converges in distribution to Y with bilateral Laplace transform E[e^(sY)]=C⁻¹(2π)^sΓ(s+1)Γ(s+3)G(s+7/2)²/[G(s+6)G(s+1)], where C makes the transform equal 1 at s=0.

concept.title: Frame in a Hilbert space
concept.description: A countable family (g_j) in a Hilbert space H is a frame if A||f||²≤∑_j|⟨f,g_j⟩|²≤B||f||² for all f∈H and some 0<A≤B<∞.

concept.title: Bessel sequence in a Hilbert space
concept.description: A countable family (g_j) in a Hilbert space is Bessel if ∑_j|⟨f,g_j⟩|²≤B||f||² for every f and some finite B.

concept.title: Time-frequency shift of a Euclidean function
concept.description: For x,ω∈ℝᵈ, the time-frequency shift of f is (M_ωT_xf)(t)=e^(2πiω·t)f(t−x). Translation is T_x and modulation is M_ω.

concept.title: Short-time Fourier transform
concept.description: For f,g∈L²(ℝᵈ), the short-time Fourier transform with window g is V_gf(x,ω)=⟨f,M_ωT_xg⟩.

concept.title: Lattice Gabor frame
concept.description: For g∈L²(ℝᵈ) and a,b>0, the family (M_{mb}T_{na}g)_{m,n∈ℤᵈ} is a lattice Gabor frame when it satisfies the Hilbert-space frame inequalities.

concept.title: Wiener amalgam space W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ)
concept.description: For 1≤p,q≤∞ and Q=[0,1)ᵈ, W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ)(ℝᵈ) consists of measurable f with (||f·1_{Q+k}||_p)_{k∈ℤᵈ}∈ℓᵠ, with this sequence norm.

concept.title: Feichtinger algebra S₀ on Euclidean space
concept.description: The Feichtinger algebra S₀(ℝᵈ) consists of f∈L²(ℝᵈ) for which V_gf∈L¹(ℝ²ᵈ) for a fixed nonzero Schwartz window g; choosing a different such window gives the same space.

concept.title: Mixed Gabor analysis–synthesis operator
concept.description: If g,γ generate Bessel Gabor systems for a,b>0 and ⟨γ,g⟩≠0, define S_{a,b;g,γ}f=(ab)ᵈ/⟨γ,g⟩ ∑_{m,n}⟨f,M_{mb}T_{na}g⟩M_{mb}T_{na}γ, with Hilbert-norm convergence.

concept.title: Walnut representation on Wiener amalgam spaces
concept.description: For g,γ∈W(L∞,ℓ¹) with ⟨γ,g⟩≠0, the mixed Gabor operator extends boundedly to every W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ), 1≤p,q≤∞, and equals ⟨γ,g⟩⁻¹∑_n aᵈG_n·T_{n/b}, where G_n(x)=∑_k conjugate(g(x−n/b−ak))γ(x−ak); the operator series converges absolutely after a uniform translation bound.

concept.title: Strong dense-sampling limit of Gabor operators on Wiener amalgams
concept.description: If g,γ∈W(L∞,ℓ¹) and ⟨γ,g⟩≠0, then ||S_{a,b;g,γ}f−f||_{W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ)}→0 as a,b→0 for every f∈W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ) with 1≤p,q<∞.

concept.title: Operator-norm dense-sampling limit of Gabor operators on Wiener amalgams
concept.description: If g,γ∈W(L∞,ℓ¹), ⟨γ,g⟩≠0, and conjugate(g)γ is locally Riemann integrable, then ||S_{a,b;g,γ}−I|| on W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ) tends to zero as a,b→0 for every 1≤p,q≤∞.

concept.title: Power-concave function with positive exponent
concept.description: For p>0, a nonnegative function u on a convex subset Ω of ℝⁿ is p-concave if uᵖ is concave on Ω, equivalently u((1−λ)x+λy)≥((1−λ)u(x)ᵖ+λu(y)ᵖ)¹⁄ᵖ for x,y∈Ω and 0≤λ≤1.

concept.title: Nonnegative power mean with the Borell–Brascamp–Lieb zero convention
concept.description: For p>0 and 0<λ<1, the BBL mean M_p(a,b;λ) is ((1−λ)aᵖ+λbᵖ)¹⁄ᵖ when a,b>0, and is defined to be 0 when ab=0. This zero convention concerns extension beyond positive supports.

concept.title: Volume-normalized centroid-aligned Hausdorff distance of convex bodies
concept.description: For convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, H₀(K,L) is the Hausdorff distance between their volume-one dilates after translating their centroids to the origin.

concept.title: Relative asymmetry of two sets after volume normalization
concept.description: For measurable K,L⊂ℝⁿ with positive finite volume, A(K,L)=inf_x |K△(x+λL)|/|K| with λ=(|K|/|L|)¹⁄ⁿ; △ denotes symmetric difference.

concept.title: p-Minkowski supremal convolution
concept.description: For positive p, 0<λ<1 and nonnegative functions u_i on compact convex supports Ω_i, their p-Minkowski convolution at z is the supremum of M_p(u₀(x),u₁(y);λ) over z=(1−λ)x+λy, x∈Ω₀,y∈Ω₁, using the stated BBL zero convention.

concept.title: Brunn–Minkowski inequality for convex-body volume
concept.description: For convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ and λ∈[0,1], |(1−λ)K+λL|¹⁄ⁿ≥(1−λ)|K|¹⁄ⁿ+λ|L|¹⁄ⁿ. For 0<λ<1 equality holds exactly when K,L are homothetic.

concept.title: Borell–Brascamp–Lieb inequality at positive power
concept.description: For p>0, λ∈(0,1), nonnegative integrable u₀,u₁ with positive integrals I₀,I₁ and compact supports Ω₀,Ω₁, if h((1−λ)x+λy)≥M_p(u₀(x),u₁(y);λ), then ∫_{(1−λ)Ω₀+λΩ₁}h≥M_{p/(np+1)}(I₀,I₁;λ), using the BBL zero convention.

concept.title: Variational torsional rigidity of a Euclidean domain
concept.description: For a bounded open domain Ω, torsional rigidity is T(Ω)=sup_{0≠v∈H₀¹(Ω)}(∫_Ω|v|)²/∫_Ω|∇v|². Equivalently T(Ω)=∫_Ωu for the weak solution of −Δu=1 with zero boundary values.

concept.title: Support-volume stability of the positive-power BBL inequality
concept.description: Fix p>0 and λ∈(0,1). For bounded nonnegative p-concave u_i on compact convex supports Ω_i with I_i=∫u_i>0, if h dominates their p-Minkowski convolution and ∫h≤M_{p/(np+1)}(I₀,I₁;λ)+ε, then for sufficiently small ε, |(1−λ)Ω₀+λΩ₁|≤M_{1/n}(|Ω₀|,|Ω₁|;λ)[1+2(n+M_{p/(np+1)}(I₀,I₁;λ)⁻¹)ε^{p/(p+1)}].

concept.title: Quantitative positive-power BBL inequality from support asymmetry
concept.description: For fixed p>0 and λ∈(0,1), bounded nonnegative p-concave u_i on compact convex supports Ω_i, I_i=∫u_i>0, and h dominating their p-Minkowski convolution, sufficiently small A(Ω₀,Ω₁) gives ∫h≥M_{p/(np+1)}(I₀,I₁;λ)+δ A(Ω₀,Ω₁)^{2(p+1)/p}, with δ>0 depending only on n,λ,p,I_i and |Ω_i|.

concept.title: Gâteaux derivative of a real functional
concept.description: A functional f on a real normed space has Gâteaux derivative Df(x)∈E* if (f(x+th)−f(x))/t→Df(x)[h] for every direction h as t→0.

concept.title: Fenchel conjugate of a real convex functional
concept.description: For f:E→(−∞,∞], its Fenchel conjugate is f*(x*)=sup_{x∈E}(⟨x*,x⟩−f(x)) on the continuous dual E*.

concept.title: Bregman distance of a differentiable convex functional
concept.description: For a proper convex functional f differentiable on int(dom f), D_f(x,y)=f(x)−f(y)−⟨Df(y),x−y⟩ for x∈dom f and y∈int(dom f). It need not be symmetric or satisfy the triangle inequality.

concept.title: Bregman projection onto a convex set
concept.description: Given a differentiable convex f and a nonempty closed convex C⊂dom f, the Bregman projection of x is the unique minimizer of y↦D_f(y,x) over C whenever that minimizer exists and is unique. Existence and uniqueness require additional hypotheses.

concept.title: Total convexity of a functional on bounded sets
concept.description: A differentiable convex f is totally convex on bounded sets if, for every bounded B⊂int(dom f) and t>0, inf{D_f(y,x):x∈B,y∈dom f,||y−x||=t}>0 whenever the constraint set is nonempty.

concept.title: Asymptotic fixed point of a Banach-space map
concept.description: For T:C→C in a Banach space, p∈C is an asymptotic fixed point if some bounded sequence x_n∈C converges weakly to p while ||x_n−Tx_n||→0.

concept.title: Bregman strongly nonexpansive map
concept.description: Relative to a differentiable convex f, T:C→C is Bregman strongly nonexpansive with respect to its nonempty asymptotic fixed set F̂ if D_f(p,Tx)≤D_f(p,x) for p∈F̂ and, for bounded x_n, D_f(p,x_n)−D_f(p,Tx_n)→0 implies D_f(x_n,Tx_n)→0.

concept.title: Bregman firmly nonexpansive map
concept.description: For a differentiable convex f, a map T:C→C is Bregman firmly nonexpansive if ⟨Df(Tx)−Df(Ty),Tx−Ty⟩≤⟨Df(x)−Df(y),Tx−Ty⟩ for every x,y∈C.

concept.title: Mixed equilibrium problem
concept.description: For a convex set C, a bifunction Θ:C×C→ℝ and φ:C→ℝ, the mixed equilibrium problem asks for x∈C such that Θ(x,y)+φ(y)≥φ(x) for every y∈C.

concept.title: Bregman resolvent of a mixed equilibrium problem
concept.description: For a differentiable convex f, the mixed equilibrium resolvent sends x to the set of z∈C satisfying Θ(z,y)+φ(y)−φ(z)+⟨Df(z)−Df(x),y−z⟩≥0 for every y∈C. Domain, uniqueness and existence depend on the hypotheses.

concept.title: Poisson summation for Euclidean Schwartz functions
concept.description: For f∈𝒮(ℝᵈ), γ>0 and f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^(−2πix·ξ)dx, γᵈ∑_{n∈ℤᵈ}f(x+γn)=∑_{k∈ℤᵈ}f̂(k/γ)e^(2πik·x/γ), with absolute convergence.

concept.title: Plancherel theorem for the Euclidean Fourier transform
concept.description: With f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^(−ix·ξ)dx on Schwartz functions in ℝᵈ, f↦(2π)^(−d/2)f̂ extends uniquely to a unitary operator on L²(ℝᵈ). Equivalently the e^(−2πix·ξ) Fourier normalization is unitary without a prefactor.

concept.title: Recursive α-DOST partition of integer frequencies
concept.description: For α∈[0,1], set i₀=0,s₀=1 and for p≥1 let i_p=s_{p−1}, β_p=⌊i_p^α⌋, s_p=i_p+β_p. The positive frequency blocks are I_p={i_p,…,s_p−1}, with I₀={0}; negative blocks are their reflections.

concept.title: α-DOST orthonormal basis on the unit interval
concept.description: For the α-DOST frequency blocks I_p of size β_p, the functions B_{p,τ}(t)=β_p^(−1/2)∑_{η∈I_p}e^(2πiη(t−τ/β_p)), 0≤τ<β_p, form an orthonormal basis of L²([0,1]); α=0 is the Fourier basis and α=1 is the DOST basis.

concept.title: α-DOST nonstationary windowed system
concept.description: For α-DOST blocks I_p, β_p=|I_p|, μ,ν>0 and a window φ, define φ_{p,k}(t)=β_p^(−1/2)∑_{η∈μI_p}e^(2πiη(t−kν/β_p))φ(t−kν/β_p), p,k∈ℤ. Translation spacing depends on the frequency block; α=0 recovers a Gabor system.

concept.title: Painless α-DOST frame theorem
concept.description: Fix α∈[0,1] and μ>0 and use φ̂(ξ)=∫φ(t)e^(−2πitξ)dt. Let φ be Schwartz with 0≤φ̂≤1 and support φ̂⊂[−L,L]. Put Φ_p(ω)=∑_{η∈μI_p}φ̂(ω−η). If 0<A≤∑_p|Φ_p(ω)|²≤B<∞ uniformly, then for 0<ν<(2L+μ)⁻¹ the α-DOST system is a frame for L²(ℝ).

concept.title: Integer partition
concept.description: An integer partition is a finite nonincreasing sequence of positive integers, including the empty sequence. Its size is the sum of its parts.

concept.title: Young diagram of an integer partition
concept.description: For a partition λ, its Young diagram is the set of cells (i,j) with 1≤j≤λ_i, drawn in rows of lengths λ_i.

concept.title: Frobenius coordinates of an integer partition
concept.description: For a partition with r diagonal cells, its Frobenius coordinates are (r;a₁,…,a_r;b₁,…,b_r), where a_i and b_i are the arm and leg lengths at diagonal cell i.

concept.title: Bernoulli numbers
concept.description: The Bernoulli numbers B_n∈ℚ are determined by t/(exp(t)−1)=∑_(n≥0) B_n tⁿ/n!, as an identity of formal power series; thus B₁=−1/2.

concept.title: Q-bracket of a function on integer partitions
concept.description: For f from integer partitions to ℚ, its q-bracket is ⟨f⟩_q=(∑_λ f(λ)q^|λ|)/(∑_λ q^|λ|), a rational formal power series; the denominator has constant term one.

concept.title: Bloch–Okounkov shifted power sums
concept.description: For Frobenius coordinates (r;a_i;b_i), put C_λ={a_i+1/2,−b_i−1/2:1≤i≤r}, P_j(λ)=∑_(c∈C_λ)sgn(c)cʲ, and Q₀=1, Q_k=P_(k−1)/(k−1)!+β_k for k>0, where ∑β_k t^k=(t/2)/sinh(t/2). These are the shifted-symmetric generators in Zagier’s normalization.

concept.title: Shifted symmetric polynomial on integer partitions
concept.description: A shifted symmetric polynomial on partitions is a polynomial in the Bloch–Okounkov functions Q₂,Q₃,…, with rational coefficients; its weight is determined by assigning Q_k weight k.

concept.title: Bloch–Okounkov quasimodularity theorem
concept.description: For every homogeneous shifted symmetric polynomial f on partitions of weight k, the q-bracket ⟨f⟩_q is a weight-k quasimodular form for SL₂(ℤ).

concept.title: Serre p-adic modular form
concept.description: For a prime p, a series f=∑a_n qⁿ in ℚ_p[[q]] is a Serre p-adic modular form if it is a uniform p-adic limit of rational-coefficient classical level-one modular forms: the infimum over n of v_p(a_n−a_(i,n)) tends to +∞.

concept.title: Mod-p filtration of a level-one modular q-series
concept.description: For p≥5 and f∈𝔽_p[[q]] admitting a modular lift, its filtration w(f) is the least nonnegative integer k such that f is the reduction of a weight-k, level-one modular form with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients.

concept.title: P-depleted Bloch–Okounkov functions
concept.description: For a prime p and the signed half-integer coordinate set C_λ, define P_j^(p)(λ)=∑_(c∈C_λ,p∤2c)sgn(c)cʲ, Q₀^(p)=1−1/p and Q_k^(p)=P_(k−1)^(p)/(k−1)!+(1−p^(k−1))β_k for k>0. This is the paper’s regularization of the shifted power sums.

concept.title: Normalized one-point Bloch–Okounkov q-bracket
concept.description: For k≥1, the normalized one-point q-bracket is 𝒬_k(τ)=2^(k−2)(k−1)!⟨Q_k⟩_q. Its p-depleted version is 𝒬_k^(p)=2^(k−2)(k−1)!⟨Q_k^(p)⟩_q. All nonconstant Fourier coefficients of the undepleted series are integral, and both series vanish for odd k.

concept.title: Euler’s totient congruence theorem
concept.description: If a,n are integers with n≥1 and gcd(a,n)=1, then a^φ(n)≡1 modulo n.

concept.title: Kummer congruences for p-regularized Bernoulli numbers
concept.description: Let p≥5 be prime and r≥1. For positive even k₁,k₂ not divisible by p−1 and congruent modulo φ(pʳ), the p-integral rationals (1−p^(k_i−1))B_(k_i)/k_i are congruent modulo pʳ.

concept.title: Quasimodular forms as Serre p-adic modular forms
concept.description: For p≥5, every level-one quasimodular form with rational Fourier coefficients is a Serre p-adic modular form, since E₂,E₄,E₆ belong to the completion and generate the rational quasimodular ring.

concept.title: Meromorphic Jacobi form of integral weight and index
concept.description: For integral k,m and a specified modular subgroup, a meromorphic Jacobi form obeys the weight-k index-m modular transformation and φ(z+rτ+s;τ)=exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz))φ(z;τ). It may have poles in z, is holomorphic in τ away from its polar divisor, and has at most meromorphic cusp growth. Negative indices are allowed; Fourier expansions are taken in chambers avoiding poles.

concept.title: Elliptic raising operator for Jacobi transformations
concept.description: For a function φ(z;τ) with Jacobi index m, the elliptic raising operator is Y_mφ=(2πi)^(−1)∂φ/∂z+2m(Im z/Im τ)φ. It preserves the index and raises the modular weight by one when applied to a Jacobi-transforming function.

concept.title: Bloch–Okounkov one-point theta formula
concept.description: With F(z;τ)=½∑_(k≥0)⟨Q_k⟩_q(4πiz)^(k−1), one has F(z;τ)=η(τ)³/(2θ₁(2z;τ)), where θ₁(z;τ)=∑_(n∈ℤ)(−1)ⁿq^((n+1/2)²/2)exp(2πiz(n+1/2)). Equivalently θ₁=−i θ[1/2,1/2] in the catalogue’s characteristic convention.

concept.title: Partial-fraction identity for the partition-crank generating function
concept.description: For |q|<1 and w away from the poles, ∏_(n≥1)(1−qⁿ)/((1−wqⁿ)(1−w^(−1)qⁿ))=(1−w)/(q;q)_∞ ∑_(n∈ℤ)(−1)ⁿq^(n(n+1)/2)/(1−wqⁿ).

concept.title: P-adic congruences for depleted Bloch–Okounkov q-brackets
concept.description: Let p≥5 and let positive even k₁,k₂ not divisible by p−1 satisfy k₁≡k₂ mod φ(pʳ). Then 𝒬_(k₁)^(p)≡𝒬_(k₂)^(p) mod pʳ. For positive even k not divisible by p−1, lim_(r→∞)𝒬_(k+φ(pʳ))=𝒬_k^(p), uniformly p-adically, so the depleted q-bracket is a Serre p-adic modular form of weight k.

concept.title: Mod-p filtration of a Bloch–Okounkov q-bracket
concept.description: For a prime p≥5 and a positive even integer k<p−1, the mod-p filtrations of 𝒬_k and 𝒬_k^(p) are both k(p+1)/2.

concept.title: Legendre symbol
concept.description: For an odd prime p and an integer a, the Legendre symbol (a/p) is zero if p divides a, one if a is a nonzero square modulo p, and minus one otherwise.

concept.title: Quasimodularity and correction formula for depleted Bloch–Okounkov q-brackets
concept.description: For p≥5 and positive even k, 𝒬_k^(p) is a weight-k quasimodular form on Γ₀(p²). Moreover 𝒬_k^(p)(τ)=𝒬_k(τ)−p^(k−1)𝒬_k(p²τ)−p^(k−1)f_k^(p)(τ), where f_k^(p)=−∑_(n≥1,p∤n)∑_(M≥0)(−1)ⁿ(2M+1)^(k−1)q^((n²+np(2M+1))/2). The correction is supported on N with Legendre symbols (N/p)=(2/p).

concept.title: Quadratic form over a field of characteristic different from two
concept.description: On a finite-dimensional vector space over a field F with char(F)≠2, a quadratic form is a map Q with Q(ax)=a²Q(x) whose polarization B(x,y)=(Q(x+y)−Q(x)−Q(y))/2 is bilinear. Thus Q(x)=B(x,x).

concept.title: Nondegenerate quadratic space
concept.description: A quadratic space (V,Q) over a field of characteristic different from two is nondegenerate if its polarized bilinear form has zero radical: B(x,y)=0 for every y forces x=0.

concept.title: Positive definite rational quadratic form
concept.description: A quadratic form on a finite-dimensional rational vector space is positive definite if its scalar extension to ℝ has Q(x)>0 for every nonzero vector x.

concept.title: Quadratic Z-lattice
concept.description: A quadratic ℤ-lattice N is a finitely generated free abelian subgroup spanning a finite-dimensional rational quadratic space, equipped with the restricted form Q. It is integral when Q(N)⊆ℤ; the bilinear form B=(Q(x+y)−Q(x)−Q(y))/2 need not then be integer-valued.

concept.title: Localization of a quadratic Z-lattice
concept.description: For a quadratic ℤ-lattice N and a prime p, its localization N_p=ℤ_p⊗_ℤN is a quadratic ℤ_p-lattice with the scalar-extended form inside ℚ_p⊗_ℤN.

concept.title: Coset of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a quadratic ℤ-lattice N and ν in its rational span, the coset ν+N carries the values Q(ν+x)=Q(ν)+2B(ν,x)+Q(x). Its conductor is the least positive integer m such that mν∈N.

concept.title: Almost universal integer-valued polynomial
concept.description: An integer-valued polynomial on ℤⁿ is almost universal if it represents every sufficiently large positive integer at an integral argument.

concept.title: Norm ideal of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: The norm ideal n(N) of a quadratic lattice over ℤ or ℤ_p is the fractional ideal generated by all values Q(x) with x∈N; it is integral when the quadratic form is integer-valued.

concept.title: Scale ideal of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: The scale ideal s(N) of a quadratic lattice over ℤ or ℤ_p is the fractional ideal generated by B(x,y) for x,y∈N, where B is the half-polarization of Q.

concept.title: Discriminant square class of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a basis e₁,…,e_n of a quadratic lattice, its discriminant is det(B(e_i,e_j)), regarded up to multiplication by the square of a unit of the coefficient ring. Its rational square class is independent of the chosen basis.

concept.title: Isometry of quadratic spaces and lattices
concept.description: An isometry of quadratic spaces is a bijective linear map preserving Q. An isometry of quadratic lattices also carries the underlying lattice onto the target lattice.

concept.title: Isotropic and anisotropic quadratic spaces
concept.description: A quadratic space is isotropic if it has a nonzero vector x with Q(x)=0; otherwise it is anisotropic.

concept.title: Orthogonal direct sum of quadratic spaces
concept.description: For quadratic spaces (V_i,Q_i), their orthogonal direct sum has underlying direct sum and Q((v_i))=∑Q_i(v_i); distinct summands are orthogonal for the polarized form. The same notation applies to lattice decompositions.

concept.title: Orthogonal group of a quadratic space
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space V, O(V) is the group of linear automorphisms preserving Q and O⁺(V)=SO(V) is its determinant-one subgroup. For a lattice N, O(N) and O⁺(N) are the subgroups preserving N.

concept.title: Reflection in an anisotropic vector of a quadratic space
concept.description: If Q(v)≠0, the reflection in v is τ_v(x)=x−2B(x,v)v/Q(v), an isometry of determinant −1 fixing v-perpendicular pointwise.

concept.title: Square-class group of a field
concept.description: For a field F, its square-class group is F×/(F×)², where (F×)² is the subgroup of nonzero squares.

concept.title: Spinor norm of an orthogonal transformation
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space over F of characteristic different from two, the spinor norm θ:O(V)→F×/(F×)² sends a product of reflections τ_(v₁)⋯τ_(v_r) to the square class of ∏Q(v_i). This is independent of the reflection factorization.

concept.title: Genus of a quadratic Z-lattice
concept.description: The genus of a quadratic ℤ-lattice N consists of the isometry classes of lattices whose rational quadratic space is isometric to that of N and which are isometric to N over ℤ_p for every prime p and over ℝ.

concept.title: Proper spinor genus of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: In a rational quadratic space, the proper spinor genus of a lattice is its orbit under rational determinant-one isometries and adelic determinant-one isometries with trivial local spinor norms. It refines the genus and is the spinor-genus convention used in the source’s representation arguments.

concept.title: Primitive representation by a quadratic lattice
concept.description: A scalar t is represented primitively by a quadratic lattice N if Q(x)=t for a primitive vector x∈N. Over ℤ, primitive means x∉mN for every integer m>1; over ℤ_p it means x∉pN.

concept.title: Primitive spinor exception of a positive definite ternary genus
concept.description: A positive integer t is a primitive spinor exception of a positive definite ternary lattice genus if it is represented primitively by the genus but not primitively by every proper spinor genus in it.

concept.title: Hilbert symbol of a local field
concept.description: For a local field F of characteristic different from two and a,b∈F×, the Hilbert symbol (a,b)_F is +1 if ax²+by²=z² has a nonzero solution in F³ and −1 otherwise; it depends only on the square classes of a and b.

concept.title: Norm subgroup of a finite field extension
concept.description: For a finite field extension L/K, its norm subgroup is N_(L/K)(L×)⊆K×, the image of the multiplicative group under the field norm.

concept.title: Square criterion in a p-adic field Q_p
concept.description: A nonzero p-adic rational a=p^v u with u∈ℤ_p× is a square in ℚ_p exactly when v is even and, for odd p, the residue of u is a square modulo p; for p=2 the condition on u is u≡1 mod 8.

concept.title: Furstenberg positivity for finite i.i.d. unimodular two-dimensional matrix products
concept.description: Let A₁,A₂,… be i.i.d. matrices with a finitely supported law μ on real 2×2 matrices of determinant ±1. If the closed group generated by supp μ is noncompact and strongly irreducible, then lim_(n→∞)n⁻¹log‖A_n⋯A₁‖ exists almost surely and is a strictly positive constant.

concept.title: Kingman’s subadditive ergodic theorem for nonnegative integrable cocycles
concept.description: Let T preserve an ergodic probability measure and let nonnegative integrable functions f_n satisfy f_(n+m)≤f_n+f_m∘T^n. Then f_n/n converges almost surely and in L¹ to the constant inf_(n≥1)E[f_n]/n.

concept.title: Oseledets theorem for finite i.i.d. unimodular two-dimensional products
concept.description: For i.i.d. matrices from a finite subset of GL₂(ℝ) with determinant ±1, there is γ≥0 such that almost surely every nonzero vector has logarithmic growth exponent γ or −γ under A_n⋯A₁; if γ>0 the vectors with exponent −γ form a one-dimensional subspace, and all vectors outside it have exponent γ.

concept.title: Birkhoff pointwise ergodic theorem
concept.description: For a probability-preserving measurable transformation T and f∈L¹, the averages n⁻¹∑_(j=0)^(n−1)f∘T^j converge almost surely and in L¹ to E[f|I], where I is the invariant σ-algebra; if T is ergodic this limit is the constant E[f].

concept.title: Real projective line
concept.description: The real projective line is the space of one-dimensional linear subspaces of ℝ², with the quotient topology from ℝ²∖{0} under nonzero scalar multiplication.

concept.title: Stationary measure for a random projective action
concept.description: For a probability law μ on invertible real matrices acting on the real projective line, a probability measure ν is μ-stationary if ν=∫A_*ν dμ(A), with A_*ν the pushforward under the projective action.

concept.title: Boundary averaging coefficients of harmonic energy measures
concept.description: For a regular harmonic structure with boundary size at least three, D²=−γD (γ>0), boundary fixed points with connected punctured complements, and invertible harmonic extension operators, choose harmonic functions h_k spanning modulo constants. For a cell word w put a_j(w)=∑_k⟨u_j,A_wh_k⟩², with u_j the j-th column of D, and b_j(w)=a_j(w)/∑_i a_i(w). These positive coefficients average boundary limits of harmonic-energy densities to the cell average.

concept.title: Hino’s sharp disk bound for three-boundary harmonic energy coefficients
concept.description: For boundary averaging coefficients b_j(w) of a regular harmonic structure with exactly three boundary points, every finite cell word w satisfies ∑_(j=1)^3 b_j(w)²<1/2. The upper bound is sharp over all cell words.

concept.title: Hino’s radial concentration theorem for three-boundary harmonic energy coefficients
concept.description: For boundary averaging coefficients b_j(w) of a regular harmonic structure with three boundary points, let π:S^N→K be the coding map and ν the chosen sum of harmonic energy measures. If κ is either a full-support Bernoulli product measure with strongly irreducible projected harmonic extension matrices, or a Borel measure with π_*κ≪ν, then ∑_(j=1)^3 b_j(ω₁⋯ω_n)²→1/2 for κ-almost every ω.

concept.title: One-dimensional energy-image density theorem
concept.description: For a strongly local regular symmetric Dirichlet form and a bounded domain function f, the pushforward under f of its energy measure ν_f is absolutely continuous with respect to one-dimensional Lebesgue measure. Consequently ν_f has no point masses.

concept.title: Jensen gap bounds from second derivatives
concept.description: If f is twice differentiable on [a,b] and m≤f″≤M, then for 0≤v≤1, m v(1−v)(b−a)²/2≤vf(a)+(1−v)f(b)−f(va+(1−v)b)≤M v(1−v)(b−a)²/2.

concept.title: Minkowski product inequality for positive vectors
concept.description: For a_i,b_i>0, (∏_i a_i)¹⁄ⁿ+(∏_i b_i)¹⁄ⁿ≤(∏_i(a_i+b_i))¹⁄ⁿ. Equality holds precisely when the vectors a and b are proportional.

concept.title: Cardinality of finite subsets of an infinite well-ordered set
concept.description: If X is an infinite well-ordered set of cardinality κ, then |X^{<ω}|=|[X]^{<ω}|=κ, and a countable union of sets of cardinality at most κ has cardinality at most κ.

concept.title: Normal topological space
concept.description: A topological space is normal if every two disjoint closed subsets have disjoint open neighborhoods.

concept.title: Urysohn lemma for a normal space
concept.description: If K,L are disjoint closed subsets of a normal space X, there is a continuous f:X→[0,1] with f=0 on K and f=1 on L.

concept.title: Finite continuous partition of unity on a compact Hausdorff space
concept.description: For a finite open cover U₁,…,U_n of compact Hausdorff K, there are continuous nonnegative ψ_i supported in U_i such that ∑ψ_i=1 on K.

concept.title: Weierstrass polynomial approximation theorem
concept.description: Every continuous real function on a compact real interval is a uniform limit of real polynomials.

concept.title: Signed Riesz–Markov representation on a compact Hausdorff space
concept.description: Every bounded real linear functional on C(K), K compact Hausdorff, is integration against a unique finite signed regular Borel measure μ; its operator norm is |μ|(K).

concept.title: Limit inferior of an extended-real sequence
concept.description: For a sequence a_n in the extended real line, liminf a_n=sup_N inf_{n≥N}a_n.

concept.title: Maximal ℓ² domain of a nondegenerate locally finite graph Laplacian
concept.description: For a locally finite weighted graph with inf_x m(x)>0, its Dirichlet and Neumann energy forms coincide, and their self-adjoint Laplacian has domain {f∈ℓ²(V,m):Δf∈ℓ²(V,m)}.

concept.title: ℓᵖ contractivity and ℓ² smoothing of the minimal graph heat semigroup
concept.description: The minimal heat semigroup of a locally finite weighted graph is contractive on ℓᵖ(V,m),1≤p≤∞. For t>0 and f∈ℓ² it has P_tf∈D(L); for f∈D(L), LP_tf=P_tLf.

concept.title: Principal real power on the right half-plane
concept.description: For Re z>0 and α∈ℝ, z^α=exp(α Log z), where Log z is the holomorphic logarithm real on positive real numbers. This fixes the branch used for Bergman kernels (1−z w̄)^(−α).

concept.title: Dirichlet series
concept.description: A Dirichlet series is ∑_(n≥1)a_n n^(−s), with complex coefficients and n^(−s)=exp(−s log n), considered on a right half-plane where it converges.

concept.title: Dirichlet polynomial
concept.description: A Dirichlet polynomial is a finite sum ∑_(n≤N)a_n n^(−s) with complex coefficients.

concept.title: Multiplicative arithmetic function
concept.description: An arithmetic function a:ℕ₊→ℂ is multiplicative if a(1)=1 and a(mn)=a(m)a(n) whenever gcd(m,n)=1.

concept.title: Euler product of a Dirichlet series
concept.description: For a multiplicative coefficient function a, an absolutely convergent Dirichlet series factors as ∑a(n)n^(−s)=∏_(p prime)(∑_(j≥0)a(pʲ)p^(−js)). An Euler-product representation specifies these local factors and its domain of convergence.

concept.title: Entire function of finite order
concept.description: An entire function f has finite order if for some finite positive C,A one has |f(z)|≤exp(C(1+|z|)^A) throughout ℂ.

concept.title: Selberg class of Dirichlet series
concept.description: The Selberg class consists of Dirichlet series L(s)=∑a(n)n^(−s) with a(1)=1 and a(n)=O_ε(n^ε) for every ε>0, for which (s−1)^mL(s) is entire of finite order for some m≥0, and Λ(s)=Qˢ∏Γ(λ_js+μ_j)L(s) satisfies Λ(s)=ω overline(Λ(1−bar(s))) with Q,λ_j>0, Re μ_j≥0 and |ω|=1. Its Euler product has log L_p(s)=∑_(j≥1)b(pʲ)p^(−js), with b(pʲ)=O(p^(jδ)) for some δ<1/2. Its degree is d_L=2∑λ_j.

concept.title: Selberg-class function with a polynomial Euler product
concept.description: A Selberg-class function has a polynomial Euler product of length m if L_p(s)=∏_(j=1)^m(1−α_j(p)p^(−s))^(−1) for every prime p, with fixed m; its Ramanujan bound implies |α_j(p)|≤1. The length m need not equal the functional-equation degree.

concept.title: Right-half-plane zero-counting function
concept.description: For a meromorphic L-function with isolated zeros, N_L(σ,T) counts its nontrivial zeros ρ=β+iγ with β>σ and 0<γ≤T, with multiplicity. A power-saving zero-density estimate bounds this by O(T^(1−η)) for some η>0.

concept.title: Resonance method for large values of a Dirichlet series
concept.description: Choose a Dirichlet polynomial R(t)=∑r(n)n^(−it) and a nonnegative smooth weight Φ, then compare M₂=∫L(σ+it)|R(t)|²Φ(t/T)dt with M₁=∫|R(t)|²Φ(t/T)dt. The inequality max|L|≥|M₂|/M₁ turns a coefficient choice making the weighted correlation large into a large-value bound.

concept.title: Rankin’s trick for nonnegative arithmetic sums
concept.description: For a_n≥0, x>0 and δ>0, one has ∑_(n>x)a_n≤x^(−δ)∑_(n≥1)a_n n^δ whenever the sum on the right is finite.

concept.title: Distance from a real number to the nearest integer
concept.description: For x∈ℝ, ‖x‖=min_(k∈ℤ)|x−k| is its distance to the nearest integer, taking values in [0,1/2].

concept.title: Kronecker approximation theorem for a continuous flow
concept.description: If λ₁,…,λ_n are real numbers linearly independent over ℚ, then for every β∈ℝⁿ and ε>0 there exists t∈ℝ with max_j‖tλ_j−β_j‖<ε.

concept.title: Chen’s weighted quantitative Kronecker approximation theorem
concept.description: Let M≥1, λ,β∈ℝⁿ satisfy u·β∈ℤ whenever u∈ℤⁿ, |u_j|≤M and u·λ=0. For δ_j>0, Δ=∑δ_j, T₁<T₂, and Λ=min{|u·λ|:u∈ℤⁿ, |u_j|≤M, u·λ≠0}, one has inf_(T₁≤t<T₂)∑δ_j‖tλ_j−β_j‖²≤(Δ/4)sin²(π/(2(M+1)))+ΔMⁿ/(4πΛ(T₂−T₁)), provided the defining minimum for Λ is nonempty.

concept.title: Mellin inversion formula for the exponential function
concept.description: For x>0 and c>0, e^(−x)=(2πi)^(−1)∫_(c−i∞)^(c+i∞)Γ(w)x^(−w)dw, interpreted as the limit of integrals over vertical segments.

concept.title: Stirling estimate for gamma on vertical lines
concept.description: Uniformly for σ in a fixed compact real interval and |t|→∞, |Γ(σ+it)|=sqrt(2π)|t|^(σ−1/2)e^(−π|t|/2)(1+O(1/|t|)).

concept.title: Aistleitner–Pańkowski resonance lower bound in the Selberg class
concept.description: Let L be in the polynomial-Euler-product Selberg class with length m and ∑_(p≤x)|a(p)|²=(κ+o(1))x/log x, κ>0. For fixed 1/2≤σ<1 and large T, max_(T≤t≤2T)|L(σ+it)|≥exp((C_L(σ)+o(1))(log T)^(1−σ)/(log log T)^θ), where θ=1/2 at σ=1/2 and θ=1 otherwise, C_L(1/2)=sqrt(κ), and C_L(σ)=κ^σ m^(1−2σ)(3−2σ)^(3/2−σ)/(2sqrt(2σ−1)) for σ>1/2.

concept.title: Aistleitner–Pańkowski large logarithmic values from zero density
concept.description: Let L be in the Selberg class, 1/2≤σ<1 and θ∈ℝ. Suppose N_L(σ,T)=O(T^(1−η)) for some η>0 and ∑_(p≤x)|a(p)|=(κ+o(1))x/log x, κ>0. For all large T, max_(T≤t≤2T)Re(e^(−iθ)log L(σ+it))≥c_(κ,η)(log T)^(1−σ)/log log T, with c_(κ,η)=((1−e^(−1))κ/4)(η/(4sqrt(e)))^(1−σ). The logarithm is continued from the Euler-product half-plane along zero-free horizontal paths.

concept.title: Aistleitner–Pańkowski lower bound on the one-line
concept.description: Suppose L is in the Selberg class and ∑_(p≤x)|a(p)|=κx/log x+O(x/log²x), κ>0. For every real θ and all sufficiently large T there are σ>1 and t∈[T,2T] with Re(e^(−iθ)log L(σ+it))≥κ log log log T+O(1). In particular |L(1+it)|=Ω((log log t)^κ) as t→∞.

concept.title: Conditional upper bounds for Selberg-class large values
concept.description: Let L be in the Selberg class with no zeros in Re s>1/2 and ∑_(p≤x)|a(p)|=(κ+o(1))x/log x, κ>0. For fixed 1/2≤σ<1 there is c>0 with |L(σ+it)|≪exp(c(log t)^(2−2σ)/log log t). If the prime coefficient mean has error O(x/log²x), then |L(1+it)|≪(log log t)^κ.

concept.title: Continuous-time supermartingale
concept.description: An integrable adapted process M on a filtered probability space is a supermartingale if E[M_t|F_s]≤M_s almost surely for every s≤t; the term refers to a continuous time parameter and does not require continuous sample paths.

concept.title: Continuous functions vanishing at infinity
concept.description: For a locally compact Hausdorff space E, C₀(E) is the space of continuous real functions f for which {x:|f(x)|≥ε} is compact for every ε>0, with the supremum norm.

concept.title: Feller Markov semigroup
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup P_t on a locally compact separable metric space E is Feller if it maps C₀(E) into itself and ‖P_tf−f‖∞→0 as t↓0 for every f∈C₀(E).

concept.title: Generator of a Feller semigroup
concept.description: For a Feller semigroup P_t on C₀(E), its generator is Af=lim_(t↓0)(P_tf−f)/t in the supremum norm, with domain those f∈C₀(E) for which this limit exists. Extended generators on unbounded functions require a separately specified martingale-domain convention.

concept.title: Usual stochastic order for finite measures on the real line
concept.description: For finite positive Borel measures μ and ν of equal mass on ℝ, μ≤_stν means μ([a,∞))≤ν([a,∞)) for every real a; for probabilities this is equivalently domination of expectations of bounded increasing measurable functions.

concept.title: Stochastically monotone Markov semigroup on the half-line
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup P_t on [0,∞) is stochastically monotone if P_t(x,·)≤_stP_t(y,·) whenever x≤y, for every t≥0.

concept.title: Stochastic domination of Markov semigroups on the half-line
concept.description: A Markov semigroup P_t on [0,∞) is stochastically dominated by Q_t if P_t(x,·)≤_stQ_t(x,·) for every x≥0 and t≥0.

concept.title: Weighted total variation norm of a signed measure
concept.description: For a measurable weight V≥1 and a signed measure μ, its weighted variation norm is ‖μ‖_V=sup{|∫f dμ|:f measurable, |f|≤V}, allowing infinity. The convention V=1 is the full total variation norm, twice the usual supremum-over-events distance for differences of probability measures.

concept.title: V-uniform ergodicity of a continuous-time Markov process
concept.description: A Markov semigroup P_t is V-uniformly ergodic with rate κ>0 if it has a unique invariant probability π and a finite constant D such that ‖P_t(x,·)−π‖_V≤DV(x)e^(−κt) for all x and t≥0, for a fixed measurable V≥1.

concept.title: Geometric Foster–Lyapunov condition for a continuous-time generator
concept.description: For a specified extended generator A of a Markov process, a continuous function V≥1 in its declared domain satisfies a geometric drift condition if AV≤−kV+b1_C for constants k>0,b<∞ and a specified compact or small set C; the domain and small-set convention are part of the chosen route.

concept.title: Stopped modified Lyapunov function at the origin
concept.description: For a half-line Markov process X and τ₀=inf{t≥0:X_t=0}, a function V≥1 is a stopped modified Lyapunov function with constant k>0 when V(X_(t∧τ₀))+k∫₀^(t∧τ₀)V(X_s)ds is a supermartingale for each initial state.

concept.title: Reflected Itô diffusion on the positive half-line
concept.description: A continuous adapted process Y_t≥0 solves a reflected Itô equation if Y_t=Y₀+∫₀ᵗg(Y_s)ds+∫₀ᵗσ(Y_s)dW_s+L_t, where L is continuous, adapted, nondecreasing, starts at zero and can increase only when Y_t=0.

concept.title: Finite-activity reflected jump-diffusion on the half-line
concept.description: A half-line reflected diffusion with coefficients g,σ is pieced together with jumps having a state-dependent finite destination measure ν_x: while at x, jumps occur at rate ν_x([0,∞)) and land with normalized law ν_x/ν_x([0,∞)), when this rate is positive. Bounded jump rates ensure no finite-time accumulation; the zero-rate case has no jumps.

concept.title: Two rank-based finite-activity Lévy particles
concept.description: Two real particles are driven by the upper and lower coordinates of a two-dimensional Lévy process with finite jump measure, drift vector (g₊,g₋) and positive definite covariance: the particle currently ranked higher uses the upper driver and the lower-ranked particle uses the lower driver, with a declared rule resolving ties. The ranked gap is the difference of their ordered positions.

concept.title: Sarantsev’s weighted variation contraction under ordered domination
concept.description: Let a half-line strong Markov semigroup P be stochastically dominated by a stochastically monotone semigroup Q. If Q has a nondecreasing stopped modified Lyapunov function V with constant k, then ‖P_t(x,·)−P_t(y,·)‖_V≤(V(x)+V(y))e^(−kt). Consequently any invariant probability π for P with π(V)<∞ is unique and satisfies ‖P_t(x,·)−π‖_V≤(V(x)+π(V))e^(−kt).

concept.title: Differentiation under an integral with an integrable derivative bound
concept.description: Let I be an open real interval, (X,μ) a σ-finite measure space and f:I×X→ℝ measurable. Suppose f(t₀,·) is integrable for some t₀∈I and, outside one μ-null set, t↦f(t,x) is differentiable on I with |∂_tf(t,x)|≤g(x) for an integrable g. Then F(t)=∫f(t,x)dμ(x) is differentiable on I and F′(t)=∫∂_tf(t,x)dμ(x). The same conclusion is local when the bound holds on a neighborhood of the point in question.

concept.title: Projective space over a field
concept.description: For a field F, projective n-space consists of nonzero vectors in F^(n+1) modulo multiplication by nonzero scalars; points are written [x₀:⋯:x_n]. Homogeneous polynomial equations define its projective algebraic subsets.

concept.title: Elliptic curve over a characteristic-zero field
concept.description: Over a characteristic-zero field F, an elliptic curve can be presented as a nonsingular projective cubic y²z=x³+Axz²+Bz³ with A,B∈F and 4A³+27B²≠0, with distinguished point O=[0:1:0] and the chord-and-tangent abelian group law. Curves are identified by F-isomorphisms preserving O.

concept.title: Isogeny of elliptic curves in characteristic zero
concept.description: An isogeny φ:E→E′ over F is a nonconstant algebraic group homomorphism of elliptic curves preserving O. Its degree equals the order of its finite geometric kernel in characteristic zero. A cyclic isogeny has a cyclic kernel.

concept.title: Dual isogeny of an elliptic-curve isogeny
concept.description: For an isogeny φ:E→E′ of degree n, the dual isogeny φ̂:E′→E satisfies φ̂φ=[n] on E and φφ̂=[n] on E′.

concept.title: Torsion subgroup E[n] of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over F, E[n] is the subgroup of E(F̄) annihilated by multiplication by n. In characteristic zero it is a free rank-two ℤ/nℤ-module with its natural action of Gal(F̄/F).

concept.title: Division field of an elliptic curve
concept.description: The n-division field F(E[n]) is the extension of F generated by the affine coordinates of all n-torsion points of an elliptic curve E/F. It is finite Galois, and its Galois group acts faithfully on E[n].

concept.title: Galois representation on elliptic-curve torsion
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E/F in characteristic zero, the natural action on E[n] gives ρ_(E,n):Gal(F̄/F)→Aut(E[n])≅GL₂(ℤ/nℤ) after choosing a basis; its kernel fixes the division field F(E[n]).

concept.title: Quadratic twist of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For E:y²=x³+Ax+B over a characteristic-zero field F and D∈F×/(F×)², the quadratic twist E^D is y²=x³+D²Ax+D³B. It becomes isomorphic to E over F(√D), with Galois descent changed by the associated quadratic character.

concept.title: Abelian group with a group action
concept.description: A G-module is an abelian group M equipped with an action of G by abelian-group automorphisms. A morphism is a group homomorphism commuting with the G-actions.

concept.title: Cohomology of a group with abelian coefficients
concept.description: For a G-module M, Hⁿ(G,M)=ker(d:Cⁿ→C^(n+1))/im(d:C^(n−1)→Cⁿ), where Cⁿ consists of maps Gⁿ→M and (df)(g₁,…,g_(n+1))=g₁f(g₂,…)+∑_(i=1)^n(−1)^if(…,g_ig_(i+1),…)+(−1)^(n+1)f(g₁,…,g_n). For a profinite G and a discrete M, use continuous cochains.

concept.title: First group cohomology with abelian coefficients
concept.description: For a G-module M, H¹(G,M) is the abelian group of cocycles f(gh)=f(g)+g·f(h), modulo coboundaries f(g)=g·m−m. For profinite G and discrete M, the cocycles are continuous.

concept.title: Cyclic restriction kernel in first group cohomology
concept.description: For a finite group G and a G-module M, H¹_loc(G,M)=ker(H¹(G,M)→∏_(C≤G cyclic)H¹(C,M)). It records cohomology classes whose restrictions to every cyclic subgroup vanish.

concept.title: Local-global divisibility problem for elliptic-curve points
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field F and an integer m>1, the local-global divisibility question asks whether a point P∈E(F) divisible by m in E(F_v) for all but finitely many finite places v must already be divisible by m in E(F).

concept.title: Tate module of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E in characteristic zero and a prime ℓ, T_ℓ(E)=lim←E[ℓⁿ], with transition maps multiplication by ℓ. It is a rank-two ℤ_ℓ-module with a continuous Galois action.

concept.title: Complex multiplication of an elliptic curve
concept.description: An elliptic curve E in characteristic zero has complex multiplication if End_(F̄)(E) strictly contains ℤ; the extra endomorphisms form an order in an imaginary quadratic field.

concept.title: Weil pairing on elliptic-curve torsion
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E in characteristic zero, the Weil pairing e_n:E[n]×E[n]→μ_n is a nondegenerate alternating bilinear pairing, equivariant under Galois. Consequently the determinant of ρ_(E,n) is the cyclotomic character modulo n.

concept.title: Cohomology formulas for a finite cyclic group
concept.description: For G=⟨g⟩ of order n acting on M, put N=1+g+⋯+g^(n−1). Then H¹(G,M)=ker N/(g−1)M and H²(G,M)=M^G/NM. The formulas extend periodically to positive odd and even degrees.

concept.title: Vanishing of finite-group cohomology when the group order is invertible
concept.description: For a finite group G and a G-module M on which multiplication by |G| is invertible, Hⁿ(G,M)=0 for every n>0.

concept.title: Lawson–Wuthrich classification of first torsion cohomology over Q
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be an elliptic curve, p prime and G=Gal(ℚ(E[p])/ℚ). Then H¹(G,E[p]) vanishes except in exactly these cases: p=3 and E has a rational point of order 3 and a unique rational cyclic 3-isogeny; p=5 and E^5 has a rational point of order 5 and a unique rational cyclic 5-isogeny; or p=11 and E is ℚ-isomorphic to the Cremona curve 121c2, y²+xy=x³+x²−3632x+82757. In every exceptional case the cohomology group has p elements.

concept.title: Lawson–Wuthrich classification of prime-power torsion cohomology over Q
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be elliptic, p>3, G_i=Gal(ℚ(E[p^i])/ℚ). The groups H¹(G_i,E[p^i]) vanish for every i≥2 exactly when (E,p) is outside the following list: p∈{5,7} and E has rational p-torsion; p=5 and E has a rational 5-isogeny and E^5 has rational 5-torsion; p=5 and E→E′ is a rational 5-isogeny, E has no rational cyclic 25-isogeny, and (E′)^5 has rational 5-torsion; p=5 and E→E′→E″ is a rational cyclic 25-isogeny with rational 5-torsion on E′; or p=11 and E is Cremona 121c1 or 121c2. Vanishing for i=2 is equivalent to vanishing for all i≥2.

concept.title: Prime-power local-global divisibility for elliptic curves over Q
concept.description: For a prime p and i≥1, local-global divisibility by p^i has a positive answer for every elliptic curve over ℚ exactly when p>3 or p^i is 2 or 3. Thus powers of 2 or 3 of exponent at least two admit counterexamples.

concept.title: Lawson–Wuthrich counterexample to local-global divisibility by nine
concept.description: On the elliptic curve E:y²+y=x³+20 over ℚ, let P=(−2,3). The point 3P is divisible by 9 in E(ℚ_ℓ) for every prime ℓ≠3, but it is not divisible by 9 in E(ℚ). The curve has Cremona label 243a2.

concept.title: Weak Feller Markov semigroup
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup P_t on a metric state space is weak Feller if P_tf is bounded and continuous for every bounded continuous real function f and every t≥0. This condition does not assert preservation of functions vanishing at infinity.

concept.title: Extended martingale generator of a Markov process
concept.description: A pair of Borel functions (f,Af) belongs to the extended martingale generator of a Markov process X when ∫₀ᵗ|Af(X_s)|ds is locally finite and f(X_t)−f(X₀)−∫₀ᵗAf(X_s)ds is a local martingale under every initial state, using the declared filtration and localization convention.

concept.title: Well-posedness of bounded-rate reflected jump-diffusions on the half-line
concept.description: Suppose g and σ are globally Lipschitz on [0,∞), inf σ>0, and ν_x are finite positive Borel destination measures such that x↦∫f dν_x is continuous for every bounded continuous f and sup_xν_x([0,∞))<∞. Piecing out reflected diffusions with jump measure ν_x yields a unique-in-law nonexplosive weak Feller strong Markov family. Its extended generator on bounded C² test functions with f′(0)=0 is Af(x)=g(x)f′(x)+σ(x)²f″(x)/2+∫(f(y)−f(x))dν_x(y).

concept.title: Compact topological dynamical system with an invertible map
concept.description: A compact topological dynamical system (X,T) consists of a compact Hausdorff space X and a homeomorphism T:X→X; in the metric version X is compact metrizable.

concept.title: Topological entropy of a map of a compact metric space
concept.description: For a continuous self-map T of compact metric X, let s_n(ε) be the largest size of a set whose distinct points have max_(0≤j<n)d(Tʲx,Tʲy)>ε. Its topological entropy is h_top(T)=sup_(ε>0)limsup_(n→∞)n^(−1)log s_n(ε).

concept.title: Möbius-orthogonal bounded sequence
concept.description: A bounded complex sequence a_n is Möbius-orthogonal if lim_(N→∞)N^(−1)∑_(n=1)^N μ(n)a_n=0, where μ is the Möbius function.

concept.title: State of a C*-algebra
concept.description: A state on a C*-algebra is a positive complex linear functional of norm one; on a unital C*-algebra this is equivalent to positivity and ρ(1)=1.

concept.title: Star representation of a C*-algebra
concept.description: A star representation of a C*-algebra A on a complex Hilbert space H is a star-preserving algebra homomorphism π:A→B(H). It is cyclic if π(A)ξ is dense in H for some vector ξ.

concept.title: Completely positive map between C*-algebras
concept.description: A linear map φ:A→B between C*-algebras is completely positive if every entrywise amplification M_n(A)→M_n(B) sends positive matrices to positive matrices. It is contractive if its operator norm is at most one.

concept.title: Voiculescu–Brown entropy of a C*-algebra automorphism
concept.description: For an exact C*-algebra A with faithful representation π and automorphism α, let rcp(π,Ω,δ) be the least rank of a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B through which contractive completely positive maps approximate π on finite Ω within δ; rank is the dimension of a maximal abelian subalgebra. The entropy is sup_(Ω,δ)limsup_(n→∞)n^(−1)log rcp(π,⋃_(j=0)^(n−1)αʲΩ,δ).

concept.title: Contractive approximation entropy of a Banach-space isometry
concept.description: For an isometric automorphism α of a Banach space X, choose an isometric embedding ι:X→Y admitting finite-set approximations through contractive maps X→ℓ∞^d→Y. Let rc(Ω,δ) be the least such d for error below δ on finite Ω. The contractive approximation entropy is sup_(Ω,δ)limsup_(n→∞)n^(−1)log rc(⋃_(j=0)^(n−1)αʲΩ,δ).

concept.title: Unitary element of a unital C*-algebra
concept.description: In a unital C*-algebra A, an element u is unitary if u*u=uu*=1; equivalently its adjoint is its inverse.

concept.title: Noncommutative torus C*-algebra
concept.description: For a real skew-symmetric d×d matrix Θ, the noncommutative torus A_Θ is the universal unital C*-algebra generated by unitaries u₁,…,u_d with u_ju_k=exp(2πiΘ_jk)u_ku_j. Universality means any unitary tuple satisfying these relations determines a unique unital star homomorphism from A_Θ. This denotes the C*-completion, not just its dense smooth subalgebra.

concept.title: Noncommutative toral automorphism
concept.description: For S=(s_ij)∈GL_d(ℤ) with SᵀΘS≡Θ modulo integer matrices, the noncommutative toral automorphism α_S of A_Θ sends the generator u_j to u₁^(s_1j)⋯u_d^(s_dj), in that fixed order.

concept.title: Nilpotent group
concept.description: A group G is d-step nilpotent if its lower central series G₁=G, G_(j+1)=[G_j,G], generated by the indicated commutators, satisfies G_(d+1)={1}. A nilpotent group is d-step nilpotent for some finite d.

concept.title: Finitely generated group
concept.description: A group is finitely generated if some finite set of elements and their inverses generates the whole group.

concept.title: Compact nilmanifold
concept.description: A compact d-step nilmanifold is G/Γ where G is a d-step nilpotent real Lie group and Γ is a discrete cocompact subgroup. G need not be connected in this convention.

concept.title: Nilsystem
concept.description: A d-step nilsystem is a compact nilmanifold X=G/Γ with the homeomorphism x↦gx given by left translation by a fixed g∈G.

concept.title: Nilsequence
concept.description: A basic nilsequence has the form a_n=F(gⁿx), n∈ℤ, for continuous complex F on a compact nilmanifold and a nilrotation x↦gx. A nilsequence is a uniform limit of basic nilsequences, allowing their nilpotency steps to vary; a d-step nilsequence uses a fixed step bound d.

concept.title: Symmetric Cesàro-null bounded sequence
concept.description: A bounded complex sequence (a_n)_(n∈ℤ) is symmetric Cesàro-null if (2N+1)^(−1)∑_(n=−N)^N|a_n|→0. For bounded sequences this is equivalent to the same condition with |a_n|².

concept.title: Almost nilsequence with a symmetric Cesàro-null remainder
concept.description: An almost nilsequence in this convention is a bounded complex sequence a_n=b_n+c_n where b is a nilsequence and c is symmetric Cesàro-null.

concept.title: Integer-valued polynomial on Z
concept.description: An integer-valued polynomial is a polynomial p∈ℚ[x] satisfying p(n)∈ℤ for every n∈ℤ. Its coefficients need not all be integers; for example x(x−1)/2 is allowed.

concept.title: Polynomial sequence in a nilpotent group
concept.description: For a nilpotent group G, a sequence g:ℤ→G is polynomial if some iterate of the difference Dg(n)=g(n)^(−1)g(n+1) is identically one. Equivalently it can be written U₁^(p₁(n))⋯U_r^(p_r(n)) with fixed U_j∈G and integer-valued polynomials p_j.

concept.title: Compact vector in a unitary representation
concept.description: For a unitary action of G on H, a vector u is compact if its orbit Gu has compact closure in Hilbert norm. The compact-vector subspace H_c(G) is the closed span of finite-dimensional invariant subspaces.

concept.title: Equidistribution of a sequence modulo one
concept.description: A real sequence x_n is equidistributed modulo one if, for every interval I⊆[0,1), the proportion of n with fractional part in I tends to the length of I; for a two-sided sequence use centered intervals [−N,N].

concept.title: Weyl equidistribution theorem for real polynomials
concept.description: If a real polynomial has at least one irrational coefficient of positive degree, then its values on the integers are equidistributed modulo one.

concept.title: Gelfand–Naimark–Segal representation theorem for a state
concept.description: For every state ρ on a C*-algebra A there are a Hilbert space H_ρ, a star representation π_ρ:A→B(H_ρ) and a unit cyclic vector ξ_ρ with ρ(a)=⟨π_ρ(a)ξ_ρ,ξ_ρ⟩. The cyclic representation is unique up to a unitary carrying the cyclic vector to the other one.

concept.title: Green–Tao Möbius orthogonality for nilsequences
concept.description: Every nilsequence (a_n) is Möbius-orthogonal: N^(−1)∑_(n=1)^N μ(n)a_n→0. This qualitative consequence extends the basic nilmanifold theorem to uniform limits.

concept.title: Kronecker’s root-of-unity theorem
concept.description: If a monic integer polynomial has only nonzero complex roots, all of modulus at most one, then every root is a root of unity.

concept.title: Kerr–Li entropy lower bound for a noncommutative toral automorphism
concept.description: If α_S is a noncommutative toral automorphism and λ_i are the eigenvalues of S, counted with multiplicity, then ht(α_S)≥½∑_(|λ_i|>1)log|λ_i|.

concept.title: Leibman’s compact-vector criterion for nilpotent unitary actions
concept.description: If a finitely generated nilpotent group G=⟨T₁,…,T_r⟩ acts unitarily on H, then H_c(G)=⋂_(T∈G)H_c(T)=⋂_(j=1)^rH_c(T_j).

concept.title: Bergelson–Leibman polynomial mean-ergodic theorem on the rational complement
concept.description: Let G be a finitely generated nilpotent unitary group on H and g:ℤ→G a polynomial sequence with g(0)=1. Let E=⟨g(ℤ)⟩ and H_rat=⋃_(l≥1){u:P^l u=u for every P∈E}. If u⊥H_rat, then (2N+1)^(−1)∑_(n=−N)^Ng(n)u→0 in Hilbert norm.

concept.title: Nilsequence decomposition of polynomial matrix coefficients of nilpotent unitary actions
concept.description: Let U₁,…,U_d be unitary operators generating a nilpotent group and let p_j be integer-valued polynomials. For all u,v in the Hilbert space, the sequence ⟨U₁^(p₁(n))⋯U_d^(p_d(n))u,v⟩ is the sum of a nilsequence and a symmetric Cesàro-null bounded sequence. Equivalently this holds for every polynomial sequence in a finitely generated nilpotent unitary group.

concept.title: Almost-nilsequence states of zero-entropy noncommutative toral automorphisms
concept.description: Let A_Θ be a noncommutative torus and α_S its noncommutative toral automorphism. If ht(α_S)=0, then for every state ρ and every a∈A_Θ the sequence ρ(α_Sⁿ(a)), n∈ℤ, is a nilsequence plus a symmetric Cesàro-null bounded sequence. Consequently it is Möbius-orthogonal.

concept.title: Purely atomic finite measure
concept.description: A finite measure is purely atomic if it is a countable sum ∑_j a_jδ_{x_j} of positive point masses, with ∑_j a_j<∞; finite signed measures are purely atomic when their total variation is.

concept.title: Support of a Radon measure
concept.description: The support of a nonnegative Radon measure on a topological space is the complement of the union of its open null sets; equivalently, it consists of points whose every open neighborhood has positive measure.

concept.title: Atomicity of Radon measures on scattered compacta
concept.description: Every finite Radon measure on a compact Hausdorff scattered space is purely atomic; the same holds for finite signed regular measures via total variation.

concept.title: Fréchet–Urysohn property of finite-subset compacta
concept.description: For every set X and n<∞, σ_n(2^X) is a compact Hausdorff Fréchet–Urysohn space.

concept.title: Real ℓ² space indexed by an arbitrary set
concept.description: For a set X, ℓ²(X;ℝ) consists of families a_x with sup_{F⊂X finite}∑_{x∈F}|a_x|²<∞, with norm given by the square root of that supremum and the corresponding sum inner product.

concept.title: Orthonormal coordinates for a real Hilbert space
concept.description: Every real Hilbert space H is linearly isometric to ℓ²(X;ℝ) for an orthonormal basis indexed by some set X; the coordinates of h are its inner products with the basis vectors.

concept.title: Extension norms between finite-subset compacta at large cardinals
concept.description: For 1≤m<n and |X|≥ℵ_{n−1}, η(σ_m(2^X),σ_n(2^X))=∑_{k=0}^m binom(n,k)binom(n−k−1,m−k).

concept.title: Spectral theorem for a self-adjoint Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: A densely defined self-adjoint operator A has a unique projection-valued measure E on ℝ such that A=∫λ dE(λ), with D(A)={x:∫λ²d⟨E(λ)x,x⟩<∞}; measurable functions of A are defined by the same spectral integration.

concept.title: One-dimensional Sobolev interpolation into derivative sup norms
concept.description: For integers 0≤j<N, there is C_{N,j} such that ||u^(j)||∞≤C_{N,j}(||u||₂+||u^(N)||₂)^a||u||₂^(1−a) for u∈H^N(0,1), where a=(j+1/2)/N.

concept.title: Density of Schwartz functions in finite-exponent Euclidean Lᵖ
concept.description: For 1≤p<∞, Schwartz functions are dense in Lᵖ(ℝᵈ); in particular compactly supported smooth functions are dense.

concept.title: Fourier transform of a Gaussian
concept.description: For a>0 and the transform f̂(ξ)=∫e^(−ix·ξ)f(x)dx on ℝᵈ, the transform of exp(−a|x|²) is (π/a)^(d/2)exp(−|ξ|²/(4a)).

concept.title: Yosida approximation of a maximal monotone relation
concept.description: For a maximal monotone relation A on a Hilbert space and λ>0, J_λ=(I+λA)⁻¹ is its resolvent and A_λ=λ⁻¹(I−J_λ) is its Yosida approximation, a single-valued Lipschitz monotone map.

concept.title: Metric projection onto a closed convex Hilbert subset
concept.description: For a nonempty closed convex subset C of a Hilbert space H, each x∈H has a unique nearest point P_Cx∈C, characterized by Re⟨x−P_Cx,y−P_Cx⟩≤0 for every y∈C.

concept.title: Minimal section of a maximal monotone relation
concept.description: The minimal section A⁰ of a maximal monotone Hilbert-space relation A sends x∈D(A) to the unique element of the nonempty closed convex set A(x) having minimum norm.

concept.title: Strong–weak closedness of maximal monotone graphs
concept.description: If A is maximal monotone on a Hilbert space, x_n→x strongly and y_n⇀y weakly with y_n∈Ax_n, then y∈Ax.

concept.title: Resolvent and Yosida estimates for maximal monotone relations
concept.description: For maximal monotone A, J_λ is nonexpansive, A_λ is λ⁻¹-Lipschitz and monotone, A_λx∈A(J_λx), and for x∈D(A), A_λx→A⁰x with ||A_λx||≤||A⁰x||.

concept.title: Weak sequential compactness of bounded Hilbert sequences
concept.description: Every bounded sequence in a Hilbert space has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Minty surjectivity theorem in Hilbert space
concept.description: A monotone relation A on a Hilbert space is maximal monotone if and only if ran(I+λA)=H for one, equivalently every, λ>0.

concept.title: Lipschitz monotone perturbation of a maximal monotone relation
concept.description: If A is maximal monotone on a Hilbert space and B:H→H is monotone and globally Lipschitz, then A+B is maximal monotone.

concept.title: Endpoint traces of one-dimensional Sobolev functions
concept.description: Every u∈H^N(0,1;𝕂ᵈ), N≥1, has continuous representatives for derivatives of order j<N and bounded linear traces u↦u^(j)(0),u^(j)(1). The complete endpoint jet map onto 𝕂^(2Nd) is surjective.

concept.title: Dissipative boundary interconnection with a nonlinear controller
concept.description: Given a boundary system (𝔄,𝔅,𝔠) on X and a controller relation M_c on X_c×U, its feedback relation on X×X_c sends (x,x_c) to (𝔄x,z_c) when (z_c,𝔅x)∈M_c(x_c,𝔠x); its domain imposes that boundary condition.

concept.title: Local Taylor remainder estimate for one-dimensional Sobolev functions
Monoid
concept.description: A monoid is a semigroup with an element1 satisfying1x=x1=x for every x.

concept.title: Minimal unitization of an invariant-metric semigroup
concept.description: Every semigroup with a two-sided translation-invariant metric is either a metric monoid or the nonidentity part of a unique smallest metric monoid, up to an isomorphism fixing the original semigroup. Distances to the adjoined identity satisfy d(1,b)=d(b,b²).

concept.title: Mogul’skii–Ottaviani–Skorohod inequalities in metric semigroups
concept.description: For independent X_i in a separable invariant-metric semigroup, S_k=X₁⋯X_k and m≤n, P(min_{m≤k≤n}d(z₁,z₀S_k)≤a) min_{m≤k≤n}P(d(S_k,S_n)≤b)≤P(d(z₁,z₀S_n)≤a+b). Replacing the minimum event by max≥a gives the upper-tail bound with terminal distance≥a−b.

concept.title: Kolmogorov zero-one law
concept.description: For a sequence of independent random elements, every event in the tail σ-algebra ⋂_nσ(X_k:k≥n) has probability zero or one.

concept.title: Tail-count comparison for independent maxima
concept.description: For independent nonnegative random variables Y_i, let M=sup_iY_i and q(t)=∑_iP(Y_i>t). Then q(t)/(1+q(t))≤P(M>t)≤min(1,q(t)), with the left side interpreted as1 when q=∞.

concept.title: Inverse tail-count function of a random-variable family
concept.description: For nonnegative random variables Y_i, their inverse tail-count function on (0,1] is ℓ(t)=inf{y>0:∑_iP(Y_i>y)≤t}, extended by0 off[0,1] with endpoint conventions specified separately.

concept.title: Convex subdifferential on a Banach space
concept.description: For a proper convex f:X→(−∞,∞] on a real Banach space, ∂f(x)={x*∈X*:f(y)≥f(x)+⟨x*,y−x⟩ for all y∈X}, with empty value outside domf.

concept.title: Local boundedness of a set-valued map
concept.description: A map T:X⇒Y into a normed space is locally bounded at x if some neighborhood U of x has bounded union ⋃_{u∈U}T(u). It is locally bounded on its domain if this holds at every x with T(x)≠∅.

concept.title: Essential smoothness of a Banach convex function
concept.description: A proper lower-semicontinuous convex function on a real Banach space is essentially smooth if its convex subdifferential is single-valued and locally bounded on its domain.

concept.title: Strictly convex function
concept.description: A real-valued or extended-real function f on a real vector space is strictly convex if f((1−t)x+ty)<(1−t)f(x)+tf(y) for distinct x,y in its effective domain and0<t<1.

concept.title: Essential strict convexity in Banach space
concept.description: A proper lower-semicontinuous convex function f on a real Banach space is essentially strictly convex if (∂f)⁻¹ is locally bounded on its domain and f is strictly convex on every convex subset of dom∂f.

concept.title: Legendre function on a Banach space
concept.description: A proper lower-semicontinuous convex function on a real Banach space is Legendre if it is both essentially smooth and essentially strictly convex.

concept.title: Usual conditions for a filtration
concept.description: A filtration on a probability space satisfies the usual conditions if it is right-continuous, F_t=⋂_(s>t)F_s, and F₀ contains every subset of every null set of the ambient probability space.

concept.title: Uniformly integrable family of real random variables
concept.description: A family of integrable real random variables (X_i) is uniformly integrable if lim_(K→∞)sup_iE[|X_i|1_(|X_i|>K)]=0.

concept.title: Stochastic process of class D
concept.description: An adapted process X on a declared time interval is of class D if the random variables X_τ, over all finite stopping times τ taking values in that interval, form a uniformly integrable family. On a finite horizon [0,T], this means all stopping times τ≤T.

concept.title: Optional stochastic process
concept.description: A process is optional if it is measurable for the optional σ-algebra on time×sample space, the σ-algebra generated by adapted càdlàg processes.

concept.title: Strong optional supermartingale
