concept.description: An optional process X is a strong supermartingale if X_τ is integrable for every bounded stopping time τ and E[X_τ|F_σ]≤X_σ almost surely whenever σ≤τ are bounded stopping times.

concept.title: Làdlàg path
concept.description: A path on a real time interval into a metric space is làdlàg if it has both left and right limits at every interior time; neither limit is required to equal the value at that time.

concept.title: Càdlàg semimartingale
concept.description: A real adapted càdlàg process X is a semimartingale if it can locally be written as X=X₀+M+A, where M is a local martingale starting at0 and A is an adapted càdlàg process of locally finite variation starting at0.

concept.title: Stochastic integral of a predictable process against a semimartingale
concept.description: For a real semimartingale X and a predictable locally bounded integrand H, H·X is the canonical stochastic-integral extension of elementary predictable sums ∑H_i(X_(t∧t_(i+1))−X_(t∧t_i)), where H_i is measurable at time t_i; convergence is in probability uniformly on compact time intervals.

concept.title: Quadratic covariation of càdlàg semimartingales
concept.description: For real càdlàg semimartingales X,Y, their quadratic covariation is [X,Y]_t=X_tY_t−X₀Y₀−∫₀ᵗX_(s−)dY_s−∫₀ᵗY_(s−)dX_s. Its jumps satisfy Δ[X,Y]_t=ΔX_tΔY_t; [X]=[X,X] is quadratic variation.

concept.title: Martingale orthogonal to a Brownian motion
concept.description: A càdlàg local martingale M is orthogonal to a d-dimensional Brownian motion W if [M,W^i] is identically0 for every coordinate i. The Brownian continuity is part of this convention; orthogonality of two arbitrary jump martingales need not mean zero optional covariation.

concept.title: Predictable stopping time
concept.description: A stopping time τ is predictable if it admits stopping times τ_n increasing to τ with τ_n<τ on {τ>0}; such a sequence announces τ.

concept.title: Quasi-left-continuous filtration
concept.description: A usual filtration is quasi-left-continuous if F_τ=F_(τ−) for every predictable stopping time τ, where F_(τ−) is generated by F₀ and the events A∩{t<τ} with A∈F_t.

concept.title: Doob–Meyer decomposition of a càdlàg class-D supermartingale
concept.description: On a usual filtered probability space, a càdlàg supermartingale X of class D on [0,T] has a unique decomposition X=X₀+M−A, where M is a càdlàg uniformly integrable martingale starting at0 and A is predictable, càdlàg, nondecreasing and starts at0.

concept.title: Mertens decomposition of a class-D strong optional supermartingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration, a class-D strong optional supermartingale X has a unique decomposition X=X₀+M−A−I, where M is a càdlàg uniformly integrable martingale, A is predictable càdlàg nondecreasing, and I is predictable left-continuous nondecreasing and purely discontinuous, all starting at0. Equivalently I=C_− for an adapted càdlàg purely discontinuous increasing C with C_(0−)=0.

concept.title: Supermartingale potential
concept.description: A nonnegative right-continuous supermartingale X on [0,∞) is a potential if E[X_t] tends to0 as t tends to∞.

concept.title: Doob’s Lp maximal inequality for càdlàg martingales
concept.description: For 1<p<∞ and a càdlàg real martingale M on [0,T] with M_T∈Lᵖ, ‖sup_(t≤T)|M_t|‖_p≤p/(p−1)‖M_T‖_p.

concept.title: Continuous approximation of the natural compensator of a potential
concept.description: For a class-D supermartingale potential X with natural increasing process A, there are continuous increasing approximants A^n whose associated potentials X^n are bounded above by X and whose terminal values converge weakly in L¹ to A_∞.

concept.title: Integration identity for optional projection against a continuous increasing process
concept.description: For a nonnegative measurable process H with optional projection ^oH and an adapted continuous increasing integrable process A, E∫H_s dA_s=E∫(^oH)_s dA_s. The projection is characterized by (^oH)_τ=E[H_τ|F_τ] at finite stopping times where integrable.

concept.title: Reflexivity and weak compactness of Lp for a finite reflexive exponent
concept.description: For 1<p<∞ on a σ-finite measure space, Lᵖ is reflexive; every norm-bounded sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence, and the norm of a weak limit is at most the liminf of the norms.

concept.title: Meyer’s Lp estimate for the increasing process of a supermartingale potential
concept.description: For each 1<p<∞ there are positive constants c_p,C_p such that if X is a class-D supermartingale potential with natural predictable increasing process A, then c_p‖sup_tX_t‖_p≤‖A_∞‖_p≤C_p‖sup_tX_t‖_p, allowing infinite norms.

concept.title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequalities for càdlàg local martingales at p≥1
concept.description: For each p≥1 there are 0<c_p≤C_p<∞ such that every real càdlàg local martingale M starting at0 satisfies c_pE([M]_T^(p/2))≤E[sup_(t≤T)|M_t|^p]≤C_pE([M]_T^(p/2)) for stopping times T, with extended expectations.

concept.title: Supersolution of a Brownian BSDE with an orthogonal martingale
concept.description: On a usual Brownian-carrying filtration over [0,T], a supersolution with terminal ξ and driver g is a tuple (Y,Z,M,K) satisfying Y_t=ξ−∫_t^Tg(s,Y_s,Z_s)ds−∫_t^TZ_s dW_s−(M_T−M_t)+(K_T−K_t), where Y is adapted làdlàg, Z predictable and integrable, M càdlàg martingale orthogonal to W, and K predictable nondecreasing làdlàg with K₀=0.

concept.title: Reflected Brownian BSDE with a càdlàg lower obstacle
concept.description: A reflected Brownian BSDE with an orthogonal martingale is a supersolution (Y,Z,M,K) with càdlàg Y,K and a càdlàg adapted obstacle S such that Y_t≥S_t on [0,T] and ∫₀^T(Y_(s−)−S_(s−))dK_s=0. The terminal constraint Y_T=ξ necessarily requires S_T≤ξ.

concept.title: Lp a priori estimate for BSDE supersolutions in a general filtration
concept.description: Fix p>1 and finite T. For an Lᵖ supersolution (Y,Z,M,K) of a Brownian BSDE with an orthogonal martingale in a usual filtration, with uniformly Lipschitz driver g, there is C depending only on p,T and its Lipschitz constants such that E[(∫₀^T|Z_s|²ds)^(p/2)]+E[[M]_T^(p/2)]+E[K_T^p]≤C(E|ξ|^p+E sup_(t≤T)|Y_t|^p+E[(∫₀^T|g(s,0,0)|ds)^p]). No quasi-left-continuity hypothesis is required.

concept.title: Q-curve
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a number field is a ℚ-curve if it is isogenous over ℚ̄ to every Galois conjugate. It is completely defined over a Galois number field K if it and the isogenies between its conjugates are defined over K. A quadratic ℚ-curve is one defined over a quadratic number field.

concept.title: Classical cusp form with Dirichlet character
concept.description: A weight-k cusp form with Dirichlet character χ modulo N is holomorphic on the upper half-plane, satisfies f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=χ(d)(cτ+d)^k f(τ) for matrices in Γ₀(N), and vanishes at every cusp. Equivalently it belongs to the χ-eigenspace of diamond operators on the cusp forms for Γ₁(N).

concept.title: Hecke operators on classical modular forms
concept.description: For f=∑a_nqⁿ of weight k and character χ modulo N, the Hecke operator T_p for p∤N has q-coefficients a_(pn)+χ(p)p^(k−1)a_(n/p), with a_(n/p)=0 unless p divides n. For p|N the operator U_p has coefficients a_(pn). Composite operators are obtained by the standard coprime multiplicativity and prime-power recurrences.

concept.title: Normalized weight-two newform
concept.description: A normalized weight-two newform of level N and character χ is a simultaneous eigenform for all classical Hecke operators in the new cuspidal subspace, with first q-coefficient one. The new subspace is the Petersson-orthogonal complement of forms obtained as g(dτ) from lower levels dividing N.

concept.title: Compact modular curve of a congruence subgroup
concept.description: For a finite-index congruence subgroup Γ⊆SL₂(ℤ), its compact complex modular curve is Γ\(ℍ∪ℙ¹(ℚ)), with the Riemann-surface charts at elliptic points and cusps. Its arithmetic model and the identification of its complex points must be specified separately; the marked-point and µ_N level conventions for X₁(N) can assign different cusp fields to the same analytic labels.

concept.title: Modular parametrization of an elliptic curve
concept.description: A modular parametrization over K is a nonconstant morphism of algebraic curves π:X₁(N)_K→E for some N; for a rational elliptic curve the source may be X₀(N). Its pullback carries invariant differentials on E to weight-two cusp differentials.

concept.title: Optimal modular parametrization
concept.description: For fixed source X₁(N), a modular parametrization π:X₁(N)→E is optimal if it is maximal for domination: π′ dominates π when π=φ∘π′ for an isogeny φ:E′→E over the base field, with pairs considered up to isomorphism. The analogous X₀(N) notion is called strong in §2.

concept.title: Invariant differential of an elliptic curve
concept.description: A nonzero invariant differential on an elliptic curve is a regular one-form unchanged by translations. For a generalized Weierstrass equation y²+a₁xy+a₃y=x³+a₂x²+a₄x+a₆, it is a scalar multiple of dx/(2y+a₁x+a₃); in short form it is a multiple of dx/(2y).

concept.title: Minimal integral Weierstrass model over a local field
concept.description: For an elliptic curve over a discretely valued characteristic-zero local field, an integral Weierstrass model has a_i in the valuation ring, and is minimal if the valuation of its discriminant is least among all integral Weierstrass equations for the same curve.

concept.title: Local minimal differential of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Over a discretely valued local field, a local minimal elliptic differential is dx/(2y+a₁x+a₃) for a minimal integral Weierstrass equation. It is determined up to multiplication by a unit of the valuation ring.

concept.title: Fractional ideal of a number field
concept.description: A nonzero fractional ideal of a number field K is a finitely generated O_K-submodule I⊆K with aI⊆O_K for some nonzero a∈O_K. Products and inverses give the group of nonzero fractional ideals.

concept.title: Absolute norm of a fractional ideal
concept.description: For a nonzero integral ideal I⊆O_K, N(I)=|O_K/I|. Extend this multiplicatively to nonzero fractional ideals by N(I/J)=N(I)/N(J); for a principal ideal (a), this equals |N_(K/ℚ)(a)|.

concept.title: Weierstrass ideal of an elliptic differential
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E/K and invariant differential ω, choose a local minimal differential ω_𝔭 at every finite prime. The Weierstrass ideal is δ_ω=∏_𝔭 𝔭^(v_𝔭(ω/ω_𝔭)), a fractional ideal independent of the unit choices. It can be nonprincipal, and a global minimal differential need not exist.

concept.title: Manin ideal of a modular parametrization
concept.description: For π:X₁(N)→E/K, let D_E be the O_K-lattice of invariant differentials integral at every finite place. If P=π*H⁰(E,Ω¹) and P_int=P∩O_K[[q]]dq/q, the Manin ideal c(π) is defined by π*D_E=c(π)P_int. It is the ideal analogue of the Manin constant when the integral differential module need not be free.

concept.title: Generalized Manin conjecture for Q-curves
concept.description: For an optimal modular parametrization π:X₁(N)→E of a ℚ-curve completely defined over its base number field, the Manin ideal c(π) is the unit ideal.

concept.title: Complex uniformization theorem for an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over ℂ with nonzero invariant differential ω, there is a full lattice Λ⊆ℂ and a complex analytic group isomorphism ℂ/Λ≅E(ℂ) pulling ω back to dz. The lattice is the set of integrals of ω over integral closed cycles.

concept.title: Period lattice of an elliptic differential
concept.description: The period lattice Λ(E,ω) is the full lattice in ℂ for which the analytic uniformization ℂ/Λ→E(ℂ) pulls the chosen invariant differential ω back to dz. Scaling ω by a scales Λ by a. For a real pair (E,ω), its real period is the least positive element of Λ∩ℝ.

concept.title: Intrinsic period factor of an elliptic curve over a quadratic field
concept.description: For E/K and an invariant differential ω, let δ_ω be its Weierstrass ideal. If K is real quadratic, set Ω_E=(ω₁ω_(1,ν))/N(δ_ω), the product of the positive real periods at its two real embeddings. If K is imaginary quadratic, set Ω_E=2·covol(Λ(E,ω))/N(δ_ω). This is independent of ω by the number-field product formula.

concept.title: Reduction type of an elliptic curve over a local field
concept.description: Reduce a minimal integral Weierstrass equation modulo the maximal ideal. Nonsingular reduction is good; nodal reduction is multiplicative, split if both tangent directions at the node are rational over the residue field and nonsplit otherwise; the remaining singular case is additive reduction.

concept.title: Hasse–Weil L-function of an elliptic curve over a number field
concept.description: For E/K, its Hasse–Weil L-function is ∏_𝔭 P_𝔭((N𝔭)^(−s))^(−1). At good reduction, P_𝔭(T)=1−a_𝔭T+(N𝔭)T² with a_𝔭=N𝔭+1−|E(k_𝔭)|. At split multiplicative, nonsplit multiplicative and additive reduction the factors P_𝔭 are 1−T, 1+T and 1 respectively. The product converges for Re s>3/2.

concept.title: Manin–Drinfel’d theorem on cuspidal divisor classes
concept.description: For a compact modular curve associated to a congruence subgroup, every degree-zero divisor supported on its cusps has torsion class in its Jacobian. In particular a modular parametrization sends the difference of two cusps to a torsion point on an elliptic curve.

concept.title: Newform factorization for a completely defined quadratic Q-curve
concept.description: Let E/K be a non-CM ℚ-curve completely defined over a quadratic field K, and let μ:E→νE satisfy νμ∘μ=[m]. If m is not a square, there is a normalized weight-two newform f of level N and coefficient field ℚ(√m), with its unique Galois conjugate σf, such that L(E/K,s)=L(f,s)L(σf,s). If m is square, E is K-isogenous to a curve E₀/ℚ and the factorization is L(E₀,s)L(E₀^d,s), where K=ℚ(√d).

concept.title: Bruin–Ferraguti construction of a quadratic Q-curve’s newform
concept.description: Given a completely defined non-CM quadratic ℚ-curve E/K and a K-isogeny μ:E→νE with νμ∘μ=[m], m nonsquare, choose an embedding ℚ(√m)→ℂ. Compute the newform’s level from N²=N_K(E)norm·Δ_K², determine its character from the sign of m and the quadratic character of K, and match its Euler factors to those of E. At ambiguous primes the chosen μ distinguishes the sign via Frobenius and the reduced isogeny; this yields f rather than just the unordered conjugate pair.

concept.title: Bruin–Ferraguti rationality and denominator bound for quadratic Q-curves
concept.description: Let E/K be a non-CM ℚ-curve completely defined over a quadratic field, not K-isogenous to a curve over ℚ, with μ:E→νE and νμ∘μ=[m]. Let μ*(ωνE)=αω_E, α=p+q√Δ_K of norm m, and D_α={x∈O_K:xα∈O_K}. Put R=L(E/K,1)√|Δ_K|/Ω_E. Then R∈ℚ. Assuming the generalized Manin conjecture, 2q·|E(K)_tors|²·t·N(D_α)·s²·R∈ℤ, where t=4 if m≡1 mod4 and t=1 otherwise, and s is the lcm of minimal K-isogeny degrees from all curves in E’s K-isogeny class to E.

concept.title: Uniform Fréchet differentiability on bounded sets
concept.description: A differentiable real function f on a Banach space is uniformly Fréchet differentiable on bounded sets if for every bounded B, sup_{x∈B,||h||=1}|(f(x+th)−f(x))/t−Df(x)h|→0 as t→0.

concept.title: Coercive real functional
concept.description: A real or extended-real functional f on a normed space is coercive if f(x)→+∞ as ||x||→∞, equivalently each finite sublevel set is bounded.

concept.title: Supercoercive real functional
concept.description: A functional f on a normed space is supercoercive if f(x)/||x||→+∞ as ||x||→∞.

concept.title: Sequential consistency of a Bregman distance
concept.description: For differentiable convex f, sequential consistency means that bounded x_n and D_f(y_n,x_n)→0 imply ||y_n−x_n||→0.

concept.title: Total convexity and Bregman sequential consistency
concept.description: For a differentiable convex function whose effective domain contains at least two points, total convexity on bounded sets is equivalent to sequential consistency of its Bregman distance.

concept.title: Uniform continuity of a uniformly differentiable convex gradient
concept.description: If f:E→ℝ is convex, bounded on bounded sets and uniformly Fréchet differentiable on bounded sets, then Df:E→E* is uniformly norm-continuous on bounded sets.

concept.title: Variational characterization of a Bregman projection
concept.description: For differentiable strictly convex f on a Banach space and convex C, z∈C minimizes D_f(·,x) if and only if ⟨Df(x)−Df(z),y−z⟩≤0 for all y∈C. Such z satisfies D_f(y,z)+D_f(z,x)≤D_f(y,x).

concept.title: Fenchel–Young gap
concept.description: For a proper convex f on a Banach space, its Fenchel–Young gap is V_f(x,x*)=f(x)+f*(x*)−⟨x*,x⟩≥0; when f* is differentiable and the Legendre duality identities hold, V_f(x,x*)=D_f(x,Df*(x*)).

concept.title: Composition theorem for Bregman strongly nonexpansive maps
concept.description: Suppose f is Legendre, bounded and uniformly Fréchet differentiable on bounded sets, totally convex on bounded sets, with Df* bounded on bounded subsets of E*=domf*. If T₁,…,T_N:C→C are Bregman strongly nonexpansive and their asymptotic fixed sets have nonempty intersection, their composition is Bregman strongly nonexpansive and its asymptotic fixed set equals that intersection.

concept.title: Scalar convergence lemma for vanishing convex recurrences
concept.description: If a_n≥0,0<α_n<1, ∑α_n=∞ and a_{n+1}≤(1−α_n)a_n+β_n, then a_n→0 provided limsup β_n/α_n≤0 or ∑|β_n|<∞.

concept.title: Complex unit disk
concept.description: The complex unit disk is 𝔻={z∈ℂ:|z|<1}.

concept.title: Co-invariant subspace of a Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: A closed subspace Q of a Hilbert space is co-invariant for T if T*Q⊂Q, equivalently Q⊥ is invariant for T.

concept.title: Unitary equivalence of operators
concept.description: Operators T on H and S on K are unitarily equivalent if a unitary U:H→K satisfies UT=SU; tuples are unitarily equivalent if one U intertwines every corresponding coordinate.

concept.title: Products and ranges of commuting orthogonal projections
concept.description: For finitely many pairwise commuting orthogonal Hilbert-space projections P_i, ∏P_i is the orthogonal projection onto ⋂ranP_i, and I−∏(I−P_i) projects onto the closed sum∑ranP_i.

concept.title: Weak operator topology
concept.description: The weak operator topology on bounded operators H→K is the coarsest topology for which T↦⟨Tx,y⟩ is continuous for every x∈H,y∈K; a net converges exactly when all these matrix coefficients converge.

concept.title: Strong operator topology
concept.description: The strong operator topology on bounded operators H→K is pointwise norm convergence: T_i→T exactly when ||(T_i−T)x||→0 for each x∈H.

concept.title: Standard analytic reproducing kernel Hilbert space on the disk
concept.description: A standard analytic RKHS R_k on the disk has nonvanishing holomorphic–antiholomorphic kernel k, dense polynomials and contractive coordinate multiplication, and polynomials p_j(z,w̄)→1/k(z,w) whose hereditary evaluations p_j(M_z,M_z*) are uniformly norm bounded.

concept.title: Operator contractive with respect to an analytic kernel
concept.description: For a standard analytic RKHS R_k with fixed approximating p_j and polynomial orthonormal basis ψ_m, T is k-contractive if p_j(T,T*) are uniformly bounded and converge weakly to C≥0, and I−∑_{m<j}ψ_m(T)Cψ_m(T)*→0 strongly.

concept.title: Arazy–Engliš dilation for kernel-contractive operators
concept.description: If T is k-contractive for a standard analytic RKHS R_k and D=closure(ranC), then Vh=∑_m ψ_m⊗C^(1/2)ψ_m(T)*h is an isometry intertwining T* with M_z*, and T is unitarily equivalent to a compression of M_z on a co-invariant subspace of R_k⊗D.

concept.title: Analytic quotient model for doubly commuting Bergman hypercontractions
concept.description: A doubly commuting tuple of pure m_i-hypercontractions is unitarily equivalent to the coordinate multipliers compressed to A²_m(D_T)⊖∑_iΘ_i A²_mhat_i(E_i), where D_T is the closed range of the product defect and each Θ_i is a one-variable partially isometric multiplier from a tensor Hardy–Bergman space.

concept.title: Tensor classification of scalar doubly commuting Bergman quotients
concept.description: A joint backward-shift-invariant subspace Q of the scalar tensor weighted Bergman space has doubly commuting compressed coordinate multipliers if and only if Q is unitarily equivalent to Q₁⊗⋯⊗Q_n with each Q_i a one-variable backward-shift-invariant Bergman subspace; each factor is the orthogonal complement of a partially isometric Hardy multiplier range.

concept.title: Darboux criterion for Riemann integrability
concept.description: A bounded function on a compact rectangle is Riemann integrable if and only if for every ε>0 there is a rectangular partition whose upper and lower Darboux sums differ by less than ε.

concept.title: Associate duality of Wiener amalgam spaces
concept.description: For1≤p,q≤∞, the Köthe associate of W(Lᵖ,ℓᵠ) under the integral pairing is W(Lᵖ′,ℓᵠ′), with norm obtained as the supremum of |∫fg| over the unit ball; when p,q<∞ this represents its continuous dual.

concept.title: Correlation summability of Wiener windows
concept.description: For g,γ∈W(L∞,ℓ¹)(ℝᵈ), let G_{a,b;n}(x)=∑_{k∈ℤᵈ}conj(g(x−n/b−ak))γ(x−ak). Then ∑_n||G_{a,b;n}||∞≤(1+1/a)ᵈ(2+2b)ᵈ||g||_W||γ||_W, and aᵈ∑_{n≠0}||G_{a,b;n}||∞→0 as a,b→0.

concept.title: Uniform Riemann sums for a Wiener-space function
concept.description: If f∈W(L∞,ℓ¹)(ℝᵈ) is locally Riemann integrable, then ess sup_y|aᵈ∑_{n∈ℤᵈ}f(y+an)−∫f|→0 as a↓0.

concept.title: L² convergence of densely sampled Gabor reconstruction
concept.description: For g,γ∈L² with⟨γ,g⟩≠0, suppose normalized self-Gabor operators S_{a,b;g,g} and S_{a,b;γ,γ} have uniformly bounded norms for0<a,b≤1. Then the normalized cross-Gabor operators are well-defined and converge strongly to the identity onL² as a,b→0.

concept.title: Adjoint-lattice coefficient summability for Feichtinger windows
concept.description: If g,γ∈S₀(ℝᵈ), then for every a,b>0, ∑_{l,n∈ℤᵈ}|⟨γ,M_{l/a}T_{n/b}g⟩|<∞.

concept.title: Logarithmic quantile bound for independent partial products
concept.description: There is a universal c>0 such that for independent random elements in a separable invariant-metric semigroup and0<t≤s≤1/2, U_n*(t)≤c log(1/t)/max{log(1/s),loglog(4/t)}[U_n*(s)+M_n*(t/2)], where U_n andM_n are partial-product and increment maxima.

concept.title: Moment bound for large-jump partial products
concept.description: For independent X₁,…,X_n in a separable invariant-metric monoid, let ℓ be the inverse increment tail-count function and U_n″(r) the maximal partial-product distance after replacing every increment with distance≤ℓ(r) by the identity. Then ||U_n″(r)||_p≤2exp(2^p r/p)||ℓ||_{Lᵖ(0,1)} for0<r<1 andp>0.

concept.title: Diameter of a Euclidean set
concept.description: The diameter of A⊂ℝⁿ is sup{|x−y|:x,y∈A}, possibly infinite.

concept.title: Euclidean unit sphere
concept.description: The unit sphere S^(n−1) is {x∈ℝⁿ:|x|=1}, with the subspace topology and its rotation-invariant surface measure when needed.

concept.title: Groemer’s Hausdorff stability of Brunn–Minkowski
concept.description: For n≥2,λ∈(0,1) and convex bodies K,L with volume ratio and normalized diameters bounded, the relative Brunn–Minkowski deficit is at least c H₀(K,L)^(n+1), where c>0 depends only on n,λ,that ratio and diameter bound; H₀ normalizes volume and centroid.

concept.title: Figalli–Maggi–Pratelli stability of Brunn–Minkowski
concept.description: For convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ and0<λ<1, the relative Brunn–Minkowski deficit is at least[nm/(ΛMθ_n²)] A(K,L)², where m=min(|K|^(1/n),|L|^(1/n)), M=max(|K|^(1/n),|L|^(1/n)), Λ=max(λ/(1−λ),(1−λ)/λ), and θ_n depends only on n.

concept.title: Square-root concavity of the torsion function
concept.description: If Ω is a bounded open convex Euclidean set and u is its zero-boundary torsion solution−Δu=c withc>0, then sqrt(u) is concave onΩ.

concept.title: Minkowski comparison of torsion functions
concept.description: If Ω_λ=(1−λ)Ω₀+λΩ₁ for bounded open convex sets and u_i solve−Δu_i=c>0 with zero boundary data inΩ_i, then sqrt(u_λ((1−λ)x+λy))≥(1−λ)sqrt(u₀(x))+λsqrt(u₁(y)) forx∈Ω₀,y∈Ω₁.

concept.title: Steiner point of a convex body
concept.description: For K⊂ℝⁿ a convex body, its Steiner point is s(K)=n∫_{S^(n−1)}u h_K(u)dσ(u), withσ the normalized rotation-invariant sphere measure. It is translation covariant and additive under Minkowski addition.

concept.title: Hadwiger’s rotational Minkowski averaging theorem
concept.description: For every convex body K there are rotationsρ_j for which k⁻¹(ρ₁K+⋯+ρ_kK) converges in Hausdorff distance to a ball with the same mean width asK. After translating K so s(K)=0, the limiting ball is centered at0.

concept.title: Proper degenerate elliptic equation operator
concept.description: A continuous scalar equation operator F(x,r,p,X) on symmetric matrices is proper degenerate elliptic in the standard sign convention if F(x,r,p,X)≤F(x,s,p,Y) wheneverr≤s andY≤X; reversing the whole equation reverses both inequalities.

concept.title: Viscosity subsolution of an elliptic equation
concept.description: An upper-semicontinuous u is a viscosity subsolution of F(x,u,Du,D²u)=0 if everyC² test functionφ touching u from above atx satisfies F(x,u(x),Dφ(x),D²φ(x))≤0, for the standard proper elliptic sign convention.

concept.title: Comparison property for viscosity Dirichlet problems
concept.description: An elliptic Dirichlet problem has the comparison property if every viscosity subsolution lying below a viscosity supersolution on the boundary lies below it throughout the domain. Supersolutions use lower semicontinuity and test functions touching from below with the reversed operator inequality.

concept.title: Time-homogeneous Markov chain on a measurable state space
concept.description: A discrete-time process (X_n) on a measurable space with a probability kernel P is Markov when P(X_(n+1)∈A|X₀,…,X_n)=P(X_n,A) almost surely for every measurable A; the same kernel is used at every step.

concept.title: Invariant probability of a Markov kernel
concept.description: A probability measure π is invariant for a Markov kernel P if ∫P(x,A)dπ(x)=π(A) for every measurable A; equivalently πP=π.

concept.title: Coupling of probability measures
concept.description: A coupling of probability measures μ and ν on measurable spaces E and F is a probability measure on E×F whose coordinate marginals are μ and ν.

concept.title: Wasserstein distance of order one for a lower semicontinuous metric
concept.description: On a Polish space E with a finite-valued metric d lower semicontinuous for its given product topology, W_d(μ,ν)=inf_(γ coupling μ,ν)∫d(x,y)dγ(x,y), allowing the value∞. The metric d need not induce the original Polish topology.

concept.title: Wasserstein Dobrushin coefficient of a Markov kernel
concept.description: For a Markov kernel P on a metric state space, its Wasserstein coefficient is τ_d(P)=sup_(x≠y)W_d(P(x,·),P(y,·))/d(x,y), allowing infinity.

concept.title: Geometric Wasserstein contraction of iterated Markov kernels
concept.description: A Markov kernel P has geometric Wasserstein contraction if τ_d(P^n)≤Cρ^n for all integers n≥0, for constants C≥1 and 0≤ρ<1. The n=0 term is the identity kernel coefficient1.

concept.title: V-uniform ergodicity of a discrete-time Markov kernel
concept.description: A Markov kernel P is V-uniformly ergodic if it has an invariant probability π with π(V)<∞ and there are C<∞ and 0≤ρ<1 such that ‖P^n(x,·)−π‖_V≤CV(x)ρ^n for all x and n≥0, for a measurable weight V≥1.

concept.title: Kantorovich–Rubinstein duality for a lower semicontinuous metric
concept.description: For probability measures μ,ν on a Polish space equipped with a finite lower semicontinuous metric d, W_d(μ,ν)=sup_f|∫f dμ−∫f dν|, where f ranges over bounded Borel functions with |f(x)−f(y)|≤d(x,y). The equality is understood in the extended nonnegative reals; finite first moments also permit arbitrary integrable1-Lipschitz tests.

concept.title: Wasserstein contraction and submultiplicativity for Markov kernels
concept.description: For Markov kernels P,Q on the declared lower-semicontinuous metric state space, W_d(μP,νP)≤τ_d(P)W_d(μ,ν) and τ_d(PQ)≤τ_d(P)τ_d(Q), whenever the products are unambiguous; the zero-coefficient case means all rows coincide.

concept.title: Weighted total variation as a Wasserstein distance
concept.description: For a lower semicontinuous weight V≥1 on a Polish space, set d_V(x,y)=(V(x)+V(y))1_(x≠y). For probabilities μ,ν with finite V-moments, W_(d_V)(μ,ν)=‖μ−ν‖_V.

concept.title: Rudolf–Schweizer Lyapunov-weighted Wasserstein perturbation bound
concept.description: Let P,Q be Markov kernels with τ_d(P^n)≤Cρ^n for n≥0, C≥1 and ρ<1. Suppose QV≤δV+L with V≥1,0≤δ<1, and κ=max(q₀(V),L/(1−δ))<∞. Put γ=sup_xW_d(P(x,·),Q(x,·))/V(x). Then W_d(p₀P^n,q₀Q^n)≤Cρ^nW_d(p₀,q₀)+Cγκ(1−ρ^n)/(1−ρ).

concept.title: Rudolf–Schweizer total-variation perturbation bound from weighted geometric ergodicity
concept.description: Suppose ‖P^n(x,·)−π‖_V≤CV(x)ρ^n with C≥1,ρ<1,V≥1, QV≤δV+L and PV≤V+L. Put κ=max(q₀(V),L/(1−δ))<∞ and γ=sup_x‖P(x,·)−Q(x,·)‖_TV/V(x). For0<γ<e^(−1), ‖p₀P^n−q₀Q^n‖_TV≤Cρ^n‖p₀−q₀‖_V+[eκ/(1−ρ)] [2C(L+1)]^(1/log(1/γ))γlog(1/γ).

concept.title: Autoregressive process of order one
concept.description: A real AR(1) process satisfies X_n=aX_(n−1)+Z_n, where (Z_n) are i.i.d. real innovations independent of X₀; the stable parameter range is |a|<1.

concept.title: Metropolis–Hastings transition kernel
concept.description: For a target probability π and proposal kernel Q, let r(x,y) be the Radon–Nikodym ratio of the reversed joint proposal law π(dy)Q(y,dx) to the forward law π(dx)Q(x,dy) on their mutually absolutely continuous part, and set r=0 on the forward-only singular part. The acceptance probability a=min(1,r) gives P(x,dy)=a(x,y)Q(x,dy)+(1−∫a(x,z)Q(x,dz))δ_x(dy).

concept.title: Bayesian posterior density
concept.description: For a prior density p(θ) and likelihood ℓ(y|θ), the posterior density given observation y is π(θ|y)=ℓ(y|θ)p(θ)/∫ℓ(y|u)p(u)du, when the denominator is positive and finite.

concept.title: Unadjusted Langevin algorithm
concept.description: For a differentiable positive target density π on ℝ^d and step h>0, the unadjusted Langevin chain is X_(n+1)=X_n+h∇logπ(X_n)+√(2h)Z_(n+1), with independent standard Gaussian vectors Z_n. It is the Euler discretization of the Langevin diffusion and generally does not preserve π exactly.

concept.title: Quadratic form with an integral symmetric matrix
concept.description: A quadratic form with an integral matrix is Q(x)=xᵀAx for a symmetric matrix A over ℤ. In the monomial expansion every mixed coefficient is even. This convention is stronger than merely requiring integer values on ℤⁿ.

concept.title: Homogeneous polynomial over a field
concept.description: A polynomial over a field in finitely many variables is homogeneous of degree d if all its nonzero monomials have total degree d. The zero polynomial is homogeneous of every degree by convention.

concept.title: Jacobian nonsingularity of a projective plane equation
concept.description: For a nonzero homogeneous polynomial F in three variables over a field K, its projective equation is Jacobian-nonsingular if no nonzero vector over an algebraic closure satisfies F=∂₁F=∂₂F=∂₃F=0. This tests the equation as a scheme, retaining multiplicities rather than replacing F by its square-free part.

concept.title: Determinant polynomial of a net of quadratic forms
concept.description: For three symmetric k×k matrices A₁,A₂,A₃ over a field, the determinant polynomial of their net is F(a₁,a₂,a₃)=det(a₁A₁+a₂A₂+a₃A₃), homogeneous of degree k. Its zero locus parametrizes singular linear combinations of the three forms.

concept.title: Quadratic net with a nonsingular determinant equation
concept.description: A triple of k-variable quadratic forms over a field of characteristic different from two has a nonsingular determinant equation if det(a₁A₁+a₂A₂+a₃A₃)=0 is a Jacobian-nonsingular projective plane equation. The condition is geometric, after extension to an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Projective complete intersection
concept.description: A projective complete intersection of codimension r in projective N-space over a field is the closed subscheme cut out by r homogeneous polynomials forming a regular sequence in the homogeneous coordinate ring. Its dimension is N−r.

concept.title: Singular locus of a projective complete intersection
concept.description: For a projective complete intersection cut out by f₁,…,f_r over a perfect field, the geometric singular locus consists of its points where the r×(N+1) matrix (∂f_i/∂x_j) has rank less than r. The empty locus has dimension −1.

concept.title: Complete quadratic exponential sum
concept.description: For an integral symmetric matrix A, positive integer q, and integer vector b, the complete quadratic exponential sum is ∑_(x∈(ℤ/qℤ)^k)exp(2πi(xᵀAx+bᵀx)/q). The sum is independent of the residue representatives.

concept.title: Smoothly weighted representation count for quadratic forms
concept.description: For integral-matrix quadratic forms Q₁,…,Q_r, a compactly supported smooth nonnegative function w on ℝᵏ, B>0, and n∈ℤʳ, the weighted representation count is R_(B,w)(n)=∑_(x∈ℤᵏ,Q_i(x)=n_i for all i)w(x/B). Compact support makes this sum finite.

concept.title: Singular integral of a system of quadratic forms
concept.description: For real quadratic forms Q₁,…,Q_r and compactly supported smooth w, put I_w(θ)=∫_(ℝᵏ)w(x)exp(2πi∑θ_iQ_i(x))dx. When I_w is integrable, the singular integral at µ∈ℝʳ is J_w(µ)=∫_(ℝʳ)I_w(θ)exp(−2πiθ·µ)dθ.

concept.title: Singular series of a system of integral quadratic forms
concept.description: For integral-matrix Q₁,…,Q_r in k variables and n∈ℤʳ, put T(n;q)=∑_(a mod q,gcd(a₁,…,a_r,q)=1)∑_(x mod q)exp(2πia·(Q(x)−n)/q). When absolutely convergent, the singular series is S(n)=∑_(q≥1)q^(−k)T(n;q).

concept.title: p-adic solution density of a polynomial system
concept.description: For r integer polynomials f_i in k variables, their p-adic solution density at n is lim_(e→∞)p^(e(r−k))#{x mod pᵉ:f_i(x)≡n_i mod pᵉ for all i}, when this limit exists. The normalization uses the expected codimension r.

concept.title: Bounded-degree affine finite-field point upper bound
concept.description: For an affine variety V⊆𝔸ʳ over 𝔽_q of dimension n cut out by boundedly many equations of bounded degrees, #V(𝔽_q)=O(qⁿ), with the implied constant depending only on the ambient dimension, number of equations and degree bound.

concept.title: Deligne–Hooley point bound for projective complete intersections
concept.description: For a projective complete intersection V of dimension n over 𝔽_q with geometric singular locus of dimension s, #V(𝔽_q)=1+q+⋯+qⁿ+O(q^((n+s+1)/2)); the constant can be bounded in terms of the ambient dimension and defining degrees. Use s=−1 if V is smooth.

concept.title: Integer sublevel bound for a homogeneous polynomial
concept.description: If P∈ℚ[x₁,…,x_s] is nonzero homogeneous of positive degree d, then for M,N≥1 the number of x∈ℤˢ with max|x_i|≤N and |P(x)|≤M is O_P(N^(s−1)M^(1/d)).

concept.title: Prime-power sublevel bound for a homogeneous polynomial
concept.description: For a nonzero homogeneous P∈ℤ[x₁,…,x_s] of positive degree d, uniformly for primes p and integers f≥0, #{x∈(ℤ/pᶠℤ)ˢ:P(x)≡0 mod pᶠ}=O_P(p^(sf−f/d)).

concept.title: Multivariate Hensel lifting with a nonunit Jacobian determinant
concept.description: Let F∈ℤ_p[x₁,…,x_r]ʳ and a∈ℤ_pʳ. If v_p(det DF(a))=ν<∞ and F(a)≡0 mod p^(2ν+1), then F has a zero b∈ℤ_pʳ with b≡a mod p^(ν+1).

concept.title: Rank characterization of a nonsingular quadratic determinant net
concept.description: For k≥4 over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two, a quadratic net has a Jacobian-nonsingular determinant equation exactly when every nonzero combination of its matrices has rank at least k−1 and the common projective zero set has its three gradients linearly independent at every point.

concept.title: Discriminant polynomial detecting singular fibers of a quadratic net
concept.description: For a k-variable integral quadratic net with nonsingular determinant equation, there is a nonzero homogeneous H_Q∈ℤ[n₁,n₂,n₃], of positive degree at most 2(k+1)k(k−1), such that, over any algebraically closed field of characteristic zero or odd characteristic where the specialized determinant equation remains nonsingular, H_Q(n)=0 exactly when some x with Q(x)=n has Jacobian rank below three.

concept.title: Minor-arc mean-square estimate for three quadratic forms
concept.description: For an integral quadratic net Q in k≥10 variables with nonsingular determinant equation, let S_B(α)=∑_(x∈ℤᵏ)w(x/B)exp(2πiα·Q(x)). For 0<Δ<1/13, remove the boxes |α_j−a_j/q|≤B^(−2+Δ) around primitive tuples with q≤B^Δ in (ℝ/ℤ)³, obtaining m(Δ). Then ∫_(m(Δ))|S_B(α)|²dα≪_(Q,w,ε,Δ)B^(2k−6−6Δ+ε).

concept.title: Mean-square representation asymptotic for a nonsingular quadratic net
concept.description: For an integral quadratic net Q in k≥10 variables with nonsingular determinant equation and compactly supported smooth nonnegative w, there is a polynomial H_Q detecting singular fibers, of degree at most 2(k+1)k(k−1), for which ∑_(|n|∞≤B²,H_Q(n)≠0)|R_(B,w)(n)−J_w(B^(−2)n)S(n)B^(k−6)|²≪_(Q,w)B^(2k−6−1/28).

concept.title: Almost-all representation asymptotic for three quadratic forms
concept.description: For an integral quadratic net Q in k≥10 variables with nonsingular determinant equation, N=B² and 0<ϖ<1/56, all but O_(Q,w,ϖ)(N^(3−(1/56−ϖ))) integer triples |n|∞≤N satisfy R_(B,w)(n)=J_w(B^(−2)n)S(n)B^(k−6)+O_(Q,w,ϖ)(B^(k−6−ϖ)).

concept.title: Local-density bounds for three quadratic forms
concept.description: For an integral quadratic net Q in k>6 variables with nonsingular determinant equation and H_Q(n)≠0, S(n)≪_ε|n|∞^ε. If Q(x)=n is soluble in every ℤ_p, then S(n)≫_ε|n|∞^(−ε)∏_(p≤p₀)|H_Q(n)|_p^α>0, with α=3^(k+3)(2k−6). Also J_w is bounded, and for w positive on a sufficiently large fixed ball, J_w(µ)≫_w|H_Q(µ)|^β for real-soluble fibers with 1/2≤|µ|∞≤1, where β=3^(k+3)(2k−7).

concept.title: Average integral Hasse principle for three quadratic forms
concept.description: For k≥10 there is ϖ(k)>0 such that, for every integral quadratic net Q in k variables with nonsingular determinant equation, the number of n∈ℤ³ with |n|∞≤N for which Q(x)=n is soluble over ℝ and every ℤ_p but not over ℤ is O_Q(N^(3−ϖ(k))).

concept.title: Simultaneous prime values of three quadratic forms
concept.description: Let Q be an integral quadratic net in k≥10 variables with nonsingular determinant equation. If some real x has Q_i(x)>0 for all i, and for every prime p some x_p∈ℤ_pᵏ has p∤∏_(i=1)^3Q_i(x_p), then infinitely many triples of rational primes are simultaneously represented by Q on ℤᵏ.

concept.title: Monotone real function
concept.description: A real function on a linearly ordered set is nondecreasing if x≤y impliesf(x)≤f(y), and nonincreasing if the reverse inequality holds; monotone means either.

concept.title: Quasi-concave function
concept.description: A real functionf on a convex set is quasi-concave if f((1−t)x+ty)≥min(f(x),f(y)) for0≤t≤1, equivalently all its superlevel sets are convex.

concept.title: Rotational invariance of a scalar elliptic operator
concept.description: An operatorF(x,r,p,X) is rotationally invariant if F(ρx,r,ρp,ρXρᵀ)=F(x,r,p,X) for everyρ∈SO(n), with the same equation domain after rotating its spatial argument.

concept.title: Positive inward boundary derivative condition
concept.description: A differentiable functionu>0 on a domainΩ with zero boundary data satisfies the positive inward derivative condition if for everyx∈∂Ω and every inward directionν atx, liminf_{Ω∋y→x}∂_νu(y)>0.

concept.title: Power-transformed elliptic quasi-concavity condition
concept.description: For0<p<1 defineG_{i,p}^θ(x,t,A)=F_i(x,t^(1/p),t^(1/p−1)θ,t^(1/p−3)A). The mixed quasi-concavity condition atλ asksG_{λ,p}^θ((1−λ)ξ₀+λξ₁)≥min(G_{0,p}^θ(ξ₀),G_{1,p}^θ(ξ₁)) forξ_i=(x_i,t_i,A_i),t_i>0 and every fixedθ. Atp=0 useG_{i,0}^θ(x,t,A)=F_i(x,e^t,e^tθ,e^tA).

concept.title: Power-Minkowski subsolution principle for elliptic equations
concept.description: Letu_i be positive classical zero-boundary solutions on bounded convexΩ_i,0≤p<1. If their equation operators satisfy the power-transformed mixed quasi-concavity condition atλ, and whenp>0 the positive inward boundary derivative condition holds, then theirp-Minkowski convolution is a viscosity subsolution of the equation on(1−λ)Ω₀+λΩ₁.

concept.title: Mean-width rearrangement comparison for elliptic solutions
concept.description: Letu solve a rotationally invariant proper elliptic zero-boundary problem on a bounded convexΩ and satisfy the positive inward boundary derivative condition. If0<p<1 and each transformedG_p^θ has convex nonnegative superlevel set in(x,t,A), then the corresponding solutionv on the ballΩ♯ of equal mean width satisfies||v||_r≥||u||_r for every0<r≤∞.

concept.title: Uniform-limit stability of viscosity subsolutions
concept.description: For a continuous proper degenerate elliptic operatorF, a locally uniform limitu of viscosity subsolutionsu_j is a viscosity subsolution, provided the domains eventually contain every compact subset of the limiting open domain.

concept.title: Layer-cake representation of a nonnegative moment
concept.description: For a σ-finite measure μ, a measurable u≥0 and q>0, ∫u^q dμ=q∫_0^∞t^(q−1)μ({u>t})dt, allowing infinity.

concept.title: Dirichlet rational approximation of one real number
concept.description: For every irrational real θ and positive integer N there are integers p and 1≤q≤N with 0<|θ−p/q|<1/(qN). In particular infinitely many distinct rationals satisfy |θ−p/q|<1/q².

concept.title: Lower bound two for the irrationality exponent
concept.description: Every irrational real number θ has irrationality exponent μ(θ)≥2.

concept.title: Reciprocal invariance of the irrationality exponent
concept.description: For every nonzero irrational real θ, μ(1/θ)=μ(θ), including infinite values.

concept.title: Wallis power-integral bounds
concept.description: There are constants c,C>0 such that for every integer n≥1, c/√n≤∫₀^(π/2)sinⁿx dx≤C/√n; the identical bounds hold with cosine in place of sine.

concept.title: Principal real arccosine
concept.description: The principal real arccosine arccos:[−1,1]→[0,π] is the inverse of the restriction of cosine to [0,π].

concept.title: Logarithmic real power-series identity
Necessary zero-term condition for a real series
concept.description: If a real series ∑_(n≥1)a_n converges, then a_n→0.

concept.title: Transpose of a matrix
concept.description: For anm×n matrixA=(a_ij), the transposedn×m matrixAᵀ has entries(Aᵀ)_ij=a_ji.

concept.title: Measure-preserving transformation
concept.description: A measurable map T from a measure space (Ω,F,μ) to itself preserves μ if μ(T⁻¹A)=μ(A) for every measurable A.

concept.title: Ergodic measure-preserving transformation
concept.description: A probability-preserving transformation T is ergodic if every measurable set A with μ(T⁻¹A△A)=0 has μ(A) equal0 or1.

concept.title: Stationary random sequence
concept.description: A sequence (E_n) is stationary if, for every m≥1 and shift k≥0, the joint laws of (E₀,…,E_(m−1)) and (E_k,…,E_(k+m−1)) agree.

concept.title: Ergodic stationary random sequence
concept.description: A stationary random sequence is ergodic when its induced probability measure on sequence space is ergodic under the left shift.

concept.title: Discrete-time random dynamical system
concept.description: Over a measure-preserving transformation θ of an environmental probability space, a discrete random dynamical system is a measurable cocycle φ(n,ω,x) with φ(0,ω,x)=x and φ(n+m,ω,x)=φ(n,θ^mω,φ(m,ω,x)). It is continuous if x↦φ(n,ω,x) is continuous.

concept.title: Absorbing set for a Markov chain
concept.description: A measurable set A is absorbing for a Markov kernel P if P(x,A)=1 for every x∈A; after the chain enters A it stays in A.

concept.title: Quasi-stationary distribution of an absorbing Markov chain
concept.description: For a Markov chain absorbed almost surely in A, a quasi-stationary distribution is a probability μ supported on Aᶜ and a number0<λ<1 with ∫P(x,B)dμ(x)=λμ(B) for every measurable B⊆Aᶜ. Thus the law started from μ remains μ after conditioning on survival for any positive number of steps.

concept.title: Small random perturbation of a discrete map
concept.description: For a continuous map F:S→S on a metric space, a family of Markov kernels P_ε is a small random perturbation if for every δ>0, sup_(x∈S)P_ε(x,{y:d(y,F(x))≥δ}) tends to0 as ε tends to0.

concept.title: Large deviation principle at small-noise speed1/ε
concept.description: A family of probability measures μ_ε on a topological space satisfies an LDP with speed1/ε and lower semicontinuous rate I:S→[0,∞] if liminf_(ε↓0)εlogμ_ε(U)≥−inf_UI for every open U and limsup_(ε↓0)εlogμ_ε(C)≤−inf_CI for every closed C; log0=−∞.

concept.title: Attractor of a continuous discrete map
concept.description: For a continuous map F on a metric space, an attractor is a compact invariant set A with a neighborhood U such that for every neighborhood V of A, F^n(U)⊆V for all sufficiently large n.

concept.title: Omega limit set of a forward orbit
concept.description: For a forward orbit x_n=F^n(x) in a metric space, its omega limit set is the set of limits of subsequences x_(n_j) with n_j tending to positive infinity.

concept.title: Alpha limit set of a complete orbit
concept.description: For a complete orbit (x_n) indexed by all integers with x_(n+1)=F(x_n), its alpha limit set consists of limits of subsequences x_(n_j) with n_j tending to negative infinity.

concept.title: Morse decomposition of discrete dynamics
concept.description: On a compact invariant set, a Morse decomposition is a finite ordered family of disjoint isolated compact invariant sets K₁,…,K_m such that every complete orbit outside their union has its alpha limit in one K_j and omega limit in a K_i with j<i. Isolated means maximal invariant in some neighborhood.

concept.title: Empirical measure of a discrete trajectory
concept.description: For states X₀,…,X_n in a measurable space, their empirical measure is (n+1)⁻¹∑_(j=0)^nδ_(X_j); its mass on a measurable set is the fraction of sampled states lying in that set.

concept.title: Stochastic persistence by empirical occupation near extinction
concept.description: For a stochastic population process on a compact metric state space S with closed extinction set S₀, empirical stochastic persistence means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that, from each x∉S₀, almost surely limsup_(n→∞)(n+1)⁻¹#{0≤j≤n:d(X_j,S₀)≤δ}≤ε.

concept.title: Top Lyapunov exponent of a matrix product
concept.description: For a sequence of random matrices B_n, the top Lyapunov exponent is the limit r=lim_(n→∞)n⁻¹log‖B_n⋯B₁‖ when it exists almost surely and is constant. Existence and equality with a particular vector’s growth require additional hypotheses.

concept.title: Structured stochastic population difference equation
concept.description: For n species with state vectors X_i∈ℝ_(≥0)^(k_i), a structured stochastic population map has updates X_(i,t+1)=A_i(X_t,E_(t+1))X_(i,t), where A_i are continuous nonnegative matrix-valued functions of community state and a stationary ergodic environmental sequence.

concept.title: Invasion growth rate of a structured population in a stationary environment
concept.description: For a stationary ergodic community/environment trajectory and an absent species i with linearized update Z_(t+1)=A_i(X_t,E_(t+1))Z_t, its invasion growth rate is the almost-sure asymptotic per-capita rate lim_(t→∞)t⁻¹log‖Z_t‖ when the positive-matrix hypotheses make it independent of the positive initial direction.

concept.title: Exponential discrete Lotka–Volterra map
concept.description: For an interaction matrix A and intrinsic growth vector r, the exponential discrete Lotka–Volterra map on the nonnegative orthant is F_i(x)=x_i exp(r_i+∑_jA_(ij)x_j).

concept.title: Poisson Lotka–Volterra process
concept.description: With habitat scale ε>0 and an exponential discrete Lotka–Volterra map F, let population counts update conditionally independently as N_(i,t+1)|X_t∼Poisson(F_i(X_t)/ε), and set X_(i,t+1)=εN_(i,t+1). The density process lives on εℤ_(≥0)^k and coordinate extinction is absorbing.

concept.title: Ricker population map
concept.description: The Ricker map is the nonnegative population update F(x)=x exp(r(1−x)) with r>0, using carrying-capacity scale1.

concept.title: Primitive nonnegative matrix
concept.description: A square matrix with nonnegative real entries is primitive if some positive integer power has all entries strictly positive.

concept.title: C^k map between open Euclidean sets
concept.description: For an integer k≥0, a map between open Euclidean sets is of class C^k if every component partial derivative of total order at most k exists and is continuous; order zero means the component itself. A C^∞ map has this property for every finite k.

concept.title: Continuity of finite-dimensional operator inversion
concept.description: For a nonzero finite-dimensional normed space X, invertible operators form an open subset of L(X), and A↦A⁻¹ is continuous in operator norm. More precisely, if A is invertible and ‖A−B‖<1/‖A⁻¹‖ then B is invertible.

concept.title: Lipschitz bound from a bounded Euclidean derivative
concept.description: If U⊆ℝⁿ is convex and open, f:U→ℝᵐ is Fréchet differentiable, and ‖Df(x)‖≤M throughout U, then ‖f(x)−f(y)‖≤M‖x−y‖ for every x,y∈U.

concept.title: Continuous partial derivatives and continuous Fréchet differentiability
concept.description: For a map between open Euclidean sets, continuous first coordinate partial derivatives are equivalent to existence of a continuous Fréchet derivative. The derivative is represented by the matrix of those partial derivatives.

concept.title: Dirichlet simultaneous rational approximation
concept.description: For α∈ℝᵈ and an integer N≥1 there are integers 1≤q≤Nᵈ and p₁,…,p_d with max_j|qα_j−p_j|<1/N. If a common divisor is cancelled from (p₁,…,p_d,q), the resulting approximation errors |α_j−p_j/q| do not increase.

concept.title: Kirszbraun extension theorem for Hilbert spaces
concept.description: EveryL-Lipschitz map from a subset of a real Hilbert space to a real Hilbert space extends to the whole domain Hilbert space with the same Lipschitz constant. Complex Hilbert spaces may be viewed as real for this metric assertion.

concept.title: Continuous short-time Fourier reconstruction
concept.description: Forφ∈L²(ℝᵈ) nonzero, f∈L² andV_φf∈L¹(ℝ²ᵈ), f=||φ||₂⁻²∫_{ℝ²ᵈ}V_φf(z)π(z)φdz as an absolutely convergentL²-valued Bochner integral, whereπ(z) is the time-frequency shift.

concept.title: Quadratic bounds for the scalar arithmetic–harmonic gap
concept.description: For0<v<1 and0<a<b, withA_v=va+(1−v)b andH_v=(v/a+(1−v)/b)⁻¹, v(1−v)(1−a/b)²a≤A_v−H_v≤v(1−v)(1−b/a)²b. The factorv(1−v) is sharp asb/a→1.

concept.title: Spectral-interval upper bound for the matrix arithmetic–harmonic gap
concept.description: For positive definite matrices satisfying0<mI≤A≤B≤MI and0≤v≤1, A∇_vB−A!_vB≤v(1−v)(1−M/m)²B, whereA∇_vB=vA+(1−v)B andA!_vB=(vA⁻¹+(1−v)B⁻¹)⁻¹.

concept.title: Powered determinant refinement of the arithmetic–harmonic inequality
concept.description: For positive definiteA,B∈M_n(ℂ),0<v≤τ<1 andλ≥1, (v/τ)^λ det(A∇_τB−A!_τB)^(λ/n)≤det(A∇_vB)^(λ/n)−det(A!_vB)^(λ/n), using the same arithmetic/harmonic weight convention.

concept.title: Intrinsic finite balls imply graph cutoff completeness
concept.description: A locally finite weighted graph admitting an intrinsic pseudometricρ for which every finite-radius ball has finite cardinality isΓ-cutoff complete: there are finitely supported0≤η_k≤1 increasing pointwise to1 withΓ(η_k)≤1/k.

concept.title: Uniqueness of natural finite-subset extension families
concept.description: Fix1≤m<n. There is exactly one familyT_X:C(σ_m(2^X))→C(σ_n(2^X)) indexed by finite setsX, consisting of linear extension operators uniformly bounded inX, and natural under every injectionu:Y→X via pullbackf(χ_A)↦f(χ_{u⁻¹(A)}).

concept.title: Moment equivalence with truncated partial-product quantiles
concept.description: For everyp₀>0, constants depending only onp₀ give ||U_n||_p≈U_n*(e^(−p)/4)+||ℓ||_p≈(U_n′(e^(−p)/8))*(e^(−p)/4)+||ℓ||_p forp≥p₀ and any finite independent sequence in a separable abelian invariant-metric monoid. Hereℓ is the inverse increment tail-count function on(0,1), andU_n′(r) is the maximal partial-product distance after deleting increments larger thanℓ(r).

concept.title: Kernel of a module homomorphism
concept.description: For an R-module homomorphism f:M→N, its kernel is the submodule {x∈M:f(x)=0}.

concept.title: Cokernel of a module homomorphism
concept.description: For an R-module homomorphism f:M→N, its cokernel is the quotient module N/f(M).

concept.title: Exact sequence of modules
concept.description: A sequence of homomorphisms of modules over one commutative ring is exact at a module if the image of the incoming map equals the kernel of the outgoing map; it is exact if this holds at every term.

concept.title: Snake lemma for modules
concept.description: For a commuting diagram of R-modules with exact rows 0→A→B→C→0 and 0→A′→B′→C′→0 and vertical maps a,b,c, there is a natural exact sequence 0→ker a→ker b→ker c→coker a→coker b→coker c→0.

concept.title: S-unit group of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K and a finite set S of its places containing all archimedean places, its S-unit group is E_S={x∈K×:|x|_v=1 for every v∉S}. The definition is independent of the representative absolute value of each place.

concept.title: Finite generation of the S-unit group
concept.description: For a number field K and finite S containing the infinite places, the S-unit group is isomorphic to μ(K)×ℤʳ for a finite integer r, where μ(K) is the finite group of roots of unity in K.

concept.title: L-primary character dual of an abelian pro-l group
concept.description: For an abelian pro-ℓ group G, its ℓ-primary character dual is G∨=Hom_cont(G,ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ), where the target and the dual group have the discrete topology. For a discrete ℓ-primary torsion group A, write A∨=Hom(A,ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ) with the topology of pointwise convergence.

concept.title: Character biduality for abelian pro-l groups
concept.description: Evaluation identifies every abelian pro-ℓ group G with (G∨)∨. Under this duality the maximal divisible subgroup of G∨ corresponds to the maximal quotient of G isomorphic to a product of copies of ℤ_ℓ; its coordinate quotients correspond to continuous characters G→ℤ_ℓ.

concept.title: Perfect Kummer character pairing
concept.description: Let n=ℓʳ be invertible in a field F containing μ_n, D⊆F×/(F×)ⁿ a subgroup, and L=F(x^(1/n):[x]∈D). Then Gal(L/F)×D→μ_n, (σ,[x])↦σ(x^(1/n))/x^(1/n), is a perfect character pairing. Passing to limits gives Gal(L/F) and the universal ℓ-primary Kummer radical as character duals over fields containing all ℓ-power roots of unity.

concept.title: Universal-radical invariants in a cyclotomic tower
concept.description: For K containing μ_(2ℓ) and K∞/K its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension, the natural map ℛ_(K_n)→ℛ_(K∞) is injective and has image ℛ_(K∞)^(Gal(K∞/K_n)).

concept.title: Tate’s cyclotomic invariant quotient for the l-primary K2
concept.description: For K containing μ_(2ℓ), let I_n=(T_ℓ(μ)⊗_(ℤ_ℓ)ℛ_(K∞))^(Gal(K∞/K_n)). The ℓ-primary torsion subgroup of K₂^M(K_n) is canonically I_n/(I_n)_div, where (I_n)_div denotes its maximal divisible subgroup.

concept.title: Cyclotomic binomial unit congruence
concept.description: Let ℓ be prime and m≥1, with m≥2 if ℓ=2. For every n≥0, ((1+ℓᵐ)^(ℓⁿ)−1)/ℓ^(m+n) belongs to 1+ℓℤ_ℓ. In particular its numerator has ℓ-adic valuation m+n.

concept.title: Exact sequence for rationalizing a Z_l-module
concept.description: For a ℤ_ℓ-module M let M_tor={x:ℓʳx=0 for some r≥0}. There is an exact sequence 0→M/M_tor→ℚ_ℓ⊗_(ℤ_ℓ)M→(ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)⊗_(ℤ_ℓ)M→0 induced by ℤ_ℓ⊆ℚ_ℓ.

concept.title: Hermitian complex matrix
concept.description: A square complex matrix A is Hermitian if its conjugate transpose A* equals A; equivalently A_(ij)=overline(A_(ji)) for every i,j.

concept.title: John ellipsoid theorem
concept.description: For every convex bodyK⊂ℝⁿ, an affine change of coordinates putsK between the unit Euclidean ball and then-fold dilate of that ball.

concept.title: Brenier transport between uniform convex-body measures
concept.description: For convex bodiesE,F of positive volume, there is a convex functionφ whose gradientT pushes the uniform probability onE to that onF; this map is unique almost everywhere among gradients of convex functions with that pushforward property.

concept.title: Smooth boundary regularity of convex transport
concept.description: The Brenier map between uniform measures on bounded smooth uniformly convex domains is a smooth diffeomorphism up to the boundary, and its Jacobian determinant is|F|/|E| for sourceE and targetF.

concept.title: Coarea formula for a smooth scalar function
concept.description: For a smooth real functionf on an open subset ofℝⁿ and a nonnegative measurableg, ∫g(x)|∇f(x)|dx=∫_ℝ∫_{f⁻¹(t)}g(x)dH^(n−1)(x)dt, allowing infinity.

concept.title: Sard theorem for a smooth scalar function
concept.description: For a smooth functionf:Ω⊂ℝⁿ→ℝ, the set of critical valuesf({x:Df(x)=0}) has Lebesgue measure zero.

concept.title: Anisotropic perimeter defined by a support function
concept.description: For a convex bodyK containing0 in its interior and a bounded Lipschitz domainE, P_K(E)=∫_{∂E}h_K(ν_E)dH^(n−1), whereν_E is the outward unit normal.

concept.title: Wulff anisotropic isoperimetric inequality
concept.description: For a convex bodyK containing0 in its interior and a bounded Lipschitz domainE, P_K(E)≥n|K|^(1/n)|E|^((n−1)/n).

concept.title: Quadratic control by the arithmetic–geometric mean defect
concept.description: For positiveλ₁≤⋯≤λ_n, letλ_A=n⁻¹∑λ_i andλ_G=(∏λ_i)^(1/n). Then ∑_i(λ_i−λ_G)²≤7n²λ_n(λ_A−λ_G).

concept.title: Smooth uniformly convex approximation of convex bodies
concept.description: Every Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of smooth uniformly convex bodies. Volume and symmetric-difference volume converge under such approximation of full-dimensional bodies.

concept.title: Singular values of a complex matrix
concept.description: For a complex m×n matrix M, its singular values σ₁≥⋯≥σ_q≥0, q=min(m,n), are the nonnegative square roots of the eigenvalues of M*M, with the additional forced zero eigenvalues omitted when n>m.

concept.title: Schatten norm of a finite matrix
concept.description: For a real or complex matrix M with singular values σ_j and1≤p<∞, its Schatten p-norm is ‖M‖_p=(∑σ_j^p)^(1/p); ‖M‖_∞=maxσ_j is the operator norm. The p=1 case is the nuclear norm and p=2 is the Frobenius norm.

concept.title: Singular-value rank truncation
concept.description: For an SVD M=∑_(j=1)^qσ_j u_jv_j*, choose M_r=∑_(j≤r)σ_j u_jv_j* and M_c=M−M_r. Repeated singular values can make the choice nonunique, while the singular values and Schatten norms of the head and tail are well defined.

concept.title: Linear matrix measurement map
concept.description: For fixed matrices A₁,…,A_m of the same size as X, a linear matrix measurement map sends X to (tr(XA_j*))_(j=1)^m. On Hermitian matrices with Hermitian A_j, this takes real values; noisy data have the form b=A(X)+w.

concept.title: Nuclear norm minimization for noisy matrix recovery
concept.description: Given a linear matrix measurement map A, data b and tolerance η≥0, nuclear norm recovery chooses a minimizer of ‖Z‖₁ subject to ‖A(Z)−b‖₂≤η; with η=0 this imposes A(Z)=b. Uniqueness and stable recovery require further hypotheses on A.

concept.title: Frobenius robust rank null space property
concept.description: A linear matrix measurement map A has the Frobenius robust rank null space property of order r with constants0<ρ<1 and τ>0 if, for every matrix M, ‖M_r‖₂≤ρ‖M_c‖₁/√r+τ‖A(M)‖_(ℓ²), where M_r is its singular-value rank-r truncation and M_c its tail.

concept.title: Stable rank null space property
concept.description: A linear matrix measurement map A has the stable rank null space property of order r with constant0<ρ<1 if ‖M_r‖₁≤ρ‖M_c‖₁ for every M in kerA.

concept.title: Rank restricted isometry property
concept.description: A linear matrix measurement map A has the rank-r restricted isometry property with constant δ∈[0,1) if (1−δ)‖X‖_F²≤‖A(X)‖_(ℓ²)²≤(1+δ)‖X‖_F² for every matrix X of rank at most r.

concept.title: Phase retrieval from quadratic measurements
concept.description: Phase retrieval asks to recover a real or complex vector x from intensities |a_j*x|². In the complex case x is identifiable only up to multiplication by a scalar of modulus1; lifting X=xx* turns these observations into linear rank-one matrix measurements tr(a_ja_j*X).

concept.title: Finite-dimensional density matrix
concept.description: A density matrix is a positive semidefinite complex matrix with trace1; its rank measures the number of nonzero eigenvalues in its spectral decomposition.

concept.title: Finite-dimensional positive operator-valued measure
concept.description: A finite POVM on ℂⁿ is a finite collection of positive semidefinite matrices E_j with ∑E_j=I. For a density matrix X, its outcome probabilities are tr(E_jX).

concept.title: Rank-restricted informational completeness
concept.description: A finite POVM is rank-r informationally complete if every two distinct density matrices X,Z of rank at most r have tr(E_jX)≠tr(E_jZ) for some POVM element E_j.

concept.title: Weighted approximate complex projective t-design
concept.description: For unit vectors w_i∈ℂⁿ and weights p_i≥0 summing to1, the weighted family is an approximate projective t-design of Schatten-p accuracy θ if ‖∑p_i(w_iw_i*)^(⊗t)−∫_(‖w‖₂=1)(ww*)^(⊗t)dσ(w)‖_p≤θ/binom(n+t−1,t), where σ is uniform spherical probability. Accuracy0 gives an exact design.

concept.title: Standard complex Gaussian vector
concept.description: A standard complex Gaussian vector has independent coordinates (g_j+ih_j)/√2, where all g_j,h_j are independent real N(0,1) variables; thus E|a_j|²=1.

concept.title: Rademacher random sequence
concept.description: A Rademacher sequence consists of independent random variables ε_j with P(ε_j=1)=P(ε_j=−1)=1/2.

concept.title: Gaussian width of a Euclidean set
concept.description: For T⊆ℝᵈ, its Gaussian width is w(T)=E sup_(x∈T)⟨g,x⟩ for a standard Gaussian vector g∈ℝᵈ, whenever the supremum is measurable; in the compact finite-dimensional sets used here it is finite.

concept.title: Spectral condition number of an invertible matrix
concept.description: For an invertible square real or complex matrix W, its spectral condition number is κ(W)=σ_max(W)/σ_min(W)=‖W‖_(op)‖W⁻¹‖_(op).

concept.title: Positive semidefinite matrix square root
concept.description: For a positive semidefinite complex matrix W=Udiag(λ_j)U*, its positive square root is W^(1/2)=Udiag(√λ_j)U*; this does not depend on the chosen orthonormal eigenbasis.

concept.title: Nuclear singular-value perturbation inequality
concept.description: For complex matrices X,Y of equal size with singular values in decreasing order, ∑_j|σ_j(X)−σ_j(Y)|≤‖X−Y‖₁.

concept.title: Schatten tail bound from the nuclear norm
concept.description: For a matrix M,1≤r≤min(m,n) and1≤p<∞, its singular-value tail satisfies ‖M_c‖_p≤r^(1/p−1)‖M‖₁.

concept.title: Schatten error bound under the Frobenius robust rank null space property
concept.description: If A has Frobenius robust rank null space constants0<ρ<1,τ>0 of order r, then for1≤p≤2 and all X,Z, ‖Z−X‖_p≤(1+ρ)²[(1−ρ)r^(1−1/p)]⁻¹(‖Z‖₁−‖X‖₁+2‖X_c‖₁)+τ(3+ρ)(1−ρ)⁻¹r^(1/p−1/2)‖A(Z−X)‖_(ℓ²). Consequently any nuclear-norm minimizer with noise at mostη obeys the p=2 bound2(1+ρ)²[(1−ρ)√r]⁻¹‖X_c‖₁+2τ(3+ρ)(1−ρ)⁻¹η.

concept.title: Null space characterization of uniform nuclear-norm exact recovery
concept.description: For a linear matrix measurement map A, every matrix X of rank at most r is the unique nuclear-norm minimizer with data A(X) if and only if ‖M_r‖₁<‖M_c‖₁ for every nonzero M∈kerA.

concept.title: Second-countable topological space
concept.description: A topological space is second countable if it has a countable basis: a sequence of open sets such that every open set is their union over some index set.

concept.title: Measurable state space of a dynamical system
concept.description: For a probability-preserving transformation S of (Y,F,m), a state space is a measurable map π:Y→X to a measurable space. It carries π_*m and is identified inside Y with the sub-σ-algebra π⁻¹F_X; S need not induce a map on X.

concept.title: Koopman operator of a probability-preserving transformation
concept.description: For a probability-preserving transformation S, its Koopman operator on L^p,1≤p≤∞, is U_Sf=f∘S. It is an isometry; for invertible S with measurable inverse it is unitary on complex L².

concept.title: Multiplication by a bounded measurable function on L²
concept.description: For a bounded measurable function h on a measure space, the multiplication operator M_h on L² sends f to hf; its operator norm is the essential supremum of|h|.

concept.title: Compressed Koopman averaging operator
concept.description: For a measurable dynamical state space with conditional expectation P_Xf=E[f|F_X], its averaging operator is T=P_XU_SP_X on L²(Y), restricted when desired to L²(F_X). This is a contraction and fixes constants; the family P_XU_S^nP_X need not equal T^n.

concept.title: Markov module property for a compressed Koopman operator
concept.description: A probability-preserving system with state σ-algebra F_X has the Markov module property if there is a closed U_S-invariant subspace M⊆L²(Y), containing L²(F_X) and stable under multiplication by every bounded F_X-measurable function, such that P_XU_SP_Xf=P_XU_Sf for every f∈M.

concept.title: Twisted compression identity under the Markov module property
concept.description: If a compressed Koopman state space has the Markov module property, then P_X(M_hU_SM_h)^nP_X=(M_hTM_h)^n for every bounded F_X-measurable h and n≥1. In particular P_XU_S^nP_X=T^n.

concept.title: Binary Pinsker inequality
concept.description: For a,b∈[0,1], the binary relative entropy D(a‖b)=a log(a/b)+(1−a)log((1−a)/(1−b)) satisfies D(a‖b)≥2(a−b)², using the usual zero/infinite endpoint conventions.

concept.title: Large-deviation bound for a Koopman state space with the Markov module property
concept.description: Let a probability-preserving system with state space X have the Markov module property, and let its averaging operator satisfy0<λ=‖T‖_(L²₀(X))<1. For an X-measurable0≤φ≤1 with p=∫φdm∈(0,1), set A_n=n⁻¹∑_(i=0)^(n−1)φ∘S^i. If η∈[p,1], k≥1 and θ=λ^k≤(η−p)/(1−p), then m(A_n≥η)≤k exp(D(η‖p)) exp(−nD(η‖θ+(1−θ)p)/k). If η∈[0,p] and θ≤(p−η)/p, the analogous lower-tail bound replaces the last entropy by D(η‖(1−θ)p).

concept.title: Entropy of a finite measurable partition
concept.description: For a finite measurable partition ξ of a probability space, H_m(ξ)=−∑_(A∈ξ)m(A)logm(A), with0log0=0. The join ξ∨η consists of the nonempty intersections of their atoms.

concept.title: Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy of a probability-preserving transformation
concept.description: For a probability-preserving transformation S and finite measurable partition ξ, set h_m(S,ξ)=lim_(n→∞)n⁻¹H_m(∨_(i=0)^(n−1)S^(-i)ξ), equivalently the infimum over n by entropy subadditivity. Its measure entropy is h_m(S)=sup_ξh_m(S,ξ), possibly infinite.

concept.title: Two-sided metric Bowen ball
concept.description: For an invertible map S of a metric space, the two-sided Bowen ball of radius r and length2n+1 about y is {z:d(S^iz,S^iy)<r for every−n≤i≤n}.

concept.title: Shannon–McMillan–Breiman theorem for a finite partition
concept.description: For an invertible ergodic probability-preserving transformation S and finite measurable partition ξ, −(2n+1)⁻¹logm((∨_(i=−n)^nS^(-i)ξ)(y)) converges almost surely to h_m(S,ξ), where the expression uses the atom containing y.

concept.title: Entropy approximation by increasing generating finite partitions
concept.description: If finite measurable partitions ξ_l increase and their generated σ-algebra is the whole probability σ-algebra modulo null sets, then h_m(S,ξ_l) increases to h_m(S) for a probability-preserving transformation S.

concept.title: Local entropy lower bound on a second-countable metric space
concept.description: Let S be an invertible continuous ergodic probability-preserving transformation with measurable inverse on a second-countable metric space with Borel probability m and finite h_m(S). Then for m-almost every y, lim_(r↓0)liminf_(n→∞)−(2n+1)⁻¹logm(B_r^(-n,n)(y))≥h_m(S).

concept.title: Lattice in a locally compact group
concept.description: A lattice in a locally compact group G is a discrete subgroup Γ for which Γ\G carries a finite nonzero right G-invariant measure; normalize it to probability. It is cocompact if Γ\G is compact.

concept.title: Bowen neighborhood for translation on a homogeneous quotient
concept.description: For a group element a and identity neighborhood B, its(s,t)-Bowen neighborhood is B^(s,t)=∩_(i=s)^ta^(-i)Ba^i. On a quotient Γ\G the corresponding translate about y is yB^(s,t), using the stated right-action convention.

concept.title: Homogeneity of Haar volume for Bowen neighborhoods
concept.description: An identity neighborhood B in a locally compact group is(a,h)-homogeneous if some C>0 satisfies vol(B^(s,t))≥C exp(−h(t−s+1)) whenever s≤0≤t. Haar volume is a-homogeneous if for every h>h_m(a) such neighborhoods form a basis at the identity, where m is the invariant probability on a lattice quotient.

concept.title: Cyclic group
concept.description: A group G is cyclic if there is an element g such that every element of G equals gⁿ for some integer n. A finite cyclic group has a finite order equal to the order of a generator.

concept.title: Cyclotomic Z_l-extension of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: For a finite extension F of ℚ_p and a prime ℓ, the cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension Fᶜ/F is the unique ℤ_ℓ subextension of F(μ_(ℓ∞))/F. When F contains μ_(2ℓ), adjoining all ℓ-power roots of unity already gives this extension.

concept.title: L-primary completion of a local multiplicative group
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field F and prime ℓ, the ℓ-primary completion of its multiplicative group is ℛ_F=lim←_r F×/(F×)^(ℓʳ), with the natural quotient transition maps and inverse-limit topology. It carries the continuous norm maps induced by finite local-field extensions.

concept.title: Local logarithmic unit group
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field F, let Fᶜ/F be its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension with finite layers F_n. Its logarithmic unit group is ⋂_(n≥0)N_(F_n/F)(ℛ_(F_n))⊆ℛ_F, where ℛ_F is the ℓ-primary completion of F×.

concept.title: Global logarithmic unit group
concept.description: For a number field K and prime ℓ, its logarithmic unit group is the subgroup of ℤ_ℓ⊗_ℤK× whose image in ℛ_(K_v) belongs to the local logarithmic unit group for every finite place v of K. These canonical local images are induced by K×→K_v×.

concept.title: Hasse norm theorem for a cyclic number-field extension
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite cyclic extension of number fields. An element a∈K× is a norm from L× exactly when, for every place v of K and a place w of L above v, its image in K_v× is a norm from L_w×.

concept.title: L-adic Hasse norm theorem for cyclic l-extensions
concept.description: For a cyclic degree-ℓⁿ number-field extension L/K with K containing μ_(2ℓ), an element of ℤ_ℓ⊗K× lies in N_(L/K)(ℤ_ℓ⊗L×) exactly when its images in every finite-place ℓ-primary multiplicative completion are local norms from L.

concept.title: Logarithmic units as cyclotomic global norms
concept.description: For a number field K containing μ_(2ℓ) with cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K∞=⋃K_n, its logarithmic unit group is ⋂_(n≥0)N_(K_n/K)(ℤ_ℓ⊗K_n×). This intersection is taken after ℓ-adification and need not equal ℤ_ℓ⊗(⋂_(n≥0)N_(K_n/K)K_n×).

concept.title: Cyclotomic norms of logarithmic units
concept.description: For K∞=⋃K_n the cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension, its group of cyclotomic norms of logarithmic units is N_(K∞/K)(Ẽ_(K∞))=⋂_(n≥0)N_(K_n/K)(Ẽ_(K_n)), a subgroup of Ẽ_K; here Ẽ denotes the global logarithmic unit group. This is a global norm intersection inside ℤ_ℓ⊗K×.

concept.title: Norm-coherent principal ideles and logarithmic units
concept.description: For a cyclotomic tower K∞/K with K containing μ_(2ℓ), norm-compatible sequences in ℝ_(K_n)=ℤ_ℓ⊗K_n× are exactly the norm-compatible sequences of logarithmic units. Their projection to level zero is ⋂_n N_(K_n/K)(Ẽ_(K_n)).

concept.title: Locally cyclotomic abelian pro-l extension
concept.description: For a number field K containing μ_(2ℓ), an abelian pro-ℓ extension L/K is locally cyclotomic if, for every finite intermediate E/K and every finite place v of K, each completion E_w/K_v is contained in the local cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K_vᶜ/K_v.

concept.title: L-primary logarithmic class group of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K containing μ_(2ℓ), let K^lc be the compositum of its locally cyclotomic abelian pro-ℓ extensions. Its ℓ-primary logarithmic class group is Gal(K^lc/K∞), where K∞/K is cyclotomic. This is the degree-zero logarithmic class-group convention.

concept.title: Hilbertian radical in a cyclotomic tower
concept.description: For K containing μ_(2ℓ), its Hilbertian radical is the subgroup of ℛ_K consisting of classes ℓ^(−r)⊗x such that, for every finite layer K_n of K∞/K, x lies in N_(K_n/K)(K_n×)(K×)^(ℓʳ).

concept.title: Finite group algebra over a commutative ring
concept.description: For a finite group G and commutative ring R, R[G] is the free R-module on symbols g∈G, with multiplication extended R-bilinearly from the group law. It need not be commutative if G is not abelian.

concept.title: One-dimensional character with values in a ring
concept.description: A one-dimensional R-valued character of a group G is a group homomorphism χ:G→R×, where R× is the multiplicative group of units of the commutative ring R.

concept.title: Character idempotents for a prime-to-l cyclic group over Z_l
concept.description: Let ℓ be odd and Δ cyclic of order d dividing ℓ−1. For every character χ:Δ→ℤ_ℓ×, e_χ=d^(−1)∑_(δ∈Δ)χ(δ)^(−1)δ is an idempotent in ℤ_ℓ[Δ]. These idempotents are pairwise orthogonal and sum to one, giving M=⊕_χ e_χM for every ℤ_ℓ[Δ]-module M.

concept.title: L-adic Tate twist of a Galois module
concept.description: For a ℤ_ℓ-module M with a Galois action and cyclotomic character χ_ℓ, its i-th Tate twist M(i), i∈ℤ, is the same underlying module with action σ⋅_i m=χ_ℓ(σ)^i(σ⋅m). Equivalently tensor with the rank-one module ℤ_ℓ(i), using the dual tensor power for negative i.

concept.title: Leopoldt conjecture in the Z_l-extension form
concept.description: For every number field K and prime ℓ, if Z is the compositum of all ℤ_ℓ-extensions of K and r₂ is the number of complex places of K, then Gal(Z/K) is isomorphic as a topological group to ℤ_ℓ^(r₂+1).

concept.title: Coincidence of initial radicals for a logarithmically principal field
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ), with |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓᵐ. If its ℓ-primary logarithmic class group is trivial, then its initial ℤ_ℓ-extension radical, the ℓᵐ-torsion of its universal Tate kernel, and the ℓᵐ-torsion of its Hilbertian radical coincide.

concept.title: Norm surjectivity on cyclotomic root-of-unity groups
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ), |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓᵐ, and K_n be its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ layers. For every j≥n the norm N_(K_j/K_n) maps μ_(ℓ∞)(K_j) onto μ_(ℓ∞)(K_n).

concept.title: Intersection of ordinary and twisted cyclotomic radical invariants
concept.description: In the cyclotomic setup with |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓᵐ and γ*=γ/(1+ℓᵐ), one has ℛ_(K∞)^(Γ_n)∩ℛ_(K∞)^(Γ_n*)=ℛ_(K_n)[ℓ^(m+n)], where Γ_n is generated by γ^(ℓⁿ) and Γ_n* by (γ*)^(ℓⁿ).

concept.title: Energy measures do not charge polar sets
concept.description: For a regular symmetric Dirichlet form, the finite energy measure of a bounded domain function vanishes on sets of zero capacity; hence quasi-continuous representatives can be used consistently in its composition and pushforward identities.

concept.title: Strongly local energy-measure chain rule
concept.description: For a strongly local regular symmetric Dirichlet form, bounded domainf and C¹ functionsΦ,Ψ withΦ(0)=Ψ(0)=0 and bounded derivatives, the compositions lie in the form domain and their mutual energy measure isν_(Φ(f),Ψ(f))=Φ′(f)Ψ′(f)ν_f. In Hino’s normalization2E(Φ(f),Ψ(f))=∫Φ′(f)Ψ′(f)dν_f.

concept.title: Inner regularity of finite Borel measures on the real line
concept.description: For a finite Borel measureρ onℝ and a Borel setA, ρ(A)=sup{ρ(K):K⊆A compact}.

concept.title: Smooth cutoff for a compact subset of an open real set
concept.description: IfK⊆O⊆ℝ withK compact andO open, there is h∈C_c^∞(ℝ) with0≤h≤1,h=1onK and supporth⊆O.

concept.title: Bounded bilinear map of normed spaces
concept.description: A bilinear mapB:E×F→G of normed spaces is bounded if||B(x,y)||≤C||x||||y|| for someC and allx,y; its norm is the least suchC.

concept.title: Schatten class of a compact Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: For1≤p<∞, the Schatten classS_p(H,K) consists of compact operatorsT:H→K whose singular values belong toℓᵖ, with norm||T||_p=(∑s_n(T)^p)^(1/p);p=1 gives trace class andp=2 gives Hilbert–Schmidt operators.

concept.title: Lévy process taking values in a real Hilbert space
concept.description: A Lévy process in a separable real Hilbert spaceU starts at0, has stationary independent increments and is continuous in probability, with a càdlàg version. In a filtered setting its incrementL(t)−L(s) is independent ofF_s for t>s; square integrability and meanzero are additional hypotheses.

concept.title: Covariance range Hilbert space
concept.description: For a nonnegative trace-class operatorQ on a real Hilbert spaceU, H_Q=ranQ^(1/2) carries the inner product⟨x,y⟩_{H_Q}=⟨Q^(−1/2)x,Q^(−1/2)y⟩_U, where the inverse is taken on(kerQ)⊥. It is a Hilbert space; vectorssqrt(γ_n)e_n for positive eigenvaluesγ_n form an orthonormal basis.

concept.title: Hilbert-valued Itô integral for square-integrable Lévy martingales
concept.description: For a meanzero square-integrableU-valued Lévy processL with covarianceQ and predictableΦ∈L²(Ω×[0,T];S₂(H_Q,H)), the integral∫ΦdL is theL² limit of integrals of predictable step processes with finite cylindrical noise-coordinate functionals extending continuously toU, whose integrals are coefficient operators applied to Lévy increments.

concept.title: Itô isometry for Hilbert-valued Lévy martingale integrals
concept.description: For a meanzero square-integrable Lévy martingaleL with covarianceQ and predictableΦ∈L²(Ω×[0,T];S₂(H_Q,H)), E||∫_0^TΦdL||_H²=E∫_0^T||Φ||_{S₂(H_Q,H)}²dt; the integral process is a square-integrable martingale.

concept.title: Tensor product of real Hilbert spaces
concept.description: For real Hilbert spacesH,K, H⊗₂K is the completion of the algebraic real tensor product for the inner product⟨h⊗k,h′⊗k′⟩=⟨h,h′⟩⟨k,k′⟩, extended bilinearly.

concept.title: Projective tensor product of Banach spaces
