concept.description: For Banach spacesE,F over the same scalar field, E⊗̂_πF is the completion ofE⊗F for ||u||_π=inf{∑||e_j||||f_j||:u=∑e_j⊗f_j}, where the infimum ranges over all finite tensor representations.

concept.title: Injective tensor product of Banach spaces
concept.description: For Banach spacesE,F, E⊗̂_εF is the completion ofE⊗F for ||∑e_j⊗f_j||_ε=sup_{||a||_{E′},||b||_{F′}≤1}|∑a(e_j)b(f_j)|.

concept.title: Bounded operators on projective, injective and Hilbert tensor products
concept.description: BoundedS:E→E′ andT:F→F′ induce boundedS⊗T on projective and injective tensor completions, with norm||S||||T||. The same holds for Hilbert tensor products when the spaces are Hilbert.

concept.title: Operator identifications of Hilbert tensor norms
concept.description: For real Hilbert spacesH,K, h⊗k corresponds tox↦⟨x,h⟩k. Under this identification, the projective, Hilbert and injective completions are respectively trace-class, Hilbert–Schmidt and compact operatorsH→K with their corresponding norms; in particular||u||_ε≤||u||₂≤||u||_π and the canonical maps are injective.

concept.title: Trace duality for compact Hilbert-space operators
concept.description: For real Hilbert spacesH,K, every continuous linear functional onK(H,K) has the formT↦tr(ST) for a unique trace-classS:K→H, and its functional norm is||S||₁.

concept.title: Duality of injective and projective Hilbert tensor products
concept.description: For separable real Hilbert spacesH,K, (H⊗̂_εK)′ is isometrically identified withH′⊗̂_πK′ by the natural bilinear pairing.

concept.title: Tensor second moment and covariance of a Hilbert random element
concept.description: For a square-integrable random elementX in a real Hilbert spaceH, M₂X=E[X⊗X] andCovX=E[(X−EX)⊗(X−EX)] are Bochner integrals inH⊗̂_πH, withCovX=M₂X−EX⊗EX and||M₂X||_π≤E||X||².

concept.title: Positive self-adjoint Hilbert generator with compact inverse
concept.description: A positive compact-inverse generator is a densely defined self-adjoint operatorA on a real Hilbert space, bounded below by a positive constant and with compact inverseA⁻¹:H→H.

concept.title: Spectral semigroup for a positive compact-inverse generator
concept.description: A positive compact-inverse generator has an orthonormal eigenbasisAe_n=λ_ne_n withλ_n>0 andλ_n→∞ in infinite dimension. S(t)x=∑e^(−tλ_n)⟨x,e_n⟩e_n is a strongly continuous analytic contraction semigroup, and∫₀ᵀ||A^(1/2)S(t)x||²dt≤||x||²/2.

concept.title: Fractional domain scale of a positive self-adjoint generator
concept.description: For a positive self-adjointA with compact inverse and eigenpairs(λ_n,e_n), Ḣ^r=D(A^(r/2)) consists ofx with∑λ_n^r|⟨x,e_n⟩|²<∞, with that square-sum norm; A^(r/2)x=∑λ_n^(r/2)⟨x,e_n⟩e_n.

concept.title: Lions–Magenes Hilbert-triple energy identity
concept.description: IfV⊂H⊂V′ is a Hilbert Gelfand triple andv∈L²(0,T;V) has weak derivativev′∈L²(0,T;V′), thenv has a continuousH-valued representative and ||v(t)||_H²−||v(s)||_H²=2∫_s^t⟨v′,v⟩. Ifv(T)=0, sup_t||v(t)||_H²≤||v||_{L²V}²+||v′||_{L²V′}².

concept.title: Parabolic space-time trial and terminal test spaces
concept.description: ForV⊂H⊂V′, the parabolic trial space isX=L²(0,T;V) and the terminal test space isY={v∈L²(0,T;V):v′∈L²(0,T;V′),v(T)=0}, with ||v||_Y²=||v||_{L²V}²+||v′||_{L²V′}².

concept.title: Diagonal pairing on projective trial and injective test tensors
concept.description: LetW=L²(0,T;H) and let the Banach spaceY embed contractively inC([0,T];H). The pairingD(u₁⊗u₂,v₁⊗v₂)=∫⟨u₁(t),v₁(t)⟩⟨u₂(t),v₂(t)⟩dt extends to a bounded operatorW⊗̂_πW→(Y⊗̂_εY)′ of norm≤1. Replacing one or both trial factors byH gives bounds√T andT respectively.

concept.title: Nečas inf-sup theorem on Hilbert spaces
concept.description: For a bounded bilinearB:H₁×H₂→ℝ, its associated mapH₁→H₂′ is boundedly invertible exactly when both primal and transposed inf-sup constants are positive. In that case both constants equal||B⁻¹||⁻¹, and the solution toB(u,·)=f satisfies||u||≤||B⁻¹||||f||.

concept.title: Backward parabolic space-time isomorphism
concept.description: For positive self-adjointA with compact inverse, V=D(A^(1/2)), X=L²(0,T;V) and terminalY, B(u,v)=∫⟨u,−v′+Av⟩ defines an isomorphismB:X→Y′ with||B⁻¹||≤1 under the energy norms.

concept.title: Affine stochastic evolution equation with Hilbert Lévy noise
concept.description: For a positive compact-inverse generatorA and a centered square-integrableHilbert Lévy processL, the affine evolutiondX+AXdt=(G₁X+G₂)dL has a mild solution whenX(t)=S(t)X₀+∫₀ᵗS(t−s)(G₁X(s)+G₂)dL(s), withpredictableX, bounded timeL² moments,F₀-measurableX₀∈L²(Ω;H), bounded linearG₁:H→S₂(H_Q,H), andG₂∈S₂(H_Q,H).

concept.title: Closed operators and Hilbert Lévy stochastic integrals
concept.description: LetC:D(C)⊂H→K be closed. If predictableΦ takes values inD(C) and bothΦ andCΦ are square-integrable Hilbert–Schmidt integrands, then∫ΦdL lies inD(C) almost surely andC∫ΦdL=∫CΦdL.

concept.title: Mild well-posedness of affine Hilbert Lévy evolution
concept.description: The affine Hilbert Lévy evolution has a unique predictable mild solution with bounded timeL²(H) norm. For0≤r≤1, it has bounded timeL²(Ḣ^r) norm ifX₀∈L²(Ḣ^r) and∫₀ᵀ||A^(r/2)S(t)G₁||_{L(Ḣ^r,S₂(H_Q,H))}²dt<∞.

concept.title: Stochastic Fubini theorem for Hilbert Lévy integrals
concept.description: For a jointly measurable kernelK(s,t) predictable ins and satisfying∫(E∫||K(s,t)||_{HS}²ds)^(1/2)dt<∞, deterministic integration int and square-integrableHilbert Lévy stochastic integration ins commute, asH-valuedL² random variables.

concept.title: Weak identity for a Hilbert Lévy mild solution
concept.description: For the affine evolution mild solutionX andv∈C¹([0,T];D(A)) withv(T)=0, ∫₀ᵀ⟨X,−v′+Av⟩dt=⟨X₀,v(0)⟩+∫₀ᵀ⟨v,G(X)dL⟩ almost surely; the scalar weak integral pairsv(t) with the operator integrand before integration.

concept.title: Projective second-moment regularity for affine Lévy evolution
concept.description: Suppose the affine Lévy evolution has boundedL²(Ḣ^r) moments for some0≤r≤1 and∫₀ᵀ||A^(1/2)S(t)G₁||_{L(Ḣ^r,S₂(H_Q,H))}²dt<∞. ThenX∈L²(Ω;L²(0,T;V)) forV=D(A^(1/2)), andM₂X belongs toX_space⊗̂_πX_space, X_space=L²(0,T;V).

concept.title: Deterministic projective/injective equation for a Lévy SPDE second moment
concept.description: For the affine Lévy evolution with the stated projective moment regularity, assumeG₁:V→L(U,H) andG₂:U→H are bounded extensions. WithB the parabolic space-time map,q the noise covariance tensor andD the diagonal pairing, u=M₂X∈X_space⊗̂_πX_space satisfies(B⊗B)u−D((G₁⊗G₁)u q)=R₀₀M₂X₀+D([G₁m⊗G₂+G₂⊗G₁m+G₂⊗G₂]q) in(Y⊗̂_εY)′, wherem(t)=S(t)EX₀ andR₀₀ pairs both initial traces.

concept.title: Small-noise uniqueness of the tensor variational moment equation
concept.description: In the affine Lévy tensor setting, if||G₁||_{L(V,S₂(H_Q,H))}<1, the perturbed map(B⊗B)−D((G₁⊗G₁)(·)q) is bounded below by1−||G₁||² in the projective trial norm. Its variational equation therefore has at most one solution for every test-dual right-hand side; for the moment and covariance right-hand sides, the stochastic solution supplies existence.

concept.title: Deterministic tensor variational equation for affine Lévy covariance
concept.description: For the affine Lévy moment setting, c=CovX∈X_space⊗̂_πX_space satisfies[(B⊗B)−D((G₁⊗G₁)(·)q)]c=R₀₀CovX₀+D([G(m)⊗G(m)]q), wherem=S(·)EX₀. This equation has the unique solutionc for every bounded affineG₁ in the stated setting; no noise-smallness assumption is required after an exponential time-weight reduction.

concept.title: Self-dual beta-deformed Barnes G-function
concept.description: For β>0,Q=β+β⁻¹ and Re x>0, define G_β(x)=exp(L_β(x)), where L_β(x)=(x−Q/2)log(2π)/2+∫₀^∞[(e^(−Qt/2)−e^(−xt))/((1−e^(−βt))(1−e^(−t/β)))+e^(−t)(Q/2−x)²/2+(Q/2−x)/t]dt/t. This convergent integral fixes its normalization and makes G_β=G_(1/β); in particular G_β(Q/2)=1.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Regularized logarithmic gamma integral
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Shift relation for the self-dual beta-deformed Barnes function
concept.description: For β>0 and Re x>0, G_β(x+β)=β^(1/2−βx)(2π)^((β−1)/2)Γ(βx)G_β(x), with G_β fixed by its convergent normalized integral.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Chi distribution with integer degrees of freedom
concept.description: For a positive integer d, the chi distribution with d degrees of freedom is the law of(∑_(j=1)^dg_j²)^(1/2), where the g_j are independent standard real normal variables.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Trotter tridiagonal representation of GUE eigenvalues
concept.description: Let H_N have GUE density proportional to exp(−2NtrH_N²). Its eigenvalue multiset has the same law as that of(2√(2N))⁻¹T_N, where T_N is real symmetric tridiagonal, its diagonal entries are independentN(0,2), its adjacent off-diagonal entries are independentχ_(2j),j=1,…,N−1, and all these random variables are mutually independent.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Euler beta–gamma integral for positive real parameters
concept.description: For real a,b>0, Γ(a)Γ(b)=Γ(a+b)∫₀¹t^(a−1)(1−t)^(b−1)dt.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Gaussian integral on the real line
concept.description: The real improper integral∫_(−∞)^∞e^(−x²)dx equals√π.
concept.field: Random matrix theory and special functions

concept.title: Homothetic projection theorem
concept.description: Ifn≥3 and convex bodiesK,L⊂ℝⁿ have homothetic orthogonal projections onto every hyperplane, thenK andL are themselves homothetic.

concept.title: Mixed volume with a segment and projection volume
concept.description: For a full-dimensional convex bodyK⊂ℝⁿ and a unit vectoru, nV(K[n−1],[0,u]) equals the(n−1)-dimensional volume of the orthogonal projection ofK onto u⊥.

concept.title: Derivative of a generalized quantile of an integrable density
concept.description: For nonnegative integrablef onℝ withF=∫f>0, letq(t)=inf{x:F⁻¹∫_{−∞}^x f≥t},0<t<1. Thenq is increasing, pushes Lebesgue probability tof(x)dx/F, andf(q(t))q′(t)=F for almost everyt.

concept.title: Area inequality for a monotone real map
concept.description: Ifw:(a,b)→ℝ is increasing andh≥0 is measurable, then∫_ℝh(x)dx≥∫_a^b h(w(t))w′(t)dt; jumps and a singular part can only increase the left-hand mass not represented by the a.e. derivative.

concept.title: Hausdorff quantitative BBL for positive power-concave functions
concept.description: For fixedp>0,0<λ<1 and bounded nonnegativep-concaveu_i on convex compact supportsΩ_i with positive integralsI_i, anyh dominating theirp-Minkowski convolution satisfies∫h≥M_{p/(np+1)}(I₀,I₁;λ)+cH₀(Ω₀,Ω₁)^((n+1)(p+1)/p) whenH₀ is small. Herec>0 depends on the fixed dimension,weights,p,integrals,volumes andnormalized diameters.

concept.title: Quantitative Brunn–Minkowski for torsional rigidity
concept.description: For bounded open convexΩ₀,Ω₁⊂ℝⁿ and0<λ<1, torsional rigidityT defined by−Δu=1 satisfies T((1−λ)Ω₀+λΩ₁)≥M_{1/(n+2)}(T(Ω₀),T(Ω₁);λ)+c₁H₀^(3(n+1)) and also≥the same mean+c₂A^6 for sufficiently small respective distances, with positive constants depending on the fixed geometric and torsional data.

concept.title: Quantitative Urysohn inequality for torsional rigidity
concept.description: LetΩ⊂ℝⁿ,n≥2, be bounded open convex and centered at its centroid, and letΩ♯ be the centered ball of equal mean width. For sufficiently smallH=H(Ω,Ω♯), T(Ω♯)≥T(Ω)(1+cH^(3(n+1))); also T(Ω♯)≥T(Ω)(1+c′A_rot^6) for smallA_rot=sup_ρA(Ω,ρΩ), with positive fixed-data constants.

concept.title: Finite-exponent quantitative Minkowski comparison for elliptic solutions
concept.description: Under the power-Minkowski viscosity/comparison hypotheses with0<p<1, suppose positive solutionsu₀,u₁ arep-concave. For0<r<∞ the deficit∫u_λ^r−M_{p/(np+r)}(∫u₀^r,∫u₁^r;λ) is bounded below bycH₀^((n+1)(p+r)/p), and separately byc′A^(2(p+r)/p), for small distances and positive fixed-data constants including the normalized diameters when needed.

concept.title: Finite-exponent quantitative mean-width rearrangement comparison
concept.description: Under the rotational elliptic mean-width comparison hypotheses with0<p<1 andp-concave solutionu, letv solve the corresponding problem on the equal-width ball. For0<r<∞, ∫v^r≥∫u^r+cH(Ω,Ω♯)^((n+1)(p+r)/p), and separately≥∫u^r+c′A_rot^(2(p+r)/p), for sufficiently small distances and positive fixed-data constants depending on n,p,r,the moment and relevant diameter.

concept.title: Zagier’s leading Eisenstein coefficient of a one-point q-bracket
concept.description: For every integer r≥1, the normalized one-point bracket 𝒬_(2r)=2^(2r−2)(2r−1)!⟨Q_(2r)⟩_q is a polynomial of degree r in G₂=−E₂/24 over the rational level-one modular-form ring. Its leading coefficient is (2r−1)!!8^(r−1)/r, where (2r−1)!!=1·3·⋯·(2r−1).

concept.title: Serre–Swinnerton-Dyer algebra of level-one forms modulo p
concept.description: For p≥5 let A(X,Y) be the reduction of the homogeneous weight-(p−1) polynomial expressing E_(p−1) in E₄,E₆. The algebra of reductions of rational p-integral level-one modular forms is 𝔽_p[X,Y]/(A−1). The polynomial A is square-free; for a nonzero homogeneous F of weight k, its q-series filtration is k−r(p−1), where r is the greatest exponent with Aʳ dividing F.

concept.title: Mod-p filtration of powers of E2
concept.description: For p≥5 and every positive integer r, the reduction of E₂ʳ has level-one modular filtration r(p+1). The same formula holds for G₂ʳ, since G₂=−E₂/24 and 24 is a p-adic unit.

concept.title: Modular and elliptic transformations of odd theta
concept.description: Put Θ(z;τ)=−iθ[½,½](τ,z), q=exp(2πiτ). Then Θ(z;τ+1)=exp(πi/4)Θ(z;τ), Θ(z/τ;−1/τ)=−i√(−iτ)exp(πiz²/τ)Θ(z;τ), Θ(z+1;τ)=−Θ(z;τ), and Θ(z+τ;τ)=−exp(−πiτ−2πiz)Θ(z;τ). The square root is the holomorphic branch positive at τ=i.

concept.title: Jacobi triple product for the odd theta function
concept.description: For Θ=−iθ[½,½], q=exp(2πiτ), one has Θ(z;τ)=exp(πiτ/4)(exp(πiz)−exp(−πiz))∏_(n≥1)(1−qⁿ)(1−exp(2πiz)qⁿ)(1−exp(−2πiz)qⁿ). The products converge locally uniformly for τ in the upper half-plane.

concept.title: Nonvanishing of an absolutely convergent complex product
concept.description: If ∑_(n≥1)|a_n|<∞, then ∏_(n≥1)(1+a_n) converges and is nonzero exactly when none of its factors is zero. The corresponding local uniform assertion holds when the absolute sums converge uniformly on compact sets.

concept.title: Simple zero lattice and derivative of odd theta
concept.description: For τ in the upper half-plane, Θ(z;τ)=−iθ[½,½](τ,z) has exactly the simple zeros z∈ℤ+τℤ, and ∂Θ/∂z(0;τ)=2πiη(τ)³. In particular η has no zeros in the upper half-plane.

concept.title: Eisenstein exponential formula for one-point q-brackets
concept.description: As a formal power series in t, ∑_(k≥0)⟨Q_k⟩_q t^k=exp(2∑_(j≥1)G_(2j)t^(2j)/(2j)!), where G_(2j)=−B_(2j)/(4j)+∑_(n≥1)σ_(2j−1)(n)qⁿ and Q_k has the Bloch–Okounkov normalization.

concept.title: S and T transformations of the Dedekind eta function
concept.description: For τ in the upper half-plane, η(τ+1)=exp(πi/12)η(τ) and η(−1/τ)=√(−iτ)η(τ), using the holomorphic square-root branch positive at τ=i.

concept.title: Real analytic function on an open Euclidean set
concept.description: A real-valued or complex-valued function on an open subset of ℝᵈ is real analytic if, around each point a, it equals a power series ∑_(α∈ℕᵈ)c_α(x−a)^α that converges absolutely on some neighborhood of a.

concept.title: Covariance of the Jacobi elliptic raising operator
concept.description: For the weight-k index-m Jacobi modular slash action and real analytic φ, the elliptic raising operator Y_m satisfies Y_m(φ|_(k,m)γ)=(Y_mφ)|_(k+1,m)γ for every γ∈SL₂(ℤ). Thus Y_m preserves the index and raises the transformation weight by one, allowing nonholomorphic dependence on the elliptic variable.

concept.title: Modular covariance of a Jacobi circular constant term
concept.description: Suppose φ has weight-k index-m Jacobi modular covariance on Γ and is real analytic near z=0 apart from a finite-order singularity. Put Φ(z;τ)=exp(2πimz Im(z)/Im(τ))φ(z;τ). If A(τ)=lim_(r→0)∫₀¹Φ(r exp(2πit);τ)dt exists, then A(γτ)=(cτ+d)^kA(τ) for every γ∈Γ. This assertion is a transformation law and does not alone imply holomorphy or cusp growth.

concept.title: Countable set
concept.description: A set is countable if it admits an injection into the natural numbers; finite sets are included.

concept.title: One-sided Dini derivatives
concept.description: For a real functionF, its upper and lower right Dini derivatives are limsup andliminf_{h↓0}(F(x+h)−F(x))/h; upper and lower left derivatives useh↑0. These are extended-real limits;F is differentiable exactly when all four agree and are finite.

concept.title: Rising sun lemma
concept.description: For continuousG on[a,b], the pointsx admitting a latery withG(y)>G(x) are covered by countably many disjoint intervals(a_j,b_j) withG(b_j)≥G(a_j), while outside those intervalsG(y)≤G(x) for every latery. Interior interval endpoints have equalG values.

concept.title: Continuous and jump decomposition of a bounded monotone function
concept.description: A bounded nondecreasing real function is the sum of a continuous nondecreasing function and an absolutely summable positive linear combination of unit step jumps, allowing each step an intermediate value at its jump point. It has only countably many discontinuities.

concept.title: Sobolev regularity for the smooth Dirichlet Poisson problem
concept.description: On a bounded smooth domainΩ, a weak zero-boundary solutionu∈H₀¹(Ω) of−Δu=f withf∈H^m(Ω),m≥0integer, belongs toH^{m+2}(Ω), with anH^{m+2} estimate controlled byf andthe domain.

concept.title: Higher Sobolev embedding into continuous derivatives
concept.description: On a bounded smoothΩ⊂ℝⁿ, H^m(Ω) embeds continuously intoC^k(Ω̄) wheneverm>k+n/2, for nonnegative integersm,k.

concept.title: Weak comparison principle for the Poisson equation
concept.description: Ifu,v∈H¹(Ω), (u−v)_+∈H₀¹(Ω) and−Δu≤−Δv weakly on a bounded domain, thenu≤v almost everywhere; continuous representatives obey the pointwise inequality.

concept.title: Hopf boundary lemma for a positive Poisson solution
concept.description: For a smooth domain and a positive classicalsolutionu of−Δu=c>0 with zeroDirichletdata, an interior tangent ball at a boundarypoint forces a strictly positive derivative in every strictly inward direction there.

concept.title: Continuity of torsion functions under convex-domain convergence
concept.description: If convex bodiesK_j converge to a full-dimensionalK in Hausdorff distance, the zero-extended weak solutionsu_j of−Δu_j=c>0 onintK_j withzeroDirichletdata converge uniformly to the corresponding zero-extendedu onintK.

concept.title: Spectrum of a boundary-fixed harmonic extension matrix
concept.description: For a regular harmonic structure on a connected p.c.f. self-similar set with every boundaryp_i fixed by a cell map andK\{p_i} connected, the harmonic extension matrixA_i has simple eigenvalues1 andr_i, every other eigenvalue has modulus<r_i, and thep_i-columnu_i ofD is a nonzero left r_i-eigenvector orthogonal to constants. There is a nonnegative right r_i-eigenvectorv_i uniquely normalized by(u_i,v_i)=1.

concept.title: Cell energy formula for a p.c.f. harmonic function
concept.description: For a regular harmonic structure(D,r), harmonicf with boundary vectorx and a cell wordw, its Hino-normalized energy measure satisfiesν_f(K_w)=−2r_w⁻¹(A_wx)^TD(A_wx), whereA_w is harmonic restriction to that cell.

concept.title: Self-similar decomposition of energy measures
concept.description: For the regular strongly local form associated with a regular p.c.f. harmonic structure, its energy measures obeyν_f(B)=∑_(|w|=m)r_w⁻¹ν_(f∘ψ_w)(ψ_w⁻¹B) for BorelB and each cell levelm, using quasi-continuous versions.

concept.title: Finite complex Gram–Schmidt orthonormalization
concept.description: In a finite-dimensional complex inner-product space, every linearly independent finite listv₁,…,v_k can be transformed into an orthonormal listq₁,…,q_k with span(q₁,…,q_j)=span(v₁,…,v_j) for everyj. Every orthonormal list inℂⁿ extends to an orthonormal basis; for a prescribed nonzero first vector the completion can be chosen Borel measurably.

concept.title: Bilateral Laplace inversion on an integrable vertical line
concept.description: Letμ be a Borel probability onℝ andc∈ℝ with∫e^(cx)dμ(x)<∞. IfF(t)=∫e^((c+it)x)dμ(x) belongs toL¹(ℝ), thenμ has the continuous densityf(x)=e^(−cx)(2π)⁻¹∫_(−∞)^∞e^(−itx)F(t)dt.

concept.title: Multiplier between analytic Hilbert function spaces
concept.description: For analytic reproducing-kernel Hilbert spacesR₁(E),R₂(F), a holomorphicoperator-valuedΘ:𝔻→B(E,F) is a multiplier if pointwise multiplicationf(z)↦Θ(z)f(z) defines a bounded mapR₁(E)→R₂(F). A partially isometric multiplier has a partial-isometry multiplication operator.

concept.title: Invariant subspaces of a contractive analytic RKHS
concept.description: LetR be an analyticRKHS on𝔻 whose coordinate multiplier is contractive. Every closed coordinate-invariant subspaceS⊂R⊗E* isΘH²(E) for an auxiliaryHilbertE and a partially isometric multiplierΘ:H²(E)→R⊗E*.

concept.title: Multiplier quotient model for a kernel-contractive operator
concept.description: For a standard analyticRKHS R_k and a k-contractive operatorT with defectC, T is unitarily equivalent to the compression ofM_z to(R_k⊗D)⊖ΘH²(E), whereD=closure(ranC) andΘ is a partially isometric analytic multiplier for someE.

concept.title: Multiplier model for doubly commuting standard-kernel tuples
concept.description: LetT_i be doubly commuting k_i-contractive operators for standard analytic spacesR_{k_i}, with commuting positive defectsC_i andD=closure(ran∏C_i). ThenT is unitarily equivalent to coordinate compression on(R_{k₁}⊗⋯⊗R_{k_n}⊗D)⊖∑ranΘ_i, with closed sum and one-coordinate partially isometric Hardy multipliersΘ_i tensored with identities on other factors.

concept.title: Generation for nonlinear port–controller feedback
concept.description: For an impedance-passive port-Hamiltonian boundarysystem(𝔄,𝔅,𝔠) and anm-dissipative controllerrelationM_c onX_c×U, defineA(x,x_c)=(𝔄x,z_c) when(z_c,𝔅x)∈M_c(x_c,𝔠x). This feedbackrelation ism-dissipative and densely defined onX×closure(Π_{X_c}D(M_c)), and generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup there.

concept.title: Exponential stability criterion for nonlinear boundary–controller feedback
concept.description: For passive plant(𝔄,𝔅,𝔠) and controller(z_c,y_c)∈M_c(x_c,u_c), assume0∈M_c(0), Re⟨(z_c,y_c),(x_c,u_c)⟩≤−ρ(||x_c||²+||Πu_c||²), ||y_c||²≤c(||x_c||²+||Πu_c||²), and||x_c(t₀)||²≤(1−δ)||x_c(0)||²+c||Πu_c||²_{L²(0,t₀)}. If a plantfunctionalq satisfies|q(x)|≤C||x||² and||x||²+dq(x)/dt≤C(||𝔅x||²+||Π𝔠x||²), then the interconnected contraction semigroup is uniformly exponentially stable at0.

concept.title: First-order port–controller exponential stability from one-end observability
concept.description: Under the nonlinear boundary-controller exponential criterion’s controllerhypotheses, let the passive port-Hamiltonian plant haveorder1 and Lipschitz coerciveHamiltoniandensityH. If||(Hx)(1)||²≤C(||𝔅x||²+||Π𝔠x||²) on the plantdomain, then its nonlinear controllerfeedback generates a contraction semigroup with globally uniformly exponentially stable equilibrium0.

concept.title: Multidimensional DOST nonstationary system
concept.description: Partition each frequencycorona{2^(p−1)≤||ξ||∞<2^p} into half-open boxes of sideβ_p=2^(p−1), and letI_{p,ℓ} be their integerpoints, with a finitecentralblockandβ₀=1. For windowφ andµ,ν>0, the multidimensionalDOST system consists ofT_{νk/β_p}[β_p^(−d/2)∑_{η∈µI_{p,ℓ}}e^(2πiη·x)φ(x)], k∈ℤᵈ.

concept.title: Painless multidimensional DOST frame theorem
concept.description: Letφ be Schwartz with compactly supported nonnegativeFouriertransform and letΦ_{p,ℓ}=∑_{η∈µI_{p,ℓ}}φ̂(·−η). IfΦ are uniformly bounded byC₁, atmostC₂ are nonzero at eachfrequency, andsomeΦ≥C₃>0 at everyfrequency, then the multidimensionalDOST system is anL² frame for sufficiently smallν, with boundsC₃²/νᵈ andC₁²C₂/νᵈ. Its canonical dual is obtained by dividing eachΦ byΣ|Φ|² and multiplying byνᵈ.

concept.title: Star homomorphism between C*-algebras
concept.description: A star homomorphism φ:A→B between C*-algebras is a complex-linear multiplicative map satisfying φ(a*)=φ(a)*. The algebras and map need not be unital. A unital star homomorphism additionally preserves the multiplicative identities when they exist.

concept.title: Closed two-sided ideal of a C*-algebra
concept.description: A closed two-sided star ideal I in a C*-algebra A is a complex vector subspace, closed in norm, with AI⊆I, IA⊆I and I*=I. Closed two-sided ideals in a C*-algebra are automatically star-stable.

concept.title: Quotient C*-algebra
concept.description: For a closed two-sided ideal I of a C*-algebra A, the quotient vector space A/I has induced multiplication and involution and quotient norm ‖a+I‖=inf_(x∈I)‖a+x‖; this is the quotient C*-algebra.

concept.title: Algebraic star tensor product of C*-algebras
concept.description: For C*-algebras A,B, their algebraic tensor product A⊙B over ℂ has multiplication (a⊗b)(a′⊗b′)=aa′⊗bb′ and involution (a⊗b)*=a*⊗b*, extended linearly and conjugate-linearly. No completion or C*-norm is part of this algebraic construction.

concept.title: Minimal C*-tensor product
concept.description: Given faithful star representations π:A→B(H) and ρ:B→B(K), the minimal C*-tensor product A⊗_min B is the operator-norm closure of (π⊗ρ)(A⊙B) in B(H⊗K). The spatial tensor norm is independent of the faithful representations.

concept.title: Exact C*-algebra
concept.description: A C*-algebra A is exact if for every C*-algebra B and closed two-sided ideal I⊆B the canonical sequence 0→I⊗_min A→B⊗_min A→(B/I)⊗_min A→0 is exact as a sequence of linear maps.

concept.title: Arveson extension for completely positive contractions
concept.description: Let A be a C*-subalgebra of B(H). Every completely positive contraction φ:A→B(K) extends to a completely positive contraction Φ:B(H)→B(K). When A contains the identity and φ is unital, the extension may be chosen unital.

concept.title: Representation independence of completely positive approximation rank
concept.description: For faithful star representations π:A→B(H) and ρ:A→B(K), finite Ω⊆A and δ>0, the least finite-dimensional C*-rank through which completely positive contractions approximate π on Ω within δ equals the corresponding rank for ρ, allowing the value infinity.

concept.title: Topological entropy by finite open covers
concept.description: For a continuous self-map T of a nonempty compact Hausdorff space X, h_top(T)=sup_𝒰 lim_(n→∞)n⁻¹log N(⋁_(j=0)^(n−1)T^(−j)𝒰), where 𝒰 ranges over finite open covers and N is the least cardinality of a subcover. The join consists of intersections of one set from each cover.

concept.title: C*-algebra of complex continuous functions on a compact space
concept.description: For a compact Hausdorff space X, C(X) is the unital commutative C*-algebra of continuous complex-valued functions, with pointwise addition and multiplication, conjugation as involution, and norm ‖f‖∞=sup_(x∈X)|f(x)|.

concept.title: Character of a C*-algebra
concept.description: A character of a C*-algebra A is a nonzero continuous star homomorphism χ:A→ℂ. The character space carries the topology of pointwise convergence on A, equivalently the relative weak-star topology in A*.

concept.title: Gelfand representation of a commutative unital C*-algebra
concept.description: For a commutative unital C*-algebra A, its character space Â is compact Hausdorff, and Γ:A→C(Â), Γ(a)(χ)=χ(a), is an isometric star isomorphism.

concept.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for a positive functional
concept.description: For a positive complex linear functional φ on a complex star algebra, |φ(b*a)|²≤φ(a*a)φ(b*b) for every a,b.

concept.title: Norm of a positive functional on a unital C*-algebra
concept.description: A positive linear functional φ on a unital C*-algebra is bounded and ‖φ‖=φ(1). In particular it is a state precisely when φ(1)=1.

concept.title: Weak-star compactness of a unital C*-algebra state space
concept.description: The states S(A) of a unital C*-algebra form a weak-star compact convex subset of the dual unit ball. Every star automorphism α induces the weak-star homeomorphism ρ↦ρ∘α of S(A).

concept.title: Embedding independence of contractive approximation rank
concept.description: For a Banach space X, a finite set Ω⊆X and δ>0, the least d admitting contractive maps X→ℓ∞ᵈ→Y approximating a CA embedding ι:X→Y on Ω within δ is independent of the CA embedding. Here a CA embedding is an isometry admitting such finite-set approximations for every Ω,δ.

concept.title: Kerr–Li positive CA entropy and dual-ball dynamics
concept.description: Let α be an isometric automorphism of a Banach space X and T_α(ω)=ω∘α on the weak-star compact dual unit ball. If a closed T_α-invariant set Z has evaluation X→C(Z) an isomorphism onto a closed subspace, the conditions h_c(α)>0, h_top(T_α)>0, h_top(T_α)=∞, and h_top(T_α|Z)>0 are equivalent.

concept.title: Kerr–Li equality of classical and approximation entropies
concept.description: For a homeomorphism T of a compact Hausdorff space X and α_T(f)=f∘T on C(X), h_t(α_T)=h_c(α_T)=h_top(T), where h_t is Voiculescu–Brown entropy and h_c is contractive approximation entropy.

concept.title: Zero Voiculescu–Brown entropy implies zero CA entropy
concept.description: If α is a star automorphism of an exact C*-algebra and h_t(α)=0, then h_c(α)=0.

concept.title: Singular value decomposition of a complex matrix
concept.description: Every complex m×n matrixM admits M=UΣV*, whereU,V are unitary andΣ is rectangular diagonal with nonnegative diagonal entries equal to the singular values ofM in decreasing order.

concept.title: Singular-value product bound in operator norm
concept.description: For compatible real or complex matricesA,X,B and every singular-value indexj, σ_j(AXB)≤‖A‖_(op)‖B‖_(op)σ_j(X). For invertibleA,B this also givesσ_j(X)≤‖A⁻¹‖_(op)‖B⁻¹‖_(op)σ_j(AXB).

concept.title: Rademacher desymmetrization for independent centered matrices
concept.description: For independent mean-zero integrable random matricesX_i and independent Rademacher signsε_i, E‖∑ε_iX_i‖_(op)≤2E‖∑X_i‖_(op), whenever the right side is finite.

concept.title: Gaussian increment comparison for expected suprema
concept.description: For centered separable Gaussian processes(X_t),(Y_t) on the same index set with E(X_s−X_t)²≤E(Y_s−Y_t)² for all s,t and finite expected suprema, E sup_tX_t≤E sup_tY_t.

concept.title: Gordon Gaussian comparison for a spherical infimum
concept.description: For a real m×d matrixA with independent standard normal entries and nonemptyT⊆S^(d−1), E inf_(x∈T)‖Ax‖₂≥E‖g_m‖₂−E sup_(x∈T)⟨g_d,x⟩, whereg_m,g_d are standard Gaussian vectors.

concept.title: Gaussian concentration for a Lipschitz function
concept.description: Ifg is a standard Gaussian vector andF is realL-Lipschitz in Euclidean norm, then P(F(g)≤EF(g)−t)≤exp(−t²/(2L²)) and P(F(g)≥EF(g)+t)≤exp(−t²/(2L²)) for t>0.

concept.title: Positive and negative moments of an integer-degree chi distribution
concept.description: Forχ_d with d positive integer and reala>−d, Eχ_d^a=2^(a/2)Γ((d+a)/2)/Γ(d/2).

concept.title: McDiarmid bounded differences inequality
concept.description: For independent variablesX_i and an integrable realF whose value changes by at mostc_i when only coordinatei changes, P(F−EF≥t)≤exp(−2t²/∑c_i²) for t>0.

concept.title: Rademacher symmetrization of a centered empirical supremum
concept.description: For independent identically distributedX_i, an integrably bounded separable classF of real measurable functions, and independent Rademacherε_i, E sup_(f∈F)∑(Ef(X_i)−f(X_i))≤2E sup_(f∈F)∑ε_i f(X_i).

concept.title: Rademacher contraction for an expected supremum
concept.description: For a bounded setT⊆ℝ^m andL-Lipschitz real functionsψ_i withψ_i(0)=0, E_εsup_(t∈T)∑ε_iψ_i(t_i)≤L E_εsup_(t∈T)∑ε_it_i, whereε_i are independent Rademacher signs.

concept.title: Expected Euclidean norm of a standard Gaussian vector
concept.description: For a standard Gaussian vectorg∈ℝ^m, E‖g‖₂=√2Γ((m+1)/2)/Γ(m/2) and m/√(m+1)≤E‖g‖₂≤√m.

concept.title: Expected operator norm of a standard real Gaussian matrix
concept.description: IfG is an m×n real matrix with independentN(0,1) entries, then E‖G‖_(op)≤√m+√n.

concept.title: Gordon escape through a spherical mesh
concept.description: LetA be an m×d real matrix with independent standard normal entries,T⊆S^(d−1) nonempty, andw(T)=E sup_(x∈T)⟨g_d,x⟩. For everyt>0, P{inf_(x∈T)‖Ax‖₂≥E‖g_m‖₂−w(T)−t}≥1−exp(−t²/2).

concept.title: Mendelson small-ball lower bound for independent linear measurements
concept.description: Letφ_i be independent copies of an integrable random vectorφ∈ℝ^d, and letE be a nonempty bounded deterministic subset ofℝ^d. DefineQ_ξ=inf_(u∈E)P(|⟨φ,u⟩|≥ξ) andW_m=E sup_(u∈E)⟨m^(−1/2)∑ε_iφ_i,u⟩ with independent Rademacherε_i. Forξ>0,t≥0, with probability at least1−exp(−2t²), inf_(u∈E)(∑|⟨φ_i,u⟩|²)^(1/2)≥ξ√mQ_(2ξ)−2W_m−ξt.

concept.title: Latała fourth-moment bound for an independent-entry matrix
concept.description: For a real random matrixX with independent mean-zero entries and finite fourth moments, E‖X‖_(op)≤C[max_i(∑_jEX_ij²)^(1/2)+max_j(∑_iEX_ij²)^(1/2)+(∑_(i,j)EX_ij⁴)^(1/4)], whereC is universal.

concept.title: Extreme singular values of a rectangular real Gaussian matrix
concept.description: For an m×n matrixA,1≤n≤m, with independent real standard normal entries andt>0, P{√m−√n−t≤σ_min(A)≤σ_max(A)≤√m+√n+t}≥1−2exp(−t²/2).

concept.title: Matrix Bernstein inequality for a self-adjoint sum
concept.description: LetX_k be independent mean-zero self-adjoint n×n random matrices with‖X_k‖_(op)≤R almost surely. Setv=‖∑EX_k²‖_(op). Then for everyt>0, P{‖∑X_k‖_(op)≥t}≤2n exp[−t²/(2(v+Rt/3))].

concept.title: Finite-dimensional real torus
concept.description: The d-dimensional real torus is the quotient topological abelian group ℝᵈ/ℤᵈ, equivalently the product of d copies of the unit circle via x↦exp(2πix).

concept.title: Positive definite function on a discrete group
concept.description: A function φ:G→ℂ on a discrete group is positive definite if ∑_(i,j)c_i conjugate(c_j)φ(g_j⁻¹g_i)≥0 for all finite choices g_i∈G and c_i∈ℂ. Equivalently (g,h)↦φ(h⁻¹g) is a positive definite kernel.

concept.title: Bochner representation on the integer lattice
concept.description: Every positive definite function φ:ℤᵈ→ℂ has a unique finite positive Borel measure μ on ℝᵈ/ℤᵈ such that φ(n)=∫exp(2πi⟨n,x⟩)dμ(x). Its mass is φ(0), so it is a probability measure exactly when φ(0)=1.

concept.title: Weyl exponential-sum criterion
concept.description: A two-sided real sequence x_n is equidistributed modulo one if and only if (2N+1)⁻¹∑_(n=−N)^N exp(2πikx_n)→0 for every nonzero integer k. The analogous equivalence holds for one-sided Cesàro averages.

concept.title: Limit superior of a real sequence
concept.description: For a real sequence a_n, its limit superior is limsup a_n=inf_N sup_(n≥N)a_n, with values in the extended real line. Equivalently limsup a_n=−liminf(−a_n).

concept.title: Van der Corput correlation bound
concept.description: If |a_n|≤1, then for every integer H≥1, limsup_(N→∞)|N⁻¹∑_(n=1)^N a_n|²≤1/H+(2/H²)∑_(h=1)^(H−1)(H−h)limsup_(N→∞)Re(N⁻¹∑_(n=1)^(N−h)a_(n+h)conjugate(a_n)).

concept.title: Conjugate complex Hilbert space
concept.description: For a complex Hilbert space H, its conjugate H̄ has the same additive group, scalar multiplication c·ū=(conjugate(c)u)̄, and inner product ⟨ū,v̄⟩=conjugate(⟨u,v⟩). A unitary U induces Ūū=(Uu)̄.

concept.title: Eigenvectors of a tensor product of unitaries
concept.description: For unitary U on H and V on K, every vector w with (U⊗V)w=λw is a norm-convergent sum ∑_j c_j u_j⊗v_j, where (u_j) and (v_j) are orthonormal families, Uu_j=α_j u_j, Vv_j=β_j v_j, and α_jβ_j=λ for nonzero terms.

concept.title: Compact vectors of one unitary operator
concept.description: For a unitary T, the compact-vector subspace H_c(T) is the closed linear span of its eigenvectors. For every positive integer k, H_c(Tᵏ)=H_c(T).

concept.title: Subgroups of finitely generated nilpotent groups are finitely generated
concept.description: Every subgroup of a finitely generated nilpotent group is itself finitely generated and nilpotent.

concept.title: Intersections of tensor product subspaces
concept.description: For finitely many closed subspaces M_i⊆H and N_i⊆K, ⋂_i(M_i⊗N_i)=(⋂_iM_i)⊗(⋂_iN_i), where each tensor product is the closed Hilbert tensor subspace of H⊗K.

concept.title: Null coefficients of polynomial nilpotent unitary orbits
concept.description: Let G be a finitely generated nilpotent unitary group, g:ℤ→G polynomial with g(0)=1, and E=⟨g(ℤ)⟩. If u is orthogonal to H_c(E), then ⟨g(n)u,v⟩ is symmetric Cesàro-null for every v.

concept.title: Distal compact metric dynamical system
concept.description: A homeomorphism T of a compact metric space X is distal if inf_(n∈ℤ)d(Tⁿx,Tⁿy)>0 for every pair of distinct points x,y.

concept.title: Minimal point of a compact dynamical system
concept.description: A point x of a compact dynamical system (X,T) is minimal if its orbit closure contains no proper nonempty closed T-invariant subset. Equivalently, the orbit of every point in that closure is dense in the closure.

concept.title: Syndetic subset of the integers
concept.description: A set S⊆ℤ is syndetic if some positive integer L makes every integer interval {a,a+1,…,a+L} meet S.

concept.title: Every point of a distal compact metric system is minimal
concept.description: Every point in a distal compact metric dynamical system is a minimal point.

concept.title: Distality of nilrotations
concept.description: Every translation on a compact nilmanifold is a distal homeomorphism. Connectedness of the nilpotent Lie group is not required.

concept.title: Syndetic return times of a minimal point
concept.description: If x is a minimal point of a compact dynamical system and U is an open neighborhood of x, then {n∈ℤ:Tⁿx∈U} is syndetic. Conversely syndetic returns to every neighborhood imply minimality.

concept.title: Algebra and uniform closure of nilsequences
concept.description: For a fixed d≥1, basic d-step nilsequences form a complex algebra stable under conjugation and integer shifts; the same is true with no step bound. Their uniform closures, the d-step nilsequences and nilsequences, are uniformly closed algebras with the same invariances.

concept.title: Polynomial phases are basic nilsequences
concept.description: For every real polynomial p, the sequence exp(2πip(n)), n∈ℤ, is a basic nilsequence.

concept.title: Connected simply connected realization of basic nilsequences
concept.description: Every basic nilsequence can be realized as the restriction of a continuous test function along a nilrotation on a compact nilmanifold whose ambient nilpotent Lie group is connected and simply connected, allowing an increase of the dimension.

concept.title: Interlacing nilsequences on finitely many arithmetic progressions
concept.description: Let m≥1 and a be a bounded complex sequence on ℤ. If each subsequence a_(mt+r), 0≤r<m, is a basic nilsequence, a nilsequence, or an almost nilsequence with symmetric Cesàro-null remainder, respectively, then a has the same respective property.

concept.title: Uniformly closed algebra of nilsequence plus null sequences
concept.description: The bounded sequences that are sums of a nilsequence and a symmetric Cesàro-null sequence form a uniformly closed complex algebra invariant under conjugation and shifts. The same holds for a fixed nilpotency step bound.

concept.title: Compact and weak part of a unitary representation
concept.description: For a unitary representation of a group G on H, the compact vectors form a closed invariant subspace H_c, equal to the closed span of finite-dimensional invariant subspaces. Its orthogonal complement H_w is invariant, and H=H_c⊕H_w. For every unitary representation on K the diagonal tensor representation on H_w⊗K has no nonzero invariant vector.

concept.title: Product normal form of polynomial sequences in a nilpotent group
concept.description: For a nilpotent group G, the sequences g:ℤ→G annihilated by a sufficiently high iterate of Dg(n)=g(n)⁻¹g(n+1) are exactly finite products U₁^(p₁(n))⋯U_r^(p_r(n)) with U_j∈G and integer-valued polynomials p_j. If g(0)=1, the factors can be chosen with p_j(0)=0.

concept.title: Holomorphic logarithm
concept.description: A holomorphic logarithm of a nowhere-zero holomorphic function f on an open complex domain U is a holomorphic g:U→ℂ with exp(g)=f; on a connected U any two differ by a constant integer multiple of 2πi.

concept.title: Residue of a meromorphic function
concept.description: For a meromorphic function f near an isolated singularity a, its residue is (2πi)⁻¹∮f(z)dz around a sufficiently small positively oriented circle containing no other singularity; equivalently it is the coefficient of (z−a)⁻¹ in the Laurent expansion.

concept.title: Residue theorem
concept.description: For a meromorphic function near the closure of a bounded region with piecewise smooth oriented boundary, with finitely many poles inside and none on the boundary, the boundary integral is 2πi times the sum of the residues, with winding-number weights for a general closed contour.

concept.title: Borel–Carathéodory theorem
concept.description: Let f be holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closed disk |z−a|≤R and 0<r<R. Then max_{|z−a|≤r}|f(z)−f(a)|≤2r/(R−r)·(max_{|z−a|≤R}Re f(z)−Re f(a)).

concept.title: Hadamard three-circles theorem
concept.description: For a holomorphic f on an annulus r₁≤|z−a|≤r₃, continuous on its boundary, set M(r)=max_{|z−a|=r}|f(z)|. For r₁<r₂<r₃, log M(r₂)≤[log(r₃/r₂)log M(r₁)+log(r₂/r₁)log M(r₃)]/log(r₃/r₁), with zero values interpreted by a limit.

concept.title: Phragmén–Lindelöf principle for a finite-order strip
concept.description: Let f be holomorphic in a<Re z<b and continuous on its closure, with |f(σ+it)|≤exp(C(1+|t|)^N) uniformly in the strip. If |f|≤M on both vertical boundary lines, then |f|≤M throughout; if the two boundary values tend uniformly to zero as t→+∞, then the interior strip supremum also tends to zero.

concept.title: Convexity bound for the Selberg class
concept.description: For L in the Selberg class with gamma degree d_L=2∑λ_j, every ε>0 gives |L(σ+it)|≪_{L,ε}|t|^{d_L(1−σ)/2+ε}, uniformly 0≤σ≤1 and |t|≥2.

concept.title: Smoothed second moment of a short Dirichlet polynomial
concept.description: Let Φ∈C_c^∞((1,2)), ε>0 and R(t)=∑_{n≤N}r_n n^{−it}, with N≤T^{1−ε}. Then ∫ℝ|R(t)|²Φ(t/T)dt=T(∫Φ)∑|r_n|²+O_{Φ,ε}(∑|r_n|²), uniformly in all complex r_n and T≥2.

concept.title: Logarithmic integral below one
concept.description: For 0<x<1 define li(x)=∫₀ˣdt/log t. This improper integral is finite; its derivative is 1/log x.

concept.title: Expansion of the logarithmic integral below one
concept.description: For 0<x<1, li(x)=C+log(−log x)+∑_{j≥1}(log x)^j/(j·j!), where C is an absolute real constant. In particular li(x)=log(−log x)+O(1) as x↑1.

concept.title: Second mean-value theorem for integrals
concept.description: If f is a monotone real function on [a,b] and g is continuous there, some ξ∈[a,b] satisfies ∫ₐᵇfg=f(a)∫ₐ^ξg+f(b)∫_ξᵇg.

concept.title: Tensor moments of a uniform complex unit vector
concept.description: Ifw is uniform on the unit sphere ofℂⁿ andt is a positive integer, E(ww*)^(⊗t)=P_sym/binom(n+t−1,t), whereP_sym is the orthogonal projector onto tensors fixed by all factor permutations.

concept.title: Positivity and trace-norm contraction of a partial trace
concept.description: The partial traceTr_K on finite matrix tensors is characterized byTr_K(A⊗B)=tr(B)A. It maps positive semidefinite matrices to positive semidefinite matrices and satisfies‖Tr_K Z‖₁≤‖Z‖₁ for HermitianZ.

concept.title: Expected norm of a matrix Rademacher series
concept.description: For deterministic self-adjoint n×n matricesA_i and independent Rademacherε_i, E‖∑ε_iA_i‖_(op)≤√(2log(2n))‖∑A_i²‖_(op)^(1/2).

concept.title: Matrix Chernoff bound for the expected norm of a positive sum
concept.description: For independent positive semidefinite n×n matricesX_i with‖X_i‖_(op)≤L almost surely andμ=‖∑EX_i‖_(op), E‖∑X_i‖_(op)≤(e^τ−1)μ/τ+Llog(n)/τ for everyτ>0.

concept.title: Cardinality of a Euclidean sphere net
concept.description: For0<ε<1, the unit sphere inℝ^d has a finiteε-net of cardinality at most(1+2/ε)^d in Euclidean distance.

concept.title: Small-ball bound for Gaussian or exact four-design quadratic measurements
concept.description: LetZ be Hermitian with‖Z‖_F=1. Leta either be a standard complex Gaussian vector or have the law[n(n+1)]^(1/4)w, wherew is drawn from an exact weighted complex projective4-design. For0≤ξ≤1, P(|a*Za|≥ξ)≥(1−ξ²)²/24.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Small-ball bound for trace-accurate or norm-constrained operator-accurate four-designs
concept.description: Letw be drawn from a weighted approximate complex projective4-design andseta=[n(n+1)]^(1/4)w. Ifθ₁≤1/4, then for every HermitianZ with‖Z‖_F=1 and0≤ξ≤1/√2, P(|a*Za|≥ξ)≥(1−2ξ²)²/192. The same bound holds underθ_∞≤1/(16s²),s≥1, provided also‖Z‖₁≤2√s.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Expected norm of a Gaussian rank-one Rademacher sum
concept.description: For independent standard complex Gaussian vectorsa_i∈ℂⁿ and independent Rademacherε_i, ifm≥cn then E‖m^(−1/2)∑_(i=1)^mε_ia_ia_i*‖_(op)≤C√n for universalc,C>0.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Expected norm of a bounded isotropic rank-one Rademacher sum
concept.description: FixK≥1. Let independent randoma_i∈ℂⁿ satisfy‖a_i‖₂²≤Kn almost surely and‖Ea_ia_i*‖_(op)≤K. For independent Rademacherε_i andm≥2nlogn,n≥2, E‖m^(−1/2)∑ε_ia_ia_i*‖_(op)≤C_K√(nlog(2n)), whereC_K depends only onK.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Helstrom formula for distinguishing two states with equal priors
concept.description: For density matricesX,Y and priorprobabilities1/2 each, the largest probability of correctly identifying the state using any finite POVM is1/2+‖X−Y‖₁/4. Equivalently max_(0≤E≤I)|tr(E(X−Y))|=‖X−Y‖₁/2.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Banach space of bounded complex sequences on the integers
concept.description: The space ℓ∞(ℤ) consists of bounded complex sequences a=(a_n)_(n∈ℤ), with pointwise vector operations and supremum norm ‖a‖∞=sup_n|a_n|. This norm makes it a Banach space.

concept.title: Compact abelian topological group
concept.description: An abelian topological group whose underlying topological space is compact Hausdorff.

concept.title: Almost periodic complex sequence
concept.description: A bounded complex sequence a_n on ℤ is almost periodic if a_n=f(τⁿx) for some compact abelian topological group G, τ,x∈G and continuous f:G→ℂ.

concept.title: Bohr characterizations of almost periodic sequences
concept.description: For a bounded complex sequence on ℤ, almost periodicity is equivalent both to relative norm compactness of its integer translates in ℓ∞(ℤ), and to uniform approximability by finite linear combinations of the sequences exp(2πint), t∈ℝ/ℤ.

concept.title: Heisenberg theta sequence
concept.description: For real α,β, the Heisenberg theta sequence is ω_n(α,β)=κ(nα,nβ)exp(πin(n−1)αβ), where κ(s,t)=∑_(k∈ℤ)exp(−π(t+k)²)exp(2πiks) for real s,t. These sequences arise by evaluating theta functions along Heisenberg nilrotations.

concept.title: Rational independence modulo one
concept.description: Real numbers x₁,…,x_r are rationally independent modulo one if 1,x₁,…,x_r are linearly independent over ℚ, equivalently ∑_j m_jx_j∈ℤ with integers m_j forces all m_j=0.

concept.title: Quadratic mean norm of a nilsequence
concept.description: For a nilsequence a on ℤ, its quadratic mean norm is ‖a‖₂=(lim_(N→∞)N⁻¹∑_(n=0)^(N−1)|a_n|²)^(1/2). The limit exists for nilsequences; it agrees with integration of |f|² on the uniquely ergodic orbit closure for basic nilsequences, and extends by uniform approximation.

concept.title: Host–Kra density of elementary theta sequences
concept.description: The 2-step nilsequences are the uniformly closed shift-invariant linear span of sequences exp(2πins)exp(πin(n−1)t)∏_(j=1)^dω_n(α_j,β_j), where s,t∈ℝ/ℤ, d≥0 and α₁,…,α_d,β₁,…,β_d are rationally independent modulo one. Their linear span is also dense among 2-step nilsequences in the quadratic mean norm.

concept.title: Host–Kra–Maass local cube criterion for nilsequences
concept.description: For d≥2, a bounded complex sequence a is a (d−1)-step nilsequence iff for every ε>0 some L≥1 and δ>0 have this property: for all k,n₁,…,n_d∈ℤ, if |a_(k+∑η_jn_j+t)−a_(k+t)|<δ for every |t|≤L and every η∈{0,1}ᵈ except η=(1,…,1), then |a_(k+∑n_j)−a_k|<ε.

concept.title: Homotopy of continuous maps
concept.description: A homotopy from continuous f₀:X→Y to f₁:X→Y is a continuous map F:X×[0,1]→Y with F(x,0)=f₀(x) and F(x,1)=f₁(x). A homotopy relative to A⊆X additionally keeps F(a,t) constant in t for each a∈A.

concept.title: Simply connected topological space
concept.description: A path-connected space X is simply connected if every continuous loop γ:[0,1]→X with γ(0)=γ(1) is homotopic relative to its endpoints to the constant loop at γ(0).

concept.title: Exponential map of a real Lie group
concept.description: For a real Lie group G and X in its Lie algebra, exp_G(X)=γ_X(1), where γ_X:ℝ→G is the unique smooth group homomorphism with γ_X′(0)=X under the tangent-space identification at the identity.

concept.title: Exponential diffeomorphism for simply connected nilpotent Lie groups
concept.description: For a connected simply connected nilpotent real Lie group G, exp_G is a diffeomorphism from its Lie algebra onto G. In particular each g∈G has a unique mth root exp_G((1/m)log_G(g)) for every positive integer m.

concept.title: Entropy formula for an integer toral automorphism
concept.description: For A∈GL_d(ℤ), the induced homeomorphism T_A:x↦Ax of ℝᵈ/ℤᵈ has topological entropy ∑_(j=1)^d max(0,log|λ_j|), where λ_j are the complex eigenvalues of A with multiplicity.

concept.title: Rapidly decreasing sequence on the integer lattice
concept.description: A complex sequence a=(a_r)_(r∈ℤᵈ) is rapidly decreasing if sup_r(1+|r|²)^k|a_r|<∞ for every nonnegative integer k. These seminorms give the space its standard locally convex topology.

concept.title: Smooth noncommutative torus
concept.description: For the ordered monomials u^r=u₁^(r₁)⋯u_d^(r_d) in A_Θ, the smooth noncommutative torus A_Θ^∞ consists of the norm-convergent sums ∑_(r∈ℤᵈ)a_r u^r with rapidly decreasing coefficients. It has the topology of their rapid-decrease seminorms and the product and involution inherited from A_Θ.

concept.title: Tracial state on a C*-algebra
concept.description: A tracial state on a C*-algebra A is a state τ satisfying τ(ab)=τ(ba) for all a,b∈A. It is faithful if τ(a*a)=0 implies a=0.

concept.title: Canonical trace of a noncommutative torus
concept.description: The canonical faithful tracial state τ on A_Θ is determined on finite ordered Fourier sums by τ(∑_r a_r u^r)=a_0. It extends continuously to A_Θ; the ordered monomials form an orthonormal basis of the Hilbert completion for ⟨a,b⟩=τ(b*a), so that completion identifies with ℓ²(ℤᵈ).

concept.title: Real torus
concept.description: The n-dimensional real torus is the compact abelian topological group (ℝ/ℤ)^n with quotient topology and coordinatewise addition; integration of a periodic function is integration over [0,1]^n.

concept.title: Sectorial Stirling formula for gamma
concept.description: For each δ>0, uniformly as |z|→∞ in |arg z|≤π−δ, Γ(z)=√(2π)exp((z−1/2)Log z−z)(1+Oδ(|z|⁻¹)), where Log is the principal logarithm on the slit plane.

concept.title: Riemann zeta function
concept.description: The Riemann zeta function is ζ(s)=∑_{n≥1}n^{−s} for Re s>1, with its meromorphic continuation to ℂ, having a simple pole at1 and residue1. Its nontrivial zeros are the zeros with0<Re s<1, counted with multiplicity.

concept.title: Classical logarithmic zero-free region for zeta
concept.description: There is c>0 such that ζ(σ+it)≠0 whenever σ≥1−c/log(|t|+3), except for its pole at1.

concept.title: Local zero count for the Riemann zeta function
concept.description: For T≥2, the number of nontrivial zeta zeros ρ with |Imρ−T|≤1, counted with multiplicity, is O(log T).

concept.title: Truncated explicit formula for the Chebyshev function
concept.description: For half-integers x≥3 and T≥2, ψ(x)=x−∑_{|Imρ|<T}x^ρ/ρ+O(x log²(xT)/T+log x), where ρ runs over nontrivial zeros of ζ with multiplicity and ψ(x)=∑_{n≤x}Λ(n).

concept.title: Jensen formula on a disk
concept.description: If f is holomorphic near |z−a|≤R, f(a)≠0 and f has no zeros on the boundary, then (2π)⁻¹∫₀^{2π}log|f(a+Re^{iθ})|dθ=log|f(a)|+∑_{|ρ−a|<R}mρ log(R/|ρ−a|).

concept.title: Local zero count in the Selberg class
concept.description: For a fixed L in the Selberg class and T≥2, the number of nontrivial zeros ρ with |Imρ−T|≤1 is O_L(log(T+3)), counted with multiplicity.

concept.title: Local logarithmic-derivative expansion in the Selberg class
concept.description: For a fixed Selberg-class L, uniformly −5/2≤σ≤7/2 and sufficiently large |t| (depending on L) at points s=σ+it which are not zeros or poles, L′(s)/L(s)=∑_{ρ:|Imρ−t|≤1}(s−ρ)⁻¹+O_L(log|t|), with nontrivial zeros counted with multiplicity.

concept.title: Smoothed prime lower approximation for log L
concept.description: Let L be in the Selberg class with Euler logarithm b(p^k)≪p^{kδ}, δ<1/2, and a(p)=|a(p)|e^{iωp}. If1/2≤σ<1,t₀≥15 and L(σ′+it)≠0 for σ′>σ, |t−t₀|≤2(log t₀)², then for every realθ and x>2 some |t₁|≤(log t₀)² gives Re(e^{−iθ}log L(σ+i(t₀+t₁)))≥(1/2)∑_{|log(p/x)|≤1}|a(p)|p^{−σ}cos(t₀logp−ωp)(1−|log(p/x)|)−C_L[x(log t₀)⁻²+x^{2δ−2σ+1/2}logx], using the Euler-normalized logarithm continued horizontally from Re s>1 and its finite boundary values.

concept.title: Polynomial powers of a quasi-unipotent matrix on residue classes
concept.description: If an invertible complex d×d matrix A has all eigenvalues roots of unity, some m≥1 satisfies (Aᵐ−I)ᵈ=0, and A^(mt+r)=Aʳ∑_(j=0)^(d−1)binom(t,j)(Aᵐ−I)^j for every t∈ℤ and 0≤r<m. Thus every entry is polynomial in t; if A is real the coefficients are real.

concept.title: Scalar-commuting unitaries generate a two-step nilpotent group
concept.description: If unitary operators U₁,…,U_d satisfy U_iU_j=ζ_(ij)U_jU_i with scalar |ζ_(ij)|=1, their generated group is nilpotent of class at most two: every group commutator is a scalar operator and is therefore central.

concept.title: Norm density of Fourier polynomials in a noncommutative torus
concept.description: Finite linear combinations of the ordered monomials u₁^(r₁)⋯u_d^(r_d), r∈ℤᵈ, are norm dense in A_Θ.

concept.title: Discrete antiderivative of a polynomial
concept.description: For every real polynomial P there is a real polynomial Q with Q(0)=0 and Q(n+1)−Q(n)=P(n). Thus for n≥0, Σ_(j=0)^(n−1)P(j)=Q(n), and the same polynomial identity extends to signed sums for negative n.

concept.title: Contractivity of star homomorphisms of C*-algebras
concept.description: Every star homomorphism φ:A→B of C*-algebras is contractive: ‖φ(a)‖≤‖a‖. An injective star homomorphism is isometric; in particular every star automorphism is isometric.

concept.title: Exactness of a noncommutative torus
concept.description: Every finite-dimensional noncommutative torus A_Θ is an exact C*-algebra.

concept.title: Sarnak Möbius disjointness conjecture
concept.description: For every homeomorphism T of a compact metric space X with h_top(T)=0, every continuous f:X→ℂ and every x∈X satisfy N⁻¹∑_(n=1)^N μ(n)f(Tⁿx)→0. Equivalently all bounded sequences realized by continuous observations of zero-entropy compact metric systems are Möbius-orthogonal.

concept.title: Centered subGaussian real random variable
concept.description: A centered real random variableX is subGaussian if someK≥0 satisfiesEexp(tX)≤exp(K²t²/2) for every realt.

concept.title: Gaussian orthogonal ensemble in Frobenius normalization
concept.description: GOE(n) here is the law of a real symmetric n×n matrix whose diagonal entries are independentN(0,1) and whose upper offdiagonal entries are independentN(0,1/2), independent also of the diagonal. Equivalently its coordinates in a real orthonormal Frobenius basis are independent standard normals.

concept.title: Trace Hölder bound for nuclear and operator norms
concept.description: For real or complex matricesA,B of equal size, |tr(A*B)|≤‖A‖₁‖B‖_(op).

concept.title: Statistical dimension of a closed convex cone
concept.description: For a closed convex coneC⊆ℝ^d, its statistical dimension isδ(C)=E‖Π_Cg‖₂², whereg is a standard Gaussian vector andΠ_C is the Euclidean nearest-point projection.

concept.title: Gaussian nullspace phase bound for a convex cone
concept.description: For a closed convex coneC⊆ℝ^d, statisticaldimensionδ(C), and an m×d matrixA with independent real standard normal entries, ifm≤δ(C)−t√d witht>0 thenP(kerA∩C≠{0})≥1−4exp(−t²/8).

concept.title: Positive-semidefinite nullspace obstruction for Gaussian symmetric measurements
concept.description: LetA(X)=(tr(A_iX))_(i=1)^m with independentA_i∼GOE(n) in Frobenius normalization andd=n(n+1)/2. For0<ε<1 andm≤(1−ε)d/2, with probability at least1−4exp(−ε²d/32), kerA contains a nonzero positive semidefinite realmatrixΔ. Consequently every noiseless positive-semidefinite feasibility set through anyX≥0 contains the unboundedrayX+tΔ,t≥0.

concept.title: Ramanujan criterion for a polynomial Euler product
concept.description: For a multiplicative Dirichlet series with fixed-length Euler factors ∏_{j=1}^m(1−α_j(p)p^{−s})⁻¹, the coefficient bounds |a(n)|≪εn^ε for every ε>0 are equivalent to |α_j(p)|≤1 for every p,j. In this case |a(p)|≤m.

concept.title: Hadamard logarithmic-derivative identity under Selberg RH
concept.description: Let L be a Selberg-class function with all nontrivial zeros ρ=1/2+iγ. For1/2<σ≤2 and sufficiently large |t|, away from zeros, Re[L′(σ+it)/L(σ+it)]=∑ρ(σ−1/2)/|σ+it−ρ|²−(d_L/2)log|t|+O_L(1); the nonnegative sum converges and counts multiplicities.

concept.title: Perron integral for the positive logarithm
concept.description: For y>0 and c>0, (2πi)⁻¹∫_{c−i∞}^{c+i∞}y^w w⁻²dw=max(logy,0); the vertical integral is absolutely convergent.

concept.title: Formal derivative of a polynomial
concept.description: For f(x)=∑_(i=0)^n a_ix^i over a commutative ring, its formal derivative is f′(x)=∑_(i=1)^n i a_ix^(i−1).

concept.title: Integral basis from a local Eisenstein polynomial
concept.description: If f is Eisenstein of degree n over a p-adic local field K and α is a root, then f is irreducible, L=K(α) is totally ramified of degree n, α is a uniformizer, and O_L=O_K[α], free over O_K with basis1,α,…,α^(n−1).

concept.title: Derivative norm of a monogenic discriminant
concept.description: For a monic separable degree-n polynomial f over K with root α and L=K(α) of degree n, the discriminant of1,α,…,α^(n−1) is (−1)^(n(n−1)/2)N_(L/K)(f′(α)). For a local integral basis this generates the field discriminant ideal.

concept.title: Valuation of a local field norm
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields with normalized discrete valuations, v_K(N_(L/K)x)=f(L/K)v_L(x), where f is the residue degree.

concept.title: Coefficient criterion for the discriminant of an Eisenstein polynomial
concept.description: Let f=xⁿ+∑_(i<n)f_ix^i be Eisenstein over K and J=an+b with0≤b<n. Put l(i)=max(2+a−v_K(i),1) for i<b and max(1+a−v_K(i),1) for i≥b. Then Disc(K(α)/K)=𝔭^(n+J−1) iff v_K(f_i)≥l(i) for1≤i<n and, when b≠0,v_K(f_b)=l(b), provided J satisfies Ore’s conditions.

concept.title: Valuations of Eisenstein ramification coefficients
concept.description: For Eisenstein f=xⁿ+∑_(k<n)f_kx^k over K, a root α and v_L(α)=1, the coefficients of ρ(x)=f(αx+α)/αⁿ satisfy ρ_i=∑_(k=i)^n binom(k,i)f_kα^(k−n) and v_L(ρ_i)=min_(k=i)^n{n v_K(binom(k,i)f_k)+k−n} for1≤i≤n.

concept.title: Coefficient criterion for a Newton polygon with specified markings
concept.description: Let R be a lower convex polygon over the integer interval[a,b], and let T⊆S⊆{a,…,b} include all vertex abscissas in T. A polynomial h with nonzero endpoint coefficients has lower Newton polygon R and, among tested abscissas S, precisely the on-polygon points T iff v(h_i)≥R(i) for all i, equality holds for i∈T, and v(h_i)>R(i) for i∈S∖T, using v(0)=∞.

concept.title: Rellich analytic eigendecomposition for Hermitian matrix families
concept.description: If A(t) is a square complex matrix whose entries are real analytic on an open real interval I and A(t)=A(t)* for every t∈I, then A(t)=U(t)D(t)U(t)* with U(t) unitary and D(t) real diagonal, all entries of U and D real analytic throughout I.

concept.title: Directed partially ordered set
concept.description: A directed set is a nonempty partially ordered set D in which every pair of indices has a common upper bound.

concept.title: Convergence of a net in a metric space
concept.description: A net in a metric space X is a function x:D→X from a directed set. It converges to a∈X if for every ε>0 some d₀∈D satisfies d≥d₀⇒dist(x_d,a)<ε.

concept.title: Minimal unitization of a nonunital C*-algebra
concept.description: For a nonzero nonunital C*-algebra A, its minimal unitization Ã is A⊕ℂ with (a,λ)(b,μ)=(ab+λb+μa,λμ), (a,λ)*=(a*,λ̄), identity(0,1), and norm sup_{b∈A,‖b‖≤1}‖ab+λb‖. For A=0, set Ã=ℂ.

concept.title: C*-algebra structure of the minimal unitization
concept.description: The minimal unitization Ã of a nonunital C*-algebra A is a unital C*-algebra; a↦(a,0) embeds A isometrically as a closed two-sided ideal of codimension one.

concept.title: Positive contractive approximate identity in a C*-algebra
concept.description: A positive contractive approximate identity of a C*-algebra A is a net e_d∈A with e_d≥0,‖e_d‖≤1, and ‖e_da−a‖→0 and ‖ae_d−a‖→0 for every a∈A. No countability or monotonicity is required in this convention.

concept.title: Existence of positive contractive approximate identities
concept.description: Every C*-algebra admits a positive contractive approximate identity.

concept.title: State extension to the minimal C*-unitization
concept.description: Every state ρ on a nonunital C*-algebra A has the unique state extension ρ̃(a+λ1)=ρ(a)+λ to its minimal unitization.

concept.title: Root valuations and Newton polygon slopes
concept.description: For a polynomial over a complete discretely valued field, each finite lower Newton segment of slope −s and horizontal length m corresponds to exactly m nonzero roots of valuation s in an algebraic closure, counted with multiplicity. The power of x dividing the polynomial accounts separately for its zero roots.

concept.title: Uniformizer change of leading ramification residues
concept.description: Let α,α′ be uniformizers of the same totally ramified L/K and let δ be the residue of α′/α. Their ramification polygons and on-polygon coefficient markings agree. For an on-polygon abscissa j with ordinate R_j, the normalized leading residues γ_j=overline(ρ_j α^(−R_j)) satisfy γ′_j=δ^(−R_j)γ_j.

concept.title: Uniformizer invariance of the residual-polynomial orbit
concept.description: The residual-polynomial orbit attached to a totally ramified local extension is independent of its generating uniformizer, including the marked on-polygon coefficient points.

concept.title: Leading residues of ramification coefficients from Eisenstein coefficients
concept.description: For an on-polygon ramification point (j,J), write J=an+b with1≤b≤n. Put F_b=v_K f_b, λ_b=overline(f_bπ^(−F_b)), c=overline(f₀/π), and β(b,j)=overline(binom(b,j)π^(−v_K binom(b,j))). Then F_b=a+1−v_K binom(b,j) and γ_j=β(b,j)λ_b(−c)^(−a−1), with f_n=1.

concept.title: Compatibility of fine ramification residues with Eisenstein coefficients
concept.description: Fix an admissible marked ramification polygon with its exact coefficient-valuation bounds. Prescribed nonzero on-polygon residues γ_j are realizable iff there are residue units c and λ_b, with λ_n=1, satisfying γ_j=β(b,j)λ_b(−c)^(−a−1) at every marked point J=an+b,1≤b≤n. Shared indices b use the same λ_b; horizontal residues must equal overline(binom(n,j)).

concept.title: Coordinate and root-product formulas for Eisenstein distance
concept.description: For monic degree-n Eisenstein f,g over K, d(f,g)=|π|^w with w=min_(0≤i<n)(v_K(g_i−f_i)+i/n). If α=α₁,…,α_n are the roots of f and β is a root of g closest to α, then d(f,g)=∏_(i=1)^n max(|β−α|,|α−α_i|). In particular d is an ultrametric.

concept.title: Krasner truncation discs for Eisenstein extensions
concept.description: For totally ramified degree-n extensions of K with discriminant exponent n+J−1, choose an integer c>1+2J/n. Reducing Eisenstein coefficients modulo𝔭^c preserves the generated field up to K-isomorphism. The generating Eisenstein polynomials partition into closed distance discs of radius|π|^c, one for each admissible coefficient tuple modulo𝔭^c; each disc has constant extension invariants.

concept.title: Krasner count from polynomial discs to embedded fields
concept.description: Let X be a K-isomorphism-stable family of totally ramified degree-n extensions inside a fixed algebraic closure, all with discriminant exponent n+J−1. If c>1+2J/n is an integer and N_X is the number of radius|π|^c discs of their Eisenstein generating polynomials, then |X|=nN_X/((q−1)q^(nc−(n+J−1)−2)), where q is the residue cardinality.

concept.title: Positive-gauge Schatten recovery bound from a robust rank null space property
concept.description: Let A(X)=(tr(A_jX))_j on Hermitian matrices have Frobenius robust rank null space constantsρ,τ of orderr. Suppose W=Σ_jt_jA_j>0 andκ=‖W‖op‖W⁻¹‖op satisfiesκρ<1. For1≤p≤2 andX,Z≥0, ‖Z−X‖p≤2Cκr^(1/p−1)‖X_c‖₁+r^(1/p−1/2)‖A(Z−X)‖₂‖W⁻¹‖op[C‖t‖₂/√r+D‖W‖opτ], whereC=(1+κρ)²/(1−κρ) andD=(3+κρ)/(1−κρ).

concept.title: Robust rank null space bound for Gaussian quadratic measurements
concept.description: For independent standard complex Gaussian vectorsa_j∈ℂⁿ letA(X)=(a_j*Xa_j)_j on Hermitian matrices. There are universalc,C,c₀>0 such that for1≤r≤n,0<ρ<1 andm≥Cρ⁻²nr, with probability at least1−exp(−cm), A has Frobenius robust rank null space constantsρ andτ=c₀/√m of orderr.

concept.title: Conditioning of a complex Gaussian sample covariance matrix
concept.description: For independent standard complex Gaussian vectorsa_j∈ℂⁿ letW=m⁻¹Σ_ja_ja_j*. There are universalc,C>0 such that ifm≥Cn then, with probability at least1−exp(−cm), (1/2)I≤W≤(3/2)I; consequently‖W‖op≤3/2,‖W⁻¹‖op≤2 andκ(W)≤3.

concept.title: Uniform stable positive-semidefinite recovery from Gaussian quadratic measurements
concept.description: For independent standard complex Gaussian vectorsa_j∈ℂⁿ setA(X)=(a_j*Xa_j)_j. There are universalc,C,C₁,C₂>0 such that if1≤r≤n andm≥Cnr, with probability at least1−exp(−cm), simultaneously for allPSD X,Z and1≤p≤2, ‖Z−X‖p≤C₁r^(1/p−1)‖X_c‖₁+C₂r^(1/p−1/2)m⁻¹/²‖A(Z−X)‖₂. In particular every noiselessPSD feasibility set through a rank≤r matrix is a singleton; aPSD least-squares minimizer for noisy data has the same bound with residual at most twice the noise norm.

concept.title: Fundamental inequality of a valued field extension
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of discretely valued fields with a fixed extending valuation, the ramification index e and residue degree f satisfy ef≤[L:K]. In particular e≤[L:K].

concept.title: Krasner count of totally ramified extensions with fixed discriminant
concept.description: Let J=an+b,0≤b<n, satisfy Ore’s conditions over a p-adic field K of residue cardinality q. Put l(i)=max(2+a−v_K(i),1) for i<b, and max(1+a−v_K(i),1) for i≥b. The number of embedded totally ramified degree-n extensions of discriminant𝔭^(n+J−1) is n q^(n+J−1−∑_(i=1)^(n−1)l(i)) if b=0, and n(q−1)q^(n+J−2−∑_(i=1)^(n−1)l(i)) otherwise.

concept.title: Countable union of countable sets
concept.description: A union of countably many countable sets is countable (using countable choice to choose enumerations when they are not supplied).

concept.title: One-sided free sequence for a finite-valued set mapping
concept.description: If X is uncountable, n≥1 and S maps finite subsets of X to finite subsets of X, there are distinct z₁,…,z_n such that z_j∉S({z_i:i∈I}) whenever I⊂{1,…,n} is nonempty and j<min I or j>max I.

concept.title: Hoffmann–Jørgensen moment control by an increment maximum and quantile
concept.description: For independent increments in a separable invariant-metric semigroup, let U_n and M_n be the partial-product and increment distance maxima. For p>0 and t_p=U_n*(2^(−1−2p)), E U_n^p≤2^(1+2p)(E M_n^p+t_p^p).

concept.title: Stochastic integral increments for a right-regularized làdlàg process
concept.description: LetX be an optional làdlàg real process whose right-limit processX⁺ is a càdlàg semimartingale, andH a predictable process bounded after localization by stopping times. PutJ_t=∫_(0,t]H_s dX⁺_s−H_t(X_(t+)−X_t), using the ordinary càdlàg integral. Define∫_s^tH_u dX_u=J_t−J_s. This fixes increments even whenX has a right jump at0; the normalized primitive isJ_t−J_0.

concept.title: C² Itô formula for a càdlàg semimartingale
concept.description: For a real càdlàg semimartingaleA andf∈C²(ℝ), f(A_t)=f(A_0)+∫_(0,t]f′(A_(s−))dA_s+(1/2)∫_(0,t]f″(A_(s−))d[A]^c_s+Σ_(0<s≤t)[f(A_s)−f(A_(s−))−f′(A_(s−))ΔA_s], where[A]^c is the continuous part of the quadratic variation.

concept.title: C² Itô formula with combined left and right jumps
concept.description: LetX be optional and làdlàg withX⁺ a càdlàg semimartingale andX_(0−)=X_0. Forf∈C²(ℝ) putR_f(a,b)=f(b)−f(a)−f′(a)(b−a). Then f(X_t)=f(X_0)+∫_0^t f′(X_(s−))dX_s+(1/2)∫_0^t f″(X_(s−))d[X⁺]^c_s+Σ_(0≤s<t)R_f(X_(s−),X_(s+))+R_f(X_(t−),X_t), using the right-regularized integral increments.

concept.title: Kunita–Watanabe inequality for càdlàg covariation measures
concept.description: For real càdlàg semimartingalesM,N and predictableH,K on[0,T], ∫₀ᵀ|H_sK_s| |d[M,N]|_s≤(∫₀ᵀH_s²d[M]_s)^(1/2)(∫₀ᵀK_s²d[N]_s)^(1/2) almost surely, whenever the two right-hand integrals are finite; |d[M,N]| is the total variation of the signed covariation measure.

concept.title: Positivity and polarization of càdlàg quadratic variation
concept.description: For real càdlàg semimartingalesX,Y, the quadratic variations[X] and[Y] are locally finite increasing processes. Covariation is symmetric and bilinear, and[aX+bY]=a²[X]+2ab[X,Y]+b²[Y] for reala,b; in particular every such quadratic combination is increasing.

concept.title: Discrete topological space
concept.description: A topological space is discrete if every subset is open.

concept.title: Totally disconnected topological space
concept.description: A topological space is totally disconnected if every nonempty connected subset has exactly one point.

concept.title: Profinite group
concept.description: A profinite group is a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group. Finite groups have their discrete topology in this convention.

concept.title: Discrete module for a topological group
concept.description: A discrete module for a topological group G is an abelian G-module M with the discrete topology and continuous action G×M→M. Equivalently each element of M has an open stabilizer in G.

concept.title: Cochain complex of modules
concept.description: A cochain complex over a commutative ring R is a family of R-modules Cⁿ indexed by integers with R-linear maps dⁿ:Cⁿ→C^(n+1) satisfying d^(n+1)dⁿ=0. Its nth cohomology is Hⁿ(C)=ker dⁿ/im d^(n−1).

concept.title: Map of cochain complexes
concept.description: A cochain map f:C→D is a degree-preserving family of module homomorphisms fⁿ:Cⁿ→Dⁿ satisfying d_Dⁿfⁿ=f^(n+1)d_Cⁿ in every degree. It induces maps on cohomology by mapping a cocycle to its image.

concept.title: Long exact cohomology sequence of complexes
concept.description: A degreewise short exact sequence0→A→B→C→0 of cochain maps induces natural connecting homomorphisms δ:Hⁿ(C)→H^(n+1)(A) and an exact sequence⋯→Hⁿ(A)→Hⁿ(B)→Hⁿ(C)→H^(n+1)(A)→⋯.

concept.title: Finite image of a continuous map from compact to discrete
concept.description: Every continuous map from a compact space to a discrete space has finite image.

concept.title: Compactness of a finite product
concept.description: A finite Cartesian product of compact topological spaces is compact in the product topology.

concept.title: Quotient conjugation action on first group cohomology
concept.description: For N normal in G and a G-module M, g acts on a cocycle z:N→M by(g·z)(n)=g·z(g⁻¹ng). This induces an action of G/N on H¹(N,M), because inner N-actions induce the identity on cohomology. For profinite groups and discrete modules use continuous cocycles.

concept.title: Convex power jump-remainder lower bound
concept.description: For1<p<2 and reala,b withR=max(|a|,|b|)>0, |b|ᵖ−|a|ᵖ−p|a|^(p−1)sgn(a)(b−a)≥[p(p−1)/2](b−a)²R^(p−2), withsgn(0)=0. WhenR=0 bothsides are defined as0.

concept.title: Eigenvalue density of an isotropic Hermitian Gaussian matrix
concept.description: If a Hermitian n×n matrix has density proportional toexp(−a trH²),a>0, forLebesgue measure on its independent realcoordinates, its unordered real eigenvalues have jointdensity proportional toexp(−aΣ_jx_j²)∏_(i<j)(x_i−x_j)².
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Hankel moment determinant and orthogonal-polynomial product
concept.description: Letw be a possibly complex integrable weight onℝ with finite absolute moments throughdegree2n−2 and nonzero leadingprincipal Hankel determinants. Ifp_j(x)=κ_jx^j+⋯ satisfy∫p_jp_kw=δ_jk for0≤j,k<n, then det(∫x^(j+k)w(x)dx)_(j,k=0)^(n−1)=(1/n!)∫_(ℝⁿ)∏_(i<j)(x_i−x_j)²∏_iw(x_i)dx_i=∏_(j=0)^(n−1)κ_j⁻².
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Three-term recurrence for normalized orthogonal polynomials
concept.description: For a normalized polynomial sequence∫p_jp_kw=δ_jk with nonzero leadingcoefficientsκ_j and all needed Hankel determinants nonzero, multiplication byx has the recurrence xp_j=b_jp_(j+1)+a_jp_j+b_(j−1)p_(j−1), whereb_j=κ_j/κ_(j+1) andp_(−1)=0. The pairing is bilinear and may use a complexweight.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Christoffel–Darboux identity for an orthonormal polynomial kernel
concept.description: For bilinearly normalized orthogonal polynomials p_j with leadingcoefficientsκ_j≠0, Σ_(j=0)^(n−1)p_j(x)p_j(y)=(κ_(n−1)/κ_n)[p_n(x)p_(n−1)(y)−p_(n−1)(x)p_n(y)]/(x−y); atx=y use the derivative limit.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Normalized matrix Riemann–Hilbert problem on an oriented contour
concept.description: Given an oriented contourΣ and invertible jump matrixJ on it, a normalized matrixRiemann–Hilbert problem seeksY holomorphic offΣ with boundaryvaluesY_+=Y_-J, prescribed growth at any distinguished endpoints or singularities, and prescribed normalization at infinity. The plus side is theleftside of the orientedcontour.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Orthogonal-polynomial Cauchy-transform matrix
concept.description: For orthonormal polynomials p_n,p_(n−1) of a real-line weightw, withleadingcoefficientsκ_n,κ_(n−1)≠0, formY(z) with firstcolumn(κ_n⁻¹p_n(z),−2πiκ_(n−1)p_(n−1)(z))ᵀ and secondcolumn given by the corresponding entries∫_(ℝ)(firstcolumn)(x)w(x)/(2πi(x−z))dx. Away from singularities it has the uppertriangular jump[[1,w],[0,1]] and degree-n normalization at infinity.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: L² Cauchy boundary operators on smooth intersecting contours
concept.description: For an oriented contour made from finitely many smooth compact arcs and straight rays, with finitely many transverse intersections and nonzero meeting angles, C f(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Σ f(s)/(s−z)ds has bounded nontangential boundaryoperatorsC_± onL²(Σ), satisfyingC_+f−C_-f=f almosteverywhere.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Neumann-series inversion for a bounded operator
concept.description: IfA is a bounded linear operator on a Banach space with‖A‖<1, thenI−A is invertible and(I−A)⁻¹=Σ_(k=0)^∞A^k in operator norm, with‖(I−A)⁻¹‖≤(1−‖A‖)⁻¹.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Liouville theorem for bounded entire functions
concept.description: Every bounded holomorphic function onℂ isconstant; consequently an entirematrix-valued function tending toI at infinity is identicallyI, entry byentry.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Modified Bessel functions I and K
concept.description: On the principal slit plane, I_ν(z)=Σ_(k≥0)(z/2)^(ν+2k)/(k!Γ(k+ν+1)); fornonintegerν putK_ν(z)=π[I_(−ν)(z)−I_ν(z)]/[2sin(πν)], with the removable integer-order values obtained by continuation. Their continuations and derivatives give the normalized fundamental solutions ofz²y″+zy′−(z²+ν²)y=0.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Sectorial large-argument asymptotics of modified Bessel functions
concept.description: Forν in compact sets and fixedδ>0, I_ν(z)=e^z(2πz)^(−1/2)[1−(4ν²−1)/(8z)+O(z⁻²)] uniformly for|argz|≤π/2−δ, andK_ν(z)=(π/(2z))^(1/2)e^(−z)[1+(4ν²−1)/(8z)+O(z⁻²)] uniformly for|argz|≤3π/2−δ on the continued logarithm branch. Higher inverse-power expansions hold on closed subsectors.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Airy Ai function and sectorial asymptotics
concept.description: The entire Airy function Ai(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Γexp(t³/3−zt)dt, whereΓ goes from∞e^(−iπ/3) to∞e^(iπ/3), satisfiesAi″=zAi andAi(z)+ωAi(ωz)+ω²Ai(ω²z)=0,ω=e^(2πi/3). Uniformly for|argz|≤π−δ, Ai(z)=e^(−2z^(3/2)/3)z^(−1/4)(2√π)⁻¹[1−5z^(−3/2)/48+O(z⁻³)] andAi′(z)=−e^(−2z^(3/2)/3)z^(1/4)(2√π)⁻¹[1+7z^(−3/2)/48+O(z⁻³)], using principalpowers.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Barnes integral identity for the logarithm of gamma
concept.description: ForRez>−1 and holomorphic logarithms normalized bylogΓ(1)=logG(1)=0, ∫₀ᶻlogΓ(1+x)dx=(z/2)log(2π)−z(z+1)/2+zlogΓ(1+z)−logG(1+z), whereG is the canonical BarnesG-function and the integral stays inRe x>−1.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Dixon–Anderson interlacing integral
concept.description: Let a₁>⋯>a_(n+1) be real and s₁,…,s_(n+1)>0 be real. On a₁>t₁>a₂>⋯>t_n>a_(n+1), ∫∏_(i<j)(t_i−t_j)∏_(i=1)^n∏_(j=1)^(n+1)|t_i−a_j|^(s_j−1)dt=[∏_jΓ(s_j)/Γ(Σ_js_j)]∏_(i<j)(a_i−a_j)^(s_i+s_j−1).

concept.title: Convergence and holomorphy of the Selberg integral
concept.description: Forn≥2 the Selberg integrand∏_it_i^(a−1)(1−t_i)^(b−1)∏_(i<j)|t_i−t_j|^(2γ) is absolutelyintegrable on[0,1]^n whenRea,Reb>0 andReγ>−min(1/n,Rea/(n−1),Reb/(n−1)). Its integral is holomorphic in(a,b,γ) on thisdomain, with positive-real bases used off the measurezero collision/endpoints.

concept.title: Detailed balance for a Markov kernel
concept.description: A Markov kernel P on a measurable space satisfies detailed balance with a probability π if the measure π(dx)P(x,dy) on the product space is invariant under(x,y)↦(y,x). Such a kernel is reversible with respect toπ.

concept.title: Detailed balance implies invariance
concept.description: If a Markov kernel P satisfies detailed balance with π, thenπP=π.

concept.title: Detailed balance of the general Metropolis–Hastings kernel
