concept.description: For a target probabilityπ and proposal kernelQ, the general Metropolis–Hastings kernel with acceptance min(1,r), where r is the reversed/forward joint-proposal Radon–Nikodym ratio on their common part and zero on the forward-only part, satisfies detailed balance withπ and hence leavesπ invariant.

concept.title: Irreducibility with respect to a measure
concept.description: A Markov kernelP on(E,𝔈) is ψ-irreducible ifψ is a nonzeroσ-finite measure and every A∈𝔈 withψ(A)>0 satisfies∑_{n≥1}Pⁿ(x,A)>0 for everyx∈E.

concept.title: Aperiodicity of a general-state irreducible Markov chain
concept.description: A ψ-irreducible Markov chain is aperiodic if it admits no measurable cyclic decomposition of lengthd≥2: disjoint ψ-positive setsD₀,…,D_{d−1} withψ-null complement andP(x,D_{i+1 mod d})=1 for everyx∈D_i.

concept.title: Small set for a Markov kernel
concept.description: A measurable setC is small forP if some integerm≥1,ε>0 and probabilityν satisfyP^m(x,A)≥εν(A) for everyx∈C and measurableA.

concept.title: Petite set for a Markov kernel
concept.description: A measurable setC is petite forP if some probability(a_n) on the nonnegative integers,ε>0 and probabilityν satisfy∑_{n≥0}a_nP^n(x,A)≥εν(A) for allx∈C and measurableA.

concept.title: Weak Feller Markov kernel
concept.description: A Markov kernelP on a topological space is weak Feller ifPf is bounded continuous wheneverf is bounded continuous.

concept.title: Positive Harris recurrence
concept.description: A ψ-irreducible Markov chain is Harris recurrent if every ψ-positive measurable set is visited infinitely often almost surely from every initial state; it is positive Harris recurrent if it also admits an invariant probability.

concept.title: Invariant moment bound from geometric drift
concept.description: IfP is a Markov kernel,πP=π and a finite measurableV≥0 satisfiesPV≤aV+b with0≤a<1,0≤b<∞, thenπ(V)≤b/(1−a); no prior integrability assumption onV is required.

concept.title: Compact small sets for a positive continuous transition density
concept.description: LetP(x,dy)=p(x,y)dy onℝᵈ, wherep is jointly continuous and strictly positive. Every compactC⊂ℝᵈ is a one-step small set; the chain is Lebesgue-irreducible and aperiodic.

concept.title: Harris geometric ergodicity from petite-set drift
concept.description: LetP be ψ-irreducible and aperiodic. If a finite measurableV≥1, a petite setC withsup_CV<∞,0≤a<1 andb<∞ satisfyPV≤aV+b1_C, thenP is positive Harris recurrent andV-uniformly ergodic.

concept.title: Kantorovich duality for a nonnegative lower semicontinuous cost
concept.description: For Borel probabilities μ,ν on Polish spaces X,Y and nonnegative lower semicontinuous c:X×Y→[0,∞], inf_{γ∈Π(μ,ν)}∫c dγ equals sup{∫φ dμ+∫ψ dν: φ,ψ bounded continuous and φ(x)+ψ(y)≤c(x,y)}; both sides may be infinite.

concept.title: Cost transform in optimal transport
concept.description: For a cost c:X×Y→(−∞,∞] and a function φ on X, its c-transform is φ^c(y)=inf_{x∈X}(c(x,y)−φ(x)); the analogous transform from Y back to X is defined by the same cost. Extended values are allowed where the infimum is not finite.

concept.title: Geometric drift bounds stopped weighted occupation
concept.description: If a Markov chain has finite V≥1 and PV≤aV+b1_C with 0≤a<1, then for each 1<r<1/a there is K<∞ such that E_x[∑_{k=0}^{τ_C−1}r^k V(X_k)]≤K(V(x)+b1_C(x)), where τ_C=inf{k≥1:X_k∈C}. For a=0 any finite r>1 is allowed.

concept.title: Geometric ergodic bound from a weighted Kendall petite set
concept.description: Let a ψ-irreducible aperiodic chain have f≥1 and a petite set C such that for some κ>1 the stopped potential G(x)=E_x∑_{k=0}^{τ_C−1}κ^k f(X_k) is finite everywhere and bounded on C. Then the chain is positive Harris recurrent with invariant π, π(f)<∞, and there are r>1,R<∞ with ∑_{n≥0}r^n||P^n(x,·)−π||_f≤R G(x) for every x.

concept.title: Induced module for a finite group
concept.description: For H≤G finite and an H-module M, the induced module can be realized as functions f:G→M satisfying f(hg)=h·f(g), with pointwise addition and G-action(g₀·f)(g)=f(gg₀). This is the coinduced function model, canonically isomorphic to induction for finite groups.

concept.title: Corestriction in finite-group cohomology
concept.description: For H≤G finite and a G-module M, corestriction Cor:Hⁿ(H,M)→Hⁿ(G,M) is the inverse of Shapiro’s isomorphism followed by the map induced by Tr:Ind_H^G(M|H)→M. In the function model, Tr(f)=∑_s s⁻¹f(s), over representatives s of the right H-cosets, independent of the right-coset representatives.

concept.title: Restriction–corestriction multiplication by index
concept.description: For a subgroup H of a finite group G and a G-module M, Cor∘Res on Hⁿ(G,M) is multiplication by[G:H], for every n≥0.

concept.title: Injective restriction to a subgroup of index prime to the coefficient characteristic
concept.description: Let p be prime, G finite and M a G-module killed by p. If H≤G has index coprime to p, then Res:Hⁿ(G,M)→Hⁿ(H,M) is injective for all n>0. In particular this applies to a p-Sylow subgroup.

concept.title: Sylow p-subgroup of a finite group
concept.description: If p^a is the largest power of a prime p dividing the order of a finite group G, a Sylow p-subgroup is a subgroup of order p^a. Its index is prime to p.

concept.title: Cauchy’s theorem on an element of prime order
concept.description: If a prime p divides the order of a finite group G, then G contains an element of order p.

concept.title: Degree-zero Tate cohomology of a finite group
concept.description: For a finite group G acting on an abelian group M, Ĥ⁰(G,M)=M^G/N_GM, where N_G(m)=∑_(g∈G)g·m is the norm map. Its image lies in M^G.

concept.title: Cup product in group cohomology
concept.description: For G-modules M,N, cup product sends Hʳ(G,M)×Hˢ(G,N) to H^(r+s)(G,M⊗ℤN), with diagonal G-action on the tensor product. On inhomogeneous cocycles it is(a∪b)(g₁,…,g_(r+s))=a(g₁,…,g_r)⊗(g₁⋯g_r)·b(g_(r+1),…,g_(r+s)). Equivariant pairings M⊗N→P give the corresponding products into H^(r+s)(G,P).

concept.title: Additive group of rational numbers modulo integers
concept.description: The group ℚ/ℤ is the quotient of the additive rational group by its integer subgroup; each element is a rational residue class and has finite order. In group cohomology it is given the stated group action, often trivial.

concept.title: Cup-product period generator for cyclic group cohomology
concept.description: For a finite cyclic group C of order n, choose an injective character χ:C→ℚ/ℤ and let δχ∈H²(C,ℤ) be its connecting class for0→ℤ→ℚ→ℚ/ℤ→0. Cup product with δχ induces an isomorphism Ĥ⁰(C,M)→H²(C,M) for every C-module M, natural in coefficient and group automorphisms together with the chosen character.

concept.title: Descending filtered module
concept.description: A descending filtration on a module M is a family of submodules F^iM indexed by integers with F^(i+1)M⊆F^iM. Its ith associated graded module is F^iM/F^(i+1)M.

concept.title: First-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence
concept.description: A first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence in an abelian category consists of objects E_r^(a,b) for r≥r₀ and integers a,b, zero unless a,b≥0, with differentials d_r:E_r^(a,b)→E_r^(a+r,b−r+1), d_r∘d_r=0, and isomorphisms E_(r+1)≅ker d_r/im d_r. For fixed (a,b) the terms stabilize to E_∞^(a,b). Convergence to objects H^n means each H^n has a finite descending filtration by subobjects whose graded pieces are E_∞^(a,n−a). Modules over a ring are the basic example.

concept.title: Hochschild–Serre spectral sequence in group cohomology
concept.description: For a normal subgroup N of G and a G-module M, there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence E₂^(a,b)=Hᵃ(G/N,Hᵇ(N,M)) converging to H^(a+b)(G,M). The quotient action is induced on cochains by(g·c)(n₁,…,n_b)=g·c(g⁻¹n₁g,…,g⁻¹n_bg).

concept.title: Recurrence transfer from uniform future hitting probabilities
concept.description: For a time-homogeneous Markov chainX and measurable setsB,C, suppose someβ>0 satisfiesP_x(X_s∈C for somes≥1)≥β for everyx∈B. Then almost surely, ifX visitsB infinitelyoften, it also visitsC infinitelyoften.

concept.title: Finite substochastic matrix
concept.description: A finite square real matrixQ is substochastic ifQ_ij≥0 andΣ_jQ_ij≤1 for everyrowi. Adding one absorbingcemetery state with transitionprobability1−Σ_jQ_ij fromrowi makesQ the transientpart of a stochasticmatrix.

concept.title: Quasi-stationary law of an irreducible finite killed chain
concept.description: LetQ be an irreducible finite substochastic matrix with0<ρ(Q)<1. Its cemetery-augmentedchain is absorbed almostsurely, and its unique quasi-stationary distribution is the positive left Perroneigenvector normalized tosum1; its one-stepsurvivalprobability isρ(Q), and its meansurvivaltime is1/(1−ρ(Q)).

concept.title: Absorption or divergence for Poisson population updates
concept.description: For a PoissonLotka–Volterra densityprocessX_t with scaleε>0, almostsurely eitherX_t=0 forsomefinite t orΣ_iX_(i,t)→∞. If its deterministicmeanmap satisfiesF(ℝ_+^k)⊆[0,M]^k, absorptionat0 isalmostsure; morepreciselyP_x(τ_0>n)≤(1−e^(−kM/ε))^n fornonzero x.

concept.title: Weighted supremum space of measurable functions
concept.description: For a finite measurable weight V≥1 on a measurable space E, B_V consists of real or complex measurable f with ||f||_V=sup_x|f(x)|/V(x)<∞; with pointwise operations this is a Banach space.

concept.title: Weighted operator norm of a kernel difference
concept.description: For Markov kernels P,Q and finite weights V,W≥1, the norm of P−Q:B_V→B_W is sup_x ||P(x,·)−Q(x,·)||_V/W(x), whenever the rows have finite V moments; the equality follows by taking the two suprema over x and |f|≤V in either order.

concept.title: Power interpolation of weighted uniform ergodicity
concept.description: If ||P^n(x,·)−π||_V≤Cρ^nV(x), π(V)<∞ and V≥1, then for every 0<r<1 the chain is V^r-uniformly ergodic, with bound 2^(1−r)C^rρ^(nr)V(x)^r.

concept.title: Stationary law of a contractive first-order autoregression
concept.description: For X_n=αX_(n−1)+Z_n on ℝ with |α|<1 and iid innovations satisfying E|Z_1|<∞, the law of ∑_{j≥0}α^j Z_(j+1) is the unique invariant probability. The series converges almost surely and in L¹; the invariant first moment is at most E|Z_1|/(1−|α|), and its mean is EZ_1/(1−α).

concept.title: Continuity of translations in L¹
concept.description: For f∈L¹(ℝᵈ), ||f(·−h)−f||_1→0 as h→0.

concept.title: Weighted spectral gap for a compactly regularized contractive random iteration
concept.description: Let iid random Lipschitz maps F on a complete separable metric space have E Lip(F)^a<1 and E d(F(x₀),x₀)^a<∞ for a≥1. Put V(x)=(1+d(x,x₀))^a. If some power P^ℓ is compact from bounded measurable functions to B_V, then P is V-uniformly ergodic and the infimum geometric rate is at most (E Lip(F)^a)^(1/a).

concept.title: Compactness of a squared strong Feller kernel in a weighted space
concept.description: Let (X,d) be a separable metric space with compact closed balls, V≥1 measurable with V(x)→∞ as d(x,x₀)→∞, and P a strong Feller Markov kernel with P(x,dy)=K(x,y)η(dy) for a σ-finite measure η and jointly measurable K≥0. Then P² maps bounded measurable functions compactly into B_V. Here strong Feller means bounded measurable functions become continuous.

concept.title: Weighted geometric ergodicity of an autoregression with a density
concept.description: For a real AR(1) kernel with |α|<1 and iid innovations having a Lebesgue density and finite first absolute moment, V(x)=1+|x| gives V-uniform ergodicity. For every ρ with |α|<ρ<1 there is C_ρ<∞ such that ||P^n(x,·)−π||_V≤C_ρρ^nV(x). This statement does not assert that the endpoint rate |α| is attained.

concept.title: Weakly unimodal density on the real line
concept.description: A real probability density h is weakly unimodal if some m∈ℝ makes h nondecreasing on (−∞,m) and nonincreasing on (m,∞); jumps and flat portions are allowed.

concept.title: Translation bound for a bounded unimodal density
concept.description: If a real probability density h is weakly unimodal and h≤H, then ∫|h(z)−h(z−a)|dz≤2H|a| for every a∈ℝ.

concept.title: Weak and strong weighted kernel perturbations for autoregressions
concept.description: For AR(1) kernels P_α with any innovation density of finite first moment and V=1+|x|, ||P_β−P_α||_(B_1→B_V)→0 as β→α. For fixed 0<α<1, the stronger norm ||P_β−P_α||_(B_V→B_V) need not tend to0 as β↓α; in fact its liminf is positive for every such density.

concept.title: Total variation bound for a centered Gaussian location mixture
concept.description: Let Z∼N(0,σ²), σ>0, and let an independent real Δ have EΔ=0 and EΔ²<∞. For every m, the full total variation norm between laws m+Z+Δ and m+Z is at most EΔ²/σ².

concept.title: QSD survival and boundary mass from a trapping set
concept.description: Letμ be aQSD with survivalλ for a kernelP absorbed inS₀. IfU⊆S₀ᶜ hasμ(U)>0 andP(x,U)≥1−β forx∈U, thenλ≥1−β. IfalsoP(x,S₀)≥a>0 forx∈V⊆S₀ᶜ, thenμ(V)≤(1−λ)/a≤β/a.

concept.title: Invariance of a small-noise QSD limit with survival tending to one
concept.description: LetS⊂ℝᵈ be closed,F:S→S continuous withboundedimage,andP_ε a smallrandomperturbation ofF withcommonabsorbingS₀ andQSDsμ_ε,survivalsλ_ε. Ifε_n↓0,μ_(ε_n) convergesweaklytoμ andλ_(ε_n)→1, thenμ isF-invariant.

concept.title: Strict trapping neighborhoods of a compact attractor
concept.description: Let F be a continuous map of a closed set S⊆ℝᵈ into itself with bounded image F(S), and let A be a compact attractor of F. Then there are a bounded open neighborhood U of A and δ>0 such that F(cl U) is compact, F(cl U)⊆U and N_δ(F(U))⊆U.

concept.title: Positive-attractor QSD survival and boundary concentration estimate
concept.description: LetF:S→S becontinuous withboundedimage onclosedS⊂ℝᵈ, andP_ε smallrandomperturbations withabsorbingS₀ andQSDsμ_ε. SupposeA⊂S₀ᶜ isacompactattractor andμ_ε(U)>0 foreveryneighborhoodU ofA. Then someδ>0 givesλ_ε≥1−β_δ(ε), whereβ_δ(ε)=sup_xP_ε(x,S∖N_δ(Fx)). IfV₀ isanopenneighborhoodofS₀ andβ_δ(ε)/inf_(x∈V₀∖S₀)P_ε(x,S₀)→0, everyweakQSDlimitμ satisfiesμ(V₀)=0 andisF-invariant.

concept.title: Open-set inequality under weak convergence
concept.description: Ifprobabilitymeasuresμ_n convergeweaklytoμ onametricspace, thenμ(U)≤liminf_nμ_n(U) foreveryopensetU.

concept.title: Petite covering theorem for an irreducible Markov kernel
concept.description: Every ψ-irreducible Markov kernel on a countably generated measurable state space admits an increasing sequence of petite sets whose union is the whole state space.

concept.title: Transfer of petiteness by uniform randomized-time access
concept.description: If C is petite for P and a set A has K_b(x,C)≥δ>0 for every x∈A, where K_b=∑_{n≥0}b_nP^n for a probability(b_n), then A is petite.

concept.title: Closure of a petite set for an irreducible weak Feller kernel
concept.description: For a ψ-irreducible weak Feller Markov kernel on a locally compact Polish space, the closure of every petite set is petite.

concept.title: Compact petite sets for a Lebesgue-irreducible weak Feller kernel
concept.description: Every compact subset of ℝᵈ is petite for a weak Feller Markov kernel that is irreducible with respect to Lebesgue measure. The full support of Lebesgue measure is essential to this version; irreducibility and weak Feller alone do not imply it for arbitrary irreducibility measures.

concept.title: Equivalent petite-set drift from weighted uniform ergodicity
concept.description: If a ψ-irreducible Markov kernel is V-uniformly ergodic for finite V≥1, then there are a finite V₀ with c⁻¹V≤V₀≤cV, a petite set C on which V₀ is bounded, λ<1 and b<∞ such that PV₀≤λV₀+b1_C.

concept.title: Sharp linear Wasserstein perturbation for an autoregressive coefficient
concept.description: For real AR(1) kernels with common iid innovation Z of finite first moment and coefficients |α|,|β|<1, W₁(π_α,π_β)≤|α−β|[1−|β|+E|Z|]/[(1−|α|)(1−|β|)]. If EZ≠0, W₁(π_α,π_β)≥|α−β||EZ|/[|1−α||1−β|], so the linear dependence on the coefficient error cannot be improved in general.

concept.title: Lyapunov-weighted Wasserstein bound for acceptance errors
concept.description: Let P_α,P_β share proposal Q and have acceptance errors E(x,y)=|α(x,y)−β(x,y)|. If τ_d(P_α^n)≤Cρ^n, P_βV≤δV+L and γ=sup_x V(x)⁻¹∫d(x,y)E(x,y)Q(x,dy)<∞, then for p(V)<∞, W_d(pP_α^n,pP_β^n)≤γC max{p(V),L/(1−δ)}(1−ρ^n)/(1−ρ), using the n=0 convention C≥1.

concept.title: Weighted variation stability under bounded acceptance error
concept.description: Suppose V≥1 is lower semicontinuous and P_α is V-uniformly ergodic with constants C,ρ, P_αV≤δV+L, and another acceptance kernel P_β shares proposal Q. If |α−β|≤s and λ=1+sup_x QV(x)/V(x)<∞ satisfy δ+λs<1, then ||pP_α^n−pP_β^n||_V≤λs C max{p(V),L/(1−δ−λs)}(1−ρ^n)/(1−ρ), for finite p(V), C≥1 and n≥0.

concept.title: Uniform perturbation rate for bounded-statistic noisy Langevin chains
concept.description: For a finite exponential-family likelihood ℓ_θ(y)∝exp(θs(y)) with |s|≤S, Gaussian prior variance σ_p² and 0<σ²<4σ_p², compare the exact Gaussian Euler Langevin kernel with the kernel using an iid N-sample estimate of E_θs. For every initial law of finite first moment, both invariant laws exist and the full-TV errors between invariant laws and between nth-step laws, uniformly in n, are O(logN/N). The implied constant may depend on the fixed model, step and initial moment.

concept.title: Upper triangular subgroup of GL₂ over a field
concept.description: For a field k, the upper triangular subgroup of GL₂(k) consists of matrices [[a,b],[0,d]] with a,d∈k× and b∈k. Its conjugates are exactly the stabilizers of one-dimensional subspaces of k².

concept.title: Elementary generation of SL₂ over a field
concept.description: For any field k, SL₂(k) is generated by the elementary matrices U(t)=[[1,t],[0,1]] and L(t)=[[1,0],[t,1]], t∈k.

concept.title: Prime-field GL₂ subgroup dichotomy at the coefficient prime
concept.description: If G≤GL₂(𝔽_p), p prime, and p divides|G|, then either G contains SL₂(𝔽_p), or G stabilizes a line and is conjugate into the upper triangular subgroup. The field is specifically the prime field.

concept.title: Maschke splitting in characteristic prime to the group order
concept.description: If a finite group G acts linearly on a finite-dimensional vector space V over k and|G|is nonzero in k, then every G-invariant subspace W has a G-invariant direct complement.

concept.title: Mod-p cyclotomic character
concept.description: For p prime and a characteristic-zero field F, the mod-p cyclotomic character ω_p:Gal(Fsep/F)→𝔽_p× is characterized by σ(ζ)=ζ^(ω_p(σ)) for every pth root of unity ζ.

concept.title: Galois group of a prime cyclotomic field
concept.description: For a prime p and primitive pth root ζ_p, Gal(ℚ(ζ_p)/ℚ) is isomorphic to𝔽_p× by σ↦a when σ(ζ_p)=ζ_p^a.

concept.title: Surjectivity of the cyclotomic character under disjointness
concept.description: For a number field F with F∩ℚ(ζ_p)=ℚ, the mod-p cyclotomic character ω_p of F is surjective onto𝔽_p×.

concept.title: Cyclotomic determinant of an elliptic torsion representation
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field F and a prime p, detρ_(E,p)=ω_p as characters ofGal(Fsep/F) into𝔽_p×.

concept.title: Order of a general linear group over a finite field
concept.description: For a finite field𝔽_q, |GL_n(𝔽_q)|=∏_(j=0)^(n−1)(qⁿ−qʲ). In particular the order of GL₂(𝔽_p) is p(p−1)²(p+1), whose p-part is p.

concept.title: Lagrange’s theorem for a finite group
concept.description: For a subgroup H of a finite group G, |G|=[G:H]|H|. In particular |H| divides |G|.

concept.title: Lawson–Wuthrich second torsion cohomology classification over number fields
concept.description: Let E/F be elliptic, p prime, F a number field withF∩ℚ(ζ_p)=ℚ, andG=Gal(F(E[p])/F). ThenH²(G,E[p])is nonzero exactly whenp>2, E has exactly one F-rational cyclic subgroup of orderp, and for its isogenyϕ:E→E′ the dual kernelE′[ϕ̂] has an F-rational point of orderp. In that caseH² has p elements.

concept.title: Gordon lower bound for the expected least Gaussian singular value
concept.description: For anm×n matrixG withindependentrealN(0,1) entries and1≤n≤m, Eσ_min(G)≥√m−√n.

concept.title: Lieb concavity of the trace exponential with a logarithm
concept.description: For a fixed Hermitian matrixH, the functionA↦tr exp(H+logA) isconcave onthepositive-definite Hermitian cone, wherelogA isdefined by spectralcalculus.

concept.title: Operator monotonicity of the positive matrix logarithm
concept.description: Forpositive-definite Hermitian matricesA≼B, logA≼logB, wherelogA=U diag(logλ_j)U* in a unitary eigendecompositionA=U diag(λ_j)U*.

concept.title: Monotonicity of the trace of a matrix exponential
concept.description: For Hermitian matricesA≼B, tr exp(A)≤tr exp(B).

concept.title: Jensen inequality for a finite-dimensional random vector
concept.description: LetD⊆ℝᵈ beconvex, X anintegrableD-valuedrandomvector withEX∈D, andφ:D→ℝ continuousandconvex withE|φ(X)|<∞. Thenφ(EX)≤Eφ(X); the inequalityreversesforconcaveφ.

concept.title: Fundamental domain of a discrete group action
concept.description: For a discrete group acting on a topological space, a fundamental domain is a region whose translates cover the space and whose interior contains at most one point of each orbit. Boundary representatives may repeat; for integration one chooses a measurable domain meeting almost every orbit once.

concept.title: Petersson inner product of cusp forms
concept.description: For weight-k cusp forms f,g on Γ=Γ₀(N) or Γ₁(N), the Petersson pairing is ⟨f,g⟩=∫_D f(z)overline(g(z))y^(k−2)dxdy, z=x+iy, over a fundamental domain D for Γ on the upper half-plane. It converges, is independent of D and is a positive definite Hermitian form; a common unitary character is allowed.

concept.title: Degeneracy map between cusp-form levels
concept.description: For M|N and d|N/M, the degeneracy map α_d:S_k(Γ₁(M))→S_k(Γ₁(N)) sends f(z) to f(dz), equivalently ∑a_nq^n to ∑a_nq^(dn). On a fixed character subspace it is used only when the character at level N is induced from level M.

concept.title: Old and new cuspidal subspaces
concept.description: The old subspace S_k(Γ₁(N))^old is the span of all α_d(S_k(Γ₁(M))) with proper divisors M|N and d|N/M. The new subspace is its orthogonal complement for the Petersson inner product. Character-χ old/new subspaces are the intersections with S_k(Γ₀(N),χ).

concept.title: Uniform probability law on the complex unit sphere
concept.description: For n≥1, the uniform probability on {z∈ℂⁿ:‖z‖₂=1} is the pushforward of a standard complex Gaussian vector g under g↦g/‖g‖₂. Define this map arbitrarily at g=0, an event of probability zero. This is the law called a Haar-random unit vector; it is invariant under unitary coordinate changes.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Sample covariance conditioning for a trace-accurate four-design
concept.description: Let n≥2 and let w be drawn from a weighted projective 4-design of trace-norm accuracy θ₁≤1/4. Put a=[n(n+1)]^(1/4)w. Its population covariance satisfies (3/4)I≼Eaa*≼(3/2)I. For independent copies a_j and W=m⁻¹Σ_ja_ja_j*, there is a universal C such that u≥1 and m≥Cun log(2n) imply P((1/2)I≼W≼2I)≥1−e^(−u); hence ‖W‖op≤2, ‖W⁻¹‖op≤2 and κ(W)≤4 on this event.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Robust rank null space bound for trace-accurate four-design measurements
concept.description: Let n≥2, 1≤r≤n and let w_j be independent draws from a weighted projective 4-design of trace-norm accuracy θ₁≤1/4. Set A(X)=(√(n(n+1))w_j*Xw_j)_j. Universal constants c,C,C₀>0 satisfy: if 0<ρ<1 and m≥Cρ⁻²nr log(2n), then with probability at least 1−e^(−cm), A has the Frobenius robust rank null space property of order r with constants ρ and τ=C₀/√m.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Uniform stable PSD recovery from trace-accurate four-design measurements
concept.description: Let n≥2, 1≤r≤n and A(X)=(√(n(n+1))w_j*Xw_j)_j, where w_j are independent draws from a weighted projective 4-design of trace-norm accuracy θ₁≤1/4. There are universal C,C₁,C₂>0 such that s≥1 and m≥Csnr log(2n) give, with probability at least 1−e^(−sr), simultaneously for all positive semidefinite X,Z and 1≤p≤2, ‖Z−X‖p≤C₁r^(1/p−1)‖X_c‖₁+C₂r^(1/p−1/2)m⁻¹/²‖A(Z−X)‖₂.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Trace-norm density-matrix least squares with trace-accurate designs
concept.description: Let n≥2, 1≤r≤n and L(X)=(√(n(n+1)/m)w_j*Xw_j)_j, with independent unit vectors drawn from a weighted projective 4-design of trace-norm accuracy θ₁≤1/4. If m≥Cnr log(2n), then with probability at least 1−e^(−cm), for every density matrix X and noise vector w, any minimizer Z of ‖L(Z)−(L(X)+w)‖₂ over density matrices satisfies ‖Z−X‖₁≤C₁‖X_c‖₁+C₂√r‖w‖₂, with universal constants.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Low-rank density identification by completed random rank-one measurements
concept.description: For n≥2 and 1≤r≤n, draw independent uniform complex unit vectors w_j with m≥Cnr, or independent unit vectors from a weighted 4-design of trace-norm accuracy θ₁≤1/4 with m≥Cnr log(2n). Choose δ>0 with δΣ_jw_jw_j*≼I. The operators E_j=δw_jw_j* and E₀=I−Σ_jE_j form a POVM. With probability at least 1−e^(−cm), every density matrix of rank at most r is uniquely determined among all density matrices by these outcome probabilities, with suitable universal constants.
concept.field: Random matrix recovery and quantum information

concept.title: Maximal ideal
concept.description: A maximal ideal of a commutative ring R is a proper ideal contained in no larger proper ideal.

concept.title: Local commutative ring
concept.description: A local ring is a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal. A homomorphism of local rings is local if it sends the maximal ideal of its source into the maximal ideal of its target.

concept.title: Sheaf on a topological space
concept.description: A sheaf of sets on X assigns a set F(U) to each open U and restriction maps compatible with identities and composition, such that sections agreeing on every overlap of any open cover glue to one unique section. Sheaves of groups, rings or modules carry the respective operations compatibly with restriction.

concept.title: Stalk of a sheaf
concept.description: The stalk F_x is the set of germs of sections near x: pairs(U,s) with x∈U and s∈F(U), identified when their restrictions agree on some smaller neighborhood of x. Algebraic operations on a sheaf induce the same operations on its stalks.

concept.title: Locally ringed space
concept.description: A locally ringed space is a topological space X with a sheaf of commutative rings O_X whose stalk at each point is a local ring. A morphism consists of a continuous map f:X→Y and compatible ring maps O_Y(U)→O_X(f⁻¹U) whose induced maps on stalks are local.

concept.title: Prime spectrum and Zariski topology
concept.description: Spec R is the set of prime ideals of a commutative ring R with closed sets V(I)={𝔭:I⊆𝔭}. Its standard open subsets are D(f)={𝔭:f∉𝔭}; these form a topology basis.

concept.title: Affine scheme
concept.description: The affine scheme Spec R is the prime spectrum of R with the structure sheaf characterized on standard opens by O(D(f))=R_f and the localization restriction maps. Its stalk at 𝔭 is R_𝔭. An affine scheme is any locally ringed space isomorphic to one of these.

concept.title: Scheme
concept.description: A scheme is a locally ringed space admitting an open cover by affine schemes, with the given local-ringed-space structures on those opens.

concept.title: Morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is a morphism of their locally ringed spaces. On affine opens it is induced contravariantly by a unital homomorphism of commutative rings. An S-scheme is a scheme with a specified morphism to S; morphisms over S commute with these structure maps.

concept.title: Fiber product of schemes
concept.description: For X→S and Y→S, X×_S Y is the scheme with projection morphisms whose composites to S agree, universal for pairs of morphisms T→X,T→Y over S. For affine schemes Spec A,Spec B over Spec R it is Spec(A⊗_R B).

concept.title: Base change and fibers of a scheme
concept.description: For X→S and S′→S, the base change is X_(S′)=X×_S S′ with its projection to S′. The fiber at s∈S is X_s=X×_S Spec κ(s), where κ(s)=O_(S,s)/𝔪_s is the residue field of the local ring. A geometric fiber extends this residue field to an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Closed immersion of schemes
concept.description: A scheme morphism i:Z→X is a closed immersion if it is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset and the structure-sheaf map O_X→i_*O_Z is surjective on stalks. Affinely it is induced by a quotient map of rings R→R/I.

concept.title: Separated morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism X→S is separated if its diagonal X→X×_S X is a closed immersion. A scheme is separated over a specified base if its structure morphism is separated.

concept.title: Morphism of schemes of finite type
concept.description: A morphism X→S is locally of finite type if locally on affine source and target charts it comes from a ring map R→A with A generated by finitely many elements as an R-algebra. It is of finite type if it is also quasi-compact: inverse images of quasi-compact open subsets are quasi-compact.

concept.title: Smooth morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is smooth if locally on affine source and target charts its corresponding algebra map is smooth, meaning finitely presented and formally smooth for nilpotent-ideal lifting. Smoothness over a field is used for nonsingular geometric fibers, not merely regularity over an imperfect field.

concept.title: Proper morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is proper if it is separated, of finite type and universally closed: after every base change the map on underlying topological spaces sends closed sets to closed sets. A scheme over a field is complete if its structure morphism is proper.

concept.title: Projective space as a scheme
concept.description: Projective n-space over a field k is obtained by gluing the n+1 standard affine charts Spec k[x₀/x_i,…,x_n/x_i], omitting x_i/x_i, with the standard coordinate-ratio changes on overlaps. Its points over an extension field are nonzero vectors modulo common nonzero scaling.

concept.title: Projective scheme over a field
concept.description: A k-scheme is projective if it admits a closed immersion over k into some projective space Pⁿ_k. Projectivity includes the specified algebraic scheme structure, rather than only its set of geometric points.

concept.title: Group scheme
concept.description: A group scheme G over S is an S-scheme with multiplication G×_S G→G, an identity section S→G and inverse G→G satisfying the group axioms as identities of S-morphisms. It need not be affine, connected or proper.

concept.title: Abelian variety
concept.description: An abelian variety over a field k is a smooth proper geometrically connected commutative group scheme over k. Geometric connectedness means connectedness after base change to an algebraic closure; its group law and identity are defined over k.

concept.title: Irreducible topological space
concept.description: A topological space is irreducible if it is nonempty and cannot be written as a union of two proper closed subsets. Equivalently any two nonempty open subsets intersect.

concept.title: Krull dimension of a topological space
concept.description: The Krull dimension of a topological space is the supremum of the lengths r of chains Z₀⊊Z₁⊊⋯⊊Z_r of nonempty irreducible closed subsets. The dimension of a scheme is the dimension of its underlying space.

concept.title: Smooth projective algebraic curve
concept.description: A smooth projective geometrically connected curve over k is a one-dimensional k-scheme smooth over k, geometrically connected, and admitting a closed immersion into some projective space over k.

concept.title: Divisor on a smooth projective curve
concept.description: A divisor on a smooth projective curve C/k is a finite integer sum D=∑n_PP of closed points. Its degree is ∑n_P[k(P):k]. After extension to an algebraic closure, geometric points are used with degree1. A divisor is effective if all n_P≥0.

concept.title: Rational function on a smooth projective curve
concept.description: A rational function on a smooth projective geometrically connected curve is an equivalence class of regular functions on nonempty open subsets, with equality on a smaller nonempty open subset. They form the function field k(C), the fraction field of any nonempty affine coordinate domain.

concept.title: Principal divisor on a smooth projective curve
concept.description: For a nonzero rational function f on a smooth projective curve C, its principal divisor is div(f)=∑_P ord_P(f)P, with normalized orders from the discrete valuation local rings at the closed points. Divisors differing by div(f) are linearly equivalent; degree-zero divisors modulo principal divisors form Pic⁰(C).

concept.title: Jacobian of a pointed smooth projective curve
concept.description: For a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C/k with P∈C(k), its Jacobian is an abelian variety J with a morphism ι_P:C→J sending P to0 such that every morphism C→A into an abelian variety sending P to0 factors uniquely through a homomorphism J→A. The underlying J is canonically independent of the chosen base point.

concept.title: Abel–Jacobi map on curve divisors
concept.description: For a pointed smooth projective curve C/k with Jacobian(J,ι_P), a geometric degree-zero divisor ∑n_QQ maps to ∑n_Qι_P(Q) in J(k̄). The map kills principal divisors and identifies degree-zero divisor classes with J(k̄), compatibly with the Galois action; it is independent of P on degree-zero divisors.

concept.title: Fraction field of an integral domain
concept.description: For an integral domain R, its fraction field Frac(R) consists of fractions a/b with a∈R,b a nonzero element of R, identified by cross multiplication. It is a field containing R and every injective homomorphism from R into a field extends uniquely to a homomorphism from Frac(R).

concept.title: Integral domain
concept.description: An integral domain is a nonzero commutative ring R in which ab=0 implies a=0 or b=0.

concept.title: Exponential upper bound for a binomial coefficient
concept.description: For integers 1≤k≤N, binom(N,k)≤(eN/k)^k.

concept.title: Dirichlet theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions
concept.description: For coprime positive integers a and m there are infinitely many primes p with p≡a mod m.

concept.title: Pullback and pushforward of divisors under a finite curve map
concept.description: For a finite nonconstant map f:C→D of smooth projective curves, pullback of a closed point is the sum of its inverse points weighted by ramification indices, and pushforward weights a closed point by its residue-field degree. These operations preserve principal divisor classes through function pullback and norm and induce maps of Jacobians with f_*f^*=[deg f].

concept.title: Analytic uniformization of a complex abelian variety
concept.description: For a complex abelian variety A of dimension g, the exponential map identifies A(C) analytically with its complex tangent space modulo a lattice of rank2g. A homomorphism is induced by its complex-linear tangent map carrying the source lattice into the target lattice; for an endomorphism, an invertible tangent map is equivalent to having finite kernel and being an isogeny.

concept.title: Hecke correspondence on a full-level modular curve
concept.description: For p prime with p≡1 mod N, the determinant-p integral matrices congruent to I mod N define a degree-(p+1) correspondence on the compact full-level modular curve X(N). Its action on divisors and on the Jacobian is the sum of the maps from its branches, equivalently pullback followed by pushforward; its action on holomorphic differentials is the weight-two Hecke action under H⁰(X(N),Ω¹)≅S₂(Γ(N)).

concept.title: Ramanujan bound for weight-two Hecke operators
concept.description: For p∤N, every eigenvalue of the usual degree-(p+1) Hecke correspondence on weight-two cuspidal differentials of the level-N modular curve has absolute value at most2√p. On X(N) for p≡1 mod N this is the determinant-p correspondence congruent to I modulo N.

concept.title: Isogeny class of elliptic curves over a field
concept.description: The F-isogeny class of an elliptic curve E/F is the collection of F-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves E′/F admitting an F-defined isogeny E→E′. The dual isogeny makes this relation symmetric.

concept.title: Cyclic isogeny of elliptic curves
concept.description: An isogeny of elliptic curves is cyclic if its geometric kernel is a cyclic group. In characteristic zero a cyclic isogeny of degree n has geometric kernel isomorphic to ℤ/nℤ.

concept.title: Tate-module Galois representation of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field F and a prime p, the continuous action of Gal(Fsep/F) on T_p(E) defines ρ_(E,p∞):Gal(Fsep/F)→Aut_(ℤ_p)(T_p(E)). A ℤ_p-basis identifies the target with GL₂(ℤ_p); reduction modulo pⁱ gives the action on E[pⁱ].

concept.title: Principal congruence subgroup of a general linear group
concept.description: For a commutative ring R and ideal I, the principal congruence subgroup GL_n(R,I) is the kernel of entrywise reduction GL_n(R)→GL_n(R/I). It consists of invertible matrices congruent to the identity modulo I.

concept.title: Successive congruence kernel for general linear groups
concept.description: For a prime p, n≥1 and i≥2, the kernel of GL_n(ℤ/pⁱℤ)→GL_n(ℤ/p^(i−1)ℤ) is isomorphic to the additive group M_n(𝔽_p) by I+p^(i−1)A↦A modp. Conjugation corresponds to conjugation by the reduced matrix in GL_n(𝔽_p).

concept.title: Lifting a full congruence image from p² to all finite levels
concept.description: Let p be odd, n≥1 and H≤GL_n(ℤ_p). Write H_i for its image modulo pⁱ. If H₂ is the entire inverse image of H₁ under reduction modulo p, then H_i is the entire inverse image of H₁ for every i≥2. No closedness assumption is needed for this finite-level assertion.

concept.title: Conjugation action on a matrix space
concept.description: For a subgroup G≤GL_n(k) over a field k, the matrix space M_n(k) is a linear representation of G by g·A=gAg⁻¹. The trace-zero subspace is invariant under this action.

concept.title: Group of equivariant homomorphisms
concept.description: For abelian G-modules M,N, Hom_G(M,N) is the abelian group of additive maps f:M→N satisfying f(gm)=g f(m), with pointwise addition. If M,N are 𝔽_p-vector spaces and the G-actions are linear, every additive map is 𝔽_p-linear, so Hom_G(M,N) is an 𝔽_p-vector space.

concept.title: Index of a subgroup
concept.description: For a subgroup H≤G, the index [G:H] is the cardinality of the set of left cosets gH. Left and right cosets have the same cardinality by inversion.

concept.title: Greenberg’s 5-adic image index for a rational 5-isogeny
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be a non-CM elliptic curve with a ℚ-rational isogeny of degree5, and let I=[GL₂(ℤ₅):imρ_(E,5∞)]. Then v₅(I)=0 if no curve in the ℚ-isogeny class of E has two distinct ℚ-rational cyclic subgroups of order5, and v₅(I)=1 otherwise.

concept.title: Full finite congruence images for a non-CM rational p-isogeny at p≥7
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be non-CM, p≥7 prime, and suppose E has a ℚ-rational isogeny of degreep. For every i≥2, the image of Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ) on E[pⁱ] is the full inverse image of its image on E[p] in GL₂(ℤ/pⁱℤ).

concept.title: Normalizer character on first cohomology of a unipotent prime-order subgroup
concept.description: For an odd prime p, let V=𝔽_p² and H=⟨h⟩ with h=[[1,1],[0,1]]. Then H¹(H,V)≅𝔽_p by [ξ]↦the second coordinate of ξ(h). The normalizer element [[u,w],[0,v]] acts on this group by multiplication by u⁻¹v².

concept.title: Character criterion for first cohomology of a prime-field Borel subgroup
concept.description: Let p be odd and H≤G≤GL₂(𝔽_p), where H={[[1,t],[0,1]]:t∈𝔽_p} and G is upper triangular. Then H¹(G,𝔽_p²) has dimension1 exactly when every [[u,w],[0,v]]∈G satisfies u=v², and vanishes otherwise. If detG=𝔽_p×, the nonzero case forces p=3 or p≡2 mod3 and G={[[v²,w],[0,v]]:v∈𝔽_p×,w∈𝔽_p}.

concept.title: Exponential map of a commutative complex Lie group
concept.description: For a commutative complex Lie group G, the exponential map exp:Lie(G)→G is a holomorphic homomorphism with differential equal to the identity at0. For v in its complex tangent space, z↦exp(zv) is the unique holomorphic one-parameter subgroup with derivative v at0.

concept.title: Analytification of a smooth projective complex variety
concept.description: A smooth projective variety over ℂ has a compact complex manifold of complex points, and algebraic morphisms induce holomorphic maps. A geometrically connected such variety has connected complex points; an algebraic group structure therefore gives a compact connected complex Lie group.

concept.title: Lattice structure of a discrete Euclidean subgroup
concept.description: Every discrete subgroup Λ of a finite-dimensional real vector space V is generated over ℤ by a real-linearly independent finite family. The quotient V/Λ is compact exactly when that family is a real basis of V.

concept.title: Path lifting for a covering map
concept.description: For a covering map p:Y→X, every continuous path in X and specified starting point over its initial point have a unique continuous lift. Homotopies of paths lift with a prescribed initial lift; a closed loop downstairs lifts to a path whose endpoint is in the same fiber as its starting point.

concept.title: Integration of a differential one-form along a path
concept.description: For a smooth one-form ω on a smooth manifold and a piecewise smooth path γ:[a,b]→M, its integral is ∫_a^b ω_(γ(t))(γ′(t))dt, summed over the smooth pieces. Pullback of forms commutes with path integration, and the integral of dh equals h(γ(b))−h(γ(a)); closed forms pair with integral one-cycles through their homology classes.

concept.title: Vanishing of finite-group cohomology under a nontrivial central scalar
concept.description: Let G be a finite group acting linearly on an 𝔽_p-vector space V. If a central element acts as λI with λ≠1, then Hʲ(G,V)=0 for every j≥0. The representation need not be faithful.

concept.title: Rational cyclic subgroup of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field F, a rational cyclic subgroup of order n is a cyclic subgroup C≤E[n](F̄) of order n stable under Gal(F̄/F). Individual elements of C need not be F-rational. For n prime it is equivalently a Galois-invariant line in E[n].

concept.title: Quadratic twist of an elliptic torsion representation
concept.description: Let E/F be elliptic in characteristic zero, D∈F× and p an odd prime. Put κ_D(σ)=σ(√D)/√D∈{±1}⊂𝔽_p×. After identifying geometric torsion by an F(√D)-isomorphism, ρ_(E^D,p)=κ_Dρ_(E,p). In particular quadratic twisting preserves the Galois-stable lines in E[p].

concept.title: Cyclotomic expression for the quadratic character of √5
concept.description: Over any characteristic-zero field F, the quadratic character κ_5:σ↦σ(√5)/√5, viewed in 𝔽₅×, equals the square ω₅² of the mod5 cyclotomic character.

concept.title: Lawson–Wuthrich first torsion cohomology classification over number fields
concept.description: Let E/F be elliptic, F a number field, p prime, F∩ℚ(ζ_p)=ℚ, and G=Gal(F(E[p])/F). Then H¹(G,E[p])≠0 exactly in these cases: p=3 and E has a rational point of order3 and exactly one F-rational cyclic subgroup of order3; p=5 and E^5 has the corresponding point and unique subgroup of order5; or p≥11, p≡2 mod3 and E has exactly one F-rational cyclic subgroup C of orderp, on which Galois acts by ω_p^((p+1)/3). In every such case H¹ has p elements.

concept.title: Uniform nuclear-norm recovery from independent entries with bounded fourth moments
concept.description: Let the real measurement matrices Phi_j be independent copies of a matrix with independent centered entries of variance1 and fourth moments at most C4. For 1≤r≤min(n1,n2) and 0<rho<1, constants c,C,K>0 depending only on C4 give: if m≥C rho⁻²r(n1+n2), then with probability at least 1−e^(−cm), every nuclear-norm minimizer Xsharp from data A(X)+w with ‖w‖₂≤eta obeys ‖Xsharp−X‖F≤2(1+rho)²‖X_c‖₁/((1−rho)√r)+K(3+rho)eta/((1−rho)√m), simultaneously for all X and w.

concept.title: Explicit Gaussian measurement bound for uniform stable nuclear-norm recovery
concept.description: Let A be a real n1×n2 matrix measurement map generated by independent standard Gaussian entries. Let 1≤r≤min(n1,n2), 0<rho<1, kappa>1 and 0<epsilon<1, and set L=sqrt(1+(1+rho⁻¹)²). If m/√(m+1)≥kappa[(√r)L(√n1+√n2)+√(2log(1/epsilon))]/(kappa−1), then with probability at least 1−epsilon every nuclear-norm minimizer Xsharp with noise tolerance eta satisfies ‖Xsharp−X‖F≤2(1+rho)²‖X_c‖₁/((1−rho)√r)+2kappa√2(3+rho)eta/((1−rho)√m), uniformly for all X and admissible noises.

concept.title: Chi-squared divergence of probability measures
concept.description: For probability measures P≪Q with density r=dP/dQ, the chi-squared divergence is χ²(P‖Q)=∫(r−1)²dQ, allowing +∞. It is +∞ when P is not absolutely continuous with respect to Q.

concept.title: Total variation bound by chi-squared divergence
concept.description: For probability measures P,Q, the full total variation norm satisfies ||P−Q||_TV≤√χ²(P‖Q), with the inequality understood in the extended sense. The convention sup_A|P(A)−Q(A)| has the additional factor1/2.

concept.title: Homomorphism of abelian varieties
concept.description: A homomorphism A→B of abelian varieties over k is a k-scheme morphism preserving addition and the identity. The set Hom_k(A,B) is an abelian group under pointwise addition of morphisms.

concept.title: Abelian subvariety
concept.description: An abelian subvariety of A/k is a closed subgroup scheme B⊆A which is itself an abelian variety over k, with the inclusion preserving the group structures.

concept.title: Simple abelian variety
concept.description: An abelian variety A/k of positive dimension is k-simple if it has no proper nonzero abelian subvariety over k. It is absolutely simple if its base change to an algebraic closure is simple.

concept.title: Isogeny of abelian varieties
concept.description: An isogeny A→B over k is a surjective homomorphism of abelian varieties whose kernel is a finite group scheme. In characteristic zero its degree is the number of geometric kernel points, equivalently the degree of the corresponding finite map; two varieties are k-isogenous if such a k-map exists.

concept.title: Category of abelian varieties up to isogeny
concept.description: Over a fixed characteristic-zero field k, abelian varieties up to isogeny have morphism spaces Hom⁰_k(A,B)=Hom_k(A,B)⊗_ℤℚ, with composition induced by composition of homomorphisms and extended ℚ-bilinearly. Every isogeny is invertible in this category.

concept.title: Rational endomorphism algebra of an abelian variety
concept.description: The algebra End⁰_k(A)=End_k(A)⊗_ℤℚ has addition induced by the group law on A and multiplication given by composition. It is a finite-dimensional associative ℚ-algebra; the subscript specifies the field over which the endomorphisms are defined.

concept.title: Simple abelian variety of GL₂-type over ℚ
concept.description: A ℚ-simple abelian variety A is of GL₂-type if End⁰_ℚ(A) is a number field of degree dim A over ℚ. This convention concerns simple varieties; the broader convention allowing a commutative semisimple subalgebra of dimension dim A also permits products.

concept.title: Weil restriction of an abelian variety
concept.description: For a finite separable field extension L/k and an abelian variety A/L, Res_(L/k)A is the abelian variety over k representing the functor T↦Hom_L(T×_k L,A) on k-schemes. It has dimension [L:k]dim A; after a separable splitting extension it becomes the product of the conjugate abelian varieties.

concept.title: Tate module of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a characteristic-zero field k and a prime ℓ, T_ℓA=lim←A[ℓⁿ](k̄) with multiplication-by-ℓ transition maps. It is a free ℤ_ℓ-module of rank2dim A with its continuous absolute Galois action; V_ℓA=T_ℓA⊗_(ℤ_ℓ)ℚ_ℓ.

concept.title: Hasse–Weil L-function of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K, its Hasse–Weil L-function is the Euler product L(A,s)=∏_v det(1−Fr_v^(−1)·Nv^(−s) | (V_ℓ(A)^∨)^(I_v))^(−1) over finite places v, with ℓ different from the residue characteristic of v. Here V_ℓ(A)^∨=Hom(V_ℓ(A),ℚ_ℓ) carries the dual Galois action and Fr_v^(−1) is a geometric Frobenius, the inverse of an arithmetic Frobenius, acting on inertia invariants. The rational local polynomial is independent of ℓ; the product is initially considered in a right half-plane of absolute convergence.

concept.title: L-function of a normalized weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f=∑a_nqⁿ, its L-function is L(f,s)=∑a_n n^(−s), initially in a right half-plane of absolute convergence and then analytically continued. Its unramified Euler factor at p∤N is (1−a_pp^(−s)+χ(p)p^(1−2s))^(−1).

concept.title: Strongly modular abelian variety over a number field
concept.description: An abelian variety A/K is strongly modular over K if its Hasse–Weil L-function is a finite product of L-functions of normalized weight-two newforms for groups Γ₁(N_i). The base field K is part of this property; geometric modularity alone does not imply it.

concept.title: Hecke algebra of weight-two cusp forms
concept.description: The integral Hecke algebra at level N is the commutative ring generated by the classical Hecke operators T_n and diamond operators on S₂(Γ₁(N)); on the modular Jacobian they act through the associated algebraic correspondences. A normalized eigenform f gives a homomorphism T→ℂ by T_n↦a_n(f) and diamond d↦χ(d).

concept.title: Quotient of an abelian variety by an abelian subvariety
concept.description: For an abelian subvariety B⊆A over k, the quotient A/B is an abelian variety with a surjective homomorphism A→A/B having kernel B, universal among homomorphisms from A that vanish on B.

concept.title: Modular abelian variety attached to a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f on Γ₁(N), let I_f be the kernel of its eigenvalue homomorphism on the Hecke algebra T. The modular abelian variety A_f is the quotient J₁(N)/(I_fJ₁(N)), where I_fJ₁(N) is the abelian subvariety generated by the images of the operators in I_f. It is defined over ℚ and its complex differential space pulls back to the span of all Galois conjugates of f.

concept.title: Finite morphism of schemes
concept.description: A scheme morphism f:X→Y is finite if for each affine open Spec R⊆Y its inverse image is affine Spec A and A is a finitely generated R-module via f. In particular a finite group scheme over a field has finite-dimensional coordinate algebra.

concept.title: Congruence subgroup Γ₀(N)
concept.description: For N≥1, Γ₀(N) is the subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) consisting of matrices whose lower-left entry is divisible by N. It contains Γ₁(N); the map sending a matrix to its lower-right entry modulo N identifies Γ₀(N)/Γ₁(N) with (ℤ/Nℤ)×.

concept.title: Diamond operator on Γ₁(N) modular forms
concept.description: For d∈(ℤ/Nℤ)× and a weight-k modular form on Γ₁(N), choose γ∈Γ₀(N) with lower-right entry d modulo N and set ⟨d⟩f=f|ₖγ. This is independent of γ modulo Γ₁(N); the character-χ subspace satisfies ⟨d⟩f=χ(d)f, and cusp forms are preserved.

concept.title: Complex multiplication of a weight-two newform
concept.description: A normalized weight-two newform f has complex multiplication if there is a nontrivial quadratic Dirichlet character χ such that χ(p)a_p(f)=a_p(f) for almost all primes p. Equivalently f has a nontrivial quadratic self-twist; non-CM means no such character exists.

concept.title: Inner twist of a non-CM weight-two newform
concept.description: For a non-CM normalized weight-two newform f with coefficient field F, an inner twist is a pair(γ,χ) with γ:F→ℂ an embedding and χ a Dirichlet character satisfying γ(a_p(f))=χ(p)a_p(f) for almost all primes p. For such f the character is unique for a given γ, and the occurring embeddings are automorphisms of F.

concept.title: Splitting field determined by newform inner twists
concept.description: For a non-CM weight-two newform, take the finite collection of its inner-twist characters χ. A character modulo M is viewed on Gal(ℚ(ζ_M)/ℚ) through a↦(ζ_M↦ζ_M^a), and determines the fixed field of its kernel. The splitting field attached to the newform is the compositum of these fields inside ℚ̄.

concept.title: Gauss sum of a Dirichlet character
concept.description: For a primitive Dirichlet character χ of conductor M, its Gauss sum is g(χ)=∑_(a mod M)χ(a)exp(2πia/M). Character values are extended by0 to nonunits; the exponential fixes the chosen complex embedding of the roots of unity.

concept.title: Splitting map for a multiplicative Galois 2-cocycle
concept.description: Let a finite Galois group G act on a field F, and let c:G×G→F× be a multiplicative2-cocycle. A splitting map is a1-cochain β:G→F× such that c(σ,τ)=β(σ)σ(β(τ))/β(στ). Such a map exists exactly when the cohomology class of c is zero; two splitting maps differ by a1-cocycle.

concept.title: Building block of a modular abelian variety
concept.description: For a modular abelian variety A_f and a field L over which all its geometric endomorphisms are defined, a building block is an absolutely simple abelian variety B/L such that (A_f)_L is L-isogenous to a power of B. Its isogeny class, rather than a chosen equation or embedding into A_f, is intrinsic.

concept.title: Sheaf of Kähler differentials of a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X over k, Ω¹_(X/k) is the sheaf of O_X-modules obtained by gluing the modules Ω¹_(A/k) on affine charts Spec A with their localization identifications. Its global sections are regular differential one-forms; a morphism induces pullback of these differentials.

concept.title: Invariant differentials on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/k, an invariant differential is a global section of Ω¹_(A/k) unchanged by every translation after field extension. These form a k-vector space of dimension dim A, identified with the cotangent space at the identity by evaluation; homomorphisms pull them back to invariant differentials.

concept.title: Stochastic exponential of a continuous local martingale
concept.description: For a real continuous local martingale L with L₀=0, its stochastic exponential is the strictly positive process E(L)_t=exp(L_t−[L]_t/2), where [L] is quadratic variation. It is the solution of dE(L)=E(L)dL with initial value1.

concept.title: Essential supremum of a family of random variables
concept.description: On a probability space, the essential supremum of a family (X_i) of measurable extended real random variables is the almost-sure equivalence class of the least measurable upper bound: X_i≤Y almost surely for every i, and Y≤Z almost surely for every measurable Z with that property. Unlike an ordinary pointwise supremum, it is defined modulo null sets.

concept.title: Novikov exponential-martingale criterion
concept.description: If L is a real continuous local martingale with L₀=0 and Eexp([L]_T/2)<∞ on a finite horizon, its stochastic exponential E(L) is a uniformly integrable martingale on [0,T], with E E(L)_T=1.

concept.title: Continuous and purely discontinuous decomposition of a local martingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration, every real càdlàg local martingale N has a unique decomposition N=N₀+N^c+N^d, where N^c is a continuous local martingale starting at0 and N^d is purely discontinuous, meaning [N^d,C]=0 for every continuous local martingale C.

concept.title: Optional sampling for a uniformly integrable càdlàg martingale
concept.description: For a uniformly integrable càdlàg martingale M on a finite horizon [0,T] and stopping times σ≤τ≤T, E[M_τ|F_σ]=M_σ. In particular a martingale closed by an integrable terminal variable can be sampled at bounded stopping times.

concept.title: Debut theorem for a progressively measurable set
concept.description: On a complete right-continuous filtration, the first entrance time into a progressively measurable subset of [0,∞)×Ω is a stopping time, allowing infinity when the set is empty.

concept.title: Brownian orthogonal decomposition of a local martingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration carrying a d-dimensional Brownian motion W, every real càdlàg local martingale N has a unique decomposition N=N₀+∫Z_s·dW_s+M, where Z is predictable and locally square-integrable and M is a càdlàg local martingale starting at0 with [M,W^i]=0 for every i. Uniqueness of Z is modulo dt×dP.

concept.title: Snell representation of a càdlàg reflected semimartingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration let Y=Y₀+N−A be a càdlàg class-D process, where N is a uniformly integrable martingale and A is predictable càdlàg nondecreasing with A₀=0. Let R be adapted càdlàg with its positive stopped values uniformly integrable, Y≥R on [0,T), and ∫₀ᵀ(Y_(s−)−R_(s−))dA_s=0, using R_T=Y_T. Then Y_t is the essential supremum of E[R_τ1_(τ<T)+Y_T1_(τ=T)|F_t] over τ∈[t,T] for which the reward is integrable; the same formula holds with extended conditional expectations for other τ.

concept.title: Digamma function on the positive real axis
concept.description: For x>0, the real digamma function is ψ(x)=Γ′(x)/Γ(x), the logarithmic derivative of the positive-real gamma function.

concept.title: Contour integral of a complex function
concept.description: For a complex function f continuous along a piecewise continuously differentiable path γ:[a,b]→ℂ, its contour integral is ∫_γ f(z)dz=∫_a^b f(γ(t))γ′(t)dt, summing over the finitely many smooth pieces and integrating real and imaginary parts.

concept.title: Normal algebraic field extension
concept.description: An algebraic field extension L/k is normal if every irreducible polynomial in k[X] with a root in L splits completely into linear factors over L. Equivalently the minimal polynomial over k of every element of L splits over L.

concept.title: Finite Galois field extension
concept.description: A finite Galois extension L/k is a field extension of finite vector-space dimension which is both normal and separable. Its automorphisms fixing k form the finite Galois group Gal(L/k).

concept.title: Fixed field of field automorphisms
concept.description: For a group H of automorphisms of a field L, its fixed field L^H consists of all elements of L fixed by every automorphism in H. An intermediate field of L/k is a subfield M with k⊆M⊆L; Gal(L/M) denotes the subgroup fixing M pointwise.

concept.title: Artin fixed-field degree theorem
concept.description: For a finite subgroup H of the automorphism group of a field L, the extension L/L^H is finite Galois, has degree |H| and has Galois group exactly H.

concept.title: Fixed-field characterization of finite Galois extensions
concept.description: For a finite normal separable extension L/k, the group Gal(L/k) has order[L:k] and fixes exactly k. For every intermediate field M, the extension L/M is again finite normal separable, so L^(Gal(L/M))=M.

concept.title: Lenglart–Lépingle–Pratelli comparison for increasing processes
concept.description: Let A,B be nonnegative predictable nondecreasing processes, with the zero-time convention A₀₋=B₀₋=0. Suppose q,a>0 satisfy E[(A_T1_(T>0)−A_S1_(S>0))^q]≤a E[B_T^q1_(S<T)] for every pair of stopping times S≤T. For every p>0 there is C=C(a,q,p) such that E A_∞^p≤C E B_∞^p, with extended moments. The adapted càdlàg version replaces A_T,A_S,B_T by their left limits.

concept.title: Garsia–Neveu Lp bound for an increasing process
concept.description: Let A be nonnegative predictable nondecreasing and X≥0 integrable. If E[A_∞−A_S1_(S>0)]≤E[X1_(S<∞)] for every stopping time S, then ‖A_∞‖p≤p‖X‖p for p≥1, allowing infinite moments and using A₀₋=0. The adapted càdlàg version uses A_(S−) and A₀₋=0.

concept.title: Davis decomposition of a càdlàg local martingale
concept.description: For a real càdlàg local martingale M starting at0, write S_t=sup_(s≤t)|ΔM_s|. After localization with E S_∞<∞, M=K+L with K a finite-variation martingale, E TV(K)_∞≤4 E S_∞, and L a local martingale with |ΔL_t|≤4S_(t−). The decomposition is used locally when the expectations are not globally finite.

concept.title: Quadratic-variation isometry for a càdlàg martingale
concept.description: For a real square-integrable càdlàg martingale M starting at0, E|M_T|²=E[M]_T on bounded horizons; localization gives the corresponding stopped identities for locally square-integrable martingales.

concept.title: Poincaré complete reducibility for abelian varieties
concept.description: For an abelian subvariety B⊆A over a characteristic-zero field k, there is an abelian subvariety C⊆A over k for which addition B×C→A is a k-isogeny. Thus nontrivial decompositions up to isogeny correspond to nontrivial idempotents in End⁰_k(A).

concept.title: Rank-one rational Hom space for non-CM isogenous elliptic curves
concept.description: If E,E′ are geometrically non-CM elliptic curves over a characteristic-zero field k and µ:E→E′ is a k-isogeny, then Hom_k(E,E′)⊗ℚ=ℚµ and End⁰_k(E)=ℚ. Every nonzero homomorphism E→E′ is an isogeny.

concept.title: Finite Galois descent for morphisms of schemes
concept.description: For k-schemes X,Y and a finite Galois extension L/k, a morphism X_L→Y_L comes from a unique k-morphism X→Y exactly when it is invariant under the natural semilinear Gal(L/k) action. This applies to homomorphisms of abelian varieties and their rational Hom spaces.

concept.title: Modularity of a simple GL₂-type abelian variety over ℚ
concept.description: Every simple abelian variety A/ℚ with End⁰_ℚ(A) a number field of degree dim A is ℚ-isogenous to A_f for a normalized weight-two newform f. Its coefficient field is isomorphic to End⁰_ℚ(A).

concept.title: Isogeny invariance and product formula for abelian L-functions
concept.description: Abelian varieties isogenous over a number field have identical Hasse–Weil L-functions, including bad local factors. The L-function of a product is the product of the two L-functions.

concept.title: L-function identity for Weil restriction of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/L and a finite number-field extension L/k, L(Res_(L/k)A/k,s)=L(A/L,s), with every local Euler factor, including ramified and bad places, retained.

concept.title: Newform factorization of the modular abelian variety L-function
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f with coefficient field F and attached abelian variety A_f/ℚ, L(A_f/ℚ,s)=∏_(σ:F→ℂ)L(σf,s), including the local factors at primes dividing the level.

concept.title: Quadratic base-change factorization of an elliptic L-function
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E₀/k and a quadratic number-field extension K=k(√d), L(E₀/K,s)=L(E₀/k,s)L(E₀^d/k,s), including all local Euler factors, where E₀^d is the quadratic twist associated to K/k.

concept.title: Regular sequence in a commutative ring
concept.description: An ordered sequence f₁,…,f_r in a commutative ring R is regular if R/(f₁,…,f_r)≠0 and multiplication by f_i is injective on R/(f₁,…,f_(i−1)) for every i. The order and the nonzero final quotient are part of this convention.

concept.title: Krull dimension of a commutative ring
concept.description: The Krull dimension of a commutative ring R is the supremum of lengths r of strictly increasing chains 𝔭₀⊊⋯⊊𝔭_r of prime ideals. For the zero ring, which has no prime ideals, use dimension−1.

concept.title: Residue field at a prime ideal
concept.description: For a commutative ring R and prime ideal 𝔭, its residue field is κ(𝔭)=R_𝔭/𝔭R_𝔭, equivalently the fraction field of R/𝔭. For a maximal ideal 𝔪 it is R/𝔪.

concept.title: Radical of an ideal
concept.description: For an ideal I in a commutative ring R, its radical is √I={a∈R:aⁿ∈I for some positive integer n}. An ideal is radical when I=√I.

concept.title: Affine polynomial zero locus and its vanishing ideal
concept.description: For a field k, an extension K/k and I⊆k[x₁,…,x_n], V_K(I)={a∈Kⁿ:f(a)=0 for every f∈I}. For W⊆Kⁿ, I_k(W) consists of the k-polynomials vanishing on W. An affine algebraic set is such a common zero locus, with the Zariski topology.

concept.title: Dimension of an affine variety
concept.description: For an affine variety with reduced finitely generated coordinate algebra A, its dimension is the Krull dimension of A. Its points over an extension K/k are the k-algebra maps A→K; reducible varieties are allowed.

concept.title: Perfect field
concept.description: A field k is perfect if every algebraic extension of k is separable. In characteristic zero this always holds; in characteristic p>0 it is equivalent to surjectivity of x↦xᵖ on k.

concept.title: Jacobian matrix of a polynomial system
concept.description: For polynomials f₁,…,f_r∈k[x₀,…,x_N], their formal Jacobian matrix is (∂f_i/∂x_j), where formal partial differentiation sends a monomial a x₀^e₀⋯x_N^e_N to e_j a x₀^e₀⋯x_j^(e_j−1)⋯x_N^e_N. It may be evaluated at points over any extension field.

concept.title: Zariski’s lemma for a field finitely generated as an algebra
concept.description: If a field extension K/k is finitely generated as a k-algebra, then K/k is finite algebraic.

concept.title: Existence of a maximal ideal above a proper ideal
concept.description: Every proper ideal of a nonzero commutative ring with identity is contained in a maximal ideal.

concept.title: Model of an abelian variety over a discrete valuation ring
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/K and a discrete valuation ring R with fraction field K, an R-model is a scheme 𝒜→Spec R with a specified isomorphism 𝒜_K≅A. Its generic fiber is the base change to Spec K, and its special fiber is the base change to the residue field of R.

concept.title: Néron model of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/K over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring R, its Néron model is a smooth separated R-scheme 𝒜 of finite type with generic fiber A such that Hom_R(Z,𝒜)→Hom_K(Z_K,A) is bijective for every smooth R-scheme Z. Its commutative group-scheme structure is the unique extension of that of A.

concept.title: Abelian scheme
concept.description: An abelian scheme over S is a proper smooth group scheme over S whose geometric fibers are connected. Each geometric fiber is an abelian variety.

concept.title: Good reduction of an abelian variety
concept.description: An abelian variety over the fraction field K of a discrete valuation ring R has good reduction if it extends to an abelian scheme over R. Equivalently its Néron model is proper over R; for elliptic curves this agrees with smooth reduction of a minimal Weierstrass model.

concept.title: Identity component and component group of a Néron special fiber
concept.description: For a Néron model 𝒜 over a discrete valuation ring with residue field k, the geometric identity component 𝒜⁰_(k̄) is the connected component containing the identity in its geometric special fiber. The geometric component group Φ(k̄)=𝒜_k(k̄)/𝒜⁰_k(k̄) is the finite group of connected components, with its natural Galois action. The open subgroup 𝒜⁰ has the whole generic fiber and only the identity component of the special fiber.

concept.title: Additive group scheme
concept.description: The additive group scheme 𝔾_a over a ring R is the affine line Spec R[t] with addition induced by t↦t⊗1+1⊗t, identity t↦0 and inverse t↦−t. Its points over an R-algebra A are the additive group of A.

concept.title: Zariski tangent and cotangent space at a rational point
concept.description: For a k-rational point x of a k-scheme X, its cotangent space is 𝔪_x/𝔪_x² over k, where 𝔪_x is the maximal ideal of O_(X,x). Its dual Hom_k(𝔪_x/𝔪_x²,k) is the Zariski tangent space T_xX; equivalently tangent vectors are k-morphisms Spec k[ε]/(ε²)→X reducing to x.

concept.title: Algebraic dual of a vector space
concept.description: For a vector space V over a field k, its algebraic dual V* is Hom_k(V,k), with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication. No topology or continuity condition is imposed.

concept.title: Boundedness in probability of a random family
concept.description: A family (X_i) of real random variables is bounded in probability if lim_(K→∞)sup_iP(|X_i|>K)=0. The definition also applies across different probability spaces by using each variable’s own probability.

concept.title: Uniform convergence in probability on compact time intervals
concept.description: A sequence of processes X^n on the same probability space converges ucp to X if, for every finite T and epsilon>0, P(sup_(t≤T)|X_t^n−X_t|>epsilon)→0. Vector processes use any fixed finite-dimensional norm.

concept.title: Uniform tightness of a sequence of semimartingales
concept.description: A sequence of real semimartingales X^n satisfies condition UT if for every finite T the family of stochastic-integral terminal values (H·X^n)_T, over all n and elementary predictable integrands H bounded in absolute value by1, is bounded in probability. The elementary integrands use finite stopping-time intervals and coefficients measurable at the left endpoint.

concept.title: Stability of stochastic integrals under UT and ucp convergence
concept.description: On a common usual filtered space let X^n,X be càdlàg semimartingales and H^n,H adapted càdlàg processes. If X^n satisfies UT and (H^n,X^n)→(H,X) jointly ucp, then ∫H^n_(s−)dX_s^n→∫H_(s−)dX_s ucp.

concept.title: Covariation stability under UT and ucp convergence
concept.description: On a common usual filtered space let X^n,Y^n and X,Y be real càdlàg semimartingales. If each sequence X^n and Y^n satisfies UT and (X^n,Y^n)→(X,Y) jointly ucp, then [X^n,Y^n]→[X,Y] ucp.

concept.title: Comparison for càdlàg reflected Brownian BSDE solutions
concept.description: Let two given càdlàg reflected Brownian BSDE solutions on a usual Brownian-carrying filtration have a common finite horizon, globally Lipschitz drivers g1,g2 and some p>1 integrability: the suprema of |Y| and K_T and the square roots of the Brownian and orthogonal-martingale quadratic variations lie in Lp. Use the convention Y_t=xi−∫_t^Tg ds−∫_t^TZ dW−(M_T−M_t)+K_T−K_t. If xi1≤xi2, S1≤S2 and g1(t,y,z)≥g2(t,y,z) almost everywhere for every y,z, then Y1≤Y2 indistinguishably.

concept.title: Snell envelope decomposition for a càdlàg reward with integrable positive maximum
concept.description: On a usual filtration over [0,T], let a real adapted càdlàg reward R have E(sup_tR_t^+)^p<∞ for some p>1 and terminal R_T in Lp. Its stopping value U_t=esssup_(τ≥t)E[R_τ|F_t], with extended expectations when the negative part is not integrable, has a càdlàg class-D version and decomposition U=U₀+N−A with N a UI càdlàg martingale and A predictable càdlàg nondecreasing starting at0. It is the least class-D supermartingale dominating R; U_T=R_T and ∫₀ᵀ(U_(s−)−R_(s−))dA_s=0. Moreover sup|U| lies in Lp.

concept.title: Linear reflected Brownian BSDE on a usual filtration
concept.description: Let p>1 and let a usual filtration carry a d-dimensional Brownian motion W. Let xi∈Lp, an adapted càdlàg lower obstacle S satisfy sup S^+∈Lp and S_T≤xi, and a progressively measurable driver h satisfy ∫₀ᵀ|h_s|ds∈Lp. Then the reflected equation Y_t=xi−∫_t^Th_sds−∫_t^TZ_sdW_s−(M_T−M_t)+K_T−K_t has a unique càdlàg solution, with M orthogonal to W, K predictable nondecreasing, ∫(Y_-−S_-)dK=0, and sup|Y|, K_T, (∫|Z|²)^(1/2), [M]_T^(1/2) in Lp.

concept.title: Affine linear subspace over a field
concept.description: An affine linear subspace of kⁿ is a translate a+W of a vector subspace W≤kⁿ. Its dimension is dimW, independently of the chosen a.

concept.title: Irreducible component of a topological space
concept.description: An irreducible component of a topological space is a maximal irreducible closed subset, ordered by inclusion. Distinct irreducible components need not be disjoint.

concept.title: Total geometric degree of an affine variety
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, the degree of an irreducible affine variety W⊂kⁿ of dimensionr is the maximum number of points in a finite intersection W∩L with an affine linear subspace L of dimensionn−r. The total geometric degree of a reducible variety is the sum over all its irreducible components, including components of smaller dimension; the empty set has degree0.

concept.title: Finite irreducible decomposition of an affine variety
concept.description: Every affine variety over an algebraically closed field is the union of finitely many irreducible components, uniquely determined as its maximal irreducible closed subsets.

concept.title: Affine hypersurface Bézout inequality
concept.description: Let W⊂kⁿ over an algebraically closed field be a nonempty affine variety of pure dimensionr, and let f be a nonzero polynomial of degreeD≥1 that vanishes identically on none of its irreducible components. If W∩V(f) is nonempty, it is pure of dimensionr−1 and its total geometric degree is at most D times that ofW.

concept.title: Geometric degree bound for bounded affine equations
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, the common zero locus in kⁿ of s polynomials of degrees at mostD≥1 has total geometric degree at most Dˢ. Zero polynomials and nonzero constants are allowed, using degree0 for the empty locus.

concept.title: Lower ramification groups of a local field extension
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields, normalize v_L(L×)=ℤ. For real t≥−1 set G_t={σ∈Gal(L/K):v_L(σa−a)≥t+1 for every a∈O_L}. Then G_(−1) is the full Galois group, G₀ is inertia and G₁ is wild inertia.

concept.title: Upper ramification groups of a local field
concept.description: For a finite Galois local extension with lower groups G_t, let φ(u)=∫₀^u[G₀:G_t]^(−1)dt for u≥0, let ψ be its increasing inverse and put G^v=G_(ψ(v)). For the absolute Galois group, G_K^v is the inverse limit of these upper groups over finite Galois subextensions; the quotient-compatible upper numbering is used.

concept.title: Local ℓ-adic Galois representation
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field K of residue characteristic p and a prime ℓ≠p, a local ℓ-adic representation is a continuous linear action of Gal(K̄/K) on a finite-dimensional vector space over a finite extension F/ℚ_ℓ, with its ℓ-adic topology. Its inertia-fixed vectors form V^I_K.

concept.title: Artin and Swan conductor of a local ℓ-adic representation
concept.description: For a local ℓ-adic representation V, its Swan exponent is Sw(V)=∫₀^∞codim_F V^(G_K^u)du, where G_K^u are the positive upper ramification groups. The Artin conductor exponent is a(V)=codim_F V^I_K+Sw(V); its conductor ideal is 𝔭_K^(a(V)). These exponents are nonnegative integers in this setting.

concept.title: Conductor ideal of an abelian variety over a number field
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/K over a number field, its conductor ideal is 𝔑_K(A)=∏_v𝔭_v^(a(V_ℓA|_(G_Kv))), with ℓ different from the residue characteristic at v. The exponent uses the inertia-fixed codimension and Swan conductor of its rational Tate representation and is independent of ℓ; only finitely many exponents are nonzero.

concept.title: Relative discriminant ideal of number fields
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields, the relative discriminant 𝔡_(L/K) is the O_K-ideal locally generated by determinants det(Tr_(L/K)(b_i b_j)) for integral bases after localization at primes of O_K. For K=ℚ it is generated by the ordinary field discriminant up to sign.

concept.title: Relative ideal norm of number fields
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields, the ideal norm sends a prime 𝔓 of O_L above 𝔭 of O_K to 𝔭^[O_L/𝔓:O_K/𝔭] and extends multiplicatively to nonzero fractional ideals. For K=ℚ its positive generator is the absolute ideal norm.

concept.title: Lp bound for the increasing parts of a strong supermartingale
concept.description: Let p>1 and let X be a real strong optional supermartingale on a usual filtration over [0,T] with E sup_(t≤T)|X_t|^p<∞. In its Mertens decomposition X=X₀+M−A−I, with predictable càdlàg nondecreasing A and predictable left-continuous nondecreasing purely discontinuous I starting at0, one has E A_T^p+E I_T^p≤C_p E sup_(t≤T)|X_t|^p, with C_p depending only on p.

concept.title: Optional section theorem
concept.description: For an optional set E on a usual filtered probability space and every epsilon>0, there is a stopping time tau whose graph on {tau<∞} is contained in E and P(tau<∞)≥P(π(E))−epsilon, where π(E) is its projection on the sample space, measured in the completed probability space.

concept.title: Càdlàg regularization of a closed martingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration over a finite horizon, the martingale t↦E[V|F_t] for an integrable terminal variable V has a càdlàg version. This version is uniformly integrable and satisfies E[V|F_tau] at every bounded stopping time tau.

concept.title: Riemann surface
concept.description: A Riemann surface is a connected Hausdorff second-countable topological space covered by coordinate neighborhoods homeomorphic to open subsets of ℂ, with holomorphic transition maps. The charts define holomorphic functions and maps; its complex dimension is one.

concept.title: Group scheme of roots of unity
concept.description: Over a ring R, µ_N is the group scheme Spec R[t]/(t^N−1), with multiplication induced by t↦t⊗t, identity t↦1 and inverse t↦t^(N−1). Its points over an R-algebra are the units whose Nth power is1.

concept.title: Family of elliptic curves
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a scheme S is an abelian scheme E→S whose geometric fibers have dimension one. In particular it has a specified identity section, and its group law is part of the family; pullback gives a family over every S′→S.

concept.title: Coarse moduli scheme
concept.description: For a moduli functor F of isomorphism classes of families on k-schemes, a coarse moduli scheme M has a natural transformation F→Hom_k(−,M) universal among transformations to represented scheme functors, and inducing a bijection on points over every algebraically closed extension of k. It need not carry a universal family.

concept.title: Arithmetic modular curve with µ_N level structure
concept.description: For N≥4 over ℚ, Y₁^µ(N) represents isomorphism classes of elliptic-curve families with a closed group-scheme embedding µ_N↪E[N]; X₁^µ(N) is its smooth projective compactification. Its complex point τ corresponds to E_τ=ℂ/(ℤ+τℤ), with ζ_N↦1/N. This fixes the arithmetic model and complex identification: its cusp∞ is ℚ-rational and its local parameter is q=exp(2πiτ).

concept.title: Arithmetic modular curve X₀(N)
concept.description: Over ℚ, Y₀(N) is the coarse moduli curve of elliptic curves with a cyclic subgroup scheme of order N; X₀(N) is its smooth projective compactification. On complex points τ corresponds to ℂ/(ℤ+τℤ) with subgroup generated by1/N, giving Γ₀(N)\ℍ. The arithmetic curve and its moduli convention are distinguished from the bare complex quotient.

concept.title: Continuous induction from a subgroup of finite index
