concept.description: For an open subgroup H of finite index in a profinite group G and a continuous H-action on an R-module M, Ind_H^G M can be realized as continuous functions f:G→M satisfying f(hg)=h f(g), with (g₀f)(g)=f(gg₀). It is a finite direct product of copies of M indexed by H\G; this fixes the function-model convention.

concept.title: Tate module of a Weil restriction
concept.description: For a finite separable extension L/k of characteristic-zero fields and an abelian variety A/L, T_ℓ(Res_(L/k)A) is canonically isomorphic as a continuous G_k-module to Ind_(G_L)^(G_k)T_ℓ(A). Rationalizing gives the same identity for V_ℓ.

concept.title: Induction formula for a local Artin conductor
concept.description: For a finite separable extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields of residue characteristic p and a finite-dimensional continuous ℓ-adic representation V of G_L, ℓ≠p, a_K(Ind_(G_L)^(G_K)V)=f_(L/K)a_L(V)+dim(V)v_K(𝔡_(L/K)), where f is the residue degree and 𝔡 is the local discriminant ideal.

concept.title: Conductor formula for Weil restriction of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/L of dimension g and a finite extension of number fields L/K, 𝔑_K(Res_(L/K)A)=Norm_(L/K)(𝔑_L(A))·𝔡_(L/K)^(2g). In particular for an elliptic curve over quadratic K/ℚ the rational conductor is the absolute norm of its K-conductor times Δ_K².

concept.title: Local conductor of the representation of a newform
concept.description: For a normalized primitive weight-two newform f of level N, the two-dimensional ℓ-adic representation attached to f has conductor exponent v_p(N) at each prime p≠ℓ. This includes primes dividing the nebentypus conductor and the level.

concept.title: Tate representation decomposition of a modular abelian variety
concept.description: For A_f attached to a weight-two newform with coefficient field F, extending coefficients from ℚ_ℓ to an algebraic closure decomposes V_ℓ(A_f) into the two-dimensional Galois representations attached to the embeddings σ:F→ℚ̄_ℓ, one for each embedding counted with multiplicity. These representations have Frobenius traces σ(a_p).

concept.title: Conductor of the abelian variety attached to a newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f of level N and coefficient field F, its associated abelian variety A_f/ℚ has conductor N^[F:ℚ]. The integer N is the primitive newform level, not a chosen oldform ambient level.

concept.title: Quadratic lattice over ℤ_p
concept.description: A quadratic ℤ_p-lattice in a nondegenerate quadratic space V over ℚ_p is a free ℤ_p-submodule L of finite rank spanning V overℚ_p, equipped with the restricted quadratic form. No integrality of Q(L) or B(L,L) is assumed unless specified.

concept.title: Dual of a local quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ_p-lattice L inside its ℚ_p-span V with half-polarization B, its dual is L#={v∈V:B(v,L)⊆ℤ_p}. The dual is taken with respect to B, so a half-integral polarization convention changes it.

concept.title: Modular quadratic lattice over ℤ_p
concept.description: A nondegenerate quadratic ℤ_p-lattice L is pᵃ-modular, a∈ℤ, if L#=p^(−a)L inside its rational span. Equivalently its Gram matrix divided by pᵃ is invertible overℤ_p. The case a=0 is unimodular.

concept.title: Jordan decomposition of a local quadratic lattice
concept.description: A Jordan decomposition of a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ_p-lattice L is an orthogonal direct sum L=⊥_a L_a, with finitely many nonzero summands and each L_a pᵃ-modular. Summands of the same modularity power are grouped; the choice of the actual sublattices need not be unique.

concept.title: Diagonalizable local quadratic lattice
concept.description: A quadratic ℤ_p-lattice is diagonalizable overℤ_p if it admits a ℤ_p-basis e₁,…,e_r with B(e_i,e_j)=0 wheneveri≠j. Diagonalizability is a lattice condition, stronger than diagonalizing the underlying ℚ_p-quadratic space.

concept.title: The even binary unimodular ℤ₂-lattice A(2,2)
concept.description: The standard even binary unimodular ℤ₂-lattice A(2,2) has Gram matrix [[2,1],[1,2]] under the conventionQ(x)=B(x,x), hence Q(x,y)=2x²+2xy+2y² and determinant3. The same matrix defines its integral ℤ-model.

concept.title: Square-free part of a positive rational number
concept.description: For d∈ℚ_(>0), its square-free part sf(d) is the unique positive square-free integer s with d/s a rational square. Its odd square-free part sf(d)′ is sf(d) divided by2 if sf(d) is even, and otherwise sf(d).

concept.title: Odd part of a nonzero rational number
concept.description: The odd part of a nonzero rational a is a′=2^(−v₂(a))a, a unit ofℤ₂. If a is a nonzero integer, a′ is an odd integer; its residue modulo8 is therefore well-defined. This removes the entire2-power, not the odd square factors.

concept.title: Orthogonal complement of a vector in a quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a quadratic ℤ_p-lattice L and a nonisotropic vector v in its ℚ_p-span, the lattice orthogonal complement of v is L∩v⊥={x∈L:B(v,x)=0}. Its rational span is v⊥; v need not itself belong toL.

concept.title: Representation of a scalar by a quadratic lattice
concept.description: A scalar t is represented by a quadratic lattice L if Q(x)=t for some x∈L. Local representation uses x∈L_p; it is distinct from rational representation in ℚ_pL and from primitive lattice representation.

concept.title: Existence of a Jordan splitting over ℤ_p
concept.description: Every nondegenerate quadratic ℤ_p-lattice has a Jordan decomposition. At oddp it can be split into orthogonal rankone blocks; atp2 one may require ranktwo modular blocks as well as rankone blocks before grouping equal modularities.

concept.title: Shift invariance of a normalized quadratic coset polynomial
concept.description: Let N be a quadraticℤ-lattice,ν∈ℚN andh_ν(x)=Q(x)+2B(ν,x), with h_ν(N)⊆ℤ generating dℤ for d>0. For x₀∈N putω=ν+x₀. Then h_ω(N) generates the same ideal, and h_ω(x)/d is almost universal exactly when h_ν(x)/d is.

concept.title: Dedekind independence of field homomorphisms
concept.description: Distinct homomorphisms σ₁,…,σ_n from a field E into a field L are linearly independent as L-valued functions on E: if ∑a_iσ_i(x)=0 for every x∈E with a_i∈L, then every a_i=0.

concept.title: Weil restriction along a finite free algebra
concept.description: Let S be a commutative R-algebra finite free as an R-module and let X be an S-scheme. The Weil restriction Res_(S/R)X, when representable, is the R-scheme whose T-points are Hom_S(T×_(SpecR)SpecS,X), functorially in R-schemes T. This definition permits nonaffine X and nonreduced S; it does not assert representability for every X.

concept.title: Representability and smoothness of a finite flat Weil restriction
concept.description: For a finite locally free morphism S′→S and a quasi-projective smooth S′-scheme X, Res_(S′/S)X is representable by a smooth S-scheme. Restriction of scalars commutes with base change.

concept.title: Néron model and finite extension Weil restriction
concept.description: Let S/R be a finite free extension of discrete valuation rings with fraction fields L/K. If 𝒜/S is the Néron model of an abelian variety A/L, then Res_(S/R)𝒜 exists and is the Néron model over R of Res_(L/K)A.

concept.title: Descending filtration of a group
concept.description: A descending filtration is a chain of subgroups G=F⁰G⊇F¹G⊇⋯; whenever F^(i+1)G is normal in F^iG, the ith graded quotient is Gr^iG=F^iG/F^(i+1)G. For a group scheme the filtration is by subgroup schemes and the quotient is taken as a sheaf when needed.

concept.title: Formal coordinates at the identity of a smooth group
concept.description: For a smooth group scheme of relative dimension d over a complete local ring R, the completion along its identity section has formal coordinates T₁,…,T_d and group law F(T,U)=T+U plus terms of total degree at least2. Modulo a square-zero ideal the group law is therefore addition on its tangent space.

concept.title: Greenberg filtration of a smooth group over a truncated DVR
concept.description: Let 𝒢 be a smooth commutative group scheme over a DVR S with residue field k and maximal ideal 𝔪, and suppose the k-algebra S/𝔪^e is identified with k[t]/(t^e). Assume the indicated Weil restrictions are representable. In X=Res_((S/𝔪^e)/k)(𝒢_(S/𝔪^e)), let F⁰X=X and F^iX be the kernel of reduction to 𝒢 modulo t^i for1≤i≤e. Then Gr⁰X≅𝒢_k and Gr^iX≅Lie(𝒢_k)⊗_k(𝔪/𝔪²)^(⊗i) for1≤i<e, as additive vector groups.

concept.title: Quasi-projectivity of a Néron model
concept.description: The finite-type Néron model of an abelian variety over a discrete valuation ring is quasi-projective over that ring. This supplies the representability hypothesis for finite locally free restriction of scalars.

concept.title: Quantile coupling for usual stochastic order
concept.description: For probability measures mu,nu on the real line, write Q_mu(u)=inf{x:mu((−∞,x])≥u}, 0<u<1. If U is uniform on(0,1), then Q_mu(U) has law mu, and mu≤stnu if and only if Q_mu(u)≤Q_nu(u) for every0<u<1. For probability kernels on the real line the quantile can be chosen jointly measurable in the parameter and u.

concept.title: Borel reconstruction of a càdlàg path from rational evaluations
concept.description: For a Polish state space E, the space D([0,∞),E) of càdlàg paths with its evaluation sigma-algebra is standard Borel. Restriction to a fixed countable dense time set containing0 is measurable and injective, with Borel image and Borel inverse onto that image; right continuity recovers every evaluation.

concept.title: Countable products of Polish spaces
concept.description: A countable product of Polish spaces, equipped with the product topology, is Polish; its Borel sigma-algebra is generated by coordinate projections.

concept.title: Ordered coupling of càdlàg half-line Markov paths
concept.description: Let X,Y be time-homogeneous càdlàg Markov families on[0,∞) with transition semigroups P,Q, such that P_t(x,·)≤stQ_t(y,·) whenever x≤y and t≥0. For every x≤y there is a coupling of their whole path laws started at x,y with X_t≤Y_t for every t≥0 almost surely. In particular this holds for two ordered initial states of one stochastically monotone family, or when P is stochastically dominated by a monotone Q. This path-law assertion alone makes no claim that the coordinates are Markov or martingales in their common enlarged filtration.

concept.title: Bound on the number of distinct polynomial roots
concept.description: A nonzero polynomial of degreeN over a field has at mostN distinct roots in that field or any specified field extension.

concept.title: Cyclicity of the multiplicative group of a finite field
concept.description: For a finite field𝔽_q, its multiplicative group𝔽_q× is cyclic of orderq−1.

concept.title: Teichmüller unit lifts in ℤ_ℓ
concept.description: For an odd primeℓ, reduction moduloℓ gives a group isomorphism μ_(ℓ−1)(ℤ_ℓ)→𝔽_ℓ×. Thus every nonzero residuea has a unique liftτ(a)∈ℤ_ℓ withτ(a)^(ℓ−1)=1, andτ(ab)=τ(a)τ(b).

concept.title: Elliptic building blocks from inner-twist splitting maps
concept.description: Let f be a non-CM weight-two newform with abelian coefficient field F, whose inner twists range over Gal(F/ℚ), and suppose its Gauss-sum cocycle c(σ,τ)=g(χ_σ⁻¹)g(σχ_τ⁻¹)/g(χ_(στ)⁻¹) is the coboundary of β:Gal(F/ℚ)→F×. Over the inner-twist splitting field L, there is w_β∈End_L(A_f) whose image is an elliptic building block and whose differential line pulls back to the span of ∑_σ[g(χ_σ⁻¹)/β(σ)]σf. All elliptic building blocks arise by applying coefficient-field endomorphisms to this image.

concept.title: Integrality of the Manin ideal
concept.description: For a modular parametrization π:X₁^µ(N)→E of a completely defined non-CM ℚ-curve over a number field K, with q-expansion at the rational cusp of the µ_N arithmetic model, its Manin ideal c(π) is an integral O_K-ideal.

concept.title: Cyclotomic Galois action on µ_N-level cusps
concept.description: On the µ_N arithmetic model of X₁(N), and its quotients associated to Γ₁(N)⊆Γ⊆Γ₀(N), every cusp is defined over ℚ(ζ_N). If σ_d(ζ_N)=ζ_N^d, it sends the cusp with primitive residue pair(x,y) modulo N to the cusp represented by any primitive integer lift of(x,d⁻¹y) modulo N. The result is read as a cusp residue class, not by cancelling a nonprimitive fraction; in particular∞ is rational.

concept.title: Lebesgue positivity of every positive-time half-line transition
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup on[0,∞) is positive with respect to Lebesgue measure at every positive time if P_t(x,B)>0 for every t>0, x≥0 and Borel B of positive Lebesgue measure. This is the assigned source’s total irreducibility convention, stronger than irreducibility of an occupation or resolvent kernel.

concept.title: Geometric ergodicity from a half-line Lyapunov drift and positive transitions
concept.description: Let a nonexplosive càdlàg weak Feller strong Markov family on[0,∞), with usual filtration, have positive transition probabilities to every Lebesgue-positive Borel set at every positive time. Suppose a continuous V≥1, k>0, b<∞ and compact C satisfy that V(X_t)−V(X₀)−∫₀ᵗ[−kV(X_s)+b1_C(X_s)]ds is a local supermartingale from every initial state. Then there is a unique invariant probability pi with pi(V)<∞ and constants D,rho>0 such that ‖P_t(x,·)−pi‖V≤D V(x)e^(−rho t) for every x,t. No equality rho=k or special explicit prefactor is asserted.

concept.title: Transfer of continuous-time geometric Lyapunov drift to a skeleton
concept.description: For a nonexplosive weak Feller strong Markov family on[0,∞) with positive transitions to every Lebesgue-positive Borel set at every positive time, a continuous geometric Lyapunov supermartingale drift with compact exception C implies: for a fixed skeleton spacing h>0 there are U≥1 equivalent to V, 0≤a<1, b_h<∞ and a petite set C_h for P_h with sup_(C_h)U<∞ such that P_hU≤aU+b_h1_(C_h). Equivalence means positive finite constants bound U/V above and below.

concept.title: Weil–Châtelet group of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field F, H¹(F,E)=H¹_cont(Gal(F̄/F),E(F̄)) is its Weil–Châtelet group, using the discrete Galois module of geometric points. The abelian group law is the cocycle-class group law.

concept.title: Tate–Shafarevich group of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For E over a number field F, Sha(E/F)=ker[H¹(F,E)→∏_vH¹(F_v,E)], with v running over all finite and infinite places. Each localization restricts cocycles using compatible algebraic-closure embeddings and includes the geometric points into E(F̄_v); its cohomology class is independent of these choices. Finiteness is not part of the definition.

concept.title: Surjectivity of an isogeny on geometric points
concept.description: For an isogenyφ:E→E′ of elliptic curves over a characteristic-zero fieldF, the induced map E(F̄)→E′(F̄) is surjective.

concept.title: Kummer exact sequence for an elliptic isogeny
concept.description: For a characteristic-zero field F and an F-isogenyφ:E→E′, there is an exact sequence0→E′(F)/φE(F)→H¹(F,E[φ])→ker[H¹(F,E)→H¹(F,E′)]→0. The first map sendsP to the class ofσ↦σQ−Q for anyQ∈E(F̄) withφQ=P; all groups use continuous Galois cohomology.

concept.title: Selmer group of an elliptic isogeny
concept.description: For an isogenyφ:E→E′ over a number field F, Sel_φ(E/F) consists of classes c∈H¹(F,E[φ]) whose localization at every placev lies in the image of E′(F_v)/φE(F_v) under the local Kummer map. Forφ=[n] this is the n-Selmer group. The definition imposes local Kummer conditions, not local vanishing in H¹(F_v,E[φ]).

concept.title: Selmer–Tate–Shafarevich exact sequence for an isogeny
concept.description: For an isogenyφ:E→E′ over a number field F,0→E′(F)/φE(F)→Sel_φ(E/F)→Sha(E/F)[φ]→0 is exact, where Sha(E/F)[φ]=ker[Sha(E/F)→Sha(E′/F)]. Forφ=[n], the last term is the subgroup killed byn. No finiteness assumption onSha is needed.

concept.title: Mordell–Weil rank of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field F, its Mordell–Weil rank is dim_ℚ(ℚ⊗_ℤE(F)), equivalently the number of infinite cyclic factors in E(F) when finite generation is known. It concerns rational points and is distinct from analytic rank defined by an L-function zero.

concept.title: Mordell–Weil theorem for elliptic curves
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field F, E(F) is a finitely generated abelian group, hence is isomorphic to E(F)_tors⊕ℤʳ for a finite nonnegative integerr.

concept.title: Well-posedness and smoothing of a Lipschitz reflected half-line diffusion
concept.description: For globally Lipschitz g,sigma on[0,∞) with inf sigma>0, the reflected equation X_t=x+∫₀ᵗg(X_s)ds+∫₀ᵗsigma(X_s)dW_s+L_t, with L continuous nondecreasing increasing only at X=0, has a pathwise unique nonexplosive strong solution from every x≥0. Its laws form a continuous strong Markov family whose transition operators send bounded Borel functions to bounded continuous functions at every positive time.

concept.title: Strong Markov piecing out at bounded-rate jumps
concept.description: Let a nonexplosive right-continuous strong Markov process on a standard Borel state space be killed with bounded nonnegative measurable state rate r, and restarted after each killing from a measurable probability kernel K at its pre-killing state, using independent fresh copies. The resulting pieced process is nonexplosive, unique in law for these transition rules and strong Markov. If r=0 at a state the choice of K there is immaterial; bounded rates rule out finite accumulation of killing times.

concept.title: Order of vanishing of a holomorphic function
concept.description: For f holomorphic near z₀ and not identically zero, ord_(z₀)f is the unique integer r≥0 for which f(z)=(z−z₀)^rg(z) with g holomorphic and g(z₀)≠0. Equivalently r is the first index of a nonzero Taylor coefficient; the identically zero function has order+∞.

concept.title: Analytic rank of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field K whose Hasse–Weil L-function is holomorphic near s=1, its analytic rank is ord_(s=1)L(E/K,s). The definition is conditional on the needed continuation; it does not assert general modularity or equality with the Mordell–Weil rank.

concept.title: Root number of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E/K whose completed Hasse–Weil L-function satisfies its functional equation, the global root number is the sign w(E/K)∈{±1} in Λ(E/K,s)=w(E/K)Λ(E/K,2−s). Here Λ(E/K,s)=(|Δ_K|²Norm(𝔑_K(E)))^(s/2)[(2π)^(−s)Γ(s)]^[K:ℚ]L(E/K,s); constant factors independent of s do not affect the sign.

concept.title: Root number of a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f of primitive level N, its root number η_f is the unit-modulus complex constant in Λ(f,s)=η_fΛ(f*,2−s), where f* has conjugate Fourier coefficients and Λ(f,s)=N^(s/2)(2π)^(−s)Γ(s)L(f,s). If the coefficients of f are real, η_f is±1.

concept.title: Relative logarithmic height on projective space
concept.description: For [a₀:⋯:a_n]∈ℙⁿ(K), its relative logarithmic height over the number field K is h_K=∑_v log max_i|a_i|_v using normalized local multiplicative norms. The product formula makes this independent of homogeneous scaling; division by[K:ℚ] gives the absolute-height convention.

concept.title: Relative Néron–Tate height pairing on an elliptic curve
concept.description: Fix an elliptic curve E/K and let h_K(x(P)) be relative logarithmic projective height, with x(O)=∞. Put q_K(P)=lim_(n→∞)4^(−n)h_K(x([2ⁿ]P)). The relative Néron–Tate pairing is ⟨P,Q⟩_K=(q_K(P+Q)−q_K(P)−q_K(Q))/2; thus ⟨P,P⟩_K=q_K(P). This fixes the x-coordinate normalization and the relative, rather than degree-divided absolute, convention.

concept.title: Regulator of an elliptic curve over a number field
concept.description: For a ℤ-basis P₁,…,P_r of E(K)/E(K)_tors, the regulator is Reg(E/K)=det(⟨P_i,P_j⟩_K), using the specified relative Néron–Tate pairing. The rank-zero determinant is1. A basis change in GL_r(ℤ) does not alter it; torsion factors are not incorporated into this regulator.

concept.title: Local Tamagawa number of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For E over a nonarchimedean local field K with finite residue field k, let E⁰(K) be the points reducing into the identity component of its Néron special fiber. The local Tamagawa number is c_K=[E(K):E⁰(K)]=|Φ(k)|, where Φ is the component group. It is1 at good-reduction places.

concept.title: Atkin–Lehner involution on X₀(N)
concept.description: For an exact divisor Q|N with gcd(Q,N/Q)=1, the Atkin–Lehner involution w_Q on X₀(N) sends(E,C) to(E/C_Q,C′), where C_Q⊆C has order Q and C′ is generated by the kernel E[Q]/C_Q of the dual quotient isogeny and the image of the order-N/Q subgroup of C. It extends to the compact curve overℚ; for squarefreeN these involutions generate an elementary abelian2-group.

concept.title: Local Haar measure induced by an elliptic differential
concept.description: For E over a local field K, a nonzero invariant differential ω and a Haar measure dz on(K,+) define a translation-invariant measure |ω| on E(K): in a local analytic coordinate z with ω=a(z)dz, use |a(z)|_K dz. At a complex place the associated real2-dimensional measure is understood, and the chosen additive Haar normalization is part of the data.

concept.title: Formal parameter and reduction kernel of a local elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve given by a minimal integral Weierstrass model over a local field K with valuation ring R and maximal ideal𝔪, E¹(K) is the kernel of reduction at the identity. The parameter z=−x/y identifies this kernel with𝔪 carrying the formal group law, and a minimal invariant differential has expansion(1+O(z))dz. Reduction gives E⁰(K)/E¹(K)≅the nonsingular residue-curve group.

concept.title: Néron local volume formula for an elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E/K have a minimal integral Weierstrass model over a nonarchimedean local field with residue size q, let ω_min be a minimal invariant differential and normalize additive Haar measure by vol(O_K)=1. Then ∫_(E(K))|ω_min|=c_K/L_K(E,1), where c_K=[E(K):E⁰(K)] and L_K is the local Hasse–Weil Euler factor.

concept.title: BSD period of an elliptic curve over a number field
concept.description: For E/K choose a nonzero invariant differential ω and additive Haar measures dx_v whose product on𝔄_K gives vol(𝔄_K/K)=1. Its BSD period is P(E/K)=∏_(v finite)[L_v(E,1)∫_(E(K_v))|ω|_v]·∏_(v infinite)∫_(E(K_v))|ω|_v. Almost all finite factors are1; the product formula makes the result independent of ω, and the adelic normalization fixes its discriminant factor.

concept.title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer rank conjecture over a number field
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field K, its Hasse–Weil L-function is conjectured to have analytic continuation to an entire function, with ord_(s=1)L(E/K,s) equal to its Mordell–Weil rank. No general continuation or rank equality is asserted by this conjecture record.

concept.title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term conjecture over a number field
concept.description: For E/K of Mordell–Weil rank r, the BSD conjecture asserts analytic continuation and analytic rank r, finiteness of Sha(E/K), and lim_(s→1)L(E/K,s)/(s−1)^r=P(E/K)Reg(E/K)|Sha(E/K)|/|E(K)_tors|². Here P is the adelically normalized BSD period and Reg is the relative height-pairing determinant on a torsion-free basis, with torsion kept separate.

concept.title: Strictly positive killed transition density in a bounded interval
concept.description: A one-dimensional diffusion on a bounded interval with Lipschitz coefficients and diffusion coefficient bounded above and away from0 has, before exit, a transition density strictly positive at every positive time between interior points. Consequently every interior Borel set of positive Lebesgue measure has positive killed transition probability from every interior starting point.

concept.title: Weak well-posedness of two rank-based Brownian particles
concept.description: For two real Brownian particles whose drift and positive definite covariance matrix are constant in the two rank chambers and are permuted with the particle ranks, with a fixed measurable lexicographic rule at ties, the corresponding rank-based stochastic equation has a nonexplosive weak solution unique in law.

concept.title: Positive transitions of a Lipschitz reflected half-line diffusion
concept.description: Let the reflected half-line diffusion have globally Lipschitz drift g and diffusion coefficient sigma with inf sigma>0. For every t>0, initial x≥0 and Borel set B⊆[0,∞) of positive Lebesgue measure, P_x(X_t∈B)>0.

concept.title: Tanaka formula for the absolute value of a continuous semimartingale
concept.description: For a real continuous semimartingale X, there is a continuous nonnegative nondecreasing process L^0 with L₀^0=0, increasing only when X=0, such that |X_t|=|X₀|+∫₀ᵗsgn(X_s)dX_s+L_t^0, with sgn(0)=0. This L^0 is the symmetric local time of X at0.

concept.title: Exponential ergodicity criterion for a reflected jump-diffusion
concept.description: Let g,sigma be globally Lipschitz on[0,∞), inf sigma>0, and destination measures nu_x be weakly continuous with bounded total mass and sup_x∫exp(lambda0|y−x|)nu_x(dy)<∞ for some lambda0>0. If for some0<lambda<lambda0, limsup_(x→∞)[lambda g(x)+lambda²sigma(x)²/2+∫(exp(lambda(y−x))−1)nu_x(dy)]<0, then the reflected jump-diffusion has a unique invariant probability pi with pi(exp(lambda x))<∞ and is exp(lambda x)-uniformly ergodic at some positive rate.

concept.title: Reflected jump-diffusion representation of a two-rank Lévy gap
concept.description: For two rank-based finite-activity Lévy particles driven in rank order by drift(g_plus,g_minus), positive definite Brownian covariance a and finite joint jump measure Lambda, their ranked gap Z is a reflected jump-diffusion with constant drift g_plus−g_minus, variance a_plusplus+a_minusminus−2a_plusminus, and destination measure nu_z equal to the pushforward of Lambda under (u_plus,u_minus)↦|z+u_plus−u_minus|. The two-particle system is weakly well-posed.

concept.title: Gap ergodicity under negative effective drift for two rank-based Lévy particles
concept.description: For the two-rank finite-activity Lévy system with positive definite Brownian covariance and joint jump measure Lambda, suppose ∫exp(lambda0(|u_plus|+|u_minus|))Lambda(du)<∞ for some lambda0>0 and g_plus−g_minus+∫(u_plus−u_minus)Lambda(du)<0. Then for some lambda>0 the ranked gap is exp(lambda z)-uniformly ergodic and its unique invariant law has finite exp(lambda z) moment.

concept.title: Optional sampling for a nonnegative càdlàg supermartingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration, if X is a nonnegative càdlàg supermartingale and sigma≤tau are bounded stopping times, then E[X_tau|F_sigma]≤X_sigma almost surely. No class-D assumption is needed for this bounded-time nonnegative formulation.

concept.title: Local Doob–Meyer decomposition of a càdlàg supermartingale
concept.description: On a usual filtration, a real càdlàg supermartingale X has a unique local decomposition X=X₀+N−A, where N is a càdlàg local martingale starting at0 and A is predictable càdlàg nondecreasing starting at0 and locally integrable. This is the local form; a uniformly integrable martingale conclusion requires the corresponding class-D/integrability hypotheses.

concept.title: Prime-to-characteristic Tate module of a smooth commutative group
concept.description: For a smooth commutative group scheme G of finite type over a perfect field k and a prime ℓ≠char(k), T_ℓG=lim←G[ℓⁿ](k̄) with multiplication-by-ℓ transition maps. It carries the natural Galois action; it applies to nonproper groups and disconnected special fibers as well as abelian varieties.

concept.title: Reduction lifting for a smooth group over a henselian local ring
concept.description: For a smooth commutative group scheme𝒢 over a henselian local ring R with residue field k, reduction𝒢(R)→𝒢(k) is surjective. For every positive integer n invertible in R, its reduction kernel is uniquely n-divisible; equivalently prime-to-residue-characteristic torsion lifts uniquely within a specified residue class.

concept.title: Specialization of inertia-fixed Tate modules to a Néron special fiber
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a nonarchimedean local field K with Néron model𝒜 and residue field k of characteristic p, and ℓ≠p, reduction induces T_ℓ(A)^I_K≅T_ℓ(𝒜_k), equivariantly for the residue-field Galois group G_K/I_K. The whole special fiber may be used; its finite component group contributes no Tate module.

concept.title: Tate rank and Chevalley decomposition of a smooth commutative group
concept.description: For a smooth connected commutative algebraic group G over a perfect field, its maximal connected affine subgroup is an extension of a torus of dimension t by a unipotent group of dimension u, and the quotient is an abelian variety of dimension b. For ℓ different from the characteristic, T_ℓG has rank t+2b, while dim G=t+u+b. A finite component group does not change the Tate rank.

concept.title: Properness from a proper special fiber over a DVR
concept.description: For a smooth finite-type separated scheme X over a discrete valuation ring R with geometrically connected generic fiber, if its special fiber is nonempty and proper, then X is proper over R and its special fiber is geometrically connected.

concept.title: Néron–Ogg–Shafarevich criterion
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a nonarchimedean local field K and a prime ℓ different from the residue characteristic, A has good reduction if and only if inertia acts trivially on T_ℓA. If this holds for one such ℓ it holds for every such ℓ.

concept.title: Imaginary quadratic number field
concept.description: An imaginary quadratic number field is a degree-two extension ofℚ with no embedding intoℝ, equivalently K=ℚ(√D) for a negative square-free integerD. A chosen embeddingK⊂ℂ fixes its complex realization.

concept.title: Splitting of a prime in a number-field extension
concept.description: A nonzero prime ideal𝔭 ofO_K splits completely in a finite extensionL/K if𝔭O_L is a product of[L:K] distinct prime ideals, each with residue-field degree1. In a quadratic extension this means two distinct primes of ramification index and residue degree1.

concept.title: Heegner hypothesis for an elliptic curve over ℚ
concept.description: For an elliptic curveE/ℚ of conductorN and an imaginary quadratic fieldK, the split-prime Heegner hypothesis says every rational prime dividingN splits completely inK. Extra exclusionsK≠ℚ(i),ℚ(√−3), when imposed to simplify unit factors, are separate hypotheses.

concept.title: Hilbert class field of a number field
concept.description: The Hilbert class fieldH of a number fieldK is its maximal abelian extension unramified at every finite prime and at infinity: every real place remains real. For an imaginary quadraticK the infinite-place condition is vacuous.

concept.title: Order in an imaginary quadratic field
concept.description: An order in an imaginary quadratic fieldK is a subringR⊆O_K containing1 and of finite index inO_K. It has the formR=ℤ+cO_K for a unique positive integerc, its conductor.

concept.title: Proper invertible ideal class of a quadratic order
concept.description: For an orderR in an imaginary quadratic fieldK, a proper invertible fractionalR-ideal is a rank-twoℤ-latticeI⊂K withaI⊆R for some nonzeroa∈R, multiplier ring{x∈K:xI⊆I}=R, andII′=R for another fractionalR-idealI′. Their products modulo principal idealsαR,α∈K×, formPic(R).

concept.title: Ring class field of an imaginary quadratic order
concept.description: ForR=ℤ+cO_K in an imaginary quadratic fieldK, the ring class fieldH_c/K is the abelian class field whose Artin map identifiesPic(R) withGal(H_c/K): at primes𝔭 ofO_K prime toc, the class of𝔭∩R maps to arithmeticFrobenius. H₁ is the Hilbert class field; H_c is generally smaller than the full ray class field of modulusc.

concept.title: Galois trace of a point on an elliptic curve
concept.description: For a finite Galois extensionL/K and an elliptic curveE/K, the point trace is Tr_(L/K)(P)=∑_(σ∈Gal(L/K))σP∈E(K) forP∈E(L), with addition inE. It is a group homomorphism and is distinct from the field trace of point coordinates.

concept.title: Heegner CM point on X₀(N)
concept.description: LetK⊂ℂ be imaginary quadratic with ringO_K and let𝔫⊂O_K satisfyO_K/𝔫≅ℤ/Nℤ. The cyclicN-isogenyℂ/O_K→ℂ/𝔫⁻¹ defines a Heegner CM pointx onX₀(N)(ℂ); equivalently both endpoint elliptic curves have complex multiplication byO_K. The ideal and embedding are part of the chosen construction.

concept.title: Field of definition of a Heegner CM point
concept.description: Under the split-prime Heegner hypothesis for levelN and imaginary quadraticK, a Heegner CM pointx onX₀(N) constructed from an ideal𝔫 ofO_K withO_K/𝔫≅ℤ/Nℤ is rational over the Hilbert class fieldH ofK.

concept.title: Heegner point on a parametrized elliptic curve
concept.description: Fix E/ℚ, a modular parametrizationπ:X₀(N)→E withπ(∞)=O, and a Heegner CM pointx∈X₀(N)(H) for an imaginary quadraticK satisfying the Heegner hypothesis, whereH is its Hilbert class field. The associated Heegner point is y_K=Tr_(H/K)(π(x))∈E(K). The choices are retained, and nontorsion is not part of the definition.

concept.title: Full Mordell–Weil index of a Heegner point
concept.description: If a Heegner pointy_K generates a finite-index subgroup ofE(K), its full index isI_K=[E(K):ℤy_K]. For rankone and nontorsiony_K, I_K=|E(K)_tors|·[E(K)/E(K)_tors:ℤȳ_K]. The full index includes torsion; if the cyclic subgroup has infinite index, no finiteI_K is assigned by this convention.

concept.title: Weak Mordell–Weil theorem for an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curveE over a number fieldF and a nonzero integern, the quotientE(F)/nE(F) is finite.

concept.title: Positivity and Northcott properties of the Néron–Tate height
concept.description: For an elliptic curveE over a number fieldK, the relative Néron–Tate pairing is symmetric and biadditive, its diagonalq_K is nonnegative and vanishes exactly on torsion points, and for each realB the set{P∈E(K):q_K(P)≤B} is finite.

concept.title: Coinvariant space of a group representation
concept.description: For a linear representation ρ of a group G on a vector space V over a field F, the coinvariant space is V_G=V/span_F{ρ(g)v−v:g∈G,v∈V}. Every G-equivariant map from V to a trivial representation factors uniquely through this quotient.

concept.title: Néron identity fiber in multiplicative elliptic reduction
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a nonarchimedean local field K with residue field k, multiplicative reduction means that the identity component of its Néron special fiber is a one-dimensional k-torus. It is split precisely when the two tangent directions of the nodal minimal cubic are k-rational; otherwise the torus splits over the quadratic extension of k.

concept.title: Tate representation at multiplicative elliptic reduction
concept.description: Let E/K have multiplicative reduction over a nonarchimedean local field with residue cardinality q, and ℓ≠char(k). On V=T_ℓE⊗Q_ℓ, inertia is nontrivial unipotent, V^I and V_I each have dimension one, and arithmetic Frobenius acts on them by εq and ε respectively, where ε=1 for split and−1 for nonsplit reduction. Thus the local Euler polynomial on the dual invariant representation is1−εT.

concept.title: Left Riemann-sum approximation of a semimartingale integral
concept.description: Let H be adapted càdlàg and X a càdlàg semimartingale. For deterministic partitions of mesh tending to0 on compact intervals, the left sums ∑H_(t_i)[X_(t_(i+1)∧t)−X_(t_i∧t)] converge ucp to ∫₀ᵗH_(s−)dX_s. For an adapted left-continuous locally bounded H the limit is ∫H_s dX_s.

concept.title: Weighted Riemann-sum approximation of quadratic covariation
concept.description: For càdlàg semimartingales X,Y and adapted càdlàg G, the sums ∑G_(t_i)[X_(t_(i+1)∧t)−X_(t_i∧t)][Y_(t_(i+1)∧t)−Y_(t_i∧t)] along deterministic partitions of mesh tending to0 converge ucp to ∫₀ᵗG_(s−)d[X,Y]_s.

concept.title: Fundamental quadratic discriminant
concept.description: A nonzero integer D≠1 is a fundamental discriminant if D is squarefree and D≡1 mod4, or D=4d with d squarefree and d≡2 or3 mod4. These are exactly the discriminants of quadratic number fields.

concept.title: Kronecker symbol with positive denominator
concept.description: For an integer a and a positive integer n=2^e∏p^e_p with odd primes p, put(a/n)=(a/2)^e∏(a/p)^e_p, with empty product1. Here(a/p) is the Legendre symbol and(a/2)=0 for even a and(−1)^((a²−1)/8) for odd a. This convention suffices for the quadratic characters attached to discriminants.

concept.title: Quadratic reciprocity with supplementary laws
concept.description: For distinct odd primes p,q, (p/q)(q/p)=(−1)^((p−1)(q−1)/4). For any odd prime p, (−1/p)=(−1)^((p−1)/2) and(2/p)=(−1)^((p²−1)/8).

concept.title: Unit groups modulo prime powers
concept.description: For an odd prime p and a≥1, (Z/p^aZ)× is cyclic of order p^(a−1)(p−1). For a≥3, (Z/2^aZ)× is the direct product generated by−1 of order2 and5 of order2^(a−2); the cases a=1,2 have orders1,2.

concept.title: Primitive quadratic character of a fundamental discriminant
concept.description: For a fundamental discriminant D, χ_D(n)=(D/n) for positive n extends periodically modulo|D| to a primitive real Dirichlet character on Z, with χ_D(−1)=sign(D). Conversely every primitive real Dirichlet character of modulus≥2 is obtained uniquely in this way.

concept.title: Evaluation of the complete quadratic Gauss sum
concept.description: For a positive integer N, ∑_(a modN)exp(2πia²/N) is(1+i)√N if N≡0 mod4, √N if N≡1 mod4,0 if N≡2 mod4, and i√N if N≡3 mod4, with positive real square roots.

concept.title: Gauss sum of a primitive quadratic character
concept.description: For a fundamental discriminant D and χ_D, ∑_(a mod|D|)χ_D(a)exp(2πina/|D|)=χ_D(n)√D for every positive n, where√D is the positive real square root when D>0 and i√|D| when D<0. In particular the Gauss sum at n=1 has this exact value.

concept.title: Fricke operator on weight-two cusp forms
concept.description: For f∈S₂(Γ₁(N)), put(W_Nf)(z)=(Nz²)⁻¹f(−1/(Nz)). This preserves S₂(Γ₁(N)), satisfies W_N²=1, and sends the nebentypusχ subspace to the nebentypusχ̄ subspace; it need not preserve an individual complex-character eigenspace.

concept.title: Polynomial growth of cusp-form Fourier coefficients
concept.description: For a holomorphic cusp form f(z)=∑_(n≥1)a_ne^(2πinz) of integral weight k≥2 on Γ₁(N), one has|a_n|≪_f n^(k/2). In particular its Dirichlet series converges absolutely in a right half-plane.

concept.title: Mellin formula for a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f of level N, Λ(f,s)=N^(s/2)(2π)^(-s)Γ(s)L(f,s)=N^(s/2)∫₀^∞f(it)t^(s−1)dt. The integral converges locally uniformly for all complex s and gives an entire continuation; at s=1 it gives L(f,1)=−2πi∫₀^(i∞)f(z)dz.

concept.title: Fricke pseudoeigenvalue of a primitive newform
concept.description: If f=∑a_nqⁿ is a normalized primitive weight-two newform of level N and f*=∑ā_nqⁿ, then W_Nf=w_f f* for some algebraic complex number w_f with|w_f|=1.

concept.title: Functional equation of a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f of level N, its completed entire L-function Λ(f,s)=N^(s/2)(2π)^(-s)Γ(s)L(f,s) satisfies Λ(f,s)=η_fΛ(f*,2−s), where f* has conjugate Fourier coefficients, η_f is algebraic with|η_f|=1, and η_f=−w_f in the convention W_Nf=w_ff*. If all coefficients are real thenη_f∈{±1}.

concept.title: Upper incomplete gamma function
concept.description: For x>0 and s∈C, Γ(s,x)=∫_x^∞e^(−t)t^(s−1)dt, with the real logarithm used for powers of t. This is entire in s and is defined at all s even where the ordinary gamma function has poles.

concept.title: Smoothed approximate functional equation for a weight-two newform
concept.description: Let f=∑a_nqⁿ be a normalized weight-two newform of level N, with functional-equation factorη_f, and put b_n=2πn/√N. Then Λ(f,s)=∑_(n≥1)a_nb_n^(−s)Γ(s,b_n)+η_f∑_(n≥1)ā_nb_n^(s−2)Γ(2−s,b_n). Both series and all s-derivatives converge locally uniformly, giving exponentially convergent evaluations of values and derivatives from coefficients andη_f.

concept.title: Rational point of a scheme
concept.description: For a k-scheme X and a field extension L/k, an L-rational point of X is a morphism Spec L→X over Spec k. The set of these morphisms is denoted X(L); this includes k-rational points when L=k.

concept.title: Genus of a smooth projective curve
concept.description: For a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C over a field k, its genus is g(C)=dim_k H⁰(C,Ω¹_(C/k)), the dimension of the space of global regular differential one-forms. This is the geometric genus convention.

concept.title: Riemann–Hurwitz formula in characteristic zero
concept.description: For a finite nonconstant morphism f:Y→X of smooth projective geometrically connected curves over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, let d be its degree and e_P the order of vanishing at P of the pullback of a local parameter at f(P). Then 2g(Y)−2=d(2g(X)−2)+∑_P(e_P−1).

concept.title: Genus of a prime-level modular curve X₀(p)
concept.description: For a prime p>3, the genus of X₀(p) is n−1 if p=12n+1, n if p=12n+5 or p=12n+7, and n+1 if p=12n+11. In particular X₀(11) and X₀(17) have genus one, and for p>17 with p≡2 mod3 it has genus at least two.

concept.title: Good reduction of a smooth projective curve
concept.description: A smooth projective geometrically connected curve C over a number field K has good reduction at a finite place v if it is the generic fiber of a proper smooth scheme over the discrete valuation ring O_(K,v), with geometrically connected one-dimensional fibers. Good reduction outside S means this holds at every finite place not in S.

concept.title: Shafarevich finiteness for curves of fixed genus
concept.description: For a number field K, a finite set S of finite places, and an integer g≥2, there are only finitely many K-isomorphism classes of smooth projective geometrically connected curves of genus g with good reduction outside S.

concept.title: Kodaira–Parshin covers associated to rational points
concept.description: Let C/K be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a number field. There exist a finite extension L/K, a finite set S of finite places of L, and a bound G, all independent of P∈C(K), such that each P has a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C_P/L of genus at most G, with good reduction outside S, and a finite nonconstant map C_P→C_L branched exactly over P.

concept.title: De Franchis finiteness in characteristic zero
concept.description: For fixed smooth projective geometrically connected curves D and C over a characteristic-zero field k with g(C)≥2, there are only finitely many nonconstant k-morphisms D→C. The characteristic-zero qualification excludes the infinite Frobenius iterates possible in positive characteristic.

concept.title: Faltings’s finiteness theorem for rational points
concept.description: If C is a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a number field K, then C(K) is finite.

concept.title: J-invariant of an elliptic curve in characteristic zero
concept.description: For E:y²=x³+Ax+B in characteristic zero, j(E)=1728·4A³/(4A³+27B²). It is unchanged under isomorphisms preserving the origin; over an algebraic closure, two elliptic curves are isomorphic exactly when their j-invariants agree.

concept.title: Isomorphism between short Weierstrass models
concept.description: In characteristic zero, an isomorphism preserving infinity from y²=x³+Ax+B to y²=x³+A′x+B′ is of the form (x,y)↦(u²x,u³y), where u≠0, A′=u⁴A and B′=u⁶B. Conversely these conditions give such an isomorphism.

concept.title: Geometric automorphism group of an elliptic curve in characteristic zero
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E in characteristic zero, its origin-preserving automorphism group over an algebraic closure is cyclic of order2 if j(E)∉{0,1728}, order4 if j(E)=1728, and order6 if j(E)=0. In a short Weierstrass model it consists of (x,y)↦(u²x,u³y) with u⁴A=A and u⁶B=B.

concept.title: Finiteness of fixed-field exceptional elliptic cohomology cases
concept.description: Fix a number field F and a prime p>17 with F∩ℚ(μ_p)=ℚ. There are only finitely many F-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves E/F for which H¹(Gal(F(E[p])/F),E[p]) is nonzero.

concept.title: C^k map between Euclidean open sets
concept.description: For a finite integer k≥0, a map between open Euclidean sets is C^k if all component partial derivatives of total order at most k exist and are continuous; order zero is the component itself, so C^0 means continuous. A map is C^∞ when it is C^k for every finite k.

concept.title: Galois character attached to a Dirichlet character
concept.description: For a Dirichlet characterχ modulo N and a fixed embedding of its values intoQ̄_ℓ, the associated Galois character sendsσ∈G_Q toχ(a_σ), whereσ(ζ_N)=ζ_N^(a_σ). Its value at arithmetic Frobenius atp∤Nℓ isχ(p).

concept.title: Tate component of a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a weight-two newform f with coefficient field F and modular abelian variety A_f, and a primeλ|ℓ of F, define V_(f,λ)=V_ℓ(A_f)⊗_(F⊗Q_ℓ)F_λ using the λ-factor projection. The commuting F-action makes this a continuous F_λ-linear G_Q-representation, denotedρ_(f,λ).

concept.title: Good-prime Frobenius polynomial of a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f with nebentypusχ and λ|ℓ, its two-dimensional λ-adic representation is unramified atp∤Nℓ and has arithmetic-Frobenius characteristic polynomial X²−a_pX+χ(p)p.

concept.title: Chebotarev density of Frobenius conjugacy classes
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of number fields, each conjugacy class C⊂Gal(L/K) occurs as the Frobenius class of unramified prime ideals of K with Dirichlet density |C|/|Gal(L/K)|. In particular every finite-quotient conjugacy class occurs at infinitely many primes outside any finite excluded set.

concept.title: Determinant of the Tate representation of a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f of level N and nebentypusχ, V_(f,λ) has dimension two over F_λ and detρ_(f,λ)=χ·χ_ℓ as characters of G_Q, whereχ is viewed as a Galois character andχ_ℓ is the ℓ-adic cyclotomic character. This character identity applies on every decomposition group, including primes dividing N.

concept.title: Full Atkin–Lehner quotient of a modular curve
concept.description: For squarefree N, let W(N) be the finite group generated by all Atkin–Lehner involutions w_Q on X₀(N). The quotient X*(N)=X₀(N)/W(N) is the smooth projective curve overQ whose function field isQ(X₀(N))^W(N); its noncuspidal open is denotedY*(N).

concept.title: Geometric fibers of a finite group quotient of a curve
concept.description: For a finite group G acting by automorphisms on a smooth projective curve C over a characteristic-zero field k, the smooth projective curve with function field k(C)^G is its finite quotient C/G; each geometric fiber of C→C/G is exactly one G-orbit.

concept.title: Q-curves from rational Atkin–Lehner quotient points
concept.description: For squarefree N and P∈Y*(N)(Q), every geometric lift of P toY₀(N) represents an elliptic curve geometrically isogenous to all its Galois conjugates, hence aQ-curve. All curves represented by this fiber are geometrically isogenous. This asserts the forward construction, not the converse classification of allQ-curves.

concept.title: Twisting criterion for a completely defined quadratic Q-curve
concept.description: LetK/Q be quadratic with a fixed liftν∈G_Q, letE/K be geometrically non-CM, and letµ:E→νE be a geometric isogeny. Writeσµ=c_σµ withc_σ∈{±1} forσ∈G_K. Forb∈K×, the twistE^b admits aK-defined isogeny toν(E^b) iff c_σ=κ_(N_K/Q b)(σ) for allσ∈G_K, whereκ_a(σ)=σ√a/√a.

concept.title: Normalizer of a subgroup
concept.description: For a subgroup H of a group G, its normalizer is N_G(H)={g∈G:gHg⁻¹=H}. It is a subgroup of G containing H, and H is normal in N_G(H).

concept.title: Split Cartan subgroup of GL₂ over a finite field
concept.description: For a finite field k, a split Cartan subgroup of GL₂(k) is the stabilizer of each of two distinct lines in k². In a basis on these lines it is the full group of invertible diagonal matrices, isomorphic to k××k×.

concept.title: Nonsplit Cartan subgroup of GL₂ over a finite field
concept.description: Let k₂/k be a quadratic extension of finite fields. Multiplication by k₂× on the two-dimensional k-vector space k₂ embeds it in GL₂(k). A conjugate of this subgroup is a nonsplit Cartan subgroup; it is cyclic of order |k|²−1.

concept.title: Projective general linear group PGL₂ over a finite field
concept.description: For a finite field k, PGL₂(k)=GL₂(k)/{aI:a∈k×}. It acts faithfully on the projective line P¹(k), by the action of matrices on one-dimensional subspaces of k².

concept.title: Alternating group of a finite set
concept.description: For an n-element set, the alternating group A_n is the subgroup of its symmetric group consisting of the permutations expressible as a product of an even number of transpositions. The parity of such an expression is independent of the expression.

concept.title: Dihedral group
concept.description: For an integer n≥2, the dihedral group D_(2n) is C_n⋊C₂, where the nonidentity element of C₂ acts on C_n by inversion. Equivalently it has generators r,s with r^n=s²=1 and srs⁻¹=r⁻¹; its order is 2n.

concept.title: Normalizers of Cartan subgroups of GL₂ over an odd prime field
concept.description: Let p be odd and C a split or nonsplit Cartan subgroup of GL₂(𝔽_p). Its normalizer N has [N:C]=2. In the split case N consists of diagonal and antidiagonal invertible matrices; in the nonsplit case its elements are x↦ax or x↦ax^p on 𝔽_(p²). Its image in PGL₂(𝔽_p) is dihedral of order 2(p−1) or 2(p+1), respectively.

concept.title: Prime-to-p finite subgroups of PGL₂ over a prime field
concept.description: Let p be prime and H⊆PGL₂(𝔽_p) have order coprime to p. Then H is cyclic, dihedral, or isomorphic to A₄, S₄ or A₅. The alternatives need not all occur over a given prime field.

concept.title: Subgroup classification of GL₂ over a prime field
concept.description: For a prime p>3 and G⊆GL₂(𝔽_p), at least one holds: G contains SL₂(𝔽_p); G stabilizes a line in 𝔽_p²; G is contained in the normalizer of a split or nonsplit Cartan subgroup; or its projective image is isomorphic to A₄, S₄ or A₅.

concept.title: Direct product of groups
concept.description: For groups G and H, the direct product G×H has underlying Cartesian product and multiplication (g,h)(g′,h′)=(gg′,hh′). Its identity and inverse are taken componentwise.

concept.title: Mazur’s theorem on rational isogenies of prime degree
concept.description: If an elliptic curve over ℚ admits an isogeny over ℚ of prime degree p, then p∈{2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,37,43,67,163}. Conversely each listed prime occurs for some elliptic curve over ℚ.

concept.title: Mazur’s theorem on rational elliptic torsion
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E/ℚ, its torsion subgroup E(ℚ)_tors is isomorphic either to ℤ/nℤ with 1≤n≤10 or n=12, or to ℤ/2ℤ×ℤ/(2m)ℤ with 1≤m≤4. Each of these fifteen groups occurs.

concept.title: Manin constant of an X₀ modular parametrization
concept.description: For E/Q of conductor N, let f be its normalized weight-two newform andπ:X₀(N)→E a modular parametrization. For a global minimal invariant differentialω_E, the nonzero rational number c(π) is defined byπ*ω_E=c(π)f(q)dq/q. Changing the sign ofω_E changes the sign ofc(π); its absolute value is the unsigned Manin constant.

concept.title: Integral q-expansions of Néron differentials on a modular Jacobian
concept.description: For the Néron model overZ of J₁(N), the q-expansion map at its rational Tate cusp sends invariant integral differentials intoZ[[q]]dq/q. Pullbacks of integral Néron differentials along homomorphisms J₁(N)→J₀(N)→A have integral q-expansions as well.

concept.title: Integrality of the X₀ Manin constant
concept.description: For a modular parametrizationπ:X₀(N)→E/Q at the conductor level and a global minimal differentialω_E, the signed Manin constant c(π) is a nonzero integer. In particular the unsigned constant of the optimal quotient is a positive integer.

concept.title: Manin conjecture for an optimal X₀ elliptic quotient
concept.description: For an optimal modular parametrizationX₀(N)→E/Q at the conductor level, the unsigned Manin constant is1, or equivalently the signed constant attached to a chosen minimal differential is±1. This is a conjecture, not asserted by its definition or by integrality.

concept.title: Kato critical-value Selmer finiteness for a weight-two newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f with L(f,1)≠0 and each finite prime λ of its coefficient field, the Bloch–Kato Selmer group of every G_ℚ-stable O_λ-lattice T in the Tate component V_(f,λ) is finite. In Kato’s normalization V_(f,λ) is the critical Tate twist V(f)(1) of his cohomological realization, up to replacing f by its complex-conjugate newform; the local condition above λ is the Bloch–Kato crystalline condition, not an unrestricted H¹ condition.

concept.title: Kummer exact sequence for the primary Selmer group of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K and a primeℓ, define Sel_(ℓ∞)(A/K)=ker[H¹(K,A[ℓ∞])→∏_vH¹(K_v,A)]. There is an exact sequence0→A(K)⊗(Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ)→Sel_(ℓ∞)(A/K)→Sha(A/K)[ℓ∞]→0.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato comparison for abelian-variety Selmer groups
concept.description: For an abelian variety over a number field, the Bloch–Kato finite local conditions on its rational Tate realization agree with the rationalized local Kummer conditions. In particular decomposing a modular abelian Tate realization into newform critical realizations decomposes its rational Selmer group; finite lattice discrepancies do not affect finiteness of the primary Selmer group.

concept.title: Mordell–Weil finite generation for an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K, the abelian group A(K) is finitely generated. This is the arbitrary-dimensional theorem, extending the elliptic-curve case.

concept.title: Kato rank-zero criterion for a modular abelian quotient
concept.description: Let A/Q be an abelian variety admitting a surjective homomorphism J₁(N)→A for some N. If L(A/Q,1)≠0, then A(Q) is finite. The assertion is a theorem and does not assume the full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture.

concept.title: Perron splitting of a uniformly positive matrix cocycle
concept.description: Let θ be a homeomorphism of compact metric Ω and A:Ω→M_d(ℝ) continuous and nonnegative. Suppose some s≥1 makes A^(s)(ω)=A(θ^(s−1)ω)⋯A(ω) strictly positive for every ω. There are continuous positive unit vectors u(ω),v(ω) such that A(ω)u(ω) is a positive multiple of u(θω), A(ω)ker(v(ω)ᵀ)⊆ker(v(θω)ᵀ), and ℝᵈ=ℝu(ω)⊕ker(v(ω)ᵀ). Some C>0,0<α<1 give ‖A^(n)(ω)b‖≤Cαⁿ‖A^(n)(ω)u(ω)‖ for every unit b⊥v(ω), uniformly in ω and n≥0.

concept.title: Schauder–Tychonoff fixed-point theorem
concept.description: Every continuous self-map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a Hausdorff locally convex real topological vector space has a fixed point.

concept.title: Continuity of a uniform limit
concept.description: A uniform limit of continuous maps from a topological space to a metric space is continuous.

concept.title: Common growth exponent for a stationary uniformly positive matrix product
concept.description: Let (Ω,θ,Q) be an ergodic probability-preserving compact metric system with θ a homeomorphism. Let A:Ω→M_d(ℝ) be continuous and nonnegative, with one fixed-length product A^(s)(ω)=A(θ^(s−1)ω)⋯A(ω) strictly positive for every ω. There is a finite deterministic r such that n⁻¹log‖A^(n)(ω)‖→r and n⁻¹log‖A^(n)(ω)z‖→r for Q-almost every ω and every nonzero z∈ℝ_+ᵈ.

concept.title: Shafarevich finiteness for elliptic curves
concept.description: For a number field K and a finite set S of its finite places, only finitely many K-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves have good reduction at every place outsideS.

concept.title: Finiteness of an elliptic isogeny class over a number field
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field K, only finitely many K-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves are K-isogenous toE.

concept.title: Billerey effective bound for prime isogenies
concept.description: For a geometrically non-CM elliptic curve E over a number field K, Billerey’s explicit resultant criterion computes a finite set S of rational primes containing everyp for which E admits aK-defined cyclicp-isogeny. Searching the good-prime-ideal resultants terminates because infinitely many of them are nonzero; exceptional primes dividing6disc(K)Norm(Δ) are included separately.

concept.title: Division polynomials of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Fix a characteristic-zero Weierstrass equation y²+a₁xy+a₃y=x³+a₂x²+a₄x+a₆. Its division polynomials have ψ₀=0; for odd n≥1, ψ_n=n∏_(P∈(E[n]∖{O})/{±1})(x−x(P)); for even n≥2, ψ_n=(n/2)(2y+a₁x+a₃)∏_(P∈(E[n]∖E[2])/{±1})(x−x(P)). The products give polynomials over the base field; their zeros encode the indicated torsion points in these fixed coordinates.

concept.title: Vélu quotient by a finite elliptic subgroup
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field K and a finite G_K-stable subgroup C⊂E(K̄), the quotient isogeny E→E/C is defined overK. Vélu’s finite-sum formulas compute a Weierstrass equation and the isogeny rational functions from the coordinates ofC.

concept.title: Effective prime-isogeny enumeration over a number field
concept.description: For a geometrically non-CM elliptic curve E/K over a number field, an algorithm determines every rational primep admitting aK-defined cyclicp-isogeny fromE and computes all such isogenies up to targetK-isomorphism.

concept.title: Isogeny graph of a non-CM elliptic curve over a number field
concept.description: For a geometrically non-CM elliptic curve E/K, its K-isogeny graph has vertices the K-isomorphism classes K-isogenous toE and an edge labeledp between two vertices when there is aK-defined cyclic isogeny of prime degreep between them. Dual isogenies make the edges undirected; the graph is finite and connected, and traversing prime-degree isogenies enumerates its vertices.

concept.title: Dirichlet density of a set of prime ideals
concept.description: For a set T of nonzero prime ideals in a number field K, its Dirichlet density is lim_(s→1+) (∑_(p∈T)N(p)^(−s))/log(1/(s−1)), when this limit exists. Changing finitely many primes does not change this density.

concept.title: Conjugacy class in a group
concept.description: For an element g of a group G, its conjugacy class is {hgh⁻¹:h∈G}. The conjugacy classes partition G.

concept.title: Centralizer of a group element
concept.description: For g∈G, its centralizer is C_G(g)={h∈G:hg=gh}, a subgroup. Conjugation identifies the cosets G/C_G(g) as a set with the conjugacy class of g.

concept.title: Frobenius Dirichlet density in abelian extensions
concept.description: For a finite abelian extension L/K of number fields with Galois group G and σ∈G, the unramified prime ideals of K whose Frobenius equals σ have Dirichlet density 1/|G|.

concept.title: Zero Dirichlet density of primes of higher relative residue degree
concept.description: For a finite extension M/K of number fields, the prime ideals q of M with residue degree [O_M/q:O_K/(q∩O_K)]>1 have Dirichlet density zero as primes of M.

concept.title: Signature of a number field
concept.description: The signature (r₁,r₂) of a number field K consists of the number r₁ of embeddings K→ℝ and half the number of nonreal embeddings K→ℂ, counted in complex-conjugate pairs. Thus [K:ℚ]=r₁+2r₂.

concept.title: Unit group of the ring of integers of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K, its unit group O_K× consists of the u∈O_K for which u⁻¹ also lies in O_K, with multiplication. Its torsion elements are exactly the roots of unity in K.

concept.title: Logarithmic embedding of number-field units
concept.description: Choose the real embeddings σ₁,…,σ_(r₁) and one from each conjugate pair σ_(r₁+1),…,σ_(r₁+r₂) of K. The logarithmic map sends u∈O_K× to (log|σ_i(u)|)_i∈ℝ^(r₁+r₂); its image lies in ∑_(i≤r₁)x_i+2∑_(i>r₁)x_i=0. Complex coordinates here have unweighted logarithms, with weight2 in the hyperplane.

concept.title: Minkowski’s convex-body theorem
concept.description: Let Λ⊂ℝⁿ be a full lattice with covolume d. Any convex body symmetric about the origin and of volume greater than 2ⁿd contains a nonzero point of Λ.

concept.title: Minkowski embedding of the ring of integers as a lattice
concept.description: For a number field K of signature (r₁,r₂), its embedding into ℝ^(r₁)×ℂ^(r₂), using all real and one of each conjugate pair of complex embeddings, identifies O_K with a full lattice in this real vector space. In real/imaginary coordinates its covolume is 2^(−r₂)√N(d_(K/ℚ)), using the norm of the relative discriminant ideal.

concept.title: Finiteness of integral ideals of bounded norm
concept.description: For a number field K and a real bound B, only finitely many nonzero integral ideals a⊂O_K have absolute norm N(a)≤B.

concept.title: Finiteness of algebraic integers with bounded degree and conjugates
concept.description: Given an integer d≥1 and a real B>0, only finitely many algebraic integers α have degree at most d over ℚ and every complex conjugate of absolute value at most B.

concept.title: Structure theorem for finitely generated abelian groups
concept.description: A finitely generated abelian group A is isomorphic to A_tors×ℤʳ for a unique nonnegative integer r, where A_tors={a∈A:na=0 for some nonzero integer n} is finite. The integer r is its rank.

concept.title: Skew product of a discrete random dynamical system
concept.description: For a discrete random dynamical system φ over a measure-preserving map θ on Ω, the skew product is Φ(ω,x)=(θω,φ(1,ω,x)); its iterates are Φⁿ(ω,x)=(θⁿω,φ(n,ω,x)). A probability on Ω×X invariant under Φ and having environmental marginal Q is an invariant joint law; in standard Borel spaces it is equivalently Q(dω)π_ω(dx) for an invariant random probability kernel.

concept.title: Structured population update in a stationary random environment
concept.description: Let (Ω,θ,Q) be an ergodic compact metric environmental system with θ a homeomorphism, and K⊂∏ᵢℝ_+^(dᵢ) compact. A structured population map updates xᵢ to Aᵢ(ω,x)xᵢ by continuous nonnegative square matrices, with the resulting map preserving K. Each Aᵢ has the fixed zero pattern of a primitive matrix, independent of (ω,x). The full skew product is Φ(ω,x)=(θω,(Aᵢ(ω,x)xᵢ)ᵢ); extinction is K₀={x∈K:some xᵢ=0}. Environmental coordinates may encode a full correlated path.

concept.title: Poincaré recurrence for a probability-preserving map
concept.description: If T preserves a probability measure μ and A is measurable, then μ-almost every point of A returns to A infinitely often.

concept.title: Ergodic decomposition for a continuous map of a compact metric space
concept.description: For a continuous self-map T of a compact metric space, every invariant Borel probability μ is a mixture of ergodic invariant Borel probabilities: μ=∫ν dη(ν), with ∫f dμ=∫(∫f dν)dη(ν) for every bounded Borel f. The component law is unique modulo the usual almost-everywhere convention.

concept.title: Weighted invasion criterion for structured-population persistence
concept.description: For a structured stochastic population map over an ergodic compact metric environmental system (Ω,θ,Q) with θ a homeomorphism, assume a compact forward-invariant population set K and continuous Aᵢ(ω,x) with fixed primitive zero patterns. Put K₀={x:some xᵢ=0}, Φ(ω,x)=(θω,(Aᵢ(ω,x)xᵢ)ᵢ), and rᵢ(μ)=∫limsup_n n⁻¹log‖Aᵢ^(n)(ω,x)‖dμ for Φ-invariant laws with marginal Q. If some pᵢ>0 give ∑ᵢpᵢrᵢ(μ)>0 at every such ergodic law supported on Ω×K₀, empirical stochastic persistence holds from every x∈K∖K₀ for Q-almost every environmental path.

concept.title: Growth criterion for one structured population
concept.description: Consider one structured stochastic population on a compact forward-invariant K containing0, over an ergodic compact metric environmental homeomorphism, with continuous nonnegative matrices of a fixed primitive zero pattern. Let r be the common top exponent of A(ω,0). If r>0, the population is stochastically persistent. If r<0 and A(ω,x)≤A(ω,0) entrywise for all ω,x, every positive population trajectory tends to0 for almost every environmental path.

concept.title: Minimal polynomial criterion for an algebraic integer
concept.description: An algebraic number is integral overZ if and only if its monic minimal polynomial overQ has integer coefficients. In degree two this is equivalent to its field trace and norm being integers.

concept.title: Integral basis of a quadratic number field
concept.description: Letd≠1 be a nonzero squarefree integer andF=Q(√d). ThenO_F=Z[√d] ifd≡2 or3 mod4, andO_F=Z[(1+√d)/2] ifd≡1 mod4. The squarefree assumption on the chosen radicand is essential; the same formulas with an arbitrary merely nonsquarem are not valid.

concept.title: Denominator ideal of an element of a number field
concept.description: Forα in a number field K, the denominator ideal isD_α={a∈O_K:aα∈O_K}. It is a nonzero integral ideal ofO_K and is the largest integral ideal whose product withα lies inO_K. This definition uses the full ring of integers rather than a chosen possibly nonmaximal order.

concept.title: Real periods and components of a real elliptic curve
concept.description: For E/R and a nonzero real invariant differentialω, its complex period lattice has a unique primitive positive real periodω₁ and a basisω₁,ω₂ withImω₂>0 andReω₂ either0 orω₁/2. In the first caseE(R) has two connected components and all ofE[2] is real; in the second it is connected and only one nonzero2-torsion point is real.

concept.title: Finiteness of a nonconstant morphism of smooth projective curves
concept.description: A nonconstant morphism between smooth projective geometrically integral curves over a field is finite and surjective.

concept.title: Gradient approximation for a finite differentiable convex conjugate
concept.description: Let Λ:ℝᵈ→ℝ be convex and differentiable and I=Λ*. Every x with I(x)<∞ has a sequence x_j∈∇Λ(ℝᵈ) with x_j→x and I(x_j)→I(x); for x_j=∇Λ(λ_j), I(x_j)=⟨λ_j,x_j⟩−Λ(λ_j), and x_j uniquely minimizes I(z)−⟨λ_j,z⟩.

concept.title: Gärtner–Ellis theorem with finite differentiable limiting cumulant
concept.description: Let μ_ε be probability laws on ℝᵈ such that Λ(λ)=lim_(ε↓0)εlog∫exp(⟨λ,z⟩/ε)dμ_ε(z) exists and is finite for every λ∈ℝᵈ. If Λ is differentiable on all ℝᵈ, then μ_ε satisfies a large-deviation principle at speed1/ε with good convex rate Λ*(z)=sup_λ(⟨λ,z⟩−Λ(λ)); good means each finite sublevel set is compact.

concept.title: Large deviations of a scaled independent Poisson vector
concept.description: Fix a∈ℝ_+ᵈ and let Y_ε=ε(N₁,…,N_d), with independent Nᵢ∼Poisson(aᵢ/ε). Then Y_ε satisfies a large-deviation principle at speed1/ε with good rate I_a(y)=∑ᵢ[yᵢlog(yᵢ/aᵢ)−yᵢ+aᵢ] for y∈ℝ_+ᵈ and +∞ otherwise. The conventions are 0log(0/a)=0, a=0<y gives +∞, and the a=y=0 summand is0.

concept.title: Inner twists and the Tate centralizer of a non-CM newform
concept.description: For a non-CM weight-two newform f with coefficient field F and a number field L, letΓ_L be the coefficient-field automorphismsσ with an inner-twist characterχ_σ trivial onG_L. Then dim_(Qℓ)End_(G_L)(V_ℓ(A_f))=[F:Q]·|Γ_L|.

concept.title: Complex conjugation of newform coefficients
concept.description: For a normalized newform f=∑a_nqⁿ of weight k with nebentypus ε, at every prime p not dividing the level one has ā_p=ε(p)⁻¹a_p. For a weight-two newform without complex multiplication this says that complex conjugation on the coefficient field is an inner twist with character ε⁻¹.

concept.title: Faithfulness of the rational Tate module on abelian homomorphisms
concept.description: For abelian varieties A,B over a characteristic-zero field k and a primeℓ, the natural map Hom_k(A,B)⊗Q_ℓ→Hom_(G_k)(V_ℓA,V_ℓB) is injective.

concept.title: Strong multiplicity one for classical newforms
concept.description: Two normalized primitive cuspidal newforms whose Hecke eigenvalues agree at all but finitely many primes are equal, with equal weight, level and nebentypus.

concept.title: Inner twist and nebentypus of a quadratic Q-curve newform
concept.description: Let E/K be a geometrically non-CM completely defined quadraticQ-curve with conjugate isogenyµ andνµµ=[m], where m is nonsquare, and let f be the associated newform with coefficient fieldF=Q(√m). Its nontrivial coefficient conjugationσ satisfiesσ(a_p)=χ_K(p)a_p atp outside the level, whereχ_K is the primitive quadratic character ofK. The nebentypus of f is trivial when m>0 and isχ_K, viewed modulo the level, when m<0.

concept.title: The Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for the elliptic curve 121c2
concept.description: For the elliptic curve E/ℚ given by y²+xy=x³+x²−3632x+82757, labeled 121c2 in Cremona’s tables, Sha(E/ℚ)[11]=0 and the full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer rank and leading-term assertions hold.

concept.title: Integral weight-two modular symbols
concept.description: For a congruence subgroupΓ⊂SL₂(Z), the groupM₂(Γ) of weight-two modular symbols is generated overZ by{a,b} witha,b∈P¹(Q), modulo{a,b}+{b,c}+{c,a}=0, the relations{γa,γb}={a,b} forγ∈Γ, and torsion. The notation records oriented paths between cusps; closed-symbol combinations give integral cycles on the compact modular curve.

concept.title: Integration pairing for weight-two modular symbols
concept.description: For f∈S₂(Γ₁(N)), the assignment{a,b}↦∫_a^b f(z)dz defines a well-defined complex-linear integration pairing withM₂(Γ₁(N))⊗C. The integrals at cusps converge, depend only on the modular-symbol class, and are additive in both the cusp form and the symbol.

concept.title: Compact-uniform one-step large-deviation lower bound
concept.description: For kernels P_ε on a metric space and a finite action ρ(x,y) on an open set of starting states, the one-step lower LDP bound is compact-uniform if, for every compact K in that open set and every nonempty open ball B, liminf_(ε↓0)inf_(x∈K)[εlog P_ε(x,B)+inf_(y∈B)ρ(x,y)]≥0, with log0=−∞.

concept.title: Transitive compact invariant set
concept.description: A compact invariant set K of a continuous map F is transitive in the dense-orbit sense if some x∈K has {Fⁿ(x):n≥0} dense in K.

concept.title: Localization of chain recurrence by a Morse decomposition
concept.description: For a continuous self-map of a compact metric space with a finite Morse decomposition, every chain-recurrent point belongs to the union of the Morse sets; a δ-chain is a finite sequence with d(x_(j+1),F(x_j))<δ, and chain recurrence means having a nontrivial δ-chain from the point to itself for every δ>0.

concept.title: Morse-attractor concentration of small-noise quasi-stationary laws
concept.description: Let F:S→S be continuous with bounded image on closed Euclidean S, with closed absorbing S₀ and invariant S₊=S∖S₀. Let QSDs μ_ε have kernels P_ε and survivals λ_ε. Suppose a finite continuous action ρ on S₊×S vanishes exactly at y=F(x), is uniformly positive off each fixed tracking tube, and satisfies compact-uniform lower LDP bounds. Require β_δ(ε)=sup_xP_ε(x,{y:d(y,F(x))≥δ})≤e^(−c_δ/ε) eventually, and, for every c>0, some neighborhood V of S₀ satisfies inf_(x∈V∩S₊)P_ε(x,S₀)≥e^(−c/ε) eventually. If a finite Morse decomposition separates S₀ from S₊, its non-attractor Morse sets in S₊ are transitive, and μ_ε charges every neighborhood of some positive attractor, every weak QSD limit is F-invariant and supported on the positive Morse attractors; λ_ε≥1−e^(−c/ε) eventually for some c>0.

concept.title: QSD concentration under global attraction to an absorbing boundary
concept.description: Let F:S→S be continuous with bounded image on closed Euclidean S, preserving both closed S₀ and S₊=S∖S₀. Let P_ε be small random perturbations absorbed in S₀, with QSDs μ_ε. If dist(Fⁿ(x),S₀)→0 for every x∈S, every weak limit of μ_ε as ε↓0 is supported on S₀. No assumption λ_ε→1 or strict trapping neighborhood of the whole boundary is required.

concept.title: Integer sublevel bound for a univariate polynomial
concept.description: For a polynomialP∈Q[x] of degree d≥1 with leading coefficienta≠0, andM≥1, #{x∈Z:|P(x)|≤M}≤d(2(M/|a|)^(1/d)+1). In particular it isO_(a,d)(M^(1/d)), uniformly in all the other coefficients.

concept.title: Prime-power root count with fixed leading coefficient
concept.description: ForP∈Z[x] of degree d≥1 and leading coefficienta≠0, every primep and integerf≥0 satisfy #{x modp^f:P(x)≡0modp^f}≤d·p^(f−f/d+v_p(a)/d)≤d|a|^(1/d)p^(f−f/d). Thus the constant depends only on a,d, uniformly in p,f and the other coefficients.

concept.title: Ideal class group of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K, its ideal class group Cl(K) is the group of nonzero fractional ideals of O_K modulo principal fractional ideals (a), a∈K×. Its cardinality h_K is called the class number.

concept.title: S-ideal class group of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K and a finite set S of places containing all infinite places, Cl_S(K) is Cl(K) modulo the subgroup generated by the classes of its finite prime ideals in S. Equivalently it is the ideal class group of the ring of S-integers.

concept.title: Maximal extension unramified outside a finite set of places
concept.description: Fix a separable closure of a number field K and a finite set S of places containing the infinite places. The field K_S is the compositum in that closure of all finite extensions of K unramified at each finite place outside S. It is Galois over K, and G_(K,S)=Gal(K_S/K) has its profinite topology.

concept.title: Galois cohomology unramified outside a finite set
concept.description: For K_S/K as above and a discrete continuous G_(K,S)-module M, write Hⁱ_S(K,M)=Hⁱ(G_(K,S),M). The coefficient action factors through this quotient; for H¹ this describes global classes unramified outside S when M itself is unramified there.

concept.title: Mod-p cyclotomic character module
concept.description: Let p be prime and ω:G_ℚ→𝔽_p× the mod-p cyclotomic character. For an integer k, 𝔽_p(k) is the one-dimensional 𝔽_p-vector space with σ acting by ω(σ)^k. The same notation denotes its restriction to a subgroup or its induced action through Gal(ℚ(μ_p)/ℚ); exponents are taken modulo p−1.

concept.title: Multiplicative Kummer isomorphism in Galois cohomology
concept.description: For a number field K and an integer n≥1, the connecting map gives K×/(K×)^n≅H¹(G_K,μ_n), where μ_n is the group of nth roots of unity in a separable closure. The class of a maps to the cocycle σ↦σ(α)/α for any α with α^n=a.

concept.title: Prime-to-residue-characteristic Kummer ramification criterion
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with normalized valuation v and let n≥1 be prime to its residue characteristic. For a∈K× and α^n=a, K(α)/K is unramified if and only if n divides v(a).

concept.title: S-unit Kummer exact sequence
concept.description: Let K be a number field, p an odd prime, and S a finite set of places containing the infinite places and every place above p. There is an exact sequence 0→O_(K,S)×/(O_(K,S)×)^p→H¹_S(K,μ_p)→Cl_S(K)[p]→0. Under Kummer theory the middle term consists of a∈K×/(K×)^p with v_q(a) divisible by p for every q outside S; the last map sends a to the class of the S-ideal with valuations v_q(a)/p.

concept.title: Minkowski bound for representatives of ideal classes
concept.description: For a number field K of degree n and signature (r₁,r₂), each ideal class contains a nonzero integral ideal a with N(a)≤(4/π)^(r₂)(n!/n^n)√N(d_(K/ℚ)), where d_(K/ℚ) is the relative discriminant ideal.

concept.title: Permanence of a discrete population map
concept.description: A continuous map of the nonnegative orthant is permanent if it has a compact forward-invariant absorbing set contained in the strictly positive orthant: every strictly positive initial state eventually enters that set. In particular all species eventually have one common positive lower bound independent of the initial state.

concept.title: Compact return criterion for an absorbing set
concept.description: Let T be a continuous self-map of a compact metric space X, V an open forward-invariant subset, and U an open set with closure U⊂V. If every forward orbit starting in V meets U, then the closure of ⋃_(n≥0)Tⁿ(closure U) is a compact subset of V absorbing every orbit in V.

concept.title: Weighted boundary-equilibrium criterion for Lotka–Volterra permanence
concept.description: For Fᵢ(x)=xᵢexp(bᵢ+∑ⱼAᵢⱼxⱼ), suppose there is a compact forward-invariant set absorbing all nonnegative states. If some pᵢ>0 satisfy ∑ᵢpᵢ(bᵢ+∑ⱼAᵢⱼxⱼ*)>0 at every boundary fixed point x*, then F is permanent.

concept.title: Alternative for strict positive linear feasibility
concept.description: For a real matrix A and real column b, exactly one holds: Ax=b for some column x with every coordinate strictly positive; or there is a real column p with Aᵀp≥0, pᵀb≤0, and at least one strict inequality among these scalar inequalities.

concept.title: Boundary attraction without a positive Lotka–Volterra equilibrium
concept.description: Let Fᵢ(x)=xᵢexp(bᵢ+∑ⱼAᵢⱼxⱼ) on the nonnegative orthant, with every positive forward orbit bounded. If Ax=−b has no strictly positive solution, then dist(Fⁿ(x),∂ℝ_+ᵈ)→0 for every strictly positive x.

concept.title: Invasion rates from stationary Lotka–Volterra means
concept.description: For a stationary ergodic compactly bounded solution of Xᵢ,t+1=Xᵢ,t exp(bᵢ+∑ⱼAᵢⱼXⱼ,t+Eᵢ,t), assume Eᵢ,t is integrable and let I be exactly its resident species. Put βᵢ=bᵢ+E[Eᵢ,t]. If A_(I,I)x̂_I=−β_I has a unique solution, with x̂ᵢ=0 off I, then the invasion growth rates are rᵢ=0 on I and rᵢ=∑_(j∈I)Aᵢⱼx̂ⱼ+βᵢ off I.

concept.title: Persistence from a symmetric iid storage effect
concept.description: Let Xᵢ,t+1=Xᵢ,t[Eᵢ,t+1 f(E₁,t+1X₁,t+E₂,t+1X₂,t)+s], i=1,2, with0<s<1, f positive C¹, f′<0 and f(x)→0. Let the environmental pairs be iid, exchangeable, in[e_min,M]² with e_min>0, and P(E₁≠E₂)>0. If Elog(Eᵢf(0)+s)>0, the two-species system is stochastically persistent.

concept.title: Representation number of a positive quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a positive definite quadratic ℤ-lattice L and an integer n, r_L(n)=|{x∈L:Q(x)=n}| counts its integral representing vectors. This count includes imprimitive vectors and is finite by positive definiteness.

concept.title: Weighted spinor-genus representation average
concept.description: For a positive definite quadratic ℤ-lattice L, choose representatives M of the finitely many isometry classes in its proper spinor genus. Its weighted representation average is r_spn(L)(n)=(∑_M r_M(n)/|Aut(M)|)/(∑_M 1/|Aut(M)|), where Aut(M) consists of integral isometries preserving M.

concept.title: Ternary spinor-genus representation error bound
