concept.description: For a positive definite integral ternary quadratic lattice L and every ε>0, r_L(n)=r_spn(L)(n)+O_(L,ε)(n^(1/2−1/28+ε)) as positive integers n tend to infinity, with no congruence conditions on representing vectors.

concept.title: Lower bound for a primitive ternary spinor-genus average
concept.description: For a positive definite integral ternary quadratic lattice L and every ε>0, r_spn(L)(n)≥c_(L,ε)n^(1/2−ε) for sufficiently large positive integers n primitively represented by some lattice in the spinor genus of L, with c_(L,ε)>0. The constant is not claimed effective.

concept.title: Duke–Schulze-Pillot ternary spinor-genus representation theorem
concept.description: For a positive definite integral ternary quadratic ℤ-lattice L, every sufficiently large positive integer n that is primitively represented by some lattice in its proper spinor genus is represented by L itself. The conclusion asserts integral representation and does not require that L’s representing vector be primitive.

concept.title: Adjugate identity and matrix inverse
concept.description: For a square matrix A over a commutative ring, its adjugate is the transpose of its cofactor matrix and satisfies A adj(A)=adj(A)A=(det A)I. Over a field, det A≠0 therefore gives A⁻¹=adj(A)/det A.

concept.title: Nonstationary phase with a smooth compact amplitude
concept.description: Let w∈C_c^∞(Rⁿ) and let real smooth phases φ_Λ on a neighborhood of its support satisfy |∇φ_Λ|≥cΛ and |∂^αφ_Λ|≤C_αΛ for all |α|≥1, with fixed positive c and fixed constants C_α. For Λ≥1 and every M≥1, ∫w(x)exp(iφ_Λ(x))dx=O_M(Λ^(−M)).

concept.title: Van der Corput second derivative integral test
concept.description: If f is real C² on a bounded interval [a,b] and |f″(x)|≥Λ>0 throughout it, then |∫_a^b exp(if(x))dx|≤CΛ^(−1/2) for an absolute constant C. No monotonicity of f′ is an additional hypothesis.

concept.title: Quadratic oscillatory integral bounds
concept.description: Let A be a real symmetric n×n matrix with eigenvalues ρ_j, w∈C_c^∞(Rⁿ) supported in [−1,1]ⁿ, and I(A,λ)=∫exp(2πi(xᵀAx−λ·x))w(x)dx. Uniformly in A and λ, |I(A,λ)|≤C_w∏_j min(1,|ρ_j|^(−1/2)), with a zero-eigenvalue factor interpreted as one. If |λ|≥max(1,4√n‖A‖op), then |I(A,λ)|≤C_(M,w)|λ|^(−M) for every M≥1.

concept.title: Unimodular integer matrix
concept.description: A square matrix with integer entries is unimodular if its determinant is 1 or −1; equivalently it has an inverse with integer entries.

concept.title: Smith diagonalization of an integer matrix
concept.description: For every m×n integer matrix A there are unimodular integer matrices U,V such that UAV is rectangular diagonal, with positive nonzero entries d₁,…,d_r satisfying d₁|d₂|⋯|d_r, followed by zeros. The number r is the rank of A over Q.

concept.title: Prime-power solution bound for integer linear congruences
concept.description: Let A be an m×n integer matrix of rank r≥1 over Q, b∈Z^m, p a prime and e≥1. If δ is the least p-adic valuation among the nonzero r×r minors of A, then #{x mod p^e:Ax≡b mod p^e}≤p^min(ne,(n−r)e+δ).

concept.title: Thompson metric on the strictly positive orthant
concept.description: For x,y∈(0,∞)ᵈ, the Thompson part metric is d_T(x,y)=max_i|log(x_i/y_i)|, equivalently inf{log a:a≥1,a⁻¹y≤x≤ay} with coordinatewise inequalities.

concept.title: Nonuniform strong unstable manifold for random smooth maps
concept.description: Let an invertible ergodic base drive C² maps fixing0, with tempered local C² bounds. Suppose the derivative cocycle has an Oseledets splitting with tempered projections, a simple top exponent λ₁>max(0,λ₂), and tempered inverses on its top line. For max(0,λ₂)<a<λ₁ there is a measurable local strong unstable curve tangent to the top line; its points have unique local backward orbits bounded by C(ω)e^(−an), within the tempered local neighborhoods.

concept.title: Positive stationary statistics for spatial Beverton–Holt dynamics
concept.description: Let D be a fixed primitive nonnegative d×d matrix with Dᵀ stochastic (so D is column-stochastic), c_j>0, and E_t a stationary ergodic sequence in[a,b]ᵈ with0<a≤b<∞. For X_i,t+1=∑_jD_ijE_j,t+1X_j,t/(1+c_jX_j,t), let r be the top exponent of D diag(E_t). If r>0, on the full two-sided environmental path space there is a unique strictly positive random equilibrium X*, and every nonzero nonnegative deterministic initial state has laws converging weakly to m=law(X*) and empirical state measures converging weakly to m almost surely.

concept.title: Lyapunov continuity at uniformly supported nonnegative cocycles
concept.description: Let an ergodic homeomorphism of compact metric Ω preserve Q. Let A:Ω→M_d(ℝ) be continuous and nonnegative, with a fixed zero pattern and no zero rows. Then the top exponent γ(B) of continuous nonnegative cocycles is continuous at A in uniform matrix norm, even when A is reducible. In particular, this applies at a positive diagonal cocycle and to primitive cocycles with fixed positive entry pattern.

concept.title: Nakayama determinant trick
concept.description: If M is a finitely generated module over a commutative ring R and I is an ideal with IM=M, then some a∈I satisfies (1−a)M=0. In particular M=0 when I is contained in the Jacobson radical of R.

concept.title: Finite irreducible decomposition of an affine algebraic set
concept.description: Every algebraic subset of finite-dimensional affine space over a field has finitely many irreducible components; its closed-set topology is Noetherian.

concept.title: Projective elimination and closed projection
concept.description: Let k be algebraically closed. For finitely many polynomials f_i(t₁,…,t_m;x₀,…,x_N) homogeneous in x, the set of parameters t for which the f_i(t;x) have a common nonzero x is Zariski closed in A^m_k. Equivalently the projection A^m_k×P^N_k→A^m_k takes closed algebraic subsets to closed subsets.

concept.title: Toric dual discriminant character formula
concept.description: For a smooth projective toric embedding X_A over an algebraically closed field, with lattice polytope Q and dual hypersurface equation Δ_A, let µ be the generic degree of its conormal projection. The torus character of Δ_A is (1/µ)Σ_(facesΓ⊆Q)(−1)^codimΓ(dimΓ+1)∫_Γu dµ_Γ(u), where each face measure assigns volume one to a lattice unit simplex. In characteristic zero µ=1.

concept.title: Generic singular complete intersection has one ordinary double point
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two, for1≤c≤N and homogeneous degrees d_i≥2, a general tuple in the discriminant locus of c equations in P^N cuts out a codimension-c intersection with exactly one singular point, an ordinary double point; its gradients have exactly one relation there.

concept.title: Discriminant of equal-degree complete intersections
concept.description: For1≤c≤N and d≥2, there is a primitive integer polynomial Δ in the coefficients of c degree-d forms in N+1 variables, unique up to sign, whose specialization over every field of characteristic different from two is absolutely irreducible and vanishes exactly when the forms fail to cut out a smooth codimension-c projective intersection geometrically. Its degree in each form’s coefficients is binom(N+1,c)d^(c−1)(d−1)^(N−c+1), hence its total degree is c times this number.

concept.title: Degree formula for factorization of a number-field prime
concept.description: If L/K is a finite extension of number fields and pO_L=∏_i P_i^(e_i) for a nonzero prime ideal p⊂O_K, put f_i=[O_L/P_i:O_K/p]. Then ∑_i e_i f_i=[L:K].

concept.title: Discriminant index formula for number-field orders
concept.description: For a number field K and a subring A⊂O_K containing1 and of finite index, the trace discriminants satisfy disc(A/ℤ)=[O_K:A]² d_K, where d_K is the integral-basis field discriminant. The discriminant of A is computed using any ℤ-basis of A.

concept.title: Ramification criterion from the relative discriminant
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields, a nonzero prime ideal p of O_K divides the relative discriminant d_(L/K) if and only if at least one prime of L above p has ramification index greater than1.

concept.title: Integers and ramification in a prime-power cyclotomic field
concept.description: Let p be prime, r≥1 and ζ a primitive p^rth root of unity. For K=ℚ(ζ), [K:ℚ]=p^(r−1)(p−1), O_K=ℤ[ζ], and λ=1−ζ generates the unique prime above p, with (p)=(λ)^(p^(r−1)(p−1)) and O_K/(λ)≅𝔽_p. Every prime other than p is unramified in K.

concept.title: Kummer’s Bernoulli criterion for a regular prime
concept.description: For an odd prime p, p does not divide the class number of ℚ(ζ_p) if and only if p divides none of the numerators of B₂,B₄,…,B_(p−3), written in lowest terms. Such a prime is called regular.

concept.title: Cyclotomic unramified Kummer cohomology at a regular prime
concept.description: Let p be odd, K=ℚ(ζ_p), Γ=Gal(K/ℚ), and S the infinite places and the unique prime above p. If p∤h_K, then, for the natural Γ-action, H¹_S(K,μ_p)≅𝔽_p(1)⊕⊕_(i=0)^((p−3)/2)𝔽_p(2i), where Γ acts on 𝔽_p(k) by its cyclotomic character to the kth power.

concept.title: Periodic orbit of a discrete map
concept.description: A point x of a self-map F is periodic of least period p≥1 if Fᵖ(x)=x and Fʲ(x)≠x for1≤j<p; its periodic orbit is {x,F(x),…,F^(p−1)(x)}.

concept.title: Hyperbolic attracting periodic orbit of an interval map
concept.description: For a C¹ interval map F, a periodic orbit of least period p is hyperbolic attracting if |(Fᵖ)′(x)|<1 at one, equivalently every, point x of that orbit.

concept.title: Uniformly expanding invariant set of an interval map
concept.description: For a C¹ interval map F, a compact invariant set K is uniformly expanding if some C>0 and λ>1 satisfy |(Fⁿ)′(x)|≥Cλⁿ for every x∈K and n≥1.

concept.title: Density of hyperbolicity in a regular analytic unimodal family
concept.description: Let f_λ be a nontrivial real-analytic family of analytic interval maps with one nondegenerate turning critical point. Assume regularity: the critical omega-limit contains no neutral periodic orbit unless it equals that orbit. Nontrivial means some two members have different ordered critical-orbit itineraries. Then parameters whose maps have finitely many hyperbolic periodic attractors and uniformly expanding complement of their basins are dense in the parameter domain.

concept.title: Singer’s attracting-cycle theorem for negative Schwarzian maps
concept.description: For a C³ interval map with negative Schwarzian derivative wherever its derivative is nonzero, the immediate basin of each attracting periodic orbit contains a critical point or an endpoint of the interval.

concept.title: Finite Morse decomposition of a hyperbolic interval map
concept.description: For a C³ interval map with finitely many nonflat critical points whose nonwandering dynamics is hyperbolic, the attracting periodic orbits and the transitive expanding basic components of the remaining nonwandering set form a finite Morse decomposition.

concept.title: Openness of hyperbolicity for interval maps
concept.description: If a smooth interval map has finitely many hyperbolic periodic attractors and a uniformly expanding complement of their basins, every sufficiently close smooth map in the C1 topology has the same hyperbolicity property.

concept.title: Open dense Ricker parameters with a hyperbolic Morse decomposition
concept.description: For an open dense set of r>0, F_r(x)=x exp(r(1−x)) has a unique hyperbolic attracting periodic orbit in(0,∞), and on its compact global invariant set it admits a finite Morse decomposition consisting of that orbit, {0}, and transitive uniformly expanding invariant sets in(0,∞).

concept.title: Grothendieck–Lefschetz finite-field trace formula
concept.description: For a separated finite-type scheme X over F_q and a prime ℓ∤q, #X(F_(q^a))=Σ_i(−1)^i Tr(Frob_q^a|H_c^i(X_overlineFq,Q_ℓ)) for every a≥1, where Frob_q is geometric Frobenius and the finite-dimensional compactly supported cohomology vanishes outside0≤i≤2dimX.

concept.title: Deligne weight bound for compactly supported cohomology
concept.description: For a separated finite-type scheme X over F_q and ℓ∤q, every geometric-Frobenius eigenvalue α on H_c^i(X_overlineFq,Q_ℓ) is algebraic and all its complex conjugates have absolute value at most q^(i/2).

concept.title: Cohomology outside the singular band of a complete intersection
concept.description: Let X⊂Pᴺ over F_q be a geometrically integral projective complete intersection of dimension n≥1 whose geometric singular locus has dimension s (s=−1 if X is smooth), and let ℓ∤q. For 0≤i<n and for n+s+1<i≤2n, H^i(X_F̄q,Q_ℓ) is 0 for odd i and is isomorphic, compatibly with the Galois action, to the Tate twist Q_ℓ(−i/2) for even i; for i<n this isomorphism is restriction from Pᴺ.

concept.title: Katz uniform bound on projective Betti numbers
concept.description: If X⊂P^N over an algebraically closed field is defined scheme-theoretically by m homogeneous equations of degrees at most D≥1, then for ℓ different from the characteristic, Σ_i dimH^i(X,Q_ℓ)≤8·2^m(mD+3)^(N+1). In particular these dimensions are uniformly bounded by the ambient dimension, number and degrees of equations.

concept.title: Geometric integrality of a complete intersection regular in codimension one
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, a projective complete intersection X of dimension n≥1 whose singular locus has dimension at most n−2, so that X is regular in codimension one, is integral.

concept.title: Primary decomposition in a Noetherian ring
concept.description: Every proper ideal in a commutative Noetherian ring is a finite intersection of primary ideals. An ideal Q is primary if ab∈Q and a∉Q imply b^m∈Q for some m≥1; its radical is prime. The radicals in a minimal primary decomposition are the associated primes of the quotient.

concept.title: Local cohomology with support
concept.description: For an ideal I in a Noetherian ring R, H_I^i(M) is the ith right derived functor of Γ_I(M)={m∈M:I^a m=0 for some a}. Short exact sequences of modules induce the natural long exact sequence of these groups; H_I^i(M)=0 below the I-depth of M.

concept.title: Bézout degree of a projective complete intersection
concept.description: A projective complete intersection cut out scheme-theoretically by a regular sequence of homogeneous degrees d₁,…,d_c has degree d₁⋯d_c, with its components counted with scheme multiplicities. In dimensionzero this is the scheme’s length over an algebraically closed ground field.

concept.title: Macaulay regularity of a zero-dimensional complete intersection
concept.description: If T⊂P^n over a field is a zero-dimensional complete intersection of n hypersurfaces of degrees d₁,…,d_n, then H⁰(P^n,O(k))→H⁰(T,O_T(k)) is surjective for every k≥Σ_i(d_i−1).

concept.title: Refined Gysin intersection product
concept.description: For a regular closed embedding i:Y→X of codimension c and a morphism X′→X, the refined Gysin map i^!:A_*(X′)→A_(*−c)(Y×_X X′) on Chow groups is defined by deformation to the normal cone followed by the zero-section pullback in the pulled-back normal bundle. It retains excess-intersection contributions even when the fiber product has larger than the expected dimension.

concept.title: Kollár effective Nullstellensatz degree bound
concept.description: Let n≥2,D≥3 and K be a field. If homogeneous forms f_i of common degree D in K[x₀,…,x_n] generate I, then (√I)^(D^n)⊆I. Consequently, if affine polynomials g_i in n variables have degrees at most D and h vanishes on their common zeros over an algebraic closure, then h^s=Σ_i a_i g_i for some1≤s≤D^n and a_i∈K[x₁,…,x_n].

concept.title: Jentzsch theorem for a strictly positive compact countable kernel
concept.description: Let q(x,y)>0 on a nonempty countable set, with its row action defining a compact positive operator Q on ℓ¹. Then r(Q)>0 is an eigenvalue with a strictly positive ℓ¹ eigenvector; that eigenvector is unique up to scaling among nonnegative eigenvectors, and no other eigenvalue has modulus r(Q).

concept.title: Equisummability criterion for relative compactness in ℓ¹
concept.description: A bounded family B⊂ℓ¹(X) on a countable set is relatively compact exactly when for every η>0 there is a finite K⊂X with sup_(u∈B)∑_(x∉K)|u(x)|<η.

concept.title: Existence of a QSD for a bounded nonlinear Poisson population
concept.description: Let X_(t+1)=ε(N₁,…,N_d) conditionally on X_t=x, with independent Nᵢ∼Poisson(Fᵢ(x)/ε). Suppose F is continuous and bounded, Fᵢ(x)>0 for strictly positive x, and the boundary of the nonnegative orthant is absorbing. For each ε>0 this chain has a quasi-stationary distribution supported on ε{1,2,…}ᵈ, with survival eigenvalue0<λ_ε<1.

concept.title: Uniform deviation bounds for bounded nonlinear Poisson kernels
concept.description: Let F:ℝ_+ᵈ→ℝ_+ᵈ be continuous and bounded, preserving the boundary and its complement, and let P_ε be its independent-coordinate scaled Poisson kernel. The action ρ(x,y)=∑ᵢ[yᵢlog(yᵢ/Fᵢ(x))−yᵢ+Fᵢ(x)] has compact-uniform one-step lower LDP bounds for positive starting states. For every δ>0 some c_δ>0 gives sup_xP_ε(x,{y:‖y−F(x)‖∞≥δ})≤2d e^(−c_δ/ε). For every c>0 an open boundary neighborhood V has inf_(x∈V)P_ε(x,∂ℝ_+ᵈ)≥e^(−c/ε).

concept.title: Dominant scheme morphism
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→Y is dominant if its image is dense in the underlying topological space of Y. For a morphism between integral affine schemes SpecB→SpecA, dominance is equivalent to injectivity of the ring map A→B.

concept.title: Dimension of a finite-type scheme
concept.description: The dimension of a scheme is the supremum of the lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets of its underlying space. On an affine chart SpecA it equals the Krull dimension of A; for a finite-type scheme over a field it is the maximum of these dimensions over any finite affine open cover.

concept.title: Fiber of a scheme morphism
concept.description: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y and a point y∈Y with residue field κ(y), its fiber over y is X_y=X×_Y Specκ(y), regarded as a κ(y)-scheme. For finite-type varieties over an algebraically closed field at closed points this recovers the subvariety obtained by specializing the target coordinates.

concept.title: Dimension and transcendence degree of an affine domain
concept.description: If A is a finitely generated integral algebra over a field k, then dimA equals trdeg_k FracA, the cardinality of a maximal algebraically independent subset of its fraction field over k. For a tower of finitely generated field extensions K⊂L⊂M, trdeg_KM=trdeg_KL+trdeg_LM.

concept.title: Chevalley constructible image theorem
concept.description: The image of a constructible subset under a finite-type morphism of Noetherian schemes is constructible. In an irreducible Noetherian target a constructible set containing the generic point contains a nonempty open subset; if it omits the generic point its closure is proper.

concept.title: Upper semicontinuity of local fiber dimension
concept.description: For a locally finite-type morphism f:X→Y, the function x↦dim_x(X_(f(x))) is upper semicontinuous on X: for every integer d the set where this local fiber dimension is at most d is open. This concerns points of the source; it does not assert upper semicontinuity of total fiber dimension on an arbitrary target.

concept.title: Linearly disjoint finite field extensions
concept.description: Finite extensions L/K and M/K in a common overfield are linearly disjoint over K when [LM:K]=[L:K][M:K], where LM is their compositum. Equivalently a K-basis of L remains linearly independent over M.

concept.title: Absence of nontrivial everywhere finitely unramified extensions of the rationals
concept.description: If a number field K is unramified at every finite prime of ℚ, then K=ℚ. No condition at the infinite place is needed.

concept.title: Linear disjointness of rational Galois extensions with disjoint ramification
concept.description: Let L/ℚ and M/ℚ be finite Galois extensions in a common algebraic closure. If no finite rational prime ramifies in both extensions, then L∩M=ℚ, L and M are linearly disjoint over ℚ, and restriction identifies Gal(LM/M) with Gal(L/ℚ).

concept.title: Unramified elliptic division fields at good primes
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K, p a prime and r≥1. At a finite place v of residue characteristic different from p where E has good reduction, K(E[p^r])/K is unramified.

concept.title: Kolyvagin bound from a Heegner point and surjective torsion image
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be geometrically non-CM and let K be an imaginary quadratic field distinct from ℚ(i) and ℚ(√−3), satisfying the Heegner hypothesis for E. Let y_K∈E(K) be a nontorsion Heegner point with finite index I_K=[E(K):ℤy_K]. If p≥5 and ρ_(E,p):G_ℚ→GL₂(𝔽_p) is surjective, then Sha(E/K)[p^∞] is finite and v_p(#Sha(E/K)[p^∞])≤2v_p(I_K).

concept.title: Orthogonality of finite abelian characters
concept.description: For a finite abelian group G and its complex character group Ghat, |Ghat|=|G| and Σ_(χ∈Ghat)χ(g)conjugate(χ(h)) equals|G| ifg=h and0 otherwise. Dually Σ_(g∈G)χ(g)conjugate(ψ(g)) equals|G| ifχ=ψ and0 otherwise.

concept.title: Dirichlet L-functions on the line Re(s)=1
concept.description: For a nonprincipal Dirichlet character χ, L(s,χ) is holomorphic and nonzero on Re(s)≥1. For the principal character moduloq, L(s,χ₀)=ζ(s)∏_(p|q)(1−p^(−s)) has a simple pole of residueφ(q)/q at1 and no zeros on Re(s)=1.

concept.title: Newman–Zagier Laplace Tauberian theorem
concept.description: Let f:[0,∞)→R be bounded and locally integrable. If its Laplace transform g(z)=∫₀∞f(t)e^(−zt)dt, initially defined forRe(z)>0, extends holomorphically to an open neighborhood of the closed right half-plane, then the improper integral∫₀∞f(t)dt converges and equalsg(0).

concept.title: Prime number theorem in a fixed arithmetic progression
concept.description: For fixed integers q≥1 and a with gcd(a,q)=1, π(x;q,a)=#{primesp≤x:p≡a modq} satisfies π(x;q,a)∼x/(φ(q)logx) asx→∞. The modulus is fixed; this statement asserts no uniform error bound asq varies.

concept.title: Grassmannian of vector subspaces
concept.description: For0≤r≤n over a field k, Gr(r,n) is the projective algebraic variety parametrizing r-dimensional linear subspaces of k^n. Its standard open charts consist of graphs of linear maps between complementary coordinate subspaces and are affine spaces of r×(n−r) matrices, glued by change of graph coordinates.

concept.title: Codimension of a linear-subspace intersection condition
concept.description: Let A,B be fixed subspaces of a c-dimensional vector space over an algebraically closed field, of dimensions a,b. For max(0,a+b−c)≤p≤min(a,b), the closed locus {g∈GL_c:dim(gA∩B)≥p} has codimension p(c−a−b+p).

concept.title: Smoothness of a transverse intersection
concept.description: If smooth locally closed subvarieties Y,Z of a smooth variety X over a field meet at a geometric point x with T_xY+T_xZ=T_xX, their scheme intersection is smooth at x of dimension dimY+dimZ−dimX.

concept.title: Upper semicontinuity of fiber dimension for proper morphisms
concept.description: For a proper morphism of finite-type schemes f:X→Y over a field and every integer d, the subset {y∈Y:dimX_y≥d} is closed inY. Empty fibers have dimension−1.

concept.title: Bertini smoothness for general linear sections
concept.description: Let Y⊂P^N_k be a smooth locally closed subvariety over an algebraically closed field, and0≤c≤N. A nonempty Zariski open set of codimension-c projective linear subspaces L has Y∩L empty or smooth of pure dimension dimY−c, with the intersection transverse. This holds in every characteristic.

concept.title: Diagonalization of a symmetric bilinear form by congruence
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic different from two, every symmetric matrix A admits an invertible matrix P with PᵀAP diagonal. Over an algebraically closed field, it is congruent to diag(I_r,0), where r=rankA.

concept.title: Geometry of the symmetric determinant hypersurface
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two and for n≥2, the locus of singular symmetric n×n matrices is an irreducible reduced determinant hypersurface in the affine space Sym_n. Its singular locus is exactly the matrices of rank at most n−2, which has codimension three in Sym_n.

concept.title: Proper metric space
concept.description: A metric space is proper if every closed bounded ball is compact.

concept.title: Left-invariant metric on a group
concept.description: A metric d on a group G is left invariant if d(gx,gy)=d(x,y) for all g,x,y∈G. On a topological group it is compatible if its metric topology equals the given topology.

concept.title: Existence and uniqueness of Haar measure on a locally compact group
concept.description: Every locally compact Hausdorff group admits a left Haar measure, a nonzero left-invariant Radon measure (finite on compact sets, outer regular on Borel sets, inner regular on open sets), and any two left Haar measures differ by a positive constant factor.

concept.title: Continuity of left translations in Haar L¹
concept.description: For a left Haar measure on a locally compact group and f∈L¹(G), ‖f(g⁻¹·)−f‖₁→0 as g→e.

concept.title: Struble’s proper left-invariant metrization theorem
concept.description: Every second-countable locally compact Hausdorff group has a compatible proper left-invariant metric.

concept.title: Proper metrization of a discrete–compact double quotient
concept.description: Let G be a second-countable locally compact Hausdorff group, Γ a closed discrete subgroup, and K a compact subgroup. The double quotient Γ∖G/K is second countable and has a compatible proper metric; this applies in particular to Γ∖G for a lattice Γ.

concept.title: Nonemptiness of inverse limits of finite sets
concept.description: For a sequence of nonempty finite sets X_n and maps f_n:X_(n+1)→X_n, there exists a coherent tuple (x_n) with f_n(x_(n+1))=x_n for every n. Equivalently the countable inverse limit is nonempty; the maps need not be surjective.

concept.title: Primitive prime-power root count for a smooth homogeneous equation
concept.description: Fix a homogeneous f∈Z[x₁,…,x_r] of positive degree with r≥2 whose projective hypersurface overQ is smooth. For every primep there is C_(f,p)>0 such that #{x modp^e:p∤(x₁,…,x_r), f(x)≡0 modp^e}≤C_(f,p)p^(e(r−1)) for all e≥1. The constants C_(f,p) can be chosen bounded outside a finite set of primes depending onf.

concept.title: Orthogonality of finite cyclic exponential sums
concept.description: For integers q≥1 and m, Σ_(a modq) exp(2πiam/q) equalsq ifq dividesm and0 otherwise. On (Z/qZ)^k, the product character sum similarly vanishes unless every frequency is divisible byq, in which case it equalsq^k.

concept.title: Quadratic Gauss sum kernel bound
concept.description: For a symmetric integer k×k matrixA and q≥1, define S(A;q)=Σ_(x∈(Z/qZ)^k) exp(2πixᵀAx/q) and K(A;q)={z modq:2Az≡0modq}. Then |S(A;q)|²≤q^k|K(A;q)|.

concept.title: Prime-power mean bound for quadratic Gauss sums in a net
concept.description: Let Q=(Q₁,Q₂,Q₃) be integral-matrix quadratic forms in k≥4 variables whose determinant equation is nonsingular overQ. For q=p^e, put S_q(a)=Σ_(x modq)exp(2πiΣ_ja_jQ_j(x)/q). Then Σ_(a modq,gcd(a₁,a₂,a₃,p)=1)|S_q(a)|≤A_p p^(e(3+k/2)) for some A_p independent ofe. The A_p are bounded outside the finite set of primes dividing2Disc(det(Σ_ja_jQ_j)).

concept.title: Uniform solubility of a smooth quadratic net at large primes
concept.description: For an integral-matrix quadratic net Q in k>6 variables whose determinant equation is nonsingular overQ, there exists p₀(Q) such that for every primep>p₀ and every n∈Z_p³ the system Q(x)=n has a solution x∈Z_p^k.

concept.title: Independence of eigenvectors with distinct eigenvalues
concept.description: For a linear endomorphism over a field, nonzero eigenvectors belonging to pairwise distinct eigenvalues are linearly independent.

concept.title: Diagonalization of a smooth pencil of quadrics
concept.description: Let A,B be symmetric k×k matrices over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two, with k≥3. If their two projective quadratic equations define a smooth codimension-two intersection, then an invertible change of variables makes both matrices diagonal, diag(a_i),diag(b_i), with every pair(a_i,b_i) nonzero and all ratios[a_i:b_i] distinct. Equivalently det(sA+tB) has k distinct projective roots; in particular every nonzero pencil member has rank at least k−1.

concept.title: Elliptic curve over a finite field
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a finite field k is a one-dimensional abelian variety over k, with its identity as distinguished point. Its k-rational points form the finite abelian group E(k).

concept.title: Frobenius characteristic polynomial of a finite-field elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E/𝔽_q be elliptic and ℓ∤q prime. The q-power Frobenius endomorphism, acting by qth powers on coordinates, acts on T_ℓE with characteristic polynomial T²−a_qT+q, where a_q=q+1−#E(𝔽_q).

concept.title: Frobenius traces on elliptic torsion at a good prime
concept.description: Let E/ℚ have good reduction at a rational prime ℓ and write a_ℓ=ℓ+1−#Ẽ(𝔽_ℓ). For any prime p≠ℓ and r≥1, the characteristic polynomial of arithmetic Frobenius at ℓ acting on E[p^r] is T²−a_ℓT+ℓ modulo p^r. The corresponding polynomial on T_pE is T²−a_ℓT+ℓ.

concept.title: Filtration of an elliptic good-reduction kernel
concept.description: For an elliptic curve with good reduction over a nonarchimedean local field K with valuation ring R, maximal ideal 𝔪 and residue field k, the kernel E₁(K) of reduction has the complete separated filtration E_n(K) given in a local parameter at the identity by valuation at least n. Its quotients E_n(K)/E_(n+1)(K) are the additive groups 𝔪^n/𝔪^(n+1), and addition induces their additive law.

concept.title: Prime-to-residue-characteristic divisibility under elliptic good reduction
concept.description: Let K be a characteristic-zero nonarchimedean local field with residue field k of characteristic ℓ, and let E/K have good reduction, and let n≥1 be coprime to ℓ. Multiplication by n is an automorphism of the reduction kernel E₁(K), and reduction induces E(K)[n]≅Ẽ(k)[n] and E(K)/nE(K)≅Ẽ(k)/nẼ(k).

concept.title: Lutz–Nagell integrality of rational elliptic torsion
concept.description: If E/ℚ is given by y²=x³+Ax+B with A,B∈ℤ and 4A³+27B²≠0, then every nonidentity rational torsion point has integral x- and y-coordinates.

concept.title: Dvornicich–Zannier counterexample to local-global divisibility by four
concept.description: There exist an elliptic curve E/ℚ and an infinite-order P∈E(ℚ) which lies in4E(ℚ_v) at every finite place except possibly2, but does not lie in4E(ℚ).

concept.title: Local-global divisibility by a prime on a rational elliptic curve
concept.description: For every elliptic curve E/ℚ and prime p, a rational point P∈E(ℚ) which belongs to pE(ℚ_ℓ) for all but finitely many rational primes ℓ already belongs to pE(ℚ).

concept.title: Abstract simplicial complex
concept.description: An abstract simplicial complex on a vertex set V is a family of finite subsets of V closed under taking subsets and containing every singleton. Members are simplices, their subsets are faces, and a simplex with n+1 vertices has dimension n. An isomorphism is a vertex bijection preserving simplices in both directions.

concept.title: Coxeter system
concept.description: A Coxeter system (W,S) is a group generated by involutions S with only relations (st)^(m_st)=1, where m_ss=1 and m_st=m_ts∈{2,3,…,∞} for s≠t, with∞ imposing no relation. Equivalently any assignment of S to involutions in another group satisfying these relations extends uniquely to a homomorphism from W.

concept.title: Word length in a Coxeter system
concept.description: For a Coxeter system (W,S), ℓ(w) is the minimum length of a word in S representing w; a word of length ℓ(w) is reduced.

concept.title: Reflection in an affine Euclidean hyperplane
concept.description: For a unit vector u and c∈ℝ, reflection in {x:⟨x,u⟩=c} is x↦x−2(⟨x,u⟩−c)u. It is the affine isometry fixing that hyperplane pointwise and reversing its normal direction.

concept.title: Weyl group of a finite root system
concept.description: For a finite crystallographic root system Φ in a real inner-product space, its Weyl group is the group generated by the linear reflections s_α in α⊥ for α∈Φ. It acts on Φ; since Φ spans, this action is faithful and the group is finite.

concept.title: Affine Weyl group of a reduced crystallographic root system
concept.description: For a reduced finite crystallographic root system Φ in E, its affine Weyl group is generated by s_(α,k)(x)=x−(⟨x,α⟩−k)α∨, α∈Φ,k∈ℤ. Here α∨=2α/⟨α,α⟩; equivalently W_aff=Q∨⋊W with coroot lattice Q∨ and finite Weyl group W.

concept.title: Weyl chamber of a finite root system
concept.description: For a finite root system Φ in E, an open Weyl chamber is a connected component of E∖⋃_(α∈Φ)α⊥; its closure is a closed Weyl chamber, a simplicial cone after choosing simple roots. Opposite chambers are negatives of one another.

concept.title: Affine Coxeter complex of a crystallographic root system
concept.description: For an irreducible reduced finite crystallographic root system Φ, the affine Coxeter complex is the Euclidean simplicial tessellation cut out by hyperplanes ⟨x,α⟩=k for α∈Φ,k∈ℤ. Its maximal cells are alcoves, and its walls are the reflecting hyperplanes. The affine Weyl group acts simply transitively on alcoves; labeling one alcove’s vertices by opposite walls and propagating by this action gives its vertex types.

concept.title: Affine building
concept.description: An affine building is a typed simplicial complex equipped with apartments isomorphic to one affine Coxeter complex, such that any two simplices lie in an apartment and any two apartments have a type-preserving simplicial isomorphism fixing their intersection pointwise. Apartment intersections are convex in their Euclidean realizations. It is thick if each codimension-one chamber face lies in at least three chambers, and locally finite if each vertex belongs to finitely many simplices.

concept.title: Apartment of an affine building
concept.description: An apartment is one of the distinguished subcomplexes in an affine building’s apartment system, with its Euclidean affine-Coxeter realization. The maximal apartment system consists of every subcomplex isomorphic to the model apartment in the building-theoretic sense.

concept.title: Chamber of an affine building
concept.description: A chamber of an affine building is a maximal simplex; an alcove of an apartment is a chamber in that apartment.

concept.title: Panel of an affine building
concept.description: A panel is a codimension-one face of a chamber. Two distinct chambers are adjacent if they share a panel; its type is the vertex label omitted by that panel.

concept.title: Gallery in an affine building
concept.description: A gallery is a finite sequence of chambers with consecutive distinct chambers sharing a panel; its length is the number of steps. It is minimal between its endpoints if no shorter gallery connects them. Its type is the sequence of omitted panel labels.

concept.title: Wall of an affine building apartment
concept.description: A wall in an apartment is a reflecting affine hyperplane of its affine Coxeter complex, regarded with its induced subcomplex. Its two closed half-spaces are half-apartments.

concept.title: Sector of an affine building
concept.description: A sector in an apartment is a translate v+C of a closed Weyl chamber C of its finite root system; v is its vertex. Sectors have opposite direction when their chamber cones are C and−C.

concept.title: Special vertex of an affine building
concept.description: A vertex v in an apartment is special if its stabilizer in the affine Weyl group maps onto the full finite Weyl group under the linear-part homomorphism. Equivalently every apartment wall direction has a parallel wall through v; the condition is independent of the chosen apartment.

concept.title: Type-preserving automorphism of an affine building
concept.description: A simplicial automorphism of a typed affine building is type preserving if it fixes every vertex label. Such an automorphism stabilizing a chamber fixes each of its vertices, hence the chamber pointwise.

concept.title: Strongly transitive action on an affine building
concept.description: A group action by simplicial automorphisms of an affine building is strongly transitive relative to an apartment system if it is transitive on pairs (C,A) of a chamber and an apartment containing it.

concept.title: Weyl distance between chambers of an affine building
concept.description: Fix the model affine Coxeter system (W,S) and vertex types. For chambers C,D choose an apartment and a type-preserving identification with its Coxeter complex sending C to the fundamental alcove; if D maps to w times that alcove, put δ(C,D)=w. This is independent of the choices and ℓ(δ(C,D)) is the minimal gallery length. Type-preserving automorphisms preserve δ.

concept.title: Hilbert polynomial and degree of a projective scheme
concept.description: For a finitely generated standard graded algebra A over a field with nonempty projective scheme of dimensionr, dim_kA_m agrees for large m with a polynomial of degree r whose leading coefficient is deg(ProjA)/r!. Hilbert polynomials are additive in short exact sequences of finitely generated graded modules, and a degree shift byD replaces P(m) byP(m−D).

concept.title: Component multiplicities in projective degree
concept.description: The degree of a pure-dimensional projective scheme is the sum of the degrees of its top-dimensional irreducible reduced components weighted by their positive generic scheme lengths. Thus its reduced support has degree no greater than the scheme, and deleting some components can only decrease that total.

concept.title: Dimension of an affine hypersurface section
concept.description: If A is a finitely generated integral algebra over a field and f∈A is nonzero and not a unit, every irreducible component of Spec(A/(f)) has dimension dimA−1. Equivalently a nonempty hypersurface section of an irreducible affine variety that is not the entire variety is pure of codimensionone.

concept.title: Zero divisors in a reduced Noetherian ring
concept.description: In a reduced commutative Noetherian ring, the zero divisors are exactly the union of its minimal prime ideals. Hence an element nonzero on every irreducible component of its spectrum acts injectively by multiplication.

concept.title: Unique factorization for polynomial rings over a field
concept.description: For a field k and finitely many variables, every nonzero nonunit polynomial in k[x₁,…,x_n] factors into irreducibles, uniquely up to nonzero scalar factors and reordering. In particular an irreducible polynomial generates a prime ideal.

concept.title: Irreducibility of a smooth projective plane equation
concept.description: A nonzero homogeneous polynomial F∈k[x,y,z] of positive degree whose projective plane equation is Jacobian-nonsingular over an algebraic closure is irreducible over that algebraic closure. Thus its projective curve is geometrically integral.

concept.title: Bilinearity of the quadratic Hilbert symbol over rational completions
concept.description: For v a rational prime or the real place, the quadratic Hilbert symbol is multiplicative in each variable: (ab,c)_v=(a,c)_v(b,c)_v and (a,bc)_v=(a,b)_v(a,c)_v for a,b,c∈ℚ_v×.

concept.title: Explicit quadratic Hilbert symbols over the rational completions
concept.description: At an odd prime p write a=p^αu,b=p^βv with u,v units; then (a,b)_p=(−1)^(αβ(p−1)/2)(u/p)^β(v/p)^α. At2, writing a=2^αu,b=2^βv, the symbol is (−1)^(ε(u)ε(v)+αω(v)+βω(u)), with ε(u)=(u−1)/2 mod2 and ω(u)=(u²−1)/8 mod2. At the real place the symbol is−1 exactly when both arguments are negative.

concept.title: Hilbert reciprocity over the rational numbers
concept.description: For any a,b∈ℚ×, (a,b)_v=1 for all but finitely many rational places v, and ∏_v(a,b)_v=1, where v ranges over the finite primes and the real place with ℚ_∞=ℝ.

concept.title: Hasse invariant of a diagonal local quadratic form
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic form over a local field of characteristic different from2, diagonalized as ∑_(i=1)^n a_i x_i², its Hasse invariant is ε(Q)=∏_(i<j)(a_i,a_j), using the local quadratic Hilbert symbol. This convention uses i<j, and the value is independent of the diagonalization.

concept.title: Hasse-invariant criterion for local ternary isotropy
concept.description: For a nondegenerate ternary quadratic form Q over a local field F of characteristic different from2, write d for its Gram determinant modulo squares and ε(Q)=∏_(i<j)(a_i,a_j) for a diagonalization. Then Q is isotropic if and only if ε(Q)=(−1,−d)_F.

concept.title: Parity of anisotropic places of a rational ternary quadratic form
concept.description: For a nondegenerate ternary quadratic form over ℚ, the set of places v at which the same form over ℚ_v is anisotropic is finite and has even cardinality, including the real place among the places. Consequently a positive definite ternary form isotropic at every odd prime is anisotropic at2.

concept.title: Subpower bounds for the divisor function
concept.description: For every ε>0, the numberτ(n) of positive divisors satisfies τ(n)≤C_ε n^ε for all n≥1. More generally, for every fixed C≥1 and ε>0, C^ω(n)≤C_(C,ε)n^ε, whereω(n) is the number of distinct prime divisors.

concept.title: Averaged doubled exponential sums for a smooth quadratic net
concept.description: Let Q be an integral-matrix quadratic net in k≥4 variables with nonsingular determinant equation. For ℓ=(u,v)∈Z^(2k), set S(ℓ;q)=Σ_(a modq,gcd(a₁,a₂,a₃,q)=1)Σ_(x,y modq)exp(2πi[a·(Q(x)−Q(y))+u·x+v·y]/q). For X,L≥1 and ε>0, Σ_(q≤X)Σ_(max|ℓ_i|≤L)|S(ℓ;q)|≪_(Q,ε)X^(k+3+ε)L^(2k+ε)+X^(k+4+ε)L^k.

concept.title: Folding an affine apartment onto a half-apartment
concept.description: For a wall H in an affine Coxeter apartment and a chosen closed half-apartment H⁺, its folding fixes H⁺ and reflects the other half across H. It preserves chamber incidence, does not increase gallery distances, and a gallery crossing H maps to one with a repeated consecutive chamber at that crossing.

concept.title: Canonical retraction to a building apartment
concept.description: For a thick affine building, apartment A and chamber C⊂A, there is a canonical type-preserving retraction ρ_(A,C):Δ→A. On every apartment containing C it is the unique isomorphism to A fixing the overlap pointwise. It preserves gallery distances from faces of C and does not increase gallery distance between chambers.

concept.title: Comparison of adjacent-center apartment retractions
concept.description: Let adjacent C,C′ lie in an apartment A, let H,H′ be the half-apartments containing them and r their common-wall reflection. For another chamber D, the retractions centered at C,C′ agree in H if d(C′,D)>d(C,D), and agree in H′ if the inequality reverses. If the distances are equal, ρ_C(D)∈H′, ρ_C′(D)∈H, and rρ_C(D)=ρ_C′(D).

concept.title: Coxeter subcomplex characterization of maximal apartments
concept.description: A chamber subcomplex of a thick affine building is an apartment in the maximal apartment system if it is type-preservingly isomorphic to the model affine Coxeter complex.

concept.title: Wall criterion for minimal galleries in an affine Coxeter complex
concept.description: In an affine Coxeter complex, gallery distance between chambers equals the number of walls separating them. A gallery is minimal exactly when it crosses each separating wall once and no other wall. A chamber E lies on some minimal gallery from C to D exactly when no wall separates E from both C and D.

concept.title: Gallery convexity of a building apartment
concept.description: If chambers C,D of a thick affine building lie in an apartment A, every minimal gallery in the building from C to D is contained in A.

concept.title: Reduced-word criterion for building galleries
concept.description: A non-stuttering gallery in a thick affine building is minimal if and only if its panel-type word is reduced in the model Coxeter system. Consequently its endpoint Weyl distance is the product of that reduced word.

concept.title: Weyl isometry between chamber sets
concept.description: A Weyl isometry (strong isometry) between sets of chambers in buildings with the same typed Coxeter model is a bijection f satisfying δ(fC,fD)=δ(C,D) for every pair of chambers in its domain.

concept.title: Apartment containment from a Weyl-isometric chamber set
concept.description: In a thick affine building with its maximal apartment system, any set of chambers Weyl-isometric to a subset of a model apartment is contained in an apartment.

concept.title: C¹ diffeomorphism between Euclidean open sets
concept.description: A C¹ diffeomorphism Φ:U→V between open subsets of R^n is a bijection such that both Φ and Φ⁻¹ are continuously differentiable.

concept.title: Riemann change of variables on a compact Jordan set
concept.description: Let S⊂U⊂R^n be compact and Jordan measurable, with U open. If g:U→R^n is injective and C¹ and detDg is nonzero onS, then for every Riemann-integrable f on g(S), ∫_(g(S))f(y)dy=∫_S f(g(x))|detDg(x)|dx.

concept.title: Uniqueness of Radon measures from continuous tests
concept.description: Two nonnegative Radon Borel measures on a locally compact Hausdorff space are equal if they give the same integral to every real continuous compactly supported function.

concept.title: Null-set preservation by locally Lipschitz maps
concept.description: A locally Lipschitz map between open subsets of the same Euclidean space R^n sends Lebesgue-null sets to Lebesgue-null sets. On a region with Lipschitz constantL, image outer measure is bounded by a dimensional constant times L^n times domain outer measure.

concept.title: Pointwise stabilizer of a set under a group action
concept.description: For a group action G on X and A⊆X, its pointwise stabilizer is {g∈G:ga=a for every a∈A}, a subgroup of G. This is distinct from merely preserving A as a set.

concept.title: Density of compactly supported continuous functions in Radon Lᵖ
concept.description: If μ is a Radon measure on a locally compact second-countable Hausdorff space and1≤p<∞, then compactly supported continuous functions are dense in Lᵖ(μ).

concept.title: Conditional expectation for a compact-group quotient
concept.description: Let a compact group K act continuously on a locally compact second-countable Hausdorff space Y preserving a Radon probability m. With π:Y→X=Y/K and π_*m, pullback identifies L²(X) isometrically with the K-invariant subspace of L²(Y), and P_Kf(y)=∫_Kf(k⁻¹y)dk is both conditional expectation onto π⁻¹B(X) and the orthogonal projection onto that subspace, for normalized Haar dk.

concept.title: Stable-past finite-coset criterion for a Markov state space
concept.description: Let Γ be a lattice in a second-countable locally compact group G, K a compact subgroup and a∈G. Put Y=Γ∖G, X=Y/K and S(y)=ya⁻¹. If K=⊔_(j=1)^rω_j(K∩a⁻¹Ka), where every ω_j belongs to ⋂_(n≥0)aⁿKa⁻ⁿ, then Y→X has the Markov module property for S.

concept.title: Arrow chamber-fixing subgroup
concept.description: Let G act on an affine building, and let v₀,v₁ be special vertices of one apartment sharing no wall. Let C₀ be the apartment chamber at v₀ directed toward v₁, and C₁ the chamber at v₁ directed toward v₀. The arrow subgroup is Fix_G(C₀)∩Fix_G(C₁), where fixers are pointwise; it is unchanged when the two corners are reversed.

concept.title: Dyadic oscillatory integrals for a smooth quadratic net
concept.description: Let Q be a k-variable integral quadratic net with nonsingular determinant equation, m∈{1,2}, F^(1)(x)=Q(x), F^(2)(x,y)=Q(x)−Q(y), and w∈C_c^∞(R^(mk)). Put I_m(ν,λ)=∫w(z)exp(2πi[ν·F^(m)(z)−λ·z])dz. Forφ_j>0, D_φ=∏_j([φ_j,2φ_j]∪[−2φ_j,−φ_j]) and Φ=maxφ_j, one has ∫_(D_φ)|I_m(ν,λ)|dν≪_(Q,w)∏φ_j. IfΦ≥1 it is also ≪_(Q,w)Φ^(3−mk/2)(1+logΦ)^(m−1), uniformly inλ.

concept.title: Equivalence of norms in finite dimensions
concept.description: Any two norms on the same finite-dimensional real vector space bound one another by positive constant multiples. They therefore induce the same topology and the same notions of boundedness and convergence.

concept.title: Integral reflection criterion for a primitive local lattice vector
concept.description: Let L be a quadratic ℤ_p-lattice in V and let v∈L be primitive with Q(v)≠0. The reflection τ_v(x)=x−2B(x,v)v/Q(v) preserves L if and only if2B(v,L)⊆Q(v)ℤ_p.

concept.title: Unit representation and integral rotation spinor norms
concept.description: Let L be a quadratic ℤ_p-lattice of rank at least2 with Q(L)⊆ℤ_p. If L represents every unit of ℤ_p, then θ(SO(L)) contains the square class of every unit of ℤ_p.

concept.title: Normal form of an odd-prime universal ternary lattice
concept.description: Let p be odd and L a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ_p-lattice of rank3 with Q(L)⊆ℤ_p. If Q(L)=ℤ_p, then L is isometric to⟨1,−1,−d⟩, where d is its Gram determinant up to a unit square. In particular its underlying ℚ_p-space is isotropic and θ(SO(L)) contains every unit square class.

concept.title: Unit local spinor norms imply one proper ternary spinor genus
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite ternary quadratic ℤ-lattice. If for every finite prime p the group θ(SO(L_p)) contains the square class of every unit of ℤ_p, then the genus of L contains exactly one proper spinor genus.

concept.title: Prime-square transfer for a squarefree ternary spinor exception
concept.description: Let L be positive definite integral ternary, t>0 squarefree and a primitive spinor exception of its genus, and E=ℚ(√(−dt)) for Gram determinant d. For all sufficiently large primes q: if the proper spinor genus of L does not represent t and q splits in E, L does not represent tq²; if it represents t and q is inert in E, L represents tq² exactly when it represents t.

concept.title: Infinitely many prime-square nonrepresentations from a squarefree spinor exception
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite integral ternary quadratic ℤ-lattice, and let t>0 be squarefree and a primitive spinor exception of its genus. If L does not represent t, then L fails to represent tq² for infinitely many rational primes q.

concept.title: Integral spinor norms of separated diagonal binary two-adic lattices
concept.description: Put F=ℚ₂, S=(F×)², U=ℤ₂× and H_d={γ∈F×:(γ,d)₂=1}. For L=⟨1,2^rα⟩ with r≥1 and α∈U, identify θ(SO(L)) with its inverse image in F×. This image equals H_(−2α) for r=1 or3; H_(−α)∩US for r=2; S∪αS∪5S∪5αS for r=4; and S∪2^rαS for r≥5.

concept.title: Bounded representatives of real quadratic fibers
concept.description: Let Q:R^k→R^r be a tuple of homogeneous quadratic polynomials such that DQ has rank r at every nonzero common zero. For any 0<A₂≤A₁ there is Λ depending only on Q,A₁,A₂ such that every soluble fiber Q(x)=ν with A₂≤|ν|≤A₁ has a real solution with |x|≤Λ.

concept.title: Fourier transform of the triangular kernel
concept.description: For ε>0 and sinc(t)=sin(πt)/(πt), with sinc(0)=1, one has ∫_R sinc²(εt) exp(2πitu)dt=ε^(−1)(1−|u|/ε)_+ for every real u. The d-dimensional product identity follows by integrating one coordinate at a time.

concept.title: Effective equidistribution from average Bowen-ball separation
concept.description: Let Γ be a lattice in a second-countable locally compact group G, Y=Γ∖G with Haar probability m, K compact, X=Y/K, and S(y)=ya⁻¹. Assume the Markov module property and0<λ=‖T‖_(L²₀(X))<1. Let μ be S-invariant, Ω compact, s≤0≤t, n=t−s+1≥2, and α=−n⁻¹log∫_Ωμ(yB^(s,t))dμ(y). Choose a symmetric relatively compact open identity neighborhood B₀⊂N_G(K) with B₀²⊂B, injective quotient maps gB₀→Y for Γg∈Ω, and vol(B₀^(s,t))≥Ce^(−nh), C,h>0, using covolume-one Haar measure. For X-measurable0≤φ≤1 put u=μφ. In the lower-semicontinuous case put p=m(esssup_(b∈B₀)φ(·b)), η=(u−1+κ)/κ, q=θ+(1−θ)p; in the upper-semicontinuous case put p=m(essinf_(b∈B₀)φ(·b)), η=u/κ, q=(1−θ)p. If p,u∈(0,1),0<κ<μΩ, k≥1 and θ=λᵏ, with p≤η and θ≤(η−p)/(1−p) in the first case, or η≤p and θ≤(p−η)/p in the second, then C(μΩ−κ)²e^(−n(h−α))/4≤k e^(D(u‖p))e^(−nD(η‖q)/k).

concept.title: Conditional information and entropy of a finite partition
concept.description: For a finite measurable partition ξ of a probability space and sub-σ-algebra A, set I_μ(ξ|A)(x)=−∑_(C∈ξ)1_C(x)log E_μ[1_C|A](x), with the almost-everywhere conditional-probability convention; its integral H_μ(ξ|A) is the conditional entropy.

concept.title: Chain rule for finite-partition conditional information
concept.description: For finite measurable partitions ξ,η and a sub-σ-algebra A of a probability space, I_μ(ξ∨η|A)=I_μ(η|A)+I_μ(ξ|σ(η)∨A) almost everywhere. Conditional information also commutes with pullback by a measure-preserving map when both partition and conditioning σ-algebra are pulled back.

concept.title: Domination and convergence of finite-partition conditional information
concept.description: If ξ is a finite measurable partition of a probability space and A_n increases to A_∞=σ(⋃A_n), then I_μ(ξ|A_n)→I_μ(ξ|A_∞) almost surely and in L¹, and ∫sup_n I_μ(ξ|A_n)dμ≤H_μ(ξ)+1.

concept.title: Future conditional formula for finite-partition entropy rate
concept.description: For a probability-preserving transformation T and finite partition ξ, h_μ(T,ξ)=H_μ(ξ|∨_(j≥1)T^(−j)ξ). This is the entropy rate for the ξ-name process; no generating-partition hypothesis is required.

concept.title: Maximal ergodic inequality for a nonnegative function
concept.description: If T preserves probability μ, g≥0 belongs to L¹(μ), and r>0, then μ{sup_(n≥1)n⁻¹∑_(j=0)^(n−1)g(T^jx)>r}≤‖g‖₁/r.

concept.title: Cyclic cohomology criterion for elliptic local-global divisibility
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field F, m>1 and G=Gal(F(E[m])/F). If the cyclic restriction kernel H¹_loc(G,E[m]) is zero, every P∈E(F) divisible by m in E(F_v) at all but finitely many finite places is divisible by m in E(F).

concept.title: Standard Borel measurable space
concept.description: A measurable space is standard Borel if it is measurably isomorphic to a Borel subset of a Polish space, with the induced Borel σ-algebra. Only the measurable structure, rather than a chosen compatible topology, is part of this definition.

concept.title: Ergodic decomposition on a standard Borel probability space
concept.description: If T is a probability-preserving measurable self-map of a standard Borel space (X,B,μ), there is a probability kernel x↦μ_x with μ=∫μ_xdμ(x), and μ_x is T-invariant and ergodic for μ-almost every x. It can be chosen as a regular conditional distribution of the identity given the invariant σ-algebra I, so ∫f dμ_x=E_μ[f|I](x) almost surely for every bounded Borel f; the kernel is unique up to a common μ-null set.

concept.title: Future conditional formula for relative entropy rate
concept.description: For a probability-preserving T, finite partition ξ and strictly T-invariant sub-σ-algebra A, the relative rate lim_(n→∞)n⁻¹H_μ(∨_(j=0)^(n−1)T^(−j)ξ|A) equals H_μ(ξ|A∨∨_(j≥1)T^(−j)ξ).

concept.title: Countable generation modulo a standard Borel probability
concept.description: For a probability μ on a standard Borel space and any sub-σ-algebra A, there exists a countably generated sub-σ-algebra C⊆A such that every A-set agrees μ-almost everywhere with some C-set. Thus C and A have the same μ-completion within the ambient completed probability space.

concept.title: Entropy is affine under ergodic decomposition
concept.description: For a probability-preserving measurable T on a standard Borel probability space, let μ=∫μ_xdμ(x) be its ergodic decomposition. Then h_μ(T)=∫h_(μ_x)(T)dμ(x), allowing +∞. For every finite measurable partition ξ one likewise has h_μ(T,ξ)=∫h_(μ_x)(T,ξ)dμ(x).

concept.title: Gelfand–Mazur theorem
concept.description: Every nonzero complex unital Banach algebra in which every nonzero element is invertible consists precisely of the scalar multiples of its identity, so the scalar map C→A, λ↦λ1, is an algebra isomorphism. It is isometric when ||1||=1.

concept.title: Spectral radius of a normal C*-algebra element
concept.description: For every normal element a of a complex C*-algebra, its norm equals the spectral radius sup{|λ|:λ∈σ(a)}, with spectrum computed in a unitization if necessary.

concept.title: Neumann series in a unital Banach algebra
concept.description: If a lies in a unital Banach algebra and ||a||<1, then1−a is invertible and (1−a)^(−1)=Σ_(n≥0)a^n in norm.

concept.title: Uniform local injectivity of a discrete quotient on compact sets
concept.description: Let Γ be a discrete subgroup of a locally compact Hausdorff group G and q:G→Γ∖G. For every compact Ω⊆Γ∖G there is an open identity neighborhood V⊆G such that q is injective on gV whenever q(g)∈Ω.

concept.title: Entropy scaling under iterates and inversion
concept.description: For a probability-preserving transformation T, h_μ(Tᵏ)=k h_μ(T) for every integer k≥1. If T is invertible with measurable inverse, h_μ(T⁻¹)=h_μ(T), and therefore h_μ(Tᵏ)=|k|h_μ(T) for every nonzero integer k, allowing infinite entropy.

concept.title: One-point compactification of a locally compact space
concept.description: For a noncompact locally compact Hausdorff space Y, its one-point compactification is Y∪{∞}, whose opens are the open subsets of Y together with complements of compact closed subsets of Y. It is compact Hausdorff; if Y is second countable it is metrizable.

concept.title: Properness of a compact-group quotient
concept.description: If a compact topological group K acts continuously on a Hausdorff space Y, the orbit quotient map q:Y→Y/K is closed and has compact fibers; in particular q⁻¹(C) is compact for every compact C⊆Y/K.

concept.title: State-space entropy bound for limits with Bowen-ball separation
concept.description: Let Γ be a lattice in a second-countable locally compact G, Y=Γ∖G with Haar probability m, K compact with open normalizer, X=Y/K and S(y)=ya⁻¹. Assume the Markov module property,0<λ=‖T‖_(L²₀(X))<1, Haar a-homogeneity and finite h_m(S). Let S-invariant Radon probabilities μ_i converge weakly to a probability μ. Suppose a compact-set family F satisfies sup_(Ω∈F)limsup_iμ_i(Ω)=1, and for every Ω∈F there are an open identity neighborhood B, t_i→∞ and C_Ω>0 with ∫_Ωμ_i(yB^(−t_i,t_i))dμ_i(y)≤C_Ωe^(−2ht_i), h>0. For continuous X-measurable0≤φ≤1, or an open/closed X-indicator, put u=μφ,p=mφ∈(0,1). If θ=λᵏ, k≥1, then D(u‖θ+(1−θ)p)/(−logθ)≤(h_m(S)−h)/(−logλ) when p

concept.title: State expectations controlled by an entropy deficit
concept.description: Let Γ be a lattice in a second-countable locally compact G, Y=Γ∖G with Haar probability m, K compact with open normalizer, X=Y/K and S(y)=ya⁻¹. Assume the Markov module property,0<λ=‖T‖_(L²₀(X))<1, Haar a-homogeneity and finite Haar entropy h_m(S) maximal among S-invariant probabilities. Every S-invariant Radon probability μ and continuous X-measurable0≤φ≤1 satisfy |μφ−mφ|≤sqrt((h_m(S)−h_μ(S))/(−2logλ))sqrt(−logθ)+θ for every θ=λᵏ, k≥1.

concept.title: Non-escape of mass from a state-space norm gap and entropy
concept.description: Let Γ be a lattice in a second-countable locally compact G, Y=Γ∖G with Haar probability m, K compact with open normalizer, X=Y/K and S(y)=ya⁻¹. Assume the Markov module property,0<λ=‖T‖_(L²₀(X))<1, Haar a-homogeneity and finite Haar entropy h_m(S) maximal among S-invariant probabilities. If S-invariant Radon probabilities μ_i converge vaguely to a Radon measure μ and h=liminf_i h_(μ_i)(S), then μ(Y)≥1−(h_m(S)−h)/(−logλ).

concept.title: Local Artin norm quotient and inertia image
concept.description: Let K be a finite extension ofℚ_p and L/K a finite abelian extension. The local Artin map induces K×/N_(L/K)(L×)≅Gal(L/K). Under this map, the image of O_K× is precisely the inertia subgroup of Gal(L/K). The normalization sends a uniformizer to arithmetic Frobenius on every unramified subextension.

concept.title: Unit norm criterion for unramified local abelian extensions
concept.description: Let K be a finite extension ofℚ_p and L/K a finite abelian extension. Then O_K×⊆N_(L/K)(L×) if and only if L/K is unramified. The trivial extension is included.

concept.title: Imaginary quadratic fields unramified outside two
concept.description: An imaginary quadratic extension E/ℚ is unramified at every odd finite prime if and only if E=ℚ(i) or E=ℚ(√−2).

concept.title: Jacobs–de Leeuw–Glicksberg minimal group for Hilbert contractions
concept.description: Let S be a nonempty weak-operator-closed semigroup of contractions on a Hilbert space. Then S is weakly compact and has a unique minimal idempotent Q, an orthogonal projection commuting with S. The minimal ideal QS=SQ is a compact topological group with identity Q, on which strong and weak operator topologies coincide.

concept.title: Hilbert tensor products as Hilbert–Schmidt operators
concept.description: There is a canonical unitary identification H⊗K≅HS(K̄,H) for complex Hilbert spaces: x⊗y corresponds to the rank-one map z̄↦⟨y,z⟩x when inner products are linear in their first argument. Under this identification U⊗V acts by A↦U A V̄*, for unitary U,V.

concept.title: Hilbert–Schmidt operators are compact
concept.description: Every Hilbert–Schmidt operator between Hilbert spaces is compact, and is the limit of finite-rank operators in Hilbert–Schmidt norm and hence in operator norm.

concept.title: Connected semisimple algebraic group
concept.description: A connected semisimple algebraic group over a field is a connected reductive algebraic group whose center is finite after base change to an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Simply connected semisimple algebraic group
concept.description: A connected semisimple algebraic group G over a characteristic-zero field is simply connected if every central isogeny H→G from a connected semisimple group is an isomorphism. Here a central isogeny is a surjective algebraic group homomorphism with finite central kernel; this is algebraic simply connectedness, not a statement about the topology of rational points.

concept.title: Absolutely almost simple algebraic group
concept.description: A nontrivial connected semisimple algebraic group G is absolutely almost simple if its base change to an algebraic closure has no proper positive-dimensional connected normal algebraic subgroup. Finite central normal subgroups are allowed.

concept.title: Split rank of a connected reductive group
concept.description: The F-split rank of a connected reductive F-group G is the largest integer r for which G contains an F-split torus isomorphic over F to G_m^r. A split torus maximal for inclusion has this rank.

concept.title: Congruence lattice in an S-arithmetic group
concept.description: For a connected semisimple Q-group G and finite set S of places containing infinity, put G_S=∏_(v∈S)G(Q_v). For compact open K^S⊂G(A^S), let Γ(K^S) be the projection to G_S of G(Q)∩(G_S×K^S). A lattice Γ⊂G_S is a congruence lattice if it is commensurable with such a Γ(K^S) and contains some Γ(K_1^S) of finite index, with K_1^S compact open; commensurable means their intersection has finite index in both.

concept.title: BN-pair
concept.description: A BN-pair in G consists of subgroups B,N generating G, with H=B∩N normal in N and a set S of involutions generating W=N/H, such that for s∈S,w∈W one has n_s B n_w⊂B n_(sw)B∪B n_wB and n_sBn_s⁻¹ is not contained in B; representatives n_w∈N may be chosen arbitrarily. Its Weyl system is (W,S).

concept.title: Affine BN-pair existence for a simply connected p-adic group
concept.description: For a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q_p-group G of positive Q_p-split rank, G(Q_p) has a BN-pair (B,N) with B compact open and N the rational normalizer of a maximal Q_p-split torus. Its Weyl system is of affine type, and every panel index [B:B∩n_sBn_s⁻¹] is finite and at least2.

concept.title: Building associated with a BN-pair
concept.description: For a BN-pair (B,N) in G with finite Coxeter generating set S, the poset of cosets gP_J, J⊊S and P_J=⟨B,N_J⟩, ordered by reverse inclusion, is a thick building with chambers G/B and apartments the G-translates of {wB:w∈N/(B∩N)}. G acts type preservingly and strongly transitively. If the Weyl system is irreducible affine and all panel indices [B:B∩n_sBn_s⁻¹] are finite, the building is locally finite and affine.

concept.title: Bruhat–Tits building of a simply connected p-adic group
concept.description: For a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q_p-group G of positive Q_p-split rank, its Bruhat–Tits building is a locally finite thick affine building whose apartment system is parametrized by maximal Q_p-split tori. G(Q_p) acts continuously, type preservingly and strongly transitively. Each pointwise chamber stabilizer is compact open.

concept.title: Iwahori subgroup of a simply connected p-adic group
concept.description: For a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q_p-group G of positive split rank, an Iwahori subgroup is the pointwise stabilizer of a chamber in its Bruhat–Tits building. It is compact open and all such subgroups are conjugate. In this simply connected convention the connected parahoric chamber fixer and the full pointwise chamber fixer agree.

concept.title: States separate positive C*-algebra elements
concept.description: For every nonzero positive element a of a C*-algebra A, there is a state ρ on A with ρ(a)>0; in fact a state can attain ρ(a)=||a||.

concept.title: Monotonicity of Voiculescu–Brown entropy
concept.description: If α is an automorphism of an exact C*-algebra A and B⊆A is an α-invariant C*-subalgebra with α(B)=B, then h_t(α|B)≤h_t(α).

concept.title: Tensor subadditivity of Voiculescu–Brown entropy
concept.description: For automorphisms α,β of exact C*-algebras A,B, h_t(α⊗β)≤h_t(α)+h_t(β) on the minimal C*-tensor product A⊗min B.

concept.title: Computing Voiculescu–Brown entropy on a total set
concept.description: For an automorphism α of an exact C*-algebra A and a subset D whose complex linear span is norm dense in A, h_t(α) is the supremum of h_t(α,Ω,δ) over finite Ω⊆D and δ>0.

concept.title: Complete positivity passes to opposite C*-algebras
concept.description: For C*-algebras A,B let Aop,Bop have reversed multiplication and the same star and norm. If φ:A→B is completely positive, then the same linear map φop:Aop→Bop is completely positive; contractivity is also preserved.

concept.title: Integral spinor norms of a unary and an even binary two-adic lattice
concept.description: Put F=ℚ₂, S=(F×)² and U=ℤ₂×. Let L=⟨ε⟩⊥2^rB with r≥0 and ε,η∈U, where the binary form B is Q_B(x,y)=2ηxy or2η(x²+xy+y²). The inverse image in F× of θ(SO(L)) is US when r is odd and F× when r is even.

concept.title: Integral spinor norms of unary and equal-scale diagonal binary two-adic lattices
concept.description: Put F=ℚ₂, S=(F×)², U=ℤ₂× and H_d={c∈F×:(c,d)₂=1}. For L=⟨ε⟩⊥2^r⟨γ,μ⟩ with r≥1 and ε,γ,μ∈U, identify θ(SO(L)) with its inverse image in F×. If γμ≡3 mod4, this image is US for r even and F× for r odd. If γμ≡1 mod4, it is H_(−γμ) when r≥4 and (2^rεγ,−γμ)₂=1, and F× otherwise.

concept.title: Idelic index for the number of proper spinor genera
concept.description: Let L be a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ-lattice of rank at least3, J the idele group ofℚ, and J_L={a∈J:a_v mod(ℚ_v×)²∈θ(SO(L_v)) at every place v}, with L_∞ its real quadratic space. Then the number of proper spinor genera in the genus of L is the finite index [J:ℚ×J_L].

concept.title: Dimension bound for an l1 embedding into matrices
concept.description: There is a universal c>0 such that an isomorphism γ:l1^n→γ(l1^n)⊆M_d(C), with the matrix operator norm, satisfies log(2d)≥c n/(||γ||²||γ^(−1)||²). The same bound holds for embeddings into l∞^d via diagonal matrices.

concept.title: Pajor coordinate-cube projection lemma
concept.description: For ε,λ>0 there are c,δ>0 such that whenever a complex balanced convex S⊆B1(l∞^n) contains an ε-separated set of size at least exp(λn), some coordinate set I with|I|≥cn has π_I(S)⊇Bδ(l∞^I). Separation uses the sup norm; constants depend only on ε,λ.

concept.title: Monotonicity of contractive approximation entropy
concept.description: If α is an isometric automorphism of a Banach space X and Y⊆X is a closed subspace with α(Y)=Y, then h_c(α|Y)≤h_c(α). Isometric conjugacies preserve h_c.

concept.title: Completely contractive formula for Voiculescu–Brown entropy
concept.description: For an automorphism of an exact C*-algebra, its Voiculescu–Brown entropy also equals the completely contractive approximation entropy: use the same finite-orbit growth definition, but allow completely contractive linear maps through finite-dimensional C*-algebras in place of completely positive maps. Completely contractive means that every matrix amplification has norm at most one.

concept.title: Contractive maps into commutative C*-algebras are completely contractive
concept.description: Every contractive linear map from an operator space into a commutative C*-algebra is completely contractive, meaning that all its entrywise matrix amplifications are contractions in their operator-space matrix norms.

concept.title: Voiculescu entropy identity for compact metric dynamics
concept.description: For a homeomorphism T of a compact metrizable space K and α_T(f)=f∘T on C(K), h_t(α_T)=h_top(T).

concept.title: Open-subgroup correspondence for an infinite Galois extension
concept.description: For an algebraic Galois extension L/F with Krull-topologized Galois group G, open subgroups H correspond contravariantly to intermediate fields of finite degree by H↦L^H. Open normal subgroups correspond to finite Galois intermediate extensions, and Gal(L^H/F)=G/H in that case.

concept.title: Galois-character classification of algebraic tori
concept.description: For any field F, T↦X*(T)=Hom_(F_sep-groups)(T_(F_sep),G_m) is a contravariant equivalence between F-algebraic tori and finitely generated free abelian groups with a continuous action of Gal(F_sep/F), where the character lattice is discrete. A torus is split exactly when this Galois action is trivial.

concept.title: Hensel lifting of coprime polynomial factors
concept.description: Let A be a complete discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal m. If a monic f∈A[X] has reduction f̄=ḡh̄ with ḡ,h̄ monic and coprime over A/m, then there are unique monic g,h∈A[X] of those degrees, reducing to ḡ,h̄, with f=gh.

concept.title: Normalization of a discrete valuation ring in a finite separable extension
concept.description: Let A be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field K and L/K finite separable. Its integral closure B in L is a finite A-module and a Dedekind domain. The maximal ideals of B above the maximal ideal of A correspond to extensions of the valuation to L, up to positive normalization; localizing B at each such ideal gives the extension valuation ring.

concept.title: Finite generation of lower central factors
concept.description: If a group G is generated by a finite set S, then each lower central quotient γ_j(G)/γ_(j+1)(G) is a finitely generated abelian group, generated by the images of length-j commutators in S and their inverses. If G is nilpotent, every γ_j(G) is finitely generated.

concept.title: Subgroups of finitely generated abelian groups
concept.description: Every subgroup of an abelian group generated by n elements can itself be generated by at most n elements.

concept.title: Local Baker–Campbell–Hausdorff formula
concept.description: In a finite-dimensional real Lie group, for sufficiently small X,Y in its Lie algebra one has exp(X)exp(Y)=exp(BCH(X,Y)), where BCH is a convergent universal series of iterated Lie brackets beginning X+Y+[X,Y]/2. If the Lie algebra is nilpotent, the series terminates as a polynomial.

concept.title: Integration of a Lie algebra homomorphism
concept.description: If G is a connected simply connected real Lie group and H is a real Lie group, every Lie algebra homomorphism Lie(G)→Lie(H) integrates to a unique smooth group homomorphism G→H. In particular connected simply connected Lie groups with isomorphic Lie algebras are isomorphic.

concept.title: Compact closure of an isometric action with compact orbits
concept.description: Let a group of surjective linear isometries act on a Banach space E, with every vector orbit relatively norm compact. Its closure in the strong operator topology is a compact topological group of surjective isometries, acting continuously on E.

concept.title: Jordan invariants of a two-adic quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ₂-lattice with Jordan decomposition L=L₁⊥⋯⊥L_t ordered by increasing scale, its Jordan invariants are the number t, the ranks of the blocks, their scale ideals s_i=s(L_i), and their norm ideals n_i=n(L_i). Write n_i=2^(u_i)ℤ₂ and L_(i)=L₁⊥⋯⊥L_i. These ideal/rank data are independent of the chosen Jordan splitting; the actual blocks need not be isometric across splittings.

concept.title: Isometry criterion for two-adic quadratic lattices with equal Jordan invariants
concept.description: Let L,K be lattices in the same nondegenerate ℚ₂-quadratic space with identical Jordan invariants (t,ranks,s_i,n_i=2^(u_i)ℤ₂), and let L_(i),K_(i) be their first i Jordan blocks. Then L≅K overℤ₂ exactly when, for each i<t, the square class d(L_(i))/d(K_(i)) has a representative congruent to1 modulo n_i n_(i+1)/s_i², and ℚ₂K_(i)⊥⟨2^(u_i)⟩ contains a subspace isometric to ℚ₂L_(i) whenever n_(i+1)⊆4n_i. Here d is the Gram determinant modulo unit squares.

concept.title: Integral spinor norms of distinct-scale diagonal ternary two-adic lattices
concept.description: Put F=ℚ₂ and let L=⟨1,2^iγ,2^jμ⟩ with 0<i<j and γ,μ∈ℤ₂×. Identify spinor images with inverse images in F×. If {i,j−i} meets{1,3} and {i,j,j−i} meets{2,4}, then θ(SO(L))=F×. Otherwise θ(SO(L)) is the product of θ(SO(⟨1,2^iγ⟩)) and θ(SO(⟨1,2^(j−i)γμ⟩)).

concept.title: Compact elements at a vector in a nilpotent unitary action
concept.description: If a nilpotent group G acts unitarily on H and u∈H, then G_c(u)={T∈G:{T^n u:n∈Z} is relatively norm compact} is a subgroup of G.

concept.title: Finite power-product coordinates in a nilpotent group
concept.description: For every finitely generated nilpotent group G there are S₁,…,S_r∈G such that every g∈G has a representation S₁^(a₁)⋯S_r^(a_r) with integers a_j. Uniqueness is not asserted.

concept.title: Leibman closure theorem for filtered polynomial sequences
concept.description: Let G_i be the lower central series of a group G and let nonnegative integers d_i form a nondecreasing superadditive sequence. The sequences g:Z→G satisfying D^(d_i+1)g(n)∈G_(i+1) for every i,n form a group under pointwise multiplication, where Dg(n)=g(n)^(−1)g(n+1).

concept.title: Binomial basis of integer-valued polynomials
concept.description: Every polynomial p∈Q[x] taking integer values on Z has a unique finite expansion p(x)=Σ_j c_j binom(x,j) with c_j∈Z, where binom(x,j)=x(x−1)⋯(x−j+1)/j!. Consequently p has an integer-valued discrete antiderivative P with P(0)=0 and P(n+1)−P(n)=p(n).

concept.title: Auslander–Ellis proximal minimal-point theorem
concept.description: In a compact Hausdorff topological dynamical system, every point is proximal to a minimal point in its forward orbit closure.

concept.title: Lower-central compact-group tower of a nilmanifold
concept.description: Let G be a nilpotent Lie group with G/G⁰ finitely generated and Γ a discrete cocompact subgroup. For its lower central series G_i, the subgroups G_i and G_iΓ are closed; X_i=G/(G_iΓ) form a finite tower from a point to G/Γ. Each X_(i+1)→X_i has fibers on which the compact abelian group G_i/(G_(i+1)(Γ∩G_i)) acts freely and transitively, centrally for the induced G-action.

concept.title: Centralizer of a subgroup in a group
concept.description: For H≤G, its centralizer is C_G(H)={g∈G:gh=hg for every h∈H}. It is a subgroup of G; this is distinct from the normalizer, which need only preserve H under conjugation.

concept.title: Strongly orthogonal subset of a root system
concept.description: A subset R of positive roots in a finite root system Φ is strongly orthogonal if neither α+β nor α−β lies in Φ for distinct α,β∈R. It is maximal if no larger subset of the positive roots has this property; maximality for inclusion is distinct from an unqualified maximum-cardinality convention.

concept.title: Normalizer translations in a p-adic Bruhat–Tits apartment
concept.description: For a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q_p-group of positive split rank and a maximal split torus A, the apartment normalizer acts through its affine Weyl group with compact pointwise kernel. The translations induced by A(Q_p) form a full lattice of finite index in the apartment translation lattice; a special vertex has stabilizer whose linear action is the full finite Weyl group.

concept.title: Cartan decomposition for a simply connected p-adic group
concept.description: Let G be a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q_p-group of positive split rank. There exist a compact open vertex stabilizer U⊂G(Q_p), a maximal Q_p-split torus A, a positive system of nonmultipliable relative roots, and finite Ω⊂C_(G(Q_p))(A(Q_p)) such that G(Q_p)=U A⁺ΩU, where A⁺={a∈A(Q_p):|α(a)|_p≥1 for every positive relative root α}. A fixed Cartan parametrization chooses the A⁺ and Ω components of each U-double coset.

concept.title: Strongly orthogonal root height in Cartan coordinates
concept.description: Fix Cartan data U,A,A⁺,Ω for a simply connected p-adic group and a strongly orthogonal positive-root system R among its nonmultipliable relative roots. With the fixed Cartan parametrization g=u₁aωu₂, define η_R(g)=∏_(α∈R)|α(a)|_p. Thus η_R≥1 and it is U-biinvariant; on A⁺ its values satisfy η_R(aⁿ)=η_R(a)ⁿ.

concept.title: Local automorphic unitary matrix-coefficient bound
concept.description: For a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q-group, a noncompact factor G(Q_p), and a maximal strongly orthogonal positive-root system R, put r=2 in Q_p-rank1 and r=1 otherwise. A nontrivial irreducible unitary representation in the local automorphic dual has |⟨π(g)v,w⟩|≤C(dim⟨Uv⟩dim⟨Uw⟩)^(1/2)ξ_R(g)^(1/r)‖v‖‖w‖ for U-finite vectors, where ξ_R(g)=∏_(α∈R)Ξ_(PGL₂(Q_p))(diag(α(a_g),1)) and a_g is its Cartan torus component. The automorphic dual consists of irreducibles weakly contained in restrictions of the adelic automorphic regular representation; weak containment means compact-uniform approximation of diagonal coefficients by finite positive sums of such coefficients.

concept.title: Rank-one p-adic Harish–Chandra decay
concept.description: For the normalized Harish–Chandra spherical function Ξ on PGL₂(Q_p), and every ε>0, there is C_ε with |t|_p^(−1/2)≤Ξ(diag(t,1))≤C_ε|t|_p^(−1/2+ε) whenever |t|_p≥1. Here Ξ is the spherical matrix coefficient of the unitary principal series induced from the trivial character using normalized induction.

concept.title: Direct-integral decomposition of p-adic reductive unitary representations
concept.description: For the rational-point group of a reductive group over Q_p, every strongly continuous unitary representation on a separable Hilbert space is a direct integral of irreducible unitary representations, with multiplicities. Matrix coefficients and squared norms integrate over the fibers; a common bound on fixed-compact-open invariant coefficients passes to the direct integral by Cauchy–Schwarz.
