concept.title: Adelic realization of an S-congruence quotient in L²
concept.description: Let G be a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q-group, S finite containing infinity, with G_S noncompact, and Γ a congruence lattice in G_S. For some compact open K^S⊂G(A^S), pullback embeds L²(Γ∖G_S) G_S-equivariantly and isometrically into the right-K^S-invariant part of L²(G(Q)∖G(A)); constants and their orthogonal complements are preserved. A noncompact local factor has no invariant vector on the mean-zero embedded subspace.

concept.title: Automorphic norm decay on compact-open invariant vectors
concept.description: Let G be a connected simply connected absolutely almost simple Q-group, S finite containing infinity, Γ a congruence lattice in G_S, and p∈S with G(Q_p) noncompact. Fix p-adic Cartan data and a maximal strongly orthogonal positive-root system R, with height η_R≥1, and a compact open K⊂G(Q_p). For0<ε<1/2 there is C_(Γ,K,ε)>0 such that ‖P_K U_gP_K‖_(L²₀(Γ∖G_S))≤C_(Γ,K,ε)η_R(g)^(−(1/2−ε)/r) for every g∈G(Q_p), where r=2 in Q_p-rank1 and r=1 otherwise, U_g is right translation and P_K is normalized Haar averaging.

concept.title: Proper and improper modular two-adic lattices
concept.description: A nondegenerate2^a-modular ℤ₂-quadratic lattice L is proper if its norm and scale ideals coincide, n(L)=s(L)=2^aℤ₂, and improper if n(L)=2s(L)=2^(a+1)ℤ₂. These are the only possibilities. In the unimodular case a=0, improper means even and proper means odd.

concept.title: Norm-maximal local quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a∈ℚ_p×, a lattice L spanning a nondegenerateℚ_p-quadratic space V is (a)-maximal if Q(L)⊆aℤ_p and no strictly larger lattice M⊂V containing L has Q(M)⊆aℤ_p.

concept.title: Isometry of norm-maximal lattices in a fixed local quadratic space
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space V overℚ_p and a∈ℚ_p×, any two (a)-maximal lattices spanning V are isometric overℤ_p.

concept.title: Representation by a norm-maximal local lattice
concept.description: Let L be an (a)-maximal lattice in a nondegenerateℚ_p-quadratic space V. A nonzero b∈ℚ_p is represented by L if and only if b∈aℤ_p and b is represented by V.

concept.title: Classification of quadratic spaces overℚ_p by dimension, determinant and Hasse invariant
concept.description: Two nondegenerate quadratic spaces overℚ_p are isometric if and only if they have the same dimension, determinant square class and Hasse invariant. Here the Hasse invariant is ε(Q)=∏_(i<j)(a_i,a_j)_p for any diagonalization Q=∑a_i x_i².

concept.title: Classification and values of even unimodular binary two-adic lattices
concept.description: Every even unimodular binary ℤ₂-quadratic lattice is isometric to exactly one of H with Gram matrix[[0,1],[1,0]] and A with Gram matrix[[2,1],[1,2]], using Q(x)=B(x,x). The lattice H is isotropic and represents exactly2ℤ₂; A is anisotropic and represents0 and exactly the nonzero elements ofℤ₂ with odd2-adic valuation.

concept.title: Normal forms of unimodular two-adic quadratic lattices
concept.description: A positive-rank unimodularℤ₂-quadratic lattice with norm idealℤ₂ has an orthogonal basis of unit-norm vectors. An even unimodular lattice has rank2m with m≥1 and is isometric to H^⊥m or H^⊥(m−1)⊥A, where H and A have Gram matrices[[0,1],[1,0]] and[[2,1],[1,2]], respectively.

concept.title: Choi positivity criterion for a matrix-domain map
concept.description: A linear map φ:M_n(ℂ)→A into a C*-algebra is completely positive exactly when the matrix [φ(E_ij)]_(i,j=1)^n is positive in M_n(A).

concept.title: Completely positive matrix approximation implies exactness
concept.description: If a C*-algebra A admits completely positive contractions φ_i:A→M_(n_i)(ℂ) and ψ_i:M_(n_i)(ℂ)→A with ψ_iφ_i(a)→a in norm for every a∈A, then A is exact: tensoring any short exact sequence of C*-algebras with A by the minimal tensor product preserves exactness.

concept.title: Metric and open-cover topological entropy agree
concept.description: For a continuous map of a compact metric space, the entropy defined by finite open covers equals the supremum over ε>0 of limsup_(n→∞)n⁻¹log s_n(ε), where s_n(ε) is the maximal cardinality of an ε-separated set for d_n(x,y)=max_(0≤j<n)d(T^j x,T^j y).

concept.title: Small p-adic matrix exponential and logarithm
concept.description: For matrices over Q_p with the maximum-entry norm, the series expX=∑_(n≥0)Xⁿ/n! and log(I+X)=∑_(n≥1)(−1)^(n+1)Xⁿ/n converge when ‖X‖<p^(−1/(p−1)), and define inverse analytic isometries between that open ball about0 and the corresponding ball aboutI. Conjugation commutes with these series whenever the displayed arguments lie in the domains; exp is not asserted to be a homomorphism on noncommuting matrices.

concept.title: Formal exponential stays in an algebraic subgroup
concept.description: If F has characteristic0, G⊂GL_n is a closed algebraic F-subgroup and X∈Lie(G)(F), the formal matrix curve exp(tX)∈GL_n(F[[t]]) satisfies every defining equation of G, hence is an F[[t]]-point of G. For a complete valued F, its convergent specializations also lie in G(F).

concept.title: Analytic manifold of smooth p-adic variety points
concept.description: If V is a smooth algebraic variety over Q_p, V(Q_p) has a natural Q_p-analytic manifold structure, with tangent spaces identified with the rational algebraic tangent spaces. Polynomial morphisms induce analytic maps.

concept.title: Change of variables for a p-adic analytic diffeomorphism
concept.description: For an analytic diffeomorphism f:U→V between open subsets of Q_p^d and a nonnegative Borel function h, ∫_Vh(y)dy=∫_Uh(f(x))|detDf(x)|_pdx, with product additive Haar measures; the same holds for integrable signed or complex h.

concept.title: Local exponential coordinates for a p-adic algebraic group
concept.description: Let G⊂GL_n be a connected reductive Q_p-group with Lie algebra g. On some open neighborhood U of0 in g(Q_p), the matrix exponential is an analytic bijection onto an open identity neighborhood of G(Q_p), with analytic inverse logarithm and derivative identity at0. It is Ad-equivariant where both sides are defined. After shrinking U and compatibly normalizing additive Haar measure on g and Haar measure on G, vol(expA)=vol(A) for every Borel A⊂U.

concept.title: Compactness of the integer ring of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: If F is complete for a nontrivial discrete valuation with finite residue field, its integer ring O_F is compact and open. Every quotient O_F/π^nO_F is finite for a uniformizerπ and n≥1.

concept.title: Lattice in a vector space over a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional vector space V over a nonarchimedean local field F, an O_F-lattice is an O_F-submodule generated by an F-basis of V. Equivalently it is a finite-rank free O_F-submodule whose F-span is V; this is distinct from a discrete lattice in a real vector space.

concept.title: Submodules of a finite free module over a PID
concept.description: If R is a principal ideal domain, every submodule of R^n is a finite-rank free R-module of rank at mostn.

concept.title: Compact-open integer submodules are local-field lattices
concept.description: For a finite-dimensional vector space V over a nonarchimedean local field F, an O_F-submodule L⊂V is an O_F-lattice if and only if it is compact and open in V.

concept.title: Semilinear Galois action on a vector space
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/F with group Γ, a semilinear Γ-action on an L-vector space V is an additive group action satisfying σ(av)=σ(a)σ(v) for a∈L,v∈V. The fixed vectors form an F-vector space V^Γ.

concept.title: Linear independence of distinct field embeddings
concept.description: Distinct field homomorphisms σ₁,…,σ_r:F→L are linearly independent over L as functions F→L: if∑a_iσ_i(x)=0 for everyx∈F, with a_i∈L, then all a_i=0.

concept.title: Morita equivalence for a full matrix algebra over a field
concept.description: For a field F and n≥1, the functor W↦F^n⊗_FW is an equivalence from F-vector spaces to left M_n(F)-modules, with inverse M↦e₁₁M. The natural evaluation maps give inverse functor isomorphisms.

concept.title: Finite semilinear Galois descent for vector spaces
concept.description: If L/F is finite Galois and V is a finite-dimensional L-vector space with semilinear Gal(L/F)-action, the natural L-linear map L⊗_F V^Gal(L/F)→V, a⊗v↦av, is an isomorphism. In particular every Galois-stable L-subspace descends to the F-space of its fixed vectors.

concept.title: Inverse-limit realization of a fixed-step nilsequence
concept.description: For d≥1, a bounded sequence is a d-step nilsequence exactly when it has the form F(T^n x), n∈Z, for a continuous complex function F on a minimal compact metric system that is an inverse limit of minimal d-step nilsystems.

concept.title: Factor closure of inverse limits of nilsystems
concept.description: For d≥1, every topological factor of a minimal compact metric inverse limit of d-step nilsystems is again an inverse limit of minimal d-step nilsystems.

concept.title: Host–Kra–Maass cube characterization of inverse nilsystems
concept.description: For a transitive compact metric system (X,T), with T a homeomorphism, and d≥2, let Q^[d](X) be the closure of all cubes (T^(ε·n)x)_(ε∈{0,1}^d). Then (X,T) is an inverse limit of minimal (d−1)-step nilsystems exactly when (x,y,…,y)∈Q^[d](X) implies x=y; equivalently any two cubes agreeing at all but one vertex agree at that vertex too.

concept.title: Elementary decomposition of two-step nilsequences
concept.description: Every two-step nilsequence is a uniform limit of finite sums of elementary two-step nilsequences. Here an elementary basic sequence is F(g^n x) on a two-step nilmanifold whose commutator group is identified with the circle and F(ux)=uF(x) for that circle action; uniform limits of such sequences and almost periodic sequences are included as elementary.

concept.title: Heisenberg normal form for an elementary two-step nilsequence class
concept.description: For a nonzero elementary two-step nilsequence a, let S(a) be the uniform closed span of e(ns)a_(n+k) for s∈R/Z and k∈Z. There are d≥0, t∈R/Z equal to0 or irrational, and real α₁,…,α_d,β₁,…,β_d rationally independent modulo1 such that S(a)=S(b), where b_n=e^(πin(n−1)t)∏_jω_n(α_j,β_j) uses the standard Heisenberg theta sequences. Conversely each such b is elementary.

concept.title: Quadratic-mean modulation cyclicity of a Heisenberg nilsequence
concept.description: For b_n=e^(2πins)e^(πin(n−1)t)∏_(j=1)^dω_n(α_j,β_j), with d≥0 and α₁,…,α_d,β₁,…,β_d rationally independent modulo1, the span of (e^(2πinu)b_n)_n, u∈R/Z, is dense in S(b) for the nilsequence quadratic mean norm; S(b) is the uniform closed span of its modulated integer shifts.

concept.title: Rational level-one quasimodular ring generators
concept.description: The graded ring of holomorphic level-one quasimodular forms with rational Fourier coefficients is ℚ[E₂,E₄,E₆], with generator weights2,4,6. Thus a form of fixed weight k is a homogeneous polynomial of weighted degree k in these normalized Eisenstein series.

concept.title: Serre p-adic modularity of depleted Eisenstein series
concept.description: For p≥5 and an even integer k≥2, put G_k(q)=−B_k/(2k)+∑_(n≥1)σ_(k−1)(n)q^n. Then G_k(q)−p^(k−1)G_k(q^p) is a Serre p-adic modular form of weight k, including k=2.

concept.title: Stability of Serre p-adic modular forms under V
concept.description: For a prime p, if f(q)=∑a_nq^n is a Serre p-adic modular form, then Vf(q)=f(q^p) is a Serre p-adic modular form. For nonzero forms V preserves their p-adic weight.

concept.title: Fixed-weight arithmetic and limits of Serre p-adic modular forms
concept.description: For a prime p let X=ℤ_p×ℤ/(p−1)ℤ if p is odd and X=ℤ₂ if p=2. A nonzero Serre p-adic form has weight k∈X when its classical approximating weights converge to k, independently of the approximating sequence. Sums of forms of the same weight k have weight k when nonzero, products have the sum of weights, and a uniform p-adic limit of weight-k forms is again a weight-k form when nonzero.

concept.title: Rational primitive decomposition of a nilpotent unitary action
concept.description: A unitary action of a finitely generated nilpotent group G decomposes orthogonally into invariant summands, each the closed orthogonal span of rational blocks K_F indexed by conjugates of an isolated subgroup F≤G. Here K_F is the closure of the vectors with finite F-orbit; G permutes the blocks, the stabilizer of K_F is N_G(F), elements of N_G(F) outside F have no nonzero power-fixed vector on K_F, and elements outside the normalizer have infinite block orbits. For every E≤G, the closure of its finite-orbit vectors in such a summand is the closed span of the K_F with E⊆F.

concept.title: Isolated subgroup of a nilpotent group
concept.description: A subgroup F of a nilpotent group G is isolated if x^m∈F for x∈G and m≥1 implies x∈F. This is an algebraic root-closure condition, independent of any topology on G.

concept.title: The normalizer of an isolated nilpotent subgroup is isolated
concept.description: If F is an isolated subgroup of a nilpotent group G, then N_G(F)={g∈G:gFg⁻¹=F} is also isolated.

concept.title: Polynomial intersection with an isolated nilpotent subgroup
concept.description: If g:Z→G is a polynomial sequence in a nilpotent group and F≤G is isolated, then either g(n)∈F for every n∈Z or g(n)∈F for only finitely many integers n.

concept.title: Normalizer tower condition in a nilpotent group
concept.description: If G is nilpotent of class at most c and F≤G, then its iterated normalizers F₀=F,F_(j+1)=N_G(F_j) satisfy F_c=G.

concept.title: Finite index of the subgroup generated by generator powers
concept.description: If a nilpotent group G is generated by x₁,…,x_r and m₁,…,m_r are positive integers, then ⟨x₁^(m₁),…,x_r^(m_r)⟩ has finite index in G.

concept.title: Hilbert-space van der Corput lemma
concept.description: For a bounded sequence u_n in a Hilbert space, if lim_(H→∞)H⁻¹Σ_(h=1)^H limsup_(N→∞)Re(N⁻¹Σ_(n=1)^N⟨u_(n+h),u_n⟩)=0, then N⁻¹Σ_(n=1)^N u_n→0 in norm.

concept.title: Von Neumann mean ergodic theorem for a unitary operator
concept.description: For a unitary operator U on a Hilbert space, N⁻¹Σ_(n=1)^N U^n x converges in norm to the orthogonal projection of x onto ker(U−I).

concept.title: Connected ambient model of a compact nilmanifold
concept.description: Let G be a nilpotent Lie group with finitely generated component group G/G⁰ and Γ a closed cocompact subgroup. There are a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group L, a closed cocompact subgroup Λ≤L, and a closed embedding j:G/Γ→L/Λ such that every translation by a∈G on G/Γ is represented by a translation by some b∈L on j(G/Γ). The representing b need not be chosen as a homomorphism of a.

concept.title: Reduction of a uniform nilpotent subgroup to a lattice
concept.description: If L is a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group and Λ is closed and cocompact, then Λ⁰ is a closed connected normal subgroup of L, L/Λ⁰ is connected simply connected nilpotent, and Λ/Λ⁰ is a discrete cocompact subgroup of L/Λ⁰. The resulting compact homogeneous space is naturally L/Λ.

concept.title: Green–Tao quantitative factorization of a polynomial nilorbit
concept.description: Let G/Γ be a connected simply connected m-dimensional nilmanifold with a degree-d rational filtration, an M₀-rational adapted Malcev basis, and a compatible polynomial sequence g. For every B>0 there is M with M₀≤M≪M₀^C, C depending only on B,m,d, and a decomposition g=εg′γ into polynomial sequences. Here ε has distance at most M from the identity and successive distance at most M/N on [N], g′ lies in a rational subgroup with an M-rational adapted basis and is totally M^(−B)-equidistributed there on [N], and γ is M-rational with γ(n)Γ periodic of period at most M. Total δ-equidistribution tests every zero-mean Lipschitz function on every progression of length at least δN.

concept.title: Möbius cancellation for a totally equidistributed nilorbit
concept.description: For fixed dimension m and filtration degree d there is c>0 such that, for sufficiently large N, a polynomial orbit g(n)Γ on a connected simply connected nilmanifold with a Q-rational adapted Malcev basis that is totally δ-equidistributed on [N] satisfies |N⁻¹Σ_(n=1)^N μ(n)1_P(n)F(g(n)Γ)|≪δ^c Q‖F‖_Lip logN for every real zero-mean Lipschitz F and every arithmetic progression P⊆[N] of size at least N/Q; 0<δ<1/2 and Q≥2.

concept.title: Möbius cancellation against a periodic sequence
concept.description: If |f(n)|≤1 is periodic of period q≥1, then for every A>0 and N≥2, |N⁻¹Σ_(n=1)^N μ(n)f(n)|≤C_A q(logN)^(−A), with an ineffective constant C_A independent of f,q,N.

concept.title: Malcev rational lattice basis theorem
concept.description: A connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group G with a cocompact lattice (discrete cocompact subgroup) Γ has a Lie-algebra basis X₁,…,X_m adapted to the lower central series whose ordered exponential coordinates are global, take Γ exactly to Z^m, and have rational Lie bracket constants. A connected subgroup H with Lie algebra spanned by rational combinations of the X_j has H∩Γ cocompact in H and an adapted Malcev basis of rational combinations. With dimensions fixed and rational data of height at most Q, these combinations can be chosen with height bounded by Q^C, for a dimension-dependent C.

concept.title: Malcev coordinate metric on a nilmanifold
concept.description: For an ordered Malcev coordinate map ψ:G→R^m with Γ=ψ⁻¹(Z^m), the Malcev metric d_X on G is the largest metric bounded by ‖ψ(xy⁻¹)‖∞; equivalently take infima of sums of the symmetrized coordinate distances over finite chains. It is right invariant and induces the quotient metric d_X(xΓ,yΓ)=inf_(γ∈Γ)d_X(x,yγ) on G/Γ.

concept.title: Metric comparison for a rational subnilmanifold
concept.description: Let H≤G be a closed subgroup, Γ_H=H∩Γ, and let X and Y be Q-rational Malcev bases of G/Γ and H/Γ_H with every Y_j a rational combination of the X_i of height at most Q. Then the induced Malcev metric on H/Γ_H and the restriction of the ambient quotient metric are bi-Lipschitz with constants bounded by Q^C, where C depends only on the fixed dimensions and nilpotency degrees.

concept.title: Maximal algebraic torus
concept.description: A maximal torus of an affine algebraic group G over a field F is an F-subgroup T that is an algebraic torus and is maximal among such subgroups; equivalently, T becomes a maximal torus of G after extension to an algebraic closure. Maximality concerns algebraic tori, not only F-split tori.

concept.title: Existence and geometric conjugacy of maximal tori
concept.description: Every smooth connected affine algebraic group over a field F has an F-defined maximal torus; maximality is preserved by field extension, and any two maximal tori become conjugate over a separable closure.

concept.title: Semisimple elements lie in geometric maximal tori
concept.description: In a connected affine algebraic group over an algebraically closed field, every semisimple element lies in a maximal torus.

concept.title: Semisimple elements lie in rational maximal tori
concept.description: If G is a connected reductive algebraic group over a characteristic-zero field F and a∈G(F) is semisimple, then some F-defined maximal torus T⊂G contains a.

concept.title: Horospherical maximal entropy principle
concept.description: Let G be a finite product of groups of real or p-adic points of connected reductive characteristic-zero algebraic groups, Γ a lattice, and a∈G semisimple. Put U={u∈G:aⁿua⁻ⁿ→e}. For every probability μ on Γ∖G invariant under x↦xa⁻¹, h_μ(a)≤−log|det(Ad(a)|Lie U)|, with the product of normalized local absolute values; equality holds exactly when μ is U-invariant.

concept.title: Haar entropy of a semisimple homogeneous translation
concept.description: Let G be a finite product of groups of real or p-adic points of connected reductive characteristic-zero algebraic groups, Γ a lattice with Haar probability m, and a a semisimple element supported in a Q_p-factor. For x↦xa⁻¹ on Γ∖G, h_m(a)=∑_(|λ|_p>1)log|λ|_p, where λ runs through the eigenvalues of Ad(a) on that factor Lie algebra, with multiplicity and the unique extended p-adic absolute value. Every invariant probability μ satisfies h_μ(a)≤h_m(a).

concept.title: Maya diagram and charge of a partition
concept.description: A Maya diagram is a subset X ofℤ+½ differing from the negative half-integers in finitely many places. Its charge is the number of occupied positive places minus the number of missing negative places. Charge-zero diagrams correspond bijectively to partitions λ by X_λ={λ_j−j+½:j≥1}; every diagram is uniquely X_λ+m for an integer m, its charge.

concept.title: Euler product for the complex sine
concept.description: For every z∈ℂ, sin(πz)=πz∏_(n≥1)(1−z²/n²), where the products converge locally uniformly in z.

concept.title: Euler values of the Riemann zeta function at positive even integers
concept.description: For every integer m≥1, ζ(2m)=(−1)^(m+1)B_(2m)(2π)^(2m)/(2(2m)!), with Bernoulli numbers defined by t/(exp(t)−1)=∑B_n t^n/n!.

concept.title: Fourier expansion of normalized level-one Eisenstein series
concept.description: For even k≥4 and τ in the upper half-plane, the normalized level-one Eisenstein series satisfies E_k(τ)=1−(2k/B_k)∑_(n≥1)σ_(k−1)(n)q^n, where q=exp(2πiτ), σ_r(n)=∑_(d|n,d>0)d^r, and B_k is the kth Bernoulli number. The series converges locally uniformly in τ.

concept.title: Determinant scaling of additive p-adic Haar volume
concept.description: For A∈GL_d(Q_p), additive Haar measure v on Q_p^d and Borel E⊂Q_p^d, v(AE)=|detA|_p v(E). This is independent of the scalar normalization of v.

concept.title: Bowen-volume lower bound for semisimple p-adic conjugation
concept.description: Let G=G₀×G_p, with G₀ a locally compact Hausdorff group and G_p the Q_p-points of a connected reductive algebraic group. For semisimple a∈G_p put H=∑_(|λ|_p>1)log|λ|_p over the eigenvalues of Ad(a), with multiplicity. There is an identity-neighborhood basis consisting of relatively compact open B such that vol(∩_(j=s)^t a^(−j)Ba^j)≥C_B exp(−H(t−s+1)) for all integers s≤0≤t, with C_B>0 and Haar volume on G.

concept.title: Comparison theorem for projective resolutions
concept.description: A homomorphism of modules lifts to a chain map between any projective resolutions of those modules, and any two such lifts are chain homotopic. Thus a lifted comparison between two projective resolutions of the same module induces the canonical isomorphisms on the cohomology obtained by applying Hom into any coefficient module.

concept.title: Injective module over a ring
concept.description: A left R-module I is injective if every R-linear map from a submodule A⊆B to I extends to B; equivalently Hom_R(−,I) is exact on short exact sequences.

concept.title: Right derived functors from injective resolutions
concept.description: For a left exact additive functor F between abelian categories whose source has enough injectives, choose an injective resolution A→I• and define R^qF(A)=H^q(F(I•)); resolution comparison makes these functors well defined up to canonical natural isomorphism.

concept.title: Group cohomology as derived invariants
concept.description: For a discrete group G and a left Z[G]-module M, the inhomogeneous-cochain group cohomology H^q(G,M) is naturally the q-th right derived functor of M↦M^G, equivalently Ext^q_(Z[G])(Z,M), with Z carrying the trivial action.

concept.title: Grothendieck spectral sequence for left exact functors
concept.description: Let F:B→C and G:A→B be left exact additive functors of abelian categories, with A and B having enough injectives. If G sends injectives to F-acyclic objects, then for each A∈A there is a convergent first-quadrant spectral sequence E₂^(p,q)=(R^pF)(R^qG)(A)⇒R^(p+q)(F∘G)(A).

concept.title: Generators of the p-integral level-one modular ring
concept.description: For p≥5, let ℤ_(p)={a/b∈ℚ:p∤b}. The graded ring of holomorphic level-one modular forms with rational p-integral Fourier coefficients is ℤ_(p)[E₄,E₆], with weights4,6. In particular each weight-k form has a unique weighted-homogeneous polynomial expression with p-integral coefficients.

concept.title: Kubota–Leopoldt Teichmüller branch and coefficient bounds
concept.description: For p≥5 and even a with2≤a≤p−3, there is a function L_a(s)=∑_(j≥0)c_j(s−1)^j onℤ_p with c₀∈ℤ_p, c_j∈pℤ_p for j≥1 and c_j→0 p-adically. For every positive even n≡a mod(p−1), it satisfies L_a(1−n)=−(1−p^(n−1))B_n/n. This is the branch for the nontrivial Teichmüller character ω^a.

concept.title: Uniformly integrable Komlós convex-tail lemma
concept.description: If (f_n) is a uniformly integrable sequence in L¹ of a probability space, there are finite convex combinations g_n∈conv{f_n,f_(n+1),…} converging in L¹.

concept.title: Stopping-time enumeration of càdlàg adapted jumps
concept.description: For a real càdlàg adapted process on a usual filtration, its nonzero jump set is contained, up to an evanescent set, in the union of the graphs of countably many stopping times.

concept.title: Predictable finite-variation local martingales are constant
concept.description: On a filtered probability space satisfying the usual conditions, a real predictable càdlàg local martingale whose paths have locally finite variation is indistinguishable from its initial value.

concept.title: Principal divisor criterion on an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a divisor D=Σ_P n_P(P) is principal exactly when Σ_P n_P=0 and Σ_P[n_P]P=O in the elliptic-curve group law.

concept.title: Function-field Galois theorem for an elliptic isogeny
concept.description: For an isogeny φ:E→E′ over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field k, the function-field extension k(E)/φ*k(E′) is Galois of degree degφ=|kerφ|. Its automorphisms are the translations by kerφ, so a rational function invariant under all such translations is h∘φ for a rational function h on E′.

concept.title: Kernel of the divisor map on a projective curve
concept.description: On a smooth projective connected curve over an algebraically closed field, a nonzero rational function with zero principal divisor is a nonzero constant. Thus two nonzero rational functions with the same divisor differ by a nonzero constant.

concept.title: Mertens right-jump regularization of a strong supermartingale
concept.description: For a real class-D strong optional supermartingale X on a usual filtration over [0,T], the sum I_t=∑_(0≤s<t)(X_s−X_(s+)) is a predictable left-continuous purely discontinuous nondecreasing process with I₀=0 and E I_T<∞, and X+I is a càdlàg class-D supermartingale. Right limits are only taken for s<T.

concept.title: Hilbert class field generated by a maximal-order CM j-invariant
concept.description: If K is imaginary quadratic and a is a fractional ideal of its maximal order O_K, then j(C/a) is algebraic and K(j(C/a)) is the Hilbert class field of K. The ideal classes act through the Artin map, with Frobenius at a prime ideal p sending j(C/a) to j(C/(p⁻¹a)).

concept.title: Field of definition of elliptic CM endomorphisms
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field L with geometric endomorphism ring an order in the imaginary quadratic field K, where the embedding of K is part of the CM data. Every geometric endomorphism of E is defined over the compositum LK.

concept.title: Simple continued fraction
concept.description: A finite simple continued fraction [a₀;a₁,…,a_n] is the nested expression a₀+1/(a₁+1/(⋯+1/a_n)), where a₀∈ℤ and a_j are positive integers forj≥1. An infinite simple continued fraction is the limit of these finite truncations; the truncations are its convergents.

concept.title: Recurrence for simple continued-fraction convergents
concept.description: For [a₀;a₁,a₂,…], write its nth convergent p_n/q_n in lowest terms with q_n>0. With p_(−1)=1,p₀=a₀,q_(−1)=0,q₀=1, one has p_n=a_n p_(n−1)+p_(n−2) and q_n=a_n q_(n−1)+q_(n−2) for n≥1.

concept.title: Continued-fraction formula for the irrationality exponent
concept.description: If α=[a₀;a₁,a₂,…] is irrational and p_n/q_n are its simple continued-fraction convergents, then μ(α)=2+limsup_(n→∞)log(a_(n+1))/log(q_n), with the value+∞ allowed.

concept.title: Simple continued-fraction expansion of e
concept.description: The irrational number e=exp(1) has the simple continued fraction [2;1,2,1,1,4,1,1,6,1,…]: after a₀=2 its partial quotients occur in triples (1,2m,1) for m=1,2,… .

concept.title: Schmidt’s archimedean Subspace Theorem
concept.description: Let n≥2 and let L₁,…,L_n be linearly independent linear forms in n variables with algebraic complex coefficients. For every δ>0, the nonzero vectors x∈ℤⁿ satisfying |L₁(x)⋯L_n(x)|≤‖x‖_∞^(−δ) lie in finitely many proper ℚ-linear subspaces of ℚⁿ, where ‖x‖_∞=max_i|x_i|.

concept.title: Isogeny invariance of an open elliptic Tate-image index
concept.description: Let E and E′ be isogenous over a number field F and geometrically non-CM, and let p be prime. Their closed images in Aut(T_pE) and Aut(T_pE′) have the same finite index in their respective integral automorphism groups; the same holds for the indices of their determinant-one images in SL₂(ℤ_p).

concept.title: Sylow image criterion from a nonsplit prime isogeny
concept.description: Let E/F be elliptic over a number field, p≥5, and0→Φ→E[p]→Ψ→0 a nonsplit G_F-module sequence with one-dimensional charactersφ,ψ. If E has no cyclic F-isogeny of degree p², φψ⁻¹ has order≥3, and p divides[F(μ_(p²)):F], then the p-adic Tate image contains a Sylow pro-p subgroup of GL₂(ℤ_p).

concept.title: Congruence core from a maximal cyclic square isogeny
concept.description: Let E/F be geometrically non-CM over a number field, p≥5, and suppose E has a cyclic F-isogeny of degree p² but no curve F-isogenous to E has one of degree p³. Suppose E[p] is nonsplit with kernel and quotient charactersφ,ψ, ord(φψ⁻¹)≥3, and p divides[F(μ_(p²)):F]. In a Tate basis with the cyclic p²-kernel first, the closed Tate image contains every matrix [[1+p²a,b],[p²c,1+p²d]] with a,b,c,d∈ℤ_p. Its index in GL₂(ℤ_p) has p-adic valuation1 or2.

concept.title: Exclusion of rational cyclic isogenies of degrees p² and125
concept.description: No elliptic curve over ℚ has a cyclic ℚ-isogeny of degree p² for a prime p≥7, or a cyclic ℚ-isogeny of degree125.

concept.title: Exclusion of order25 elliptic torsion over quadratic fields
concept.description: If F/ℚ has degree at most2 and E/F is elliptic, then E(F) has no point of order25.

concept.title: Ordinary filtration from two local5-isogenies
concept.description: Let E/ℚ₅ have two distinct ℚ₅-rational cyclic subgroups of order5. Then E is potentially ordinary or potentially multiplicative. There is a G_ℚ₅-stable subgroup C⊂E[5^∞] isomorphic to ℚ₅/ℤ₅, and inertia acts on the quotient E[5^∞]/C through a group of order dividing4.

concept.title: Character ratio for a non-CM rational prime isogeny at p≥11
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be geometrically non-CM with a rational isogeny of prime degree p≥11. Ifφ andψ are the characters on its kernel and quotient in E[p], thenφψ⁻¹ has order at least3.

concept.title: Sylow7-adic image for a non-CM rational7-isogeny
concept.description: If E/ℚ is geometrically non-CM and has a ℚ-rational isogeny of degree7, then its closed7-adic Tate image contains a Sylow pro-7 subgroup of GL₂(ℤ₇).

concept.title: Potential good reduction from a rational prime isogeny
concept.description: Let E/ℚ admit a ℚ-rational cyclic isogeny of prime degree N, where N=11 or N≥17. Then E has potentially good reduction at every odd rational prime, including N.

concept.title: Exponent restriction for a rational isogeny character
concept.description: Let N>5 be prime, m=(N−1)/2 and t=m/num((N−1)/12). If E/ℚ has a rational cyclic N-isogeny and potentially good reduction at N, its kernel character has the form r=αχ_N^k, where α has order dividing2t and k modulo m is0,1,1/2,1/3 or2/3; the fraction1/2 occurs only when m is odd, and1/3,2/3 only when3∤m.

concept.title: Hasse bound for an elliptic curve over a finite field
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a finite field of q elements, |#E(𝔽_q)−q−1|≤2√q.

concept.title: Imaginary quadratic class-number-one theorem
concept.description: An imaginary quadratic field has ideal class number one exactly when its fundamental discriminant is−3,−4,−7,−8,−11,−19,−43,−67 or−163.

concept.title: Rational parametrization of a genus-zero curve with a rational point
concept.description: A smooth projective geometrically integral curve C over a field k, of genus zero and with C(k) nonempty, is k-isomorphic to ℙ¹. In particular it has infinitely many k-rational points when k is infinite.

concept.title: Rational noncuspidal points at prime levels11,17 and37
concept.description: The arithmetic modular curves X₀(11),X₀(17) and X₀(37) have respectively3,2 and2 rational noncuspidal points overℚ.

concept.title: Kubert reduction of rational torsion to large prime order
concept.description: If E/ℚ has no rational torsion point of prime order at least23, then E(ℚ)_tors is one of C_m for1≤m≤10 or m=12, or C₂×C_(2v) for1≤v≤4. This is the earlier small/composite-order reduction, before excluding large-prime torsion.

concept.title: Occurrence of the fifteen rational elliptic torsion groups
concept.description: Each of C_m for 1≤m≤10 or m=12, and C₂×C_(2v) for 1≤v≤4, occurs as the full rational torsion subgroup of an elliptic curve over ℚ.

concept.title: Specialization of prime-to-residue elliptic torsion
concept.description: Let E be elliptic over a nonarchimedean local field with residue characteristicℓ and Néron model𝓔. Reduction E(K)→𝓔(k) is injective on its finite torsion subgroup of order prime toℓ.

concept.title: Component bound in additive elliptic reduction
concept.description: For an elliptic curve over a nonarchimedean local field with perfect residue field and additive reduction, the identity component of its geometric Néron special fiber is the additive group, and its geometric component group has order at most4.

concept.title: Finite generation and compactness of global logarithmic units
concept.description: For a number field K and prime ℓ, its global logarithmic unit group Ẽ_K is a finitely generated ℤ_ℓ-module. With its natural ℓ-adic module topology it is a compact Hausdorff group; field norm maps between these modules are continuous.
concept.field: Algebraic number theory and compact groups

concept.title: Projection image of an inverse limit of compact groups
concept.description: For compact Hausdorff groups G_n and continuous homomorphisms f_n:G_(n+1)→G_n, the image of lim←G_n in G₀ equals ⋂_(n≥0)f_(n,0)(G_n), where f_(n,0) is the composite transition map and f_(0,0) is the identity. Surjectivity of the transition maps is not required.
concept.field: Algebraic number theory and compact groups

concept.title: Legendre formula for the prime valuation of a factorial
concept.description: For a prime p and integer n≥0, v_p(n!)=∑_(j≥1)⌊n/p^j⌋; the sum has only finitely many nonzero terms.

concept.title: Difference series for the positive-real digamma function
concept.description: For positive real a,b, ψ(b)−ψ(a)=∑_(m≥0)(1/(m+a)−1/(m+b)); the series converges absolutely and locally uniformly for a,b>0.

concept.title: Asymptotic at a unique nondegenerate interior complex saddle
concept.description: Let Γ be a compact oriented piecewise C² simple path, smooth and regular near an interior point z₀, and let p,a be holomorphic near Γ. Suppose a(z₀)≠0, p′(z₀)=0, p″(z₀)≠0, Re p(z)>Re p(z₀) for z∈Γ∖{z₀}, and Re(p″(z₀)τ²)>0 for a nonzero tangent vector τ to Γ at z₀. Then ∫_Γ a(z)e^(−np(z))dz∼C e^(−np(z₀))/√n as positive integers n→∞, for a nonzero complex constant C fixed by the orientation and Gaussian square-root branch.

concept.title: Irrationality-exponent bound from integer linear-form growth
concept.description: Let α be an irrational real number. Suppose p_n,q_n are integers with q_n≠0 eventually and, for constants σ,τ>0, lim_(n→∞)n^(−1)log|q_n|=σ and limsup_(n→∞)n^(−1)log|q_nα−p_n|≤−τ. Then μ(α)≤1+σ/τ.

concept.title: Full p-adic image from mod-p surjectivity and determinant
concept.description: Let p≥5 and let G be a closed subgroup of GL₂(ℤ_p). If its reduction modulo p is GL₂(𝔽_p) and det(G)=ℤ_p×, then G=GL₂(ℤ_p).

concept.title: Selmer invariant factors from derived Heegner divisibilities
concept.description: Let E/ℚ be geometrically non-CM, fix a modular parametrization and an imaginary Heegner field K≠ℚ(i),ℚ(√−3), and let p be odd with full p-adic Tate image. For the Heegner derivative points P_λ at squarefree auxiliary inert conductors λ, put n(q)=min(v_p(q+1),v_p(a_q)), n(λ)=min_(q|λ)n(q), n(1)=∞; only q∤Np with n(q)>1 occur. Put m(λ)=max{s:P_λ∈p^sE(K_λ)} if this maximum is<n(λ), and∞ otherwise, and m_r=min_(ω(λ)=r)m(λ). If y_K=P₁ is nontorsion, m₀≥m₁≥⋯ stabilizes in nonnegative integers, and for n>m₀ the invariant factors of Sel_(p^n)(E/K) are n together with two copies of each m_r−m_(r+1), r≥0; zero factors are omitted.

concept.title: Integral reflection formula for two-adic rotation spinor images
concept.description: Let L be a nondegenerate quadratic ℤ₂-lattice in V=L⊗ℚ₂, and let P be the nonisotropic vectors v∈L for which the reflection s_v(x)=x−2B(x,v)v/Q(v) preserves L. Then θ(SO(L)) is the subgroup of ℚ₂×/ℚ₂×² generated by the classes Q(u)Q(v) with u,v∈P.

concept.title: Integral spinor norms of unimodular two-adic lattices
concept.description: Identify spinor images with inverse images in F× for F=ℚ₂, and put U=ℤ₂× and S=F×². If L is unimodular of rank≥3, θ(SO(L)) is F× when L is proper and US when L is improper. In rank2 the standard forms A(0,0), A(2,2), A(1,0), A(1,4), with Gram A(a,b)=[[a,1],[1,b]], have image US; a form A(ε,2δ) with ε,δ∈U has image {c∈F×:(c,−det L)₂=1}.

concept.title: Logarithmic principality implies Leopoldt in the cyclotomic tower
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ). If its degree-zero ℓ-primary logarithmic class group is trivial, then every finite layer K_n of K∞/K also has trivial logarithmic class group and satisfies both Leopoldt and Gross–Kuzmin for ℓ.

concept.title: Hilbertian radical and logarithmic classes exact sequence
concept.description: For a number field K containing μ_(2ℓ), there is a canonical exact sequence0→(ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)⊗_(ℤ_ℓ)Ẽ_K→H_K→(C̃ℓ_K)_tors→0, where H_K is its Hilbertian radical, Ẽ_K its global logarithmic units and C̃ℓ_K its degree-zero logarithmic class group.

concept.title: Logarithmic unit rank under Gross–Kuzmin
concept.description: If K contains μ_(2ℓ) and its degree-zero logarithmic class group is finite, then Ẽ_K≅μ_(ℓ∞)(K)×ℤ_ℓ^(r₂(K)) as ℤ_ℓ-modules, where r₂(K) is the number of complex places. Consequently (ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)⊗Ẽ_K≅(ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)^(r₂(K)).

concept.title: Divisible corank of the universal Tate kernel
concept.description: For a number field K containing μ_(2ℓ), its universal ℓ-primary Tate kernel is isomorphic as an abelian group to (ℚ_ℓ/ℤ_ℓ)^(r₂(K)), where r₂(K) is the number of complex places. Equivalently the maximal divisible subgroup of the cyclotomic Tate-twisted invariant radical has corank r₂(K).

concept.title: Initial cyclotomic radicals are Hilbertian
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ) with |μ_(ℓ∞)(K)|=ℓᵐ. Its initial exponent-ℓᵐ radical for the compositum of all ℤ_ℓ-extensions and the ℓᵐ-torsion of its universal Tate kernel are each contained in H_K[ℓᵐ], where H_K is its Hilbertian radical.

concept.title: Axiom of countable choice
concept.description: The set-theoretic principle that every countable family of nonempty sets has a choice function, selecting one element from each member of the family.

concept.title: Countability of ℕ×ℕ
concept.description: The set ℕ×ℕ of ordered pairs of natural numbers is countably infinite; Cantor's zig-zag enumeration of the pairs gives a bijection ℕ→ℕ×ℕ.

concept.title: Hessenberg’s theorem on infinite cardinal products
concept.description: Every infinite ordinal α is equinumerous with α×α. Consequently, for infinite cardinals κ and λ, κ⊗λ=κ⊕λ=max(κ,λ).

concept.title: Schröder–Bernstein theorem
concept.description: If there are injections A→B and B→A between two sets, then there is a bijection A→B.

concept.title: Countability of the rational numbers
concept.description: The set ℚ of rational numbers is countably infinite.

concept.title: Density of the rationals in the reals
concept.description: Between any two real numbers a<b there is a rational number q with a<q<b.

concept.title: Structure of open subsets of the real line
concept.description: Every open subset U of ℝ is the union of at most countably many pairwise disjoint nonempty open intervals, possibly unbounded, whose finite endpoints lie outside U; these are the connected components of U.

concept.title: Holomorphy of a power series in its disk of convergence
concept.description: A complex power series ∑c_k(z−z₀)^k with radius of convergence R>0 defines a holomorphic function on the open disk |z−z₀|<R, and its derivative is the termwise differentiated series, which has the same radius of convergence.

concept.title: Taylor expansion of a holomorphic function on a disk
concept.description: If f is holomorphic on the open disk |z−z₀|<R, then f(z)=∑_{k≥0}c_k(z−z₀)^k throughout that disk, with c_k=f^{(k)}(z₀)/k!=(2πi)⁻¹∮f(w)(w−z₀)^{−k−1}dw over a positively oriented circle about z₀ inside the disk.

concept.title: Runge’s approximation theorem
concept.description: If K⊂ℂ is compact and f is holomorphic on an open neighbourhood of K, then f is a uniform limit on K of rational functions whose poles lie outside K; the poles can be taken in a prescribed set meeting every bounded component of ℂ∖K, together with ∞.

concept.title: Szegő kernel of the unit disk
concept.description: For w in the unit disk, the Szegő (Cauchy) kernel is k_w(z)=1/(1−w̄z). It is the reproducing kernel of the Hardy space H²: ⟨f,k_w⟩=f(w) for f∈H², so ∥k_w∥²=1/(1−|w|²).

concept.title: Dirac measure at a point
concept.description: For a point x of a measurable space, the Dirac measure δ_x assigns a measurable set A the value 1 if x∈A and 0 otherwise. A positive multiple cδ_x is a point mass at x.

concept.title: Dirichlet space with superharmonic weight D_μ
concept.description: For a finite positive Borel measure μ on the closed unit disk, D_μ is the weighted Dirichlet space D_ω for the positive superharmonic weight ω(z)=∫ω_ζ(z)dμ(ζ), where ω_ζ is the local Dirichlet weight at ζ: 2G(z,ζ)/(1−|ζ|²) for |ζ|<1 and the Poisson kernel for |ζ|=1. By Tonelli, D_μ(f)=∫D_ζ(f)dμ(ζ); in particular D_{δ_ζ}=D_ζ.

concept.title: Sarason’s identification of boundary local Dirichlet spaces with H(b)
concept.description: For ζ on the unit circle, let b be the non-extreme Schur function whose Pythagorean-pair quotient is b/a=z/(1−ζ̄z). Then the local Dirichlet space D_ζ, normed by ∥f∥²_{H²}+D_ζ(f), equals the de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b) with equality of norms.

concept.title: Density of integrable simple functions in Lᵖ
concept.description: For a measure space and 1≤p<∞, finite linear combinations of indicators of measurable sets of finite measure form a dense subspace of Lᵖ.

concept.title: Meyers–Serrin theorem
concept.description: For an open set Ω⊆ℝⁿ, an integer k≥0 and 1≤p<∞, the smooth functions in Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω), namely C^∞(Ω)∩Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω), are dense in Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω).

concept.title: Riesz–Fischer theorem for Lᵖ
concept.description: For a measure space and 1≤p<∞, Lᵖ is complete, and every Lᵖ-convergent sequence has a subsequence converging almost everywhere to the limit.

concept.title: Integration in polar coordinates on Euclidean space
concept.description: For n≥1 and nonnegative or integrable measurable f on ℝⁿ, ∫_{ℝⁿ}f(x)dx=∫₀^∞∫_{S^{n−1}}f(rθ)dσ(θ)r^{n−1}dr, where σ is the area measure on the unit sphere.

concept.title: Hunt process
concept.description: A Hunt process on a locally compact separable metric space E is a normal strong Markov process with values in E_Δ=E∪{Δ}, the one-point compactification with absorbing cemetery Δ, whose paths are right-continuous with left limits in E_Δ and which is quasi-left-continuous: for stopping times T_n↑T, X_{T_n}→X_T almost surely on {T<∞}.

concept.title: Properly exceptional set of a Markov process
concept.description: For a Hunt process X on E and a σ-finite measure m, a set N⊂E is m-properly exceptional if it is nearly Borel (squeezed between Borel sets whose difference X almost surely never hits), m(N)=0, and for every x∉N, P_x-almost surely X_t∉N and X_{t−}∉N for all t>0; that is, E∖N is X-invariant.

concept.title: Hilbert-valued Malliavin Sobolev space Dᵏ,ᵖ(K)
concept.description: For a real separable Hilbert space K, an integer k≥0 and 1≤p<∞, Dᵏ,ᵖ(K) is the completion of K-valued smooth cylindrical Wiener functionals ∑_jF_je_j (F_j smooth cylindrical, e_j∈K) for the norm (E‖F‖_Kᵖ+∑_{j=1}^kE‖DʲF‖ᵖ_{H^{⊗j}⊗K})^{1/p}, where Dʲ is the j-fold Malliavin derivative and H the Cameron–Martin space. K=ℝ and k=1 give D¹,ᵖ.

concept.title: Capacity relative to a Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a Dirichlet form E on L²(X,m) and a strictly positive reference function h=G₁φ (0<φ≤1), Cap_h(U)=inf{E₁(u,u): u∈D(E), u≥h m-a.e. on U} for open U, extended to arbitrary sets by outer approximation with open sets.

concept.title: Capacity characterization of nests and exceptional sets
concept.description: For a Dirichlet form, an increasing sequence of closed sets F_k is a nest if and only if Cap_h(X∖F_k)→0, and a set is exceptional if and only if it has zero capacity; the capacities Cap_h for different admissible h are equivalent.

concept.title: Quasi-continuous versions in a quasi-regular Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a quasi-regular Dirichlet form, every element of its domain has a quasi-continuous m-version, unique up to an exceptional set, and E₁-convergent sequences have subsequences whose quasi-continuous versions converge quasi-uniformly.

concept.title: Wiener chaos decomposition
concept.description: For an isonormal Gaussian process W on a real separable Hilbert space H, L²(Ω,σ(W),P) is the orthogonal direct sum of the Wiener chaoses ℋ_n, the closed spans of H_n(W(h)) over unit vectors h, where H_n is the n-th Hermite polynomial.

concept.title: Density of polynomial Wiener functionals in Lᵖ
concept.description: For an isonormal Gaussian process W and 1≤p<∞, random variables p(W(h₁),…,W(h_n)) with p a polynomial are dense in Lᵖ(Ω,σ(W),P).

concept.title: Ornstein–Uhlenbeck operator on Wiener space
concept.description: The Ornstein–Uhlenbeck operator is L=−∑_n nJ_n, with J_n the projection onto the n-th Wiener chaos; it generates the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroup P_t=∑_ne^{−nt}J_n, and on smooth functionals L=−δD, so that E[F(−L)G]=E⟨DF,DG⟩_H.

concept.title: Commutation of the Malliavin derivative with the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroup
concept.description: For F∈D¹,ᵖ, DP_tF=e^{−t}P_tDF, where P_t acts on H-valued functionals componentwise; equivalently DLF=(L−I)DF for polynomial Wiener functionals F.

concept.title: Meyer inequalities on Wiener space
concept.description: For 1<p<∞ and k≥1 there are constants c,C with c‖DᵏF‖_{Lᵖ(Ω;H^{⊗k})}≤‖(−L)^{k/2}F‖_p≤C(‖F‖_p+‖DᵏF‖_{Lᵖ(Ω;H^{⊗k})}) for polynomial Wiener functionals F, where L is the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck operator; hence Dᵏ,ᵖ is the domain of (−L)^{k/2} in Lᵖ.

concept.title: Meyer multiplier theorem on Wiener space
concept.description: If φ(n)=∑_{k≥0}a_kn^{−k} for n≥N with ∑|a_k|N^{−k}<∞, then the chaos multiplier T_φF=∑_nφ(n)J_nF extends to a bounded operator on Lᵖ(Ω) for every 1<p<∞.

concept.title: Malliavin smoothness of solutions of smooth SDEs
concept.description: For an SDE with C_b^∞ coefficients driven by Brownian motion, the solution X_t^x, its spatial derivatives and solutions of associated linear SDEs belong to every D^{k,p}, with norms bounded uniformly in x and t∈[0,T]; moreover D_sX_t=J_tJ_s^{−1}σ(X_s)1_{s≤t}, with J the Jacobian of the flow.

concept.title: Malliavin derivative of an Itô integral
concept.description: If u is an adapted Malliavin differentiable process with suitable integrability, then ∫₀ᵗu_sdB^i_s is Malliavin differentiable and D_h∫₀ᵗu_sdB^i_s=∫₀ᵗD_hu_sdB^i_s+∫₀ᵗu_sh_i′(s)ds for h in the Cameron–Martin space.

concept.title: Chain rule for the Malliavin derivative
concept.description: If F=(F¹,…,F^n) has components in D^{1,p} and φ:ℝⁿ→ℝ is C¹ with bounded derivatives, then φ(F)∈D^{1,p} and Dφ(F)=∑_i∂_iφ(F)DF^i; for Malliavin smooth components the same holds for smooth φ of polynomial growth, giving products and, under inverse moments, reciprocals.

concept.title: Kusuoka–Stroock nondegeneracy of iterated Stratonovich integrals
concept.description: For m≥0 and 1<p<∞, with B̂^α the iterated Stratonovich integrals of a Brownian motion indexed by words of weighted length at most m, E[inf{∫₀¹(∑_αa_αB̂^α(t))²dt : ∑_αa_α²=1}^{−p}]<∞.

concept.title: Stratonovich equation for pulled-back vector fields
concept.description: For the stochastic flow X(t,·) of C_b^∞ Stratonovich fields V₀,…,V_d and a C_b^∞ vector field W, the pullback X(t)_*^{−1}W satisfies d(X(t)_*^{−1}W)=∑_{i=0}^d X(t)_*^{−1}[V_i,W]∘dB^i(t) with B⁰(t)=t.

concept.title: Ring with identity (not necessarily commutative)
concept.description: A ring is an abelian group R under addition with an associative multiplication R×R→R that distributes over addition on both sides and has an identity element 1. Commutativity of multiplication is not assumed. A ring homomorphism preserves addition, multiplication and 1.

concept.title: Left module over a ring
concept.description: For a ring R with identity, a left R-module is an abelian group M with a map R×M→M satisfying r(m+n)=rm+rn, (r+s)m=rm+sm, (rs)m=r(sm) and 1m=m. An R-linear map is an additive map f with f(rm)=rf(m); a submodule is an additive subgroup closed under the action; Hom_R(M,N) is the abelian group of R-linear maps M→N.

concept.title: Integral group ring
concept.description: For a group G, the integral group ring Z[G] is the free abelian group on the elements of G, whose elements are finite sums Σn_g g with n_g∈Z, with multiplication extending the group law bilinearly. It is a ring with identity, commutative exactly when G is abelian. A G-module structure on an abelian group is the same as a left Z[G]-module structure, with the same homomorphisms.

concept.title: Exact sequence in an abelian category
concept.description: In an abelian category, a composable sequence of morphisms ⋯→A→B→C→⋯ is exact at B if the image of the incoming morphism equals the kernel of the outgoing one, as subobjects of B; it is exact if this holds at every inner term. A short exact sequence is an exact sequence 0→A→B→C→0.

concept.title: Additive functor
concept.description: A functor F between additive categories is additive if each map Hom(A,B)→Hom(F(A),F(B)) is a homomorphism of abelian groups. Additive functors preserve zero objects and finite biproducts.

concept.title: Left exact functor between abelian categories
concept.description: An additive functor F between abelian categories is left exact if, for every short exact sequence 0→A′→A→A″→0, the sequence 0→F(A′)→F(A)→F(A″) is exact; equivalently F preserves kernels. It is exact if F also carries short exact sequences to short exact sequences.

concept.title: Injective object in an abelian category
concept.description: An object I of an abelian category is injective if, for every monomorphism A→B, every morphism A→I extends to a morphism B→I; equivalently the contravariant functor Hom(−,I) to abelian groups carries short exact sequences to short exact sequences.

concept.title: Abelian category with enough injectives
concept.description: An abelian category has enough injectives if every object admits a monomorphism into an injective object.

concept.title: Cochain complex in an abelian category
concept.description: In an abelian category, a cochain complex C• consists of objects Cⁿ (n∈Z) and morphisms dⁿ:Cⁿ→C^(n+1) with d^(n+1)∘dⁿ=0. A cochain map C•→D• is a family of morphisms commuting with the differentials. The cohomology objects Hⁿ(C•)=ker dⁿ/im d^(n−1) are functorial in cochain maps, and C• is exact exactly when all Hⁿ vanish. Chain complexes are the same objects with decreasing indices, C_n=C^(−n).

concept.title: Chain homotopy between maps of complexes
concept.description: Two cochain maps f,g:C•→D• of complexes in an additive category are chain homotopic if there are morphisms hⁿ:Cⁿ→D^(n−1) with fⁿ−gⁿ=d^(n−1)hⁿ+h^(n+1)dⁿ for all n. Homotopy is an equivalence relation compatible with composition and with additive functors, and homotopic maps induce the same morphisms on cohomology.

concept.title: Injective resolution in an abelian category
concept.description: An injective resolution of an object A of an abelian category is a cochain complex I⁰→I¹→I²→⋯ of injective objects, zero in negative degrees, together with a morphism A→I⁰ such that 0→A→I⁰→I¹→⋯ is exact. Every object has one when the category has enough injectives.

concept.title: Comparison theorem for injective resolutions
concept.description: In an abelian category, let 0→A→J⁰→J¹→⋯ be exact and let B→I• be an injective resolution. Every morphism A→B extends to a cochain map J•→I• compatible with the augmentations, and any two such extensions are chain homotopic. In particular any two injective resolutions of the same object are homotopy equivalent by maps over the identity, unique up to homotopy.

concept.title: Acyclic object for a left exact functor
concept.description: Let F be a left exact functor on an abelian category with enough injectives. An object A is F-acyclic if the right derived functors satisfy R^qF(A)=0 for every q>0. Injective objects are F-acyclic.

concept.title: Ext groups in an abelian category with enough injectives
concept.description: In an abelian category with enough injectives, Ext^q(A,B) is the q-th right derived functor of the left exact functor Hom(A,−), evaluated at B: choose an injective resolution B→I• and take H^q(Hom(A,I•)). Thus Ext⁰(A,B)=Hom(A,B), and Ext^q is a bifunctor, contravariant in A.

concept.title: Enough injectives in the category of G-modules
concept.description: For any group G, the category of G-modules, equivalently of left Z[G]-modules, is an abelian category with kernels and cokernels computed on underlying abelian groups, and every G-module embeds in an injective G-module.

concept.title: Projective module over a ring
concept.description: A left R-module P is projective if, for every surjective R-linear map B→C, every R-linear map P→C lifts to a map P→B; equivalently Hom_R(P,−) carries short exact sequences to short exact sequences. Free modules are projective.

concept.title: Projective resolution of a module
concept.description: A projective resolution of a left R-module M is a chain complex ⋯→P₁→P₀ of projective R-modules, zero in negative degrees, together with a map P₀→M such that ⋯→P₁→P₀→M→0 is exact.

concept.title: Cartan–Eilenberg resolution of a complex
concept.description: For a bounded below complex K• in an abelian category with enough injectives, a Cartan–Eilenberg resolution is a double complex I^(•,•) of injectives with an augmentation K•→I^(•,0) such that each column resolves Kᵖ and the induced columns of cocycles, coboundaries and cohomology are injective resolutions of those of K•.

concept.title: Spectral sequences of a double complex
concept.description: A double complex L^(•,•) in an abelian category has two spectral sequences, from filtering its total complex by columns or by rows, with ′E₁^(p,q)=H^q(L^(p,•)) and ″E₁^(p,q)=H^q(L^(•,p)). For a first-quadrant (bounded) double complex both converge to the cohomology of the total complex, inducing finite filtrations.

concept.title: Leray acyclicity lemma for derived functors
concept.description: For a left exact functor F on an abelian category with enough injectives, a bounded below complex (in particular a resolution) of F-acyclic objects computes the right derived functors of F: applying F termwise gives the same cohomology as applying F to an injective resolution.

concept.title: Enough injectives for abelian groups
concept.description: Every abelian group embeds in an injective abelian group. A module over a principal ideal domain is injective exactly when it is divisible, and a free module F over such a ring embeds in the divisible module F⊗K over its fraction field K; for abelian groups one may use Q/Z.

concept.title: Coinduced module of a group
concept.description: For a group G and an abelian group M₀, the coinduced G-module Ind_G(M₀) is the group of all functions G→M₀ with (gφ)(x)=φ(xg). It satisfies Hom_G(M,Ind_G(M₀))≅Hom_Ab(M,M₀) naturally in the G-module M, and every G-module M embeds in Ind_G(M) by m↦(g↦gm).

concept.title: Standard resolution of the integers over a group ring
concept.description: For a group G, let P_r be the free abelian group on (r+1)-tuples (g₀,…,g_r) with diagonal G-action and d(g₀,…,g_r)=Σ(−1)^i(g₀,…,ĝ_i,…,g_r). Each P_r is a free Z[G]-module, and ⋯→P₁→P₀→Z→0, with augmentation sending each tuple to 1, is a projective resolution of the trivial module Z. Hom_G(P•,M) is the complex of homogeneous cochains.

concept.title: Ext computed by projective resolutions of the first variable
concept.description: In an abelian category with enough injectives and enough projectives, for a projective resolution P•→A one has Ext^q(A,B)≅H^q(Hom(P•,B)) naturally in B, compatibly with the long exact sequences; thus Ext may be computed from either variable.

concept.title: Étale morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is étale if it is smooth of relative dimension zero: f is smooth and every fibre X_s is a scheme of dimension zero.

concept.title: Sheaf of abelian groups on the small étale site of a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X, the small étale site has as objects the étale morphisms U→X and as morphisms the X-morphisms between them; a covering of U is a family of étale maps U_i→U whose images cover U. An étale sheaf of abelian groups on X is a contravariant functor F from this category to abelian groups such that, for every covering, F(U)→∏F(U_i)⇉∏F(U_i×_U U_j) is an equalizer. Morphisms of sheaves are natural transformations.

concept.title: Sheafification for the étale topology
concept.description: Every presheaf P of abelian groups on the small étale site of a scheme X has an associated étale sheaf aP with a morphism P→aP through which every morphism from P to an étale sheaf factors uniquely. Thus a is left adjoint to the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves.

concept.title: Abelian category of étale sheaves has enough injectives
concept.description: For a scheme X, the étale sheaves of abelian groups on X form an abelian category, in which kernels are computed sectionwise and cokernels by sheafifying presheaf cokernels, and every étale abelian sheaf embeds in an injective one.

concept.title: Étale cohomology of an abelian sheaf
concept.description: For a scheme X and an étale sheaf of abelian groups F, the étale cohomology groups H^i(X_et,F) are the right derived functors of the left exact global-sections functor F↦F(X) on étale abelian sheaves. Thus H⁰(X_et,F)=F(X), and a short exact sequence of sheaves gives a long exact cohomology sequence.

concept.title: ℓ-adic étale cohomology of a scheme over a separably closed field
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over a separably closed field k and ℓ a prime different from the characteristic of k. With Z/ℓⁿZ the constant étale sheaf (locally constant Z/ℓⁿZ-valued functions), H^i(X,Z_ℓ)=lim_n H^i(X_et,Z/ℓⁿZ) and H^i(X,Q_ℓ)=H^i(X,Z_ℓ)⊗_(Z_ℓ)Q_ℓ. These groups are contravariant in X; for X=X₀⊗_(k₀)k obtained by base change, the Galois group of k over k₀ acts on them by transport of structure.

concept.title: Open immersion of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes j:U→X is an open immersion if it is a homeomorphism of U onto an open subset V of X and induces an isomorphism of U with the open subscheme (V,O_X|_V).

concept.title: Extension by zero of an étale sheaf
concept.description: For an open immersion j:U→X and an étale abelian sheaf F on U, j_!F is the étale sheaf on X associated to the presheaf sending an étale V→X to F(V) if V→X factors through U and to 0 otherwise. It restricts to F on U, vanishes away from U, and j_! is exact and left adjoint to restriction along j.

concept.title: Nagata compactification theorem
concept.description: Let S be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, meaning that S is quasi-compact and any two quasi-compact open subsets have quasi-compact intersection; for example S may be the spectrum of a field. Every separated morphism of finite type X→S factors as an open immersion X→X̄ followed by a proper morphism X̄→S.

concept.title: Compactly supported ℓ-adic cohomology
concept.description: Let X be a separated scheme of finite type over a separably closed field k and ℓ a prime different from char k. Choose an open immersion j:X→X̄ into a proper k-scheme (Nagata) and set H^i_c(X,Z/ℓⁿZ)=H^i(X̄_et,j_!Z/ℓⁿZ); this is independent of the choice up to canonical isomorphism. Then H^i_c(X,Q_ℓ)=(lim_n H^i_c(X,Z/ℓⁿZ))⊗_(Z_ℓ)Q_ℓ. If X is proper, H^i_c(X,Q_ℓ)=H^i(X,Q_ℓ).

concept.title: Geometric Frobenius action on ℓ-adic cohomology
concept.description: Let X be a separated scheme of finite type over F_q, X̄=X⊗_(F_q)F̄_q and ℓ∤q. The q-power Frobenius F_X:X→X (identity on points, f↦f^q on functions) is an F_q-morphism; its base change F=F_X×id to X̄ is finite and induces endomorphisms F* of H^i_c(X̄,Q_ℓ). The geometric Frobenius element of Gal(F̄_q/F_q), the inverse of x↦x^q, acts on these groups by transport of structure through the second factor, and this action equals F*.

concept.title: Integral scheme
concept.description: A scheme X is integral if it is nonempty and O_X(U) is an integral domain for every nonempty affine open U; equivalently X is reduced (all local rings are reduced) and its underlying space is irreducible.

concept.title: Stalk of an étale sheaf at a geometric point
concept.description: A geometric point of a scheme X is a morphism x̄:Spec Ω→X with Ω separably closed. The stalk of an étale presheaf F at x̄ is the colimit of F(U) over étale neighbourhoods (U,ū) of x̄. Morphisms and exactness of étale sheaves can be tested on stalks at geometric points.

concept.title: Direct image of étale sheaves
concept.description: For a morphism of schemes f:Y→X and an étale abelian sheaf G on Y, the direct image f_*G is the étale sheaf U↦G(U×_X Y) on X. The functor f_* is left exact, right adjoint to the inverse image f^(−1), and preserves injective sheaves; for a geometric point it gives skyscraper sheaves.

concept.title: Chow’s lemma for separated schemes of finite type
concept.description: If S is quasi-compact quasi-separated and X→S is separated of finite type, there is a proper surjective S-morphism X′→X, an isomorphism over a dense open subscheme of X, with X′ quasi-projective over S. Nagata’s refinement controls the open on which it is an isomorphism and realizes X′ as a blow-up.

concept.title: Blow-up of a scheme along a closed subscheme
concept.description: For a scheme X and a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf I defining a closed subscheme Z, the blow-up Bl_Z X=Proj(⊕_(n≥0) Iⁿ)→X is the universal morphism of schemes pulling Z back to an effective Cartier divisor; it is an isomorphism over X−Z.

concept.title: Quasi-projective morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism X→S is quasi-projective if it is of finite type and X admits an S-ample invertible sheaf; over an affine S this means X is an open subscheme of a closed subscheme of some projective space over S.

concept.title: Nagata’s blow-up gluing theorem for dense open immersions
concept.description: Over a quasi-compact quasi-separated base S, given finitely many separated finite-type S-schemes M_i containing a common schematically dense open X by quasi-compact open immersions, there are X-admissible blow-ups M_i′ of the M_i that glue along X to a separated S-scheme of finite type (Nagata, Deligne; Conrad Theorem 2.8 and Corollary 2.10).

concept.title: Absolute Noetherian approximation of schemes
concept.description: Every quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is the limit of an inverse system of schemes of finite type over Z with affine transition maps (Thomason–Trobaugh); finitely presented morphisms descend to some member of the system.

concept.title: Grothendieck trace formula with finite coefficients
concept.description: Let X be a separated scheme of finite type over a finite field k, Λ a finite ring of order prime to char k, and K a bounded complex of constructible flat étale Λ-sheaves. Then RΓ_c(X_k̄,K) is a perfect complex of Λ-modules and Σ_(x∈X(k))Tr(Frob_x|K_x̄)=Tr(π_X^*|RΓ_c(X_k̄,K)) in Λ/[Λ,Λ].

concept.title: Perfect complex over a ring
concept.description: An object of the derived category of modules over a ring Λ is perfect if it is isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective Λ-modules. An endomorphism of a perfect complex has a trace, the alternating sum of termwise traces in Λ/[Λ,Λ], independent of the representing complex.

concept.title: Cohomological dimension bound for étale cohomology
concept.description: For a scheme X of finite type over a separably closed field and a torsion étale sheaf F, H^i(X_et,F)=0 and, for X separated, H^i_c(X,F)=0 for all i>2·dim X.

concept.title: Pointwise pure and mixed ℓ-adic sheaves
concept.description: Let X₀ be a scheme of finite type over F_q and F a constructible Q_ℓ-sheaf. F is pointwise pure of weight n if, for each closed point x of X₀ with residue field of size N(x), every eigenvalue of the geometric Frobenius at x on the stalk F_x̄ is algebraic with all complex conjugates of absolute value N(x)^(n/2). F is mixed of weights ≤n if it is an iterated extension of pointwise pure sheaves of weights ≤n. The constant sheaf Q_ℓ is pure of weight 0.

concept.title: Deligne’s purity theorem for lisse sheaves on curves
concept.description: Let X₀ be a projective smooth curve over F_q, j:U₀→X₀ a dense open immersion and F a lisse Q_ℓ-sheaf on U₀ that is pointwise ι-pure of weight β. Then every eigenvalue of Frobenius on H¹(X,j_*F) is ι-pure of weight β+1 (Weil II, Theorem 3.2.3).

concept.title: Higher direct images with proper support
concept.description: For a separated morphism of finite type f:X→S, factored as an open immersion j:X→X̄ followed by a proper f̄:X̄→S, and a torsion étale sheaf F on X, R^if_!F=R^if̄_*(j_!F), independent of the factorization. When S is the spectrum of a separably closed field these are the compactly supported cohomology groups.

concept.title: Proper base change theorem in étale cohomology
concept.description: For a proper morphism f:X→S, a torsion étale sheaf F on X and a morphism g:S′→S with base change f′, the base change maps g^(−1)R^if_*F→R^if′_*(g′^(−1)F) are isomorphisms; in particular the stalk of R^if_*F at a geometric point s̄ is H^i(X_s̄,F). Consequently R^if_! commutes with arbitrary base change for separated finite-type f.

concept.title: Leray spectral sequence for proper-support direct images
concept.description: For separated finite-type morphisms g:X→Y and h:Y→Z and a torsion or ℓ-adic étale sheaf F on X, there is a spectral sequence E₂^(p,q)=R^ph_!(R^qg_!F)⇒R^(p+q)(h∘g)_!F.

concept.title: Deligne’s weight theorem for the local monodromy filtration
concept.description: Let F be a lisse Q_ℓ-sheaf on a dense open of a smooth curve over F_q, pointwise ι-pure of weight β, and s a point of the complement. Then the graded pieces Gr_i^M of the local monodromy filtration on the geometric generic stalk at s are ι-pure of weight β+i as representations of the local Weil group (Weil II, Theorem 1.8.4).

concept.title: Topological invariance of the étale site
concept.description: A universal homeomorphism of schemes Y→X, for example a nilpotent thickening or a purely inseparable base field extension, induces an equivalence between the small étale sites of X and Y; hence étale cohomology does not change under such a base change.

concept.title: Katz bound on compact Betti numbers of affine schemes
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, let V⊂Aᴺ be defined by r polynomials of degree ≤d, and suppose E(N,r,d) bounds |χ_c| for all such affine schemes. Put A(N,r,d)=E(N,r,d)+2+2Σ_(n<N)E(n,r,d) and B(N,r,d)=1+Σ_(∅≠S⊆{1..r})A(N+1,1,1+d|S|). Then Σ_i dim H^i_c(V,Q_ℓ)≤B(N,r,d) for every ℓ invertible in k (Katz, Theorem 1).

concept.title: Adolphson–Sperber bound for the ℓ-adic Euler characteristic
concept.description: If V⊂Aᴺ over an algebraically closed field is defined by r polynomials of degree at most d and ℓ is invertible, then |χ_c(V,Q_ℓ)|≤2^r·D_(N,r)(1,1+d,…,1+d)≤2^r(r+1+rd)^N, where D_(N,r) is the sum of all monomials of degree N in r+1 variables.

concept.title: Excision sequence for compactly supported cohomology
concept.description: For a separated scheme X of finite type over a separably closed field, an open U⊆X with closed complement Z, and a torsion or ℓ-adic sheaf F, there is a functorial long exact sequence ⋯→H^i_c(U,F)→H^i_c(X,F)→H^i_c(Z,F)→H^(i+1)_c(U,F)→⋯, Galois-equivariant when everything is defined over a subfield.

concept.title: Bertini theorem for general linear sections
concept.description: Let X⊂Pᴺ be a closed subvariety over an algebraically closed field and r≤dim X. For E in a nonempty Zariski-open set of codimension-r linear subspaces, X∩E is a proper linear section of dimension dim X−r that is reduced, irreducible if dim X>r, of degree deg X, and whose singular locus has dimension dim Sing X−r (empty if dim Sing X<r).

concept.title: Weak Lefschetz theorem in high degrees via the Gysin map
concept.description: Let X be an irreducible projective scheme of dimension n over a perfect field and Y⊂X a proper linear section of codimension r that is a nonsingular variety. Then the Gysin map H^(i−2r)(Ȳ,Q_ℓ(−r))→H^i(X̄,Q_ℓ) is a Galois-equivariant isomorphism for i≥n+r+1 and surjective for i=n+r.

concept.title: Cohomology of nonsingular projective complete intersections
concept.description: If X⊂Pᴺ is a nonsingular complete intersection of dimension n over a separably closed field and ℓ is invertible, then the restriction H^i(Pᴺ,Q_ℓ)→H^i(X,Q_ℓ) is an isomorphism for all i≠n with 0≤i≤2n, so only H^n can have primitive part; its dimension depends only on N and the multidegree.

concept.title: Artin vanishing theorem for affine schemes
concept.description: For an affine scheme X of finite type over a separably closed field and a torsion étale sheaf F, H^i(X_et,F)=0 for i>dim X. Consequently, by the Mayer–Vietoris spectral sequence, a separated scheme of finite type over such a field, of dimension n and covered by r affine opens, has H^i(X_et,F)=0 for i≥n+r.

concept.title: Poincaré duality for ℓ-adic cohomology of smooth varieties
concept.description: For a smooth separated scheme X of pure dimension d over a separably closed field and ℓ invertible, cup product and the trace map give a perfect pairing H^i_c(X,Q_ℓ)×H^(2d−i)(X,Q_ℓ(d))→Q_ℓ, compatible with Galois actions when X is defined over a subfield.

concept.title: ℓ-adic cohomology of projective space
concept.description: For projective space Pᴺ over a field k with separable closure k̄ and ℓ invertible in k, H^i(Pᴺ_k̄,Q_ℓ) is isomorphic as a Galois module to Q_ℓ(−i/2) for even 0≤i≤2N and is zero otherwise.

concept.title: Complete intersections are Cohen–Macaulay
concept.description: A Noetherian local ring that is the quotient of a regular local ring by an ideal generated by a regular sequence is Cohen–Macaulay. Hence every projective complete intersection over a field is a Cohen–Macaulay scheme.

concept.title: Connectedness of positive-dimensional projective complete intersections
concept.description: A projective complete intersection of dimension at least one over a field is connected; indeed H⁰(X,O_X)=k (Hartshorne, Exercise III.5.5).

concept.title: Serre’s criterion for normality
concept.description: A Noetherian ring or scheme is normal if and only if it satisfies Serre’s conditions (R₁), regularity of the local rings of dimension at most one, and (S₂), depth of each local ring at least min(2, its dimension). In particular a Cohen–Macaulay scheme regular in codimension one is normal.

concept.title: Normal Noetherian schemes are disjoint unions of integral schemes
concept.description: A Noetherian scheme is normal if and only if it is a finite disjoint union of normal integral schemes. In particular a connected normal Noetherian scheme is integral.

concept.title: Bounded denominators of rational Siegel modular forms
concept.description: If a scalar-valued Siegel modular form of degree g and weight k for Sp_2g(ℤ) has all Fourier coefficients c(T) rational, then it has bounded denominators: some positive integer l makes every l·c(T) an integer. This is a consequence of the arithmetic theory of Chai–Faltings (q-expansion principle).

concept.title: Chain in a partially ordered set
concept.description: A chain in a partially ordered set P is a subset C⊆P that is totally ordered by the restricted order, so any two elements of C are comparable. The empty set is a chain.

concept.title: Upper bound of a subset of a partially ordered set
concept.description: An upper bound of a subset A of a partially ordered set P is an element b∈P with a≤b for every a∈A; b need not belong to A.

concept.title: Maximal element of a partially ordered set
concept.description: An element m of a partially ordered set P is maximal if no x∈P satisfies m<x, that is, m≤x implies x=m. Unlike a greatest element, a maximal element need not be comparable with every element and need not be unique.

concept.title: Axiom of choice
concept.description: The set-theoretic axiom that every family of nonempty sets indexed by a set has a choice function, assigning to each index an element of the corresponding set; equivalently, a Cartesian product of nonempty sets is nonempty.

concept.title: Hartogs’ lemma on ordinals not injecting into a set
concept.description: For every set X there is an ordinal α admitting no injection into X, equivalently not in bijection with any subset of X. The proof uses the replacement axiom but not the axiom of choice.

concept.title: Well-founded recursion theorem
concept.description: Let X be a partially ordered set in which every nonempty subset has a minimal element, T a set, and r a rule assigning an element of T to each x∈X and function {y:y<x}→T. Then there is a unique f:X→T with f(x)=r(x,f|{y:y<x}) for all x. For ordinals this is transfinite recursion.

concept.title: Order-preserving map between partially ordered sets
concept.description: A function f:P→Q between partially ordered sets is order-preserving (isotone, monotone) if x≤y implies f(x)≤f(y); it is strictly order-preserving if x<y implies f(x)<f(y).

concept.title: Direct product of associative algebras over a field
concept.description: For associative algebras A₁,…,A_n over a field k, the direct product A₁×⋯×A_n is their Cartesian product with componentwise addition, scalar multiplication and multiplication. It is an associative k-algebra with identity (1,…,1), also written A₁⊕⋯⊕A_n.

concept.title: Homomorphism of Lie algebras
concept.description: A linear map f:𝔤→𝔥 between Lie algebras over the same field satisfying f([x,y])=[f(x),f(y)] for all x,y∈𝔤. An isomorphism is a bijective homomorphism.

concept.title: Nilpotent Lie algebra
concept.description: A Lie algebra 𝔤 is nilpotent if its lower central series 𝔤₁=𝔤, 𝔤ₖ₊₁=[𝔤,𝔤ₖ] (the linear span of all brackets [x,y] with x∈𝔤, y∈𝔤ₖ) reaches 0. It is m-step nilpotent if 𝔤ₘ₊₁=0, equivalently every iterated bracket [x₁,[x₂,…,[xₘ,xₘ₊₁]…]] vanishes.

concept.title: Differential of a Lie group homomorphism
concept.description: For a smooth group homomorphism φ:G→H of real Lie groups, its differential φ_*:Lie(G)→Lie(H) is the derivative of φ at the identity; equivalently it is the unique linear map with φ(exp_G(tX))=exp_H(tφ_*X) for all X∈Lie(G) and real t. It is a homomorphism of Lie algebras, and (ψ∘φ)_*=ψ_*∘φ_*.

concept.title: Exponential coordinates on a real Lie group
concept.description: For a real Lie group G, the exponential map exp_G:Lie(G)→G is smooth with derivative the identity at 0, and it restricts to a diffeomorphism from an open neighbourhood of 0 in Lie(G) onto an open neighbourhood of the identity in G.

concept.title: Adjoint representation of a real Lie group
concept.description: For a real Lie group G and g∈G, Ad_g:Lie(G)→Lie(G) is the differential of the conjugation h↦ghg⁻¹. Then g↦Ad_g is a smooth homomorphism G→GL(Lie(G)) with g·exp(X)·g⁻¹=exp(Ad_g X), and its differential is ad: X↦[X,·].

concept.title: Adjoint exponential formula for a Lie group
concept.description: For X in the Lie algebra of a real Lie group, Ad(exp X)=e^{ad X}=∑_{n≥0}(ad X)ⁿ/n!, where ad X=[X,·] is the adjoint endomorphism of the Lie algebra; equivalently exp(X)exp(Y)exp(−X)=exp(e^{ad X}Y).

concept.title: Matrix logarithm near the identity
concept.description: For a real or complex square matrix A with ∥A−I∥<1 in an operator norm, log A=∑_{n≥1}(−1)^{n+1}(A−I)ⁿ/n. The series converges absolutely and exp(log A)=A; on matrices near 0, log(exp B)=B.

concept.title: Lie subgroup–subalgebra correspondence
concept.description: For a real Lie group G, sending a connected Lie subgroup H (a subgroup carrying a Lie group structure for which the inclusion is an injective immersion, not necessarily closed) to its Lie algebra is a bijection onto the Lie subalgebras of Lie(G). Existence comes from integrating the left-invariant distribution of the subalgebra (Frobenius theorem).

concept.title: Lie group homomorphisms with bijective differential are coverings
concept.description: If φ:H→G is a smooth homomorphism of connected real Lie groups whose differential Lie(H)→Lie(G) is a linear isomorphism, then φ is surjective, its kernel is a discrete normal subgroup, and φ is a covering map.

concept.title: Connected topological groups are generated by identity neighbourhoods
concept.description: If G is a connected topological group and U is a neighbourhood of the identity, then the subgroup generated by U is all of G, since that subgroup is open and hence also closed.

concept.title: Linearity and monotonicity of conditional expectation
concept.description: For integrable real random variables X,Y, a real number a and a sub-σ-algebra G, E[aX+Y|G]=aE[X|G]+E[Y|G] almost surely, and X≤Y almost surely implies E[X|G]≤E[Y|G] almost surely.

concept.title: Local time of a continuous semimartingale
concept.description: For a real continuous semimartingale X and a level a∈ℝ, the local time L^a of X at a is the continuous nondecreasing adapted process with L^a_0=0 appearing in Tanaka's formula |X_t−a|=|X_0−a|+∫_0^t sgn(X_s−a)dX_s+L^a_t; it increases only on {t:X_t=a}. With sgn(0)=0 this is the symmetric local time; the convention sgn(0)=−1 gives the right local time.

concept.title: Itô–Tanaka formula for a continuous semimartingale
concept.description: If X is a real continuous semimartingale and f:ℝ→ℝ is a difference of two convex functions, with left derivative f′₋ and second-derivative measure f″(da), then f(X_t)=f(X_0)+∫_0^t f′₋(X_s)dX_s+½∫_ℝ L^a_t f″(da), where L^a are the right local times of X. In particular f(X) is a continuous semimartingale.

concept.title: Logarithm of a positive definite complex matrix
concept.description: For a positive definite matrix A=U diag(λ₁,…,λₙ)U* with U unitary, log A=U diag(log λ₁,…,log λₙ)U*; this Hermitian matrix does not depend on the chosen unitary diagonalization.

concept.title: Relative entropy of positive definite matrices
