concept.description: For positive definite complex matrices A and H of the same size, the entropy of A relative to H is D(A;H)=tr[A(log A−log H)−(A−H)], with matrix logarithms defined by spectral calculus.

concept.title: Nonnegativity of matrix relative entropy
concept.description: For positive definite complex matrices A and H of the same size, tr[A(log A−log H)−(A−H)]≥0, with equality when A=H. Equivalently tr M=sup_{T≻0}tr[T log M−T log T+T] for every positive definite M.

concept.title: Joint convexity of matrix relative entropy
concept.description: The map (A,H)↦tr[A(log A−log H)−(A−H)] is jointly convex on pairs of positive definite complex matrices of the same size.

concept.title: Tree (graph theory)
concept.description: An undirected graph that is connected, meaning any two vertices are joined by a path, and acyclic, meaning it has no cycle: no closed path of positive length repeating no edge and no vertex other than its common endpoints. Equivalently, any two vertices are joined by exactly one simple path; in particular a tree has no loops or parallel edges.

concept.title: Linear form over a field
concept.description: For a field K, a linear form in n variables is a K-linear map L:Kⁿ→K, written L(x)=a₁x₁+⋯+a_nx_n with coefficients a_i∈K, or formally a₁X₁+⋯+a_nX_n. Linear forms are linearly independent when their coefficient vectors are.

concept.title: Fully faithful functor
concept.description: A functor F:C→D is fully faithful if for all objects X,Y of C the map Hom_C(X,Y)→Hom_D(FX,FY), f↦F(f), is bijective. For linear functors this means F induces isomorphisms of morphism spaces.

concept.title: Dominant functor between additive categories
concept.description: A functor F:C→D between additive categories is dominant if every object of D is isomorphic to a direct summand of F(X) for some object X of C. For semisimple categories this is the notion EGNO call a surjective functor.

concept.title: Module functor between module categories
concept.description: For module categories M,N over a monoidal category C, a module functor is a functor F:M→N with natural isomorphisms F(X⊗M)≅X⊗F(M) compatible with the associativity and unit constraints. Morphisms of module functors are natural transformations commuting with these isomorphisms; a module equivalence is a module functor that is an equivalence of categories.

concept.title: Rational form of a module category
concept.description: Let k⊂K be fields, D_K a fusion category over K with rational form D_k, and M_K a semisimple K-linear module category over D_K. A rational form of M_K over k is a semisimple k-linear module category M_k over D_k with an equivalence Kar(M_k⊗_kK)≃M_K of module categories, compatible with the given tensor equivalence Kar(D_k⊗_kK)≃D_K.

concept.title: Algebra in a monoidal category
concept.description: An object A of a monoidal category with a multiplication m:A⊗A→A and unit u:1→A such that m is associative, using the associativity constraint, and u is a two-sided unit for m. Morphisms of algebras preserve m and u.

concept.title: Right module over an algebra in a monoidal category
concept.description: For an algebra (A,m,u) in a monoidal category C, a right A-module is an object M of C with an action p:M⊗A→M that is associative with respect to m and unital with respect to u. Morphisms commute with the actions; the category Mod_C(A) is a left C-module category via X⊗M.

concept.title: Bimodule over algebras in a monoidal category
concept.description: For algebras A,B in a monoidal category C, an A–B bimodule is an object M of C with a left A-module action A⊗M→M and a right B-module action M⊗B→M that commute up to the associativity constraint. Bimodule morphisms commute with both actions.

concept.title: Ostrik’s internal-End theorem for module categories
concept.description: Let M be an indecomposable semisimple module category over a fusion category C and M a nonzero object of M. Then A=Hom̲(M,M), the internal endomorphism object, is an algebra in C, and N↦Hom̲(M,N) is an equivalence of C-module categories from M to the category Mod_C(A) of right A-modules in C.

concept.title: Module functors between module-object categories as bimodules
concept.description: For algebras A,B in a tensor category C, P↦(−)⊗_AP is an equivalence from the category of A–B bimodules in C to the category Fun_C(Mod_C(A),Mod_C(B)) of right exact C-module functors between the categories of right modules, with module natural transformations as morphisms.

concept.title: Yoneda lemma
concept.description: For an object U of a category C and a functor F:C^op→Set, natural transformations Hom(−,U)→F correspond bijectively to elements of F(U), via s↦s_U(id_U); dually for covariant functors. Hence the Yoneda embedding is fully faithful and a representing object of a representable functor is unique up to unique isomorphism.

concept.title: Simplicial map between simplicial complexes
concept.description: A simplicial map f:X→Y between abstract simplicial complexes is a function on vertices sending the vertex set of every simplex of X onto a simplex of Y, possibly of lower dimension. A retraction of X onto a subcomplex Y is a simplicial map X→Y restricting to the identity on Y.

concept.title: Chamber complex
concept.description: A chamber complex is an abstract simplicial complex in which every simplex lies in a maximal simplex, called a chamber, and any two chambers are joined by a gallery of chambers whose consecutive members share a codimension-one face. A chamber subcomplex is a subcomplex that is itself a chamber complex whose chambers are chambers of the ambient complex. It is thin, or thick, if every codimension-one face of a chamber lies in exactly two, or at least three, chambers.

concept.title: Standard uniqueness lemma for chamber complex maps
concept.description: Let X,Y be chamber complexes with every codimension-one face in Y contained in at most two chambers. If two chamber maps X→Y (simplicial maps sending chambers to chambers) agree pointwise on a chamber C and both send non-stuttering galleries starting at C to non-stuttering galleries, then they are equal.

concept.title: Gate property for panels in a building
concept.description: For a panel P of a building and a chamber D there is a unique chamber proj_P D containing P nearest to D, and d(C,D)=d(C,proj_P D)+d(proj_P D,D) for every chamber C⊇P. Thus for distinct chambers C,C′⊇P either one lies on a minimal gallery from the other to D, or d(C,D)=d(C′,D) and a third chamber of P begins minimal galleries to D from both.

concept.title: Accumulation point of a subset of a topological space
concept.description: A point x is an accumulation point of a subset A if every open set containing x contains a point of A different from x.

concept.title: Multiplicativity of the determinant
concept.description: For square matrices A and B of the same size over a commutative ring, det(AB)=det(A)det(B).

concept.title: Transpose invariance of the determinant
concept.description: A square matrix over a commutative ring and its transpose have the same determinant.

concept.title: Fekete’s subadditive lemma
concept.description: If a real sequence satisfies a_{m+n}≤a_m+a_n for all m,n≥1, then a_n/n converges to inf_{n≥1}a_n/n, which may be −∞.

concept.title: Real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenvectors of a self-adjoint operator
concept.description: Every eigenvalue of a bounded self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space is real, and eigenvectors belonging to distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.

concept.title: Existence of orthonormal bases in Hilbert spaces
concept.description: Every orthonormal family in a Hilbert space extends to an orthonormal basis; in particular every Hilbert space, and every closed subspace of one, has an orthonormal basis.

concept.title: Inclusion–exclusion formula for mixed volumes
concept.description: For convex bodies K₁,…,K_d⊂ℝᵈ, d!V(K₁,…,K_d)=∑_{k=1}^d(−1)^{d+k}∑_{i₁<⋯<i_k}|K_{i₁}+⋯+K_{i_k}|, where |·| is Euclidean volume.

concept.title: Hausdorff continuity of Minkowski addition
concept.description: For nonempty compact sets A,A′,B,B′⊂ℝᵈ, the Hausdorff distance satisfies d_H(A+B,A′+B′)≤d_H(A,A′)+d_H(B,B′); hence Minkowski addition is continuous for Hausdorff convergence.

concept.title: Finite Borel measures are determined by bounded continuous functions
concept.description: Two finite Borel measures on a metric space are equal if they give the same integral to every bounded continuous real function.

concept.title: Kolmogorov–Riesz compactness criterion in Lᵖ(ℝᵈ)
concept.description: For 1≤p<∞, a subset F of Lᵖ(ℝᵈ) is relatively compact exactly when it is bounded, ∫_{|x|>R}|f|ᵖ→0 as R→∞ uniformly in f∈F, and ‖f(·−h)−f‖_p→0 as h→0 uniformly in f∈F.

concept.title: Zero extension of H₀¹ functions
concept.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝᵈ, extending u∈H₀¹(Ω) by zero outside Ω gives a function in H¹(ℝᵈ) whose weak gradient is the zero extension of ∇u; the extension map is an isometry H₀¹(Ω)→H¹(ℝᵈ).

concept.title: Translation difference bound for first-order Sobolev functions
concept.description: For 1≤p<∞, f∈W¹,ᵖ(ℝᵈ) and h∈ℝᵈ, ‖f(·−h)−f‖_{Lᵖ}≤|h|‖∇f‖_{Lᵖ}.

concept.title: Completeness of L∞
concept.description: For a measure space, L∞ with the essential-supremum norm is a Banach space.

concept.title: Principal logarithm and principal powers on the slit plane
concept.description: The principal logarithm Log is the holomorphic logarithm of z on ℂ∖(−∞,0] with Log 1=0, so Log z=ln|z|+i arg z with |arg z|<π. Principal powers are z^a=exp(a Log z) for complex a.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Analytic continuation along a path
concept.description: Given a path γ:[0,1]→ℂ, an analytic continuation along γ is a family of holomorphic functions f_t on open disks containing γ(t) such that f_t and f_s agree on the overlap of their disks whenever s is close to t; f_1 continues f_0 along γ.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Orthonormal polynomials of a complex weight on the real line
concept.description: For a complex-valued weight w on ℝ with ∫|x|^k|w(x)|dx<∞, orthonormal polynomials are complex polynomials p_j(x)=κ_jx^j+⋯ with κ_j≠0 and ∫p_j(x)p_k(x)w(x)dx=δ_jk. The pairing is bilinear, without complex conjugation; for w≥0 this is the usual orthonormal sequence.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Complex sine function
concept.description: The entire function sin z=(e^{iz}−e^{−iz})/(2i), which restricts to the real sine function on ℝ.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Fundamental pair of solutions of a second-order linear complex ODE
concept.description: For y″+p(z)y′+q(z)y=0 with p,q holomorphic on a complex domain U, a fundamental pair is two holomorphic solutions y₁,y₂ on U whose Wronskian y₁y₂′−y₁′y₂ vanishes nowhere.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Oriented contour in the complex plane
concept.description: A finite union of oriented arcs in ℂ, each the image of an injective C¹ map with nonvanishing derivative from a compact interval or a half-line, meeting only at endpoints. The left side of each arc is its + side and the right side its − side; the contour carries arc-length measure |dz|.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Nontangential boundary values on an oriented contour
concept.description: For f holomorphic on ℂ∖Σ, with Σ an oriented contour, f_±(s) is the limit of f(z) as z→s within a sector of opening less than π on the + (left) or − (right) side of Σ at a non-endpoint s, when it exists.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Cauchy integral on an oriented contour
concept.description: For an oriented contour Σ and h on Σ with ∫_Σ|h(s)||ds|/(1+|s|)<∞, the Cauchy integral is (Ch)(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Σh(s)/(s−z)ds for z∉Σ.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Weierstrass product for the gamma function
concept.description: 1/Γ(z)=z e^{γz}∏_{n≥1}(1+z/n)e^{−z/n} for all z∈ℂ, with γ the Euler–Mascheroni constant; the product converges locally uniformly. Logarithmic differentiation gives Γ′(z+1)/Γ(z+1)=−γ+∑_{k≥1}[1/k−1/(z+k)].
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Fundamental theorem for complex line integrals
concept.description: If F is holomorphic on an open set G with F′=f continuous and γ⊂G is a piecewise C¹ path from a to b, then ∫_γf(z)dz=F(b)−F(a).
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Andréief integration formula
concept.description: For a measure space (I,μ) and functions f_0,…,f_{N−1},φ_0,…,φ_{N−1} with every f_jφ_k integrable, ∫_{I^N}det[f_j(x_k)]det[φ_j(x_k)]dμ(x_1)⋯dμ(x_N)=N!det[∫_If_jφ_kdμ]_{j,k=0}^{N−1}.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Length–maximum estimate for complex line integrals
concept.description: For a piecewise C¹ path γ and f continuous on γ, |∫_γf(z)dz|≤max_{z∈γ}|f(z)|·length(γ).
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Holomorphic functions with zero derivative on a region are constant
concept.description: If f is complex differentiable with f′=0 everywhere on a connected open subset of ℂ, then f is constant there.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Bessel function of the first kind
concept.description: J_ν(z)=∑_{k≥0}(−1)^k(z/2)^{ν+2k}/(k!Γ(k+ν+1)) on the slit plane with principal powers, a solution of Bessel’s equation z²y″+zy′+(z²−ν²)y=0.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Hankel functions (Bessel functions of the third kind)
concept.description: H_ν^{(1)}=J_ν+iY_ν and H_ν^{(2)}=J_ν−iY_ν, where for nonintegral ν Y_ν=[J_ν cos νπ−J_{−ν}]/sin νπ, with integer orders by continuity in ν.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Hankel’s large-argument expansions of Bessel and Hankel functions
concept.description: As |z|→∞, H_ν^{(1)}(z)∼(2/(πz))^{1/2}e^{i(z−νπ/2−π/4)}∑_m i^m(ν,m)(2z)^{−m} for −π+δ≤arg z≤2π−δ, with the conjugate expansion for H_ν^{(2)} on −2π+δ≤arg z≤π−δ, where (ν,m)=Γ(ν+m+1/2)/(m!Γ(ν−m+1/2)); the corresponding expansions of J_ν follow.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Connection formulas for modified Bessel functions
concept.description: I_ν(z)=e^{∓νπi/2}J_ν(ze^{±πi/2}) for the appropriate ranges of arg z, and K_ν(z)=(πi/2)e^{νπi/2}H_ν^{(1)}(iz)=−(πi/2)e^{−νπi/2}H_ν^{(2)}(−iz).
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Zero set of a nonzero polynomial is Lebesgue-null
concept.description: The set of zeros in ℝⁿ of a polynomial in n real variables that is not identically zero is closed and has Lebesgue measure zero.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Resultant of two univariate polynomials
concept.description: The resultant of f=a_mx^m+⋯ and g=b_nx^n+⋯ is the determinant of their (m+n)×(m+n) Sylvester coefficient matrix. Over an algebraically closed field with a_mb_n≠0 it vanishes exactly when f and g have a common root.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Discriminant of a univariate polynomial
concept.description: For f=a_n∏(x−r_i) of degree n, disc f=a_n^{2n−2}∏_{i<j}(r_i−r_j)², a polynomial in the coefficients of f; it vanishes exactly when f has a repeated root.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Cauchy–Binet formula
concept.description: For an n×m matrix A and an m×n matrix B over a commutative ring with m≥n, det(AB)=∑_S det(A_{·S})det(B_{S·}), summing over n-element subsets S of the m indices.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Floor of a real number
concept.description: For a real number x, its floor ⌊x⌋ is the greatest integer n with n≤x.

concept.title: Orthogonal direct-sum decomposition of a Hilbert space
concept.description: A real or complex Hilbert space H is the orthogonal direct sum ⊕_m H_m of a sequence of closed subspaces when the H_m are pairwise orthogonal and every x∈H is a norm-convergent sum ∑_m x_m with x_m∈H_m; the expansion is then unique. For pairwise orthogonal closed subspaces this holds exactly when their linear span is dense.

concept.title: Sequential characterization of continuity in metric spaces
concept.description: A map f:X→Y between metric spaces is continuous at x, in the ε–δ sense, exactly when f(x_n)→f(x) for every sequence x_n→x in X. Consequently f is continuous for the metric topologies exactly when it is sequentially continuous at every point.

concept.title: Lower and upper Darboux integrals
concept.description: For bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ and a partition a=x₀<⋯<x_n=b, the lower and upper Darboux sums are ∑m_i(x_i−x_{i−1}) and ∑M_i(x_i−x_{i−1}), where m_i and M_i are the infimum and supremum of f on [x_{i−1},x_i]. The lower (upper) Darboux integral is the supremum of all lower sums (infimum of all upper sums).

concept.title: Equivalence of the Riemann and Darboux integrals
concept.description: A bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ is Riemann integrable, in the sense that its tagged Riemann sums converge as the mesh tends to zero, exactly when its lower and upper Darboux integrals are equal; the common value is then the Riemann integral.

concept.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for real inner-product spaces
concept.description: In a real inner-product space, ⟨u,v⟩²≤⟨u,u⟩⟨v,v⟩ for all vectors u,v.

concept.title: Extension of bounded linear maps from dense subspaces
concept.description: If D is a dense linear subspace of a normed space X and T:D→Y is a bounded linear map into a Banach space Y, then T has a unique bounded linear extension X→Y, and the extension has the same operator norm. In particular a linear isometry from D extends to a linear isometry on X.

concept.title: Green’s second identity
concept.description: For a bounded open set Ω⊂ℝⁿ with C¹ boundary and functions u,v that are C² on a neighbourhood of its closure, ∫_Ω(uΔv−vΔu)dx=∫_{∂Ω}(u∂_νv−v∂_νu)dS, where ∂_ν is the derivative along the outward unit normal and dS is surface measure.

concept.title: Gibbs’ inequality for relative entropy
concept.description: For probability distributions p and q on the same finite set, the relative entropy satisfies D(p∥q)≥0, with equality exactly when p=q.

concept.title: Tate–Shafarevich group of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K, Sha(A/K)=ker[H¹(K,A)→∏_vH¹(K_v,A)], where H¹(K,A)=H¹(Gal(K̄/K),A(K̄)) with the discrete Galois module of geometric points and v runs over all finite and infinite places. Localization restricts cocycles along compatible embeddings K̄→K̄_v. Finiteness is not part of the definition.

concept.title: Continuous cohomology of a profinite group with topological coefficients
concept.description: For a profinite group G acting continuously on a topological abelian group M, Hⁿ_cont(G,M) is the cohomology of the complex of continuous maps Gⁿ→M with the inhomogeneous coboundary. For discrete M it is ordinary profinite cohomology; for ℚ_p-vector spaces with p-adic topology it gives the Galois cohomology used for p-adic representations.

concept.title: Fontaine's crystalline period ring
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p, B_cris=A_cris[1/p][1/t], where A_cris is the p-adic completion of the divided-power envelope of the Witt-vector ring W(O_(ℂ_p)^♭) along the kernel of Fontaine's map θ:W(O_(ℂ_p)^♭)→O_(ℂ_p), and t=log[ε] for a compatible system ε of p-power roots of unity. It is a ℚ_p-algebra with continuous G_K-action and Frobenius.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato Selmer group of a p-adic Galois representation
concept.description: For a number field K and a G_K-stable ℤ_p-lattice T in a continuous p-adic representation V, Sel(K,T)⊂H¹(K,V/T) is the set of classes whose localization at each place v lies in the image of H¹_f(K_v,V). Here H¹_f is 0 at archimedean v, the unramified classes ker[H¹(K_v,V)→H¹(K_v^ur,V)] at v∤p, and ker[H¹(K_v,V)→H¹(K_v,B_cris⊗V)] at v|p, using continuous cohomology.

concept.title: Ample invertible sheaf
concept.description: An invertible sheaf L on a scheme X of finite type over a field is ample if for every coherent sheaf F the sheaves F⊗L^(⊗n) are generated by global sections for all large n. For proper X this holds exactly when some tensor power L^(⊗n), n≥1, is very ample.

concept.title: Projectivity of abelian varieties
concept.description: Every abelian variety over a field has an ample invertible sheaf, and hence is projective; the sheaf can be chosen symmetric, L≅[−1]*L.

concept.title: Dual abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a field k, the dual A^∨ is the abelian variety representing the identity component Pic⁰ of the Picard functor, with the Poincaré sheaf on A×A^∨ as universal family. A homomorphism f:A→B induces f^∨:B^∨→A^∨ by pulling back invertible sheaves.

concept.title: Mumford homomorphism of an invertible sheaf on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an invertible sheaf L on an abelian variety A, φ_L:A→A^∨ sends a point a to the class of t_a*L⊗L⁻¹. By the theorem of the square it is a homomorphism, and f^∨∘φ_L∘f=φ_(f*L) for every homomorphism f:B→A.

concept.title: Mumford homomorphism of an ample sheaf is an isogeny
concept.description: If L is an ample invertible sheaf on an abelian variety A, then φ_L:A→A^∨ has finite kernel and is an isogeny. In particular, for an abelian subvariety B⊆A the restriction L|_B is ample and φ_(L|B) is an isogeny.

concept.title: Identity component of a group scheme over a field
concept.description: For a group scheme G of finite type over a field k, G⁰ is the connected component of G containing the identity. It is an open and closed geometrically connected subgroup scheme of finite index; over a perfect field its reduced subscheme is a smooth subgroup scheme.

concept.title: Weak Mordell–Weil theorem for an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K and an integer n≥2, the quotient A(K)/nA(K) is finite.

concept.title: Néron–Tate height pairing on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K and a symmetric ample invertible sheaf L, the limit ĥ_L(P)=lim 4^(−n)h_L(2ⁿP) of Weil heights is a quadratic form on A(K). Its bilinear pairing is symmetric and positive semidefinite, and {P∈A(K):ĥ_L(P)≤C} is finite for every real C.

concept.title: Multiplication by n on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A of dimension g over a field k and an integer n≥1, multiplication by n is an isogeny of degree n^(2g), étale exactly when char k does not divide n. In particular it is surjective on points over a separable closure when char k∤n.

concept.title: Profinite group cohomology commutes with direct limits
concept.description: For a profinite group G and a direct system of discrete G-modules M_i indexed by a directed set, the natural map lim→Hⁿ(G,M_i)→Hⁿ(G,lim→M_i) is an isomorphism for every n≥0.

concept.title: Exactness of direct limits of abelian groups
concept.description: Direct limits over a directed set carry exact sequences of directed systems of modules over a commutative ring, in particular of abelian groups, to exact sequences: if L_i→M_i→N_i is exact for every i, compatibly with the transition maps, then lim→L_i→lim→M_i→lim→N_i is exact.

concept.title: Splitting of the tensor square of a finite Galois extension
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/k with group G, the map L⊗_kL→∏_(σ∈G)L, a⊗b↦(aσ(b))_σ, is an isomorphism of L-algebras. Equivalently, Spec L×_(Spec k)Spec L is a disjoint union of copies of Spec L indexed by G.

concept.title: Descent of morphisms along fpqc coverings
concept.description: For an fpqc covering {T_i→T} of schemes and any scheme S, morphisms T_i→S whose restrictions agree on every T_i×_TT_j glue to a unique morphism T→S. Equivalently every representable functor is a sheaf for the fpqc topology.

concept.title: Eichler–Shimura congruence relation
concept.description: For a prime p not dividing N, on the reduction of the Jacobian J₁(N) modulo p the Hecke operator T_p equals F+⟨p⟩F^∨, where F is the Frobenius endomorphism, F^∨ its dual (Verschiebung) and ⟨p⟩ the diamond operator. For J₀(N) this reads T_p=F+F^∨.

concept.title: Good reduction of X₁(N) away from the level
concept.description: For N≥5 the modular curve X₁(N) has a smooth proper model over ℤ[1/N]; hence X₁(N) and its Jacobian J₁(N) have good reduction at every prime not dividing N.

concept.title: Weil pairing on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over k and n prime to char k, there is a nondegenerate bilinear Galois-equivariant pairing e_n:A[n]×A^∨[n]→μ_n, compatible as n varies. Composition with a polarization gives pairings on A[n] and on Tate modules with values in roots of unity or ℤ_ℓ(1).

concept.title: Carayol local–global compatibility for modular forms
concept.description: Let F be totally real and π a cuspidal automorphic representation of GL₂(A_F) whose archimedean components are discrete series D_(k_τ,w) with all k_τ≥2 of the parity of w, as for a Hilbert newform, in particular a classical newform of weight ≥2 over ℚ; if [F:ℚ] is even, assume π_v essentially square-integrable at some finite v. Then π has a strictly compatible system of two-dimensional λ-adic Galois representations whose restriction to the Weil group at each finite place 𝔭 of residue characteristic different from λ's is the λ-adic realization of the Weil–Deligne representation attached to π_𝔭 by the Hecke-normalized local Langlands correspondence. Hence its local L-factor and conductor at 𝔭 are those of π_𝔭.

concept.title: Serre's modularity conjecture (Khare–Wintenberger theorem)
concept.description: Every continuous, odd, absolutely irreducible representation ρ̄:Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ)→GL₂(F̄_p) arises from a normalized cuspidal eigenform of Serre's weight k(ρ̄) and prime-to-p Artin conductor level N(ρ̄).

concept.title: Faltings's isogeny theorem for abelian varieties over number fields
concept.description: For abelian varieties A,B over a number field K and a prime ℓ, the map Hom_K(A,B)⊗ℤ_ℓ→Hom_(G_K)(T_ℓA,T_ℓB) is an isomorphism and V_ℓA is a semisimple G_K-module. For all but finitely many ℓ the mod-ℓ analogue Hom_K(A,B)⊗F_ℓ≅Hom_(G_K)(A[ℓ],B[ℓ]) holds and A[ℓ] is semisimple.

concept.title: λ-adic representations of an abelian variety of GL₂-type
concept.description: For an abelian variety A/ℚ whose endomorphism algebra contains a number field E with [E:ℚ]=dim A, V_ℓ(A) is free of rank two over E⊗ℚ_ℓ. For each prime λ|ℓ of E, V_λ(A)=V_ℓ(A)⊗_(E⊗ℚ_ℓ)E_λ is a two-dimensional E_λ-linear G_ℚ-representation ρ_λ, and an O_E-stable model gives mod-λ reductions on A[λ].

concept.title: Finite dimensionality of weight-two cusp forms
concept.description: For every N≥1 the space S₂(Γ₁(N)) of weight-two cusp forms is finite-dimensional; its dimension is the genus of X₁(N). Consequently there are only finitely many normalized newforms of weight two and level dividing a given integer.

concept.title: Endomorphism algebra of the modular abelian variety of a newform
concept.description: For a normalized weight-two newform f with coefficient field K_f, the modular abelian variety A_f has dimension [K_f:ℚ], and End⁰_ℚ(A_f) is the image of the Hecke algebra, isomorphic to K_f. In particular A_f is ℚ-simple of GL₂-type.

concept.title: Isogeny decomposition of J₁(N) into modular abelian varieties
concept.description: The Jacobian J₁(N) is ℚ-isogenous to a product of modular abelian varieties A_f, with f ranging over Galois-conjugacy classes of normalized weight-two newforms of level M dividing N, each A_f occurring with multiplicity the number of divisors of N/M.

concept.title: Poitou–Tate exact sequence
concept.description: For a number field K, a finite set S of places containing the archimedean places and those above p, and a finite G_(K,S)-module M of p-power order, there is a nine-term exact sequence linking Hⁱ(G_(K,S),M), ∏_(v∈S)Hⁱ(K_v,M) and the Pontryagin duals H^(2−i)(G_(K,S),M′)^∨, where M′=Hom(M,μ). Kato uses its versions for lattices and divisible modules.

concept.title: Local Tate duality
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a finite discrete G_K-module M, cup product followed by the invariant H²(K,μ)≅ℚ/ℤ gives perfect pairings Hⁱ(K,M)×H^(2−i)(K,Hom(M,μ))→ℚ/ℤ for 0≤i≤2.

concept.title: Kato's explicit reciprocity law for zeta elements
concept.description: For a newform f of weight k≥2 and a λ-adic lattice in its Galois realization, Kato's zeta elements in Iwasawa cohomology over the cyclotomic ℤ_p-tower are related by the Bloch–Kato dual exponential at p to period-normalized critical L-values L(f,χ,r), 1≤r≤k−1, for finite-order characters χ.

concept.title: Kato's Euler-system bound
concept.description: For a lattice T in a two-dimensional odd p-adic representation of Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ) satisfying irreducibility, purity and big-image hypotheses, an Euler system over cyclotomic fields with nonzero Iwasawa-theoretic bottom class bounds the length of the second Iwasawa cohomology by the index of the module generated by the Euler system (Kato, Theorem 13.4).

concept.title: Discriminant locus of projective complete intersections
concept.description: For a field K, integers N≥1 and 1≤c≤N+1, and degrees d₁,…,d_c≥1, let V be the affine space of c-tuples (F₁,…,F_c) of homogeneous polynomials in N+1 variables with deg F_i=d_i. The discriminant locus D⊂V is the Zariski-closed set of tuples for which {F₁=⋯=F_c=0}⊂P^N over an algebraic closure is not a smooth complete intersection of codimension c: either the codimension is smaller or the Jacobian matrix (∂F_i/∂x_j) has rank <c at a common zero. It carries its reduced structure; when D is a hypersurface its equation is the discriminant.

concept.title: General point of an algebraic variety
concept.description: A property holds at a general point of an algebraic variety X, or for a general member of a family parametrized by X, if it holds at every point of some dense Zariski-open subset of X. If X is irreducible, every nonempty open subset is dense and finitely many such conditions can be imposed simultaneously.

concept.title: Completed local ring at a point of a scheme
concept.description: For a point x of a scheme X with local ring (O_{X,x},𝔪_x), the completed local ring is Ô_{X,x}=lim←O_{X,x}/𝔪_xⁿ, the inverse limit of the quotient rings under the reduction maps. At a k-rational point of a scheme smooth of dimension n over a field k it is isomorphic to the formal power series ring k[[t₁,…,tₙ]].

concept.title: Ordinary double point
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic different from two, and x a closed point at which X has dimension d. Then x is an ordinary double point of X if its completed local ring is isomorphic to k[[T₁,…,T_{d+1}]]/(Q) for a nondegenerate quadratic form Q in d+1 variables. Such a point is singular.

concept.title: Lattice polytope
concept.description: A lattice polytope in a real vector space (or affine space) equipped with a lattice is the convex hull of finitely many lattice points; it is a convex polytope whose vertices are lattice points.

concept.title: Face of a convex polytope
concept.description: For a convex polytope Q, the convex hull of finitely many points of a real affine space, a face is Q itself or a nonempty subset Q∩{ℓ=c} where ℓ is an affine function with ℓ≤c on Q. Faces are polytopes; dim Γ is the dimension of the affine span of Γ, and codim Γ=dim Q−dim Γ. Vertices are the zero-dimensional faces.

concept.title: Projective toric variety of a lattice point configuration
concept.description: Let T̃ be a split algebraic torus over a field K with character lattice X(T̃), let h:X(T̃)→ℤ be surjective, and let A⊂h⁻¹(1) be a finite set affinely generating the lattice h⁻¹(1). The affine toric variety X̃_A is the Zariski closure in K^A of {(χ(t))_{χ∈A}: t∈T̃}; it is a cone, and its projectivization X_A⊂P^{|A|−1} is the projective toric variety of A, with dense torus T=T̃/G_m and lattice polytope Q=conv(A)⊂h⁻¹(1)⊗ℝ. The torus T̃ acts on the dual coordinates (c_χ) by c_χ↦χ(t)⁻¹c_χ.

concept.title: Projective dual variety and its discriminant
concept.description: Let X⊂P^m be a closed irreducible subvariety over an algebraically closed field. Its conormal (incidence) variety W_X⊂P^m×P̌^m is the closure of the set of pairs (x,H) with x a smooth point of X and H a hyperplane containing the tangent space T_xX. The dual variety X^∨⊂P̌^m is the image of W_X under the second projection p₂. X is defective if X^∨ is not a hypersurface; otherwise the reduced homogeneous equation of X^∨, unique up to a scalar, is the discriminant of X (for a toric X_A, the A-discriminant Δ_A).

concept.title: Degree of a generically finite dominant morphism
concept.description: For a dominant morphism f:X→Y of integral schemes of finite type over a field with dim X=dim Y, the function field K(X) (the fraction field of the coordinate ring of any nonempty affine open) is a finite extension of K(Y) via f, and deg f=[K(X):K(Y)]. Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a general point of Y has exactly deg f preimages.

concept.title: Irreducibility of the complete-intersection discriminant locus
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, the discriminant locus of c-tuples of homogeneous forms of degrees d₁,…,d_c in N+1 variables (those not cutting out a smooth codimension-c complete intersection of P^N) is irreducible. Benoist’s proof projects the incidence variety of pairs (tuple, common zero P at which the Jacobian matrix has rank <c), whose fibres over P^N are irreducible loci of rank-deficient matrices.

concept.title: Versal deformation of an ordinary double point
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two, the hypersurface Q(x₀,…,x_d)=t over the t-line, with Q a nondegenerate quadratic form, is a versal deformation of the ordinary double point Q=0 (SGA 7, Exposé XV). Consequently, in a flat family whose special fibre has an ordinary double point at x, the fibres near the special one have near x at most one singular point, and any such point is again an ordinary double point.

concept.title: Bertini theorem for linear systems
concept.description: Let X be a smooth quasi-projective variety over an algebraically closed field and L a finite-dimensional linear system of divisors on X with base locus B. In characteristic zero, a general member of L is smooth away from B. In arbitrary characteristic the same holds when the morphism X∖B→P(L^∨) defined by L is unramified.

concept.title: Gelfand–Kapranov–Zelevinsky determinantal formula for the A-discriminant
concept.description: Let X_A be a smooth projective toric variety with torus of dimension k−1, S⊂X(T̃) the semigroup generated by A, and for l≫0 let C^i(A,l)=⊕_{u∈S_{i+l}}Λ^i(Γ̃(u)_ℤ⊗K), Γ̃(u) the smallest face of the cone over Q containing u, with the differential ∂_f determined by f∈K^A. If X_A is not defective, Δ_A(f)^µ=det(C^•(A,l),∂_f)^{(−1)^k} up to a nonzero constant, where µ is the degree of the conormal projection W_{X_A}→X_A^∨ (µ=1 in characteristic zero); if X_A is defective the determinant is a nonzero constant.

concept.title: Determinant of a based exact complex
concept.description: For a bounded exact complex (W^•,d) of finite-dimensional vector spaces over a field with chosen bases e(i) of each W^i, its determinant (Cayley torsion) det(W^•,d,e)∈K^× is the alternating product of determinants of the isomorphisms induced by d between complements of the images, computed in the chosen bases. Changing bases by transition matrices M(i) multiplies it by ∏_i det M(i)^{(−1)^i}.

concept.title: Ehrhart’s theorem on lattice-point counts
concept.description: For a lattice polytope P of dimension d, the number of lattice points of its dilate lP is a polynomial in the integer l≥0 of degree d, whose leading coefficient is the volume of P normalized by the lattice (Euclidean volume relative to a fundamental domain of the lattice in the affine span).

concept.title: Serre vanishing theorem
concept.description: If X is a projective scheme over a Noetherian ring with very ample invertible sheaf O(1) and F is a coherent sheaf on X, then H^i(X,F⊗O(l))=0 for all i>0 and all sufficiently large l. In particular, for a closed subscheme X⊂P^m the restriction maps H⁰(P^m,O(l))→H⁰(X,O(l)) are surjective for l≫0.

concept.title: Sections of O(l) on a normal projective toric variety
concept.description: If the projective toric variety X_A of a lattice point configuration A is normal, then for every l≥0 the torus-eigenvectors of H⁰(X_A,O(l)) are the characters u lying in the lattice points of the dilate lQ of its polytope, and these form a basis of H⁰(X_A,O(l)).

concept.title: Reflexivity of projective duality in characteristic zero
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, for a closed irreducible subvariety X⊂P^m the conormal variety of X^∨ is the conormal variety of X with the factors exchanged. Hence (X^∨)^∨=X, and when X^∨ is a hypersurface the projection from the conormal variety W_X onto X^∨ is birational, of degree one. In positive characteristic reflexivity can fail.

concept.title: Noetherian commutative ring
concept.description: A commutative ring in which every ideal is finitely generated; equivalently every ascending chain of ideals is eventually constant.

concept.title: Integrally closed integral domain
concept.description: An integral domain A is integrally closed if every element of its fraction field that is integral over A already lies in A.

concept.title: Dedekind domain
concept.description: A Noetherian integrally closed integral domain of Krull dimension one: it is not a field and every nonzero prime ideal is maximal. Some authors, for example Milne, also admit fields.

concept.title: Integral closure of a Dedekind domain in a finite separable extension
concept.description: If A is a Dedekind domain with fraction field K and L/K is a finite separable field extension, the integral closure of A in L is a Dedekind domain, finitely generated as an A-module.

concept.title: Localization of a Dedekind domain
concept.description: For a Dedekind domain A and a multiplicative subset S not containing0, the localization S⁻¹A is again Noetherian, integrally closed and has every nonzero prime maximal; it is a Dedekind domain unless it is the fraction field.

concept.title: Convex cone in ℝᵈ
concept.description: A nonempty subset C⊆ℝᵈ is a convex cone if λx+μy∈C for all x,y∈C and real λ,μ≥0; equivalently it is convex, contains0 and is closed under nonnegative scaling, so it contains every nonnegative linear combination of its elements.

concept.title: Strict separation of a compact convex set from a disjoint closed convex set
concept.description: If A and B are disjoint nonempty closed convex subsets of ℝᵈ and A is compact, there are a nonzero linear functional φ and c∈ℝ with φ(a)<c<φ(b) for all a∈A and b∈B: some affine hyperplane strictly separates them.

concept.title: Space of compactly supported continuous functions with the inductive-limit topology
concept.description: For a locally compact Hausdorff space X, C_c(X) consists of the continuous complex functions with compact support. It carries the locally convex inductive-limit topology of the subspaces C_K(X) of functions supported in compact K, each with the supremum norm; a seminorm on C_c(X) is continuous exactly when on every C_K(X) it is bounded by a multiple of the supremum norm.

concept.title: Polynomial count of rational points of bounded adelic height
concept.description: For a linear algebraic group G over a number field F with a matrix height ‖·‖ on G(A_F) defined by a faithful representation, there are constants C,N with #{γ∈G(F):‖γ‖≤t}≤Ct^N for all t≥1.

concept.title: Hilbert–Schmidt property of square-integrable integral kernels
concept.description: For a σ-finite measure space (Y,μ), an integral operator on L²(Y) with kernel K∈L²(Y×Y) is Hilbert–Schmidt with Hilbert–Schmidt norm ‖K‖₂; conversely every Hilbert–Schmidt operator on L²(Y) has such a kernel.

concept.title: Products of Hilbert–Schmidt operators are trace class
concept.description: If A and B are Hilbert–Schmidt operators on a Hilbert space, then AB is trace class and ‖AB‖₁≤‖A‖₂‖B‖₂.

concept.title: Compactness of adelic quotients of unipotent groups
concept.description: For a unipotent linear algebraic group N over a number field F, N(F) is a discrete cocompact subgroup of N(A_F): the quotient N(F)∖N(A_F) is compact.

concept.title: Td-group
concept.description: A Hausdorff topological group in which every neighbourhood of the identity contains a compact open subgroup. Such a group is locally compact and totally disconnected; examples are G(F_v) at a nonarchimedean place and finite-adelic points G(A_F^∞).

concept.title: Smooth compactly supported test function on a Lie group times a td-group
concept.description: For G=L×D with L a real Lie group and D a td-group, C_c^∞(G) is the space of finite sums of products f_L(l)f_D(d), with f_L a compactly supported smooth complex function on L and f_D a compactly supported locally constant complex function on D.

concept.title: Dirac sequence on a locally compact group
concept.description: A sequence of nonnegative compactly supported smooth functions f_n with f_n(x⁻¹)=f_n(x) and ∫f_n=1 whose supports eventually lie in every neighbourhood of the identity. For every strongly continuous unitary representation π one then has π(f_n)v→v.

concept.title: Trace-class operators are Hilbert–Schmidt
concept.description: Every trace-class operator T on a Hilbert space is Hilbert–Schmidt, with ‖T‖₂≤‖T‖₁.

concept.title: Affine morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is affine if f⁻¹(V) is an affine scheme for every affine open subscheme V⊆S; it suffices to check this on one affine open cover of S. An S-affine group scheme is a group scheme whose structure map is affine.

concept.title: Generic point of an irreducible scheme
concept.description: A point of an irreducible scheme whose closure is the whole underlying space; every irreducible scheme has exactly one. For a morphism X→S with S irreducible, the generic fiber is the fiber over this point.

concept.title: Étale-local lifting of multiplicative-type subgroups of smooth affine group schemes
concept.description: Let G→S be a smooth affine group scheme, s∈S and H₀⊂G_s a subgroup of multiplicative type. Some étale neighbourhood (S′,s′) of (S,s) with k(s′)=k(s) carries a multiplicative-type subgroup H′⊂G_(S′) whose s′-fiber is H₀ (SGA3 XI 5.8).

concept.title: Smoothness of torus centralizers in smooth affine group schemes
concept.description: If T is a torus in a smooth affine group scheme G over a scheme S, the functorial centralizer Z_G(T) is represented by a smooth closed S-subgroup scheme of G.

concept.title: Fibral isomorphism criterion
concept.description: Let X and Y be finitely presented S-schemes with X flat over S. An S-morphism X→Y that induces an isomorphism X_s→Y_s on every fiber is an isomorphism (EGA IV₄ 17.9.5).

concept.title: Connectedness of torus centralizers in connected algebraic groups
concept.description: In a smooth connected affine algebraic group over an algebraically closed field, the centralizer of a torus is connected; in a connected reductive group it is connected reductive.

concept.title: Smoothness and connectedness of torus-fixed subgroups
concept.description: If a torus acts on a smooth connected affine algebraic group H over a field, the fixed-point subgroup scheme H^T is smooth and connected.

concept.title: Étaleness of the Weyl group scheme of a torus
concept.description: For a torus T in a smooth affine group scheme G over S, the normalizer N_G(T) is a smooth closed subgroup and W_G(T)=N_G(T)/Z_G(T) is a separated étale S-group scheme of finite presentation, quasi-finite over S.

concept.title: Constructibility of the geometrically connected fiber locus
concept.description: For a finitely presented morphism of schemes X→S, the set of points s∈S whose fiber X_s is geometrically connected is locally constructible in S (EGA IV₃ 9.7.7).

concept.title: Specialization criterion for closedness of constructible sets
concept.description: A constructible subset Y of a Noetherian scheme S is closed if and only if it is stable under specialization; equivalently, for every morphism Spec R→S from a discrete valuation ring, if the generic point maps into Y then so does the closed point.

concept.title: Local constancy of root systems along a split maximal torus
concept.description: Let G→S be a smooth affine group scheme whose geometric fibers have connected reductive identity components, and T⊂G a split torus maximal on geometric fibers. Then the root systems Φ(G⁰_s,T_s) are locally constant on S: for s near s₀ they identify with Φ(G⁰_(s₀),T_(s₀)) through the character group of T.

concept.title: Zariski's Main Theorem for quasi-finite morphisms
concept.description: Let S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and f:X→S a separated quasi-finite morphism of finite presentation. Then f factors as a quasi-compact open immersion X→T followed by a finite morphism T→S of finite presentation (Grothendieck’s form of Zariski’s Main Theorem, EGA IV₃ 8.12.6, 18.12.13).

concept.title: Linear differential operator with smooth coefficients
concept.description: On an open set U⊆ℝⁿ, an operator P=∑_(|α|≤m)a_α(x)∂^α with smooth complex coefficients a_α; its order is the largest |α| with a_α≠0. It acts on smooth functions and, through its formal transpose, on distributions. The notion is local and passes through charts to smooth manifolds, e.g. to left-invariant operators on Lie groups.

concept.title: Elliptic linear differential operator
concept.description: A linear differential operator P=∑_(|α|≤m)a_α∂^α of order m with smooth coefficients on U is elliptic if its principal symbol ∑_(|α|=m)a_α(x)ξ^α is nonzero for every x∈U and every nonzero ξ∈ℝⁿ.

concept.title: Fundamental solution of a linear differential operator at a point
concept.description: For a linear differential operator P with smooth coefficients on an open set U∋x₀, a fundamental solution at x₀ is a distribution E on U with PE=δ_(x₀), the Dirac distribution φ↦φ(x₀). It is local when U is only some neighbourhood of x₀.

concept.title: Meromorphic function of several complex variables
concept.description: A function on a connected open subset of ℂⁿ that is locally a quotient g/h of holomorphic functions, with h not identically zero; it is holomorphic off the zero set of the denominators.

concept.title: Normalized parabolic induction for adelic reductive groups
concept.description: For an F-parabolic P=MN of a connected reductive number-field group G, compatible maximal compact K, a unitary representation σ of M(A_F) and λ∈a*_(P,C), I_P(σ,λ) is right translation on functions φ:G(A_F)→V_σ with φ(nmg)=σ(m)e^((λ+ρ_P)(H_P(m)))φ(g), square-integrable on K. The factor e^(ρ_P(H_P))=δ_P^(1/2) makes it unitary for λ∈ia*_P.

concept.title: Cuspidal datum of a reductive number-field group
concept.description: An equivalence class of pairs (M,σ) with M a Levi subgroup of an F-parabolic subgroup of G and σ a cuspidal automorphic representation of M(A_F)¹; (M,σ) and (M′,σ′) are equivalent if some element of G(F) conjugates M to M′ and carries σ to a representation unitarily equivalent to σ′.

concept.title: Direct integral of unitary representations
concept.description: For a σ-finite measure space (X,μ), a separable Hilbert space H and a family x↦π_x of unitary representations of G on H with measurable matrix coefficients, the direct integral acts on L²(X,μ;H), the square-integrable measurable H-valued functions modulo null functions, by (πF)(x)=π_x(g)F(x). Measurable fields of varying Hilbert spaces are treated likewise.

concept.title: Eisenstein series on a reductive number-field group
concept.description: For an F-parabolic P of a connected reductive group G, a K-finite automorphic vector φ in the space of the induced representation I_P(λ) and λ∈a*_(P,C), E(x,φ,λ)=∑_(δ∈P(F)∖G(F))φ(δx)e^((λ+ρ_P)(H_P(δx))). It converges absolutely for Re λ∈ρ_P+(a*_P)⁺ and, by Langlands, continues meromorphically to a*_(P,C).

concept.title: Monomorphism in a category
concept.description: A morphism f:X→Y of a category is a monomorphism if it is left cancellable: f∘a=f∘b implies a=b for every object W and all morphisms a,b:W→X.

concept.title: Epimorphism in a category
concept.description: A morphism f:X→Y of a category is an epimorphism if it is right cancellable: a∘f=b∘f implies a=b for every object W and all morphisms a,b:Y→W.

concept.title: Zero morphism in a category with a zero object
concept.description: In a category with a zero object 0, the zero morphism X→Y is the composite X→0→Y of the unique morphisms through 0. Any composite of a zero morphism with another morphism is again a zero morphism.

concept.title: Kernel of a morphism in a category with a zero object
concept.description: For a morphism f:X→Y in a category with a zero object, a kernel of f is a morphism k:K→X with f∘k=0 such that every g:W→X with f∘g=0 factors as g=k∘h for a unique h:W→K.

concept.title: Cokernel of a morphism in a category with a zero object
concept.description: For a morphism f:X→Y in a category with a zero object, a cokernel of f is a morphism c:Y→C with c∘f=0 such that every g:Y→W with g∘f=0 factors as g=h∘c for a unique h:C→W.

concept.title: Product of a family of objects in a category
concept.description: For a family (X_i)_{i∈I} of objects of a category, a product is an object P with morphisms p_i:P→X_i such that for every object W and morphisms f_i:W→X_i there is a unique f:W→P with p_i∘f=f_i for all i.

concept.title: Coproduct of a family of objects in a category
concept.description: For a family (X_i)_{i∈I} of objects of a category, a coproduct is an object Q with morphisms q_i:X_i→Q such that for every object W and morphisms f_i:X_i→W there is a unique f:Q→W with f∘q_i=f_i for all i.

concept.title: Object of finite length in an abelian category
concept.description: An object X of an abelian category has finite length if it has a finite chain of subobjects 0=X_0⊂X_1⊂⋯⊂X_n=X whose successive quotients X_i/X_{i−1}, the cokernels of the inclusions, are simple objects. Such a chain is a Jordan–Hölder (composition) series of X.

concept.title: Braided monoidal functor
concept.description: A strong monoidal functor (F,J) between braided monoidal categories is braided if J_{Y,X}∘c_{F(X),F(Y)}=F(c_{X,Y})∘J_{X,Y} for all objects X,Y. A braided monoidal equivalence is a braided monoidal functor whose underlying functor is an equivalence of categories.

concept.title: Deligne tensor product of locally finite abelian categories
concept.description: For locally finite k-linear abelian categories C and D, the Deligne tensor product C⊠D is a k-linear abelian category with a bilinear bifunctor ⊠:C×D→C⊠D, right exact in each variable, such that every bilinear bifunctor C×D→A right exact in each variable factors as F̄∘⊠ for a unique right exact functor F̄:C⊠D→A.

concept.title: Opposite monoidal category
concept.description: For a monoidal category (C,⊗,a,1), the opposite monoidal category C^op (also written C^{⊗op} or C^rev) has the same underlying category, tensor product X⊗^op Y=Y⊗X and associativity constraint a^op_{X,Y,Z}=a^{-1}_{Z,Y,X}. It differs from the dual category with reversed morphisms.

concept.title: Drinfeld center as the dual category of C⊠C^op
concept.description: Let C be a finite multitensor category, regarded as a module category over C⊠C^op by (X⊠Y)⊗M=X⊗M⊗Y. The dual category Fun_{C⊠C^op}(C,C) of module endofunctors is canonically tensor equivalent to the Drinfeld center Z(C): a bimodule endofunctor −⊗Z corresponds to Z with the half-braiding given by its right module structure.

concept.title: Coset of a subgroup
concept.description: For a subgroup H of a group G and g∈G, the left coset gH={gh:h∈H}, written g+H in additive notation. The left cosets of H partition G and each is in bijection with H.

concept.title: Order of an element of a group
concept.description: The order of g in a group G is the least positive integer n with gⁿ=e, or infinite if no such n exists.

concept.title: Exponent of a finite group
concept.description: The exponent of a finite group G is the least common multiple of the orders of its elements, equivalently the least positive integer n with gⁿ=e for every g∈G.

concept.title: Irreducible linear representation of a group
concept.description: A linear representation ρ:G→GL(V) is irreducible if V≠0 and the only subspaces W⊆V with ρ(g)W⊆W for every g∈G are 0 and V.

concept.title: Fenchel–Moreau biconjugation theorem
concept.description: A proper function f:E→(−∞,∞] on a real Banach space, for example ℝᵈ, equals its biconjugate f** on E, where f**(x)=sup_{x*∈E*}(⟨x*,x⟩−f*(x*)), if and only if f is convex and lower semicontinuous.

concept.title: Brøndsted–Rockafellar theorem
concept.description: Let f be a proper lower semicontinuous convex function on a real Banach space, x₀∈dom f, ε>0 and x₀* an ε-subgradient at x₀. For every λ>0 there are x and x*∈∂f(x) with ‖x−x₀‖≤ε/λ and ‖x*−x₀*‖≤λ. Consequently every x∈dom f is a limit of points x_k∈dom ∂f with f(x_k)→f(x).

concept.title: Frobenius–Perron dimension is a ring homomorphism
concept.description: For a fusion category C, the assignment X↦FPdim(X) extends to a ring homomorphism from the Grothendieck ring K(C) to ℝ. It is the unique ring homomorphism K(C)→ℝ taking positive values on all classes of simple objects.

concept.title: Cyclotomicity of characters of the Grothendieck ring of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ and an irreducible finite-dimensional complex representation L of its Grothendieck ring K(C), there is a root of unity ξ with Tr([X],L)∈ℤ[ξ] for every object X. In particular every ring homomorphism K(C)→ℂ takes values in ℤ[ξ] for some root of unity ξ.

concept.title: Unique factorization of ideals in a Dedekind domain
concept.description: In a Dedekind domain every nonzero proper ideal is a product of nonzero prime ideals, uniquely up to order. Consequently the nonzero fractional ideals form a group, free abelian on the nonzero prime ideals, and for nonzero integral ideals a⊇b holds exactly when a divides b.

concept.title: Multiplicativity of the absolute ideal norm
concept.description: For a number field K the absolute norm N(a)=|O_K/a| of nonzero ideals of O_K is multiplicative: N(ab)=N(a)N(b). If p is a nonzero prime of O_K with p∩ℤ=pℤ, then N(p)=p^f with f=[O_K/p:𝔽_p]; hence N(a)ℤ is the relative ideal norm of a from K to ℚ.

concept.title: Inequality of arithmetic and geometric means
concept.description: For nonnegative reals x₁,…,x_n, (x₁x₂⋯x_n)^{1/n}≤(x₁+⋯+x_n)/n, with equality exactly when all x_i are equal.

concept.title: Determinant square class of a quadratic space
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space V over a field F of characteristic different from two, its determinant (or discriminant) d(V) is det(B(e_i,e_j)) for a basis e₁,…,e_n, regarded in F×/(F×)²; a change of basis multiplies the determinant by a nonzero square. For a diagonalization ∑a_ix_i², d(V)=a₁⋯a_n.

concept.title: Characterization of the hyperbolic plane
concept.description: For a nondegenerate two-dimensional quadratic space V over a field of characteristic different from two, the following are equivalent: V is isotropic; V≅⟨1,−1⟩, the hyperbolic plane; V≅⟨a,−a⟩ for every nonzero a; −d(V) is a square. Hence all isotropic nondegenerate binary spaces are isometric.

concept.title: Representation criterion via isotropy of an orthogonal sum
concept.description: Let V be a nondegenerate quadratic space over a field of characteristic different from two and a a nonzero scalar. Then V represents a, meaning Q(x)=a for some x∈V, if and only if the orthogonal sum V⊥⟨−a⟩ is isotropic.

concept.title: Orthogonal splitting off a nondegenerate subspace
concept.description: If W is a nondegenerate subspace of a quadratic space V over a field of characteristic different from two, then V=W⊥W^⊥. In particular, if Q(x)=a≠0 then V=⟨a⟩⊥(Fx)^⊥.

concept.title: Isotropy criterion for quaternary quadratic spaces over ℚ_p
concept.description: A nondegenerate four-dimensional quadratic space V over ℚ_p is isotropic if and only if either its determinant d(V) is not a square, or d(V) is a square and its Hasse invariant equals the Hilbert symbol (−1,−1)_p. When d(V) is a square the i<j and i≤j Hasse-invariant conventions agree.

concept.title: Isotropy of quadratic spaces of dimension at least five over ℚ_p
concept.description: Every nondegenerate quadratic space of dimension at least five over ℚ_p is isotropic. Consequently every nondegenerate quaternary quadratic space over ℚ_p represents every nonzero p-adic number.

concept.title: Riemann–Roch theorem for smooth projective curves
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus g over a field k, K a canonical divisor (of a nonzero rational differential) and ℓ(D)=dim_k{f∈k(C)×:div f+D≥0}∪{0}. Then ℓ(D)−ℓ(K−D)=deg D+1−g for every divisor D. Cohomologically χ(O(D))=deg D+1−g and H¹(C,O(D)) is dual to H⁰(C,Ω¹(−D)), so g=dim H¹(C,O_C).

concept.title: Global regular functions on a proper geometrically integral scheme
concept.description: If X is a proper geometrically integral scheme over a field k, then H⁰(X,O_X)=k, so every global regular function is constant. If X is merely a proper integral scheme over k, then H⁰(X,O_X) is a field finite over k.

concept.title: Projective embeddings of a genus-zero curve by positive-degree line bundles
concept.description: Let X be a proper curve over a field k with H⁰(X,O_X)=k and H¹(X,O_X)=0. For an invertible O_X-module L of degree d>0, dim H⁰(X,L)=d+1, H¹(X,L)=0 and a basis of H⁰(X,L) defines a closed immersion X→ℙ^d_k. For d=1 this gives an isomorphism X≅ℙ¹_k.

concept.title: Holomorphic map between complex manifolds
concept.description: A continuous map f:M→N between complex analytic manifolds is holomorphic if its expressions in holomorphic charts are holomorphic functions of several complex variables, equivalently if h∘f is holomorphic for every holomorphic function h on an open subset of N. A biholomorphism is a holomorphic bijection with holomorphic inverse.

concept.title: Complex tangent space of a complex manifold
concept.description: For a point p of a complex manifold M of dimension n, T_pM is the complex vector space of ℂ-linear derivations D of germs of holomorphic functions at p, D(fg)=D(f)g(p)+f(p)D(g). In local coordinates it has basis ∂/∂z_i. A holomorphic map F has ℂ-linear differential d_pF(v)(f)=v(f∘F); a holomorphic curve γ has velocity γ′(z)=d_zγ(1).

concept.title: Complex Lie group
concept.description: A group G with a structure of complex analytic manifold for which multiplication G×G→G and inversion are holomorphic. Forgetting the complex structure, G is a real Lie group of twice its complex dimension; its Lie algebra is the complex tangent space at the identity. Morphisms are holomorphic group homomorphisms.

concept.title: Holomorphic existence, uniqueness and parameter dependence for ODEs
concept.description: Let F(t,w,λ) be holomorphic on an open subset of ℂ×ℂⁿ×ℂᵐ. Near each point (t₀,w₀,λ₀) the initial-value problem w′=F(t,w,λ), w(t₀)=w₀ has a unique holomorphic solution on a disk around t₀, and the solution depends holomorphically on (t,w₀,λ).

concept.title: Topology induced by a metric
concept.description: For a metric space (X,d), the topology whose open sets are the subsets U⊆X such that every x∈U has some r>0 with open ball B(x,r)={y:d(x,y)<r}⊆U.

concept.title: Basin of attraction of a periodic orbit
concept.description: For a self-map F of a metric space and a periodic orbit O of least period p, the basin of O is the set of points x for which the iterates F^{np}(x) converge, as n→∞, to some point of O.

concept.title: C¹ topology on maps of a compact interval
concept.description: On C¹ maps of a compact interval I into ℝ, the topology induced by the metric d(f,g)=sup_I|f−g|+sup_I|f′−g′|, with one-sided derivatives at the endpoints; g is C¹-close to f when d(f,g) is small.

concept.title: Rising factorial (Pochhammer symbol)
concept.description: For a real number a and an integer m≥0, (a)₀=1 and (a)_m=a(a+1)⋯(a+m−1).

concept.title: Gegenbauer polynomial
concept.description: For λ>0 and an integer k≥0, the Gegenbauer (ultraspherical) polynomial is C_k^λ(x)=∑_{j=0}^{⌊k/2⌋}(−1)^j(λ)_{k−j}(2x)^{k−2j}/(j!(k−2j)!), with (a)_m the rising factorial. Equivalently, (1−2xt+t²)^{−λ}=∑_{k≥0}C_k^λ(x)t^k for |x|≤1 and |t|<1.

concept.title: Distance from a point to a subset of a metric space
concept.description: For a nonempty subset A of a metric space (X,d) and x∈X, d(x,A)=inf{d(x,a):a∈A}.

concept.title: Set of finite perimeter in Euclidean space
concept.description: A Lebesgue measurable E⊆ℝⁿ whose indicator has distributional gradient D1_E given by an ℝⁿ-valued Radon measure of finite total variation; its perimeter is |D1_E|(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Brenier–McCann theorem
concept.description: If μ and ν are Borel probability measures on ℝⁿ and μ is absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure, there is a convex function φ whose gradient, defined μ-almost everywhere, pushes μ forward to ν; this gradient map is unique μ-almost everywhere.

concept.title: Gradients of convex functions are locally of bounded variation
concept.description: If φ:ℝⁿ→ℝ is convex, then ∇φ is locally of bounded variation and its distributional derivative D∇φ is a Radon measure with values in symmetric positive semidefinite n×n matrices.

concept.title: McCann’s almost-everywhere Monge–Ampère equation for Brenier maps
concept.description: If T=∇φ is the Brenier map pushing f(x)dx to g(y)dy, with probability densities f and g, then g(T(x))det∇²φ(x)=f(x) for almost every x with f(x)>0, where ∇²φ is the absolutely continuous part (Aleksandrov Hessian) of D∇φ.

concept.title: Divergence theorem for BV vector fields on sets of finite perimeter
concept.description: If E⊆ℝⁿ has finite perimeter and T∈BV(ℝⁿ;ℝⁿ) is bounded, then the distributional divergence satisfies Div T(E^{(1)})=∫_{∂*E}tr_E(T)·ν_E dH^{n−1}, where E^{(1)} is the set of density-one points, ∂*E the reduced boundary with outer normal ν_E, and tr_E(T) the inner trace.

concept.title: Bounded Lipschitz domains have finite perimeter
concept.description: A bounded Lipschitz domain E⊂ℝⁿ is a set of finite perimeter; H^{n−1}-almost all of ∂E lies in its reduced boundary, where the measure-theoretic outer normal equals the classical outer unit normal, and D1_E=−ν_E H^{n−1}⌊∂E.

concept.title: Muckenhoupt’s weighted maximal inequality
concept.description: For 1<p<∞ and a weight w in the Muckenhoupt class A_p on ℝⁿ, the Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator satisfies ∫(Mf)^p w≤C∫|f|^p w, with C depending only on n, p and the A_p constant of w.

concept.title: Aₚ extrapolation into variable Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: Suppose nonnegative pairs (f,g) satisfy ∫f^{p₀}w≤C∫g^{p₀}w for some 1<p₀<∞ and every A_{p₀} weight w, with C depending on the A_{p₀} constant. If 1<p₁<p⁻ and the maximal operator is bounded on L^{(p(·)/p₁)′}, then ∥f∥_{p(·)}≤C∥g∥_{p(·)} when the left side is finite, and ∥(∑_j f_j^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}≤C∥(∑_j g_j^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)} for 1<q<∞.

concept.title: Boundedness of the maximal operator on log-Hölder variable Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: If p is globally log-Hölder continuous with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞, then the Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator is bounded on L^{p(·)}(ℝⁿ): ∥Mf∥_{p(·)}≤C∥f∥_{p(·)}.

concept.title: Radial boundary function of a function on the unit disk
concept.description: For a function f on the unit disk 𝔻 and ζ on the unit circle, the radial limit f*(ζ)=lim_{r→1⁻} f(rζ) is taken along the radius ending at ζ. The radial boundary function f* is defined at those ζ where this limit exists; Hardy-space results assert existence almost everywhere for arc-length measure.

concept.title: Strictly convex body
concept.description: A convex body K⊂ℝᵈ is strictly convex if its boundary contains no line segment of positive length; equivalently, every supporting hyperplane of K meets K in exactly one point.

concept.title: Fatou’s nontangential limit theorem for bounded holomorphic functions
concept.description: If f is bounded and holomorphic on the unit disk, then for almost every ζ on the unit circle f(z) converges as z→ζ inside every Stolz angle {z∈𝔻:|z−ζ|<α(1−|z|)}, α>1. In particular its radial limits exist almost everywhere and equal these nontangential limits.

concept.title: Beurling’s characterization of cyclic functions in Hardy H²
concept.description: A nonzero f∈H² of the unit disk has polynomial multiples dense in H² exactly when log|f*| is integrable on the circle and f(z)=c·exp∫(ζ+z)/(ζ−z)·log|f*(ζ)|dm(ζ) with |c|=1, where m is normalized arc measure. Thus the cyclic and the exponential definitions of outer functions agree in H².

concept.title: Differentiability criterion for support functions
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ and u≠0, the support function h_K is differentiable at u exactly when the support set {x∈K:⟨x,u⟩=h_K(u)} is a single point x; then ∇h_K(u)=x.

concept.title: Area formula for a C¹ parametrized hypersurface
concept.description: If M⊂ℝⁿ⁻¹ is open and X:M→ℝⁿ is an injective C¹ map whose differential has rank n−1 everywhere, then H^{n−1}(X(A))=∫_A √det(DX(y)ᵀDX(y)) dy for every Borel set A⊆M, where H^{n−1} is (n−1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure.

concept.title: Local Steiner formula for convex bodies
concept.description: For every convex body K⊂ℝⁿ of any dimension there are finite positive Borel measures Θ₀(K,·),…,Θ_{n−1}(K,·) on ℝⁿ×S^{n−1} such that, for each Borel η and ρ>0, the points x with 0<d(K,x)≤ρ whose nearest point and normal direction (p(K,x),u(K,x)) lie in η have volume n⁻¹∑_m C(n,m)ρ^{n−m}Θ_m(K,η). Each Θ_m(K,·) depends weakly continuously on K in Hausdorff distance.

concept.title: Hausdorff-measure description of the top area measure of a convex body
concept.description: For an n-dimensional convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, the area measure S_{n−1}(K,ω)=Θ_{n−1}(K,ℝⁿ×ω) given by the local Steiner formula equals the (n−1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the set of boundary points of K having an outer unit normal in ω. For bodies of dimension n−1 it is concentrated on the two unit normals of their affine hull, and it vanishes in lower dimensions.

concept.title: Minkowski’s existence theorem for polytopes
concept.description: If u₁,…,u_N are pairwise distinct unit vectors spanning ℝⁿ and f₁,…,f_N>0 satisfy ∑f_iu_i=0, there is an n-dimensional convex polytope whose facet outer unit normals are exactly u₁,…,u_N and whose facet with normal u_i has (n−1)-dimensional volume f_i.

concept.title: Blaschke selection theorem
concept.description: Every sequence of nonempty compact convex subsets of ℝⁿ contained in a fixed ball has a subsequence converging in Hausdorff distance to a nonempty compact convex set.

concept.title: Kummer map of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a characteristic-zero field K and n≥1, the connecting map of 0→A[n](K̄)→A(K̄)→A(K̄)→0 (multiplication by n) is the injective map A(K)/nA(K)→H¹(K,A[n](K̄)), sending P to the class of σ↦σ(Q)−Q for any Q with nQ=P. For K a finite extension of some ℚ_ℓ and a prime p, the maps for n=p^m pass to the limit and, after ⊗ℚ_p, give the local Kummer map κ:A(K)^∧⊗_(ℤ_p)ℚ_p→H¹(K,V_pA) in continuous cohomology, where A(K)^∧ is the p-adic completion.

concept.title: Scalar extension of a finite separable field extension
concept.description: For a finite separable extension K/k and any field extension Ω/k, K⊗_kΩ is a finite product of finite separable field extensions of Ω, one for each irreducible factor over Ω of the minimal polynomial of a primitive element. If Ω contains a normal closure of K/k, for example if Ω is algebraically closed, then a⊗b↦(σ(a)b)_σ gives K⊗_kΩ≅∏_(σ∈Hom_k(K,Ω))Ω.

concept.title: Completion decomposition of a finite separable extension
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite separable extension and |·| an archimedean or discrete nonarchimedean absolute value on K with completion K̂. Then |·| has finitely many extensions |·|₁,…,|·|_g to L, and a⊗b↦(ab)_i gives L⊗_KK̂≅∏_iL_i, where L_i is the completion of L at |·|_i. For a number field F and a prime ℓ this is F⊗_ℚℚ_ℓ≅∏_(λ|ℓ)F_λ.

concept.title: Casselman’s newform theorem for local components of GL₂
concept.description: For an irreducible infinite-dimensional admissible representation π of GL₂(F), F a nonarchimedean local field, the vectors fixed by K₁(𝔭^c)={(a b;c d)∈GL₂(O):c≡0, d≡1 mod 𝔭^c} vanish for c<a(π) and form a line for c=a(π), the conductor exponent. For the automorphic representation of a normalized newform of level N, the local component at p therefore has a(π_p)=v_p(N).

concept.title: Mackey restriction formula for induced representations
concept.description: Let H and K be subgroups of a group G with H of finite index (open, for profinite G and continuous actions). For an H-module W, Res^G_K Ind^G_H W≅⊕_(s∈K\G/H) Ind^K_(K∩sHs⁻¹)(ˢW), where ˢW is W with action k·w=(s⁻¹ks)w of K∩sHs⁻¹.

concept.title: Artin formalism for L-functions of ℓ-adic Galois representations
concept.description: For compatible systems of ℓ-adic representations of absolute Galois groups of number fields, with Euler factors det(1−Frob_v⁻¹(Nv)^(−s)|(V^∨)^(I_v))^(−1) at every finite place, L(ρ⊕ρ′,s)=L(ρ,s)L(ρ′,s), and for a finite extension K/F, L(Ind_(G_K)^(G_F)ρ,s)=L(ρ,s), with equality of all local factors including ramified places.

concept.title: Tate module of a quadratic twist of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a characteristic-zero field F, D∈F×∖(F×)² and a prime ℓ, an F(√D)-isomorphism E→E^D identifies T_ℓ(E^D)≅T_ℓ(E)⊗κ_D as G_F-modules, where κ_D(σ)=σ(√D)/√D∈{±1} is the quadratic character of F(√D)/F.

concept.title: Tate-module description of elliptic-curve Euler factors
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field K, a finite prime 𝔭 and ℓ prime to 𝔭, det(1−Frob_𝔭⁻¹T|(V_ℓE^∨)^(I_𝔭)) is 1−a_𝔭T+N𝔭T² at good reduction, 1−T at split multiplicative, 1+T at nonsplit multiplicative and 1 at additive reduction. Hence the Hasse–Weil L-function defined by reduction types is the L-function of the ℓ-adic representation V_ℓE^∨.

concept.title: Pullback of a line bundle by multiplication on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A, an integer n and an invertible sheaf L on A, n_A^*L≅L^((n²+n)/2)⊗((−1)_A^*L)^((n²−n)/2). In particular n_A^*L≅L^(n²) when L is symmetric. This is a consequence of the theorem of the cube.

concept.title: Intersection number of divisors on a smooth projective variety
concept.description: For divisors D₁,…,D_g on a smooth projective variety V of dimension g over an algebraically closed field, (D₁,…,D_g) is the sum over points v of the common support of dim_k O_(V,v)/(f₁,…,f_g), f_i local equations, when the D_i are effective and meet in finitely many points; it is extended by linearity and invariance under linear equivalence to all g-tuples.

concept.title: Multidimensional time-dependent Itô formula for càdlàg semimartingales
concept.description: Let Y be an ℝᵈ-valued càdlàg semimartingale, T<∞, D⊆ℝᵈ open and f∈C^{1,2}([0,T]×D) (∂_tf, ∂_jf, ∂_j∂_kf continuous and extending continuously to [0,T]×D), and suppose almost surely the closure of the path Y[0,T] lies in D, i.e. Y_t and Y_(t−) lie in D for t≤T. Then for t≤T, f(t,Y_t)=f(0,Y_0)+∫₀ᵗ∂_sf(s,Y_s)ds+Σ_j∫_(0,t]∂_jf(s,Y_(s−))dY^j_s+½Σ_(j,k)∫_(0,t]∂_j∂_kf(s,Y_(s−))d[Y^j,Y^k]_s+Σ_(0<s≤t)[f(s,Y_s)−f(s,Y_(s−))−∇f(s,Y_(s−))·ΔY_s−½ΔY_sᵀD²f(s,Y_(s−))ΔY_s], the jump sum converging absolutely; for continuous Y it vanishes.

concept.title: Local martingale with integrable running maximum is a martingale
concept.description: A right-continuous local martingale M with sup_(0≤s≤t)|M_s| integrable for every t≥0 is a martingale. In particular a local martingale bounded on every bounded time interval is a martingale.

concept.title: Nonnegative local martingales are supermartingales
concept.description: A nonnegative local martingale X with EX₀<∞ is a supermartingale. It is a martingale if and only if EX_t=EX₀ for every time t; the same holds on a finite horizon [0,T].

concept.title: Existence of countable product probability measures
concept.description: For probability spaces (Ω_i,𝔽_i,P_i), i∈ℕ, there is a unique probability measure P on the product σ-algebra of ∏_iΩ_i with P(A₁×⋯×A_n×∏_(i>n)Ω_i)=∏_(i≤n)P_i(A_i) for all n and A_i∈𝔽_i. Under P the coordinate maps are independent random elements with laws P_i.

concept.title: Lindelöf property of separable metric spaces
concept.description: Every cover of a subset of a separable metric space by open sets has a countable subcover.

concept.title: Noetherian topological space
concept.description: A topological space satisfying the descending chain condition on closed subsets: every decreasing sequence Z₁⊇Z₂⊇⋯ of closed subsets is eventually constant. Equivalently every nonempty family of closed subsets has a minimal member, which is what Noetherian induction uses.

concept.title: Locally closed subset of a topological space
concept.description: A subset of a topological space that is the intersection U∩Z of an open subset U and a closed subset Z.

concept.title: Constructible subset of a Noetherian topological space
concept.description: A subset of a Noetherian topological space that is a finite union of locally closed subsets. Equivalently it belongs to the smallest family of subsets containing every open subset and closed under finite intersections and complements; finite unions, intersections, complements and continuous preimages of constructible sets are constructible.

concept.title: Noetherian scheme
concept.description: A scheme is locally Noetherian if it is covered by open affine subschemes Spec A with each A a Noetherian ring, and Noetherian if moreover it is quasi-compact, equivalently covered by finitely many such affine opens. The underlying topological space of a Noetherian scheme is a Noetherian topological space.

concept.title: Local dimension of a topological space at a point
concept.description: For a point x of a topological space X, dim_x X is the minimum of the Krull dimensions of the open neighbourhoods of x, each with the subspace topology. For a scheme the local dimension is that of its underlying space.

concept.title: Algebraically independent subset of a field extension
concept.description: A subset S of a field extension L/K is algebraically independent over K if no nonzero polynomial with coefficients in K vanishes when evaluated at finitely many distinct elements of S; otherwise S is algebraically dependent over K.

concept.title: Transcendence degree of a field extension
concept.description: A transcendence basis of L/K is an algebraically independent subset S over K such that L is algebraic over K(S). Transcendence bases exist and all have the same cardinality, the transcendence degree trdeg_K L; equivalently it is the cardinality of a maximal algebraically independent subset.

concept.title: Character group of a finite abelian group
concept.description: For a finite abelian group G, its character group or dual group Ĝ is the set of group homomorphisms G→ℂ^×, a group under pointwise multiplication. Every character takes values in roots of unity, so Ĝ equals the group of homomorphisms from G to the unit circle.

concept.title: Laplace transform of a function on the half-line
concept.description: For a locally integrable f:[0,∞)→ℂ, its Laplace transform is g(z)=∫₀^∞f(t)e^(−zt)dt at those complex z for which the Lebesgue integral converges absolutely. If f is bounded the integral converges absolutely and locally uniformly on Re z>0, where g is holomorphic.

concept.title: Finite morphisms of schemes are closed
concept.description: A finite morphism of schemes, and more generally an integral morphism, is a closed map: the image of every closed subset of the source is closed in the target. Affinely this is the lying-over theorem for the integral ring map B/J→A/I.

concept.title: Noether normalization lemma
concept.description: If A is a finitely generated algebra over a field k, there are elements x₁,…,x_d of A, algebraically independent over k, such that A is a finitely generated module over the polynomial subalgebra k[x₁,…,x_d].

concept.title: Lying-over and going-up theorems for integral extensions
concept.description: Let A⊆B be commutative rings with B integral over A. Every prime ideal of A is the contraction of a prime ideal of B (lying over), and if 𝔭⊆𝔭′ are primes of A and 𝔮 is a prime of B over 𝔭, there is a prime 𝔮′⊇𝔮 of B over 𝔭′ (going up).

concept.title: Prime ideals of a localization
concept.description: For a multiplicative subset S of a commutative ring A, the map 𝔭↦S⁻¹𝔭 is an inclusion-preserving bijection from the prime ideals of A disjoint from S onto the prime ideals of S⁻¹A, with inverse given by contraction along A→S⁻¹A.

concept.title: Transitivity of algebraic field extensions
concept.description: If K⊆L⊆M are fields with M algebraic over L and L algebraic over K, then M is algebraic over K.

concept.title: Quasi-finite ring map
concept.description: A finite-type homomorphism R→S of commutative rings is quasi-finite at a prime 𝔮 of S, lying over 𝔭⊂R, if 𝔮 is an isolated point of its fibre Spec(S⊗_Rκ(𝔭)); it is quasi-finite if this holds at every prime, equivalently if every fibre ring S⊗_Rκ(𝔭) is finite-dimensional over κ(𝔭).

concept.title: Dimension inequality for a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings
concept.description: If (A,𝔪)→(B,𝔫) is a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, then dim B≤dim A+dim(B/𝔪B), with equality when B is flat over A.

concept.title: Functional equation of the Riemann zeta function
concept.description: The completed function Λ(s)=π^(−s/2)Γ(s/2)ζ(s) extends meromorphically to ℂ with simple poles only at s=0 and s=1 and satisfies Λ(s)=Λ(1−s). Consequently, outside the strip 0≤Re s≤1 the zeros of ζ are exactly the simple zeros at the negative even integers.

concept.title: Hadamard product for the Riemann xi function
concept.description: The entire function ξ(s)=s(s−1)π^(−s/2)Γ(s/2)ζ(s) has order one and ξ(s)=e^(A+Bs)∏_ρ(1−s/ρ)e^(s/ρ), the product running over the nontrivial zeros of ζ with multiplicity and converging absolutely and locally uniformly. Hence ξ′(s)/ξ(s)=B+∑_ρ(1/(s−ρ)+1/ρ).

concept.title: Polynomial growth of the Riemann zeta function in vertical strips
concept.description: For every real σ₀ there is A=A(σ₀) such that ζ(σ+it)=O(|t|^A) uniformly for σ≥σ₀ and |t|≥2.

concept.title: Local partial-fraction formula for the logarithmic derivative of zeta
concept.description: Uniformly for −1≤σ≤2 and |t|≥2, at points s=σ+it which are not zeros of ζ, ζ′(s)/ζ(s)=∑_(ρ:|t−Im ρ|<1)1/(s−ρ)+O(log|t|), the sum running over nontrivial zeros with multiplicity.

concept.title: Von Mangoldt series for the logarithmic derivative of zeta
concept.description: For Re s>1, −ζ′(s)/ζ(s)=∑_(n≥1)Λ(n)n^(−s), where Λ is the von Mangoldt function; the series converges absolutely and arises by logarithmic differentiation of the Euler product.

concept.title: Truncated Perron formula
