concept.description: Let G be a profinite group and P a closed normal pro-p subgroup such that G/P is finite of order prime to p. Then P has a complement in G, a closed subgroup H with H∩P=1 and HP=G, and any two complements are conjugate in G.

concept.title: Burnside basis theorem for pro-p groups
concept.description: Let Π be a topologically finitely generated pro-p group and Φ(Π) its Frattini subgroup, the intersection of its maximal open subgroups. Then Π/Φ(Π) is a finite-dimensional 𝔽_p-vector space, and a subset of Π generates a dense subgroup exactly when its image spans Π/Φ(Π). Hence the minimal number of topological generators is dim_𝔽p Π/Φ(Π).

concept.title: Lifting character eigen-elements under coprime action on a pro-p group
concept.description: Let a finite abelian group Ω of exponent dividing p−1 act by continuous automorphisms on a topologically finitely generated pro-p group Π, and let ξ:Ω→ℤ_p^× be a character. Every ξ-eigenvector of the Frattini quotient of Π lifts to π∈Π with α(π)=π^ξ(α) for all α∈Ω. Consequently Π has a minimal topological generating set consisting of such eigen-elements.

concept.title: Jordan–Hölder theorem for objects of finite length
concept.description: In an abelian category, any two composition series of an object of finite length have the same length, and their simple successive quotients agree up to isomorphism and reordering. In particular this applies to finite modules over a group ring.

concept.title: Degrees of rational prime isogenies of non-CM elliptic curves
concept.description: If an elliptic curve over ℚ without complex multiplication has a ℚ-rational isogeny of prime degree p, then p∈{2,3,5,7,11,13,17,37}. For p=11 the curve is a quadratic twist of one of the two curves of conductor 121 with a rational 11-isogeny (Cremona class 121A); the CM points of X₀(p) account for the remaining noncuspidal rational points for p=11,19,43,67,163.

concept.title: Kronecker–Weber theorem
concept.description: Every finite abelian extension of ℚ is contained in a cyclotomic field ℚ(ζ_n). An abelian extension unramified outside the primes dividing n and infinity can be taken inside ℚ(ζ_(n^k)) for some k.

concept.title: Greenberg’s division-field criterion for a Sylow p-adic image
concept.description: Let p be an odd prime and E/ℚ an elliptic curve with a ℚ-rational p-isogeny with kernel Φ, such that no curve ℚ-isogenous to E has a cyclic ℚ-isogeny of degree p² and E[p] has a unique rational line. Put E′=E/Φ. Then the image of Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ) in Aut(T_pE) contains a Sylow pro-p subgroup if and only if ℚ(E[p])≠ℚ(E′[p]).

concept.title: Inertia action under potentially good elliptic reduction
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a nonarchimedean local field K of residue characteristic ℓ and p≠ℓ prime. E has potentially good reduction iff inertia acts on T_pE through a finite quotient. Then this image is independent of p, has order dividing 24 (cyclic of order dividing 12 if ℓ≥5), and E acquires good reduction over the corresponding extension. For m≥3 prime to ℓ, E acquires semistable reduction over K(E[m]).

concept.title: Tate uniformization of elliptic curves with multiplicative reduction
concept.description: Let K be a p-adic field, a finite extension of ℚ_p. An elliptic curve E over K with split multiplicative reduction is isomorphic over K to the Tate curve E_q for a unique q∈K^× with |q|<1, and E(K̄)≅K̄^×/q^ℤ compatibly with the action of Gal(K̄/K). Here v(q)=−v(j(E))=v(Δ_min(E)). An elliptic curve over K with potentially multiplicative reduction is a quadratic twist of such a Tate curve.

concept.title: Dirichlet class number formula for an imaginary quadratic field
concept.description: For an imaginary quadratic field of discriminant d<−4 with Kronecker character χ, the class number is h=−(1/|d|)∑_(a=1)^(|d|−1)χ(a)a; equivalently h=L(1,χ)√|d|/π. For d=−p with p>3 prime, h=(2−χ(2))^(−1)∑_(0<a<p/2)χ(a), so 0<h<p.

concept.title: Artin reciprocity for ray class fields
concept.description: For a number field F and a modulus 𝔪, the Artin map induces an isomorphism from the ray class group Cl_𝔪(F) onto Gal(F_𝔪/F), where F_𝔪 is the ray class field; every finite abelian extension of F is contained in some F_𝔪, ramified only at places dividing 𝔪.

concept.title: Tate normal form for elliptic curves with a point of order7
concept.description: For a field k and u∈k with u⁷(u−1)⁷(u³−8u²+5u+1)≠0, E_u:y²−(u²−u−1)xy−(u³−u²)y=x³−(u³−u²)x² is an elliptic curve over k on which (0,0) has order7. Every elliptic curve over k with a k-rational point P of order7 is isomorphic over k, by an isomorphism carrying P to (0,0), to E_u for a unique u∈k.

concept.title: Simplest-cubic parametrization of cyclic cubic extensions
concept.description: If K/k is a cyclic cubic field extension with generator σ of Gal(K/k), there is t∈k such that K is the splitting field of x³−(t+3)x²+tx+1 and σ acts on its roots by γ↦1/(1−γ).

concept.title: Tate’s algorithm for elliptic curves over a p-adic field
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a p-adic field K, a finite extension of ℚ_p with valuation ring R and residue field k, given by a Weierstrass equation with coefficients in R. Tate’s algorithm, a finite sequence of coordinate changes and valuation tests on the coefficients, determines the Kodaira type of E and a minimal Weierstrass equation. An integral equation with v(Δ)<12 or v(c₄)<4 is minimal. If char k≥5 and j(E) is integral, then v(Δ_min)∈{0,2,3,4,6,8,9,10}, so 0≤v(Δ_min)≤10.

concept.title: Integral j-invariant criterion for potentially good reduction
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a nonarchimedean local field has potentially good reduction if and only if its j-invariant is integral; otherwise it has potentially multiplicative reduction.

concept.title: Chabauty–Coleman bound on a residue disc
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective curve of genus g over ℚ with Jacobian J, r=rank J(ℚ)<g, and p a prime of good reduction. The holomorphic differentials on C over ℚ_p annihilating J(ℚ) under p-adic abelian integration form a space of dimension at least g−r. If p>2 and the reduction of one of them does not vanish at P̄∈C(𝔽_p), then at most one point of C(ℚ) reduces to P̄.

concept.title: Poonen–Schaefer descent for Jacobians of cyclic covers of the projective line
concept.description: Let p be a prime, k a perfect field of characteristic not p containing a primitive p-th root of unity ζ, X the curve y^p=f(x) with Jacobian J, φ=1−ζ, and L=k[T]/(f₀) for the radical f₀ of f. If X has a k-rational divisor class of degree 1, the (x−T) map is a homomorphism J(k)/φJ(k)→L^×/L^×p k^× whose kernel has order 1 or p, and is trivial when f has a factor over k of degree prime to p. Over a number field its image lies in the kernel of the weighted norm to k^×/k^×p and is unramified outside any set of places containing the archimedean places, those above p and those of bad reduction of J.

concept.title: Index of cyclotomic units in a prime-power cyclotomic field
concept.description: For a prime power p^n, the cyclotomic units of ℚ(ζ_(p^n))^+ have finite index in its unit group equal to its class number h^+. If h^+=1, the units of ℤ[ζ_(p^n),1/p] are generated by roots of unity, the cyclotomic units and 1−ζ_(p^n).

concept.title: Injectivity of reduction on prime-to-residue torsion of an abelian variety
concept.description: Let A be an abelian variety over a number field with good reduction at a prime v of residue characteristic ℓ. For m prime to ℓ, reduction modulo v is injective on the m-torsion of A over the field; hence the order of the prime-to-ℓ rational torsion divides the order of the reduced group.

concept.title: Mazur–Kenku classification of rational cyclic isogenies
concept.description: An elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational cyclic isogeny of degree N exactly when N≤19 or N∈{21,25,27,37,43,67,163}. Mazur settled prime N and reduced the remaining question to N=169,91,65,39,125, which Kenku excluded.

concept.title: Height of the formal group of a local elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a finite extension of ℚ_p with good or multiplicative reduction. Multiplication by p on its formal group has the form [p](t)=pt+⋯≡g(t^(p^h)) modulo the maximal ideal with g′(0)≠0, where h=1 for ordinary or multiplicative reduction and h=2 for supersingular reduction. In height one the p-power torsion of the formal group over K̄ is isomorphic to ℚ_p/ℤ_p.

concept.title: Weierstrass preparation theorem
concept.description: Let O be a complete discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal 𝔪 and f=∑a_it^i∈O[[t]] with some a_n a unit and a_i∈𝔪 for i<n, n least. Then f=u·g uniquely with u∈O[[t]]^× and g a monic polynomial of degree n whose nonleading coefficients lie in 𝔪.

concept.title: Partial trace of a matrix on a tensor product
concept.description: For complex matrices on ℂᵃ⊗ℂᵇ, the partial trace over the second factor is the unique linear map Tr₂:M_(ab)(ℂ)→M_a(ℂ) with Tr₂(A⊗B)=tr(B)A for all A∈M_a(ℂ), B∈M_b(ℂ), where ⊗ is the Kronecker product; entrywise (Tr₂Z)_(ij)=∑_kZ_((i,k),(j,k)). The partial trace over the first factor is defined symmetrically.

concept.title: Symmetric subspace of a tensor power
concept.description: For n,t≥1, the symmetric subspace Sym^t(ℂⁿ)⊆(ℂⁿ)^(⊗t) consists of the tensors fixed by every factor permutation P_π(v₁⊗⋯⊗v_t)=v_(π⁻¹(1))⊗⋯⊗v_(π⁻¹(t)), π∈S_t. For the tensor-product inner product, its orthogonal projector is P_sym=(1/t!)∑_(π∈S_t)P_π.

concept.title: Approximate kinematic formula for closed convex cones
concept.description: Let C,K⊆ℝ^d be closed convex cones with statistical dimensions δ(C),δ(K), let Q be a Haar-random d×d orthogonal matrix, η∈(0,1) and a_η=√(8log(4/η)). If δ(C)+δ(K)≤d−a_η√d then P(C∩QK≠{0})≤η; if δ(C)+δ(K)≥d+a_η√d then P(C∩QK≠{0})≥1−η (Amelunxen–Lotz–McCoy–Tropp).

concept.title: Matrix Laplace transform master bounds for a sum of independent random Hermitian matrices
concept.description: For independent random Hermitian d×d matrices X_k with finite matrix moment generating functions and Y=∑_kX_k, Eλ_max(Y)≤inf_(θ>0)θ⁻¹log tr exp(∑_klog Ee^(θX_k)) and P{λ_max(Y)≥t}≤inf_(θ>0)e^(−θt)tr exp(∑_klog Ee^(θX_k)) for real t; the analogous bounds with θ<0 hold for λ_min(Y).

concept.title: Hermitian dilation of a matrix
concept.description: For a complex d₁×d₂ matrix B, its Hermitian dilation is the (d₁+d₂)-square Hermitian matrix H(B)=[[0,B],[B*,0]]. It is real-linear in B, H(B)²=diag(BB*,B*B), and its nonzero eigenvalues are ± the nonzero singular values of B, so λ_max(H(B))=‖B‖_(op).

concept.title: Irreducibility of the symmetric subspace under the unitary group
concept.description: For n,t≥1, the symmetric subspace Sym^t(ℂⁿ)⊆(ℂⁿ)^(⊗t) is an irreducible representation of the unitary group U(n) acting by U↦U^(⊗t).

concept.title: Schur’s lemma for finite-dimensional complex representations
concept.description: If ρ:G→GL(V) is an irreducible representation of a group G on a finite-dimensional complex vector space V, then every linear map T:V→V with Tρ(g)=ρ(g)T for all g∈G is a scalar multiple of the identity.

concept.title: Dimension of a symmetric tensor power
concept.description: For n,t≥1, dim Sym^t(ℂⁿ)=binom(n+t−1,t): the symmetrizations of the standard basis tensors, one for each multiset of size t from {1,…,n}, form a basis of the symmetric subspace.

concept.title: Ultracontractive symmetric Markov semigroup
concept.description: A symmetric Markov semigroup T_t on L²(X,m) is ultracontractive if for every t>0 the operator T_t maps L² into L∞ with finite norm ‖T_t‖_{2→∞}.

concept.title: Logarithmic Sobolev inequality from ultracontractivity
concept.description: If a symmetric Markov semigroup e^{−Ht} satisfies ‖e^{−Ht}‖_{2→∞}≤e^{M(t)} for all t>0, with M continuous and decreasing, then every 0≤f in the form domain of H satisfies ∫f²log₊f ≤ εQ(f)+(M(ε/4)+2)‖f‖₂²+‖f‖₂²log‖f‖₂ for every ε>0, where Q is the form of H.

concept.title: Gauss–Weierstrass heat kernel on Euclidean space
concept.description: For t>0 the heat semigroup e^{tΔ} on L²(ℝᴺ), generated by the self-adjoint Laplacian whose form is ∫|∇f|² on H¹(ℝᴺ), acts by convolution with K_t(x)=(4πt)^{−N/2}exp(−|x|²/4t).

concept.title: Beurling–Deny criteria for positivity-preserving and sub-Markov semigroups
concept.description: Let H≥0 be self-adjoint on real L²(X,m) with closed form Q. Then e^{−Ht} is positivity preserving for all t≥0 if and only if |f| lies in the form domain with Q(|f|)≤Q(f) for every f there; it is moreover an L∞ contraction for all t if and only if f∧1 lies in the form domain with Q(f∧1)≤Q(f) for every nonnegative f there.

concept.title: Hardy’s inequality on a bounded interval
concept.description: If f:[a,b]→ℂ is continuously differentiable with f(a)=f(b)=0 and d(x)=min(x−a,b−x), then ∫_a^b|f(x)|²/(4d(x)²)dx ≤ ∫_a^b|f′(x)|²dx.

concept.title: Uniform external ball condition for Lipschitz domains
concept.description: A bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᴺ satisfies a uniform external ball condition: there are α,β>0 such that for every y∈∂Ω and 0<s<β some ball of radius at least 2αs, whose centre lies within distance s of y, is disjoint from Ω.

concept.title: Interior elliptic regularity for smooth divergence-form operators
concept.description: Let L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ) have smooth real symmetric uniformly elliptic coefficients on an open Ω⊆ℝᴺ. If u∈L²_loc(Ω) and Lu∈H^k_loc(Ω) in the distributional sense, then u∈H^{k+2}_loc(Ω); in particular distributional solutions of Lu=f with smooth f are smooth.

concept.title: Stationary hitting-time tail bound by the killed principal eigenvalue
concept.description: For an irreducible reversible finite Markov chain with stationary law π and a set A whose killed matrix on Aᶜ has largest eigenvalue λ_A, the chain started from π satisfies P_π(T_A>n)≤π(Aᶜ)λ_Aⁿ for every n≥0.

concept.title: Covering map of topological spaces
concept.description: A continuous map p:Y→X such that every point of X has an open neighbourhood U for which p⁻¹(U) is a union of pairwise disjoint open subsets of Y, each mapped homeomorphically onto U by p. Such U are called evenly covered; surjectivity of p is not required.

concept.title: Connectedness of real intervals
concept.description: Every interval of the real line, in particular the closed unit interval [0,1], is connected in its subspace topology.

concept.title: Continuous images of connected spaces are connected
concept.description: If f:X→Y is a continuous map and X is connected, then the image f(X) is connected in the subspace topology of Y.

concept.title: Chevalley–Warning theorem
concept.description: Let f₁,…,f_r be polynomials in n variables over a finite field of characteristic p whose total degrees satisfy deg f₁+⋯+deg f_r<n. Then the number of common zeros in Fⁿ is divisible by p; in particular, if every f_i has zero constant term, they have a common nontrivial zero.

concept.title: Norm criterion for the quadratic Hilbert symbol
concept.description: For a local field F of characteristic different from two and a,b∈F×, the Hilbert symbol (a,b)_F equals 1 exactly when the ternary form z²−ax²−by² represents zero nontrivially, and exactly when a is a norm from F(√b), the norm map being the identity when b is a square.

concept.title: Euler’s criterion for the Legendre symbol
concept.description: For an odd prime p and an integer a, the Legendre symbol satisfies (a/p)≡a^((p−1)/2) mod p. Consequently (ab/p)=(a/p)(b/p) for all integers a,b, and (−1/p)=(−1)^((p−1)/2).

concept.title: Chinese remainder theorem for commutative rings
concept.description: If a₁,…,a_n are pairwise comaximal ideals of a commutative ring A, meaning a_i+a_j=A for i≠j, then a₁∩⋯∩a_n=a₁⋯a_n and the natural map A/(a₁⋯a_n)→A/a₁×⋯×A/a_n is a ring isomorphism.

concept.title: Discriminant criterion for reduced finite algebras over a perfect field
concept.description: Let B be a finite-dimensional commutative algebra over a perfect field k. Then B is reduced, having no nonzero nilpotent elements, if and only if its discriminant det(Tr_(B/k)(e_ie_j)) with respect to a k-basis (e_i) is nonzero.

concept.title: Finiteness of quotients of the ring of integers
concept.description: For a number field K and a nonzero ideal a of its ring of integers O_K, the quotient O_K/a is finite; its order is the numerical norm of a. In particular the residue field O_K/p at a nonzero prime ideal is a finite field.

concept.title: Faithful action of elliptic endomorphisms on the invariant differential in characteristic zero
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a characteristic-zero field F with nonzero invariant differential ω. Every geometric endomorphism φ satisfies φ*ω=a_φω for a unique a_φ∈F̄, and φ↦a_φ is an injective ring homomorphism End_(F̄)(E)→F̄.

concept.title: J-invariant of a complex lattice
concept.description: For a lattice Λ⊂ℂ, the absolutely convergent sums g₂(Λ)=60∑′ω⁻⁴ and g₃(Λ)=140∑′ω⁻⁶ over nonzero ω∈Λ give Δ(Λ)=g₂³−27g₃²≠0, and j(Λ)=1728g₂(Λ)³/Δ(Λ). It depends only on Λ up to homothety and is the j-invariant of the elliptic curve y²=4x³−g₂x−g₃ uniformized by ℂ/Λ; one writes j(ℂ/Λ)=j(Λ).

concept.title: Class-group action on CM elliptic curves
concept.description: Let O be an order in an imaginary quadratic field K⊂ℂ and Ell_O(ℂ) the set of isomorphism classes of complex elliptic curves with endomorphism ring O. For an invertible O-ideal a and E≅ℂ/Λ put aE=ℂ/a⁻¹Λ; the identity of ℂ induces an isogeny E→aE of degree N(a) with kernel E[a]. This defines a free and transitive action of the class group cl(O) on the finite set Ell_O(ℂ).

concept.title: Integrality of CM j-invariants
concept.description: If a complex elliptic curve E has complex multiplication, then its j-invariant j(E) is an algebraic integer.

concept.title: Galois compatibility of the ideal action on CM elliptic curves
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over ℚ̄⊂ℂ with complex multiplication by an imaginary quadratic order O, and a an invertible O-ideal. For every automorphism σ of ℂ, (aE)^σ≅a^σE^σ; in particular (aE)^σ≅aE^σ when σ fixes the CM field.

concept.title: Prime-norm ideals in every class of an imaginary quadratic order
concept.description: Every ideal class in the class group of an imaginary quadratic order O contains infinitely many proper O-ideals whose norm is a rational prime.

concept.title: Frobenius factorization of an elliptic isogeny in positive characteristic
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic p>0, every isogeny φ:E→E′ of elliptic curves factors as φ=ψ∘π_q, where q=p^e is the inseparable degree of φ, π_q:E→E^(q) is the q-power Frobenius isogeny and ψ:E^(q)→E′ is separable. In particular an inseparable isogeny of degree p is π_p followed by an isomorphism.

concept.title: Artin reciprocity for the Hilbert class field
concept.description: For a number field K, the Hilbert class field H/K is a finite abelian extension, and the Artin map sending each nonzero prime 𝔭 of O_K to its Frobenius element induces an isomorphism Cl(K)≅Gal(H/K). Hence [H:K] is the class number, and a prime of K splits completely in H exactly when it is principal.

concept.title: Bauer’s theorem on split primes and Galois extensions
concept.description: Let L and M be finite extensions of a number field K inside a fixed algebraic closure, with M/K Galois. If, apart from finitely many exceptions (or a set of Dirichlet density zero), every prime of K having a degree-one prime factor in L splits completely in M, then M⊆L. In particular two finite Galois extensions of K with the same split primes up to such exceptions coincide.

concept.title: Existence of an elliptic isogeny with prescribed finite kernel
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over an algebraically closed field and a finite subgroup Φ⊂E, there is an elliptic curve E′, unique up to isomorphism, and a separable isogeny φ:E→E′ with ker φ=Φ. The function field of E′ is identified with the subfield of the function field of E fixed by translations by Φ.

concept.title: Riemann integral over a box in ℝᵏ
concept.description: For a closed box B=[a₁,b₁]×⋯×[a_k,b_k]⊂ℝᵏ, a bounded f:B→ℝ is Riemann integrable with integral I if for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that every partition of B into finitely many closed subboxes B_j of diameter less than δ, with any tags ξ_j∈B_j, satisfies |∑_j f(ξ_j)vol(B_j)−I|<ε, where vol(B_j) is the product of the side lengths of B_j. For k=1 this is the Riemann integral on an interval.

concept.title: Maynard’s variational constant M_k
concept.description: For k≥1, let S_k be the set of Riemann-integrable F:[0,1]ᵏ→ℝ supported on the simplex R_k={t:t_i≥0,∑t_i≤1} with I_k(F)=∫F(t)²dt≠0 and J_k^(m)(F)=∫(∫₀¹F dt_m)²dt₁⋯dt_(m−1)dt_(m+1)⋯dt_k≠0 for every m, the inner integrals being Riemann integrals in the remaining k−1 variables. Then M_k=sup_(F∈S_k)∑_(m=1)^k J_k^(m)(F)/I_k(F).

concept.title: Maynard’s asymptotics for multidimensional Selberg sieve sums
concept.description: Let the primes have level of distribution θ>0, let H={h₁,…,h_k} be admissible, W=∏_(p≤D₀)p with D₀=logloglog N, v₀ a residue with every v₀+h_i coprime to W, and R=N^(θ/2−δ). For a fixed smooth F supported on R_k={t_i≥0,∑t_i≤1} put λ_(d₁…d_k)=∏μ(d_i)d_i∑_(d_i|r_i,(r_i,W)=1)μ(∏r_i)²∏φ(r_i)⁻¹F(log r₁/log R,…,log r_k/log R) when (∏d_i,W)=1, and 0 otherwise. Then, as N→∞, S₁=∑_(N≤n<2N,n≡v₀ (W))(∑_(d_i|n+h_i)λ_d)²=(1+o(1))φ(W)^kN(log R)^kI_k(F)/W^(k+1), and S₂^(m)=∑_(N≤n<2N,n≡v₀ (W))1_P(n+h_m)(∑_(d_i|n+h_i)λ_d)²=(1+o(1))φ(W)^kN(log R)^(k+1)J_k^(m)(F)/(W^(k+1)log N), provided I_k(F) and every J_k^(m)(F) are nonzero.

concept.title: Large sieve inequality for Dirichlet characters
concept.description: There is an absolute constant C such that for every complex f supported on an interval of length N≥1 and every Q≥1, ∑_(q≤Q)(q/φ(q))∑*_(χ mod q)|∑_n f(n)χ̄(n)|²≤C(N+Q²)∑_n|f(n)|², where ∑* runs over primitive Dirichlet characters modulo q. The constant can be taken to be one (Bombieri–Davenport, Montgomery–Vaughan).

concept.title: Siegel–Walfisz theorem
concept.description: For every A>0 there is c_A>0 such that ψ(x;q,a)=∑_(n≤x,n≡a (q))Λ(n) satisfies ψ(x;q,a)=x/φ(q)+O_A(x exp(−c_A√log x)) uniformly for x≥2, moduli q≤(log x)^A and residues a coprime to q. The implied constants are ineffective, since the proof uses Siegel’s bound for exceptional real zeros.

concept.title: Dirichlet convolution of arithmetic functions
concept.description: For arithmetic functions f,g:ℕ₊→ℂ, their Dirichlet convolution is (f*g)(n)=∑_(d|n)f(d)g(n/d). It is commutative and associative with identity δ (δ(1)=1, δ(n)=0 for n>1); for example μ*1=δ and Λ*1=log.

concept.title: Vaughan’s identity for the von Mangoldt function
concept.description: For U,V≥1, the von Mangoldt function satisfies Λ=Λ_(≤V)+μ_(≤U)*log−μ_(≤U)*Λ_(≤V)*1+μ_(>U)*Λ_(>V)*1, where * is Dirichlet convolution, 1 is the constant function and subscripts denote restriction to n≤U, n>U, n≤V or n>V. It splits Λ into Type I and Type II convolutions.

concept.title: Moment bounds for the divisor function
concept.description: For each fixed k≥1 and x≥2, ∑_(n≤x)τ(n)^k≪_k x(log x)^(2^k−1); equivalently, by partial summation, ∑_(n≤x)τ(n)^k/n≪_k(log x)^(2^k). Here τ(n) is the number of positive divisors of n.

concept.title: Rademacher type 2 constant of a Banach space
concept.description: A Banach space X has type 2 with constant T if (E‖∑_(i=1)^n ε_ix_i‖²)^(1/2)≤T(∑_(i=1)^n‖x_i‖²)^(1/2) for all n and all x₁,…,x_n∈X, where ε_i is a Rademacher sequence; T₂(X) is the least such T. It is monotone under passage to subspaces and satisfies T₂(X)≤‖S‖‖S⁻¹‖T₂(Y) for an isomorphism S of X onto a subspace of Y.

concept.title: Tomczak-Jaegermann’s type 2 bound for Schatten classes
concept.description: There is a universal constant C such that for every k≥1 and 2≤p<∞ the Schatten p-class C_p^k of k×k complex matrices with norm (Tr|x|^p)^(1/p) has Rademacher type 2 constant T₂(C_p^k)≤C√p. Consequently the k×k matrices with the operator norm have type 2 constant O(√log k).

concept.title: Pajor’s volume criterion for coordinate cube projections
concept.description: For a∈(0,1], t>0 and ε∈(0,1] there is c=c(a,t,ε)>0 such that, for every n≥1 and every compact convex S⊆[−1,1]ⁿ with Vol(S+tK)>2ⁿ(t+a)ⁿ, where K=[−1,1]ⁿ and S+tK is a Minkowski sum, some I⊆{1,…,n} with |I|≥cn has coordinate projection P_I S containing an ℓ∞^I ball of radius a(1−ε).

concept.title: Elementary two-step nilsequence
concept.description: A two-step nilmanifold X=G/Γ is elementary when its commutator subgroup G₂ is identified, by a chosen isomorphism of topological groups, with the circle S¹={u∈ℂ:|u|=1}. For such X, a translation T x=τx, x₀∈X and continuous F:X→ℂ with F(u·x)=uF(x) for u∈G₂=S¹, the sequence F(Tⁿx₀) is a basic elementary nilsequence. Elementary nilsequences are uniform limits of basic ones; by convention every almost periodic sequence is also elementary.

concept.title: Density criterion for minimality of a two-step nilrotation
concept.description: Let X=G/Γ with G a two-step nilpotent Lie group and Γ closed cocompact, T the translation by τ∈G, and suppose G is generated by its identity component and τ. Then (X,T) is minimal iff the subgroup generated by τ and Γ is dense in G, iff the subgroup generated by τ and ΓG₂ is dense. In that case the Kronecker factor of (X,T) with Haar measure is the rotation by the image of τ on the compact abelian group G/G₂Γ.

concept.title: Partial derivative of a distribution
concept.description: For a distribution T on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and 1≤j≤n, the distributional partial derivative ∂ⱼT is the distribution defined by (∂ⱼT)(φ)=−T(∂ⱼφ) for every test function φ∈C_c^∞(Ω). On an open real interval this is the distributional derivative T′(φ)=−T(φ′).

concept.title: Bounded inverse theorem for Banach spaces
concept.description: A bounded linear bijection between Banach spaces has a bounded linear inverse, so it is an isomorphism of Banach spaces. It is the bijective case of the open mapping theorem.

concept.title: Riesz theorem on compactness of the unit ball
concept.description: A normed vector space is finite-dimensional if and only if its closed unit ball {x:∥x∥≤1} is norm compact. In particular the closed unit ball of an infinite-dimensional Banach space is never compact.

concept.title: Gowers’s unconditional space contains no copy of c₀
concept.description: No closed subspace of Gowers’s unconditional space X_U is isomorphic, as a Banach space, to the sequence space c₀.

concept.title: Proximal pair of points in a topological dynamical system
concept.description: Points x,y of a compact topological dynamical system (X,T) are proximal if there is z∈X such that every neighbourhood of z contains Tⁿx and Tⁿy for a common n≥0. For compact metric X this means inf_{n≥0}d(Tⁿx,Tⁿy)=0. Allowing all n∈ℤ for a homeomorphism gives the weaker two-sided notion.

concept.title: Stone–Čech compactification of a discrete semigroup
concept.description: For a discrete semigroup S, βS is the compact Hausdorff space of ultrafilters on S, containing S as a dense subset. The operation of S extends uniquely to an associative operation on βS that is continuous in the left variable for each fixed right factor and in the right variable for each fixed factor from S, making βS a compact one-sided topological semigroup. For S=ℕ one writes p+q.

concept.title: Ellis–Numakura lemma on idempotents in compact semigroups
concept.description: Every nonempty compact Hausdorff semigroup whose multiplication is continuous in one of its variables for each fixed value of the other contains an idempotent e=e². In Ellis’s sharper form, every minimal one-sided ideal of the matching side in such a semigroup is closed and contains an idempotent.

concept.title: Existence of minimal subsystems of compact dynamical systems
concept.description: If X is a nonempty compact Hausdorff space and T:X→X is continuous, then X contains a nonempty closed set M with T(M)⊆M that has no proper nonempty closed T-invariant subset. The proof applies Zorn’s lemma to nonempty closed invariant sets ordered by reverse inclusion.

concept.title: Unit-attaining norm-one functionals on unital C*-algebras are states
concept.description: If φ is a bounded linear functional on a unital C*-algebra with ‖φ‖=φ(1)=1, then φ is positive, so φ is a state.

concept.title: Cusp form of integer weight on a congruence subgroup
concept.description: A modular form of integer weight k on a congruence subgroup Γ⊆SL₂(ℤ) that vanishes at every cusp: after the weight-k slash action by any element of SL₂(ℤ), its Fourier expansion at infinity has zero constant term. These form the subspace S_k(Γ).

concept.title: Fundamental domain of the modular group
concept.description: The closed set D={τ∈ℍ:|Re τ|≤1/2, |τ|≥1} is a fundamental domain for SL₂(ℤ) acting on the upper half-plane by Möbius transformations: every point of ℍ is SL₂(ℤ)-equivalent to a point of D, and two distinct interior points of D are never equivalent.

concept.title: Finite index of congruence subgroups of SL₂(ℤ)
concept.description: Every congruence subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) has finite index, since it contains the principal congruence subgroup Γ(N), the kernel of the reduction homomorphism SL₂(ℤ)→SL₂(ℤ/Nℤ). Hence SL₂(ℤ) is a finite union of cosets γ_jΓ.

concept.title: Transitivity of a finite group on primes over an invariant prime
concept.description: Let a finite group G act on a commutative ring R by ring automorphisms. Then R is integral over the invariant ring R^G, and any two prime ideals of R contracting to the same prime of R^G are carried to one another by some element of G.

concept.title: Rose’s theta-derivative formula for generalized divisor sums
concept.description: For a symmetric residue set S={ℓ₁,…,ℓ_s} modulo n and k≥1, put ε=1 if n∈S and ε=0 otherwise. The weight-2w part of Rose’s A_{S,n,k}(q) is a constant multiple of Ω_{S,n}(qⁿ)⁻¹∑_{i₁+⋯+i_s=2w+ε}(2w+ε;i₁,…,i_s)∏_jϑ^{(i_j)}_{ℓ_j/n−1/2}(qⁿ), where ϑ_r^{(t)}(τ)=q^{r²/2}((2πi)⁻¹∂_σ)^tϑ(τ,σ) at σ=rτ+1/2 and Ω_{S,n}=∏_{ℓ∈S}ϑ^{(δ_{ℓ,n})}_{ℓ/n−1/2}. Consequently A_{S,n,k} is quasimodular of mixed weight at most 2k for some congruence subgroup.

concept.title: Upper asymptotic density of a set of positive integers
concept.description: For S⊆ℕ₊, its upper asymptotic density is d̄(S)=limsup_{N→∞}|S∩{1,…,N}|/N, which always exists in [0,1].

concept.title: Furstenberg correspondence principle
concept.description: For A⊆ℕ with positive upper asymptotic density there are a closed shift-invariant set X⊆{0,1}^ℕ₀, a shift-invariant Borel probability measure μ on X and a clopen M⊆X with μ(M)=d̄(A), such that whenever μ(M∩T^{−n}M∩⋯∩T^{−(k−1)n}M)>0 for the shift T, some a gives a,a+n,…,a+(k−1)n∈A.

concept.title: Furstenberg multiple recurrence theorem
concept.description: For every probability-preserving transformation T of (X,μ), every measurable A with μ(A)>0 and every k≥1, liminf_{N→∞}N⁻¹∑_{n=1}^Nμ(A∩T^{−n}A∩⋯∩T^{−kn}A)>0; in particular some n≥1 has μ(A∩T^{−n}A∩⋯∩T^{−kn}A)>0.

concept.title: Opposite category
concept.description: For a category C, its opposite category C^op has the same objects, morphism sets Hom_(C^op)(X,Y)=Hom_C(Y,X), and composition taken in the reverse order. A contravariant functor from C to D is a functor C^op→D.

concept.title: Finitely generated module over a commutative ring
concept.description: A module M over a commutative ring R is finitely generated if it has finitely many elements m₁,…,m_n such that every element of M is an R-linear combination r₁m₁+⋯+r_nm_n.

concept.title: I-adic topology on a module
concept.description: For an ideal I of a commutative ring R and an R-module M, the I-adic topology on M is the topology whose open sets are the unions of cosets m+IⁿM, with m∈M and n≥0, where IⁿM is the submodule generated by the products a₁⋯a_n·x with a_i∈I and x∈M. For a prime p and R=ℤ_p, the pℤ_p-adic topology is called the p-adic topology.

concept.title: Coprime polynomials over a field
concept.description: Polynomials a,b∈k[X] over a field k are coprime, or relatively prime, if they are not both zero and every polynomial dividing both of them is a nonzero constant; equivalently their monic greatest common divisor is 1.

concept.title: Character classification of diagonalizable algebraic groups
concept.description: For a field k, M↦D(M)=Spec k[M], with k[M] the group algebra and comultiplication m↦m⊗m, is a contravariant equivalence from finitely generated abelian groups to diagonalizable affine algebraic k-groups, those whose coordinate algebra is spanned by group-like elements. Its quasi-inverse is the character group G↦X(G), and the split tori correspond to the free abelian groups of finite rank.

concept.title: Galois descent for vector spaces along a Galois extension
concept.description: For a Galois extension K/k, possibly infinite, with Krull-topologized group Γ, V↦K⊗_kV is an equivalence from k-vector spaces to K-vector spaces with a continuous semilinear Γ-action, meaning every vector has an open stabilizer; its quasi-inverse is V↦V^Γ. Applied to coordinate rings it identifies commutative Hopf k-algebras with commutative Hopf K-algebras carrying such an action compatible with the Hopf structure.

concept.title: Separable-closure splitting of groups of multiplicative type
concept.description: If an affine algebraic group over a field k becomes diagonalizable over some field extension of k, then it is already diagonalizable over a separable closure k^s, hence over a finite separable extension of k. In particular every algebraic torus over k splits over k^s.

concept.title: Extension of embeddings into an algebraic Galois extension
concept.description: Let Ω/F be an algebraic Galois extension and E an intermediate field. Every F-embedding of E into Ω extends to an F-automorphism of Ω. Consequently, when E/F is also Galois, restriction Gal(Ω/F)→Gal(E/F) is surjective.

concept.title: Continuous image of a compact space
concept.description: If f:X→Y is a continuous map of topological spaces and X is compact, then its image f(X) is compact in the subspace topology of Y.

concept.title: Compact subsets of Hausdorff spaces are closed
concept.description: Every compact subset of a Hausdorff topological space is closed.

concept.title: Local characterization of Dedekind domains
concept.description: A Noetherian integral domain that is not a field is a Dedekind domain exactly when its localization at every nonzero prime ideal is a discrete valuation ring. In particular every discrete valuation ring is a Dedekind domain, and the localization of a Dedekind domain at a nonzero prime 𝔭 is the valuation ring of the discrete valuation given by the exponent of 𝔭 in ideal factorizations.

concept.title: Division by a monic polynomial over a commutative ring
concept.description: For a commutative ring R, a polynomial a∈R[X] and a monic b∈R[X] of degree d, there are unique q,r∈R[X] with a=bq+r and r=0 or deg r<d. Hence R[X]/(b) is a free R-module with basis the classes of 1,X,…,X^(d−1).

concept.title: Logarithmic S-units containing the places above ℓ
concept.description: Let K be a number field, ℓ a prime and S a finite set of finite places of K containing every place above ℓ. An element of ℤ_ℓ⊗_ℤK× is a local logarithmic unit at every finite place outside S exactly when it lies in ℤ_ℓ⊗_ℤE_S, where E_S is the group of S-units with the archimedean places adjoined to S. In particular the global logarithmic unit group lies in ℤ_ℓ⊗_ℤ(ℓ-units of K).

concept.title: Norm compatibility of global logarithmic units
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields and a prime ℓ, the map ℤ_ℓ⊗L×→ℤ_ℓ⊗K× induced by the field norm N_(L/K) sends the global logarithmic unit group of L into that of K, because logarithmic divisor maps commute with the arithmetic and logarithmic norms.

concept.title: Compactness of finitely generated ℤ_p-modules
concept.description: For a prime p, every finitely generated ℤ_p-module M is a compact Hausdorff topological group in its p-adic topology, in which the submodules pⁿM form a base of open neighbourhoods of 0. Every ℤ_p-linear map between finitely generated ℤ_p-modules is continuous for these topologies.

concept.title: Elementary matrix over a field
concept.description: An n×n matrix over a field obtained from the identity matrix by one elementary row operation: interchanging two rows, multiplying one row by a nonzero scalar, or adding a scalar multiple of one row to a different row. Left multiplication by it performs that row operation.

concept.title: Gauss–Jordan reduction to reduced row echelon form
concept.description: Every matrix over a field can be transformed by finitely many elementary row operations into reduced row echelon form: zero rows come last, each nonzero row has leading entry 1 strictly to the right of the leading entry of the row above, and each leading 1 is the only nonzero entry of its column.

concept.title: Uniqueness theorem for Fourier coefficients on the circle
concept.description: An integrable function on the unit circle all of whose Fourier coefficients vanish is zero almost everywhere; hence integrable functions with the same Fourier coefficients agree almost everywhere.

concept.title: Jacobson’s lemma on the spectra of ab and ba
concept.description: For elements a,b of a complex Banach algebra, 1−ab is invertible in the unitization exactly when 1−ba is; hence σ(ab)∪{0}=σ(ba)∪{0} and ab and ba have the same spectral radius.

concept.title: Conditioning reduces the conditional entropy of a finite partition
concept.description: For a finite measurable partition ξ of a probability space and sub-σ-algebras A⊆C, H_μ(ξ|C)≤H_μ(ξ|A). In particular H_μ(ξ|A)≤H_μ(ξ), and for partitions H_μ(ξ|η∨ζ)≤H_μ(ξ|ζ).

concept.title: Completion of a measure space
concept.description: The completion of (X,B,μ) is the coarsest complete refinement of it: its σ-algebra consists of the sets differing from a B-set by a subset of a μ-null set, with μ extended unchanged. It is unique.

concept.title: Chain-recurrent point of a map of a metric space
concept.description: For a map F of a metric space, a δ-chain (δ-pseudo-orbit) from x to y is a finite sequence x=x₀,…,x_n=y with n≥1 and d(x_(j+1),F(x_j))<δ for all j. A point x is chain recurrent if for every δ>0 there is a δ-chain from x to itself.

concept.title: Unimodal map of a compact interval
concept.description: A C¹ map f of a compact real interval I into itself is unimodal if f′ vanishes at exactly one point c, which lies in the interior of I and is a turning point: f is strictly monotone on each of the two subintervals of I separated by c, increasing on one and decreasing on the other.

concept.title: Neutral periodic orbit of an interval map
concept.description: For a C¹ interval map F, a periodic orbit of least period p is neutral if |(Fᵖ)′(x)|=1 at one, equivalently every, point x of that orbit.

concept.title: Combinatorial equivalence of unimodal maps
concept.description: Unimodal maps f and g with turning points c and d are combinatorially equivalent if there is an order-preserving bijection h from the forward critical orbit {fⁿ(c):n≥0} onto {gⁿ(d):n≥0} with h(fⁿ(c))=gⁿ(d) for every n≥0; that is, the two critical orbits are ordered in the same way on the line.

concept.title: Arzelà–Ascoli theorem on a compact metric space
concept.description: For a compact metric space K, a family of continuous real functions on K is relatively compact in C(K) with the supremum norm if and only if it is uniformly bounded and equicontinuous.

concept.title: Weierstrass M-test
concept.description: If real or complex functions f_n on a set S satisfy sup_S|f_n|≤M_n with ∑M_n<∞, then ∑f_n converges absolutely and uniformly on S.

concept.title: Derivatives of the real sine and cosine functions
concept.description: The real sine and cosine functions are differentiable on ℝ, with sin′=cos and cos′=−sin.

concept.title: Pythagorean identity for sine and cosine
concept.description: For every real x, sin²x+cos²x=1.

concept.title: Parallelogram law in an inner-product space
concept.description: In a real or complex inner-product space with induced norm, ‖x+y‖²+‖x−y‖²=2‖x‖²+2‖y‖² for all vectors x,y.

concept.title: Extension of rational maps from smooth curves
concept.description: A rational map from a curve to a projective variety is regular at every smooth point of the curve; hence a rational map from a smooth curve is a morphism. In particular a rational function f on a smooth curve gives a morphism C→ℙ¹, P↦[f(P):1], sending the poles of f to ∞.

concept.title: Ramification and degree of a nonconstant map of smooth curves
concept.description: For a nonconstant map φ:C₁→C₂ of smooth projective curves over an algebraically closed field, with ramification index e_φ(P)=ord_P(φ*t) for a uniformizer t at φ(P): ∑_{P∈φ⁻¹(Q)}e_φ(P)=deg φ for every Q∈C₂; #φ⁻¹(Q) equals the separable degree of φ for all but finitely many Q; and e_{ψ∘φ}(P)=e_φ(P)e_ψ(φ(P)).

concept.title: Principal divisors on a smooth projective curve have degree zero
concept.description: For a nonzero rational function f on a smooth projective curve over a field, deg div(f)=0: counted with multiplicities (and residue-field degrees over a non-closed field), f has as many zeros as poles. Thus principal divisors form a subgroup of the degree-zero divisors.

concept.title: Degree-zero divisor classes of an elliptic curve
concept.description: For an elliptic curve (E,O) over an algebraically closed field, every degree-zero divisor D is linearly equivalent to (P)−(O) for a unique point P∈E, and P↦class of (P)−(O) is a group isomorphism from E with its chord-and-tangent law onto Pic⁰(E).

concept.title: Holomorphic differential on a Riemann surface
concept.description: A holomorphic differential (holomorphic 1-form) ω on a Riemann surface X is given in each chart with coordinate q by an expression f(q)dq with f holomorphic, compatible under each transition map q=φ(q′) by f(φ(q′))φ′(q′)dq′. They form a complex vector space Ω¹_hol(X), and holomorphic maps pull them back by the same change-of-variable rule.

concept.title: Weight-two cusp forms as holomorphic differentials on a modular curve
concept.description: For a congruence subgroup Γ⊆SL₂(ℤ), sending a cusp form f∈S₂(Γ) to the differential ω(f) on the compact modular curve X(Γ) whose pullback to the upper half-plane is f(τ)dτ gives a complex-linear isomorphism S₂(Γ)≅Ω¹_hol(X(Γ)) onto the holomorphic differentials.

concept.title: Double coset operator on modular forms
concept.description: For congruence subgroups Γ₁,Γ₂⊆SL₂(ℤ) and α∈GL₂⁺(ℚ), write Γ₁αΓ₂ as a finite disjoint union of orbits Γ₁β_j. For f∈M_k(Γ₁) set f[Γ₁αΓ₂]_k=∑_j f[β_j]_k, with (f[β]_k)(τ)=(det β)^(k−1)(cτ+d)^(−k)f(βτ) for β=[[a,b],[c,d]]; this is independent of the β_j and maps M_k(Γ₁) to M_k(Γ₂) and S_k(Γ₁) to S_k(Γ₂). For p prime, T_p on Γ₁(N) is the case α=diag(1,p).

concept.title: Riemann existence theorem for compact Riemann surfaces
concept.description: Every compact Riemann surface is biholomorphic to the complex points of a smooth projective connected curve over ℂ, unique up to isomorphism, and every holomorphic map between compact Riemann surfaces is induced by a unique morphism of the corresponding curves. Thus divisors, rational functions and Jacobians of compact Riemann surfaces may be treated algebraically.

concept.title: Correspondence between smooth projective curves
concept.description: A correspondence T from X to X′, smooth projective curves over an algebraically closed field, is a smooth projective curve Y with finite surjective morphisms α:Y→X and β:Y→X′, viewed as the many-valued map P↦{β(Q):Q∈α⁻¹(P)} with multiplicities. It acts on divisors by D↦β_*α^*D, multiplying degrees by deg α and preserving principal divisors, hence induces a homomorphism of Jacobians; its transpose exchanges α and β.

concept.title: Riemann hypothesis for curves over finite fields
concept.description: For a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C of genus g over F_q there are algebraic integers α₁,…,α_(2g) with #C(F_(qⁿ))=qⁿ+1−∑α_iⁿ for all n≥1, and Weil proved |α_i|=q^(1/2) for every i. The α_i are the eigenvalues of the q-power Frobenius on the ℓ-adic Tate module of the Jacobian (ℓ∤q); hence |#C(F_q)−q−1|≤2g√q.

concept.title: Evanescent subset of time × sample space
concept.description: For a probability space (Ω,F,P), a set A⊆[0,∞)×Ω is evanescent if the set of ω for which (t,ω)∈A for some t is contained in a P-null event.

concept.title: One-dimensional diffusion on an interval
concept.description: A strong Markov family (P_x)_{x∈I} of laws of processes with continuous paths in an interval I⊆ℝ, possibly killed at a terminal time. It is conservative if it is never killed and regular if P_x(τ_y<∞)>0 for every interior x and every y∈I, where τ_y is the hitting time of y.

concept.title: Scale function of a one-dimensional diffusion
concept.description: For a regular one-dimensional diffusion on I, a continuous strictly increasing s:I→ℝ with P_x(τ_b<τ_a)=(s(x)−s(a))/(s(b)−s(a)) whenever a<x<b in I; it is unique up to an increasing affine change and s(X) is a local martingale up to exit.

concept.title: Speed measure of a one-dimensional diffusion
concept.description: For a regular one-dimensional diffusion with scale function s, the Radon measure m on the interior with E_xτ_(a,b)=∫G_(a,b)(x,y)m(dy) for interior a<x<b, where G_(a,b)(x,y)=(s(x∧y)−s(a))(s(b)−s(x∨y))/(s(b)−s(a)). At an included endpoint m may carry an atom, measuring holding there; no atom means instantaneous reflection.

concept.title: Feller boundary classification for a one-dimensional diffusion
concept.description: An endpoint e of the interval of a regular one-dimensional diffusion is regular if it is reached from the interior with positive probability and the process can return from e to the interior; exit if reached but not left; entrance if not reached from the interior but left from e; natural otherwise. Entrance and natural endpoints are inaccessible.

concept.title: Gaussian logarithmic Sobolev inequality
concept.description: For a standard Gaussian vector X in ℝⁿ and smooth f with E|∇f(X)|²<∞, Ent[f(X)²]≤2E|∇f(X)|², where Ent[Z]=E[Z log Z]−EZ·log EZ for Z≥0; the constant does not depend on n (Gross).

concept.title: Herbst’s entropy lemma for subgaussian bounds
concept.description: If a real random variable X satisfies Ent[e^{λX}]≤(λ²σ²/2)E[e^{λX}] for every λ≥0, then log E[e^{λ(X−EX)}]≤λ²σ²/2 for every λ≥0, where Ent[Z]=E[Z log Z]−EZ·log EZ.

concept.title: Chernoff bound for a real random variable
concept.description: For a real random variable X with ψ(λ)=log E[e^{λ(X−EX)}], P(X−EX≥t)≤exp(−sup_{λ≥0}(λt−ψ(λ))) for every t≥0; in particular ψ(λ)≤λ²σ²/2 for λ≥0 gives P(X−EX≥t)≤exp(−t²/(2σ²)).

concept.title: Cauchy–Goursat theorem for a disk
concept.description: If f is holomorphic on an open disk D⊆ℂ, with no continuity assumption on f′, then f has a holomorphic primitive on D. Consequently ∫_γf(z)dz=0 for every closed piecewise C¹ path γ in D. The standard proof first shows that integrals over triangles vanish (Goursat’s lemma).

concept.title: Lévy inversion formula for characteristic functions
concept.description: For a Borel probability measure μ on ℝ with characteristic function φ and real a<b, lim_{T→∞}(2π)⁻¹∫_{−T}^{T}(e^{−ita}−e^{−itb})/(it)·φ(t)dt=μ((a,b))+½μ({a,b}); the limit exists.

concept.title: Optional projection of a measurable process
concept.description: On a filtered probability space satisfying the usual conditions, the optional projection of a bounded or nonnegative B(ℝ₊)⊗F-measurable process X is the optional process ᵒX, unique up to indistinguishability, such that ᵒX_τ1_(τ<∞)=E[X_τ1_(τ<∞)|F_τ] almost surely for every stopping time τ.

concept.title: Weak subsequences of bounded sequences in a reflexive Banach space
concept.description: Every norm-bounded sequence in a reflexive Banach space has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Change of variables for a Stieltjes measure through the right-continuous inverse
concept.description: Let A:[0,∞)→[0,∞) be right-continuous and nondecreasing and C_u=inf{t≥0:A_t≥u}, with inf∅=∞. For every nonnegative Borel f on [0,∞), f(0)A_0+∫_(0,∞)f dA=∫_0^∞f(C_u)1_(C_u<∞)du; the Stieltjes measure of A, with atom A_0 at 0, is the image of Lebesgue measure under u↦C_u.

concept.title: Fundamental theorem of local martingales
concept.description: On a filtration satisfying the usual conditions, for every càdlàg local martingale M and c>0 there are càdlàg local martingales M′ and A with |ΔM′|≤c, A of finite variation, and M=M′+A. Consequently every càdlàg local martingale is a locally square-integrable martingale plus a finite-variation local martingale.

concept.title: Itô isometry for integrals against a square-integrable càdlàg martingale
concept.description: If M is a càdlàg square-integrable martingale and X is predictable with E∫_(0,t]X_s²d[M]_s<∞ for every t, then the stochastic integral X·M is a càdlàg square-integrable martingale and E[(X·M)_t²]=E∫_(0,t]X_s²d[M]_s for every t.

concept.title: Doob’s maximal inequality for a right-continuous submartingale
concept.description: If M is a right-continuous submartingale, 0<T<∞ and r>0, then rP(sup_(0≤t≤T)M_t≥r)≤E[M_T⁺].

concept.title: Hitting times of closed sets by càdlàg adapted processes are stopping times
concept.description: If X is an adapted càdlàg process with values in a metric space and H is closed, then σ_H=inf{t≥0:X_t∈H or X_(t−)∈H} is a stopping time, without assuming right-continuity of the filtration.

concept.title: Associativity of the semimartingale stochastic integral
concept.description: For a càdlàg semimartingale Y and locally bounded predictable H, the integral X=H·Y is a càdlàg semimartingale, and G·X=(GH)·Y up to indistinguishability for every locally bounded predictable G.

concept.title: Dedekind independence of distinct field homomorphisms
concept.description: Distinct field homomorphisms σ₁,…,σ_n:E→L are linearly independent over L as L-valued functions on E: if ∑a_iσ_i(x)=0 for every x∈E with a_i∈L, then every a_i=0.

concept.title: Idele class group of a number field
concept.description: For a number field L, the idele class group C_L=I_L/L× is the quotient of the idele group by the diagonally embedded multiplicative group L×, with the quotient topology. For a finite Galois extension L/K the Galois group acts on I_L and L×, hence on C_L, giving the exact sequence 1→L×→I_L→C_L→1 of Gal(L/K)-modules.

concept.title: Long exact sequence of Tate cohomology
concept.description: For a finite group G, every short exact sequence 0→M′→M→M″→0 of G-modules induces an exact sequence ⋯→Ĥ^r(G,M′)→Ĥ^r(G,M)→Ĥ^r(G,M″)→Ĥ^(r+1)(G,M′)→⋯ of Tate cohomology groups, unbounded in both directions; here Ĥ^0=M^G/N_G M, Ĥ^(−1)=ker N_G/I_G M, Ĥ^r=H^r for r>0 and Ĥ^r=H_(−r−1) for r<−1.

concept.title: Vanishing of the first cohomology of idele classes
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of number fields with group G, the first cohomology group H¹(G,C_L) of the idele class group vanishes. Together with finiteness of H²(G,C_L) of order dividing [L:K] and the index bound (I_K:K×Nm(I_L))≤[L:K], it forms the second inequality of global class field theory.

concept.title: Local decomposition of the Tate cohomology of ideles
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of number fields with group G and every integer r, Ĥ^r(G,I_L)≅⊕_v Ĥ^r(G_w,L_w×), the sum over places v of K, where for each v a place w of L above v is chosen and G_w is its decomposition group. For r=0 the map from Ĥ^0(G,I_L)=I_K/Nm(I_L) is induced by the components, giving ⊕_v K_v×/Nm(L_w×).

concept.title: Integral elements form a subring
concept.description: If A is a subring of a commutative ring B, the elements of B that are integral over A form a subring of B containing A: sums, differences and products of integral elements are integral. This subring is the integral closure of A in B.

concept.title: Unique factorization domains are integrally closed
concept.description: Every unique factorization domain, in particular every principal ideal domain such as ℤ, is integrally closed in its field of fractions: a fraction a/b satisfying a monic polynomial with coefficients in the domain already lies in the domain.

concept.title: Isomorphism of stem fields of conjugate roots
concept.description: Let f∈F[X] be irreducible and let α and α′ be roots of f in extension fields of F. Then there is a unique F-isomorphism F[α]→F[α′] sending α to α′, since both fields are isomorphic to F[X]/(f).

concept.title: Unramified extension generated by a residually separable root
concept.description: Let K be complete for a discrete valuation, with valuation ring o and residue field k. If β is a root of a monic polynomial φ∈o[T] whose reduction modulo the maximal ideal is separable in k[T], then K(β)/K is unramified: its ramification index is 1 and its residue field extension is separable of degree [K(β):K].

concept.title: Dimension formula for level-one modular forms
concept.description: For the full modular group SL₂(ℤ), the space M_k of weight-k modular forms is zero for odd k, for k<0 and for k=2; for even k≥0, dim_ℂ M_k equals ⌊k/12⌋ if k≡2 (mod 12) and ⌊k/12⌋+1 otherwise. For even k≥4, M_k=S_k⊕ℂE_k, and multiplication by Δ is an isomorphism M_(k−12)→S_k onto the cusp forms.

concept.title: Bezuglyi–Handelman zero-or-dense kernel images for refinable traces
concept.description: Let (G,u) be an approximately divisible dimension group with order unit, for example a simple noncyclic dimension group, and let U be a refinable set of normalized traces. Then for every trace σ of G the image σ(ker U)⊆ℝ is either zero or dense; in particular it is never a nonzero cyclic group.

concept.title: Bezuglyi–Handelman relations between refinability, goodness and kernel quotients
concept.description: Let (G,u) be a simple dimension group, U a set of traces and Z=Z(ker U) the normalized traces vanishing on ker U; U is refinable iff Z is. (a) If U is refinable, G/ker U has Riesz interpolation and Z is a simplex. (b) If U is good, G/ker U is unperforated. (c) Good sets are refinable. (d) If U is good, G/ker U is a simple dimension group. (e) If Z is refinable and G/ker U is unperforated, ker U has dense image in Z^⊢, the continuous affine functions on S(G,u) vanishing on Z. (f) Under the hypotheses of (e), Z is good.

concept.title: Bezuglyi–Handelman density criterion for good traces
concept.description: Let G be an approximately divisible dimension group with order unit and τ a trace. Then τ is good with respect to order units if and only if the image of ker τ under the affine representation is norm dense in {τ}^⊢, the continuous affine functions on the normalized trace space vanishing at τ. For simple G every nonzero positive element is an order unit, so this characterizes good traces.

concept.title: Polymath’s Heath-Brown reduction to Type I, II and III estimates
concept.description: Let i≥1 and fix 0<ϖ<1/4, 0<δ<1/4+ϖ and 1/10<σ<1/2 with σ>2ϖ. If the Type I estimate Type_I^(i)[ϖ,δ,σ], the Type II estimate Type_II^(i)[ϖ,δ] and the Type III estimate Type_III^(i)[ϖ,δ,σ] of Polymath (2014, Definition 2.6) hold, then so does MPZ^(i)[ϖ,δ]: ∑|Δ(Λ1_[x,2x];a mod q)|≪x(log x)^(−A) over squarefree i-tuply x^δ-densely divisible q≤x^(1/2+2ϖ) with prime factors in a bounded set I, for a coprime to P_I. If σ>1/6 the Type III hypothesis can be omitted. The proof combines the Heath-Brown identity, a finer-than-dyadic decomposition, the Siegel–Walfisz theorem and a combinatorial lemma.

concept.title: Polymath’s Type I, II and III estimates for densely divisible moduli
concept.description: For fixed ϖ,δ,σ>0 (Polymath 2014, Theorem 2.8): Type_I^(1)[ϖ,δ,σ] holds if 54ϖ+15δ+5σ<1; Type_I^(2)[ϖ,δ,σ] if 56ϖ+16δ+4σ<1; Type_I^(4)[ϖ,δ,σ] if (160/3)ϖ+16δ+(34/9)σ<1 and 64ϖ+18δ+2σ<1; Type_II^(1)[ϖ,δ] if 68ϖ+14δ<1; Type_III^(1)[ϖ,δ,σ] if σ>1/18+(28/9)ϖ+(2/9)δ and ϖ<1/12. Each estimate bounds ∑_q|Δ(α⋆β;a mod q)|, or the analogue for α⋆ψ₁⋆ψ₂⋆ψ₃ with smooth ψ_j, by x(log x)^(−A) over squarefree i-tuply x^δ-densely divisible q≤x^(1/2+2ϖ), for coefficient sequences at the prescribed scales. The fourfold Type I and the Type III bounds use Deligne’s Riemann hypothesis over finite fields.

concept.title: Zero divisor in a commutative ring
concept.description: An element a of a commutative ring R is a zero divisor if ab=0 for some nonzero b∈R. An element that is not a zero divisor is a nonzerodivisor (regular element): multiplication by it is injective on R.

concept.title: Minimal prime ideal of a commutative ring
concept.description: A prime ideal 𝔭 of a commutative ring R is minimal if no prime ideal of R is strictly contained in 𝔭. More generally a prime minimal among the primes containing an ideal I is a minimal prime over I.

concept.title: Graded module over a graded commutative ring
concept.description: For a nonnegatively graded commutative ring S, a graded S-module is an S-module M with a decomposition M=⊕_{n∈ℤ}M_n of abelian groups such that S_dM_n⊆M_{d+n}. Maps of graded modules preserve degrees, and the twist M(D) is M regraded by M(D)_n=M_{n+D}.

concept.title: Standard graded algebra over a field
concept.description: A nonnegatively graded commutative k-algebra A=⊕_{m≥0}A_m over a field k with A₀=k that is generated as a k-algebra by finitely many elements of A₁. Equivalently A≅k[x₀,…,x_n]/I for an ideal I generated by homogeneous polynomials, graded by total degree.

concept.title: Projective scheme Proj A of a standard graded algebra
concept.description: For a standard graded algebra A≅k[x₀,…,x_n]/I over a field k, Proj A is the closed subscheme of projective space Pⁿ_k cut out by the homogeneous ideal I; on the chart x_i≠0 it is Spec of the degree-zero part of the localization A_{x_i}. Its points are the homogeneous primes of A not containing A₊=⊕_{m>0}A_m, so it is empty exactly when A₊ is nilpotent.

concept.title: Length of a module over a commutative ring
concept.description: The length of a module M over a commutative ring R is the supremum of the integers n for which there is a strictly increasing chain 0=M₀⊊M₁⊊⋯⊊M_n=M of submodules. M has finite length when this supremum is finite.

concept.title: Degree of a projective scheme over a field
concept.description: For a nonempty closed subscheme X=Proj A of projective space over a field, A a standard graded algebra and r=dim X, the Hilbert polynomial P(m), which equals dim_kA_m for all large m, has degree r. The degree of X is r! times the leading coefficient of P. It depends on the embedding in projective space.

concept.title: Reduced induced closed subscheme structure
concept.description: For a closed subset Z of a scheme X there is a unique reduced closed subscheme of X with underlying set Z: on an affine open Spec R it is Spec R/J, where J is the radical ideal of functions vanishing at every point of Z∩Spec R. Taking Z=X gives the reduction X_red.

concept.title: Nilradical as the intersection of prime ideals
concept.description: In a commutative ring R the set of nilpotent elements equals the intersection of all prime ideals of R. Every prime ideal contains a minimal prime ideal, so the nilradical is also the intersection of the minimal primes.

concept.title: Irreducible components of a prime spectrum
concept.description: For a commutative ring R the irreducible closed subsets of Spec R are exactly the sets V(𝔭) with 𝔭 prime, and the irreducible components of Spec R are exactly the sets V(𝔭) with 𝔭 a minimal prime ideal of R.

concept.title: Norms of integral elements over an integrally closed domain
concept.description: Let A be an integrally closed domain with fraction field F, E/F a finite extension and α∈E integral over A. Then the field norm Nm_{E/F}(α) lies in A, and α divides Nm_{E/F}(α) in A[α].

concept.title: Dimension of a hypersurface in affine space
concept.description: If f∈k[X₁,…,X_n] is a nonconstant polynomial over a field k, every irreducible component of the hypersurface V(f)⊆𝔸ⁿ_k, that is of Spec k[X₁,…,X_n]/(f), has dimension n−1.

concept.title: Dimension theorem for Noetherian local rings
concept.description: For a Noetherian local ring (R,𝔪) the Krull dimension of R equals the degree of the Hilbert–Samuel polynomial, which agrees with n↦length(R/𝔪ⁿ) for large n, and equals the least number of elements of 𝔪 generating an 𝔪-primary ideal.

concept.title: Dimension of the projective scheme of a graded algebra
concept.description: If A is a standard graded algebra over a field and Proj A is nonempty, then dim Proj A = dim A − 1, where dim A is the Krull dimension of A.

concept.title: Minimal primes of a graded ring are homogeneous
concept.description: In a nonnegatively graded commutative ring every minimal prime ideal is homogeneous, that is, generated by homogeneous elements; more generally every minimal prime over a homogeneous ideal is homogeneous.

concept.title: Local dimension of the spectrum of a finite-type algebra
concept.description: Let S be a finitely generated algebra over a field and x∈Spec S the point of a prime 𝔭. The local dimension of Spec S at x equals the largest dimension of an irreducible component through x and equals the least dim S_𝔪 over maximal ideals 𝔪⊇𝔭.

concept.title: Normalized newform of weight k with character
concept.description: A normalized newform of weight k, level N and character χ is a cusp form f=∑a_nqⁿ in the new subspace of S_k(Γ₀(N),χ) that is an eigenform for all Hecke operators T_p (p∤N) and U_p (p|N), normalized by a₁=1; its T_p-eigenvalue is then a_p. It is also called a primitive form; χ is its nebentypus.

concept.title: Coefficient field of a newform
concept.description: The coefficient (Hecke) field of a normalized newform f=∑a_nqⁿ is the subfield ℚ(a_n:n≥1) of ℂ generated by its q-expansion coefficients. It is a number field.

concept.title: Degree polynomial on the endomorphism algebra of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A of dimension g, set deg φ=0 for endomorphisms that are not isogenies and extend to End⁰(A)=End(A)⊗ℚ by deg φ=n^{−2g}deg(nφ). This function is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on the finite-dimensional ℚ-vector space End⁰(A).

concept.title: Factorization of homomorphisms through an étale isogeny
concept.description: Let α:A→A′ be an isogeny of abelian varieties with étale kernel and φ:A→B a homomorphism of abelian varieties vanishing on the finite subgroup scheme Ker α. Then φ=ψ∘α for a unique homomorphism ψ:A′→B. In particular a homomorphism killing A[n], n prime to the characteristic, is divisible by n.

concept.title: Discrete subgroups of a finite-dimensional real vector space
concept.description: A discrete subgroup of a finite-dimensional real vector space V is generated by a set of ℝ-linearly independent vectors; in particular it is a free abelian group of rank at most dim V.

concept.title: Irreducibility of λ-adic representations of weight-two newforms
concept.description: Let f be a normalized weight-two newform with coefficient field E and V_λ its λ-adic Galois representation, λ a prime of E. Each V_λ is simple as an E_λ[G_ℚ]-module, and the image of G_ℚ in Aut(V_λ) is non-abelian. If f has no complex multiplication, every open subgroup of G_ℚ acts irreducibly and non-abelianly on each V_λ.

concept.title: Traces determine semisimple representations in characteristic zero
concept.description: Two finite-dimensional semisimple linear representations of a group over a field of characteristic zero are isomorphic if and only if their characters g↦tr ρ(g) coincide.

concept.title: Unitary fusion category
concept.description: A fusion category over ℂ is unitary if it admits a unitary structure: an antilinear involution f↦f* on morphisms, reversing composition and compatible with the tensor product, for which the associativity and unit isomorphisms are unitary (u*=u⁻¹) and f*∘f=0 only when f=0. A fusion category is nonunitary if it admits no such structure. Fusion categories arising from finite-depth subfactors are unitary.

concept.title: Pseudo-unitarity of unitary fusion categories
concept.description: Every unitary fusion category over ℂ is pseudo-unitary: each simple object X has squared norm |X|² equal to FPdim(X)², so its global dimension equals its Frobenius–Perron dimension.

concept.title: Closed–open regularity of finite Borel measures on metric spaces
concept.description: For a finite Borel measure μ on a metric space X and every Borel set A⊆X, μ(A)=sup{μ(F):F⊆A closed}=inf{μ(U):U⊇A open}; equivalently, for each ε>0 there are F closed and U open with F⊆A⊆U and μ(U∖F)<ε.

concept.title: Purely discontinuous nondecreasing function
concept.description: A nondecreasing real function f on a real interval is purely discontinuous (a pure-jump function) if every increment is the sum of its jumps: for s<t, f(t)−f(s)=(f(s+)−f(s))+∑_(s<u<t)(f(u+)−f(u−))+(f(t)−f(t−)), the sum of nonnegative terms being the supremum of its finite subsums.

concept.title: Path regularity of strong optional supermartingales (Mertens)
concept.description: Under the usual conditions, almost every path of a real strong optional supermartingale X on [0,∞) has finite left and right limits at every time and is right upper semicontinuous; in particular X_(t+)≤X_t for every t, almost surely.

concept.title: Predictable processes are optional
concept.description: On a filtered probability space, the predictable σ-algebra on [0,∞)×Ω is contained in the optional σ-algebra; in particular every adapted left-continuous process is optional.

concept.title: Weak continuity of surface area measures of convex bodies
concept.description: If convex bodies K_j⊂ℝⁿ with nonempty interior converge in Hausdorff distance to a convex body K, their surface area measures converge weakly on the unit sphere: ∫f dS_{K_j}→∫f dS_K for every continuous f on S^{n−1}.

concept.title: Weighted Lebesgue space Lᵖ(w) on Euclidean space
concept.description: For a weight w on ℝⁿ (a locally integrable function with w>0 almost everywhere) and 0<p<∞, Lᵖ(w) consists of the measurable functions f with ∥f∥_{Lᵖ(w)}=(∫|f|ᵖw dx)^{1/p}<∞, identified when equal almost everywhere.

concept.title: Variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin space F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}
concept.description: Fix an admissible inhomogeneous Schwartz pair with family (ϕ_ν)_{ν≥0}. For exponents p,q with globally log-Hölder reciprocals 1/p,1/q (so 0<p⁻≤p⁺<∞, 0<q⁻≤q⁺<∞) and bounded smoothness α≥0, locally log-Hölder with a limit at infinity, F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}(ℝⁿ) consists of the tempered distributions f with finite quasi-norm ∥∥(2^{να(x)}ϕ_ν*f(x))_ν∥_{ℓ^{q(x)}}∥_{L^{p(·)}}.

concept.title: Gowers–Maurey interval estimate for ℓ₁⁺ averages
concept.description: In Schlumprecht’s space S (more generally in Gowers–Maurey-type spaces with bimonotone basis), if x/∥x∥ is a sum of N successive vectors of norm at most C/N (an ℓ₁ᴺ⁺ average with constant C) and E₁<⋯<E_M are intervals of coordinates, then ∑_{j=1}^M∥E_jx∥≤C(1+2M/N)∥x∥.

concept.title: Near-unconditionality on sets of bounded size for weakly null subsequences
concept.description: For every n∈ℕ and ε>0, every normalized weakly null sequence in a Banach space has a subsequence (y_i) with ∥∑_{i∈F}a_iy_i∥≤(1+ε)∥∑_ia_iy_i∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence (a_i) and every F⊂ℕ with |F|≤n.

concept.title: Basic subsequences of normalized weakly null sequences
concept.description: For every ε>0, every normalized weakly null sequence in a Banach space has a subsequence that is a basic sequence with basis constant at most 1+ε.

concept.title: Lusin’s theorem for Lebesgue measurable functions
concept.description: Let f be a complex Lebesgue measurable function on ℝⁿ that vanishes outside a set of finite measure, and ε>0. There is a continuous g on ℝⁿ with compact support such that |{x: f(x)≠g(x)}|<ε, and g can be chosen with sup|g|≤sup|f|. Consequently, if |f|≤1, f is the almost-everywhere limit of compactly supported continuous g_k with |g_k|≤1.

concept.title: Modular and norm convergence in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concept.description: Let p:Ω→[1,∞) be measurable on a measurable Ω⊂ℝⁿ and give L^{p(·)}(Ω) the Luxemburg norm ‖f‖=inf{λ>0: ∫_Ω|f/λ|^{p(x)}dx≤1}. If ess sup p<∞, then ‖f_n−f‖→0 exactly when ∫_Ω|f_n−f|^{p(x)}dx→0. If ess sup p=∞, some f_n have modular ∫_Ω|f_n|^{p(x)}dx→0 while ‖f_n‖ stays bounded away from 0, so the two convergences differ.

concept.title: Atomic decomposition of variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: Under the Diening–Hästö–Roudenko standing assumptions on p,q,α, every f∈F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}(ℝⁿ) is a sum ∑_{Q}t_Qa_Q over dyadic cubes of side at most one, converging in S′, with smooth atoms a_Q of any prescribed smoothness and moment order and coefficients whose discrete f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)} quasi-norm is comparable to ∥f∥.

concept.title: Embedding of variable Triebel–Lizorkin spaces under exponent comparison
concept.description: Under the Diening–Hästö–Roudenko standing assumptions, if α₀≥α₁, p₀≥p₁ with equal limits (p₀)_∞=(p₁)_∞, and q₀≤q₁, then F^{α₀(·)}_{p₀(·),q₀(·)}(ℝⁿ) embeds continuously in F^{α₁(·)}_{p₁(·),q₁(·)}(ℝⁿ); for distributions with bounded support the condition on limits at infinity can be dropped.

concept.title: Littlewood–Paley identification of Sobolev spaces as Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For 1<p<∞ and k∈ℕ₀, the Sobolev space W^{k,p}(ℝⁿ) coincides with the classical Triebel–Lizorkin space F^k_{p,2}(ℝⁿ), with equivalent norms.

concept.title: Smoothness embedding of classical Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: For 0<p<∞, 0<q₀,q₁≤∞ and real s₀>s₁, the classical inhomogeneous Triebel–Lizorkin space F^{s₀}_{p,q₀}(ℝⁿ) embeds continuously in F^{s₁}_{p,q₁}(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Density of compactly supported smooth functions in Sobolev spaces on ℝⁿ
concept.description: For 1≤p<∞ and k∈ℕ₀, C_c^∞(ℝⁿ) is dense in the Sobolev space W^{k,p}(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Ideal of a Lie algebra
concept.description: A linear subspace 𝔥 of a Lie algebra 𝔤 with [x,y]∈𝔥 for all x∈𝔤 and y∈𝔥.

concept.title: Height of a rational number
concept.description: The height of a rational number a/b in lowest terms (gcd(a,b)=1, b>0) is max(|a|,|b|); an irrational real number has infinite height.

concept.title: Filtration of a nilpotent Lie group
concept.description: For a connected simply connected Lie group G, a filtration G_• of degree d is a chain G=G₀=G₁⊇G₂⊇⋯⊇G_d⊇G_(d+1)={1} of closed connected subgroups with [G_i,G_j]⊆G_(i+j) for all i,j≥0, where [H,K] is the subgroup generated by commutators hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ and G_i={1} for i>d. Its existence forces G to be nilpotent; the lower central series is an example.

concept.title: Polynomial sequence with coefficients in a filtration
concept.description: For a group G with filtration G_•, a map g:ℤ→G lies in poly(ℤ,G_•) if ∂_(h_i)⋯∂_(h_1)g takes values in G_i for every i≥1 and all h_1,…,h_i∈ℤ, where ∂_hg(n)=g(n+h)g(n)⁻¹. Linear sequences n↦aⁿx have coefficients in the lower central series filtration.

concept.title: Malcev basis of a nilmanifold adapted to a filtration
concept.description: For G/Γ with G connected simply connected nilpotent, Γ discrete cocompact and a filtration G_•, a basis X₁,…,X_m of the Lie algebra 𝔤 is a Malcev basis adapted to G_• if each span of X_(j+1),…,X_m is an ideal, each G_i is the exponential of the span of the last dim G_i vectors, every g∈G is uniquely exp(t₁X₁)⋯exp(t_mX_m), and Γ is exactly the set with all t_j∈ℤ. The Malcev coordinate map is ψ(g)=(t₁,…,t_m).

concept.title: Q-rational Malcev basis
concept.description: A Malcev basis X₁,…,X_m of a nilmanifold is Q-rational if all structure constants c_ijk in [X_i,X_j]=∑_k c_ijk X_k are rational numbers of height at most Q.

concept.title: Rational subgroup relative to a Malcev basis
concept.description: Given a Malcev basis X₁,…,X_m of G/Γ, a closed connected subgroup G′⊆G is Q-rational relative to it if its Lie algebra 𝔤′={X∈𝔤: exp(tX)∈G′ for all real t} has a basis of combinations ∑a_iX_i whose coefficients a_i are rational of height at most Q. A rational subgroup is one that is Q-rational for some Q.

concept.title: Rational point of a nilmanifold
concept.description: For a nilmanifold G/Γ, an element γ∈G is rational if γʳ∈Γ for some integer r>0, and Q-rational if such r≤Q exists; a (Q-)rational point is a coset γΓ of such an element. A sequence (γ(n)) in G is Q-rational if every γ(n)Γ is a Q-rational point.

concept.title: Total δ-equidistribution of a finite sequence in a nilmanifold
concept.description: Let G/Γ carry a Malcev metric d and its normalized invariant probability measure. A finite sequence (g(n)Γ)_(n∈[N]) is δ-equidistributed if |E_(n∈[N])F(g(n)Γ)−∫F|≤δ‖F‖_Lip for every Lipschitz F:G/Γ→ℂ, where ‖F‖_Lip is the supremum norm plus the Lipschitz constant for d. It is totally δ-equidistributed if the same bound holds for averages over every arithmetic progression P⊆[N] of length at least δN.

concept.title: Type I/II dichotomy for Möbius correlations
concept.description: If f:ℕ→ℂ has ‖f‖∞≤1 and |E_(N<n≤2N)μ(n)f(n)|≥ε, then either a Type I average |E_(N/k<w≤2N/k)f(kw)|≫(ε/logN)^C holds for ≫(ε/logN)^C·K values k∈(K,2K] with some K≤N^(2/3), or a Type II average |E_(k,k′∈(K,2K])E_(w,w′∈[W,2W))f(kw)f̄(k′w)f̄(kw′)f(k′w′)|≫(ε/logN)^C holds with N^(1/3)/2≤K≤4N^(2/3) and N/4≤KW≤4N. It is Vaughan’s identity in bilinear form.

concept.title: Green–Tao quantitative Leibman theorem
concept.description: Let G/Γ be an m-dimensional nilmanifold with a filtration G_• of degree d and a 1/δ-rational Malcev basis adapted to it, 0<δ<1/2, and g∈poly(ℤ,G_•). If (g(n)Γ)_(n∈[N]) is not δ-equidistributed, there is a horizontal character η with 0<|η|≪δ^(−C) and ‖η∘g‖_(C^∞[N])≪δ^(−C), where C depends only on m and d.

concept.title: Horizontal character of a nilmanifold
concept.description: A horizontal character of a nilmanifold G/Γ is a continuous homomorphism η:G→ℝ/ℤ with η(Γ)=0. In Malcev coordinates it has the form η(g)=k·ψ(g) for a unique k∈ℤ^m, and its modulus is |η|=|k|.

concept.title: Smoothness norm of a polynomial phase
concept.description: Write a polynomial p:ℤ→ℝ/ℤ of degree d as p(n)=α₀+α₁C(n,1)+⋯+α_dC(n,d) with binomial coefficients C(n,j). Its C^∞[N] norm is ‖p‖_(C^∞[N])=max_(1≤j≤d)N^j‖α_j‖_(ℝ/ℤ), with ‖·‖_(ℝ/ℤ) the distance to the nearest integer; it measures how slowly p varies on [N].

concept.title: Lazard–Leibman theorem for filtered polynomial maps
concept.description: For any group H, nilpotent group G and filtration G_• of G, the maps g:H→G with ∂_(h_i)⋯∂_(h_1)g(x)∈G_i for all i and h_1,…,h_i∈H, where ∂_hg(x)=g(xh)g(x)⁻¹, form a group poly(H,G_•) under pointwise multiplication.

concept.title: Strongly recurrent linear phases have small-denominator approximations
concept.description: Let α∈ℝ, 0<δ<1/2 and 0<ε≤δ/2. If αn mod 1 lies in a fixed interval of length ε for at least δN integers n∈[N], then some integer k with 0<|k|≪δ^(−C) satisfies ‖kα‖_(ℝ/ℤ)≪εδ^(−C)/N, with C absolute.

concept.title: Malcev fundamental domain of a nilmanifold
concept.description: For a Malcev basis of G/Γ with coordinate map ψ, every g∈G factors uniquely as g={g}[g] with ψ({g})∈[0,1)^m and [g]∈Γ. Consequently, if the basis is Q-rational, G/Γ has diameter at most Q^C in the Malcev metric, with C depending only on the dimension and degree.

concept.title: Malcev coordinates of a filtered polynomial sequence
concept.description: For a Malcev basis of G/Γ adapted to a filtration G_• with dimensions m_i=dim G_i, a sequence g:ℤ→G lies in poly(ℤ,G_•) exactly when ψ(g(n))=∑_j t_j C(n,j) with t_j∈ℝ^m and (t_j)_i=0 for i≤m−m_j. In particular poly(ℤ,G_•) is preserved by reparametrizations n↦a+bn with integers a,b.

concept.title: Polynomial comparison of Malcev coordinates and Malcev metrics
concept.description: Let X be a Q-rational nested basis of the Lie algebra of G and X′ a nested basis of the Lie algebra of a closed subgroup G′ consisting of Q-rational combinations of X. On points whose coordinates or distances to the identity are at most Q, the coordinate distance |ψ(x)−ψ(y)|, d_X(x,y) and d_(X′)(x,y) (for x,y∈G′) are each bounded by Q^C times the others, with C depending only on the dimensions and step.

concept.title: Approximate left invariance of the Malcev metric
concept.description: For a Q-rational nested basis of the Lie algebra of a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group, the right-invariant Malcev metric satisfies d(gx,gy)≤Q^C d(x,y) whenever g,x,y have Malcev coordinates of size at most Q, with C depending only on the dimension and step.

concept.title: Rational points in Malcev coordinates
concept.description: For a Q-rational Malcev basis of G/Γ, an element γ∈G is rational exactly when its Malcev coordinates are rational, and rational elements form a subgroup containing Γ. Quantitatively, Q-rational elements have coordinates in (1/Q′)ℤ^m with Q′≤Q^C, coordinates in (1/Q)ℤ^m give Q^C-rational elements, and products and inverses of Q-rational elements are Q^C-rational.

concept.title: Periodicity of rational polynomial sequences on a nilmanifold
concept.description: If γ:ℤ→G is a polynomial sequence in a nilpotent Lie group and every γ(n)Γ is a rational point of G/Γ, then n↦γ(n)Γ is periodic. If G/Γ has a Q-rational Malcev basis and γ is Q-rational, the period is at most Q^C, with C depending only on the dimension and degree.

concept.title: Polynomial group law in Malcev coordinates
concept.description: For a basis X of the Lie algebra of a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group with [𝔤,X_i]⊆span(X_(i+1),…,X_m), exponential coordinates and Malcev coordinates are related by triangular polynomial maps, and multiplication and inversion in Malcev coordinates are given by triangular polynomials of bounded degree. For a Q-rational basis all coefficients are rationals of height at most Q^C.

concept.title: Möbius cancellation twisted by a Dirichlet character
concept.description: For every A>0 there is an ineffective constant C_A such that |N⁻¹∑_(n≤N)μ(n)χ(n)|≤C_A q^(1/2)(logN)^(−A) for all N≥2 and all Dirichlet characters χ of modulus q. It follows from zero-free regions for Dirichlet L-functions including Siegel’s bound.

concept.title: Two-sided Brownian motion
concept.description: A real process (W_t)_{t∈ℝ} with W_0=0 such that (W_t)_{t≥0} and (W_{−t})_{t≥0} are independent standard Brownian motions.

concept.title: Wiener integral of a deterministic square-integrable function
concept.description: For a two-sided Brownian motion W, the Wiener integral ∫_ℝf dW is the linear isometry I:L²(ℝ)→L²(P) with I(1_{(s,t]})=W_t−W_s for s<t, extended from step functions by L² limits. Its values are jointly centred Gaussian with E[I(f)I(g)]=∫fg.

concept.title: Commutant of a set of Hilbert-space operators
concept.description: For a set S of bounded operators on a complex Hilbert space H, the commutant S′ is the set of bounded operators on H commuting with every element of S. The double commutant (bicommutant) is S″=(S′)′.

concept.title: Von Neumann bicommutant theorem
concept.description: If A is a *-subalgebra of the bounded operators on a complex Hilbert space that contains the identity, then its double commutant A″ equals the closure of A in the strong operator topology and also its closure in the weak operator topology.

concept.title: Von Neumann algebra
concept.description: A von Neumann algebra on a complex Hilbert space H is a *-subalgebra M of the bounded operators on H that contains the identity and is closed in the weak operator topology; by the bicommutant theorem, equivalently M=M″. It is in particular a unital C*-algebra.

concept.title: Factor (von Neumann algebra)
concept.description: A von Neumann algebra whose center consists only of the scalar multiples of the identity.

concept.title: Normal state on a von Neumann algebra
