concept.description: A state φ of a von Neumann algebra M on a Hilbert space H is normal if there are vectors ξ₁,ξ₂,… in H with ∑ᵢ‖ξᵢ‖²=1 and φ(x)=∑ᵢ⟨xξᵢ,ξᵢ⟩ for every positive x∈M.

concept.title: Normal representation of a von Neumann algebra
concept.description: A unital star representation π:M→B(K) of a von Neumann algebra M on a complex Hilbert space K such that every vector state x↦⟨π(x)ξ,ξ⟩, with ξ∈K a unit vector, is a normal state of M. K with this action is a (left) Hilbert M-module.

concept.title: Opposite algebra
concept.description: The opposite algebra Aᵒᵖ of an associative algebra A has the same underlying vector space and identity, with reversed multiplication a·b:=ba.

concept.title: Self-dual cone in a Hilbert space
concept.description: For a subset P of a complex Hilbert space H, the dual cone is P°={ξ∈H : ⟨ξ,η⟩≥0 for every η∈P}. P is a self-dual cone if P=P°; such a P is a closed convex cone.

concept.title: Standard form of a von Neumann algebra
concept.description: A standard form (M,H,J,P) of a von Neumann algebra M on H consists of a conjugate-linear isometric involution J of H and a self-dual cone P⊆H with JMJ=M′, JcJ=c* for every c in the center of M, Jξ=ξ for ξ∈P, and aJaJ(P)⊆P for a∈M. Every von Neumann algebra has a standard form, unique up to unitary equivalence (Haagerup); H is then written L²(M), with commuting right action ξ·a=Ja*Jξ.

concept.title: Covolume of a full lattice in Euclidean space
concept.description: For a full lattice Λ=ℤe₁+⋯+ℤeₙ⊂ℝⁿ, its covolume is the Lebesgue measure of the fundamental parallelepiped {∑aᵢeᵢ:0≤aᵢ<1}, which equals |det(e₁,…,eₙ)|. It does not depend on the ℤ-basis, since two bases differ by an integer matrix of determinant ±1.

concept.title: Blichfeldt’s lemma for lattices
concept.description: Let Λ⊂ℝⁿ be a full lattice and S⊆ℝⁿ a Lebesgue-measurable set whose measure exceeds the covolume of Λ. Then S contains two distinct points α,β with β−α∈Λ.

concept.title: Discriminant of a field basis via embeddings
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite separable extension of degree m and σ₁,…,σ_m the distinct K-embeddings of L into a Galois extension Ω. For every K-basis β₁,…,β_m of L, det(Tr_(L/K)(β_iβ_j))=det(σ_i(β_j))², and this discriminant is nonzero.

concept.title: Closedness of locally compact subgroups
concept.description: If G is a Hausdorff topological group and H is a subgroup that is locally compact in the subspace topology, then H is closed in G. In particular every discrete subgroup of a Hausdorff topological group is closed.

concept.title: Multiplicative group of integers modulo n
concept.description: For an integer n≥1, (ℤ/nℤ)× is the set of residue classes modulo n of the integers coprime to n, which is a finite abelian group under multiplication of representatives.

concept.title: Relative class number of a prime cyclotomic field
concept.description: For an odd prime p, the relative class number h⁻(p) is the quotient h(ℚ(ζ_p))/h(ℚ(ζ_p+ζ_p⁻¹)) of the class numbers of ℚ(ζ_p) and of its maximal real subfield. Kummer showed that it is a positive integer, the first factor of the class number.

concept.title: Kummer’s reduction of p | h(ℚ(ζ_p)) to the relative class number
concept.description: For an odd prime p, p divides the class number of ℚ(ζ_p) if and only if p divides the relative class number h⁻(p)=h(ℚ(ζ_p))/h(ℚ(ζ_p+ζ_p⁻¹)).

concept.title: Kummer’s power-sum criterion for the relative class number
concept.description: For an odd prime p, p divides the relative class number h⁻(p) of ℚ(ζ_p) if and only if p² divides ∑_(j=1)^(p−1) j^(2k) for some integer k with 1≤k≤(p−3)/2.

concept.title: Power-sum congruence for Bernoulli numbers
concept.description: For integers m≥2 and k≥1, write B_(2k)=N_(2k)/D_(2k) in lowest terms with D_(2k)>0. Then m·N_(2k)≡D_(2k)·∑_(j=1)^(m−1) j^(2k) modulo m².

concept.title: Von Staudt–Clausen theorem
concept.description: For every k≥1, B_(2k)+∑1/p, summed over the primes p with (p−1) dividing 2k, is an integer. Hence the reduced denominator of B_(2k) is the squarefree product of those primes.

concept.title: Isogeny character of a prime-degree elliptic isogeny
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a field K of characteristic different from p, with a Gal(K̄/K)-stable line D⊂E[p], the kernel of a K-rational p-isogeny. Its isogeny character λ:Gal(K̄/K)→𝔽_p× gives the Galois action on D; the action on E[p]/D is then the mod-p cyclotomic character times λ⁻¹.

concept.title: Inertia restriction of the twelfth power of an isogeny character
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K with a K-rational p-isogeny and isogeny character λ, where p≥5 is unramified in K. Then λ¹² is unramified outside the primes above p. At each prime 𝔭|p where E does not have additive, potentially supersingular reduction, λ¹² restricted to inertia at 𝔭 equals χ_p^(α_𝔭) for some α_𝔭∈{0,12}, χ_p the mod-p cyclotomic character.

concept.title: Global reciprocity map of idelic class field theory
concept.description: For a number field K there is a continuous surjective homomorphism r:𝕀_K→Gal(K^ab/K) from the idele group, trivial on the principal ideles K×. Its restriction to each K_v× is the local reciprocity map followed by restriction. At a finite place unramified in an abelian extension it kills the local units and sends a uniformizer to the Frobenius element.

concept.title: Local reciprocity on p-th roots of unity over an unramified p-adic field
concept.description: Let K_𝔭 be a finite unramified extension of ℚ_p with residue field k and local reciprocity map θ. For a unit a∈O_(K_𝔭)× and a primitive p-th root of unity ζ, θ(a)(ζ)=ζ^(n⁻¹) where n≡N_(k/𝔽_p)(a mod 𝔭) modulo p.

concept.title: Serre’s ramification theorem for Frobenius fields of non-CM elliptic curves
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K without complex multiplication over K̄. For every finite set P of rational primes there are infinitely many primes 𝔮 of good reduction such that the field generated by a root of the Frobenius polynomial X²−t_𝔮X+N𝔮 is ramified at every prime of P.

concept.title: Degree bound on embeddings of a finite field extension
concept.description: Let E/F be a finite field extension and L/F any field extension. There are at most [E:F] homomorphisms E→L fixing F. If E is generated over F by roots of a polynomial f∈F[X] that factors into distinct linear factors in L[X], there are exactly [E:F] of them. In particular |Aut(E/F)|≤[E:F].

concept.title: Tower law for degrees of field extensions
concept.description: For fields F⊆M⊆E, [E:F]=[E:M][M:F], where [E:F] denotes the dimension of E as an F-vector space; E/F is finite if and only if E/M and M/F are. If (e_i) is an M-basis of E and (m_j) an F-basis of M, the products e_im_j form an F-basis of E.

concept.title: One-dimensional formal group law
concept.description: A one-dimensional commutative formal group law over a commutative ring R is a power series F(X,Y)∈R[[X,Y]] with F(X,Y)=X+Y+(terms of degree ≥2), F(X,F(Y,Z))=F(F(X,Y),Z) and F(X,Y)=F(Y,X). If R is a complete local ring with maximal ideal 𝔪, the operation x⊕y=F(x,y) makes 𝔪 an abelian group F(𝔪), with subgroups F(𝔪ⁿ) for n≥1.

concept.title: Jacobson radical of a commutative ring
concept.description: The Jacobson radical of a commutative ring R is the intersection of all maximal ideals of R. Equivalently it consists of the x∈R such that 1−xy is a unit for every y∈R. For a local ring it is the maximal ideal.

concept.title: Henselian local ring
concept.description: A local ring (R,𝔪) with residue field k=R/𝔪 is henselian if for every monic f∈R[X] and every factorization of its reduction f̄=g₀h₀ in k[X] into coprime monic polynomials there are monic g,h∈R[X] with f=gh, ḡ=g₀ and h̄=h₀. Equivalently every simple root in k of the reduction of a monic polynomial lifts to a root in R. Complete local rings are henselian.

concept.title: Lifting points of smooth schemes over a henselian local ring
concept.description: Let R be a henselian local ring with residue field k and X→Spec R a smooth morphism. Every k-point of the special fibre lifts to an R-point of X, so X(R)→X(k) is surjective. If X→Spec R is étale, the lift is unique: X(R)→X(k) is bijective.

concept.title: Étaleness of multiplication by an invertible integer on a smooth commutative group
concept.description: Let G be a smooth commutative group scheme over a scheme S and n a positive integer invertible on S. Then multiplication by n, [n]:G→G, is an étale morphism; its differential at the identity is multiplication by n on the Lie algebra, which is invertible.

concept.title: Product σ-algebra
concept.description: For measurable spaces (E_i,ℰ_i), i∈I, the product σ-algebra ⊗ℰ_i on the Cartesian product ∏E_i is the σ-algebra generated by the coordinate preimages π_i⁻¹(A), i∈I, A∈ℰ_i; it is the smallest σ-algebra making every coordinate projection measurable.

concept.title: Space of càdlàg paths with its evaluation σ-algebra
concept.description: For a metric space E, D([0,∞),E) is the set of càdlàg paths x:[0,∞)→E. Its evaluation σ-algebra is generated by the evaluation maps x↦x(t), t≥0, that is, by the sets {x:x(t)∈B} with B a Borel subset of E. A Skorokhod topology is additional structure.

concept.title: Quantile function of a probability measure on the real line
concept.description: For a Borel probability measure μ on ℝ with distribution function F(x)=μ((−∞,x]), the quantile function is Q_μ(u)=inf{x∈ℝ:F(x)≥u} for 0<u<1, the generalized inverse of F.

concept.title: Finite-dimensional distributions of a stochastic process
concept.description: For a stochastic process (X_t)_{t∈T} with state space (E,ℰ), the finite-dimensional distributions are the laws of the random vectors (X_{t₁},…,X_{tₙ}) on Eⁿ with the product σ-algebra, for all finite t₁<…<tₙ in T. Processes on possibly different probability spaces have the same law in this sense when all these distributions agree.

concept.title: Weak solution of a Brownian stochastic differential equation
concept.description: A weak solution of dX_t=b(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dW_t, possibly with a prescribed reflection term, is a filtered probability space with a Brownian motion W relative to its filtration and an adapted continuous process X, with its regulator if any, satisfying the integral equation almost surely. The probability space and W are part of the solution.

concept.title: Uniqueness in law for a Brownian stochastic differential equation
concept.description: A Brownian stochastic differential equation has uniqueness in law if any two weak solutions, possibly on different probability spaces, whose initial values have the same distribution have solution processes with the same finite-dimensional distributions.

concept.title: Strong solution of a Brownian stochastic differential equation
concept.description: Given a probability space carrying a Brownian motion W and an independent initial value ξ, a strong solution of dX_t=b(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dW_t, possibly with a prescribed reflection term, is a continuous process adapted to the filtration generated by ξ and W, augmented by null sets, that satisfies the integral equation almost surely.

concept.title: Pathwise uniqueness for a Brownian stochastic differential equation
concept.description: Pathwise uniqueness holds for a Brownian stochastic differential equation, possibly with a reflection term, if any two weak solutions on a common filtered probability space with the same Brownian motion and almost surely equal initial values are indistinguishable.

concept.title: Piecing out a Markov process killed at a state-dependent rate
concept.description: Given a right-continuous strong Markov process X on E, a measurable rate r:E→[0,∞) and a probability kernel K on E: run X, take an independent standard exponential variable e and kill X at ζ=inf{t:∫₀ᵗr(X_s)ds>e}; restart at time ζ from a point drawn from K(X_ζ,·) using an independent fresh copy of X, and repeat. The pieced process is defined up to the limit of the killing times and is nonexplosive if that limit is almost surely infinite.

concept.title: Second countability of separable metric spaces
concept.description: Every separable metric space is second countable: the open balls of positive rational radius centred at the points of a countable dense subset form a countable basis of its topology.

concept.title: Continuity of a measure along monotone sequences of sets
concept.description: For a measure μ and measurable sets Aₙ: if A₁⊆A₂⊆… then μ(⋃ₙAₙ)=limₙμ(Aₙ); if A₁⊇A₂⊇… and μ(A₁)<∞ then μ(⋂ₙAₙ)=limₙμ(Aₙ).

concept.title: Formal group of a Weierstrass elliptic curve
concept.description: For a generalized Weierstrass equation y²+a₁xy+a₃y=x³+a₂x²+a₄x+a₆ with coefficients in a ring R, put z=−x/y and w=−1/y. Then w has a unique expansion w(z)=z³(1+A₁z+⋯)∈R[[z]], x=z/w(z) and y=−1/w(z), and the chord-and-tangent law gives the formal group law Ê(z₁,z₂)=z₁+z₂−a₁z₁z₂−⋯ over R. The invariant differential dx/(2y+a₁x+a₃) expands as (1+a₁z+⋯)dz. If R is the valuation ring of a nonarchimedean local field with maximal ideal 𝔪, these series converge on 𝔪, and Ê(𝔪) is the abelian group 𝔪 with x⊕y=Ê(x,y).

concept.title: Group of nonsingular points of a Weierstrass cubic
concept.description: For a possibly singular Weierstrass cubic C over a field k, the set C_ns(k) of its k-rational points at which the equation is nonsingular, including O=[0:1:0], is an abelian group under the chord-and-tangent rule: P+Q+R=O when P,Q,R are the three intersections, with multiplicity, of C with a line. For a nonsingular cubic this is the group of the elliptic curve.

concept.title: Reduction of an elliptic curve over a local field and its points
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a nonarchimedean local field K with valuation ring R, maximal ideal 𝔪 and residue field k, given by a minimal integral Weierstrass equation. Reducing its coefficients modulo 𝔪 gives a possibly singular Weierstrass cubic Ẽ over k. A point P=[x:y:z]∈E(K), scaled so that x,y,z∈R are not all in 𝔪, reduces to P̃=[x̃:ỹ:z̃]∈Ẽ(k). E⁰(K) is the set of points whose reduction is a nonsingular point of Ẽ, and E¹(K) the set reducing to O=[0:1:0]; both are independent of the minimal equation chosen.

concept.title: Cassels’s integrality bound for torsion points over a local field
concept.description: Let K be a characteristic-zero field complete for a discrete valuation v, with valuation ring R, uniformizer π and residue characteristic p>0, and let E/K be given by a Weierstrass equation with coefficients in R. If P∈E(K) has exact order m≥2 and m is not a power of p, then x(P),y(P)∈R. If m=pⁿ, then π^(2r)x(P) and π^(3r)y(P) lie in R, where r=⌊v(p)/(pⁿ−pⁿ⁻¹)⌋.

concept.title: Schulze-Pillot’s theorem on exceptional integers of a positive definite ternary genus
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite integral ternary ℤ-lattice of level N. There is c=c(N) such that every t≥c represented locally everywhere by L, with bounded divisibility by the primes where L is anisotropic, is represented by every lattice in the genus of L, unless (i) t is a spinor exception, represented exactly by the lattices of the half genus representing it; or (ii) t/p² is a spinor exception for a prime p inert in the quadratic field E associated with the square class of t, in which case t is represented by all lattices of the half genus not representing t/p² and by precisely those lattices of the other half genus that represent t/p².

concept.title: Split-prime-square invariance of ternary spinor exceptions
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite integral ternary lattice, tℚ² a spinor exceptional square class of its genus with associated quadratic field E=ℚ(√(−dt)), d the discriminant. If a prime p splits in E, then for every t′ in that square class, t′p² is a (primitive) spinor exception exactly when t′ is, and t′ and t′p² are (primitively) represented by the same spinor genera of the genus.

concept.title: Quotient ordering of a partially ordered abelian group by a subgroup
concept.description: For a partially ordered abelian group G and a subgroup H with H∩G⁺={0}, the quotient ordering on G/H has positive cone (G/H)⁺={g+H: g+h∈G⁺ for some h∈H}, the image of G⁺. Since H∩G⁺={0} this is a partial ordering, and G/H is directed when G is. Unperforation need not pass to the quotient.

concept.title: Singular series in Waring’s problem
concept.description: For integers k≥2, s≥1 and n, the singular series is 𝔖_(s,k)(n)=∑_(q≥1)∑_(1≤a≤q,(a,q)=1)(q⁻¹S(q,a))^s e(−an/q), where e(x)=exp(2πix) and S(q,a)=∑_(r=1)^q e(ar^k/q) is a complete exponential sum. The double series converges absolutely when s is large compared with k, for example s≥2^k+1.

concept.title: Existence of states on a partially ordered abelian group with order unit
concept.description: Every nonzero partially ordered abelian group G with an order unit u admits a state: a positive group homomorphism s:G→ℝ with s(u)=1.

concept.title: Affine-function splitting along closed complementary faces of a Choquet simplex
concept.description: Let K be a Choquet simplex and F a closed face. There is a unique complementary face F′, disjoint from F, such that every point of K is uniquely a convex combination of a point of F and a point of F′. If F′ is also closed, restriction gives an isomorphism of ordered groups Aff K≅Aff F×Aff F′ between spaces of continuous affine real functions.

concept.title: Bezuglyi–Handelman sufficient condition for unperforated quotients of simple dimension groups
concept.description: Let (G,u) be a simple dimension group, L a subgroup with L∩G⁺={0} and G/L torsion-free, and J the closure of the image of L in Aff S(G,u) under the affine representation. If J is a real vector space, or more generally if D(J)+P(J) is dense in J, where D(J) is the largest real vector subspace of J and P(J) the subgroup generated by the nonnegative functions in J, then G/L is unperforated in the quotient ordering.

concept.title: Discreteness of lower-rank subgroups of a critical dimension group
concept.description: If G⊂ℝⁿ is a critical dimension group, a dense free abelian subgroup of rank n+1, then every subgroup of G of rank at most n is discrete in ℝⁿ.

concept.title: Bernoulli polynomials
concept.description: The Bernoulli polynomials B_n(x)∈ℚ[x] are defined by te^(xt)/(e^t−1)=∑_(n≥0)B_n(x)tⁿ/n!. Equivalently B_n(x)=∑_(j=0)^n C(n,j)B_j x^(n−j), so B_n(0)=B_n.

concept.title: Generalized Bernoulli numbers of a Dirichlet character
concept.description: For a Dirichlet character χ of conductor f, the generalized Bernoulli numbers B_(n,χ) are defined by ∑_(a=1)^f χ(a)te^(at)/(e^(ft)−1)=∑_(n≥0)B_(n,χ)tⁿ/n!. For every multiple F of f one has B_(n,χ)=F^(n−1)∑_(a=1)^F χ(a)B_n(a/F) with Bernoulli polynomials B_n(x). For the trivial character B_(n,1)=B_n for n≥2.

concept.title: p-adic powers of principal units of ℤ_p
concept.description: Let p be an odd prime and u∈1+pℤ_p. For s∈ℤ_p the binomial series u^s=∑_(j≥0)C(s,j)(u−1)^j converges, agrees with integer powers and satisfies u^(s+t)=u^s u^t. As a function of s it is a power series ∑a_n sⁿ with |a_n|_p≤p^(−n(1−1/(p−1))), convergent on a disc containing ℤ_p. For a∈ℤ_p^× one writes ⟨a⟩=a/ω(a)∈1+pℤ_p, with ω(a) the Teichmüller lift of a mod p.

concept.title: Weyl’s inequality for polynomial exponential sums
concept.description: Let f be a real polynomial of degree k≥2 with leading coefficient α, and suppose |α−a/q|≤q⁻² with q≥1 and (a,q)=1. Then for K=2^(k−1) and every ε>0, ∑_(x=1)^P e(f(x))≪_(k,ε)P^(1+ε)(P⁻¹+q⁻¹+qP^(−k))^(1/K), where e(x)=exp(2πix).

concept.title: Hua’s lemma on moments of Weyl sums
concept.description: For k≥2, 1≤j≤k and every ε>0, the Weyl sum T(α)=∑_(x=1)^P e(αx^k) satisfies ∫_0^1|T(α)|^(2^j)dα≪_(k,ε)P^(2^j−j+ε). Equivalently, the number of solutions of x₁^k+⋯+x_m^k=y₁^k+⋯+y_m^k with m=2^(j−1) and all variables in [1,P] is ≪P^(2^j−j+ε).

concept.title: Major and minor arcs in the Hardy–Littlewood circle method
concept.description: In the circle method a representation count is written r(n)=∫_0^1 T(α)^s e(−nα)dα with an exponential sum T. For a size parameter P and small δ>0, the major arcs are the disjoint neighbourhoods 𝔐(q,a)={α mod 1:|α−a/q|≤P^(−k+δ)} of rationals a/q with 1≤a≤q≤P^δ and (a,q)=1; the minor arcs are the rest of ℝ/ℤ. On major arcs T is approximated by q⁻¹S(q,a)∫_0^P e(βξ^k)dξ, while minor arcs are bounded by Weyl and mean-value estimates.

concept.title: Fourier integral theorem for functions of bounded variation
concept.description: Let φ be integrable on a bounded interval containing u₀ in its interior and of bounded variation near u₀. Then lim_(λ→∞)∫φ(u)sin(2πλ(u−u₀))/(π(u−u₀))du=(φ(u₀+)+φ(u₀−))/2; in particular the limit is φ(u₀) at a point of continuity.

concept.title: Approximation of convex bodies by strongly isomorphic simple polytopes
concept.description: For nonempty compact convex sets K₁,…,K_m⊂ℝⁿ and ε>0 there are simple polytopes P₁,…,P_m with Hausdorff distance d_H(K_i,P_i)<ε that are strongly isomorphic: for every unit vector u their faces with outer normal u all have the same dimension.

concept.title: Subgroup generated by a subset
concept.description: For a subset X of a group G, the subgroup ⟨X⟩ generated by X is the smallest subgroup of G containing X, the intersection of all subgroups containing X. It consists of the identity and the finite products x₁^(±1)⋯x_n^(±1) of elements of X and their inverses; X generates G if ⟨X⟩=G.

concept.title: Standard parabolic subgroup of a BN-pair
concept.description: Let (B,N) be a BN-pair in G with H=B∩N and Weyl system (W,S), W=N/H. For J⊆S let W_J=⟨J⟩ and let N_J be its preimage in N. The standard parabolic subgroup P_J is the subgroup of G generated by B and N_J; thus P_∅=B and P_S=G. A parabolic subgroup is a conjugate of some P_J.

concept.title: Building with an apartment system
concept.description: A (thick) building is a thick chamber complex X with a set 𝒜 of chamber subcomplexes, called apartments, each a thin chamber complex, such that any two simplices of X lie in a common apartment, and whenever two apartments A,A′ both contain a simplex x and a chamber C there is a chamber-complex isomorphism A→A′ fixing x and C pointwise. The chambers are the maximal simplices; 𝒜 is an apartment system of X.

concept.title: Type-preserving automorphism of a building
concept.description: A type function on a building X is a map from its vertices to a set I whose restriction to the vertices of each chamber is a bijection onto I; every thick building has one, unique up to a bijection of I. A simplicial automorphism of X is type preserving if it preserves the type of every vertex; one stabilizing a chamber then fixes that chamber pointwise.

concept.title: Strongly transitive action on a building
concept.description: An action of a group G on a building X by simplicial automorphisms preserving an apartment system 𝒜 is strongly transitive if G acts transitively on the pairs (C,A) consisting of an apartment A∈𝒜 and a chamber C of A.

concept.title: Resistance form of a regular harmonic structure as a Dirichlet form
concept.description: Let (D,r) be a regular harmonic structure on a p.c.f. self-similar set K, with resistance energy (E,F), F⊂C(K), and let μ be a finite Borel measure on K with full support. Then (E,F) is a strongly local regular symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(K,μ): F is dense in C(K) for the uniform norm and complete for the norm (E(u)+‖u‖²_(L²(μ)))^(1/2).

concept.title: Weak containment of unitary representations
concept.description: A unitary representation ρ of a locally compact group G is weakly contained in a unitary representation π of G if every diagonal matrix coefficient g↦⟨ρ(g)v,v⟩ of ρ is a limit, uniformly on compact subsets of G, of finite sums of diagonal matrix coefficients of π; equivalently of convex combinations of normalized ones when v is a unit vector.

concept.title: Right regular representation on L²(Γ∖G)
concept.description: For a unimodular locally compact group G and a discrete subgroup Γ, right translation (R(g)f)(Γx)=f(Γxg) defines a unitary representation R of G on L²(Γ∖G) with its quotient Haar measure; its restriction to a closed subgroup H of G is a unitary representation of H.

concept.title: Harish-Chandra function of PGL₂(ℚ_p)
concept.description: Let G=PGL₂(ℚ_p)=GL₂(ℚ_p)/ℚ_p^×, B its upper-triangular subgroup and K=PGL₂(ℤ_p). The unitary principal series induced from the trivial character of B with normalized induction is right translation on functions f:G→ℂ with f(bg)=|a/d|_p^(1/2)f(g) for b with diagonal entries a,d, normed by ∫_K|f|²dk for the Haar probability measure on K, using G=BK. With f₀ its K-fixed vector equal to 1 on K, the Harish-Chandra function is the spherical matrix coefficient Ξ(g)=⟨π(g)f₀,f₀⟩=∫_K|a(kg)/d(kg)|_p^(1/2)dk; it is K-biinvariant and Ξ(e)=1.

concept.title: Smooth Urysohn lemma in Euclidean space
concept.description: If Ω⊂ℝⁿ is open and K⊂Ω is compact, there is a compactly supported smooth function φ on Ω with 0≤φ≤1 everywhere and φ=1 on K.

concept.title: Bruhat decomposition for a BN-pair
concept.description: For a BN-pair (B,N) in G with Weyl system (W,S): (W,S) is a Coxeter system; G is the disjoint union of the double cosets BwB, w∈W; for s∈S and w∈W one has BwB·BsB=BwsB if ℓ(ws)>ℓ(w) and BwB·BsB=BwsB∪BwB if ℓ(ws)<ℓ(w); and for every J⊆S the union BW_JB of the cells BwB with w∈W_J=⟨J⟩ is a subgroup, the standard parabolic subgroup P_J.

concept.title: Subgroups containing B in a BN-pair
concept.description: For a BN-pair (B,N) in G with Weyl system (W,S), every subgroup of G containing B equals P_J=BW_JB for a unique J⊆S. The map J↦P_J is an inclusion-preserving bijection, each P_J is its own normalizer in G, and distinct P_J are not conjugate in G.

concept.title: Coxeter complex of a Coxeter system
concept.description: For a Coxeter system (W,S) with S finite, the Coxeter complex Σ(W,S) is the poset of cosets wW_T, w∈W, T⊊S, W_T=⟨T⟩, ordered by reverse inclusion and regarded as a simplicial complex. Its chambers are the singletons {w}, and W acts on it by left multiplication.

concept.title: Coxeter complexes are thin chamber complexes
concept.description: For a Coxeter system (W,S) with S finite, the Coxeter complex Σ(W,S) is a uniquely labellable thin chamber complex. W acts on it by type-preserving automorphisms, transitively on the simplices of each type, and the stabilizer of the simplex wW_T is wW_Tw⁻¹.

concept.title: Affine Weyl groups as Coxeter groups on alcoves
concept.description: For an irreducible reduced finite crystallographic root system, the affine Weyl group W_a, with the set S of reflections in the walls of a fixed alcove, is a Coxeter system acting simply transitively on alcoves, and the affine Coxeter complex is W_a-equivariantly isomorphic to the Coxeter complex Σ(W_a,S). In particular every proper standard parabolic subgroup ⟨T⟩, T⊊S, is finite.

concept.title: Bruhat–Tits existence of a valued root datum
concept.description: Let K♮ be complete for a discrete valuation ω with perfect residue field, K its maximal unramified extension, Σ=Gal(K/K♮), G a connected reductive K♮-group, S♮ a maximal K♮-split torus and S⊇S♮ a maximal K-split torus defined over K♮. The root datum of G(K) relative to S has Σ-invariant valuations compatible with ω (conjugation by the centralizer of S shifts φ_a by ω of the root character). Each such φ descends to a valuation φ♮ of the root datum (Z(K♮),(U_a(K♮))) of G(K♮) relative to S♮, the valuations of the latter compatible with ω are exactly these φ♮ and form one equipollence class, and φ↦φ♮ identifies the Σ-fixed valuations equipollent to φ with the apartment of φ♮, an affine space under the dual of the span of the relative roots in X*(S♮)⊗ℝ, whose affine roots are the intersections with it of the affine roots attached to roots nonzero on it.

concept.title: Affine Tits system from a discrete valued root datum
concept.description: Let (T,(U_a)_(a∈Φ)) be a generating root datum in a group G with a discrete valuation φ, N its group, ν:N→Aff(A) the action on the apartment A, H=ker ν, W the affine Weyl group generated by the wall reflections, C a chamber and S the reflections in the walls of C. Let G′ be generated by N′=ν⁻¹(W) and the U_a, and B=H·U_C with U_C generated by the root groups U_α of the affine roots α containing C; B is the pointwise fixer of C in G′ acting on the building of φ. Then (G′,B,N′,S) is a Tits system with B∩N′=H and Weyl group N′/H=W.

concept.title: Facet stabilizers in simply connected Bruhat–Tits theory
concept.description: Let G be a simply connected semisimple group over a field complete for a discrete valuation with perfect residue field. For every facet of its Bruhat–Tits building, the stabilizer in G(K), the pointwise fixer and the connected fixer (parahoric subgroup) coincide. In particular G(K) acts on the building by type-preserving automorphisms.

concept.title: Compact open integral points of a p-adic group scheme
concept.description: If 𝒢 is a flat affine group scheme of finite type over ℤ_p with generic fiber G, then 𝒢(ℤ_p) is a compact open subgroup of G(ℚ_p) for its local-field topology.

concept.title: Oh’s uniform bound for matrix coefficients in higher rank
concept.description: Let k be a nonarchimedean local field of characteristic different from 2 and G a connected almost k-simple group over k of k-rank at least 2, with Cartan decomposition G(k)=U A⁺ Ω U for the stabilizer U of a special vertex, and for g∈U a δ U put ξ_R(g)=∏_(α∈R)Ξ_(PGL₂(k))(diag(α(a),1)) for a maximal strongly orthogonal system R of positive roots. There is d≥1 depending only on G(k) such that every unitary representation π of G(k) without nonzero G(k)⁺-invariant vectors satisfies |⟨π(g)v,w⟩|≤d·max_(δ∈Ω)[U:U∩δUδ⁻¹]·(dim⟨Uv⟩dim⟨Uw⟩)^(1/2)ξ_R(g) for U-finite unit vectors v,w.

concept.title: Rank-one local automorphic coefficient bound
concept.description: Let G be a connected absolutely almost simple group over a number field and v a non-archimedean place at which G has K_v-rank one. There is c_v such that every infinite-dimensional irreducible unitary representation ρ in the automorphic dual of G(K_v) satisfies |⟨ρ(g)x,y⟩|≤c_v ξ_v(g)^(1/2)(dim⟨U_vx⟩dim⟨U_vy⟩)^(1/2)‖x‖‖y‖ for U_v-finite x,y, where ξ_v is the strongly orthogonal product of PGL₂ Harish-Chandra functions (Clozel–Oh–Ullmo, Clozel).

concept.title: Kneser–Tits theorem over non-archimedean local fields
concept.description: If G is a simply connected almost simple group over a non-archimedean local field k and G is k-isotropic, then G(k) is generated by its unipotent elements: G(k)=G(k)⁺ (Platonov).

concept.title: Explicit formula for the Harish-Chandra function of PGL₂(ℚ_p)
concept.description: For the Harish-Chandra function Ξ of PGL₂(ℚ_p) and every integer m≥0, Ξ(diag(p^m,1))=p^(−m/2)(1+m(p−1)/(p+1)). By K-biinvariance and the Cartan decomposition this determines Ξ; it is the s=0 case of Macdonald’s formula for zonal spherical functions.

concept.title: Bernstein’s theorem that p-adic reductive groups are type I
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a non-archimedean local field F, the locally compact group G(F) is of type I.

concept.title: Direct-integral decomposition for type I groups
concept.description: Every unitary representation of a second countable locally compact group G of type I on a separable Hilbert space is unitarily equivalent to a direct integral ∫^⊕ m(z)ρ_z dν(z) over the unitary dual, with ρ_z irreducible, a multiplicity function m with values in {1,2,…,∞} and a standard measure ν; the measure class of ν and m almost everywhere are unique.

concept.title: Strong approximation for simply connected groups
concept.description: Let G be a simply connected absolutely almost simple group over a number field F and S a finite set of places such that G_S=∏_(v∈S)G(F_v) is noncompact. Then G(F)G_S is dense in G(A_F); equivalently G(F) is dense in the S-adelic group G(A_F^S).

concept.title: Projection-valued measure on the real line
concept.description: A projection-valued measure on ℝ for a complex Hilbert space H assigns to each Borel set Ω⊆ℝ an orthogonal projection E(Ω) on H, with E(ℝ)=I, such that E(⋃ₙΩₙ)x=∑ₙE(Ωₙ)x in norm for every x∈H and every sequence of pairwise disjoint Borel sets. For each x, Ω↦⟨E(Ω)x,x⟩=‖E(Ω)x‖² is a finite positive Borel measure of total mass ‖x‖².

concept.title: Spectral integral with respect to a projection-valued measure
concept.description: For a projection-valued measure E on ℝ and a Borel function f:ℝ→ℂ, ∫f dE is the linear operator with domain D_f={x:∫|f|²d⟨E(·)x,x⟩<∞}. It is ∑αⱼE(Ωⱼ) for a simple f=∑αⱼ1_{Ωⱼ}, the operator-norm limit over uniformly approximating simple functions for bounded f, and in general (∫f dE)x=limₙ(∫f1_{|f|≤n}dE)x. It satisfies ‖(∫f dE)x‖²=∫|f|²d⟨E(·)x,x⟩.

concept.title: Product of a tempered distribution with a slowly increasing smooth function
concept.description: If g is smooth on ℝⁿ and each derivative ∂ᵅg is bounded by a polynomial, then φ↦gφ maps Schwartz space continuously into itself, and for a tempered distribution u the product gu is the tempered distribution (gu)(φ)=u(gφ). Schwartz functions, polynomials and smooth functions with bounded derivatives are such multipliers.

concept.title: Herglotz representation of a bounded Herglotz function as a Borel transform
concept.description: If F is holomorphic on the upper half-plane with Im F(z)≥0 there and |F(z)|≤M/Im z, then F(z)=∫_ℝ dμ(λ)/(λ−z) for a finite positive Borel measure μ on ℝ with μ(ℝ)≤M.

concept.title: Stieltjes inversion formula for the Borel transform of a measure
concept.description: If F(z)=∫dμ(λ)/(λ−z) is the Borel transform of a finite positive Borel measure μ on ℝ, then μ((−∞,λ])=lim_{δ↓0}lim_{ε↓0}π⁻¹∫_{−∞}^{λ+δ}Im F(t+iε)dt. In particular a finite Borel measure on ℝ, and by linearity a finite complex Borel measure, is determined by its Borel transform on ℂ∖ℝ.

concept.title: First resolvent identity
concept.description: For a closed linear operator A on a Banach space and z,z′ in its resolvent set, with R(z)=(A−z)⁻¹, R(z)−R(z′)=(z−z′)R(z)R(z′)=(z−z′)R(z′)R(z). Consequently the resolvent set is open and z↦R(z) is holomorphic there in operator norm.

concept.title: Resolvent of a self-adjoint operator off the real axis
concept.description: If A is a densely defined self-adjoint operator on a complex Hilbert space, every non-real z lies in its resolvent set, ‖(A−z)⁻¹‖≤1/|Im z|, and ((A−z)⁻¹)*=(A−z̄)⁻¹.

concept.title: Polarization identity for sesquilinear forms
concept.description: For a sesquilinear form s on a complex vector space, conjugate-linear in the first argument, with quadratic form q(x)=s(x,x), s(x,y)=¼[q(x+y)−q(x−y)+i q(x−iy)−i q(x+iy)]. Hence a sesquilinear form, for example an inner product, is determined by its quadratic form.

concept.title: Finite complex measure
concept.description: A finite complex measure on a measurable space is a map μ from the σ-algebra to ℂ with μ(⋃ₙAₙ)=∑ₙμ(Aₙ) for every sequence of pairwise disjoint measurable sets; the series then converges absolutely. Its real and imaginary parts are finite signed measures, and bounded measurable functions can be integrated against it.

concept.title: Integration by parts for absolutely continuous functions
concept.description: If u and v are absolutely continuous on [a,b], then uv is absolutely continuous and ∫_a^b u v′=u(b)v(b)−u(a)v(a)−∫_a^b u′v, where u′,v′ are the almost-everywhere derivatives and the integrals are Lebesgue integrals.

concept.title: Weak lower semicontinuity of the norm
concept.description: If xₙ converges weakly to x in a normed space, then ‖x‖≤liminfₙ‖xₙ‖. Equivalently, closed balls are weakly sequentially closed.

concept.title: Primary ideal of a commutative ring
concept.description: A proper ideal Q of a commutative ring R is primary if ab∈Q and a∉Q imply bᵐ∈Q for some m≥1; equivalently, every zero divisor of the quotient ring R/Q is nilpotent.

concept.title: Associated prime of a module
concept.description: For a module M over a commutative ring R, a prime ideal 𝔭 of R is associated to M if 𝔭 is the annihilator {r∈R:rm=0} of some element m∈M; Ass(M) denotes the set of such primes. By convention the associated primes of an ideal I are those of the quotient R/I.

concept.title: Enough injectives for modules over a ring
concept.description: For every ring R with identity, the category of left R-modules is an abelian category with enough injectives: every R-module embeds in an injective R-module, for instance in a product of copies of Hom_ℤ(R,ℚ/ℤ).

concept.title: Regular sequence on a module
concept.description: For a module M over a commutative ring R, a sequence f₁,…,f_r in R is M-regular if multiplication by f_i is injective on M/(f₁,…,f_(i−1))M for each i and M/(f₁,…,f_r)M≠0. It is a sequence in an ideal I when all f_i lie in I; the order matters.

concept.title: Depth of a module with respect to an ideal
concept.description: For an ideal I of a commutative ring R and a finitely generated R-module M with IM≠M, the I-depth of M is the supremum in {0,1,2,…,∞} of the lengths of M-regular sequences in I; if IM=M it is set to ∞. For a local ring and its maximal ideal this is the depth of M.

concept.title: Twisting sheaf O(m) on projective space
concept.description: For projective space Pⁿ over a field with homogeneous coordinates x₀,…,x_n and an integer m, O(m) is the sheaf of modules over the structure sheaf whose sections over the chart x_i≠0, and more generally over the locus f≠0 of a homogeneous f, are the degree-m elements of the localized polynomial ring; it is invertible, generated by x_iᵐ on that chart. For a closed subscheme X⊂Pⁿ, O_X(m) is its restriction to X.

concept.title: Level-one modular forms are polynomials in E₄ and E₆
concept.description: The graded ring ⊕_k M_k(SL₂(ℤ)) of complex level-one modular forms is the polynomial ring ℂ[E₄,E₆]: the Eisenstein series E₄,E₆ of weights 4 and 6 are algebraically independent over ℂ, and every weight-k form is uniquely a ℂ-linear combination of the monomials E₄ᵃE₆ᵇ with 4a+6b=k.

concept.title: Ramanujan’s differential equations for Eisenstein series
concept.description: Let θ=q d/dq and P=E₂, Q=E₄, R=E₆ be the normalized level-one Eisenstein series. Then θP=(P²−Q)/12, θQ=(PQ−R)/3 and θR=(PR−Q²)/2. More generally, for a level-one modular form f of weight k, θf−(k/12)Pf is a modular form of weight k+2.

concept.title: Unique factorization domain
concept.description: An integral domain in which every nonzero nonunit is a product of irreducible elements, uniquely up to reordering and multiplication of the factors by units. Given existence of such factorizations, uniqueness is equivalent to every irreducible element generating a prime ideal.

concept.title: Nagata’s criterion for factoriality
concept.description: Let A be an integral domain and S a multiplicative subset generated by prime elements. If every nonzero nonunit of A is a product of irreducible elements and the localization S⁻¹A is a unique factorization domain, then A is a unique factorization domain.

concept.title: Principal ideal domains are unique factorization domains
concept.description: Every principal ideal domain is a unique factorization domain: nonzero nonunits factor into irreducible elements, and every irreducible element generates a maximal, hence prime, ideal.

concept.title: Polynomial ring in one variable over a field is a principal ideal domain
concept.description: For a field k, every ideal of k[x] is generated by a single polynomial, namely any nonzero element of least degree (or 0); thus k[x] is a principal ideal domain.

concept.title: Associated primes in a short exact sequence
concept.description: For a short exact sequence 0→M′→M→M″→0 of modules over a commutative ring, Ass(M′)⊆Ass(M)⊆Ass(M′)∪Ass(M″); for a finite direct sum, Ass(M₁⊕⋯⊕M_r)=Ass(M₁)∪⋯∪Ass(M_r).

concept.title: Associated primes and zero divisors over a Noetherian ring
concept.description: For a module M over a Noetherian ring R, every ideal maximal among annihilators of nonzero elements of M is prime. Hence Ass(M) is empty only when M=0, and the set of zero divisors on M is the union of the associated primes of M.

concept.title: Finiteness of associated primes of a finitely generated module
concept.description: For a finitely generated module M over a Noetherian ring, Ass(M) is finite and contains every prime minimal in the support of M; consequently the radical of the annihilator of M is the intersection of its associated primes.

concept.title: Long exact sequence of right derived functors
concept.description: For a left exact functor F from an abelian category with enough injectives to an abelian category, every short exact sequence 0→A′→A→A″→0 induces natural connecting maps R^iF(A″)→R^(i+1)F(A′) and a long exact sequence 0→F(A′)→F(A)→F(A″)→R¹F(A′)→⋯; R^iF vanishes on injectives for i>0.

concept.title: Local cohomology as a colimit of Ext groups
concept.description: For a commutative ring A, a finitely generated ideal I and an A-module M, the right derived functors of the I-power torsion functor satisfy H_I^q(M)≅colim_n Ext^q_A(A/Iⁿ,M), the colimit taken along the surjections A/I^(n+1)→A/Iⁿ.

concept.title: Finiteness of depth over a Noetherian ring
concept.description: For a Noetherian local ring and a nonzero finitely generated module M, depth(M)≤dim Supp(M). Consequently, for any Noetherian ring R, ideal I and finitely generated module M with IM≠M, the I-depth of M is finite, so a maximal-length M-regular sequence in I exists.

concept.title: Variance of a sum of uncorrelated random variables
concept.description: If X₁,…,Xₙ have finite second moments and are uncorrelated, meaning E[XᵢXⱼ]=EXᵢ·EXⱼ for i≠j, then Var(X₁+⋯+Xₙ)=Var(X₁)+⋯+Var(Xₙ). This is Bienaymé’s formula.

concept.title: Change of variables formula for expectations
concept.description: If X is a random element of a measurable space S with distribution μ, and f:S→ℝ is measurable with f≥0 or E abs(f(X))<∞, then E f(X)=∫_S f dμ.

concept.title: Asymptotic formula for harmonic sums
concept.description: For real x≥1, ∑_{1≤n≤x}1/n=log x+γ+O(1/x), where γ=lim_{N→∞}(∑_{n≤N}1/n−log N) is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.

concept.title: Schur’s lemma on nonnegative integer combinations
concept.description: If S is a nonempty set of positive integers with greatest common divisor g, then every sufficiently large multiple of g is a nonnegative integer combination of elements of S. Hence a set of positive integers closed under addition with gcd 1 contains all sufficiently large integers.

concept.title: k-CNF Boolean formula
concept.description: A literal is a Boolean variable xᵢ or its negation ¬xᵢ; a k-clause is a disjunction of k literals on distinct variables. A k-CNF formula is a finite conjunction of k-clauses; a truth assignment σ:{x₁,…,xₙ}→{0,1} satisfies it if every clause contains a true literal.

concept.title: Algebraic cycle on a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X of finite type over a field and an integer k, a k-cycle on X is a finite formal ℤ-linear combination ∑n_V[V] of integral closed subschemes V⊂X of dimension k. The k-cycles form the free abelian group Z_k(X).

concept.title: Principal divisor of a rational function on an integral scheme
concept.description: Let W be an integral scheme of finite type over a field and f a nonzero element of its function field, the fraction field of the local ring at the generic point. For an integral closed subscheme V of codimension one, write f=a/b with a,b in the one-dimensional local ring O_(W,V) and set ord_V(f)=ℓ(O_(W,V)/(a))−ℓ(O_(W,V)/(b)), lengths as modules. Then div(f)=∑_V ord_V(f)[V] is a cycle on W.

concept.title: Chow group of a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X of finite type over a field, the Chow group A_k(X) is the group Z_k(X) of k-cycles modulo rational equivalence: the subgroup generated by the cycles div(f), viewed on X, for f a nonzero rational function on an integral closed subscheme W⊂X of dimension k+1. A_*(X) denotes ⊕_k A_k(X).

concept.title: Regular closed immersion of schemes
concept.description: A closed immersion i:Z→X is regular of codimension c if every point of Z has an affine open neighbourhood Spec A in X on which Z is Spec A/(f₁,…,f_c) for a regular sequence f₁,…,f_c in A; equivalently its ideal sheaf is locally generated by regular sequences of length c.

concept.title: Vector bundle over a scheme
concept.description: A vector bundle of rank r over a scheme X is a morphism p:E→X together with an open cover {U_i} of X and isomorphisms p⁻¹(U_i)≅U_i×Spec ℤ[t₁,…,t_r] over U_i whose transition maps are linear in the t_j, given by invertible r×r matrices of functions on U_i∩U_j. Its zero section s:X→E is defined by t₁=⋯=t_r=0.

concept.title: Normal cone of a closed subscheme
concept.description: For a closed subscheme Z⊂X with ideal sheaf I, the normal cone C_Z X→Z is the relative spectrum of the graded algebra ⊕_(n≥0)Iⁿ/I^(n+1); over an affine open Spec A with I the ideal of Z it is Spec of ⊕Iⁿ/I^(n+1). If Z→X is a regular closed immersion of codimension c, this algebra is the symmetric algebra of the locally free sheaf I/I² and C_Z X is the normal bundle N_Z X, a vector bundle of rank c.

concept.title: Deformation to the normal cone
concept.description: For a closed subscheme Z⊂X, the deformation space M°_Z X→𝔸¹ is glued from the spectra of the extended Rees algebras ∑_(n∈ℤ)s^(−n)Iⁿ⊂A[s,s^(−1)] (with Iⁿ=A for n≤0) over affine opens Spec A of X with I the ideal of Z. Its restriction over s≠0 is X×(𝔸¹∖0) and its fibre over s=0, a principal divisor, is the normal cone C_Z X.

concept.title: Homotopy invariance of Chow groups for vector bundles
concept.description: For a vector bundle p:E→X of rank r over a scheme of finite type over a field, flat pullback [V]↦[p⁻¹(V)] induces isomorphisms p*:A_k(X)→A_(k+r)(E) for all k. Its inverse is the Gysin map 0^!:A_(k+r)(E)→A_k(X) of the zero section.

concept.title: Weight of a Serre p-adic modular form
concept.description: For a prime p let X=ℤ_p×ℤ/(p−1)ℤ if p is odd and X=ℤ₂ if p=2, with the product of the p-adic and discrete topologies; ℤ embeds densely by n↦(n, n mod p−1), resp. n↦n. A nonzero Serre p-adic modular form f has weight k∈X if it is the uniform limit of rational classical level-one forms of weights k_i with k_i→k in X; by Serre the limit exists and does not depend on the sequence. The zero series has every even weight.

concept.title: Divisor power sum σ_r(n)
concept.description: For an integer r≥0 and a positive integer n, σ_r(n)=∑_(d|n, d>0) d^r is the sum of the r-th powers of the positive divisors of n. Thus σ₀(n) counts the divisors and σ₁(n) is the sum of divisors.

concept.title: Constant terms of Serre p-adic modular forms
concept.description: Let f=∑a_nqⁿ be a Serre p-adic modular form of weight k. If k has nonzero image in the finite quotient X_(m+1) of the weight group (ℤ/(p−1)p^mℤ for odd p), then v_p(a₀)+m≥inf_(n≥1)v_p(a_n). Hence if forms f⁽ⁱ⁾ of weights k⁽ⁱ⁾ have nonconstant coefficients converging uniformly and k⁽ⁱ⁾→k≠0 in X, their constant terms converge and the limit series is a Serre p-adic modular form of weight k.

concept.title: Serre’s weight congruence for congruent modular forms
concept.description: Let p be prime and m≥1. If f and f′ are level-one modular forms with rational coefficients, of weights k and k′, with f≠0 and v_p(f−f′)≥v_p(f)+m for the minimum p-adic valuation of q-coefficients, then k′≡k modulo (p−1)p^(m−1) when p≥3 and modulo 2^(m−2) when p=2.

concept.title: Kubota–Leopoldt p-adic L-function of an even Dirichlet character
concept.description: For an odd prime p and an even Dirichlet character χ there is a unique p-adic meromorphic function L_p(s,χ) on a disc containing ℤ_p, analytic except for a simple pole at s=1 when χ is trivial, with L_p(1−n,χ)=−(1−χω^(−n)(p)p^(n−1))B_(n,χω^(−n))/n for every integer n≥1. Here ω is the Teichmüller character and B_(n,ψ) are generalized Bernoulli numbers; for χ=ω^k this gives L_p(1−k,ω^k)=−(1−p^(k−1))B_k/k.

concept.title: Ring of level-one modular forms generated by E₄ and E₆
concept.description: The graded ring of holomorphic modular forms of integer weight for SL₂(ℤ) is the polynomial ring ℂ[E₄,E₆]: the normalized Eisenstein series E₄ and E₆ are algebraically independent, and every weight-k form is a unique isobaric polynomial of weight k in them.

concept.title: Quasimodular forms as polynomials in E₂ with modular coefficients
concept.description: Let Γ be a congruence subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) and φ a quasimodular form of weight 2 on Γ that is not modular, for example E₂. Every quasimodular form of weight k and depth at most p on Γ is uniquely ∑_(r=0)^p f_rφ^r with f_r a holomorphic modular form of weight k−2r on Γ. Thus the quasimodular ring is the polynomial ring over the modular ring in φ.

concept.title: Faltings’s Shafarevich finiteness for polarized abelian varieties
concept.description: For a number field K, a finite set S of places of K and integers g,d≥1, there are only finitely many K-isomorphism classes of g-dimensional abelian varieties over K with a polarization of degree d that have good reduction at every finite place outside S (Faltings 1983, Satz 6). The case d=1 concerns principally polarized abelian varieties.

concept.title: Torelli theorem for curves of genus at least two over a perfect field
concept.description: Let C and C′ be smooth projective geometrically connected curves of genus at least two over a perfect field k. If their Jacobians with the canonical principal polarizations are isomorphic as principally polarized abelian varieties over k, then C and C′ are isomorphic over k. Over an algebraically closed field every polarized isomorphism comes, up to sign and translation, from an isomorphism of curves.

concept.title: Good reduction of the Jacobian of a curve with good reduction
concept.description: Let R be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field K and C a smooth projective geometrically connected curve over K that is the generic fiber of a proper smooth R-scheme 𝒞 with geometrically connected fibers. Then the relative Jacobian of 𝒞/R is an abelian scheme over R with generic fiber the Jacobian of C and special fiber the Jacobian of the reduced curve. Hence the Jacobian of C has good reduction.

concept.title: Hermite finiteness of extensions unramified outside a finite set
concept.description: For a number field K, a finite set S of places of K and an integer N≥1, there are, up to K-isomorphism, only finitely many field extensions L/K of degree N that are unramified at every finite place outside S. The proof bounds the discriminant and applies Hermite’s theorem that only finitely many number fields have bounded discriminant.

concept.title: Principal ideal theorem for the Hilbert class field
concept.description: Let K be a number field and H its Hilbert class field. For every fractional ideal 𝔞 of the ring of integers of K, the extended ideal 𝔞O_H is principal in the ring of integers of H. This is Furtwängler’s theorem, conjectured by Hilbert and reduced by Artin to a statement about the transfer map.

concept.title: Equivalence between smooth projective curves and function fields of one variable
concept.description: Over a perfect field k, sending a curve C to its function field k(C) is an anti-equivalence between smooth projective geometrically connected curves over k with nonconstant k-morphisms and finitely generated field extensions K/k of transcendence degree one in which k is algebraically closed, with k-embeddings. The curve attached to K is the normalization of any projective model, and a finite extension of function fields corresponds to a finite nonconstant morphism.

concept.title: Ring of S-integers of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K and a finite set S of finite places of K, the ring of S-integers is O_(K,S)={x∈K: v(x)≥0 for every finite place v∉S}. It is the localization of the ring of integers inverting the primes in S, a Dedekind domain whose maximal ideals are the primes outside S.

concept.title: Adjunction formula for a curve on a smooth projective surface
concept.description: Let X be a smooth projective surface over an algebraically closed field with canonical divisor K_X, and let C⊂X be an irreducible curve. The normal sheaf of C is O_X(C)|_C, of degree the self-intersection C·C, and the arithmetic genus of C satisfies 2p_a(C)−2=C·(C+K_X). In particular a smooth C of genus g has C²+C·K_X=2g−2.

concept.title: Hilbert scheme of a projective scheme
concept.description: Let X be a projective scheme over a field k with a very ample invertible sheaf and P∈ℚ[t] a polynomial. The functor sending a k-scheme T to the closed subschemes of X×T flat over T whose fibers have Hilbert polynomial P is represented by a projective k-scheme Hilb_P(X) (Grothendieck). Its points over k are the closed subschemes of X with Hilbert polynomial P.

concept.title: Tangent space of the Hilbert scheme at a subscheme
concept.description: For a closed subscheme Y of a projective scheme X over a field k, with ideal sheaf I, the Zariski tangent space of the Hilbert scheme of X at the k-point [Y] is Hom_(O_Y)(I/I²,O_Y)=H⁰(Y,N_(Y/X)), the global sections of the normal sheaf. In particular if H⁰(Y,N_(Y/X))=0 then [Y] is an isolated reduced point of the Hilbert scheme.

concept.title: Self-adjoint element of a *-algebra
concept.description: An element a of a complex *-algebra is self-adjoint, or Hermitian, if a*=a.

concept.title: Normal element of a *-algebra
concept.description: An element a of a complex *-algebra is normal if it commutes with its adjoint: a*a=aa*.

concept.title: π-system of subsets
concept.description: A π-system on a set Ω is a family of subsets of Ω that contains A∩B whenever it contains A and B, hence is closed under finite intersections.

concept.title: Dynkin system (λ-system) of subsets
concept.description: A Dynkin system, or λ-system, on a set Ω is a family of subsets of Ω that contains Ω and is closed under complements in Ω and under countable unions of pairwise disjoint members. Equivalently, it contains Ω, contains B∖A whenever A⊆B are members, and contains the union of every increasing sequence of members.

concept.title: Closed subsets of compact spaces are compact
concept.description: Every closed subset of a compact topological space is compact in the subspace topology.

concept.title: Cantor space
concept.description: The Cantor space is the set 2^ℕ={0,1}^ℕ of infinite binary sequences with the product of the discrete topologies on {0,1}. It is a compact Polish space without isolated points.

concept.title: Perfect set theorem for Polish spaces
concept.description: Every nonempty Polish space without isolated points contains a subspace homeomorphic to the Cantor space; in particular it has the cardinality of the continuum.

concept.title: Cantor–Bendixson theorem for Polish spaces
concept.description: Every Polish space is uniquely the disjoint union of a closed subset with no isolated points in its relative topology and a countable open subset.

concept.title: Luzin–Souslin theorem
concept.description: If X and Y are Polish spaces, f:X→Y is Borel measurable, A⊆X is Borel and f is injective on A, then f(A) is a Borel subset of Y. In particular an injective Borel map between Polish spaces sends Borel sets to Borel sets.

concept.title: Gelfand spectral radius formula
concept.description: For every element a of a complex Banach algebra, computing the spectrum in the unitization if there is no identity, the spectral radius satisfies r(a)=lim_(n→∞)‖aⁿ‖^(1/n)=inf_n‖aⁿ‖^(1/n); in particular the limit exists.

concept.title: Spectral permanence for C*-subalgebras
concept.description: If B is a C*-subalgebra of a unital C*-algebra A containing the identity of A, then every element of B has the same spectrum in B as in A; an element of B invertible in A has its inverse in B.

concept.title: C*-subalgebra generated by a subset
concept.description: For a subset S of a C*-algebra A, the C*-subalgebra C*(S) generated by S is the smallest norm-closed *-subalgebra of A containing S, namely the norm closure of the *-polynomials without constant term in elements of S. For unital A, C*(a,1) is the one generated by a and the identity.

concept.title: Real spectrum of self-adjoint C*-algebra elements
concept.description: Every self-adjoint element of a C*-algebra has spectrum contained in ℝ, the spectrum being computed in the unitization if the algebra has no identity.

concept.title: Sums of positive C*-algebra elements are positive
concept.description: If a and b are self-adjoint elements of a C*-algebra whose spectra lie in [0,∞), then the spectrum of a+b also lies in [0,∞).

concept.title: Jordan decomposition of a real-valued measure
concept.description: Every countably additive real-valued set function ν on a σ-algebra is the difference ν=ν⁺−ν⁻ of two finite positive measures, where ν⁺(A)=sup{ν(B):B⊆A measurable} and ν⁻=(−ν)⁺; these two measures are mutually singular.

concept.title: Carathéodory extension theorem
concept.description: Let S be a semialgebra of subsets of Ω (closed under intersections, with complements finite disjoint unions of members) and μ:S→[0,∞] with μ(∅)=0 be finitely additive and countably subadditive on S. Then μ extends uniquely to a measure on the algebra generated by S and extends to a measure on σ(S), uniquely when μ is σ-finite.

concept.title: Spherical category
concept.description: A pivotal category in which the left and right traces of every endomorphism coincide, so each endomorphism has a single trace in End(1). For a tensor category over a field this is equivalent to requiring dim(X)=dim(X*) for every object X.

concept.title: Division ring
concept.description: A ring with identity in which 1≠0 and every nonzero element has a two-sided multiplicative inverse. Multiplication need not be commutative.

concept.title: Tube lemma
concept.description: Let X be a topological space, Y a compact space and x∈X. Every open subset of X×Y containing {x}×Y contains U×Y for some open neighbourhood U of x.

concept.title: Monic epimorphisms in an abelian category are isomorphisms
concept.description: In an abelian category, a morphism that is both a monomorphism and an epimorphism is an isomorphism; that is, abelian categories are balanced.

concept.title: Outer measure
concept.description: An outer measure on a set X is a function μ* from all subsets of X to [0,∞] with μ*(∅)=0 that is monotone and countably subadditive.

concept.title: Carathéodory’s theorem on outer-measurable sets
concept.description: For an outer measure μ* on a set X, the sets A satisfying μ*(E)=μ*(E∩A)+μ*(E∖A) for every E⊆X form a σ-algebra, and μ* restricted to this σ-algebra is a complete measure.

concept.title: Fubini theorem for compactly supported continuous functions on locally compact products
concept.description: Let μ and ν be Borel measures, finite on compact sets, on locally compact Hausdorff spaces X and Y. For f∈C_c(X×Y), the functions x↦∫f(x,y)dν(y) and y↦∫f(x,y)dμ(x) are continuous with compact support, and their integrals against μ and ν agree. No σ-finiteness is needed.

concept.title: Different of a finite separable local-field extension
concept.description: For a finite separable extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields, the different 𝔇_(L/K) is the inverse of the fractional O_L-ideal {x∈L: Tr_(L/K)(xO_L)⊆O_K}; it is an integral ideal of O_L.

concept.title: Hilbert’s formula for the different of a Galois local extension
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of local fields with finite residue fields and lower ramification groups G_i, v_L(𝔇_(L/K))=∑_(i≥0)(|G_i|−1).

concept.title: Discriminant as the norm of the different for local fields
concept.description: For a finite separable extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields, the discriminant ideal of L/K is the ideal norm N_(L/K)(𝔇_(L/K)) of the different; hence v_K(𝔡_(L/K))=f(L/K)v_L(𝔇_(L/K)).

concept.title: Herbrand’s theorem on upper numbering of quotients
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension M/K of local fields, a normal subgroup H=Gal(M/L) of G=Gal(M/K) and every v≥−1, the upper ramification groups satisfy (G/H)^v=G^vH/H.

concept.title: Transitivity of the Herbrand function and lower numbering of subgroups
concept.description: For finite Galois extensions M/L/K of local fields with H=Gal(M/L), the lower ramification groups satisfy H_u=G_u∩H, and the Herbrand functions satisfy φ_(M/K)=φ_(L/K)∘φ_(M/L) and ψ_(M/K)=ψ_(M/L)∘ψ_(L/K), the outer functions for M/L/K Galois.

concept.title: Projective schemes are proper
concept.description: For a ring A, every projective A-scheme (a closed subscheme of some ℙⁿ_A) is proper over Spec A; in particular its image under any A-morphism to a separated A-scheme is closed.

concept.title: Finiteness of normalization in a finite field extension
concept.description: If X is an integral scheme of finite type over a field k and L is a finite extension of its function field, the normalization of X in L is a finite morphism to X.

concept.title: Siegel’s theorem on S-integral points of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K with Weierstrass coordinate functions x,y, let S be a finite set of places containing the archimedean ones, and R_S the ring of S-integers. Then only finitely many points P∈E(K) have x(P)∈R_S.

concept.title: S-minimal short Weierstrass model over a principal ring of S-integers
concept.description: Let K be a number field and S a finite set of places containing the archimedean places and those above 2 and 3, with R_S a principal ideal domain. Every elliptic curve E/K has a model y²=x³+Ax+B with A,B∈R_S whose discriminant Δ=−16(4A³+27B²) generates the minimal discriminant ideal of E in R_S, so v(Δ) is the minimal local value at every v∉S.

concept.title: Formal group law of dimension d
concept.description: A d-dimensional formal group law over a commutative ring R is a d-tuple F(X,Y) of power series in R[[X₁,…,X_d,Y₁,…,Y_d]] with F(X,Y)=X+Y+(terms of total degree ≥2) and F(X,F(Y,Z))=F(F(X,Y),Z). It need not be commutative.

concept.title: Adic completion of a commutative ring
concept.description: For an ideal I of a commutative ring A, the I-adic completion is Â=lim←A/Iⁿ, the inverse limit of the quotient rings under the reduction maps, with its canonical map A→Â. A is I-adically complete if this map is an isomorphism.

concept.title: Lie algebra of a group scheme
concept.description: For a group scheme G over a commutative ring R, Lie(G) is the kernel of G(R[ε]/(ε²))→G(R) induced by ε↦0, an R-module. If R is local and G is smooth of relative dimension d along the identity section, Lie(G) is free of rank d: its tangent space at the identity.

concept.title: Even lattice of signature (b⁺,b⁻) and its dual
concept.description: An even lattice is a free abelian group M of finite rank with a nondegenerate symmetric ℤ-valued bilinear form (·,·) such that (λ,λ)∈2ℤ for all λ∈M. Its signature (b⁺,b⁻) is that of the real quadratic space M⊗ℝ, and its dual lattice is M′={x∈M⊗ℚ:(x,M)⊆ℤ}, which contains M.

concept.title: Discriminant form of an even lattice
concept.description: For an even lattice M with dual M′, the discriminant group M′/M is a finite abelian group carrying the ℚ/ℤ-valued quadratic form q(γ)=(γ,γ)/2 mod 1, whose associated bilinear form is (γ,δ) mod 1.

concept.title: Metaplectic double cover Mp₂(ℤ) of SL₂(ℤ)
concept.description: Mp₂(ℤ) consists of pairs (A,φ) with A=(a b; c d)∈SL₂(ℤ) and φ a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane with φ(τ)²=cτ+d, multiplied by (A,φ(τ))(B,ψ(τ))=(AB,φ(Bτ)ψ(τ)). It is a double cover of SL₂(ℤ) generated by T=((1 1; 0 1),1) and S=((0 −1; 1 0),√τ).

concept.title: Weil representation of a discriminant form
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (b⁺,b⁻), the Weil representation ρ_M is the unitary representation of Mp₂(ℤ) on the group algebra ℂ[M′/M], with basis e_γ, determined by ρ_M(T)e_γ=e(q(γ))e_γ and ρ_M(S)e_γ=(√i)^(b⁻−b⁺)|M′/M|^(−1/2)∑_δ e(−(γ,δ))e_δ, where e(x)=exp(2πix).

concept.title: Weakly holomorphic vector-valued modular form for a Weil representation
concept.description: For an even lattice M and k∈½ℤ, a weakly holomorphic modular form of weight k and type ρ_M is a holomorphic F:ℍ→ℂ[M′/M] with F(Aτ)=φ(τ)^(2k)ρ_M(A,φ)F(τ) for all (A,φ)∈Mp₂(ℤ) that is meromorphic at the cusp: F(τ)=∑_γ∑_(n∈q(γ)+ℤ)c_γ(n)e(nτ)e_γ with only finitely many nonzero c_γ(n) for n<0, which form its principal part.

concept.title: Hermitian symmetric domain of an orthogonal group of signature (2,n)
concept.description: For a real quadratic space V of signature (2,n), the positive definite 2-planes in V form a Grassmannian G(V). Sending a plane with oriented orthogonal basis X,Y of equal norm to [X+iY] identifies G(V) with {[Z]∈ℙ(V⊗ℂ):(Z,Z)=0,(Z,Z̄)>0}, an open subset of a complex quadric of dimension n with two components exchanged by conjugation. The index-two subgroup O⁺(V) preserving a component acts holomorphically on it.

concept.title: Meromorphic automorphic form on an orthogonal group of signature (2,n)
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (2,n), let P be the cone of nonzero Z∈M⊗ℂ with [Z] in the chosen component of the orthogonal symmetric domain. A meromorphic automorphic form of weight k and character χ for a finite-index subgroup Γ⊆O⁺(M) is a meromorphic function Ψ on P with Ψ(tZ)=t^(−k)Ψ(Z) for t∈ℂ^× and Ψ(σZ)=χ(σ)Ψ(Z) for σ∈Γ, where χ:Γ→ℂ^× is a character.

concept.title: Rational quadratic divisor on an orthogonal symmetric domain
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (2,n) and λ∈M with (λ,λ)<0, the rational quadratic divisor λ^⊥ is the set of points [Z] of the orthogonal symmetric domain with (Z,λ)=0. It is a complex hypersurface, the symmetric domain of the signature (2,n−1) lattice λ^⊥∩M.

concept.title: Siegel theta function of an indefinite even lattice
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (b⁺,b⁻), τ in the upper half-plane and v a positive definite b⁺-dimensional subspace of M⊗ℝ, Θ_M(τ;v)=∑_(γ∈M′/M)∑_(λ∈M+γ)e(τ(λ_v,λ_v)/2+τ̄(λ_(v^⊥),λ_(v^⊥))/2)e_γ, where λ_v and λ_(v^⊥) are the orthogonal projections. It transforms under Mp₂(ℤ) by ρ_M with weight (b⁺/2,b⁻/2) in (τ,τ̄).

concept.title: Borcherds regularized theta lift
concept.description: For an even lattice M of signature (b⁺,b⁻) and a weakly holomorphic modular form F of weight b⁺/2−b⁻/2 and type ρ_M, Φ_M(v,F) is the regularized integral of ⟨F(τ),Θ_M(τ;v)⟩y^(b⁺/2)dxdy/y² over SL₂(ℤ)∖ℍ: integrate over F_w={|τ|≥1,|Re τ|≤½,Im τ≤w} with an extra factor y^(−s), let w→∞ for Re s large, continue meromorphically in s and take the constant term of the Laurent expansion at s=0.

concept.title: Ideal of a semigroup
concept.description: For a semigroup S, a right ideal is a nonempty subset J with JS⊆J, a left ideal one with SJ⊆J, and a two-sided ideal is both. An ideal of a given kind is minimal if it contains no other ideal of that kind; S has at most one minimal two-sided ideal, its Sushkevich kernel K(S).

concept.title: Minimal idempotent of a semigroup
concept.description: An element e of a semigroup S with e²=e that lies in some minimal right ideal of S; equivalently eS is a minimal right ideal, or eSe is a group with identity e. Not to be confused with a primitive idempotent of an algebra.

concept.title: Stochastically continuous Markov semigroup
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup P_t on a topological state space with its Borel σ-algebra is stochastically continuous if P_tf(x)=∫f(y)P_t(x,dy) tends to f(x) as t↓0 for every bounded continuous real function f and every state x.

concept.title: Topologically irreducible Markov semigroup
concept.description: A Markov transition semigroup P_t on a topological state space with its Borel σ-algebra is topologically irreducible if P_t(x,U)>0 for every time t>0, every state x and every nonempty open set U. Irreducibility at a single time t₀ requires this only for t=t₀.

concept.title: Adjoint of a bounded operator between Banach spaces
concept.description: For a bounded linear operator T:X→Y between Banach spaces, its adjoint or dual operator T*:Y*→X* between the continuous duals is (T*y*)(x)=y*(Tx) for y*∈Y* and x∈X; it is a bounded linear operator. For Hilbert spaces it differs from the Hilbert adjoint by the conjugate-linear Riesz identifications.

concept.title: Khas’minskii’s regularity theorem for strong Feller irreducible semigroups
concept.description: If a Markov transition semigroup P_t on a topological state space is strong Feller at a time s>0 and irreducible at a time t>0, meaning P_t(x,U)>0 for every state x and nonempty open U, then it is (s+t)-regular: the transition probabilities P_{s+t}(x,·) for all states x are mutually equivalent measures.

concept.title: Strong Markov property of a discrete-time Markov chain
concept.description: For a time-homogeneous Markov chain (X_n) with kernel P and an almost surely finite stopping time T for its natural filtration, conditionally on the information up to time T the shifted sequence (X_{T+n})_{n≥0} is a Markov chain with kernel P started at X_T.

concept.title: Isometric embedding of a normed space into its bidual
concept.description: For a normed space X, the canonical map J:X→X** with (Jx)(x*)=x*(x) is a linear isometry; its range is closed when X is a Banach space. The isometry follows from the Hahn–Banach theorem.

concept.title: Semitopological semigroup
concept.description: A semigroup S with a topology for which every left multiplication s↦as and every right multiplication s↦sa is continuous; multiplication is separately but not necessarily jointly continuous. Example: bounded operators on a Banach space with the weak operator topology.

concept.title: Group kernel of a compact semitopological semigroup
concept.description: For a compact semitopological semigroup S the following are equivalent: every minimal right ideal is a minimal left ideal; S has a unique minimal right and a unique minimal left ideal; S has a unique minimal idempotent; the Sushkevich kernel K(S) is a group; some minimal idempotent commutes with every element of S. Then K(S)=eS=Se=eSe for the minimal idempotent e.

concept.title: Weak-operator compactness of the operator unit ball on Hilbert spaces
concept.description: For Hilbert spaces H and K, the set of contractions T:H→K, i.e. bounded operators with ‖T‖≤1, is compact in the weak operator topology. More generally every closed operator-norm ball is weak-operator compact.

concept.title: Contractive idempotents on a Hilbert space are orthogonal projections
concept.description: A bounded operator P on a Hilbert space with P²=P and ‖P‖≤1 is an orthogonal projection, i.e. P=P*. For an orthogonal projection P, Pf=f exactly when ‖Pf‖=‖f‖, and two orthogonal projections with the same range coincide.

concept.title: Coincidence of weak and strong operator topologies on isometries
concept.description: On the set of linear isometries between Hilbert spaces H and K, in particular on the unitary group of H, the weak and strong operator topologies coincide, since ‖T_if−Tf‖²=2‖f‖²−2Re⟨T_if,Tf⟩ for isometries.

concept.title: Continuous bijections from compact spaces to Hausdorff spaces are homeomorphisms
concept.description: A continuous bijection from a compact topological space onto a Hausdorff topological space is a homeomorphism; more generally a continuous injection from a compact space into a Hausdorff space is a homeomorphism onto its image.

concept.title: Smooth positive density on a smooth manifold
concept.description: A Borel measure μ on a smooth manifold M such that for every chart κ:U→κ(U)⊆ℝⁿ the pushforward of μ restricted to U under κ is ρ dx for a smooth strictly positive function ρ on κ(U), i.e. μ(κ⁻¹(B))=∫_Bρ dx. Example: the Riemannian volume measure √det(g_ij) dx.

concept.title: Sobolev space Hᵏ on a closed manifold
concept.description: For a compact smooth manifold M without boundary and an integer k≥0, Hᵏ(M) consists of the u∈L²(M,μ), μ a smooth positive density, such that for a finite atlas κ_j:U_j→ℝⁿ and smooth φ_j supported in U_j with ∑φ_j=1, every (φ_ju)∘κ_j⁻¹ lies in Wᵏ,²(ℝⁿ); the norm (∑_j‖(φ_ju)∘κ_j⁻¹‖²)¹ᐟ² makes it a Hilbert space, independent of the choices up to equivalent norms.

concept.title: Riemannian metric on a smooth manifold
concept.description: A Riemannian metric g on a smooth manifold M is a symmetric C∞(M)-bilinear pairing of smooth vector fields into smooth functions which in every chart has the form g=∑g_ij dxⁱdxʲ with (g_ij(x)) a smooth positive definite symmetric matrix at each point. A Riemannian manifold is a smooth manifold with a Riemannian metric.

concept.title: Laplace–Beltrami operator on a Riemannian manifold
concept.description: On a Riemannian manifold (M,g) the nonnegative Laplace–Beltrami operator acts on smooth functions by Δf=−|g|^{−1/2}∑_{i,j}∂_i(|g|^{1/2}g^{ij}∂_jf) in local coordinates, with |g|=det(g_ij) and (g^{ij}) the inverse matrix. It is a second-order elliptic operator with ∫(Δf)h̄ dvol=∫∑g^{ij}∂_if ∂_jh̄ dvol for compactly supported f,h, where dvol=|g|^{1/2}dx.

concept.title: Eigenvalue counting function of a self-adjoint operator
concept.description: For a self-adjoint operator A on a Hilbert space having an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors with real eigenvalues of finite multiplicity and no finite accumulation point, N(λ) is the number of eigenvalues at most λ counted with multiplicity, a nondecreasing integer-valued function of the real variable λ.

concept.title: Riesz representation of C₀(X)* by complex Radon measures
concept.description: For a locally compact Hausdorff space X, every bounded linear functional φ on the complex Banach space C₀(X) is f↦∫f dμ for a unique finite complex Radon measure μ, and ‖φ‖=|μ|(X); μ is positive exactly when φ is positivity preserving.

concept.title: Spectrum of a bounded self-adjoint operator between its quadratic-form bounds
concept.description: For a bounded self-adjoint operator T on a nonzero complex Hilbert space, put m=inf_{‖x‖=1}⟨Tx,x⟩ and M=sup_{‖x‖=1}⟨Tx,x⟩. Then {m,M}⊆σ(T)⊆[m,M]; in particular σ(T) is a nonempty compact subset of ℝ.

concept.title: Barycentric coordinates in a geometric simplex
concept.description: For an n-simplex conv(u₀,…,uₙ), each point x has unique coefficients s₀,…,sₙ≥0 with ∑sᵢ=1 and x=∑sᵢuᵢ. These barycentric coordinates depend continuously on x, and x lies in the face spanned by {uᵢ:i∈J} exactly when sᵢ=0 for every i∉J.

concept.title: Mesh of iterated barycentric subdivisions tends to zero
concept.description: If a triangulation of an n-simplex has mesh μ, the largest diameter of its simplices, then its barycentric subdivision has mesh at most n/(n+1)·μ. Hence the mesh of the j-th iterated barycentric subdivision of the simplex tends to 0 as j→∞.

concept.title: Schwarzian derivative of a C³ real function
concept.description: For a C³ real function f on an interval and a point x with f′(x)≠0, Sf(x)=f‴(x)/f′(x)−(3/2)(f″(x)/f′(x))². A C³ interval map has negative Schwarzian derivative if Sf(x)<0 at every x where f′(x)≠0.

concept.title: Immediate basin of an attracting periodic orbit
concept.description: For a self-map of a metric space and an attracting periodic orbit O, the immediate basin of O is the union of those connected components of the basin of attraction of O that contain a point of O.

concept.title: Composition rule for the Schwarzian derivative
concept.description: For C³ maps f and g with g′(x)≠0 and f′(g(x))≠0, S(f∘g)(x)=(Sf)(g(x))·g′(x)²+Sg(x). Consequently every iterate fⁿ of a C³ interval map with negative Schwarzian derivative again has negative Schwarzian derivative.

concept.title: Minimum principle for maps with negative Schwarzian derivative
concept.description: If f is C³ on an interval I, f′ has no zero in I and Sf<0 on I, then |f′| has no local minimum in the interior of I. Thus on a compact subinterval the minimum of |f′| is attained only at an endpoint.

concept.title: Binary Yule process
concept.description: A continuous-time population process without deaths in which each particle, independently of all other particles and of the past, lives for an exponential time of rate β>0 and then splits into two particles. N_t denotes the number of particles alive at time t.

concept.title: Kolmogorov forward equations for a continuous-time Markov chain
concept.description: For a time-homogeneous continuous-time Markov chain on a countable state space with jump rates q(k,j) and total rates λ_j=∑_{k≠j}q(j,k), under conditions that hold for finite chains and birth–death chains, the transition probabilities satisfy p′_t(i,j)=∑_{k≠j}p_t(i,k)q(k,j)−λ_jp_t(i,j), that is, p′_t=p_tQ.

concept.title: Minimum of independent exponential random variables
concept.description: If T₁,…,Tₙ are independent and Tᵢ is exponential with rate λᵢ, then V=min Tᵢ is exponential with rate λ₁+⋯+λₙ, the index I of the minimum satisfies P(I=i)=λᵢ/(λ₁+⋯+λₙ), and I and V are independent.

concept.title: Interior W²,ᵖ estimate for nondivergence-form elliptic equations
concept.description: Let a_ij be continuous and uniformly elliptic on the unit ball B₁, let b_i,c be bounded and 1<p<∞. If u∈W²,ᵖ(B₁) solves ∑a_ij∂_iju+∑b_i∂_iu+cu=f a.e. with f∈Lᵖ(B₁), then ‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ(B_{1/2})}≤C(‖u‖_{Lᵖ(B₁)}+‖f‖_{Lᵖ(B₁)}), with C depending only on n, p and the coefficients.

concept.title: Boundary W²,ᵖ estimate on a half-ball for nondivergence-form elliptic equations
concept.description: Let a_ij be continuous on the closed half-ball B̄₁⁺ and uniformly elliptic, let b_i,c be bounded and 1<p<∞. If u∈W²,ᵖ(B₁⁺) solves ∑a_ij∂_iju+∑b_i∂_iu+cu=f a.e. with f∈Lᵖ and u=g on the flat boundary in the trace sense, g∈W²,ᵖ(B₁⁺), then ‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ(B₁/₂⁺)}≤C(‖u‖_{Lᵖ}+‖g‖_{W²,ᵖ}+‖f‖_{Lᵖ}) over B₁⁺.

concept.title: Greatest common divisor of polynomials over a field
concept.description: For polynomials p,q over a field k, not both zero, a greatest common divisor is a monic polynomial d∈k[X] that divides both p and q and is divisible by every common divisor of p and q. Two such polynomials divide each other and are monic, so it is unique; it is written gcd(p,q).

concept.title: Spectral inclusion in the closure of the numerical range
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a nonzero complex Hilbert space, the spectrum σ(T) is contained in the closure of the numerical range W(T). In particular every λ∈σ(T) satisfies |λ|≤w(T).

concept.title: Ellipsoid in Euclidean space
concept.description: An ellipsoid in ℝᵈ is the image {Ax+b:|x|≤1} of the closed Euclidean unit ball under an invertible affine map x↦Ax+b.

concept.title: Affine covariance of the projection body operator
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, an invertible linear map A and x∈ℝᵈ, Π(AK+x)=|det A|A^{−T}ΠK. Consequently Petty’s ratio |ΠK|/|K|^{d−1} is invariant under invertible affine maps.

concept.title: Kubota’s integral recursion for quermassintegrals
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, 1≤k≤n−1 and 0≤j≤k, the average over k-dimensional linear subspaces E, with the rotation-invariant probability measure, of the k-dimensional quermassintegral W_{k−j}(K|E) computed in E equals (κ_k/κ_n)W_{n−j}(K), where κ_m is the volume of the m-dimensional unit ball.

concept.title: Equality in the Aleksandrov–Fenchel inequality with ball arguments
concept.description: If convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ satisfy V(K,L,B,…,B)²=V(K,K,B,…,B)V(L,L,B,…,B), where B is the Euclidean unit ball repeated n−2 times, then K and L are homothetic.

concept.title: Uniform distribution on a finite set
concept.description: For a nonempty finite set S, the probability law on S assigning probability 1/|S| to each element, hence |A|/|S| to each subset A. Choosing an element, or a k-element subset, uniformly at random means sampling from this law on S, or on the set of k-element subsets.
