For a rational prime ℓ inert in K, Gal(K_ℓ/K₁)≅(O_K/ℓO_K)^×/(ℤ/ℓℤ)^×=𝔽_(ℓ²)^×/𝔽_ℓ^× is cyclic of order ℓ+1. For a squarefree product n of such primes, restriction gives Gal(K_n/K₁)≅∏_(ℓ|n)Gal(K_ℓ/K₁), and Gal(K_n/K_(n/ℓ))≅Gal(K_ℓ/K₁).

concept.title: Kolyvagin derived Heegner point
concept.description: Fix E/ℚ of conductor N, a modular parametrization φ:X₀(N)→E and K imaginary quadratic, K≠ℚ(i),ℚ(√−3), with 𝔑⊂O_K, O_K/𝔑≅ℤ/Nℤ. For squarefree λ prime to N whose prime factors are inert in K, let y_λ=φ(x_λ)∈E(K_λ) be the Heegner point of conductor λ, choose generators t_q of the cyclic groups Gal(K_q/K₁) of order q+1, put I_q=∑_(i=1)^q i·t_q^i and I_λ=∏_(q|λ)I_q in ℤ[Gal(K_λ/K₁)], and let S represent Gal(K_λ/K)/Gal(K_λ/K₁). Then P_λ=∑_(σ∈S)σ(I_λy_λ)∈E(K_λ); P₁=Tr_(K₁/K)y₁=y_K.

concept.title: Mazur’s formal-immersion criterion for potentially good reduction
concept.description: Let K be a number field, N squarefree, and 𝔭 a prime of K of residue characteristic p with ramification index e_𝔭(K/ℚ)<p−1. Let E/K have a K-rational cyclic subgroup of order N with moduli point x∈X₀(N)(K). If some optimal quotient f:J₀(N)^new→A, composed with X₀(N)→J₀(N) sending ∞ to 0, maps x to a point of finite order in A(K), then E has potentially good reduction at 𝔭.

concept.title: Finiteness of the Mordell–Weil group of the Eisenstein quotient
concept.description: For a prime N, let J̃ be Mazur’s Eisenstein quotient of J₀(N), the optimal quotient attached to the components of the Hecke algebra meeting the Eisenstein ideal. The projection J₀(N)→J̃ maps the cuspidal subgroup isomorphically onto J̃(ℚ); in particular J̃(ℚ) is finite.

concept.title: Serre’s lifting lemma for closed subgroups of SL₂(ℤ_p)
concept.description: Let p≥5 be prime and G a closed subgroup of SL₂(ℤ_p) whose reduction modulo p is all of SL₂(𝔽_p). Then G=SL₂(ℤ_p).

concept.title: Perfectness of SL₂ over a field with more than three elements
concept.description: For a field F with more than three elements, SL₂(F) equals its commutator subgroup. In particular SL₂(𝔽_p) is perfect for every prime p≥5, whereas SL₂(𝔽₂) and SL₂(𝔽₃) are not.

concept.title: Dedekind domains with finitely many primes are principal
concept.description: A Dedekind domain with only finitely many prime ideals is a principal ideal domain.

concept.title: Integral closure commutes with localization
concept.description: Let A⊆L be an integral domain inside a field, B the integral closure of A in L, and S⊆A a multiplicative subset not containing0. Then S⁻¹B is the integral closure of S⁻¹A in L.

concept.title: Fractional ideals of a localized Dedekind domain
concept.description: Let A be a Dedekind domain and S a multiplicative subset not containing0. Then 𝔞↦S⁻¹𝔞 is an isomorphism from the subgroup of fractional ideals of A generated by the nonzero primes disjoint from S onto the group of fractional ideals of S⁻¹A; in particular prime factorizations extend along localization.

concept.title: Forward-invariant subset of a self-map
concept.description: For a map T:X→X, a subset A⊆X is forward invariant (positively invariant) if T(A)⊆A; then every forward orbit x,Tx,T²x,… starting in A stays in A.

concept.title: Absorbing set of a self-map
concept.description: For a map T:X→X and a subset Y⊆X, a set M⊆X is absorbing for Y if M is forward invariant and the forward orbit (Tⁿx)_(n≥0) of every x∈Y meets M; from its first visit on, the orbit stays in M.

concept.title: Heine–Borel theorem in Euclidean space
concept.description: A subset of ℝⁿ with the Euclidean metric is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded.

concept.title: Monotone real sequence
concept.description: A real sequence (xₙ) is monotone increasing if xₙ≤xₙ₊₁ for all n, monotone decreasing if xₙ≥xₙ₊₁ for all n, and monotone if it is either.

concept.title: Bounded real sequence
concept.description: A real sequence (xₙ) is bounded if some real B satisfies |xₙ|≤B for all n; it is bounded above (below) if some B satisfies xₙ≤B (xₙ≥B) for all n.

concept.title: Subsequence of a sequence
concept.description: For a sequence (xₙ) and a strictly increasing sequence of natural numbers n₁<n₂<n₃<⋯, the sequence (x_(n_k))_k is a subsequence of (xₙ).

concept.title: Generalized conditional expectation
concept.description: For X≥0 and a sub-σ-algebra G, E[X|G] is the a.s. unique G-measurable [0,∞]-valued variable with E[X1_A]=E[E[X|G]1_A] for A∈G. If E[X⁺|G]<∞ a.s. or E[X⁻|G]<∞ a.s., for example when X⁺ is integrable, the generalized conditional expectation is E[X⁺|G]−E[X⁻|G].

concept.title: Continuous-time Galton–Watson process
concept.description: A population process in which each individual lives for an independent exponential time of rate β and at death is replaced by an independent number of offspring with a fixed law on the nonnegative integers; offspring evolve in the same way, independently. Also called a Markov branching process.

concept.title: Extinction of a subcritical Galton–Watson process
concept.description: If the offspring mean m satisfies m<1, a Galton–Watson process started from finitely many individuals becomes extinct almost surely; since E Z_n=Z_0mⁿ, its total progeny has finite mean Z_0/(1−m).

concept.title: Extension of a uniformly continuous map to the closure
concept.description: A uniformly continuous map from a subset S of a metric space into a complete metric space extends uniquely to a continuous map on the closure of S, and the extension is uniformly continuous.

concept.title: Differentiability of C₀-semigroup orbits on the generator domain
concept.description: If A generates a strongly continuous semigroup T on a Banach space and x∈D(A), then T(t)x∈D(A), t↦T(t)x is continuously differentiable, and d/dt T(t)x=AT(t)x=T(t)Ax for all t≥0.

concept.title: Exponential bound for a strongly continuous semigroup
concept.description: For every strongly continuous semigroup T of bounded operators on a Banach space there are constants M≥1 and ω∈ℝ with ‖T(t)‖≤Me^{ωt} for all t≥0.

concept.title: Uniform boundedness principle
concept.description: A family of bounded linear operators from a Banach space into a normed space that is pointwise bounded on every vector is uniformly bounded in operator norm. Also called the Banach–Steinhaus theorem.

concept.title: Skorokhod divergence preserves Malliavin smoothness
concept.description: For separable Hilbert spaces K, the Skorokhod divergence maps Malliavin smooth H⊗K-valued Wiener functionals into Malliavin smooth K-valued ones, with Lᵖ bounds on δu and its Malliavin derivatives by finitely many Lᵠ norms of the derivatives of u.

concept.title: Sobolev embedding of Hˢ(ℝᵈ) into bounded Cᵏ functions
concept.description: For real s>k+d/2, every element of the Fourier-defined Sobolev space Hˢ(ℝᵈ) has a representative in C_bᵏ(ℝᵈ), and its Cᵏ_b norm is bounded by a constant times its Hˢ norm.

concept.title: Continuity theorem for Laplace transforms of nonnegative random variables
concept.description: If nonnegative random variables X_n satisfy E e^{−αX_n}→E e^{−αX} for every α>0, where X is a nonnegative random variable, then X_n converges to X in distribution.

concept.title: Jordan’s inequality for the sine function
concept.description: For 0≤x≤π/2, (2/π)x≤sin x≤x. Equivalently |sin(πy)|≥2‖y‖ for every real y, where ‖y‖ is the distance from y to the nearest integer.

concept.title: Hadamard factorization theorem for entire functions of finite order
concept.description: Let f be an entire function of finite order ρ with f(0)≠0 and zeros z₁,z₂,… counted with multiplicity, and let k be an integer with 0≤k≤ρ and ∑|z_n|^(−1−k)<∞. Then f(z)=e^(g(z))∏_n(1−z/z_n)exp(z/z_n+(z/z_n)²/2+⋯+(z/z_n)^k/k) for a polynomial g of degree at most ρ, the product converging absolutely and locally uniformly.

concept.title: Van der Corput first derivative integral test
concept.description: If Φ is a real C² function on a bounded interval [a,b] whose derivative Φ′ is monotonic with |Φ′(x)|≥μ>0 throughout, then |∫_a^b e^(iλΦ(x))dx|≤3/(λμ) for every λ>0; the bound does not depend on the length of [a,b].

concept.title: Eichler transformation of a quadratic space
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space V with Q(x)=B(x,x), an isotropic vector u and a vector w orthogonal to u, the Eichler transformation is E_(u,w)(x)=x+B(x,u)w−B(x,w)u−½Q(w)B(x,u)u. It is an isometry of V; for a lattice L one considers those E_(u,w) that preserve L.

concept.title: Eichler transformations are rotations with trivial spinor norm
concept.description: Every Eichler transformation of a nondegenerate quadratic space over a field of characteristic other than two has determinant one and spinor norm equal to the trivial square class.

concept.title: O’Meara–Pollak generation theorem for dyadic integral orthogonal groups
concept.description: Let L be a lattice on a nondegenerate quadratic space over a dyadic local field F. If L is modular, or if 2 is unramified in F, then the integral orthogonal group O(L) is generated by the symmetries and the Eichler transformations that preserve L. In particular this holds for every lattice over ℚ₂.

concept.title: Cartan–Dieudonné theorem
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic other than two, every isometry of an n-dimensional nondegenerate quadratic space is a product of at most n reflections (symmetries).

concept.title: Unit spinor norms of unimodular dyadic lattices of rank at least three
concept.description: If L is a unimodular lattice of rank at least three on a quadratic space over a dyadic local field F, with unit group U of its valuation ring, then θ(O⁺(L)) contains every unit square class: U(F×)²⊆θ(O⁺(L)). This is O’Meara’s 93:20 as cited by Hsia.

concept.title: Geometrically connected scheme over a field
concept.description: A scheme X over a field k is geometrically connected if its base change X×_k Spec k̄ to an algebraic closure k̄ of k is connected as a topological space; equivalently X×_k Spec L is connected for every field extension L of k.

concept.title: Chevalley structure theorem for algebraic groups
concept.description: Over a perfect field k, every smooth connected group scheme G of finite type over k contains a unique smooth connected normal affine algebraic subgroup H such that the quotient G/H is an abelian variety; H is the largest smooth connected affine algebraic subgroup of G.

concept.title: Torus–unipotent decomposition of a commutative affine group over a perfect field
concept.description: Over a perfect field, a smooth connected commutative affine algebraic group H is the direct product S×U of its largest subtorus S and its largest unipotent algebraic subgroup U.

concept.title: Descent of properness along faithfully flat quasi-compact base change
concept.description: Let S′→S be a faithfully flat quasi-compact morphism of schemes and f:X→S a morphism of schemes. If the base change X×_S S′→S′ is proper, then f is proper.

concept.title: Proper open and closed part through a proper closed fiber over a complete local ring
concept.description: Let A be a complete Noetherian local ring and X a separated A-scheme of finite type whose closed fiber is proper over the residue field. Then X is the disjoint union of two open subschemes Z and Z′ with Z proper over A and containing the closed fiber.

concept.title: Zariski’s connectedness theorem
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a proper morphism of schemes with Y locally Noetherian and f_*O_X=O_Y. Then f is surjective and every fiber of f is geometrically connected.

concept.title: Resolvent of a closed symmetric form
concept.description: For a closed symmetric form E with domain D on a real Hilbert space H and α>0, the α-resolvent G_α:H→D sends f to the unique u∈D with E(u,v)+α(u,v)_H=(f,v)_H for every v∈D. Existence and uniqueness follow from the Riesz representation theorem on D with the complete inner product E_α=E+α(·,·)_H.

concept.title: Sobolev space H¹ on the circle
concept.description: H¹(S¹) consists of real 2π-periodic L² functions whose first distributional derivative, tested against smooth periodic functions, is also in L². Functions are identified almost everywhere; the inner product (u,v)_{L²}+(u′,v′)_{L²} defines its norm.

concept.title: Energy identity for the positive part of a parabolic Sobolev function
concept.description: Let V=H¹(S¹), or V=H₀¹(Ω) for an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ, with the Gelfand triple V⊂L²⊂V*. If w∈L²(0,T;V) has weak time derivative w′∈L²(0,T;V*), then w⁺∈L²(0,T;V) and t↦‖w(t)⁺‖²_{L²} has an absolutely continuous version whose derivative is 2⟨w′(t),w(t)⁺⟩ for almost every t.

concept.title: Normal algebraic field extension
concept.description: An algebraic field extension L/k is normal if every irreducible polynomial in k[X] with a root in L splits into linear factors over L. Equivalently, the minimal polynomial over k of every element of L splits over L.

concept.title: Structure of discrete subgroups of a finite-dimensional real vector space
concept.description: Every discrete subgroup Λ of a finite-dimensional real vector space V is generated over ℤ by a finite ℝ-linearly independent family; in particular Λ is a free abelian group of rank at most dim V. The quotient V/Λ is compact exactly when that family is a real basis of V.

concept.title: Noetherian topology and irreducible decomposition of affine algebraic sets
concept.description: For a field k, the Zariski topology on any algebraic subset V of kⁿ is Noetherian. Hence V, in particular any affine variety over an algebraically closed field, is a finite union of irreducible closed subsets; an irredundant such union is unique up to order and consists exactly of the irreducible components of V.

concept.title: Smoothness of algebraic groups in characteristic zero
concept.description: Every algebraic group, that is every group scheme of finite type, over a field of characteristic zero is smooth. This extends Cartier’s theorem for affine algebraic groups to arbitrary, possibly non-affine, algebraic groups.

concept.title: Anti-affine algebraic group
concept.description: An algebraic group G over a field k is anti-affine if its only global regular functions are constants, O(G)=k. Complete connected group varieties, such as abelian varieties, are examples.

concept.title: Affinization of an algebraic group
concept.description: For an algebraic group G over a field k, the k-algebra O(G) of global regular functions is finitely generated and G^aff=Spec O(G) is an affine algebraic group. The natural homomorphism G→G^aff is faithfully flat, universal among homomorphisms from G to affine algebraic groups, and has anti-affine kernel.

concept.title: Anti-affine algebraic groups are smooth and connected
concept.description: Every anti-affine algebraic group over a field is smooth and connected.

concept.title: Smoothness of extensions and quotients of algebraic groups
concept.description: For an exact sequence e→N→G→Q→e of algebraic groups over a field, if N and Q are smooth then G is smooth, and if G is smooth then Q is smooth.

concept.title: Complex line integral along a piecewise smooth path
concept.description: For a piecewise C¹ path γ:[a,b]→ℂ and a complex function f continuous on its image, the line (contour) integral is ∫_γf(z)dz=∫_a^bf(γ(t))γ′(t)dt, summed over the finitely many C¹ pieces, with real and imaginary parts integrated separately.

concept.title: Limit inferior of a real or extended-real sequence
concept.description: For a sequence (a_n) of real or extended real numbers, liminf a_n=sup_N inf_{n≥N}a_n, a value in the extended real line [−∞,∞].

concept.title: Approximation of convex bodies by smooth uniformly convex bodies
concept.description: Every convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, n≥2, is a Hausdorff limit of smooth uniformly convex bodies: bodies whose support functions are C^∞ on ℝⁿ∖{0} with positive definite curvature matrices (class C^∞_+).

concept.title: Dual of L¹ for a σ-finite measure
concept.description: For a σ-finite measure μ, every bounded linear functional on real L¹(μ) is uniquely integration against an element of L^∞(μ), and its operator norm is that element’s essential supremum norm.

concept.title: Separability of Lᵖ for a countably generated σ-algebra
concept.description: If μ is a σ-finite measure on a countably generated σ-algebra and 1≤p<∞, then Lᵖ(μ) is separable; for example the Borel σ-algebra of a separable metric space is countably generated.

concept.title: Strong operator topology on bounded operators
concept.description: On the bounded linear operators X→Y between normed spaces, the strong operator topology is the coarsest topology making T↦Tx continuous for every x∈X; a net T_i converges to T exactly when ‖(T_i−T)x‖→0 for each x. For Hilbert spaces H→K this is the usual strong operator topology.

concept.title: Product of ideals in a commutative ring
concept.description: For ideals a and b of a commutative ring R, the product ab is the ideal of all finite sums ∑a_ib_i with a_i∈a and b_i∈b. Ideal multiplication is associative and commutative with identity R, and aⁿ is the n-fold product. An ideal a divides b if b=ac for some ideal c; then b⊆a.

concept.title: Fractional ideal of an integral domain
concept.description: For an integral domain A with fraction field K, a fractional ideal of A is a nonzero A-submodule a⊆K with da⊆A for some nonzero d∈A; every nonzero finitely generated A-submodule of K is one. Products ab of fractional ideals are defined as for ideals, principal fractional ideals are bA with b∈K×, and the nonzero ideals of A are the integral fractional ideals.

concept.title: Divisibility and units in a commutative ring
concept.description: In a commutative ring R, a divides b, written a|b, if b=ac for some c∈R, equivalently bR⊆aR. A unit is an element dividing 1, that is, an invertible element; a and b are associates if b=ua for a unit u, which in an integral domain holds exactly when aR=bR.

concept.title: Torsion submodule of a module over an integral domain
concept.description: For a module M over an integral domain R, the torsion submodule M_tors consists of the m∈M with rm=0 for some nonzero r∈R; it is a submodule. M is a torsion module if M_tors=M and torsion-free if M_tors=0.

concept.title: Direct sum of modules over a commutative ring
concept.description: For modules M_i over a commutative ring R, the direct sum ⊕M_i is the direct sum of the underlying abelian groups with coordinatewise scalar multiplication. A module M is the internal direct sum of submodules N_i when the addition map ⊕N_i→M is an isomorphism.

concept.title: Elementary divisor theorem for submodules of a finite free module over a PID
concept.description: Let R be a principal ideal domain, M a free R-module of rank n and N⊆M a nonzero submodule. There are a basis v₁,…,v_n of M, an integer m≤n and nonzero a₁|a₂|⋯|a_m in R such that a₁v₁,…,a_mv_m is a basis of N.

concept.title: Sheaf of modules on a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X, an O_X-module is a sheaf of abelian groups F on X with an O_X(U)-module structure on each F(U), compatible with the restriction maps; each stalk F_x is then an O_(X,x)-module. Homomorphisms of O_X-modules are sheaf maps that are O_X(U)-linear on every open U, and F|_U is the restriction to an open subscheme.

concept.title: Quasi-coherent sheaf on a scheme
concept.description: An O_X-module F on a scheme X is quasi-coherent if X is covered by affine opens U=Spec A with F|_U≅M̃ for an A-module M, where M̃ is the O_U-module with M̃(D(f))=M⊗_A A_f for f∈A; then F(U)=M. The structure sheaf O_X is quasi-coherent.

concept.title: Coherent sheaf on a locally Noetherian scheme
concept.description: On a locally Noetherian scheme X, a coherent sheaf is a quasi-coherent O_X-module F such that F(U) is a finitely generated O_X(U)-module for every affine open U; it suffices to check this on the affine opens of one cover.

concept.title: Tensor product of quasi-coherent sheaves
concept.description: For quasi-coherent O_X-modules F and G on a scheme X, F⊗_(O_X)G is the quasi-coherent O_X-module with (F⊗G)(U)=F(U)⊗_(O_X(U))G(U) for every affine open U, and stalks F_x⊗G_x. The n-fold tensor power is written F^(⊗n), with F^(⊗0)=O_X.

concept.title: Invertible sheaf on a scheme
concept.description: An O_X-module L on a scheme X is invertible if every point has an open neighbourhood U with L|_U≅O_U. Invertible sheaves are quasi-coherent and closed under tensor products and powers L^(⊗n). A global section s of L defines the open set X_s of points x where s generates the stalk L_x.

concept.title: Sheaf of modules generated by global sections
concept.description: An O_X-module F on a scheme X is generated by global sections if for every x∈X the images of the global sections F(X) generate the stalk F_x as an O_(X,x)-module.

concept.title: Very ample invertible sheaf over a field
concept.description: An invertible sheaf L on a scheme X over a field k is very ample if there is an immersion of X into some projective space Pⁿ_k, that is, a closed immersion into an open subscheme, such that L is isomorphic to the restriction O_X(1) of the twisting sheaf O(1).

concept.title: Relatively ample invertible sheaf
concept.description: For a quasi-compact morphism of schemes f:X→S, an invertible sheaf L on X is f-ample (relatively ample, ample on X/S) if for every affine open V⊆S the scheme U=f⁻¹(V) is covered by the affine open sets U_s, for s a global section of L^(⊗n) over U with n≥1. For X of finite type over a field k and S=Spec k this is ampleness of L.

concept.title: Projective space over a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme S, projective n-space Pⁿ_S is the base change Pⁿ_ℤ×_(Spec ℤ)S, where Pⁿ_ℤ is glued from the n+1 affine charts Spec ℤ[x₀/x_i,…,x_n/x_i] exactly as over a field. Over S=Spec A it is glued from Spec A[x₀/x_i,…,x_n/x_i], and over a field it is the usual projective space.

concept.title: Flat module over a commutative ring
concept.description: A module M over a commutative ring R is flat if N↦N⊗_R M carries injective homomorphisms of R-modules to injective homomorphisms, equivalently preserves exact sequences. It is faithfully flat if moreover N⊗_R M=0 only for N=0.

concept.title: Flat and faithfully flat morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is flat if for every x∈X the local ring O_(X,x) is a flat O_(S,f(x))-module, and faithfully flat if it is flat and surjective on underlying points. For affine schemes Spec B→Spec A this means B is flat, respectively faithfully flat, over A.

concept.title: Algebraic subgroup of an algebraic group over a field
concept.description: An algebraic subgroup of an algebraic group G over a field k is a closed subscheme H⊆G such that H(R) is a subgroup of G(R) for every k-algebra R, where X(R) denotes the k-morphisms Spec R→X; it is then an algebraic group. H is normal if H(R) is normal in G(R) for every R.

concept.title: Homomorphism of algebraic groups over a field and its kernel
concept.description: A homomorphism φ:G→H of algebraic groups over a field k is a k-morphism with φ∘m_G=m_H∘(φ×φ), equivalently inducing group homomorphisms G(R)→H(R) for all k-algebras R. Its kernel is the fibre G×_H Spec k over the identity of H, a normal algebraic subgroup with kernel points ker(G(R)→H(R)).

concept.title: Field ℂ_p of p-adic complex numbers
concept.description: ℂ_p is the completion of an algebraic closure of ℚ_p for the unique extension of the p-adic absolute value. It is algebraically closed, contains every finite extension of ℚ_p, its ring of integers O_(ℂ_p)={x:|x|_p≤1} is p-adically complete, and the absolute Galois group of ℚ_p, hence of each finite extension K, acts on ℂ_p by continuous isometric field automorphisms.

concept.title: Witt vectors of a perfect ring of characteristic p
concept.description: For a commutative ring A of prime characteristic p whose Frobenius x↦x^p is bijective, the ring W(A) of p-typical Witt vectors is, up to unique isomorphism, the p-torsion-free p-adically complete ring with W(A)/pW(A)≅A. Each element is uniquely ∑_(n≥0)[a_n]pⁿ with a_n∈A, where the Teichmüller lift [a] is the unique multiplicative section of reduction, and the Frobenius of A lifts to a ring automorphism φ of W(A). For example W(𝔽_p)=ℤ_p.

concept.title: Tilt O_(ℂ_p)^♭ of the ring of integers of ℂ_p
concept.description: O_(ℂ_p)^♭ is the inverse limit of O_(ℂ_p)/p along x↦x^p, the ring of sequences (x_n) with x_(n+1)^p=x_n under coordinatewise operations; it is a perfect ring of characteristic p with an action of the absolute Galois group of ℚ_p. Reduction gives a multiplicative bijection with p-power compatible sequences (x^((n))) in O_(ℂ_p); for example a compatible system of p-power roots of unity gives ε=(1,ζ_p,ζ_(p²),…).

concept.title: Fontaine’s map θ
concept.description: Fontaine’s map θ:W(O_(ℂ_p)^♭)→O_(ℂ_p) is given by θ(∑[x_n]pⁿ)=∑x_n^((0))pⁿ. It is a surjective ring homomorphism compatible with the Galois actions, and its kernel is the principal ideal generated by ξ=[p̃]−p for any p̃∈O_(ℂ_p)^♭ with p̃^((0))=p.

concept.title: Divided-power envelope of an ideal in a torsion-free ring
concept.description: For a commutative ring A without additive torsion and an ideal I⊆A, the divided-power envelope of A along I is the A-subalgebra of A⊗ℚ generated by the divided powers xᵐ/m! with x∈I and m≥1; if I=(ξ) it is A[ξᵐ/m!:m≥1]. These elements satisfy the identities of a divided-power structure, such as (x+y)ᵐ/m!=∑_(i+j=m)(xⁱ/i!)(yʲ/j!).

concept.title: Kato’s length bound for the Iwasawa cohomology of a newform
concept.description: For a newform f of weight k≥2 and a λ-adic realization V of f, let H¹ and H² be the Iwasawa cohomology over the cyclotomic ℤ_p-tower and Z(f)⊆H¹ the submodule generated by Kato’s zeta elements. For every height-one prime 𝔭 of the Iwasawa algebra not containing p, length H²_𝔭≤length(H¹/Z(f))_𝔭+length H²_loc,𝔭, and the local term vanishes except in one explicit weight-two case (Kato, Theorem 12.5(3)).

concept.title: Tate’s Euler–Poincaré characteristic formulas for p-adic representations
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_ℓ and a p-adic representation V of G_K, ∑(−1)ⁱdim Hⁱ(G_K,V) is −[K:ℚ_p]dim V if ℓ=p and 0 otherwise. For a number field K, a finite set Σ of places containing those above p and ∞, and V a representation of G_(K,Σ), ∑(−1)ⁱdim Hⁱ(G_(K,Σ),V)=∑_(v|∞)dim H⁰(K_v,V)−[K:ℚ]dim V.

concept.title: Dimension of the Bloch–Kato local finite subspace
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a de Rham p-adic representation V of G_K, dim_(ℚ_p)H¹_f(K,V)=dim_(ℚ_p)(D_dR(V)/D_dR⁺(V))+dim_(ℚ_p)H⁰(K,V). It follows from the exact sequence 0→ℚ_p→B_cris⊕B_dR⁺→B_cris⊕B_dR→0 tensored with V.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato duality of local finite conditions
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a de Rham p-adic representation V of G_K, the subspaces H¹_f(K,V) and H¹_f(K,V*(1)) are exact orthogonal complements under the local Tate pairing H¹(K,V)×H¹(K,V*(1))→ℚ_p.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato dual exponential map
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a de Rham representation V of G_K, the dual exponential exp*:H¹(K,V)→Fil⁰D_dR(V) is the composite of H¹(K,V)→H¹(K,B_dR⁺⊗V) with the inverse of the isomorphism H⁰(K,B_dR⁺⊗V)→H¹(K,B_dR⁺⊗V) given by cup product with log χ_cyc. It vanishes on H¹_f(K,V).

concept.title: Duality between the Galois representations of a newform and its conjugate
concept.description: For a newform f of weight k with complex-conjugate newform f*, and a finite prime λ of the coefficient field, the λ-adic representation of f* is isomorphic to Hom(V_λ(f),F_λ)(1−k) as a G_ℚ-representation. Hence lattices T in V_λ(f)(r) have duals T*(1) that are lattices in V_λ(f*)(k−r).

concept.title: p-adic Hodge properties of the Galois representation of a newform
concept.description: For a newform f of weight k≥2 and level N and a prime λ over p, the restriction of V_λ(f) to G_(ℚ_p) is de Rham, its Hodge filtration has D_dR/Fil^r one-dimensional over F_λ for 1≤r≤k−1, and for p∤N it is crystalline with det(1−φu|D_cris)=1−a_pu+ε(p)p^(k−1)u².

concept.title: Absolute values of Euler-factor roots of a newform
concept.description: For a normalized newform f=∑a_nqⁿ of weight k, level N and nebentypus ε (a Dirichlet character modulo N, so ε(ℓ)=0 when ℓ|N) and a prime ℓ, let α∈ℂ be nonzero with 1−αu dividing 1−a_ℓu+ε(ℓ)ℓ^(k−1)u². Then |α|=ℓ^((k−1)/2) or |α|=ℓ^((k−2)/2), and |α|=ℓ^((k−1)/2) when ℓ∤N.

concept.title: Courant–Fischer min-max theorem for Hermitian matrices
concept.description: If A is an n×n Hermitian matrix with eigenvalues λ₁≥⋯≥λₙ counted with multiplicity, then λᵢ=max over i-dimensional subspaces L⊆ℂⁿ of min over nonzero u∈L of u*Au/u*u; dually λᵢ=min over (n−i+1)-dimensional L of the maximum.

concept.title: Linear dependence lemma
concept.description: If v₁,…,v_m is a linearly dependent list in a vector space, some v_k lies in the span of v₁,…,v_(k−1), and removing such a v_k does not change the span of the list.

concept.title: Derivative of the natural logarithm
concept.description: The natural logarithm is differentiable on (0,∞) with ln′(x)=1/x.

concept.title: Standard function of a Hermitian matrix
concept.description: For a real function f on a set I⊆ℝ and a Hermitian matrix A=U diag(λ₁,…,λₙ)U* with U unitary and all λⱼ∈I, f(A)=U diag(f(λ₁),…,f(λₙ))U*; this Hermitian matrix does not depend on the chosen unitary diagonalization.

concept.title: Operator monotone function
concept.description: A real function f on an interval I⊆ℝ is operator monotone on I if A≼H implies f(A)≼f(H) in the Löwner order for all Hermitian matrices A,H of any common size with eigenvalues in I, where f(A) is the standard matrix function.

concept.title: Subharmonic function on an open Euclidean set
concept.description: A function v:Ω→[−∞,∞) on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ is subharmonic if −v is superharmonic: v is upper semicontinuous, not identically −∞ on any connected component, and v(x) is at most the surface-measure average of v over the sphere S(x,r) whenever the closed ball of radius r about x lies in Ω. For n=2 this is the subharmonic function on a planar domain.

concept.title: Poisson integral on a Euclidean ball
concept.description: For a ball B(a,R)⊂ℝⁿ and a function f on its boundary sphere S(a,R) that is surface-integrable, or measurable and bounded below (or above), its Poisson integral is P_f(x)=∫_{S(a,R)}(R²−|x−a|²)/(|S^{n−1}|R|x−y|ⁿ)f(y)dS(y) for x in the open ball, possibly +∞ (or −∞). The kernel is positive with total mass one.

concept.title: Newtonian fundamental solution of −Δ in dimension n≥3
concept.description: For n≥3 the locally integrable function Γ(x)=|x|^{2−n}/((n−2)|S^{n−1}|) on ℝⁿ, where |S^{n−1}| is the surface area of the unit sphere, satisfies −ΔΓ=δ₀ in the distributional sense.

concept.title: Newton’s shell theorem for the fundamental solution of the Laplacian
concept.description: Let Γ be the fundamental solution of −Δ on ℝⁿ, n≥2 (a multiple of log(1/|x|) for n=2, of |x|^{2−n} for n≥3). For R>0 the surface-measure average of y↦Γ(x−y) over the sphere |y|=R equals Γ(x) when |x|≥R and equals the constant value of Γ on the sphere of radius R when |x|≤R.

concept.title: Local criterion for superharmonicity
concept.description: Let u:Ω→(−∞,∞] be lower semicontinuous on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and not identically +∞ on any connected component. If every x∈Ω has radii r_m(x)→0 for which u(x) is at least the sphere average, or the ball average, of u over radius r_m(x) about x, then u is superharmonic. In particular superharmonicity is a local property.

concept.title: Jacobi theta inversion formula
concept.description: For real x>0 the theta function θ(x)=∑_(n∈ℤ)e^(−πn²x) satisfies θ(1/x)=√x·θ(x). Equivalently ϑ(τ)=∑_(n∈ℤ)e^(πin²τ) satisfies ϑ(−1/τ)=√(τ/i)·ϑ(τ) on the upper half-plane, with the principal square root.

concept.title: Holomorphy of integrals depending holomorphically on a parameter
concept.description: Let (X,μ) be a measure space, U⊆ℂ open and F:X×U→ℂ with F(·,s) measurable for each s and F(x,·) holomorphic for each x. If every compact K⊆U has an integrable g_K with |F(x,s)|≤g_K(x) for s∈K, then s↦∫F(x,s)dμ(x) is holomorphic on U and its derivative is ∫∂_sF(x,s)dμ(x).

concept.title: Holomorphy of a Dirichlet series in its half-plane of convergence
concept.description: If a Dirichlet series ∑a_n n^(−s) converges at s₀, then it converges for every s with Re s>Re s₀, uniformly on compact subsets of that half-plane. Its sum is holomorphic there, with derivative −∑a_n(log n)n^(−s).

concept.title: Compact-open topology
concept.description: For topological spaces X and Y, the compact-open topology on the set C(X,Y) of continuous maps X→Y is the coarsest topology in which every set {f: f(K)⊆U}, with K⊆X compact and U⊆Y open, is open.

concept.title: Pontryagin dual of a locally compact abelian group
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group A, its Pontryagin dual Â is the group of unitary characters A→𝕋={z∈ℂ:|z|=1} under pointwise multiplication, with the compact-open topology. Writing 𝕋 as ℝ/ℤ gives the same topological group.

concept.title: Self-duality of the additive group of a local field
concept.description: For a local field F and a nontrivial unitary character ψ of its additive group, the map a↦ψ_a with ψ_a(x)=ψ(ax) is an isomorphism of topological groups from F onto its Pontryagin dual F̂.

concept.title: Pontryagin dual of a restricted product
concept.description: Let G=∏′_v(G_v,H_v) be the restricted product of locally compact abelian groups G_v with respect to compact open subgroups H_v defined for almost all v. Restricting characters to the factors is an isomorphism of topological groups from Ĝ onto the restricted product ∏′_v(Ĝ_v,H_v^⊥), where H_v^⊥ is the compact open subgroup of characters of G_v trivial on H_v.

concept.title: Triviality of Tate’s standard adelic character on the number field
concept.description: For a number field F let ψ_v be Tate’s standard additive character of F_v: x↦e^(−2πix) on ℝ, the character of ℚ_p trivial on ℤ_p sending p^(−n) to e^(2πi/p^n), and these composed with the trace to ℝ or ℚ_p at other places. At every finite place unramified over ℚ the largest fractional ideal on which ψ_v is trivial is O_v, so ψ=∏_vψ_v is a nontrivial unitary character of A_F; and ψ is trivial on the diagonally embedded F.

concept.title: Unique ergodicity of the fibres of a Host–Kra cube nilmanifold
concept.description: Let (X=G/Γ,μ,T) be an ergodic (k−1)-step nilsystem with Haar measure μ and T translation by τ∈G. Then the Host–Kra cube measure μ^[k] is the Haar measure of a sub-nilmanifold X_k⊆X^(2^k), invariant and ergodic under the diagonal map T^[k] and the face transformations T_i^[k], 1≤i≤k; and for every x∈X the closed fibre W_(k,x)={𝐱∈X_k: x_0=x} is uniquely ergodic under T_1^[k],…,T_k^[k], i.e. carries exactly one invariant Borel probability measure.

concept.title: Function of locally bounded variation on a Euclidean open set
concept.description: A locally integrable function f on an open set U⊆ℝⁿ has locally bounded variation, f∈BV_loc(U), if for every open V⊆U with compact closure in U, sup{∫_V f div φ dx : φ a compactly supported C¹ vector field on V with |φ|≤1 everywhere} is finite. A vector-valued function is BV_loc when each component is.

concept.title: Matrix-valued signed Radon measure on a Euclidean open set
concept.description: An m×k matrix-valued signed Radon measure on an open U⊆ℝⁿ is an array μ=(μ^(ij)) in which each entry is a difference of two nonnegative Radon measures on U, evaluated on Borel sets with compact closure in U. For m=k it is symmetric if μ^(ij)=μ^(ji), and positive semidefinite if ∑_(i,j)ξ_iξ_jμ^(ij) is a nonnegative measure for every ξ∈ℝ^k.

concept.title: Second-order criterion for convexity
concept.description: A twice differentiable real function on an open convex subset D of ℝⁿ is convex if and only if its Hessian matrix is positive semidefinite at every point of D.

concept.title: Riesz representation of nonnegative functionals on test functions
concept.description: If L:C_c^∞(ℝⁿ)→ℝ is linear and nonnegative, meaning L(f)≥0 whenever f≥0, then there is a nonnegative Radon measure μ on ℝⁿ with L(f)=∫f dμ for every f∈C_c^∞(ℝⁿ).

concept.title: Local Lipschitz continuity of convex functions on Euclidean space
concept.description: Every convex function f:ℝⁿ→ℝ is locally Lipschitz: on every ball it is bounded, and for each r>0 it is Lipschitz on B(x,r) with constant (2/r)·sup_{B(x,2r)}|f|.

concept.title: Locally Lipschitz functions are locally W^{1,∞}
concept.description: A function f on an open U⊆ℝⁿ is locally Lipschitz if and only if (after modification on a Lebesgue-null set) f and its weak first partial derivatives are locally bounded, f∈W^{1,∞}_loc(U).

concept.title: Convergence of mollifications on Euclidean open sets
concept.description: Let η_ε be the standard mollifiers and f^ε=η_ε*f on U_ε={x∈U: dist(x,∂U)>ε} for f∈L¹_loc(U), U⊆ℝⁿ open. Then f^ε is smooth on U_ε; f^ε→f uniformly on compact subsets if f is continuous, and f^ε→f in L^p_loc(U) if f∈L^p_loc(U), 1≤p<∞.

concept.title: Classical inhomogeneous Triebel–Lizorkin space F^s_{p,q}
concept.description: For s∈ℝ, 0<p<∞ and 0<q≤∞, fix an admissible Schwartz pair with inhomogeneous family (φ_j)_(j≥0). F^s_(p,q)(ℝⁿ) consists of the tempered distributions f whose quasi-norm ‖(∑_(j≥0)(2^(js)|φ_j*f|)^q)^(1/q)‖_(L^p(ℝⁿ)) is finite, with the supremum over j when q=∞.

concept.title: Bessel potential space L^p_s
concept.description: For s∈ℝ and 1<p<∞, the Bessel potential (inhomogeneous fractional Sobolev) space L^p_s(ℝⁿ), also written H^s_p, consists of the tempered distributions u for which ((1+|ξ|²)^(s/2)û)^∨ is a function in L^p(ℝⁿ), normed by its L^p norm.

concept.title: Mikhlin multiplier theorem
concept.description: If m is C^k on ℝⁿ∖{0} with k=⌊n/2⌋+1 and |∂^αm(ξ)|≤A|ξ|^(−|α|) for all |α|≤k, then for 1<p<∞ the Fourier multiplier operator f↦(m f̂)^∨ extends from Schwartz functions to a bounded operator on L^p(ℝⁿ), with norm bounded by a constant depending on n,p times A+‖m‖_∞.

concept.title: Littlewood–Paley square function theorem on Lᵖ
concept.description: Let Ψ be a Schwartz function on ℝⁿ whose Fourier transform is supported in an annulus and satisfies ∑_(j∈ℤ)Ψ̂(2^(−j)ξ)=1 for ξ≠0, and Δ_jf=Ψ_(2^(−j))*f. For 1<p<∞, ‖(∑_j|Δ_jf|²)^(1/2)‖_p is comparable to ‖f‖_p for f∈L^p(ℝⁿ); moreover for any Schwartz θ with annular Fourier support, ‖∑_jθ_(2^(−j))*f_j‖_p≤C‖(∑_j|f_j|²)^(1/2)‖_p for sequences of functions f_j.

concept.title: Independence of Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norms from the dyadic resolution
concept.description: For s∈ℝ, 0<p<∞ and 0<q≤∞, the classical inhomogeneous Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norms ‖(∑_j(2^(js)|φ_j*f|)^q)^(1/q)‖_(L^p) defined with two different admissible dyadic resolutions, Littlewood–Paley partitions of unity included, are equivalent; hence the space F^s_(p,q)(ℝⁿ) does not depend on the resolution.

concept.title: Integral morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is integral if it is affine and, for every affine open Spec R⊆S with f⁻¹(Spec R)=Spec A, every element of A is integral over R via the ring map R→A.

concept.title: Going up and closedness of the induced map on spectra
concept.description: For a ring map R→S, the going-up property holds (whenever 𝔭⊆𝔭′ are primes of R and 𝔮 is a prime of S over 𝔭, there is a prime 𝔮′⊇𝔮 of S over 𝔭′) if and only if the induced map Spec S→Spec R is a closed map.

concept.title: Finite ring maps are integral
concept.description: If a ring map R→S makes S a finitely generated R-module, then every element of S is integral over R: multiplication by s∈S satisfies a monic polynomial over R obtained from the determinant trick applied to S.

concept.title: Flat pullback of algebraic cycles
concept.description: For a flat morphism f:X→Y of relative dimension r between schemes of finite type over a field, f*[V]=[f⁻¹(V)] for an integral closed subscheme V⊆Y of dimension k, where [f⁻¹(V)] is the cycle of the scheme-theoretic inverse image with multiplicities the lengths of its local rings at generic points of its components. Extended linearly, f*:Z_k(Y)→Z_(k+r)(X) preserves rational equivalence and induces f*:A_k(Y)→A_(k+r)(X).

concept.title: Proper pushforward of algebraic cycles
concept.description: For a proper morphism f:X→Y of schemes of finite type over a field and an integral closed subscheme V⊆X of dimension k, f_*[V]=deg(V/f(V))[f(V)] if dim f(V)=k, where deg is the degree of the extension of function fields, and f_*[V]=0 otherwise. Extended linearly, f_*:Z_k(X)→Z_k(Y) preserves rational equivalence and induces f_*:A_k(X)→A_k(Y).

concept.title: Effective Cartier divisor
concept.description: A closed subscheme D of a scheme X is an effective Cartier divisor if X is covered by affine opens Spec A on which D is Spec A/(f) for a nonzerodivisor f∈A. Its ideal sheaf is then invertible; O_X(D) denotes the dual invertible sheaf, whose canonical section 1 vanishes exactly along D.

concept.title: Capping with the first Chern class of an invertible sheaf
concept.description: For an invertible sheaf L on a scheme X of finite type over a field and an integral closed subscheme V⊆X of dimension k+1, c₁(L)∩[V] is the class of the Weil divisor of any nonzero rational section of L restricted to V. This is well defined up to rational equivalence and gives homomorphisms c₁(L)∩−:A_(k+1)(X)→A_k(X).

concept.title: Projective bundle of a finite locally free sheaf
concept.description: For a finite locally free sheaf E of rank r on a scheme X, the projective bundle π:P(E)=Proj_X(Sym*E)→X comes with a tautological invertible sheaf O_P(1) and a surjection π*E→O_P(1); over any open where E is free it is the projective space P^(r−1) over that open. Its points over X correspond to invertible quotients of the pulled-back E.

concept.title: Localization exact sequence for Chow groups
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over a field, Z⊆X a closed subscheme and U=X∖Z. Proper pushforward along Z→X and restriction to U give an exact sequence A_k(Z)→A_k(X)→A_k(U)→0 for every k.

concept.title: Surjectivity of flat pullback along affine-space bundles
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a flat morphism of relative dimension r between schemes of finite type over a field such that Y is covered by opens U over which f is isomorphic to the projection U×A^r→U. Then flat pullback f*:A_k(Y)→A_(k+r)(X) is surjective for every k.

concept.title: Projective bundle formula for Chow groups
concept.description: Let E be a finite locally free sheaf of rank r on a scheme X of finite type over a field, with projective bundle π:P→X and tautological sheaf O_P(1). Then (α₀,…,α_(r−1))↦Σ_i c₁(O_P(1))^i∩π*α_i is an isomorphism ⊕_(i=0)^(r−1)A_(k+i)(X)→A_(k+r−1)(P).

concept.title: First Chern class of a relative effective Cartier divisor on flat pullbacks
concept.description: Let p:X→Y be a flat morphism of relative dimension r between schemes of finite type over a field and i:D→X an effective Cartier divisor flat over Y. For α∈A_(k+1)(Y), c₁(O_X(D))∩p*α=i_*((p|_D)*α) in A_(k+r)(X), and the Gysin restriction of p*α to D is (p|_D)*α.

concept.title: Projection formula for first Chern classes under proper pushforward
concept.description: For a proper morphism p:X→Y of schemes of finite type over a field, an invertible sheaf L on Y and α∈A_(k+1)(X), p_*(c₁(p*L)∩α)=c₁(L)∩p_*α in A_k(Y).

concept.title: Principal divisor through the closure of the graph of a rational function
concept.description: Let X be an integral scheme of finite type over a field and f a nonzero rational function, regular and invertible on a dense open U. Let Y⊆X×P¹ be the closure of the graph of f|_U, with projections p:Y→X (proper, an isomorphism over U) and q:Y→P¹. Then div_Y(f)=[q⁻¹(0)]−[q⁻¹(∞)] and div_X(f)=p_*div_Y(f).

concept.title: Finiteness of a proper dominant morphism over codimension-one points
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a proper dominant morphism of integral schemes with Y locally Noetherian and R(Y)⊆R(X) a finite extension of function fields. If ξ∈Y has dim O_(Y,ξ)=1, then f is finite over some open neighbourhood of ξ.

concept.title: Torsion-free modules over a Dedekind domain are flat
concept.description: A module over a Dedekind domain, in particular over a discrete valuation ring, is flat if and only if it is torsion free.

concept.title: Finite flat morphisms of finite presentation are finite locally free
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is finite locally free if and only if it is finite, flat and locally of finite presentation. In particular a finite flat morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme is finite locally free.

concept.title: Pushforward of a flat pullback along a finite locally free morphism
concept.description: If f:X→Y is a finite locally free morphism of degree d between schemes of finite type over a field, then f is proper and flat of relative dimension zero and f_*f*α=dα for every cycle α on Y.

concept.title: Elliptic curve over a field
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a field k is a pair (E,O) of a smooth projective geometrically connected curve E over k of genus one and a k-rational point O. Every such curve is isomorphic to a nonsingular Weierstrass cubic y²z+a₁xyz+a₃yz²=x³+a₂x²z+a₄xz²+a₆z³ with O=[0:1:0], and conversely; its points over any extension of k form an abelian group under the chord-and-tangent rule with identity O.

concept.title: Separable degree of a finite field extension
concept.description: For a finite field extension L/K, the separable degree [L:K]_s is the degree over K of the separable closure of K in L (the largest subextension separable over K); it equals the number of K-embeddings of L into an algebraic closure of K. The inseparable degree [L:K]/[L:K]_s is a power of the characteristic.

concept.title: Moving the support of a divisor away from finitely many points
concept.description: On a nonsingular variety X over an algebraically closed field, for every divisor D and finitely many points x₁,…,x_m there is a divisor D′ linearly equivalent to D whose support contains none of the x_i.

concept.title: Number of points in the fibres of a finite separable map
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a finite surjective map of irreducible varieties over an algebraically closed field with Y normal. Every fibre has at most deg f points, and if k(X)/f*k(Y) is separable then the points of Y with exactly deg f preimages form a nonempty open subset.

concept.title: Frobenius factorization of a map of curves
concept.description: Over a perfect field of characteristic p>0, every nonconstant map φ:C₁→C₂ of smooth curves factors as C₁→C₁^(q)→C₂, the q-power Frobenius morphism followed by a separable map, where q is the inseparable degree of φ. The Frobenius morphism is purely inseparable of degree q and, on points over an algebraically closed field, raises coordinates to the q-th power, a bijection.

concept.title: Irreducibility from irreducible equidimensional fibres
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a surjective regular map of projective varieties over an algebraically closed field with Y irreducible. If all fibres f⁻¹(y) are irreducible and of the same dimension, then X is irreducible.

concept.title: Irreducibility of the variety of rank-deficient matrices
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, for m≥n the m×n matrices of rank less than n, the common zero locus of the maximal minors, form an irreducible closed subvariety of the affine space of all m×n matrices.

concept.title: ε-subdifferential of a convex function on a Banach space
concept.description: For a proper convex f:X→(−∞,∞] on a real Banach space X, a point x with f(x)<∞ and ε>0, the ε-subdifferential is ∂_εf(x)={x*∈X*: f(y)≥f(x)+⟨x*,y−x⟩−ε for every y∈X}; its elements are the ε-subgradients (approximate subgradients) of f at x.

concept.title: Hahn–Banach separation theorem for an open convex set
concept.description: In a real normed space, if A and B are disjoint nonempty convex sets and A is open, there are a nonzero continuous linear functional ℓ and a real α with ℓ(a)<α≤ℓ(b) for all a∈A and b∈B.

concept.title: Hahn–Banach strict separation of a closed convex set from a compact convex set
concept.description: In a real normed space E, if A and B are disjoint nonempty convex sets with A closed and B compact, there are a continuous linear functional f on E, α∈ℝ and ε>0 with f(a)≤α−ε for all a∈A and f(b)≥α+ε for all b∈B. This is the second geometric form of the Hahn–Banach theorem.

concept.title: Epigraph of an extended-real function
concept.description: For f:X→(−∞,∞], epi f={(x,λ)∈X×ℝ: f(x)≤λ}. On a real vector space f is convex exactly when epi f is convex; on a topological space f is lower semicontinuous exactly when epi f is closed in X×ℝ.

concept.title: Affine minorants of a convex function at relative interior points of its domain
concept.description: If f:ℝⁿ→(−∞,∞] is convex and not identically ∞ and x₀ lies in the relative interior of dom f={f<∞}, there is s in the linear subspace parallel to aff dom f with f(x)≥f(x₀)+⟨s,x−x₀⟩ for every x; thus f has an affine minorant agreeing with it at x₀ and its subdifferential at x₀ is nonempty.

concept.title: Relative interior and closure of a convex set in ℝᵈ
concept.description: For a convex C⊆ℝᵈ, the closure cl C is convex, ri(cl C)=ri C and cl(ri C)=cl C; in particular int(cl C)=int C, so the boundary of cl C is cl C∖int C.

concept.title: Riemann mapping theorem
concept.description: Every simply connected open connected subset of ℂ other than ℂ itself is conformally equivalent to the open unit disc: there is a bijective holomorphic map from it onto the disc, whose inverse is then holomorphic.

concept.title: Koebe one-quarter theorem
concept.description: If f is holomorphic and injective on the open unit disc U with f(0)=0 and f′(0)=1, then f(U) contains the open disc of radius 1/4 about 0; the Koebe function z/(1−z)² shows that 1/4 cannot be improved.

concept.title: Simple connectivity of a plane region via its complement in the Riemann sphere
concept.description: A connected open subset Ω of ℂ is simply connected exactly when its complement in the Riemann sphere ℂ∪{∞} is connected.

concept.title: Cauchy–Riemann operator ∂̄ on the plane
concept.description: For a differentiable complex function f of z=x+iy on an open subset of ℂ=ℝ², ∂̄f=½(∂f/∂x+i∂f/∂y), the Wirtinger derivative with respect to z̄; the Cauchy–Riemann equations for f are ∂̄f=0.

concept.title: Cauchy–Pompeiu formula for compactly supported C¹ functions
concept.description: If f is a continuously differentiable complex function on ℂ with compact support, then f(z)=−(1/π)∬_ℂ (∂̄f)(ζ)/(ζ−z) dξ dη for every z∈ℂ, where ζ=ξ+iη and ∂̄ is the Cauchy–Riemann operator.

concept.title: Laurent expansion of a holomorphic function on an annulus
concept.description: A function holomorphic on an annulus {r<|z−a|<R}, 0≤r<R≤∞, equals Σ_{n∈ℤ}c_n(z−a)ⁿ there, with locally uniform convergence and c_n=(2πi)⁻¹∮_{|ζ−a|=ρ}f(ζ)(ζ−a)^{−n−1}dζ for any r<ρ<R; the coefficients are unique.

concept.title: Bezuglyi–Handelman dimension-group criterion for quotients of simple dimension groups
concept.description: Let (G,u) be a simple dimension group and L a convex subgroup such that for every l∈L and ε>0 there are l₁,l₂∈L with l=l₁−l₂ and l̂₁,l̂₂≥−ε on the normalized trace space S(G,u). Then G/L with the quotient ordering is a dimension group. This applies when J=P(J), where J is the closure of the image of L in Aff S(G,u) and P(J) the subgroup generated by its nonnegative elements.

concept.title: Basic sequence in a Banach space and its basis constant
concept.description: A sequence (xₙ) of nonzero vectors in a Banach space is basic if it is a Schauder basis of its closed linear span. Its basis constant is supₙ∥Pₙ∥ for the partial-sum projections Pₙ(∑aᵢxᵢ)=∑_{i≤n}aᵢxᵢ on that span, that is, the least K with ∥∑_{i≤m}aᵢxᵢ∥≤K∥∑_{i≤n}aᵢxᵢ∥ for all m≤n and all scalars.

concept.title: Mazur’s basic-sequence selection from a weak-star null set
concept.description: Let X be a Banach space and S⊆X** a set whose weak-star closure contains 0 but whose norm closure does not. Then for every ε>0, S contains a basic sequence with basis constant at most 1+ε.

concept.title: Nash-Williams theorem: open sets of infinite subsets of ℕ are Ramsey
concept.description: Give the set [ℕ]^ω of infinite subsets of ℕ the topology inherited from the product topology on {0,1}^ℕ. If U⊆[ℕ]^ω is open, then every infinite L⊆ℕ has an infinite M⊆L such that either every infinite subset of M lies in U or none does.

concept.title: Well-ordering theorem
concept.description: Every set admits a well-ordering, that is, a total order in which every nonempty subset has a least element. Over Zermelo–Fraenkel set theory it is equivalent to the axiom of choice.

concept.title: Steiner formula for Minkowski sums with a cube
concept.description: For a compact convex S⊆ℝⁿ, K=[−1,1]ⁿ and t≥0, Vol(S+tK)=∑_{k=0}^{n}(∑_{|I|=n−k}Vol_{n−k}(P_I S))2ᵏtᵏ, where P_I is the coordinate projection onto ℝ^I and Vol₀=1; equivalently the mixed volumes of S with the cube are averages of volumes of coordinate projections of S.

concept.title: Pajor’s two-letter subcube lemma for p-ary words
concept.description: For an integer p≥2 and α>0 there is c=c(p,α)>0 such that for every n≥1 and every S⊆{1,…,p}ⁿ with |S|≥2^{αn}, there are a set I⊆{1,…,n} with |I|≥cn and two distinct letters ℓ,m such that the coordinate restriction of S to I contains {ℓ,m}^I.

concept.title: Nuclear C*-algebra
concept.description: A C*-algebra A is nuclear if there are contractive completely positive maps φₙ:A→M_{k(n)}(ℂ) and ψₙ:M_{k(n)}(ℂ)→A with ∥ψₙ(φₙ(a))−a∥→0 for every a∈A (the completely positive approximation property).

concept.title: Commutative C*-algebras are nuclear
concept.description: Every commutative C*-algebra is nuclear; for C(X) with X compact Hausdorff the approximating maps come from partitions of unity subordinate to finite open covers.

concept.title: Nuclear C*-algebras are exact
concept.description: If B is a nuclear C*-algebra and J is a closed two-sided ideal of a C*-algebra A, then 0→J⊗_min B→A⊗_min B→(A/J)⊗_min B→0 is exact; in particular nuclear C*-algebras are exact.

concept.title: Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring dynamical entropy
concept.description: For a unital C*-algebra A with a state ϕ and a ϕ-preserving automorphism α, h_ϕ(α) is the supremum over channels γ:B→A (unital completely positive maps from finite-dimensional C*-algebras) of lim_n n⁻¹H_ϕ(γ,α∘γ,…,α^{n−1}∘γ), where H_ϕ is the Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring mutual entropy defined by optimizing over decompositions of ϕ (abelian models).

concept.title: Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring entropy is bounded by Voiculescu–Brown entropy
concept.description: If α is an automorphism of a unital exact C*-algebra A and ϕ is an α-invariant state, then the Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring entropy satisfies h_ϕ(α)≤ht(α), the Voiculescu–Brown topological entropy.

concept.title: Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring entropy of a commutative system is Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy
concept.description: If T is a homeomorphism of a compact metrizable space X, μ is a T-invariant Borel probability measure, ϕ(f)=∫f dμ and α(f)=f∘T⁻¹ on C(X), then the Connes–Narnhofer–Thirring entropy h_ϕ(α) equals the Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy h_μ(T).

concept.title: Variational principle for topological entropy
concept.description: For a continuous map T of a compact metrizable space X, h_top(T)=sup_μ h_μ(T), the supremum of Kolmogorov–Sinai entropies over T-invariant Borel probability measures μ.

concept.title: Cohomology of a sheaf of modules on a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X the O_X-modules form an abelian category with enough injectives, and the cohomology groups H^i(X,F) of an O_X-module F are the right derived functors of the left exact global-sections functor F↦F(X), so H⁰(X,F)=F(X). For X over a field k they are k-vector spaces. If X is proper over k and F is coherent, each H^i(X,F) is finite-dimensional, only finitely many are nonzero, and χ(X,F)=∑(−1)^i dim_k H^i(X,F) is the Euler characteristic of F.

concept.title: Morphism to projective space defined by generating sections
concept.description: Let X be a scheme over a field k, L an invertible O_X-module and s₀,…,s_n∈H⁰(X,L) global sections that generate L, i.e. the open sets X_{s_i} where s_i generates the stalk cover X. They define the unique k-morphism φ:X→P^n_k with φ⁻¹(D₊(x_i))=X_{s_i}, given on X_{s_i} by x_j/x_i↦s_j/s_i. A basis of H⁰(X,L), when it generates L, defines such a morphism, unique up to a linear change of coordinates.

concept.title: Diffeomorphism between smooth manifolds
concept.description: A diffeomorphism between smooth manifolds M and N is a smooth bijection F:M→N whose inverse map N→M is also smooth. Open subsets of smooth manifolds are smooth manifolds, so one speaks of a diffeomorphism from an open neighbourhood of a point onto an open subset.

concept.title: Splitting field of a polynomial
concept.description: A splitting field of a nonzero polynomial f over a field k is a field extension K/k in which f factors as a product of linear polynomials and which is generated over k by the roots of f in K. Splitting fields exist and are unique up to k-isomorphism; an extension K/k is the splitting field of f inside a given field containing K if K is generated by the roots of f there.

concept.title: Cohomology of coherent sheaves with zero-dimensional support on a proper scheme
concept.description: Let X be a proper scheme over a field k and F a coherent O_X-module whose support has dimension at most 0. Then F is generated by global sections, H⁰(X,F)=⊕_{x∈Supp F}F_x, H^i(X,F)=0 for i>0, and χ(X,F)=dim_k H⁰(X,F).

concept.title: Local triviality of invertible sheaves over the base of a finite morphism
concept.description: Let π:X→Y be a finite morphism of schemes and L an invertible O_X-module. Every y∈Y has an open neighbourhood V such that L|_{π⁻¹(V)} is trivial. In particular every invertible module on a scheme finite over a field is trivial.

concept.title: Ampleness of positive-degree invertible sheaves on a proper curve
concept.description: Let X be a proper curve over a field k (an integral separated scheme of finite type of dimension one, proper over k) and L an invertible O_X-module. Then L is ample if and only if deg(L)>0, where deg(L)=χ(X,L)−χ(X,O_X).

concept.title: Projective scheme of the section ring of an ample invertible sheaf
concept.description: Let X be a proper scheme over a field k and L an ample invertible O_X-module. Then the canonical morphism X→Proj(⊕_{d≥0}H⁰(X,L^{⊗d})) is an isomorphism; more generally this holds for an f-ample invertible sheaf along a universally closed morphism f:X→S, with the relative Proj of ⊕f_*L^{⊗d}.

concept.title: Closed immersion of Proj induced by a surjection of graded rings
concept.description: Let A→B be a homomorphism of graded rings with A generated by A₁ over A₀, which is surjective in all sufficiently large degrees. Then it induces a morphism Proj B→Proj A defined on all of Proj B, this morphism is a closed immersion, and it pulls back O_{Proj A}(n) to O_{Proj B}(n). In particular a graded quotient of k[T₀,…,T_n] gives a closed subscheme of P^n_k.

concept.title: Smooth dependence of ODE solutions on initial data and parameters
concept.description: Let F(t,x,λ) be a smooth map from an open subset of ℝ×ℝⁿ×ℝᵐ to ℝⁿ. The solutions of x′=F(t,x,λ), x(t₀)=x₀ form a smooth map (t,t₀,x₀,λ)↦x(t;t₀,x₀,λ) on an open domain containing every (t₀,t₀,x₀,λ). The same holds, via charts, for the flows of smooth vector fields on manifolds depending smoothly on parameters.

concept.title: Dixmier–Malliavin approximate-delta lemma for Schwartz functions on the real line
concept.description: Given positive bounds B_j, there are constants 0<b_j<B_j and ψ∈S(ℝ) such that ∑_{j=0}^{n}(−1)^j b_j ψ^{(2j)} converges to the Dirac distribution δ in S′(ℝ) as n→∞. One may take ψ̂(ξ)=∏_{n≥1}(1+ξ²/a_n²)⁻¹, the reciprocal of the entire function ∑_j(2π)^j b_jξ^{2j}, with a_n≥n increasing; then sup|ψ^{(j)}| is bounded independently of the chosen sequence.

concept.title: Differentiability of limits under uniform convergence of derivatives
concept.description: Let f_n be continuously differentiable functions on an open interval I such that f_n(x₀) converges for some x₀∈I and f_n′ converges uniformly on I. Then f_n converges locally uniformly to a continuously differentiable f with f′=lim f_n′. Consequently, if every derivative of a sequence of smooth functions converges locally uniformly, the limit is smooth and derivatives may be taken termwise.

concept.title: Projective general linear group over a field and its fractional linear action
concept.description: For a field F, PGL_n(F)=GL_n(F)/F^×, the quotient by the nonzero scalar matrices. PGL₂(F) acts faithfully on the projective line P¹(F) by linear fractional transformations z↦(az+b)/(cz+d), and for a field extension K/F it acts in the same way on P¹(K)=K∪{∞}.

concept.title: Cayley–Hamilton theorem
concept.description: Every square matrix A over a commutative ring satisfies its characteristic polynomial: if det(xI−A)=xⁿ+c_{n−1}x^{n−1}+⋯+c₀, then Aⁿ+c_{n−1}A^{n−1}+⋯+c₀I=0. For a 2×2 matrix this reads A²−tr(A)A+det(A)I=0.

concept.title: Rational canonical form of a matrix over a field
concept.description: Every square matrix A over a field F is similar over F to a unique block-diagonal matrix of companion matrices of monic polynomials d₁∣d₂∣⋯∣d_r (the invariant factors of F[x]-module Fⁿ with x acting by A), with d_r the minimal polynomial. In particular two n×n matrices whose minimal polynomials both equal their common characteristic polynomial are similar over F.

concept.title: Alternating multilinearity of the determinant
concept.description: For n×n matrices over a commutative ring, the determinant is linear in each row when the other rows are fixed, and permuting the rows by a permutation σ multiplies it by sgn(σ); in particular it vanishes when two rows coincide. The same holds for columns.

concept.title: Archimedean property of the real numbers
concept.description: For every real number x there is a natural number n with n>x; equivalently, for every ε>0 there is a natural number n with 1/n<ε.

concept.title: Euclid’s lemma for primes
concept.description: If a prime p divides a product ab of integers, then p divides a or p divides b.

concept.title: Diameter of a subset of a metric space
concept.description: For a nonempty subset A of a metric space (X,d), its diameter is diam A=sup{d(x,y):x,y∈A}, an element of [0,∞].

concept.title: Universality of nondegenerate isotropic quadratic spaces
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic different from two, a nondegenerate isotropic quadratic space V splits as V≅H⊥W with H a hyperbolic plane; in particular V represents every element of the field.

concept.title: Complex cosine function
concept.description: The entire function cos z=(e^{iz}+e^{−iz})/2, which restricts to the real cosine function on ℝ.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Ray-integral representation of the Hankel functions
concept.description: For Re(ν+½)>0 and an acute angle β, H_ν^{(1)}(z)=(2/(πz))^{1/2}e^{i(z−νπ/2−π/4)}Γ(ν+½)^{−1}∫_0^{∞e^{iβ}}e^{−u}u^{ν−½}(1+iu/(2z))^{ν−½}du for −π/2+β<arg z<3π/2+β, and H_ν^{(2)}(z) has the conjugate representation, with i replaced by −i, for −3π/2+β<arg z<π/2+β.
concept.field: Random matrix asymptotics and complex analysis

concept.title: Diagram of a link or tangled trivalent graph
concept.description: A compact subset of the plane, or of a disc meeting its boundary in finitely many endpoints, that is locally an arc, three arcs meeting at a trivalent vertex, or two arcs crossing transversally at a double point away from the vertices, each double point being marked with the arc that passes over. Closed loops are allowed. It depicts a link or a trivalent graph embedded in three-dimensional space.

concept.title: Regular isotopy of link and trivalent-graph diagrams
concept.description: The equivalence relation on diagrams of links and tangled trivalent graphs generated by planar isotopy, the second and third Reidemeister moves, and the moves sliding a strand over or under a trivalent vertex. The first Reidemeister move, which adds or removes a kink, is not allowed, so regular isotopy invariants see the blackboard framing.

concept.title: Reshetikhin–Turaev invariant of coloured ribbon graphs
concept.description: In a ribbon category, a diagram of a link or tangled trivalent graph with oriented edges coloured by objects and vertices coloured by morphisms between the tensor products of the incident colours evaluates to a morphism: crossings are read as braidings, caps and cups as duality maps, and vertices as their colours. The value is invariant under regular isotopy.

concept.title: Clasped G₂ web space
concept.description: For a sequence C of clasps, each a string of symbols 1 and 2 at consecutive boundary points whose weight is the sum of the G₂ fundamental weights λ₁ for each 1 and λ₂ for each 2, Kuperberg’s W(C) is the subspace of the G₂ web space, with type-2 strands drawn as double edges, spanned by the non-elliptic webs without internal double edges in which every clasp is non-convex: every path transverse to the web that cuts off the clasp has weight at least the clasp’s weight in the dominance order.

concept.title: Schwarz’s first fundamental theorem of invariant theory for G₂
concept.description: For the compact group G₂ acting on its seven-dimensional representation, the imaginary octonions, every multilinear invariant form is a linear combination of products of the invariant bilinear form B(a,b), the invariant trilinear form T(a,b,c)=B(a×b,c) and its Hodge-dual four-form, evaluated on the arguments in some order.

concept.title: Quantum Weyl dimension formula
concept.description: For a generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group and a dominant integral weight λ, the quantum dimension of the simple module L(λ), the trace of the element K_{2ρ}, equals ∏_{α>0}[(λ+ρ,α)]/[(ρ,α)] over the positive roots, where ρ is half the sum of the positive roots and [n]=(q^{n/2}−q^{−n/2})/(q^{1/2}−q^{−1/2}).

concept.title: Linear system of divisors
concept.description: Let X be a scheme over a field k, L an invertible sheaf on X and V⊆H⁰(X,L) a finite-dimensional subspace. The linear system |V| is the family of zero schemes div(s) of the nonzero sections s∈V, parametrized by the projective space P(V) of lines in V. Its base locus B is the closed set where all sections in V vanish; on X∖B, V defines a morphism φ_V:X∖B→P(V^∨) to the projective space of hyperplanes of V, sending x to the sections vanishing at x, and the members of |V| restricted to X∖B are the pullbacks of hyperplanes.

concept.title: Unramified morphism of schemes over a field
concept.description: A morphism f:X→Y of schemes locally of finite type over a field k is unramified if the natural map f*Ω¹_(Y/k)→Ω¹_(X/k) is surjective, i.e. its relative differentials Ω_(X/Y) vanish. At a k-rational point x this says that the differential T_xX→T_(f(x))Y of Zariski tangent spaces is injective; over an algebraically closed field f is unramified exactly when this holds at every closed point.

concept.title: Smoothness and regularity over a perfect field
concept.description: A scheme locally of finite type over a perfect field (for instance of characteristic zero) is smooth if and only if all its local rings are regular. Over an arbitrary field, smooth schemes are regular.

concept.title: Differential criterion for smoothness of an integral algebra over a field
concept.description: A finitely generated integral algebra B over a field K is smooth over K if and only if its module of Kähler differentials Ω_(B/K) is projective of constant rank dim B.

concept.title: Conormal exact sequence of Kähler differentials
concept.description: For a surjection of K-algebras C→B=C/I there is an exact sequence I/I²→Ω_(C/K)⊗_C B→Ω_(B/K)→0, the first map sending f to 1⊗df.

concept.title: Height plus dimension formula for affine domains
concept.description: For a finitely generated integral algebra A over a field and a prime ideal 𝔭⊆A, ht(𝔭)+dim(A/𝔭)=dim A. In particular such algebras are catenary.

concept.title: Étale characterization of henselian local rings
concept.description: A local ring (R,𝔪,k) is henselian if and only if every étale morphism X→Spec R is a local isomorphism at each point x over the closed point with κ(x)=k; then for such x there is exactly one section Spec R→X sending the closed point to x.

concept.title: Étale quasi-sections of smooth morphisms
concept.description: Let X→S be smooth, s∈S and x a closed point of the fibre X_s with κ(x) separable over κ(s). Then there are an étale morphism S′→S, a point s′ over s with κ(s′)=κ(x), and a section of X×_S S′→S′ through a point over x at s′.

concept.title: Fibrewise criterion for flatness
concept.description: Let X→S and Y→S be locally of finite presentation and f:X→Y an S-morphism. If X is flat over S and every fibre f_s:X_s→Y_s is flat, then f is flat and Y is flat over S at the points of f(X); conversely these conditions follow from flatness of f and of Y over S along f(X).

concept.title: Smoothness as flatness plus smooth fibres
concept.description: A morphism f:X→S locally of finite presentation is smooth at x if and only if it is flat at x and the fibre X_(f(x)) is smooth over κ(f(x)) at x; in particular f is étale at x if and only if it is flat at x and the fibre is étale at x.

concept.title: Flatness criterion for homomorphisms of smooth algebraic groups
concept.description: For a homomorphism f:G→G′ of smooth group schemes of finite type over a field with dim G=dim G′, the following are equivalent: f is flat; f maps the identity component G⁰ onto G′⁰; ker f is finite; f is quasi-finite; f is finite.

concept.title: Differential criterion for étaleness between smooth schemes
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of S-schemes with X smooth over S at x and Y smooth over S at f(x). Then f is étale at x if and only if the canonical map (f*Ω¹_(Y/S))_x→(Ω¹_(X/S))_x is bijective.

concept.title: Artinian local ring
concept.description: A local ring (A,𝔪) is Artinian if it is Noetherian of Krull dimension zero; equivalently it has finite length as a module over itself, equivalently it is Noetherian and 𝔪ⁿ=0 for some n.

concept.title: Versal formal deformation of a complete local algebra
concept.description: Let k be a field and A a complete local Noetherian k-algebra with residue field k. A deformation of A over a local Artinian k-algebra B with residue field k is a flat B-algebra A_B with an isomorphism A_B⊗_B k≅A; it pulls back along local homomorphisms B→B′ by A_B⊗_B B′. A formal deformation over a complete local Noetherian k-algebra R with residue field k is a compatible family of deformations over the R/𝔪_Rⁿ. It is versal if, for every surjection B′→B of local Artinian k-algebras, every deformation over B′ whose restriction to B is pulled back along a local homomorphism R→B is pulled back along a local homomorphism R→B′ lifting it.

concept.title: Elkik’s theorem on henselian versal deformations of isolated singularities
concept.description: Let S be the spectrum of a henselian local ring and X₀ a scheme of finite type over its residue field, smooth outside a closed point x. Then X₀ at x has a henselian versal S-deformation, unique up to non-unique isomorphism; over a Noetherian S a henselian deformation is versal if and only if it induces a formal versal deformation over the completion of its base.

concept.title: Chevalley’s theorem on subgroups as stabilizers of lines
concept.description: For every algebraic subgroup H of an affine algebraic group G over a field k, there is a finite-dimensional algebraic representation V of G and a one-dimensional subspace L⊆V such that H is the stabilizer of L in G.

concept.title: Flag variety of a finite-dimensional vector space
concept.description: A flag in an n-dimensional vector space V over k is a chain 0=V₀⊊V₁⊊…⊊V_r=V of subspaces; it is maximal (complete) when r=n, so dim V_i=i. For fixed dimensions d₁<…<d_r=n the flags form the flag variety, the closed subvariety of the product of Grassmannians Gr(d₁,V)×…×Gr(d_r,V) cut out by the inclusions V_i⊆V_{i+1}. It is projective, and GL_V acts transitively on it, identifying it with GL_V/B(F) for the stabilizer B(F) of one such flag F.

concept.title: Lie–Kolchin theorem
concept.description: A smooth connected solvable affine algebraic group G over an algebraically closed field is trigonalizable: every finite-dimensional algebraic representation of G stabilizes a maximal flag, i.e. has a basis in which G acts by upper triangular matrices.

concept.title: Closed orbit lemma for algebraic group actions
concept.description: Let a smooth algebraic group G act on an algebraic variety X over an algebraically closed field. Every orbit is open in its closure, and the complement of an orbit in its closure is a union of orbits of strictly smaller dimension. In particular, every orbit of minimum dimension is closed.

concept.title: Dimension formula for quotients of algebraic groups
concept.description: For an algebraic subgroup H of an algebraic group G over a field, the quotient G/H satisfies dim G = dim H + dim G/H.

concept.title: Closed immersions are proper
concept.description: Every closed immersion of schemes is proper. Consequently a closed subscheme of a scheme proper over a base is proper over that base; in particular closed subschemes of complete schemes over a field are complete.

concept.title: Borel fixed point theorem
concept.description: Let G be a smooth connected solvable algebraic group over a field k acting on a nonempty complete algebraic scheme X. Then G has a fixed point in X(k̄); over an algebraically closed field, there is a k-point fixed by G.

concept.title: Weierstrass equation and its invariants
concept.description: A Weierstrass equation over a commutative ring R is y²+a₁xy+a₃y=x³+a₂x²+a₄x+a₆ with a_i∈R. Its invariants are b₂=a₁²+4a₂, b₄=a₁a₃+2a₄, b₆=a₃²+4a₆, b₈=a₁²a₆+4a₂a₆−a₁a₃a₄+a₂a₃²−a₄², c₄=b₂²−24b₄, c₆=−b₂³+36b₂b₄−216b₆ and the discriminant Δ=−b₂²b₈−8b₄³−27b₆²+9b₂b₄b₆, with j=c₄³/Δ when Δ is invertible. The substitution x=u²x′+r, y=u³y′+su²x′+t with u a unit and r,s,t∈R gives a Weierstrass equation with u⁴c₄′=c₄, u⁶c₆′=c₆ and u¹²Δ′=Δ. Over a field the projective cubic of the equation is nonsingular exactly when Δ≠0, and the isomorphisms between the resulting elliptic curves carrying O=[0:1:0] to O are exactly these substitutions.

concept.title: Tate curve over a p-adic field
concept.description: For a p-adic field K (a finite extension of ℚ_p) and q∈K^× with |q|<1, put s_k(q)=∑_{n≥1}n^kqⁿ/(1−qⁿ), a₄(q)=−5s₃(q) and a₆(q)=−(5s₃(q)+7s₅(q))/12. These are power series in q with integer coefficients, so they converge in K. The Tate curve E_q is the Weierstrass equation y²+xy=x³+a₄(q)x+a₆(q) over K.

concept.title: Dedekind zeta function of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K, ζ_K(s)=∑_𝔞N(𝔞)^{−s}, summed over the nonzero ideals 𝔞 of its ring of integers O_K with N(𝔞)=|O_K/𝔞|. It converges absolutely for real s>1 (indeed for Re s>1) and has the Euler product ζ_K(s)=∏_𝔭(1−N(𝔭)^{−s})^{−1} over the nonzero prime ideals; for K=ℚ it is the Riemann zeta function.

concept.title: Analytic class number formula for a number field
concept.description: For a number field K of degree n=r₁+2r₂ with r₁ real and r₂ pairs of complex embeddings, class number h, regulator R, discriminant D and w roots of unity, lim_{s→1+}(s−1)ζ_K(s)=2^{r₁}(2π)^{r₂}hR/(w√|D|). For an imaginary quadratic field this reads lim_{s→1+}(s−1)ζ_K(s)=2πh/(w√|D|).

concept.title: Decomposition of rational primes in a quadratic field
concept.description: Let K be a quadratic field with discriminant D and quadratic character χ=χ_D. A rational prime p splits as pO_K=𝔭𝔭′ with 𝔭≠𝔭′ and N𝔭=N𝔭′=p if χ(p)=1, remains prime with norm p² if χ(p)=−1, and ramifies as pO_K=𝔭² with N𝔭=p if χ(p)=0, i.e. p∣D. Consequently ζ_K(s)=ζ(s)L(s,χ_D).

concept.title: Value at s=1 of the L-function of a primitive Dirichlet character
concept.description: Let χ be a primitive Dirichlet character of modulus m>1 with Gauss sum τ(χ)=∑_{x mod m}χ(x)e^{2πix/m}. If χ is even, L(1,χ)=−(τ(χ)/m)∑_{0<x<m}χ̄(x)log sin(πx/m); if χ is odd, L(1,χ)=(πiτ(χ)/m²)∑_{0<x<m}χ̄(x)x.

concept.title: Analytic uniformization of the Tate curve
concept.description: Let K be a p-adic field and q∈K^× with |q|<1. The Tate curve E_q is an elliptic curve over K with discriminant Δ=q∏_{n≥1}(1−qⁿ)²⁴ and j-invariant j(E_q)=1/q+744+196884q+⋯, a power series with integer coefficients. Convergent series X(u,q), Y(u,q) define a surjective homomorphism φ:K̄^×→E_q(K̄) with kernel q^ℤ that commutes with the action of Gal(K̄/K); hence E_q(L)≅L^×/q^ℤ for every algebraic extension L/K.

concept.title: Compositional inverse of a formal power series
concept.description: Let R be a commutative ring and f(T)=a₁T+a₂T²+⋯∈R[[T]] with a₁ a unit of R. There is a unique g(T)=a₁⁻¹T+⋯∈R[[T]] with f(g(T))=T, and then also g(f(T))=T.

concept.title: Twisting invariant γ=−c₄/c₆ of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a field K of characteristic different from 2 and 3 with j(E)≠0,1728. Then γ(E/K)=−c₄/c₆∈K^×/(K^×)² is independent of the Weierstrass equation. Another such E′ is isomorphic to E over K if and only if j(E′)=j(E) and γ(E′/K)=γ(E/K); if j(E′)=j(E) but the γ differ, E′ is the quadratic twist of E by L=K(√(γ(E/K)/γ(E′/K))), via an isomorphism ψ with ψ(P^σ)=χ(σ)ψ(P)^σ for the quadratic character χ of L/K.

concept.title: Discriminant and c₄ criterion for the reduction type
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a nonarchimedean local field given by a minimal Weierstrass equation. Then E has good reduction if and only if v(Δ)=0, multiplicative reduction if and only if v(Δ)>0 and v(c₄)=0, and additive reduction if and only if v(Δ)>0 and v(c₄)>0.

concept.title: Minimal proper regular model of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Let R be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field K and E an elliptic curve over K. A proper regular model of E is a regular integral scheme 𝒞, proper and flat over R, with generic fibre isomorphic to E. It is minimal if its special fibre contains no exceptional curve (a smooth rational component of self-intersection −1) that can be blown down. Such a model exists and is unique up to unique isomorphism; its smooth locus over R is the Néron model of E.

concept.title: Direct limit of a directed system of modules
concept.description: For a directed set I, a directed system of modules over a commutative ring R consists of R-modules M_i and homomorphisms φ_ji:M_i→M_j for i≤j with φ_ii=id and φ_kj∘φ_ji=φ_ki. Its direct limit lim→M_i is the set of pairs (i,x), x∈M_i, modulo (i,x)∼(j,y) when φ_ki(x)=φ_kj(y) for some k≥i,j, with operations computed in a common M_k. With the induced maps M_i→lim→M_i it is universal among compatible families of homomorphisms into a fixed module. Every element comes from some M_i, and x∈M_i maps to 0 exactly when φ_ki(x)=0 for some k≥i. Abelian groups are the case R=ℤ.

concept.title: Classification of the places of a number field
concept.description: For a number field K, the nonarchimedean places correspond bijectively to the nonzero prime ideals 𝔭 of O_K, the place of 𝔭 being represented by |x|_𝔭=N(𝔭)^(−ord_𝔭(x)); the archimedean places correspond to the real embeddings K→ℝ and to the pairs of complex-conjugate embeddings K→ℂ. Thus K has r₁+r₂ archimedean places.

concept.title: Open normal subgroups of a profinite group form a basis at the identity
concept.description: In a profinite group G the open normal subgroups form a basis of neighbourhoods of the identity, and each of them has finite index in G.
