concept.title: Petersson adjoints of the Hecke and diamond operators
concept.description: On the space S_k(Γ₁(N)) of weight-k cusp forms with the Petersson inner product, for every prime p∤N the diamond operator ⟨p⟩ and the Hecke operator T_p have adjoints ⟨p⟩*=⟨p⟩⁻¹ and T_p*=⟨p⟩⁻¹T_p. Hence the operators ⟨n⟩ and T_n with (n,N)=1 are normal.

concept.title: Power-bounded operator
concept.description: A bounded linear operator T on a normed space is power-bounded if its powers are uniformly bounded in operator norm: sup_{n≥0}‖Tⁿ‖<∞, with T⁰ the identity.

concept.title: Hennion's quasi-compactness theorem for Doeblin–Fortet operators
concept.description: Let T be a bounded operator on a complex Banach space (L,‖·‖) with spectral radius ρ(T), and let |·| be a norm on L such that T is compact from (L,‖·‖) to (L,|·|). If for every n≥1 there are R_n,r_n≥0 with ‖Tⁿf‖≤R_n|f|+r_n‖f‖ for all f∈L, and r=liminf_n r_n^{1/n}<ρ(T), then T is quasi-compact and its essential spectral radius is at most r. This strengthens the Ionescu Tulcea–Marinescu theorem.

concept.title: Essential spectral radius of the Banach-space adjoint
concept.description: For a bounded operator Q on a complex Banach space B and its adjoint Q′ on the dual space B*, the essential spectral radii agree: r_ess(Q′)=r_ess(Q). Since Q and Q′ also have the same spectral radius, Q is quasi-compact exactly when Q′ is.

concept.title: Dual of a normed vector lattice
concept.description: The dual E′ of a normed vector lattice E, ordered by φ≥0 when φ(f)≥0 for all f≥0, is an order complete Banach lattice under the dual norm. The modulus of φ is given on positive elements by |φ|(f)=sup{|φ(g)|:|g|≤f}, so |φ(g)|≤|φ|(|g|) and ‖|φ|‖=‖φ‖.

concept.title: Peripheral decomposition of a quasi-compact Markov kernel on a weighted-supremum space
concept.description: Let P be a Markov kernel with Pw/w bounded for a weight w≥1. If P is quasi-compact on B_w, then r(P)=1 and P=L+N with LN=NL=0, r(N)<1 and Lf=∑_{k=1}^sλ_kφ_k(f)f_k, where |λ_k|=1, the f_k are bounded measurable eigenfunctions (Pf_k=λ_kf_k), the φ_k are complex measures with ∫w d|φ_k|<∞, and φ_j(f_k)=δ_{jk}. In particular P is power-bounded on B_w.

concept.title: Range of a positive projection on a Banach lattice
concept.description: If P is a positive projection on a Banach lattice E, its range PE, ordered by the cone E₊∩PE, is a vector lattice with sup_{PE}(x,y)=P(x∨y), and a Banach lattice under a norm equivalent to the norm of E. If P is strictly positive, PE is a vector sublattice of E.

concept.title: Classification of finite-dimensional Archimedean vector lattices
concept.description: A real vector lattice of finite dimension n≥1 is Archimedean if and only if it is lattice isomorphic to ℝⁿ with the coordinatewise order; equivalently it has a basis of pairwise disjoint positive elements whose coordinate functionals are positive.

concept.title: Separation of points and tangents by meromorphic functions on a compact Riemann surface
concept.description: On every compact Riemann surface X the field M(X) of global meromorphic functions separates points and tangents: for distinct p,q∈X some f∈M(X) has f(p)≠f(q) (poles allowed), and for every p some f∈M(X) has multiplicity one at p, i.e. f−f(p) has a simple zero or f has a simple pole there. In particular X has nonconstant meromorphic functions.

concept.title: Riemann–Roch theorem for compact Riemann surfaces
concept.description: Let X be a compact Riemann surface of genus g, K the divisor of a nonzero meromorphic 1-form and L(D)={f∈M(X): f=0 or div f+D≥0} for a divisor D. Then dim L(D)−dim L(K−D)=deg D+1−g. In particular dim L(D)=deg D+1−g when deg D>2g−2.

concept.title: Very ampleness of divisors of degree at least 2g+1 on a compact Riemann surface
concept.description: Let X be a compact Riemann surface of genus g and D a divisor with deg D≥2g+1. Then the complete linear system |D| has no base points and the map φ_D:X→Pⁿ given by a basis of L(D) is a holomorphic embedding onto a smooth projective curve of degree deg D. Hence every compact Riemann surface embeds holomorphically into projective space.

concept.title: Chow’s theorem on analytic subsets of projective space
concept.description: Every closed complex-analytic subset of complex projective space Pⁿ(ℂ) is algebraic, i.e. the zero set of finitely many homogeneous polynomials. Consequently every compact analytic subset of a complex algebraic variety is Zariski closed.

concept.title: Regularity of holomorphic maps between complex algebraic varieties
concept.description: Every holomorphic map from a complete (compact) complex algebraic variety X to a complex algebraic variety Y is a regular map, i.e. a morphism of varieties. Consequently a compact complex-analytic space carries at most one structure of algebraic variety.

concept.title: Comparison of algebraic and analytic local rings of a complex variety
concept.description: For a complex algebraic variety X and a point x, the inclusion of the local ring O_{X,x} into the ring of germs of holomorphic functions at x induces an isomorphism of their completions. Hence both rings have the same dimension, and X is nonsingular at x exactly when the analytic space X^h is a complex manifold near x.

concept.title: Weierstrass division theorem for power series over a complete discrete valuation ring
concept.description: Let O be a complete discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal 𝔪 and f=∑a_iT^i∈O[[T]] with a_i∈𝔪 for i<n and a_n a unit. Every g∈O[[T]] can be written uniquely as g=qf+r with q∈O[[T]] and r∈O[T] a polynomial of degree at most n−1.

concept.title: Landau’s determination of h(−4n)=1
concept.description: For a positive integer n, every primitive positive definite binary quadratic form of discriminant −4n is properly equivalent to x²+ny², i.e. the form class number h(−4n) equals 1, if and only if n=1, 2, 3, 4 or 7.

concept.title: Number of genera of binary quadratic forms
concept.description: For a negative integer D≡0,1 mod 4, the primitive positive definite binary quadratic forms of discriminant D fall into 2^(μ−1) genera, where μ is the number of assigned characters (for D≡1 mod 4, the number of odd primes dividing D); the principal genus consists of the squares in the form class group C(D).

concept.title: Reduction theory of positive definite binary quadratic forms
concept.description: Every primitive positive definite binary quadratic form is properly equivalent to a unique reduced form ax²+bxy+cy², meaning |b|≤a≤c with b≥0 whenever |b|=a or a=c. Hence the form class number h(D) is the number of reduced forms of discriminant D, and it is finite.

concept.title: Form class group and ideal class group of an imaginary quadratic order
concept.description: Let O be the order of discriminant D<0 in an imaginary quadratic field. Sending a primitive positive definite form ax²+bxy+cy² of discriminant D to the lattice [a,(−b+√D)/2] induces an isomorphism from the form class group C(D) onto the group of proper fractional O-ideals modulo principal ideals; in particular h(D)=h(O).

concept.title: Class number formula for an imaginary quadratic order
concept.description: Let O be the order of conductor f in an imaginary quadratic field K of discriminant d_K. Then h(O)=h(O_K)·f/[O_K×:O×]·∏_(p|f)(1−(d_K/p)/p), with (d_K/p) the Kronecker symbol; in particular h(O) is a multiple of h(O_K).

concept.title: Singular j-invariants generate ring class fields
concept.description: Let O be an order in an imaginary quadratic field K⊂ℂ and 𝔞 a proper fractional O-ideal. Then j(𝔞) is an algebraic integer and K(j(𝔞)) is the ring class field of O, so [K(j(𝔞)):K]=h(O).

concept.title: Weber modular functions
concept.description: With q=e^(2πiτ) for τ in the upper half-plane, Weber’s functions are f(τ)=q^(−1/48)∏_(n≥1)(1+q^(n−1/2)), f₁(τ)=q^(−1/48)∏(1−q^(n−1/2)) and f₂(τ)=√2·q^(1/24)∏(1+qⁿ). They satisfy f(τ)f₁(τ)f₂(τ)=√2 and f₁(2τ)f₂(τ)=√2, and γ₂(τ)=(f(τ)²⁴−16)/f(τ)⁸ is the cube root of j(τ) that is real on the imaginary axis.

concept.title: Weber’s theorem on the cube root of a singular j-invariant
concept.description: Let O be an order of discriminant D in an imaginary quadratic field K with 3∤D, and write O=[1,τ₀] with τ₀=√−m if D=−4m and τ₀=(3+√−m)/2 if D=−m≡1 mod 4. Then γ₂(τ₀), the cube root of j(τ₀) real on the imaginary axis, is an algebraic integer, K(γ₂(τ₀)) is the ring class field of O, and ℚ(γ₂(τ₀))=ℚ(j(τ₀)).

concept.title: Weber function values generating ring class fields
concept.description: Let m be a positive integer not divisible by 3 and O=ℤ[√−m]⊂K=ℚ(√−m). If m≡6 mod 8, then f₁(√−m)² is an algebraic integer generating the ring class field of O over K; if m≡3 mod 4, the same holds for f(√−m)², where f, f₁ are Weber’s functions.

concept.title: Euler’s theorem on y²=x³+1
concept.description: The only rational solutions of y²=x³+1 are (x,y)=(−1,0), (0,±1) and (2,±3). Euler proved this in 1738 by Fermat’s method of infinite descent.

concept.title: Rank formula for descent via a rational 2-isogeny
concept.description: Let E:y²=x(x²+ax+b) over ℚ with a,b∈ℤ and b(a²−4b)≠0, and let E′:y²=x(x²−2ax+a²−4b) be its quotient by the 2-torsion point (0,0). The map α:E(ℚ)→ℚ×/ℚ×² with α(O)=1, α(0,0)=b and α(x,y)=x otherwise is a homomorphism with finite image; with α′ defined likewise on E′(ℚ), |α(E(ℚ))|·|α′(E′(ℚ))|=2^(r+2), where r is the Mordell–Weil rank of E.

concept.title: Mazur’s rank-zero theorem for prime-conductor curves with rational torsion
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over ℚ of prime conductor with a ℚ-rational point of prime order p∈{2,3,5}. Then E(ℚ) has rank zero, and the p-primary part of the Tate–Shafarevich group of E is trivial.

concept.title: Order of the cuspidal divisor class on X₀(p)
concept.description: For a prime p, the two cusps 0 and ∞ of X₀(p) are rational over ℚ, and the class of the degree-zero divisor (0)−(∞) in the Jacobian J₀(p) has order n, the numerator of (p−1)/12 written in lowest terms (Ogg).

concept.title: Hyperelliptic involution of a genus-two curve
concept.description: A smooth projective curve G of genus two over a field k has a unique involution S, defined over k, whose quotient G/S has genus zero; it is induced by the canonical linear system and therefore commutes with every automorphism of G. In characteristic other than two, S has exactly six geometric fixed points.

concept.title: Integral implicit function theorem over a complete nonarchimedean field
concept.description: Let K be complete for a discrete nonarchimedean absolute value, with valuation ring O and uniformizer π. If F∈O[[x,y]]^m, F(0,0)=0 and det(∂F/∂y)(0,0) is a unit of O, the formal solution y=f(x) of F(x,f(x))=0 with f(0)=0 has coefficients in O. If every F_i is a special restricted power series (degree-d coefficients divisible by π^(d−1), no constant term), so is every f_i; f converges on O^n and gives all solutions in O^n×O^m. In particular such a map O^n→O^n with unit Jacobian at 0 has an inverse of the same form.

concept.title: Cauchy product of absolutely convergent series
concept.description: If ∑a_n and ∑b_n converge absolutely in a complete valued field, such as ℝ, ℂ or ℚ_p, then their Cauchy product ∑_n(∑_(i+j=n)a_ib_j) converges absolutely to (∑a_n)(∑b_n). Hence evaluating power series at a point of common absolute convergence is multiplicative.

concept.title: Tensor product of modules over a Hopf algebra
concept.description: For modules U and W over a Hopf algebra H over a field k, the vector space U⊗W is an H-module by h·(u⊗w)=∑h₍₁₎u⊗h₍₂₎w, where Δ(h)=∑h₍₁₎⊗h₍₂₎, and k is the trivial module h·c=ε(h)c. Coassociativity and the counit axioms make the associativity and unit isomorphisms of vector spaces into module isomorphisms.

concept.title: Invariant vectors of a module over a Hopf algebra
concept.description: For a module M over a Hopf algebra H with counit ε, the invariant subspace is M^H={m∈M : h·m=ε(h)m for every h∈H}, the largest subspace on which H acts through ε.

concept.title: Invariant bilinear form on a Lie algebra
concept.description: A bilinear form B on a Lie algebra 𝔤 is invariant if B([x,y],z)=B(x,[y,z]) for all x,y,z∈𝔤; equivalently every ad y=[y,·] is skew for B.

concept.title: Hopf algebra structure on a universal enveloping algebra
concept.description: For a Lie algebra 𝔤, U(𝔤) is a Hopf algebra whose coproduct and counit are the algebra homomorphisms with Δ(x)=x⊗1+1⊗x and ε(x)=0, and whose antipode is the antihomomorphism with S(x)=−x, for x∈𝔤. Thus 𝔤 acts on a tensor product of modules by x(v⊗w)=xv⊗w+v⊗xw and on a dual module by (xf)(v)=−f(xv).

concept.title: Kohno’s infinitesimal braid algebra
concept.description: For r≥2, T_r is the associative ℂ-algebra generated by elements t_ij=t_ji (1≤i<j≤r) subject to [t_ij,t_kℓ]=0, [t_ik+t_iℓ,t_kℓ]=0 and [t_ij,t_ik+t_jk]=0 for pairwise distinct indices, where [X,Y]=XY−YX. These are the infinitesimal pure braid relations underlying the Knizhnik–Zamolodchikov connection.

concept.title: Special linear Lie algebra 𝔰𝔩_k(ℂ)
concept.description: The Lie algebra of complex k×k matrices of trace zero with bracket [X,Y]=XY−YX. For k≥2 it is simple; its natural module is ℂᵏ, on which matrices act by multiplication.

concept.title: Orthogonal Lie algebra 𝔰𝔬_n(ℂ)
concept.description: The Lie algebra of complex n×n matrices X with Xᵀ=−X, those infinitesimally preserving the symmetric form B(u,v)=uᵀv in the sense B(Xu,v)+B(u,Xv)=0, with bracket XY−YX. Its natural module is ℂⁿ; it is simple for n=3 and n≥5.

concept.title: Symplectic Lie algebra 𝔰𝔭_2k(ℂ)
concept.description: For k≥1, the Lie algebra of complex 2k×2k matrices X with XᵀJ+JX=0 for J=[[0,I],[−I,0]], equivalently ω(Xu,v)+ω(u,Xv)=0 for the symplectic form ω(u,v)=uᵀJv, with bracket XY−YX. It is simple, and its natural module is ℂ²ᵏ.

concept.title: Quantized enveloping algebra U_q(𝔤𝔩_k)
concept.description: Over ℚ(q) or ℂ(q), U_q(𝔤𝔩_k) is generated by E_i,F_i (1≤i<k) and K_a^(±1) (1≤a≤k) with commuting K_a, K_aK_a^(−1)=1, K_aE_iK_a^(−1)=q^(δ_ai−δ_a,i+1)E_i, K_aF_iK_a^(−1)=q^(δ_a,i+1−δ_ai)F_i, E_iF_j−F_jE_i=δ_ij(K_iK_(i+1)^(−1)−K_i^(−1)K_(i+1))/(q−q^(−1)), and the quantum Serre relations E_i²E_j−[2]E_iE_jE_i+E_jE_i²=0 for |i−j|=1, E_iE_j=E_jE_i for |i−j|>1, likewise for the F_i. It is a Hopf algebra with Δ(K_a)=K_a⊗K_a, Δ(E_i)=E_i⊗K_iK_(i+1)^(−1)+1⊗E_i, Δ(F_i)=F_i⊗1+K_i^(−1)K_(i+1)⊗F_i (conventions vary). Its natural module has basis v_1,…,v_k with K_av_b=q^(δ_ab)v_b, E_iv_(i+1)=v_i, F_iv_i=v_(i+1), all other generators killing the basis vectors.

concept.title: Iwahori–Hecke algebra of the symmetric group
concept.description: For r≥1 and q an indeterminate, H_r(q) is the associative algebra over ℤ[q,q⁻¹] or ℂ(q) generated by T_1,…,T_(r−1) with the braid relations T_iT_(i+1)T_i=T_(i+1)T_iT_(i+1), T_iT_j=T_jT_i for |i−j|>1, and (T_i−q)(T_i+q⁻¹)=0. It is free with basis T_w over the permutations w∈S_r, and specializing q=1 gives the group algebra of S_r. Other normalizations use (T_i−q)(T_i+1)=0.

concept.title: Solvable Lie algebra
concept.description: A Lie algebra 𝔤 is solvable if its derived series 𝔤⊇[𝔤,𝔤]⊇[[𝔤,𝔤],[𝔤,𝔤]]⊇⋯ reaches 0 after finitely many steps.

concept.title: Cartan’s criterion for solvability
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic zero, a Lie subalgebra 𝔤 of 𝔤𝔩(V) for a finite-dimensional vector space V is solvable if tr(xy)=0 for all x∈[𝔤,𝔤] and y∈𝔤.

concept.title: First cohomology of a Lie algebra with coefficients
concept.description: For a representation E of a Lie algebra 𝔤, H¹(𝔤,E)=Z¹/B¹, where 1-cocycles are linear maps a:𝔤→E with a([x,y])=x·a(y)−y·a(x) and 1-coboundaries are the maps x↦x·v for v∈E. For representations U and W, H¹(𝔤,Hom(W,U)) classifies extensions 0→U→V→W→0 up to equivalence, the zero class corresponding to split extensions.

concept.title: Cartan–Killing classification of complex simple Lie algebras
concept.description: Every finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra is isomorphic to exactly one of 𝔰𝔩_(n+1) (n≥1), 𝔰𝔬_(2n+1) (n≥2), 𝔰𝔭_(2n) (n≥3), 𝔰𝔬_(2n) (n≥4) or the exceptional algebras 𝔢₆, 𝔢₇, 𝔢₈, 𝔣₄, 𝔤₂, corresponding to the connected Dynkin diagrams of reduced irreducible root systems.

concept.title: Verma module of a Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group
concept.description: For an integral weight λ, M(λ) is the quotient of U_q(𝔤) by the left ideal generated by the E_i and the K_i−q_i^(⟨λ,α_i∨⟩). It is generated by a highest-weight vector of weight λ, every module generated by such a vector is a quotient of it, and it has a unique simple quotient.

concept.title: Triangular decomposition of a Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group
concept.description: Multiplication U⁻⊗U⁰⊗U⁺→U_q(𝔤) is a linear isomorphism, where U⁺ and U⁻ are the subalgebras generated by the E_i, respectively the F_i, and U⁰ is the Laurent polynomial algebra in the K_i. The algebras U^± are graded by the root lattice with finite-dimensional homogeneous pieces.

concept.title: Drinfeld–Rosso pairing of a quantum group
concept.description: There is a unique bilinear pairing between the subalgebras U^≤0 (generated by the F_i, K_i^(±1)) and U^≥0 (generated by the E_i, K_i^(±1)) of U_q(𝔤) that is a Hopf pairing with prescribed values on generators. For q not a root of unity, its restriction to each pair of homogeneous pieces U⁻_(−µ)×U⁺_µ is nondegenerate.

concept.title: Lusztig’s quasi-R-matrix of a quantum group
concept.description: Θ=∑_(µ≥0)Θ_µ with Θ_µ=∑_i v_i^µ⊗u_i^µ∈U⁻_(−µ)⊗U⁺_µ for dual bases with respect to the Drinfeld–Rosso pairing, and Θ₀=1⊗1. On a tensor product of finite-dimensional type-1 modules only finitely many Θ_µ act nonzero; Θ acts invertibly and intertwines the coproduct with the bar-twisted coproduct.

concept.title: Schur–Weyl duality for the general linear group
concept.description: For V=ℂᵏ and r≥1, the algebra of GL_k(ℂ)-equivariant endomorphisms of V^⊗r is spanned by the permutations of tensor factors by S_r, and the span of the image of GL_k(ℂ) is the commutant of S_r.

concept.title: Brauer algebra
concept.description: For r≥1 and a parameter δ, B_r(δ) has a basis of Brauer diagrams, the perfect matchings of 2r points in two rows, multiplied by stacking diagrams and replacing each closed loop by a factor δ. Equivalently it is generated by S_i,E_i (1≤i<r) with S_i²=1, the braid relations for the S_i, E_i²=δE_i, E_iE_(i±1)E_i=E_i, S_iE_i=E_iS_i=E_i, S_(i+1)E_iS_(i+1)=S_iE_(i+1)S_i and commutation of generators with indices differing by at least two.

concept.title: Brauer’s centralizer theorem for orthogonal and symplectic groups
concept.description: For the natural module V of O_n(ℂ) or Sp_2k(ℂ) and r≥1, the algebra of group-equivariant endomorphisms of V^⊗r is the image of the Brauer algebra B_r(n), respectively B_r(−2k), with S_i acting by the (for Sp signed) transposition of factors i,i+1 and E_i by contraction with and insertion of the invariant form.

concept.title: Howe (𝔤𝔩_m, 𝔤𝔩_n) duality on polynomials
concept.description: On the polynomial ring in variables x_pi (1≤p≤m, 1≤i≤n), the commuting actions of 𝔤𝔩_m and 𝔤𝔩_n by the polarization operators ∑_i x_pi∂/∂x_qi and ∑_p x_pi∂/∂x_pj give a multiplicity-free decomposition ⊕_λ L^m_λ⊗L^n_λ over partitions λ with at most min(m,n) parts, where L^m_λ is the simple 𝔤𝔩_m-module of highest weight λ.

concept.title: Irreducibility of the Casimir subalgebra on 𝔤𝔩_n weight spaces
concept.description: The subalgebra of U(𝔤𝔩_n) generated by the diagonal elements U_ii and the elements U_ijU_ji+U_jiU_ij acts irreducibly on every weight space of every finite-dimensional irreducible 𝔤𝔩_n-module (Millson–Toledano Laredo).

concept.title: Equivariant maps for a connected Lie group and its Lie algebra
concept.description: If G is a connected real or complex Lie group and V, W are finite-dimensional representations of G with differentials representations of Lie(G), a linear map V→W is G-equivariant exactly when it is Lie(G)-equivariant; in particular End_G(V)=End_(Lie G)(V).

concept.title: Action of an algebraic group on an algebraic scheme
concept.description: An action of an algebraic group G over a field k on an algebraic k-scheme X is a k-morphism μ:G×_kX→X with μ∘(e×id_X)=id_X and μ∘(m×id_X)=μ∘(id_G×μ); equivalently, actions of the groups G(R) on the sets X(R) natural in the k-algebra R. For x∈X(k) the orbit map G→X is g↦μ(g,x); a morphism of G-schemes is equivariant if it commutes with the actions.

concept.title: Stabilizer of a rational point under an algebraic group action
concept.description: For an action of an algebraic group G on an algebraic k-scheme X and x∈X(k), the stabilizer (isotropy group) G_x is the fibre over x of the orbit map G→X: the closed subscheme of G with G_x(R)={g∈G(R): g·x_R=x_R} for every k-algebra R. It is an algebraic subgroup of G.

concept.title: Reduced scheme
concept.description: A scheme X is reduced if every local ring O_(X,x) has no nonzero nilpotent elements; equivalently O_X(U) is a reduced ring for every open U⊆X. An algebraic group is called reduced when its underlying scheme is reduced.

concept.title: Algebraic group of multiplicative type over a field
concept.description: An affine algebraic group G over a field k is of multiplicative type if its base change G_K is diagonalizable for some field extension K/k.

concept.title: Quotient of a scheme by an equivalence relation
concept.description: Let u₀,u₁:R⇉X be morphisms of S-schemes such that (u₀,u₁):R→X×_SX is a monomorphism whose T-points form an equivalence relation on X(T) for every S-scheme T. A quotient is a morphism u:X→Y with u∘u₀=u∘u₁ that is a cokernel of (u₀,u₁) among S-schemes and for which R→X×_YX is an isomorphism; when it exists it is unique up to unique isomorphism.

concept.title: Existence of quotients of equivalence relations admitting a quasi-section
concept.description: Let u₀,u₁:R⇉X be an equivalence relation of S-schemes admitting a quasi-section: a subscheme U⊆X such that u₁ restricted to u₀⁻¹(U) is finite, locally free and surjective onto X, and every set of mutually equivalent points of U lies in an affine open of U. Then the quotient u:X→Y exists, is a cokernel also in ringed spaces, is surjective, satisfies R≅X×_YX, and is faithfully flat when u₀ is flat (SGA 3 V 6.1).

concept.title: Generic existence of quotients by flat equivalence relations
concept.description: Let S be Noetherian and u₀,u₁:R⇉X an equivalence relation of S-schemes with u₁ flat of finite type, X of finite type over S and R→X×_SX quasi-finite. Then X has a dense saturated open subscheme W on which the induced relation admits a quasi-section, so its quotient W→V exists and is faithfully flat, open and of finite presentation (SGA 3 V 8.1).

concept.title: Quotient by a finite locally free equivalence relation
concept.description: Let u₀,u₁:R⇉X be an equivalence relation of S-schemes with u₁ finite locally free such that every equivalence class lies in an affine open of X. Then the quotient p:X→Y exists; p is finite locally free, integral and open, Y is affine if X is, R≅X×_YX, Y is also the fppf sheaf quotient, and its formation commutes with base change (SGA 3 V 4.1).

concept.title: Faithfully flat descent of properties of morphisms
concept.description: Let S′→S be faithfully flat and quasi-compact and f:X→S a morphism of schemes with base change f′:X×_SS′→S′. If f′ is surjective, flat, an isomorphism, a closed immersion, affine or finite, then so is f; if f is locally of finite presentation and f′ is smooth, then f is smooth (EGA IV 2.6–2.7 and 17.7.4).

concept.title: Openness of flat morphisms locally of finite presentation
concept.description: A flat morphism of schemes locally of finite presentation is universally open: it and each of its base changes map open subsets to open subsets (EGA IV 2.4.6).

concept.title: Generic flatness theorem
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a dominant morphism of schemes of finite type over a Noetherian ring, with Y reduced. Then Y has a dense open subscheme V such that f⁻¹(V)→V is faithfully flat (Demazure–Gabriel I §3 3.7; EGA IV 6.9.1).

concept.title: Compatibility of scheme-theoretic images with flat base change
concept.description: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f:X→Y, the scheme-theoretic image, the smallest closed subscheme of Y through which f factors, is cut out by the kernel of O_Y→f_*O_X. If g:Y′→Y is flat, the scheme-theoretic image of the base change X×_YY′→Y′ is g⁻¹ of the scheme-theoretic image of f (Demazure–Gabriel I §2 4.14).

concept.title: Openness of projections of products over a field
concept.description: For schemes X and Y over a field k, the projection X×_kY→X is open. In particular, for a field extension K/k the morphism X_K→X is open and surjective (Demazure–Gabriel I §3 3.12).

concept.title: Weight decomposition of representations of diagonalizable groups
concept.description: An affine algebraic group G over a field k is diagonalizable if and only if every representation V of G is the direct sum of its eigenspaces V_χ={v: g·v=χ(g)v} over the characters χ of G; equivalently every finite-dimensional representation is a direct sum of one-dimensional subrepresentations (Milne, Theorem 12.12).

concept.title: Local finiteness of coalgebras and comodules
concept.description: Over a field, every coalgebra is the union of its finite-dimensional subcoalgebras and every comodule is the union of its finite-dimensional subcomodules. In particular the coordinate Hopf algebra of an affine algebraic group is a directed union of finite-dimensional subcoalgebras C, each with a finite-dimensional dual algebra C^∨.

concept.title: Decomposition of finite-dimensional commutative algebras into local factors
concept.description: A finite-dimensional commutative algebra A over a field k is the finite product of its localizations at its finitely many maximal ideals, each a local Artinian k-algebra. If k is algebraically closed every factor has residue field k, so A is reduced exactly when A≅kⁿ.

concept.title: Finite étale algebra over a field
concept.description: A finite-dimensional commutative algebra A over a field k is étale if A⊗_kK is reduced for every field extension K/k; equivalently A is a finite product of finite separable field extensions of k, equivalently A⊗_kk^s≅(k^s)ⁿ for a separable closure k^s.

concept.title: Centralizers of maximal tori in reductive groups
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a field k and T a torus in G with T_(k^a) maximal in G_(k^a). Then the centralizer C_G(T) equals T; consequently the centre Z(G) is contained in every maximal torus of G (Milne, Proposition 17.61).

concept.title: Subgroups and quotients of groups of multiplicative type
concept.description: Every algebraic subgroup and every quotient of an algebraic group of multiplicative type over a field is of multiplicative type; for a diagonalizable group D(M) they are the D(M″) and D(M′) for quotients M″ and subgroups M′ of the character group M (Milne 12.9(c), 12.17).

concept.title: Finite intersection of a central torus with the derived group
concept.description: If T is a central torus in a smooth connected algebraic group G over a field, then T∩DG is finite, DG being the derived group; if moreover G/T is perfect, multiplication T×DG→G is surjective with kernel T∩DG embedded antidiagonally (Milne, Proposition 12.46).

concept.title: Radical of a connected group variety
concept.description: For a smooth connected algebraic group G over a field, its radical R(G) is the largest smooth connected normal solvable algebraic subgroup of G. Following Milne, G is semisimple when the radical of G_(k^a) is trivial.

concept.title: Radical of a reductive group as its central torus
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a field, the radical R(G) is the largest torus Z(G)_t contained in the centre, its formation commutes with field extension, and the quotient G/R(G) is semisimple (Milne, Corollary 17.62).

concept.title: Semisimple algebraic groups are perfect
concept.description: Every connected semisimple algebraic group over a field equals its derived group; in particular it has no nontrivial characters (Milne, Corollary 21.50).

concept.title: Semisimplicity of representations under field extension
concept.description: Let V be a finite-dimensional representation of an affine algebraic group G over a field k and K/k a field extension. If V_K is a semisimple representation of G_K then V is semisimple; conversely, V semisimple implies V_K semisimple when K/k is separable (Milne, Proposition 4.19).

concept.title: Semisimplicity of the Lie algebra of a semisimple group in characteristic zero
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic zero, the Lie algebra of a connected semisimple algebraic group is a semisimple Lie algebra: it has no nonzero commutative ideal (Milne §22b).

concept.title: Casimir operator of a faithful representation of a semisimple Lie algebra
concept.description: For a faithful finite-dimensional representation V of a semisimple Lie algebra g over a field of characteristic zero, the trace form β(x,y)=Tr_V(xy) on g is nondegenerate. For bases (e_i),(f_i) of g dual under β, the Casimir operator c_V=∑e_if_i∈End(V) commutes with the action of g and has trace dim g.

concept.title: Lie algebra of the stabilizer of a subspace
concept.description: For a representation V of an affine algebraic group G over a field and a subspace W⊆V, the Lie algebra of the stabilizer Stab_G(W) is {x∈Lie G: xW⊆W} (Milne, Proposition 10.31). Hence, in characteristic zero and for connected G, W is G-stable exactly when it is stable under Lie G.

concept.title: Doob’s maximal inequality for a finite discrete-time submartingale
concept.description: If (X_k)_(0≤k≤n) is a submartingale for a filtration (F_k) and r>0, then rP(max_(k≤n)X_k≥r)≤E[X_n1{max_(k≤n)X_k≥r}]≤E[X_n⁺].

concept.title: Gaussian integration by parts for a standard normal variable
concept.description: If ξ∼N(0,1) and f:ℝ→ℝ is continuously differentiable with ξf(ξ) and f′(ξ) integrable, then E[ξf(ξ)]=E[f′(ξ)] (Stein’s identity).

concept.title: Linear images of a standard Gaussian vector
concept.description: If Z∈ℝᵏ has independent N(0,1) coordinates and A is a real n×k matrix, then AZ has the centered multivariate normal distribution N(0,AAᵀ). In particular Σ^(1/2)Z∼N(0,Σ) for every positive semidefinite Σ.

concept.title: Addition formula for the complex exponential
concept.description: For all complex a and b, exp(a)exp(b)=exp(a+b). In particular exp(z)exp(−z)=1, so exp never vanishes.

concept.title: Smooth partition of unity subordinate to an open cover of a Euclidean open set
concept.description: For every open cover (U_i) of an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ there are nonnegative compactly supported smooth functions ψ_m on Ω, each supported in some U_i, such that every compact subset of Ω meets the supports of only finitely many ψ_m and ∑_mψ_m=1 on Ω.

concept.title: Leibniz rule for weak derivatives with a smooth compactly supported factor
concept.description: If u∈Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) for an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and φ∈C_c^∞(Ω), then φu∈Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) and D^α(φu)=∑_(β≤α)C(α,β)D^βφ·D^(α−β)u for every multi-index |α|≤k, with C(α,β)=∏_iC(α_i,β_i).

concept.title: Mollification commutes with weak derivatives
concept.description: If u∈Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) for an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and φ_r is a mollifier supported in the ball of radius r, then D^α(φ_r*u)(x)=(φ_r*D^αu)(x) for every |α|≤k and every x∈Ω with dist(x,∂Ω)>r.

concept.title: Discreteness of a number field in its adele ring
concept.description: For a number field F, the diagonal image of F in the adele ring A_F is a discrete subgroup, hence closed; consequently Fⁿ is discrete and closed in A_Fⁿ for every n.

concept.title: Agreement of the restricted-product and affine-embedding topologies on adelic points
concept.description: For an affine scheme X of finite type over a number field F, the restricted-product topology on X(A_F)=∏′_vX(F_v), formed with the integral points of any model over a ring of S-integers, coincides with the topology obtained from any closed embedding X⊆Aⁿ_F as a subspace of A_Fⁿ; closed immersions induce closed topological embeddings.

concept.title: Torsion abelian group
concept.description: An abelian group in which every element has finite order: for each a there is an integer n≥1 with na=0.

concept.title: Fourier transform on a locally compact abelian group
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group G with Haar measure and dual group Γ, the Fourier transform of f∈L¹(G) is f̂(γ)=∫_Gf(x)̅γ(x)dx for γ∈Γ; for a complex Radon measure μ the Fourier–Stieltjes transform is μ̂(γ)=∫̅γdμ.

concept.title: Topology of the dual of a locally compact abelian group
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group G with dual Γ, the pairing (x,γ)↦γ(x) is jointly continuous; the sets {γ:|1−γ(x)|<r for all x∈K}, K compact and r>0, and their translates form a base of the Gelfand topology of Γ, which is the compact-open topology; and Γ is a locally compact abelian group.

concept.title: Continuous characters separate points of a locally compact abelian group
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group G with dual Γ, every neighbourhood of 0 in G contains a set {x:|1−γ(x)|<r for all γ∈C} with C⊆Γ compact and r>0; in particular for every x≠0 there is γ∈Γ with γ(x)≠1.

concept.title: Uniqueness theorem for Fourier–Stieltjes transforms on a locally compact abelian group
concept.description: If μ is a complex Radon measure on the dual Γ of a locally compact abelian group G and ∫_Γγ(x)dμ(γ)=0 for every x∈G, then μ=0; dually a measure on G with vanishing Fourier–Stieltjes transform is zero.

concept.title: Fourier transforms supported in an open set of a dual group
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group G with dual Γ and every nonempty open E⊆Γ, there is f∈L¹(G) whose Fourier transform f̂ is not identically zero and vanishes outside E.

concept.title: Continuous characters of a profinite group have finite image
concept.description: If G is a profinite group and f:G→ℝ/ℤ is a continuous homomorphism, then f(G) is a finite subgroup of ℝ/ℤ; hence f takes values in ℚ/ℤ.

concept.title: Centre of a group
concept.description: The centre Z(G) of a group G is the set of elements z with zg=gz for every g∈G. It is a normal subgroup of G.

concept.title: Central series of a group
concept.description: A central series of a group G is a finite chain G=G₀≥G₁≥⋯≥G_r=1 of normal subgroups such that each G_(i−1)/G_i lies in the centre of G/G_i, equivalently [G_(i−1),G]≤G_i; r is its length.

concept.title: Pivotalization of a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, fix a tensor isomorphism g:Id→(−)**** (it exists by ENO's Theorem 2.6). The pivotalization C̃ is the ℤ/2-equivariantization of C under the double-dual autoequivalence; its simple objects are pairs (X,f) with X simple and f:X→X** an isomorphism satisfying f**∘f=g_X. C̃ is a spherical fusion category, the forgetful tensor functor C̃→C is surjective and sends simple objects to simple objects, and dim C̃=2 dim C.

concept.title: Modularity of the Drinfeld centre of a spherical fusion category
concept.description: If C is a spherical fusion category over ℂ, then its Drinfeld centre Z(C), with the induced braiding and spherical structure, is a modular tensor category (Müger).

concept.title: Verlinde formula for a modular tensor category
concept.description: In a modular tensor category with S-matrix S and fusion matrices N_Z, conjugation by S diagonalizes the fusion rules: S⁻¹N_Z S is diagonal with entries s_(XZ)/dim(X). Equivalently, the ring homomorphisms from the Grothendieck ring to ℂ are Z↦s_(XZ)/dim(X), and the primitive idempotents of the complexified Grothendieck ring are linear combinations of simple classes with coefficients given by entries of S.

concept.title: Cyclotomicity of the S-matrix of a modular tensor category
concept.description: For a modular tensor category over ℂ there is a root of unity ξ such that every entry of its S-matrix lies in ℚ(ξ) (de Boer–Goeree, Coste–Gannon).

concept.title: Character idempotents of a based ring
concept.description: Let A be a based ring of finite rank, such as the Grothendieck ring of a fusion category, with basis b_i and duality b_i↦b_i*, and let L be an irreducible representation of A over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero. Then e_L=Σ_i Tr(b_i,L)b_i* is central in A⊗k and acts by zero on every irreducible representation not isomorphic to L, so it is a nonzero multiple of the primitive central idempotent of the semisimple algebra A⊗k corresponding to L.

concept.title: Ring of integers of a cyclotomic field
concept.description: For n≥1 and a primitive nth root of unity ζ, the ring of integers of the cyclotomic field ℚ(ζ) is ℤ[ζ].

concept.title: Ng–Schauenburg cyclotomicity of dimensions in a spherical fusion category
concept.description: Let C be a spherical fusion category over ℂ with Frobenius–Schur exponent N, which equals the order of the ribbon twist of its Drinfeld centre. Then the dimension of every object of C and the global dimension dim C lie in the cyclotomic field ℚ(ζ_N).

concept.title: Total positivity of squared norms in a fusion category
concept.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, every simple object X has squared norm |X|²>0, and |X|² is a totally positive algebraic integer, being an eigenvalue of a nonnegative integer matrix. Hence the global dimension dim C≥1 is a totally positive algebraic integer (Etingof–Nikshych–Ostrik).

concept.title: Brauer's induction theorem
concept.description: Every complex character of a finite group G is a linear combination with integer coefficients of monomial characters, that is, characters induced from one-dimensional characters of subgroups of G; the subgroups can be taken elementary.

concept.title: Character inner product and intertwiners for finite groups
concept.description: For finite-dimensional representations V,W of a finite group G over a field of characteristic zero, ⟨χ_V,χ_W⟩=(1/|G|)Σ_(s∈G)χ_V(s⁻¹)χ_W(s) equals dim Hom_G(V,W). In particular the irreducible complex characters are orthonormal.

concept.title: Simple polygon in the plane
concept.description: A simple polygon is a closed curve in ℝ² formed by finitely many line segments [v₁,v₂],…,[v_n,v₁] (n≥3), its edges, where consecutive edges meet only at their common vertex and nonconsecutive edges are disjoint. By the Jordan curve theorem it bounds a closed region, the union of the curve and its bounded complementary component.

concept.title: Length of a curve in Euclidean space
concept.description: For a continuous curve γ:[a,b]→ℝᵈ, its length is the supremum over partitions a=t₀<t₁<⋯<t_k=b of Σᵢ|γ(tᵢ)−γ(tᵢ₋₁)|; γ is rectifiable when this is finite. A shortest path in a set X between two points is a curve in X joining them of minimal length among all such curves.

concept.title: Interior angle sum of a simple polygon
concept.description: The interior angles of a simple polygon with m vertices sum to (m−2)π.

concept.title: Algebra of subsets of a set
concept.description: An algebra (Boolean algebra, field) of subsets of a set X is a family of subsets of X that contains the empty set and is closed under complements in X and under finite unions; hence also under finite intersections and differences.

concept.title: Monotone class of subsets
concept.description: A monotone class on a set X is a family of subsets of X containing the union of every increasing sequence E₁⊆E₂⊆⋯ of its members and the intersection of every decreasing sequence E₁⊇E₂⊇⋯ of its members.

concept.title: Variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin sequence space f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}
concept.description: For exponents p,q,α as in the Diening–Hästö–Roudenko standing assumptions, f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)} consists of sequences (s_Q) indexed by the dyadic cubes Q⊆ℝⁿ of side at most one for which the quasi-norm ∥(2^{να(x)}∑_{Q∈D_ν}|s_Q||Q|^{−1/2}χ_Q(x))_{ν≥0}∥_{L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})} is finite, D_ν being the cubes of side 2^{−ν}.

concept.title: Frazier–Jawerth construction of smooth atoms from the φ-transform
concept.description: Given an admissible inhomogeneous Schwartz pair, integers K,L≥0, 0<r and m large, every tempered distribution f=∑_Q t_Qϕ_Q (φ-transform coefficients t_Q, Q dyadic of side ≤1) can be rewritten as f=∑_Q(t_r^*)_Q a_Q in S′, with smooth atoms a_Q supported in 3Q having K derivatives and L vanishing moments in scale-normalized form, where (t_r^*)_Q=(∑_{P∈D_ν}|t_P|^r(1+2^ν|x_P−x_Q|)^{−m})^{1/r} for Q∈D_ν.

concept.title: Boundedness of the φ-transform on variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: Under the Diening–Hästö–Roudenko standing assumptions on p,q,α, the φ-transform f↦(⟨f,ϕ_Q⟩)_Q is bounded from F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}(ℝⁿ) to the sequence space f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}: ∥S_ϕf∥_{f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}}≤c∥f∥_{F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}}.

concept.title: Molecular synthesis estimate for variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin spaces
concept.description: Under the Diening–Hästö–Roudenko standing assumptions, let (m_Q) be smooth molecules with moment order n/min{1,p(x),q(x)}−n−α(x)+ε and smoothness order α(x)+1+ε near Q (and sufficiently fast decay). For every (s_Q)∈f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)} the sum f=∑_Q s_Qm_Q converges in S′ and ∥f∥_{F^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}}≤c∥(s_Q)∥_{f^{α(·)}_{p(·),q(·)}}.

concept.title: Variational solution of an SPDE in a Gelfand triple
concept.description: On a Gelfand triple V⊂H⊂V* with cylindrical Wiener noise W on U and progressively measurable A:[0,T]×V×Ω→V*, B:[0,T]×V×Ω→L₂(U,H), a variational solution of dX=A(t,X)dt+B(t,X)dW is a continuous adapted H-valued process X whose dt⊗P-class lies in L^α([0,T]×Ω;V)∩L²([0,T]×Ω;H) and which satisfies, almost surely for all t, X_t=X₀+∫₀ᵗA(s,X̄_s)ds+∫₀ᵗB(s,X̄_s)dW_s, the first integral a V*-valued Bochner integral, X̄ a progressively measurable V-valued version.

concept.title: Non-discrete projection of a finite-covolume subgroup of a product
concept.description: Let G=G₁×G₂ be a product of locally compact groups with G₁ noncompact, and H⊆G a closed subgroup such that G/H carries a finite invariant measure. Then the projection of H to G₂ is not discrete, and G₂ modulo its closure carries a finite invariant measure.

concept.title: Closed subgroup theorem for p-adic Lie groups
concept.description: Every closed subgroup of a Lie group over the p-adic field ℚ_p (an analytic group over ℚ_p) is itself a p-adic Lie subgroup, with Lie algebra a ℚ_p-subalgebra of the ambient Lie algebra; every continuous homomorphism of p-adic Lie groups is analytic.

concept.title: Borel density theorem for arithmetic subgroups
concept.description: If G is a semisimple group over a number field K and S is a finite set of places containing the archimedean ones such that no K-simple factor H of G has ∏_{v∈S}H(K_v) compact, then every S-arithmetic subgroup of G(K) is Zariski-dense in G. (Borel; over ℚ: arithmetic subgroups of a semisimple ℚ-group of noncompact type are Zariski-dense.)

concept.title: Quasi-splitness of an algebraic group at almost all places
concept.description: A connected algebraic group over a number field K is quasi-split over the completion K_v for all but finitely many places v; in particular a semisimple K-group is K_v-isotropic at almost all places.

concept.title: Weak approximation for simply connected groups
concept.description: A semisimple simply connected group G over a number field K has weak approximation with respect to every finite set S of places: G(K) is dense in ∏_{v∈S}G(K_v).

concept.title: Compactness of local points of an anisotropic group
concept.description: For an algebraic group G over a non-discrete locally compact field K, the group G(K) is compact if and only if the identity component G° is reductive and anisotropic over K. More generally G(K)/H(K) is compact iff H contains a maximal connected K-split solvable subgroup of G°.

concept.title: Connectedness of real points of a simply connected simple group
concept.description: If G is a simply connected simple algebraic group over ℝ, then G(ℝ) has no nontrivial noncentral normal subgroups; in particular G(ℝ) is connected (É. Cartan).

concept.title: Function of bounded variation on a Euclidean open set
concept.description: A function u∈L¹(Ω;ℝᵐ) on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ has bounded variation, u∈BV(Ω;ℝᵐ), if its distributional derivative is a finite ℝ^{m×n}-valued Radon measure Du: ∫u_α∂_iφ dx=−∫φ dD_iu_α for all φ∈C_c^∞(Ω). Equivalently its variation sup{∑_α∫u_α div φ_α dx : φ∈C_c¹(Ω;ℝ^{m×n}), |φ|≤1} is finite; it equals the total variation |Du|(Ω).

concept.title: Distributional divergence of a BV vector field
concept.description: For T∈BV(Ω;ℝⁿ), Ω⊆ℝⁿ open, Div T=∑_iD_iT_i is the trace of the matrix-valued measure DT: the finite signed Radon measure with ∫φ dDiv T=−∫T·∇φ dx for φ∈C_c^∞(Ω). If T is C¹, Div T=div T dx.

concept.title: Points of Lebesgue density of a measurable set
concept.description: For a Lebesgue measurable E⊆ℝⁿ and t∈[0,1], E^{(t)} is the set of points x with |E∩B_r(x)|/|B_r(x)|→t as r→0. E^{(1)} and E^{(0)} are the measure-theoretic interior and exterior; ℝⁿ∖(E^{(0)}∪E^{(1)}) is the essential boundary.

concept.title: Reduced boundary and measure-theoretic normal of a set of finite perimeter
concept.description: For E⊆ℝⁿ of finite perimeter, the reduced boundary ∂*E consists of the points x with |D1_E|(B_r(x))>0 for all r>0 at which lim_{r→0}D1_E(B_r(x))/|D1_E|(B_r(x)) exists and is a unit vector. This limit is the inner unit normal; its negative ν_E(x) is the measure-theoretic outer unit normal.

concept.title: Inner trace of a BV function on the reduced boundary
concept.description: For u∈BV(ℝⁿ;ℝᵐ), E⊆ℝⁿ of finite perimeter and x∈∂*E with outer normal ν_E(x), the inner trace tr_E(u)(x) is the vector a, when it exists, with r^{−n}∫_{B_r(x)∩{y:(y−x)·ν_E(x)<0}}|u(y)−a|dy→0 as r→0; equivalently with the half ball replaced by B_r(x)∩E.

concept.title: Gluing of BV functions along the reduced boundary of a set of finite perimeter
concept.description: Let u,v∈BV(Ω;ℝᵐ) and E a set of finite perimeter in Ω, with one-sided traces u⁺, v⁻ on ∂*E∩Ω (relative to the inner normal). Then w=u1_E+v1_{Ω∖E}∈BV(Ω;ℝᵐ) iff ∫_{∂*E∩Ω}|u⁺−v⁻|dH^{n−1}<∞, and then Dw=Du⌞E^{(1)}+(u⁺−v⁻)⊗ν H^{n−1}⌞(∂*E∩Ω)+Dv⌞E^{(0)}, ν the inner normal.

concept.title: Existence of one-sided traces of BV functions on rectifiable sets
concept.description: If u∈BV(Ω;ℝᵐ) and Γ⊆Ω is countably H^{n−1}-rectifiable and oriented by a unit normal ν, then for H^{n−1}-a.e. x∈Γ there are u^±(x) with ρ^{−n}∫_{B_ρ^±(x,ν(x))}|u−u^±(x)|→0, the half balls on either side of ν(x); moreover Du⌞Γ=(u⁺−u⁻)⊗ν H^{n−1}⌞Γ.

concept.title: De Giorgi structure theorem for sets of finite perimeter
concept.description: For a set E of finite perimeter in ℝⁿ, the reduced boundary ∂*E is countably (n−1)-rectifiable and |D1_E|=H^{n−1}⌞∂*E, so D1_E=−ν_E H^{n−1}⌞∂*E and the perimeter is H^{n−1}(∂*E); at each x∈∂*E the blow-ups (E−x)/r converge locally in measure to the half space {y:y·ν_E(x)<0}.

concept.title: Resistance form
concept.description: A resistance form on a set X is a pair (E,F): F is a linear space of real functions on X containing the constants and E is a nonnegative symmetric quadratic form on F with E(u,u)=0 only for constant u, such that F modulo constants is a Hilbert space for E; every function on a finite subset of X extends to a member of F; the effective resistance R(p,q)=sup{|u(p)−u(q)|²/E(u,u)} is finite for all p,q∈X; and the unit contraction ū=(0∨u)∧1 of each u∈F lies in F with E(ū,ū)≤E(u,u) (Kigami’s axioms RF1–RF5).

concept.title: Resistance form as the limit of a compatible sequence of networks
concept.description: Let V₀⊂V₁⊂… be finite sets with Laplacians H_m on V_m (symmetric, nonnegative off-diagonal entries, zero row sums) that are compatible: minimizing the energy of H_(m+1) over extensions from V_m gives the energy of H_m. On V_*=⋃V_m put F={u: lim_m E_m(u|V_m)<∞} and E(u,u)=lim_m E_m(u|V_m), the energies being nondecreasing. Then (E,F) is a resistance form on V_*, and it extends to a resistance form on the completion of V_* for its effective resistance metric, whose functions are continuous for that metric.

concept.title: Closedness of a resistance form in L²
concept.description: Let (E,F) be the resistance form of a resistance metric R on X with (X,R^(1/2)) separable, and μ a σ-finite Borel measure on X. Then L²(X,μ)∩F with the inner product E(u,v)+∫uv dμ is a Hilbert space. If moreover μ(X)<∞ and ∫R(p,p*)μ(dp)<∞ for some p*, its inclusion into L²(X,μ) is a compact operator.

concept.title: Resistance topology of a regular harmonic structure
concept.description: For a harmonic structure (D,r) on a connected p.c.f. self-similar set K, the completion Ω of V_*=⋃V_m for the effective resistance metric R of its resistance form embeds in K. The following are equivalent: Ω=K; (Ω,R) is compact; (Ω,R) is bounded; every function in the form domain is bounded; (D,r) is regular (all r_i<1). In the regular case R is a metric on K compatible with its original topology.

concept.title: Maximum principle for harmonic functions on a p.c.f. self-similar set
concept.description: Let (D,r) be a harmonic structure, not necessarily regular, on a connected p.c.f. self-similar set K. Every harmonic function u extends continuously to K, and on every cell K_w its values lie between the minimum and maximum of u on ψ_w(V₀). If x∈K∖V₀ lies in the connected component C of K∖V₀, then u(x) lies between the minimum and maximum of u over the boundary points in the closure of C, with equality only if u is constant on C.

concept.title: Energy approximation by harmonic splines on a p.c.f. self-similar set
concept.description: For a harmonic structure on a p.c.f. self-similar set with resistance form (E,F), each u∈F has a unique m-harmonic interpolant u_m (harmonic on every m-cell, equal to u on V_m). If h is m-harmonic and f∈F vanishes on V_m then E(h,f)=0; hence E(u−u_m,u−u_m)=E(u,u)−E_m(u|V_m)→0 as m→∞.

concept.title: Conductance criterion for a p.c.f. harmonic structure
concept.description: For a harmonic structure (D,r) on a connected p.c.f. self-similar set K and distinct p,q∈V₀, D_pq>0 if and only if some connected component of K∖V₀ contains p and q in its closure. Moreover every chain of points of V_m∖V₀ joined consecutively, and to its endpoints p,q∈V_m, by positive level-m conductances lies in one component of K∖V₀ whose closure contains p and q.

concept.title: Components at a fixed boundary point of a p.c.f. self-similar set
concept.description: Let K be a connected p.c.f. self-similar set and p the fixed point of a cell map ψ_i. Each connected component of K∖{p} meets V₀, so there are finitely many, and ψ_i maps them onto their intersections with ψ_i(K) by a permutation. For p∈V₀ the number of components of K∖{p} equals the number of components of K∖V₀ whose closure contains p.

concept.title: Affine space over a real vector space
concept.description: An affine space under a real vector space V is a nonempty set A on which the additive group of V acts freely and transitively, (x,v)↦x+v; for x,y∈A, x−y denotes the unique v∈V with y+v=x. Choosing an origin identifies A with V, and affine maps, affine functions and half-spaces of A are those corresponding to affine ones on V; these notions do not depend on the origin.

concept.title: Root datum in a group (Bruhat–Tits)
concept.description: For a finite root system Φ, possibly nonreduced, a root datum of type Φ in a group G is a system (T,(U_a,M_a)_(a∈Φ)) with T a subgroup and each U_a a nontrivial subgroup such that: for b∉−ℝ₊a the commutator group (U_a,U_b) lies in the subgroup generated by the U_(pa+qb) with p,q≥1 and pa+qb∈Φ; U_(2a)⊂U_a when 2a∈Φ; M_a is a right coset of T and U_(−a)∖{1}⊂U_aM_aU_a; nU_bn⁻¹=U_(r_a(b)) for n∈M_a, r_a the reflection in a; and TU⁺∩U⁻={1}, where U⁺ (resp. U⁻) is generated by the U_a for the positive (resp. negative) roots of a Weyl chamber. It is generating if T and the U_a generate G. The subgroup N generated by T and the M_a has a unique homomorphism onto the Weyl group of Φ, with kernel T, through which conjugation by N permutes the U_a.

concept.title: Valuation of a root datum
concept.description: A valuation of a root datum (T,(U_a,M_a)_(a∈Φ)) in a group G is a family of maps φ_a:U_a→ℝ∪{∞} such that: each φ_a takes at least three values; each U_(a,k)=φ_a⁻¹([k,∞]) is a subgroup and U_(a,∞)={1}; for m∈M_a the function u↦φ_(−a)(u)−φ_a(mum⁻¹) is constant on U_(−a)∖{1}; for b∉−ℝ₊a the commutator group (U_(a,k),U_(b,l)) lies in the subgroup generated by the U_(pa+qb,pk+ql) with p,q≥1; φ_(2a) is the restriction of 2φ_a when 2a∈Φ; and if u∈U_a∖{1} and u′,u″∈U_(−a) with u′uu″∈M_a then φ_(−a)(u′)=−φ_a(u). For v in the ambient vector space of Φ, the family φ_a+a(v) is again a valuation, said to be equipollent to φ. The valuation is discrete if each value set φ_a(U_a∖{1}) meets every bounded interval in finitely many points.

concept.title: Apartment of a valued root datum
concept.description: Let φ be a valuation of a root datum (T,(U_a,M_a)) of type Φ in G, with a Weyl-invariant inner product on the ambient space V of Φ. The apartment A is the set of valuations equipollent to φ, a Euclidean affine space under V. The group N generated by T and the M_a acts on valuations by (n·ψ)_a(u)=ψ_(w⁻¹a)(n⁻¹un), w the image of n in the Weyl group; this preserves A and defines a homomorphism ν from N to the affine isometries of A. The affine roots are the half-spaces α={x: a(x−φ)+k≥0} with a∈Φ and k a value φ_a(u) not increased on uU_(2a); U_α=U_(a,k), their boundaries are the walls, ν(n)α is an affine root with nU_αn⁻¹=U_(ν(n)α), and suitable elements of M_a act by the reflections in the walls. Let W be the group generated by these reflections. If φ is discrete, W is an affine Weyl group (a product of affine Weyl groups of reduced root systems) whose affine roots are exactly these half-spaces; the chambers are the connected components of the complement of the walls, the facets are the classes of points lying in the same affine roots, and each facet is W-conjugate to a unique facet of the closure of a fixed chamber, its type.

concept.title: Building of a valued root datum
concept.description: Let φ be a valuation of a generating root datum (T,(U_a,M_a)) in a group G, with apartment A, action ν of N on A and H=ker ν. For x∈A let P_x=H·U_x, where U_x is generated by the root groups U_α of the affine roots α containing x. The Bruhat–Tits building of (G,φ) is the quotient of G×A by the equivalence relation (g,x)∼(h,y) if y=ν(n)x and g⁻¹hn∈P_x for some n∈N. G acts by left translation, x↦[1,x] embeds A compatibly with ν, the G-translates of A are the apartments and the G-translates of facets of A are the facets of the building. It depends only on the equipollence class of φ.

concept.title: Bruhat–Tits decomposition for a quasi-concave function on a valued root datum
concept.description: Let φ be a valuation of a generating root datum (T,(U_a,M_a)_(a∈Φ)) in G, N the group of the datum, ν its action on the apartment and H=ker ν. For a quasi-concave function f:Φ→ℝ (for instance f_Ω(a)=inf{k: a(x−φ)+k≥0 on Ω} for a nonempty subset Ω of the apartment), let U_f be generated by the U_(a,f(a)), U_f^±=U_f∩U^± and N_f=N∩H·U_f. Then U_f∩U_a=U_(a,f(a))U_(2a,f(2a)), the product map ∏U_(a,f(a)) over the positive (resp. negative) nondivisible roots, in any order, is a bijection onto U_f⁺ (resp. U_f⁻), U_f=U_f⁻U_f⁺N_f, and N_f is generated by the N∩U_(a,f(a))U_(−a,f(−a)). Moreover the roots a with f′(a)+f′(−a)=0 form a root system Φ_f and N_f maps onto its Weyl group with kernel H∩U_f.

concept.title: Fixers of subsets of an apartment in the building of a valued root datum
concept.description: In the building of a valued root datum (T,(U_a,M_a)) in G, with apartment A, N acting on A through ν and H=ker ν, let Ω be a nonempty subset or a facet of A. The fixer of Ω in G for its action on the building is N_Ω·H·U_Ω, where N_Ω is the subgroup of N fixing Ω pointwise through ν and U_Ω is generated by the root groups U_α of the affine roots α containing Ω; it is the intersection of the fixers of the points of Ω.

concept.title: Maximal unramified extension of a complete discretely valued field
concept.description: For a field K complete for a discrete valuation with residue field k, the maximal unramified extension K^ur is the union, inside a separable closure of K, of the finite extensions L/K with ramification index 1 and separable residue extension of degree [L:K]. It is a Galois extension of K, the valuation extends uniquely to it, and its residue field is a separable closure of k.

concept.title: Root subgroup of a reductive group relative to a split maximal torus
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G with a split maximal torus T (for instance over an algebraically closed field) and a root a of G relative to T, the root subgroup U_a is the unique closed subgroup admitting an isomorphism x_a from the additive group onto U_a with t·x_a(u)·t⁻¹=x_a(a(t)u) for all points t of T and u of the additive group.

concept.title: Relative root subgroup of a reductive group
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a field k, S a maximal k-split torus and T⊇S a maximal torus. For a relative root a∈Φ(G,S), the relative root subgroup U_a (Borel–Tits U_(a)) is the closed subgroup generated, after extension to an algebraic closure, by the root subgroups U_α of the roots α of T whose restriction to S is a positive integer multiple of a. It is a connected unipotent k-subgroup normalized by the centralizer of S, independent of T, and U_(2a)⊂U_a.

concept.title: Root datum of a reductive group relative to a maximal split torus
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a field k, S a maximal k-split torus with centralizer Z and normalizer N_G(S), and Φ=Φ(G,S) its relative root system. With U_a the relative root subgroups and M_a the cosets of Z(k) in N_G(S)(k) meeting U_(−a)(k)U_a(k)U_(−a)(k), the system (Z(k),(U_a(k),M_a)_(a∈Φ)) is a generating root datum of type Φ in G(k) (Borel–Tits), whose group N is N_G(S)(k).

concept.title: Converse of Hölder’s inequality
concept.description: On a σ-finite measure space let 1≤p≤∞ and 1/p+1/q=1. For every measurable function g, ‖g‖_q=sup{∫|g|f dμ : f≥0 measurable, ‖f‖_p=1}, the value ∞ being allowed; in particular g∈L^q exactly when the supremum is finite, and then ‖g‖_q is the norm of the functional f↦∫fg on Lᵖ.

concept.title: Linear isometry between normed spaces
concept.description: A linear map T:X→Y between normed vector spaces with ‖Tx‖=‖x‖ for every x∈X. It is injective and bounded, with operator norm 1 when X≠0.

concept.title: Compactness of the adelic quotient of an anisotropic reductive group
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a number field F having no proper parabolic F-subgroup, equivalently every F-split torus of G is central. Then G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ is compact. This is the compactness theorem of Borel–Harish-Chandra and Mostow–Tamagawa.

concept.title: Compactness of the norm-one idele class group
concept.description: For a number field F, the diagonal F^× is a discrete subgroup of the group I_F¹ of ideles of idelic norm 1, and the quotient I_F¹/F^× is compact.

concept.title: Compactness of the adelic flag variety G(A_F)/P(A_F)
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a number field F and a parabolic F-subgroup P, the natural map G(A_F)/P(A_F)→(G/P)(A_F) is a homeomorphism onto the adelic points of the projective variety G/P; in particular G(A_F)/P(A_F) is compact.

concept.title: Standard parabolic subgroups of a reductive group
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a field k, P a minimal parabolic k-subgroup and S⊆P a maximal k-split torus, with simple relative roots Δ. The parabolic k-subgroups containing P correspond bijectively to subsets I⊆Δ, P_I having as Levi subgroup the centralizer of the identity component of ⋂_(α∈I)ker α; every parabolic k-subgroup is G(k)-conjugate to exactly one P_I, so the minimal parabolic k-subgroups are G(k)-conjugate.

concept.title: Bruhat decomposition for the rational points of a reductive group
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a field k, P a minimal parabolic k-subgroup with unipotent radical U, S⊆P a maximal k-split torus and W the relative Weyl group. Then G(k) is the disjoint union of the double cosets P(k)n_wP(k)=U(k)n_wP(k), w∈W, for representatives n_w∈N_G(S)(k); equivalently (P(k),N_G(S)(k)) is a BN-pair in G(k) (Borel–Tits).

concept.title: Isomorphism theorem for split reductive groups
concept.description: For split connected reductive groups (G,T) and (G′,T′) over a field, every isomorphism of their root data (X*(T),Φ,X_*(T),Φ^∨)≅(X*(T′),Φ′,X_*(T′),Φ′^∨) is induced by an isomorphism G≅G′ carrying T onto T′; in particular split reductive groups with isomorphic root data are isomorphic.

concept.title: Tits index of a reductive group
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a field k, take a maximal k-split torus S inside a maximal k-torus T and compatible orderings, with absolute simple roots Δ of (G,T). The Galois group of a splitting field acts on Δ by the *-action s*α=w_s(sα), w_s in the absolute Weyl group. The Tits index is (Δ, *-action, Δ₀) with Δ₀ the simple roots vanishing on S; the relative simple roots are the restrictions of the *-orbits in Δ∖Δ₀, and parabolic k-subgroups containing the standard minimal one correspond to *-stable subsets of Δ containing Δ₀.

concept.title: Galois descent of closed subschemes along a finite Galois extension
concept.description: Let X be a scheme over a field k and l/k a finite Galois extension. A closed subscheme Z⊆X_l with σ(Z)=Z for every σ∈Gal(l/k) is the base change of a unique closed subscheme of X. In particular a Galois-stable closed subgroup of G_l, for an algebraic k-group G, is defined over k.

concept.title: Horn’s inequality for singular values of a product
concept.description: For compact operators A,B on a Hilbert space, with singular values μ₁≥μ₂≥… counted with multiplicity, ∏_(n=1)^N μ_n(AB)≤∏_(n=1)^N μ_n(A)μ_n(B) for every N.

concept.title: Weyl’s inequality for log-majorized sequences
concept.description: Let a₁≥…≥a_N≥0 and b₁≥…≥b_N≥0 with ∏_(j≤k)a_j≤∏_(j≤k)b_j for k=1,…,N. Then ∑_(j≤N)g(a_j)≤∑_(j≤N)g(b_j) for every continuous increasing g on [0,∞) with t↦g(eᵗ) convex; in particular ∑_(j≤N)a_j≤∑_(j≤N)b_j.

concept.title: Inverse limit of measure-preserving systems
concept.description: A measure-preserving system (X,μ,T) is the inverse limit of systems (X_j,μ_j,T_j), j∈ℕ, with factor maps π_j:X_(j+1)→X_j, if there are factor maps p_j:X→X_j with π_j∘p_(j+1)=p_j for every j such that the σ-algebra of X is generated, up to null sets, by the σ-algebras p_j⁻¹(B_j).

concept.title: Sesquilinear form on a complex vector space
concept.description: A map s:V×V→ℂ on a complex vector space that is linear in one variable and conjugate-linear in the other, e.g. s(αx+x′,y)=αs(x,y)+s(x′,y) and s(x,αy+y′)=ᾱs(x,y)+s(x,y′). Which variable is conjugate-linear is a convention; over ℝ the analogue is a bilinear form.

concept.title: Trace of a trace-class operator
concept.description: For a trace-class operator T on a Hilbert space H, tr T=∑_i⟨Te_i,e_i⟩ for any orthonormal basis (e_i) of H. The sum converges absolutely, does not depend on the basis, and satisfies |tr T|≤‖T‖₁; tr is linear.

concept.title: Singular value decomposition of a compact Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: Every compact operator A:H→G between Hilbert spaces has a Schmidt representation A=∑_n s_n⟨·,e_n⟩f_n, convergent in operator norm, with orthonormal families (e_n) in H, (f_n) in G and a nonincreasing null sequence s_n≥0. The s_n, the singular values, are the eigenvalues of |A|=(A*A)^{1/2} with multiplicity.

concept.title: Singular values of a compact operator as approximation numbers
concept.description: For a compact operator A between Hilbert spaces with singular values s₁≥s₂≥…, s_k=inf{‖A−B‖: B bounded with rank B<k} for every k≥1; truncating the singular value decomposition after k−1 terms attains the infimum.

concept.title: Ideal property of compact operators
concept.description: If T:X→Y is a compact operator between normed spaces and R:W→X, S:Y→Z are bounded linear operators, then STR:W→Z is compact.

concept.title: Hilbert space of Hilbert–Schmidt operators
concept.description: For Hilbert spaces H,G, the Hilbert–Schmidt operators H→G form a Hilbert space under ⟨A,B⟩=tr(B*A), whose norm ‖A‖₂ dominates the operator norm; A↦A* maps it isometrically onto the Hilbert–Schmidt operators G→H.

concept.title: Nuclear operator between Banach spaces
concept.description: A bounded operator T:X→Y between Banach spaces is nuclear if Tx=∑_nφ_n(x)y_n for some φ_n∈X*, y_n∈Y with ∑‖φ_n‖‖y_n‖<∞. Its nuclear norm is the infimum of ∑‖φ_n‖‖y_n‖ over all such representations.

concept.title: Projective tensor products as nuclear operators under the approximation property
concept.description: If X* or Y has the approximation property, the map X*⊗̂_πY→L(X,Y) extending φ⊗y↦φ(·)y is injective and an isometric isomorphism onto the nuclear operators X→Y with the nuclear norm.

concept.title: Injective tensor products as compact operators under the approximation property
concept.description: For Banach spaces X,Y the injective norm on X*⊗Y is the operator norm of the associated finite-rank operators, so X*⊗̂_εY is the closure of the finite-rank operators in L(X,Y). If X* or Y has the approximation property, this closure is the space K(X,Y) of compact operators.

concept.title: Approximation property of Hilbert spaces
concept.description: Every Hilbert space H has the approximation property: for every compact K⊆H and ε>0 there is a finite-rank operator R on H with ‖x−Rx‖≤ε for all x∈K. The orthogonal projections onto spans of finitely many vectors of an orthonormal basis form a bounded net converging pointwise to the identity.

concept.title: Nuclear representations of trace-class operators
concept.description: An operator T:H→G between Hilbert spaces is trace class if and only if T=∑_j⟨·,x_j⟩y_j for some x_j∈H, y_j∈G with ∑‖x_j‖‖y_j‖<∞. Then ‖T‖₁ is the infimum of ∑‖x_j‖‖y_j‖ over all such representations and is attained by the singular value decomposition.

concept.title: Ideal property of Hilbert–Schmidt operators
concept.description: If T:H→K is a Hilbert–Schmidt operator between Hilbert spaces and S:K→L, U:G→H are bounded operators, then STU is Hilbert–Schmidt and ‖STU‖₂≤‖S‖‖T‖₂‖U‖.

concept.title: Group scheme of multiplicative type over a scheme
concept.description: A group scheme H over a scheme S is of multiplicative type if it is diagonalizable locally for the fpqc topology: every point of S has an affine open neighbourhood U=Spec A and a faithfully flat A-algebra A′ such that H×_S Spec A′ is isomorphic to the diagonalizable group D_(A′)(M)=Spec A′[M] of some abelian group M, where A′[M] is the group algebra with comultiplication m↦m⊗m (SGA 3, IX 1.1). A subgroup of multiplicative type of an S-group scheme G is a subgroup scheme of G that is of multiplicative type.

concept.title: Rational map between algebraic varieties
concept.description: For algebraic varieties X and Y over a field k, a rational map X⇢Y is an equivalence class of k-morphisms U→Y defined on dense open subsets U⊆X, two being equivalent when they agree on a dense open subset of X. It is regular (defined) at a point x if some representative is defined on an open neighbourhood of x; a rational map regular at every point is a morphism X→Y. A rational function on X is a rational map to the affine line.

concept.title: Smooth point of an algebraic variety
concept.description: A point x of an algebraic variety X over a field k is smooth (nonsingular) if the structure morphism X→Spec k is smooth on some open neighbourhood of x. The variety is smooth when all its points are smooth.

concept.title: Unipotent part of a connected solvable group over a perfect field
concept.description: Let G be a smooth connected solvable affine algebraic group over a perfect field k. Then G has a normal unipotent algebraic subgroup G_u such that G/G_u is of multiplicative type; G_u contains every unipotent algebraic subgroup of G, its formation commutes with field extension, it is smooth and connected, G/G_u is a torus, and G_u is the unique smooth subgroup with G_u(k^a) the set of unipotent elements of G(k^a) (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Theorem 16.33(a)–(c)).

concept.title: Conjugacy of maximal diagonalizable subgroups of a trigonalizable group
concept.description: Let G be a trigonalizable affine algebraic group, i.e. isomorphic to an algebraic subgroup of the upper triangular group, over an algebraically closed field k, and q:G→D=G/G_u its quotient by the normal unipotent subgroup with diagonalizable quotient. Then q has sections that are homomorphisms, any two such sections are conjugate by an element of G_u(k), and the maximal diagonalizable subgroups of G are exactly the images s(D) of sections, so any two are G_u(k)-conjugate (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Theorems 16.26(a) and 16.27).

concept.title: A connected group variety over an algebraically closed field without tori is unipotent
concept.description: A smooth connected affine algebraic group over an algebraically closed field that contains no nontrivial torus is unipotent (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Proposition 16.60). It is the algebraically closed case of the corresponding criterion over an arbitrary field, proved first and separately.

concept.title: Multiplicative part of a connected nilpotent algebraic group
concept.description: Let G be a connected nilpotent affine algebraic group over a field k and Z(G)_s the multiplicative part of its centre. Then Z(G)_s is the largest algebraic subgroup of G of multiplicative type; it is characteristic and central, and G/Z(G)_s is unipotent. If G becomes trigonalizable over a separable extension then G=G_u×Z(G)_s uniquely, and if G is smooth then Z(G)_s is a torus (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Theorem 16.47).

concept.title: Centralizer of a semisimple element of the Lie algebra of a group variety
concept.description: Let G be a connected smooth affine algebraic group over a field with Lie algebra g, and X∈g semisimple. The subgroup C_G(X) of G fixing X under the adjoint action is smooth with Lie algebra z_g(X)={Y∈g:[Y,X]=0}; consequently C_G(X)=G exactly when X is central in g (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Proposition 17.76 and Corollary 17.77).

concept.title: Rational noncentral semisimple Lie algebra elements over an infinite field
concept.description: For a smooth affine algebraic group G over an algebraically closed field, the elements of its Lie algebra g with noncentral semisimple part form a Zariski-open subset of g. Hence, if G is defined over an infinite field k and g⊗k^a contains a noncentral semisimple element, then so does g, and the centralizers of such elements span g (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Propositions 17.78–17.79; Springer, Linear Algebraic Groups, 13.3.4).

concept.title: Isogeny reduction to a nilpotent group or a noncentral semisimple Lie element
concept.description: For a smooth affine algebraic group G over a field k there is an isogeny φ:G→G′, a surjective homomorphism with finite kernel, such that either G′ is nilpotent or the Lie algebra of G′ over k^a contains a noncentral semisimple element, and every torus of G′ is the image of a torus of G. In characteristic p it is a composite of infinitesimal isogenies dividing out p-Lie subalgebras of semisimple elements (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Proposition 17.80; Springer, Linear Algebraic Groups, 13.3.5).

concept.title: Existence and conjugacy of Borel pairs over a finite field
concept.description: Let G be a smooth connected affine algebraic group over a finite field k. Then G has a Borel pair (B,T) defined over k, a Borel subgroup B of G with a maximal torus T of B, both geometrically Borel and maximal, and any two Borel pairs are conjugate by an element of G(k). The proof applies the Lang–Steinberg theorem to the Frobenius (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Proposition 17.99).

concept.title: Representability of the functor of multiplicative-type subgroups of a smooth affine group scheme
concept.description: Let G be a smooth affine group scheme over a scheme S. The functor sending an S-scheme T to the set of subgroups of multiplicative type of G_T is representable by an S-scheme that is smooth and separated over S; likewise Hom_(S-gr)(H,G) is representable, smooth and separated for every S-group H of multiplicative type and of finite type (SGA 3, XI, Théorème 4.1 and Corollaire 4.2).

concept.title: Algebras generated by finitely many integral elements are finite
concept.description: If a ring map R→S makes S generated as an R-algebra by finitely many elements each integral over R, then S is a finitely generated R-module. Consequently a ring map is finite if and only if it is integral and of finite type (Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemmas 10.36.4–10.36.5, tags 00GM, 02JJ).

concept.title: Minimal polynomials of integral elements over an integrally closed domain
concept.description: Let A be an integrally closed domain with fraction field F and E a finite extension of F. An element of E is integral over A if and only if its minimal polynomial over F has all its coefficients in A (Milne, Algebraic Geometry, Proposition 1.44).

concept.title: Characteristic polynomial of multiplication in a finite field extension
concept.description: Let E/F be a finite field extension and α∈E with minimal polynomial f=Xⁿ+a₁Xⁿ⁻¹+⋯+aₙ over F, and m=[E:F[α]]. The characteristic polynomial of the F-linear map x↦αx on E is f^m. Hence Tr_(E/F)(α)=−m·a₁ and Nm_(E/F)(α)=(−1)^(mn)aₙ^m, the products and sums of the roots of f taken m times (Milne, Fields and Galois Theory, Proposition 5.44 and Corollary 5.45).

concept.title: Nilpotent endomorphisms have trace zero
concept.description: A nilpotent endomorphism N of an n-dimensional vector space over a field, with N^r=0, has minimal polynomial a power of X and characteristic polynomial Xⁿ. Hence its trace and determinant vanish, and so do those of every nilpotent square matrix.

concept.title: Integral domains algebraic over a field are fields
concept.description: If an integral domain R contains a field k and every element of R is algebraic over k, then R is a field: for β≠0 the ring k[β] is finite-dimensional over k and multiplication by β on it is injective, hence surjective. In particular a finite-dimensional k-algebra that is a domain is a field (Milne, Fields and Galois Theory, Proposition 1.32; Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, Lemma 3.30).

concept.title: Regular local rings of dimension one are discrete valuation rings
concept.description: A Noetherian local ring (A,𝔪) of Krull dimension one with dim_(A/𝔪)𝔪/𝔪²=1 is a discrete valuation ring: it is a domain, any t∈𝔪∖𝔪² generates 𝔪, and every nonzero element is uniquely utⁿ with u a unit, so ord(utⁿ)=n is a normalized discrete valuation on its fraction field. At a regular point p of a one-dimensional Noetherian scheme the local ring is therefore a discrete valuation ring with uniformizer any t∈𝔪_p∖𝔪_p².

concept.title: Going down for flat ring maps
concept.description: If R→S is a flat homomorphism of commutative rings, it has the going-down property: for primes 𝔭⊆𝔭′ of R and a prime 𝔮′ of S lying over 𝔭′ there is a prime 𝔮⊆𝔮′ of S lying over 𝔭. The proof uses that R_𝔭′→S_𝔮′ is faithfully flat, so every prime of R_𝔭′ is a contraction (Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma 10.39.19, tag 00HS).

concept.title: Homomorphisms from a simple algebraic extension and roots of the minimal polynomial
concept.description: Let α be algebraic over a field F with minimal polynomial f, and let φ₀:F→Ω be a homomorphism of fields. Then φ↦φ(α) is a bijection from the homomorphisms F(α)→Ω extending φ₀ onto the roots of φ₀f in Ω. In particular there are at most deg f=[F(α):F] such extensions, with equality exactly when φ₀f has deg f distinct roots in Ω.

concept.title: Herbrand’s theorem on lower numbering of quotients
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension M/K of local fields with G=Gal(M/K), a normal subgroup H=Gal(M/L) and real u≥−1, the lower ramification groups satisfy G_uH/H=(G/H)_v with v=φ_(M/L)(u), where φ_(M/L) is the Herbrand function of M/L and G/H is identified with Gal(L/K).

concept.title: Poisson integral formula for harmonic functions on a ball
concept.description: If u is continuous on the closed unit ball of ℝⁿ and harmonic on the open ball B, then u(x)=∫_S u(ζ)P(x,ζ)dσ(ζ) for x∈B, with Poisson kernel P(x,ζ)=(1−|x|²)/|x−ζ|ⁿ and normalized surface measure σ on the unit sphere S; by translation and dilation the same holds on every ball. Differentiating under the integral gives D^αu(x)=∫_S u(ζ)D^α_xP(x,ζ)dσ(ζ), so harmonic functions are infinitely differentiable.

concept.title: Normal closure of a finite field extension
concept.description: For a finite extension K/k generated by α₁,…,α_n, a normal closure of K/k is a splitting field over K of the product of the minimal polynomials of the α_i over k. It is a finite normal extension of k containing K, generated over k by the roots of these polynomials, and is unique up to K-isomorphism.

concept.title: Right exactness of the tensor product of modules
concept.description: For a commutative ring A and an A-module P, an exact sequence M′→M→M″→0 of A-modules gives an exact sequence M′⊗_AP→M⊗_AP→M″⊗_AP→0. In particular (A/𝔞)⊗_AM≅M/𝔞M for every ideal 𝔞 of A.

concept.title: p-adic representation of a profinite group
concept.description: For a prime p and a profinite group G, typically an absolute Galois group G_K, a p-adic representation of G is a finite-dimensional ℚ_p-vector space V with a linear G-action such that the action map G×V→V is continuous for the p-adic topology on V.

concept.title: Dual of a group representation
concept.description: For a representation of a group G on a vector space V over a field k, the dual (contragredient) representation is the algebraic dual V*=Hom_k(V,k) with (g·λ)(v)=λ(g⁻¹v).

concept.title: Fontaine’s de Rham period ring
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p, B_dR⁺ is the completion of W(O_(ℂ_p)^♭)[1/p] along the kernel of Fontaine’s map θ (extended ℚ_p-linearly). It is a complete discrete valuation ring with residue field ℂ_p, and t=log[ε] is a uniformizer on which G_K acts through the p-adic cyclotomic character. B_dR=B_dR⁺[1/t] is its fraction field, with G_K-action and filtration FilⁱB_dR=tⁱB_dR⁺ (i∈ℤ).

concept.title: De Rham p-adic representation
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a p-adic representation V of G_K, D_dR(V)=(B_dR⊗_(ℚ_p)V)^(G_K) is a K-vector space with descending Hodge filtration FilⁱD_dR(V)=(FilⁱB_dR⊗_(ℚ_p)V)^(G_K); D_dR⁺(V)=Fil⁰D_dR(V). V is de Rham if dim_K D_dR(V)=dim_(ℚ_p)V.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato local finite subspace H¹_f
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a p-adic representation V of G_K, H¹_f(K,V)=ker(H¹(K,V)→H¹(K,B_cris⊗_(ℚ_p)V)), the kernel of the map on continuous Galois cohomology induced by v↦1⊗v.

concept.title: Local Tate duality for p-adic representations
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_ℓ and a p-adic representation V of G_K, there is a canonical isomorphism H²(K,ℚ_p(1))≅ℚ_p, and cup product with the evaluation V⊗Hom(V,ℚ_p(1))→ℚ_p(1) gives perfect pairings Hⁱ(K,V)×H^(2−i)(K,Hom(V,ℚ_p(1)))→ℚ_p of finite-dimensional spaces for 0≤i≤2, in continuous cohomology.

concept.title: Filtered tensor and dual compatibility of D_dR
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p, de Rham representations of G_K are stable under subquotients, tensor products and duals, and D_dR is exact and compatible with them as filtered K-vector spaces: D_dR(V)⊗_K D_dR(V′)≅D_dR(V⊗V′) and D_dR(V^∨)≅D_dR(V)^∨ with the tensor-product and dual filtrations.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato fundamental exact sequence
