concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p, with B_cris⊂B_dR and crystalline Frobenius φ, the sequence 0→ℚ_p→B_cris⊕B_dR⁺→B_cris⊕B_dR→0, x↦(x,x), (y,z)↦(y−φ(y),y−z), is an exact sequence of ℚ_p[G_K]-modules; equivalently 0→ℚ_p→B_cris^(φ=1)→B_dR/B_dR⁺→0 is exact.

concept.title: Ramanujan–Petersson theorem for holomorphic newforms
concept.description: For a normalized newform f=∑a_nqⁿ of weight k≥1, level N and nebentypus ε, and a prime p∤N, both roots of X²−a_pX+ε(p)p^(k−1) have absolute value p^((k−1)/2); in particular |a_p|≤2p^((k−1)/2). Deligne proved it for k≥2 via the Weil conjectures, Deligne–Serre for k=1.

concept.title: Newform coefficients at primes dividing the level
concept.description: Let f=∑a_nqⁿ be a normalized newform of weight k, level N and character χ of conductor m, let q|N be prime, and N_q, m_q the q-parts of N, m. If N_q=m_q then |a_q|=q^((k−1)/2); if N_q=q and m_q=1 then a_q²=χ′(q)q^(k−2), with χ′ the character modulo N/q inducing χ; otherwise a_q=0.

concept.title: Divergence of a real sequence to ±∞
concept.description: A real sequence (xₙ) diverges to +∞, written lim xₙ=∞, if for every K∈ℝ there is M with xₙ>K for all n≥M; it diverges to −∞ if for every K there is M with xₙ<K for all n≥M. Together with finite limits this gives limits of real sequences valued in the extended real line.

concept.title: Schematic closure in an affine model over a Dedekind domain
concept.description: Let o be a Dedekind domain with fraction field F, 𝒴=Spec A a flat affine o-scheme of finite type, and X=Spec B a closed subscheme of its generic fiber 𝒴_F. The schematic closure of X in 𝒴 is Spec of the image of A→A⊗_oF→B: a closed subscheme of 𝒴, flat over o, with generic fiber X, and the smallest such closed subscheme.

concept.title: Torus over a base scheme
concept.description: For a scheme S, an S-torus is an S-group scheme T that becomes isomorphic to a finite product G_m^n of multiplicative groups G_m=Spec O_S[t,t⁻¹] after base change along an étale covering of S (equivalently fpqc-locally on S). Over a field this is an algebraic torus.

concept.title: Maximal torus of a smooth affine group scheme
concept.description: For a smooth affine group scheme G over a scheme S, a maximal torus is a closed S-subgroup scheme T⊂G that is an S-torus and whose fiber T_s̄ at every geometric point s̄ of S is a maximal torus of G_s̄.

concept.title: Cocharacter of an affine group scheme
concept.description: For an affine group scheme G over a ring k, a cocharacter (1-parameter subgroup) is a homomorphism of k-group schemes λ:G_m→G, where G_m=Spec k[t,t⁻¹] with t↦t⊗t; equivalently a Hopf-algebra map k[G]→k[t,t⁻¹]. A nontrivial kernel, and λ=1, are allowed.

concept.title: Dynamic subgroups P_G(λ), U_G(λ), Z_G(λ) of a cocharacter
concept.description: For an affine group scheme G over a ring k and a cocharacter λ, let G_m act by t·g=λ(t)gλ(t)⁻¹. For a k-algebra R, P_G(λ)(R) consists of the g∈G(R) whose orbit map, an R[t,t⁻¹]-point of G, comes from an R[t]-point (lim_{t→0} t·g exists); U_G(λ)(R) of those with limit 1; Z_G(λ)(R) of those centralizing λ.

concept.title: Existence of faithful representations of affine algebraic groups
concept.description: Every affine algebraic group G over a field k admits a faithful finite-dimensional representation, i.e. a homomorphism G→GL_n that is a closed immersion; thus G is isomorphic to a closed subgroup of some GL_n.

concept.title: Schematic closure of a generic-fiber subgroup is a subgroup scheme
concept.description: Let o be a Dedekind domain with fraction field F, 𝒢 a flat affine group scheme of finite type over o and H⊂𝒢_F a closed F-subgroup scheme. Then the schematic closure of H in 𝒢 is a closed o-subgroup scheme of 𝒢, flat over o, with generic fiber H.

concept.title: Torus fibers spread to open neighbourhoods
concept.description: Let G→S be an fppf affine group scheme with connected fibers. If the fiber G_s is a torus for some s∈S, then G_U is an S-torus over some open neighbourhood U of s (SGA3 X 4.9).

concept.title: Openness of fiberwise maximality of a torus
concept.description: Let G→S be a smooth affine group scheme and T⊂G an S-torus. If T_s is a maximal torus of the identity component G⁰_s for some s∈S, then there is an open neighbourhood V of s such that Z_G(T)⁰_V=T_V and T_v is a maximal torus of G⁰_v for every v∈V (SGA3 XIX 2.6).

concept.title: Constructibility of the geometrically connected fiber locus
concept.description: For a morphism of finite presentation f:X→S, the set of s∈S whose fiber X_s is geometrically connected is locally constructible (EGA IV 9.7.7). In particular, over an integral noetherian base, if the generic fiber is geometrically connected then so are all fibers over a dense open subset.

concept.title: Gradings from multiplicative-group actions
concept.description: For a ring k, an action of G_m on an affine k-scheme Spec A is equivalent to a ℤ-grading A=⊕_{n∈ℤ}A_n of the k-algebra A, where t·f=tⁿf for f∈A_n; likewise a G_m-module structure on a k-module is a ℤ-grading into weight spaces.

concept.title: Morphisms from the projective line to affine schemes are constant
concept.description: For a ring R, the global functions on the projective line P¹_R are Γ(P¹_R,O)=R. Hence every R-morphism from P¹_R to an affine R-scheme factors through Spec R, i.e. is constant.

concept.title: Étale monomorphisms are open immersions
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is an open immersion if and only if it is an étale monomorphism (EGA IV 17.9.1).

concept.title: Completion of a smooth scheme along a section
concept.description: Let X be smooth of relative dimension d over a noetherian local ring k near a section e with ideal I. If h₁,…,h_d∈I lift a basis of the free module I/I², then x_i↦h_i gives an isomorphism k[[x₁,…,x_d]]≅ the I-adic completion of the coordinate ring.

concept.title: Semidirect decomposition of dynamic subgroups
concept.description: For a finitely presented affine group scheme G over a ring k and a cocharacter λ, U_G(λ) is a closed normal subgroup of P_G(λ), Z_G(λ)=P_G(λ)∩P_G(−λ) is the centralizer of λ, and multiplication Z_G(λ)⋉U_G(λ)→P_G(λ) is an isomorphism; the fibers of U_G(λ) are unipotent.

concept.title: Dynamic subgroups of reductive groups are parabolic
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a field and any cocharacter λ:G_m→G, the subgroup P_G(λ) is a parabolic subgroup of G.

concept.title: Parabolic subgroups containing a Borel and subsets of simple roots
concept.description: Let (G,T) be split reductive over a field, B⊇T a Borel subgroup and Δ its simple roots. The parabolic subgroups containing B correspond bijectively to subsets I⊆Δ. For a cocharacter λ of T, P_G(λ)⊇B if and only if ⟨α,λ⟩≥0 for all positive roots α, and then P_G(λ) is the parabolic for I={α∈Δ:⟨α,λ⟩=0}.

concept.title: Hörmander space B_{p,k} of distributions
concept.description: For a temperate weight function k on ℝⁿ and 1≤p≤∞, B_{p,k} is the space of tempered distributions u whose Fourier transform is a function with k·û∈L^p, normed by (2π)^{−n}‖kû‖_p. For p=2 and k(ξ)=(1+|ξ|²)^{s/2} it is the Sobolev space Hˢ.

concept.title: Embedding of B_{p,k} into C^j
concept.description: If k is a temperate weight, 1/p+1/p′=1, j≥0 an integer and (1+|ξ|)^j/k(ξ)∈L^{p′}, then every element of B_{p,k} is a C^j function; conversely the inclusion B_{p,k}∩ℰ′(Ω)⊂C^j forces this integrability (Hörmander, Theorem 2.2.7).

concept.title: Differential operator of constant strength
concept.description: A linear differential operator P(x,D) on an open set Ω⊆ℝⁿ has constant strength if for all x,y∈Ω the frozen constant-coefficient operators P(x,D) and P(y,D) are equally strong, i.e. P̃(x,ξ)/P̃(y,ξ) is bounded above and below, where P̃(ξ)²=∑_α|P^{(α)}(ξ)|².

concept.title: Elliptic constant-coefficient operators dominate all operators of their order
concept.description: A constant-coefficient operator P(D) of order m is stronger than every operator of order ≤m if and only if it is elliptic, in which case 1+|ξ|^{2m}≤C(|P(ξ)|²+1). Consequently an elliptic operator with continuous coefficients has constant strength (Hörmander, Theorem 3.3.6 and §7.4).

concept.title: Hörmander’s local solution operator for operators of constant strength
concept.description: Let P(x,D) have C^∞ coefficients and constant strength near x₀. On every sufficiently small neighbourhood Ω of x₀ there is a linear map E:ℰ′(ℝⁿ)→ℰ′(Ω) with P(x,D)Ef=f and EP(x,D)u=u in Ω, and ‖Ef‖_{p,P̃₀k}≤C_k‖f‖_{p,k} for every temperate weight k (Hörmander, Theorem 7.3.1).

concept.title: Hypoellipticity of operators of constant strength with hypoelliptic frozen part
concept.description: Let P(x,D) have C^∞ coefficients and constant strength in Ω, with P(x₀,D) hypoelliptic for some x₀. If u is a distribution on Ω and P(x,D)u∈C^∞, then u∈C^∞; this applies to every elliptic operator, since elliptic constant-coefficient operators are hypoelliptic (Hörmander, Theorems 4.1.7 and 7.4.1).

concept.title: Pseudo-Eisenstein series
concept.description: For a cuspidal datum (M,π) of a reductive group over a global field and a Paley–Wiener section φ of the induced family, the pseudo-Eisenstein series is θ_φ(g)=∑_{γ∈P(k)∖G(k)}φ̂(γg), the Eisenstein series E(φ(λ),λ)(g) integrated over a vertical plane Re λ=λ₀ far inside the positive chamber. It is rapidly decreasing on G(k)∖G(A).

concept.title: Standard intertwining operator for automorphic induction
concept.description: For standard Levi subgroups M, M′ of a reductive group over a global field and a Weyl element w with wMw⁻¹=M′, M(w,λ) maps automorphic forms on U(A)M(k)∖G(A) to those for M′ by (M(w,λ)φ)(g)=∫_{(U′∩wUw⁻¹)(A)∖U′(A)}φ(w⁻¹ug)e^{⟨λ+ρ,H(w⁻¹ug)⟩}du·e^{−⟨wλ+ρ′,H(g)⟩}, convergent for Re λ in a translate of the positive chamber.

concept.title: Paley–Wiener theorem for compactly supported smooth functions
concept.description: The Fourier–Laplace transform identifies compactly supported smooth functions on a finite-dimensional real vector space V, supported in a ball of radius R, with the entire functions F on V_ℂ* satisfying |F(λ)|≤C_N(1+|λ|)^{−N}e^{R|Re λ|} for every N.

concept.title: Decomposition of automorphic L² along cuspidal data
concept.description: For a reductive group G over a global field, L²(G(k)∖G(A))_ξ is the Hilbert direct sum, over equivalence classes X of cuspidal data, of the closed subspaces L²_X spanned by pseudo-Eisenstein series from X; these subspaces are mutually orthogonal and the pseudo-Eisenstein series are dense (Langlands; Moeglin–Waldspurger II.1.12, II.2.4).

concept.title: Inner product formula for pseudo-Eisenstein series
concept.description: For Paley–Wiener sections φ, ψ attached to cuspidal data (M,π), (M′,π′), ⟨θ_φ,θ_ψ⟩=∫_{Re λ=λ₀}∑_{w}⟨M(w,λ)φ(λ),ψ(−w λ̄)⟩dλ, the sum over Weyl elements w with wMw⁻¹=M′ and wπ≅π′; in particular it vanishes for inequivalent cuspidal data (Langlands; Moeglin–Waldspurger II.2.1).

concept.title: Meromorphic continuation and functional equations of Eisenstein series
concept.description: For cuspidal automorphic data on a reductive group over a global field, the Eisenstein series E(φ,λ) and the standard intertwining operators M(w,λ) continue meromorphically to all λ, are holomorphic on the unitary axis, and satisfy E(M(w,λ)φ,wλ)=E(φ,λ) and M(w′,wλ)M(w,λ)=M(w′w,λ); M(w,λ) is unitary on the unitary axis (Langlands; Moeglin–Waldspurger Ch. IV).

concept.title: Langlands’ square-integrability criterion for automorphic forms
concept.description: An automorphic form with unitary central character on a reductive group over a global field is square integrable modulo the centre if and only if, for every standard parabolic P, the real parts of the central exponents of the cuspidal components of its constant term along P lie in the open negative cone spanned by the simple coroots (Langlands; Moeglin–Waldspurger I.4.11).

concept.title: Harish-Chandra finiteness theorem for automorphic forms
concept.description: For a reductive group over a number field, the space of automorphic forms with a fixed finite set of K-types annihilated by a fixed ideal of finite codimension in the centre of the universal enveloping algebra is finite-dimensional (Harish-Chandra).

concept.title: Analytic Fredholm theorem
concept.description: If z↦K(z) is a holomorphic family of compact operators on a Banach space over a connected open subset of ℂ, then either I−K(z) is invertible for no z, or (I−K(z))⁻¹ exists outside a discrete set and is meromorphic there with finite-rank residues.

concept.title: Jacobi theta series θ_{m,μ} of index m
concept.description: For an integer m≥1 and a residue class μ mod 2m, θ_{m,μ}(τ,z)=∑_{r∈ℤ, r≡μ (mod 2m)} q^(r²/4m)ζ^r with q^(r²/4m)=e^(2πi r²τ/4m) and ζ^r=e^(2πi rz), for τ in the upper half-plane and z∈ℂ. The series converges absolutely and locally uniformly, so the 2m functions θ_{m,μ} are holomorphic; they have weight ½ and index m.

concept.title: Generation of SL₂(ℤ) by S and T
concept.description: The modular group SL₂(ℤ) is generated by S=(0 −1; 1 0) and T=(1 1; 0 1). Consequently a transformation law of modular type holds for all of SL₂(ℤ) once it holds for S and T.

concept.title: Nuclear map between C*-algebras
concept.description: A completely positive contraction φ:A→B between C*-algebras is nuclear if there are completely positive contractions θ_i:A→M_{n_i}(ℂ) and γ_i:M_{n_i}(ℂ)→B with ‖γ_i(θ_i(a))−φ(a)‖→0 for every a∈A.

concept.title: Kirchberg’s characterization of exact C*-algebras by nuclear embeddings
concept.description: A C*-algebra A is exact, meaning that 0→J⊗_min A→B⊗_min A→(B/J)⊗_min A→0 is exact for every C*-algebra B and closed ideal J, if and only if A has a faithful representation π:A→B(H) that is a nuclear map.

concept.title: Tensor products of completely positive maps on minimal C*-tensor products
concept.description: If φ:A→C and ψ:B→D are completely positive maps between C*-algebras, the algebraic tensor product map φ⊙ψ extends to a completely positive map φ⊗ψ:A⊗_min B→C⊗_min D with ‖φ⊗ψ‖=‖φ‖‖ψ‖; the same holds for maximal tensor products.

concept.title: Siegel modular forms of weight zero are constant
concept.description: Every Siegel modular form of weight 0 for the full modular group Sp₂ₙ(ℤ), n≥1, is a constant function on the Siegel upper half-space.

concept.title: Z_l-extensions are unramified outside l
concept.description: Every ℤ_ℓ-extension of a number field K is unramified at all finite places of K not dividing ℓ and at all infinite places; in particular it lies in the maximal abelian pro-ℓ extension of K unramified outside ℓ.

concept.title: Galois group of the maximal abelian l-ramified pro-l extension over the l-Hilbert class field
concept.description: For a number field K and a prime ℓ, let M be the maximal abelian pro-ℓ extension of K unramified outside ℓ and H its maximal unramified abelian ℓ-extension. Class field theory gives Gal(M/H)≅U_K/s_K(E_K), where U_K=∏_{𝔩|ℓ}U¹_{K_𝔩} is the product of local principal units above ℓ, E_K=ℤ_ℓ⊗O_K× and s_K is the diagonal (semi-localization) map.

concept.title: Structure of the principal units of a p-adic field
concept.description: For a finite extension F/ℚ_p, the group U¹_F=1+𝔪_F of principal units is a finitely generated ℤ_p-module isomorphic to μ_{p^∞}(F)×ℤ_p^([F:ℚ_p]), where μ_{p^∞}(F) is the finite group of p-power roots of unity in F.

concept.title: Accessible stopping time
concept.description: A stopping time T is accessible if there are predictable stopping times T₁,T₂,… whose graphs cover its graph {(T(ω),ω):T(ω)<∞} up to an evanescent set; that is, almost surely T∈{T₁,T₂,…} on {T<∞}.

concept.title: Functional monotone class theorem
concept.description: Let 𝒜 be a π-system on a set E and H a vector space of bounded real functions on E containing the constant 1 and the indicators of members of 𝒜, such that the limit of every uniformly bounded increasing sequence of nonnegative members of H is in H. Then H contains every bounded σ(𝒜)-measurable real function.

concept.title: Generators of the predictable σ-algebra
concept.description: On a filtered probability space the predictable σ-algebra on [0,∞)×Ω, generated by the adapted left-continuous processes, is also generated by the predictable rectangles {0}×A with A∈F₀ and (t,∞)×A with t≥0 and A∈F_t; equivalently by the continuous adapted processes, or by the stochastic intervals [τ,∞) of predictable stopping times τ.

concept.title: Strict past of a predictable time generated by an announcing sequence
concept.description: If stopping times τ_n≤τ converge to τ with τ_n<τ whenever 0<τ<∞, in particular if (τ_n) announces a predictable stopping time τ, then F_(τ−) is the σ-algebra generated by ⋃_nF_(τ_n), and also the one generated by ⋃_nF_(τ_n−).

concept.title: Predictable projection of a measurable process
concept.description: On a complete filtered probability space, a measurable process X with E[1_(τ<∞)|X_τ||F_(τ−)] almost surely finite for every predictable stopping time τ has a predictable projection: the predictable process ᵖX, unique up to evanescence, with ᵖX_τ1_(τ<∞)=E[X_τ1_(τ<∞)|F_(τ−)] almost surely for every predictable stopping time τ.

concept.title: Jacobi polynomial
concept.description: For real α,β>−1 and an integer n≥0, P_n^{(α,β)}(x)=((α+1)_n/n!)∑_{k=0}^{n}(−n)_k(n+α+β+1)_k/(k!(α+1)_k)·((1−x)/2)^k, a real polynomial of degree n, where (a)_k is the rising factorial.

concept.title: Rodrigues formula for Jacobi polynomials
Gegenbauer polynomials as symmetric Jacobi polynomials
concept.description: For λ>0 and n≥0, C_n^λ(x)=((2λ)_n/(λ+1/2)_n)P_n^{(λ−1/2,λ−1/2)}(x): with this normalization the symmetric Jacobi polynomials have generating function (1−2xt+t²)^{−λ}.

concept.title: Orthogonality of Gegenbauer polynomials
concept.description: For λ>0, ∫_{−1}^{1}C_m^λ(x)C_n^λ(x)(1−x²)^{λ−1/2}dx=0 when m≠n, and for m=n it equals √π(2λ)_nΓ(λ+1/2)/(n!(n+λ)Γ(λ)).

concept.title: Integration of zonal functions over the sphere
concept.description: For d≥2, a point p of S^{d−1} and a bounded Lebesgue integrable Φ on [−1,1], u↦Φ(u·p) is integrable for spherical area σ and ∫Φ(u·p)dσ(u)=|S^{d−2}|∫_{−1}^{1}Φ(t)(1−t²)^{(d−3)/2}dt; moreover {u:u·p∈N} is σ-null for every Lebesgue-null N⊆[−1,1].

concept.title: Binomial series for a real exponent
concept.description: For a real number a and real x with |x|<1, (1−x)^{−a}=∑_{n≥0}(a)_n xⁿ/n!, the series converging absolutely, where (a)_n is the rising factorial.

concept.title: Nonexpansiveness of the metric projection onto a closed convex set
concept.description: For a nonempty closed convex set A⊆ℝⁿ, the nearest-point map p(A,·) is 1-Lipschitz: |p(A,x)−p(A,y)|≤|x−y| for all x,y∈ℝⁿ.

concept.title: Existence and uniqueness of the maximal-volume ellipsoid in a convex body
concept.description: Every convex body K⊂ℝⁿ contains an ellipsoid whose volume is maximal among all ellipsoids contained in K, and any two such maximal ellipsoids coincide.

concept.title: Minkowski’s determinant inequality
concept.description: For positive definite real symmetric n×n matrices A and B, det(A+B)^{1/n}≥det(A)^{1/n}+det(B)^{1/n}, with equality exactly when A and B are proportional; equivalently det((1−λ)A+λB)≥det(A)^{1−λ}det(B)^λ for 0≤λ≤1, with equality for 0<λ<1 only if A=B.

concept.title: Polar of a subset of Euclidean space
concept.description: For A⊆ℝⁿ, its polar is A°={y∈ℝⁿ:⟨x,y⟩≤1 for every x∈A}; it is a closed convex set containing the origin.

concept.title: Bipolar theorem in Euclidean space
concept.description: If A⊆ℝⁿ is closed, convex and contains the origin, then (A°)°=A; equivalently a∈A exactly when ⟨y,a⟩≤1 for every y∈A°.

concept.title: Fritz John’s multiplier rule for infinitely many inequality constraints
concept.description: Let F be C¹ on an open U⊆ℝᴺ, S a compact metric space and G:U×S→ℝ continuous with ∇_uG(u,s) existing and continuous in (u,s). If u₀ maximizes F on {u∈U:G(u,s)≤0 for all s∈S}, then ∇F(u₀)=0 or there are s₁,…,s_m∈S with m≤N, G(u₀,s_i)=0 and λ_i≥0 such that ∇F(u₀)=∑λ_i∇_uG(u₀,s_i).

concept.title: Successive minima of a symmetric convex body
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ symmetric about the origin and 1≤i≤n, the i-th successive minimum λ_i(K) is the least λ>0 such that λK contains i linearly independent points of ℤⁿ, so 0<λ₁≤⋯≤λ_n; the integer lattice may be replaced by any full lattice.

concept.title: Minkowski’s second theorem on successive minima
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ symmetric about the origin with successive minima λ₁,…,λ_n relative to ℤⁿ, 2ⁿ/n!≤λ₁λ₂⋯λ_n·vol(K)≤2ⁿ.

concept.title: Davenport’s lemma on rescaled parallelepipeds
concept.description: Let L₁,…,L_n be real linear forms of determinant 1 and λ₁,…,λ_n the successive minima of the parallelepiped |L_i(x)|≤1. If ρ₁≥⋯≥ρ_n>0, ρ₁λ₁≤⋯≤ρ_nλ_n and ρ₁⋯ρ_n=1, then after a permutation of the forms the parallelepiped |ρ_iL_i(x)|≤1 has successive minima λ′_i with c₁(n)λ_iρ_i≤λ′_i≤c₂(n)λ_iρ_i for every i.

concept.title: Mahler’s theorem on successive minima of reciprocal parallelepipeds
concept.description: If Π is the parallelepiped |L_i(x)|≤1 given by n independent real linear forms and Π* is the reciprocal (polar) parallelepiped given by the dual forms, then their successive minima satisfy c₁(n)≤λ_jλ*_{n+1−j}≤c₂(n) for j=1,…,n, with constants depending only on n.

concept.title: Mahler’s theorem on successive minima of compound parallelepipeds
concept.description: Let Π be a parallelepiped in ℝⁿ given by n independent linear forms, with successive minima λ₁,…,λ_n, and 1≤p≤n. Its p-th compound (pseudocompound) parallelepiped in Λ^pℝⁿ≅ℝ^ℓ, ℓ=C(n,p), has successive minima ν₁≤⋯≤ν_ℓ comparable, up to constants depending only on n, to the products λ_{i₁}⋯λ_{i_p} over p-element index sets arranged in increasing order.

concept.title: Siegel’s lemma
concept.description: If M<N and L₁,…,L_M are linear forms in N variables with integer coefficients of absolute value at most A≥1, then the system L₁(z)=⋯=L_M(z)=0 has a nonzero integer solution z with max_k|z_k|≤(NA)^{M/(N−M)}.

concept.title: Index of a multivariate polynomial at a point with respect to weights
concept.description: For a nonzero P∈ℝ[X₁,…,X_m], a point α∈ℝᵐ and positive integers r₁,…,r_m, the index of P at α relative to (r₁,…,r_m) is the least value of i₁/r₁+⋯+i_m/r_m over multi-indices with ∂^{i₁+⋯+i_m}P/∂X₁^{i₁}⋯∂X_m^{i_m}(α)≠0; the zero polynomial has index +∞. Schmidt’s variant replaces α by blocks of linear forms.

concept.title: Roth’s lemma on the index at rational points
concept.description: Let m≥1, 0<ε<1/12 and ω=24·2^{−m}(ε/12)^{2^{m−1}}. Suppose positive integers r₁,…,r_m satisfy ωr_h≥r_{h+1}, and coprime pairs (p_h,q_h) with q_h>0 satisfy q_h^{r_h}≥q₁^{r₁} and q_h≥2^{3m/ω}. Then every nonzero integer polynomial P of degree at most r_h in X_h with coefficients of absolute value at most q₁^{ωr₁} has index less than ε at (p₁/q₁,…,p_m/q_m) relative to (r₁,…,r_m).

concept.title: Topological generating set of a topological group
concept.description: A subset X of a topological group G topologically generates G if the subgroup generated by X is dense in G. G is topologically finitely generated if some finite subset topologically generates it.

concept.title: Frattini subgroup of a profinite group
concept.description: For a profinite group G, the Frattini subgroup Φ(G) is the intersection of all maximal open subgroups of G, the proper open subgroups contained in no larger proper open subgroup (Φ(G)=G if G is trivial). It is a closed normal subgroup, and G/Φ(G) is the Frattini quotient of G.

concept.title: p-adic powers of an element of a pro-p group
concept.description: For a pro-p group Π, an element π∈Π and a∈ℤ_p, the power π^a is the limit of the integer powers π^(a_n) for any integers a_n converging to a in ℤ_p. It is well defined, lies in the closure of the cyclic subgroup generated by π, and satisfies π^(a+b)=π^aπ^b and (π^a)^b=π^(ab).

concept.title: Reduced row echelon form of a matrix
concept.description: A matrix over a field is in reduced row echelon form if its zero rows come last, the leading (leftmost nonzero) entry of each nonzero row lies strictly to the right of the leading entry of the row above, every leading entry equals 1, and each leading 1 is the only nonzero entry of its column.

concept.title: Degree and leading coefficient of a polynomial
concept.description: For a nonzero polynomial f=a₀+a₁X+⋯+a_nX^n over a commutative ring with a_n≠0, the degree deg f is n and the leading coefficient is a_n. By convention the zero polynomial has degree −∞.

concept.title: Monic polynomial over a commutative ring
concept.description: A polynomial over a commutative ring is monic if it is nonzero and its leading coefficient, the coefficient of its highest-degree term, equals 1.

concept.title: Simple group
concept.description: A group is simple if it is nontrivial and its only normal subgroups are the trivial subgroup and the whole group.

concept.title: Perfect group
concept.description: A group G is perfect if it equals its commutator subgroup [G,G]; equivalently, G has no nontrivial abelian quotient.

concept.title: Projective special linear group over a field
concept.description: For a field F and n≥1, PSL_n(F)=SL_n(F)/Z, where Z=SL_n(F)∩F^×I is the group of scalar matrices of determinant 1, which is the centre of SL_n(F).

concept.title: Finiteness of open subgroups of given index in a finitely generated profinite group
concept.description: Let G be a topologically finitely generated profinite group. For each n there are only finitely many open subgroups of index n in G; consequently the identity has a fundamental system of neighbourhoods consisting of a descending chain of open characteristic subgroups.

concept.title: Frattini subgroup of a pro-p group from p-th powers and commutators
concept.description: For a pro-p group G, every maximal closed subgroup is open, normal and of index p, the Frattini quotient G/Φ(G) is an elementary abelian p-group, and Φ(G) is the closed subgroup G^p[G,G] generated by the p-th powers and the commutators.

concept.title: Nontrivial normal subgroups of a finite p-group meet the centre
concept.description: Let P be a finite p-group and N a nontrivial normal subgroup of P. Then N contains a nontrivial element of the centre of P. In particular a nontrivial finite p-group has nontrivial centre.

concept.title: Schur–Zassenhaus theorem for finite groups
concept.description: Let N be a normal subgroup of a finite group G whose order is coprime to its index. Then N has a complement H in G, a subgroup with N∩H=1 and NH=G, and any two complements are conjugate in G. Conjugacy is classically proved when N or G/N is solvable, and in general follows from the Feit–Thompson theorem.

concept.title: Nonemptiness of inverse limits of nonempty compact Hausdorff spaces
concept.description: The inverse limit of an inverse system of nonempty compact Hausdorff spaces and continuous maps, indexed by a directed set, is nonempty. In particular an inverse limit of nonempty finite sets over a directed set is nonempty.

concept.title: Schur’s lemma for simple objects of an abelian category
concept.description: In an abelian category every nonzero morphism between simple objects is an isomorphism. Hence morphisms between nonisomorphic simple objects are zero and the endomorphism ring of a simple object is a division ring.

concept.title: Isomorphism theorems for subobjects in an abelian category
concept.description: Let X be an object of an abelian category. For subobjects A and B of X, (A+B)/A≅B/(A∩B). For subobjects A⊆B⊆X, (X/A)/(B/A)≅X/B, and the subobjects of X/A correspond bijectively to the subobjects of X containing A.

concept.title: Left modules over a ring form an abelian category
concept.description: For a ring R, the category of left R-modules and R-linear maps is abelian: it is additive, kernels and cokernels are the usual submodule and quotient module, and every injective (surjective) homomorphism is the kernel (cokernel) of its cokernel (kernel).

concept.title: Iwasawa’s simplicity criterion
concept.description: Let a perfect group G act doubly transitively on a set X, and suppose the stabilizer of some point has an abelian normal subgroup whose conjugates in G generate G. Then G/K is simple, where K is the kernel of the action.

concept.title: Doubly transitive group action
concept.description: An action of a group G on a set X with at least two elements is doubly transitive if for any two ordered pairs (x₁,x₂) and (y₁,y₂) of distinct elements of X there is g∈G with gx₁=y₁ and gx₂=y₂.

concept.title: Generation of SL_n over a field by elementary transvections
concept.description: For a field F and n≥2, the group SL_n(F) is generated by the elementary transvections I+λE_ij with i≠j and λ∈F, where E_ij is the matrix unit.

concept.title: Serre’s ℓ-adic openness theorem for elliptic curves without complex multiplication
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K without complex multiplication over K̄. For every prime ℓ the image of Gal(K̄/K) in Aut(T_ℓE)≅GL₂(ℤ_ℓ) is open; equivalently its Lie algebra is all of End(V_ℓE). In particular this image is not abelian and V_ℓE is irreducible under every open subgroup of the Galois group.

concept.title: Serre’s description of inertia on the p-torsion of an elliptic curve over an unramified p-adic field
concept.description: Let K be a finite unramified extension of ℚ_p and E/K an elliptic curve with good or multiplicative reduction. For good ordinary (height one) or multiplicative reduction, inertia acts on E[p] by matrices (θ *; 0 1) with θ the level-one fundamental character, so its image has order p−1 or p(p−1). For good supersingular (height two) reduction, E[p] is a line over 𝔽_(p²) on which inertia acts by the level-two fundamental character; its image is a nonsplit Cartan subgroup of order p²−1.

concept.title: Subgroups of GL₂(𝔽_p) containing a Cartan subgroup
concept.description: Let p be prime and G a subgroup of GL₂(𝔽_p) containing a Cartan subgroup, or containing a half split Cartan subgroup (conjugate to the diagonal matrices diag(a,1)) with p≠5 in that case. Then G=GL₂(𝔽_p), or G lies in a Borel subgroup, or G lies in the normalizer of a Cartan subgroup.

concept.title: Density zero of supersingular primes for a non-CM elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K without complex multiplication. The set of finite places of K where E has good supersingular reduction, i.e. reduction whose formal group has height two, has Dirichlet density zero.

concept.title: Serre’s criterion for compatible systems with abelian reductions
concept.description: Let (ρ_ℓ) be a system of semisimple ℓ-adic representations of a number field K that is rational and strictly compatible, with Frobenius polynomials in ℚ[t] independent of ℓ. Suppose that for infinitely many ℓ the semisimplified reduction of ρ_ℓ modulo ℓ is abelian and its characters, restricted to the local units at ℓ via class field theory, are products of conjugates of the inverse reduction map with exponents bounded by a fixed N. Then the system comes from a representation of one of Serre’s groups S_m over ℚ; in particular every ρ_ℓ is abelian.

concept.title: Strict compatibility of the ℓ-adic representations of an elliptic curve
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over a number field K and v a finite place of good reduction with residue field k_v of Nv elements. For every prime ℓ not dividing Nv, the action on T_ℓE is unramified at v and Frobenius has characteristic polynomial T²−a_vT+Nv with a_v=Nv+1−#Ẽ_v(k_v)∈ℤ independent of ℓ. Thus (V_ℓE) is a strictly compatible system of rational ℓ-adic representations whose exceptional set is the set of places of bad reduction.

concept.title: Local reciprocity and the fundamental characters of tame inertia
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with residue field k of q elements and L/K an abelian tamely ramified extension. The local reciprocity map sends the units O_K^× onto the inertia group I(L/K), factoring through k^×, and the composite of the tame inertia group I_t→I(L/K) with this identification is the inverse of the fundamental character θ_(q−1):I_t→k^×: an element s acts as the reciprocity image of θ_(q−1)(s)^(−1).

concept.title: Trace criterion for supersingular elliptic curves over finite fields
concept.description: An elliptic curve over a finite field of characteristic p is supersingular, i.e. its formal group has height two, if and only if the trace of its Frobenius endomorphism is divisible by p. In particular an elliptic curve whose Frobenius trace is zero is supersingular.

concept.title: Open mapping theorem for Banach spaces
concept.description: A surjective bounded linear operator between Banach spaces maps open sets to open sets.

concept.title: Continuity of linear operators between normed spaces
concept.description: For a linear map T between normed spaces the following are equivalent: T is bounded; T is continuous; T is continuous at one point. A bounded T satisfies ‖Tx−Ty‖≤‖T‖‖x−y‖.

concept.title: Riemann sphere
concept.description: The extended complex plane Ĉ=ℂ∪{∞}, topologized as the one-point compactification of ℂ, with the coordinate w=1/z (1/∞=0) used near the point ∞.

concept.title: Lévy–Prokhorov metric
concept.description: For Borel probability measures μ,ν on a metric space, d_P(μ,ν)=inf{ε>0: μ(B)≤ν(B^ε)+ε and ν(B)≤μ(B^ε)+ε for every Borel set B}, where B^ε={x: d(x,B)<ε}. It is a metric on the Borel probability measures.

concept.title: Alexandrov’s portmanteau theorem for nets of probability measures
concept.description: For Borel probability measures on a metric space, a net μ_α converges to μ in the weak topology iff limsup μ_α(F)≤μ(F) for every closed F, iff liminf μ_α(G)≥μ(G) for every open G, iff μ_α(E)→μ(E) for every Borel E with μ(∂E)=0. Equivalently the sets {ν: ν(F_i)<μ(F_i)+ε, i≤n}, F_i closed, ε>0, form a neighbourhood base of μ.

concept.title: Ranga Rao’s uniform convergence theorem for weakly convergent measures
concept.description: If a net of Borel probability measures μ_α on a separable metric space converges weakly to μ, then ∫f dμ_α→∫f dμ uniformly over every uniformly bounded, pointwise equicontinuous family of bounded continuous real functions f.

concept.title: Limit of a function at infinity
concept.description: For a real- or complex-valued function f defined on a subset of ℝ that is unbounded above, lim_{x→∞}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is M such that |f(x)−L|<ε for every x>M in the domain.

concept.title: Dirichlet integral of sin x/x
concept.description: The integrals S(T)=∫₀ᵀ(sin x)/x dx converge to π/2 as T→∞, so the improper integral ∫₀^∞(sin x)/x dx equals π/2, although sin x/x is not Lebesgue integrable on (0,∞); in particular S is bounded on [0,∞).

concept.title: Equality case of Jensen’s inequality for strictly convex functions
concept.description: If φ is strictly convex on an interval containing the values of an integrable real random variable X, φ(X) is integrable and Eφ(X)=φ(EX), then X is almost surely constant.

concept.title: Conditional expectation of a variable independent of the σ-algebra
concept.description: If an integrable random variable X is independent of a sub-σ-algebra G, then E[X|G]=E[X] almost surely.

concept.title: Hausdorff spaces are characterized by a closed diagonal
concept.description: A topological space X is Hausdorff if and only if its diagonal {(x,x):x∈X} is closed in X×X with the product topology.

concept.title: Continuity of maps into a product space
concept.description: A map f:Z→∏_iX_i into a product of topological spaces is continuous for the product topology if and only if every coordinate map π_i∘f is continuous; in particular f×g:X×Z→Y×W is continuous when f and g are.

concept.title: Differentiability implies continuity for real functions
concept.description: If a real function f is differentiable at a point x₀, then f is continuous at x₀.

concept.title: Limit laws for sums, products and quotients of real functions
concept.description: If lim_{x→x₀}f(x)=L₁ and lim_{x→x₀}g(x)=L₂ for real functions, then f+g, f−g and fg have limits L₁+L₂, L₁−L₂ and L₁L₂ at x₀, and f/g has limit L₁/L₂ when L₂≠0.

concept.title: Chain rule for a holomorphic function along a differentiable path
concept.description: If F is holomorphic on an open set G⊆ℂ and γ:[a,b]→G is differentiable at t, then F∘γ is differentiable at t with (F∘γ)′(t)=F′(γ(t))γ′(t).

concept.title: Unordered sum of a family in a normed space
concept.description: For a family (v_s)_{s∈S} in a normed space indexed by an arbitrary set, ∑_{s∈S}v_s=v means that for every ε>0 there is a finite F₀⊆S with ‖v−∑_{s∈F}v_s‖<ε for every finite F with F₀⊆F⊆S.

concept.title: Orthonormal expansion with respect to an arbitrary orthonormal basis
concept.description: If (e_s)_{s∈S} is an orthonormal basis of a Hilbert space H, indexed by an arbitrary set, then every h∈H satisfies h=∑_{s∈S}⟨h,e_s⟩e_s as an unordered norm-convergent sum and ‖h‖²=∑_{s∈S}|⟨h,e_s⟩|²; only countably many coefficients are nonzero.

concept.title: Lebesgue measure as the restriction of Lebesgue outer measure
concept.description: Every Lebesgue measurable set E⊆ℝⁿ satisfies m(E)=m*(E), where m* is Lebesgue outer measure; m* has the same value whether computed with countable covers by open boxes, closed boxes or closed cubes.

concept.title: Outer unit normal of a Lipschitz domain
concept.description: Let E⊂ℝⁿ be a Lipschitz domain and y∈∂E. If near y, after a rotation, E lies above the graph of a Lipschitz u:ℝⁿ⁻¹→ℝ with y=(z,u(z)) and u is differentiable at z, the outer unit normal is ν(y)=(∇u(z),−1)/√(1+|∇u(z)|²); it does not depend on the chosen graph representation.

concept.title: Rademacher’s theorem on differentiability of Lipschitz maps
concept.description: Every Lipschitz map f:ℝⁿ→ℝᵐ is (Fréchet) differentiable at Lebesgue-almost every point of ℝⁿ.

concept.title: Area of the graph of a Lipschitz function
concept.description: If u:ℝⁿ⁻¹→ℝ is Lipschitz, then for every Lebesgue measurable G⊆ℝⁿ⁻¹ the graph Γ(u;G)={(z,u(z)):z∈G} satisfies H^{n−1}(Γ(u;G))=∫_G√(1+|∇u(z)|²)dz, and H^{n−1} restricted to the graph of u is a Radon measure on ℝⁿ.

concept.title: Lebesgue–Besicovitch differentiation theorem for Radon measures
concept.description: If μ and ν are Radon measures on ℝⁿ, then D_μν(x)=lim_{r→0}ν(B(x,r))/μ(B(x,r)) exists for μ-almost every x, is locally μ-integrable, and ν=(D_μν)μ+ν^s with ν^s singular with respect to μ; the same holds componentwise for ℝᵐ-valued Radon measures ν.

concept.title: Quasimartingale
concept.description: An adapted càdlàg process X on [0,∞], with X_∞=0 if X is indexed by [0,∞), such that E|X_t|<∞ for all t and Var(X)=sup_τ E∑_i|E[X_{t_i}−X_{t_{i+1}}|F_{t_i}]|<∞, the supremum over finite subdivisions τ of [0,∞].

concept.title: Quasimartingales as differences of positive supermartingales
concept.description: A process X indexed by [0,∞) is a quasimartingale if and only if X=Y−Z for positive right-continuous supermartingales Y and Z.

concept.title: Hausdorff maximality theorem
concept.description: Every nonempty partially ordered set contains a maximal totally ordered subset (a chain not properly contained in any other chain). It is equivalent to the axiom of choice and to Zorn’s lemma.

concept.title: Density of differences of support functions on the sphere
concept.description: Every twice continuously differentiable function f on S^{n−1} can be written f=h_K−h_{rBⁿ} on S^{n−1} for a convex body K and some r>0. Consequently the linear span of support functions of convex bodies, restricted to S^{n−1}, is dense in C(S^{n−1}) for the maximum norm.

concept.title: Modulus of continuity of a function on a metric space
concept.description: For a real function f on a metric space (G,d) and t>0, ω(t,f)=sup{|f(x)−f(y)|: d(x,y)≤t}. It is nondecreasing in t, and f is uniformly continuous exactly when ω(t,f)→0 as t→0; a λ-Lipschitz f has ω(t,f)≤λt.

concept.title: Positive linear operator on a space of continuous functions
concept.description: A linear operator A from the real continuous functions C(G) on a compact space G to C(G) is positive if f≥0 on G implies Af≥0 on G. For each point x, f↦(Af)(x) is then a positive linear functional.

concept.title: Gauss quadrature for a positive measure on an interval
concept.description: Let μ be a positive Borel measure on [−1,1] whose support has at least m+1 points, and p_{m+1} its orthogonal polynomial of degree m+1. Then p_{m+1} has m+1 simple zeros λ_1<…<λ_{m+1} in (−1,1), and there are positive weights (Christoffel or Cotes numbers) c_i with ∫P dμ=∑c_iP(λ_i) for every real polynomial P of degree at most 2m+1.

concept.title: Bruns’ inequality for the zeros of Legendre polynomials
concept.description: Write the zeros of the Legendre polynomial P_n as cos θ_1>…>cos θ_n with 0<θ_1<…<θ_n<π. Then (ν−1/2)π/(n+1/2)<θ_ν<νπ/(n+1/2) for ν=1,…,n; in particular the ν largest zeros exceed cos(νπ/(n+1/2)).

concept.title: Khintchine inequality
concept.description: For independent Rademacher signs ε_1,…,ε_n, real a_1,…,a_n and 0<p<∞, A_p(∑a_i²)^{1/2}≤(E|∑ε_ia_i|^p)^{1/p}≤B_p(∑a_i²)^{1/2} with constants depending only on p; B_p≤C√p for p≥2, so ∑ε_ia_i has ψ₂ norm at most an absolute multiple of (∑a_i²)^{1/2}.

concept.title: ψ_α Orlicz norm of a random variable
concept.description: For α>0 and a real random variable X, ‖X‖_{ψ_α}=inf{λ>0: E exp(|X/λ|^α)≤2} (a quasi-norm for α<1). Up to constants depending on α it is equivalent to sup_{p≥1}p^{−1/α}(E|X|^p)^{1/p} and to the tail bound P(|X|>t)≤2exp(−ct^α/‖X‖_{ψ_α}^α); ψ₂ variables are subgaussian and ψ₁ variables subexponential.

concept.title: Expected maximum of ψ₂ random variables
concept.description: If X_1,…,X_N (N≥2) are random variables, not necessarily independent, with ‖X_i‖_{ψ₂}≤K, then E max_i|X_i|≤CK√(log N) for an absolute constant C.

concept.title: Concentration of measure on the Euclidean sphere
concept.description: Let σ be the normalized rotation-invariant measure on S^{n−1}. Every 1-Lipschitz f:S^{n−1}→ℝ satisfies σ{|f−M_f|>ε}≤2exp(−cnε²) for its median (or mean) M_f and an absolute c (Lévy). In particular σ{x: |⟨x,θ⟩|>ε}≤√(π/2)·exp(−ε²n/2) for every unit vector θ.

concept.title: Gromov–Milman concentration on the orthogonal group
concept.description: Let μ_n be normalized Haar measure on O(n) with the Hilbert–Schmidt metric. Every L-Lipschitz F:O(n)→ℝ satisfies μ_n{|F−∫F dμ_n|≥ε}≤C exp(−cnε²/L²) for absolute constants c,C.

concept.title: ψ₁ bound for a Rademacher chaos of order two
concept.description: If ε, ε′ are independent Rademacher sequences and X=∑_{j,k}a_{jk}ε_jε′_k with real coefficients, then (E|X|^p)^{1/p}≤(p−1)(EX²)^{1/2} for p≥2 (hypercontractivity), hence ‖X‖_{ψ₁}≤C(∑a_{jk}²)^{1/2} for an absolute C.

concept.title: Deviation inequality for sums of i.i.d. ψ_α random variables
concept.description: For 0<α≤1 and i.i.d. copies X_1,…,X_n of a ψ_α random variable, there are constants C,c depending on α and ‖X_1‖_{ψ_α} with P(∑_{i≤n}X_i>Cn)≤exp(−cn^α); this is a Bernstein-type inequality (Schmuckenschläger 1993).

concept.title: Cramér’s large deviation theorem
concept.description: Let X_1,X_2,… be i.i.d. real random variables with E e^{tX_1}<∞ for t in a neighbourhood of 0, and I(a)=sup_t(ta−log E e^{tX_1}). Then (1/n)log P(∑_{i≤n}X_i≥an)→−I(a) for a>EX_1 and (1/n)log P(∑X_i≤an)→−I(a) for a<EX_1; the upper bounds P(…)≤e^{−nI(a)} hold for every n.

concept.title: Normalized standard Gaussian vector is uniform on the sphere
concept.description: If g is a standard Gaussian vector in ℝⁿ, then g/|g| is distributed according to the normalized rotation-invariant measure on S^{n−1} and is independent of |g|.

concept.title: Bourgain–Lindenstrauss–Milman almost-orthogonal partition lemma
concept.description: Let {w_α}_{α∈A}⊂S^{n−1} satisfy sup_{y∈S^{n−1}}(#A)^{−1}∑_α|⟨w_α,y⟩|≤δ, let 0<λ<1 and k≤n. Then A contains disjoint families F_β={β_1,…,β_k}, β∈B, covering more than (1−λ)#A−k indices, such that each family lies within δ4^k/λ of an orthonormal set: |v_{β_i}−w_{β_i}|≤δ4^k/λ for orthonormal v_{β_1},…,v_{β_k}.

concept.title: Unconditional convex body
concept.description: A convex body K⊂ℝⁿ is unconditional with respect to an orthonormal basis (e_i) if it is invariant under every reflection x↦x−2⟨x,e_i⟩e_i, equivalently under all sign changes of the coordinates in that basis.

concept.title: Cross-polytope bound for unconditional convex bodies
concept.description: There is an absolute constant c such that every convex body K⊂ℝⁿ that is unconditional with respect to an orthonormal basis (e_i) satisfies K⊂c√n M*(K)·conv{±e_1,…,±e_n}, where M*(K) is the half mean width (Klartag 2000, Lemma 3.2).

concept.title: Total degree of a multivariate polynomial
concept.description: For a nonzero polynomial f in R[X₁,…,X_n] over a commutative ring, its total degree deg f is the largest value of e₁+⋯+e_n over the monomials X₁^(e₁)⋯X_n^(e_n) occurring in f with nonzero coefficient. By convention the zero polynomial has degree −∞.

concept.title: Prime-power order of a finite field
concept.description: A finite field F has prime characteristic p, and its number of elements is q=p^f, where f is the dimension of F as a vector space over its prime field 𝔽_p. In particular q·1=0 in F.

concept.title: Multiplicativity of the sign of a permutation
concept.description: For permutations σ,τ of {1,…,n}, sgn(σ∘τ)=sgn(σ)·sgn(τ). Hence the sign is a group homomorphism from the symmetric group to {±1}, and sgn(σ⁻¹)=sgn(σ).

concept.title: Indecomposable module category
concept.description: A module category M over a monoidal category C is indecomposable if it is nonzero and is not equivalent, as a C-module category, to a direct sum M₁⊕M₂ of two nonzero C-module categories; the direct sum is the product category M₁×M₂ with componentwise action, associativity and unit constraints.

concept.title: Relative tensor product over an algebra in a tensor category
concept.description: For an algebra A in a tensor category C, a right A-module (M,p) and a left A-module (N,q), M⊗_AN is the cokernel of p⊗id_N−id_M⊗q: M⊗A⊗N→M⊗N, the coequalizer of the two actions. If M is a B–A bimodule and N an A–D bimodule, M⊗_AN inherits a B–D bimodule structure.

concept.title: Right exact functor between abelian categories
concept.description: An additive functor F between abelian categories is right exact if, for every short exact sequence 0→X→Y→Z→0, the sequence F(X)→F(Y)→F(Z)→0 is exact.

concept.title: Fully faithful essentially surjective functors are equivalences
concept.description: A functor F:C→D is an equivalence of categories if and only if it is fully faithful and essentially surjective, meaning every object of D is isomorphic to F(X) for some object X of C.

concept.title: Action of a group scheme on a scheme
concept.description: For a group scheme (G,m,e) over a scheme S and an S-scheme X, a left action is an S-morphism a:G×_SX→X with a∘(e×id_X)=id_X and a∘(m×id_X)=a∘(id_G×a); equivalently, for every S-scheme T the maps G(T)×X(T)→X(T) are group actions, functorial in T. Right actions X×_SG→X are defined symmetrically.

concept.title: Nilpotent algebraic group
concept.description: An algebraic group G over a field k is nilpotent if it has a central normal series G=G₀⊇G₁⊇⋯⊇G_t=e: normal algebraic subgroups such that the image of G_i in G/G_(i+1) is central, i.e. its points over every k-algebra R commute with all of (G/G_(i+1))(R).

concept.title: Base change of smooth morphisms
concept.description: If X→S is a smooth morphism of schemes and S′→S is any morphism, then the base change X×_SS′→S′ is smooth.

concept.title: Valuation ring
concept.description: An integral domain A with fraction field K is a valuation ring if for every nonzero x∈K either x∈A or x⁻¹∈A. Valuation rings are local; the valuation ring of a discretely valued field is an example.

concept.title: Valuative criterion of properness
concept.description: A quasi-separated morphism of finite type f:X→Y is proper if and only if, for every valuation ring A with fraction field K and every commutative square Spec K→X, Spec A→Y over f, there is exactly one morphism Spec A→X making both triangles commute.

concept.title: Spreading out an abelian variety to an abelian scheme
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field K there are a finite set S of places of K, containing the archimedean places, and an abelian scheme over the ring of S-integers O_(K,S) whose generic fibre is A; equivalently A has good reduction at all but finitely many places.

concept.title: Strict henselization of a local ring
concept.description: For a local ring (R,𝔪,k) and a separable closure k^s of k, the strict henselization R^sh is the colimit of the local rings, at points over 𝔪 with residue field embedded in k^s, of étale R-algebras. It is a henselian local ring with residue field k^s, flat and local over R; for a discrete valuation ring it is a discrete valuation ring unramified over R.

concept.title: Finiteness of Galois cohomology unramified outside a finite set
concept.description: Let K be a number field, S a finite set of places containing the archimedean ones, and M a finite discrete Gal(K^s/K)-module unramified outside S whose order is an S-unit. Then the subgroup of H¹(K,M) of classes unramified at every place outside S is finite.

concept.title: Unitriangular embedding of a unipotent group
concept.description: A unipotent affine algebraic group over a field k is isomorphic to an algebraic subgroup of the group U_n of upper unitriangular n×n matrices over k, for some n.

concept.title: Central series of the unitriangular group
concept.description: For the group U_n of upper unitriangular matrices over a field, ordering the entries above the diagonal by distance from it, the subgroups U_n^(r) where the first r entries vanish form a central normal series U_n=U_n^(0)⊇U_n^(1)⊇⋯⊇e whose successive quotients are isomorphic to 𝔾_a.

concept.title: Isomorphism theorems for algebraic groups
concept.description: For algebraic groups over a field, the Noether isomorphism theorems hold: a homomorphism factors as a quotient map followed by an embedding with image its quotient by the kernel, and for algebraic subgroups H and normal N of G, H∩N is normal in H and H/(H∩N)≅HN/N ⊆ G/N.

concept.title: Pseudo-abelian variety
concept.description: A pseudo-abelian variety over a field is a smooth connected algebraic group in which every smooth connected affine normal algebraic subgroup is trivial.

concept.title: Largest smooth connected affine normal subgroup of an algebraic group
concept.description: Every algebraic group G over a field contains a largest smooth connected affine normal algebraic subgroup N, and G/N contains no nontrivial such subgroup; if G is smooth and connected, N is the unique smooth connected affine normal subgroup with G/N a pseudo-abelian variety.

concept.title: Pseudo-abelian varieties over perfect fields are abelian varieties
concept.description: Every pseudo-abelian variety over a perfect field is complete, hence an abelian variety.

concept.title: Affine subgroups of abelian varieties are finite
concept.description: Every affine algebraic subgroup of an abelian variety over a field is finite; consequently every homomorphism from a smooth connected affine algebraic group to an abelian variety is trivial.

concept.title: Subgroups, quotients and extensions of unipotent groups
concept.description: Algebraic subgroups and quotients of unipotent affine algebraic groups are unipotent, and an extension of a unipotent algebraic group by a unipotent algebraic group is unipotent.

concept.title: Additive-character criterion for multiplicative type
concept.description: An affine algebraic group G over a field is of multiplicative type if and only if it is commutative and every homomorphism G→𝔾_a is trivial; equivalently, G becomes diagonalizable over a separable closure.

concept.title: Homomorphisms between unipotent and multiplicative-type groups are trivial
concept.description: Over a field there are no nontrivial homomorphisms from a unipotent algebraic group to an algebraic group of multiplicative type, nor from an algebraic group of multiplicative type to a unipotent one.

concept.title: Splitting of extensions of unipotent groups by diagonalizable groups
concept.description: Over an algebraically closed field, every extension e→D→G→U→e of a unipotent algebraic group U by a diagonalizable algebraic group D splits: D→G has a retraction homomorphism, so G≅D×U.

concept.title: Smooth connected groups of multiplicative type are tori
concept.description: A smooth connected algebraic group of multiplicative type over a field is an algebraic torus.

concept.title: Cusp form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concept.description: A modular form of weight κ∈(1/2)ℤ with a multiplier on a congruence subgroup Γ is a cusp form if it vanishes at every cusp: for each cusp, the Fourier expansion obtained after the slash action of a metaplectic element sending that cusp to ∞ has zero constant term. These form the subspace S_κ(Γ,χ). Weight-3/2 cusp forms on Γ₁(N), 4|N, are the case κ=3/2 with the cube of the theta multiplier.

concept.title: Petersson inner product of half-integral weight cusp forms
concept.description: For cusp forms f,g of the same weight κ∈(1/2)ℤ and multiplier on a congruence subgroup Γ, ⟨f,g⟩=∫_D f(z)·conj(g(z))·y^(κ−2)dxdy, z=x+iy, over a fundamental domain D for Γ on the upper half-plane. The integrand is Γ-invariant, the integral converges and does not depend on D, and it is a positive definite Hermitian form on the cusp space; orthogonal complements of subspaces of cusp forms are taken for it.

concept.title: Unary theta series of weight 3/2
concept.description: For a squarefree integer t≥1 and an odd Dirichlet character ψ, h_(t,ψ)(z)=∑_(m≥1)ψ(m)m e^(2πitm²z). It is a cusp form of weight 3/2, with character, on Γ₁(N) whenever 4t·cond(ψ)² divides N. For a level N, U⊆S_(3/2)(Γ₁(N)) denotes the span of the unary theta series lying in that space; their coefficients are supported on finitely many square classes tℤ².

concept.title: Shimura lift of a half-integral weight cusp form
concept.description: Let f=∑a(n)qⁿ be a cusp form of weight λ+1/2, λ≥1, with character χ on Γ₀(4N), and t a squarefree positive integer. Apart from its constant term, the t-th Shimura lift S_t f=∑A_t(n)qⁿ is defined by ∑A_t(n)n^(−s)=L(s−λ+1,χ_t)∑_(m≥1)a(tm²)m^(−s), where χ_t(m)=χ(m)((−1)^λt/m) with the Kronecker symbol. Shimura proved that S_t f is a modular form of weight 2λ on Γ₀(2N) with character χ². Forms on Γ₁(4N) are lifted componentwise along their decomposition into character eigenspaces.

concept.title: Hecke operator T(p²) on half-integral weight modular forms
concept.description: For a modular form f=∑a(n)qⁿ of weight λ+1/2 with character χ on Γ₀(4N) and a prime p∤4N, Shimura’s Hecke operator gives T(p²)f=∑b(n)qⁿ with b(n)=a(p²n)+χ(p)((−1)^λn/p)p^(λ−1)a(n)+χ(p)²p^(2λ−1)a(n/p²), where a(n/p²)=0 unless p²|n. It preserves the modular and cusp forms of that weight, level and character; T(m²) for m coprime to 4N is defined multiplicatively.

concept.title: Normality of the Hecke operators T(p²) on half-integral weight cusp forms
concept.description: For primes p∤4N the Hecke operators T(p²) on S_(λ+1/2)(Γ₀(4N),χ) commute with one another and are normal for the Petersson inner product; a unimodular multiple of each is Hermitian. Hence the cusp space has an orthogonal basis of simultaneous eigenforms of all T(p²), p∤4N, and each T(p²) commutes with the orthogonal projection onto any subspace stable under all of them, such as the span U of the unary theta series and its complement U^⊥.

concept.title: Eichler commutation relation for theta series
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite integral quadratic ℤ-lattice of rank k and level N, and p∤N a prime. The Hecke operator T(p²) of weight k/2 maps θ_L to a linear combination, with coefficients depending only on p, k and L_p, of θ_L and the sum of θ_K over the Kneser p-neighbours K of L (for even k also T(p) when p is a similitude norm). Thus T(p²) acts on the theta series of the classes in the genus of L through a neighbour-counting matrix (Eichler 1952, §§11, 21).

concept.title: Kneser p-neighbour of a quadratic lattice
concept.description: For a prime p, two integral quadratic ℤ-lattices L and K on the same rational quadratic space are p-neighbours if L∩K has index p in both L and K. Then K_q=L_q for every prime q≠p; when p∤2disc(L) also K_p≅L_p, so K lies in the genus of L. The p-neighbour graph has these lattices as vertices and p-neighbour pairs as edges.

concept.title: Connectedness of the Kneser p-neighbour graph
concept.description: Let L be an integral quadratic ℤ-lattice of rank at least 3 and p∤2disc(L) a prime. Every lattice K on the same rational quadratic space with K_q=L_q for all primes q≠p and K_p≅L_p is joined to L by a finite chain of successive p-neighbours (Kneser 1957).

concept.title: Spin group of a quadratic space
concept.description: For a nondegenerate quadratic space V of dimension at least 3 over a field F of characteristic not two, Spin(V) is the group of units g of the even Clifford algebra C⁺(V) with gVg⁻¹=V and gḡ=1 for the canonical involution. Conjugation gives an exact sequence 1→{±1}→Spin(V)→SO(V)→F×/F×² whose last map is the spinor norm. As an algebraic group Spin(V) is simply connected, and absolutely almost simple when dim V=3 or dim V≥5.

concept.title: Hecke equivariance of the Shimura lift
concept.description: For f∈S_(λ+1/2)(Γ₀(4N),χ), λ≥1, a squarefree t and primes p∤4N, the t-th Shimura lift satisfies S_t(T(p²)f)=T(p)S_t f, with the weight-2λ Hecke operator for the character χ². Hence if f is an eigenform of all T(p²), p∤4N, the lift is an eigenform of all T(p) with the same eigenvalues, and for n coprime to 4N, a(tn²)=a(t)∑_(d|n)μ(d)χ_t(d)d^(λ−1)A(n/d), where A(m) is the T(m)-eigenvalue of the lift (Shimura 1973, Corollary 1.8).

concept.title: Cuspidality criterion for Shimura lifts of weight-3/2 cusp forms
concept.description: Let f be a cusp form of weight 3/2 with character on Γ₀(4N) and t a squarefree positive integer. Its t-th Shimura lift, a modular form of weight 2, is a cusp form if and only if f is Petersson-orthogonal to the unary theta series ∑ψ(m)m e^(2πitm²z) of that level and character. Thus all Shimura lifts of f are cusp forms exactly when f is orthogonal to the whole span U of unary theta series (Kojima 1980; Cipra 1983; Sturm 1982).

concept.title: Maass form of half-integral weight
concept.description: For k∈(1/2)ℤ and a multiplier system ν of weight k on Γ₀(N), a Maass form of weight k is a smooth function f on the upper half-plane with f(γz)=ν(γ)((cz+d)/|cz+d|)^k f(z) for γ∈Γ₀(N), which is an eigenfunction of the weight-k Laplacian Δ_k=y²(∂_x²+∂_y²)−iky∂_x and has polynomial growth at every cusp; it is a Maass cusp form if its constant terms at all cusps vanish. If F is a holomorphic modular form of weight k for ν, then y^(k/2)F is a Maass form with eigenvalue (k/2)(1−k/2).

concept.title: Kloosterman sum attached to a multiplier system
concept.description: For a multiplier system ν of weight k on Γ₀(N), integers m,n and c>0 with N|c, K(m,n;c)=∑ν(γ)^(−1)e((ma+nd)/c), summed over the double cosets Γ_∞γΓ_∞ in Γ₀(N) with lower row (c,d), i.e. over d mod c coprime to c. For half-integral k and the theta multiplier on Γ₀(4N) it equals ∑_(d mod c,(d,c)=1)(c/d)ε_d^(2k)e((md̄+nd)/c), where dd̄≡1 mod c and ε_d is 1 or i according as d≡1 or 3 mod 4.

concept.title: Kuznetsov–Proskurin sum formula for weights 0, 1/2, 1, 3/2
concept.description: For k∈{0,1/2,1,3/2}, a multiplier of weight k on Γ₀(N), positive integers m,n and a smooth test function φ on [0,∞) with φ(0)=φ′(0)=0 and suitable decay, the sum ∑_(c≡0 mod N)c^(−1)K(m,n;c)φ(4π√(mn)/c) equals a spectral expansion: a sum over an orthonormal basis of Maass cusp forms of weight k of products of their m-th and n-th Fourier coefficients times an explicit Bessel transform of φ at their spectral parameters, plus the corresponding Eisenstein-series integrals and a sum over holomorphic cusp forms of weights k+2j weighted by a second Bessel transform (Kuznetsov; Proskurin 1979).

concept.title: Iwaniec’s bound for half-integral weight Kloosterman sums averaged over levels
concept.description: Let n be squarefree and 8|N. For a level Q, x≥1 and |ν|≤1 let K_Q(x) be the sum over c≤x with Q|c of c^(−1/2)K(n,n;c)e(2νn/c), where K(n,n;c) are half-integral weight Kloosterman sums for the theta multiplier. For P≥1 and the levels Q=pN with primes P<p≤2P, p∤n, Iwaniec (1987, Theorem 3) proved ∑_Q|K_Q(x)|≪[xP^(−1/2)+xn^(−1/4)+(x+n)^(5/8)(x^(1/4)P^(3/8)+n^(1/8)x^(1/8)P^(1/4))]τ(n)(log nx)^(O(1)) with an absolute constant, improving on Weil’s bound for suitable P.

concept.title: Petersson formula for half-integral weight cusp forms
concept.description: Let 4|N and k=l+1/2 with l≥2, with the theta multiplier on Γ₀(N). For an orthonormal basis {f_j} of S_k(Γ₀(N)) with Fourier coefficients f̂_j(n) and n≥1, Γ(k−1)(4πn)^(1−k)∑_j|f̂_j(n)|²=1+2πi^(−k)∑_(c≡0 mod N)c^(−1)K(n,n;c)J_(k−1)(4πn/c). It follows from expressing the Fourier coefficients of Poincaré series through Kloosterman sums and Bessel functions (Petersson 1932).

concept.title: Schulze-Pillot’s lower bound for primitive representation measures of ternary half-genera
concept.description: Let L be a positive definite integral ternary ℤ-lattice and a a positive squarefree integer whose square class is spinor exceptional for gen L, so that the genus splits into two half-genera H₁, H₂ with respect to a. There is C₀=C₀(L,a)>0 such that for every m≥1 and i=1,2, if the primitive representation measure r*(am²,H_i) is nonzero then r*(am²,H_i)≥C₀r*(am²,gen L); here r* denotes Siegel-weighted averages of primitive representation numbers (Schulze-Pillot 1984, Korollar 2).

concept.title: Kneser–Hsia theorem on representation measures of ternary spinor genera
concept.description: Let L be a nondegenerate ternary quadratic ℤ-lattice on V and a≠0 with −2a·det V not a square; put E=ℚ(√(−2a det V)). Unless θ(O⁺_A(L))⊆N_(E/ℚ)(I_E), which happens for a in at most finitely many square classes, the Siegel-weighted representation measure of a is the same for every spinor genus in gen L. Otherwise gen L splits into two half-genera with equally many spinor genera, and spinor genera in the same half-genus have equal measure. The same holds for primitive representations (Kneser 1961; Hsia 1976 for definite forms).

concept.title: Siegel lower bound for primitive representations by a ternary genus
concept.description: For a positive definite integral ternary ℤ-lattice L and ε>0 there is c=c(L,ε)>0, not effectively computable, such that the Siegel-weighted genus average r*(n,gen L) of primitive representation numbers satisfies r*(n,gen L)≥c n^(1/2−ε) for every positive integer n primitively represented by L_p at every prime p. It follows from Siegel’s product formula in local densities and Siegel’s bound L(1,χ)≫n^(−ε) for the quadratic character of ℚ(√(−n det L)).

concept.title: Maximal lattice of an anisotropic local quadratic space
concept.description: Let V be an anisotropic nondegenerate quadratic space over ℚ_p and a∈ℚ_p×. Then {x∈V:Q(x)∈aℤ_p} is a lattice, the unique (a)-maximal lattice on V. Consequently for every lattice L on V there is r₀ such that each x∈V with Q(x)∈p^(r₀+2s)ℤ_p lies in p^sL for all s≥0 (Eichler 1952, Satz 9.4; O’Meara 91:1).

concept.title: Jaulent’s Hilbertian description of the Hilbert kernel of K₂
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ), let K_n be the finite layers of its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K∞, Γ_n=Gal(K∞/K_n), and H_(K∞) the union of their Hilbertian radicals. Under Tate’s surjection (T_ℓ⊗ℛ_(K∞))^(Γ_n)→K₂(K_n)_ℓ, the subgroup (T_ℓ⊗H_(K∞))^(Γ_n) maps onto the ℓ-primary Hilbert kernel, the kernel of all Hilbert symbols at noncomplex places. It is exactly the subgroup of elements of infinite height in (T_ℓ⊗ℛ_(K∞))^(Γ_n); in particular it contains the maximal divisible subgroup.

concept.title: Kummer description of the Bertrandias–Payan radical in a cyclotomic tower
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ), let K_n be the finite layers of its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K∞, Γ_n=Gal(K∞/K_n), T̄_ℓ the dual of the Tate module, and H_(K∞) the union of their Hilbertian radicals. Then (T̄_ℓ⊗H_(K∞))^(Γ_n) is exactly the subgroup of elements of infinite height in (T̄_ℓ⊗ℛ_(K∞))^(Γ_n). By Kummer theory it is the radical over K∞ of the compositum of the cyclic ℓ-extensions of K_n that embed in cyclic ℓ-extensions of arbitrarily large degree; it contains the maximal divisible subgroup, the radical of the compositum of the ℤ_ℓ-extensions of K_n.

concept.title: Galois descent of Hilbertian radicals in a cyclotomic tower
concept.description: Let K contain μ_(2ℓ) and let K_n be the finite layers of its cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension K∞. Inside ℛ_(K∞), for m≥n the Hilbertian radical of K_m meets ℛ_(K_n) in the Hilbertian radical of K_n. Hence H_(K_n)=H_(K∞)^(Gal(K∞/K_n)), where H_(K∞) is the union of the H_(K_m).

concept.title: Open map between topological spaces
concept.description: A map f:X→Y between topological spaces is open if the image f(U) of every open subset U of X is open in Y.

concept.title: Uniquely ergodic topological dynamical system
concept.description: A compact topological dynamical system (X,T) is uniquely ergodic if X carries exactly one T-invariant Borel probability measure. For an action of a group of homeomorphisms the measure is required to be invariant under every element of the group.

concept.title: Ellis enveloping semigroup of a flow
concept.description: For a group T acting by homeomorphisms on a compact Hausdorff space X, the enveloping semigroup E(X) is the closure, in the product space X^X of all self-maps with pointwise convergence, of the maps x↦xt for t∈T. Under composition it is a compact semigroup, each evaluation p↦xp is continuous, and xE(X) is the orbit closure of x.

concept.title: Ellis’s characterization of distal flows by the enveloping semigroup
concept.description: A flow of a group T on a compact Hausdorff space X is distal if and only if its enveloping semigroup E(X) is a group; its elements are then bijections of X.

concept.title: Parry’s ergodicity criterion for nilrotations
concept.description: Let X=G/Γ be a compact nilmanifold of a nilpotent Lie group G, and let a finitely generated group act on X by left translations by elements of G. If N is the subgroup generated by the identity component of G and the translating elements, the action is ergodic for the Haar probability measure of X if and only if the induced action on the compact abelian group [N,N]∖X is ergodic.

concept.title: Minimal translations of compact abelian groups are ergodic
concept.description: If a group of translations of a compact abelian group Z has a dense orbit, so that the translation action is minimal, then it is ergodic for the Haar probability measure of Z.

concept.title: Lagrange interpolation formula
concept.description: For distinct elements x₀,…,x_n of a field K and any y₀,…,y_n∈K there is a unique polynomial P∈K[x] of degree at most n with P(x_i)=y_i, namely P(x)=∑_i y_i∏_(j≠i)(x−x_j)/(x_i−x_j). In particular a real polynomial of degree at most n taking rational values at n+1 rational points has rational coefficients.

concept.title: Coarea formula for Lipschitz maps
concept.description: Let f:ℝⁿ→ℝ^m be Lipschitz with n≥m and let Jf=√det(Df Dfᵀ) be its Jacobian, defined almost everywhere by Rademacher’s theorem. For every Lebesgue measurable g≥0, and for every integrable g, ∫_(ℝⁿ) g Jf dx=∫_(ℝ^m)∫_(f⁻¹(y)) g dH^(n−m) dy, where H^(n−m) is Hausdorff measure.

concept.title: Functor category
concept.description: For categories C and D, the functor category Fun(C,D) has functors C→D as objects and natural transformations as morphisms, composed componentwise. The presheaf category of C is Fun(C^op,Set), with Set the category of sets and functions; U↦Hom(−,U) defines the Yoneda functor C→Fun(C^op,Set).

concept.title: Category of finite-dimensional representations of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For an affine algebraic group G over a field k, Rep_k(G) has the finite-dimensional algebraic representations as objects and the G-equivariant k-linear maps as morphisms. It carries the tensor product V⊗W, on which g∈G(R) acts by r_V(g)⊗r_W(g), with unit the trivial one-dimensional representation k, and a forgetful functor to finite-dimensional k-vector spaces.

concept.title: Regular representation of an affine algebraic group
concept.description: For an affine algebraic group G over k, the (right) regular representation is the rational representation of G on its coordinate algebra O(G) given by (gf)(x)=f(xg), corresponding to the comodule structure Δ:O(G)→O(G)⊗O(G). Every finite-dimensional representation embeds into a finite direct sum of copies of it.

concept.title: Transfer homomorphism to a subgroup of finite index
concept.description: For a subgroup H of finite index in a group G with right coset representatives g₁,…,g_n, the transfer (Verlagerung) V:G→H/[H,H] sends g to ∏ᵢ gᵢ g φ(gᵢg)⁻¹, where φ(x) is the representative of Hx. It is a homomorphism independent of the representatives and induces G^ab→H^ab.

concept.title: Group-theoretic principal ideal theorem
concept.description: For a finite group G with commutator subgroup G′, the transfer homomorphism G/G′→G′/[G′,G′] is trivial. Conjectured by Artin and proved by Furtwängler (1930); simpler proofs are due to Iyanaga and Witt.

concept.title: Compatibility of the Artin map with extension of ideals and transfer
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite Galois extension of number fields and K⊆K′⊆L. For ideals 𝔞 of K prime to the ramification, the Artin symbol of the extended ideal 𝔞O_(K′) in Gal(L/K′)^ab is the transfer of the Artin symbol of 𝔞 in Gal(L/K)^ab (Artin).

concept.title: Opposite parabolic subgroups and the big cell
concept.description: For a parabolic k-subgroup P of a connected reductive k-group G there is a parabolic k-subgroup P⁻ opposite to P, i.e. P∩P⁻ is a Levi subgroup of both, and two such are conjugate by a unique element of R_u(P)(k). For opposite P and P⁻ the product map R_u(P⁻)×P→G is an isomorphism onto an open subvariety of G.

concept.title: Grothendieck’s theorem on maximal tori, splitting and density of rational points
concept.description: Let G be a connected algebraic group over a field k. Then G has a maximal torus defined over k. If G is reductive, it splits over a finite separable extension of k, and if moreover k is infinite then G(k) is Zariski dense in G (Grothendieck, SGA 3 XIV; Rosenlicht for perfect k).

concept.title: Normalizer theorem for parabolic subgroups
concept.description: Let P be a parabolic subgroup of a connected reductive group G over an algebraically closed field. Then P is its own normalizer, N_G(P)=P, and P is the only conjugate of P containing the unipotent radical R_u(P).

concept.title: Splitness of unipotent radicals of parabolic subgroups
concept.description: For a parabolic k-subgroup P of a connected reductive group G over a field k, the unipotent radical R_u(P) is defined over k and is k-split, i.e. it has a composition series of connected k-subgroups with successive quotients isomorphic to the additive group.

concept.title: Rational fixed points of split solvable group actions
concept.description: Let H be a connected k-split solvable algebraic group acting on a complete k-variety V. If V(k) is nonempty then H has a fixed point in V(k) (Rosenlicht; Borel–Tits 2.7). In particular every homogeneous space of H over k has a k-point.

concept.title: Representability of normalizers of smooth subgroup schemes with connected fibers
concept.description: Let G be a smooth affine group scheme over a scheme S and Y,Y′⊆G finitely presented closed subschemes with Y smooth with nonempty geometrically connected fibers. The transporter functor of Y into Y′ is represented by a finitely presented closed subscheme of G; in particular the normalizer N_G(Y) is a finitely presented closed subgroup scheme.

concept.title: Quotient of a group scheme by a self-normalizing smooth subgroup
concept.description: Let G→S be a smooth affine group scheme with connected fibers and H a smooth closed subgroup with connected fibers and H=N_G(H). The étale quotient sheaf G/H is a smooth S-scheme, quasi-projective Zariski-locally on S, equal to the functor of closed subgroups étale-locally conjugate to H. If every geometric fiber G_s/H_s is projective then G/H→S is proper with S-ample line bundle det(Lie ℋ)^∨ for the universal conjugate ℋ.

concept.title: Normal commutative ring
concept.description: A commutative ring R is normal if for every prime ideal 𝔭 the localization R_𝔭 is an integrally closed integral domain. A normal domain is a normal ring that is an integral domain.

concept.title: Normal scheme
concept.description: A scheme X is normal if for every point x the local ring O_(X,x) is an integrally closed integral domain.

concept.title: Regular local ring
concept.description: A Noetherian local ring (R,𝔪) with residue field κ=R/𝔪 is regular if dim_κ 𝔪/𝔪² equals the Krull dimension of R.

concept.title: Cohen–Macaulay local ring
concept.description: A Noetherian local ring (R,𝔪) is Cohen–Macaulay if its depth, the 𝔪-depth of R as a module over itself, equals its Krull dimension. A Noetherian ring is Cohen–Macaulay if all its localizations at prime ideals are, and a locally Noetherian scheme is Cohen–Macaulay if all its local rings are.

concept.title: Serre’s conditions (R_k) and (S_k)
concept.description: For an integer k≥0, a Noetherian ring R satisfies (R_k) if R_𝔭 is a regular local ring for every prime 𝔭 with dim R_𝔭≤k, and (S_k) if depth R_𝔭≥min(k, dim R_𝔭) for every prime 𝔭. A locally Noetherian scheme satisfies (R_k) or (S_k) if all its local rings satisfy the corresponding local condition; (R₁) is called regularity in codimension one.

concept.title: Reducedness criterion (R₀)+(S₁) for Noetherian rings
concept.description: A Noetherian ring is reduced if and only if it satisfies Serre’s conditions (R₀) and (S₁): its localizations at minimal primes are fields and every localization at a prime of positive height has positive depth.

concept.title: Characterizations of discrete valuation rings
concept.description: For a ring A the following are equivalent: A is a discrete valuation ring; A is a Noetherian valuation ring that is not a field; A is a regular local ring of dimension one; A is a Noetherian local domain whose maximal ideal is generated by one nonzero element; A is a one-dimensional Noetherian local normal domain. Then every nonzero element is uπⁿ with u a unit and π a generator of the maximal ideal.

concept.title: Kollár’s alternative for Noetherian local rings of depth less than two
concept.description: For a Noetherian local ring (R,𝔪) exactly one of the following holds: R is Artinian; R is regular of dimension one; depth R≥2; or there is a finite ring map R→R′ with R′≠0, not an isomorphism, whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of 𝔪, such that 𝔪 is not an associated prime of R′.

concept.title: Normality of reduced rings with finitely many minimal primes
concept.description: For a reduced ring R with finitely many minimal primes the following are equivalent: R is normal; R is integrally closed in its total ring of fractions Q(R), the localization at the set of nonzerodivisors; R is a finite product of normal domains.

concept.title: Support criterion for annihilation by a power of an ideal
concept.description: For a finitely generated module M over a Noetherian ring R and an ideal I, some power Iⁿ annihilates M if and only if the support of M, the set of primes 𝔭 with M_𝔭≠0, is contained in V(I), the set of primes containing I.

concept.title: Pullback of a quasi-coherent sheaf along a morphism of schemes
concept.description: For a morphism f:X→Y of schemes and a quasi-coherent O_Y-module G, the pullback f*G is the quasi-coherent O_X-module such that, whenever Spec A⊆X and Spec B⊆Y are affine opens with f(Spec A)⊆Spec B and G|_(Spec B)≅M̃, one has f*G|_(Spec A)≅(M⊗_B A)~. It is compatible with composition, (g∘f)*≅f*g*, and with tensor products, and it sends invertible sheaves to invertible sheaves.

concept.title: Theorem of the square for invertible sheaves on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an invertible sheaf L on an abelian variety A over a field k and points a,b∈A(k), t_(a+b)*L⊗L≅t_a*L⊗t_b*L, where t_a:A→A is translation by a.

concept.title: Cartier divisor on an integral scheme
concept.description: Let X be an integral scheme with function field K, the local ring at its generic point. A Cartier divisor D is given by an open cover {U_i} and nonzero f_i∈K with f_i/f_j a unit of O_X(U_i∩U_j), two such data being identified when their local equations differ by units on a common refinement; f_i is a local equation of D on U_i. Divisors form an abelian group, written additively, under multiplication of local equations. D is effective if its local equations can be chosen in O_X(U_i), its support is the closed set of points where a local equation is not a unit, the principal divisor div(f) of f∈K× has the single local equation f, and D,D′ are linearly equivalent, D∼D′, if D−D′ is principal.

concept.title: Invariance of intersection numbers of divisors under linear equivalence
concept.description: Let V be a smooth projective variety of dimension g over an algebraically closed field k, D₁,…,D_(g−1) divisors and D∼D′ linearly equivalent divisors such that both (D₁,…,D_(g−1),D) and (D₁,…,D_(g−1),D′) have finite common support. Then ∑_v(D₁⋯D_(g−1)·D)_v=∑_v(D₁⋯D_(g−1)·D′)_v, where for effective divisors with local equations f₁,…,f_g at an isolated common point v the local multiplicity is dim_k O_(V,v)/(f₁,…,f_g), extended multilinearly to differences of effective divisors.

concept.title: Theorem of the cube
concept.description: Let U, V, W be complete varieties over a field k with k-points u₀, v₀, w₀. An invertible sheaf on U×V×W whose restrictions to {u₀}×V×W, U×{v₀}×W and U×V×{w₀} are trivial is itself trivial.

concept.title: Closed-immersion criterion by separation of points and tangent vectors
concept.description: Let X be a proper scheme over an algebraically closed field k and V⊆H⁰(X,L) a finite-dimensional space of sections of an invertible sheaf with no base points. The induced morphism X→P(V^∨) is a closed immersion if and only if V separates points (for distinct closed points x,y some member of |V| contains x but not y) and separates tangent vectors (for every closed point x and nonzero tangent vector t at x some member through x does not contain t in its tangent space).

concept.title: Tensor products of ample invertible sheaves are ample
concept.description: On a scheme of finite type over a field, the tensor product of two ample invertible sheaves is ample; more generally L⊗M is ample when L is ample and M is generated by its global sections.

concept.title: Finite length of quotients by ideals containing a power of the maximal ideal
concept.description: If (O,𝔪) is a Noetherian local ring and 𝔞 an ideal containing 𝔪^r for some r>0, then O/𝔞 is an O-module of finite length.

concept.title: Length formula for principal ideals in one-dimensional local rings
concept.description: Let O be a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring with minimal primes 𝔭₁,…,𝔭_n and a∈O a nonzerodivisor lying in no 𝔭_i. Then ℓ_O(O/aO)=∑_i ℓ_(O_(𝔭_i))(O_(𝔭_i))·ℓ_O(O/(𝔭_i+aO)), lengths as modules.

concept.title: Semilocal ring of finitely many nonsingular points of a curve
