concept.description: For finitely many nonsingular points x₁,…,x_r of an irreducible curve, the intersection Õ of their local rings in the function field is a principal ideal domain with exactly r maximal ideals; there are t_i∈Õ with v_(x_i)(t_j)=δ_ij, and every nonzero u∈Õ is t₁^(k₁)⋯t_r^(k_r)·v with k_i=v_(x_i)(u) and v a unit of Õ.

concept.title: Normalization of a projective curve is projective
concept.description: For an irreducible projective curve C over an algebraically closed field, its normalization ν:C^ν→C, the finite birational morphism from the normal curve obtained by integral closure of the local rings in the function field, has C^ν a nonsingular projective curve.

concept.title: Abscissa of absolute convergence of a Dirichlet series
concept.description: For a Dirichlet series ∑a_n n^(−s), its abscissa of absolute convergence σ_a∈[−∞,+∞] is the infimum of the real numbers σ for which ∑|a_n|n^(−σ) converges. The series converges absolutely for Re s>σ_a and for no s with Re s<σ_a.

concept.title: Minimal discriminant ideal of an elliptic curve over a number field
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over a number field K, the minimal discriminant 𝔇_(E/K) is the integral ideal ∏_v 𝔭_v^(ord_v(Δ_v)) of O_K, the product over the finite places v, where 𝔭_v={x∈O_K:|x|_v<1} and Δ_v is the discriminant of a minimal integral Weierstrass model of E over the completion K_v. Almost all exponents are zero.

concept.title: Roth’s theorem over a number field
concept.description: Let K be a number field, v a place of K with its absolute value extended to an algebraic closure, α algebraic over K, ε>0 and C>0. Then only finitely many x∈K satisfy |x−α|_v<C·H_K(x)^(−2−ε), where H_K is the relative multiplicative height on K. Over ℚ with the real absolute value this is Roth’s irrationality-exponent theorem.

concept.title: Compactness of the points of a projective variety over a local field
concept.description: For a local field F (ℝ, ℂ or a nonarchimedean local field), ℙⁿ(F) with the quotient topology from Fⁿ⁺¹∖{0} is compact. Hence for a projective variety X over F, the set X(F), closed in ℙⁿ(F), is compact in its F-adic topology.

concept.title: Banks–Freiberg–Maynard exceptional-character lemma for smooth moduli
concept.description: There is an absolute c>0 such that for T≥3 and P≥T^(1/log log T), among all primitive Dirichlet characters χ mod q with q≤T and largest prime factor P⁺(q)≤P, at most one has L(s,χ) vanishing in the region Re s>1−c/log P, |Im s|≤exp(log P/√(log T)). If such χ exists it is real, L(s,χ) has a single simple real zero there, and P⁺(q)≫log q≫log log T. It rests on Chang’s character-sum bound for smooth moduli.

concept.title: Banks–Freiberg–Maynard modified Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem
concept.description: Fix C>0 and θ=1/2−δ∈(0,1/2). For ε>0 small enough in terms of C, δ and the exceptional-character constant, let q₀<N^ε be squarefree with P⁺(q₀)<N^(ε/log log N), and let Z be the largest prime factor of the possible exceptional modulus at level N^(2ε) (Z=1 if none). Then ∑ over q<N^θ with q₀|q and (q,Z)=1 of max_((a,q)=1)|ψ(N;q,a)−ψ(N)/φ(q)| is ≪_(δ,C) N/(φ(q₀)(log N)^C).

concept.title: Banks–Freiberg–Maynard sieve estimates for Maynard–Tao weights on varying tuples
concept.description: Let H={h₁,…,h_k} be admissible with 0≤h_i≤N and with every prime factor of ∏(h_j−h_i) at most w=ε log N, let W be the product of the primes ≤w other than the exceptional prime, and b a residue with each b+h_i coprime to W. For weights w(n)=∑_(d_i|n+h_i)λ_d with λ_d=∏μ(d_i)·∑_j∏_ℓF_(ℓ,j)(log d_ℓ/log N), supported on ∏d_i≤N^δ coprime to the exceptional prime, sums over N<n≤2N, n≡b (mod W) satisfy ∑w(n)²∼(N/W)B^(−k)I_k(F), ∑1_P(n+h_j)w(n)²∼(N/W)B^(−k)J_k(F), and ∑1_P(n+h_j)1_P(n+h_ℓ)w(n)²≤(4+O(δ))(N/W)B^(−k)L_k(F) for j≠ℓ, where B=φ(W)log N/W and I_k,J_k,L_k are the usual integrals of the symmetric function F=∑_j∏_ℓF′_(ℓ,j).

concept.title: Banks–Freiberg–Maynard Erdős–Rankin-type tuple construction
concept.description: Fix k and β_k≥…≥β₁≥0. For y large in terms of β and k, numbers x≥1 and z with 2y(1+(1+β_k)x)≤2z≤y·log log y/log log log y, and any set Z of primes with ∑_(p∈Z,p≥p′)1/p≪1/p′≪1/log z for p′∈Z, there are residues a_p (p≤y, p∉Z) and an admissible k-tuple {h₁,…,h_k} that is exactly the set of integers in (0,z] lying in no class a_p mod p. Moreover p|(h_j−h_i) implies p≤y, and h_i=β_ixy+y+O(y·exp(−(log y)^(1/4))).

concept.title: Approximately divisible dimension group with order unit
concept.description: A dimension group G with order unit u is approximately divisible if no extreme point σ of the normalized trace space S(G,u) has discrete image σ(G) in ℝ; equivalently (Goodearl–Handelman), the affine representation G→Aff S(G,u) has norm-dense image. Simple dimension groups other than ℤ are approximately divisible.

concept.title: Kernel of a group homomorphism
concept.description: For a group homomorphism f:G→H, the subgroup ker f={g∈G: f(g)=e_H} of elements sent to the identity.

concept.title: Refinable set of traces on an ordered abelian group with order unit
concept.description: For a partially ordered abelian group G with order unit u and a set U⊆S(G,u) of normalized traces, U is refinable if whenever b,a′₁,…,a′_n∈G⁺ satisfy τ(b)=∑ᵢτ(a′ᵢ) for every τ∈U, there are aᵢ∈G⁺ with b=∑ᵢaᵢ and τ(aᵢ)=τ(a′ᵢ) for every τ∈U and every i. For U={τ} this is refinability of τ.

concept.title: Good set of traces on an ordered abelian group with order unit
concept.description: For a partially ordered abelian group G with order unit u and U⊆S(G,u), U is good if whenever a∈G and b∈G⁺ satisfy τ(b)−τ(a)≥δ for some δ>0 and all τ∈U, there is c∈G⁺ with c≤b and τ(c)=τ(a) for all τ∈U. For a singleton this is goodness of the trace; it differs from goodness of U relative to Aff S(G,u).

concept.title: Riesz interpolation property for an ordered abelian group
concept.description: A partially ordered abelian group has Riesz interpolation if whenever a₁,a₂≤b₁,b₂ there is c with a₁,a₂≤c≤b₁,b₂.

concept.title: Order units of an unperforated group are detected by normalized traces
concept.description: Let G be an unperforated partially ordered abelian group with order unit u. An element g∈G is an order unit exactly when σ(g)>0 for every normalized trace σ∈S(G,u); without unperforation, strict positivity on S(G,u) only makes some multiple of g an order unit (Goodearl).

concept.title: Equivalence of Riesz interpolation, decomposition and refinement
concept.description: For a partially ordered abelian group the following are equivalent: Riesz interpolation; Riesz decomposition (0≤a≤b+c with b,c≥0 gives a=b₁+c₁ with 0≤b₁≤b, 0≤c₁≤c); and Riesz refinement (a₁+a₂=b₁+b₂ with all terms ≥0 gives c_ij≥0 with a_i=∑_jc_ij and b_j=∑_ic_ij) (Goodearl, Proposition 2.1).

concept.title: Choquet simplex of states of an interpolation group with order unit
concept.description: If G is a partially ordered abelian group with Riesz interpolation and order unit u, its normalized state (trace) space S(G,u), a compact convex subset of ℝ^G in the topology of pointwise convergence, is a Choquet simplex (Goodearl, Theorem 10.17).

concept.title: Cofiniteness of an additive semigroup of positive integers with gcd one
concept.description: If a set S of positive integers is closed under addition and the greatest common divisor of its elements is 1, then S contains every sufficiently large integer.

concept.title: Cauchy–Riemann equations for a complex differentiable function
concept.description: If f=u+iv is complex differentiable at z₀=x₀+iy₀, its partial derivatives exist there and satisfy f_x=−i f_y, that is u_x=v_y and u_y=−v_x, with f′(z₀)=f_x(z₀). Conversely, if f_x and f_y exist near z₀, are continuous at z₀ and satisfy f_x=−i f_y there, then f is complex differentiable at z₀.

concept.title: Segment chains in open connected subsets of the plane
concept.description: Any two points of an open connected subset G of ℂ can be joined by a finite chain of horizontal and vertical line segments lying in G; in particular G is path connected. Conversely, a subset of ℂ in which any two points are joined by a path is connected.

concept.title: Continuity of sums and products of real functions on ℝⁿ
concept.description: If f and g are real functions continuous on a set S⊆ℝⁿ, then f+g, f−g and fg are continuous on S, and f/g is continuous at each point of S where g≠0. Since the coordinate functions are continuous, every real polynomial function on ℝⁿ is continuous.

concept.title: Arc-length integral formula for C¹ curves
concept.description: If γ:[a,b]→ℝⁿ is continuously differentiable, its length (the supremum of inscribed polygon lengths) is finite and equals ∫_a^b|γ′(t)|dt. Summing over pieces gives the same formula for piecewise C¹ curves.

concept.title: Watson’s lemma for Laplace integrals in a complex sector
concept.description: Let q on (0,∞) have finitely many discontinuities and infinities, with q(t)∼∑_{s≥0}a_s t^{(s+λ−μ)/μ} as t→0⁺ for some μ>0 and Re λ>0, and let ∫_0^∞e^{−zt}q(t)dt converge for some z. Then this Laplace integral satisfies I(z)∼∑_{s≥0}Γ((s+λ)/μ)a_s z^{−(s+λ)/μ} as z→∞ uniformly in |arg z|≤π/2−δ, for each δ>0, with principal powers.

concept.title: Derivatives of order estimates for holomorphic functions in sectors
concept.description: If f is holomorphic in a region containing a closed annular sector S and f(z)=O(z^ρ) (or o(z^ρ)) as z→∞ in S, then f^{(m)}(z)=O(z^{ρ−m}) (respectively o(z^{ρ−m})) as z→∞ in every closed annular sector properly interior to S with the same vertex. Hence asymptotic power-type expansions of such f may be differentiated termwise in interior subsectors.

concept.title: Mutually singular measures
concept.description: Two measures μ and ν on the same measurable space are mutually singular, ν⊥μ, if there is a measurable set B with μ(B)=0 and ν(X∖B)=0, so that they are concentrated on disjoint sets.

concept.title: Lebesgue decomposition of Radon measures on Euclidean space
concept.description: If μ and ν are Radon measures on ℝⁿ, then ν=ν_ac+ν_s for Radon measures ν_ac≪μ and ν_s⊥μ, called the absolutely continuous and singular parts of ν with respect to μ. Applied to positive and negative parts, signed and matrix-valued Radon measures decompose entrywise.

concept.title: Aleksandrov Hessian of a convex function
concept.description: Let φ be convex on ℝⁿ and differentiable at an interior point x₀ of its domain. A symmetric n×n matrix A is the Aleksandrov Hessian ∇²φ(x₀) if sup_(y∈∂φ(x))|y−∇φ(x₀)−A(x−x₀)|=o(|x−x₀|) as x→x₀, where ∂φ is the subdifferential.

concept.title: Cyclically monotone subset of ℝᵈ×ℝᵈ
concept.description: A set S⊆ℝᵈ×ℝᵈ is cyclically monotone if for all finitely many (x₁,y₁),…,(x_k,y_k)∈S one has ⟨y₁,x₂−x₁⟩+⟨y₂,x₃−x₂⟩+⋯+⟨y_k,x₁−x_k⟩≤0; equivalently ∑|x_i−y_i|²≤∑|x_i−y_(i−1)|² cyclically.

concept.title: Rockafellar’s theorem on cyclically monotone sets
concept.description: A nonempty set S⊆ℝᵈ×ℝᵈ is cyclically monotone if and only if it is contained in the subdifferential of a proper lower semicontinuous convex function on ℝᵈ; maximal cyclically monotone sets are exactly such subdifferentials.

concept.title: Krein–Milman theorem
concept.description: In a locally convex Hausdorff topological vector space, every compact convex set is the closed convex hull of its extreme points.

concept.title: Hausdorff dimension
concept.description: The Hausdorff dimension of a subset A of a metric space is inf{s≥0: H^s(A)=0}, equivalently sup{s: H^s(A)=∞}, where H^s is s-dimensional Hausdorff measure.

concept.title: Anderson–Klee theorem on nondifferentiability of convex functions
concept.description: The set of points in the interior of its domain where a convex function on ℝᵈ is not differentiable has Hausdorff dimension at most d−1; in particular it is Lebesgue null.

concept.title: Max formula for directional derivatives of a convex function
concept.description: If φ is convex on ℝᵈ and finite near p, then ∂φ(p) is nonempty, convex and compact, and the one-sided directional derivative is φ′(p;v)=lim_(h↓0)(φ(p+hv)−φ(p))/h=max_(y∈∂φ(p))⟨y,v⟩.

concept.title: Convergence of subgradients at a point of differentiability
concept.description: Let φ be convex on ℝᵈ and x in the interior of its domain. Then φ is differentiable at x if and only if ∂φ(x) is the single point ∇φ(x), and in that case y_n→∇φ(x) whenever x_n→x and y_n∈∂φ(x_n).

concept.title: Hausdorff measure of a Lipschitz image
concept.description: If g is a Lipschitz map between metric spaces with constant k and A is a subset of its domain, then H^s(g(A))≤k^s H^s(A) for every s≥0.

concept.title: Aleksandrov’s theorem on second differentiability of convex functions
concept.description: A convex function φ on ℝⁿ has a second-order expansion φ(y)=φ(x)+∇φ(x)·(y−x)+½(y−x)ᵀA(x)(y−x)+o(|y−x|²) at Lebesgue-almost every interior point x of its domain, where A(x) is the density of the absolutely continuous part of the matrix measure D∇φ; A(x) is the Aleksandrov Hessian at x.

concept.title: Restriction of a Radon measure to a measurable set
concept.description: If μ is a Borel regular measure on ℝⁿ and A is μ-measurable with μ(A)<∞, or A is Borel and μ is Radon, then the restriction μ⌊A(B)=μ(A∩B) is a Radon measure.

concept.title: Modulus of a number field
concept.description: A modulus of a number field F is a formal product 𝔪=𝔪₀𝔪_∞ of a nonzero ideal 𝔪₀ of the ring of integers O_F and a set 𝔪_∞ of real places of F. A prime 𝔭 divides 𝔪 if it divides 𝔪₀, and a real place divides 𝔪 if it lies in 𝔪_∞.

concept.title: Ray class group of a number field
concept.description: For a modulus 𝔪=𝔪₀𝔪_∞ of a number field F, let I^𝔪 be the group of fractional ideals whose prime factorization involves no prime dividing 𝔪₀, and P_(𝔪,1)⊆I^𝔪 the subgroup of principal ideals aO_F with a∈F× such that ord_𝔭(a−1)≥ord_𝔭(𝔪₀) for every 𝔭|𝔪₀ and σ(a)>0 for every real place σ in 𝔪_∞. The ray class group is Cl_𝔪(F)=I^𝔪/P_(𝔪,1); for 𝔪=1 it is the ideal class group.

concept.title: Artin map of a finite abelian extension of number fields
concept.description: Let L/F be a finite abelian extension of number fields and 𝔪 a modulus of F divisible by every prime of F that ramifies in L. The Artin map ψ_(L/F):I^𝔪→Gal(L/F) is the homomorphism on the group of fractional ideals prime to 𝔪₀ sending each prime 𝔭∤𝔪₀ to its Frobenius element in Gal(L/F), extended multiplicatively through prime factorization.

concept.title: Ray class field of a number field
concept.description: For a modulus 𝔪=𝔪₀𝔪_∞ of a number field F, a ray class field modulo 𝔪 is a finite abelian extension F_𝔪 of F in a fixed algebraic closure, unramified at every prime not dividing 𝔪₀ and at every real place not in 𝔪_∞ (such places stay real), whose Artin map I^𝔪→Gal(F_𝔪/F) is surjective with kernel P_(𝔪,1).

concept.title: Modular curves X₁(N)→X₀(N) over ℤ[1/N]
concept.description: For an integer N≥5, X₁(N) over ℤ[1/N] is the Deligne–Rapoport compactification by cusps of the moduli scheme Y₁(N) of elliptic curves E over ℤ[1/N]-schemes with a point P of exact order N, and X₀(N) over ℤ[1/N] that of the coarse moduli scheme Y₀(N) of pairs (E,C) with C a cyclic subgroup scheme of order N; their generic fibres are the modular curves over ℚ, with complex points Γ₁(N)\ℍ* and Γ₀(N)\ℍ*. The rule (E,P)↦(E,⟨P⟩) gives a finite morphism X₁(N)→X₀(N), and d∈(ℤ/Nℤ)× acts on X₁(N) over X₀(N) by the diamond operator (E,P)↦(E,dP), with d=−1 acting trivially.

concept.title: Galois covering of normal integral schemes
concept.description: A finite surjective morphism f:Y→X of normal integral schemes is a Galois covering with group G if the finite group G acts on Y by automorphisms over X and the induced action on function fields makes K(Y)/K(X) a Galois extension with Galois group G. It is cyclic of degree n if G is cyclic of order n.

concept.title: Ramification of X₁(N)→X₀(N) at prime level
concept.description: Let N≥5 be prime and k an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from N. The Galois covering X₁(N)→X₀(N) over k, with group (ℤ/Nℤ)×/{±1}, is unramified at the cusps and at every point with j≠0,1728; it is ramified exactly at the points of X₀(N) with j=1728 when N≡1 mod 4, with inertia cyclic of order 2, and with j=0 when N≡1 mod 3, with inertia cyclic of order 3 (wildly ramified of first type in characteristics 2 and 3).

concept.title: Sylow theorems for finite groups
concept.description: Let G be a finite group and p a prime with |G|=p^a·m, p∤m. Then G has a subgroup of order p^a; any two such Sylow p-subgroups are conjugate, every p-subgroup of G lies in one, and their number n_p divides m and satisfies n_p≡1 (mod p).

concept.title: Degeneracy maps between modular curves X₀(N)→X₀(M)
concept.description: For positive integers d and M with dM|N, the degeneracy map B_d:X₀(N)→X₀(M) over ℚ sends an elliptic curve E with cyclic subgroup C of order N to E/C[d] with the subgroup of order M of the image of C, C[d] being the subgroup of order d of C. It extends to the compactified curves, and on the upper half-plane it is induced by τ↦dτ.

concept.title: New quotient J₀(N)^new of the Jacobian of X₀(N)
concept.description: Let J₀(N) be the Jacobian of X₀(N) over ℚ. Its old subvariety is the abelian subvariety generated by the images of the homomorphisms J₀(M)→J₀(N) induced by pullback of divisors along the degeneracy maps B_d:X₀(N)→X₀(M), for all M|N with M<N and d|N/M. The new quotient J₀(N)^new is the quotient of J₀(N) by its old subvariety.

concept.title: Optimal quotient of an abelian variety
concept.description: An optimal quotient of an abelian variety J over a field k is a surjective homomorphism J→A onto an abelian variety A whose kernel is connected, hence an abelian subvariety B, so that A≅J/B. An optimal quotient of a quotient J→J′ is a composite J→J′→A with J′→A optimal.

concept.title: Formal immersion of schemes at a point
concept.description: A morphism f:X→Y of noetherian schemes of finite type is a formal immersion at x∈X if the induced map of completed local rings Ô_(Y,f(x))→Ô_(X,x) is surjective; equivalently f induces an isomorphism of residue fields k(f(x))≅k(x) and is formally unramified at x.

concept.title: Mazur’s formal immersion of X₀(N) into an optimal new quotient at the cusp ∞
concept.description: Let m be the largest square dividing N, J₀(N)→A a nontrivial optimal quotient of the new quotient J₀(N)^new, and f the morphism over ℤ[1/m] from the smooth locus of the minimal regular model of X₀(N) to the Néron model of A extending x↦class of (x)−(∞). Then f is a formal immersion along the cusp section ∞ in every residue characteristic p≠2.

concept.title: Raynaud’s specialization lemma for finite flat group schemes
concept.description: Let R be a discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic (0,p) whose absolute ramification index e satisfies e<p−1, and G a finite flat commutative group scheme over R. Then every x∈G(R) has the same order as its reduction in G(k), k the residue field. More generally a homomorphism of finite flat R-group schemes that is injective on generic fibres is a closed immersion.

concept.title: Deligne–Rapoport model of X₀(N) over ℤ
concept.description: The Deligne–Rapoport compactified coarse moduli scheme X₀(N)/ℤ of generalized elliptic curves with a Γ₀(N)-structure is a proper flat curve over ℤ with generic fibre X₀(N)/ℚ, smooth over ℤ[1/N]. The cusps 0 and ∞ extend to ℤ-sections in its smooth locus, the j-map to ℙ¹_ℤ has the cuspidal locus as preimage of j=∞, and the Tate curve identifies the formal completion along ∞ with Spf ℤ[[q]].

concept.title: De Rham property of the p-adic Tate module of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a finite extension K of ℚ_p, the rational p-adic Tate module V_pA is a de Rham representation of G_K (Fontaine), and D_dR(V_pA)/Fil⁰D_dR(V_pA) is identified with the tangent space of A at the origin.

concept.title: Bloch–Kato exponential map
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a de Rham representation V of G_K, the Bloch–Kato exponential exp:D_dR(V)/Fil⁰D_dR(V)→H¹(K,V) is the connecting map of the fundamental exact sequence 0→ℚ_p→B_cris^(φ=1)⊕B_dR⁺→B_dR→0 tensored with V. Its image is H¹_e(K,V)⊆H¹_f(K,V), and H¹_f(K,V)/H¹_e(K,V)≅D_cris(V)/(1−φ)D_cris(V).

concept.title: Compatibility of the Bloch–Kato exponential with the exponential of a formal group
concept.description: Let K be a finite extension of ℚ_p and G a commutative formal Lie group of finite height over O_K with rational Tate module V. Then V is de Rham, D_dR(V)/Fil⁰ is the tangent space of G_K, and the Bloch–Kato exponential agrees with the classical exponential tan(G_K)→G(O_K)⊗ℚ followed by the Kummer coboundary G(O_K)⊗ℚ→H¹(K,V); in particular H¹_e(K,V)=H¹_f(K,V).

concept.title: Grothendieck’s semistable reduction theorem for abelian varieties
concept.description: An abelian variety over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring acquires semistable reduction after a finite separable extension: the identity component of the special fibre of its Néron model becomes an extension of an abelian variety by a torus.

concept.title: Weil’s Riemann hypothesis for abelian varieties over finite fields
concept.description: For an abelian variety B over 𝔽_q and a prime ℓ∤q, the eigenvalues of the q-power Frobenius on the Tate module T_ℓB are algebraic integers all of whose complex conjugates have absolute value q^(1/2). In particular 1 is not an eigenvalue.

concept.title: Mattuck’s theorem on points of an abelian variety over a p-adic field
concept.description: For an abelian variety A of dimension d over a finite extension K of ℚ_p, the group A(K) is compact and contains an open subgroup of finite index isomorphic to ℤ_p^(d[K:ℚ_p]), given by the formal group logarithm. Hence A(K) has no nonzero divisible elements and A(K)⊗ℚ_ℓ=0 for ℓ≠p.

concept.title: Eisenstein ideal of the Hecke algebra of prime level
concept.description: For a prime N, let 𝕋⊂End(J₀(N)) be Mazur’s Hecke algebra, the subring generated by the Hecke operators T_ℓ (ℓ≠N) and the Atkin–Lehner involution w. The Eisenstein ideal 𝔍⊂𝕋 is generated by 1+ℓ−T_ℓ for all primes ℓ≠N and by 1+w; the prime ideals of 𝕋 containing 𝔍 are the Eisenstein primes.

concept.title: Eisenstein quotient of J₀(N) at prime level
concept.description: For a prime N with Hecke algebra 𝕋 and Eisenstein ideal 𝔍, let γ_𝔍 be the kernel of the map from 𝕋 to its 𝔍-adic completion and γ_𝔍J₀(N) the abelian subvariety generated by the images αJ₀(N), α∈γ_𝔍. Mazur’s Eisenstein quotient is J̃=J₀(N)/γ_𝔍J₀(N), an optimal quotient of J₀(N) over ℚ on which 𝕋 acts through the components of Spec 𝕋 meeting the support of 𝔍.

concept.title: Cuspidal subgroup of J₀(N) at prime level
concept.description: For a prime N, the cusps 0 and ∞ of X₀(N) are ℚ-rational, and the cuspidal subgroup C⊂J₀(N)(ℚ) is the subgroup generated by the class of the degree-zero divisor (0)−(∞).

concept.title: Rational torsion of J₀(N) and its Eisenstein quotient at prime level
concept.description: For a prime N, the rational torsion of J₀(N) is its cuspidal subgroup C (Ogg’s conjecture, proved by Mazur), and the natural projections induce isomorphisms C=J₀(N)(ℚ)_tors→J⁻(ℚ)_tors→J̃(ℚ)_tors, where J⁻=J₀(N)/(1+w)J₀(N) and J̃ is the Eisenstein quotient.

concept.title: Mazur’s admissible group schemes over ℤ
concept.description: For a prime N, put S=Spec ℤ and S′=Spec ℤ[1/N]. An admissible p-group over S is a commutative quasi-finite separated flat S-group scheme, finite flat over S′ and killed by a power of p, whose restriction to S′ has a filtration by finite flat subgroup schemes with successive quotients isomorphic to ℤ/p or µ_p.

concept.title: Mazur’s flat-cohomology bound for admissible groups
concept.description: For an admissible p-group G over S=Spec ℤ, write hⁱ(G)=log_p#Hⁱ_fppf(S,G), δ(G) for its defect (log_p of the order of G over S′ minus log_p of the order of its fibre at N) and α(G) for the number of constituents ℤ/p in an admissible filtration. Then h¹(G)−h⁰(G)≤δ(G)−α(G).

concept.title: Admissibility of Eisenstein torsion in J₀(N)
concept.description: For a prime N and a maximal ideal 𝔓 of Mazur’s Hecke algebra 𝕋, the Jordan–Hölder constituents of the Galois module J₀(N)[𝔓] are one-dimensional over 𝕋/𝔓 exactly when 𝔓 is an Eisenstein prime; in that case the closure of J₀(N)[𝔓^r] in the Néron model is an admissible group scheme for every r.

concept.title: Rank-one Tate modules of J₀(N) over completed Hecke algebras
concept.description: For a prime N and a maximal ideal 𝔓 of 𝕋 of residue characteristic p≠N, let J_𝔓 be the 𝔓-component of the p-divisible group of the Néron model of J₀(N). The Tate modules of the toric part of its fibre at N and of the corresponding defect module are 𝕋_𝔓-modules of rank one; if J_𝔓 is ordinary at p (as when T_p∉𝔓, e.g. for Eisenstein primes), the Tate modules of its étale and multiplicative parts are 𝕋_𝔓-modules of rank one.

concept.title: Fppf cohomology of a commutative group scheme
concept.description: For a scheme S and a commutative S-group scheme G, the fppf cohomology groups Hⁱ_fppf(S,G) are the derived-functor cohomology groups of the sheaf represented by G on the big fppf site of S, whose coverings are jointly surjective families of flat morphisms locally of finite presentation. Short exact sequences of fppf sheaves, such as 0→G[n]→G→G→0 for n surjective, give long exact cohomology sequences.

concept.title: P-divisible (Barsotti–Tate) group
concept.description: For a prime p and a scheme S, a p-divisible group of height h over S is an inductive system of finite locally free commutative S-group schemes G_ν of order p^(νh) with closed immersions identifying G_ν with the p^ν-torsion of G_(ν+1). For an abelian scheme A over S, A[p^∞]=(A[p^ν])_ν is p-divisible of height 2 dim A.

concept.title: Decomposition of the p-adic completion of a finite ℤ-algebra
concept.description: Let T be a commutative ring finitely generated as a ℤ-module and p a prime. Then T⊗ℤ_p is the product of the completions T_𝔪 of T at the finitely many maximal ideals 𝔪 containing p, the factors being cut out by orthogonal idempotents e_𝔪 with ∑e_𝔪=1.

concept.title: Support of a module over a commutative ring
concept.description: The support of a module M over a commutative ring A is the set of prime ideals 𝔭 of A containing the annihilator ideal Ann(x) of some x∈M, equivalently those with localization M_𝔭≠0. For finitely generated M it is the closed subset V(Ann M) of Spec A.

concept.title: Torsion of positive-degree cohomology of a profinite group
concept.description: For a profinite group G and a discrete G-module M, the cohomology groups Hⁱ(G,M) are torsion for all i≥1, being direct limits of cohomology groups of finite quotients G/U, each killed by the order of G/U.

concept.title: Standard Néron n-gon
concept.description: For n≥1 and a base ring R, the standard n-gon over R is obtained from n copies of ℙ¹_R indexed by ℤ/n by gluing the section ∞ of the i-th copy to the section 0 of the (i+1)-th; for n=1 it is ℙ¹_R with 0 and ∞ identified, the nodal cubic. Its smooth locus is 𝔾_m×ℤ/n, a commutative group scheme acting on the polygon by rotations, and µ_n⊂𝔾_m lies in it.

concept.title: Generalized elliptic curve (Deligne–Rapoport)
concept.description: A generalized elliptic curve over a scheme S is a proper flat morphism E→S of finite presentation whose geometric fibres are either smooth connected curves of genus one or standard Néron polygons, together with a morphism E^sm×_S E→E that makes the smooth locus E^sm a commutative S-group scheme and is an action of E^sm on E inducing rotations on the singular geometric fibres.

concept.title: Tate curve over ℤ[[q]]
concept.description: The Tate curve Tate(q) is the generalized elliptic curve over ℤ[[q]] given by y²+xy=x³+a₄(q)x+a₆(q) with a₄=−5∑_(n≥1)σ₃(n)qⁿ and a₆=−∑_(n≥1)(5σ₃(n)+7σ₅(n))/12·qⁿ (integral coefficients), whose discriminant is q∏_(n≥1)(1−qⁿ)²⁴. Its fibre over ℤ((q)) is an elliptic curve, its fibre at q=0 is the standard 1-gon, and µ_N⊂𝔾_m in that fibre extends to a closed subgroup scheme µ_N↪Tate(q)^sm.

concept.title: Formal completion of a scheme along a closed subscheme
concept.description: For a locally noetherian scheme X and a closed subscheme Z with ideal sheaf ℐ, the formal completion X̂_Z is the topological space of Z with the sheaf of rings lim←O_X/ℐⁿ. For X=Spec A and Z=V(I) it is the formal spectrum Spf Â of the I-adic completion; e.g. the completion of the affine line over ℤ along its zero section is Spf ℤ[[q]].

concept.title: Cartier dual of a finite Galois module
concept.description: For a field K of characteristic zero with algebraic closure K̄, and a finite discrete G_K-module M, the Cartier (Tate) dual is M′=Hom(M,μ), the group of homomorphisms from M to the roots of unity μ⊂K̄^×, with G_K acting by (g·f)(m)=g(f(g⁻¹m)). It is a finite discrete G_K-module of the same order as M. If K is a number field, M is a G_(K,S)-module and S contains the places above the primes dividing #M, then M′ is again a G_(K,S)-module.

concept.title: Invariant isomorphism for the Brauer group of a local field
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k with separable closure k̄, there is a canonical isomorphism inv_k:H²(G_k,k̄^×)→ℚ/ℤ (the invariant map): every class is split by the maximal unramified extension k̃, and on H²(Gal(k̃/k),k̃^×) the map is induced by the normalized valuation and evaluation of characters at Frobenius. If k has characteristic zero, the Kummer sequences identify H²(G_k,μ), for the group μ of all roots of unity in k̄, with H²(G_k,k̄^×), so H²(G_k,μ)≅ℚ/ℤ canonically.

concept.title: Class field axiom for cyclic extensions of local fields
concept.description: For a finite cyclic extension K/k of nonarchimedean local fields, the Tate cohomology of K^× satisfies #Ĥ⁰(Gal(K/k),K^×)=[K:k] and H¹(Gal(K/k),K^×)=1; equivalently the Herbrand quotient of K^× equals [K:k].

concept.title: Cohomological triviality of units in unramified extensions of local fields
concept.description: For an unramified Galois extension K/k of nonarchimedean local fields, the unit group U_K and the principal units U_K¹ are cohomologically trivial Gal(K/k)-modules: all their Tate cohomology groups vanish for every subgroup. If K/k is tamely ramified, U_K¹ is still cohomologically trivial.

concept.title: Injectivity of restriction to a Sylow subgroup on p-primary cohomology
concept.description: For a profinite (or finite) group G, a discrete G-module A, a prime p and a p-Sylow subgroup G_p, restriction Ĥⁿ(G,A)(p)→Ĥⁿ(G_p,A) on the p-primary part is injective for n≥1 (all n if G is finite); more generally restriction to a closed subgroup of index prime to p is injective on p-primary parts.

concept.title: Corestriction after restriction is multiplication by the index
concept.description: For an open subgroup U of a profinite group G and a discrete G-module A, cor∘res:Hⁿ(G,A)→Hⁿ(U,A)→Hⁿ(G,A) is multiplication by the index (G:U) in every degree n; if U is normal, res∘cor is the norm N_(G/U).

concept.title: Tate’s duality theorem for profinite groups
concept.description: Let G be a profinite group with cd_P G=n<∞ for a set of primes P, and D_P its dualizing module at P. Then cup product and the trace map give isomorphisms Hⁱ(G,Hom(A,D_P))≅H^(n−i)(G,A)^* for all i and all finite P-primary discrete G-modules A if and only if lim→_U Hⁱ(U,ℤ/pℤ)^*=0 for all p∈P and all i<n, the limit over open subgroups U dual to corestriction; G is then a duality group at P of dimension n.

concept.title: Dualizing module of the absolute Galois group of a local field
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k, the dualizing module D=lim→_(K,n)H²(K,ℤ/nℤ)^* of the category of discrete torsion G_k-modules is canonically isomorphic, as a G_k-module, to the group μ of all roots of unity in the separable closure (the prime-to-p part if char k=p>0).

concept.title: Cohomological dimension of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k and a prime p different from char k, the absolute Galois group has cd_p(G_k)=2 and strict cohomological dimension scd_p(G_k)=2; if p=char k then cd_p(G_k)=1. Moreover cd_p(L)≤1 for every algebraic extension L/k of degree divisible by p^∞.

concept.title: Local reciprocity law of local class field theory
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k and a finite Galois extension K/k there is a canonical isomorphism k^×/N_(K/k)K^×≅Gal(K/k)^ab (the local reciprocity map), and the norm groups N_(K/k)K^× of finite Galois extensions are exactly the open subgroups of finite index in k^×.

concept.title: Finiteness of Galois cohomology of a local field with finite coefficients
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k and a finite discrete G_k-module A of order prime to char k, the groups Hⁱ(G_k,A) are finite for all i≥0; if A is a G_k-module finitely generated over ℤ with torsion of order prime to char k, then H¹(G_k,A) is finite.

concept.title: Tate’s global duality theorem for S-idèle class coefficients
concept.description: For a number field k, a nonempty set S of places containing the archimedean ones, G_S=Gal(k_S/k) and C_S the S-idèle class group of k_S (with norm-one part C_S⁰), and a discrete G_S-module A finitely generated over ℤ, cup product into H²(G_S,C_S⁰)≅(1/#G_S)ℤ/ℤ induces topological isomorphisms Ĥⁱ(G_S,Hom(A,C_S⁰))≅Ĥ^(2−i)(G_S,A)^∨ for all i≤0, and for all i if A is ℤ-free.

concept.title: Poitou–Tate duality of Tate–Shafarevich groups of a Galois module
concept.description: For a number field k, a set S of places containing the archimedean ones, and a finitely generated G_S-module A whose torsion has order invertible on S, with A′=Hom(A,O_S^×), cup product induces a perfect pairing of finite groups Ш¹(G_S,A′)×Ш²(G_S,A)→ℚ/ℤ, where Шⁱ(G_S,A) is the kernel of the localization map Hⁱ(G_S,A)→∏_(v∈S)Hⁱ(k_v,A).

concept.title: Tate’s local Euler–Poincaré characteristic formula for finite modules
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field k and a finite discrete G_k-module A of order a prime to char k, the groups Hⁱ(k,A) are finite and #H⁰(k,A)·#H²(k,A)/#H¹(k,A)=‖a‖_k, the normalized absolute value of a; for k/ℚ_p finite this is p^(−[k:ℚ_p]v_p(a)), and it equals 1 if a is prime to the residue characteristic.

concept.title: Euler–Poincaré formula for finite Galois modules over ℝ and ℂ
concept.description: For k=ℝ or ℂ and a finite G_k-module A of order a with dual A′=Hom(A,μ), #H⁰(k,A)·#H⁰(k,A′)/#H¹(k,A)=‖a‖_k, where ‖a‖_ℝ=a and ‖a‖_ℂ=a²; equivalently the Tate-cohomology quotient #Ĥ⁰(k,A)/#H¹(k,A) times #H⁰(k,A′) equals ‖a‖_k.

concept.title: Triviality of the Herbrand quotient of a finite module
concept.description: For a finite cyclic group G and a finite G-module A, the Herbrand quotient h(G,A)=#Ĥ⁰(G,A)/#Ĥ¹(G,A) equals 1. More generally, for commuting endomorphisms f,g of a finite abelian group with fg=gf=0, #(ker f/im g)=#(ker g/im f).

concept.title: Simple p-primary modules of a pro-p group
concept.description: For a pro-p group G, every simple discrete p-primary G-module is isomorphic to ℤ/pℤ with trivial action. Equivalently, a nonzero discrete p-primary G-module has a nonzero G-fixed element, so finite p-primary G-modules have composition series with factors ℤ/pℤ.

concept.title: Class formation of S-idèle classes of a number field
concept.description: For a number field k and a set S of places containing the archimedean places, the pair (G_S,C_S), with G_S the Galois group of the maximal extension unramified outside S and C_S the S-idèle class group of k_S, is a class formation: H¹(G(K|L),C_S(K))=0 and H²(G(K|L),C_S(K))≅(1/[K:L])ℤ/ℤ compatibly with restriction for finite Galois subextensions K/L of k_S/k.

concept.title: Tate’s global Euler–Poincaré characteristic formula for finite modules
concept.description: For a number field k, a finite set S of places containing the archimedean places, and a finite G_S-module A whose order is a unit away from S, #H⁰(G_S,A)·#H²(G_S,A)/#H¹(G_S,A)=∏_(v|∞)#H⁰(k_v,A)/‖#A‖_v, where ‖a‖_v=a for v real and a² for v complex.

concept.title: Tate’s comparison of continuous cohomology of a p-adic representation and its lattices
concept.description: Let G be a profinite group whose cohomology groups with finite p-primary coefficients are finite, V a p-adic representation of G and Λ⊂V a G-stable ℤ_p-lattice. Then the continuous cohomology Hⁱ(G,Λ) is a finitely generated ℤ_p-module, Hⁱ(G,Λ)≅lim←_n Hⁱ(G,Λ/pⁿΛ), and the natural map Hⁱ(G,Λ)⊗_(ℤ_p)ℚ_p→Hⁱ(G,V) is an isomorphism (Tate).

concept.title: Cohomological dimension of the Galois group unramified outside S
concept.description: For a number field k, a prime p and a set S of places containing the archimedean places and those above p, cd_p(G_(k,S))≤2 provided k is totally imaginary when p=2; in general, for i≥3 and finite p-primary A, restriction gives Hⁱ(G_(k,S),A)≅⊕_(v real)Hⁱ(k_v,A).

concept.title: Tate–Sen theorem on the Galois cohomology of ℂ_p(r)
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and r∈ℤ, let ℂ_p(r) be ℂ_p with G_K acting semilinearly twisted by χ_cyc^r. Then H⁰(G_K,ℂ_p)=K and H⁰(G_K,ℂ_p(r))=0 for r≠0; in continuous cohomology H¹(G_K,ℂ_p(r))=0 for r≠0, and H¹(G_K,ℂ_p) is one-dimensional over K, spanned by the class of log∘χ_cyc, so cup product with log χ_cyc is an isomorphism H⁰(G_K,ℂ_p)→H¹(G_K,ℂ_p).

concept.title: Vanishing of the cohomology of ℂ_p-representations over the cyclotomic tower
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p, its cyclotomic ℤ_p-tower K_∞ and H=Gal(K̄/K_∞), and a finite-dimensional ℂ_p-vector space W with continuous semilinear G_K-action, Hⁿ_cont(H,W)=0 for n≥1, and inflation Hⁿ(Gal(K_∞/K),W^H)→Hⁿ(G_K,W) is an isomorphism for all n≥0 (Tate–Sen formalism).

concept.title: Tate’s normalized traces on the cyclotomic tower
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p with cyclotomic ℤ_p-tower K_n, the normalized traces p^(−m)Tr_(K_(n+m)/K_n) extend to continuous K_n-linear projections R_n of the completion K̂_∞ onto K_n, commuting with Gal(K_∞/K). On X_n=ker R_n, γ−1 is bijective with bounded inverse for a generator γ of Gal(K_∞/K_n) (n large), and for a 1-unit λ∈K that is not a root of unity, γ−λ is bijective on K̂_∞.

concept.title: Completed unramified descent for semilinear modules
concept.description: Let R be a complete discrete valuation ring with residue field k, and R′ the completion of its maximal unramified extension, with G_k acting. For a finitely generated R′-module M with continuous semilinear G_k-action, M^(G_k) is finitely generated over R and R′⊗_R M^(G_k)→M is an isomorphism; in particular M↦M^(G_k) is exact.

concept.title: Serre–Tate inequality for Hodge–Tate multiplicities
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p and a continuous semilinear ℂ_p-representation W of G_K, the natural map ⊕_(q∈ℤ)ℂ_p(−q)⊗_K(W(q))^(G_K)→W is injective. Hence for a p-adic representation V, ∑_q dim_K(ℂ_p(q)⊗V)^(G_K)≤dim V, with equality exactly when V is Hodge–Tate.

concept.title: Deligne’s λ-adic Galois representation of a newform
concept.description: For a normalized newform f=∑a_nqⁿ of weight k≥2, level N and character ε, with coefficient field F, and a finite prime λ of F over p, there is a continuous semisimple representation ρ_(f,λ):G_ℚ→GL₂(F_λ), unique up to isomorphism, unramified outside Np, such that for every prime ℓ∤Np an arithmetic Frobenius at ℓ has trace a_ℓ and determinant ε(ℓ)ℓ^(k−1) (Deligne; Eichler–Shimura for k=2). Kato’s realization V_(F_λ)(f), cut out of the étale cohomology of modular curves, is its contragredient: det(1−Fr_ℓ⁻¹u|V_(F_λ)(f))=1−a_ℓu+ε(ℓ)ℓ^(k−1)u².

concept.title: Completed group algebra of a profinite group
concept.description: For a profinite group G and the valuation ring O of a finite extension of ℚ_p, the completed group algebra (Iwasawa algebra) is O[[G]]=lim←_U O[G/U], the inverse limit of the finite group algebras over open normal subgroups U, with its compact topology. For G=Gal(ℚ(ζ_(p^∞))/ℚ)≅ℤ_p^× it is Kato’s Λ=O[[G_∞]], a two-dimensional complete semilocal ring.

concept.title: Iwasawa cohomology over the cyclotomic ℤ_p-tower
concept.description: For a finitely generated ℤ_p-module T with continuous G_ℚ-action unramified at almost all primes, Kato sets H^q(ℤ[ζ_(pⁿ),1/p],T)=lim←_m H^q_ét(Spec ℤ[ζ_(pⁿ),1/p],j_*(T/p^mT)), j the inclusion of the generic point, and H^q(T)=lim←_n H^q(ℤ[ζ_(pⁿ),1/p],T) under corestriction (trace) maps; similarly H^q_loc(T)=lim←_n H^q(ℚ_p(ζ_(pⁿ)),T) in continuous Galois cohomology. These are modules over Λ=ℤ_p[[Gal(ℚ(ζ_(p^∞))/ℚ)]], and H^q(V)=H^q(T)⊗ℚ for a lattice T in V.

concept.title: Height of a prime ideal
concept.description: The height of a prime ideal 𝔭 of a commutative ring R is the supremum of the lengths r of chains of prime ideals 𝔭₀⊊𝔭₁⊊⋯⊊𝔭_r=𝔭; equivalently the Krull dimension of the localization R_𝔭.

concept.title: Localization of a module at a prime ideal
concept.description: For a module M over a commutative ring R and a prime ideal 𝔭, the localization M_𝔭=(R∖𝔭)⁻¹M consists of fractions m/s with s∉𝔭, where m/s=m′/s′ when t(s′m−sm′)=0 for some t∉𝔭; it is an R_𝔭-module, isomorphic to M⊗_R R_𝔭.

concept.title: Euler system over cyclotomic fields (Kato’s definition)
concept.description: Let L/ℚ_p be finite with valuation ring O_L, T a free O_L-module of finite rank with continuous O_L-linear G_ℚ-action unramified outside a finite set Σ of primes containing p, and Ξ={m≥1: the primes dividing m and lying in Σ are exactly p}. An Euler system for (T,L,Σ) is a family z_m∈H¹(ℤ[ζ_m,1/p],T), m∈Ξ, such that for m|m′ the norm (corestriction) sends z_(m′) to (∏_ℓ P_ℓ(σ_ℓ⁻¹))z_m, ℓ over primes dividing m′ but not m, where P_ℓ(t)=det(1−Fr_ℓ⁻¹t|T) and σ_ℓ is the arithmetic Frobenius of ℓ in Gal(ℚ(ζ_m)/ℚ) acting through O_L[Gal(ℚ(ζ_m)/ℚ)].

concept.title: Crystalline p-adic representation
concept.description: For a finite extension K of ℚ_p with maximal unramified subfield K₀, a p-adic representation V of G_K is crystalline if D_cris(V)=(B_cris⊗_(ℚ_p)V)^(G_K), a K₀-vector space with Frobenius φ induced from B_cris, has dimension dim_(ℚ_p)V (B_cris-admissibility).

concept.title: Algebra of formal power series in noncommuting variables
concept.description: For a set X and a field k, k⟨⟨X⟩⟩ consists of all formal sums ∑a_w w over the words w in X, with coefficientwise addition and the product extending concatenation; it is the degree completion ∏ₙ of the free algebra k⟨X⟩. If k has characteristic zero, exp(z)=∑zⁿ/n! and log(1+z)=∑(−1)ⁿ⁺¹zⁿ/n are defined on the ideal 𝔪 of series without constant term and are mutually inverse bijections 𝔪→1+𝔪.

concept.title: Friedrichs’s theorem on primitive elements of an enveloping algebra
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic zero, the elements u of the universal enveloping algebra U(𝔤) of a Lie algebra with Δu=u⊗1+1⊗u for the coproduct are exactly the elements of 𝔤. Since the free associative algebra on X is the enveloping algebra of the free Lie algebra on X, the latter is the set of primitive elements of the free associative algebra.

concept.title: Finiteness of extensions of bounded degree of a p-adic field
concept.description: Let K be a field of characteristic zero complete for a discrete valuation with finite residue field, that is, a finite extension of ℚ_p. For every n≥1 there are, up to K-isomorphism, only finitely many field extensions of K of degree n. The proof uses Krasner’s lemma and compactness of the space of Eisenstein polynomials of degree n.

concept.title: Hermite’s theorem on number fields of bounded discriminant
concept.description: For every B>0 there are, up to isomorphism, only finitely many number fields K with |d_K|≤B (Hermite 1857). Minkowski’s bound shows that the degree is bounded in terms of |d_K|, and for fixed degree a generator with bounded conjugates is found by Minkowski’s lattice point theorem.

concept.title: Tower formula for discriminants of number fields
concept.description: For number fields K⊆L, the absolute discriminants and the relative discriminant ideal satisfy |d_L|=|d_K|^[L:K]·N_(K/ℚ)(𝔡_(L/K)), where N_(K/ℚ) is the absolute norm of ideals. In particular |d_L| is bounded once [L:K] and the norm of 𝔡_(L/K) are bounded.

concept.title: Normalization of an integral scheme
concept.description: For an integral scheme X with function field K, the normalization ν:X^ν→X glues the spectra of the integral closures of the rings O_X(U) in K over the affine opens U⊆X. X^ν is an integral scheme with function field K whose local rings are integrally closed domains, ν is affine and dominant, and ν is universal for dominant morphisms to X from such schemes. Normalizing in a finite extension L of K is defined in the same way.

concept.title: Equivalence between integral varieties with dominant rational maps and finitely generated field extensions
concept.description: For a field k, sending an integral variety X over k to its function field k(X) is an anti-equivalence from integral k-varieties with dominant rational maps to finitely generated field extensions of k with k-embeddings. Every finitely generated K/k is the fraction field of a finitely generated k-algebra, hence the function field of an affine variety.

concept.title: Projective compactification of a reduced curve over a field
concept.description: Let X be a reduced separated scheme of finite type and dimension at most one over a field k. There is an open immersion X→X̄ with dense image into a closed subscheme X̄ of some projective space over k such that X̄∖X is a finite set of closed points whose local rings are discrete valuation rings. A proper scheme of dimension at most one over k is projective.

concept.title: Global functions detect geometric connectedness of a proper scheme
concept.description: For a proper scheme X over a field k, H⁰(X,O_X) is a finite-dimensional k-algebra, a product of Artinian local algebras indexed by the connected components of X. If X is geometrically reduced, then X is geometrically connected if and only if H⁰(X,O_X)=k.

concept.title: Picard group of a scheme
concept.description: For a scheme X, Pic(X) is the abelian group of isomorphism classes of invertible O_X-modules under tensor product, the inverse of L being its dual L^∨=Hom(L,O_X). A morphism f:Y→X induces the pullback homomorphism f*:Pic(X)→Pic(Y).

concept.title: Jacobian variety of a smooth projective curve
concept.description: For a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C of genus g over a field k, let P⁰_C(T) be the group of invertible sheaves on C×_k T of degree zero on every fibre modulo pullbacks of invertible sheaves on T. The Jacobian J=Jac(C) is the g-dimensional abelian variety over k with a morphism of functors P⁰_C→J that is an isomorphism whenever C(T)≠∅. It exists without a rational point, is unique up to unique isomorphism and commutes with field extension; J(k′)=Pic⁰(C_(k′)) when C(k′)≠∅.

concept.title: Polarization of an abelian variety
concept.description: A polarization of an abelian variety A over a field k is an isogeny λ:A→A^∨ to the dual abelian variety that, after base change to an algebraic closure k̄, equals φ_L for an ample invertible sheaf L on A_k̄. It is principal if λ is an isomorphism. A principally polarized abelian variety is a pair (A,λ), and an isomorphism (A,λ)→(A′,λ′) is an isomorphism β:A→A′ with β^∨∘λ′∘β=λ.

concept.title: Canonical principal polarization of a Jacobian
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus g≥1 over k with Jacobian J. Over k̄ choose P∈C(k̄) with Abel–Jacobi map ι_P:C→J and let Θ be the theta divisor, the image of C^(g−1)→J, (P₁,…,P_(g−1))↦∑ι_P(Pᵢ). Changing P translates Θ, so λ_C=φ_(L(Θ)):J→J^∨ does not depend on P and is defined over k; it is an isomorphism, the canonical principal polarization of J.

concept.title: Jacobian scheme of a smooth proper relative curve
concept.description: Let π:𝒞→S be proper and smooth with geometrically connected one-dimensional fibres. Let P⁰_(𝒞/S)(T) be the group of invertible sheaves on 𝒞×_S T of degree zero on all fibres modulo pullbacks from T. The Jacobian scheme Pic⁰_(𝒞/S) is an S-group scheme J with a morphism of functors P⁰_(𝒞/S)→J that is injective and an isomorphism whenever 𝒞×_S T→T has a section. It is unique, commutes with base change, and its fibre over s∈S is the Jacobian variety of the curve 𝒞_s.

concept.title: Symmetric power of a smooth curve
concept.description: For a smooth projective curve C over a field and r≥1, the symmetric power C^(r)=C^r/S_r is the quotient by the symmetric group permuting the factors. It is a smooth projective variety of dimension r whose points over an algebraically closed field are the effective divisors of degree r on C; it represents the functor of relative effective divisors of degree r.

concept.title: Hyperelliptic curve
concept.description: A smooth projective connected curve of genus g≥2 over an algebraically closed field is hyperelliptic if it admits a finite morphism of degree two to ℙ¹, equivalently a linear system of degree two and dimension one; such a linear system is then unique and its fibres are exchanged by the hyperelliptic involution.

concept.title: Pullback of translates of the theta divisor to a curve
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective curve of genus g≥1 over an algebraically closed field, f:C→J the Abel–Jacobi map attached to a point, Θ=W^(g−1) the image of C^(g−1) and κ the image of a canonical divisor. If a∈J(k) and f(C) is not contained in the translate Θ_a, there is a unique effective divisor D(a) of degree g with f(D(a))=a+κ, and the pullback of Θ_a to C is the divisor D(a) (Riemann’s theorem on the theta divisor).

concept.title: Representability of the Picard functor of a projective flat curve
concept.description: Let X→S be a projective flat curve locally of finite presentation whose geometric fibres are reduced and irreducible. Then the relative Picard functor Pic_(X/S) is represented by a smooth separated S-scheme, the disjoint union of open and closed subschemes (Pic_(X/S))ⁿ of line bundles of degree n; (Pic_(X/S))⁰ is the identity component Pic⁰_(X/S), quasi-projective over S, and each (Pic_(X/S))ⁿ is a Pic⁰_(X/S)-torsor (Grothendieck).

concept.title: Properness of the Jacobian scheme of a smooth proper curve
concept.description: If X→S is a proper smooth morphism whose geometric fibres are connected curves and the identity component Pic⁰_(X/S) of its Picard functor is representable, then Pic⁰_(X/S) is proper over S; this is checked with the valuative criterion, extending degree-zero line bundles from the generic fibre over a discrete valuation ring.

concept.title: Projectivity of proper relative curves with integral fibres
concept.description: Let X→S be a proper flat curve of finite presentation whose geometric fibres are reduced irreducible curves of genus g and which is a relative complete intersection. Then its relative dualizing sheaf is invertible; for g≥2 it is S-ample, and for g=0,1 a suitable invertible sheaf is S-ample, so X→S is projective. In particular proper smooth curves with connected fibres are projective, at least étale locally on S.

concept.title: Effectivity of descent for quasi-projective schemes with ample sheaves
concept.description: Let S′→S be faithfully flat and quasi-compact. A descent datum on a scheme X′ quasi-projective over S′ that is compatible with a descent datum on an S′-ample invertible sheaf on X′ is effective: X′ descends to an S-scheme X, quasi-projective over S. Group structures and properties such as properness and smoothness descend as well.

concept.title: Extended Bruhat–Tits building of a reductive group over a local field
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a nonarchimedean local field F, the reduced building B(G,F) is the building of the valued root datum of G(F) relative to a maximal F-split torus. The extended building is B¹=B×V¹, V¹ the real dual of the rational characters of G, with g·(x,v)=(gx,v+θ(g)) where ⟨θ(g),χ⟩=−ω(χ(g)). Its apartments A(S)×V¹ correspond to maximal F-split tori S; a point is special if its image in A(S) is a special point. The stabilizer of (x,v) is the stabilizer of x in G(F)¹=ker θ.

concept.title: Iwasawa decomposition with respect to an Iwahori subgroup
concept.description: Let G be connected reductive over a field with a discrete valuation whose ring of integers is Henselian with perfect residue field, S a maximal split torus with normalizer N, U the unipotent radical of a minimal parabolic subgroup containing the centralizer of S, and P_C the Iwahori subgroup of a chamber C in the apartment of S. Then G(k)=U(k)·N(k)·P_C.

concept.title: Parahoric subgroup of a reductive group over a local field
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a discretely valued field k with Henselian integers and perfect residue field, and a point or facet x of its Bruhat–Tits building, the parahoric subgroup P_x=G(k)⁰_x is the connected stabilizer of x, the group of o-points of the connected Néron-type model of the stabilizer; it is contained in the stabilizer G(k)¹_x with finite index. For a chamber it is the Iwahori subgroup.

concept.title: Maximality of vertex stabilizers in the Bruhat–Tits building
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a discretely valued field with Henselian integers and perfect residue field, every bounded subgroup of G(k) fixes a point of the building B(G), and for a vertex x the stabilizer G(k)¹_x is a maximal bounded subgroup of G(k); it is open. Every maximal bounded subgroup has the form G(k)¹_y.

concept.title: Compactness of closed bounded subsets of points over a local field
concept.description: For an affine variety X over a locally compact nondiscrete valued field k, a subset of X(k) is bounded if its coordinates are bounded in some, equivalently any, affine embedding; closed bounded subsets of X(k) are compact. Hence the bounded open subgroups of G(k) are exactly its compact open subgroups.

concept.title: Reductive integral models are hyperspecial point stabilizers
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a nonarchimedean local field k with valuation ring o. For every reductive o-group scheme 𝒢 with generic fiber G there is a hyperspecial vertex x of the Bruhat–Tits building such that the identity of G extends to an isomorphism 𝒢≅𝒢⁰_x with the connected parahoric group scheme; for hyperspecial x the stabilizer scheme 𝒢_x is connected, so 𝒢(o) is the full stabilizer G(k)¹_x.

concept.title: Mostow’s self-adjoint realization of a real reductive group
concept.description: For a reductive algebraic ℝ-subgroup G⊆GL_n there is a∈GL_n(ℝ) such that aGa⁻¹ is self-adjoint, i.e. stable under transpose (Mostow).

concept.title: Polar decomposition of the real points of a reductive group
concept.description: For a self-adjoint reductive ℝ-subgroup G⊆GL_n, every element of G(ℝ) factors uniquely as kc with k orthogonal and c positive definite symmetric, both in G(ℝ). Hence K₁=G(ℝ)∩O(n) is a maximal compact subgroup, G(ℝ)/K₁ is homeomorphic to a vector space, every compact subgroup lies in a maximal one, and all maximal compact subgroups of G(ℝ) are conjugate.

concept.title: Iwasawa decomposition of the real general linear group
concept.description: The multiplication map O(n)×A×U→GL_n(ℝ), where A is the group of positive diagonal matrices and U the group of upper unitriangular matrices, is a homeomorphism; existence follows from Gram–Schmidt orthonormalization.

concept.title: Structure and rational conjugacy of minimal parabolic subgroups
concept.description: Let G be connected reductive over a field k and S a maximal k-split torus. For each positive system Φ⁺ of relative roots, Z_G(S)·U_(Φ⁺) is a minimal parabolic k-subgroup with unipotent radical U_(Φ⁺), every minimal parabolic k-subgroup is of this form for some maximal split torus, and any two minimal parabolic k-subgroups are conjugate under G(k) (Borel–Tits).

concept.title: Parabolic subgroups of a Weil restriction
concept.description: For a finite separable field extension L/k and a connected reductive L-group G, P↦R_(L/k)P is a bijection from parabolic L-subgroups of G onto parabolic k-subgroups of R_(L/k)G, preserving inclusions; in particular minimal parabolics correspond, and for L algebraically closed R_(L/k)B is a minimal parabolic k-subgroup for every Borel B.

concept.title: Faltings height of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A of dimension g over a number field K with a semiabelian model 𝒜 over O_K, let ω be the invertible O_K-module s*Ω^g_(𝒜/O_K) metrized at each complex place by ‖α‖²=(i/2)^g∫|α∧ᾱ|. The Faltings height is h(A)=[K:ℚ]⁻¹ times the Arakelov degree of ω; it is invariant under finite extension of K for semistable models (stable height).

concept.title: Faltings’s finiteness of principally polarized abelian varieties of bounded height
concept.description: For a number field K, an integer g and a real c, there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of pairs consisting of a semiabelian scheme over O_K with abelian generic fiber of dimension g and a principal polarization of that generic fiber, whose Faltings height is at most c (Faltings 1983, Satz 1).

concept.title: Change of the Faltings height under isogeny
concept.description: If φ:A₁→A₂ is an isogeny of semiabelian schemes over O_K with abelian generic fibers and kernel G (a quasi-finite flat group scheme), then h(A₂)=h(A₁)+½log deg φ−[K:ℚ]⁻¹log #(s*Ω¹_(G/O_K)). In particular exp(2[K:ℚ](h(A₂)−h(A₁))) is a rational number whose numerator and denominator involve only primes dividing deg φ (Faltings 1983, Lemma 5).

concept.title: Finiteness of isogeny classes of abelian varieties with good reduction outside S
concept.description: For a number field K, a finite set S of places and g≥1, there are only finitely many isogeny classes of g-dimensional abelian varieties over K with good reduction outside S (Faltings 1983, Satz 5).

concept.title: Isogeny from a polarized to a principally polarized abelian variety
concept.description: If an abelian variety A over a field k has a polarization λ, then after a finite extension of k there is an isogeny A→B of degree dividing deg λ onto an abelian variety B with a principal polarization, obtained as the quotient by a maximal isotropic subgroup of ker λ for the Weil pairing.

concept.title: Raynaud’s determinant character of a finite flat group scheme
concept.description: Let G be a finite flat group scheme over the ring of integers of a p-adic field K, killed by p, of order p^h. If the ramification of K is small (e<p−1), the Galois action on the top exterior power of G(K̄) is χ^d for the mod-p cyclotomic character χ, where p^d is the order of s*Ω¹_(G); in general this holds on inertia up to a character of finite order (Raynaud 1974).

concept.title: Weil height associated to an invertible sheaf
concept.description: For a projective variety X over a number field K, Weil’s height machine assigns to each invertible sheaf L on X a function h_L:X(K̄)→ℝ, well defined up to a bounded function, such that h_L=h∘φ+O(1) when L≅φ*O(1) for a morphism φ:X→ℙⁿ with h the absolute logarithmic height, and h_(L⊗M)=h_L+h_M+O(1).

concept.title: Symmetric invertible sheaf on an abelian variety
concept.description: An invertible sheaf L on an abelian variety A is symmetric if [−1]*L≅L, where [−1] is the inversion morphism of A; antisymmetric if [−1]*L≅L⁻¹.

concept.title: Quadratic form on an abelian group
concept.description: A function q:Γ→ℝ on an abelian group Γ is a quadratic form if q(−x)=q(x) and ⟨x,y⟩=q(x+y)−q(x)−q(y) is biadditive. Equivalently q satisfies the parallelogram law q(x+y)+q(x−y)=2q(x)+2q(y); then ⟨,⟩ is a symmetric pairing with ⟨x,x⟩=2q(x).

concept.title: Positivity and Northcott finiteness for Weil heights
concept.description: Let X be a projective variety over a number field K and h_L a Weil height. Then h_L is bounded below on the complement of the base locus of L, and if L is ample then for every finite extension K′/K and real B the set {P∈X(K′):h_L(P)≤B} is finite (Weil height machine, parts (e) and (g)).

concept.title: Quasi-parallelogram law for Weil heights on abelian varieties
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a number field and a symmetric invertible sheaf L, the Weil height satisfies h_L([m]P)=m²h_L(P)+O(1) for each integer m and h_L(P+Q)+h_L(P−Q)=2h_L(P)+2h_L(Q)+O(1), with constants independent of the points.

concept.title: Tate’s limit construction of canonical heights
concept.description: Let φ:X→X be a morphism of a projective variety over a number field and L an invertible sheaf with φ*L≅L^⊗a for some a>1. Then ĥ(P)=lim a⁻ⁿh_L(φⁿ(P)) exists, ĥ=h_L+O(1) and ĥ∘φ=aĥ, and ĥ is the unique function with these two properties (Néron, Tate).

concept.title: Hermite polynomial
concept.description: The n-th Hermite polynomial is H_n(x)=((−1)ⁿ/n!)e^{x²/2}(dⁿ/dxⁿ)e^{−x²/2}, with H₀=1; equivalently exp(tx−t²/2)=∑_{n≥0}tⁿH_n(x). H_n has degree n and leading coefficient 1/n!; many authors use the monic normalization n!H_n.

concept.title: Polynomial Wiener functional
concept.description: For an isonormal Gaussian process W on a real Hilbert space H, a polynomial Wiener functional (polynomial random variable) is a random variable p(W(h₁),…,W(h_n)) with n≥1, h₁,…,h_n∈H and p a real polynomial in n variables.

concept.title: Uniqueness theorem for multivariate Laplace transforms
concept.description: If ν is a finite signed Borel measure on ℝᵐ such that ∫e^{⟨t,x⟩}|ν|(dx)<∞ and ∫e^{⟨t,x⟩}ν(dx)=0 for every t∈ℝᵐ, then ν=0. Thus a Laplace transform finite on all of ℝᵐ determines the measure.

concept.title: Doob–Dynkin factorization lemma
concept.description: If Y is a random vector in ℝᵐ and Z is a real random variable measurable with respect to the σ-algebra generated by Y, then Z=φ(Y) for some Borel function φ:ℝᵐ→ℝ.

concept.title: Nelson’s hypercontractivity of the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroup
concept.description: For the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroup P_t of an isonormal Gaussian process, 1<p<∞ and t>0, ‖P_tF‖_{q(t)}≤‖F‖_p for all F∈Lᵖ, where q(t)=1+e^{2t}(p−1). Consequently all Lᵖ norms, 1<p<∞, are equivalent on each Wiener chaos.

concept.title: Mehler’s formula for the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroup
concept.description: If W′ is an independent copy of the isonormal Gaussian process W and F=ψ_F(W), then P_tF=E′[ψ_F(e^{−t}W+√(1−e^{−2t})W′)] for t≥0, where P_t=∑_ne^{−nt}J_n. Hence P_t extends to a positive contraction on Lᵖ for every 1≤p<∞.

concept.title: M. Riesz theorem on Lᵖ boundedness of the Hilbert transform
concept.description: The Hilbert transform Hf(x)=p.v.(1/π)∫f(x−t)t^{−1}dt, defined on test functions, extends to a bounded operator on Lᵖ(ℝ) for every 1<p<∞. It is not bounded on L¹ or L^∞.

concept.title: Chaos characterization of the Malliavin derivative
concept.description: For F in L²(Ω,σ(W),P) with Wiener chaos projections J_nF, F∈D^{1,2} if and only if ∑_n n‖J_nF‖₂²<∞; then E‖DF‖_H²=∑_n n‖J_nF‖₂² and D(J_nF)=J_{n−1}(DF). Thus D maps the n-th chaos into the (n−1)-th H-valued chaos.

concept.title: α-excessive function of a Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a Dirichlet form on L²(X,m) with L² semigroup (T_t) and α>0, a function u∈L²(X,m) is α-excessive if e^{−αt}T_tu≤u m-a.e. for every t>0. Such u are nonnegative; for u in the form domain this is equivalent to E_α(u,v)≥0 for every nonnegative v in the domain.

concept.title: Banach–Saks theorem for Hilbert spaces
concept.description: Every weakly convergent sequence in a Hilbert space has a subsequence whose Cesàro means (u_{n₁}+⋯+u_{n_k})/k converge in norm to the weak limit.

concept.title: Choquet property of the capacity of a Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a Dirichlet form and an admissible reference function h=G₁φ, the capacity Cap_h is a Choquet capacity: it is monotone, Cap_h(⋃A_n)=lim Cap_h(A_n) for increasing sets, Cap_h(⋂K_n)=lim Cap_h(K_n) for decreasing compact sets, and it is countably subadditive.

concept.title: 1-capacity of a regular Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a regular Dirichlet form on L²(X,m), Cap(U)=inf{E₁(u,u): u in the domain, u≥1 m-a.e. on U} for open U (∞ if no such u), and Cap(A)=inf{Cap(U): A⊂U open}. For open U of finite capacity the unique minimizer e_U is the 1-equilibrium potential of U.

concept.title: Kolmogorov extension theorem
concept.description: If T is an index set and (μ_J) a projectively consistent family of Borel probability measures on S^J, J⊂T finite, for a Polish space S, then there is a unique probability measure on the product σ-algebra of S^T whose finite-dimensional marginals are the μ_J.

concept.title: Absorption at zero of nonnegative right-continuous supermartingales
concept.description: If (Z_t) is a nonnegative right-continuous supermartingale and T=inf{t: Z_t=0 or Z_{t−}=0}, then almost surely Z_t=0 for all t≥T on {T<∞}.

concept.title: L² Cauchy integral operators on Lipschitz graphs
concept.description: For a Lipschitz graph Γ={x+iν(x):x∈ℝ} in ℂ (ν′ bounded) and f∈L²(Γ), the Cauchy integral (2πi)⁻¹∫_Γf(s)(s−z)⁻¹ds has nontangential boundary values C_±f almost everywhere on Γ from above and below. C_± are bounded on L²(Γ), with norms bounded in terms of ‖ν′‖_∞, and satisfy C_+f−C_−f=f. This is the Coifman–McIntosh–Meyer theorem.

concept.title: Inverse image of étale sheaves
concept.description: For a morphism of schemes f:Y→X and an étale abelian sheaf F on X, the inverse image f^(−1)F is the étale sheaf on Y associated to the presheaf sending an étale V→Y to the colimit of F(U) over étale U→X with an X-morphism V→U. Its stalk at a geometric point ȳ of Y is F at the geometric point f∘ȳ, so f^(−1) is exact. For an immersion or étale map it is the restriction F|_Y.

concept.title: Higher direct images of étale sheaves
concept.description: For a morphism of schemes f:Y→X, the higher direct images R^if_* are the right derived functors of the left exact direct image f_* from étale abelian sheaves on Y to those on X. R^if_*F is the étale sheaf associated to the presheaf U↦H^i(U×_X Y,F), and R⁰f_*=f_*.

concept.title: Torsion étale abelian sheaf
concept.description: An étale abelian sheaf F on a scheme X is torsion if every local section is locally killed by a positive integer: for s∈F(U) there are an étale covering {U_i→U} and integers n_i≥1 with n_i·s|_(U_i)=0. Equivalently every stalk of F at a geometric point is a torsion abelian group, and F is the union of its subsheaves F[n] of sections killed by n.

concept.title: Constructible étale sheaf of modules
concept.description: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and Λ a Noetherian ring. An étale sheaf of Λ-modules F on X is locally constant if there is an étale covering {U_i→X} with each F|_(U_i) the sheaf associated to a constant presheaf, and constructible if X is a finite union of locally closed subschemes X_j such that each restriction F|_(X_j) is locally constant with finitely generated stalks.

concept.title: Constructible ℓ-adic sheaf
concept.description: Let X be a Noetherian scheme on which ℓ is invertible, E a finite extension of Q_ℓ with valuation ring R and maximal ideal m. A constructible R-sheaf is a projective system (F_n) of constructible étale sheaves of R/mⁿ-modules with F_(n+1)⊗R/mⁿ≅F_n. Constructible E-sheaves are R-sheaves modulo torsion sheaves, and constructible Q̄_ℓ-sheaves are their colimit over all E⊂Q̄_ℓ. A sheaf is lisse if each F_n is locally constant; its stalk F_x̄ at a geometric point is then lim F_(n,x̄), tensored with E or Q̄_ℓ.

concept.title: Frobenius action on stalks of an ℓ-adic sheaf
concept.description: Let X₀ be a scheme of finite type over F_q and F a constructible Q̄_ℓ-sheaf on X₀. For a closed point x with residue field k(x) of N(x) elements and a geometric point x̄ over x, Gal(k̄(x)/k(x)) acts on the stalk F_x̄ by transport of structure. F_x denotes the action of the geometric Frobenius, the inverse of a↦a^(N(x)); it is well defined up to conjugation, so det(1−F_x t,F) and the eigenvalues of F_x on F_x̄ are well defined.

concept.title: Étale cohomology with coefficients in a constructible ℓ-adic sheaf
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over a separably closed field k with ℓ invertible and F=(F_n) a constructible Z_ℓ-sheaf. Then H^i(X,F)=lim_n H^i(X,F_n) and H^i_c(X,F)=lim_n H^i_c(X,F_n), with E- and Q̄_ℓ-coefficients obtained by tensoring. If X=X₀⊗_(F_q)F̄_q and F is the inverse image of a sheaf on X₀, Gal(F̄_q/F_q) acts on these groups by transport of structure, and the geometric Frobenius acts as the endomorphism F* induced by the Frobenius correspondence.

concept.title: ι-pure and ι-mixed ℓ-adic sheaves
concept.description: Fix a field isomorphism ι:Q̄_ℓ→C. For α∈Q̄_ℓ^× and a prime power q, the ι-weight of α relative to q is w_q(α)=2log_q|ια|. A constructible Q̄_ℓ-sheaf F on a scheme X₀ of finite type over F_q is pointwise ι-pure of weight β∈R if w_(N(x))(α)=β for every closed point x and every eigenvalue α of F_x on F_x̄, and ι-mixed if it has a finite filtration whose graded pieces are pointwise ι-pure. The same terms apply to Q̄_ℓ-representations of Gal(F̄_q/F_q). Duals negate ι-weights, and the Tate twist Q_ℓ(1) is ι-pure of weight −2.

concept.title: Weil group of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with residue field k of q elements and inertia subgroup I⊂Gal(K̄/K). The Weil group W(K̄/K) is the inverse image in Gal(K̄/K) of the subgroup of Gal(k̄/k) generated by the geometric Frobenius, the inverse of x↦x^q, topologized so that I is an open subgroup. A Frobenius lift is an element of W(K̄/K) mapping to the geometric Frobenius.

concept.title: Grothendieck’s ℓ-adic local monodromy theorem
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with finite residue field of characteristic p, ℓ≠p a prime, and V a finite-dimensional ℓ-adic representation of Gal(K̄/K) or of the Weil group W(K̄/K). Then the inertia group I acts quasi-unipotently: some open subgroup I₁⊂I acts unipotently, and there is a unique nilpotent map N:V(1)→V with σ acting as exp(N·t_ℓ(σ)) for σ∈I₁, where t_ℓ:I→Z_ℓ(1) is the ℓ-adic tame character σ↦(σ(π^(1/ℓⁿ))/π^(1/ℓⁿ))_n. N is the logarithm of the unipotent part of the local monodromy.

concept.title: Monodromy filtration of a nilpotent endomorphism
concept.description: For a nilpotent endomorphism N of an object V of an abelian category there is a unique finite increasing filtration M of V by subobjects M_i such that N(M_i)⊆M_(i−2) and, for every k≥0, N^k induces an isomorphism Gr^M_k V≅Gr^M_(−k) V, where Gr^M_i V=M_i/M_(i−1). When N²=0 it is M_(−1)=im N⊆M₀=ker N⊆M₁=V.

concept.title: Local monodromy filtration of an ℓ-adic representation
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with finite residue field of characteristic p≠ℓ and V an ℓ-adic representation of the Weil group W(K̄/K). The local monodromy filtration M of V is the monodromy filtration of the nilpotent logarithm N of the unipotent part of the local monodromy, given by Grothendieck’s monodromy theorem (after identifying V(1) with V). It is stable under W(K̄/K), so its graded pieces Gr^M_i V are again representations of the Weil group.

concept.title: ι-weights of a representation of a local Weil group
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with residue field of q elements, ι:Q̄_ℓ→C a field isomorphism, ℓ∤q, and V a Q̄_ℓ-representation of the Weil group W(K̄/K). Two Frobenius lifts have the same eigenvalues on V up to roots of unity, by Grothendieck’s monodromy theorem, so the ι-weights w_q(α)=2log_q|ια| of the eigenvalues α of any Frobenius lift are well defined. V is ι-pure of weight β if all these weights equal β, and ι-mixed in general.

concept.title: Universal homeomorphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:Y→X is a universal homeomorphism if for every morphism X′→X the base change Y×_X X′→X′ is a homeomorphism of underlying topological spaces.

concept.title: Deligne’s upper bound for weights of j_*F at missing points of a curve
concept.description: Let X₀ be a smooth geometrically irreducible curve over F_q, j:U₀→X₀ a dense open immersion with complement S₀, and F a lisse sheaf on U₀ pointwise ι-pure of weight β. Then for every x∈S₀ each eigenvalue α of F_x on the stalk (j_*F)_x̄ satisfies w_(N(x))(α)≤β (Weil II, Lemma 1.8.1).

concept.title: Primitive decomposition and tensor/dual compatibility of the monodromy filtration
concept.description: For a nilpotent endomorphism N of a finite-dimensional vector space V over a field of characteristic zero, with monodromy filtration M and primitive parts P_(−i)=ker(N:Gr^M_(−i)→Gr^M_(−i−2)), one has Gr^M_i V≅⊕_(j≥|i|, j≡i mod 2) P_(−j), and the formation of Gr^M and of the primitive parts is compatible with tensor products (V′⊗V″, N′⊗1+1⊗N″) and duals (V^∨,−N^∨), via the Jacobson–Morozov sl₂-action (Weil II 1.6.4–1.6.14).

concept.title: Deligne’s upper weight bound for H¹_c of pure lisse sheaves on curves
concept.description: Let U₀ be a smooth curve over F_q and F a lisse Q̄_ℓ-sheaf on U₀ pointwise ι-pure of weight β. Then every eigenvalue α of the Frobenius F on H¹_c(U,F) satisfies w_q(α)≤β+1 (Weil II, Lemma 3.2.4 for all k and Corollary 3.2.5).

concept.title: Poincaré duality for j_* of a lisse sheaf on a smooth projective curve
concept.description: Let X be a smooth projective curve over an algebraically closed field, j:U→X a dense open immersion and F a lisse Q̄_ℓ-sheaf on U with dual F^∨. Cup product and the trace map give a perfect pairing H¹(X,j_*F)×H¹(X,j_*(F^∨(1)))→Q̄_ℓ, compatible with Frobenius when everything is defined over F_q (SGA 4½ [Dualité] 1.3, 2.1).

concept.title: Stalks of étale higher direct images via strict henselization
concept.description: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f:X→S, an étale abelian sheaf F on X and a geometric point s̄ of S, (R^nf_*F)_s̄≅H^n(X×_S Spec O^(sh)_(S,s̄),p^(−1)F), where O^(sh)_(S,s̄) is the strict henselization and p the projection (Stacks Theorem 59.53.1).

concept.title: Global sections of étale sheaves on schemes proper over a henselian local ring
concept.description: Let A be a henselian local ring, f:X→Spec A proper and X₀ the closed fibre. For every étale sheaf F on X the restriction Γ(X,F)→Γ(X₀,F|_(X₀)) is bijective, and for finite constant coefficients H¹(X,M)≅H¹(X₀,M) (Stacks Lemmas 59.91.2–59.91.3 and 59.85.1).

concept.title: Gabber’s affine analogue of proper base change
concept.description: Let (A,I) be a henselian pair, X an affine scheme over Spec A and X₀=X×Spec(A/I). For every torsion étale abelian sheaf F on X, H^q(X,F)→H^q(X₀,F|_(X₀)) is an isomorphism for all q (Stacks Section 59.82, Lemma 59.82.8).

concept.title: Invariance of cohomology of proper curves under extension of separably closed fields
concept.description: Let k′/k be an extension of separably closed fields, X a proper k-scheme of dimension at most one and F a torsion étale abelian sheaf on X. Then H^q(X,F)→H^q(X_(k′),F|_(X_(k′))) is an isomorphism for all q (Stacks Lemma 59.83.12).

concept.title: Exactness of étale direct image along finite morphisms
concept.description: For a finite morphism of schemes f:Y→X the direct image f_* on étale abelian sheaves is exact, so R^if_*F=0 for i>0; its stalk at a geometric point x̄ is ⊕ of the stalks of F at the geometric points of Y over x̄, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change (Milne LEC Prop. 8.4, Ex. 12.3; Stacks 59.55.2–59.55.3).

concept.title: Characterization of universal homeomorphisms as integral universally injective surjections
concept.description: A morphism of schemes is a universal homeomorphism if and only if it is integral, universally injective and surjective (Stacks Morphisms Lemma 29.46.5).

concept.title: Equivalence of étale sites under thickenings
concept.description: If X₀→X is a thickening of schemes (a closed immersion with locally nilpotent ideal, or more generally a closed immersion that is a homeomorphism), then V↦V×_X X₀ is an equivalence from schemes étale over X to schemes étale over X₀ (EGA IV 18.1.2; Stacks Étale Morphisms Theorem 41.15.1).

concept.title: Descent of étale morphisms along surjective integral universally injective morphisms
concept.description: For a surjective integral universally injective morphism S′→S, base change from schemes étale over S to étale schemes over S′ with descent data relative to S′/S is fully faithful, and every descent datum on a quasi-compact separated étale S′-scheme is effective (Stacks Étale Morphisms Lemma 41.20.3 and Proposition 41.20.6).

concept.title: Finiteness of higher direct images with proper support
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a separated morphism of finite type of Noetherian schemes and Λ a Noetherian torsion ring. Then the higher direct images with proper support R^if_! carry constructible sheaves of Λ-modules to constructible sheaves, vanish for i>2·dim of the fibres, and Rf_! preserves bounded complexes of finite Tor-dimension with constructible cohomology (SGA 4 XVII 5.3.6; SGA 4½ [Th. finitude]).

concept.title: Structure of the inertia group of a local field
concept.description: Let K be a nonarchimedean local field with residue field k of characteristic p and q elements. The wild inertia group P is the unique pro-p Sylow subgroup of the inertia group I, and I/P≅∏_(ℓ≠p)Z_ℓ(1)=lim μ_n (n prime to p) via σ↦σ(π^(1/n))/π^(1/n). Conjugation by a Frobenius lift acts on I/P through the cyclotomic character, i.e. as raising to the q-th power for the arithmetic Frobenius.

concept.title: Labelling of a chamber complex
concept.description: A labelling (typing) of a chamber complex X by a finite set I is a map λ from the vertices of X to I whose restriction to the vertex set of every chamber is a bijection onto I; the type of a simplex is the image of its vertices (Garrett records the complementary cotype). X is uniquely labellable if any two labellings differ by a bijection of the label sets. A simplicial automorphism g of a labelled X is type preserving if λ∘g=λ.

concept.title: Standard parabolic subgroups of a Coxeter system
concept.description: Let (W,S) be a Coxeter system and W_T=⟨T⟩ for T⊆S. Then (W_T,T) is a Coxeter system whose length function is the restriction of that of (W,S); every reduced expression of an element of W_T uses only letters from T; T↦W_T is an inclusion-preserving bijection from subsets of S onto these subgroups; and W_T∩W_T′=W_(T∩T′).

concept.title: Poset criterion for a simplicial complex
concept.description: A partially ordered set is isomorphic to the face poset of an abstract simplicial complex (with finite simplices, ordered by inclusion) if and only if each lower set {y: y≤x} is isomorphic to the poset of nonempty subsets of a finite nonempty set, and any two elements having a common lower bound have a greatest lower bound.

concept.title: Chamber theorem for reflection groups of locally finite hyperplane families
concept.description: Let H be a locally finite set of affine hyperplanes in a Euclidean space, stable under the orthogonal reflections in its members, C a chamber (component of the complement of their union) and S the set of reflections in the walls of C. Then W=⟨S⟩ is the group generated by all reflections in H and acts simply transitively on chambers; the length of w is the number of hyperplanes separating C from wC; the closure of C is a fundamental domain whose point stabilizers are generated by the elements of S fixing the point; and (W,S) satisfies the deletion condition, so is a Coxeter system.

concept.title: Satake’s Hecke eigenvalue formula for spherical functions of PGL₂
concept.description: Let k be a p-adic field with residue field of order q, G=PGL₂(k), K=PGL₂(𝒪), and ω_s(g)=∫_K |a(kg)/d(kg)|^(1/2+s)dk the zonal spherical function of the unramified principal series with parameter s∈ℂ.
