If τ_m is the characteristic function of the image of the integral matrices whose determinant has valuation m, then ∫τ_m ω_s = q^(m/2)(q^((m+1)s)−q^(−(m+1)s))/(q^s−q^(−s)) for Haar measure with K of volume 1, read as (m+1)q^(m/2) at s=0.

concept.title: Canonical integral model of the centralizer of a maximal split torus
concept.description: Let K♮ be complete for a discrete valuation ω with perfect residue field and ring of integers O♮, G a connected reductive K♮-group, S♮ a maximal K♮-split torus and Z its centralizer. There is a smooth affine O♮-group scheme 𝔷 of finite type with generic fibre Z (the canonical model) whose O♮-points are {z∈Z(K♮): ω(χ(z))=0 for every K♮-rational character χ of Z}; if the connected centre of G is anisotropic, this is the kernel of the action of Z(K♮) on the apartment of S♮.

concept.title: Exchange, deletion and folding characterizations of Coxeter systems
concept.description: For a group W generated by a set S of elements of order 2, with word length ℓ, the following are equivalent: (W,S) is a Coxeter system; the deletion condition (a word of length d>ℓ(w) for w can be shortened by deleting two letters); the exchange condition; and the folding condition (if ℓ(sw)=ℓ(w)+1=ℓ(wt) and ℓ(swt)<ℓ(w)+2 for s,t∈S, then sw=wt).

concept.title: σ-compact topological space
concept.description: A topological space is σ-compact if it is the union of countably many compact subsets. A subset of a space is σ-compact if it is σ-compact in the subspace topology, equivalently a countable union of compact subsets of the space.

concept.title: Riesz–Markov–Kakutani representation of positive functionals on C_c(X)
concept.description: For a locally compact Hausdorff space X, every positive linear functional I on the space C_c(X) of compactly supported continuous real functions is I(f)=∫f dμ for a unique Radon measure μ (finite on compact sets, outer regular on Borel sets, inner regular on open sets). Moreover μ(U)=sup{I(f): 0≤f≤1, supp f⊆U} for open U and μ(K)=inf{I(f): f≥1_K} for compact K.

concept.title: Regularity of σ-finite Radon measures
concept.description: A σ-finite Radon measure μ on a locally compact Hausdorff space is inner regular by compact sets and outer regular by open sets on every Borel set. Moreover, for every Borel set B and ε>0 there are a closed set F and an open set U with F⊆B⊆U and μ(U∖F)<ε.

concept.title: Open subsets of second-countable locally compact Hausdorff spaces are σ-compact
concept.description: In a second-countable locally compact Hausdorff space, every open subset, in particular the whole space, is a countable union of compact subsets.

concept.title: Conditional Fatou lemma
concept.description: For nonnegative random variables X_n on a probability space and a sub-σ-algebra G, E[liminf_n X_n|G]≤liminf_n E[X_n|G] almost surely, where conditional expectations of nonnegative variables are taken with values in [0,∞].

concept.title: Cauchy integral formula for closed curves with winding numbers
concept.description: Let f be holomorphic on a simply connected open set U⊆ℂ and γ a closed piecewise C¹ curve in U. For every z∈U not on γ, (2πi)⁻¹∫_γ f(ζ)/(ζ−z)dζ=n(γ,z)f(z), where n(γ,z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_γ dζ/(ζ−z) is the winding number of γ about z; in particular the integral vanishes when z lies outside γ.

concept.title: Helly selection theorem for bounded Borel measures on the real line
concept.description: Every sequence of Borel measures μ_n on ℝ with μ_n(ℝ)≤M has a subsequence converging vaguely, that is ∫f dμ_n→∫f dμ for every compactly supported continuous f, to a Borel measure μ with μ(ℝ)≤M.

concept.title: Borel transforms of finite measures are Herglotz functions
concept.description: For a finite positive Borel measure μ on ℝ, the Borel transform F(z)=∫_ℝ dμ(λ)/(λ−z) is holomorphic on ℂ∖ℝ, satisfies F(z̄)=F(z)‾ and Im F(z)=Im z·∫_ℝ dμ(λ)/|λ−z|², and obeys |F(z)|≤μ(ℝ)/Im z on the upper half-plane; in particular it maps the upper half-plane into the closed upper half-plane.

concept.title: Quantitative Kronecker theorem for linear sequences on a torus
concept.description: Let m≥1, 0<δ<1/2 and α∈ℝ^m. If the finite sequence (nα mod ℤ^m)_(n∈[N]) is not δ-equidistributed on ℝ^m/ℤ^m, that is |E_(n∈[N])F(nα)−∫F|>δ‖F‖_Lip for some Lipschitz F:ℝ^m/ℤ^m→ℂ, then some k∈ℤ^m with 0<|k|≪δ^(−O_m(1)) satisfies ‖k·α‖_(ℝ/ℤ)≪δ^(−O_m(1))/N (Green–Tao, Proposition 3.1).

concept.title: Almost k-simple algebraic group
concept.description: A nontrivial connected semisimple algebraic group G over a field k is almost k-simple if every proper normal closed k-subgroup of G is finite, i.e. G has no proper positive-dimensional connected normal k-subgroup. Absolutely almost simple groups are almost k-simple; a Weil restriction of an absolutely almost simple group is almost k-simple without being absolutely almost simple.

concept.title: Cartan decomposition for reductive groups over nonarchimedean local fields
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a nonarchimedean local field k, S a maximal k-split torus with centralizer Z, Φ⁺ a positive system of relative roots, and K the stabilizer in G(k) of a special vertex of the apartment of S in the Bruhat–Tits building. Then G(k)=K·Z⁺·K, where Z⁺ consists of the z∈Z(k) with |α(z)|≥1 for every α∈Φ⁺ (via the valuation homomorphism of Z(k)). Since A⁺=Z⁺∩S(k) has finite index in Z⁺ modulo the maximal compact subgroup of Z(k), G(k)=K·A⁺·Ω·K for a finite subset Ω⊂Z(k).

concept.title: Harish-Chandra function of PGL₂ over a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: Let k be a nonarchimedean local field with ring of integers O and absolute value |·|, G=PGL₂(k), B its upper-triangular subgroup and K=PGL₂(O). Normalized induction from the trivial character of B gives right translation on functions f:G→ℂ with f(bg)=|a/d|^(1/2)f(g) for b with diagonal entries a,d, normed by ∫_K|f|²dk for the Haar probability measure of K, using G=BK. With f₀ the K-fixed vector equal to 1 on K, the Harish-Chandra function is Ξ(g)=⟨π(g)f₀,f₀⟩=∫_K|a(kg)/d(kg)|^(1/2)dk; it is K-biinvariant with Ξ(e)=1. For k=ℚ_p it is the Harish-Chandra function of PGL₂(ℚ_p).

concept.title: Subgroup G(k)⁺ generated by unipotent radicals of parabolic subgroups
concept.description: For a connected reductive group G over a field k, G(k)⁺ is the subgroup of G(k) generated by the groups U(k) of k-points of the unipotent radicals U of the parabolic k-subgroups of G; equivalently (Borel–Tits) by the k-points of the k-split unipotent k-subgroups. It is a normal subgroup of G(k), trivial when G is k-anisotropic.

concept.title: Finite vector of a representation under a subgroup
concept.description: For a representation π of a group G on a complex vector space V and a subgroup U of G, a vector v∈V is U-finite if the linear span ⟨Uv⟩ of {π(u)v: u∈U} is finite-dimensional. For a unitary representation and a compact subgroup U these vectors form a dense subspace.

concept.title: Affine Bruhat decomposition for reductive groups over local fields
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over a nonarchimedean local field k, S a maximal k-split torus with normalizer N, and I the Iwahori subgroup of a chamber in the apartment of S in the Bruhat–Tits building. Then G(k)=I·N(k)·I, and I n I↦ n gives a bijection of I∖G(k)/I with the Iwahori–Weyl group N(k)/(N(k)∩I).

concept.title: Tempered unitary representation of a reductive group over a local field
concept.description: Let G be the k-points of a connected reductive group over a local field k with a good maximal compact subgroup K and Harish-Chandra function Ξ_G. A unitary representation ρ of G is tempered if |⟨ρ(g)v,w⟩|≤(dim⟨Kv⟩dim⟨Kw⟩)^(1/2)Ξ_G(g) for all g∈G and all K-finite unit vectors v,w (Oh’s convention); by Cowling–Haagerup–Howe and Oh this is equivalent to weak containment in the regular representation.

concept.title: Harish-Chandra function of a reductive group over a local field
concept.description: For the k-points G of a connected reductive group over a local field, with minimal parabolic subgroup B, modular function δ_B and good maximal compact subgroup K with G=BK, the Harish-Chandra function is Ξ_G(g)=∫_K δ_B(gk)^(−1/2)dk, the diagonal matrix coefficient of the K-fixed unit vector of the representation unitarily induced from the trivial character of B. It is continuous, bi-K-invariant, takes values in (0,1] and is L^(2+ε) modulo the centre.

concept.title: Oh’s temperedness of restrictions to strongly orthogonal root subgroups
concept.description: Let k be a local field with char(k)≠2, G the k-points of a connected reductive group of k-semisimple rank at least 2 with G/Z(G) almost k-simple (and not locally Sp_(2n)(ℂ)), S a strongly orthogonal system of positive nonmultipliable roots, and G_S the k-points of the reductive subgroup generated by a maximal k-split torus and the root groups U_(±α), α∈S. Then for every unitary representation ρ of G without nonzero G⁺-invariant vectors, the restriction ρ|G_S is tempered (Oh, Theorem 5.5).

concept.title: Holomorphic function with values in a complex Banach space
concept.description: A map f from an open subset U of ℂ to a complex Banach space X is holomorphic if for every z₀∈U the difference quotients (f(z)−f(z₀))/(z−z₀) converge in the norm of X as z→z₀; the limit is the complex derivative f′(z₀). For X=ℂ this is ordinary holomorphy.

concept.title: Locally compact subspaces of Hausdorff spaces are open in their closure
concept.description: If A is a subset of a Hausdorff space X that is locally compact in the subspace topology, then A is open in its closure, i.e. A is locally closed in X. In particular a dense locally compact subspace of a Hausdorff space is open.

concept.title: Closure of a subgroup of a topological group is a subgroup
concept.description: In a topological group G the closure of a subgroup H is again a subgroup of G, because multiplication and inversion are continuous; the closure of a normal subgroup is normal.

concept.title: Open subgroups of a topological group are closed
concept.description: Every open subgroup H of a topological group G is closed, since its complement is the union of the cosets xH with x∉H, each open because translations are homeomorphisms.

concept.title: Spectra in a unital closed subalgebra of a Banach algebra
concept.description: Let B be a closed subalgebra of a unital complex Banach algebra A containing the identity of A. For every b∈B, σ_A(b)⊆σ_B(b) and the topological boundary of σ_B(b) is contained in σ_A(b) (indeed in its boundary). Hence σ_B(b)=σ_A(b) whenever σ_B(b) has empty interior, e.g. when it lies in ℝ.

concept.title: Kneser–Tits conjecture for classical groups over local and global fields
concept.description: Let K be a local or global field and G a simply connected absolutely almost simple K-isotropic group of classical type A_n, B_n, C_n or D_n, excluding the trialitarian forms ³D₄ and ⁶D₄. Then G(K)=G(K)⁺. For inner type A this is the triviality of the reduced Whitehead group SK₁(D), for outer type A that of the reduced unitary Whitehead group.

concept.title: Prasad–Raghunathan reduction of the Kneser–Tits problem to K-rank one
concept.description: Let G be a simply connected absolutely almost simple group of K-rank at least 2, S a maximal K-split torus and H its centralizer. Then H(K) is generated by the groups H_i(K)=H(K)∩G_i(K), where G_i are the K-isotropic K-simple components of K-rank one obtained from the Tits index by keeping one Galois orbit of distinguished vertices; hence G(K)=G(K)⁺ if this holds for every G_i.

concept.title: Quasi-splitness of exceptional groups over nonarchimedean local fields
concept.description: Over a nonarchimedean local field K every absolutely almost simple simply connected K-group of type E₈, F₄ or G₂ is K-split; every group of type ³D₄, ⁶D₄ or ²E₆ is quasi-split; every group of type B_n, C_n or E₇ splits over a quadratic extension, and every inner form of type E₆ splits over an extension of degree 3. These follow from Kneser’s vanishing of H¹(K,G) for simply connected G.

concept.title: Kneser’s classification of anisotropic simply connected groups over local fields
concept.description: Every simply connected absolutely almost simple group that is anisotropic over a nonarchimedean local field K is isomorphic to SL₁(D), the group of reduced-norm-one elements of a finite-dimensional central division algebra D over K; in particular it is an inner form of type A.

concept.title: Canonical factorization of Hardy H² functions with exponential outer factor
concept.description: Every nonzero f∈H² of the unit disk has log|f*|∈L¹ of the circle, the function Q_f(z)=exp∫(ζ+z)/(ζ−z)·log|f*(ζ)|dm(ζ) lies in H², and f=M_f·Q_f with M_f an inner function. Here m is normalized arc measure; M_f is constant exactly when log|f(0)|=∫log|f*|dm.

concept.title: Completeness of the Hausdorff metric on compact subsets of ℝⁿ
concept.description: The nonempty compact subsets of ℝⁿ form a complete metric space under the Hausdorff distance: every Cauchy sequence converges to a nonempty compact set.

concept.title: Closed regularity of finite Borel measures on a metric space
concept.description: Every finite Borel measure μ on a metric space is closed regular: for each Borel set B, μ(B) is the supremum of μ(F) over closed sets F⊆B, equivalently the infimum of μ(U) over open sets U⊇B.

concept.title: Weak convergence of finite Borel measures on a metric space
concept.description: Finite positive Borel measures μ_j on a metric space converge weakly to a finite Borel measure μ if ∫f dμ_j→∫f dμ for every bounded continuous real function f. For probability measures this is the usual weak convergence; testing f=1 shows that total masses converge.

concept.title: Affine hull and dimension of a subset of ℝⁿ
concept.description: The affine hull aff A of a nonempty A⊆ℝⁿ is the set of affine combinations ∑λ_ix_i of finitely many x_i∈A with ∑λ_i=1; it is the smallest affine subspace x+V, V a linear subspace, containing A. The dimension of A, in particular of a convex set, is dim V.

concept.title: Minkowski–Weyl theorem for convex polytopes
concept.description: A subset of ℝⁿ is a convex polytope, the convex hull of finitely many points, if and only if it is a bounded intersection of finitely many closed halfspaces.

concept.title: Radius of convergence of a complex power series
concept.description: For a complex power series ∑c_k(z−z₀)^k, its radius of convergence is R=sup{|z−z₀|: the series converges at z}∈[0,∞]. The open disk |z−z₀|<R is its disk of convergence (all of ℂ when R=∞).

concept.title: Cauchy–Hadamard theorem for complex power series
concept.description: A complex power series ∑c_k(z−z₀)^k with radius of convergence R satisfies 1/R=limsup|c_k|^{1/k}. It converges absolutely for |z−z₀|<R, absolutely and uniformly on |z−z₀|≤r for each r<R, and diverges for |z−z₀|>R.

concept.title: Morera’s theorem
concept.description: A continuous complex function f on an open set G⊆ℂ whose integral ∫_γf(z)dz vanishes for every closed piecewise smooth path γ in G is holomorphic on G.

concept.title: Uniform limits and complex line integrals
concept.description: If continuous functions f_n converge uniformly to f on the image of a piecewise smooth path γ in ℂ, then ∫_γf_n(z)dz→∫_γf(z)dz. Consequently a uniformly convergent series of continuous functions can be integrated termwise along γ.

concept.title: Anderson–Klee bound on singular boundary points of a convex body
concept.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ with nonempty interior and 0≤r≤n−1, the boundary points whose normal cone has dimension at least n−r can be covered by countably many compact sets of finite r-dimensional Hausdorff measure. In particular the boundary points with more than one outer unit normal form an H^{n−1}-null set.

concept.title: Area formula for Lipschitz maps
concept.description: For a Lipschitz map f:ℝ^m→ℝⁿ with m≤n, its Jacobian Jf=√det(Df^TDf) exists almost everywhere, and for every Lebesgue measurable A⊆ℝ^m, ∫_A Jf dx=∫_{ℝⁿ}#(A∩f⁻¹{y})dH^m(y), where H^m is m-dimensional Hausdorff measure and # counts points.

concept.title: Commutator subgroup of two subgroups
concept.description: For subgroups H and K of a group G, [H,K] is the subgroup of G generated by all commutators hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ with h∈H and k∈K. Since the inverse of such a commutator is a commutator of k and h, [H,K]=[K,H].

concept.title: Three subgroup lemma
concept.description: For subgroups A, B, C of a group G and a normal subgroup N of G containing [[B,C],A] and [[C,A],B], also [[A,B],C]⊆N. In particular, for normal subgroups A, B, C one has [[A,B],C]⊆[[B,C],A]·[[C,A],B]. It follows from the Hall–Witt identity.

concept.title: Normal closure of a subset of a group
concept.description: For a subset B of a group G, the normal closure of B in G is the smallest normal subgroup of G containing B; it is the subgroup generated by all conjugates gbg⁻¹ with b∈B and g∈G.

concept.title: Central series with infinite cyclic factors in a finitely generated torsion-free nilpotent group
concept.description: Every finitely generated nilpotent group G with no nonidentity elements of finite order has a central series 1=H₀⊆H₁⊆⋯⊆H_s=G of normal subgroups in which each H_i/H_(i−1) lies in the centre of G/H_(i−1) and is infinite cyclic.

concept.title: Change of variables for analytic isomorphisms over a local field
concept.description: Let K be a local field with normalized absolute value |·| and additive Haar measure dx on Kⁿ, and let φ:U→V be an analytic isomorphism of open subsets of Kⁿ. Then ∫_V f(y)dy=∫_U f(φ(x))|det Dφ(x)| dx for every nonnegative measurable or integrable f on V. Equivalently, the measures |ω| defined by top-degree analytic forms satisfy |φ*ω|=φ*|ω|.

concept.title: Haar measure on a restricted product of locally compact groups
concept.description: Let G=∏′_v(G_v,K_v) be the restricted product of locally compact groups G_v with respect to compact open subgroups K_v given for almost all v, and let μ_v be left Haar measures with μ_v(K_v)=1 for almost all v. There is a unique left Haar measure μ on G whose restriction to each open subgroup ∏_(v∈S)G_v×∏_(v∉S)K_v is the product of the μ_v; its modular quasi-character is Δ_G(g)=∏_vΔ_(G_v)(g_v).

concept.title: Modular quasi-character of a closed normal subgroup
concept.description: If N is a closed normal subgroup of a locally compact group G, then the modular quasi-character of N is the restriction to N of the modular quasi-character of G: Δ_N=Δ_G|_N. In particular N is unimodular whenever Δ_G is trivial on N.

concept.title: Semialgebra of subsets of a set
concept.description: A family S of subsets of a set Ω that is closed under finite intersections and such that the complement in Ω of each member is a finite disjoint union of members of S; for example ∅ together with the half-open intervals (a,b], −∞≤a<b≤∞, in ℝ.

concept.title: Measure on an algebra of sets (premeasure)
concept.description: A set function μ from an algebra A of subsets of Ω to [0,∞] with μ(∅)=0 such that μ(⋃ᵢAᵢ)=∑ᵢμ(Aᵢ) for every sequence of pairwise disjoint Aᵢ∈A whose union also lies in A.

concept.title: Countably generated σ-algebra
concept.description: A σ-algebra F on a set Ω is countably generated (separable) if F=σ(C) for some countable family C of subsets of Ω.

concept.title: ε–δ criterion for absolute continuity of a finite measure
concept.description: Let μ be a positive measure and ν a complex (in particular a finite signed or finite positive) measure on the same σ-algebra. Then ν≪μ if and only if for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that |ν(A)|<ε for every measurable A with μ(A)<δ. Finiteness of ν is needed for the forward implication.

concept.title: Herbrand function of a Galois extension of local fields
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of nonarchimedean local fields with lower ramification groups G_t (t≥−1), the Herbrand function is φ_(L/K)(u)=∫₀^u dt/[G₀:G_t] for u≥−1, where [G₀:G_t] means [G_t:G₀]^(−1) for −1≤t≤0, so φ_(L/K)(u)=u on [−1,0]. It is a continuous, strictly increasing, piecewise linear bijection of [−1,∞) onto itself; its inverse is denoted ψ_(L/K).

concept.title: Equivalence of norms on a finite-dimensional space over a complete valued field
concept.description: Let K be a field complete for an absolute value and E a finite-dimensional K-vector space. Any two norms on E are equivalent and E is complete for each of them; in particular the norm topology is the product topology of Kⁿ for any choice of basis.

concept.title: Norm formula for the unique extension of a complete valuation
concept.description: Let K be complete for a nonarchimedean valuation v and L/K a finite extension of degree n. Then w(x)=v(N_(L/K)x)/n is a valuation on L extending v; it is the only valuation on L extending v, and L is complete for w. Equivalently |x|_L=|N_(L/K)x|_K^(1/n).

concept.title: Monogenicity of integer rings of extensions of complete discretely valued fields
concept.description: Let K be complete for a discrete valuation with valuation ring o, and L/K a finite extension whose residue field extension is separable, with O the valuation ring of L. Then O=o[ω] for some ω∈O.

concept.title: Different of a monogenic local extension via the derivative of the minimal polynomial
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite separable extension of complete discretely valued fields with valuation rings O⊇o. If O=o[α] and f∈o[T] is the minimal polynomial of α, then the different of L/K is 𝔇_(L/K)=f′(α)O. The proof uses Euler’s formula: the trace-dual basis of 1,α,…,α^(n−1) is b₀/f′(α),…,b_(n−1)/f′(α), where f(T)/(T−α)=∑b_iT^i.

concept.title: Inertia group and ramification index of a Galois extension of complete discretely valued fields
concept.description: Let L/K be a finite Galois extension of complete discretely valued fields with separable residue field extension l/k. Reduction gives an exact sequence 1→G₀→Gal(L/K)→Gal(l/k)→1, where the inertia group G₀ consists of the automorphisms acting trivially on l, and |G₀| equals the ramification index e(L/K).

concept.title: Genus of a compact Riemann surface
concept.description: The genus of a compact Riemann surface X is g(X)=dim_ℂΩ¹_hol(X), the dimension of the complex vector space of holomorphic differentials on X. It is finite, and by the Riemann–Roch theorem it equals the number of handles of the underlying closed surface.

concept.title: Atkin–Lehner–Li newform decomposition of cusp forms on Γ₁(N)
concept.description: For integers k,N≥1, the normalized newforms of level N form a basis of the new subspace S_k(Γ₁(N))^new, distinct newforms having distinct systems of Hecke eigenvalues, and S_k(Γ₁(N))=⊕_(M|N)⊕_(d|N/M)α_d(S_k(Γ₁(M))^new) with α_d(f)(τ)=f(dτ). Thus the forms f(dτ), for newforms f of level M dividing N and d dividing N/M, form a basis of S_k(Γ₁(N)).

concept.title: Galois conjugates of weight-two normalized eigenforms
concept.description: Let f=∑a_nqⁿ∈S₂(Γ₀(N),χ) be a normalized eigenform for all Hecke operators, with coefficient field K_f. For every field embedding σ:K_f→ℂ the conjugate f^σ=∑σ(a_n)qⁿ is a normalized eigenform in S₂(Γ₀(N),σ∘χ), and if f is a newform then so is f^σ.

concept.title: Degeneracy maps between modular curves X₁(N)→X₁(M)
concept.description: For M|N and d|N/M there is a morphism B_d:X₁(N)→X₁(M) of curves over ℚ given on the upper half-plane by τ↦dτ. By Albanese functoriality it induces a homomorphism J₁(N)→J₁(M) over ℚ, and pulling back the differential f(τ)dτ along B_d gives d·f(dτ)dτ, so on weight-two cusp forms it is d times the degeneracy map α_d.

concept.title: Analytic Jacobian of a compact Riemann surface
concept.description: For a compact Riemann surface X of genus g, the analytic Jacobian is the complex torus Jac(X)=Ω¹_hol(X)^∧/H₁(X,ℤ), where a homology class γ gives the functional ω↦∫_γω on holomorphic differentials. It has dimension g, and by Abel’s theorem it is isomorphic to the degree-zero divisor class group Pic⁰(X).

concept.title: Local algebraicity of rational abelian ℓ-adic representations of G_ℚ
concept.description: Let ρ be a semisimple abelian ℓ-adic representation of Gal(ℚ̄/ℚ) that is rational: unramified outside a finite set with Frobenius characteristic polynomials having rational coefficients. Then ρ is locally algebraic; in particular each one-dimensional constituent agrees with an integral power χ_ℓ^n of the ℓ-adic cyclotomic character on an open subgroup of an inertia group at ℓ.

concept.title: Semisimplicity of restrictions to finite-index subgroups
concept.description: Let ρ be a semisimple finite-dimensional linear representation of a group G over a field of characteristic zero, and H a subgroup of finite index in G. Then the restriction of ρ to H is semisimple.

concept.title: Dichotomy for subgroups of GL₂ with infinite projective image
concept.description: Let F be a field of characteristic zero and G⊆GL₂(F) a non-abelian subgroup acting semisimply on F² whose image in PGL₂(F) is infinite. Then either every subgroup of finite index in G acts irreducibly and non-abelianly on F², or G lies in the normalizer of a Cartan subgroup C of GL₂(F) with [G:G∩C]=2, and a finite-index subgroup of G is abelian exactly when it lies in C.

concept.title: Riemann–Lebesgue lemma on the real line
concept.description: If f is Lebesgue integrable on ℝ, then ∫f(x)cos(λx)dx and ∫f(x)sin(λx)dx tend to 0 as the real parameter λ→∞; equivalently the Fourier transform of f tends to 0 at infinity.

concept.title: Möbius action of SL₂(ℝ) on the upper half-plane
concept.description: The upper half-plane is ℍ={τ∈ℂ: Im τ>0}. A matrix [[a,b],[c,d]]∈SL₂(ℝ) acts on ℍ by τ↦(aτ+b)/(cτ+d); this is a group action, since Im((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=Im τ/|cτ+d|² and composition of these maps corresponds to matrix multiplication. The matrices ±I act trivially. Restriction gives the action of SL₂(ℤ) and of its subgroups on ℍ.

concept.title: Ring ℤ/nℤ of integers modulo n
concept.description: For a positive integer n, ℤ/nℤ is the quotient ring of the integers by the ideal nℤ: its n elements are the residue classes of integers modulo n, added and multiplied through representatives.

concept.title: L-function of a compatible system of ℓ-adic Galois representations
concept.description: Let F be a number field and (ρ_ℓ) a family of continuous representations of G_F on finite-dimensional ℚ_ℓ-vector spaces V_ℓ, compatible in the sense that for each finite place v the polynomial P_v(T)=det(1−Frob_v⁻¹T|(V_ℓ^∨)^(I_v)), for ℓ prime to v, has rational coefficients independent of ℓ. Here I_v is an inertia group at v, Frob_v an arithmetic Frobenius and V^∨ the dual representation. The L-function is the Euler product L(ρ,s)=∏_v P_v((Nv)^(−s))^(−1) over all finite places, including ramified ones.

concept.title: Gowers uniformity norm on a finite abelian group
concept.description: For f:G→ℂ on a finite abelian group G and d≥1, ‖f‖_(U^d) is the 2^d-th root of the average over x,h₁,…,h_d∈G of ∏_(ω∈{0,1}^d) C^(|ω|)f(x+ω₁h₁+⋯+ω_dh_d), where C is complex conjugation. The average is nonnegative, and ‖·‖_(U^d) is a norm for d≥2.

concept.title: Gowers–Cauchy–Schwarz inequality
concept.description: For functions f_ω:G→ℂ, ω∈{0,1}^d, on a finite abelian group G, the Gowers inner product ⟨(f_ω)⟩_(U^d), the average over x,h₁,…,h_d of ∏_ω C^(|ω|)f_ω(x+ω₁h₁+⋯+ω_dh_d), satisfies |⟨(f_ω)⟩_(U^d)|≤∏_ω‖f_ω‖_(U^d).

concept.title: Wigert’s maximal-order bound for the divisor function
concept.description: The number d(n) of positive divisors of n satisfies log d(n)≤(log 2+o(1))·log n/log log n as n→∞, and this order is attained infinitely often. In particular d(n)≤exp(C log n/log log n) for an absolute constant C and all n≥3.

concept.title: Goldston–Yıldırım truncated divisor sum Λ_R
concept.description: For a parameter R≥1 and a positive integer n, Λ_R(n)=∑_(d|n, d≤R) μ(d)log(R/d), with μ the Möbius function. It truncates the identity Λ(n)=∑_(d|n)μ(d)log(n/d) for the von Mangoldt function; Λ_R(n)=log R whenever n is a prime larger than R.

concept.title: Goldston–Yıldırım correlation estimates for W-tricked truncated divisor sums
concept.description: Let W be the product of the primes up to a sufficiently slowly growing w(N) and R a small fixed power of N. For fixed m,t, affine-linear forms ψ_i on ℤ^t with integer linear parts bounded by √w(N)/2, nonzero and pairwise non-proportional, and a box B with sides at least R^(10m), the average of ∏_iΛ_R(Wψ_i(x)+1)² over B is (1+o(1))(W log R/φ(W))^m. For distinct h_i with |h_i|≤N² and an interval B of length at least R^(10m), the average of ∏_iΛ_R(W(x+h_i)+1)² is at most (1+o(1))(W log R/φ(W))^m∏_(p|Δ)(1+O(p^(−1/2))), where Δ=∏_(i<j)|h_i−h_j|.

concept.title: Quasi-projectivity of torsors under smooth group schemes over a Dedekind scheme
concept.description: Let S be a Dedekind scheme and G a smooth, separated S-group scheme of finite type. Every G-torsor X over S is quasi-projective over S; in particular G itself is quasi-projective over S. This is Raynaud’s theorem, Bosch–Lütkebohmert–Raynaud, Néron Models, 6.4/1.

concept.title: Finite sets of points of a quasi-projective scheme lie in an affine open
concept.description: If X is quasi-projective over an affine scheme, then every finite set of points of X is contained in some affine open subscheme of X.

concept.title: Infinitesimal lifting criterion for smoothness
concept.description: A morphism of schemes X→S locally of finite presentation is smooth if and only if, for every affine S-scheme T and closed subscheme T₀⊂T defined by a square-zero ideal, every S-morphism T₀→X extends to an S-morphism T→X.

concept.title: Uniformly elliptic operator in nondivergence form
concept.description: A second-order linear operator Lu=∑_{i,j}a_ij∂_iju+∑_ib_i∂_iu+cu on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ with real coefficient functions, a_ij=a_ji, and constants 0<λ≤Λ such that λ|ξ|²≤∑a_ij(x)ξ_iξ_j≤Λ|ξ|² for all x∈Ω and ξ∈ℝⁿ. Derivatives are classical, or weak for Sobolev functions.

concept.title: Trace theorem for W¹,ᵖ on bounded Lipschitz domains
concept.description: For a bounded Lipschitz domain U⊂ℝⁿ and 1≤p<∞ there is a bounded linear operator T:W¹,ᵖ(U)→Lᵖ(∂U;Hⁿ⁻¹) with Tf=f|∂U for every f∈W¹,ᵖ(U)∩C(Ū). Tf is the trace of f; boundary values f=g on part of ∂U mean Tf=Tg Hⁿ⁻¹-almost everywhere there.

concept.title: Density of functions smooth up to the boundary in W¹,ᵖ of a Lipschitz domain
concept.description: If U⊂ℝⁿ is bounded with Lipschitz boundary and 1≤p<∞, every f∈W¹,ᵖ(U) is a W¹,ᵖ-limit of functions in W¹,ᵖ(U)∩C^∞(Ū); if also f∈C(Ū), the approximants can be chosen to converge uniformly on Ū.

concept.title: Interior W²,ᵖ estimate for the Poisson equation
concept.description: For 1<p<∞, if f∈Lᵖ(B₁) and u∈W²,ᵖ(B₁) satisfies Δu=f almost everywhere in the unit ball B₁⊂ℝⁿ, then ‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ(B₁/₂)}≤C(‖u‖_{Lᵖ(B₁)}+‖f‖_{Lᵖ(B₁)}) with C depending only on n and p.

concept.title: Dynkin’s formula for Markov chains
concept.description: For a Markov chain (X_k) with natural filtration (F_k), nonnegative adapted Z_k and a stopping time τ, put τⁿ=min{n,τ,inf{k:Z_k≥n}}. Then E_x[Z_{τⁿ}]=E_x[Z₀]+E_x[∑_{i=1}^{τⁿ}(E[Z_i|F_{i−1}]−Z_{i−1})] for every initial state x and every n.

concept.title: Lebesgue decomposition theorem for σ-finite measures
concept.description: If μ and ν are σ-finite measures on one measurable space, then ν=ν_a+ν_s uniquely with ν_a absolutely continuous and ν_s singular with respect to μ; ν_a has a Radon–Nikodym density with respect to μ.

concept.title: Martingale differentiation of measures along refining partitions
concept.description: Let φ and ν be finite measures on a measurable space whose σ-algebra is generated by a refining sequence of countable partitions 𝓑_i, and let B_i(y) be the cell of 𝓑_i containing y. Then ν(B_i(y))/φ(B_i(y)) converges for φ-almost every y to the Radon–Nikodym density of the absolutely continuous part of ν with respect to φ (Doob’s differentiation theorem).

concept.title: Chapman–Kolmogorov equations for a Markov kernel
concept.description: For a Markov kernel P on a measurable space with iterates Pⁿ, P^{n+m}(x,B)=∫Pⁿ(x,dy)P^m(y,B) for all n,m≥0, states x and measurable B; for a Markov chain with kernel P, Pⁿ(x,B)=P_x(X_n∈B).

concept.title: Feller’s boundary criteria for a diffusion on natural scale
concept.description: For a regular one-dimensional diffusion on natural scale with speed measure ν, right endpoint b and interior point u: b is accessible iff b is finite and ∫_u^b(b−x)ν(dx)<∞; accessible and reflecting iff b is finite and ν(u,b]<∞; an entrance boundary iff b=∞ and ∫_u^∞xν(dx)<∞. Left endpoints are symmetric.

concept.title: Feller property of a regular one-dimensional diffusion
concept.description: A regular one-dimensional diffusion on an interval I extends, after adjoining its entrance boundaries to I, to a continuous Feller process on the enlarged interval; in particular its transition operators preserve continuous functions vanishing at the remaining inaccessible ends.

concept.title: Strong Markov property of Feller processes
concept.description: A canonical right-continuous Feller process is strong Markov: for every initial law, optional time τ and measurable path functional ξ≥0, E[ξ∘θ_τ|F_τ]=E_{X_τ}[ξ] almost surely on {τ<∞}, where θ_τ shifts the path by τ.

concept.title: Ratio ergodic theorem for recurrent one-dimensional diffusions
concept.description: For a regular recurrent one-dimensional diffusion on natural scale with speed measure ν, and measurable f,g≥0 with νf<∞ and νg>0, ∫₀ᵗf(X_s)ds/∫₀ᵗg(X_s)ds→νf/νg almost surely under every P_x as t→∞ (Derman; Motoo and Watanabe).

concept.title: Locally integrable stochastic process
concept.description: A real process X on a filtered probability space is locally integrable if there are stopping times T_n increasing to ∞ almost surely such that each variable 1_(T_n>0)sup_(t≤T_n)|X_t| is integrable. For a nonnegative increasing process A with A₀=0 this means E[A_(T_n)]<∞ for every n.

concept.title: Kunita–Watanabe covariation characterization of the stochastic integral
concept.description: For locally square-integrable càdlàg martingales M,L and a predictable G that is locally square-integrable against [M], the stochastic integral G·M satisfies [G·M,L]_t=∫_(0,t]G_s d[M,L]_s, and it is the unique locally square-integrable martingale Y with Y₀=0 having this covariation with every such L. In particular [G·M,H·N]=∫GH d[M,N].

concept.title: Strict-past variables placed at a predictable time give predictable processes
concept.description: If T is a predictable stopping time and U is an F_(T−)-measurable random variable, then the processes U1_[T,∞) and U1_[T] (equal to U at time T and 0 elsewhere) are predictable.

concept.title: Doléans’ theorem: natural increasing processes are exactly the predictable ones
concept.description: On a filtration satisfying the usual conditions, an integrable increasing process A (adapted, right-continuous, nondecreasing, A₀=0, EA_∞<∞) is natural, meaning E∫_(0,∞)ΔM_t dA_t=0 for every bounded càdlàg martingale M, if and only if A is predictable.

concept.title: Dunford–Pettis weak compactness criterion in L¹
concept.description: For a subset H of L¹ of a probability space the following are equivalent: H is uniformly integrable; H is relatively compact for the weak topology σ(L¹,L^∞); every sequence in H has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concept.title: Quasi-compact morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is quasi-compact if f⁻¹(V) is quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open subset V⊆S; it suffices to check this over the members of an affine open cover of S. A scheme is quasi-compact if its underlying topological space is.

concept.title: Quasi-separated morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is quasi-separated if its diagonal morphism X→X×_S X is quasi-compact. A scheme X is quasi-separated if X→Spec ℤ is, equivalently if the intersection of any two affine open subschemes of X is quasi-compact.

concept.title: Morphism of schemes of finite presentation
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is of finite presentation if it is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For affine X=Spec A and S=Spec R this says that A is a finitely presented R-algebra.

concept.title: Locally constructible subset of a topological space
concept.description: In a topological space X an open subset U is retrocompact if U∩W is quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open W⊆X. A subset E⊆X is constructible if it is a finite union of sets U∖V with U and V retrocompact open subsets, and locally constructible if X has an open cover by subsets V_i such that each E∩V_i is constructible in V_i. In a Noetherian space both notions reduce to finite unions of locally closed subsets.

concept.title: Quasi-finite morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S locally of finite type is quasi-finite at x∈X if x is an isolated point of its fibre X_(f(x)). The morphism f is quasi-finite if it is of finite type and every point of X is isolated in its fibre; equivalently f is of finite type and every fibre is a finite discrete space.

concept.title: Normalizer and centralizer of a subgroup scheme
concept.description: Let G be a group scheme over S and H⊆G a closed subgroup scheme. The normalizer N_G(H) and the centralizer Z_G(H) are the subgroup functors of G assigning to an S-scheme S′ the set of g∈G(S′) with gH_(S′)g⁻¹=H_(S′), respectively the set of g∈G(S′) whose conjugation action on H_(S′) is trivial. When represented by closed subgroup schemes of G these are denoted by the same symbols; Z_G(H) is normal in N_G(H).

concept.title: Quotient of a group scheme by a flat subgroup scheme
concept.description: For an S-group scheme G and a flat, finitely presented closed subgroup scheme H, a quotient G/H is an S-scheme Q with a morphism π:G→Q, constant on the cosets of H, that makes G a right H-torsor over Q; it is unique up to unique isomorphism when it exists. If H is normal in G, the quotient is an S-group scheme and π is a homomorphism with kernel H.

concept.title: Irreducible-subset criterion for constructibility in a Noetherian space
concept.description: A subset E of a Noetherian topological space X is constructible if and only if, for every irreducible closed subset Z⊆X, the intersection E∩Z either contains a nonempty open subset of Z or is not dense in Z.

concept.title: Generic constancy of the number of geometric connected components of fibres
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes of finite type and y∈Y. There is a nonempty open subset V of the closure of {y} such that the number of connected components of the geometric fibres (X_v)_K, for K a separably closed extension of κ(v), is constant for v∈V.

concept.title: Connected components under extension of a separably closed field
concept.description: If X is a scheme over a separably closed field k and K/k is any field extension, the projection X_K→X induces a bijection on connected components. Hence the number of connected components of X×_k K, for K a separably closed extension of k, does not depend on K, and for a morphism of schemes this number for the fibres is compatible with arbitrary base change.

concept.title: Finiteness of the integral closure in a finite separable extension
concept.description: Let A be an integrally closed domain with fraction field K and B its integral closure in a finite separable extension L/K of degree m. Using a K-basis of L contained in B and its dual basis for the trace pairing, B lies between two free A-submodules of L of rank m. Hence B is a finitely generated A-module when A is Noetherian, and free of rank m when A is a principal ideal domain.

concept.title: Finitely generated modules over a Noetherian ring are Noetherian
concept.description: If A is a Noetherian commutative ring, every finitely generated A-module M is Noetherian: every submodule of M is finitely generated, equivalently every ascending chain of submodules of M is eventually constant.

concept.title: Transitivity of integrality
concept.description: If A⊆B⊆C are commutative rings with B integral over A and C integral over B, then C is integral over A. Consequently the integral closure of A in C is integrally closed in C; for an integral domain A, its integral closure in an algebraic extension of its fraction field is an integrally closed domain.

concept.title: Integral domains algebraic over a field are fields
concept.description: If an integral domain B contains a field k and every element of B is algebraic over k, then B is a field: for nonzero b∈B, multiplication by b is an injective k-linear endomorphism of the finite-dimensional k-vector space k[b], hence surjective, so b is invertible.

concept.title: Radicial morphism of schemes
concept.description: A morphism of schemes f:X→S is radicial if it is injective on underlying points and every residue field extension κ(x)/κ(f(x)) is purely inseparable; equivalently f is universally injective, meaning every base change of f is injective on underlying points.

concept.title: Fibral criterion for smooth and étale morphisms
concept.description: Let X and Y be S-schemes locally of finite presentation with X flat over S, and f:X→Y an S-morphism. Then f is smooth (respectively étale) if and only if every fibre f_s:X_s→Y_s is smooth (respectively étale), and Y is then flat over S at the points of f(X); pointwise, f is étale at x if f_s is étale at x (EGA IV₄ 17.8.2–17.8.3, resting on the fibral flatness criterion EGA IV₃ 11.3.10).

concept.title: Separatedness of Proj of a graded ring
concept.description: For a graded commutative ring S=⊕_(d≥0)S_d, the scheme Proj(S) is separated over Spec(S₀). In particular projective space Pⁿ_ℤ is a separated scheme.

concept.title: Valuative criterion for Proj of a finitely generated graded ring
concept.description: If a graded ring S is finitely generated as an S₀-algebra, then Proj(S)→Spec(S₀) satisfies the existence and uniqueness parts of the valuative criterion: for a valuation ring A with fraction field K, every morphism Spec K→Proj(S) compatible with a given Spec A→Spec(S₀) extends uniquely to Spec A→Proj(S).

concept.title: Stability of proper morphisms under composition and base change
concept.description: Closed immersions of schemes are proper, a composition of proper morphisms of schemes is proper, and the base change of a proper morphism along any morphism of schemes is proper.

concept.title: Morphisms from proper schemes to separated schemes are proper
concept.description: Let X→S be proper and Y→S separated. Then every S-morphism X→Y is proper, as the composite of the graph X→X×_S Y, a closed immersion, with the base-changed projection X×_S Y→Y; in particular its image is closed in Y.

concept.title: Representability and smoothness of normalizers of multiplicative-type subgroups
concept.description: Let G be a finitely presented affine group scheme over S and Y,Y′⊆G finitely presented closed subschemes with Y finite flat over S or a subgroup of multiplicative type. The transporter of Y into Y′ is represented by a finitely presented closed subscheme of G, so the normalizer N_G(Y) is a finitely presented closed subgroup. If G is smooth and Y,Y′ are subgroups of multiplicative type, these schemes are smooth (SGA 3 XI 2.4bis; Conrad, Reductive group schemes, Proposition 2.1.2).

concept.title: Representability of Hom-schemes out of finite flat schemes
concept.description: If X→S is finite, flat and finitely presented and Y→S is affine of finite presentation, the functor S′↦Hom_(S′)(X_(S′),Y_(S′)) is represented by an affine S-scheme of finite presentation. Likewise group homomorphisms from a finite flat finitely presented S-group to an affine finitely presented S-group are classified by an affine finitely presented S-scheme Hom_(S-gp)(G,G′).

concept.title: Relative schematic density of torsion in groups of multiplicative type
concept.description: If H is a group scheme of multiplicative type over a scheme S, the torsion subgroups H[n], n≥1, are relatively schematically dense in H: after any base change S′→S, the only closed subscheme of H_(S′) containing every H[n]_(S′) is H_(S′) itself (EGA IV₃ 11.10.8–11.10.10).

concept.title: Algebraic space
concept.description: An algebraic space over a scheme S is a sheaf of sets F on the category of S-schemes with the fppf topology whose diagonal F→F×_S F is representable by schemes and which admits a surjective étale morphism U→F from a scheme U. Every scheme is an algebraic space; quotients of schemes by flat equivalence relations are in general algebraic spaces rather than schemes.

concept.title: Artin’s theorem on quotients by flat equivalence relations
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over a Noetherian scheme S and R⊆X×_S X an equivalence relation represented by a closed subscheme such that both projections R→X are flat. Then the fppf quotient sheaf X/R is a separated algebraic space of finite type over S (M. Artin, Versal deformations and algebraic stacks, 1974, Corollary 6.3).

concept.title: Quasi-finite separated algebraic spaces over Noetherian schemes are schemes
concept.description: An algebraic space that is quasi-finite and separated over a Noetherian scheme is a scheme (Knutson, Algebraic Spaces, II 6.15); Laumon–Moret-Bailly remove the Noetherian hypothesis.

concept.title: Normalization of a scheme in a morphism
concept.description: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f:Y→X, let 𝒪′ be the integral closure of 𝒪_X in the quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-algebra f_*𝒪_Y. The normalization of X in Y is the integral morphism ν:X′=Spec_X(𝒪′)→X, through which f factors as Y→X′→X.

concept.title: Relative spectrum of a quasi-coherent algebra
concept.description: For a scheme S and a quasi-coherent sheaf of 𝒪_S-algebras 𝒜, the relative spectrum π:Spec_S(𝒜)→S is the S-scheme glued from the affine schemes Spec 𝒜(U) over affine opens U⊆S. It is affine over S with π_*𝒪=𝒜, and 𝒜↦Spec_S(𝒜) is an anti-equivalence between quasi-coherent 𝒪_S-algebras and schemes affine over S.

concept.title: Quasi-finite separated morphisms are quasi-affine
concept.description: Let f:X→S be quasi-finite and separated, and let X→S′→S be its factorization through the normalization S′ of S in X. Then X→S′ is a quasi-compact open immersion and S′→S is integral; in particular f is quasi-affine (EGA IV₃ 18.12.12).

concept.title: Integral quasi-coherent algebras are directed colimits of finite ones
concept.description: On a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X, every integral quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-algebra is the directed colimit of its finite quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-subalgebras, and it is also a directed colimit of finite and finitely presented quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-algebras.

concept.title: Limit of an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms
concept.description: A directed inverse system of schemes S_i with affine transition morphisms has a limit S=lim S_i in the category of schemes; S is affine over each S_i, being the relative spectrum over a fixed S_0 of the colimit of the pushed-forward structure sheaves. If the S_i are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, every quasi-compact open subset of S is the inverse image of a quasi-compact open subset of some S_i.

concept.title: Immersions into a limit of schemes descend to a finite stage
concept.description: Let X=lim X_i be a directed limit of S-schemes with affine transition morphisms and Y→X an S-morphism. If Y→X is a closed immersion, the X_i are quasi-compact and Y is locally of finite type over S, then Y→X_i is a closed immersion for all large i; if Y→X is an immersion, Y is quasi-compact and the X_i are quasi-separated, then Y→X_i is an immersion for large i; and if the transition morphisms are closed immersions, X_i→S is locally of finite type and Y→S is locally of finite presentation, an isomorphism Y→X is already an isomorphism onto X_i for large i.

concept.title: Factorization of quasi-compact immersions
concept.description: A quasi-compact immersion of schemes Z→X factors as an open immersion of Z into its scheme-theoretic closure followed by a closed immersion of that closure into X.

concept.title: Finite morphisms are limits of finitely presented finite morphisms
concept.description: If X→S is a finite morphism and S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, then X is a directed limit lim X_i of schemes finite and of finite presentation over S whose transition morphisms are closed immersions.

concept.title: Geometrically reduced scheme over a field
concept.description: A scheme X over a field k is geometrically reduced if its base change X×_k Spec K is reduced for every field extension K/k; for X locally of finite type it suffices that the base change to an algebraic closure of k is reduced. A k-algebra A is geometrically reduced when Spec A is, i.e. A⊗_k K is reduced for every field extension K.

concept.title: Dimension of local rings at closed points of an irreducible algebraic scheme
concept.description: If X is an irreducible scheme of finite type over a field and x is a closed point of X, then the local ring O_(X,x) has Krull dimension dim X; equivalently every maximal ideal of a finitely generated algebra over a field whose nilradical is prime has height equal to its dimension (Noether normalization).

concept.title: Connected components of an algebraic group are irreducible and equidimensional
concept.description: For an algebraic group G over a field, every connected component of G is irreducible, so the irreducible components are the connected components, and they all have dimension dim G; consequently every local ring O_(G,x) at a closed point has Krull dimension dim G. The proof uses translations by points over an algebraic closure.

concept.title: Dense smooth locus of a geometrically reduced algebraic scheme
concept.description: If X is a geometrically reduced scheme of finite type over a field k, the set of points at which X→Spec k is smooth is a dense open subset of X. For X irreducible this follows from the existence of a separating transcendence basis of its function field, which makes X birational to a hypersurface f(T₁,…,T_(d+1))=0 with ∂f/∂T_(d+1)≠0.

concept.title: Regular local rings are integral domains
concept.description: Every regular Noetherian local ring is an integral domain (indeed a unique factorization domain, by the Auslander–Buchsbaum theorem); in particular it is reduced.

concept.title: Reduced algebras over a perfect field are geometrically reduced
concept.description: If k is a perfect field and A is a reduced k-algebra, then A⊗_k K is reduced for every field extension K of k. Hence every reduced scheme over a perfect field is geometrically reduced.

concept.title: Quotient of a topological group by a normal subgroup
concept.description: If N is a normal subgroup of a topological group G, then the quotient group G/N with the quotient topology is a topological group and the projection G→G/N is open; G/N is Hausdorff if and only if N is closed in G.

concept.title: ℓ-adic logarithmic valuation of a p-adic field
concept.description: For a prime ℓ and a finite extension F of ℚ_p, Jaulent’s ℓ-adic logarithmic valuation is ṽ_F=−Log_ℓ|·|_F/deg F on the ℓ-adic completion ℛ_F of F×. Here Log_ℓ is Iwasawa’s ℓ-adic logarithm, |x|_F is the principal ℓ-adic absolute value ⟨N𝔭^(−v_F(x))⟩ for p≠ℓ and ⟨N_(F/ℚ_ℓ)(x)N𝔭^(−v_F(x))⟩ for p=ℓ (⟨·⟩ the projection of ℤ_ℓ^× onto its principal units), and deg F=f̃_F·deg p with f̃_F=[F∩ℚ̂_p^c:ℚ_p] the logarithmic inertia degree, deg p=Log_ℓ p for p≠ℓ and deg ℓ=ℓ (4 if ℓ=2).

concept.title: Kernel and image of the ℓ-adic logarithmic valuation
concept.description: For a prime ℓ and a finite extension F of ℚ_p, the ℓ-adic logarithmic valuation ṽ_F is a surjective ℤ_ℓ-linear map from the ℓ-adic completion ℛ_F of F× onto ℤ_ℓ whose kernel is the local logarithmic unit group (the cyclotomic norms in ℛ_F). If p≠ℓ it is proportional to the ordinary normalized valuation: ṽ_F=(f_F/f̃_F)·v_F, where the ratio of the ordinary and logarithmic inertia degrees is a power of p (Jaulent 1994, Théorème 1.4).

concept.title: Richardson’s closed-orbit theorem for fixed-point subgroups
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive closed normal subgroup of an affine algebraic group H over an algebraically closed field, S a linearly reductive closed subgroup of H and Z=(G^S)° the identity component of the S-centralizer of G. If H acts morphically on an affine variety X and x is an S-fixed point of X, then some one-parameter subgroup λ of Z has lim_(t→0)λ(t)·x in the unique closed G-orbit in the closure of G·x; in particular G·x is closed if and only if Z·x is closed (Richardson 1982, Theorem C).

concept.title: Conjugacy classes of semisimple elements are closed
concept.description: In an affine algebraic group G over an algebraically closed field, the conjugacy class of every semisimple element is Zariski closed in G (Humphreys, Linear Algebraic Groups §18.2; Steinberg 1965, 6.14).

concept.title: Jordan decomposition in an affine algebraic group
concept.description: Every element g of an affine algebraic group over an algebraically closed field has a unique factorization g=g_s g_u=g_u g_s with g_s semisimple and g_u unipotent (its image in a faithful representation is unipotent). The factors are preserved by homomorphisms of algebraic groups, in particular by conjugation, and lie in every closed subgroup containing g.

concept.title: Unipotent radical of a Borel subgroup as a product of root subgroups
concept.description: Let G be a connected reductive group over an algebraically closed field, B a Borel subgroup and T⊆B a maximal torus, with positive roots Φ⁺ determined by B. Then B=T⋉U for the unipotent radical U of B, and for any ordering of Φ⁺ the product map ∏_(α∈Φ⁺)U_α→U of root subgroups is an isomorphism of varieties; thus each u∈U is uniquely ∏_α x_α(c_α).

concept.title: Surjectivity of linearly independent characters of a torus
concept.description: If χ₁,…,χ_n are characters of an algebraic torus T over an algebraically closed field k that are linearly independent in the character group X(T), then t↦(χ₁(t),…,χ_n(t)) maps T(k) onto (k^×)^n.

concept.title: Inverse limit of a directed inverse system of groups
concept.description: For a directed set I, an inverse system of groups consists of groups G_i and homomorphisms p_ij:G_j→G_i for i≤j with p_ii=id and p_ij∘p_jk=p_ik. Its inverse limit lim G_i is the subgroup of ∏G_i of families (g_i) with p_ij(g_j)=g_i for all i≤j, with the coordinate projections; it is universal among families of homomorphisms into the G_i compatible with the p_ij. For topological groups and continuous p_ij it carries the subspace topology of the product topology, finite groups being discrete.

concept.title: One-sided shift on sequences over a finite alphabet
concept.description: For a finite set 𝒜, the one-sided shift is the map σ:𝒜^ℕ₀→𝒜^ℕ₀, (σx)_n=x_{n+1}, on one-sided sequences, with the product of the discrete topologies on 𝒜. A closed subset X with σ(X)⊆X is a one-sided subshift.

concept.title: Weakly mixing measure-preserving transformation
concept.description: A probability-preserving transformation T of (X,𝔅,μ) is weakly mixing if N⁻¹∑_{n=1}^N|μ(A∩T⁻ⁿB)−μ(A)μ(B)|→0 for all measurable A,B, equivalently N⁻¹∑_{n=1}^N(∫f·g∘Tⁿdμ−∫f dμ∫g dμ)²→0 for all f,g∈L²(μ). This holds exactly when T×T is ergodic for μ×μ.

concept.title: Compact measure-preserving system
concept.description: A probability-preserving system (X,𝔅,μ,T) is compact if for every f∈L²(μ) the orbit {f,Tf,T²f,…} under the Koopman operator Tf=f∘T has compact closure in the norm topology of L²(μ); a function with this property is called almost periodic. Ergodic rotations of compact groups are examples.

concept.title: Rokhlin disintegration theorem for probability measures
concept.description: Let π:(X,𝔅,μ)→(Y,𝔇,ν) be a measurable map of standard Borel probability spaces with π_*μ=ν. There is a ν-almost everywhere unique measurable family y↦μ_y of Borel probability measures on X with μ_y(π⁻¹{y})=1 for ν-a.e. y and μ(A)=∫μ_y(A)dν(y) for every measurable A; then f↦∫f dμ_{π(x)} is the conditional expectation given π⁻¹𝔇. If π is a factor map from (X,μ,T) to (Y,ν,S), then T_*μ_y=μ_{Sy} for ν-a.e. y.

concept.title: Relative product of a measure-preserving system over a factor
concept.description: For a factor map π from a probability-preserving system (X,μ,T) to (Y,ν,S), with disintegration μ=∫μ_y dν(y), the relative product X×_Y X is the system (X×X, μ×_Yμ, T×T) with μ×_Yμ=∫(μ_y×μ_y)dν(y). It is probability-preserving, has Y as a factor, and ∫f(x)g(x′)d(μ×_Yμ)=∫E(f|Y)E(g|Y)dν.

concept.title: Relatively weakly mixing extension of measure-preserving systems
concept.description: An extension π:(X,μ,T)→(Y,ν,S) of ergodic probability-preserving systems is relatively weakly mixing if the relative product X×_Y X with T×T is ergodic. Over the one-point factor this is weak mixing of T.

concept.title: Compact extension of measure-preserving systems
concept.description: An extension π:(X,μ,T)→(Y,ν,S) of probability-preserving systems, with disintegration μ=∫μ_y dν(y), is compact if the functions almost periodic relative to Y are dense in L²(μ); f is almost periodic relative to Y if for every δ>0 there are g_1,…,g_m∈L²(μ) such that for every n, min_s‖Tⁿf−g_s‖_{L²(μ_y)}<δ for ν-almost every y. Over the one-point factor this is a compact system.

concept.title: Product estimate for bounded elements of a Dirichlet form domain
concept.description: For a symmetric Dirichlet form E on L²(X,m), if u and v are essentially bounded elements of its domain then uv lies in the domain and E(uv,uv)^{1/2}≤‖u‖_∞E(v,v)^{1/2}+‖v‖_∞E(u,u)^{1/2}; hence the bounded elements of the domain form an algebra.

concept.title: Normal contractions operate on a Dirichlet form
concept.description: If E is a symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(X,m) and φ:ℝ→ℝ is a normal contraction, φ(0)=0 and |φ(s)−φ(t)|≤|s−t|, then φ∘u lies in the domain and E(φ∘u,φ∘u)≤E(u,u) for every u in the domain. Conversely, a closed symmetric form on which the unit contraction operates has this property.

concept.title: Leibniz rule for energy measures of a strongly local Dirichlet form
concept.description: For a strongly local regular symmetric Dirichlet form and bounded u,v,w in its domain, the mutual energy measures satisfy dν_(uv,w)=ũ dν_(v,w)+ṽ dν_(u,w), where ũ and ṽ are quasi-continuous modifications of u and v.

concept.title: Beurling–Deny decomposition of a regular Dirichlet form
concept.description: Every regular symmetric Dirichlet form E on L²(X,m) satisfies, for u,v in its domain with compact support and continuous, E(u,v)=E^(c)(u,v)+∫∫_{X×X∖diag}(u(x)−u(y))(v(x)−v(y))J(dx,dy)+∫uv dk, where E^(c) is a strongly local symmetric form, J is a symmetric positive Radon measure off the diagonal (jumping measure) and k is a positive Radon measure (killing measure). E^(c), J and k are uniquely determined by E; in particular E is strongly local exactly when J=0 and k=0.

concept.title: Proper map between topological spaces
concept.description: A continuous map f:X→Y between topological spaces is proper if the preimage f⁻¹(K) of every compact subset K⊆Y is compact. Between locally compact Hausdorff spaces, an injective proper map is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset.

concept.title: Open mapping theorem for σ-compact locally compact group actions
concept.description: If a σ-compact locally compact group G acts continuously and transitively on a locally compact Hausdorff space X, then for every x∈X the orbit map G/G_x→X, gG_x↦gx, is a homeomorphism. In particular a continuous surjective homomorphism from a σ-compact locally compact group onto a locally compact Hausdorff group is open.

concept.title: Markov–Kakutani fixed point theorem
concept.description: A family of pairwise commuting continuous affine maps of a nonempty compact convex subset C of a Hausdorff topological vector space into itself has a common fixed point. For a single map T, every cluster point of the averages n⁻¹∑_(j<n)Tʲx is fixed.

concept.title: Ergodic measures are the extreme invariant probability measures
concept.description: For a family of measurable self-maps of a measurable space, in particular a continuous map of a compact space with its Borel σ-algebra, an invariant probability measure is an extreme point of the convex set of invariant probability measures exactly when it is ergodic.

concept.title: Choquet’s representation theorem for metrizable compact convex sets
concept.description: If K is a metrizable compact convex subset of a locally convex Hausdorff space, its set of extreme points is a G_δ and every x∈K is represented by a Borel probability measure μ on K with μ(ext K)=1, i.e. f(x)=∫f dμ for every continuous affine f on K.

concept.title: Choquet–Meyer uniqueness theorem
concept.description: A compact convex subset K of a locally convex Hausdorff space, embedded in a closed hyperplane not containing 0, is a Choquet simplex (each point has a unique maximal representing measure) exactly when the cone generated by K is a lattice in its own order. For metrizable K the unique maximal measure is the unique representing measure concentrated on ext K.

concept.title: L² stochastic integral against a square-integrable martingale
concept.description: For a càdlàg square-integrable martingale M and a predictable X with E∫_(0,t]X_s²d[M]_s<∞ for all t, X·M is the càdlàg square-integrable martingale, unique up to indistinguishability, with E[((X·M)−(Xⁿ·M))_t²]→0 for every t whenever simple predictable Xⁿ=∑ξ_i1_(t_i,t_(i+1)] (ξ_i bounded F_(t_i)-measurable) approximate X in the norms (E∫_(0,t]|X−Xⁿ|²d[M])^(1/2); here (Xⁿ·M)_t=∑ξ_i(M_(t_(i+1)∧t)−M_(t_i∧t)).

concept.title: Kronecker factor of an ergodic system
concept.description: For an ergodic probability-preserving system (X,μ,T), its Kronecker factor is the factor determined by the T-invariant sub-σ-algebra generated by the eigenfunctions of the Koopman operator, i.e. the f∈L²(μ) with f∘T=λf for a constant λ. It is realized by an ergodic rotation of a compact abelian group, and is the largest factor of this kind.

concept.title: C*-dynamical system
concept.description: A C*-dynamical system (A,G,α) consists of a C*-algebra A, a locally compact group G and a group homomorphism α:G→Aut(A) into the star automorphisms (bijective star homomorphisms A→A) that is continuous for pointwise norm convergence: s↦α_s(a) is norm-continuous for each a∈A.

concept.title: Operator system in a unital C*-algebra
concept.description: An operator system is a self-adjoint linear subspace S of a unital C*-algebra A containing the unit. Each M_n(S)⊆M_n(A) inherits a positive cone, so positive and completely positive maps on S are defined as for C*-algebras.

concept.title: Arveson extension theorem for operator systems
concept.description: If S is an operator system in a unital C*-algebra A and φ:S→B(H) is completely positive, then φ extends to a completely positive map A→B(H); that is, B(H) is injective in the category of operator systems and completely positive maps.

concept.title: Paulsen off-diagonal lemma
concept.description: Let X be a subspace of a unital C*-algebra A, φ:X→B a linear map into a unital C*-algebra, and S_X={[λ1,x;y*,μ1]:λ,μ∈ℂ,x,y∈X}⊆M₂(A) the Paulsen operator system. Then [λ1,x;y*,μ1]↦[λ1,φ(x);φ(y)*,μ1] is completely positive on S_X if and only if φ is completely contractive.

concept.title: Order reversal of inversion in a unital C*-algebra
concept.description: If x and y are invertible positive elements of a unital C*-algebra with x≤y, then y⁻¹≤x⁻¹.

concept.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for positive semidefinite Hermitian forms
concept.description: If s is a positive semidefinite Hermitian sesquilinear form on a complex vector space V, then |s(x,y)|²≤s(x,x)s(y,y). Hence N={x:s(x,x)=0} is a linear subspace and s induces an inner product on V/N.

concept.title: Nontangential limit at a point of the unit circle
concept.description: A function F on the unit disk 𝔻 has nontangential limit L at ζ∈𝕋 if F(z)→L as z→ζ within each Stolz angle S_α(ζ)={z∈𝔻:|z−ζ|<α(1−|z|)}, α>1. Radial approach is the special case z=rζ.

concept.title: Simple polytope
concept.description: An n-dimensional convex polytope in ℝⁿ is simple if each of its vertices (0-dimensional faces) lies in exactly n facets ((n−1)-dimensional faces).

concept.title: Strongly isomorphic convex polytopes
concept.description: Convex polytopes P,Q⊂ℝⁿ are strongly isomorphic if dim F(P,u)=dim F(Q,u) for every unit vector u, where F(P,u)=P∩{x:⟨x,u⟩=h(P,u)} is the face of P with outer normal u. Strongly isomorphic polytopes are combinatorially isomorphic.

concept.title: Fatou’s theorem on nontangential limits of Poisson integrals
concept.description: Let μ be a finite complex Borel measure on the unit circle with Lebesgue decomposition dμ=h dm+dμ_s, h∈L¹(m), μ_s⊥m. Then at every ζ where dμ/dm(ζ)=h(ζ) exists, hence for m-almost every ζ, the Poisson integral P[μ](z) tends to h(ζ) as z→ζ within every Stolz angle.

concept.title: Identification of Hardy Hᵖ functions with their boundary functions
concept.description: For 1≤p≤∞ and f∈Hᵖ(𝔻) there is a unique f̃∈Lᵖ(𝕋) with vanishing negative Fourier coefficients such that f(r·)=f̃∗P_r on 𝕋 for 0<r<1, so f is the Poisson integral of f̃; f(r·)→f̃ in Lᵖ as r↑1 (weak-* when p=∞), and ‖f‖_{Hᵖ}=‖f̃‖_p.

concept.title: Irreducible positive operator on a Banach lattice
concept.description: A positive operator T on a Banach lattice E is irreducible if {0} and E are the only closed ideals J of E with T(J)⊆J. For a positive kernel operator on Lᵖ(μ), 1≤p<∞, this means the kernel gives positive mass to (X∖S)×S whenever S and X∖S have positive measure.

concept.title: Ando–Krieger theorem on positive spectral radius
concept.description: Let E be a Banach lattice with order continuous norm and T>0 an irreducible positive operator in the band of regular operators generated by the order continuous finite-rank operators, for example an irreducible positive kernel operator on Lᵖ(μ), 1≤p<∞. Then the spectral radius r(T) is strictly positive.

concept.title: Kernel operators on Lᵖ as the band generated by finite-rank operators
concept.description: For σ-finite measure spaces (X,μ),(Y,ν) and 1≤p,q≤∞, a regular operator T:Lᵖ(μ)→L^q(ν) belongs to the band generated by the order continuous finite-rank operators exactly when it is given by a measurable kernel, Tf(t)=∫K(s,t)f(s)dμ(s); T↦K is a lattice isomorphism onto an ideal of measurable kernels.

concept.title: Spectral radius of a positive operator lies in its spectrum
concept.description: For a positive operator T on a complex Banach lattice, the spectral radius r(T) belongs to the spectrum σ(T).

concept.title: Riesz–Schauder theory for operators with a compact power
concept.description: If T is a bounded operator on a complex Banach space and some power Tᵏ is compact, then σ(T)∖{0} is at most countable with 0 as its only possible accumulation point, and each nonzero λ∈σ(T) is a pole of the resolvent and an eigenvalue whose spectral projection has finite rank.

concept.title: Perron–Frobenius theorem for irreducible positive operators with a resolvent pole
concept.description: Let T>0 be an irreducible positive operator on a Banach lattice with r(T)>0 a pole of the resolvent. Then r(T) is a pole of order one with residue a rank-one projection φ⊗u, φ strictly positive and u quasi-interior; the eigenspace for r(T) is spanned by u; each peripheral eigenvalue is simple; and r(T) is the only eigenvalue with a positive eigenvector.

concept.title: Trivial peripheral point spectrum of eventually quasi-interior positive operators
concept.description: Let T>0 on a Banach lattice have r(T)=1 and a nonzero positive fixed vector of its adjoint, and suppose that for each x>0 some Tⁿx is a quasi-interior point of the positive cone. Then 1 is the only eigenvalue of T of modulus one.

concept.title: Power-series representability of Cauchy integrals of measures
concept.description: Let μ be a finite complex measure on a measure space X and φ a bounded complex measurable function on X. Then f(z)=∫dμ(ζ)/(φ(ζ)−z) is representable by convergent power series, hence holomorphic, on every open set disjoint from the closure of φ(X).

concept.title: Cauchy formula on a compact set via a cycle in its neighbourhood
concept.description: If K is a compact subset of an open set Ω⊆ℂ, there is a cycle Γ in Ω∖K, made of finitely many oriented segments, such that f(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Γ f(w)(w−z)⁻¹dw for every f holomorphic on Ω and every z∈K.

concept.title: Boundary H² regularity for second-order elliptic Dirichlet problems
concept.description: Let U⊂ℝⁿ be bounded with C² boundary and L=−∑∂_j(a^{ij}∂_i)+∑b^i∂_i+c uniformly elliptic with a^{ij}∈C¹(Ū), b^i,c∈L^∞(U). If f∈L²(U) and u∈H₀¹(U) weakly solves Lu=f, then u∈H²(U) and ‖u‖_{H²}≤C(‖f‖_{L²}+‖u‖_{L²}) with C depending only on U and the coefficients.

concept.title: Openness of the invertible group and continuity of inversion in a Banach algebra
concept.description: In a unital complex Banach algebra the invertible elements form an open set G: if x∈G and ‖h‖<‖x⁻¹‖⁻¹ then x+h∈G. Inversion is a homeomorphism of G, differentiable with derivative h↦−x⁻¹hx⁻¹.

concept.title: Normal cones and support sets of a Minkowski sum
concept.description: For nonempty compact convex K,L⊂ℝⁿ, x∈K and y∈L, the normal cone of K+L at x+y is N(K,x)∩N(L,y), and the support set of K+L at x+y is the sum of the support sets of K at x and of L at y.

concept.title: Normal cones of a polytope generated by facet normals
concept.description: If P⊂ℝⁿ is an n-dimensional polytope with facets F₁,…,F_k and outer unit facet normals u₁,…,u_k, then for each proper face F the normal cone N(P,F) is the positive hull of the u_i with F⊆F_i.

concept.title: Vertex normal-cone criterion for strongly isomorphic polytopes
concept.description: Two convex polytopes in ℝⁿ are strongly isomorphic exactly when they have the same set of normal cones at their vertices: {N(P,x):x a vertex of P}={N(Q,y):y a vertex of Q}.

concept.title: Geometrically integral scheme over a field
concept.description: A scheme X over a field k is geometrically integral if for every field extension k′/k the base change X_(k′)=X×_(Spec k)Spec k′ is an integral scheme.

concept.title: Lie subalgebra
concept.description: A Lie subalgebra of a Lie algebra 𝔤 over a field is a vector subspace 𝔥⊆𝔤 closed under the bracket, [𝔥,𝔥]⊆𝔥; with the restricted bracket it is itself a Lie algebra.

concept.title: Immersion of smooth manifolds
concept.description: A smooth map F:M→N of smooth manifolds is an immersion if its differential dF_x:T_xM→T_(F(x))N is injective at every point x∈M. An injective immersion need not be a homeomorphism onto its image.

concept.title: Canonical sheaf and canonical divisor of a smooth variety
concept.description: For a scheme X smooth of pure dimension n over a field k, the canonical sheaf is ω_X=∧ⁿΩ¹_(X/k), the top exterior power of the sheaf of Kähler differentials. If X is moreover integral, a canonical divisor K_X is a Cartier divisor whose associated invertible sheaf O_X(K_X) is isomorphic to ω_X; it is well defined up to linear equivalence.

concept.title: Arithmetic genus of a projective curve
concept.description: For a projective curve C over a field k, that is a projective k-scheme of dimension one, the arithmetic genus is p_a(C)=1−χ(C,O_C)=1−dim_k H⁰(C,O_C)+dim_k H¹(C,O_C).

concept.title: Regular local rings are Cohen–Macaulay
concept.description: Every regular local ring (R,𝔪) of dimension d is Cohen–Macaulay: a minimal system of generators x₁,…,x_d of 𝔪 is a regular sequence, and each R/(x₁,…,x_c) is regular of dimension d−c.

concept.title: Dimension criterion for regular sequences in a Cohen–Macaulay local ring
concept.description: In a Cohen–Macaulay Noetherian local ring (R,𝔪), elements x₁,…,x_c∈𝔪 form a regular sequence if and only if dim R/(x₁,…,x_c)=dim R−c; in that case every quotient R/(x₁,…,x_i) is Cohen–Macaulay of dimension dim R−i.

concept.title: Localizations of Cohen–Macaulay local rings are Cohen–Macaulay
concept.description: If R is a Cohen–Macaulay Noetherian local ring and 𝔭 is a prime ideal of R, then the localization R_𝔭 is Cohen–Macaulay; hence a Noetherian ring is Cohen–Macaulay as soon as its localizations at maximal ideals are.

concept.title: Local rings of a polynomial ring at maximal ideals are regular
concept.description: For a field k, the localization of the polynomial ring k[x₁,…,x_n] at any maximal ideal is a regular local ring of dimension n; in particular k[x₁,…,x_n] is a regular ring.

concept.title: Cotangent exact sequence of Kähler differentials
concept.description: For ring maps A→B→C there is an exact sequence C⊗_BΩ_(B/A)→Ω_(C/A)→Ω_(C/B)→0, and for morphisms of schemes X→Y→Z the corresponding sequence π*Ω_(Y/Z)→Ω_(X/Z)→Ω_(X/Y)→0 of quasi-coherent sheaves on X is exact.

concept.title: Differentials of a smooth morphism are locally free
concept.description: If π:X→Y is a smooth morphism of schemes of relative dimension n, then the sheaf of relative Kähler differentials Ω_(X/Y) is locally free of rank n. In particular a smooth k-scheme of pure dimension n has Ω_(X/k) locally free of rank n.

concept.title: Kähler differentials vanish for separable algebraic field extensions
concept.description: If L/K is a separable algebraic field extension, then the module of Kähler differentials Ω_(L/K) is zero.

concept.title: Global Frobenius theorem for involutive distributions
concept.description: Let 𝒟 be a smooth involutive distribution of rank c on a smooth manifold M. Through every point m∈M passes a unique maximal connected integral manifold of 𝒟, and every connected integral manifold of 𝒟 through m is contained in it.

concept.title: Smooth factorization through integral manifolds of involutive distributions
concept.description: Let (P,φ) be an integral manifold of a smooth involutive distribution on M and ψ:N→M a smooth map with ψ(N)⊆φ(P). Then the unique map ψ₀:N→P with φ∘ψ₀=ψ is continuous and hence smooth.

concept.title: Seesaw principle for invertible sheaves on products
concept.description: Let V be a complete variety and T a variety over a field, and L an invertible sheaf on V×T. The set of t∈T with L|_(V×{t}) trivial is closed in T. If L|_(V×{t}) is trivial for all t and L|_({v}×T) is trivial for some v∈V(k), then L is trivial.

concept.title: Translation-invariant invertible sheaves on an abelian variety
concept.description: For an invertible sheaf L on an abelian variety A with group law m and projections p,q:A×A→A, the following are equivalent: t_a*L≅L for all a∈A(k^al); the kernel K(L) of φ_L is all of A; m*L≅p*L⊗q*L. Such sheaves constitute Pic⁰(A).

concept.title: Mumford homomorphism of an ample sheaf is onto Pic⁰
concept.description: If L is an ample invertible sheaf on an abelian variety A over an algebraically closed field, then every invertible sheaf in Pic⁰(A) is isomorphic to t_a*L⊗L⁻¹ for some a∈A; that is, φ_L maps A onto Pic⁰(A)=A^∨(k).

concept.title: Euler-characteristic formula for intersection numbers on a surface
concept.description: For divisors C,D on a smooth projective surface X over a field, the intersection number satisfies C·D=χ(O_X)−χ(O_X(−C))−χ(O_X(−D))+χ(O_X(−C−D)), and if C is an effective curve then C·D=deg_C(O_X(D)|_C).

concept.title: Serre duality for smooth projective varieties
concept.description: For a smooth projective variety X of pure dimension n over a field k with canonical sheaf ω_X and a locally free sheaf F of finite rank, H^i(X,F) is naturally dual to H^(n−i)(X,F^∨⊗ω_X) for all i; in particular χ(X,F)=(−1)ⁿχ(X,F^∨⊗ω_X).

concept.title: Maximal abelian extension of a field
concept.description: For a field K with a fixed separable closure K^sep, the maximal abelian extension K^ab is the compositum in K^sep of all finite Galois extensions of K whose Galois group is abelian.

concept.title: Norm functoriality of the local Artin map
concept.description: For local fields L⊇E⊇K with L/K Galois, the local Artin maps satisfy φ_(L/K)(Nm_(E/K)a)=φ_(L/E)(a) in Gal(L/K)^ab for a∈E^×, the right side mapped through Gal(L/E)⊆Gal(L/K); equivalently φ_E(a)|_(K^ab)=φ_K(Nm_(E/K)a).

concept.title: Idelic norm groups contain open subgroups
concept.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields, the norm group Nm_(L/K)(I_L) contains an open subgroup of the idele group I_K.

concept.title: Second inequality of global class field theory
concept.description: For a finite Galois extension L/K of number fields, the index (I_K:K^×·Nm_(L/K)I_L) is finite and divides [L:K]; equivalently H¹(Gal(L/K),C_L)=0 and the order of H²(Gal(L/K),C_L) divides [L:K].

concept.title: Frobenius elements generate the Galois group of a solvable extension
concept.description: If L/K is a finite solvable Galois extension of number fields and T a finite set of primes containing the ramified ones, then the Frobenius elements of the primes outside T generate Gal(L/K).

concept.title: Local Artin map of ℚ_p on cyclotomic extensions
concept.description: For a=u·p^t with u∈ℤ_p^×, the local Artin map of ℚ_p acts on a p^r-th root of unity by ζ↦ζ^(u₀⁻¹), u₀≡u mod p^r, and on an m-th root of unity with p∤m by ζ↦ζ^(p^t).

concept.title: Cup-product formula for the local Artin map
concept.description: For a finite abelian extension L/K of local fields with group G, a∈K^× and a character χ:G→ℚ/ℤ with coboundary δχ∈H²(G,ℤ), one has χ(φ_(L/K)(a))=inv_K(a∪δχ), where a∪δχ∈H²(G,L^×).

concept.title: Splitting of global Brauer classes by cyclic cyclotomic extensions
concept.description: For a number field K, every element of H²(Gal(K^al/K),K^al×) maps to zero in H²(Gal(K^al/L),K^al×) for some cyclic cyclotomic extension L of K.

concept.title: Analytic continuation of ray class L-series
concept.description: For a modulus 𝔪 of a number field K of degree d and a character χ of the ray class group, L(s,χ)=∏_(𝔭∤𝔪)(1−χ(𝔭)N𝔭^(−s))^(−1) extends analytically to Re s>1−1/d if χ is nontrivial, while the Dedekind zeta function ζ_K is analytic there except for a simple pole at s=1.

concept.title: Nonvanishing at s=1 of ray class L-series
concept.description: For a modulus 𝔪 of a number field K and a nontrivial character χ of the ray class group Cl_𝔪(K), the L-series L(s,χ) does not vanish at s=1.

concept.title: Curve y^p=f(x) as a cyclic cover of the projective line
concept.description: For a prime p, a perfect field k of characteristic not p and a nonconstant f∈k[x] whose roots in an algebraic closure all have multiplicity less than p, the curve y^p=f(x) is the smooth projective geometrically connected curve X over k with function field k(x)[y]/(y^p−f(x)). The function x gives a degree-p cover X→ℙ¹, and if k contains a primitive p-th root of unity ζ, then (x,y)↦(x,ζy) is an automorphism of X over ℙ¹.

concept.title: Weil reciprocity on a curve
concept.description: For nonzero rational functions f,g with disjoint divisors on a smooth projective curve over an algebraically closed field, f(div g)=g(div f), where a function is evaluated on a divisor ∑n_PP as ∏f(P)^(n_P).

concept.title: Generalized Jacobian of a curve with a modulus
concept.description: For a smooth projective curve X over a field and an effective divisor 𝔪, the generalized Jacobian J_𝔪 is the commutative algebraic group whose points classify degree-zero divisors prime to 𝔪 modulo divisors of functions congruent to 1 modulo 𝔪; it is an extension of the Jacobian of X by a connected linear algebraic group.

concept.title: Unramified image of the descent map under good reduction
concept.description: Let A be an abelian variety with good reduction over a nonarchimedean local field whose residue characteristic does not divide the degree of an isogeny φ:A→B. Then the image of the descent map B(K)/φA(K)→H¹(K,A[φ]) consists of unramified classes.
