concept.title: Rational 1−ζ torsion of the Jacobian of y^p=f(x)
concept.description: For the Jacobian J of y^p=f(x) over a field k containing μ_p, with φ=1−ζ, if f has n distinct irreducible factors over k and at least one has degree prime to p, then dim_(𝔽_p) J(k)[φ]=n−2.

concept.title: Local index of 1−ζ on the Jacobian of y^p=f(x)
concept.description: For the Jacobian J of genus g of y^p=f(x) over a finite extension k_v of ℚ_ℓ containing μ_p, with φ=1−ζ, one has #J(k_v)/φJ(k_v)=|p|_v^(−g[k_v:ℚ_ℓ]/(p−1))·#J(k_v)[φ].

concept.title: Mordell–Weil rank of a cyclic-cover Jacobian over a cyclotomic extension
concept.description: Let k be a global field of characteristic not p, f∈k[x] p-th-power-free, J the Jacobian of y^p=f(x) and ζ a primitive p-th root of unity. Then rank J(k)=rank J(k(ζ))/[k(ζ):k].

concept.title: Conductor of a Dirichlet character
concept.description: The conductor f_χ of a Dirichlet character χ modulo n is the least positive divisor f of n such that χ is induced from a character modulo f, i.e. χ(a)=χ(b) whenever a≡b (mod f) and a,b are prime to n; the inducing character modulo f is primitive. With the usual convention, a product χψ of Dirichlet characters denotes the primitive character associated with a↦χ(a)ψ(a).

concept.title: Analytic and meromorphic functions on a p-adic disc
concept.description: Let K be a field complete for a nonarchimedean absolute value, such as ℂ_p. A function on a disc D={s∈K:|s−a|<R} is analytic if it is given by a power series ∑c_n(s−a)ⁿ with c_n∈K converging at every point of D. A function on D minus a point b is meromorphic with at most a simple pole at b if (s−b)f(s) extends to an analytic function on D; the pole is simple when that function is nonzero at b.

concept.title: Identity principle for p-adic power series
concept.description: Let K be a field complete for a nonarchimedean absolute value. If a power series with coefficients in K converges on a disc D and vanishes on a subset of D having an accumulation point in D, then it is identically zero on D. In particular two analytic functions on D that agree on such a set coincide.

concept.title: Analyticity of p-adic binomial-coefficient series with geometric decay
concept.description: Let p be prime and 0<r<p^(−1/(p−1)). If f(X)=∑_(n≥0)a_n·C(X,n) with a_n∈ℂ_p and |a_n|≤M·rⁿ for some M, then f is given by a power series ∑b_nXⁿ with |b_n|≤M·R^(−n), where R=(r·p^(1/(p−1)))^(−1)>1; thus f is analytic on the disc |X|<R, which contains ℤ_p.

concept.title: Kummer’s Bernoulli criterion for the relative class number of ℚ(ζ_p)
concept.description: For an odd prime p, p divides the relative class number h⁻(p) of ℚ(ζ_p) if and only if p divides the numerator of one of the Bernoulli numbers B₂,B₄,…,B_(p−3), written in lowest terms.

concept.title: Kummer’s formula for the relative class number of ℚ(ζ_p)
concept.description: Let p=2m+1 be an odd prime, g a primitive root modulo p, g_s the least positive residue of g^s modulo p, θ a primitive (p−1)th root of unity and F(X)=∑_(s=0)^(p−2)g_sXˢ. Then the relative class number of ℚ(ζ_p) is h⁻(p)=|F(θ)F(θ³)⋯F(θ^(p−2))|/(2p)^(m−1).

concept.title: Wilson’s theorem
concept.description: For every prime p, (p−1)!≡−1 (mod p).

concept.title: Non-modularity modulo p of the p-depleted Eisenstein divisor series
concept.description: Let p≥5 be prime and k a positive integer divisible by p−1. The reduction modulo p of ∑_(n≥1, p∤n)σ_(k−1)(n)qⁿ is not the reduction of any level-one modular form with p-integral rational coefficients and weight divisible by p−1.

concept.title: Level-one modular forms modulo 2 and 3
concept.description: For p=2 or 3, the algebra of reductions modulo p of level-one modular forms with p-integral rational q-expansion coefficients is the polynomial algebra 𝔽_p[Δ̃] generated by the reduction of the Ramanujan Δ-function, since E₄ and E₆ both reduce to 1.

concept.title: Bernoulli’s formula for sums of powers
concept.description: For integers m≥1 and n≥1, the power sum S_m(n)=0^m+1^m+⋯+(n−1)^m satisfies (m+1)S_m(n)=∑_(k=0)^m C(m+1,k)B_k n^(m+1−k), where B_k are the Bernoulli numbers (B₁=−1/2).

concept.title: Transformation law of the weight-two Eisenstein series
concept.description: For τ in the upper half-plane and (a b; c d)∈SL₂(ℤ), the normalized weight-two Eisenstein series E₂(τ)=1−24∑_(n≥1)σ₁(n)qⁿ satisfies E₂((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)²E₂(τ)+(12/(2πi))c(cτ+d). Thus E₂ is quasimodular but not modular.

concept.title: Maximal real subfield of a cyclotomic field
concept.description: For n≥3 and a primitive nth root of unity ζ_n∈ℂ, the maximal real subfield of the cyclotomic field ℚ(ζ_n) is ℚ(ζ_n)⁺=ℚ(ζ_n)∩ℝ. It equals ℚ(ζ_n+ζ_n⁻¹) and is the fixed field of complex conjugation restricted to ℚ(ζ_n).

concept.title: Divisor-sum identity for the Möbius function
concept.description: For every positive integer n, ∑_(d|n)μ(d) equals 1 if n=1 and 0 if n>1; in Dirichlet-convolution notation μ*1=δ. Equivalently (Möbius inversion) g=f*1 holds if and only if f=g*μ.

concept.title: Divisor-sum identity for the von Mangoldt function
concept.description: For every positive integer n, ∑_(d|n)Λ(d)=log n, i.e. Λ*1=log as arithmetic functions; it follows from the prime factorisation of n. By Möbius inversion, Λ=μ*log.

concept.title: Mean values of divisor-type multiplicative functions
concept.description: Let k≥0 be an integer and f a multiplicative function with f(p)=k+O_k(1/p) for all primes p and f(p^j)=O_k(j^(O_k(1))) for j≥1, and let 𝔖=∏_p(1−1/p)^k(1+f(p)/p+f(p²)/p²+⋯). Then ∑_(n≤x)f(n)/n=𝔖(log x)^k/k!+O_k((log(2+x))^(k−1)) for x≥1, and for k≥1 also (1/x)∑_(n≤x)f(n)=𝔖(log x)^(k−1)/(k−1)!+O_k((log(2+x))^(k−2)) (Tao, 254A Notes 1, Theorem 36).

concept.title: Analytic large sieve inequality
concept.description: Let a_n be complex numbers for M<n≤M+N, S(α)=∑_n a_n e(nα) with e(t)=exp(2πit), and let α_1,…,α_R be points of ℝ/ℤ with ‖α_r−α_s‖≥δ for r≠s. Then ∑_r|S(α_r)|²≤(N−1+δ⁻¹)∑_n|a_n|² (Selberg; Montgomery–Vaughan proved N+δ⁻¹). Taking the Farey fractions a/q with q≤Q, (a,q)=1, which are Q⁻²-spaced, gives ∑_(q≤Q)∑_(a mod q)*|S(a/q)|²≤(N+Q²)∑|a_n|².

concept.title: Gallagher’s comparison of primitive character sums with additive sums
concept.description: For complex numbers a_n (finitely many nonzero) and an integer q≥1, (q/φ(q))∑*_(χ mod q)|∑_n a_nχ(n)|²≤∑_(1≤a≤q,(a,q)=1)|∑_n a_n e(an/q)|², where ∑* runs over primitive Dirichlet characters modulo q and e(t)=exp(2πit). It follows from writing χ̄(n)τ(χ)=∑_a χ(a)e(an/q) for primitive χ, with |τ(χ)|²=q (Gallagher).

concept.title: Frobenius morphisms of a scheme in characteristic p
concept.description: For a scheme X over a field k of characteristic p>0, the absolute Frobenius of X is the identity on the underlying space with f↦f^p on O_X, and the relative Frobenius F_(X/k):X→X^((p)) is the induced k-morphism to the base change of X along x↦x^p on k; in coordinates it raises them to the pth power. For k=𝔽_q, q=p^r, the q-power Frobenius F_X:X→X is the 𝔽_q-endomorphism obtained by iterating r times. It commutes with every 𝔽_q-morphism, and its fixed points in X(𝔽̄_q) are X(𝔽_q), those of F_Xⁿ being X(𝔽_(qⁿ)). For an abelian variety A over 𝔽_q, F_A fixes 0 and is an endomorphism of A.

concept.title: Properness and smoothness of the Γ₁(N) moduli stack of generalized elliptic curves
concept.description: For N≥1 the moduli stack M_Γ₁(N) of Γ₁(N)-structures on generalized elliptic curves (a point of exact order N in the smooth locus whose multiples form an ample divisor) is a proper flat algebraic stack over ℤ with geometrically connected fibres of pure dimension one, and it is smooth over ℤ[1/N]; over ℤ[1/N] it is the Deligne–Rapoport compactified moduli space of X₁(N), with generic fibre the modular curve X₁(N)/ℚ (Deligne–Rapoport; Conrad 2007, Theorems 3.2.7, 3.3.1 and 4.2.1(1)).

concept.title: Fine moduli scheme for Γ₁(N)-structures when N≥5
concept.description: For N≥5, Γ₁(N)-structures on generalized elliptic curves over algebraically closed fields of characteristic prime to N have no nontrivial automorphisms, and the restriction of the moduli stack M_Γ₁(N) to ℤ[1/N] is a scheme, a fine moduli scheme for these structures (Conrad 2007, Theorem 4.2.1(2) and Remark 4.2.2; Katz–Mazur).

concept.title: Reduction of degree-zero divisor classes and morphisms of curves at a good prime
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective curve over ℚ with good reduction at p and C̃ its reduction over 𝔽̄_p, defined using a maximal ideal of ℤ̄ over p. Reducing points, ∑n_P(P)↦∑n_P(P̃), sends principal degree-zero divisors to principal divisors and induces a surjection Pic⁰(C)→Pic⁰(C̃). For a morphism h:C→C′ to another such curve of positive genus, the pushforwards h_* and h̃_* on Pic⁰ commute with reduction (Diamond–Shurman, Theorem 8.5.9).

concept.title: Reduction of an isogeny of elliptic curves at a good prime
concept.description: Let φ:E→E′ be an isogeny over ℚ̄ of elliptic curves over ℚ̄ with good reduction at a maximal ideal 𝔭 of ℤ̄ over p. Then φ reduces to an isogeny φ̃:Ẽ→Ẽ′ over 𝔽̄_p of the same degree, compatible with reduction of points and with composition of isogenies; in particular the reductions of φ and of its dual ψ satisfy ψ̃∘φ̃=[deg φ] (Diamond–Shurman, Theorem 8.5.10).

concept.title: Reduction of torsion and of p-isogenous images at a good prime
concept.description: Let E be an elliptic curve over ℚ̄ with good reduction at a maximal ideal 𝔭 of ℤ̄ over p. The reduction map E[N]→Ẽ[N] is surjective for every N≥1, and for every subgroup C⊂E of order p the quotient E/C again has good reduction at 𝔭, which is ordinary if that of E is ordinary and supersingular if that of E is supersingular (Diamond–Shurman, Proposition 8.4.4).

concept.title: Ordinary and supersingular elliptic curves
concept.description: An elliptic curve E over a field k of characteristic p>0 is ordinary if E[p](k̄)≅ℤ/pℤ and supersingular if E[p](k̄)=0; exactly one of these holds. An elliptic curve over a number field with good reduction at a prime above p has ordinary or supersingular reduction there according to the type of its reduction.

concept.title: Moduli description of the Hecke operator T_p on X₁(N)
concept.description: Let S₁(N) be the set of isomorphism classes [E,Q] of complex (or algebraic) elliptic curves E with a point Q of exact order N, mapped to X₁(N) by the moduli map. For a prime p, the operator [E,Q]↦∑_C[E/C,Q+C] on divisors of S₁(N), summed over subgroups C⊂E of order p with C∩⟨Q⟩=0, corresponds under the moduli map to the Hecke operator T_p on divisors and on Pic⁰ of X₁(N), whose action on S₂(Γ₁(N)) is the usual T_p (Diamond–Shurman, §§5.2, 6.3, 7.9, diagram (7.18)).

concept.title: Cartier dual of a finite commutative group scheme
concept.description: For a finite locally free commutative group scheme G over a scheme S, its Cartier dual is G^∨=Hom_(S-gr)(G,𝔾_m), the sheaf of group homomorphisms to the multiplicative group. It is again finite locally free commutative of the same order, the evaluation pairing G×G^∨→𝔾_m is perfect and G^∨∨≅G. Over a field k, for G étale of order prime to char k, G^∨ corresponds to the Galois module Hom(G(k^sep),μ(k^sep)).

concept.title: Cartier duality of the kernels of an isogeny and its dual
concept.description: If f:A→B is an isogeny of abelian varieties over a field with kernel N, then the dual homomorphism f^∨:B^∨→A^∨ is an isogeny whose kernel is canonically the Cartier dual N^∨ of N; equivalently the exact sequence 0→N→A→B→0 dualizes to 0→N^∨→B^∨→A^∨→0 (Mumford, Abelian Varieties §15; Milne 1986, Theorem 11.1).

concept.title: Weil’s trace formula for an endomorphism of a curve
concept.description: Let C be a smooth projective curve over an algebraically closed field k, α:C→C a nonconstant morphism and α′ the endomorphism of the Jacobian J of C induced by α. Then the intersection number on C×C of the graph Γ_α with the diagonal Δ is (Γ_α·Δ)=1−Tr(α′)+deg α, where Tr(α′) is the trace of α′ on the Tate module T_ℓJ for any prime ℓ≠char k (Weil; Milne, Abelian Varieties 2008, III Proposition 11.2).

concept.title: Characteristic polynomial of an endomorphism of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an endomorphism α of an abelian variety A of dimension g over a field k there is a unique monic polynomial P_α∈ℤ[X] of degree 2g with P_α(n)=deg(n−α) for all integers n, where deg is zero on non-isogenies. For every prime ℓ≠char k, P_α is the characteristic polynomial of α acting on V_ℓA=T_ℓA⊗ℚ_ℓ, so its roots are the eigenvalues of α on the Tate module and Tr(α) is minus its coefficient of X^(2g−1) (Milne, Abelian Varieties 1986, 12.9; 2008, I 10.20).

concept.title: Pic⁰ of an abelian variety
concept.description: For an abelian variety A over a field k, Pic⁰(A) is the subgroup of the Picard group Pic(A) consisting of the classes of invertible sheaves L that are translation-invariant over an algebraic closure: t_a*L≅L on A_(k^al) for every a∈A(k^al), where t_a is translation by a.

concept.title: Classification of order-p group schemes over a strictly henselian discrete valuation ring
concept.description: Let R be a strictly henselian discrete valuation ring with fraction field of characteristic 0, residue characteristic p and absolute ramification index e=v(p). Every finite flat commutative R-group scheme of order p has equation X^p=δX for some δ∈R with 0≤v(δ)≤e, and isomorphism classes correspond bijectively to the integers v(δ) in [0,e] (Oort–Tate; Raynaud’s case F=𝔽_p).

concept.title: Normal sheaf of a closed subscheme
concept.description: For a closed subscheme Y of a scheme X with ideal sheaf I⊆O_X, the conormal sheaf I/I² is an O_Y-module, and the normal sheaf is its dual N_(Y/X)=Hom_(O_Y)(I/I²,O_Y). When I/I² is locally free, for instance for a local complete intersection in a smooth scheme, N_(Y/X) is the normal bundle.

concept.title: Flatness criterion over a square-zero extension
concept.description: Let A′→A be a surjection of Noetherian rings whose kernel J satisfies J²=0. An A′-module M′ is flat over A′ if and only if M=M′⊗_(A′)A is flat over A and the natural map M⊗_A J→M′ is injective. This is a special case of the local criterion of flatness.

concept.title: Hilbert polynomial of a coherent sheaf on a proper scheme over a field
concept.description: Let X be a proper scheme over a field k with an invertible sheaf L, and F a coherent O_X-module. The Hilbert polynomial of F with respect to L is the unique Φ_F∈ℚ[λ] with Φ_F(m)=χ(X,F⊗L^(⊗m)) for every integer m (Snapper's lemma gives polynomiality). The Hilbert polynomial of a closed subscheme Z⊆X is that of O_Z, computed with L|_Z.

concept.title: Invertible sheaf of a divisor on a smooth projective curve
concept.description: For a divisor D on a smooth projective geometrically connected curve C over a field k, O_C(D) is the sheaf of rational functions with O_C(D)(U)={f∈k(C)×:(div f+D)|_U≥0}∪{0}. It is invertible, its global sections are L(D)={f:div f+D≥0}∪{0}, O_C(D)⊗O_C(D′)≅O_C(D+D′), and linearly equivalent divisors give isomorphic sheaves.

concept.title: Cyclotomic units of a cyclotomic field
concept.description: For n≢2 (mod 4) and a primitive nth root of unity ζ_n, let V_n be the multiplicative group generated by ±ζ_n and the numbers 1−ζ_n^a, 1≤a≤n−1. The cyclotomic units of ℚ(ζ_n) are C_n=V_n∩E_n, where E_n is the unit group of ℤ[ζ_n]; those of the maximal real subfield ℚ(ζ_n)⁺ are C_n⁺=C_n∩ℚ(ζ_n)⁺.

concept.title: Hurwitz genus formula for separable morphisms of curves
concept.description: Let φ:C₁→C₂ be a nonconstant separable morphism of smooth projective curves over an algebraically closed field, of genera g₁ and g₂. Then 2g₁−2≥(deg φ)(2g₂−2)+∑_(P∈C₁)(e_φ(P)−1), with equality exactly when the characteristic divides no ramification index e_φ(P); in particular equality holds when φ is unramified.

concept.title: Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of a coherent sheaf on projective space
concept.description: For an integer m, a coherent sheaf F on projective space Pⁿ over a field is m-regular if H^i(Pⁿ,F(m−i))=0 for every i≥1, where F(r)=F⊗O(r).

concept.title: Castelnuovo's lemma on m-regular sheaves
concept.description: If a coherent sheaf F on Pⁿ over a field is m-regular, then it is m′-regular for every m′≥m; for every r≥m the multiplication map H⁰(O(1))⊗H⁰(F(r))→H⁰(F(r+1)) is surjective, F(r) is generated by global sections and H^i(Pⁿ,F(r))=0 for i≥1.

concept.title: Mumford's uniform regularity bound for subsheaves of a trivial bundle
concept.description: For integers p,n≥0 there is a polynomial F_(p,n) with integer coefficients in n+1 variables such that, over every field k, every coherent subsheaf F of O_(Pⁿ_k)^(⊕p) whose Hilbert polynomial is χ(F(r))=∑_(i=0)^n a_i·binom(r,i) is m-regular for m=F_(p,n)(a₀,…,a_n).

concept.title: Representability of the Grassmannian functor of locally free quotients
concept.description: For a scheme S, a coherent O_S-module E and d≥0, the functor sending an S-scheme T to the set of locally free rank-d quotients of E_T (up to isomorphism of quotients) is represented by a proper S-scheme Grass(E,d) with a universal quotient; the determinant of the universal quotient gives a closed Plücker embedding into P(∧^dE) when E is locally free, so Grass(E,d) is projective over S.

concept.title: Cohomology and base change for flat coherent sheaves
concept.description: Let π:X→S be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and F a coherent O_X-module flat over S. Then s↦dim H^i(X_s,F_s) is upper semicontinuous and s↦χ(X_s,F_s) is locally constant; if (R^iπ_*F)_s→H^i(X_s,F_s) is surjective it is an isomorphism near s and R^iπ_*F commutes with base change there, and it is locally free near s exactly when the map in degree i−1 is also surjective. In particular, if H^i(X_s,F_s)=0 for all s and i≥1, then π_*F is locally free and commutes with every base change.

concept.title: Flattening stratification of a coherent sheaf on projective space
concept.description: Let S be a Noetherian scheme and F a coherent sheaf on Pⁿ_S. Only finitely many Hilbert polynomials f occur for the restrictions of F to the fibres, and there are locally closed subschemes S_f⊆S whose underlying sets are the points with fibre polynomial f, such that a morphism T→S factors through S_f exactly when the pullback of F to Pⁿ_T is flat over T with every fibre Hilbert polynomial equal to f.

concept.title: Closed vanishing locus of a homomorphism into a flat coherent sheaf
concept.description: Let π:X→S be a projective morphism with S Noetherian, E and F coherent O_X-modules with F flat over S, and f:E→F a homomorphism. There is a closed subscheme S′⊆S such that a morphism T→S factors through S′ exactly when the pullback f_T:E_T→F_T on X_T is zero; it is the zero locus of the linear scheme Spec Sym Q representing T↦Hom(E_T,F_T) (EGA III 7.7.6).

concept.title: Frobenius–Dedekind determinant formula for a finite abelian group
concept.description: For a finite abelian group G and a complex function f on G, det[f(ab⁻¹)]_(a,b∈G)=∏_χ∑_(a∈G)χ(a)f(a), the product over all characters χ of G, and det[f(ab⁻¹)−f(a)]_(a,b≠1)=∏_(χ≠1)∑_(a∈G)χ(a)f(a).

concept.title: Factorization of the Dedekind zeta function of an abelian number field
concept.description: If K is an abelian number field and X is its group of primitive Dirichlet characters (those of Gal(K/ℚ) via a cyclotomic field containing K), then ζ_K(s)=∏_(χ∈X)L(s,χ).

concept.title: Fricke operator on weight-k cusp forms with character
concept.description: For f∈S_k(Γ₀(N),χ) put (f|W_N)(z)=N^(k/2)(Nz)^(−k)f(−1/(Nz)), the weight-k slash action of [[0,−1],[N,0]] normalized by its determinant. W_N maps S_k(Γ₀(N),χ) onto S_k(Γ₀(N),χ̄) and satisfies W_N²=(−1)^k.

concept.title: Petersson adjoint of the Fricke operator
concept.description: On weight-k cusp forms on Γ₀(N) with character, ⟨f|W_N,g⟩=(−1)^k⟨f,g|W_N⟩ for the Petersson inner product. Since W_N²=(−1)^k, the Fricke operator is a Petersson isometry: ⟨f|W_N,g|W_N⟩=⟨f,g⟩.

concept.title: Fricke operator intertwines Hecke operators with their adjoints
concept.description: On S_k(Γ₀(N),χ), conjugation by the Fricke operator W_N carries each Hecke operator T(n) (including U_p for p|N) to its Petersson adjoint T*(n): (f|W_N)|T(n)=(f|T*(n))|W_N. Hence if f is a common eigenform with T(n)-eigenvalues a_n, then f|W_N has T(n)-eigenvalues ā_n.

concept.title: Rankin–Selberg residue formula for a cusp form
concept.description: For a cusp form F=∑a(n)qⁿ of weight k on Γ₀(N), the Dirichlet series ∑_(n≥1)|a(n)|²n^(−(s+k−1)) converges for Re s>1 and extends meromorphically past s=1, where it has a simple pole whose residue is c(N,k)⟨F,F⟩ with ⟨,⟩ the Petersson inner product and c(N,k)≠0 depending only on N and k (Rankin 1939).

concept.title: Rational basis of a space of cusp forms
concept.description: For N,k≥1 the space S_k(Γ₁(N)) (and S_k(Γ₀(N))) of cusp forms has a ℂ-basis consisting of forms whose q-expansion coefficients are rational integers (Shimura, Introduction to the Arithmetic Theory of Automorphic Functions, Theorem 3.52).

concept.title: Interchange of double series over a complete nonarchimedean field
concept.description: Let K be complete for a nonarchimedean absolute value. If a_mn→0 as max(m,n)→∞, then ∑_m∑_n a_mn and ∑_n∑_m a_mn converge and are equal. In particular, if ∑a_m and ∑b_n converge in K, their Cauchy product converges to (∑a_m)(∑b_n), with no absolute-convergence hypothesis.

concept.title: Termwise differentiation of power series over a complete nonarchimedean field
concept.description: Over a field K complete for a nonarchimedean absolute value, a power series f(x)=∑a_nxⁿ is differentiable on its disc of convergence with f′(x)=∑na_nx^(n−1); hence a_n=f^((n))(0)/n!, the coefficients are unique, and two power series (or analytic functions) on a common disc with equal derivatives differ by a constant there.

concept.title: Iwasawa p-adic logarithm on ℚ_p×
concept.description: Iwasawa’s p-adic logarithm Log_p:ℚ_p×→ℚ_p is the unique group homomorphism that agrees with the logarithm series log(1+x)=∑_(n≥1)(−1)^(n−1)xⁿ/n on the principal units 1+pℤ_p and satisfies Log_p(p)=0. It vanishes on the roots of unity of ℚ_p.

concept.title: Components of the special fiber of a minimal regular elliptic model
concept.description: Let 𝒞 be the minimal proper regular model over a discrete valuation ring of an elliptic curve, with special fiber ∑n_iF_i. Then the fiber is connected, some n_i=1, the arithmetic genus of the fiber is 1, and K·F_i=0 for the canonical divisor K. If there are at least two components, each F_i is a smooth rational curve with F_i²=−2, so ∑_(j≠i)n_jF_j·F_i=2n_i.

concept.title: Néron identity component as the smooth locus of a minimal Weierstrass model
concept.description: For an elliptic curve E over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring with minimal Weierstrass model W, the canonical map from the R-smooth locus W^sm to the Néron model is an isomorphism onto its identity component 𝒩⁰. Geometrically 𝒩⁰ of the special fiber is an elliptic curve, 𝔾_m or 𝔾_a according as the reduced cubic is smooth, nodal or cuspidal.

concept.title: Raynaud’s component-group formula for Néron models of Jacobians
concept.description: Let X be a regular proper flat curve over a strictly henselian discrete valuation ring with geometrically irreducible generic fiber, special-fiber components X_i of multiplicities δ_i, and residue field perfect or a section present. Then the component group of the Néron model of the Jacobian of X_K is ker β/im α, where α:ℤ^I→ℤ^I is given by the intersection matrix (X_i·X_j) (divided by geometric multiplicities) and β(a)=∑a_iδ_i.

concept.title: O’Meara’s isometry criterion for lattices over a dyadic local field
concept.description: Let L,K be lattices on the same regular quadratic space over a dyadic local field with the same fundamental invariants (number of Jordan components, their dimensions and scales, norm groups, weights and norm generators a_i), and Jordan chains L_(i),K_(i). Then L≅K iff for each i<t: dL_(i)/dK_(i)≅1 mod 𝔣_i; FL_(i)→FK_(i)⊥⟨a_(i+1)⟩ when 𝔣_i⊆4a_(i+1)𝔴_(i+1)⁻¹; and FL_(i)→FK_(i)⊥⟨a_i⟩ when 𝔣_i⊆4a_i𝔴_(i+1)⁻¹ (O’Meara 93:28).

concept.title: Local square theorem
concept.description: Let F be a nonarchimedean local field with ring of integers 𝔬 and uniformizer π. For every α∈𝔬 there is β∈𝔬 with 1+4πα=(1+2πβ)²; thus every element of 1+4π𝔬 is a square (O’Meara 63:1). Over ℚ₂, units congruent to 1 modulo 8 are squares.

concept.title: Witt’s cancellation theorem
concept.description: Over a field of characteristic not two, if U⊥W≅U⊥W′ for nondegenerate quadratic spaces, then W≅W′. Equivalently (Witt’s extension theorem) every isometry between subspaces of a nondegenerate quadratic space extends to an isometry of the whole space.

concept.title: Cancellation of hyperbolic lattice components over a dyadic local field
concept.description: Let L be a lattice on a regular quadratic space over a dyadic local field with splittings L=J⊥K=J′⊥K′, J≅J′. If J is the hyperbolic binary lattice A(0,0) (or an orthogonal sum of copies of it), then K≅K′ (O’Meara 93:14); Corollary 93:14a extends this to 𝔞-modular J whose norm group is contained in suitable norm groups of K and K′.

concept.title: Classification of unimodular lattices on a dyadic quadratic space by norm groups
concept.description: Two unimodular lattices on the same quadratic space over a dyadic local field are isometric if and only if they have the same norm group 𝔤L=Q(L)+2𝔰L (O’Meara 93:16).

concept.title: Euler-system relations for Heegner points of ring class conductor
concept.description: Let y_λ∈E(K_λ) be Heegner points of squarefree conductor λ built from inert primes p∤N. If λ=pλ′, then Tr_(K_λ/K_λ′)y_λ=a_p y_λ′; for each prime of K_λ above p, y_λ≡Frob_p(y_λ′) modulo that prime; and complex conjugation satisfies y_λ≡ε·σ(y_λ) modulo torsion for some σ∈Gal(K_λ/K), with ε=±1 the negative of the sign of the functional equation of E.

concept.title: Bohr compactification of a topological abelian group
concept.description: The Bohr compactification B(Z) of a topological abelian group Z is the Pontryagin dual of the group of continuous characters of Z taken with the discrete topology. It is a compact abelian group with a continuous homomorphism Z→B(Z) of dense image through which every continuous homomorphism of Z to a compact group factors.

concept.title: Eigenvalue of a topological dynamical system
concept.description: For a topological dynamical system (X,T), λ∈S¹ is an eigenvalue if f∘T=λf for some nonzero continuous f:X→ℂ (an eigenfunction). The eigenvalues form a subgroup of S¹; one also writes them as t∈ℝ/ℤ with λ=e^(2πit).

concept.title: Compact connected abelian Lie groups are tori
concept.description: Every compact connected abelian Lie group of dimension d is isomorphic, as a topological group, to the torus ℝ^d/ℤ^d.

concept.title: Symplectic basis theorem for alternating forms
concept.description: A nondegenerate alternating bilinear form on a finite-dimensional vector space over a field F has even dimension 2d and admits a symplectic basis, in which its Gram matrix is J=[[0,I_d],[−I_d,0]]; equivalently every invertible alternating matrix B over F can be written B=ΦᵀJΦ with Φ∈GL_(2d)(F).

concept.title: Jacobi triple product identity
concept.description: For complex q,z with |q|<1 and z≠0, ∑_(n∈ℤ)q^(n²)zⁿ=∏_(m≥1)(1−q^(2m))(1+zq^(2m−1))(1+z⁻¹q^(2m−1)); both sides converge absolutely and locally uniformly. Shifting the summation lattice gives the product formula for ∑_(m∈ℤ+r)q^(m²/2)z^m for every real r.

concept.title: Theta functions with rational characteristic are Jacobi forms
concept.description: For rational r the theta function ϑ_r(τ,σ)=∑_(m∈ℤ+r)q^(m²/2)e^(2πimσ), q=e^(2πiτ), satisfies the modular and elliptic transformation laws of a Jacobi form of weight 1/2 and index 1/2 (with a multiplier system) for a congruence subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) depending on r.

concept.title: Taylor coefficients of a Jacobi form are quasimodular
concept.description: If φ(τ,z) is a Jacobi form of weight k for a subgroup Γ of SL₂(ℤ) with Taylor expansion φ=∑_(m≥0)φ_m(τ)z^m in z, then each φ_m is a quasimodular form of weight k+m for Γ; equivalently (∂/∂z)^mφ(τ,0) is quasimodular of weight k+m (Eichler–Zagier, §3).

concept.title: Right-continuous filtration
concept.description: For a filtration (F_t)_(t≥0), the σ-algebras F_(t+)=⋂_(s>t)F_s form a filtration (F_(t+)), which is itself right-continuous. A filtration is right-continuous if F_t=F_(t+) for every t.

concept.title: Left-continuous path
concept.description: A path x:[0,∞)→E in a metric space is left-continuous if d(x(t−h),x(t))→0 as h↓0 for every t>0.

concept.title: Locally square-integrable martingale
concept.description: A right-continuous adapted real process M is a locally square-integrable martingale if there are stopping times τ_k↑∞ almost surely such that each stopped process M^(τ_k)=(M_(t∧τ_k))_(t≥0) is a martingale with E[M_(t∧τ_k)²]<∞ for every t.

concept.title: Quadratic variation of a stopped locally square-integrable martingale
concept.description: If M is a right-continuous square-integrable or locally square-integrable martingale and τ is a stopping time, then the quadratic variation of the stopped process M^τ=(M_(t∧τ)) is the stopped quadratic variation: [M^τ]=[M]^τ up to indistinguishability.

concept.title: Bounded-energy limits in the domain of a closed form
concept.description: Let E be a closed nonnegative symmetric form on a real Hilbert space H. If u_n lie in its domain, sup_n E(u_n,u_n)<∞ and u_n→u in H, then u lies in the domain, u_n→u weakly in the Hilbert space (D(E),E₁) with E₁=E+(·,·)_H, and E(u,u)≤liminf_n E(u_n,u_n).

concept.title: Weak Harnack inequality for weak supersolutions of divergence-form elliptic equations
concept.description: Let L u=D_i(a^(ij)D_ju+b^iu)+c^iD_iu+du be strictly elliptic on Ω⊆ℝⁿ with bounded measurable coefficients, and f^i∈L^q, g∈L^(q/2) with q>n. If u∈W^(1,2)(Ω) is a weak supersolution of Lu=g+D_if^i that is nonnegative on a ball B_(4R)(y)⊆Ω, then for 1≤p<n/(n−2) (any p≥1 if n≤2), R^(−n/p)‖u‖_(L^p(B_(2R)(y)))≤C(ess inf_(B_R(y))u+k(R)), with k(R)=λ^(−1)(R^(1−n/q)‖f‖_q+R^(2−2n/q)‖g‖_(q/2)) and C depending only on n, the ellipticity ratio, the scaled coefficient bound, q and p.

concept.title: Global boundedness of weak subsolutions of divergence-form elliptic equations
concept.description: Let L u=D_i(a^(ij)D_ju+b^iu)+c^iD_iu+du be strictly elliptic with bounded measurable coefficients on a bounded domain Ω⊆ℝⁿ, and f^i∈L^q, g∈L^(q/2) with q>n. If u∈W^(1,2)(Ω) is a weak subsolution of Lu=g+D_if^i with u≤0 on ∂Ω in the sense u⁺∈W₀^(1,2)(Ω), then ess sup_Ω u≤C(‖u⁺‖_(L²(Ω))+λ^(−1)(‖f‖_q+‖g‖_(q/2))), where C depends only on n, the coefficient bounds, q and |Ω|.

concept.title: Global Hölder estimate for weak solutions under an exterior cone condition
concept.description: Let L be a strictly elliptic divergence-form operator with bounded measurable coefficients on Ω⊆ℝⁿ, f^i∈L^q and g∈L^(q/2) with q>n, and suppose Ω satisfies a uniform exterior cone condition on a boundary portion T. If u∈W^(1,2)(Ω) solves Lu=g+D_if^i and osc_(∂Ω∩B_R(x₀))u≤KR^(α₀) for all x₀∈T and R>0, then u is Hölder continuous on Ω∪T, with ‖u‖_(C^α(Ω′))≤C(sup_Ω|u|+K+k) for Ω′⊆Ω at positive distance from ∂Ω∖T.

concept.title: Local extremum of a real-valued function on a metric space
concept.description: A function f:X→ℝ on a metric space has a local (relative) maximum at c∈X if for some δ>0, f(x)≤f(c) for every x∈X with d(x,c)<δ; a local minimum reverses the inequality, and a local extremum is either. Subsets of ℝ and ℝⁿ carry the Euclidean metric.

concept.title: Limits of real sequences preserve non-strict inequalities
concept.description: If convergent real sequences satisfy xₙ≤yₙ for every n, then lim xₙ≤lim yₙ; in particular a≤xₙ≤b for every n gives a≤lim xₙ≤b.

concept.title: Sequential characterization of limits of real functions
concept.description: Let c be a cluster point of S⊆ℝ and f:S→ℝ. Then f(x)→L as x→c exactly when f(xₙ)→L for every sequence xₙ in S∖{c} converging to c.

concept.title: Taylor’s theorem with mean-value remainder on ℝⁿ
concept.description: Let f be a real function on an open U⊆ℝⁿ containing the segment from x to x+p. If f is C¹, then f(x+p)=f(x)+∇f(x+tp)ᵀp for some t∈(0,1); if f is C², then f(x+p)=f(x)+∇f(x)ᵀp+½pᵀ∇²f(x+tp)p for some t∈(0,1).

concept.title: Tangent line inequality for a convex function
concept.description: If f is convex on an open interval I and differentiable at h∈I, then f(a)≥f(h)+f′(h)(a−h) for every a∈I.

concept.title: Generalized Klein inequality for Hermitian matrices
concept.description: Let fᵢ,gᵢ be finitely many real functions on an interval I with Σᵢfᵢ(a)gᵢ(h)≥0 for all a,h∈I. Then Σᵢtr[fᵢ(A)gᵢ(H)]≥0 for all Hermitian matrices A,H of the same size with eigenvalues in I, where fᵢ(A) and gᵢ(H) are standard matrix functions.

concept.title: Operator convex function
concept.description: A real function f on an interval I⊆ℝ is operator convex on I if f(τA+(1−τ)H)≼τf(A)+(1−τ)f(H) in the Löwner order for all τ∈[0,1] and all Hermitian matrices A,H of any common size with eigenvalues in I, where f(A) is the standard matrix function. f is operator concave when −f is operator convex.

concept.title: Operator concavity of the positive definite matrix logarithm
concept.description: For positive definite complex matrices A,H of the same size and τ∈[0,1], τ log A+(1−τ)log H≼log(τA+(1−τ)H) in the Löwner order; that is, the logarithm is operator concave on (0,∞).

concept.title: Matrix perspective of an operator convex function
concept.description: For an operator convex f:(0,∞)→ℝ and positive definite matrices A,H of the same size, Ψ_f(A;H)=A^{1/2}f(A^{−1/2}HA^{−1/2})A^{1/2}, with A^{1/2} the positive square root. When A and H commute, Ψ_f(A;H)=A f(HA⁻¹).

concept.title: Joint operator convexity of the matrix perspective
concept.description: If f:(0,∞)→ℝ is operator convex, its matrix perspective satisfies Ψ_f(τA₁+(1−τ)A₂;τH₁+(1−τ)H₂)≼τΨ_f(A₁;H₁)+(1−τ)Ψ_f(A₂;H₂) in the Löwner order for positive definite matrices Aᵢ,Hᵢ of the same size and τ∈[0,1].

concept.title: Simultaneous unitary diagonalization of commuting Hermitian matrices
concept.description: If Hermitian complex matrices A and H of the same size commute, there is one unitary U with A=U diag(λ₁,…,λₙ)U* and H=U diag(μ₁,…,μₙ)U*, all λⱼ,μⱼ real.

concept.title: Divisible module over an integral domain
concept.description: A module M over an integral domain R is divisible if for every nonzero r∈R the map M→M, x↦rx, is surjective. Over R=ℤ these are exactly the divisible abelian groups.

concept.title: Compactly supported ℓ-adic Euler characteristic
concept.description: For a separated scheme X of finite type over a separably closed field and a prime ℓ invertible there, χ_c(X,Q_ℓ)=Σ_i(−1)^i dim_(Q_ℓ)H^i_c(X,Q_ℓ). The sum is finite because these spaces are finite-dimensional and vanish for i>2·dim X.

concept.title: Mayer–Vietoris spectral sequence for a finite open cover in étale cohomology
concept.description: For a scheme X covered by open subschemes U_1,…,U_r and an étale abelian sheaf F there is a spectral sequence E_1^(p,q)=⊕_(i_0<⋯<i_p)H^q(U_(i_0)∩⋯∩U_(i_p),F)⇒H^(p+q)(X_et,F), the Čech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of the cover. For r=2 it is the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence.

concept.title: Katz affine weak Lefschetz theorem for general hyperplane sections
concept.description: Let V⊂Aᴺ be a smooth connected affine variety of dimension n≥2 over an algebraically closed field and ℓ invertible. For all affine hyperplanes H in a dense open set, V∩H is smooth and connected of dimension n−1 and restriction H^i(V,Q_ℓ)→H^i(V∩H,Q_ℓ) is bijective for i≤n−2 and injective for i=n−1 (Katz, Affine cohomological transforms, 3.4.1 and 3.4.3).

concept.title: Étale cohomology of affine space
concept.description: For a separably closed field k, m≥0 and n invertible in k, H^0(A^m_k,Z/nZ)=Z/nZ and H^i(A^m_k,Z/nZ)=0 for i>0; hence H^i(A^m_k,Q_ℓ) is Q_ℓ for i=0 and zero otherwise. With compact supports, H^i_c(A^m_k,Q_ℓ) is Q_ℓ(−m) for i=2m and zero otherwise.

concept.title: Étale cohomology with supports in a closed subscheme
concept.description: For a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X with open complement U and an étale abelian sheaf F, Γ_Z(X,F) is the group of global sections of F whose restriction to U vanishes. Its right derived functors are the cohomology groups with supports H^q_Z(X,F), and there is a long exact sequence ⋯→H^q_Z(X,F)→H^q(X,F)→H^q(U,F)→H^(q+1)_Z(X,F)→⋯.

concept.title: Excision for étale cohomology with supports
concept.description: Let f:X′→X be an étale morphism, Z⊆X a closed subscheme and Z′=X′×_X Z. If Z′→Z is an isomorphism, then H^q_Z(X,F)≅H^q_(Z′)(X′,f^*F) for every étale abelian sheaf F on X and all q. In particular H^q_Z(X,F) depends only on an open neighbourhood of Z.

concept.title: Cohomological purity for smooth pairs in étale cohomology
concept.description: Let X be a smooth separated scheme of finite type over a field k, Z⊂X a closed subscheme smooth over k of pure codimension c, n invertible in k and F a locally constant constructible sheaf of Z/n-modules on X. Then H^q_Z(X,F)≅H^(q−2c)(Z,F|_Z(−c)) for all q, where (−c) is the twist by μ_n^⊗(−c); in particular H^q_Z(X,F)=0 for q<2c. Passing to the limit gives H^q_Z(X,Q_ℓ)≅H^(q−2c)(Z,Q_ℓ(−c)).

concept.title: Gysin map in ℓ-adic cohomology for a smooth closed subscheme
concept.description: Let X be a scheme of finite type over a separably closed field, ℓ invertible, and Y⊂X a closed subscheme contained in an open X′⊆X such that X′ and Y are smooth and Y has pure codimension r in X′. The Gysin map ι_*:H^(i−2r)(Y,Q_ℓ(−r))→H^i(X,Q_ℓ) is the composite of the purity isomorphism with H^i_Y(X′,Q_ℓ), the excision isomorphism H^i_Y(X′,Q_ℓ)≅H^i_Y(X,Q_ℓ) and the forget-supports map to H^i(X,Q_ℓ). It is Galois-equivariant when everything is defined over a subfield.

concept.title: Proper linear section of a projective scheme
concept.description: For a closed subscheme X⊆Pᴺ over a field, a proper linear section of codimension r is the scheme-theoretic intersection X∩E with a linear subvariety E⊆Pᴺ of codimension r, the common zero scheme of r linearly independent linear forms, such that X and E intersect properly: every irreducible component of X∩E has dimension dim X−r. For r=1 it is a proper hyperplane section.

concept.title: Poincaré–Verdier duality for smooth morphisms
concept.description: Let f:X→Y be a smooth compactifiable morphism of pure relative dimension d between schemes of finite type over a Noetherian scheme, n invertible and A a Noetherian ring with nA=0. The trace morphism Tr_f:Rf_!f^*L(d)[2d]→L induces an isomorphism f^*L(d)[2d]≅Rf^!L for L∈D⁺(Y,A); equivalently Hom(K,f^*L(d)[2d])≅Hom(Rf_!K,L) for all K (SGA 4 XVIII 3.2.5; Fu, Thm. 8.5.2).

concept.title: Local constancy of higher direct images under smooth proper morphisms
concept.description: If f:X→S is a smooth proper morphism and n is invertible on S, then for every locally constant constructible sheaf F of Z/n-modules on X the sheaves R^qf_*F are locally constant constructible and their formation commutes with arbitrary base change (SGA 4 XVI 2.2). The same holds for ℓ-adic coefficients.

concept.title: ℓ-adic first Chern class of an invertible sheaf
concept.description: For a scheme X on which ℓ is invertible, the Kummer sequences 0→μ_(ℓⁿ)→G_m→G_m→0 give boundary maps Pic(X)=H^1(X_et,G_m)→H^2(X_et,μ_(ℓⁿ)), compatible in n; their limit is the first Chern class c_1:Pic(X)→H^2(X,Z_ℓ(1)) (SGA 4½ Cycle; SGA 5 VII).

concept.title: Étale cohomology commutes with limits of schemes
concept.description: Let X=lim X_i be the limit of a directed system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, (F_i) a compatible system of abelian sheaves and F=colim f_i^(−1)F_i on X. Then colim_i H^p(X_(i,et),F_i)=H^p(X_et,F) for all p (SGA 4 VII 5.7; Stacks 09YQ).

concept.title: Vanishing of torsion étale cohomology of curves
concept.description: Let X be a separated scheme of finite type and dimension at most 1 over an algebraically closed field and F a torsion étale abelian sheaf. Then H^q(X_et,F)=0 for q>2, and for q>1 if X is affine (Stacks 03SC).

concept.title: Vanishing of higher direct images for proper morphisms of bounded fibre dimension
concept.description: If f:X→Y is a proper morphism of schemes all of whose fibres have dimension at most n, then R^qf_*F=0 for q>2n and every torsion étale abelian sheaf F on X (SGA 4 XII 5.2; Stacks 095U).

concept.title: Torsion étale sheaves as filtered colimits of constructible sheaves
concept.description: On a Noetherian scheme X every torsion abelian étale sheaf is a filtered colimit of constructible abelian sheaves. If its support lies in a subset E closed under specialization, the constructible sheaves can be chosen supported on closed subsets contained in E (SGA 4 IX 2.7.2; Stacks 0F0N).

concept.title: Cup product in ℓ-adic étale cohomology
concept.description: For a scheme X of finite type over a separably closed field and n invertible, tensoring resolutions gives cup products H^i(X,F)⊗H^j(X,G)→H^(i+j)(X,F⊗G) for sheaves of Z/n-modules, and H^i_c(X,F)⊗H^j(X,G)→H^(i+j)_c(X,F⊗G) for X separated. For F=Z/ℓ^m(a), G=Z/ℓ^m(b) they are compatible in m and give cup products H^i_c(X,Q_ℓ(a))×H^j(X,Q_ℓ(b))→H^(i+j)_c(X,Q_ℓ(a+b)).

concept.title: Trace map in ℓ-adic cohomology of a smooth variety
concept.description: For a smooth separated scheme X of pure dimension d over a separably closed field and n invertible, the trace map Tr_X:H^(2d)_c(X,Z/n(d))→Z/n is glued from étale coordinates U→A^d, using adjunction for étale maps and the degree map on Picard groups of curves. It is compatible with étale maps and composition (SGA 4 XVIII 2.9; Fu §8.2). Its limit over n=ℓ^m is Tr_X:H^(2d)_c(X,Q_ℓ(d))→Q_ℓ.

concept.title: Irreducible element of an integral domain
concept.description: A nonzero nonunit p of an integral domain such that whenever p=ab, one of a and b is a unit.

concept.title: Prime element of a commutative ring
concept.description: A nonzero nonunit p of a commutative ring such that p|ab implies p|a or p|b; equivalently, the principal ideal pR is a prime ideal.

concept.title: Maximal ideals are prime
concept.description: Every maximal ideal of a commutative ring is a prime ideal; equivalently, the quotient by a maximal ideal is a field and hence an integral domain.

concept.title: Factorization into irreducibles under the ascending chain condition on principal ideals
concept.description: In an integral domain in which every ascending chain of principal ideals becomes constant, for example a Noetherian domain, every nonzero nonunit is a finite product of irreducible elements.

concept.title: Polynomial ring over an integral domain is an integral domain
concept.description: If R is an integral domain, then R[X] is an integral domain: for nonzero f,g the leading coefficient of fg is the product of their leading coefficients, so deg(fg)=deg f+deg g.

concept.title: Monomorphisms are kernels of their cokernels in an abelian category
concept.description: In an abelian category every monomorphism is a kernel of its cokernel and every epimorphism is a cokernel of its kernel. Hence taking cokernels and kernels gives mutually inverse bijections between the subobjects and quotient objects of each object.

concept.title: Gallery distance in a chamber complex
concept.description: The gallery distance d(C,D) between chambers C and D of a chamber complex is the least length n of a gallery C=C₀,C₁,…,C_n=D; a gallery of that length is minimal. For a simplex A, d(A,D) is the least distance from a chamber having A as a face to D.

concept.title: Convexity of apartments in a building
concept.description: If an apartment A of a building contains chambers C and D, then every minimal gallery in the building from C to D lies in A.

concept.title: Apartments of a building are Coxeter complexes
concept.description: For an apartment system of a thick building there is a Coxeter system (W,S) such that every apartment is isomorphic as a chamber complex to the Coxeter complex Σ(W,S). This follows from Tits’ characterization of Coxeter complexes by foldings.

concept.title: Projections and the gate property in a Coxeter complex
concept.description: In a Coxeter complex, for a simplex A and a chamber C there is a unique chamber proj_A C having A as a face at least gallery distance from C; every minimal gallery from A to C starts with it, and d(C,D)=d(C,proj_A C)+d(proj_A C,D) for every chamber D having A as a face.

concept.title: Sequential characterization of closed sets in a metric space
concept.description: A subset F of a metric space is closed if and only if the limit of every convergent sequence of points of F lies in F; equivalently the closure of F is the set of limits of sequences in F.

concept.title: Summatory bound for the r-fold divisor function
concept.description: For an integer r≥1 let d_r(n) be the number of ordered r-tuples of positive integers with product n. Then ∑_(n≤x)d_r(n)=O(x(log x)^(r−1)) for x≥2; in fact the sum is asymptotic to x(log x)^(r−1)/(r−1)!.

concept.title: Fourier inversion theorem for locally compact abelian groups
concept.description: For a locally compact abelian group G with Haar measure there is a Haar measure on the dual group Ĝ, the dual measure, such that whenever f∈L¹(G) and f̂∈L¹(Ĝ), f(x)=∫_Ĝ f̂(ξ)ξ(x)dξ for almost every x, and for every x if f is continuous.

concept.title: Dual Haar measure of a compact abelian group is counting measure
concept.description: If G is a compact abelian group with Haar measure normalized by |G|=1, the Haar measure on its discrete dual group dual to it for Fourier inversion is counting measure; dually, counting measure on a discrete group has the normalized Haar probability on the compact dual as dual measure.

concept.title: Axiom schema of replacement
concept.description: The Zermelo–Fraenkel axiom schema stating that if a formula defines a rule assigning to every set A a unique set f(A), then for every set X the images {f(A): A∈X} form a set.

concept.title: Every well-ordered set is isomorphic to a unique ordinal
concept.description: Every well-ordered set is order-isomorphic to exactly one ordinal, by a unique order isomorphism; the ordinal is its order type. The construction uses the axiom of replacement.

concept.title: The union of a set of ordinals is an ordinal
concept.description: For every set S of ordinals, its union ⋃S is an ordinal, the least ordinal containing every member of S as a subset; in particular the class of all ordinals is not a set.

concept.title: Successor of an ordinal
concept.description: For an ordinal α, its successor α+1=α∪{α} is again an ordinal and is the least ordinal strictly greater than α. An ordinal of this form is a successor ordinal.

concept.title: Uniform Cauchy criterion for series of functions
concept.description: A series ∑u_n of real or complex functions on a set S converges uniformly on S exactly when for every ε>0 there is N, independent of z∈S, with |u_(n+1)(z)+⋯+u_(n+p)(z)|<ε for all n≥N, p≥1 and z∈S.

concept.title: Bounded-below operators are injective with closed range
concept.description: If T is a bounded linear operator from a Banach space X to a normed space Y with ∥Tx∥≥C∥x∥ for some C>0 and all x∈X, then T is injective and its range is closed in Y.

concept.title: Kernel–range orthogonal decompositions for a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concept.description: For a bounded operator T:H→K between Hilbert spaces, H=N(T)⊕closure(R(T*)) and K=N(T*)⊕closure(R(T)) orthogonally. In particular T has dense range exactly when its adjoint T* is injective, and T is injective exactly when T* has dense range.

concept.title: Approximate eigenvalue of a bounded operator
concept.description: A scalar λ is an approximate eigenvalue of a bounded operator T on a Banach space if there are unit vectors x_n with ∥Tx_n−λx_n∥→0. Every eigenvalue is one, every approximate eigenvalue lies in the spectrum σ(T), and they form the approximate point spectrum.

concept.title: Compactness of the spectrum of a bounded operator
concept.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Banach space, the resolvent set is open and contains every λ with |λ|>∥T∥, so the spectrum σ(T) is a compact subset of the closed disc {|λ|≤∥T∥}.

concept.title: Pointwise limits of measurable functions are measurable
concept.description: On a measurable space, the pointwise limit of a sequence of measurable real- or complex-valued functions is measurable.

concept.title: Monotonicity of ℓ^q quasi-norms in the exponent
concept.description: For 0<q≤r≤∞ and every scalar sequence a, ∥a∥_(ℓ^r)≤∥a∥_(ℓ^q); hence ℓ^q⊆ℓ^r with inclusion of quasi-norm at most one.

concept.title: Codimension-one normal subgroups containing a proper subgroup of a nilpotent Lie group
concept.description: In a connected simply connected nilpotent Lie group G, every proper closed connected subgroup H lies in a closed connected normal subgroup of codimension one; on Lie algebras, every proper subalgebra of a nilpotent Lie algebra lies in an ideal of codimension one.

concept.title: Derivative of a function from a real interval into a normed space
concept.description: For f from a real interval I into a normed space X, the derivative at t∈I is the norm limit f′(t)=lim (f(t+h)−f(t))/h as h→0 with t+h∈I (one-sided at an endpoint), when it exists. f is continuously differentiable (C¹) on I if f′(t) exists for every t∈I and t↦f′(t) is continuous.

concept.title: Linearity of the Banach-valued Riemann integral
concept.description: If f,g:[a,b]→X are Riemann integrable into a Banach space X and α is a scalar, then αf and f+g are Riemann integrable with ∫αf=α∫f and ∫(f+g)=∫f+∫g; in particular the integral of a constant u is (b−a)u.

concept.title: Interval additivity of the Banach-valued Riemann integral
concept.description: If f:[a,b]→X is Riemann integrable into a Banach space X and a≤c≤b, then f is integrable on [a,c] and [c,b] and ∫_a^b f=∫_a^c f+∫_c^b f.

concept.title: Muckenhoupt Aₚ weight
concept.description: For 1<p<∞, a weight w on ℝⁿ (a locally integrable function with w>0 almost everywhere) belongs to A_p if [w]_{A_p}=sup_Q(|Q|⁻¹∫_Q w)(|Q|⁻¹∫_Q w^{−1/(p−1)})^{p−1}<∞, the supremum over all cubes Q; [w]_{A_p} is its A_p constant. Taking balls instead of cubes gives the same class with comparable constants.

concept.title: Boundedness of the centered maximal operator with respect to a weight
concept.description: For a weight w on ℝⁿ let M_c^w f(x)=sup_{δ>0}w(Q(x,δ))⁻¹∫_{Q(x,δ)}|f|w dy, the supremum over open cubes Q(x,δ) centred at x. Then M_c^w maps L¹(w) to weak L¹(w) with norm at most 24ⁿ and is bounded on Lᵠ(w) for 1<q≤∞, with constants depending only on n and q and not on w.

concept.title: Rubio de Francia extrapolation theorem for Aₚ weights
concept.description: Let 1<p₀<∞ and let F be a family of pairs (f,g) of nonnegative measurable functions on ℝⁿ with ∫f^{p₀}w≤C∫g^{p₀}w for every w∈A_{p₀}, C depending only on [w]_{A_{p₀}}. Then for every 1<p<∞ and w∈A_p, ∫f^pw≤C∫g^pw with C depending on [w]_{A_p}, and for 1<q<∞ also ∥(∑_jf_j^q)^{1/q}∥_{L^p(w)}≤C∥(∑_jg_j^q)^{1/q}∥_{L^p(w)} for sequences in F; the inequalities are asserted when the left side is finite.

concept.title: Hardy–Littlewood maximal theorem on Lᵖ
concept.description: For 1<p≤∞ the Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator is bounded on Lᵖ(ℝⁿ): ∥Mf∥_p≤C_{n,p}∥f∥_p with a constant depending only on n and p.

concept.title: Dimension of the space of homogeneous harmonic polynomials
concept.description: For n≥2 the space H_m(ℝⁿ) of homogeneous harmonic polynomials of degree m on ℝⁿ has dimension 1 for m=0, n for m=1, and C(n+m−1,n−1)−C(n+m−3,n−1) for m≥2. For fixed n this is asymptotic to 2m^{n−2}/(n−2)! as m→∞, so dim H_m(ℝⁿ)≤C_n m^{n−2} for m≥1.

concept.title: Poisson integral of polynomial boundary data on the ball
concept.description: If p is a polynomial on ℝⁿ of degree m, the Poisson integral over the unit ball of its restriction to the unit sphere is P[p|_S]=(1−|x|²)q+p for some polynomial q of degree at most m−2; in particular P[p|_S] is a polynomial of degree at most m.

concept.title: Double complex in an abelian category
concept.description: A double complex L^{•,•} in an abelian category consists of objects L^{p,q} (p,q∈ℤ) and morphisms d₁^{p,q}:L^{p,q}→L^{p+1,q} and d₂^{p,q}:L^{p,q}→L^{p,q+1} with d₁∘d₁=0, d₂∘d₂=0 and d₁∘d₂=d₂∘d₁; thus every column L^{p,•} and row L^{•,q} is a cochain complex. Some authors require anticommuting squares instead; the two conventions differ by signs.

concept.title: Total complex of a double complex
concept.description: For a double complex L^{•,•} with only finitely many nonzero L^{p,q} on each antidiagonal p+q=n (for instance a first-quadrant one), the total complex has Totⁿ(L)=⊕_{p+q=n}L^{p,q} and differential dⁿ=∑_{p+q=n}(d₁^{p,q}+(−1)^p d₂^{p,q}), which squares to zero.

concept.title: Cohomological spectral sequence in an abelian category
concept.description: A cohomological spectral sequence starting at r₀ consists of objects E_r^{p,q} (p,q∈ℤ, r≥r₀) of an abelian category, differentials d_r:E_r^{p,q}→E_r^{p+r,q−r+1} with d_r∘d_r=0, and isomorphisms from E_{r+1}^{p,q} to the cohomology of d_r at (p,q). It is bounded if each total degree p+q has only finitely many nonzero E_{r₀}^{p,q}; then each E_r^{p,q} is constant for large r, with value E_∞^{p,q}. A bounded one converges to objects Hⁿ if each Hⁿ has a finite decreasing filtration F^pHⁿ with E_∞^{p,n−p}≅F^pHⁿ/F^{p+1}Hⁿ.

concept.title: Spectral sequence of a filtered cochain complex
concept.description: Let K• be a cochain complex in an abelian category with a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes F^pK•. There is a cohomological spectral sequence with E₀^{p,q}=F^pK^{p+q}/F^{p+1}K^{p+q}, d₀ induced by the differential, and E₁^{p,q}=H^{p+q}(F^pK•/F^{p+1}K•). If in each degree n the filtration is finite (F^pKⁿ=Kⁿ for p≪0 and F^pKⁿ=0 for p≫0), the spectral sequence is bounded and converges to H(K•) with the filtration F^pHⁿ=im(Hⁿ(F^pK•)→Hⁿ(K•)).

concept.title: Quasi-isomorphism of cochain complexes
concept.description: A cochain map f:K•→L• between complexes in an abelian category is a quasi-isomorphism if every induced morphism Hⁿ(f):Hⁿ(K•)→Hⁿ(L•) on cohomology objects is an isomorphism.

concept.title: Injective resolution of a bounded below complex
concept.description: An injective resolution of a cochain complex K• in an abelian category is a quasi-isomorphism K•→I• into a bounded below complex (Iⁿ=0 for n≪0) of injective objects.

concept.title: Homotopy lifting into bounded below complexes of injectives
concept.description: In an abelian category let I• be a bounded below complex of injective objects and α:K•→L• a quasi-isomorphism of cochain complexes. Every cochain map γ:K•→I• is homotopic to β∘α for some cochain map β:L•→I•, and any two such β are homotopic. In particular two injective resolutions of a complex are homotopy equivalent by maps compatible with the augmentations up to homotopy.

concept.title: Existence of Cartan–Eilenberg resolutions
concept.description: In an abelian category with enough injectives, every bounded below cochain complex K• has a Cartan–Eilenberg resolution, which may be chosen with I^{p,•}=0 whenever Kᵖ=0 for all smaller degrees.

concept.title: Subsets of a separable metric space are separable
concept.description: Every subset of a separable metric space is separable in the restricted metric: it has a countable subset dense in it.

concept.title: Conic intrinsic volumes of a closed convex cone
concept.description: For a polyhedral cone C⊆ℝ^d and k=0,…,d, v_k(C) is the probability that the Euclidean projection of a standard Gaussian vector onto C lies in the relative interior of a k-dimensional face of C. For a general closed convex cone v_k(C) is the limit of v_k(C_i) for polyhedral cones C_i converging to C in the conic Hausdorff metric. The v_k(C) form a probability distribution on {0,…,d}.

concept.title: Conic kinematic formula
concept.description: Let C,K⊆ℝ^d be closed convex cones, not both linear subspaces, and Q a Haar-random orthogonal matrix. Then P(C∩QK≠{0})=∑_{i=0}^{d}(1+(−1)^{i+1})∑_{j=i}^{d}v_i(C)v_{d+i−j}(K), equivalently twice the sum of the conic intrinsic volumes v_k(C×K) over k≥d+1 with k−d−1 even. For K a (d−m)-dimensional subspace this is the Crofton formula 2∑_{j≥0}v_{m+1+2j}(C).

concept.title: Concentration of conic intrinsic volumes
concept.description: Let C be a closed convex cone with polar C°, ω(C)²=min(δ(C),δ(C°)) and p_C(λ)=4exp(−(λ²/8)/(ω(C)²+λ)). For the tail sums t_k(C)=∑_{j≥k}v_j(C) of the conic intrinsic volumes: if k≤δ(C)−λ+1 then t_k(C)≥1−p_C(λ), and if k≥δ(C)+λ then t_k(C)≤p_C(λ) (Amelunxen–Lotz–McCoy–Tropp).

concept.title: Unique extension of an absolute value from a complete field
concept.description: If K is complete for an absolute value |·|, archimedean or not, and L/K is a finite extension of degree n, then |·| has exactly one extension to an absolute value on L, namely |β|=|N_{L/K}(β)|^{1/n}, and L is complete for it.

concept.title: First isomorphism theorem for rings
concept.description: For a homomorphism φ:R→S of rings, its kernel is an ideal of R and φ induces an injective ring homomorphism R/ker φ→S with image φ(R); in particular a surjective φ gives R/ker φ≅S.

concept.title: Multiplicative system of representatives for a perfect residue ring
concept.description: Let A be Hausdorff and complete for a decreasing filtration by ideals 𝔞₁⊇𝔞₂⊇⋯ with 𝔞_n𝔞_m⊆𝔞_(n+m), and suppose k=A/𝔞₁ is a perfect ring of characteristic p. There is exactly one system of representatives f:k→A commuting with p-th powers; its image consists of the elements of A that are p^n-th powers for every n, and f is multiplicative. If A has characteristic p, f is also additive (Teichmüller representatives).

concept.title: Uniformizer expansions in a complete discrete valuation ring
concept.description: Let A be a complete discrete valuation ring with fraction field K and residue field k, S⊆A a system of representatives of k containing 0, and π a uniformizer. Every a∈A is uniquely a convergent series ∑_{n≥0}s_nπⁿ with s_n∈S, every such series converges, and every x∈K is uniquely ∑_{n≥n₀}s_nπⁿ with n₀∈ℤ.

concept.title: Degree of a simple algebraic extension
concept.description: If α is algebraic over a field F with minimal polynomial f of degree n, then F(α)=F[α]≅F[X]/(f), the elements 1,α,…,α^(n−1) form an F-basis, and [F(α):F]=n.

concept.title: Existence of the Hilbert–Samuel polynomial
concept.description: Let R be a Noetherian ring, q an ideal generated by r elements and M a finitely generated R-module with M/qM of finite length. Then every M/qⁿM has finite length, and n↦length(M/qⁿM) agrees for all large n with a polynomial p_q(M,n) with rational coefficients and degree at most r, the Hilbert–Samuel polynomial. Its degree does not change when q is replaced by its radical.

concept.title: Induced module from a subgroup of finite index
concept.description: For a subgroup H of finite index in a group G and an H-module W, Ind_H^G W is the group of functions f:G→W with f(hg)=h·f(g) for h∈H, with pointwise addition and G-action (g₀f)(g)=f(gg₀). Choosing representatives of H∖G identifies it with a direct sum of [G:H] copies of W.

concept.title: Semisimple linear representation of a group
concept.description: A linear representation of a group G on a vector space V is semisimple, or completely reducible, if V is a direct sum of irreducible subrepresentations; equivalently, every G-invariant subspace of V has a G-invariant complement.

concept.title: Degree of Hilbert–Samuel polynomials in a short exact sequence
concept.description: Let R be Noetherian, q an ideal and 0→M′→M→M″→0 an exact sequence of finitely generated modules. M/qM has finite length if and only if M′/qM′ and M″/qM″ do; then p_q(M′,n)−p_q(M,n)+p_q(M″,n) has degree less than deg p_q(M′,n) and positive leading coefficient, and deg p_q(M,n)=max(deg p_q(M′,n),deg p_q(M″,n)). The proof uses the Artin–Rees lemma.

concept.title: Finite-length criterion for modules over a Noetherian ring
concept.description: For a finitely generated module M over a Noetherian ring, the following are equivalent: M has finite length; every prime in the support of M is maximal; every associated prime of M is maximal. Then the associated primes and the support coincide and form a finite set.

concept.title: Prime avoidance lemma
concept.description: Let R be a commutative ring, a⊆R a subset closed under addition and multiplication (for example an ideal), and p₁,…,p_n ideals of which all but at most two are prime. If a⊆p₁∪⋯∪p_n, then a⊆p_i for some i.

concept.title: Krull dimension of a module
concept.description: For a nonzero module M over a commutative ring R, dim M is the supremum of the lengths r of chains p₀⊊⋯⊊p_r of prime ideals in the support of M. For M=R it is the Krull dimension of R.

concept.title: Hilbert–Serre theorem on Hilbert series of graded modules
concept.description: Let R=⊕_{n≥0}R_n be a graded ring with R₀ Artinian, generated over R₀ by finitely many homogeneous elements of positive degrees k₁,…,k_r, and M a finitely generated graded R-module. Then its Hilbert series ∑length(M_n)tⁿ is a rational function e(t)/(t^l(1−t^{k₁})⋯(1−t^{k_r})) with e∈ℤ[t]. If all k_i=1, length(M_n) agrees for large n with a polynomial of degree at most r−1.

concept.title: Associated graded ring and module of an ideal filtration
concept.description: For an ideal q of a commutative ring R, the associated graded ring is G(R)=⊕_{n≥0}qⁿ/qⁿ⁺¹ with multiplication induced from R. For a module M with a q-filtration M=F⁰M⊇F¹M⊇⋯ (qFⁿM⊆Fⁿ⁺¹M), G(M)=⊕_nFⁿM/Fⁿ⁺¹M is a graded G(R)-module; the q-adic filtration Fⁿ=qⁿM is the basic example.

concept.title: Akizuki–Hopkins theorem
concept.description: A commutative ring is Artinian if and only if it is Noetherian of Krull dimension zero; such a ring has only finitely many prime ideals.

concept.title: Additivity of length
concept.description: For a module M over a commutative ring and a submodule M′, length(M)=length(M′)+length(M/M′), with both sides infinite together; equivalently length is additive on short exact sequences.

concept.title: Finitely generated modules over an Artinian ring have finite length
concept.description: Every finitely generated module over an Artinian commutative ring has finite length, and its associated primes and support coincide and are finite.

concept.title: Jacobson density theorem
concept.description: Let E be a semisimple module over a ring R, R′=End_R(E) and f∈End_{R′}(E). For all x₁,…,x_n∈E there is α∈R with αx_i=f(x_i) for every i. If E is finitely generated over R′, the natural map R→End_{R′}(E) is surjective.

concept.title: Induced and coinduced modules agree for finite index
concept.description: For a subgroup H of a group G and an H-module M there is a natural G-map ℤ[G]⊗_{ℤ[H]}M→Hom_{ℤ[H]}(ℤ[G],M), identified after a choice of coset representatives with the inclusion of a direct sum into a direct product of copies of M; it is an isomorphism when [G:H] is finite. The coinduced module is the function model {f:G→M: f(hg)=hf(g)}.

concept.title: Criterion for a module to be induced by transitively permuted summands
concept.description: Let a G-module N be a direct sum ⊕_{i∈I}M_i of subgroups with gM_i=M_{gi} for an action of G on I. If the action is transitive and H is the stabiliser of i, then M_i is an H-module and N≅Ind_H^G M_i; in general N≅⊕Ind_{G_i}^G M_i over representatives i of the orbits, G_i the stabilisers.

concept.title: Valence formula for level-one modular functions
concept.description: Let f≢0 be meromorphic on the upper half-plane with f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)^k f(τ) for all of SL₂(ℤ) and meromorphic at ∞ in q=e^(2πiτ). Then v_∞(f)+½v_i(f)+⅓v_ρ(f)+∑_p v_p(f)=k/12, where ρ=e^(2πi/3), v_p is the order of f at p (negative at poles), v_∞ is the order in q at q=0, and the sum runs over the SL₂(ℤ)-orbits in the upper half-plane other than those of i and ρ.

concept.title: Siegel’s fundamental domain for Sp₂g(ℤ)
concept.description: Let F_g be the set of Z=X+iY in the Siegel upper half-space ℍ_g with |det(CZ+D)|≥1 for every [[A,B],[C,D]]∈Sp₂g(ℤ), with Y reduced in Minkowski’s sense, and with every entry of X of absolute value at most 1/2. Every point of ℍ_g is Sp₂g(ℤ)-equivalent to a point of F_g (Siegel 1939).

concept.title: Completion of a primitive integer vector to a unimodular matrix
concept.description: For n≥2, every vector in ℤⁿ whose entries have greatest common divisor 1 is the first column of a matrix in SL_n(ℤ).

concept.title: Siegel Φ-operator
concept.description: For a Siegel modular form f of weight k and degree g≥1 for Sp₂g(ℤ), (Φf)(Z′)=lim_(t→+∞) f([[Z′,0],[0,it]]) for Z′∈ℍ_(g−1). Computed termwise on the Fourier expansion, it keeps the coefficients a([[T′,0],[0,0]]); it is a linear map from weight-k forms of degree g to those of degree g−1 (constants for g=1), whose kernel is the space of cusp forms.

concept.title: Divisibility by χ₁₀ of genus-two forms vanishing on the diagonal
concept.description: If F is a Siegel modular form of even weight k for Sp₄(ℤ) whose restriction F([[τ₁,0],[0,τ₂]]) to the diagonal vanishes identically, then F=χ₁₀G for a Siegel modular form G of weight k−10, where χ₁₀ is Igusa’s weight-10 cusp form (Igusa 1962; Freitag 1965).

concept.title: Maass’s formula for Fourier coefficients of genus-two Siegel Eisenstein series
concept.description: For even k≥4 and positive definite half-integral T=[[n,r/2],[r/2,m]], the Fourier coefficient of the normalized genus-two Siegel Eisenstein series E_k^(2) is (2/(ζ(1−k)ζ(3−2k)))∑_(d|gcd(n,r,m)) d^(k−1)H(k−1,(4nm−r²)/d²), where H is Cohen’s generalized class-number function; a nonzero singular T equivalent to diag(t,0) has the t-th coefficient of the elliptic E_k. In particular all coefficients are rational.

concept.title: Transformation formula for Siegel theta constants
concept.description: For M=[[A,B],[C,D]]∈Sp₂g(ℤ) and each half-integral characteristic m, θ[M·m](M⟨Z⟩)=c(M,m)det(CZ+D)^(1/2)θ[m](Z), where M·m is Igusa’s affine action of Sp₂g(ℤ) on characteristics modulo 2, which preserves parity, and c(M,m) is an eighth root of unity for a fixed branch of the square root. Thus Sp₂g(ℤ) permutes the even theta constants up to these factors.

concept.title: Theta-constant expressions for E₄ and Δ
concept.description: For the three even genus-one theta constants θ₀₀,θ₀₁,θ₁₀ on the upper half-plane, Jacobi’s identity θ₀₀⁴=θ₀₁⁴+θ₁₀⁴ holds, the normalized Eisenstein series is E₄=½(θ₀₀⁸+θ₀₁⁸+θ₁₀⁸), and (θ₀₀θ₀₁θ₁₀)⁸=2⁸Δ for the Ramanujan cusp form Δ.

concept.title: Integral ring of level-one modular forms
concept.description: The graded ring of modular forms for SL₂(ℤ) with integral Fourier coefficients is ℤ[E₄,E₆,Δ], where 1728Δ=E₄³−E₆². Its weight-4e part is free over ℤ with basis E₄^(e−3i)Δ^i for 0≤i≤e/3, its weight-(4e+6) part is E₆ times the weight-4e part, and all other weights are zero.

concept.title: Formal power series over an integral domain form an integral domain
concept.description: If R is an integral domain, the formal power series ring R[[X₁,…,X_n]] is an integral domain: the product of the lowest-degree nonzero homogeneous parts of two nonzero series is nonzero.

concept.title: Invariant subring of a group action on a commutative ring
concept.description: For a group G acting on a commutative ring R by ring automorphisms, the invariant subring R^G={r∈R: g·r=r for every g∈G} is the set of elements fixed by every group element. It is a subring of R containing 0 and 1.

concept.title: Incomparability of primes in an integral ring extension
concept.description: Let A⊆B be commutative rings with B integral over A. If 𝔮⊆𝔮′ are prime ideals of B with 𝔮∩A=𝔮′∩A, then 𝔮=𝔮′. Thus there are no strict inclusions among the primes of B lying over a given prime of A.

concept.title: Local Kronecker–Weber theorem for ℚ_p
concept.description: Every finite abelian extension of the p-adic field ℚ_p is contained in a cyclotomic extension ℚ_p(ζ_n) for some n≥1. More generally, for a nonarchimedean local field K with Lubin–Tate extension K_π of a uniformizer π, the maximal abelian extension is K_π·K^un.

concept.title: Rational CM points of X₀(N) for the class-number-one primes
concept.description: For N∈{11,19,43,67,163}, the modular curve X₀(N) has a ℚ-rational noncuspidal point fixed by the Atkin–Lehner involution w_N; it is the elliptic curve with complex multiplication by the ring of integers of ℚ(√−N), of class number one, with the cyclic N-isogeny given by √−N. For N=19,43,67,163 it is the only noncuspidal ℚ-rational point of X₀(N).

concept.title: Rational points of the genus-one modular curves X₀(N)
concept.description: For N∈{11,14,15,17,19,20,21,24,27,32,36,49}, the modular curve X₀(N) has genus one and its finitely many ℚ-rational points are explicitly known (Ligozat). Consequently no elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational point of order N for these N, and none has a ℚ-rational cyclic subgroup of order 20, 24, 32, 36 or 49.

concept.title: Nonexistence of rational points of order 13 on elliptic curves over ℚ
concept.description: No elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational point of order 13; equivalently, X₁(13)(ℚ) consists of cusps (Mazur–Tate 1973, independently Blass).

concept.title: Nonexistence of rational points of order 16 on elliptic curves over ℚ
concept.description: No elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational point of order 16 (Lind 1940).

concept.title: Nonexistence of rational cyclic subgroups of order 35 on elliptic curves over ℚ
concept.description: No elliptic curve over ℚ has a Galois-stable cyclic subgroup of order 35: every ℚ-rational point of X₀(35) is a cusp. In particular no elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational point of order 35.

concept.title: Nonexistence of rational points of order 18 or 25 on elliptic curves over ℚ
concept.description: No elliptic curve over ℚ has a ℚ-rational point of order 18 or of order 25: the ℚ-rational points of X₁(18) and X₁(25) are cusps (Kubert, via descent on their Jacobians).

concept.title: Quotient of a variety by a finite group
concept.description: Let a finite group G act on an algebraic variety V over an algebraically closed field such that every orbit lies in an affine open set, for example V quasi-projective. Then V/G exists: the projection V→V/G is finite, surjective and constant on orbits, its fibres are exactly the G-orbits, V/G is affine with coordinate ring A^G when V=Spec A is affine, k(V/G)=k(V)^G when V is irreducible, and V/G is normal when V is. If V and the action are defined over a subfield, so is V/G.

concept.title: Admissible representation of GL_n over a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: Let F be a nonarchimedean local field with valuation ring O. A representation π of GL_n(F) on a complex vector space V is smooth if every vector is fixed by some open subgroup of GL_n(O), and admissible if moreover, for every open subgroup K of GL_n(O), the space V^K of K-fixed vectors is finite-dimensional. It is irreducible if V≠0 and V has no proper nonzero GL_n(F)-stable subspace.

concept.title: Automorphic representation of a classical newform
concept.description: For a normalized newform f of weight k, level N and character χ, write GL₂(A_ℚ)=GL₂(ℚ)·GL₂⁺(ℝ)·∏_pK_p with K_p the closure of Γ₀(N) in GL₂(ℤ_p), and put φ_f(γg_∞k)=(f|_k g_∞)(i)·χ(k). The right translates of φ_f span an irreducible cuspidal automorphic representation π_f of GL₂(A_ℚ), a restricted tensor product ⊗′_vπ_v whose finite components π_p are irreducible admissible infinite-dimensional representations of GL₂(ℚ_p).

concept.title: Kirillov model of an irreducible representation of GL₂
concept.description: Let F be a nonarchimedean local field and ψ a nontrivial additive character. Every irreducible admissible infinite-dimensional representation π of GL₂(F) is realized, uniquely, on a space of locally constant functions on F^× containing the compactly supported ones, with (a b;0 1) acting by f(x)↦ψ(bx)f(ax) and the centre acting by the central character; for π supercuspidal the space is exactly the Schwartz–Bruhat functions on F^×.

concept.title: Action of the Weyl element in the Kirillov model of a supercuspidal representation
concept.description: In the Kirillov model of a supercuspidal representation of GL₂(F) with central character ω, the Mellin components f̂(ν,t)=∑_nt^n∫_(O^×)f(uϖ^n)ν(u)du transform under w=(0 1;−1 0) by (π(w)f)^(ν,t)=C(ν,t)f̂(ν⁻¹ω₀⁻¹,t⁻¹z₀⁻¹), where ω₀=ω|O^×, z₀=ω(ϖ), and each C(ν,t)=C₀(ν)t^(n_ν) is a monomial with n_ν≤−2 (Jacquet–Langlands).

concept.title: Principal series representation of GL₂ over a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: For quasi-characters μ₁,μ₂ of F^×, B(μ₁,μ₂) is the representation of GL₂(F) by right translation on locally constant functions f with f((a b;0 d)g)=μ₁(a)μ₂(d)|a/d|^(1/2)f(g). It is admissible; it is irreducible unless μ₁μ₂⁻¹=|·|^(±1), when it has a one-dimensional constituent and an infinite-dimensional special constituent. The irreducible ones are the principal series.

concept.title: Jacquet–Langlands classification of irreducible admissible representations of GL₂
concept.description: Every irreducible admissible representation of GL₂ over a nonarchimedean local field is exactly one of: a one-dimensional representation χ∘det, an irreducible principal series B(μ₁,μ₂) (with B(μ₁,μ₂)≅B(μ₂,μ₁) the only coincidences), a special representation σ(μ|·|^(1/2),μ|·|^(−1/2)), or a supercuspidal representation, one whose matrix coefficients are compactly supported modulo the centre.

concept.title: Spherical vectors of irreducible admissible representations of GL₂
concept.description: An irreducible admissible representation of GL₂(F), F nonarchimedean, has nonzero GL₂(O)-fixed vectors only if it is a one-dimensional representation χ∘det or a principal series B(μ₁,μ₂) with μ₁,μ₂ unramified; the space of GL₂(O)-fixed vectors then has dimension one. Supercuspidal and special representations have no GL₂(O)-fixed vectors.

concept.title: Multiplicity one for cuspidal automorphic representations of GL₂
concept.description: Each irreducible representation of GL₂(A_F), F a number field, occurs at most once in the space of cusp forms on GL₂(F)∖GL₂(A_F) (Jacquet–Langlands).

concept.title: Tensor product factorization of irreducible admissible representations of GL₂ over the adeles
concept.description: Every irreducible admissible representation π of GL₂(A_F), F a number field, is a restricted tensor product ⊗′_vπ_v of irreducible admissible representations of the local groups GL₂(F_v), with π_v containing a GL₂(O_v)-fixed vector for almost all v; the local components are determined by π up to isomorphism.

concept.title: Totally real number field
concept.description: A number field F is totally real if every field embedding F→ℂ has image contained in ℝ.

concept.title: Discrete series representation D_(k,w) of GL₂(ℝ)
concept.description: For integers k≥2 and w of the same parity, D_(k,w) is the irreducible essentially square-integrable representation of GL₂(ℝ) occurring in the representation unitarily induced from the characters t↦|t|^((k−1−w)/2)sgn(t)^k and t↦|t|^((1−k−w)/2) of the diagonal torus; its central character is t↦t^(−w). These are the archimedean components of automorphic representations attached to holomorphic modular forms of weight k.

concept.title: Essentially square-integrable representation of GL_n over a local field
concept.description: An irreducible admissible representation π of GL_n(F), F a local field, is essentially square-integrable if some twist π⊗|det|^s has unitary central character and matrix coefficients square-integrable on GL_n(F) modulo its centre. For GL₂ over a nonarchimedean field these are the special and the supercuspidal representations.

concept.title: Weil–Deligne representation of a nonarchimedean local field
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field K with Weil group W_K and residue field of q elements, a Weil–Deligne representation over a field E of characteristic zero is a pair (ρ,N) of a homomorphism ρ:W_K→GL(V) on a finite-dimensional E-vector space, trivial on an open subgroup of inertia, and a nilpotent endomorphism N of V with ρ(w)Nρ(w)⁻¹=q^(−v(w))N, v(w) the power of geometric Frobenius induced by w. It is Frobenius-semisimple if ρ is semisimple. For E=E_λ with λ prime to q, w↦ρ(w)exp(t_λ(w)N) is a continuous λ-adic representation of W_K, its λ-adic realization; by Grothendieck's monodromy theorem every continuous λ-adic representation of W_K arises in this way.

concept.title: Jacquet–Langlands local functional equation for GL₂
concept.description: Let π be an irreducible admissible infinite-dimensional representation of GL₂(F), F nonarchimedean, with central character ω, realized in its Kirillov model for a nontrivial additive character ψ. The zeta integrals Z(s,f,χ)=∫_(F^×)f(a)χ(a)|a|^(s−1/2)d^×a, for f in the model and χ a character of F^×, converge for Re s≫0 and span a fractional ideal of ℂ[q^(±s)] with a unique generator L(s,χπ)=P(q^(−s))⁻¹, P(0)=1; and there is a unit ε(s,χπ,ψ) of ℂ[q^(±s)] with Z(1−s,π(w)f,χ⁻¹ω⁻¹)/L(1−s,χ⁻¹π̃)=ε(s,χπ,ψ)Z(s,f,χ)/L(s,χπ) for all f, where π̃ is the contragredient.

concept.title: Local L- and ε-factors of Weil–Deligne representations
concept.description: For a Weil–Deligne representation σ=(ρ,N) of a nonarchimedean local field K over ℂ, L(s,σ)=det(1−q^(−s)ρ(Φ)|V_N^(I))⁻¹ with Φ a geometric Frobenius and V_N^(I) the inertia invariants of ker N. There is a unique family of factors ε(s,σ,ψ), for nontrivial additive characters ψ, additive in exact sequences, inductive in degree zero, and equal to Tate's local constants for one-dimensional σ (Langlands, Deligne); ε(s,σ,ψ)=ε(0,σ,ψ)q^(−a(σ)s) for ψ of conductor O_K, with a(σ) the Artin conductor exponent.

concept.title: Local Langlands correspondence for GL₂
concept.description: For a nonarchimedean local field F there is a unique bijection π↦σ(π) from irreducible admissible infinite-dimensional representations of GL₂(F) to two-dimensional Frobenius-semisimple Weil–Deligne representations of F over ℂ (with ρ irreducible or N≠0 when σ is not a sum of characters) such that, for every character χ of F^×, L(s,χπ)=L(s,χ⊗σ(π)) and ε(s,χπ,ψ)=ε(s,χ⊗σ(π),ψ); then det σ(π) corresponds to the central character and σ(χπ)=χ⊗σ(π). It was established by Jacquet–Langlands, Tunnell and Kutzko. Carayol's Hecke normalization is σ(π̃⊗|·|^(1/2)) in this normalization, compatible with automorphisms of the coefficient field.

concept.title: Strictly compatible system of λ-adic representations
concept.description: For number fields F and E, a family (σ_λ) of continuous representations of Gal(F̄/F) on finite-dimensional E_λ-vector spaces, indexed by the finite places λ of E, is a strictly compatible system if there is a finite set S of finite places of F such that, for every finite place v∉S, σ_λ is unramified at v whenever v does not divide the residue characteristic of λ, and the characteristic polynomial of a Frobenius element at v has coefficients in E independent of λ.

concept.title: Shimura curves attached to a quaternion algebra over a totally real field
concept.description: Let F be totally real of degree d and B a quaternion algebra over F split at exactly one real place. For G=Res_(F/ℚ)B^× and small compact open K⊂G(A_f), the Shimura curve M_K, with M_K(ℂ)=G(ℚ)∖(G(A_f)×(ℂ∖ℝ))/K, is a proper smooth curve over F (affine modular curves when F=ℚ, B=M₂(ℚ)); the M_K form a projective system acted on by G(A_f).

concept.title: Jacquet–Langlands correspondence between quaternion algebras and GL₂
